name: Meongmeong Yaong Habit Stamp
description:
Turn what you want to do every day into habits, and stamp each day you keep them.

Every stamp comes with golden confetti and a party popper as the dog and cat cheer you on. On days you finish every habit, both friends show up on your stamp board.

● Today: one tap to stamp each habit, with per-habit streaks and an all-done streak
● Stamp board: see every day you kept your habits on a monthly calendar
● Daily reminder: an optional nudge at the time you choose
● Korean and English
● No ads, no sign-up, and your records stay on your device

Use up to 7 habits for free. Premium (a one-time purchase, not a subscription) unlocks unlimited habits.

Start small: a glass of water, a short walk, a few pages. Today's stamp becomes tomorrow's habit.

Note: the dog and cat's sounds, "멍멍" (meongmeong) and "야옹" (yaong), stay in Korean.

name: 小船过闸
description: 选择闸室, 调整水位, 帮助小船通过水闸. 在十八个关卡中规划航程, 留意吃水条件, 使用撤回与提示寻找路线. 进度和最佳成绩保存在本机.

name: MinoDeep: Cave Adventure
seller_name: Messt Tarimcilik Hayvancilik Insaat Sanayi ve Ticaret Limited Sirketi
description:
Dig deep with Mino and explore caves that are alive!

Tunnel through soil, collect the crystals and reach the exit before time runs out. But watch your step: dig under a rock and it falls, sand slides, water flows and lava burns. Every cave is a small puzzle where one wrong move brings the ceiling down.

500 HAND-CRAFTED AND GENERATED LEVELS
From the green caverns to frozen depths and lava halls, every map page brings new tricks.

LIVING CAVES
Falling rocks, sliding sand, flowing water, burning lava, ice, gas, pressure plates, levers and gates. Push rocks, open paths and plan ahead.

MONSTERS AND BOSSES
Spiders, bats, slimes, scorpions, golems, ghosts, mimic chests and gunners with machine guns. Some only fall to dynamite, and only the bazooka can stop a golem.

ITEMS AND TOOLS
Dynamite, bombs, the bazooka, a diving helmet with air tanks for swimming, buckets and more. Find hidden chests and spend your gold in the shop.

BUILD YOUR OWN LEVELS
Use the level editor, publish your caves for everyone and earn gold when new players try them. Play other players' levels in Community and visit their profiles.

DAILY COMPETITION
Every level you finish adds points to today's ranking. Reach the podium before midnight!

MORE TO DO
Daily gifts, goals, endless achievements, stars and reward chests. Your progress is saved to your account, so you can continue on another device.

Available in 10 languages. Free to play, with optional in-app purchases and ads.

name: Gymem
description:
Gymem is a strength training log that remembers your previous sets. Record weights and reps, build your own workout splits or start a freestyle session.

Log regular sets, supersets and dropsets. Use the rest timer between sets, then open your workout history for a quick overview. Tap an exercise to see every set you logged.

Gymem works offline without an account and includes a plate calculator with adjustable bar weights, advanced charts and workout CSV export.

name: Sainte Bible — Louis Segond
description:
SAINTE BIBLE — LOUIS SEGOND 1910
Lisez, recherchez et méditez la Parole de Dieu où que vous soyez, même sans connexion Internet.

Toute la Bible Louis Segond 1910 est disponible hors ligne : Ancien Testament (39 livres) et Nouveau Testament (27 livres), soit 31 170 versets.

RECHERCHE BIBLIQUE
Trouvez un verset, un passage ou un thème dans toute la Bible. La recherche ne tient pas compte des accents et met en évidence les occurrences.

NAVIGATION INTUITIVE
Naviguez facilement par livre, chapitre et verset. La grille des chapitres est claire et la lecture reprend à votre dernière position.

SURLIGNAGE EN 4 COULEURS
Repérez vos versets avec une couleur (or, vert, bleu ou rose). Les surlignages et les favoris sont conservés sur votre appareil.

MARQUE-PAGES ET FAVORIS
Sauvegardez vos versets préférés, ajoutez plusieurs versets à la fois ou retirez-les selon vos besoins.

HISTORIQUE DE LECTURE
Retrouvez les chapitres lus récemment et supprimez les entrées de votre choix.

COPIE ET PARTAGE FACILES
Copiez un verset ou partagez plusieurs versets par Messages, Mail ou une autre app de votre choix.

MODE SOMBRE OU CLAIR
Choisissez un thème sombre, clair ou automatique et réglez la taille du texte.

VERSET DU JOUR
Affichez le verset du jour sur l’accueil et, si vous le souhaitez, recevez une notification locale à 8 h.

HORS LIGNE ET SANS PUBLICITÉ
Le texte biblique est inclus dans l’application. Aucun compte ni connexion n’est requis.

FONCTIONNALITÉS :
- Bible Louis Segond 1910 complète hors ligne (66 livres, 31 170 versets)
- Interface française, quel que soit le réglage de langue de l’iPhone
- Recherche dans toute la Bible, sans tenir compte des accents
- Surlignage en quatre couleurs et favoris
- Sélection multiple, copie et partage de versets
- Historique de lecture et reprise de position
- Mode sombre, clair ou automatique
- Verset du jour avec notification facultative à 8 h
- Taille de police réglable
- Aucune publicité, aucun abonnement, aucun compte

« Ta parole est une lampe à mes pieds, et une lumière sur mon sentier. » — Psaumes 119:105

Compatibilité : iPhone et iPad (iOS 17 ou plus récent).

name: Tongue Twisters - Twisty
description:
Make English speaking practice a game with Twisty. Listen to a tongue twister, practice its tricky sounds, then say it aloud to see which words you matched.

Explore 126 tongue twisters across six levels, from vowel warmups to fast, challenging phrases. Every challenge includes a sound focus, an articulation tip, and a spoken example you can play at different speeds.

• Practice English pronunciation, diction, and speaking fluency with short challenges
• See a live transcript and word-by-word feedback after each speech test
• Earn stars and XP, and build a daily practice streak
• Complete every level to earn a shareable Champion certificate

Try two speech tests for free. A subscription unlocks unlimited speech tests and all six levels.

Whether you’re preparing to speak in public, working on English sounds, or just having fun with words, there’s always another phrase to try.

name: IDAF Decision Studio
description:
Explore how a change to a built asset or transport scenario can affect a decision.

IDAF Decision Studio presents four interactive 3D demonstrations: a multi-storey parking building, a facilities and energy model, resort villas and pools, and a conceptual GCC passenger and freight rail chain. Orbit each scene, inspect its elements, change assumptions, and compare illustrative financial and operational consequences.

Your changes save on your device. Export a JSON backup to Files or Dropbox, and import it later on another device.

All geometry, quantities, routes, incidents and financial figures are fictional examples. They are not live project data, validated engineering results, official rail plans or investment recommendations. The app works offline and does not require an account.

Guided by IDAF™ · BIM MENA.

name: Presa - Pressed Flora Journal
description:
A pressed flower can become a bookmark, a greeting card, or the beginning of a paper landscape. Presa gives those small ideas room to take shape.

Begin with a blank canvas or a making reference that catches your eye. Pick a paper texture, set the proportions and background color, then bring in flowers and foliage. Move a stem, turn a petal, crop an edge or adjust a color until the arrangement feels right. Layer controls, duplication, undo and redo make it easy to explore another direction.

Your own photographs can become part of the piece, too. Choose an image from your photo library, extract a flower as a transparent cutout and keep it in your personal materials. Combine it with the included botanical elements whenever you start something new.

For projects you want to make by hand, Presa connects inspiration with practical preparation. Bookmark, card and framed-piece references include dimensions, supplies, layout diagrams and making steps. Illustrated guides cover choosing flowers, arranging petals, using absorbent paper and caring for color, with individual preparation notes for flowers and foliage. You can also open a digital canvas sized to the reference and try an arrangement before working on paper.

Keep the flowers and paper layouts you want to revisit, or browse flower stories for a fresh idea. Name and save your compositions in My works, where you can preview a piece, continue editing or remove it when you choose.

A few leaves, a little paper, something worth keeping.

name: DILI – Did I Like It?
description:
Welcher Kaffee hat dich begeistert? Was hat dir an dem kleinen Restaurant gefallen? Und welches Brettspiel würdest du sofort wieder spielen? Mit DILI – Did I Like It? hältst du fest, was du ausprobiert hast und warum es dir gefallen hat.

Dein privates Bewertungstagebuch
Lege eigene Sammlungen an – für Kaffee, Restaurants, Bücher, Filme oder alles andere, das du ausprobieren und bewerten möchtest. Ergänze deine Einträge mit Fotos und bei Bedarf mit einem Ort.

Bewerte, was dir wichtig ist
Wähle eine fertige Vorlage oder erstelle deine eigene. Beim Kaffee zählen für dich vielleicht Aroma und Geschmack, beim Restaurant eher Essen, Service und Atmosphäre. Vergib Sterne pro Kriterium und gewichte die Kriterien so, wie es für dich passt.

Finde deine Favoriten wieder
Durchsuche deine Sammlungen und schau nach, was dich beim letzten Mal überzeugt hat. Deine Einträge und Bewertungen bleiben privat – ohne öffentlichen Feed.

name: WeekPick
description:
주간픽은 일상의 작은 선택을 도와주는 선택 도구예요.

■ 오늘의 선택
점심 메뉴, 음료, 운동, 주말 계획처럼 고민되는 2~3가지를 넣으면 오늘의 기운과 얼마나 맞는지 오행 일치도(%)로 보여 주고 하나를 골라 줘요. 프리셋 칩으로 자주 쓰는 후보를 빠르게 채울 수 있어요.

■ 함께 정하기
친구나 모임 사람들의 생년월일을 넣으면 모두의 기운을 합쳐 모임 메뉴와 장소를 골라 줘요. 입력한 정보는 저장하지 않아요.

■ 이번 주의 선택
이번 주에 고른 선택이 한 줄씩 쌓여요. 고른 쪽이 더 길고 진하게 보여서 한눈에 돌아볼 수 있어요. 덤으로 한 주의 좋은 날을 보고 오락용 번호를 한 번 만들어 볼 수도 있어요.

■ 한 줄 기록
집중·관계·휴식 중 하나를 골라 이번 주를 한 줄로 남기고, 도감에서 모아 볼 수 있어요.

■ 안심하고 쓰세요
- 계정과 로그인이 없어요.
- 광고·분석·추적이 없어요.
- 입력한 정보는 이 기기에만 저장돼요.
- 모든 기능이 오프라인에서 동작해요.

번호 기능은 오락용이며 당첨을 예측하거나 확률을 높이지 않아요. 결과는 재미로 참고해 주세요.

name: PocketDesk Remote
description:
PocketDesk Remote lets you use your own computers at home or at work from an iPhone, iPad, or iPhone Duo, over VNC or RDP (Microsoft Remote Desktop Protocol). Reach a Mac with Screen Sharing turned on, a Windows PC with Remote Desktop turned on (Pro, Enterprise, or Education), or a VNC server on Linux.

Features
• RDP connections are always encrypted with TLS. The first time you connect, you check the computer’s certificate fingerprint, and you’re warned if the certificate changes.
• Sign in to RDP with a local account, a Microsoft account, or a domain account
• VNC with no password, a VNC password, or a macOS account
• VNC connections without an SSH tunnel are clearly marked as not encrypted
• Finds computers with Remote Desktop, Screen Sharing, or VNC on your local network, using Bonjour and a scan of your subnet
• Touch mode or trackpad mode, with gestures to click, drag, scroll, and zoom
• A special keys row with Esc, Tab, Ctrl, Alt, ⌘ or Win, arrow keys, and F1–F12, plus shortcuts like Ctrl + Alt + Del and Send text
• Works with a hardware keyboard, trackpad, mouse, and Apple Pencil
• Laptop layout on iPhone Duo: half-fold it and stand it up like a laptop. The remote screen moves to the top half, and the bottom half becomes a trackpad or keyboard you can switch between.
• The remote screen fills the display, with a floating toolbar you can drag, collapse, or tuck against the edge
• Fit to screen or actual size, with pinch to zoom
• Set the resolution and scale for each RDP connection
• Choose which display to view when a VNC server reports more than one
• Portrait, landscape, and multitasking windows on iPad. Rotating or folding doesn’t drop the connection.
• Passwords and private keys stay in this device’s iOS Keychain
• Available in 10 languages, with light and dark appearance

Ads and PocketDesk Plus
PocketDesk Remote is free to use and contains ads. After you tap Disconnect, a full-screen ad from Google may sometimes appear. Ads never appear on the remote screen, and how often they can appear is strictly limited.

PocketDesk Plus is an optional subscription, billed monthly or yearly through the App Store. It removes ads and adds SSH tunnels:
• SSH tunnels encrypt VNC connections. Sign in with a password or an imported Ed25519 or ECDSA private key.
• The first time you connect, you confirm the SSH host key fingerprint. If it changes later, PocketDesk stops the connection.
The yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial for first-time subscribers, and you’re only charged after the trial ends. The subscription renews automatically until you cancel. Cancel at least 24 hours before it renews, or before the trial ends, and you won’t be charged. Cancel anytime in the App Store. Everything else, including RDP, stays free with or without it.

No account needed. Connections go straight from your device to your computer, never through our servers. Your connection details, passwords, and screen content are never sent to us or included in ad requests.

Before you start: turn on Screen Sharing, Remote Desktop, or a VNC server on the computer you want to reach. PocketDesk Remote is a client only. It doesn’t let anyone control your iPhone or iPad.

Terms of Use: https://pocketdesk.cc/en/terms/
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://pocketdesk.cc/en/privacy/

name: 一拖客管
description: 一拖CRM，智能工作平台

name: Skidar
description:
Skidar is one app for a whole day on the mountain.

FIND YOUR WAY
• A 3D piste map of 4,221 ski areas, with every lift and run.
• Routes from where you stand to any lift, run, restaurant or bar, at your own pace and on the runs you are happy with. Ask in plain words: "to the Roundhouse on blues, no gondolas".
• Press Go and it guides you like a sat-nav: spoken directions through your headphones, an arrow for each junction, and signs on the map where the route changes run.

FIND YOUR FRIENDS
• Start a group and send one link. Everyone appears on the map as their own rider, in their own colours.
• Group chat, photos, voice messages, calls and hold-to-talk like a walkie-talkie.
• Suggest a place to meet and everyone gets a route there.
• Pin a Spotify Jam or Apple Music playlist for the group.
• Add friends with a QR code and link your social accounts.

KNOW HOW IT IS UP THERE
• Lift queues measured by the skiers standing in them.
• Which lifts are open or shut, and how busy each run is.
• Snow reports from people who have just skied a run. Report your own and earn points.
• Weather at the top and bottom of the lifts.

YOUR DAY, HONESTLY COUNTED
• Track runs, vertical, distance, top speed and time on snow, lifts and stops.
• Every day and every season in your history.
• Share a picture of your day.

AND AFTER
• Places to eat, stay and park near the lifts.
• Lost and found for each resort.

Skidar is free. Lift status, queues and snow reports come from other skiers and can be wrong: always follow the resort's own signs and ski patrol.

name: Vigil: Live Earth
description:
Vigil is a quiet window onto a restless planet.

THE WORLD, LIVE
Earthquakes, wildfires, tropical storms, satellites and flights, plotted on a globe you can spin and pinch. Tap anything to learn what it is and why it matters.

PRESS AND HOLD
Hold anywhere on the globe to see the ground beneath you: the tectonic plate, the nearest fault, and the great quakes that shaped the place.

PULSE
A calm daily summary of what the planet did today: how many quakes, the strongest, and which storms are active.

SKY
When the space station passes over you, how dark tonight will be, the moon phase, and which planets are out.

ATLAS
A pocket geography of every country, chapters on how the Earth works, flag, capital and outline quizzes, and a daily Pinpoint challenge.

PLACES
Add the places you care about and Vigil will gently tell you when something happens nearby.

PUBLIC CAMERAS
Look through public volcano, road and weather cameras around the world.

WIDGETS
Today's quakes, the next station pass and your places, on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.

Vigil uses public data from agencies such as the USGS, NASA and national weather services. No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: Netivei HaMoreshet
description:
Netivei HaMoreshet takes you to the places where the modern story of Jerusalem was written. The Castel, Ammunition Hill, Sha'ar HaGai, Mount Scopus, the Western Wall and dozens more, each with its own story, photos and directions to get there.

Sites near you
See which heritage sites are close by, or search by name, topic or era: the War of Independence, the years of the divided city and the Six-Day War.

Every site on one map
Each site is pinned on the map with a photo. Filter by topic and tap a site to learn more.

Ready-made routes
Four routes link sites around a single theme, like the fight for the road to Jerusalem in 1948 or the reunification of the city in 1967. Walk or drive, and move from stop to stop.

A page for every site
Historical background, era, exact location and a photo gallery. One tap starts turn-by-turn navigation.

A game at every stop
Trivia and a photo puzzle built from the story of each place, currently in Hebrew. Good for kids, groups and anyone who wants to see what stuck after the visit.

After your visit
Save favorites, mark the places you have been, write a review and add photos.

Arrival alerts
If you like, the app can let you know when you reach one of the sites and link you to its story. Alerts stay off until you turn them on in Settings.

The app is available in Hebrew and English and is free to use. You can browse everything without an account.

name: LingaRadio
description:
LingaRadio helps you follow internet radio from around the world with original-language captions and translations. Listen to news and talk shows while practicing a language with real broadcasts.

• Find stations by language, genre, or name.
• Follow conversations on supported broadcasts with live captions and translations. Choose originals, translations, or both.
• Record eligible broadcasts. Replay the audio from any point and browse saved captions when available.
• Save a caption to your notes with a memo and tags. From a note linked to a recording, jump to the original audio.

Premium removes banner ads and lets radio continue playing when the screen is locked or you switch to another app.

An internet connection is required for radio. Captions and translations depend on the device, language, and stream format. A language model may need to be downloaded the first time. Song lyrics are outside the caption feature, and station terms govern recording availability.

Privacy Policy https://www.infotopia.jp/apps/lingaradio/privacy.html?lang=en
Terms of Use https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: VaneWhim
description:
VaneWhim is a pocket cabinet of deliberately useless toys.

Drag a phantom razor through endless foam. Spin a fan that cools nothing. Blow into the mic to raise bubbles. Tilt your phone to pour imaginary water. Shake up a popcorn kettle. Flicker and snuff a candle—then relight it again.

Built for restless moments, not real chores. No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Motion, microphone levels, and haptics stay on your iPhone.

What’s inside
• Whisker Clip — shave foam for no reason
• Still Breeze — a fan with zero airflow
• Froth Mic — blow soft bubbles
• Tip & Spill — pour by tilting
• Kernel Pop — shake or tap to erupt kernels
• Ember Wick — tilt, blow out, relight

Also included: favorites, a local play journal, lighthearted badges, English & Chinese, and full offline preferences.

Entertainment only. Not a real appliance, science tool, or wellness device—just delightful nothing.

name: Sample Roasters B2B
MyCrm+ ניהול לידים חכם ומתקדם
description:
MyCrm+ מרכזת את כל הלידים, השיחות והמשימות של העסק במסך אחד בנייד, בעברית מלאה ומימין לשמאל

ליד שנכנס מגיע כהתראה לנייד באותו רגע, גם כשהאפליקציה סגורה. אפשר לפתוח אותו, לראות את כל ההיסטוריה מולו ולחזור ללקוח לפני שהוא פונה למישהו אחר

◆ ניהול לידים מלא
כל ליד עם שם, טלפון, דואר אלקטרוני, חברה ועיר. סטטוס מתקדם משלב ראשון ועד סגירה, עדיפות, ציון איכות, ערך עסקה משוער ותגיות חופשיות. אפשר להוסיף שדות מותאמים אישית שמתאימים בדיוק לעסק שלכם

◆ התראות לנייד ברגע אמת
ליד חדש, הודעה שממתינה למענה או משימה שהגיע זמנה מגיעים כהתראה למסך הנעילה. כל סוג התראה נשלט בנפרד במסך ההגדרות, כך שאפשר להשתיק את מה שפחות דחוף בלי לוותר על מה שחשוב

◆ תיבת שיחות מרכזית
כל השיחות עם הלקוחות במקום אחד, עם היסטוריה מלאה לכל איש קשר. תמונות, קבצים והקלטות קוליות נשמרים לצד הליד עצמו, כך שכל מי שנכנס לכרטיס רואה את התמונה השלמה

◆ מעקב וסגירת עסקאות
צינור מכירות עם שלבים שאתם מגדירים, הסתברות סגירה לכל שלב ומעקב אחרי ערך העסקאות. כל שינוי סטטוס נרשם ביומן פעילות שאפשר לחזור אליו

◆ משימות ותזכורות
משימה לכל ליד עם תאריך יעד ועדיפות, תזכורות מעקב אוטומטיות ולוח שנה שמרכז פגישות, שיחות ותזכורות

◆ עבודת צוות
הזמנת חברי צוות, הרשאות לפי תפקיד מבעלים ועד צופה, שיוך לידים לנציג מטפל ותגובות פנימיות עם תיוג של עמית לצוות

◆ טפסי לידים
בניית טופס איסוף לידים לאתר או לקמפיין, כולל שדות מותנים ותיוג אוטומטי של כל פנייה שנכנסת ממנו

◆ תבניות הודעה
תבניות מוכנות עם משתנים שמתמלאים לבד, כדי שמענה חוזר ייקח שניות במקום דקות

◆ אוטומציות
כללים שרצים לבד כשמשהו קורה. ליד חדש נכנס, סטטוס השתנה או תגית נוספה, והמערכת ממשיכה משם

◆ דוחות ותובנות
לוח בקרה עם מספרי לידים לפי שלב, קצב תגובה, שיעור סגירה ומגמות לאורך זמן

◆ בנוי לעברית
כל הממשק בעברית ומימין לשמאל, תאריכים ושעות לפי אזור הזמן של ישראל וסכומים בשקלים

◆ הנתונים שלכם
כל מרחב עבודה מופרד ברמת בסיס הנתונים, כך שנתונים של עסק אחד לעולם אינם נגישים לעסק אחר. התעבורה מוצפנת. אפשר לייצא את כל הנתונים בכל רגע, ואפשר למחוק את החשבון מתוך האפליקציה, בהגדרות הפרופיל

למי זה מתאים
לעסקים קטנים ובינוניים, לסוכנויות, לנותני שירות ולכל צוות מכירות שמקבל לידים מכמה מקורות ורוצה סדר אחד שמחזיק את כולם

האפליקציה מיועדת למשתמשים בעלי חשבון קיים במערכת MyCrm+

name: QERVAN-ASC
seller_name: VIET TECHNIQUE OFFICE EQUIPMENT COMPANY LIMITED
description:
This is a five-part calculator for archaeological dating, laid out as a section drawing: each layer of the site is a method, and you dig down through them.

RADIOCARBON ¹⁴C (0–2 ka)
Enter a ¹⁴C age and its measurement error, pick the sample type — charcoal, bone, shell or plant — and choose the curve preset for your region: IntCal20, SHCal20 or Marine20. Reservoir correction ΔR, contamination percentage and measurement error all feed the result. Switch on the Bayesian prior to pull the estimate toward a known sequence boundary. You get a calibrated age in cal BP with 1σ (68.3%) and 2σ (95.4%) ranges, a probability curve, and a reliability rating from LOW to HIGH driven by contamination, error and reservoir uncertainty.

LUMINESCENCE TL/OSL (2–100 ka)
Equivalent dose De in grays, dose rate in Gy/ka, water content, cosmic contribution, mineral fraction — quartz, K-feldspar or polymineral — and a fading setting. The module attenuates the dose rate for water, adds cosmic dose, and returns an age in ka with its error, the effective dose rate, the recovery ratio, and an OUTLIER flag when recovery drifts outside 0.9–1.1.

STRATIGRAPHIC MODELLING (layers)
Five layers from topsoil to bedrock, each with an age. Choose the sedimentation model — uniform, linear or piecewise — flag a disturbed layer to truncate continuity, and set the Bayesian prior tightness. The age-depth chart draws the whole sequence and prints the boundary ages, the mean rate in years per centimetre and the rate between every pair of layers. Where the sequence breaks, an unconformity warning appears on the chart.

CROSS-VALIDATION (fusion)
Place ¹⁴C, TL/OSL and U-Th results side by side with their errors. Add a systematic error term, then choose how to weight them: inverse variance, equal, or applicability with four context presets (under 2 ka, 2–10 ka, 10–50 ka, over 50 ka). The module returns the weighted mean and its error, the age differences between each pair of methods, χ² with two degrees of freedom, an approximate p value, a consistency rating from CONSISTENT to REJECTED, and a recommended age.

CULTURAL PHASING (phases)
Four boundary ages — Palaeolithic, Neolithic, Bronze, Iron — plus fuzziness in years, a typology score and a regional offset, with East Asia, Europe, the Americas or the Pacific as the framework. You get transition probabilities at each boundary, a regional synchrony score, and a timeline that draws fuzzy edges instead of hard lines.

EXPORT AND FLOW
Every module exports its report as a PDF, previewed on the device and shareable from the preview. Each one also carries a Next button, so a single session can run from one radiocarbon measurement to a phasing framework: ¹⁴C, then OSL, then stratigraphy, then cross-validation, then phasing.

ON SCOPE
This is a planning and teaching tool. The radiocarbon module applies curve offsets plus sample-specific bias rather than a full laboratory calibration lookup, and the phasing module uses a simplified probabilistic transition model. For publication-grade ages, run your measurements through your laboratory's calibration software and cite the curves directly.

No account, no network, no analytics. Everything you enter stays on this device.

name: Aquife
description:
Aquife is an offline coastal culture atlas for travelers who want the story behind a shoreline. Browse 80 named resort destinations across eight coast families: Mediterranean, Caribbean, Indian Ocean, Pacific Rim, Southeast Asia, Atlantic Europe, Middle East / North Africa, and the Americas. Each entry connects a coast type with a cultural thread and a place-linked specialty so a destination can be understood as a living place rather than a generic beach list.

Move from discovery to context in one continuous route. Use the Atlas to open featured and compact destination cards, compare region families, or search by destination, culture, and specialty. Destination pages lead into Culture Thread and Regional Specialty sections that explain origin, everyday practice, visitor etiquette, provenance, sensory context, and how to encounter a practice respectfully. The content is bundled for offline reading and the app does not require an account, sign-in, network content feed, payment, or protected media permission.

The signature action is Trace a Coastline. Choose three distinct stops, keep their cultural and specialty context together, and save the result as a Coast Card. Saved Coast Cards can be reopened from Saved Journeys and cleared from Settings after confirmation. The result stays on the iPhone as local app data; clearing it does not remove the bundled atlas.

Aquife is designed for readers and travelers who want a memorable route with reasons behind it. It does not rank destinations, sell bookings, collect location data, or make claims about live availability. Destination facts, imagery, and legal copy should be reviewed against the operator’s approved sources before any public publication.

name: Loupe & Ledger: Jewelry Vault
description:
Built for modern loose diamond, gemstone, fine jewelry, and luxury watch collectors, Loupe & Ledger: Jewelry Vault organizes every parcel won on live auctions, custom ring build, grading certificate, and timepiece in one architectural mobile vault.

INSTANT AI CERTIFICATE & WATCH SCANNER
Snap a photo or screenshot of an IGI, GIA, GCAL, or HRD grading report—including specialty, antique, and geometric cuts (Dutch Marquise, Old Mine, Old European, Portuguese, Rose Cut, Moval, Crisscut & more)—or Rolex, Omega & Tudor warranty cards. Built-in AI Vision extracts the Report/Serial Number, Carat Weight, Color, Clarity, Cut, Proportions, Measurements (mm), and Growth Method (CVD / HPHT) in seconds.

4Cs COLLECTOR STONE EXCHANGE
Ready to trade up or searching for an exact 4Cs match? Mark any stone Available for Trade or Open to Purchase, filter community listings by shape, carat, color, and clarity, and connect directly with fellow collectors via TikTok or Email with zero marketplace fees.

LIVE AUCTION $/CARAT CALCULATOR & PROPORTION CHECK
Bidding on a 10-second live auction clock? Benchmark landed price-per-carat ($/ct) instantly and run cut-proportion & L/W ratio checks before claiming.

SPARKLE CLIPS, 9:16 SPEC CARDS & COLLECTOR RANKS
Record HD diamond fire clips, earn verified Collector Rank badges, and export 9:16 video or foil Spec Cards with your private purchase price hidden.

100% PRIVATE ON-DEVICE VAULT + INSURANCE SCHEDULES
Your private ledger, purchase prices, photos, and videos live locally on your device. Generate printable Insurance Appraisal PDF Schedules or export full JSON & CSV backups anytime.

MEMBERSHIP TIERS
• Starter Free: Log up to 10 vault pieces, run 3 AI Certificate Scans (+ bonus milestone scans), and attach 2 video clips free.
• Loupe & Ledger Pro ($4.99/mo or $35.99/yr): Unlock unlimited vault pieces, unlimited AI scans, unlimited HD video clips, Crown Pro flair, and printable Insurance Appraisal Schedules.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://vault.getloupeandledger.com/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://vault.getloupeandledger.com/privacy.html

name: Sarora
description:
You have a cut list on the back of an envelope: a side panel at 72, a back panel at 71, six shelves and a handful of rails. You know the price of a board. What you do not know is how many boards this actually takes — because every cut eats a blade's width, and the last piece on a board needs a cut too.

Sarora answers that, and only that:

• A piece is a label, a length in inches, and a count.
• A board is a stock length, a kerf, and a price — 48, 72 or 96 inches; 1/8, 3/16 or 1/4 inch blade.
• Pieces are packed longest first onto the first board with room, and every piece pays one kerf.
• The result is boards to buy, price, offcut, yield, and the layout of every board, cut by cut.

name: HollyCipher
description: HollyCipher is a Christmas-themed English word-guessing game. Each round shows a holiday picture, and you tap letters to spell the matching word. Correct answers earn points and build a combo, and hints are available when you get stuck. The app includes a word collection, achievement badges, and match statistics. Scores are saved to a local leaderboard on this device, so you can review your highest score and best combo anytime.

name: Dokugotchi
description:
It's raining in Kettlebrook. You duck into the Little Lantern Shelter to wait it out, and a small someone by the window looks up as if they've been expecting you.

Dokugotchi is a cozy sudoku game for iPhone with a pixel-art pet who sits beside the board and cheers you on. Solve puzzles, earn coins, and slowly turn one empty little room into a home.

SUDOKU, AT YOUR PACE
• 8 difficulty levels, from Beginner to Extreme, with thousands of puzzles
• A Daily Puzzle that pays 5× the coins, plus a streak and a calendar
• Mini 6×6 puzzles in three levels, for when you only have one cup of tea's worth of time
• Unlimited mistakes. Each one just makes the coins a little smaller
• For seasoned solvers: optional strict mode, auto-fill notes and "show where it fits"

A FRIEND FROM THE SHELTER
Maple the capybara runs the Little Lantern Shelter, and 60 friends are sitting on their cushions: animals of all kinds, 20 cat breeds and 19 dog breeds. Say hello to as many as you like. Pick one, give them a name, and take them home.

Some animals never sit on those cushions. Rare and ultra-rare threatened animals arrive only through fostering, once you've visited 30 days in a row. Each one comes with an info card showing its real IUCN Red List status.

LIFE AT HOME
Your pet wanders the house, naps, eats snacks, writes you songs, sends you postcards and keeps a diary. Some diary pages are silly. Some are about the night it rained.

BUILD THEM A HOME
Coins buy outfits, furniture, decor, wallpapers, snacks and new rooms for a dollhouse home with a garden. Decorate every room however you like. Your pet will try out the furniture personally.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Custom app icons featuring your own pet, in 4 poses on 3 backdrops
• Three looks (Cocoa, Marshmallow and Seaside), in light or dark mode
• A smooth board option, if pixel numbers are hard on your eyes
• Sound effects in four styles, and cozy original music (plus Debussy's Clair de Lune)

FREE. REALLY.
Dokugotchi is made by one indie developer, one pixel at a time. It's completely free: no ads, no pop-ups, no account to make. Every coin, outfit and room is yours to earn by playing.

If you'd like to say thanks, there's a little tip jar. Tips are optional and never unlock anything. Everyone gets the same game, tip or no tip.

The kettle's always on in Kettlebrook. Come in out of the rain.

name: Step Click Metronome
description:
Build your to your own rhythmic patterns. Step Click is a metronome where every beat is a box you can turn off, click, or accent — so you can practice odd groupings, clave patterns, displaced accents, etc.

• Tap any box to cycle off → click → accent
• Set any tempo and any number of steps
• Nine sounds, including woodblock, clave, cowbell, hi-hat and kick, chosen separately for accents and regular clicks
• Save your patterns as presets, with built-in claves to start from
• Rock-solid timing that keeps playing with the screen locked
• Play along with music from other apps
• Lock Screen and Dynamic Island controls to pause and change tempo

No account, no ads, no tracking. Your presets stay on your phone.

name: 颜文字电台
description:
欢迎来到颜文字实验缸！

挑两只颜文字做亲本，把它们撞在一起。新孵出的幼体会继承亲本的眼睛和嘴巴，轮廓或特效还有机会发生突变。

每个新面孔都会自动收进图鉴。你可以让幼体继续参与碰撞，发现更多组合，也可以收藏或复制喜欢的颜文字。

在表情库里按心情浏览、搜索和随机换台，再把颜文字加进自己的句子，一键复制或分享。

来看看今天会遇见什么表情吧。

BAA.KG - доска объявлений Кыргызстана. Покупайте и продавайте быстро и бесплатно: автомобили, недвижимость, электронику, бытовую технику, одежду, детские и домашние товары, а также находите работу и услуги — всё в одном приложении.

Транспорт • Недвижимость • Компьютерная техника • Электроника • Бытовая техника • Услуги • Работа • Одежда и обувь • Детские товары • Товары для дома • Животные и многое другое.

ВЫБИРАЙТЕ СВОЙ РЕГИОН
Бишкек, Ош и другие города Кыргызстана — смотрите объявления рядом с вами.

name: University Time Manager
description: University Time Manager (UTM) is an app designed for University students to manage and track their time. Studying earns points to build a small city inside the app! Study with Do Not Disturb on doubles your points earnings.

name: 1BPM: Heart Rate & Breathing
description:
1BPM is a general wellness app. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any medical condition. Readings are estimates. Always talk to a healthcare professional for medical advice.

Take a calm minute for yourself. 1BPM estimates your heart rate and breathing from tiny colour changes in your skin, using just your iPhone's camera, then helps you slow down with a gentle breathing guide.

TWO WAYS TO MEASURE
- Fingertip: rest a finger on the rear camera and flash.
- Face: hands-free with the front camera, while the screen glows softly as a ring light.
Clear tips tell you exactly how to place your finger or where to hold your iPhone.

WHAT YOU'LL SEE
- Heart rate, with a steady live reading that doesn't jump around
- Breathing rate
- Heart rate variability (RMSSD, SDNN and pNN50)
- A relaxation and stress score
- Rhythm steadiness and fingertip perfusion
- Your average heartbeat waveform

A BREATHING GUIDE THAT FEELS CALM
A soft, full-screen bubble paces gentle breaths at 7 a minute, a little longer out than in. No forced deep breaths.

APPLE WATCH APP
Live heart rate from your Apple Watch, the one-minute breathing guide with gentle wrist taps, and your latest iPhone reading at a glance. The watch app uses Apple Health (HealthKit) only to read your live heart rate while it's open. It doesn't save anything to Health.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Camera frames are processed on your iPhone and never recorded, stored or sent. No account, no ads, no analytics. Your readings stay on your devices, and you can delete them at any time.

Results vary with lighting, movement, skin tone, cold hands and how firmly you press. For adults 18 and over. If you have chest pain, trouble breathing or think you may be having a medical emergency, call 911.

name: 715Hobbies
description:
Never miss a card show.

715Hobbies is the free community hub for trading card collectors. Find your next show, keep up with weekly game nights, and connect with collectors near you.

UPCOMING EVENTS
Browse card shows and conventions across the US — dates, venues, hours, admission, and a link to the source for every listing. Tap a show to save it to your calendar, and check the countdown to the next local show right on the home page.

WEEKLY GAME NIGHTS
Every regular game night at local shops, organized by day — Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, One Piece, Lorcana, Yu-Gi-Oh!, Flesh and Blood and more. Filter by day, shop, or game to plan your week.

FIND SHOPS
Discover card and game shops near you with hours, directions, and the weekly events they host.

MARKETPLACE
Buy and sell cards with collectors in your area. Create a free profile, list your cards, message sellers, and meet up locally to make the deal — no fees, no shipping, no middlemen.

SHOW OFF
Share photos of your collection and your latest shop and show pickups with the community.

NEW TO THE HOBBY?
The Beginner's Hub walks you through buying basics, card condition, your first trade, and how to store and protect your collection.

715Hobbies is free. Browsing shows, game nights, and shops needs no account — a free profile is only needed to buy and sell in the Marketplace.

Questions or feedback: contact@715hobbies.com

name: A Life To Know
description:
Before you care for me, get to know me.

A Life to Know helps families share the person behind the room number. Build a warm, simple profile of your loved one's life story, and let every caregiver, nurse, aide and visitor meet them as a person, not a chart.

HOW IT WORKS You create a profile in minutes and fill in what matters: what they like to be called, where they grew up, the work they were proud of, and the small routines that make a day feel like theirs.

Each profile becomes a scannable card. Print it and place it by the bed or outside the room. Anyone caring for them scans it with a phone camera and reads the story instantly. No account. No app to install.

WHAT YOU CAN SHARE- Who they are: their name, their story, what made them who they are
Favorites and dislikes: music, food, shows, pastimes, and things to avoid
What makes them smile, and what to say when the day is hard
Routines and a typical day, so care fits the way they live
Family, with photos of the faces they know best
Memories and photos, gathered into a life story you can read together
Conversation starters, so a caregiver has personal topics to ask about.

Families print their personalized QR card to go in the loved one's room.
Pause a card any time, so its link stops opening the profile
Add up to two people, each with their own separate story, answers and photos
Choose the greeting, font and color of your card

A caregiver sees only what the family chose to share: a warm introduction, not a medical record. It takes seconds to read and gives them everything needed to start a real conversation.

PRIVACY, IN PLAIN LANGUAGE Caregiver profiles are meant to be opened by anyone with the link, so families decide exactly what goes in. Your account stays yours: only you can edit a profile. Deleting your account removes the profiles you created, along with their memories, photos and family members. We never ask for diagnoses, medications or insurance details, and we never sell your information.

A FEW MINUTES FOR A LIFETIME OF CONTEXT A favorite song. A beloved grandchild. A job they were proud of. Write it down once, and everyone who cares for them will know.

A personal introduction, not a medical record. Families choose what caregivers see.

name: Abyssal Citadel
description:
Abyssal Citadel is a multiplayer strategy game. Build and upgrade your citadel, raid other players with Attacks and Magic Attacks, and hire other players as mercenaries. Join a clan to fight six tiers of monster battles together (up to The God Slaughter and its Godsbane set), climb the leaderboards and strike the World Boss with everyone online. Collect gear, runes and gems, forge runewords, summon souls and cast Incantations. Daily rewards, events and a live World and clan chat keep the citadel busy.

Play for free with the same account on your iPhone or at abyssalcitadel.com. Optional in-app purchases include Regeneration Shards, Essence, items and the Patron Membership.

Patron Membership is an auto-renewing monthly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it any time in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://abyssalcitadel.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://abyssalcitadel.com/privacy

name: Ads Smart Manager
description:
Ads Smart Manager helps market vendors and pop-up sellers keep track of sales, stock, and cash throughout the day.

• Start a session by naming your market, entering your opening cash, and adding the products you brought.
• Record sales quickly by selecting products and quantities, then marking each sale as cash or non-cash.
• Count what’s left and compare your physical stock with the expected quantities.
• Close the session by comparing counted cash with expected cash and adding a note for any difference.
• Review completed sessions and their sales totals in Session History.

Tap Try Demo to explore the workflow with sample products and sales.

name: AdsDrop: Marketing & IT Agency
description:

name: Agent Micro Controller
description:
Agent Micro Controller turns your iPhone or iPad into a physical-feeling control deck for the AI coding agents running on your own Macs.

Six lit keys hold your chats. Each light shows what that agent is doing: white when idle, blue while it thinks, green when it is done, yellow when it needs you, red if something went wrong. Green and yellow stay lit until you check that chat, so nothing slips by.

• Hold to talk, review the draft, then press Send. Nothing is sent until you press Send.
• Turn the chat knob to browse chats, press it to open one, or start a new chat and work in it straight away.
• Switch between your Macs and between agent apps with one tap.
• Stop a running agent, open artifacts and map your own quick keys.
• Full-screen deck on iPhone and iPad, with Aurora, Sunset, Candy and Mono themes and soft key clicks.

HOW IT CONNECTS
The free Mac companion (download from GitHub, linked from our support page) runs on each Mac and presses the controls in your agent apps for you. Pair by scanning a code with your phone on the same Wi-Fi. Your phone talks only to Macs you have paired, over an encrypted connection on your own network. Tailscale is optional, for reaching your Macs away from home. There is no account, no cloud service and no tracking.

Try it first: tap Try the demo on the first screen to play with a sample deck without a Mac.

Works with the Claude, Codex and Muse desktop apps for macOS. Agent Micro Controller is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic, OpenAI or the makers of Muse.

name: Aindox Seguridad
description:
Aindox Seguridad es la plataforma con la que las empresas chilenas gestionan su cumplimiento de la Ley 21.719 de protección de datos personales. Con la app tienes tu programa de privacidad a mano: revisa pendientes, responde solicitudes y sigue el avance de tu equipo desde el iPhone.

CENTRO DE CONTROL
• Lo que requiere tu atención hoy: solicitudes por vencer, evaluaciones pendientes e incidentes abiertos.
• Avance de la implementación y el siguiente paso recomendado.

REGISTRO DE ACTIVIDADES DE TRATAMIENTO (RAT)
• Consulta qué datos personales trata tu empresa, para qué y con qué base de licitud.
• Estados de cada tratamiento y su nivel de completitud.

SOLICITUDES DE TITULARES (ARSOP)
• Bandeja de solicitudes de acceso, rectificación, supresión, oposición y portabilidad.
• Plazos legales a la vista para que nada se venza.

EVALUACIONES DE IMPACTO, INCIDENTES Y TERCEROS
• Evaluaciones de impacto (EIPD) y su estado de aprobación.
• Registro de incidentes y brechas de seguridad.
• Proveedores que tratan datos por cuenta de tu empresa.

INGRESO SIMPLE Y SEGURO
• Entra con tu usuario y contraseña, o con tu cuenta de Apple, Google o Microsoft.
• Doble factor de autenticación y cambio entre empresas.

Y MÁS
• Políticas y textos legales, consentimientos, evidencias, catálogo de datos y diagnóstico de madurez.
• Avisos de la plataforma en una sola bandeja.
• Modo oscuro.

La app es para usuarios de empresas clientes de Aindox Seguridad. Las cuentas las crea el administrador de cada empresa o el equipo de Aindox; si aún no tienes una, puedes solicitar acceso desde la app, escribirnos a contacto@aindox.cl o visitar seguridad.aindox.cl.

Aindox Seguridad es una herramienta de apoyo a la gestión: no reemplaza la asesoría jurídica.

name: AirDesk Remote Desktop
description:
Use AirDesk to connect to your Windows PC or Mac from your iPhone or iPad. Access your desktop apps and files remotely, and control your computer with touch, a mouse, or a keyboard.

• Find your computers and those shared with you in one place.
• View and control a remote desktop from your iPhone or iPad.
• Share files and text with a remote computer.

To get started, install AirDesk on the Windows PC or Mac you want to access and sign in to your account. An internet connection is required. Performance varies with your network and devices.

name: AisleOrder

name: AI枕音
seller_name: Beijing Yiyou Gravitation Technology Co., Ltd.
description:

AI枕音提供历史、宇宙、人物传记与原创童话。选一篇想听的，设好停止时间，慢慢听下去。

【四类故事，随时开始】
从历史细节、人物经历到宇宙探索，每篇都可以独立收听。纪实节目附资料来源，原创童话明确标记为虚构。

可以设定停止时间，也可以选择听完本集后停止。收起播放器或切换页面，不会重置正在进行的定时。

保存收听进度和收藏，重新打开时可以继续。

【保存后离线听】
