节目使用 AI 合成声音讲述，不冒充真人配音。部分节目需要联网获取。AI枕音不进行睡眠监测，不诊断或治疗失眠。

name: Akuvita
seller_name: NEW SENSES UZAY TEKNOLOJI VE SAGLIK ARASTIRMALARI ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
Akuvita, AkuvitaBand bileklikleri ile Akuvita Pets ve Akuvita BB tasmalarının yol arkadaşıdır. Ölçümleri başkalarıyla değil, sizin (ya da hayvanınızın) son 14 günlük olağanıyla karşılaştırır; bir değişiklik olduğunda bunu sade bir dille gösterir.

AKUVITABAND BİLEKLİK (Bluetooth)
• Dinlenme nabzı, nabız değişkenliği (HRV), uyku, deri sıcaklığı, adım.
• Sesten ölçüler: ses netliği, perde oynaklığı, ses perdesi, el titremesi. Ses analizi bileklikte yapılır; ham ses kaydedilmez.
• Her ölçü için olağan aralık (son 14 günün ortancası ± 2 ölçek) ve günlük değerler.
• "Şimdi ölç" ile 60 saniyelik nabız ölçümü.
• 14 günlük PDF raporu.
• Bileklik verisi yalnız telefonunuzda saklanır, sunucuya gönderilmez. Eklemek için sağlık verisi işlenmesine açık rıza alınır.

AKUVITA PETS ve AKUVITA BB (tasmalar)
• Kedi, köpek ve büyükbaş tasmaları: seslenme, öksürük benzeri sesler, hareket, solunum ve nabız.
• 100 puanlık günlük sağlık skoru ve 30 günlük eğilim.
• Haftalık eğilim uyarıları: seslenmede artış ya da azalma, sık öksürük benzeri sesler, olağan dışı nabız.
• Tasmayı ekranındaki 6 haneli kodla eşleyin; aynı tasmayı ailenizdeki başka telefonlara da ekleyebilirsiniz.

Cihazınız yoksa "Örnek cihazla dene" ile uygulamayı örnek verilerle gezebilirsiniz.

Hesap açmanız gerekmez; uygulama ad, e-posta ya da konum istemez, reklam içermez.

Akuvita bir teşhis veya tedavi aracı değildir. Ölçümler kişisel takip içindir; bir değişiklik sizi kaygılandırıyorsa hekiminize ya da veterinerinize danışın.

Bileklik ve tasmalar akuvita.com'da satılır.

name: Alibi: Spy Logic Puzzles
description:
A network of agents. Some of them are moles. And every single one tells the truth.

Alibi is a game of pure deduction. Each agent gives one debrief: a true statement about the network. Read it, work out who must be loyal and who must be a mole, and make the call. Every correct call opens another debrief, until the whole network is secured.

NO GUESSING, EVER
• Every file has been checked by a solver: at every step, at least one agent can be worked out by logic alone.
• A wrong call is counted, but it never ends the file.
• Three levels of hint, from a nudge to the full reasoning. Hints are free and unlimited.

BUILT FOR REASONING ON A PHONE
• Tap a debrief and the agents it talks about are outlined on the board.
• Rows and columns are labelled, so "row 3" never means counting.
• The debrief you are working from stays next to the board.
• A short training file teaches the game in a few taps.

A NEW FILE EVERY DAY
• One free daily file, the same for every player.
• Keep a streak going, and see how long each file took you. There is no time limit.

600 FILES, THREE SIZES
• Small (12 agents), Medium (16) and Large (20), each from easy to hard.
• The first 10 files of every size are free.
• One purchase opens all 600 files, three daily files a day and every past daily file. No subscription.

QUIET BY DESIGN
• No ads
• No account
• No lives, no energy, no timers that punish you
• Works offline
• Light and dark themes, with sound and haptics you can switch off

name: Almaniyar: آلمانی با فارسی
description:
آلمانی‌یار آلمانی را از صفر تا سطح A1 به فارسی و دری یاد می‌دهد؛ برای کسانی که در آلمان زندگی می‌کنند یا می‌خواهند بروند.

▪ آلمانیِ زندگی واقعی
۱۲ واحد و ۶۰ درس کوتاه از موقعیت‌هایی که هر روز پیش می‌آید: آشنایی، وقت و قرار، اداره و مدارک، خرید، خانه، خانواده، دکتر، شهر و رفت‌وآمد، مدرسه، کار، بانک و پست، و اوقات فراغت.

▪ هر اشتباه، به فارسی توضیح داده می‌شود
فقط «درست» و «غلط» نمی‌گوییم؛ می‌گوییم چرا. گرامر را هم در مقایسه با فارسی می‌بینی: ۳۶ کارت گرامر، کوتاه و روشن.

▪ der، die یا das؟
هر اسم همیشه به رنگ جنسش است: آبی برای der، قرمز برای die، سبز برای das. در بازی der/die/das هر کلمه را در کوزهٔ درستش بینداز و حرف تعریف‌ها را بی‌زحمت حفظ کن.

▪ بلند بگو
جمله‌ها را بشنو و بلند تکرار کن؛ برنامه می‌گوید کدام کلمه جا افتاد. صدایت ضبط و ذخیره نمی‌شود.

▪ مرور هوشمند
۶۰۵ واژه، هر کدام درست وقتی برمی‌گردد که داری فراموشش می‌کنی. مرور و بازی هیچ‌وقت قلب نمی‌گیرد.

▪ و بیشتر
آزمون تعیین سطح، راهنمای الفبا و تلفظ، هدف روزانه و زنجیرهٔ روزها، یادآور اختیاری، و واژه‌ها به دری اگر بخواهی.

آلمانی‌یار رایگان است و تبلیغ دارد. با اشتراک Plus تبلیغ‌ها حذف می‌شوند و قلب‌ها نامحدود می‌شوند. اشتراک خودکار تمدید می‌شود مگر آن را دست‌کم ۲۴ ساعت پیش از پایان دوره در تنظیمات اشتراک‌های فروشگاه لغو کنی.

حریم خصوصی: https://faizahmaddae.github.io/topjow-legal/almaniyar/

Almaniyar teaches German to Persian and Dari speakers – from zero to A1, with every explanation in Farsi and Dari.

• 12 real-life situations, 60 short lessons: meeting people, appointments, government offices, shopping, housing, family, the doctor, getting around, school, work, bank and post, free time.
• Every mistake explained in Farsi, and grammar compared with Persian (36 grammar cards).
• Every noun in its colour: der blue, die red, das green – plus the der/die/das game to make the articles stick.
• Pronunciation practice: hear a sentence, say it out loud. Your voice is not recorded or stored.
• Smart review: 605 words come back just as you start to forget them.
• Placement test, alphabet and pronunciation guide, daily goal, streak and an optional reminder.

Almaniyar is free with ads. Plus (subscription) removes ads and gives unlimited hearts. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period in your store's subscription settings.

Privacy: https://faizahmaddae.github.io/topjow-legal/almaniyar/privacy-en.html

شرایط استفاده · Nutzungsbedingungen · Terms of Use: https://faizahmaddae.github.io/topjow-legal/almaniyar/terms.html

name: Alseiada Delivery
description:
Alseiada is a shipment delivery platform in Iraq that connects merchants and delivery drivers in one app.

For merchants:
• Create a shipping order in seconds by scanning the receipt QR code
• Follow each order: new, on the way, delivered, postponed, returned
• Clear account statement with collected amounts and delivery fees
• Instant notifications when an order status changes

For drivers:
• List of assigned orders with address and customer phone
• Update status in one tap: delivered, partial, postponed, returned
• Call or WhatsApp the customer
• Driver statement and returns management

New accounts are activated after approval by Alseiada.
You can delete your account at any time from the profile screen.

name: AMBE CoreSupply
description:
AMBE CoreSupply is the procurement and inventory app for hotels and resorts that run the AMBE CoreSupply system. It is a staff tool: you sign in with the account your hotel's administrator created for you, and what you can see and do follows the permissions they set.

WHAT YOUR TEAM CAN DO

• Purchase requests. Departments pick items from the hotel's catalogue and send the request for approval.
• Approvals. Department heads, purchasing, cost control, finance and the general manager approve with a personal PIN and an on-screen signature. Each step is recorded.
• Quotations and purchase orders. Purchasing compares supplier quotations side by side, applies prices and issues purchase orders.
• Receiving. Stores scan the QR code printed on the purchase order, enter what actually arrived, photograph damaged goods and post the receipt. Partial deliveries are supported.
• Stock. On-hand quantities by store, batches and expiry dates, transfers, store requisitions, spoilage and stock counts by barcode.
• Reports. Department spend against budget, purchase history by item, open orders and deliveries.
• Help. A built-in manual and a support desk to ask your administrator.

BUILT FOR YOUR PHONE

• Push notifications on the lock screen the moment a document is waiting for your approval. Tap one to open that document.
• Camera scanning of purchase-order QR codes and item barcodes.
• Photo capture and photo library attachment for damaged goods and supporting documents.
• Export to PDF, Word or Excel through the iOS share sheet: save to Files, AirDrop, Mail or print.
• Works for several properties: choose your hotel's server once and the app remembers it.

GETTING STARTED

AMBE CoreSupply is available to any hotel or resort. Your hotel installs the AMBE CoreSupply server and its administrator creates the staff accounts; there is no sign-up inside the app. On first launch, enter the server address your hotel gave you, then sign in. To bring AMBE CoreSupply to your property, contact us at https://79f.vn.

PRIVACY

Your data goes directly to your hotel's own server. The app does not use advertising, analytics or tracking, and does not access your location or contacts.

name: Ambitree: Goal & Habit Planner
description:
Ambitree helps you turn a big goal into small habits and to-dos you can check off every day.

PLAN YOUR GOALS
• Write your own goal, start from a template, or describe your dream in one sentence and let AI draft a plan of habits and tasks. Remove any step you don't want before you use it.
• Group habits and to-dos under a goal, or keep them on their own.
• Repeat habits on the days you pick and add reminders.

CHECK OFF YOUR DAY
• See today's habits and to-dos on a week strip and tap to check them off.
• Keep your streak going and see your month at a glance.
• Get a morning quote and an evening check-in at the times you choose.
• Check off today's list from a home screen widget.

WRITE A DIARY
• Pick a mood, write a few lines and add photos.
• Look back on past entries by date.

EARN REWARDS
• Check in every day and finish daily missions to open silver and gold gifts.
• Use keys to open treasure chests for seeds and fruit.
• Feed Pip, your forest friend, and help it grow up to level 30.
• Collect stickers and profile frames, or trade fruit in the shop for Premium days.
Seeds, fruit and keys are earned in the app and are not sold for money.

JOIN THE COMMUNITY
• Share goals, routines and tips in the feed. Clap, comment and follow people.
• Copy a plan someone shared and make it your own.
• Report posts, comments and members, and block anyone you don't want to see.

YOUR ACCOUNT
Goals, habits, to-dos and diary entries are saved on your phone first, so the app works offline. The feed, rewards and AI planning need an account: sign in with Apple or Google, or continue with an anonymous account on this phone. Signing in with Apple or Google also keeps a backup you can restore on a new phone. You can delete your account in Settings at any time.

AMBITREE PREMIUM
• Unlimited goals, habits and tasks (the free plan holds 20 goals, 100 habits and 100 tasks)
• Habits by times per week or times per day
• Up to 12 reminders for each habit or task
• Your whole calendar, beyond the 17 days around today
• Check off past days up to 7 days back
• Detailed progress reports
• Every diary style, and saving entries without ads
• No ads
• Bonus rewards without ads, plus a Premium bonus box every day

Premium is an optional auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly. The yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. The yearly price is charged when the trial ends unless you cancel at least 24 hours before it ends. Payment is charged to your store account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your store account settings.

Privacy: https://rn-apps-site.pages.dev/ambitree-site/privacy.html
Terms: https://rn-apps-site.pages.dev/ambitree-site/terms.html

name: APEC - PCC
description:
APEC is the official mobile app for the Association of Pabna Ex-Cadets. Stay connected with batchmates, manage your membership, and use the services built for Pabna Cadet College alumni — wherever you are.

WHO IT’S FOR
This app is for registered APEC members. Sign in with your member account to access the directory and member-only services. New registrations can be submitted in-app and are reviewed before full access is granted.

STAY CONNECTED
• Member directory — find fellow ex-cadets by name, batch, and contact details
• Batchmates — reconnect with your batch in one place
• Chat — message within the APEC community
• EC members — see who serves on the Executive Committee

EVENTS & GATHERINGS
• Browse upcoming reunions, meetings, and association events
• View event details, schedules, and venues
• Register for events and track your registration status

MEMBERSHIP & DUES
• Check membership status and life-member eligibility
• Pay membership dues securely from your phone
• Keep your profile, photo, and contact information up to date

CAREER & BUSINESS
• Jobs board — browse openings shared by members, filter by category and location, and post roles for the community
• Business directory — discover and list member-owned businesses
• CV Bank — share and explore professional profiles within the network
• Marketplace — buy, sell, and inquire about listings among members

APEC HOUSE
• Browse rooms and availability
• Book stays and manage your bookings from the app

BUILT FOR THE APEC COMMUNITY
APEC brings association life into one trusted place — so ex-cadets can support each other in career, business, and fellowship, and stay close to the association that binds them.

Support and membership questions: contact the APEC office through the channels published by the Association of Pabna Ex-Cadets.

Association of Pabna Ex-Cadets (APEC)

name: AplusDeliveryMobile
description:
APlus Fresh Delivery is the app for APlus Fresh delivery drivers. It guides each driver through the day's round, from loading at the warehouse to proof of delivery at the customer's door.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• See the day's round: every stop, in order, with the shop's address, phone number and order total
• Scan the QR code on each delivery note, or type the invoice number, to open the right order
• Count the goods with the customer and confirm the quantities delivered
• Record arrival at each shop and follow the round on a map
• Capture the customer's signature and up to six photos as proof of delivery
• Mark a delivery as incomplete and record the reason
• Review completed deliveries and the day's totals
• Use the app in Khmer or English

SIGNING IN
Accounts are issued by APlus Fresh. Drivers sign in with their Driver ID QR badge or a 6-digit PIN provided by the company. There is no public sign-up.

LOCATION
While a driver is signed in and the app is open, it shares the phone's position with APlus Fresh dispatch so the round can be followed. Location is not collected when the app is closed.

name: Aqarpro Oman
description:
Aqarpro Oman is a property marketplace for the Sultanate of Oman. Browse land, villas, apartments and commercial property for sale or rent, and deal with the owner or broker directly.

Find property
- Listings across Oman's regions and wilayats, with photos, price, area and location.
- Search by place name, and filter by property type, sale or rent, price, area and rooms.
- Map view: see listings as pins on the map.

Decide with more information
- Price history for a listing: buyers' offers and the seller's replies, so you can see how the price has moved.
- Save the listings you like with a heart and find them in Favourites, also on a map.
- Property alerts: see new matches and price changes for the alerts on your account.

Negotiate in the app
- Send an offer to the seller and receive replies in one conversation.
- Use ready-made offer and reply forms, in Arabic or English.
- Interested in only part of a plot? Use "I want half of this property" to register your interest in co-buying.
- Turn on notifications to hear about replies to your offers.

For owners and brokers
- Publish a property with photos, and set its location on the map or with a Google Maps link.
- Link your WhatsApp number to see and manage the listings that carry your number, including marking them as sold.

Safety and your data
- Report a listing, a message or a user, and block users you do not want to hear from.
- Clear terms of use, including rules for what may be posted.
- You can delete your account at any time from the Profile tab, or on our website.

Good to know
- You can browse without an account. An account is needed to publish, mark favourites and negotiate.
- Arabic and English interface.
- Contact a seller by phone or WhatsApp straight from the listing.

Aqarpro connects buyers, owners and brokers. It is not a party to any sale or rental agreement.

name: AquaLinePro
description:
AquaLinePro is an offline record book for ornamental fish breeders. Keep fish, breeding projects, fry batches, and tanks on your iPhone or iPad. No account is required, and the app works without an internet connection.

Fish and tanks
Create a profile for each fish, including species, strain, sex, status, photos, and parents. A fish occupies one tank at a time. When you set a tank capacity, AquaLine warns you as the tank fills.

Breeding and fry
Plan a pairing, record what happens, and open a fry batch from a successful breeding. Log deaths, splits, grades, transfers, and sales so the same fish is not counted twice. Review survival, pair results, and growth from the measurements you enter.

Lineage and traits
Look up recorded parents, offspring, and generations. A generation is suggested only when both parents already have one. Compare traits you observed in a batch. These records describe what you saw. They do not predict genetics.

Sales and notes
Mark fish for sale, then record customers, payments, refunds, and expenses. Batch profit is calculated from the amounts you enter. Attach research notes to the fish, projects, batches, or tanks they describe.

Your records stay on the device
Search across your records, export CSV, and create PDF reports. Back up the database and photos together, and restore that backup on this device. If a restore fails, the records already on the device remain in place.

name: Armory Rush: Co-op Crafting
description:
The front line runs on what you build.

Armory Rush is a co-op crafting game for 1 to 4 players. Soldiers queue at your bunker window with orders for rifles, vests, medkits and more. Your crew grabs parts, runs the lathe and the press, carries finished kit to the window and keeps the front line from breaking. Then the shells start landing, a machine overheats and somebody has to put out the fire.

PLAY TOGETHER
• Online with friends using a room code, or join a public room
• Phones, tablets and the web version play in the same room
• Local co-op on one screen with gamepads
• Solo, or with up to 3 bot armourers who pick up the slack
• Solo and bot games work offline

BUILD THE BIG STUFF
Jeeps, UAVs, torpedoes and walkers take more than one pair of hands. One player bolts the frame, another feeds parts, a third keeps the window stocked.

EVERY MAP PLAYS DIFFERENTLY
Warship decks, armored trains, submarine pens, frozen mountain passes and more. 14 maps across the campaign and expeditions, endless Field Ops with a fresh layout every run, a daily challenge and an arena.

SHORT MISSIONS, REAL PRESSURE
Most missions take a few minutes. Learn each bunker, split the jobs, and find the rhythm that gets your squad three stars.

FAIR BY DESIGN
Everything that changes how you play is earned in the game. Scrip from missions unlocks outfits and field kits, and medals unlock more. Real money only buys cosmetic outfit sets, a Supporter Pack, Remove Ads or a tip for the team. Rewarded ads are always your choice.

No account needed. Your progress stays on your device.

Questions or bug reports: contact@artistscompany.net

name: Arrowcrab AI Diver
description:
Arrowcrab Diver is a clean, simple scuba logbook. Download your dives, see every trip at a glance, and understand your diving with clear charts of depth, gas and SAC. No photos, no clutter: just your dives.  Support for multiple dive computers for single dive as well!

DOWNLOAD YOUR DIVES
Pull dives straight from a dive computer over Bluetooth. Or import a Shearwater dive log export, a FIT file from Garmin Descent or Suunto, or a UDDF file from Apple Watch Ultra with Oceanic+. Dives you already have are skipped, and each dive is stamped with the computer it came from.

ENTER AN OLD LOGBOOK FAST
Add dives by hand with a compact form: date, times, location, depth, duration, tank pressures, O2% and temperature, plus visibility, conditions and comments when you want them. "Add Another Dive" keeps the form open and counts dive numbers up or down, so a paper logbook goes in quickly.

TRIPS AT A GLANCE
New dives group into trips automatically by date, each with its dive count, hours, maximum depth and average gas. Load a whole season at once, then add trips with their dates and the dives sort themselves. Filter the whole app by location with one tap.

THE DIVE TABLE
Every dive in one sortable table. Tap a dive for its stats and tank pressure chart, and edit anything, including depths, pressures, O2% and GF99.

CHARTS AND GAS ANALYSIS
Depth trends, durations, temperatures, dive frequency, locations and tank pressures. Gas Analysis shows your SAC rate, consumption over time and by location, start and end pressures, and O2 mixes. Pinch to zoom any chart and tap a point to jump to that dive.

BUDDIES
Keep your dive buddies with contact details and photos, add a buddy to a whole trip at once, and see how many dives you've shared.

ASK ARROWCRAB AI
Ask questions about your log in plain language: "What was my deepest dive?", "Which trip had the most dives?", "Summarize my 2025 diving." Only your log data is sent, only when you press Send, and only after you agree.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Your log lives on your device or in a folder you choose, such as iCloud Drive, and opens in the other Arrowcrab apps if you add photos later.

Ask ArrowCrab AI is optional and needs your own Anthropic or OpenAI API key; the provider bills you directly for what you use. Everything else works without one.

Arrowcrab Diver is a logbook, not a dive planner. It does not give decompression, gas-planning or medical advice.

name: ATA Finder
description:
ATA Finder helps you find the right ATA code for a defect without paging through lists.

• Type the defect the way you would write it in the AML, in English or Dutch
• Get the 4-digit ATA code, with the matching MEL items as supporting evidence
• Copy the code with one tap
• Separate index for the 777 and the 787; switch with the toggle or by tapping the aircraft
• "More possibilities" for doubtful matches, and a notice for words that are not found
• Browse by ATA chapter
• Works fully offline: all data is inside the app, nothing is collected or sent

Sources: Boeing/FAA Master Minimum Equipment List (MMEL), 787 rev. 19 (draft) and 777 rev. 23a. Codes tagged "General" come from the standard ATA breakdown and are not in the MMEL.

Important: this is an aid, not a replacement for the AML IFU or the ATA Breakdown list of your operator; those prevail. Not for operational use. Not affiliated with Boeing or any airline.

name: Attrezzi STEM
Aura AI: Daily Horoscope
description:
Aura is a horoscope read from where the planets really are, shown in colors that are yours alone.

Every morning you get one phrase for the day and four short readings: love, work, money and energy. They take a minute. If you want more, the full reading is underneath.

The real sky
The Moon's phase and sign, the planets, the eclipses: Aura works them out for the day you are reading. Nothing with a date in it is copied from a column.

Your own colors
The background of every screen is an aura painted from the sky. Your Sun sign is in every one. Your Moon sign leads your own. No two people match, and no two days look the same.

What is inside
• Today: a phrase, four readings, do and don't, the Moon tonight, your best time.
• Ahead: your week at a glance, the month with its bright and gentle days marked, and the year.
• A good day for it: name a plan and Aura finds the dates that suit it.
• You: your birth chart as a wheel, with all ten planets read in plain words.
• Match: add a person and read how your two charts meet.
• Ask Aura: ask about today, a date, a person or a planet. It already knows your chart.
• Reminders, saved readings, and cards you can share.

Free every day
Today's and tomorrow's reading, your signature aura, your signs, the shape of your week, month and year, and three questions to Aura are free for as long as you like.

Membership
Members get every day ahead in full, the whole chart read, match reports, the best dates for plans, and Ask Aura without the limit.
• Yearly or monthly, each with 7 days free.
• Payment is taken from your Apple account when the trial ends. The subscription renews until you cancel, at least a day before the period ends, in your Apple account settings.

Private by design
Your chart is worked out on your phone. No account is needed.

Aura is for reflection and enjoyment. It is not medical, legal or financial advice.

Terms: https://tryaura.org/terms
Privacy: https://tryaura.org/privacy

name: Aussie Pop
description:
The snack thieves are after the pantry, and only the hungriest team in the outback can stop them!

Aussie Pop is a bite-sized strategy puzzle. Place your animals beside the belt, press GO, and watch the food fly: the koala flicks leaves, the kangaroo lobs apples, the wombat rolls bursting nuts and the cockatoo fans out berries. Every animal has only so much food, so where you put them is everything.

PLAN, THEN PLAY THE WAVE
• Drag your animals onto the spots beside the belt, then send the wave out.
• Every pop fills your power bar. When it is full, pick a power: TURBO, FREEZE or BOOM.
• There are three treats in the pantry. Every thief that gets in takes one, so cover the whole belt.

MATCH THE COLOURS
• Food of a thief's own colour counts double: leaves for green Slimes, apples for red Shields.
• Tough Shields, splitting Splitters and Bandits that steal your food each need a different answer.

60 LEVELS, THREE STARS EACH
• Keep every thief out and all three stars are yours.
• Every level has been checked to be winnable with three stars.
• Short levels of two or three waves, made for a quick break.

GROW YOUR TEAM
• New animals and new thieves keep arriving as you climb the map.
• Earn coins and upgrade your animals and your powers in the shop.
• Three boosters for a tight spot: the Mega Apple, the Golden Nut and the Rainbow Fruit.

EASY TO PICK UP
• Play with one hand, in portrait.
• No account and no sign-in.
• Your progress is saved on your device.

Aussie Pop is free to play. It has adverts and optional in-app purchases. Most adverts are ones you choose to watch for a reward, and buying anything removes the adverts between levels.

name: AutoAlert Driver
description:
AutoAlert Drivers is the partner app for towing and roadside assistance providers. Go online when you're ready to work, receive service requests from customers nearby, and get paid for every job you complete.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Sign up and verify your account: upload your driver's license, business license and vehicle details. Our team reviews and approves your account.
2. Choose the services you offer, such as towing, tyre service or fuel delivery.
3. Go online to start receiving requests from customers near you.
4. Review the job details and send your offer.
5. Navigate to the customer, complete the job and get paid.

FEATURES
• Nearby job requests: get notified the moment a customer needs help in your area.
• Send offers: review the location, vehicle and service before you accept.
• Built-in navigation: get directions to the customer's location.
• Live tracking: customers can see you on the way, so there are fewer calls and less waiting.
• In-app chat: message customers without sharing your personal number.
• Earnings and history: see every completed job and payment in one place.
• Bank payouts: add your bank account to receive your earnings.
• Multiple vehicles: manage all your service vehicles from your profile.
• Help and support: raise a ticket and track replies inside the app.

YOU'RE IN CONTROL
Work when you want. Your location is only shared while you're online, and you can go offline at any time.

REQUIREMENTS
• A valid driver's license and business license
• A roadside or tow vehicle in working condition
• Account approval by the AutoAlert team

Privacy Policy: https://autoalertapp.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://autoalertapp.com/terms-of-service/
Support: https://autoalertapp.com/contact-us/

Looking for roadside help instead? Download the AutoAlert app for customers on the App Store.

name: AXe Mirror
description:
AXe Mirror shows the iOS Simulator that is running on your own Mac, live on your iPhone or iPad, and lets you touch it.

It is the companion to AXe, the free command-line tool for driving iOS Simulators. Run one command on your Mac, scan a code, and the simulator you are developing in appears in your hand.

WHY USE IT
• Feel your app the way your users will: on a real screen, with real fingers, while it still runs in the Simulator beside your debugger.
• Check a build from the sofa, a meeting room or another desk.
• Show work in progress on a device without installing anything on it.

WHAT IT DOES
• Live video of one simulator at up to 60 frames a second, with a picture that adapts to your connection.
• Taps, drags, swipes and two-finger gestures are sent back to the simulator.
• Home, app switcher and lock buttons.
• Connects directly between your devices when it can, on the same network or across the internet, and uses a relay when it cannot.
• Encrypted from end to end. A relay only passes on data it cannot read.
• Pair once with a one-time code. Only devices you have paired can connect to your Mac.
• No account, no sign-up, no tracking.

TRY IT WITHOUT A MAC
Tap "Try the demo" to use a sample simulator that we keep running.

WHAT YOU NEED
• A Mac with Apple silicon, Xcode and AXe (free, from axe-cli.com).
• An iPhone or iPad.

GETTING STARTED
1. Install AXe on your Mac.
2. Run: axe mirror pair
3. Scan the code with this app.
4. Run: axe mirror --udid followed by your simulator's ID

AXe Mirror is free.

name: AZ Truck Test Ontario 2026
description:
Get ready for your Ontario truck licence knowledge tests: Class A (AZ), Class D (DZ) and the Z air brake endorsement.

489 PRACTICE QUESTIONS
• 310 truck questions and 179 air brake questions, written from the Official MTO Truck Handbook and Air Brake Handbook
• Every answer explained, with the handbook chapter it comes from
• Checked against the current ontario.ca handbooks and rules

STUDY ONE TOPIC AT A TIME
• Truck: licences and rules, hours of service, inspections and defects, coupling and cargo, driving skills, weather and emergencies, signs and the road test
• Air brakes: how they work, air supply, service and spring brakes, trailer brakes, brake adjustment, and inspection and system tests
• See your progress in every topic

KEY NUMBERS
• Hours-of-service limits, inspection rules and air brake pressures on one page
• The numbers learners most often get wrong, in plain words

MOCK TESTS
• A fresh mock test every time, with your score at the end
• Review every question you miss until you get it right

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
• English, French, Punjabi and Traditional Chinese
• Switch any question to English with one tap

STAY ON TRACK
• Set your test date and see the days left
• Daily reminder and a study streak

Try free questions from every topic. Pay once to unlock everything. No subscription, no ads. Your progress stays on your iPhone.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Government of Ontario, the Ministry of Transportation or DriveTest.

name: Babysitting Connection
description:
Babysitting Connection is a membership-based babysitting service that connects local families with high quality, fully vetted babysitters. Every sitter is screened before joining our roster, so you can book care with complete peace of mind.

Our sitters are:
• 18 years or older
• CPR certified
• Background and driving record checked
• Experienced in childcare
• Interviewed face to face by our team
• Equipped with their own reliable transportation

We proudly serve families in Austin, San Antonio, and Central and Northern Ohio.

Using the Babysitting Connection app, you can:
• Request child care in just a few taps
• Book a sitter directly, or post to the Job Board and let sitters apply
• Schedule date nights, overnights, and recurring care
• Arrange childcare for weddings, events, and group sits
• Book pet care through Pet Sitting Connection: pop-in visits, walks, and overnight stays
• Get Sidekick Support for transportation, party help, or a lifeguard
• View sitter profiles and save your favorites
• See your confirmed appointments on a calendar
• Manage your membership, children, pets, and payment details
• Receive booking updates and message our team

Local & Reliable. Convenient. Family and Kid Approved. Complete Peace of Mind.

name: Backflow Test Ledger
description:
A clear field record for every assembly and every return visit.

Backflow Test Ledger keeps assembly details, tester information, measured readings and next-test dates together, so the next service visit starts with useful context.

KEEP EQUIPMENT DETAILS CLOSE
Save assembly type, model, serial number, location, tester credentials and test-kit details alongside your record.

RECORD THE TEST YOU PERFORMED
Enter initial readings, repairs, retest readings and your own result. The app records your observations; it does not perform the test or decide whether an assembly passes.

MAKE REPEAT VISITS EASIER
Start a repeat inspection with the assembly and tester details already filled in. Previous readings and results are cleared. Add an optional device reminder for the next test date.

PREPARE A FIELD REPORT
Keep photos and service notes together. Plus includes full PDF service reports, with required-field checks before a report is finalized. Confirm your local water authority's required form and submission process.

TRY ONE INSPECTION
Free access includes one saved inspection and a watermarked draft PDF preview. Plus unlocks continued creation and complete reports. Existing saved records remain readable and editable after expiry.

Subscription prices and billing periods are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple subscription settings. Restore Purchases is available in the app.

Website: https://www.trisphereapps.com
Support: https://www.trisphereapps.com/contact
Privacy Policy: https://www.trisphereapps.com/privacypolicy
Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Basair-بصائر
description:
تطبيق بصائر (Basair) هو رفيقك الإيماني اليومي المتكامل، صُمم بعناية فائقة ليعينك على أداء عباداتك بكل يسر وطمأنينة بتصميم إسلامي ملكي فاخر وبدون أي إعلانات مزعجة.

أبرز مميزات التطبيق:
• مواقيت الصلاة والأذان بدقة متناهية وفق موقعك الجغرافي وبطرق الحساب المعتمدة عالمياً مع إشعارات الأذان المخصصة وتنبيهات الشروق والضحى.
• المصحف الشريف كاملاً بالرسم العثماني المعتمد، مع بطاقة "أكمل القراءة" للحفظ التلقائي للوصول المباشر لآخر سورة وصفحة توقفت عندها.
• قسم "الأربعون النووية" كاملاً مع شرح معاني الأحاديث والفوائد الإيمانية وإمكانية البحث الفوري بدون إنترنت.
• بوصلة القبلة الذكية ثلاثية الأبعاد بتوجيه دقيق ومباشر نحو الكعبة المشرفة مدعومة بحساسات الواقع المعزز.
• ميزة مشاركة الآيات والأحاديث كـ ستوري (9:16) بتصميمات إسلامية راقية لنشر الخير بين الأهل والأصدقاء.
• المسبحة الإلكترونية الذكية مع أصوات تسبيح واهتزاز تفاعلي وإحصائيات يومية لذكر الله.
• أذكار الصباح والمساء وأذكار ما بعد الصلاة مأخوذة من كتاب حصن المسلم.
• دعم كامل للوضع الليلي وتنسيق 12/24 ساعة والتقويم الهجري المعتمد.

name: BCSIPTL
description:
BCSIPTL is a private wallet for everyday money. It opens on My Wallet: a greeting, slips waiting to be reviewed, and the month’s income, expenses, and cashflow.

File expenses into groups such as Groceries, Dining out, and Shopping. Each group can have a monthly allowance. Linden marks a group when it is close to that line and when it goes over. Hold a group to reorder it. Income is kept separate, so cashflow is simply money in minus money out.

Automatic slips wait in Review until you accept them. They do not change the totals before that. A day map shows which days were busier. Insights reads the span you are looking at. Keeps is a notebook of belongings: what you paid, and what you feel they are worth now. Linden does not download prices and does not give financial advice.

name: Beacon for MeshCore
description:
Beacon keeps your family or group connected when phones have no signal. It works with a MeshCore LoRa radio over Bluetooth. No mobile network, Wi-Fi or internet is needed.

SEE EVERYONE ON THE MAP
• Every member of your private channel appears on the map, with a badge showing whether they're safe
• Tap anyone for their location, address, elevation, distance and direction from you
• Positions update automatically as people move, using very little radio airtime
• Works with Apple Maps offline maps, so the map still shows with no signal

SHARED STATUS FOR THE WHOLE GROUP
• Emergency state: set green, yellow or red with a short message everyone sees at the top of their screen
• Safe / not safe: mark yourself, or report for someone else
• Rally point: long-press the map to set where to meet
• Every change shows who made it and when, and the newest change always wins, so every phone agrees

CHAT
• A group chat for your channel, plus direct messages with delivery confirmation
• Notifications for messages, safety reports and state changes, including urgent alerts for "not safe" and RED emergencies
• Reply right from the notification

RADIO SETTINGS BUILT IN
• Pick your region's preset or set frequency, bandwidth, spreading factor and coding rate
• Create private channels and share their secret with your group
• Set your radio's name, location, Bluetooth PIN, transmit power and more

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no servers, no tracking. Your location only goes to the channel you choose
• Status and location sharing are turned off on the Public channel

Requires a MeshCore companion radio with Bluetooth firmware (for example Heltec, RAK WisBlock, LilyGo T-Echo or Seeed T1000-E). Not sure yet? Tap "Try the demo" to explore Beacon without a radio.

Beacon is an independent app and is not affiliated with the MeshCore project.

name: Becino Build
description:
Samedi matin. Vous êtes dans le jardin avec un mètre ruban, un crayon et une idée en tête : une terrasse en bois, une clôture ou un petit abri pour ranger les outils. Reste une question : par où commencer ?

Becino Build vous donne la réponse. Choisissez votre projet (terrasse, clôture ou abri de jardin), puis planifiez-le en quelques minutes.

Saisissez les dimensions de votre projet. L'application calcule les pièces nécessaires et les quantités à prévoir pour le réaliser.

La liste de matériaux s'affiche ligne par ligne, avec la quantité à acheter pour chaque élément. Vous savez exactement quoi mettre dans le chariot.

Cette liste s'accompagne d'une estimation du coût. Chaque poste affiche son prix indicatif en dollars ($), et le total vous donne une base fiable pour établir votre budget.

Place ensuite au montage. L'application vous propose un ordre de construction étape par étape, des fondations jusqu'aux finitions, pour que vous sachiez toujours ce qui vient ensuite.

Becino Build s'adresse aux bricoleurs du dimanche comme aux passionnés de construction, à tous ceux qui préfèrent préparer leur chantier avant de scier la première planche.

Pas de jargon d'architecte. Des chiffres clairs, un ordre logique et moins de mauvaises surprises le jour du chantier.

name: Beetbuch: Garden Planner
description:
Your vegetable garden, planned. Beetbuch is the bed planner for raised beds, vegetable plots and balcony boxes.

PLAN YOUR BEDS SQUARE BY SQUARE
• Create your beds at real size, each square is 30 × 30 cm (about one square foot)
• Tap a square and choose from 50 vegetables, herbs and flowers
• Each square shows as many plants as really fit: 9 onions, 16 radishes
• Share your plan as an image with friends, your allotment club or on Pinterest
• Plant several squares at once, for example a whole row of carrots

COMPANION PLANTING AT A GLANCE
• Green border: good neighbors. Red border: plants that don't get along
• The picker suggests the plants that suit their neighbors first
• For every plant: good and bad neighbors, spacing, heavy or light feeder

NOW IN THE GARDEN
• What to start indoors, sow, plant out and harvest in your beds right now
• A season calendar for every plant
• Adjusted to your climate: choose when your last frost usually is
• Weather for your garden: frost, heat and rain with concrete tips for your beds

GARDEN KNOW-HOW
• Filling raised beds, improving soil, feeding, watering and mulching
• Germination temperature, sowing depth and time to harvest for every plant
• 50 hand-drawn vegetables, herbs and flowers

BEETBUCH PLUS
• Unlimited beds
• Crop rotation over the years: Beetbuch warns you when the same plant family grew in a square before, or a heavy feeder follows a heavy feeder
• Plan next year now and look back at previous seasons
• Sowing reminders whenever a new task starts in your beds
• Weather alerts for frost, heat or heavy rain, at most one a day, adjustable
• Harvest journal with photos and yearly totals
• Your own varieties such as Ox heart or Lollo rosso
• Bed styles: larch, metal, stone, corten steel
• Share plans without watermark
• Home screen widget: what's due now, with frost warnings
• 1 week free with the yearly plan

No account, no tracking, no ads. Your beds stay on your iPhone. For the weather the app can use your approximate location, and harvest photos go to the cloud (EU) only if you agree.

Dates are guide values from common gardening practice. Weather, soil and variety can shift them.

Subscription: Beetbuch Plus monthly or yearly, charged to your Apple account. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your Apple account settings.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://growkit.de/beetbuch/privacy/

name: Bento by Moonlight
description:
The lanterns are lit and the night market is busy. Every guest at your stall wants their bento packed just so: salmon beside the rice, the tamago in a corner, every square of the box filled.

Drag each piece into the tray, turn it to fit, and fill the box. When it's full, wrap it up and watch your guest light up.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Fill every square of the tray with the foods you're given
• Grant each guest's little wishes for extra stars
• Turn pieces, take moves back, or ask the chef for a tip when you're stuck
• Rush orders, picky guests and conveyor belts keep every night different

A NIGHT MARKET THAT GROWS
Each new chapter brings a new season, new guests and a new kind of tray to master, from sauce cups to pack around to rounded jubako boxes. The market grows a little every time you finish one.

FOURTEEN LITTLE GUESTS
Mika the Moon Bunny, Kuma the Tanuki, Pon the Firework Frog, Hana the Tea Hedgehog and ten more, each with their own favourite foods and their own little voice.

SOMETHING NEW EVERY DAY
• A fresh daily bento to serve
• Weekend festivals with bigger rewards
• The Moon Pass: a 28-day season of free rewards, with golden ones if you get the pass
• Trays, cloths and table sets to make your stall your own

PLAY YOUR WAY
• No account needed. Your progress stays on your device and is backed up to your own iCloud.
• Ads are optional: watch a short video only when you want a reward.
• Plays in 11 languages.

Bento by Moonlight is free to play, with optional in-app purchases.

name: BergCykelHyr
description:
Ut på stigarna – med rätt cykel direkt till dörren.

BergCykelHyr är ett enkelt sätt att hyra mountainbike, enduro, downhill, trail och elcykel i hela Sverige. Vi levererar cykeln till din adress, så att du kan fokusera på turen – inte på logistiken.

Oavsett om du ska ta dig an tekniska stigar i skogen, rulla långt över grusvägar eller hoppa i bikeparken finns en cykel som passar just din stil. Vårt sortiment omfattar 16 noggrant utvalda modeller – från snabba cross-countrycyklar och fullfjädrade enduromaskiner till elcyklar, gravel, fatbike, touring och barncyklar. Alla cyklar är servade och kontrollerade inför varje hyra.

SÅ FUNKAR DET
1. Välj din cykel – bläddra bland kategorier, jämför specifikationer och hitta rätt storlek.
2. Boka enkelt – ange hyresdatum, leveransadress och dina uppgifter.
3. Vi levererar – cykeln kommer till din dörr och du betalar kontant vid leverans. Ingen betalning sker i appen.

VARFÖR BERGCYKELHYR?
• Leverans i hela Sverige – cykeln finns där du ska cykla
• Servade cyklar – genomgångna inför varje hyra
• Betala vid leverans – inget att betala i förväg
• Stort utbud – MTB, enduro, downhill, trail, elcykel, gravel, fatbike, touring och mer
• Alla dina hyror på ett ställe – se orderdetaljer och hantera bokningar
• Tydliga villkor och en GDPR-anpassad integritetspolicy

Välj din stil och hitta cykeln för din nästa tur. Ladda ner BergCykelHyr – ditt äventyr börjar på två hjul.

name: Bestframe: Photo Cleanup
description:
Free up space without losing the photos that matter, privately: everything happens on your iPhone, and nothing is uploaded.

Bestframe finds duplicates, near-identical shots, blurry photos, old screenshots and big videos, suggests the best photo of every moment, and shows you everything before anything is deleted.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything is checked on your iPhone. No account, no uploads, no ads, no tracking.
• Photos kept only in iCloud are checked from the previews on your iPhone; the app tells you how many have no preview yet and couldn't be checked. To confirm a possible duplicate, Bestframe downloads a small preview of the two photos from your own iCloud Photos; nothing is uploaded.

FINDS WHAT YOU CAN CLEAR
• Duplicates: exact copies of the same photo, anywhere in your library.
• Similar shots: bursts and retakes of the same moment, and the same picture saved as another file.
• Blurry photos and old screenshots.
• Large items: the biggest videos and photos first.
• Worth a look: photos you might not need, like receipts, forwarded greetings, barcodes, accidental shots and screenshots older than 90 days. You decide what stays; nothing is selected for you.

KEEPS PRIVATE PAPERS PRIVATE
• Potentially sensitive photos: photos of passports, IDs, bank cards and cheques, found on your iPhone. A card number or a passport's code lines confirm it; the text is never stored or sent anywhere.
• Hide them in the Hidden album, which Photos locks with Face ID, keep them as they are, export them to a drive, or delete the ones you no longer need.

KEEPS THE BEST
• Suggests the sharpest, best-exposed shot of each group, with face quality and resolution taken into account, and tells you why.
• In Duplicates, the extra copies are selected for you; in Similar shots, nothing is selected until you choose.
• Favorites, protected photos and the best shot of every group are never selected for you.

FAST, SAFE REVIEW
• Swipe to keep or select, with skip and undo, or select in a grid.
• Compare shots side by side and zoom in.
• See how much space your selection frees. Delete one group at a time, or everything you selected in one tap; every Delete button shows how many items it removes.
• iOS asks you to confirm every deletion, and deleted items stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days. Changed your mind? Recover Deleted Photos shows you the way back.

EXPORT TO A USB DRIVE
• Your whole library and your albums, as in the Photos app, by year, month or day.
• Choose a USB drive once; then Export New Items copies everything you haven't exported yet, in one tap.
• Or select photos, a whole day, month or year, or an album. Pick year and month folders, file names, edited versions and Live Photo videos.
• Each file is read back from the drive and checked after copying, and exporting again skips what's already there. Then keep the originals on your iPhone too, or delete only what was exported.
• With Bestframe open, plugging in your drive offers to export what's new.

SHRINK BIG VIDEOS
• Save a smaller copy of a large video that keeps its date and location, then decide whether to delete the original.

KEEPS UP WITH YOUR LIBRARY
• Results appear while the first scan is still running.
• Later scans only check new or edited photos.
• The Dashboard shows your photos and videos by year and resolution; tap a tile to go straight to them.

HELP BUILT IN
• Short animated guides show every feature step by step.
• Questions or ideas? Write to us right from the app.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Sizes are estimates. The space comes back once items leave Recently Deleted.
• With iCloud Photos, deleting a photo removes it from all your devices.
• If you share only some photos with the app, only those are checked, and the app says so.

Bestframe is free, with no in-app purchases and no subscription.

name: BFB Scan Pro - PDF Scanner OCR
description:
No account, no cloud. Never an ad while you scan.
Scanning, creating a PDF and sharing are included in the free version, with no watermark.

BFB Scan Pro turns your paper into clean, readable PDFs in seconds, on iPhone and iPad.

INCLUDED IN THE FREE VERSION
• Edges found automatically, automatic capture, page straightened. Several pages in a row, as many as you need.
• For each page: Color (background cleaned up), Gray, Black and white or Original. Rotate a page, change the order, delete the one you don't need.
• Text read on the device, in six languages: French, English, German, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese. Copy it, or find a document among all your scans by a word it contains.
• Searchable PDF (selectable text) or light PDF for email, text (.txt), JPEG images, printing and sharing.
• Two-sided: scan the fronts, turn the stack over, scan the backs. The pages go back in order.
• ID card: front and back on a single A4 page, at actual size.
• Several documents merged into one PDF.
• Import PDFs, images or photos, or open in BFB Scan Pro a PDF shared from the Share button.
• Folders, multiple selection: move, rename, delete.

THE ESSENTIALS OF A LETTER OR BILL
The amount due, the due date, the reference and the IBAN (verified with its check digits) are shown at the top of the document. Each one copies with a single tap.
Made for letters and bills in euros. Read automatically: always check against the page.

BFB SCAN PRO, THE OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION
• Signature: draw it with your fingertip, then place it anywhere on the page.
• No ads at all.
Two plans, monthly or yearly. The price is shown in the app before any purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it at any time in your Apple Account settings, under Subscriptions. Already subscribed on another device? Settings, Restore my purchases.

YOUR DOCUMENTS STAY WITH YOU
Detection, cleanup, text reading and conversions happen on the iPhone or iPad. BFB Scan Pro never sends your documents over the Internet and asks for no account. A document leaves the device only if you share it yourself.
Internet access is only used for the ads of the free version, never while you scan, and for the subscription. Manage your choices in Settings, Privacy choices.

The free version is funded by two discreet ad banners: one at the top of the library, one at the bottom of documents.

Privacy policy: https://brk-apk.com/en/bfb-scan-pro/confidentialite.html
Terms of use (Apple's standard license agreement): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Big Head GM
description:
Big Head GM is the free fantasy football app nobody in your league knows about yet.

DAILY GAMES
• Fantasle: guess the mystery fantasy football player in 8 tries. Green means a match, yellow means close.
• Prospectle: guess the mystery 2027 draft prospect.
• New puzzles every day, plus Unlimited mode. Turn on the daily reminder so you never lose your streak.

FANTASY TOOLS
• Start or sit: add the players you're stuck on and get a clear call, based on scoring, recent form and the matchup.
• Trade analyzer: see who wins the deal in PPR, half PPR, standard, TE premium, superflex, redraft or dynasty, and what it takes to even it out.
• Waiver wire: the best pickups each week at every position, and why.
• Rankings, rest-of-season schedules and a fantasy mock draft to practice for next year.

LIVE EVERY WEEK
• Scores and fantasy points for every player, every game.
• Quick-hit news: injuries, returns and new starters, each with its source.
• Award odds: MVP, Offensive and Defensive Player of the Year, the rookie awards and Coach of the Year.

2027 MOCK DRAFT
• Take over any team and run the draft. The computer picks for everyone else, and they'll call you with trade offers.
• A big board of the top 2027 prospects and team-by-team mock drafts.

No account. No ads. No sign-up.

Big Head GM is not affiliated with the NFL or any NFL team. Odds are shown for information only; Big Head GM is not a sportsbook and does not take bets.

name: Billivanta
description:
Billivanta is a calm night ledger for your household. It keeps recurring bills, payments, everyday expenses and monthly budgets in one place, so you always know where the month stands.

THE BALANCE STACK
Your Overview opens on three layered glass cards. Tap or swipe to flip between them: Budget left (with a balance-to-budget ring), Bills still due this month, and Spent so far. The numbers roll as they change, like an odometer.

BILLS THAT LOOK AFTER THEMSELVES
• Add bills with a payee, amount, category, due date, repeat rule (weekly, monthly, yearly or custom, such as every 2 months or every 10 days), an autopay flag and notes
• Mark a bill paid in one tap. Billivanta records the payment and moves the bill to its next due date. Month-end dates such as the 31st stay anchored correctly.
• Overdue bills turn coral and bills due soon turn amber
• Local reminders fire a chosen number of days before each due date
• Undo a payment and the bill goes back to its previous due date

EXPENSES, HISTORY AND CATEGORIES
• Log everyday expenses in seconds from the floating + button
• Search and filter your full payment and expense history by month and category
• Create your own categories with a colour and a glyph

PLAN AND UNDERSTAND
• Set a monthly budget for each category. Progress bars and overspend warnings show how each one is doing.
• Optionally add your monthly income to see your net
• Monthly summaries show totals, top categories and how this month compares with the last one
• Full-screen analytics include an interactive category donut, category bars, a 6-month trend, and a bills-versus-expenses split
• Statistics show average monthly spend, on-time payment rate, autopay share and your monthly bill commitment
• Export CSV (ledger or bills) or a full JSON backup

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE FIRST
No account needed: the app opens straight to your ledger. Everything works offline, without a connection. An optional cloud backup syncs your records quietly in the background under an anonymous identifier. There is no account, no sign-in, no ads and no tracking. You can turn backup off or delete the cloud copy at any time.

You can also choose your currency, appearance (System, Light or Dark) and haptics.

Billivanta is an organiser, not financial advice.

name: BillSarthiLite
description:
Bill Sarthi Lite – Simple & Fast Restaurant Billing App

Run your restaurant, café, food stall, or small food business with ease using Bill Sarthi Lite, a simple and affordable mobile billing solution designed to make everyday billing faster and more convenient.

Whether you own a small café, fast-food outlet, bakery, dhaba, or takeaway shop, Bill Sarthi Lite helps you create bills, print receipts, and monitor sales directly from your smartphone.

KEY FEATURES

FAST & EASY BILLING
Create professional customer bills in seconds. Add items, adjust quantities, calculate totals, and complete transactions with a simple, user-friendly interface.

BLUETOOTH RECEIPT PRINTING
Connect a compatible Bluetooth receipt printer to print customer bills quickly and conveniently.

SALES REPORTS
Keep track of your business performance with easy-to-understand sales reports. Monitor daily transactions and stay informed about your sales activity.

SIMPLE MENU MANAGEMENT
Organize your products and menu items to make everyday billing easier and more efficient.

MOBILE-FIRST EXPERIENCE
Manage your billing directly from your smartphone without requiring a computer or complicated POS setup.

QUICK & EASY SETUP
Get started with a simple interface designed for small business owners. No advanced technical knowledge is required.

IDEAL FOR

• Cafés and coffee shops

WHY CHOOSE BILL SARTHI LITE?

• Simple and intuitive interface
• Fast and convenient billing

MAKE EVERY BILL COUNT!

Spend less time on manual billing and more time serving your customers. Bill Sarthi Lite brings essential billing tools into one convenient mobile application.

Download Bill Sarthi Lite and simplify your restaurant billing experience today.

Website: https://billsarthi.com

Developed by Designing and Marketing IT Solutions.

name: Binkei
description:
Binkei turns your hand embroidery steps into a work plan you can follow at the hoop and reuse for the next piece. Organize a single project or keep a small studio batch on track from the first sample to final handoff.

• Build a stitch plan. Browse diagrams for Suzhou embroidery, European embroidery, and foundational stitches. Save favorites, reorder steps, and note thread colors, strand counts, stitch direction, and tension. Check off each step as you finish it.
• Budget thread from a stitched sample. Log the color, strand count, number of cuts, and cut length for each step. Compare actual use with your estimates, revise the plan, and check how much thread still needs to be prepared for each color.
• Revise a batch in progress. Review how the sample differs from the batch template, then apply the updated plan to selected pieces that are eligible and haven't started. Check thread preparation again before returning to stitching.
• Review quality and repeat the work. Check each piece before handoff and track rework through completion. Export stitch plans, thread budgets, or batch status as plain text. Start the next batch from a saved template.

name: Bipolar
description:
Halte jeden Tag fest, wie es dir geht: gut, unruhig, elend oder gemischt.

• Monatskalender und Jahresübersicht
• Medikation: Lege deine Medikamente einmal an und erfasse nur noch Änderungen – die Dosis gilt bis zur nächsten Änderung. Einnahmen bei Bedarf hältst du an einzelnen Tagen fest.
• Auswertung der Phasen
• Nur-Lese-Zugriff für vertraute Personen über iCloud
• Monatliches PDF als Backup in iCloud Drive, inklusive Medikationsverlauf
• Import und Export als JSON

Die Daten liegen ausschliesslich in deinem iCloud-Konto. Kein Konto, keine Werbung, keine Analyse.

Persönliches Tagebuch, kein Medizinprodukt. Die App gibt keine Dosierungsempfehlungen und erinnert nicht an Einnahmen.

name: BirVakit: Namaz Vakitleri
description:
BirVakit; namaz vakitlerini, ezan bildirimlerini, kıble pusulasını ve Kur'an-ı Kerim'i tek, sade bir uygulamada toplar. Reklam yok, üyelik yok, ücret yok.

NAMAZ VAKİTLERİ
• Diyanet İşleri Başkanlığı'nın açıkladığı vakitler; Türkiye'nin bütün il ve ilçeleri ile yurt dışındaki şehirler
• Sıradaki vakte kalan süre, günün altı vakti, kerahat vakitleri
• Gece vakitleri (gecenin üçte biri, seher), imsakiye ve dini günler
• Konumunuzla otomatik ilçe seçimi; birden fazla konum kaydedip aralarında geçiş

EZAN VE BİLDİRİMLER
• Her vakit için ayrı bildirim ve ses seçimi (ezan, çan, melodi, zil)
• Vakitten önce hatırlatma, sahur ve cuma hatırlatmaları

KIBLE
• Pusula ile kıble yönü
• Harita görünümü: bulunduğunuz yerden Kâbe'ye uzanan çizgi
• Yakındaki camiler ve yol tarifi

KUR'AN-I KERİM
• Mushaf, sayfa sayfa (604 sayfa) ve meâlli okuma
• Diyanet ve Elmalılı mealleri, çeviriyazı, kelime kelime meal
• Farklı hafızlardan dinleme; dinlediğiniz sûre telefona kaydedilir, sonra internetsiz dinlenir
• Ezber modu: ayet aralığı ya da sayfa seçin; Dinle · Gizle · Sına adımlarıyla hafızların usulüyle ezberleyin
• Yer imleri, notlar, listeler, hatim ve okuma takibi

NAMAZ TAKİBİ VE PLAN
• Kıldığınız namazları işaretleyin, haftanızı görün
• Kaza namazı ve kaza orucu takibi; bilmiyorsanız borcunuzu hesaplayın
• Günlük plan: Kur'an, zikir, tesbihat gibi küçük günlük hedefler

DUA, ZİKİR VE REHBER
• Zikirmatik, tesbihat, Esmâü'l-Hüsnâ
• Dualar, Hadis-i Şerifler, namaz rehberi
• Elif-Bâ dersleri, Cuma hutbesi, Hac ve Umre rehberi
• Zekât ve fitre hesaplama

iPHONE VE APPLE WATCH
• Ana ekran ve kilit ekranı widget'ları
• Kilit ekranında Canlı Etkinlik ile sıradaki vakit
• Apple Watch: vakitler, günün namazları, kıble ve zikirmatik; kadran eklentileri

GİZLİLİK
Hesap açmanız gerekmez. Takip, plan, zikir ve not kayıtlarınız yalnızca telefonunuzda saklanır; hiçbir sunucuya gönderilmez. Uygulama reklam ve izleme içermez.

Türkçe, İngilizce ve Almanca kullanılabilir.

name: Bloom: Self-Care & Habits
description:
Bloom is the aesthetic self-care and habit tracker that makes taking care of yourself feel like a soft, rewarding ritual — not a chore.

Track the little things that make you glow: skincare, water, movement, meditation, supplements, sunlight, gratitude and sleep. Tap to log, watch your glow ring fill up, and keep your streak alive.

GENTLE DAILY RITUALS
• A calm Today screen with your glow ring, level and streak
• Log habits with one tap, with soft haptics
• Hydration tracker with a living water glass
• Pick your vibe each day and see your mood over the week

ROUTINES THAT GUIDE YOU
• Morning Ritual, Evening Glow-up, Sunday Reset and Sleep Wind-down
• Build your own routine step by step
• Focus mode with a timer for every step
• Live Activities: your routine follows you on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island

BREATHE WITH THE BLOOM
• Box breathing, 4-7-8 Relax and Soft Balance
• A breathing flower that opens and closes with you
• Soft, original sounds for every phase

WATCH YOUR PROGRESS BLOOM
• Daily progress and hydration charts
• 16-week consistency calendar
• Personal insights about your strongest habits

LEVEL UP YOUR GLOW
• Earn XP and level up from Fresh Bloom to Celestial Being
• Unlock badges like Hydration Hero and Glass Skin
• Aura themes to change the whole look of the app

WIDGETS EVERYWHERE
Add Bloom to your Home Screen and Lock Screen: today's habits, water, streak, next routine, level, your week, and a one-tap Breathe widget.

BLOOM+ (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION)
Unlock every Aura theme, routine templates and unlimited custom routines.
• Yearly: $29.99 with a 1-week free trial • Monthly: $4.99
Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-up, no ads. Your data stays on your iPhone.

Bloom is a wellness app for building healthy habits. It does not provide medical advice.

name: Blu Laser
description:
Measure a site, mark up the photos, and bring the details back to the shop. Blu Laser gives cabinetmakers, carpenters, and remodelers one place for project photos, dimensions, and site notes.

• Take a wall photo or import one, then draw editable dimension lines and add notes.
• Enter measurements by hand or receive live single-distance readings from the original Bosch GLM 100 C laser meter over Bluetooth. A meter is optional.
• Organize photos and measurements by project, room, and wall. Sketch room layouts and add openings, notes, and measurement checks.
• Work in metric or imperial units, including fractional inches.
• Share annotated photos, project PDFs, and measurement CSVs. Save editable project backups in Files.

Blu Laser works without an account. Projects are saved on your device. You choose when and where to share or back up your work.

name: BMD Baustoffe
description:
BMD Baustoffe – Bau mein Dach

Qualitätsbaustoffe für Ihr Projekt – einfach und bequem mit BMD.

Mit der BMD Baustoffe App haben Sie Ihren zuverlässigen Partner für Dachausbau, Trockenbau, Innenausbau, Grundmauerschutz und Sanierung immer dabei.
Entdecken Sie unser umfangreiches Sortiment an hochwertigen Baustoffen und Zubehör – von Dampfbremsen und Unterspannbahnen über Baufolien, Klebebänder und Klebstoffe bis hin zu praktischem Zubehör rund um Dach und Ausbau. 

Mit der BMD App können Sie:
- Baustoffe und Zubehör bequem entdecken
- schnell die passenden Produkte für Ihr Bauprojekt finden
- Produktinformationen übersichtlich einsehen
- Ihre benötigten Baustoffe direkt und unkompliziert bestellen
- von der Erfahrung und Qualität von BMD Baustoffe profitieren

BMD steht seit 2012 für Erfahrung und Fachwissen rund um Dach, Ausbau und Sanierung. Das Sortiment richtet sich sowohl an Profis als auch an alle, die bei ihrem Bauprojekt Wert auf zuverlässige Materialien legen.
BMD Baustoffe – bärenstark bauen.

name: Board Your Dreams
description:
Create a vision board that feels like you.

Board Your Dreams is a personal creative studio for collecting the places, feelings and goals you want to bring into your life. Start with a fully editable template, add photos and affirmations, arrange layers and export your board to share or print for your planner.

CREATIVE TOOLS
• Add photos from your library
• Find inspiration on Unsplash or search Pinterest and bring your saved images back
• Choose editable templates, design moods and collage layouts
• Write and style titles and affirmations
• Move, resize and rotate everything with touch
• Add shapes, frames and paper colours
• Style photo edges, filters, backgrounds, textures and layers
• Remove photo backgrounds and turn photos into stickers, right on your device
• Undo, redo and duplicate elements
• Export PDF, PNG or JPG, with print and digital sizes
• Fit A3, A4, A5, B6 and custom planner sizes in millimetres
• Preview a planner page or two-page spread, with margins and cut marks
• Save to Files, share and move editable .vboard projects between the app and website

DESIGN WITH AI
Talk naturally with the optional AI companion while it edits the real board in front of you. It can find inspiration photos, add text, change colours and arrange a complete board from your goals.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Boards and imported photos stay in protected storage on your device, and background removal happens on your device too. You decide when to use a feature that sends a prompt or your voice for processing.

The editor is free. Remove the background from three photos for free, then unlock unlimited background removal and stickers with a one-time purchase. Optional AI voice time is available as a one-time consumable purchase. There is no subscription and purchased minutes do not expire.

name: Borealis by Boreal Micro
description:
Borealis is the companion app for Borealis, an aftermarket controller for Nanoleaf Aurora (Light Panels) made by Boreal Micro. The app needs a Borealis controller; it doesn't work with Nanoleaf's own controllers.

Everything happens on your own Wi-Fi network: no account, no sign-in, no cloud service.

LIGHTS
• Power, brightness and colour for every Borealis on your network, found automatically
• Your own colour presets
• A live preview of your panel layout

SCENES
• Built-in animated scenes: Rainbow Wave, Aurora, Fireplace, Sparkle and Pulse
• Music-reactive scenes that follow the beat using the controller's microphone: Music Pulse, Beat Ripple and Spectrum
• A scene editor: choose an effect, its colours and settings, and save it on the controller

AUTO-BRIGHTNESS
• Draw how your panels dim as the room gets darker, using Borealis's ambient light sensor

SETUP AND UPDATES
• Connect a new Borealis to your Wi-Fi over Bluetooth, without a smart home hub
• Name your lights; the name is shared with Home Assistant and Matter
• Install firmware updates over Wi-Fi

Borealis also works with Apple Home and other Matter smart home apps, and with Home Assistant. Use this app for scenes, music effects and settings, and your smart home app for everything else.

Privacy: the app collects no personal data and has no analytics or ads. See borealmicro.com/privacy.

Nanoleaf and Aurora are trademarks of Nanoleaf. Boreal Micro is not affiliated with or endorsed by Nanoleaf.

name: Botano - PlushCam
description:
Left your plushie at home? Worried it'll get dirty or lost, or is it simply too big to bring along?

With PlushCam you photograph your plushie once, at home. After that, wherever you go, open the camera and it's already in the shot.


How it works

1. Take a photo of your plushie's front against a plain background, and PlushCam cuts it out automatically (or pick a photo from Photos)
2. Add its right side, back and left side if you want more angles
3. When you're out, open the camera, frame the view and press the shutter


In the moment: two ways to frame it

Handheld
Just like holding it up to the lens: the bottom half stays out of frame, so it looks like it's really in your hand.

Full body
Your plushie stands in the scene with a soft shadow at its feet, as if it's sitting on the ground or a table.

Switch between them in one tap, or drag it anywhere in between.


Afterwards: add it to photos you already took

Didn't think of it at the time? Pick a photo from Photos and place your plushie in it. It's saved in high resolution.


Make it fit the scene

- Drag with one finger, pinch to resize and rotate
- Up to 5 plushies in one shot
- Switch between the angles you've shot, or flip it
- Brightness and colour adjust to the surroundings automatically, or fine-tune brightness and shadow yourself
- Tilt your plushie and its shadow follows its outline
- Each plushie remembers where you last placed it
- Front and back camera, zoom, and landscape shots


Your photos

- Your plushie is redrawn at the photo's resolution, not pasted on as a small picture
- Add an instant-film style white border with the date printed at the bottom
- Saved straight to Photos, or share them right away


Free and membership

Save your first 3 photos for free, with a small PlushCam watermark in the corner. Then buy a lifetime membership once for unlimited photos with no watermark, unlimited plushies, and backups you can take to a new phone. No ads, no subscription.


No account needed

No sign-up, no sign-in. Your plushies and photos stay on your phone, and the cut-out is done on your phone too.

Haven't photographed your own yet? PlushCam comes with an original buddy, Sprouty, so you can try it right away.

name: BrickedUp: Smash & Collapse
description:
BrickedUp is a fast, satisfying brick-smashing puzzle game. Tap a group of two or more matching bricks to highlight it, then tap again to smash it. Bigger groups score far more, so plan ahead and set up the big hit.

Every level gives you a set number of swings to clear a brick target. Beat it, bank a bonus for every swing you saved, and move on to a tougher yard.

SMASH BIG, MAKE SPECIALS
• Sweeper: clears its whole row
• Drill: clears its whole column
• Blast brick: blows out a wide diamond around it
• Prism: wipes every brick of the most common color
Set one special off next to another and they chain, multiplying your score.

MORE TO MASTER
• Iron blocks from level 3 that take two hits to break
• New colors that join as you climb
• Column clears for huge bonuses
• Extra bricks past the target give you a head start on the next level
• Unused specials carry over to the next level
• Three hints per level when you're stuck

MADE FOR PHONES
• Plays fully offline, so it's great on the train or a plane
• Satisfying haptic feedback on every smash
• Sound effects that respect your silent switch and play nicely with your own music
• Color-blind friendly: every brick color has its own shape

NO ADS. No accounts. No data collected. Just bricks.

name: Bunkroom Alerts
description:
Bunkroom Alerts puts your department's box alarm pre-alerts on your phone, so you know what's coming in before the tones drop.

Built by a firefighter for career crews and volunteers. Your department sets it up with Bunkroom Alerts and approves every member, so only your people see your calls.

PRE-ALERTS ON YOUR PHONE
• Box pre-alerts sound on your phone, even when it's locked
• Pick the alert sound, including real station tones
• Turn alerts on for a shift and they turn off by themselves when it ends, or turn them off any time
• Earlier pre-alerts stay in the list for 24 hours, then clear on their own

SEE IT AND GO
• Every active pre-alert pinned on a map
• One tap for directions in Apple Maps, Google Maps or Waze
• A full-screen alert option for a phone or iPad left on the apparatus floor

MORE THAN ONE DEPARTMENT
• Work at one department and volunteer at another? Add both and get alerts from each

YOUR DEPARTMENT DECIDES
• Departments can add a live call dashboard, hydrant maps, map books and building notes for their crews
• Officers approve members and can review reported posts

IMPORTANT
Bunkroom Alerts is a backup alert and reference tool. It is not a 911 or dispatch system and does not replace your department's official alerting. Always follow your department's dispatch and procedures.

SUBSCRIPTION
Some departments include Bunkroom Alerts for their members. Others use a monthly subscription, Bunkroom Alerts Monthly, at $5.99 a month. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. It renews every month unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Terms and Conditions: https://bunkroomalerts.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://bunkroomalerts.com/privacy

name: BuntingLark
description:
Bunting Lark on lyhyt 3D-katuseikkailu. Olet nauhalintu, jolla on käytössään kolme sadevesikourua ja yksi vihellys.

Pyyhkäise vaihtaaksesi kourua. Pidä painettuna viheltääksesi: saat nopeuspuuskan mukulakivillä ja ilmapyrähdyksen ollessasi ilmassa. Napauta poimiaksesi vilkuttavan naapuruston asukkaan tai hypätäksesi lätäkön yli.

Neljä kaupunginosaa jakaa saman kadun.

**Lyhtykortteli:** Väistele busseja ja saavuta leipomon markiisi. Kuivilla mukulakivillä kourunvaihto tapahtuu heti pyyhkäisyn hetkellä.

**Koristenauhakatu:** Pysy leipomon pakettiauton ilmavirrassa. Märillä mukulakivillä pysyt vanhassa kourussa, kunnes liuku ylittää kadun keskikohdan.

**Lauttaruuhka:** Täytä olkalaukku ennen kuin saavutat markiisin. Poiminnan jälkeen et voi palata jättämääsi kouruun hetkeen.

**Yölaituri:** Ramppi nostaa kaikki kourut ilmaan. Pujottele renkaiden läpi, jos haluat, ja laskeudu sitten merkitylle laiturille. Yötuuli työntää liitoa sivuun, mutta tyyntyy laiturin lähestyessä.

Suoritetusta tehtävästä saat Siistin, Rohkean tai Villin nauhan. Nauhojen langoilla voit parantaa pitoa, aerodynamiikkaa, pomppua tai liitokorkeutta. Huivit muuttavat vain ulkonäköäsi.

Aamunkoiton reitti on yksi tämän päivän päivämäärän perusteella tällä puhelimella luotu ja tallennettu katu. Huomenna katu on erilainen. Paras tuloksesi säilyy täällä. Käyttäjätiliä, keskustelutoimintoa tai verkkoyhteyttä ei tarvita. Koko pesäsi pysyy omalla laitteellasi.

name: Bunto – Malen für Kinder
description:
Bunto – die Mal-App für kleine Künstler

Farbe wählen, Fläche antippen, fertig: Bunto macht Ausmalen für Kinder einfach, bunt und völlig sorgenfrei. Ein Ort zum Malen – nicht zum Klicken, Kaufen oder Ausgeforscht-Werden.

KEINE WERBUNG. KEINE IN-APP-KÄUFE.
Bunto enthält weder Werbung noch In-App-Käufe – nicht in dieser Version und auch nicht in künftigen Updates. Kein Konto, kein Login, keine Datensammlung, keine Links nach draußen. Alles funktioniert komplett offline.

128 SELBST GEZEICHNETE MOTIVE IN 15 WELTEN
Weihnachten, Advent, Winter, Freies Malen, Dinos, Baustelle, Häuser, Mandalas, Tiere, Meer, Fahrzeuge, Weltraum, Essen, Natur und Fantasie – jedes Motiv ist ein Original, ganz ohne Fremdmaterial.

EINFACH FÜR KLEINE FINGER
• Eimer: Farbe wählen, Fläche antippen – gefüllt wird exakt bis zum Rand
• Pinsel mit Randhilfe: Die Farbe bleibt in der Fläche, in der man startet – auch wenn der Finger mal wackelt
• Radierer, Rückgängig und „Neu anfangen“ mit Rückfrage
• Würfel: Überraschungsmotiv, wenn man sich nicht entscheiden kann
• Angefangene Bilder werden automatisch gespeichert, Vorschaubilder zeigen, was schon gemalt ist
• Fertige Kunstwerke mit einem Tipp in den Fotos sichern – für Oma, Opa und den Kühlschrank
• Große Tasten, kaum Text und keine versehentlichen Wege aus dem Mal-Bildschirm

IMMER WIEDER NEU – AUCH SAISONAL
Wir erweitern Bunto laufend um neue Motive: passend zu den Jahreszeiten und Festen, zum Beispiel Ostern, Sommer, Halloween und Weihnachten. Alle Updates bleiben ohne Werbung und ohne In-App-Käufe.

FÜR ELTERN
Bunto sammelt, speichert und sendet keine personenbezogenen Daten und enthält keine Drittanbieter-SDKs. Nur wenn Ihr Kind „In Fotos speichern“ tippt, fragt iOS nach Schreibzugriff auf die Fotos – gelesen werden Ihre Fotos nie. Entwickelt für die Kids Category, Altersfreigabe 4+.

VON UNS FÜR EUCH
Bunto wird mit Liebe in Hamm entwickelt von Jörn Bergmeier, Bergmeier&Bergmeier GbR. Fragen, Wünsche oder Ideen für neue Motive? Schreibt uns über bunto.webcoffee.io – wir freuen uns über jede Nachricht!

name: Buzz Buzz Football
description:
Remember the football game that buzzed? A metal field, two teams of little plastic figures, and a switch. You lined them up, flicked it on, and the whole board hummed while they shuffled off in whatever direction they felt like.

Buzz Buzz Football is that game, on your phone.

YOU CALL IT. THE BOARD PLAYS IT.
Pick a formation and a play, then press START. Every figure runs the way it was aimed. Nobody steers. Blocks hold or they don't, the runner breaks free or gets caught, and then you call the next one.

A FULL GAME
• Four quarters, halftime, and sudden-death overtime
• Eleven running plays, a passing game, punts, field goals and extra points
• Kickoffs with a return to call and a coverage to choose
• An opening coin toss
• Eight defenses, picked from the formation you see across the line

AN OPPONENT WORTH BEATING
Play a Rookie who mostly guesses, or a Pro who plays the percentages and learns your habits.

JUST LIKE THE TOY
Figures get knocked over. Now and then one spins in circles. The grandstand scoreboard keeps the score and the chain gang marks the first down. You can even adjust each figure's aim and the dial under its base, if you want to tinker.

EASY TO PICK UP
A few taps and a decision each down. No twitch reflexes, no timers while you think: the clock only runs while the board does.

NO STRINGS
No ads. No accounts. No purchases. Nothing is collected. It plays without a connection, and your record stays on your phone.

Sound: "Electric generators LOOPABLE" by FreeSoundFX, "Metal Whistle" by freesound_community and "Truck Horn" by SoundReality, from Pixabay, used under the Pixabay Content License.

name: C Weave Run
