description:
Looking for a quick session that stays addictive? C Weave Run blends card reading with lane dodging. Swipe to slide across the track, scan each approaching wall of cards, and weave into the single safe gap before impact.
The rule is simple: among 3–6 cards, only one face value matches its top number. Land there to clear and score; miss to burn a life, wipe your combo, and permanently speed up the run—three mistakes and it is over.
Combo drives the leaderboard: double at five, triple at ten. Pickup cards can slow time, lock your streak, or double points—while fog and speed boosts raise the pressure.
Pick a difficulty from Novice to Extreme, check past runs, and tweak number placement or haptics. Open the app and start weaving: slide, match, and push for a new personal best.

name: CalorixMaps: Akarsu Rehberi
seller_name: NEW SENSES UZAY TEKNOLOJI VE SAGLIK ARASTIRMALARI ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
Akarsular hızlı aktığı yerde kum ve çakılı taşır, yavaşladığı yerde bırakır; en ağır taneler en önce bırakılır. CalorixMaps, Türkiye'deki akarsuları uydu verisi ve yükseklik modeliyle boydan boya tarar ve ağır minerallerin çökelmesine en elverişli yerleri haritada gösterir.

• TOP10 ve TOP100: Haritada gördüğünüz bölgenin en elverişli 10 yeri ve Türkiye geneli en iyi 100 yer.
• Birikim göstergesi: Her yer için beş kademeli göreli gösterge ve beş etken — eğim kırığı, menderes iç kıyısı, kol birleşimi, yukarı havzada kaynak kayaç ve akarsu büyüklüğü.
• Sit ve koruma alanları: Arkeolojik alanlar, milli parklar ve koruma alanları haritada işaretlidir; bu alanlarda öneri gösterilmez.
• Kayıtlı yerler: İlgilendiğiniz yerleri kaydedin, internet olmadan açın, yol tarifi alın.
• Öğrenin: 20 animasyon video, rehber yazıları ve 60'tan fazla soru-cevap.
• Yıl boyu öneriler: Her hafta mevsime uygun bir öneri (kar erimesi, taşkın, yaz kuraklığı, sonbahar sağanakları).
• Aynı hesapla harita.calorix.org'da termal atalet haritası, alan analizi ve yeraltı kesiti.

ÖNEMLİ: CalorixMaps bir ön inceleme ve eğitim aracıdır. Maden ya da define yeri bildirimi değildir; birikim göstergesi rezerv hesabı değildir. Türkiye'de maden arama ve işletme yalnız MAPEG ruhsatıyla yapılır (3213 sayılı Maden Kanunu); izinsiz kazı ve define araması suçtur (2863 sayılı Kanun md. 74). Calorix yasadışı kazıya, define aramasına ve kaçak madenciliğe karşıdır.

Abonelik: İlk 7 gün ücretsiz. Sonra aylık 59,99 TL ya da yıllık 449,99 TL (KDV dahil). Ödeme, satın almayı onayladığınızda Apple hesabınızdan alınır. Abonelik, dönem bitmeden en az 24 saat önce iptal edilmezse kendiliğinden yenilenir. Yönetim ve iptal: Ayarlar › Apple Hesabı › Abonelikler.

Kullanım koşulları: https://harita.calorix.org/sozlesme.html
Gizlilik: https://calorix.org/gizlilik-ve-guvenlik-politikasi/

name: Calypso Private Browser
description:
Calypso is a private browser that also keeps the videos you want.

Calypso keeps no history, cookies or cache. Your open tabs stay encrypted on your device, so they're there next time. Tap Erase and it's all gone.

Ads, trackers, cookie banners and pop-ups are blocked on every site, and tracking codes are stripped from links. If a site acts up, tap the shield in the address bar to turn blocking off for that site.

Found a video you want to keep? Tap Save or press and hold the video, then pick a playlist. It works on iPhone and iPad. You can name it first, save up to 10 at once and choose which one goes first. Saving keeps going after you leave the app, and you can start watching before it's done.

Saved videos are encrypted on your iPhone and open only with your password, Face ID or Touch ID. They're left out of iCloud and backups. Rename them, sort them into playlists and skip from one to the next.

You can also:
• Split the screen and use two pages at once
• Listen to any page, or just the text you select
• Open a link from any app with the Share button
• Use it in your own language
• See all your tabs at once and swipe one away to close it
• Lock Calypso itself with Face ID
• Set your own homepage and search engine
• Search by voice
• Darken pages with Night mode
• Import bookmarks from another browser
• Pick a different app icon

No account, no sign-in, and no data collected.

Calypso never saves copy-protected video. Please only save videos you have the right to keep.

name: Camerae: Route Traffic Cams
description:
Camerae shows you every highway traffic camera along your drive, in the order you'll pass them.

Enter where you're starting and where you're going. Camerae plans the route and lines up the cameras along it, from the first mile to the last, with the distance and drive time to each one. Tap a camera for live video, or scroll the list to watch the snapshots refresh.

Check for snow on the pass, a backup at the bridge, or fog in the valley before you leave.

• Every camera on your route, in driving order • Live video for over half the cameras, with snapshots for the rest • Compare alternate routes, each with its own cameras • Several views from one pole, starting with the one facing your direction of travel • Offline cameras are marked, so you don't wait on a dead feed • Start from your current location, or save a Home • No account, no ads, no tracking

Coverage: about 4,000 cameras across California (Caltrans) and Nevada (NDOT).

Camerae is for planning a trip and for passengers. Please don't watch cameras while you drive.

Camera imagery courtesy of Caltrans and NDOT / nvroads.com. Camerae is not affiliated with or endorsed by either agency.

name: CampusBuddy
description:
CampusBuddy zeigt dir in Echtzeit, wo auf dem Campus der DHBW Mannheim gerade ein guter Platz zum Lernen frei ist. Statt von Raum zu Raum zu laufen, siehst du in Sekunden, wo es ruhig ist, wo noch Steckdosen frei sind und wo gerade Vorlesungen stattfinden.

LERNPLÄTZE FINDEN
Alle Lernräume auf einen Blick, mit Foto, Auslastung, Lautstärke und Status (frei, wird voll, voll, belegt oder geschlossen). Filter für freie und ruhige Räume, Räume mit Steckdosen und deine Favoriten.

LIVE-STATUS VON STUDIERENDEN
Du bewertest einen Raum mit zwei Tipps: wie voll und wie laut es ist. Die Bewertungen der letzten Stunde ergeben den aktuellen Status für alle.

RAUM-DETAILS
Fotos, Plätze, Steckdosen, WLAN, Heizung und Klima, Ausstattung, Öffnungszeiten, Wasserspender und die Belegung durch Vorlesungen direkt aus der DHBW-Raumplanung.

GRUPPENSUCHE
Sag, wie viele ihr seid und wann ihr los wollt. CampusBuddy schlägt passende freie Räume vor, nach Eignung sortiert, und du schickst den Vorschlag direkt an deine Gruppe.

MENSA
Der Speiseplan der Mannheimer Mensen mit Bildern, Preisen für Studierende und Tageswechsel.

KEIN KONTO NÖTIG
Keine Anmeldung, keine Werbung, kein Tracking. Deine Favoriten bleiben auf deinem Gerät.

CampusBuddy ist ein unabhängiges Studierendenprojekt und kein offizielles Angebot der DHBW.

name: Canada Road Watch
description:
DISCLAIMER: This app does not represent any government entity. Canada Road Watch is an independent app made by Movil Softwares Inc. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or a service of Ontario 511, Québec 511, DriveBC, any provincial ministry of transportation or any government.

Official sources of the road information in this app:
• Ontario (Ontario 511, Government of Ontario): https://511on.ca
• Québec (Québec 511, Gouvernement du Québec): https://www.quebec511.info
• British Columbia (DriveBC, Government of British Columbia): https://www.drivebc.ca
Full list of official sources at the end of this description.

Canada Road Watch shows the closures, incidents, construction and road-condition reports published by official provincial sources, on a map and in a list, with the time each report was last updated.

CHECK A ROUTE
• Enter a start (or use where you are) and a destination.
• See every reported closure, incident, construction zone and road-condition report along the way, in driving order ("km 16", "km 433").
• Save routes you drive often and check them again in one tap.

EXPLORE THE MAP
• Different symbols for closures, incidents, construction and road-condition reports.
• Filter by report type and search by highway number, like 401, 20 or 99.

CLEAR TIMESTAMPS
• Every report shows when the source last updated it, in the local time of the province.
• The app shows when it last checked each source, and says so when a source is unavailable or a report may be outdated.
• A report with no time says "Timestamp unavailable" instead of guessing.

WATCH A HIGHWAY
• Save a highway section in Ontario, Québec or BC, like Highway 17 near Kenora, and see its current reports in Alerts.

PRIVACY
• No account and no ads. Saved routes and highways stay on your device.
• Location is optional and only used while the app is open.

IMPORTANT
Reports come from official sources and can be incomplete or out of date. No report doesn't guarantee clear road conditions. Always follow road signs, official notices and instructions from authorities. Do not use the app while driving.

Coverage: Ontario provincial highways; Québec roadwork and winter road conditions on the provincial network; British Columbia DriveBC events and road conditions. Other provinces and territories are not included yet.

OFFICIAL SOURCES
Government of Ontario
• Ontario 511 road and travel information: https://511on.ca
• Ontario 511 developer data used by this app: https://511on.ca/developers/doc
• Open Government Licence – Ontario: https://www.ontario.ca/page/open-government-licence-ontario
Gouvernement du Québec (Ministère des Transports et de la Mobilité durable)
• Québec 511: https://www.quebec511.info
• Travaux routiers (roadwork data): https://www.donneesquebec.ca/recherche/dataset/travaux-routiers
• Condition routière hivernale (winter road conditions data): https://www.donneesquebec.ca/recherche/dataset/condition-routiere-hivernale-du-reseau-routier-mtq
• Licence CC BY 4.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Government of British Columbia
• DriveBC: https://www.drivebc.ca
• DriveBC Open511 API used by this app: https://api.open511.gov.bc.ca/help
• Open Government Licence – British Columbia: https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content?id=A519A56BC2BF44E4A008B33FCF527F61

Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Ontario. Contains information from the Gouvernement du Québec, licensed under CC BY 4.0. Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – British Columbia. This app does not close roads, issue travel advisories or replace any 511 service. Where this app and the official sources differ, the official sources are correct.


Privacy policy: https://movilsoftwares.com/canada-road-watch/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://movilsoftwares.com/canada-road-watch/terms.html

name: Cap Civique: French civic test
description:
Prepare for France’s civic exam at your own pace, understanding every question, even while your French is still growing.

Since 1 January 2026, the civic exam is required for a first multi-year residence card or a resident card: 40 questions in French, 45 minutes, 32 correct answers to pass.

A WALK AT NIGHT
You walk with Pompon, a small clay cat with a lantern, through five districts inspired by places in France. Every question you truly know lights a lamp in the street, and the town slowly brightens with what you have learned. Turn around now and then: the lane you just walked glows behind you. On the big map, the path runs from the station to the lighthouse.

At the end of each district, a gate is waiting: ten questions in French, with no help, like on the day. It never blocks the way; you can walk on and come back whenever you like.

EVERY QUESTION, UNDERSTOOD
• The question in French, as in the exam
• Help in your language, one tap away: English, Arabic or simple French
• Read aloud, at normal or slower speed
• Tap a hard word to see what it means; it goes into your word notebook
• After each answer, one plain sentence of why, with its source

THE WORKSHOPS
Another way to revise: sort cards into baskets, say true or false, find the pairs, put dates in order.

THE ESSENTIALS, WHEN TIME IS SHORT
Short on time before the exam? The Essentials gathers our revision cards into 20 minutes, 1 hour or 3 hours: first the principles behind the situational questions, then one fact for each topic of the published programme. It is our own selection, made with care. It does not predict the exam's questions and does not promise a pass.

LIKE THE REAL DAY
• Mock exams in the real format: 40 questions, 45 minutes, no help
• All five exam themes, plus practice scenarios
• The questions for your card: the multi-year card and the resident card lists are not quite the same

WHERE DO YOU STAND?
• An estimate out of 40, shown as a range, that gets sharper with every session
• You see what you still need to reach 32
• 10-question sessions, about 5 minutes
• What you don’t know yet comes back at the right time, until you are sure

ANSWERS WITH SOURCES
More than 420 questions, written for the app. Every answer cites an official source (Constitution, Légifrance, Service-Public…) that you can read in the app.

A CLEAR PRICE
Free, with no time limit: 60 to 70 questions depending on your card, across every theme (the first district is entirely free, its workshops too), a taste of The Essentials, one full mock exam and your estimate. Everything else: one payment, no subscription. Family Sharing included.

A GENTLE MOOD
Soft sounds and a quiet night ambience, which you can turn off in Settings.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS
No sign-up, no ads, no tracking. Your answers stay on your device. For iPhone and iPad.

The French voice and the illustrations are made with the help of AI.

Cap Civique is an independent app, not affiliated with the French administration. It helps you prepare, but it does not promise a pass: the estimate is only an estimate.

name: Captain Protein
description:
Captain Protein brings the UAE's favourite sports nutrition store to your phone.

Browse hundreds of products from trusted international brands – protein powders, creatine, pre-workouts, amino acids, vitamins, healthy snacks, protein bars, sauces and gym accessories – and order in a few taps.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Browse by category or search for any product
• View product details, flavours and sizes
• Add to cart and check out securely
• Sign in with a one-time email code – no password to remember
• Track your orders from your account
• Save your favourite products
• Use the app in English or Arabic
• Get notified about new offers and arrivals (optional)

DELIVERY
Delivery is currently available within the United Arab Emirates only.

ABOUT CAPTAIN PROTEIN
Captain Protein is a UAE-based store for sports nutrition and healthy living, serving customers in Abu Dhabi and across the Emirates.

Dietary supplements are not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease. Please read product labels and consult a healthcare professional if you have a medical condition, are pregnant or are taking medication.

name: CAREBOOK
description:
Keep every self-care session in one place — and finally see which rituals are worth your time and money.

Modern wellness is full of appointments, treatments, and “just one more” visits. Without a clear log, it’s easy to lose track of what you spent, how long it took, and what actually made you feel better. This app turns scattered care into a clean personal journal with real numbers behind every ritual.

Record each session with the details that matter: type of treatment, location, cost, duration, and a personal effect score from 1 to 10. Add a short note while the feeling is still fresh. Over time, your archive becomes a living history of how you care for yourself — not a pile of receipts and vague memories.

Track with intention • Capture bodywork, nail studio visits, hair appointments, spa days, skin treatments, and custom rituals
• Save place, price, duration, date, and effect in a few taps
• Edit or remove entries anytime without breaking your history
• Browse a clear timeline instead of a cluttered list

Understand your rhythm • See total spend, logged care time, and session count at a glance
• Review average monthly cost and average effect score
• Explore period views for month, quarter, and year
• Follow spend movement with interactive charts and value details

Find what truly pays off • Compare subjective results against cost with a focused value ranking
• Highlight the rituals that deliver the strongest return for the price
• Handle zero-cost sessions cleanly without distorting insights
• Jump from an insight back to the original entry when you want context

Plan what’s next • Schedule upcoming care for this week or the next
• Set expected price and duration before you go
• Adjust or cancel plans as your week changes
• Enable optional local reminders so planned sessions don’t slip away

Designed to feel premium • Dark, editorial interface with a precise yellow accent
• Large metrics and calm spacing for quick reading
• Custom navigation built for one-handed everyday use
• Smooth micro-interactions that stay out of the way

Whether you visit a spa once a month or keep a packed self-care calendar, you get a private, reliable system for logging rituals, watching spend, judging value, and planning what comes next — with clarity instead of guesswork.

name: CarTelly: Car Video Player
description:
Bring your personal videos together with CarTelly. Import from Files, add a video URL or M3U/M3U8 playlist, and find what you want to watch in your library.

YOUR MEDIA, WITHIN REACH
Play your videos, search your library, and keep favorites close at hand. Open web pages in the built-in browser.

SCREEN SHARING FOR COMPATIBLE DISPLAYS
Use ReplayKit to share your iPhone screen and app audio with a compatible car display. Connect your display, start screen sharing, then open your content on iPhone. Compatibility depends on your display and connection setup. Protected content and some third-party apps may restrict screen capture or audio.

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
Available in English and Vietnamese. No account is required.

CarTelly does not provide movies, TV channels, or subscriptions to content. Add only content you own or have permission to access. Use video features only while parked and where permitted.

name: Catexit: Cat Escape Puzzle
description:
Zombie guard dogs are on patrol. You are one small cube cat with a big plan: get out.

Catexit is a sliding puzzle with teeth. Swipe and your cat slides until it hits a wall or an obstacle — no stopping halfway. Every move counts, because the guards move too.

HOW IT WORKS
• Swipe to slide. The cat keeps going until something stops it.
• Reach the door to escape the room.
• Guard dogs walk a fixed patrol line — one step for every move you make. Read the dashed line on the floor and time your slide.
• Followers copy your every move. Use the walls to shake them off.
• Grab fish on the way for a higher score.

THINK BEFORE YOU SWIPE
• 60 rooms that slowly add new ideas: guards, followers, both at once, and new obstacles.
• Every room is checked by a solver, so there is always a way out.
• Earn up to three stars: escape, collect fish, and save moves.
• Stuck? Use a hint or undo your last move.

MADE FOR SHORT BREAKS
• Rooms take a minute or two.
• Play offline.
• Cute low-poly 3D look, clear top-down view.
• English and Turkish.

Catexit is free to play with ads. A one-time "Remove ads" purchase turns off ads between rooms. Optional "watch an ad" rewards for hints stay available if you want them.

Can you find the perfect escape?

name: CenTriC Control
description:
CenTriC Control brings your Clipsal AC2 controls together on iPhone and iPad. Adjust the lights, open the blinds or set the air conditioning from a dashboard you can arrange around the way you use your home or building.

• Browse controls by room or category, and pin the ones you use most to your home dashboard.
• Dim lights, recall scenes and operate configured blinds, fans and air conditioning.
• See the status of compatible controls at a glance.
• Explore a sample home in the interactive demo without connecting to a controller.

Live control requires a compatible Clipsal AC2 running the CenTriC controller interface and a network connection to that controller. Available controls depend on your installation.

name: Chagok: Kids Growth Album
description:
Merge matching photos and watch your child grow, one year at a time.
Chagok Chagok is a merge puzzle game played with your own child's photos, from baby to big kid.

HOW IT WORKS
- Pick photos of your child from youngest to oldest
- Drop them and merge two of the same to grow into the next age
- Finish the game to get your growth album card

GROWTH ALBUM CARD
- Add your child's name and turn the result into a single card
- Save it to your photo library or share it with family and friends

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No ads, no sign-up
- Your photos stay on your phone and are never uploaded

FREE AND PAID
- Free: 4 of your photos (sample drawings fill the rest), the basic card style, save and share cards
- One-time purchase, yours for good: 6 of your photos, photos stay saved, My albums (reload photo sets you played with), all 4 card styles, and no app name on the card (not a subscription)

name: ChakanACM Authenticator
description:
ChakanACM Authenticator는 ChakanACM 인증 서비스가 적용된 웹사이트에서 QR 코드를 스캔해 본인 인증을 하는 앱입니다. 비밀번호를 입력하는 대신 내 iPhone으로 로그인을 확인할 수 있습니다.

■ 주요 기능

• QR 스캔 로그인 인증
웹사이트 로그인 화면에 표시된 인증 QR을 앱으로 비추면 인증이 시작됩니다.

• 온라인 인증
네트워크에 연결되어 있으면 스캔과 동시에 인증 결과가 서버로 전송되어 로그인이 바로 완료됩니다.

• 오프라인 코드 인증
인증 결과를 바로 보낼 수 없는 환경에서는 앱에 8자리 인증 코드가 표시됩니다. 이 코드를 웹 화면에 입력하면 인증이 완료됩니다.

• 기기 등록키로 내 기기만 등록
기기마다 고유한 기기 등록키가 발급됩니다. 웹사이트에 등록키를 입력하고 등록 QR을 스캔하면 이 기기가 인증 수단으로 연결됩니다.

• 여러 서비스 계정을 한 앱에서
ChakanACM이 적용된 여러 서비스의 계정을 한 앱에 등록하고, 목록에서 계정을 골라 바로 인증할 수 있습니다.

• PIN과 생체 인증 잠금
처음 실행할 때 6자리 PIN을 설정하며, Face ID 또는 Touch ID로 잠금을 해제할 수 있습니다. 다른 사람이 앱을 함부로 사용할 수 없습니다.

• 암호화 백업과 복원
등록한 인증 정보를 암호화된 파일로 백업하고, 기기를 바꿀 때 복원할 수 있습니다.

■ 이용 방법
1. 앱을 설치하고 6자리 PIN을 설정합니다.
2. 앱에서 [인증 정보 추가] > [등록 QR 스캔]을 선택합니다.
3. 웹사이트의 인증 방식 관리에서 QR 인증 앱을 등록하고, 기기 등록키를 입력한 뒤 화면의 QR을 앱으로 스캔합니다.
4. 이후 로그인할 때는 웹사이트에서 QR 인증을 선택하고, 앱에서 계정을 눌러 인증 QR을 스캔하면 됩니다.

■ 개인정보와 보안
• 인증 정보는 기기 안의 보안 저장소에만 보관합니다.
• 광고나 사용 행태 분석 도구를 사용하지 않습니다.
• 카메라는 QR 코드를 스캔할 때만 사용하며, 촬영한 이미지는 저장하거나 전송하지 않습니다.

■ 안내
• 이 앱은 ChakanACM 인증 서비스가 적용된 웹사이트에서만 사용할 수 있습니다.
• 앱 안에서 회원가입을 하지 않으며, 계정은 이용 중인 서비스에서 발급됩니다.
• 계정과 인증 방식에 관한 문의는 해당 서비스 관리자에게 해 주세요.

name: Champions VGC Dex
description:
Champions VGC Dex is the fastest way to read an opponent in competitive doubles. Built for the minute you have at team preview and every turn after, it answers "what does this do, and how do I beat it?" in seconds — fully offline.

THREAT READ
• A one-glance threat profile for every species and Mega form: set-up sweeps with the post-boost numbers, raw damage against the whole meta, Trick Room and Tailwind plans, priority, disruption, weather and terrain, and the ability traps that punish standard plays.
• The likely set from real ladder data: top moves, abilities, items, spreads and teammates, with usage bars.
• Kill-shot strip: the 4× weakness you can trust — ability-aware, so Levitate never fools you.
• Built-in KO benchmarks: which moves OHKO or 2HKO the top of the meta, with zero inputs.

SPEED, STATS & MATCHUPS
• Provable Lv. 50 speed tiers (min, common, max) with one-tap Icy Wind, Choice Scarf, Tailwind and paralysis.
• Lv. 50 stats with Stat Point annotations, abilities with ladder usage, the full movepool with usage, spread-move tags and type matchups.

TEAM PREVIEW
• Pin their six — a dock keeps them one tap away all battle.
• Briefing: archetypes, top threats, speed order and the best attacking types into their whole team.

DAMAGE CALCULATOR
• Pick any two, edit Stat Points, nature, ability, item, boosts and status, set weather, terrain, screens and Helping Hand, and see the full roll, % range and KO chance. Doubles spread damage handled exactly.
• Save your own sets; load meta presets in one tap.

META TEAMS
• Real tournament teams with every set — study a build, then plan your counter.

DATA
• Master+ and all-ranks ladder data from Smogon's public usage statistics plus open-source game data. Everything is built in: no account, no ads, no tracking.

Made for players of Pokémon Champions doubles.

UNOFFICIAL FAN APP. Champions VGC Dex is not affiliated with, endorsed, sponsored, or approved by Nintendo, Creatures Inc., GAME FREAK inc., The Pokémon Company, or The Pokémon Company International. Pokémon, Pokémon Champions, and Pokémon character names are trademarks of Nintendo.

name: Charba: Farm Puzzle
description:
Charba (Kyrgyz for "homestead" or "farm") is a calm puzzle game about life on a mountain pasture. Each level gives you a few minutes: water the grass, collect eggs, wool and milk, turn them into goods at your workshops, sell them and reach the level goal. The faster you finish, the more stars you earn.

HOW IT PLAYS
• One-finger controls: water grass, collect products and send them to market with simple taps.
• Hens lay eggs, sheep give wool, cows give milk. Workshops turn raw materials into more valuable goods.
• Spend coins on new animals, building upgrades and a bigger warehouse.
• A dog and a cat help on the farm, while a wolf and a magpie try to get in the way. Chase the wolf off in time.
• Rain and heat appear on some levels and change the rules on the fly.

WHAT IS INSIDE
• 24 levels in two chapters, with three stars for speed on every level. Bonus levels included.
• Buildings and workshops with several upgrade steps.
• The Shop: spend horseshoes you earn in play on helpers such as wind-up robots, auto-watering and the helper Dyikan. Horseshoes are earned in the game and are not sold for money.
• My Farm: unlocks after level 6. A relaxed mode with no timer and no losing, where you grow your own farm and build conveyors, an auto-truck and a market stall.
• Migration to the jailoo: once your farm runs on autopilot you can start over in a new place and keep your legacy.
• Neighbor orders, seasonal holidays (such as Nowruz) and decorations.
• Personal records and a result card you can share.
• Works offline. Interface in 12 languages: Russian, English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), Italian, Turkish, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese.

ADS AND PURCHASES
The game is free and contains ads: a banner on screen, a short ad after you win a level, and optional videos you can watch for help in a level. A single purchase, Remove Ads, turns off the banner and the ads between levels, and you can restore it in Settings on another device with the same Apple ID. Optional videos for a bonus stay available if you choose to watch them.

The game is intended for players aged 13 and over. No account or sign-up needed.

Support: https://dotfourteen-code.github.io/charba-privacy/support.html
Privacy Policy: https://dotfourteen-code.github.io/charba-privacy/privacy.html

name: Chuyện Kể: Parent Story Voice
description:
Children love hearing their parents read. Chuyện Kể keeps that voice, attached to the very picture book your child loves, so they can hear it any time — even when Dad is travelling or Mom is home late.

SIMPLE TO SET UP
• Photograph the cover and pages with the camera. The app finds the edges, flattens the page and balances the paper colour. Split a two-page spread with one tap.
• Record each page: tap to record, tap to stop. Re-record just the page you want.
• Add a closing line like "The end — sleep tight, sweetheart!".
• Done. The book appears on your child's shelf.

FOR YOUR CHILD
• A shelf of big covers that is easy to pick from. With several readers, your child chooses "Mom reads", "Dad reads", "Grandma reads".
• Each page plays once, then a gentle hint invites a page turn. Tap or swipe to turn, tap the middle to hear it again.
• No ads, no outbound links, nothing to tap by mistake. Hold the lock to exit.

BEDTIME
• The screen dims, pages turn on their own and the story flows.
• Sleep timer; at the end, stop or play a lullaby sung by you.
• Set a daily listening limit.

FOR PARENTS
• Parent gate with a math question, a PIN, or Face ID / Touch ID.
• Supports books that read right to left, like Japanese manga.
• Back up the whole library to one file, optionally password-protected, to move to a new device.
• 6 sample stories included, ready to play.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no servers, no data collection. Your book photos and recordings stay on your device.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Free: 2 books (sample stories don't count), up to 16 pages each, 1 reader per book.
Premium — one-time purchase, no subscription: unlimited books and pages, several readers per book, bedtime mode. Works with Family Sharing.

Please use book photos for your own family only, not to publish copyrighted content.

name: Cicada Clock
description:
Cicada Clock keeps a shift team in sync: the rota, clocking in and out, hours, leave and handovers, in one calm app.

It is built for workplaces that run on shifts: cafés, shops, kitchens, salons, care teams and warehouses. Managers plan and see the day. Staff see their shifts and clock in on their own iPhone.

FOR YOUR TEAM
• Clock in and out on your iPhone with a GPS pin at your workplace. A punch away from the site still counts; it is simply flagged.
• See your rota: what you are scheduled for, and what you actually worked.
• Reminders before a shift starts, before it ends, and when a break is nearly over.
• Request leave by picking the dates, and see your balance.
• Leave a handover for the next shift, typed or spoken. Speech is turned into text on your iPhone.
• Ask Ivy, the built-in assistant, about your hours, breaks, shifts and leave.
• Clocking works without a signal. The punch keeps the time you tapped and is sent when you are back online.
• Faster sign-in with Face ID or Touch ID, with a PIN as a backup.

FOR MANAGERS
• A live board: who is clocked in, who is due, and who has said they are on the way.
• Build the week's rota by hand, or have Cicada draft it from everyone's contracts and your opening hours. You review it, then publish.
• See whether every part of the day is covered before you publish.
• Approve or decline leave requests.
• Hours counted from real clock-ins, with a CSV you can share with whatever payroll you use.
• Add people from the app. Each person gets their own login.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No clock-in photos and no face scans.
• No background location. One location is recorded when you clock in and one when you clock out, and never in between.
• No ads and no tracking.
• Staff can delete their own account from the app.

HOURS, NOT PAY
Cicada Clock records working time. It does not calculate pay, tax or payslips; your employer's payroll does that.

HOW ACCOUNTS WORK
Cicada Clock is for organisations. An organisation's owner creates the account and buys a yearly membership in the app, sized for up to 10, 20 or 60 people. Staff sign in with the login their employer gives them; they cannot register on their own.

Memberships are yearly auto-renewing subscriptions, charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. They renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed or cancelled in your App Store account settings.

Privacy policy: https://cicadaclock.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://cicadaclock.com/terms
Help: support@cicadaclock.com

name: CitasPlus: Agenda de Citas
description:
CitasPlus es la app para dueños y empleados de negocios que trabajan con citas: barberías, salones de belleza, uñas y pestañas, spas, consultorios, estudios de tatuaje, fisioterapia, entrenadores y más.

Lleva tu agenda en el bolsillo: consulta tus citas del día, agenda nuevas en segundos, confirma o cancela, y contacta a tus clientes por llamada o WhatsApp con un solo toque.

TU DÍA DE UN VISTAZO
• Las citas de hoy, la siguiente cita y cuántas tienes pendientes.
• "Terminar día": cierra tu agenda para que ya no te agenden más ese día.

AGENDA UNA CITA EN SEGUNDOS
• Elige servicio, fecha y hora: solo ves las horas que de verdad están libres.
• Si eres el dueño, agenda a nombre de cualquiera de tus empleados.
• Recorre tu agenda día por día y ve quién atiende cada cita.

CONFIRMA Y CONTACTA AL INSTANTE
• Confirma, cancela o edita una cita, o márcala como "No asistió".
• Llama o escribe por WhatsApp a tu cliente desde la misma cita.

AVISOS CUANDO TE AGENDAN
• Recibe una notificación cada vez que alguien agenda o cancela, y abre la cita directo desde el aviso.
• Elige si quieres tus avisos en la app o por WhatsApp.

TUS CLIENTES, ORDENADOS
• Busca por nombre o teléfono y consulta el historial de cada cliente.
• Bloquea a quien no se presenta para que no vuelva a agendar.

SABE CUÁNTO GANAS
• Totales de hoy, de la semana y del mes, sin hacer cuentas a mano.
• Desglose por servicio y comparación entre meses.
• Cartera: revisa lo que te cobraron en línea y solicita tu transferencia.

TU NEGOCIO, A TU MANERA
• Servicios con su precio y su duración.
• Horario laboral (también partido, con hora de comida), intervalo entre citas y confirmación manual.
• Bloquea vacaciones y días libres.
• Galería de trabajos: sube fotos desde la cámara o tu galería para que tus clientes te elijan.

PARA EL DUEÑO DEL NEGOCIO
• Datos y logo del negocio, y tu liga de reservas.
• Da de alta a tus empleados, cada uno con su agenda, sus servicios y su horario.

Tus clientes no necesitan descargar nada: agendan desde el navegador con tu liga o tu código QR y reciben su recordatorio por WhatsApp.

IMPORTANTE: CitasPlus es una herramienta para negocios. Para iniciar sesión necesitas una cuenta de CitasPlus. Si eres empleado, pide al dueño de tu negocio que te dé de alta.

¿Dudas o sugerencias? Escríbenos a contacto@citasplus.net

name: CitronDingle
description: CitronDingle is a casual fruit game. Watch the lineup, then tap each fruit back into the same order. Correct taps add points, wrong taps lose points, and you try to clear more levels before time runs out. In Fruit Rush, fruits move in from the top, left, and right. Tap them to score. Consecutive catches build a combo, a fruit that slips away breaks it, and they move faster as time passes. Daily challenges, achievements, and a fruit gallery are included. The leaderboard stays on this device and is a local leaderboard.

name: City Radio: World FM
description:
Listen to internet radio from cities around the world.

- Stations from 225 countries: switch countries to hear local radio in Japan, Taiwan, the US, Europe and more
- Search stations worldwide by name, such as jazz, news or city pop
- Save your favorite stations and jump back to recently played ones
- Background playback with lock screen info
- No account, no personal data collected

Station data comes from the public Radio Browser directory; audio is served by each station. Some major stations only stream through their own official apps and are not included.

name: Clash Charts
description:
O Clash Charts é a ferramenta analítica definitiva para líderes, colíderes e membros dedicados de Clash of Clans que desejam levar a gestão e o desempenho de suas guerras ao mais alto nível competitivo.

Desenvolvido com foco em velocidade, clareza e inteligência tática, o Clash Charts transforma os dados brutos da API oficial em gráficos visuais intuitivos, relatórios de scouting e métricas detalhadas que o jogo não mostra.

DESTAQUES E FUNCIONALIDADES:

HISTÓRICO DE GUERRAS E CWL
• Acompanhe o histórico de Guerras Clássicas e da Liga de Guerra (CWL).
• Placar completo de estrelas, porcentagem de destruição, taxa de acerto e eficiência de ataques.
• Detalhamento ataque por ataque: exércitos utilizados, estilos de vila atacada e resultado.

SCOUTING E RAIO-X DOS JOGADORES
• Mapeamento automático de todos os membros do seu clã com Centro de Vila (CV/TH).
• Taxa de acerto de 3 estrelas (Hit Rate) e média de destruição por ataque.
• Desempenho defensivo: veja quantas estrelas seus membros costumam conceder aos adversários.
• Identifique os membros mais consistentes e quem precisa de apoio estratégico.

VISUALIZAÇÕES TÁTICAS E GRÁFICOS GAMER
• Gráficos de dispersão e evolução de desempenho ao longo das temporadas.
• Matriz tática de confrontos e árvores de decisão.
• Análise de tendências por modalidade e tamanho de guerra (5v5 até 50v50).

NAVEGAÇÃO INSTANTÂNEA E CACHE LOCAL (0ms)
• Carregamento imediato sem telas de espera para dados já sincronizados.
• Sincronização inteligente em segundo plano para capturar novas guerras em andamento.
• Sistema de backup simples para exportar e restaurar suas tags salvas com um clique.

GESTÃO DE MÚLTIPLOS CLÃS
• Acompanhe clãs principais e clãs de apoio/família em uma interface unificada.
• Agrupe clãs nos filtros para ver estatísticas combinadas de toda a sua comunidade.

FEITO DE JOGADOR PARA JOGADOR
Sem cadastros demorados, sem pedidos de senhas ou dados pessoais. Basta inserir a Tag pública do seu clã ou jogador para começar a analisar imediatamente.

----------------------------------------------------
Isenção de Responsabilidade (Supercell Fan Content Policy):
Este material é não oficial e não é endossado pela Supercell. O Clash Charts é um aplicativo de apoio independente desenvolvido por fãs de acordo com as diretrizes da Política de Conteúdo de Fãs da Supercell. Para mais informações, consulte: https://supercell.com/en/fan-content-policy/

name: Clayway: Clay Cat Platformer
description:
Mocha, the potter's Siamese cat, has one job: bring the three Embers back to the Hearth Kiln before the whole valley turns to stone.

Clayway is a 2D platformer where the ground is soft clay, and you can shape it. Drag the clay into ramps, bridges and stairs to make your own path, then run, claw and pounce across it.

• Shape the world: pull clay up, push it down and watch it settle back into place. Pink clay bounces, spongy clay breaks, cracked ledges crumble.
• 3 worlds, 9 levels: Sunbaked Mesa, Springbloom Valley and Riverworks, each ending in a boss fight: Mudmaw, Cinder Crow and the Glaze Golem.
• Claw combos, Tail Spin, Clay Disc and stomp quakes, plus new skills from the snacks the potter left behind: Pounce, Double Jump and Wall Climb.
• Ride cable cars, ferries, gears and lifts, and hunt for the secret flowers and beads hidden in every chapter.
• Built for touch: virtual stick and buttons, and you can drag the clay with another finger. Game controllers supported.
• Plays offline. No ads. No purchases. In-game text is in English.

name: Cleaning A Yacht
description:
This is a game centered around the cleaning and maintenance of yachts.
Complete all the yacht no hu procedures in sequence: assemble the hull, add fuel, start the navigation operation, clean the hull, and finally complete the shooting for commemoration. Once you have completed all the processes, you can finish one round of the challenge and experience the full enjoyment of maintaining a yacht.

name: ClipAgent
description:
ClipAgent turns your Twitch, Kick and YouTube streams into vertical clips ready for TikTok, Reels and Shorts. ClipAgent for Mac does the heavy lifting: it records, finds the best moments, cuts them and adds captions. This app is your remote control on iPhone.

EVERYTHING ON YOUR MAC, IN YOUR POCKET
• See which channels are recording right now and for how long.
• “Clip now”: save the moment that just happened, or the last 30 s, 1, 2 or 5 minutes.
• Review every clip full screen and approve or discard it with a tap.
• Save it to Photos or share it straight to TikTok, Instagram or anywhere.
• Copy the AI-suggested title and hashtags.
• Gameplays: your long 20–30 minute episodes, with chapters for YouTube.
• Make clips from a link or from a video on your iPhone — your Mac does the rest.
• All your Mac's settings, from your phone too.

INSTANT NOTIFICATIONS
Get notified of every new clip (with “Approve” and “Discard” right in the notification) and when a channel starts recording, even with the app closed.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
The app only talks to your Mac. Your clips, accounts and keys never go anywhere else. Pair with a QR code; each iPhone gets its own key, which you can remove at any time.

Don't have ClipAgent on your Mac yet? Tap “Try without a Mac” and explore the app with a demo.

Requires ClipAgent for Mac (clipagent.stream). For iPhone with iOS 17 or later, in English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch and Polish.

name: Clipeo Rota
description:
Clipeo Rota replaces the paper lineup sheet the coach hands in before every set.

COACH
• Type each player's number in their zone on the court, and rotate the lineup with one tap, in either direction.
• Prepare the sets one after another. Repeating the rotation of an earlier set? Open it and use it for the current set.
• Tap «Mostrar QR» (Show QR): the rotation fills the screen, ready to be scanned from one or two metres away.
• The screen stays on while you prepare the rotation.

REFEREE AND SCORER
• Scan each team's QR code and see both rotations together, every number in its zone on the court.
• The app warns you if a QR code is not valid, belongs to another format, or if the teams handed in different sets.

FORMATS
• Volleyball 6v6, with the official zones I–VI.
• Mini volleyball 3v3 and 4v4.

NO ACCOUNTS, NO CONNECTION
Everything works offline, even in gyms with no signal. There is no sign-up and no advertising, and the app does not collect personal data: it only stores the team code and the player numbers on your device.

The app's interface is in Spanish. Before using it in competition, check that your federation or league accepts the lineup on a screen.

Clipeo Rota is the sister app of Clipeo, volleyball statistics.

name: Clocked In: Career Lessons
description:
Can you talk your way into a job? Which offer letter is actually the best deal once you read the fine print? What do all those first-day HR forms do to your paycheck? And can you catch the paperwork mistakes before they cost someone money?

Clocked In puts students in the middle of those moments. It was created by a classroom teacher and brings four hands-on work and career lessons together in one app, with one home screen and one nickname, and each lesson saves its own progress.

THE FOUR LESSONS
• The Interview: build a one-page resume, answer interview questions while reading the interviewer's reaction, then decide how to respond to a job offer, and see how a polite counteroffer compares with an ultimatum.
• The Offer Letters: open three offer letters, read the fine print, pick one, and live with that choice for twelve months as commutes, bonuses, overtime rules, and surprises play out.
• HR Day One: fill out a W-4, set up direct deposit, choose a 401(k) amount and a health plan before the deadline, then see how those choices play out over your first year.
• Check In / Check Out: fill out clinic paperwork with a fictional identity, check a medical bill and write a check, then work the front desk and catch the mistakes in other people's paperwork.

HOW IT WORKS
• Realistic choices with feedback that explains why, not just right or wrong.
• Every lesson ends with a result or report students can share with their teacher using the share sheet.
• Do the lessons in order or jump to any one. The home screen shows progress for each lesson.
• Resetting one lesson never touches the others.
• Built-in helpers where they matter: a calculator, read aloud, and word tiles in Check In / Check Out.

BUILT FOR THE CLASSROOM
• Students enter a nickname only. No accounts, no email, no sign-in.
• Works fully offline. No ads, no tracking, no data collection.
• Classmates sharing a device can each keep their own progress under their own nickname.

For educational purposes only. This app is not career, HR, financial, tax, medical, or legal advice. Employment laws and workplace rules vary by state and employer. All people, companies, clinics, and places are fictional, and dollar amounts and forms are simplified examples.

name: Cloudkeep Heist
description:
Which vault holds the sapphire? As the thief, read the first archive clue to narrow it down to two. Take a chance on a vault now, or look for a second clue to be sure. Once you have the gem, you still have to slip past the guard and reach an exit.

Switch sides in round two. As the guard, listen for footsteps, set traps at the passages and catch the thief twice. A sound in an empty corridor might be a decoy.

Choose from 16 heroes. Send ice waves across a passage or return to your mirror to shake a pursuer. Practice against a bot, open a private room with a friend or play a ranked match.

The in-game interface is in Turkish.

Terms of Use — https://vps-5386fd3e.vps.ovh.net:9444/heist/kosullar.html

name: Club Director: Football Boss
description:
Club Director Soccer or Football Club Owner is a FC or sim game that allows you to be the club president and control the boardroom and decide everything happens to the club.

It’s a modern football club owner simulator where you’ll sit at the very top of the FC’s hierarchy. As the football director or chairman, every major financial and executive decision will rest on your shoulders. 

Whether you take over a giant FC or create your own soccer club, it takes grit to run a sports club. Take smart decisions, lead from the top and take your club to the top of the leagues and tournaments.

KEY FEATURES OF THE  Club Director - Football Boss: Soccer CLUB OWNER SIMULATOR GAME:

#Boardroom Leadership & Club Strategy:

Running a football club as the chairman is a different kettle of fish to picking matchday squads. Your job as the soccer club director is to shape the long-term success and identity of the FC. You will hire the right manager, purchase the right players, sell the aging ones, and oversee the day-to-day club management without interfering in training sessions. You are not just another football fan, you are at the top management position, and this football tycoon experience will test your business acumen big time. Build a football team capable of winning major honours, or watch careless calls drag your sports management project into turmoil.

#Enjoy Realistic Transfers and Business:

Just like real life, the rival clubs, agents, and players will test your ability to run a football club. Transfers will happen directly across the table and you’ll have to decide smartly as the next season depends on it. Play the role of a seasoned football club director and negotiate loan wage contributions, buyouts, and release clauses. Don’t submit an insulting offer to another football club chairman, as they will walk away without any hesitation whatsoever. Whether you call the role as football director or soccer director - you will get to enjoy interactive negotiation mechanics that bring authentic drama to every single deal.


#Enjoy the Road to Domestic and European Glory:

Climb the League Pyramid with dominance and write an unforgettable club story across an authentic six-tier English Football pyramid. Setting a high bar for club football games, your journey starts anywhere from regional non-league grounds to the grandest European stages. Steer ambitious pro clubs through congested winter fixtures, survive nerve-wracking promotion play-offs, and outsmart rival club owners in this football club simulator game. Your decisions will enable the club to dominate the Swiss-style league phase and claim European silverware. 

#Financial Discipline is the Key for Long-Term Growth:

If you want your club to survive and thrive, keep away from reckless spending. Always keep the budget in mind while signing a new player or manager as a smart club owner or director. 
You must balance weekly wages against lucrative sponsorship packages and stadium expansions. Snap up unattached free agents, suss out transfer-listed bargains, and be wise when you sell academy prospects for massive profit. Financial control is very much essential to build football club legacies that stand the test of time, and it’s your job to ensure that as the club president.

#Enjoy Amazing Gameplay with Live Matchdays and Sleek Mobile Design:
 
Take your seat in the Soccer Club Director VIP box and feel match tension through rapid live text commentary. The fluid gaming will keep you gripped as shots hit the woodwork. Thanks to the masterful dark mode and one-handed navigation, you will not have to deal with messy spreadsheet layouts. Whether you fancy fun football entertainment on the commute or deep fc simulation that allows you to control a football club on mobile, this club boss football game has you sorted.

Step up as the ultimate football or soccer club director, back your manager and players with your wisdom and smart decisions, and lead your squad to the top.

name: CodeGap
description:
Could one copying mistake turn a pickup code into another valid ticket?

CodeGap helps market pickup desks, campus distribution teams and handmade-order handoffs check their existing codes before printing or issuing them. Import your pickup list, trace possible mistakes, try replacements under real lock constraints, and compare candidates at the desk.

For example, swapping the last two characters of 2714 produces 2741. Dropping the leading zero from 0123 produces 123. CodeGap checks whether that result matches another valid code in the current batch and shows the exact error path.

1. Build a pickup batch
Add tickets individually or import UTF-8 CSV with ticket IDs, codes, statuses and descriptions. Codes stay as text, preserving leading zeroes. Review additions, updates, skipped records, duplicate codes and invalid rows before saving.

2. Choose realistic copying errors
Enable missing-character errors, adjacent swaps and directed character substitutions independently. Add a rule such as O to 0, with an explicit choice to add its reverse. Each error path performs one selected operation. Configure allowed characters, code lengths, case sensitivity and ignored display separators for your batch.

3. Inspect connected conflicts
Two aligned code cards show the original code and its mistaken match, highlighting the changed positions. Expand them to inspect ticket details and print or issue status. Unique code pairs, directed relationships and individual error paths have separate counts. Duplicate codes are listed separately. Connected groups bring related codes together for review.

4. Test replacements with locks respected
Printed, issued and manually locked tickets are protected. Select the unprinted tickets you can change, try a single replacement or generate a candidate plan. Every trial checks the full batch again, showing eliminated, new and remaining conflicts, including new matches with a third code. Compare change counts, before-and-after bars and verification status, then review each old and new code before applying. Retired codes retain their ticket history and are reserved against reassignment.

5. Check an entry at the pickup desk
Search by exact code, selected one-step errors or prefix. Enter 274 to find valid codes that could produce that entry after one deletion. Exact matches appear first, alongside other eligible candidates. Read ticket descriptions and compare an entry character by character before confirming the ticket with the person collecting it. Retired-code matches are identified separately.

6. Export and continue your work
Share an updated CSV list or a PDF check report with ticket IDs, old and new codes, statuses, change reasons, check settings and versions. Search or archive batches, resume plan drafts, and restore a full backup containing code histories and plan relationships.

Start with the editable example batch to explore the workflow, then create a batch for your own pickup list.

English and Simplified Chinese interfaces are available on iPhone and iPad in portrait orientation. Core calculations, ticket records, plans and queries run locally. Feedback and optional contact details can be saved on the device. You choose the destination when exporting or sharing.

name: COLREGs Trainer
description:
Study the International Regulations for Preventing Collisions at Sea (COLREGs) the way you will use them on the bridge: read the rule, recognise the vessel, make the call.

COLREGs Trainer is built for deck cadets, OOW candidates, yachtmaster students and watchkeepers who want to understand the Rules of the Road, not just memorise them. Every answer explains why and shows the rule it comes from.

EVERY RULE, MADE CLEAR (FREE)
• All 41 International rules, Parts A to F
• A plain-English explanation and key points for each rule
• Side-by-side comparisons of rules that are easy to confuse, such as underway vs making way and NUC vs RAM
• Search by rule number or topic

MISTAKES THAT COME BACK (FREE)
• A question you miss returns until you answer it correctly on two different days
• Mastery for each rule shows what to revise next
• Your progress is saved on your device

PRACTICE QUESTIONS
• 205 questions in six banks: rules, navigation lights, day shapes, sound signals, rule recall and mixed
• Short sets of 5, 10 or 20, or a quick mixed set
• Practice by rule when one rule keeps tripping you up

LIGHTS AND SHAPES
• Navigation lights for 11 vessel types, drawn at night with every light labelled
• The day shapes each vessel shows, hoisted on its mast, with the rule that requires them
• Recognition drills that ask what you are looking at

SOUND SIGNALS
• Manoeuvring, warning and restricted-visibility signals played as short and prolonged blasts
• A visual pattern of each signal, and a drill that asks you to name it

BRIDGE ENCOUNTERS
• 56 written scenarios with a plot of the situation: head-on, crossing, overtaking and more
• Choose your action, then see the reasoning and the rule behind it

RULE RECALL
• Fill-in-the-gap drills that train you to recall the wording of each rule

EXAM REHEARSAL
• Timed papers: 20 questions in 30 minutes or 40 questions in 60 minutes
• Flag questions to come back to, then review every answer at the end

ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
• Signal of the day and Quick practice widgets

AT SEA, OFFLINE
• Everything works without a connection
• No ads and no tracking
• No account needed; signing in is optional

FREE AND PRO
All 41 rules, comparisons, search, mistake review and progress are free, along with 10 questions in each bank, the first 10 bridge scenarios, half of the lights, shapes and sound signals, the first drill of each type and rule recall for Rules 5 to 8.

A one-time COLREGs Trainer Pro purchase unlocks all 205 questions, all 56 scenarios, every lights, shapes and sounds entry and drill, rule recall for every rule, and timed exam papers, plus questions added in future updates. No subscription, nothing renews.

COLREGs Trainer covers the International COLREGs, not US Inland or local rules. It is a study aid, not an official publication, and it does not replace the regulations, your training establishment or your examiner.

name: Comfy Rooms: Cozy Decor No Ads
description:
A cozy decorating puzzle with zero ads. Ever.

Every room starts white, like a little paper model. Pick a piece from your tray, carry it onto its white twin, and watch it fill with color. Piece by piece, the whole diorama comes to life.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• No ads, not even "optional" ones
• No timers, no lives, no fails: take all the time you want
• Plays offline, anywhere: plane, train, bed
• Real 3D miniatures: turn the room with a finger, pinch to look closer
• Gentle hints whenever you're stuck
• Soft sounds and tiny moving details: a swaying plant, a flickering candle
• Your progress is always saved

15 HANDMADE ROOMS
A reading nook, a tiny kitchen, a sunny bedroom, a castle chamber, a living room, a spa bathroom, a kid's room, a balcony garden, a pirate ship cabin, an art studio, a greenhouse, a wizard's tower, a rainy day den, a winter cabin and a bedtime room under the stars. Each one has its own little twist: twin pieces, things that stack, things that hang.

FAIR AND SIMPLE
Play the first four rooms for free. Love it? Unlock all 15 rooms with one purchase, yours forever. No subscription, no coins, no energy.

Short, calm sessions, perfect before bed. Make yourself comfy.

name: Coral Relics: Reef Mahjong
description:
A flash of pink beneath a tile gives away the edge of a shell. To reach it, tap two matching tiles with nothing on top of them. Your pair can sit across the board or at different heights. Uncover every treasure to finish the dive, even if a few tiles are still on the sand.

Your first find in Coral Relics: Reef Mahjong is a Pearl Shell in Sunlit Reef. From there, the Ocean Map leads through Shipwreck Bay, Ancient Ruins, Crystal Grotto and Giant Kelp Forest. Across 50 dives, there are 28 treasures to discover. Visit the Treasure Room to see where you found your Brass Spyglass or follow a clue to a piece your shelves are missing.

Each dive starts with three hearts. A mismatch costs one. When a pair is hard to spot, ask for a hint, undo a move or use your free shuffle. Spend coins from completed dives on a Heart Pearl to restore a heart, a Tide Shell for an extra shuffle or a Twin Star to clear a pair.

Play offline and pick up where you left off. Your current dive and collection are saved on your iPhone.

name: CoStint
description:
CoStint helps healthcare travelers explore furnished housing near their assignments.

Browse rooms and entire homes, save listing links on your iPhone, and plan your dates and monthly budget with an offline trip planner. Sign in to access your marketplace workspace, saved housing, applications and messages.

CoStint reviews people, properties, healthcare credentials and assignment details through separate verification workflows. Each badge reflects a specific review status; it is not a guarantee of safety, suitability or availability. Read listing details and confirm arrangements before booking.

An internet connection is required for live listings and account features. Your on-device trip plan and shortlist remain available offline. Availability and terms may change.

CoStint is a housing marketplace, not a healthcare service or an emergency service.

name: CowTrax
description: CowTrax is the Test Day app for dairy herd improvement (DHI) organizations. Technicians record cows and milk weights in the parlor, and the finished Test Day goes straight to the organization's lab.

name: Cozy Flower Den
description:
Step into a quiet greenhouse den where every flower has its own temperament — and every bloom is an experiment you solve with your hands.

Cozy Flower Den is a calm, original puzzle-simulation game with three hands-on botanical experiments. There are no timers shouting at you and no walls of text: you read the flowers themselves — the way a petal droops, the ripple that runs through a bud, the shimmer of vapor leaving a leaf.

BLOOM CLIMATE CHAMBER
Warmth spreads through a living temperature field inside a glass chamber. Slide glass partitions, draw the insulation film, open the ventilation shutters, and spend a handful of heat and cool sources wisely. Each bud asks for its own climate story — a cool rest, a gentle warm-up, a humid night — and blooms only when every phase is met. Rush the change and the petals feel the shock.
• 40 handcrafted levels across eight chapters
• Real heat diffusion, drafts, condensation and day–night cycles
• Scored on Climate Stability, Flower Health and Bloom Quality

DORMANCY KNOCK
A sensitive bud sleeps in a mossy alcove. Tap, double tap, press and hold, release at the right moment, or leave a delayed second touch. Too fast and it tires; too rough and it closes; listen to its rhythm and it opens petal by petal.
• 30 levels featuring eight sensitive flowers, each with its own temperament
• Stimulus, fatigue and recovery that respond to how you touch
• Scored on Gesture Accuracy, Rhythm Control, Recovery Efficiency and Bud Condition

STOMA WINDOW
Look through the lens at a single pore on a leaf. Spread two fingers to part the guard cells — or drag one cell with a single finger — and balance the carbon dioxide drifting in against the water vapor escaping. Bright mornings, dry afternoons, sudden wind: the weather keeps changing, and so does the perfect opening.
• 30 levels of shifting light, humidity, temperature and wind
• Aperture, CO₂ intake, water loss and cell turgor simulated in real time
• Scored on Gas Exchange, Water Conservation, Aperture Control and Cell Stability

YOUR OWN COZY BOTANICAL SANCTUARY
Return to the den between experiments. Record every flower you coax into bloom in the Botanical Journal, visit the Daily Specimen for a fresh challenge each day, and replay any tutorial whenever you like.

FEATURES
• Three distinct experiments, each with its own simulation, controls and look
• 100 handcrafted levels, every one verified solvable
• A new Daily Specimen every day
• Botanical Journal with 16 original flower species
• Interactive tutorials and a gentle first-visit walkthrough
• Original illustrations, sounds and procedural flower animation
• Built natively for iPhone, including iPhone Duo open and closed layouts, small and large screens, and landscape
• VoiceOver labels, Dynamic Type, Reduced Motion and Touch Assistance options

Cozy Flower Den — A Little World for Every Bloom.

name: Crateleaf
description: ପ୍ରତ୍ୟେକ ବକ୍ସକୁ ଏକ ସ୍ଥାୟୀ ନମ୍ବର ଦିଅନ୍ତୁ ଏବଂ ଭିତରର ଜିନିଷଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଲେଖନ୍ତୁ। କୌଣସି ଜିନିଷ କେଉଁ ବକ୍ସରେ ଏବଂ କେଉଁ ସ୍ଥାନରେ ଅଛି ତୁରନ୍ତ ଖୋଜନ୍ତୁ। ଘର, ଗ୍ୟାରେଜ କିମ୍ବା ଭଣ୍ଡାର ପାଇଁ ସ୍ଥାନ ଚିହ୍ନଟ କରନ୍ତୁ, ନେଇବା ଓ ଫେରାଇବା ରେକର୍ଡ ରଖନ୍ତୁ, ସମଗ୍ର ସୂଚୀ ରପ୍ତାନି କରନ୍ତୁ। ସମସ୍ତ ତଥ୍ୟ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଫୋନରେ ସାଇତି ରହେ; ଇଣ୍ଟରନେଟ୍ ବିନା ବ୍ୟବହାର କରିପାରିବେ।

name: Creo: Creative Practice
description:
Creo gives you one small creative exercise a day. Caption a picture, find ten uses for a paperclip, finish a story in three lines. Most take about three minutes.

Keep the ideas that come out of it. Write them down, tag them, group them into collections, and see which ones connect.

Take the Creative DNA test: 20 questions from the International Personality Item Pool, a public research question bank. It describes how you approach creative work, not how good you are, and your answers never leave your phone.

Share a post or a challenge answer with the community if you want to, or keep everything private. Run a brainstorm with friends, keep a streak together, and record a timestamped fingerprint of an idea when you want proof of when you wrote it.

Creo is free. No ads, no subscriptions, no AI writing for you.

name: Cristal Sistema
description:
Cristal es la app para las empresas de limpieza y mantenimiento y para todo su equipo.

Para empezar, escribí el código que te dio tu empresa. Para crear tu empresa, tocá «Crear mi empresa» y pasale el código a tu equipo: en un minuto está andando.

Para registrar el trabajo:
• Registrá la entrada y la salida en cada lugar con un toque. La app reconoce el lugar por la ubicación del celular.
• Mirá cuánto llevás en el lugar donde estás.
• Registrá aunque no tengas internet: el registro queda guardado y se manda solo cuando vuelve la señal.
• Pedí los insumos que te faltan.
• Mandá una foto de cómo quedó un lugar o de algo que falta.
• Mirá tus horas del mes.

Desde el panel, adentro de la misma app:
• Mirá en vivo quién está trabajando y dónde.
• Sumá a las personas nuevas y mirá sus horas.
• Recibí los pedidos de insumos y los avisos del equipo en el celular.

Tu ubicación: la app la usa solo para confirmar que estás en tu lugar de trabajo, cuando registrás la entrada o la salida y mientras tenés la app abierta. Con la app cerrada no la usa.

name: CubeCoach
description:
CubeCoach hjälper dig att öva på att lösa en 3×3-kub med nybörjarmetoden. Fyll i färgen på var och en av de 54 rutorna eller skriv dragföljden som du blandade kuben med. Appen visar kubens läge i 3D och kontrollerar bland annat färgantal, bitarnas orientering och paritet.

Följ sju steg från det vita korset till de sista gula kantbitarna. För varje steg ser du hur många bitar som redan är klara. Appen markerar nästa steg och visar ett kort råd.

Formelbiblioteket har 18 algoritmer i sex grupper, från grundläggande dragföljder till sista lagret. Spela upp en algoritm på kuben, gå vidare ett drag i taget eller börja om. Du kan kopiera dragföljden och markera vilka algoritmer du har övat på.

Tidtagaren skapar nya blandningar på enheten. Aktivera en inspektion på 15 sekunder om du vill öva med den. Spara lösningar och följ bästa tid samt snitt över fem och tolv försök. I historiken kan du lägga till två sekunder, markera ett försök som DNF eller ta bort en tid.

CubeCoach fungerar offline och sparar tider, inställningar och övningsmarkeringar på enheten. Gränssnittet finns på engelska och förenklad kinesiska.

name: Cue Scroll: Script Prompter
description:
Keep your script in view and return to a marked passage. Paste text or choose a UTF-8 TXT file from Files, add cues and open the reading view.

Set scroll speed, text size and line spacing. Pause, jump to a cue and resume when ready. Mirror only the reading text while keeping controls readable, or choose right-to-left text direction. Reading positions stay tied to the text across layout changes. After an interruption or reopening, scrolling stays paused until you explicitly resume.

Keep up to 10 scripts and 100 cues per script. Each script is limited to 100,000 user-perceived characters and 500 KiB of UTF-8 text. Keep an editing draft and up to 10 undo steps. Imported originals keep their UTF-8 BOM, when present, and line breaks. Editing and TXT export do not overwrite the file you chose outside the app.

Export the current script as TXT, or share a JSON backup with scripts, cues, reading settings, positions, editing drafts, undo history and referenced originals. Restoring replaces all current local records after confirmation and validation; it does not merge them. Local originals referenced by current work and undo are limited to 5 MiB in total, saved record data to 16 MiB and a backup to 32 MiB.

Deleting local app data leaves external originals and copies already shared untouched. You choose export destinations through the iOS share sheet. Files providers and destinations may use the network under your settings.

Automatic scrolling runs at the speed you set. Cue Scroll does not record video or follow your voice. Paid download with no in-app purchases, subscription, account, advertising or analytics. Script processing and storage stay on your device; your text is not automatically translated or uploaded.

name: Curbhunt: Garage Sales
description:
Curbhunt shows the garage sales, yard sales and moving sales around you on one map, with what's open today first.

FIND SALES NEAR YOU
• The map opens on your area. Curbhunt only asks for your precise location when you tap "Use my location".
• Today, Tomorrow, This weekend or any dates you choose. "Today" means still open now, judged in the sale's own time zone.
• Filter by what's for sale: furniture, clothes, toys, tools, electronics, books and more, plus free stuff.
• Pull up the list to see every sale on the map, sorted by distance or date.

EVERY SALE, CLEARLY
• Photos, the days and hours of each day, what's for sale and a short note from the host.
• Multi-day sales show the next day with its own hours, never one day's hours for all of them.
• Save the sales you like and find them again in Saved.

POST YOUR OWN SALE FOR FREE
• Type your address, place the pin on the exact spot, add your days, hours and photos.
• Your exact address is hidden from shoppers until the day before your sale. Until then they only see the general area.
• Edit, cancel or delete your sale whenever you want.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Sign in with your email and a one-time code. No passwords.
• No ads and no tracking.
• Delete your account and your sales from the app at any time.

In English and Spanish. Made for iPhone, including iPhone Duo.

Something wrong with a listing? Report it from the sale's page and we'll take a look.

name: CyberTent
description:
Designed for iPhone Duo in tent mode.

Fold your phone and set it on your desk. Turn the outward-facing screen into a nameplate, status sign or celebration card. CyberTent is built around the Duo tent experience and also works with an ordinary iPhone on a stand.

CARDS FOR THE MOMENT
Choose paper, acrylic and conference-red nameplates. Adjust names, organizations, roles, spacing, alignment and logos. Birthday, coffee and gift cards bring a personal message into a real scene. Template identities are fictional. Favorite, reorder and revisit cards; display in portrait or landscape with hideable controls and an optional two-way layout on one screen.

FOCUS AND REST
Set focus, short breaks, long breaks and a finite number of rounds. Pause and resume, use optional continuous flow, and review local daily records. A cat or dog can accompany your session. Optional notifications and Live Activities show timing subject to system settings. Start a focus session, display a chosen card or open your pet through Shortcuts. Changing the displayed card keeps your timer.

QR CODES AND YOUR OWN WORDS
Generate a code from text or a link, or import an image from Photos or Files. On-device detection suggests a crop; choose among multiple codes or adjust it yourself. Add your own title and instructions. QR content is never opened automatically.

TELEPROMPTER
Keep multiple scripts with independent reading positions and settings. Adjust font size, speed, mirroring, current-line highlighting and an optional opening countdown. Jump to a paragraph; tap the text, use the persistent pause button or press Space to pause. Leaving the app pauses scrolling. No camera required.

DESKTOP COMPANIONS
Name your cat and dog, choose coats and accessories, and enjoy six expressions, gentle actions and tap reactions. Add a clock or use focus companionship. Reduce Motion and energy-saving options limit animation. Moon blocks (jiaobei) generate two random faces and keep recent results locally.

STANDBY AND SHARING
Add widgets yourself, then follow the current card, pin a public card or show focus. QR images and logos need separate permission; scripts stay private. iOS controls widget layout, refreshing and night colors.

Export editable templates or preview images through Files. Sharing starts with fictional examples; choose each original field or image before exporting. Importing creates a new private card. Full local backups support merge or replacement and keep a recovery copy.

English, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese interfaces. Saved content stays as written. No account, ads, in-app purchases, subscriptions or analytics SDK. App content is processed locally; exported files and device backups follow your chosen provider and system settings.

Full-screen display and locked-screen StandBy are separate experiences. CyberTent does not take over StandBy or independently control two screens. Night colors may affect QR scanning. For longer sessions, choose brightness and energy-saving settings to suit your device.

name: Cyclical Abundance
description:
Your capacity changes. Your worth does not.

Cyclical Abundance is a reflective companion by writer and educator Natalie O'Donnell. It invites you to understand energy, money and worth as currents that move through seasons, rather than stock to be hoarded or chased. Like the year, like the moon, your days move through four phases: Void, Spark, Radiance and Harvest.

THE DAILY COMPASS
A short morning or evening check-in. Notice your energy, clarity and capacity, name your emotions and what you need, and choose the quarter of the compass that feels like today, or let a few gentle questions suggest one. The phase is always yours to choose and change. Each check-in closes with a reflection to carry with you.

YOUR JOURNAL
Write freely or begin from a seasonal prompt. Every entry stays on your phone and is never shared.

YOUR PATTERNS
Soft observations of how your energy, clarity and capacity move over time. Observations, never verdicts: there are no scores and no streaks.

EXPLORE
- Phase pages on the direction, element and season of each quarter
- Essays such as "Currency as current", "The biology of worth" and "The art of receiving"
- A library of practices and reflective prompts
- The Abundance Compass, a map of the currents that sustain you: energy, time, attention, rest, connection, creativity, material and ecological resources
- Today's Moon, with symbolic lunar details you can turn on or off

AN OPTIONAL CYCLE LENS
If it is meaningful to you, turn on the cycle lens to see seasonal correspondences on each phase and add an optional question to your check-in. No dates are recorded, and it never chooses a phase for you.

SEASONAL GUIDES (PREMIUM)
Four in-depth guides, one for each phase, with practices for money, time and relationships, ecological and ancestral reflections, a seasonal ritual and journal prompts. The opening and first practice of every guide are free. The full guides are included with an optional Premium subscription, billed monthly or yearly through your Apple account at the price shown in the app. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple account settings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign in. Your check-ins, journal, maps and settings stay on your device, and you can erase everything in Settings with one tap.

A reflective tool, not medical, psychological or financial advice. Cyclical Abundance does not diagnose or measure anything, and it is not a substitute for care from a qualified professional.

Terms of Use: https://469130c8-dd10-4d56-929d-10de74c82472.appandrunning.com/terms

name: DaoShi Reminder
description:
DaoShi Reminder brings everyday reminders and simple daily records into one clear workspace.

PLAN YOUR DAY
See what needs doing today, review completed items, and preview tomorrow without accidentally changing future tasks.

BUILD A ROUTINE
Choose the weekdays yourself. Set a daily reminder, several fixed times, or an interval during the day for drinking water, taking a walk, and other routines.

LOOK BACK IN THE CALENDAR
Quickly choose a month or year. See which days are complete and which still have unfinished reminders.

RECORD YOUR WEIGHT
Enter your weight when completing a weight reminder. View your records and changes over time.

KEEP YOUR DEVICES IN SYNC
Use the app on iPhone, iPad, and native macOS. When iCloud is available, reminders and records sync through your Apple Account’s private iCloud database. The developer does not read your private iCloud records.

Your records remain available on the device. No app account is required. No advertising or third-party analytics.

Support: daoshitixing@mayn.cc

name: Darwaza TV
description:
Darwaza TV brings your Darwaza TV subscription to iPhone, iPad and Apple TV. Sign in with your activation code and enjoy live channels, movies and series in a clean, fast app made for both touch and the Siri Remote.

LIVE TV
• Channels organised in packages, with logos and channel numbers
• Switch channels instantly with the remote (up / down)
• Channel list over the video while you watch
• Favorites and your own channel order
• Fast search across all channels

MOVIES & SERIES
• Browse by category, or see everything in one place
• Seasons and episodes with details, cast and ratings
• Continue Watching — pick up exactly where you stopped
• Favorites for movies and series
• Search movies and series

PLAYBACK
• Built-in subtitles plus online subtitle files
• Choose subtitle language and size
• Two video engines: Apple player or VLC, for wider format support
• Audio and subtitle track selection

YOUR WAY
• Reorder, hide or lock categories
• Parental lock with PIN
• Works on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV

IMPORTANT
Darwaza TV is a player for subscribers of the Darwaza TV service. An active subscription and activation code are required. The app does not include any channels or content by itself; all content is provided by the service linked to your activation code.

name: Datathesys Operator
description:
Datathesys Operator è l’app per consultare e gestire gli impianti di automazione realizzati con la Datathesys Automation Suite: serre, campi agricoli, edifici, linee di produzione.

• Aggiungi un impianto inserendo il suo indirizzo o inquadrando il QR code dallo Studio
• Entra con le credenziali del tuo impianto
• Pagine dell’impianto con valori in tempo reale, grafici e scene
• Allarmi attivi e storico
• Notifiche push degli allarmi (con il servizio Datathesys Cloud)
• Più impianti nella stessa app
• Protezione con Face ID o codice del dispositivo; i comandi verso l’impianto chiedono sempre conferma

L’app è gratuita e serve a chi ha un impianto Datathesys: senza un impianto e le credenziali fornite dal tuo installatore non mostra dati.

Assistenza: support@datathesys.it

name: DaVinci Disc Golf Simulator
description:
DaVinci Disc Golf Simulator brings aerospace-grade 6-Degree-of-Freedom (6-DOF) flight dynamics, hardware launch monitor analytics, and parametric disc geometry to players, coaches, and mold designers on iPhone and iPad.

Built on a Dormand-Prince RK4(5) adaptive numerical integrator and a parametric cross-section synthesizer, DaVinci calculates real aerodynamic lift, drag, pitching moment, gyroscopic precession, and off-axis torque (OAT) wobble damping directly from physical disc geometry and release mechanics—not generic flight-number curves.

6-DOF NEWTON-EULER FLIGHT PHYSICS & OAT WOBBLE DAMPING
Simulate complete 3D trajectories with instant telemetry for Total Carry Distance, Max Apex Height, Lateral Drift, Ground Roll, Landing Velocity, Flight Time, and Speed-to-Spin Advance Ratio. Models time-dependent nutation damping w(t) = w0 * exp(-t / 0.65), parasitic form-drag penalties, and high-speed pitching-moment perturbations caused by off-axis release wobble.

2,400+ PDGA APPROVED MOLDS WITH LIVE SYNC
Search, filter, and simulate over 2,400 PDGA-certified disc molds across 166+ brands, or dial in custom caliper geometry (Outer Diameter, Total Height, Rim Depth, Rim Width, Rim Configuration, and Mass). Stay up to date with newly approved PDGA molds via one-tap, privacy-safe catalog updates.

LAUNCH MONITOR CSV INTEGRATION (TECHDISC & DISC SENSE READY)
Import multi-throw CSV sessions directly from TechDisc, Disc Sense, or generic launch monitors. Overlay every recorded throw in a unified multi-flight comparison table and 3D trajectory canvas, or load individual throws directly into the live release controls. Includes a built-in sample launch monitor dataset so you can explore pro, intermediate, nose-up, and high-wobble release profiles right out of the box.

6-DOF BIOMECHANICAL RELEASE COACH & DISC RECOMMENDER
Unlock hidden distance at your exact current arm speed—without throwing harder. DaVinci's coordinate-ascent optimization engine analyzes your release across four biomechanical dimensions:
• Nose Angle Attack (eliminating airbrake stall)
• Hyzer & Swing Plane Alignment (maximizing full S-curve glide)
• Launch Vector Elevation (optimizing carry height vs. wind)
• Spin Efficiency & OAT Wobble Suppression (stabilizing high-speed turn)
Get quantified yardage gains (+ft / +m) for each mechanical adjustment, plus 4 personalized PDGA mold recommendations tailored to your unmodified natural release tendencies.

PHYSICS-DERIVED FLIGHT RATINGS & DIVISION PRESETS
Compare manufacturer-claimed Speed, Glide, Turn, and Fade numbers against physics-corrected flight ratings computed for your actual release velocity, spin rate, altitude, temperature, and headwind/tailwind conditions. Includes one-tap PDGA division presets for MPO, MA1, MA2, MA3, Novice/Junior, and FPO–FA4 in both RHBH/LHFH and RHFH/LHBH spin directions.
