PARAMETRIC CAD CROSS-SECTION SYNTHESIZER
Inspect 2D disc cross-sections with calculated internal volume, plastic mass, center of gravity, moments of inertia (Ixx, Izz), and aerodynamic baseline coefficients (Cd0, Cl0, Cm0), with .DXF and .SVG profile export.

100% OFFLINE-FIRST, PRIVATE, ONE-TIME PURCHASE
No subscriptions, no accounts, no ads, and zero personal data collection.

Trademark Notice: TechDisc and Disc Sense are trademarks of their respective owners and are referenced solely to describe CSV telemetry file compatibility. Fused Manufacturing, LLC is not affiliated with or endorsed by TechDisc, Disc Sense, or the PDGA.

name: Day by Dot: Habit Tracker
description:
A dot for each day. A note when you need one.

Day by Dot is a private habit journal for iPhone. Track habits you want to build or reduce, record your answers in a week of daily dots, and look back at the patterns that matter to you.

MAKE PROGRESS YOUR WAY
Choose Build for something you want to do more often, or Reduce for something you want to do less. Record Yes, No, or Skip. Revisit earlier days, set a chain goal, and focus on today's or yesterday's unanswered habits for a shorter check-in.

KEEP THE STORY BEHIND EACH DAY
Add notes alongside your answers. Search your writing, browse habit descriptions, and remember what made a day different. Notes are saved separately from your Yes or No answer.

SEE PATTERNS OVER TIME
Explore bar charts, rings, and weekday patterns across weeks, months, and years. Compare a habit with its previous period, or use the weekly and monthly Scoreboard to see the full calendar period. Trends measures favorable answers among answered days; Scoreboard includes unmarked days and excludes skipped days.

ORGANIZE YOUR ROUTINES
Group habits with tags and keep a separate order for each tag. Set local reminders for habits or groups. See today's recorded count in a Home Screen widget, and use Shortcuts to open a check-in or record an answer.

MAKE YOUR JOURNAL FEEL LIKE YOURS
Choose from seven themes, including Night. Protect access with an optional journal passcode and Face ID or Touch ID on supported devices. Enabling journal locking hides the widget's counts.

KEEP YOUR FILES IN YOUR HANDS
Save a complete JSON backup, a CSV table, or an Excel XML workbook to your chosen Files location. Restore from a Day by Dot JSON backup after confirming replacement. Saving to iCloud Drive is a manual file operation, not automatic journal sync. Exported files contain readable journal content.

Local journaling works offline and needs no account. There are no ads, subscriptions, or analytics SDKs. The developer does not receive your journal. Requires iOS 17 or later.

name: Dayquill
description:
Dayquill helps you paint time into a day you actually want to live—lightweight, beautiful, and fully offline.
TODAY
See tasks, schedules, habit check-ins, and focus minutes in one calm view. Start the day with a greeting, date, and a short quote.
PLAN NOTEBOOKS
Group goals into notebooks—exam prep, travel lists, monthly themes. Use built-in templates or save your own. Track progress as you go.
HABITS
Boolean or numeric check-ins, streaks, calendar heat, and optional reminders. Pin habits to Today for one-tap logging.
FOCUS
Pomodoro, countdown, or stopwatch. Optional on-device ambient sounds, screen-keep-on, and a clear focus history for the week.
PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Data stays on your iPhone or iPad
• No account, no cloud sync, no tracking SDKs
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no membership
• Uninstalling the app deletes everything
Dayquill is for people who want structure without noise—plan gently, check in kindly, and focus when it matters.

name: DEAD HOUR
description:
Survive a city overrun by the undead in DEAD HOUR, a first-person zombie survival game.

Fight walkers, runners, crawlers, spitters and brutes. Explore the city, search buildings for supplies and use vehicles to escape or fight back.

Play campaign stages or try Deathmatch, Waves and Boss Fight modes. Complete weekly missions to earn points and unlock weapons, character looks and cosmetic skins. Tournament scores and progress are stored on your device; online leaderboards are not currently available.

Use the on-screen controls to move, aim, shoot, reload and interact.

name: Deep Anvil
description:
You wake in a forge deep inside a mountain. An anvil, a furnace, one cart of coal, and a stone gate shut in seven layers. A voice comes through the brass pipe in the wall. That gate, it says, only opens from within.

Brynn the smith picks up the hammer.

■ One more, or enough
· Every strike uses the success rate shown on screen
· A failure may crack the weapon, and a weapon full of cracks shatters when it cracks again
· Every five levels comes a crux: pass it and the weapon changes form and its cracks close
· Go into the deep now, or strike once more: that is yours to decide. The weapon comes back with you

■ Six kinds, 366 forms
· Pick, sword, axe, spear, maul, dagger
· A lump of iron grows into a new form every five levels, through fire, frost and lightning, until starlight becomes its edge
· Every form you reach is kept in the Armory. Fill a page and you earn scrap

■ The weight of the hammer
· Each strike is three blows on the anvil, and every success in a row makes the next blow heavier
· String successes together and the forge heats up into Fever Time, when every strike is free
· Blows out of nowhere, and Chance Time: after three failures in a row the next strike cannot fail
· Star Catch: strike while the star is in the middle band for a little more chance

■ A day at the forge
· Surprises turn up while you work: Golden Rain, the Lucky Box, a Rush Order, the Anvil's Breath and the Wandering Smith's Commission
· Gather twelve kinds of tools in your pouch, like Lucky Charcoal, a Warding Charm and the Sure Blow, and use them when it counts
· At the end of each day, improve the workshop, dig through the heap of broken weapons and spin Today's Wheel
· Every day brings a gift and three tasks

■ The Deep
· Break the first gate and the old galleries open. Between every two gates five creatures bar the way, a chief at the end
· The weapon is you. The stronger it is, the more health and power you have; from +30 each kind has its own special attack, from +150 the Awakened Blow
· Fights play out by themselves. Your chance to win is on the screen before you go
· After every creature you choose: climb on, or go back. Lose, and the weapon takes a crack
· Thirty kinds, from the Cave Goblin to the Workshop Golem, the Orc Warlord, the Ember Lich, the Demon King and the Heartfire Dragon. Two hidden ones wait in the Endless Anvil

■ Seven gates
· Each gate that breaks gives back one thing that was forgotten. A name, a craft, the people, and what lies past them
· There are two endings. After an ending the Endless Anvil opens, where you collect the six legends

■ Good to know
· Free to start. Ads for extra coal or scrap are watched only when you choose, and a short ad sometimes plays when you go to sleep after a day
· No account needed. Progress is saved on this device
· Text and voices in Korean, English, Japanese and Simplified Chinese
· Play in portrait or landscape

In-app purchases: Anvil Regular (monthly subscription), and packs of coal, scrap and tools. The whole game can be finished without buying anything.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://meteorstudio.co.kr/games/privacy

name: Dekita! Kids PE AI Coach
description:
PE "I did it!" moments, at home.

Dekita! helps children aged 5–10 and their parents practise jump rope, running and the back hip circle. Film with your iPhone and the AI watches the movement and gently points out one thing to fix.

■ Demos that move
A boy or girl demo shows each move step by step (1→2→3→4), so children see exactly what to do.

■ AI counting and scoring

name: Dhru Flux
description:
Dhru Flux is the repair shop in your pocket. Check devices in, follow every repair, ring up sales and run your working day from one app.

REPAIRS
• Check in a repair step by step: customer, device, what is wrong, condition and consent
• Follow each repair from received to handed over, with notes, photos, parts, tasks and quality checks

SALES
• Search or scan to add products and services, then take cash or card

YOUR TEAM

STOCK

name: Diffly - 文件对比
description:
Diffly 是一款为开发者与专业用户打造的横屏文本对比工具。导入两个文件或直接粘贴两段文本，即可并排查看差异、快速定位每一处改动。

• 支持 TXT、Markdown、JSON、CSV 及 Swift、JavaScript、Python、C/C++ 等常见代码文本（单文件最大 5 MB、50,000 行）
• 行级 Myers 差异计算，修改行支持字符级高亮

• 忽略空白、忽略大小写，实时重算差异
• 本机保存最近 30 组对比记录，随时重新打开
• 查找与替换，支持撤销上次替换
• 字体、字号与行高可调

Diffly 专为横屏设计，竖屏时会提示旋转设备。所有对比都在设备本地完成，不会上传你的文件内容。

name: Dig Pixels Together
description:
One hole. A world of pixels. Your next great drop.

Dig Pixels Together is a colorful arcade puzzle game about matching, timing and going deeper. Drag to aim, release to drop and match the colors below. Plan around the next piece, keep streaks alive and turn a careful move into a big clear.

MAKE EACH DROP COUNT
Read the pile, spot a match and keep the action moving. Short match goals give you something to work toward during a solo run, with Power Pixels to earn along the way. In dig mode, well-aimed matches charge your battery and help you keep digging.

POWER UP YOUR DIG
Unlock Power Pixels that clear a color, drill through layers, crush blocks, repair the board or unleash the Mega Pixel. Try different combinations and discover what they can do together.

DIG YOUR WAY
Play privately on your device. Players 18 and older can also opt into the shared world to add their runs to the world's progress, explore shared finds and rankings, and see who reached a discovery first. Daily goals and rewards work in either mode.

A PILE WITH PERSONALITY
Every pixel has a face. The blocks react to the action, an announcer celebrates big moments and procedural music follows the pace of play. Power Pixels bring their own bursts of spectacle.

KEEP BUILDING YOUR BEST RUN
Work toward daily goals, collect daily rewards and spend the bytes you earn on upgrades. Watch your depth and best streak grow as you learn where to place the next piece. Color-blind colors are available in settings.

Aim carefully. Keep the streak alive. Dig a little deeper together.

DofusFM is the free companion app for Dofus 1.29 and Dofus Retro players. Practice smithmagic, plan your gear and look up anything in the game — all in one place, without risking a single kama.

name: Dog Food Check
description:
Your dog just grabbed something off the table, or you'd like to share your snack. Ask Dog Food Check and know in seconds.

Hold the button and say it, type it, or take a photo of the plate or the ingredient label. You get a clear verdict: OK, A little, Not OK or Ask your vet, with the reason in plain words.

WHAT YOU GET
• A clear verdict and why, written for dog owners
• What an amount means for a small, medium and large dog, with the chocolate maths done for you
• Ingredient labels read for you: xylitol, onion, garlic, raisins and other risky ingredients are flagged
• Up to five follow-up questions in the same chat

WHEN YOUR DOG ALREADY ATE IT
The answer starts with what to do now, a short list of what to have ready when you call, and a button that finds an emergency vet near you on a map, wherever you are.

YOUR QUESTIONS STAY YOURS
No account. Your questions and answers are kept on your iPhone and in your own iCloud, so your other devices show the same history.

TRY IT FREE
Your first two questions are free. Premium lets you ask as often as you need, with photos, labels and follow-ups, as a monthly or yearly subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless it is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage it in your Apple Account settings.

Answers are general information written by AI following veterinary toxicology references. Dog Food Check is not a vet. If your dog seems unwell or has eaten something dangerous, call your vet or an emergency vet straight away.

name: Dog Shelter
description:
Dog Shelter is a free, offline tool for small animal shelters. It replaces paper notebooks with one place for your dogs and cats, your supplies and your money, and shows you in advance when something is about to run out.

There is no account, no sign-in and no internet connection needed. Everything is stored on your iPhone.

GET STARTED IN A MINUTE
Answer three questions: the name and photo of your shelter, how many places you have for dogs and cats, and your currency.

HOME
• See how many dog and cat places are taken
• See how many days your food, medicine and money will last, with run-out dates
• A "needs attention" list: low or expiring supplies, overdue and upcoming vaccinations, over capacity, missing feeding information
• Quick actions for everyday tasks

ANIMALS
• A profile for every dog and cat: photo, name, sex, breed, color, approximate age, weight, microchip, sterilized or not, arrival date and story, enclosure, character and special needs
• Feeding: food item, grams per day and meals per day
• Health records: vaccinations, deworming, flea and tick treatment, vet visits, surgery and tests, each with a next-due date
• Medication courses with daily dose and dates
• A journal of dated notes with categories for each animal
• Mark an animal as adopted with the date, the adopter's name and contact, and notes
• Record other outcomes (returned to owner, transferred, passed away) and bring an animal back to the shelter
• Share an adoption card as an image
• Search, filter and sort

SUPPLIES
• Food, medicine and other items with stock, unit, price and expiry date
• Consumption is calculated automatically from your animals' feeding and medication courses, plus optional manual daily usage
• Stock goes down by itself as days pass
• Days-left forecast with the run-out date and a chart of projected stock
• Restock, remove or recount items, with a history and an optional expense record

MONEY
• Balance, donations and income, and expenses by category
• Monthly summary chart
• A forecast of how long your funds will last, based on what the shelter needs: food, medicine and monthly fixed costs
• Balance correction

SETTINGS
• Edit your shelter: name, photo, places and currency
• Reminders (local notifications) for low supplies, due vaccinations and expiring medicine, with a threshold in days
• Backup: export all data as a JSON file and restore it later
• Privacy policy and about, right in the app
• Delete all data

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking
• No network access: all data stays on your device
• The camera is used only to take photos of your animals and shelter

Forecasts are estimates based on the data you enter. Dog Shelter is a record-keeping tool and does not provide veterinary advice.

name: Dottie May
description:
A gentle, free period tracker with a cheerful daisy-filled shop for the things that make your cycle easier.

TRACK YOUR CYCLE
Tap the days of your period on the calendar and Dottie May does the rest. A friendly countdown shows when your next period is likely to start, and the calendar marks estimated fertile days and ovulation so you can plan ahead.

SEE YOUR PATTERNS
Cycle History shows your past periods and how long each cycle lasted, so you can understand what is normal for your body. The more you log, the better the estimates get.

GENTLE REMINDERS
Turn on reminders and Dottie May will give you a heads-up a few days before your period is expected.

A SHOP MADE FOR YOU
Browse hand-picked period care, heating pads, self-care, skincare, comfy bras, underwear and sleepwear. Save favorites with a heart and buy directly from trusted retailers. For adults, a Private section with its own passcode keeps more personal picks out of sight.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-up. Your cycle data stays on your device and is never sent anywhere.

ALWAYS FREE
Dottie May has no subscriptions and no paywalls. We may earn a commission when you buy through links in the Shop, at no extra cost to you.

Please note: all predictions are estimates, not medical advice, and should not be used as birth control.

Download Dottie May and get to know your cycle.

description:

Spend Review

Buyer Bench
Use CPI/ROAS calculators, budget split helpers, a creative brief scratchpad, and a launch checklist for weekly prep.

name: Driftfall – Snow & Petals

Driftfall lets snow, sakura petals, maple leaves and more fall over your own photos. Set it as your Lock Screen, or send it as a moving photo.

YOUR OWN PHOTOS
Pick any photo from your library and choose what falls on it. Adjust how much falls and how the wind blows, and drag to frame your photo.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

name: Duridoori
description:
Duridoori is a small drawing room for you and your friends. Every day brings one new topic, and everyone draws it. Your friends' drawings open once you have drawn yours.

2. See today's topic.
3. Draw it and choose which rooms to post to.
4. Friends' drawings open. Leave a reaction.

What's inside
• Rooms joined by invite code, up to 8 people each
• One short topic a day, from imagined scenes to everyday things and landscapes
• Pen in 3 sizes, 10 colors, eraser, undo and redo
• Four reactions: heart, funny, wow, nicely drawn. Poke a friend who hasn't drawn yet
• A calendar of the days you drew together
• Report and block tools to keep rooms friendly

A posted drawing can't be edited. Draw something small today.

name: EasyAds קידום סרטונים

EasyAds מקדמת את הסרטונים שלכם ב-YouTube דרך קמפיינים רשמיים ב-Google Ads, בלי להקים חשבון מודעות ובלי להבין בהצעות מחיר. מדביקים קישור לסרטון, בוחרים קהל ותקציב, ואנחנו מקימים ומנהלים את הקמפיין

צפיות, חשיפות, אחוז צפייה, זמן צפייה, כמה צפו עד הסוף, לייקים, תגובות ושיתופים, פילוח לפי מיקום המודעה, גרף יומי והשוואה בין ההערכה לתוצאה. התנועה מהקמפיין מופיעה גם ב-YouTube Studio כתנועה מפרסום

EdgeCore TV is the Apple TV app for EdgeCore, the entertainment and control system on board your yacht. It shows the vessel's own media library on every television on board, and puts the room's lights and climate a button away.

FILMS AND SERIES
Browse the vessel's library as a wall of posters: A–Z, newly added, continue watching and unwatched. Each title has its details, trailer and subtitle choice. Playback picks up where you left off, in this cabin or any other.

LIVE TV AND RECORDINGS
Where the vessel has live television, watch the channels with a full programme guide a week ahead, pause and rewind live TV, and record programmes or whole series. Channels and recordings come from the vessel's own system.

MUSIC
Browse the vessel's music and see what is playing in the room.

THE ROOM, FROM THE SOFA
Hold Play/Pause on the remote, anywhere in the app, even during a film: the room's lighting scenes, brightness and air-conditioning appear over what you are watching, together with the weather outside.

MADE FOR GUESTS
No accounts or sign-in. Each Apple TV knows its room, and the crew's phones and wall panels can send a film or a channel straight to the television.

TRY IT WITHOUT A YACHT
Away from a vessel, the app opens a small sample library and a sample room, so you can see how it works. The titles in it are invented.

EdgeCore TV needs an EdgeCore system on board for real use. Visit oceanedgesystems.com or write to info@oceanedgesystems.com.

name: Ekwill Alarm
description:
Ekwill Alarm is the building alarm app for the team at Crocker Refrigeration, Heating & Air in Santa Barbara. It works only with our own office and warehouse, and only our employees can sign in, with their Crocker Crew account.

• See whether the building is armed or disarmed, read straight from the alarm
• Arm and disarm, with Face ID before disarming
• Hold the alarm off for a few hours, or until someone arms it
• See every door, and unlock the ones you are allowed to
• Activity: who armed, disarmed or unlocked, and when
• Alerts, for the people chosen to get them, when a door opens or someone is seen inside after hours
• A panic button that sounds the building's siren

What each person can do (view only, arm, arm and disarm, or admin) is set by the company.

Questions? Call the office at (805) 965-6326 or email info@crockerair.com.

name: ElementApp
seller_name: ELEMENT TECH SOCIEDAD DE RESPONSABILIDAD LIMITADA
description:
ElementApp es la app de campo de Element ERP para vendedores, cobradores y equipos que trabajan en la calle. Se conecta directamente al sistema de su empresa y sigue funcionando aunque no tenga señal.

QUÉ PUEDE HACER
• Cargar pedidos de venta y emitir facturas desde el iPhone.
• Elegir cliente, plazo de pago y productos: el total se calcula al instante.
• Registrar pagos y cobranzas.
• Consultar y editar contactos con RUC o CI, y llamar o escribir por WhatsApp desde la ficha del cliente.
• Generar y compartir facturas en PDF.
• Acceder a los documentos de la empresa.
• Marcar asistencia con ubicación y verificación facial.
• Recibir notificaciones del sistema.

TRABAJA SIN SEÑAL
Clientes, productos y plazos de pago quedan guardados en el teléfono. Las facturas, pedidos y pagos que cargue sin conexión se sincronizan solos cuando vuelve la señal.

CÓMO EMPEZAR
1. Ingrese el nombre de su empresa en "Cliente" y elija la base de datos.
2. Inicie sesión con su usuario y contraseña de Element ERP.
3. Marque "Recordarme" para entrar directo la próxima vez.

REQUISITOS
ElementApp requiere una cuenta activa de Element ERP y plan de App Mobile. Si su empresa todavía no usa Element ERP, contáctenos en elementtech.com.py.

name: Embassy Freight
description:
Embassy Freight là ứng dụng tiện ích Vận tải Quốc tế (Sea & Air Freight) và Hải quan Xuất Nhập Khẩu dành cho doanh nghiệp, chủ hàng và chuyên viên mua hàng XNK tại Việt Nam.

TÍNH NĂNG NỔI BẬT:
• Tra cứu Hành trình Vận đơn 24/7: Kiểm tra tức thì trạng thái lô hàng đường biển (FCL/LCL) và đường hàng không (Air Cargo) theo số House B/L, Master B/L, AWB tại TP.HCM & Hà Nội, kèm thông báo Chuông & Rung khi lô hàng cập nhật chặng mới.
• Tra Biểu thuế Xuất Nhập Khẩu & Mã HS 2026: Tra cứu nhanh phân nhóm mã HS 8 số chuẩn AHTN (có dấu hoặc không dấu), đối chiếu thuế suất MFN, C/O Form E (ACFTA), C/O Form D (ATIGA) và thuế GTGT (VAT).
• Bảng Tính Thuế Nhập Khẩu & VAT Tự động: Nhập trị giá CIF và tỷ giá để ước tính ngay tổng số thuế nộp NSNN bằng VNĐ.
• Công cụ Tính CBM & Đề xuất Container: Quy đổi thể tích (m³), trọng lượng tính cước hàng không (1 CBM = 167 kg), đơn vị hàng lẻ LCL (W/M) và gợi ý phương án đóng hàng tối ưu (Cont 20'DC, 40'DC, 40'HC).
• Nhận Báo giá Cước & Thủ tục Hải quan Trọn gói: Gửi yêu cầu báo giá trực tuyến và quản lý lịch sử báo giá ngay trong tài khoản khách hàng.

Phát triển & Hỗ trợ kỹ thuật 24/7: Phước San — ĐT/Zalo: 0936911656.

name: Emberfall: Kingdoms
description:
Rise from a small keep to a mighty kingdom! Build a living 3D city, recruit legendary heroes and lead your army into epic battles.

BUILD YOUR KINGDOM
• 15 buildings in a hand-crafted 3D city: Ember Keep, farms, sawmill, quarry, iron mine, hero hall, academy and more
• Upgrade your Keep to unlock new buildings and higher levels
• Resources keep flowing while you are away
• The last 5 minutes of every upgrade are free

TRAIN YOUR ARMY
• Infantry, cavalry and archers, each strong against another
• Higher camp levels unlock stronger troop tiers
• Heal wounded troops in the Infirmary

RECRUIT HEROES
• 16 heroes from Rare to Ultra Rare, each with a battle skill
• Level them up with tomes and earn stars with shards
• Build a squad of up to 5 heroes; recruit odds are shown in the game, with a guaranteed SSR

EPIC BATTLES
• Watch your squads clash in animated auto-battles, at double speed if you like
• Conquest: fight through stage after stage for rewards
• Arena: daily duels against rival lords, without losing troops
• World map: gather resources and hunt wild beasts

AND MORE
• Join an alliance for gifts and faster upgrades
• Chapter quests, daily tasks and free daily chests
• Play offline, anytime
• English and Turkish

Emberfall is free to play. It is supported by ads and optional gem purchases.

name: EnAffaire Delivery Hub
description:
EnAffaire Delivery Hub connects your restaurant to a shared pool of independent local drivers. You keep your customers,
your menu prices and 100% of every order: no commission is ever taken.

• Every delivery order in one list: online orders from your EnAffaire ordering page, plus phone orders you key in.
• Auto-dispatch: the app offers each order to the driver who will arrive just before the food is ready (road travel time), and shows why that driver was picked. Change the ready time of any order, or take over and dispatch by hand.
• Send an order to one driver, or to every nearby driver: the first to accept gets it.
• Live map of the drivers near you, "driver arriving" alerts, delivery photo and a tracking link.
• Vouch for drivers you know in one tap; accept drivers other restaurants vouched for.
• Daily payout report per driver: pay the driver the same day by Interac e-Transfer or cash, the driver confirms.
• Chat with the driver, translated both ways.
• English and French.

Requires an EnAffaire Delivery Hub plan for your restaurant.

name: Evidence Box: Cold Case
description:
Seven cases nobody closed. Seven boxes on your desk.

It is 2004. You are Walt Henley, a retired detective called back to the county evidence room to look at seven old cases again. Each case is one box. Everything you need is inside it. Nothing else is.

OPEN THE BOX
Every box is locked, and every lock is a puzzle the evidence answers. A date written on a calendar. A ring heard on an answering machine. A key hidden where only the paperwork says it is. Turn the box in your hands, work the dials, and see what each lock lets out.

READ EVERYTHING
Time cards, ledgers, autopsy reports, photographs, letters, maps. Play the tapes and listen closely: a voice, a chime, a ring in the next room. The case is in the details, and every answer is backed by more than one clue.

NAME WHO DID IT
Each case ends in one sentence: who, how, when, why. Fill every blank from the words you found and submit it as a whole. A wrong answer never tells you which part was wrong. Get it right and the case is stamped CLOSED.

• 7 handcrafted cases, from a motel night desk to a lighthouse, a radio station and a darkroom
• Real locks to open with your fingers, not a list of choices
• Recorded tapes with transcripts
• Three hints for every lock and every blank, so you are never stuck for good
• Game Center achievements and a Detective Score board
• Your cases sync between your devices through iCloud
• Plays offline. No ads, no account, no data collected
• In English and Japanese

All characters and events are fictional.

name: F47 Docket
description:
To-do lists, Markdown notes, voice memos and a scratch pad, in one calm app for your Mac, iPhone and iPad, kept in sync through your own iCloud.

WORKSPACES
Keep Personal and Work apart, or add your own, each with its colour and icon. Every workspace has its own lists, notes, voice memos and scratch pad, one tap from its Home.

TO-DO LISTS
Lists side by side, each split into categories. Add to-dos as fast as you can type, tick them off, drag them where they belong. Give one a date or a reminder when it needs one, and see everything due across workspaces in Upcoming.

NOTES
Write in Markdown and see it styled as you type: headings, bold, highlights, checklists, quotes and code. Add pictures, tag notes with #tags, link one note to another, and pin the ones you need most.

VOICE MEMOS
Record a thought in a tap, and keep recording when your iPhone locks. Give memos a title and notes, and sort them into folders.

SCRATCH PAD
One page per workspace for the door code, the phone number, the thing you need for the next ten minutes.

GET THINGS IN FAST
Quick Capture from anywhere on the Mac with a keyboard shortcut. On iPhone and iPad: Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Control Center buttons, Share to Docket from any app, and Siri and Shortcuts.

FIND ANYTHING
Search every list, note, scratch pad and voice memo at once, in every workspace.

YOURS, PRIVATELY
No account, no analytics, no tracking. Docket syncs through your own iCloud, and your text is encrypted on your device before it leaves. Changes made offline sync when you're back online. If edits to a note's or to-do's text can't be merged, Docket keeps both versions for you to choose. Export a backup whenever you like.

TRY IT FREE
Every feature is free for 5 days. Then one in-app purchase unlocks Docket for good on your Mac, iPhone and iPad. No subscription. If you don't buy, everything stays readable and in sync.

Requires macOS 15 or later (Apple silicon and Intel), or iOS 18 / iPadOS 18 or later.

name: FACETS
description:
Discover the hidden details of classical sculpture with FACETS, an interactive visual exploration app designed to sharpen your observation skills.

Explore sculptural surfaces, study intricate textures and discover how light reveals the marks, shapes and techniques behind every masterpiece.

LIGHT LAB

Experiment with simulated lighting to explore shadows, carved details, surface textures and artistic techniques from different perspectives.

ART INTERPRETATION

Discover possible explanations behind sculptural features and learn to recognize the visual evidence of carving techniques.

OBSERVATION JOURNAL

Save your discoveries, record personal observations and revisit fascinating details whenever you want.

VISUAL COMPARISON

Compare saved observations side by side to identify differences in form, texture, depth and lighting.

FACETS transforms art appreciation into an engaging journey of visual discovery, helping you see beyond the surface.

name: Facturador Deployits
description:
Facturador Deployits lleva la facturación electrónica y la gestión de tu negocio en Ecuador a tu iPhone. Emite comprobantes autorizados por el SRI, controla tu inventario en varias bodegas, atiende pedidos y administra a tu equipo con permisos por perfil, todo conectado en tiempo real con tu cuenta del panel web.

DOCUMENTOS ELECTRÓNICOS SRI
• Emite facturas, notas de crédito, notas de débito, comprobantes de retención, guías de remisión y liquidaciones de compra.
• Envío al SRI y consulta del estado de autorización de cada comprobante.
• Descarga y comparte el RIDE (PDF) y el XML autorizado, o envíalos por correo a tu cliente.
• Configura tu firma electrónica, establecimientos, puntos de emisión y secuenciales.
• Tarifas de IVA y códigos de retención listos para usar.
• Carga de compras desde el XML del comprobante de tu proveedor.

INVENTARIO
• Productos con variantes (talla, color y más) y unidades de medida, con cantidades decimales.
• Stock en tiempo real por bodega y alertas de productos con stock bajo.
• Transferencias entre bodegas con recepción pendiente y confirmación.
• Movimientos de inventario con historial de entradas, salidas y ajustes.
• Preparación de pedidos (picking) para tu bodega.

VENTAS Y COMPRAS
• Clientes y proveedores en un solo lugar.
• Cotizaciones con adjuntos, que puedes convertir en pedidos y facturas.
• Pedidos y pedidos asignados a vendedores o repartidores.
• Registro de compras que actualiza tu stock automáticamente.
• Apertura y cierre de caja con el resumen de cada sesión.

REPORTES
• Panel de inicio con el resumen de ventas de tu negocio.
• Reportes de ventas, ventas por usuario, compras, facturas, guías de remisión, stock por bodega y stock bajo.

ADMINISTRACIÓN DE USUARIOS
• Crea y administra los usuarios de tu empresa.
• Perfiles con permisos: cada persona ve solo los módulos que le corresponden.
• Datos de tu empresa, plantillas de documentos y de correo, e historial de los correos enviados.
• Personaliza los colores y el tamaño de letra de la app.

SEGURIDAD
• Ingreso con Face ID o Touch ID.
• Bloqueo automático tras un periodo de inactividad.
• Conexión cifrada y verificada con el servidor, y protección de la pantalla para que tus datos tributarios no queden en capturas.
• La app no funciona en dispositivos con jailbreak, para proteger tu información.

REQUISITOS
Necesitas una cuenta de Facturador Deployits. Las cuentas y los usuarios se crean desde el panel web de tu empresa. Para emitir comprobantes electrónicos debes contar con RUC y firma electrónica vigente registrados en el SRI.

name: Fallstone
description:
Set a stone down. Feel it settle. Let go.

Fallstone is a quiet balancing game on small islands floating above the clouds. Each island asks for one thing: build a cairn tall enough to reach the golden ring. There's no timer and no score to chase, so you can look away whenever you like.

PLACE EVERY STONE BY HAND Slide a stone over the cairn, roll the little ball under your thumb to turn or tip it, and set it down. While you're still holding it you can feel whether it will stay: it rests quietly and glows green when it's balanced, and leans when its weight hangs over the edge. Nudge it until it sits right, then let go. Real physics takes it from there.

VINES FOR A STEADY HAND Every stone you let go in balance grows a vine from the stone below. The better you build, the further the vines climb, and the more blossoms your cairn earns.

CHECKPOINTS THAT KEEP WHAT YOU'VE BUILT Reach a ring along the way and the cairn below it takes root: flowers open, vines spiral up, and that part of the cairn is safe. Keep strengthening it, because every stone you add below the line roots too.

NOTHING IS EVER LOST Pick a loose stone back up and place it again. Tuck stones under overhangs, wedge them into gaps, step the cairn outwards. Every island has its own rocks, ledges and crevices to build from.

STONES WITH CHARACTER Grippy sandstone, heavy granite, light pumice, slippery glass and soft moss each behave differently, so no single trick works for all of them.

A SKY THAT MOVES Islands drift from morning through golden hour, dusk, night and dawn, and the seasons change as you travel: blossoms in spring, falling leaves in autumn, snow in winter.

POSTCARDS Finish an island and the game takes a postcard of your cairn. Save it to your gallery and visit any island you've reached again.

CALM BY DESIGN • No ads • No account, no data collected • Plays offline • A gentle soundtrack and soft haptics, both adjustable

Welcome to Fallstone.

name: Family Tracker
description:
Family Track is a private, invite-only location sharing app for families.
Create a family, invite the people you trust, and see everyone on a live map —
with rich notifications when it matters:
• LIVE MAP — see family members move in real time, with photos or colour
markers, movement badges (driving/walking) and accuracy circles.
• PLACES & GEOFENCES — draw places on the map (home, school, work). Get an
alert when someone arrives or leaves, optionally with a status emoji.
• PERSONAL PLACES — members keep their own private list of places.
• SOS — a big, deliberate hold-to-trigger emergency button that alerts the
whole family with your location, plus quick-dial emergency numbers that
adapt to the country you are in.
• CHAT — family chat, direct messages and custom groups with photos, voice
notes, video notes and read receipts.
• VOICE CALLS — one-to-one and group voice calls (up to 4 people).
• STATUSES — set a status emoji ("At school", "Working late"…) so everyone
knows what's happening without asking.
• DEVICE PROFILES — phones, tablets, computers and GPS trackers (Teltonika)
can all report to the same family. Choose one personal tracking device;
alerts ring there first.
• PRIVACY BY DESIGN — invite-only. Nobody can join without an invite or
pairing code from a family admin. Location history is retained for a
configurable period (default 30 days) and then deleted. Data deletion is
self-service: https://lokter.org.uk/data-deletion.html
Family Track requires an ongoing subscription-free setup with your family on
the web dashboard (https://track.lokter.org.uk).

name: FamilyWishes
description:
FamilyWishes keeps the whole family's wish lists in one place — and keeps gift surprises secret.

PASTE A LINK FROM ANY STORE
Found something at your favorite store? Paste the link and FamilyWishes fills in the gift name for you. Add a price, quantity, size or color, and how much they want it.

LISTS FOR EVERY KID — NO KID ACCOUNTS
Parents add children as profiles, so kids never need an email or a login. Keep separate lists for each child and each occasion.

OCCASIONS FOR THE WHOLE FAMILY
Create an occasion like Christmas or a birthday, invite grandparents, aunts, uncles and cousins with a code, and choose who's included.

SURPRISES STAY SECRET
When someone claims a gift, the person getting it never sees it. Everyone else knows it's taken, so no more duplicate presents.

YOUR GIFT CHECKLIST
Keep track of what you've claimed, what's bought and what's wrapped, with private notes only you can see.

GRANDPARENT-EASY
Big buttons, clear lists, and simple sharing links that work for everyone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, and we never sell your data. Delete your account and everything in it any time from Settings.

name: Farm & Fence
description:
A calm logic puzzle on a game board: cows, sheep, chickens and many other animals made of painted wood are waiting for their enclosures. With a swipe you build fences between the squares – until every species has its own enclosure with exactly one water trough and enough space.

HOW IT WORKS
• Swipe along the lines between the squares to build fences. Tapping a line adds or removes a single piece of fence.
• Every enclosure needs exactly one water trough and exactly one species. The dots on the base show how many squares an animal needs.
• Hedges are ready-made fences, rocks are not pasture. Later, giraffes, koalas and pandas need a tree in their enclosure.
• Some animals don't get along: fox and chickens, lion and zebra, polar bear and seal must not be neighbours.
• Little signs show what an enclosure is still missing. Hints, undo and restart are unlimited.
• Rotate and tilt the board until you can see every square clearly.
• Solve a puzzle with the fewest fences to earn a golden horseshoe.

YOUR FARM
Many puzzles give you a farm piece: a well, an apple tree, a scarecrow, a silo and more. Place them on your farm however you like. The animals from your solved pastures roam around, and your most recently solved pastures lie on the table as little boards.

NO RUSH
No ads, no waiting times, no energy bars, no random purchases, no subscription. No account needed. The game plays offline; only purchases and restoring them need an internet connection.

WHAT IS FREE, WHAT COSTS SOMETHING?
Included for free: 12 puzzles – the first four of the Farm Meadow chapter (with tutorial), the Fox chapter and the Zoo chapter – and your very own farm with 11 farm pieces.

Another 493 puzzles come in 13 chapters as in-app purchases. Each chapter is a one-time purchase – no random content, no in-game currency, no gameplay advantage:
• Farm Meadow chapter (8 more puzzles), Fox chapter (39 more puzzles) and Zoo chapter (6 more puzzles with giraffes, lions and zebras)
• Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter seasons – 50 puzzles each plus a matching farm theme
• Savanna, Polar World, Jungle and Australia animal worlds – 40 puzzles each with new animals and three farm pieces
• Pond and Brook and Lantern Evening – 40 puzzles each plus three farm pieces
Some chapters open once you know the basics from earlier puzzles; the shop shows which puzzle needs to be solved first. On a new device, tap “Restore purchases” in the shop while signed in with the same Apple Account to get your chapters back.

A THANK-YOU AFTER 200 PUZZLES
Once you have solved 200 puzzles, you can pick a chapter of your choice as a gift – once. Good to know: since 12 puzzles are included for free, you can only reach 200 with puzzles from chapters you bought. The gift is part of your progress and is backed up with your device's iCloud Backup, if it is turned on. “Restore purchases” does not bring it back, because it is not a purchase.

SETTINGS FOR YOU
English or German, four calm music tracks or shuffle, sound effects, haptics, reduced motion, space needed as a number, tinted enclosures, morning or evening mood, graphics quality and a battery-saving frame rate.

PRIVACY
Farm & Fence does not collect personal data: no account, no analytics, no tracking, no server of our own. Your progress stays on your device.

name: Fasting Tracker: Meal Photos
description:
A fasting timer with no ads, no sign-up and no free trial that turns into a charge.

START A FAST IN ONE TAP
Pick 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 23, 24, 36 or 48 hours. See how long you have been fasting, when you can eat, and what stage your body is in.

REMINDERS THAT RING ON TIME
Get a notification when you reach your goal, at the halfway point, and when your eating window closes.

TRACK WHAT MATTERS
Weight, water and meals in one place. Edit any fast after the fact. Streaks, weekly averages and a clean history.

MEAL PHOTOS
Snap your plate and get protein and calories for each food. Adjust portions before you save.

ASK OUT LOUD
Tap and ask "What's my streak?" or "How much protein today?" and hear the answer from your own log.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Everything lives on your phone. Back up to a file, export a spreadsheet or a PDF report for your doctor. Optional sync is encrypted on your phone with a key only you hold.

FREE FOREVER
The timer, reminders, stages, water, weight and history.

FULL VERSION
Meal photos (up to 8 a day), asking out loud, insights and encrypted sync. Choose monthly, yearly or a one-time lifetime purchase. Monthly and yearly plans renew automatically until you cancel in Settings, your name, Subscriptions. Cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. No free trial.

Fasting is not medical advice. Talk to your doctor before fasting, especially if you are pregnant, diabetic or take medication.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://plainworkgroups.duckdns.org/privacy/fasting

name: FEE Anbar
description:
FEE Anbar is a warehouse, sales and cash app for small and growing businesses.

• Goods receipts – record incoming goods from suppliers with quantities and prices
• Transfers – move stock between your warehouses and keep both sides accurate
• Stock – see what you have, where it is, and what is running low
• Sales – record sales to customers and keep their history
• Customers and suppliers – one list with contacts and balances
• Cash – follow money in and out alongside your stock movements
• Catalog – products and categories with photos

Your team works in the same company account, and the app speaks Azerbaijani, Russian and English.

An FEE Anbar account is required. You can delete your account at any time from the app or at anbar.fee.az/privacy.

name: Felton Express Pizza philly
description:
Feltonville Express Pizza – Order Online

Craving delicious pizza, wings, cheesesteaks, or your favorite comfort food in Philadelphia? Get everything you love from Feltonville Express Pizza with our easy-to-use ordering app!

Welcome to Feltonville Express Pizza, your neighborhood destination for great food, convenient online ordering, and delicious meals for every occasion.

ORDER YOUR FAVORITES

Explore our menu and discover a wide variety of freshly prepared favorites:

* Pizza: Classic cheese pizza, specialty pizza, meat lovers, Buffalo chicken, BBQ chicken, and more.
* Wings: Buffalo wings, chicken wings, and delicious chicken favorites.
* Philly Cheesesteaks: Beef cheesesteaks, chicken cheesesteaks, pizza steaks, and specialty steaks.
* Hoagies & Sandwiches: A variety of classic sandwiches, clubs, and toasted grinders.
* Burgers: Delicious beef burgers, cheeseburgers, and specialty burgers.
* Stromboli: Traditional and specialty strombolis.
* Pasta: Italian favorites including spaghetti, ravioli, and lasagna.
* More Favorites: Fresh salads, wraps, quesadillas, gyros, seafood, breakfast, sides, and desserts.

EASY ONLINE FOOD ORDERING

Skip the hassle and order directly from your phone.

With the Feltonville Express Pizza app, you can:

* Browse our full food menu.
* Customize your favorite meals.
* Place online food orders quickly and easily.
* Choose convenient pickup or delivery.
* Enjoy an easy and convenient ordering experience.
* Reorder your favorite meals whenever you’re hungry.

YOUR LOCAL PHILADELPHIA PIZZERIA

Proudly serving the Feltonville community and surrounding Philadelphia neighborhoods, Feltonville Express Pizza is here when you’re craving great pizza, Philly cheesesteaks, wings, and more.

Whether you’re ordering lunch, dinner, breakfast, or a family meal, we’ve got something for everyone.

DOWNLOAD AND ORDER TODAY!

Make your next meal easier with Feltonville Express Pizza.

Visit us at:
4812 Rising Sun Avenue
Philadelphia, PA 19120

Order online and enjoy your favorites from Feltonville Express Pizza!

name: Flat Is Fine
description:
Life is not supposed to be this hard.

They say mountains are there to be climbed. Mountains are there. That's all.

Flat Is Fine is a to-do list that wants you to do less. Bring the goals, chores and ambitions you think you're supposed to climb. Most of them turn out to be someone else's. The rest get a lot smaller once you look at them properly, and those are the ones you finish.

René Descartes did his best work lying in bed until eleven. From there he gave the world the coordinate plane, which is flat, and a method for making hard things easy. This app is that method, pointed at your list.

Programmers have a saying: "We do these things not because they are easy, but because we thought they were going to be easy." This is the app for everyone who has thought that.

SEVEN WAYS TO DO LESS

• The Flattener. Name a mountain and push it flat with your thumb. For the goals that were never yours.
• The Method. Descartes' four rules: doubt it, divide it, start with the easiest, review. A marathon becomes three short walks, and the first is to the end of the road.
• Lie Flat. A timer that only runs while your phone is lying down. Pick it up and it pauses.
• The Easy Ledger. Log what you thought something would take and what it took. The app works out your personal multiplier, so your next plan is an honest one.
• The Terrain. One question a day: how steep was it? Your month, drawn as an elevation profile. Aim for a line.
• The Flat Week. A weekly planner with three columns: Must, Wait and Drop. Ten lines, because a longer list is a project. The third column is the point.
• Sea Level. Two lists that last longer than a week: what is already good enough, and what you have decided not to chase.

AND YES, THINGS GET DONE

• The Range keeps every mountain still standing, with its next easy step on top.
• Today shows the one small thing worth doing, and how much climbing you've avoided so far.
• No streaks. A streak is a mountain with a calendar.

A LIBRARY THAT OPENS AS YOU GO

Fifty-three pages: Descartes, Pascal, Seneca, Montaigne and friends, plus true facts about the five real mountains your own are measured against. Each comes with a flat reading. They open as you use the tools. Share a page, or your progress, as a card.

MAKE IT YOURS

Six themes and six app icons.

YOURS ALONE

No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything you write stays on your iPhone.

THE SUBSCRIPTION

The first mountain is flattened before anyone mentions money. After that, Flat Is Fine is a subscription, monthly or yearly, and both start with three days free. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://thomasaj.com/flatisfine/privacy

name: FlightAbove Companion App
description:
FlightAbove is the companion app for FlightAbove displays: the desk, wall and TV screens that show the aircraft flying over your home. Change any setting from your phone, follow the flights you care about, and keep a logbook of everything your displays have spotted.

You need a FlightAbove display (Altitude, Mini, Horizon, Frame, Frame Plus or Connect) or a FlightAbove Cloud subscription, and a FlightAbove account.

ALL YOUR DISPLAYS IN ONE PLACE
- See every display on your account and whether it's online
- On the same Wi-Fi, changes go straight to the display; away from home they go through your account
- Rename or restart a display, or open the web dashboard
- Add a new display by scanning its setup QR code

CHANGE IT FROM THE SOFA
- Look: choose a face. Radar, LED Wall, Bay Grid, Postcard, Arcade, CRT, Split Flap, analogue and digital clocks and more, each with its own options
- Location and aircraft: set where your display watches and how far it looks
- Screen and sound: brightness, volume and chimes
- Hours and alarm: sleep hours and a wake-up alarm
- Changes are saved to the display and kept in sync with the web dashboard

TRACK A FLIGHT
Add up to three flights by flight number, callsign or registration. Your display looks them up itself and shows them as a tile over any face, and the app tells you when they land.

ALERTS FOR THE RARE ONES
Turn on alerts for emergency squawks, military aircraft, emergency services such as air ambulances and police helicopters, notable aircraft, and your own watchlist.

YOUR FLIGHT LOG
- Counts for the last hour, today, the last 7 and 30 days and all time
- Your best day and daily activity charts
- Every route your displays have seen, on a 3D globe or a map
- A logbook of every aircraft, sorted by most seen, latest or rarest, with airline liveries
- Aircraft pages with routes, sightings and first-seen dates
- Achievements to unlock, from First Spotter to Logbook Legend

SHARE A DISPLAY
Invite family to manage a display you own, for example a gift for a parent or a display in a child's room. You stay the owner and can remove access at any time.

NOTIFICATIONS
Choose what reaches your phone: a display going offline or coming back, tracked flights landing, achievements, order updates and replies from support.

ORDERS AND SUPPORT
Follow your FlightAbove orders with delivery tracking, and open or reply to support tickets with photos and videos from the app.

Light and dark appearance follow your phone, or pick one yourself.

Questions? Visit flightabove.io/contact.

name: Flip Clock & Focus Timer
description:
Turn your iPhone into a full-screen flip clock for your desk or bedside. See the digits flip as time changes. Set it upright or turn it sideways for a wider display.

MAKE IT YOUR CLOCK
• Choose from four free clock faces, including a dim red face for nighttime.
• Keep the screen awake while the clock is open. Choose 12- or 24-hour time and show or hide seconds and the date.
• Add the flip-clock style to your Home Screen or Lock Screen. Clock widgets update by the minute.

FOCUS AND TIME EVERYDAY TASKS
• Start a 25-minute focus session with a 5-minute break from the clock menu.
• Set a countdown for cooking or studying, or use the stopwatch to count up. Adjust the alert volume for in-app playback. Allow notifications for alerts when the app is in the background.
• See how much time you've focused and share milestone cards.

MAKE IT YOUR OWN WITH PRO
• Get all 12 faces, custom colors and fonts, flip sounds, hourly chimes and scheduled night mode.
• Customize focus and break lengths, start the next round automatically, and record stopwatch laps.
• See supported timers on the Lock Screen with Live Activities. Get more widget sizes, StandBy widgets and a transparent widget background.
• Create a face code to share your setup.

Share a desk image with a photo you choose, even on the free plan.

The app is free to download. Try Pro for 30 days from your first launch of the paid edition. You can claim a free trial receipt in Settings. After the trial, the basic clock, focus timer, countdown, stopwatch and focus stats stay free. Unlock Pro with a one-time purchase if you want to keep the extra features. No subscription or automatic charges.

No account or ads. Your settings, timer state and focus stats stay on your device.

name: Flipside Arcade
description:
Flipside Arcade is a pocket arcade of ten original pixel games. Pick a cartridge, tap Play and you're in.

TEN CARTRIDGES
- Snap Snake: eat, grow, don't bite yourself.
- Hinge Hoops: sixty seconds to find your arc.
- Brick Breaker Fold: clear the wall, slow time when it counts.
- Clamshell Golf: nine holes of pull-back putting.
- Hinge Fisher: drop deep and reel in the big ones.
- Star Fold: drag to fly while your ship fires on its own.
- Clamshell Climber: only up. Don't touch the lava.
- Dungeon Flip: one room at a time. Find the stairs.
- Gem Drop: line up three and chain the rest.
- Pocket Racer: three lanes, seven rivals, go.

EVERY DAY
- A new daily challenge for every cartridge.
- A progress bar to your next unlock.
- A streak that forgives one missed day.

BUILT FOR FOLDING PHONES, GREAT ON EVERY IPHONE AND IPAD
On iPhone Duo, fold it halfway and the game sits on the top screen with the controls below. Some games use the hinge itself: aim your shot in Hinge Hoops or drop your line in Hinge Fisher. Close it mid-run and your game is saved. Every game also plays fully with on-screen controls on any iPhone and iPad.

FAIR AND FREE
Every game plays fully free. Optional one-time unlocks add shell finishes, game skins and harder modes. No subscriptions, no accounts, no ads, and your progress stays on your device.

name: FlyBy - Live Aircraft Map
description:
FlyBy shows aircraft that are in the air right now on a map.

Move the map anywhere and the aircraft in that area appear. Tap one to see where it came from, where it is going, and how high and how fast it is flying.

Features
• Map: aircraft position and heading, colored by altitude
• List: sort by distance, callsign, altitude, or speed, and search
• Details: callsign, origin and destination airports, airline, altitude, speed, heading, vertical rate
• Track: the path the selected aircraft has flown, drawn on the map
• Weather: surface conditions at the map center and at the aircraft's position (temperature, wind, visibility, pressure)
• Units: aviation units (ft, kt) and metric shown together
• Layouts for iPhone, iPad, and foldable iPhone
• English and Korean

Good to know
• Departure and estimated arrival times are estimates calculated from the track and current speed. They are not airline schedules.
• Route information comes from a scheduled-route table, so it can differ from the actual flight and is missing for some flights.
• Aircraft positions come from signals collected by ground receivers, so aircraft outside receiver coverage do not appear.
• This app must not be used for navigation or flight operations.

Data sources
• Aircraft positions and tracks: The OpenSky Network (https://opensky-network.org)
• Routes: adsbdb
• Weather: Apple Weather

The app works within OpenSky's request limits. If you have your own OpenSky API client, you can add it in Settings to raise the limit (optional).

name: Foliotempo
description: Foliotempo మీరు చదువుతున్న పుస్తకాలను ఒకే చోట నిల్వ చేస్తుంది. ప్రతి పుస్తకానికి మొత్తం పేజీలు, ప్రారంభం–ముగింపు పేజీలు, ఎంత సమయం ఖర్చైందో గుర్తు పెడుతుంది. ఆ డేటా నుండే మీ చదవే వేగాన్ని లెక్కిస్తుంది, మిగిలిన పేజీలు ఎంత సమయం పట్టుతాయో అంచనా వేస్తుంది. రోజుకు ఎంత నిమిషాలు చదవగలనో చెప్పితే, ఎన్ని రోజుల్లో పూర్తి చేయగలనో కూడా చూపిస్తుంది.

name: Form Check Cam
description:
Move. Look up. Watch.
Form Check Cam is a camera that plays your front camera video a few seconds late, full screen. Prop up your iPhone, make your swing, and look up: the swing you just made is already playing. There is nothing to record, stop, or rewind.
It is made for golf swings first, and it works just as well for tennis, baseball, dance, or any practice where you want to check your form.

A DELAY OF 2 TO 20 SECONDS
The default is 7 seconds. Tap the “s ago” tag on the right to change it in 1-second steps, or pick 3, 5, 7, 10, or 15 seconds with one tap.

SET UP FIRST, THEN IT STARTS
Right after you open the app, you see the live view with corner brackets. While you place the camera where it can see your form, the delay builds up and the view switches to the delayed video. After that, a small window at the top left keeps showing the live view.

PAUSE AND GO FRAME BY FRAME
Tap Pause to review. Drag the vertical handle to find the moment, then step back or forward one frame at a time. Choose a speed of 1/4×, 1/8×, normal, or 1/2×.

LOOP THE PART YOU CARE ABOUT
Set the yellow range with its handles, and the app plays that range on a loop.

CHECK WITH LINES
Draw up to 4 lines. Drag an endpoint and a magnifier appears, so you can match your club angle or your posture precisely.

SAVE ONLY WHAT YOU WANT
Tap Save to add the yellow range to Photos. Saved videos are never mirrored, even when the display is.

MAKE IT EASY TO SEE
In Settings, you can turn on Mirror Display and Maximum Brightness, and pick a Highlight Color: yellow, green, cyan, orange, pink, or white. On cameras that support it, recording at 120 fps makes slow motion and frame stepping smoother.

SUPPORTS IPHONE DUO
Use it closed, on the outer screen. Use it open, on the inner screen. Fold it halfway and it stands on its own, with the video and the controls split top and bottom or left and right. It also works on other iPhone models.

PRIVACY
There is no account, no ads, and no analytics. Your video is never sent off your device. Only the range you save goes to Photos.

PAY ONCE
One purchase, and it is yours. There is no subscription and there are no in-app purchases.

By arcion Inc.

name: Formscape
description:
Turn any site photo into design concepts in minutes. See what a property could become, from new façades and green roofs to renovated interiors, then share it with clients, investors, or your team in a single link.

Formscape helps everyone who shapes the built environment explore ideas fast and get buy-in sooner.

Built for the whole project team
• Developers: Visualize a property’s potential before you buy, pitch, or plan.
• Architects: Test early design directions in minutes, before committing to detailed drawings.
• Interior designers: Show clients new layouts, finishes, and styles from a photo of the existing room.
• Contractors: Help homeowners and clients picture the finished result and win more jobs.

How it works
> Snap or upload a photo. Start with a building, lot, streetscape, or interior.
> Get distinct concepts. Formscape generates different design directions you can compare and refine until they reflect your vision.
> Share instantly. Send a polished presentation link. Clients and partners can compare options and leave feedback without downloading anything.
> Keep every idea. Save concepts by project and revisit earlier directions anytime.

The best projects start with a shared vision. Formscape gets everyone there faster.

name: fotohut
description:
The filter looks great, so why not my photo?

You've seen it happen: the filter photo looked lovely, but on your own photo that feeling just isn't there. Indoor shots come out yellow and shady ones come out blue, yet filters lay the same look over every photo.

fotohut doesn't just lay a filter on top. It fits the film to each photo, so your photos come closer to the feeling you saw when you picked it.

Fitted to every photo
Yellowish indoor shots and bluish shade shots both move toward the feeling you picked.

Faces stay natural
Colors change, but skin tones don't turn strange.

Nights stay night
Night keeps its night mood, and sunsets keep their glow.

Softer backgrounds
Soft focus gently blurs only the background.

'90s film texture
Grain and faded color, as if it were shot on film.

Choose with your own photo
Try every film on your photo before you pick one.

15 films
- Clear Days: clean and crisp
- Warm Days: warm color
- Cool Days: blue, quiet air
- Old Days: faded, long-ago memories
- Painted Days: clear, vivid color, like a scene from an animated film

More films are on the way.

Membership
Use every film, including the ones still to come. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Photos are developed on this device and saved to Photos. Nothing is sent to a server.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://radlad.app/fotohut/privacy/#en

name: Foydada
description:
Foydada is an open procurement marketplace for Uzbekistan. Buyers publish tenders, contractors find work. No middlemen, direct chat, clear submission deadlines.

Live tenders across 14 regions of Uzbekistan: construction, supplies, services, IT. Filter by price and deadline, message the buyer directly in chat.

Three ways to trade:
— Tenders: a buyer publishes a job and contractors respond in chat.
— Auctions: a seller lists a lot and buyers place bids in real time.
— Requests: a buyer describes the goods with a hidden budget and sellers send sealed offers.

Companies are verified by their documents. When the work is done, both sides confirm completion and rate each other, and the rating is public.

In the app: the catalogue of tenders, auctions and companies, an account with your tenders, lots and requests, chats and notifications.

name: Frame Pick: Video Stills
description:
Choose a video from Files, explore the preview and keep up to 20 still-image candidates. Compare the current frame with a selected candidate and review the requested and actual extraction times.

Export your selection as JPEG or PNG through the iOS share sheet. The original video stays unchanged; an app-owned working copy and your candidate session are kept on your device.

No account, advertising or subscription is required. This is a still-frame selection tool, not a video downloader or an AI image enhancer. Available decoding depends on the video and device; protected or unsupported files may not open.

name: Freeling: missions IT-Finance
description:
Génère ton matching et trouve ta mission freelance IT & Finance, gratuitement.

Freeling réunit les missions IT & Finance, les consultants freelances, les candidats en recherche d'emploi et les ESN sur une plateforme intelligente.

POUR LES FREELANCES ET LES CANDIDATS (100 % gratuit, sans abonnement ni commission)

• Découvrez chaque jour de nouvelles missions freelance et offres en CDI IT & Finance, y compris des missions Off Market détectées sur les réseaux sociaux, sans doublons

• Voyez votre pourcentage de compatibilité avec chaque mission grâce au matching intelligent, et repérez en quelques secondes les opportunités les mieux adaptées.

• Match ma mission : partagez une annonce depuis LinkedIn ou un site d'emploi vers Freeling, pour obtenir votre score de matching et vos points forts et adaptez votre dossier de compétences.

• Importez votre CV et générez un dossier de compétences professionnel au format Word ou PDF.

• Recevez des alertes personnalisées par mail et des notifications sur votre téléphone.

• Accédez gratuitement aux coordonnées disponibles pour contacter les recruteurs, et échangez avec eux grâce à la messagerie intégrée.

POUR LES ESN ET LES ENTREPRISES

• Publiez vos offres de mission
• Accédez à des profils de consultants IT & Finance
• Contactez les candidats et suivez vos échanges au même endroit

POURQUOI FREELING ?

• Moins de temps à chercher, plus de temps à saisir les bonnes opportunités.

• Des missions IT & Finance : SAP, ERP, développement, data, cloud, cybersécurité, infrastructure, DevOps, chef de projet, PMO, Business Analyst, finance d'entreprise, trésorerie et bien plus.

• Votre profil et vos échanges restent protégés, avec un verrouillage possible de l'appli par Face ID ou code.

Téléchargez Freeling et trouvez votre prochaine mission.

name: Frost_Bound
description:
Frost_Bound is an adventurous and thrilling game.
In the frozen darkness, the protagonist sets out on an adventure. There are many peculiar obstacles in the levels, and you need to handle them properly to avoid danger. The level scenes constantly change. Are you, the explorer, ready?

name: Fruven
description:
Pick fruit for the day you want to eat it.
Buying avocados for Saturday toast or packing apples for the week? Fruven helps you know what to look for at the store, when to check the fruit you brought home, and what was good enough to buy again.
Shop with a day in mind
Choose when you want to eat your fruit and get a checklist for that shopping trip. Look for practical clues such as gentle give in an avocado or bruising in a box of strawberries. Get tips for apples, avocados, bananas, kiwis, oranges, and strawberries.
Remember what’s in your fruit bowl
Add the fruit you bring home, note where you keep it, and log what you notice when you check it. Set an optional reminder so you remember to look in on that firm kiwi before you need it for breakfast.
See what’s typically in season
Browse the harvest calendar by month for California, Washington, or Florida. Use the fruit guide to look up selection and storage tips before you shop.
Remember what you’d buy again
Was that lunchbox apple crisp and tart? Did the strawberries taste as good as they looked? Save a tasting with flavor, texture, and whether you’d buy it again. Add a photo or voice note if you like, revisit your tastings by month, or share a tasting card.

name: Fudebo: Write Kana from Memory
description:
Fudebo does one thing: you write Japanese kana from memory.

Writing a character once beats staring at a chart ten times. You get only the sound or the romaji, you write with your finger in a practice square, and Fudebo checks every stroke: count, order, direction and shape. Get one wrong and that stroke turns red, the correct stroke order plays, you trace it once and write it again.

LEARN FIRST, THEN WRITE
• Four short intro cards: how the kana chart works and the basics of writing
• A short lesson before each new row: hear the whole row, see the pattern
• A card for every character: stroke-order animation, pronunciation tip, writing tips, the kanji it came from, an example word
• Three steps for each new character: trace, copy a faint guide, write from memory

ONE PAGE A DAY
• Set your own amount (10 to 200 writes), about 10 minutes by default
• Characters you miss come back tomorrow; the ones you get right come back less often
• Look-alike characters are tested together, and Fudebo tells you when you wrote the other one
• The next row opens when you know this one. No streaks, no penalty for missing a day

PRACTICE: WRITE UNTIL YOU KNOW IT
• Unlimited writing: a character counts as learned after 3 correct in a row with no hints
• Weak-spot drill, look-alike duel, dictation, hiragana/katakana swap, 60-second challenge
• Copybook: write one character 12 times

YOUR COPYBOOK
• Every page you write is kept, so you can see your progress
• Compare your first, middle and latest writing of each character and replay how you wrote it
• Progress and handwriting sync with your iCloud

Choose how you practice: romaji or sound only, how many hints, how many repetitions, how strict the check is, and the grid style.

Free: all lessons and practice for the 46 basic hiragana, one page a day, unlimited writing with learned hiragana, your copybook.
Fudebo Pro (monthly, yearly or one-time purchase): katakana, voiced kana, yōon, 66 basic words, every practice mode, unlimited pages, no ads.

Subscriptions renew automatically and can be cancelled anytime in your App Store account settings.
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Stroke data: KanjiVG (CC BY-SA 3.0)

name: Full BASIC
description:
Learn to program the way a whole generation did: type a few lines, press Run and watch them work. Full BASIC brings back the BASIC of the 1980s, in its most complete form, to your Mac, iPhone and iPad.

FOR LEARNERS, TEACHERS AND RETRO FANS
- Small enough to learn in an afternoon, rich enough to take seriously.
- A built-in manual, with context help from the editor.
- 38 explained example programs, from "Hello, world" to classics such as Lunar Lander, Hamurabi, the Game of Life and the Mandelbrot set, and a catapult duel with craters and wind.
- Errors point to the exact place in your code.
- Completely free: no in-app purchases, no account, no ads, no data collection, and it works fully offline. Ready for the classroom.

THE WHOLE STANDARD
Full BASIC implements the Full BASIC standard (ANSI X3.113-1987, adopted as FIPS PUB 68-2): the structured BASIC that was written down in a standard but that almost nobody ever implemented in full. It is tested against a suite of more than 400 programs with their expected output.
- Structured programming: IF and SELECT CASE blocks, FOR and DO loops, SUB, FUNCTION and DEF, with recursion and multiple program units.
- Exception handling with WHEN, USE, RETRY and CAUSE EXCEPTION: programs that recover instead of crashing.
- Arithmetic your way: floating point, or exact decimal arithmetic with OPTION ARITHMETIC for money calculations.
- Strings, arrays and MAT operations, DATA and READ, formatted output with PRINT USING.
- Files: sequential and other access methods on the files you choose.
- Graphics: windows, lines, areas, colors, text and pictures with transformations.
- CHAIN to run another program of yours.

THE APP
- A code editor with syntax highlighting, line numbers, and renumbering and reordering of lines.
- A console for text and graphics, with keyboard input for your programs.
- Open and save your .bas files from the Files app or the Finder.
- A debugger: breakpoints, step into, over and out, pause, call stack and variables, with exceptions shown where they happen.
- Export your graphics as SVG.
- iCloud Drive: keep your programs in iCloud and open them on all your devices.
- Light, dark and system appearance.

PRIVACY
Full BASIC collects no data, has no ads and no tracking, and never sends your data anywhere. Your programs stay on your device or in your own iCloud Drive.

NOT AFFILIATED
Full BASIC is an independent implementation of the published standard. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or certified by ANSI, NIST or any other standards body. The real-time facilities and the line editor described in the standard are not part of the app.

name: Gestione Rimborsi
description:
Turn your reimbursable expenses into a document ready to hand in. Gestione Rimborsi is made for anyone who has to report travel, meals, fuel or business trip expenses to a client, a company or an organization. The app is in Italian.

RECEIPTS THAT READ THEMSELVES
Snap a photo of the receipt: the app reads the amount, date, merchant and document number and fills in the form for you. You can always correct or type by hand: the values read are only suggestions. Reading happens on your iPhone, even offline.

A PDF READY TO SEND
Pick the person and the period: the app creates a PDF with the list of expenses, the totals and every receipt attached on its own page. Add your signature, drawn with your finger or loaded from a photo, and fill in place and date automatically.

PEOPLE AND EXPENSES UNDER CONTROL
Assign expenses to several people, group them by month with subtotals, search and filter by category, period or person. Export everything to CSV or create a full backup you can restore on another device.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
Everything is stored on your phone. If you want, Cloud syncs with your own WordPress site: no third-party servers, just your own space.

FREE TRIAL
Try the app with 2 people and 4 automatic receipt readings, with no time limit. Manual entry is always free. With Pro (€2.99/month or €19.99/year) people and readings are unlimited; WordPress Cloud is an add-on for Pro subscribers (€1.49/month or €9.99/year). Subscriptions renew automatically and can be cancelled at any time in your Apple account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.fabricaapp.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://www.fabricaapp.com/privacy/

name: Ghost: Tattoo Stencil Maker
description:
Ghost turns a photo, a sketch or a finished design into a clean black-and-white stencil.

Made for tattoo artists who would rather spend their time tattooing than tracing.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose a photo or design from your library.
2. Ghost draws the line work in seconds.
3. Adjust it, set the real size, then print or share.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Convert photos, sketches and digital designs
• Control detail, solid black areas, line weight and cleanup
• Drag a handle across the image to compare with the original
• Clean up by hand: erase, draw, or clear a solid area to its outline
• Mirror the design
• Set the real width in centimetres or inches
• Print at real size with AirPrint; large designs are split across sheets
• Share as PNG, transparent PNG or a real-size PDF
• Tattoo mode: full screen, stays awake, stencil and photo one tap apart

IT TRACES, IT DOES NOT REDRAW
Ghost follows the lines of your design. It does not invent or change them.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your device. Your images and your clients' photos are never uploaded, and Ghost works without an internet connection.

FREE
Every tool in this version is free. No account is needed.

Privacy Policy: https://jokecoder.github.io/ghost-stencil/

name: Gimbalo
description:
Gimbalo is a small woodshop bench that lives in your phone. One side holds a spirit level, the other holds a marble run, and a brass lever across the top flips between LEVEL and PLAY. Tug the drawer pull at the bottom and out slides the log, your best times, the bench finish and a little About page.

What's on the bench:
– A spirit level with two vials. Lay the phone flat and you get the round bull's-eye, good for checking a shelf or a tabletop. Stand it on an edge and the tube vial takes over, which is what you want for hanging a picture straight. Auto picks the vial for you, or you can pin it to Surface or Edge.
– Zero. If the thing you're measuring against isn't quite true (or your phone case has a bump on the back), tap Zero to calibrate to it. Hold the button to clear it again.
– Hold. Freezes the reading so you can pull the phone out of an awkward corner and still see the number.
– A small tap of haptic feedback the moment you're within half a degree of level, so you can keep your eyes on the work.
– The log. Press LOG, give the reading a label like "Shelf, left" and it goes in the drawer with the date and the angles. Delete the ones you don't need.
– Marble Run. Tilt the phone to roll a steel marble through 8 hand-made mazes and into the cup. It uses the same motion sensors as the level. Holes send the marble back to the start with the clock still running, each finished maze unlocks the next, and best times go in the drawer. Hold the phone however is comfortable before you tap start; that becomes "flat". Prefer not to tilt? Switch to the thumb pad.
– Bench finish. Walnut, oak, ebony or cherry, with brass or steel hardware. The vials and the marble keep their colours on every finish, so they stay easy to read.

A word of honesty from the bench: a phone level is handy for everyday jobs around the house, like pictures, shelves and wobbly tables. It is not a replacement for a precision tool. If you're setting up a machine or anything that has to be dead on, reach for a proper level.

No account to make, no ads, and it all works offline. Saved readings, best times and your finish are backed up under an anonymous ID, and there's a Reset my data button in the drawer if you want it all gone.

name: Golden Era Bodybuilding Plan
description:
Train the way the classic physiques of the 1970s were built.

Golden Era Bodybuilding brings the whole old-school system into one free app: heavy basics, training by feel, six days of iron and a Sunday to rest and grow.

EXERCISES FOR EVERY MUSCLE
• A moving demo of the perfect rep for every exercise
• Start and finish positions, golden era sets and reps
• How to feel the muscle working, the way the old champions trained

PROGRAMS
• 7 days, 30 days, 8 weeks, 12 weeks and a full year
• Gain muscle, fat loss, lean body, V-taper and a women's program
• Today's workout waits on the home screen: tick each exercise and mark the day complete

GOLDEN ERA DIET
• Calorie and protein calculator for your body type and goal
• Meal plans for gaining muscle, bulking, losing fat, women and vegetarians

DAILY REMINDERS
• Today's workout from your program every morning
• Your diet of the day, an evening nudge and a weekly progress recap

TRAINING GUIDE
• The golden era method, heavy basics, training by feel, intensity techniques, old-school cardio, the rest day and the stomach vacuum

No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything works offline and stays on your phone.

The training and nutrition content is general information for healthy adults and is not medical advice. Talk to a doctor before starting a new exercise or diet plan.

name: Golf Glint: Yardage Book
description:
Golf Glint is a yardage book on your iPhone. Search for a course or a town, open its book and turn the pages with a swipe, like paper. Write on any page with the pen, or stick a note where you need it.

More than 13,000 courses around the world have a yardage book so far.

IN EVERY BOOK
• Cover: a photo of the course, an aerial picture of its holes, or a photo of your own
• The course's story, where there is one: its history and things worth knowing
• A course map with every hole on one page
• The scorecard, with a column for your score
• A page for each hole, drawn to scale: distance arcs to the centre of the green, carry numbers on bunkers and water, and how much the hole plays uphill or downhill
• A page for each green: a height or slope map, arrows showing which way the green falls, and the distance to its front, centre and back
• Pages for notes, and a page naming every source
Heights and green slopes are shown where public surveys cover the course.

YOUR TEES, YOUR UNITS
• Pick the tees you play and the distances follow
• Choose Custom to set your own distance on each hole
• Yards or metres

WRITE ON IT
• Draw with the pen: circle a target, mark a line, jot down a number
• Stick notes anywhere on a page, and fold them away when you don't need them
• On hole and green maps, notes stay pinned to the ground: a note on a bunker stays on that bunker when you change tees
• See every note in a book in one list and jump to its page

ON THE COURSE
• Each book you open is saved on your iPhone, so it opens with no signal
• Your notes sync through your own iCloud
• The app and its books come in ten languages

NOT A RANGEFINDER
Golf Glint doesn't use GPS on the course and doesn't show where you are. It is a book you read and write on, before and during your round.

SOURCES AND PRIVACY
Course maps © OpenStreetMap contributors. Heights and green slopes come from public surveys where they exist; each page names its source. Course photos from Wikimedia Commons, credited on the cover. Aerial pictures from Apple Maps.
No account and no ads. To list courses near you, the app sends only a rough position (about 1 km).

name: Golf Vectors
description:
Make your own yardage book, quickly and easily.

Golf Vectors is built around one idea: the yardages that matter are the ones you choose. Walk the course, tap Mark My Spot at the places you care about, and Golf Vectors shows how far away each one is from wherever you stand, along with how far uphill or downhill it is.
