Front of the green. The bunker you always find. The tree that blocks the dogleg. The spot where the fairway runs out. Your yardage book has exactly what you want in it, and it gets better every time you play.

ONE PURCHASE, NOTHING ELSE
• No account to set up and nothing to register.
• No subscriptions.
• No in-app purchases. Course downloads are free.
• No ads.
You buy Golf Vectors once, and that's it.

NOT A SCORING APP
Golf Vectors doesn't keep score, track stats or work out a handicap. It does one thing well: your yardages.

YOUR COURSES, YOUR WAY
Golf Vectors doesn't come preloaded with courses. You map the courses you play, and it only takes a few minutes per hole:
• Create a course, add a hole, and tap Mark My Spot wherever you're standing.
• Or aim the crosshair on the satellite map to mark places you can't walk to, like the far side of a pond.
• Name each spot anything you like, and add notes.

ON THE COURSE
• Yards (or meters) to every spot, on a satellite map with a line from you to each one.
• Uphill and downhill in feet (or meters), so you can club up or down.
• A 5-yard grid over the green to judge depth and pin position.
• Mark each hole's tee, and the hole opens by itself when you walk up to it.
• Spots you've walked past drop off the map, so it stays clear as you head to the green.
• Your yardages work without a signal. Use Prepare for Offline before you play to load the map pictures.

COURSES TO DOWNLOAD
TIOTH maps courses you can download as a starting point, then make your own. The list is small for now and growing.
Want your course mapped? Email the course name and address to support@tioth.com and we'll create an initial version you can download.

SHARE WITH FRIENDS
Share a course with your playing partners by AirDrop, Messages or Mail, or send it to TIOTH so other golfers can download it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your courses are saved on your iPhone. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you choose to share it. Your location is only used while the app is open.

name: Grandparents Pregnancy Tracker
description:
A grandbaby is on the way! Grandparents Pregnancy Tracker counts down to the big day and follows the pregnancy week by week, written for grandparents in warm, plain language.

Most pregnancy apps are written for the person who is pregnant. This one is written for you: what the baby is doing this week, what the parents may be going through, and a simple way you can help.

COUNT DOWN TOGETHER
• Enter the due date and see the days to go, how many weeks along, and the trimester
• See how big the baby is this week, compared with a fruit or vegetable
• Keep track of several grandbabies, and twins

WEEK BY WEEK, FOR GRANDPARENTS
• A page for every week from 4 to 40
• The baby: what's growing and changing
• The parents: what they may be feeling
• How you can help: one practical, kind idea each week

A JOURNAL FOR YOUR GRANDCHILD
• Write notes and add photos along the way
• A keepsake to look back on together one day

CHECKLISTS FOR GRANDPARENTS
• Getting ready: visits, help, diapers, car seat, freezer meals and more
• Planning the baby shower, from the guest list to the thank-you notes

EASY TO USE
• Three text sizes, including extra large
• Light and dark mode
• No account and no sign-up

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything you enter stays on your iPhone
• No ads, no tracking, and nothing is sent anywhere

This app shares general information for grandparents and is not medical advice. Every pregnancy is different; the parents' doctor or midwife is the person to ask.

name: Gregoire & Beuoy Real Estate
description:
Local Expertise. Exceptional Real Estate. Discover Santa Barbara, Montecito, and Hope Ranch real estate with the Gregoire & Beuoy Real Estate app. A personalized way to explore the market and stay connected with a team that knows it firsthand.

Whether you're searching for your next home, exploring luxury properties, or considering a sale, our app combines powerful home search tools with the local knowledge and personalized service of the Gregoire & Beuoy Group at Compass.

Explore Santa Barbara's Most Desirable Communities

Search available properties throughout Montecito, Hope Ranch, Santa Barbara, and the surrounding coastal communities. From oceanfront estates to distinctive neighborhood homes, explore the opportunities that make this market exceptional. 

Stay Ahead of the Market

Receive notifications when new listings match your search criteria, save your favorite properties, and revisit homes that catch your attention.

Your Real Estate Team, One Tap Away

Connect directly with Chris Gregoire and Chad Beuoy to ask questions, request showings, discuss properties, or gain perspective on the local market.

A More Personalized Home Search

Organize and share your favorite listings with family, friends, or your agents, making it easier to navigate your search and make informed decisions.

Expert Guidance for Sellers

Considering selling your home? Connect with our team to discuss market conditions, property positioning, and a tailored 3-Phase Marketing Strategy designed around your goals.

Experience Real Estate at a Higher Standard.

Download the Gregoire & Beuoy Real Estate app and discover a more connected, informed approach to buying and selling real estate along the Santa Barbara coast.

name: Groovo AI
description:
Groovo turns your notes into study material. Snap a photo of your notebook or textbook pages, or upload a PDF: in seconds you get a clear summary, a quiz, a concept map and even a podcast to listen to.

Summaries, quizzes, maps and podcasts are built from the material you upload, not from web searches. Groovo uses AI and can make mistakes: always check important points in your textbook.

FIVE WAYS TO STUDY THE SAME PAGE
• Summary: full paragraphs that explain and connect the concepts, with the definitions and examples from your text.
• Quizzes and open questions: multiple-choice and open questions with an explanation for every answer.
• Concept map: the main ideas and how they connect.
• Podcast: your summary becomes audio you can listen to, even with the screen off.
• Deep dive: pick a point of the summary and Groovo explains it in more detail.

REVIEW THAT WORKS
Every wrong answer becomes a gap. Groovo brings it back after 1, 3, 7 and 14 days until you know it.

MIDDLE SCHOOL
A section for students aged 11 to 14. Groovo doesn't do the homework for them: it guides them one step at a time, checks what they write and tells them what to fix. The ready-made answer unlocks only after their own attempt. Tools: paraphrase, text analysis, book report, step-by-step lessons and essay writing.

Sign in with Apple, Google or email. Groovo is currently available in Italian.

Groovo is a product of DFN Development S.R.L.

name: GrowERP Club & Association
description:
Run your club in one app. GrowERP Club is made for sports clubs and associations: members with their sections and membership types, families on one membership, and the whole member list imported from your spreadsheet.

Key Features:
• Members with date of birth, gender, membership type, sections, join and leave date
• Membership types with their dues per year, quarter or month
• Family memberships: one payer, the family linked to it
• Import your member list from a CSV file
• Sections (departments) with their member counts
• Your club's own website with a membership application form
• Invoicing and accounting included

Made for sports clubs and associations with 20 to 2,000 members. GrowERP is open source and runs on the Moqui and Apache OFBiz business platforms — no licence fees, no lock-in.

Accessible on Linux, Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and web browsers. All synchronized in real-time.

name: GrowERP Food Producer
description:
Bake, sell and trace every batch. GrowERP Food is made for artisan bakeries and small food makers: recipes that scale to any batch, ingredients received with the supplier's lot number and expiry date, and the stock that expires first used first.

Key Features:
• Recipes with their yield: scale from 20 loaves to 60 and the ingredients follow
• Ingredients received by lot with best-before date; lots on stock, expiring first on top
• Batches made from the recipe, with the lots they used
• Traceability one step back and one step forward, as EU food law asks
• Wholesale orders and the counter (point of sale) in one app
• Your own webshop and website
• Purchasing, inventory and accounting included

Made for bakeries, sauce and specialty-food makers with 2 to 30 people. GrowERP is open source and runs on the Moqui and Apache OFBiz business platforms — no licence fees, no lock-in.

Accessible on iPhone, iPad, Mac, other main platforms and web browsers. All synchronized in real-time.

name: GrowERP Job Shop
description:
Quote made-to-order parts in minutes, priced from the routing and the bill of materials. GrowERP Jobshop is made for small machine, fabrication and sheet-metal shops that make parts to the customer's drawing.

Key Features:
• Quote calculator: setup and run time per operation, work-centre rates, material from the BOM, outside processing and your markup
• The price per piece for every quantity the customer asks: 10, 100 or 1000
• The chosen quantity becomes a quote; accepted, it becomes the job
• Work centres with an hourly rate, routings and bills of materials
• Work orders that use the material and put the finished parts in stock
• Customers, parts, purchasing, inventory and invoicing
• Your own website with a quote request form
• Accounting with ledger, invoices and payments

Made for job shops with 1 to 15 people: quote at the office desk, follow the job on a tablet on the shop floor; it is the same data either way. GrowERP is open source and runs on the Moqui and Apache OFBiz business platforms — no licence fees, no lock-in.

Accessible on iPhone, iPad, Mac, other main platforms and web browsers. All synchronized in real-time.

name: GrowERP Repair Shop
description:
Run your repair shop from intake to pickup. GrowERP Repair follows every job on a repair board: from intake and diagnosis through the quote, the repair and waiting for parts, to ready and picked up. Drag a ticket to the next stage when the work moves on.

Key Features:
• Repair tickets with the customer's equipment, serial number and service history
• Quotes of labour and parts; the customer approves by a link in a text message
• Text messages to the customer from your own Twilio number, replies on the ticket
• Parts reserved from stock, missing parts ordered from your supplier
• Labour hours logged per ticket, billed at pickup together with the parts
• Pick up and pay at the counter, cash or card; stock and books updated
• Online booking: customers book a time on your own website
• Your own website, managed in-app, with the booking form ready

Made for bike shops, small engine and garden equipment repair, and other repair and service shops. GrowERP is open source and runs on the Moqui business platform — no licence fees, no lock-in.

Accessible on Linux, Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and web browsers. All synchronized in real-time.

name: Grumpy Vrbas
description:
Grumpy je pizza i sandwich bar u Vrbasu (M. Tita 103). Pica sa šamota i sendviči u domaćoj lepinji, a Grumpy je mrzovoljan, ali ti nećeš biti.

U aplikaciji možeš:
• da pogledaš ceo meni sa cenama (pice, parče, sendviči, piće)
• da poručiš za dostavu ili preuzimanje, plaćanje gotovinom
• da pratiš status porudžbine i dobiješ obaveštenje kad je prihvaćena, spremna ili na putu
• da igraš Grumpy igrice i osvojiš kod za popust od 5, 10 ili 20%
• da vidiš akcije, radno vreme i gde se nalazimo

Prijava je preko Apple ili Google naloga, bez lozinki.

name: Gym Strength & Recovery
description:
New to the gym? Returning after a break, or coming back after an injury? Then this app is for you.

Gym Strength & Recovery is a simple diary for your training and how your body responds to it. You record your exercises and keep an eye on how you feel afterwards. No complicated programmes, no jargon, no account to set up.

RECORD YOUR WORKOUTS
• Weights: exercise, weight, sets and repetitions
• Cardio: duration, distance, speed, incline, resistance and effort
• Classes and anything else, with as much or as little detail as you like
• Add a note on how each session felt

KEEP TRACK OF HOW YOUR BODY FEELS
• Note pain, stiffness, swelling, weakness or spasms, and where you felt them
• Rate how strong it was from 0 to 10
• Record when you noticed it: during exercise, afterwards, before bed or the next morning
• Recovery check-ins after the gym, everyday activity or long periods of sitting

SEE THE PATTERN
Look back through your workouts, symptoms and check-ins to see what your body copes with well and what it doesn't, so you can build up at your own pace. It's also a handy record to show a physiotherapist or trainer.

WORKS WITH APPLE HEALTH AND FITNESS
• Workouts you record can be added to Apple Health, so they count in Fitness
• Bring in workouts from your Apple Watch and add how they felt
• Connecting is optional and you stay in control

A GENTLE DAILY REMINDER
Set a time that suits you for a quick check-in on how you're feeling.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Everything you record stays on your iPhone. There's no sign-up, and your workouts, symptoms and recovery notes are never shared with us or anyone else.

FREE FOR 7 DAYS
Try everything free for a week. After that, a single payment of £4.99 unlocks the app for good. There's no subscription. If you choose not to unlock, you can still read everything you recorded.

PLEASE NOTE
Gym Strength & Recovery is a diary for your own records. It does not give medical advice, diagnose or treat any condition. If you're worried about pain or an injury, speak to a doctor or physiotherapist.

Made in the UK by NDS Studio.

name: HajdaGo
description:
HajdaGo answers one question: where should I go right now?

Turn on location, pick how much time you have, and get a short walk through 3 to 5 places nearby that are open now: parks, museums, cafes, viewpoints, monuments and more. The weather is taken into account. "Hidden gems" skips chains and the places every tourist already knows.

Every place card shows what a newcomer needs: open now or not, minutes on foot and by car, stars from other visitors, and which languages the staff speak. One tap opens the place in your maps or taxi app.

Collect a stamp in your city passport at every place you visit. The map starts under clouds and opens up where you walk. See how much of your district and your city you have explored.

Better with friends: send a walk with a day and time, chat, share places and lists, and compare your week on the friends board.

Free, no ads, no tracking. Works in English, Polish and Ukrainian. Map data from OpenStreetMap.

name: Ham Chatting
description:
Ham Chatting is a handheld for where you are standing: push-to-talk voice and short text between the phones around you, over your own Wi-Fi - no internet, no repeater, no reflector and no server.

NOBODY CAN DOUBLE
Press the big button and it turns amber while the channel gives you the floor; your microphone opens only when it turns red, with a tone you can hear without looking. Two people cannot talk over each other - something no radio can promise.

A CALLING CHANNEL AND TWELVE WORKING CHANNELS
CALL is where everyone meets, open to anyone on your network and labelled with your region's simplex calling frequency. Split off to one of twelve working channels to talk: each is private to your group, unlocked by a short code you share by QR or read out. A wrong code is not an error message - the channel is simply silent.

TEXT THAT NEVER WAITS
Messages ride the same channel as the voice and are never blocked by the floor, so you can type while someone else is talking. One-tap Q-codes: QSY, QRT, QRX, QSL, QTH?, 73 and HELP.

REPLAY WHAT YOU MISSED
The last two minutes of everything you heard, a tap away - 10 seconds, 30 seconds, 1 minute or 2. A live voice cuts in, and a station you blocked is never replayed.

YOUR VOICE, NOT A VOCODER
Uncompressed audio by default, so a voice sounds like a voice. Wide (16 kHz) for the most natural sound, Clear (8 kHz), or Efficient (Codec2) when the channel is crowded. A short dropout is smoothed over instead of clicking.

NET CONTROL
One station on each channel is Net Control, chosen automatically. Press at the same moment as someone else and one of you gets the floor; the other is told the channel is busy and presses again when it is clear - nothing waits in line to open a microphone later. Net Control can take the floor back or refuse it to a station - the phone left transmitting in somebody's bag - and a refusal holds through a rejoin and a change of Net Control. A stuck button is cut off by a three-minute time-out as well.

SAFE BY DEFAULT
Everyone accepts the house rules - zero tolerance for abuse - before joining. Block anyone in a tap, and what they said before disappears too; report them and they are blocked at once, with an email to us that we answer within 24 hours. Offensive words in what you receive are hidden by default.

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
A live roster of who is in range, with link-quality bars. Floor tones, a busy cue and a time-out warning on your own phone. Parrot self-test to check your audio with nobody else present. It keeps the screen awake while you are on a channel, and rebuilds its connections by itself when you come back to it. Every phone on a channel needs the same version of the app, and one on another version is listed, so you know who to update.

NOT A RADIO
Ham Chatting never transmits on the amateur bands and cannot key a radio, so no licence is needed - family and helpers can join the team. You bring the network: a pocket travel router is ideal - it needs no internet connection - and a home network works too.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no server, no analytics, no ads. Your voice and messages go directly between the phones on your network and nowhere else, and nothing reaches us unless you email us yourself.

Built for field days, hamfests, club meetings and drills - for the moments when the people you need are close enough to see.

name: HD Office צופה מסמכים ו-PDF
description:
מסמכים נפתחים בטלפון מסודרים וברורים. HD Office מציגה קובצי PDF, Word, Excel ומצגות במסך נקי אחד, גם בפורמטים הישנים, בעברית מלאה מימין לשמאל, וכל העיבוד נעשה בתוך המכשיר

מסמכי PDF
• עמודים חדים וברורים
• מונה עמודים שמראה באיזה עמוד אתם נמצאים
• מסמך שמוגן בסיסמה נפתח אחרי הקלדת הסיסמה
• עברית מוצגת נכון

מסמכי Word
• פריסת עמודים כמו במסמך המקורי, כולל כותרת עליונה וחלוקה לעמודים
• תצוגת קריאה שמסדרת את הטקסט מחדש לרוחב המסך
• גרפים שבתוך מסמכי docx מוצגים במקומם
• גם קובצי Word ישנים (doc), מסמכי RTF ומסמכי ODT

גיליונות Excel
• טבלה בסגנון גיליון אלקטרוני עם אותיות עמודות ומספרי שורות
• לשוניות בתחתית המסך למעבר מהיר בין גיליונות
• גיליונות מימין לשמאל מוצגים בכיוון הנכון
• שורות ועמודות מוקפאות נשארות במקומן בזמן הגלילה
• צבעים, גבולות ותאים ממוזגים כפי שהוגדרו בקובץ
• מספרים, תאריכים ו-₪ בפורמט שהוגדר בקובץ
• תמונות שבתוך הגיליון
• הקשה על תא מציגה את התוכן המלא שלו
• שינוי רוחב עמודות בגרירה, והקשה כפולה על אות העמודה מתאימה אותה לתוכן
• גלילה חלקה גם בגיליונות של אלפי שורות
• גרפים: עמודות, קווים, עוגה, שטח ופיזור, במקום שבו הם נמצאים בגיליון, גם בקובצי xls ישנים

מצגות PowerPoint
• כל השקופיות ברצף, אחת אחרי השנייה
• מונה שקופיות
• גם מצגות ישנות (ppt) ומצגות ODP

נוח לשימוש יומיומי
• כפתור אחד לפתיחת כל קובץ מאפליקציית הקבצים, כולל iCloud Drive ושירותי אחסון שמחוברים אליה
• ארבעה אריחים לפי סוג קובץ, שכל אחד מהם פותח את בורר הקבצים מסונן לסוג שלו
• מסמך שקיבלתם במייל, בהודעה או בכל אפליקציה אחרת נשלח ל-HD Office מתפריט השיתוף ונפתח מיד
• רשימת "נפתחו לאחרונה" לפתיחה חוזרת בלחיצה
• חיפוש בתוך המסמך, עם סימון התוצאות ומעבר ביניהן
• כפתור שיתוף ששולח את המסמך הפתוח לכל אפליקציה במכשיר
• שמירת עותק של המסמך בכל תיקייה שתבחרו באפליקציית הקבצים
• קובצי Word, Excel ו-PowerPoint שמוגנים בסיסמה נפתחים אחרי הקלדת הסיסמה
• הגדלה בצביטה ובהקשה כפולה בכל סוגי המסמכים
• מצב כהה שמתחלף לפי הגדרת המכשיר

פרטיות
בלי חשבון, בלי הרשמה, בלי פרסומות ובלי מעקב. האפליקציה לא מתחברת לאינטרנט, והקבצים נקראים ומוצגים בתוך המכשיר בלבד. רשימת "נפתחו לאחרונה" נשמרת באחסון הפרטי של האפליקציה במכשיר, ואפשר להסיר ממנה כל קובץ

פורמטים נתמכים
• מסמכים: pdf, docx, doc, docm, dotx, dot, rtf, odt, txt
• גיליונות: xlsx, xlsm, xltx, xls, ods, csv
• מצגות: pptx, ppt, ppsx, pps, odp

חשוב לדעת
• האפליקציה מיועדת לצפייה ולקריאה ואינה עורכת מסמכים
• תמונות בתוך גיליון מוצגות בקובצי xlsx. בקובצי xlsx גדולים במיוחד מוצגים הנתונים, צבעי הרקע, התאים הממוזגים והגרפים, ובקובצי ods ו-csv הנתונים עצמם. בקובצי xls, ods ו-csv ובקובצי xlsx גדולים מוצגות עד 30,000 שורות בכל גיליון
• שמות הפורמטים מוזכרים לצורך תאימות בלבד ושייכים לבעליהם. HD Office היא אפליקציה עצמאית שאינה קשורה אליהם

המסמכים שלכם נפתחים כמו שצריך ונשארים אצלכם

name: HeightAhead AI
description:
Camera-based height estimates require a compatible iPhone with rear LiDAR. On other supported iPhone models, enter measurements manually or import checkup reports.

Log your child’s height and weight and see how measurements change over time. Set a reminder for the next check and share a PDF report when you choose.

• Add profile
• Backup & restore
• Notes
• Units  cm/kg · in/lb

Automatic extraction supports checkup reports in Simplified Chinese or English only. Check the dates, units, and numbers before saving.

Camera estimates are for home growth tracking only. Check the reading with a stadiometer or tape measure. If you have health questions, consult a healthcare professional.

name: HelpMeConstruct
description:
HelpMeConstruct connects people who need repair and construction work with licensed technicians, contracting companies and building-material shops nearby.

FOR CLIENTS
• Post a job in a minute, with photos or a voice note
• Get prices from nearby pros and compare them side by side
• See profiles, work photos and ratings before you choose
• Your exact address and phone stay private until you hire
• Request building materials and get price and delivery from nearby shops
• Pay the pro directly. HelpMeConstruct never handles your money

FOR PROS (technicians, companies, labour supply)
• See jobs near you in your trade
• Send your price in seconds, even as a voice note
• See the client's budget before you price
• No fee, no commission, no subscription

FOR MATERIAL SHOPS
• Receive material requests from contractors and home owners nearby
• Reply with price and delivery time from your phone

Trades: AC & HVAC, plumbing, electrical, painting, tiling, carpentry, gypsum & fit-out, masonry, waterproofing, handyman, labour & helpers, building materials.

Available in English, Arabic and Urdu. Now live in the Gulf, growing worldwide.

name: Hereabouts Admin
description:
Hereabouts Admin is for the people who look after a Juniper Mist network. It puts what matters in your hand while you walk the building: which sites need attention, what is down, how each service level is doing and why, and what to do about it.

- Sites at a glance: the ones that need attention first, devices down, open findings, and each site's worst service level
- Service levels for Wi-Fi, the wired network and the internet link, with why they were missed, when, and the access points, switches and users affected
- Access points, switches, gateways and clients, searchable, each with its own detail and service levels
- This iPhone: which access point your own phone is on now, its signal and link, and a button to bounce it off
- Act on the spot: locate an access point by blinking its light, restart a device, bounce a switch port, disconnect a client, rename a device, with Face ID before every change and an undo where it can be undone
- Ask Marvis, Mist's AI assistant, in your own words, with its answers laid out as summaries, tables and charts
- Findings from labs with their evidence and a fix to preview and apply
- Floor plans, ping, traceroute, cable tests, guest Wi-Fi keys and device claiming
- Alerts for new critical findings, and works on iPhone and iPad

Hereabouts Admin works with an account on a labs server connected to your Mist organisation, signed in with a password and a two-factor code. No account? Tap "Explore with sample data" on the first screen to see every screen with made-up sites; nothing connects to a real network.

name: Hexweft Arc
description: Hexweft Arc ਇੱਕ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਟੈਕਸਟ–ਬਾਈਟ ਵਰਖਸਪੇਸ ਹੈ। ਲਿਖਤ ਨੂੰ ਯੂਟੀਐਫ‑੮ ਜਾਂ ਹੋਰ ਏਨਕੋਡਿੰਗ ਨਾਲ ਬਾਈਟਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਦਲੋ ਜਾਂ ਉਲਟਾ ਕਰੋ; ਸਮੂਹ, ਭਰਾਈ, ਵੱਖਰਕਰਨ ਅਤੇ ਲਾਈਨ–ਬ੍ਰੇਕ ਵਿਕਲਪ ਬਦਲੋ। ਅੱਖਰਾਂ, ਬਾਈਟਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਹਰ ਅੱਖਰ ਲਈ ਔਸਤ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਦੇਖੋ, ਆਫਸੈੱਟ–ਆਧਾਰਿਤ ਹੈਕਸ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ ਨਾਲ ਹਰ ਬਾਈਟ ਦੀ ਜਾਂਚ ਕਰੋ, ਕਈ ਟੁਕੜਿਆਂ ਲਈ ਬੈਚ ਪ੍ਰਕਿਰਿਆ ਕਰੋ, ਅਤੇ ਨਤੀਜੇ ਇਸੀ ਫੋਨ ਤੇ ਸੰਭਾਲੋ। ਇੰਟਰਨੈੱਟ ਲੋੜੀਂਦਾ ਨਹੀਂ; ਸਾਰਾ ਕੰਮ ਡਿਵਾਈਸ ਤੇ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ।

name: HeyStack Photo App
description:
HeyStack helps you turn a photodump into a smaller set worth keeping. Choose a sample photo and tap your own face, then import photos, albums or shared albums. Set the number or percentage you want to keep. With your permission, AI helps choose distinct, flattering shots of you. Review the results and make the final selection yourself.

Keep your selections together in your private HeyStack album. Save chosen originals to a new album in Photos, preserving the original assets and Live Photos. HeyStack never deletes photos from your iPhone library.

Choose a username and share selected pictures with accepted friends. Browse their photos, expand a picture and tag a friend. Your profile photos are visible only to you and your accepted friends.

Analysis uploads smaller photo previews and requires your permission. AI can make mistakes, so you remain in control of your final selection. An internet connection is needed for analysis and sharing.

name: HFSM
description:
HFSM — Field Service Management Built for Contractors

Take control of your field service business with Hunter Field Service Management (HFSM), an all-in-one platform designed to help contractors organize operations, manage crews, serve customers, and grow their businesses.

Whether you’re a solo contractor or managing multiple service trucks, HFSM brings your daily operations together in one connected system.

MANAGE JOBS FROM START TO FINISH

Create work orders, assign technicians, manage service appointments, and track job progress. Keep your office and field teams connected with job details, customer information, and service history.

SMART SCHEDULING & DISPATCH

Organize your calendar, coordinate crews, view assigned work, and manage daily routes. Help technicians stay informed with appointment details and job updates.

ESTIMATES, INVOICES & PAYMENTS

Build professional estimates and invoices, manage line items, record payments, and monitor outstanding balances. Keep financial information organized without switching between multiple tools.

CUSTOMERS & PROPERTY MANAGEMENT

Maintain customer profiles, service addresses, property details, equipment records, and job history. Access the information your team needs when visiting a property.

INTERACTIVE PROPERTY MAPS

Document property layouts and important service locations using visual property maps. Help technicians locate equipment and understand job-site details.

INVENTORY & EQUIPMENT TRACKING

Organize products, materials, equipment, and inventory across your operations. Keep better track of supplies used by your field teams.

TECHNICIAN TOOLS

Give field employees access to assigned jobs, customer details, job notes, photos, and work updates. Support time tracking and field documentation from their phones.

CUSTOMER COMMUNICATION

Support your customer experience with appointment notifications, reminders, and available email and SMS communication tools.

BUILT FOR MULTIPLE SERVICE INDUSTRIES

HFSM is designed for irrigation and sprinkler contractors, landscaping companies, plumbing businesses, HVAC professionals, electrical contractors, property maintenance teams, and other field service providers.

GROW WITH YOUR BUSINESS

Start with the tools you need and expand as your company grows. HFSM supports independent contractors, small teams, and businesses managing multiple technicians and service vehicles.

WHY HFSM?

Because running a contracting business should not require juggling disconnected spreadsheets, calendars, invoices, and customer records.

HFSM helps bring your office and field operations into one place, giving you more visibility and control over the work that matters.

Learn more at https://hfsm.app

Feature availability may vary by subscription plan, company configuration, and user permissions. An HFSM account is required.

name: HiddenLives
description:
Every place keeps a secret. Some of them are waiting for you.

The bench where someone got the call. The café where two strangers became something more. The bus stop where a life quietly changed direction. HiddenLives hides short, anonymous stories at the real places where they happened, and nobody else ever knew.

SOME ONLY OPEN WHERE THEY HAPPENED
• Every light on the map is a story someone left behind.
• Read from anywhere in the world.
• Locked stories show only their first line. The rest opens when you stand within 100 metres of the spot. Once opened, it stays with you.
• You can only leave a story at a place you are standing at, and you decide who can read it: anyone, or only those who come to find it.

NO ONE WILL EVER KNOW IT WAS YOU
• No account, no name, no email, no phone number, no profile, no followers, no replies.
• Every story is signed "Someone" and shows only a season and a year, never the day.
• Everything travels encrypted. Your location is only used to check you are near a place and is never stored with your stories.
• Ads in the free version are never personalised and cannot follow you to other apps.

SAFE BY DESIGN
• Stories are checked for names, phone numbers, addresses and handles before they appear.
• Report any story or block its writer in one tap. Anything that breaks the rules is removed.

FEEL, KEEP, WANDER
• Tag a story with one of twelve feelings, from joy and gratitude to loss and hope.
• Let the writer know a story reached someone.
• Keep the ones that stay with you.
• Your trail remembers every place where a story opened for you.

LEAVE NO TRACE
Take back any story at any time. One tap deletes everything you left, on your phone and on our servers.

HiddenLives is free with ads. HiddenLives Pro removes them (monthly or yearly subscription, renewing automatically until cancelled).
For people aged 18 and over.

Terms of Use: https://hiddenlives-app.web.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://hiddenlives-app.web.app/privacy

name: Highland Ruins
description:
The Highlands used to be one country. Then the Hush rose from below, a dark fog, and the land broke into nine floating islands. You wake at dawn on the smallest of them. There is a spring, a few trees, a starter chest and a long tally of marks scratched into the rock. When the light goes, something climbs up over the edge.

Highland Ruins is a quiet, eerie first-person survival game for iPhone. Gather, combine, build and keep the fire burning, then build bridges across the fog until all nine islands are connected again.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Crosshair controls: tap anywhere to hit what's under the X, hold anywhere to dig, and drag while holding to aim.
• A tap-to-pick item wheel.
• A Guide Book with the story, your quests and how to play.
• 22 quests with rewards: gather fiber, chop logs, build a fire pit, sleep in a bed, defeat 1, 5, 25 and 100 creatures, and connect the islands.
• A starter chest with a wooden pickaxe, axe and shovel.
• Place dirt, stone and flint blocks and piles. They need ground under them; only bridges and planks reach over the edge.
• Water flows into holes you dig and spreads.
• Health bars on creatures, so you know when to fight and when to run.
• Each island has its own creatures, ruins and secrets: hidden tunnels, waterfalls inside islands, and old chapels you can mine for stone bricks.
• An original light jazz soundtrack, with a Music volume slider.

SURVIVE THE NIGHT
• A full day lasts 20 minutes. Dusk comes sooner than you think.
• Keep an eye on health, hunger, thirst and Dread, the fear that grows in the dark.
• A lit fire pit keeps the night away. Most things won't come near it. Some things want to put it out.
• Build a bed under a roof to sleep through the night and set where you wake.

GATHER, COMBINE, BUILD
• Dig into smooth, sculptable ground: dirt, clay, stone and veins of ore. Work trees, bushes and rocks.
• Craft by dropping ingredients into a tray. The order never matters, and a wrong guess never wastes anything.
• Discover recipes by experimenting, or learn them from torn notes left behind.
• Snap walls, floors, roofs and doors together into a real home.

BRIDGE THE VOID
• Plant a tree farm, then lay a bridge out across the black, one metre at a time.
• Wood, then stone, then iron: each reaches farther. Drift rocks let you go farther still.
• Nine islands hide old ruins, their quiet guardians, blueprints and the story of what happened here.

GROW YOUR HOLD
• Build generators that slowly make food, water, logs, stone and ore, and upgrade them as you level up.
• A free daily chest with a gentle seven-day streak. Miss a day and it only steps back a little.
• Level up to 50 and unlock new tools, stations and bridges along the way.

TWO WAYS TO PLAY
• Normal: fall, and you wake again. Your things wait where you lost them, for a while.
• Survival: one life. When it ends, the world ends with it.

COMFORT OPTIONS
• Touch controls built for landscape, with a crosshair in the middle of the screen.
• Reduce flashing, camera shake off, larger text, left-handed and split touch controls, and a customisable layout.
• Battery saver and graphics quality settings.
• A photosensitivity warning on first launch.

No ads. No in-app purchases. No account. Plays fully offline.

Made by Puzzlys Studio.

name: HiMaker
description:
HiMaker helps you turn creative ideas into pixel art and fuse bead designs, from your first sketch to the finished piece.

Create pixel art
Draw and edit designs on a grid, choose colors, and build your own patterns one pixel at a time.

Turn photos into patterns
Choose a photo, crop it, and transform it into a pixel-style pattern for your next project.

Import and organize designs
Bring existing patterns into HiMaker and keep your creations together for easy access.

Keep track of your beads
Manage your bead colors and quantities so you can prepare for your next project.

Connect a compatible bead board
Connect a supported device via Bluetooth to display patterns and highlight colors as you work.

Whether you're planning a small pixel design or working on a larger bead project, HiMaker keeps your creative tools in one place.

A compatible Bluetooth device is required for connected board features.

name: Hipla - Focus
description:
With Hipla, users can create detailed movement replays of their strength training sessions. Simply record or import a video of a squat, lunge, or push-up. The app uses on-device pose detection to identify specific movement phases—descent, the transition point, and the drive—and automatically applies variable slow-motion speeds to these critical moments.

All video analysis and processing happen locally on your device; your training videos are never uploaded to a server. Previewing replays is free, while exporting the final processed video to your photo library requires in-app coins. Users can manually adjust phase markers on the timeline for precision. Hipla maintains a history of your processed videos, including movement types, speed curves, and identification confidence, to help you review your form over time.

name: HOLD ON! Sky Drop
description:
Grab a ride. Hold on. Let go.

HOLD ON! is a one-touch timing game about nerve. Touch and hold to grab a balloon, a zipline or a bird, and it carries you over a chain of floating platforms. Let go to drop onto one. Land it and the next ride is waiting. Miss, and it is a long way down.

EVERY RIDE IS A DECISION
Drop on the first platform and bank a safe point. Or hold on past one, two, three platforms for a bigger score, while your grip drains the whole time. The safe choice and the greedy choice are both always on screen.

NO AIMING AID
There is no landing marker. You come down ahead of your shadow, and how far ahead depends on what is carrying you. The balloon is slow and steady. The zipline gets faster the longer you hold. The bird weaves from side to side. Learning each one is the game.

HARD, NEVER UNFAIR
Level 1 has no hazards. After that, spikes start to guard the landing spots, loosely at first and then tighter with every level. Every carrier always behaves the same way, and after every fall the game shows you exactly where you came down and by how much you missed.

DAILY RUN
One route a day, the same for every player. One ranked attempt. Unlimited practice.

MAKE IT YOURS
Earn coins by playing and spend them on skins. Coins are never sold, and no skin changes how the game plays.

FAIR BY DESIGN
Nothing you can buy and no ad you can watch changes your grip, your speed or your score. The purchases remove ads or add cosmetics, and that is all.

Tap Grip, in Settings, lets you tap once to grab and once to let go instead of holding. Same game, same scores.

HOLD ON! contains ads and optional in-app purchases.

name: Hold the Line: Mutant Front
description:
Hold the Line: Mutant Front is a zombie tower defense game with deep upgrades. Dig in, build your arsenal and stop the mutating dead before they break your line.

DEFEND THE TRENCH
Place machine guns, mortars, snipers and more along your trench. Tap a weapon to upgrade it, sell it or replace it as the waves get tougher. When your line falls you can continue and fight back from where you left off.

500 WAVES, 6 ZONES
Fight through a continuous campaign across six zones. Each zone brings new zombies, bigger hordes and giant bosses. Your turrets and progress carry over as you push forward.

MUTATIONS EVOLVE
The horde adapts to your defense. Choose mutation cards between waves to shape your strategy and survive what comes next.

UPGRADE EVERYTHING
Collect DNA and spend it in the Laboratory and the Weapon Tree to make your defense permanently stronger. Unlock new weapons in the Arsenal as you advance. Even when you fall, every run makes you stronger for the next one.

DAILY MISSION
Complete the daily mission for bonus DNA and keep climbing your best wave record.

FEATURES
- Tower defense with an incremental upgrade system
- 500 waves across 6 zones with boss fights
- Weapon Tree, Laboratory and Arsenal upgrades
- Mutation cards that change the battlefield
- Encyclopedia of zombies and mutants
- Hand-drawn art and atmospheric music
- Free to play, no ads, no purchases

Music: "Welcome to HorrorLand" by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under CC BY 4.0.

name: Holy Bible KJV – Daily Reading
description:
HOLY BIBLE KJV — DAILY READING
Read the King James Version aloud, follow a plan, and keep one chosen verse with you each day. The whole Bible is on your iPhone, with no account and no connection.

The complete King James Version (1769 text, without Apocrypha) is included: 39 Old Testament books and 27 New Testament books, 31,102 verses, set in a serif typeface.

READ ALOUD
The English voice on your iPhone reads the chapter. Pause it, choose a slower or faster pace, and keep listening with the screen locked.

READING PLANS
Bible in a Year, the New Testament in 90 days, or a month of Psalms & Proverbs. Mark each day as you finish it.

365 CHOSEN VERSES
Home, the notification, and the Home Screen widget share one famous King James verse each day, beginning with John 3:16 on January 1.

VERSE IMAGE
Place a verse on night, dawn, sea, an olive grove, or parchment, then share the picture.

MEMORIZE
Hide words in the verse and tap each blank to learn it.

BIBLE SEARCH
Find a verse, passage, or topic throughout the Bible. Search results highlight matching text.

EASY NAVIGATION
Browse by book, chapter, and verse. A clear chapter grid helps you find a passage, and reading resumes at your last position.

FOUR HIGHLIGHT COLORS
Mark verses in gold, green, blue, or pink. Highlights and bookmarks are saved on your device.

BOOKMARKS AND HISTORY
Save favorite verses and return to recently read chapters.

COPY AND SHARE
Copy a verse or share several verses through Messages, Mail, or another app you choose.

DARK, LIGHT OR SEPIA
Choose your appearance and adjust the text size.

OFFLINE AND AD-FREE
The Bible text is included in the app. No account, subscription, or Internet connection is required.

"Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path." — Psalm 119:105

name: Hoops Ke.
description:
Hoops Ke is the official platform for Kenyan basketball leagues, tournaments, live scores, player analytics, and team operations.

REAL-TIME MATCH CENTER & BOXSCORES
• Live quarter-by-quarter scores, synced game clocks, and play-by-play updates across premier, regional, and tournament competitions.
• Full boxscores, shot efficiency, rosters, and matchup comparisons from tip-off to final buzzer.

LOCK SCREEN LIVE ACTIVITIES & HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
• Pin ongoing or upcoming matchups directly to your Lock Screen and Dynamic Island from the Game Details screen.
• Add Small or Medium HoopsKe Home Screen widgets to check live scores and upcoming tip-offs at a glance and tap straight into any matchup.

DESIGNED FOR IPHONE, IPAD & IPHONE DUO
• Native iOS tab navigation automatically adapts across compact screens, foldable canvases, and iPad sidebars.
• Multi-pane split views let you browse Games, Standings, and Teams alongside rich matchup and team previews.
• Flexible courtside Scoreboard mode adapts cleanly across portrait, landscape, and split-screen multitasking.

STANDINGS, PLAYOFFS & MEDIA HUB
• Division and conference standings with point differentials and playoff cutoff indicators.
• Tournament brackets, game-day editorial recaps, comic-style matchup stories, and weekly League MVP rankings.
• Ask the built-in HoopsKe AI Analyst about team form, fixtures, and league leaders.

OFFICIAL TEAM MERCH & IN-APP CONSENT
• Browse verified club merchandise in the HoopsKe Shop with scannable matchday Order Pickup QR Passes.
• Athletes and guardians can review and complete TalantaDraft KE data and media consent directly in the app.

name: Hushmeter: Decibel Meter dB
description:
Hushmeter turns your iPhone into a sound level meter. See how loud it is right now in dB(A), how long it is safe to listen at that level, and save a report when the noise won't stop.

LIVE METER
• Live reading in dB(A), updated four times a second
• Minimum, average (Leq) and maximum for the session
• Color zones that are always written out: Safe, Loud, Harmful over time
• "About as loud as" comparisons, from a quiet library to a rock concert
• The last 60 seconds as a chart
• Safe listening time based on the NIOSH guideline

NOISE REPORTS
• Record for a few minutes or a whole night, also with the screen locked
• A chart with your limit line, plus average, peak and minutes over the limit
• Short audio clips of the loudest moments, kept only on your iPhone
• Export a PDF to send to a landlord, building manager or HOA

HUSHMETER PRO
• PDF export and unlimited saved reports
• Daily noise dose with NIOSH or OSHA exchange rates
• Alerts when the level stays above your limit
• dB(C) weighting for bass, music and speakers
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets

PRIVACY
Live metering never records audio. Audio is saved only inside a report you start, and it stays on your device. No account and no ads.

ABOUT ACCURACY
Hushmeter uses the iPhone microphone, so readings are estimates and not a certified measurement. For the closest results, calibrate it against a reference meter in Settings.

Hushmeter Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase or when a free trial ends, and renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://hushmeter.vercel.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://hushmeter.vercel.app/privacy

name: Hydrant Flow Test
description:
Hydrant Flow Test keeps one hydrant site on this iPhone. Pitot outlets add into Q20 and NFPA class.

Drag the demand point and the supply verdict updates. Outlet readings flag Unsteady when the spread is too wide.

There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: IDSnap - Passport Photo Maker
description:
NO SUBSCRIPTION. FIRST PHOTO FREE. YOUR PHOTO NEVER LEAVES YOUR PHONE.

Skip the photo booth. IDSnap turns a photo from your phone into a passport, visa or ID photo made to official size rules — and lays out 4 copies on a standard 4×6 in (10×15 cm) print you can order anywhere for less than a dollar.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick your country and document.
2. Take a photo against any light wall, or choose one from Photos.
3. IDSnap does the rest: white background, head size, eye line, light and color.
4. Save the print sheet and order a 4×6 print at any drugstore, supermarket kiosk or photo shop. Or keep the single digital file for online applications.

MADE TO THE RULES
• 30+ countries and documents: US 2×2 in, Canada, Schengen/EU, Italy, Australia, China, India, Japan, Korea, Türkiye and more
• Head size and eye position set in millimeters for each document
• Pure white background with clean hair edges
• Automatic checks: straight look, eyes open, mouth closed, even light, glasses glare
• Clear advice when a photo won't pass, with a simple guide on how to stand and shoot

NATURAL RETOUCH
• Auto light and auto color
• Soft skin, brighter eyes, tidier brows and lips
• Glasses glare reduction
• Your face stays your face: no reshaping, no filters

PRINT ANYWHERE
• 4 photos on one 4×6 sheet with cut lines
• High-resolution digital file for online forms
• Save, print or share in one tap

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photo never leaves your phone. No account, no upload, no tracking.

PRICING — CLEAR AND FAIR
• Your first photo is free: see the result before you pay anything
• Then pay once per photo, or once for unlimited photos for the whole family (Family Sharing)
• No subscription, no weekly fees, nothing to cancel
• Made by a professional photographer with 28 years behind the camera

Note: IDSnap prepares photos to the published size and composition rules of each document. The issuing authority makes the final decision on acceptance.

name: ifcNetUtil
description:
ifcNetUtil es la calculadora de red para técnicos, instaladores y administradores de sistemas. Rápida, clara, en español y sin anuncios.

Escribe la red como la tengas: en notación CIDR (192.168.1.0/24), con IP y máscara (192.168.1.10 255.255.255.0) o en IPv6 (2001:db8::/48). La app detecta el formato y te muestra al momento:

• Número de dispositivos posibles (hosts utilizables), con /31 y /32 tratados correctamente.
• Dirección de red, máscara, prefijo, wildcard y broadcast.
• Primer y último host y direcciones totales.
• Tipo de dirección: privada, pública, CGNAT, link-local, loopback, multicast…
• Máscara, IP y red en binario y hexadecimal.

SUBREDES
Divide cualquier red por número de subredes, por hosts necesarios en cada una o eligiendo el nuevo prefijo. Verás cada subred con su rango de hosts, lista para copiar.

IPv6
Formas comprimida y expandida, rango completo, número exacto de direcciones y cuántas redes /64 caben en tu prefijo.

TABLA DE PREFIJOS
Referencia rápida de /0 a /32 con su máscara y número de hosts, y los prefijos IPv6 más habituales con su uso típico.

CONTRASEÑAS ROBUSTAS
Genera contraseñas seguras para routers, Wi-Fi y equipos: longitud, mayúsculas, números, símbolos y opción de evitar caracteres que se confunden (I, l, 1, O, 0). Guárdalas cifradas en el Llavero del iPhone, protegidas con Face ID, y compártelas o cópialas con borrado automático del portapapeles.

PRIVACIDAD
La app no recopila ni envía ningún dato. Todo se calcula en tu iPhone y funciona sin conexión.

Hecha por ifcCOM, operador de internet en la Axarquía (Málaga).

name: IJsrug
description:
IJsrug is een werkplaats met twee banken. Op de ijssnede zet je diepte, korrel, water en wachttijd, en lees je helderheid en vasthouden. Op de goudkam zet je folie, warmte, gangen en helling, en lees je stijging en kleef.

Eén stap tegelijk. Geen levens, geen aftellen, geen reclame en geen account. Wat je bewaart, blijft op dit apparaat.

• 64 stappen ijssnede — snijd de lens en lees de helderheid
• 78 stappen goudkam — leg de kam en lees de kleef
• De steenrekening neemt alleen aan wat je zelf bewaart
• Het pad gaat op volgorde; houd het venster, dan opent de volgende stap
• Terugkoppeling vanaf de voorpagina blijft op dit apparaat

IJsrug verzamelt niets en verstuurt niets. Geen analyse en geen reclame. Verwijder je IJsrug, dan is de werkplaats weg.

name: Image to PDF: PDF Maker & Scan
description:
Turn photos into clean PDF files in seconds. Image to PDF is a PDF maker, document scanner and PDF editor in one simple app: pick your images, adjust the pages and share a finished PDF straight from your iPhone.

IMAGE TO PDF CONVERTER
• Convert JPG, PNG, HEIC and other photos to PDF
• Pick photos from any album, in the order you want
• Crop, rotate, reorder and delete pages before saving
• Page size: A4, Letter, Legal, A3, A5 or fit to image
• Portrait or landscape, with or without margins
• Four compression levels, from best quality to smallest file
• Protect the PDF with a password as you create it

DOCUMENT SCANNER
• Scan papers, receipts, notes and books with your camera
• Automatic edge detection and perspective correction
• Scanner filters: Original, Docs, Image, Super, Enhance, Gray and B&W
• ID card mode puts the front and back on one page

PDF EDITOR
• Draw, highlight and add text on any PDF
• Sign documents with your own signature
• Add a watermark or page numbers

PDF TOOLS
• Merge PDF: combine several files into one
• Split PDF and extract the pages you need
• Organize pages: reorder, rotate or remove them
• Compress PDF to make big files easy to send
• Lock a PDF with a password, or remove a password you know
• Save PDF pages as images
• Print any PDF

OFFICE TO PDF
• Convert Word, Excel, PowerPoint and TXT files to PDF
• Open and read DOCX, XLSX, PPTX and TXT files

PDF READER
• Smooth scrolling with pinch and double-tap zoom
• Go to any page and search the text
• Night mode and page-by-page reading

FILE LIBRARY
• Your PDFs and office documents in one place: All, Recent and Favorites
• Import from the Files app, iCloud Drive or any app with "Open in"
• Search, sort by name, date or size, list or grid view
• Rename, share and delete files in a tap

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your documents are converted on your iPhone and are never uploaded. Creating and editing PDFs works offline.

IMAGE TO PDF PREMIUM
Image to PDF is free to use with ads. Premium removes all ads and unlocks every tool without videos. Choose a weekly or yearly subscription (the yearly plan starts with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers) or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. name: Impératifs
description:
La certification des établissements de santé version 2027 compte 22 critères impératifs : les exigences fondamentales qu'aucun établissement ne peut manquer. Un seul critère impératif évalué sous le niveau attendu déclenche une fiche anomalie et pèse directement sur la décision de certification.

Impératifs les couvre tous les 22, dans un format unique pensé pour tous les professionnels — soignants, encadrement, direction, fonctions support. Un critère se travaille en 7 minutes ; la formation complète tient en 3 heures.

• Pour chaque critère : l'exigence en langage clair avec l'intitulé officiel, le risque patient derrière la conformité, ce qui est regardé le jour de la visite, vos réflexes concrets, les pièges classiques, l'essentiel à retenir, et un quiz de 4 questions avec explication à chaque réponse.

• Une introduction complète : ce qu'est un critère impératif, la fiche anomalie, les seuils de décision de certification, les cinq méthodes d'évaluation (patient traceur, parcours traceur, traceur ciblé, audit système, observations).

• Un mode révision qui rejoue automatiquement les questions ratées, jusqu'à les maîtriser.

• Le suivi de progression par chapitre — Le patient (7 critères), Les équipes de soins (12), L'établissement (3) — avec badge par critère validé et étiquettes de champ d'application (psychiatrie, maternité, chirurgie et interventionnel, patient âgé).

• Simple et respectueuse : 100 % gratuite, sans publicité ni achat intégré, 100 % hors ligne (fonctionne en mode avion dès le premier lancement), aucun compte, aucune donnée collectée — votre progression reste sur votre appareil.

Contenus pédagogiques rédigés et édités par Nexcellis (Praetor Santé) à partir du référentiel public « Certification des établissements de santé pour la qualité des soins — version 2027 », © Haute Autorité de santé. Le texte officiel, disponible sur has-sante.fr, fait seul foi. Application indépendante : Nexcellis n'est lié à aucune autorité publique ; cette application n'est ni éditée, ni approuvée par la HAS.

name: In Good Order: Tasks & Plans
description:
In Good Order gives your tasks and plans a place to live. Capture a to-do in Inbox, decide when to start it, and see what’s coming up without losing sight of today.

PLAN YOUR DAY
Use Today and Upcoming to see when work is planned. Give a task a separate deadline, set a reminder, or set it aside in Anytime or Someday until you’re ready.

GIVE PROJECTS A STRUCTURE
Group related tasks under project headings and organize projects into areas. Add notes, checklists, and tags. Use Quick Find to jump to a list or find something you’ve already captured.

MAKE ROUTINES REPEAT
Schedule tasks on a fixed pattern or start the next interval after completing one. Use the repeating task list to review, pause, or resume a schedule.

CAPTURE FROM WHERE YOU ARE
Send text or links from the system share sheet, create tasks with Shortcuts, and bring a selected list to your Home Screen with a widget. On a compatible paired Apple Watch, view Today and Inbox, add tasks, and check off steps.

KEEP YOUR LIBRARY CLOSE
Start without an account. Your task library is stored on your device. Optionally show selected calendars or import incomplete reminders from Apple Reminders. Save a JSON backup to Files and merge it back when you need it. On iPad, work with two windows and move tasks between lists.

name: IndiYatra
description:
From booking to itinerary management, our app is your go-to platform for all your travel needs, ensuring a smooth and enjoyable journey.

MAJOR HIGHLIGHTS: 
- Flights - Plan Your Travels Seamlessly with a Range of Domestic & International Flight Options.
- Hotels - Explore a wide selection of hotels with flexible options at the best prices around.
Buses - Easily book bus tickets for your preferred routes and timings throughout India. 
- Holidays - Book Domestic & International Travel Packages at Affordable Rates for Families, Couples, and Friends.
- Visas - Simplify your international travel plans with our visa service which covers 15 countries and has a 98.5% success rate.


TOP FEATURES: 
- Seamless Flight Planning:  Effortlessly plan your travels with a diverse range of domestic and international flight options available at your fingertips.
- Affordable Packages: Explore cost-effective travel options for various destinations.
- Expert Visa Assistance: Receive professional guidance for visa applications.
- Secure Transactions: We ensure safety with our reliable payment system.
- Customer Service: Access responsive support from our team.

Get started on your journey now! Download the app

name: Interstellar Postman
description:
Space needs its mail! Draw a route with your finger and the little mail ship flies exactly along your line, delivering letters to planets across the galaxy.

SIMPLE TO START, CLEVER TO MASTER
• One finger is all you need: draw, release, watch the delivery
• Dodge asteroids, comets and moving planets
• Use portals, slip past black holes, open magnetic gates
• Short of fuel? Find the shortest path for three stars

10 WORLDS AND 1000+ LEVELS
• 60 hand-made levels across 10 worlds, from the Mushroom Nebula to the Space Shipyard
• A tricky boss delivery at the end of every world
• Endless Space after the main story: new levels are generated forever

COLLECT AND CUSTOMIZE
• Earn stamps for new stars and first deliveries
• Unlock ships (rocket, saucer, paper plane, golden envelope) and colourful trails
• Fill your stamp album and complete achievements
• Daily mission, daily gift and a 7-day login reward

MADE FOR EVERYONE FROM 6 TO 60
• Calm pace: no level timers, take as long as you like
• Interactive tutorial for the first levels
• Boosters when you need a hand: shield, slow motion, extra fuel
• Available in English, Ukrainian, Russian, Spanish and German

The game is free. It contains optional rewarded videos and, for players 13+, short ads between levels, which you can remove with a one-time purchase. Players under 13 see only child-safe, non-personalized ads they choose to watch, and purchases are behind a grown-up check.

Privacy policy: https://rryymmbb.github.io/privacy/
Support: m.buryak.developer@gmail.com

name: Intervity: Interview Prep
description:
Intervity helps you prepare for technical interviews through deep, question-driven learning. No account, no subscription, no ads.

PICK A SKILL, MASTER IT STEP BY STEP
Choose a masterclass track such as Distributed Systems, Kafka & Event Streaming, or React Native & Mobile Performance, or type any topic you want to learn. Intervity plans a roadmap of sub-topics and takes you through them one concept at a time.

LEARN BY ANSWERING REAL TRADE-OFF QUESTIONS
Each concept is a 4-option engineering challenge grounded in real code, configuration and production numbers. Difficulty grows from Basic to Intermediate, Advanced and Pro, so you build a solid mental model before you reach staff-level trade-offs.

INSTANT FEEDBACK AND MISTAKE REVIEW
• Get a clear explanation of why the right answer works.
• See exactly why the option you picked fails.
• Every mistake is saved. Review it later and practice with targeted drills.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• Earn XP and level up your coach, Teddy.
• See your mastery across core areas on a skill radar.
• Resume any session exactly where you stopped.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your progress, answers and notes are stored on your device. Intervity has no accounts, no ads and no analytics trackers.

WHO IS IT FOR
Software engineers preparing for interviews, students learning system design, and anyone who wants to understand engineering trade-offs deeply.

Intervity is open source under the Apache 2.0 license.

Credits: Teddy character animation by japarj ("Wave, Hear and Talk"), remixed from JcToon ("Login Character"), Rive Marketplace, licensed CC BY 4.0.

name: Inward
description:
INWARD 是为在日留学生和刚到日本生活的朋友准备的生活互助平台，现已开放东京与大阪。
毕业回国闲置流转：家具、家电、自行车、教材……学长学姐的闲置，正好是你落地第一周需要的。
合作机构发布的真实房源信息，价格、费用明细、建筑年份写得明明白白，先看清楚再联系。
区役所手续、手机卡、翻译陪同、搬家帮忙——发个求助，总有人搭把手。
官方用户群和同城活动，落地不孤单。
App 内置助手，帮你找房源、找闲置、发求助，用说话的方式就能办。
平台只做信息连接：交易由用户双方自行线下完成，平台不经手资金。
支持中文、英文、日文等 29 种语言。

name: IRL Moments
description:
You had to be there. Now everyone’s photos can be in one place.

Start a private gathering for a dinner, wedding, trip or game night and share a link or QR code. Guests verify their phone number, then add the photos only they caught. No app download needed for them; it works in any browser.

• Private by design: only people with your invitation can see the photos. No public feeds, no discovery.
• Highlights: the most-liked (or a random) set of photos at the top, plus a featured photo.
• Likes and comments, if you want them.
• See what’s new: cards show new photos and who joined since you last looked.
• Sorted by when photos were taken, from every phone.
• Optional photo locations, off unless you turn them on.
• You’re in control: turn off saving, close the gathering, remove photos or people, let guests invite others or not. Guests can leave any time.
• English and Spanish.

name: Iroglass: Color Glass Puzzle
description:
Fill a 6×6 frame with pieces of colored glass, leaving no gaps.
The catch: pieces of the same color can never share an edge.
Watch both shape and color to find the arrangement that fits.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag a glass piece onto the frame, or tap to preview a spot and tap again to place it
• When you lift a piece, cells where it can't go are dimmed
• Fill every cell and light pours into your finished panel

NEW RULES AS YOU GO
• From level 20: riveted glass that can't be moved
• From level 40: marked cells that only take one color
• Every 10th level is a tougher special panel

WHEN YOU'RE STUCK
• Undo: step back one move at a time
• Hint: shows the next piece to place
• Auto: places one piece in the right spot
Solve without help to earn 3 stars.

STYLE YOUR PANELS
Collect glass palettes, frames, scenes and light effects to decorate your panels your way.

GALLERY AND DAILY PANEL
Every solved panel is kept in your gallery exactly as you placed it, ready to share as an image.
A new daily panel arrives every day.

PERFECT IF YOU
• Like to think at your own pace with no timer
• Enjoy block fill and tiling puzzles
• Love the glow of stained glass and jewel tones

No account needed. Puzzles are created on your device, so you can play offline.
Every color also has its own shape mark, so you can play no matter how you see color.

name: Itemora: Receipt & Warranty
description:
Everything you own. One smart place.

Itemora is your personal ownership assistant. Scan a receipt and Itemora remembers the return window, the warranty and the upkeep for you, then reminds you before it's too late.

NEVER MISS A RETURN
Itemora knows the return policies of Amazon, Walmart, Target, Costco, Best Buy, Apple, Home Depot, Lowe's and IKEA. Add a purchase and the return deadline is filled in for you, with a reminder before the window closes and another on the last day.

WARRANTIES, HANDLED
See at a glance what's still covered and for how long. Paid with a card that extends warranties? Itemora adds the extra coverage automatically.

ADD PURCHASES ANY WAY YOU LIKE
• Scan paper receipts with the camera
• Import photos, PDFs and order-confirmation emails
• Paste order text or type details by hand
Itemora reads the store, price and date for you, right on your iPhone.

CLAIM KITS
Need a repair or refund? Create a one-page PDF with your receipt, serial number and coverage dates, ready to send to the store or manufacturer.

HOME INVENTORY FOR INSURANCE
Add a photo and a room to each item and export an insurance-ready inventory report, room by room.

CARE REMINDERS
Set maintenance schedules (water filters, servicing, descaling) and Itemora reminds you when they're due.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything stays on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking. Lock Itemora with Face ID.

ITEMORA PLUS
Track up to 10 items free. Itemora Plus adds unlimited items, unlimited Claim Kits and the home inventory report.
• Monthly: $4.99
• Yearly: $39.99
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.hirex.mn/itemora-privacy

name: JBA Joondalup Business
description:
The official app of the Joondalup Business Association, supporting local business since 1994.

- Browse and register for upcoming JBA networking events, workshops and functions
- Get push notifications for event reminders and member announcements
- Explore the member business directory
- Manage your membership and member profile
- Event staff can check attendees in by scanning ticket QR codes at the door
- Saved upcoming events stay visible even when you're offline

Whether you're a sole trader, a growing firm or an established Joondalup business, the JBA app keeps you connected to the people who back local business.

name: Jelly Isles
description:
Slide. Match. Pop!

Swipe a jelly and it glides until it hits something. Bring three of the same color together and they pop. Clear every jelly to finish the level. It sounds simple, and the first levels are, but every island adds a new twist.

WHY YOU'LL LIKE IT
• 100 handcrafted puzzles on 10 colorful islands. Every level has a verified solution.
• No luck involved: nothing falls from the sky. It's just you and the board.
• New twists as you go: bushes, crates, frozen jellies, sticky honey and cages.
• Rescue friends, restore islands and collect stars.
• Stuck? Undo is free, and the Hint button shows a move that really works.
• Daily rewards, a star chest and Game Center achievements.
• Play offline. No ads. No account.

FAIR AND FREE
Every level can be finished without paying. Optional purchases (coin packs, a one-time Starter Pack and Island Owner) are there if you want boosters faster.

name: JLCC – Japan Luxury by CC
description:
Discover your next extraordinary find with JLCC — Japan Luxury by CC.

Browse pre-owned designer bags, jewelry, watches, small leather goods and more, sourced from our Tokyo collection. Explore current product photos, detailed specifications and prices, all in a native app designed for your iPhone and iPad.

FIND YOUR PIECE
Search by brand, style or a description, with helpful suggestions powered by JLCC's smart search. Refine the collection by category, type, designer, typed JPY price range, color, material, condition and more.

TAKE A CLOSER LOOK
Swipe through product photos, zoom in, check verified item details and compare prices before and with tax. Photos flagged as AI-generated include a disclosure in the gallery.

SAVE WHAT YOU LOVE
Build a collection of favorite pieces stored privately on your device. Open a saved item to check its latest price and availability.

SHOP WITH JLCC
Availability is checked again before continuing to JLCC's website checkout. You can also ask our team about eligible discounts, learn about Loyalty Points, check shipping information or plan a visit to our Tokyo showroom.

Purchases and website account access take place on JLCC's website in your browser. Saved pieces do not sync with the website wishlist. Inventory, prices and availability may change. Eligibility, tax and shipping details are confirmed at checkout.

name: JobWise: Crew Clock & Jobs
seller_name: Emergency Response & Global Security Solutions, LLC
description:
JobWise is the time clock and job tracker built for small service crews: landscapers, lawn care, cleaning companies, contractors, painters and tree services.

YOUR CREW
• One big button to clock in and out, right on their phone
• Switch jobs, shop time, drive time and supply runs without clocking out
• Take job photos that go straight onto the job
• Text the customer "on my way" with an arrival time

YOUR OFFICE
• See who's on the clock and where, live, while they're working
• Labor, materials and profit on every job as the work happens
• Payroll-ready hours with overtime figured for you, exported in one tap
• Estimates customers approve and sign on their phone
• Week schedule by crew, with repeating jobs that schedule themselves
• Invoices with a pay-online link

PRIVACY YOUR CREW CAN TRUST
Location is shared only while a crew member is clocked in. It starts at clock-in and stops at clock-out. Each person sees a notice and agrees before their first clock-in. With the app, location keeps working with the phone locked, so crews don't have to keep the screen on.

HOW TO START
Your company signs up for JobWise on the web. The office then sends each crew member a sign-in link or QR code. Already have an account? Sign in with your company code.

name: Jotmint
description: A notes app that gets out of the way, so the thought lands before it disappears.

name: JuicySpinel
description: JuicySpinel is a vibrant fruit-wheel arcade where timing meets style. Rotate glowing lanes, Pulse matching fruit essences into crystal spinels, climb the Copper Hearth map, unlock journal lore, and claim daily rewards. Clear twelve handcrafted levels, chain combos for higher scores, and forge your best run as a guest or signed-in player. Fast rounds, crisp controls, and juicy visuals make every spin feel fresh.

name: KADI Mobility
description:
KADI is a simple, safe way to get around. Request a ride in a few taps, watch your driver arrive on the map, and pay the way that suits you.

FOR RIDERS
• Book a ride in seconds: set your pickup and destination
• Track your driver as they arrive
• Share your trip with family or friends
• Pay with cash or card, and add a tip if you like

FOR DRIVERS
• Apply to drive right in the app
• Accept nearby ride requests and drive on your own schedule
• Drivers earn more with KADI

SAFE AND TRUSTED
Every KADI driver is verified, with documents and vehicle checked, before they can accept rides. You can share your trip details with someone you trust at any time.

KADI is made by KADI Mobility Technologies Ltd, Nigeria.

name: Kagedash: Ninja Run
description:
Kagedash is a side-scrolling ninja runner. Your masked ninja sprints across the rooftops of a moonlit town on their own, and it is up to you to time every jump, slide and dash.

THREE MOVES, ENDLESS RHYTHM
Tap to jump and tap again in mid-air for a double jump. Slide under hanging saws. Dash for a burst of invincibility that cuts down enemy ninjas, smashes saw blades and knocks throwing stars out of the air. Or land right on an enemy's head and bounce off.

HAND-BUILT LEVELS
The road is stitched together from 25 hand-built sections that grow harder as you go: fire vents that flare on a beat, rolling boulders, spikes that pop up as you approach, and more. Rest stretches give you a breather, and the two-route sections let you choose: the safe road below, or the high road across swinging planks with more coins and a prize at the end. The farther you run, the faster it gets.

SIX SCENES
Pick where your run begins from six scenes: moonlit rooftops, misty bamboo, a snowy castle, a gate of glowing embers, a sakura garden and a maple temple. The scenery changes every 500 meters, each with its own colors and drifting petals, leaves, snow, sparks or maple leaves.

NINJAS, POWER-UPS AND COMPANIONS
Choose from six ninjas, each with their own colors and look. Grab six kinds of power-ups: a shield, a coin magnet, double coins, a gale rush that carries you forward untouchable, kunai that aim themselves, and a companion. A fox spirit, paper crane or tanuki follows you, takes one hit for you and even pulls you back up from a fall.

FEATS AND TITLES
Unlock 14 feats and climb six ninja titles, from Fledgling to Shadowblade Master, as your best score grows. Beat your record and the sky fills with fireworks; the results screen shows your new feats and any promotion.

THE ONI MASK COLOSSUS
A giant floating oni mask with armored fists chases you down. It slams the ground, sweeps the screen, rains ghost fire and launches spirit orbs, and every attack is telegraphed. Jump, slide and dash to survive, then dash into its blue spirit orb to send it back at the mask. Four hits win the fight.

LEARN IN TWO MINUTES
A short tutorial teaches every move on its own practice course. It cannot end your run: if you slip, you simply try that step again.

ENEMIES WITH PERSONALITY
Sword ninjas patrol, charge or leap, and raise their blades when you get close. Straw-hat throwers show you whether the next star will fly high or low before they let it go. Shield guards block a dash, so land on their heads instead. Kite ninjas glide in at head height, so slide underneath.

ORIGINAL MUSIC
A taiko-and-flute soundtrack that speeds up as you do, plus a tense track of its own for every boss fight.

CLEAN
No ads. No in-app purchases. No account. No internet connection needed, and no data collected.

CONTROLS
iPhone and iPad: tap the right half of the screen to jump, hold the left half to slide, and tap DASH in the corner to dash.
Mac: Space, W or Up to jump; S or Down to slide; J or Shift to dash; P to pause.

Available in English, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, German, French and Spanish.

name: KAI Golf
description:
KAI Golf is your app for golf venues running KAI: book, get into your box and see where your game loses strokes.

HOME
Your next booking at a glance: place, time, players and the door code. The code is there even without a connection, right at the door.

BOOKINGS
All your upcoming and past bookings. Book new times in a few steps, and cancel where the venue allows it.

GOLF DELTA
Golf Delta shows your strokes against a level you choose, in four parts: off the tee, approach, short game and putting. See where you lose strokes and where you gain them, indoor and outdoor, competition and practice apart. Plus your clubs with their average distance.

OUTDOOR AND INDOOR
Your rounds with the scorecard, fairways and greens hit. Indoor, your latest simulator sessions: rounds with the scorecard, and practice with each club's data and the dispersion seen from above.

PROFILE
Photo, language (German, English, Spanish, Portuguese), light or dark. Delete your account right in the app.

To sign in you need an account on the KAI Golf Portal: with email, passkey, Google or Apple.

name: Kajer Arabi: Saudi Arabic
description:
Kajer Arabi teaches Bangladeshi workers the everyday spoken Saudi Arabic they need at work, in shops, at the doctor and with the police. Every phrase shows the Bangla meaning, the Arabic and a Bangla-letter pronunciation, with a computer voice in a Saudi accent and a Bangla voice for the meaning.

• "What do I say?": tap a situation (boss is not paying, police ask for iqama, I am sick) and see the exact lines to say (29 situations)
• 302 useful phrases in 17 packs: boss talk, construction, farm, cleaning, hotel and restaurant, factory, driver, shop, house work, money, health and danger, iqama and rights, a pack for women
• 10 real-life dialogues and numbers 1-100 with a listening game
• End-of-service award estimate and 12 rights cards with the Saudi Labour Law article and official sources (HRSD), always free
• Lost your job? Qiwa 60-day counter, how employer transfer works, an Arabic-English CV picture and scam warning list. The app does not give jobs and takes no money
• Emergency numbers (911/999/997/998/1919) and what to say on the call

No ads, no account, no tracking. The whole app works offline; the internet is used only when you choose to send feedback from inside the app.
Not a government app and not linked to any government. Content was checked by AI against official Saudi sources (HRSD), not yet by a lawyer; confirm your own case on 19911.

Tosa Creations Limited, Dhaka, Bangladesh. Contact: support@tosacreations.com

name: Kaptajn Snefnug
description:
Kaptajn Snefnug er en skattejagt gennem seks håndmalede landskaber, hvor kortene ligger spredt i landskabet i stedet for i et firkantet bræt.

SPIL SOM EN SKATTEJAGT
Hvert kapitel er et helt landskab. Vendte kort er kastet ud i græs, sne, lava og klipper, og du skal finde dem blandt motiverne. Når du vender to kort, afgøres det med det samme, om de viser den samme relikvie. Korrekte par forsvinder fra landskabet og giver dig point. Fejlede par lægger sig tilbage, og rækken nulstilles.

LAER LANDSKABET
Hver relikvie har sin egen plads i billedet. Papegøjen sidder lige ved vandfaldet, kompasset ligger tæt på stranden, og ankeret hviler ved den rådne mole. Når du en gang har set et kort, ved du, hvor du skal kigge næste gang. Landskabet er det samme ved hvert besøg, så erfaring tæller.

RAEKKE OG POINT
Rækken tæller dine korrekte par i træk. Jo længere rækken holder, desto flere point tjener du, og du kan se den vokse i bunden af skærmen. Hvert kapitel tæller både dine træk og den tid, rejsen tager.

TRE STJERNER HVERT STED
Du kan få op til tre stjerner i hvert kapitel. Det afgørende er antallet af træk, ikke en tilfældighed. Få alle tre stjerner ved at gennemføre kapitlet i færrest mulige træk, og gør det igen, hvis du vil forbedre din rekord.

SEKS KAPITLER, DER LAASES OP
Tågeskoven med fire par giver den første smag. Frossen Fjord, Nordlys Sne, Lavagrotten, Ørkenens Ruiner og Stormkysten følger med flere par, flere relikvier og nye landskaber. Hvert kapitel låses op, når det forrige er gennemført, så du bestemmer selv, hvornår rejsen fortsætter.

KATALOG OVER RELIKVIER
De 12 relikvier, du finder, bliver samlet i katalogen med deres navn og deres plads i landskabet. Katalogens Herre låses op, når alle 12 er fundet.

PRAESTATIONER FOR DIN REJSE
Fjorten præstationer venter, og de fleste af dem kræver mere end en enkelt gennemførsel. Færdiggør et kapitel uden at bruge LET MIG SE. Gennemfør et kapitel på under 14 træk. Byg en række på fire i én rejse. Saml tusind point på tværs af dine rejser.

EN REJSE DER HOLDER STIL
Spillet er bygget omkring en enkelt bevægelse, og hvert fund giver sit eget lyd og sin egen følelse. Undervejs samler spillet dine bedste tider, dine gennemførte kapitler og alle dine fundne relikvier, så du altid kan se, hvor langt du er nået. Vil du starte forfra, nulstilles rejsen med ét tryk.

Der er hverken annoncer eller køb i appen.

name: Katman: Bugün ne giysem
description:
Sabah dışarı çıkarken hava 4°C, öğlen 16°C, akşam yine soğuk. Ne giymeli?

Katman hava durumunu sana okumaz; kararı verir. Dışarıda olacağın saatlerin tahminine bakar ve tek cümle söyler: "Mont giy, 13:00'te çıkar."

SENİ TANIR
Her akşam tek soru: Üşüdün mü, tam iyi miydi, sıcakladın mı? Hangi bölgen: ayakların, ellerin, gövden? Katman bunu öğrenir. Ayakları çabuk üşüyen birine bot ve kalın çorap, hiç üşümeyen birine spor ayakkabı önerir. Herkesin "soğuk"u farklıdır; Katman seninkini öğrenir.

GÜN İÇİNİ DÜŞÜNÜR
Sabah serin, öğlen ılık mı? Hangi katmanı ne zaman çıkaracağını, akşam ne zaman geri giyeceğini söyler. Gece yağmuru, ıslak zemin, rüzgâr ve kar hesaba katılır.

SENDE OLANI ÖNERİR
Dolabında olmayanı önermez. Su geçirmez ayakkabın yoksa sana onu almanı söylemez; sadece dikkat etmeni söyler.

GEREKTİĞİNDE UYARIR
Fırtına, kuvvetli rüzgâr, buzlanma, aşırı sıcak ve aşırı soğukta kısa bir uyarı. Gereksiz gürültü yok.

SABAH BİLDİRİMİ VE WIDGET
Karar sabah bildirimiyle gelir; ana ekran widget'ında da bir bakışta görünür. Akşam sorusuna widget'tan cevap verebilirsin.

GİZLİ KALIR
Hesap yok, reklam yok, izleme yok. Öğrendiği her şey telefonunda kalır.

Hava verisi: Open-Meteo.com

name: KE9Game: Gilded Gyre
description:
Gilded Gyre is a hands-on physics puzzle set inside a gilded maze. Drag the gravity pad to steer a round gold orb and a faceted ruby. Let them coast, reverse gently and use a short focus hold when one light needs to wait.

Read the room as you go. Pale guides slide, velvet rails grip, pressure plates open latches and dark wells ask for a careful approach.

- 32 chambers across four galleries
- Eight separate paired trials
- Analog gravity control and timed physical pins
- Interactive latch, hinge and material studies
- A playable control-sensitivity bench
- Earned orb finishes, local records and recorded dual-orb trails
- English portrait play on iPhone and iPad
- Offline play without an account

name: Keepose: Pose Guide Camera
description:
Ever wanted to take a photo with the exact same composition as one you love?
