Keepose pulls out just the composition — where the person stands, how big they are, the space around them and the horizon — and shows it on your camera so you can match it.

■ Save compositions
· On Instagram, tap Share → “Keepose” and you're done
· Screenshots and photos work too: Keepose picks out just the photo
· Reads the person's outline, headroom, footroom and horizon
· Group shots with friends or your partner are saved as group compositions

■ Shoot the same way
· See the saved outline right on your camera
· One clear instruction at a time: “Step back”, “Tilt the camera up a little”
· Auto shot: it takes the photo by itself once everything matches
· Self-timer (3s/10s) and front camera
· Overlay the original photo to line up the background too

■ Keep it organized
· Folders and tags for your own composition library
· Move to a new phone with a single backup file — it even works between iPhone and Android
· Available in 15 languages

■ Privacy
· No sign-up, no ads, no tracking
· Photos are analyzed only on your phone and never uploaded

Keepose is an independent app and is not affiliated with Instagram or Meta. Instagram is a trademark of Meta Platforms, Inc.

name: Kendo Basics
description:
Kendo Basics is a training log for people who go to a dojo.
Log your dojo training, look back on it, and practice alone on days you can't go.

■ Training log
- Back from the dojo? Tap "Log it" to record your previous session (types and minutes) as is.
- Log kihon, kirikaeshi, jigeiko, match practice, kata and conditioning by the minute, with calories.
- Keep a one-line "Today's insight": what your sensei pointed out, what to change next time.
- Get a reminder on the evenings of your dojo days.

■ Stats
- Weekly streak, days this month, comparison with last month, trends by weekday and period, plus a breakdown by training type.
- See the body parts you used most in the last 3 days on a body map. You can note sore spots too.

■ On your own
- Practice okuri-ashi and suburi (men, kote, do in 1, 2 or 3 counts) to voice commands. The path of the shinai is drawn as you raise and strike.
- Stretching: about 3 minutes before the dojo, about 4 minutes after (calves and Achilles, wrists, shoulders).
- Spot the opening: a 1-minute reaction game — tap men, kote or do when it opens. Compare with your own records and keep your top 5.

■ New to kendo
- Learn the moves: grip, chudan, okuri-ashi and men, kote, do strikes, in pictures with numbered points.
- 4-week basics course: 3 times a week, 1–6 minutes each.

■ At the dojo
- Bogu training timer: sound cues for rounds and rest.
- Match scoreboard: red/white team match scores and records.

No account needed. Your records stay on this device (you can move them with a backup file).
This app does not replace your sensei. Use it to log and review what you learn at the dojo.

name: KH Helper
description:
KH Helper keeps the congregations that share a Kingdom Hall organized: who has which room and when, what maintenance needs doing, and which expenses are waiting for approval.

KH Helper is for Kingdom Halls already set up at khhelper.com. Your Kingdom Hall's administrators add you, then you sign in with Apple, Google or an email code.

RESERVATIONS • See the Kingdom Hall's calendar by month, with every reservation and meeting • Request a room, and see how many congregations have approved it • Approve or disapprove requests for your congregation, with a reason • Cancel a request that hasn't been approved yet

MAINTENANCE • Report something that needs attention, with photos, right from the Kingdom Hall • Maintenance coordinators turn reports into work items, assign them, and set due dates • Accept or decline your assignments, and mark work complete with photos and comments • Keep track of scheduled maintenance tasks for each month

EXPENSES • Submit a receipt by photo, scan or file • Approvers review receipts, circle the amount and stamp their initials, even zoomed in • See pending and approved expenses for the Kingdom Hall

ALSO • My Inbox brings together everything that needs your attention • Choose which notifications you get on iPhone and iPad • Cleaning schedule by month • Designed for iPhone and iPad, with Dark Mode, larger text and VoiceOver support

Your information is visible only to members of your own Kingdom Hall, according to their roles. KH Helper has no ads and no tracking.

name: Kilogrid
description:
Kilogrid is a land-navigation toolkit built around grid coordinates.

• Big position readout in MGRS, USNG, UTM, lat/lon, OS grid and Plus Code
• 28 datums using official national grids (OSTN15, NADCON5, NTv2 and others), within about 2 cm of the PROJ reference
• Map grid with 100 km letters, offline MBTiles, Apple and optional Google maps
• Waypoints, overlays, tracks, GPX/KML/CSV import and export
• Draw lines, areas, grid-aligned boxes, circles and labels on the map; go to any typed coordinate in one step; Apple Watch app
• Intersection, resection, bearings, declination (WMM2025), sun and moon times, pace count
• No accounts, no ads, no analytics. Kilogrid is a navigation aid, not a substitute for a map and compass.

name: Kitten Run Anime
description:
Run, pick the right gate, and watch your kitten transform.

Kitten Run is a one-thumb gate runner. Every run starts as a pencil sketch of a kitten. Steer down the runway, choose the gates that add charm, avoid the ones that take it away, and your kitten changes in front of you: sketch, full color, cat-girl, and finally her legendary form.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Drag left and right to steer.
• Blue gates add charm. Black gates and ink blots take it away.
• Pick up coins on the runway for extra charm.
• Cross the goal with charm to spare and keep running through the bonus arches, all the way up to ×10.

50 CAT-GIRLS TO COLLECT
A café maid, a knight, a witch, a princess, a rock guitarist, an ice mage and 44 more. Every stage has its own character with five forms, and the album keeps the best form you have reached with each one. Can you make all 50 legendary?

UPGRADES
Spend coins on Head Start to begin each run with more charm, and on Coin Bonus to earn more from every stage.

NO INTERRUPTIONS
• No ads
• No account or sign-up
• Plays offline
• Nothing is collected: your progress stays on your iPhone

name: KLAD
description:
KLaD is a free digital book library in your pocket. Explore the catalog, open any book, and read it in a clean, distraction-free reader that remembers your place.

DISCOVER BOOKS
• See all available books on the home screen
• Search the catalog to find a title quickly
• Browse by category or by author
• Open any book to view its details before you start reading

A READER BUILT FOR COMFORT
• Smooth page-by-page reading, just like an e-reader
• Tap the screen edges or swipe to turn pages
• A quick tutorial the first time you open a book

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
• Your reading progress is saved automatically
• A resume card on the home screen takes you straight back to your current book
• See at a glance which books you have started and which you have finished

MAKE IT YOURS
• Light and dark themes, or follow your device setting
• Create an account, sign in, and edit your profile

KLaD is free to use. Download it and start reading today.

name: Kokki Shuto: 世界の国々と首都一覧
description:
Note: the app is available in Japanese only.

Kokki Shuto is a four-choice quiz focused only on the names, capitals and flags of 197 countries.

- Four modes: flag to country, country to flag, country to capital, capital to country, or mix them all
- Wrong choices come from the same region, so you learn to tell similar flags and capitals apart
- A country counts as learned after three correct answers in a row
- Countries you have not learned or got wrong come up first, with review modes for tricky flags and capitals
- Filter by region; 10, 20 or 30 questions per round
- A reference list of every country's flag, name and capital, with search

No ads, no in-app purchases, no account and no network access. Records stay on your device.

name: Korean History Comics
description:
Follow 5,000 years of Korean history through comic slides and narration — from the Paleolithic era to modern Korea. (The app content is in Korean.)

• 11 eras, 53 episodes, about 15 comic slides each
• Slide player with narration and synced subtitles; auto-advance, female voice (male voice for episodes 1-5) and speed options
• Key exam points on every slide
• 1-minute summary and a 10-question quiz at the end of each episode, with explanations
• Legends such as the Dangun story are clearly marked as legends and kept apart from recorded facts (standard textbook account)
• Continue where you left off, works offline, optional daily episode reminder
• Export/import your study record

No ads, no account, no in-app purchase, no tracking.

Illustrations and narration were created with local AI models and reviewed by the developer.

name: Korxast: Jobs & Hiring
description:
Korxast is where work finds people and people find work.

Looking for a job? Browse real openings in your city — pay, schedule, location and description right on the card. Save the ones you like and apply in one tap.

Hiring? Post a job in a minute and receive applications. Browse specialist profiles with skills and experience.

Offering a service? Create a professional profile and reach clients near you.

FEATURES
• Jobs and services across the cities of Tajikistan
• Map view: work and specialists near you
• Search and filters by category, city and format
• Request → accept → chat: nobody can message you until you accept
• Job applications and new-message notifications
• Employer and specialist profiles with verification badges
• Germany section: Ausbildung and work abroad
• Sign in with Google, Apple, Passkey, phone number or username
• Tajik and Russian interface

SAFETY
Listings are moderated. Contact details are shared only within an accepted request. You can delete your account at any time inside the app.

Every talent deserves an opportunity.

Support: support@korxast.com

name: Kung Fu Soccer: Pixel Arcade
description:
Retro pixel football the way it used to be: no referee, no offside, no mercy. Slide tackle, throw punches, barge through defenders and charge up shape-shifting super shots that knock opponents flat.

• 6 teams, each with its own signature super: Fire Shot, Thunder, Banana Shot, Tsunami, Tiger Pounce and Ghost Shot.
• 30 named players with their own faces, personalities, stats, supers and goal celebrations.
• Arcade moves: shoulder-charge dribbles, diving headers, overhead kicks, juggling, lob passes and slide tackles.
• Keepers can catch or punch away even super shots, and a punch sends everyone crowding the box flying. Get hit by a super and you'll be seeing stars.
• Tactics room before kick-off: pick a formation, a playing style and swap your players around.
• Rain, snow, wind, night games and thunderstorms where lightning strikes the pitch.
• Tournament mode, 1 player vs CPU, 2 players on one device with a controller or keyboard, or watch CPU vs CPU.
• Easy touch controls built for landscape phones and tablets. Game controllers supported.
• Plays offline. No ads. No purchases. English and Vietnamese.

name: Kursda: курсы валют
description:
Kursda показывает курсы валют во всех банках Узбекистана и помогает понять, где выгоднее купить или продать доллар, евро, рубль, фунт и тенге.

КУРСЫ ВСЕХ БАНКОВ
• Покупка и продажа по каждому банку, лучшие курсы выделены
• Официальный курс Центрального банка и его изменение за день
• Калькулятор: введите сумму и сразу увидите, сколько получите в каждом банке
• Избранные банки, сортировка и поиск
• График курса за неделю, месяц и год

КАРТА БАНКОВ И БАНКОМАТОВ
• Отделения и банкоматы на карте с часами работы
• Фильтр «Открыто сейчас»
• Маршрут в Apple Картах, Яндекс Картах или Google Maps
• «Рядом со мной»: где выгоднее менять с учётом дороги

КАЛЬКУЛЯТОРЫ
• Кредит, автокредит и ипотека: платёж, переплата и график платежей
• Ставки банков подставляются в расчёт одним нажатием
• Досрочное погашение: сколько сэкономите на процентах
• Сравнение двух кредитов и расчёт суммы, которую можно взять по доходу
• Калькулятор вклада с пополнением и капитализацией

ЕЩЁ
• Конвертер любых пар валют
• Вклады, цены на золотые слитки, комиссии переводов с карты на карту
• Основная ставка Центрального банка и инфляция
• Курсы криптовалют в долларах и сумах
• Портфель: сколько стоят ваши валюта и криптовалюта в сумах

УВЕДОМЛЕНИЯ И ВИДЖЕТЫ
• Сообщим, когда курс дойдёт до нужного значения
• Виджеты на домашнем экране и экране блокировки

Русский и узбекский языки (латиница и кириллица), светлая и тёмная тема. Без регистрации и рекламы.

Курсы и ставки носят справочный характер — перед операцией уточняйте их в банке. Приложение не является банком, не проводит обмен и не даёт финансовых рекомендаций.

name: Kvittering+
description:
Kvittering + gjør det enkelt å ta vare på kvitteringene dine.

Ta et bilde med kameraet, eller velg et bilde fra Bilder. Appen leser teksten på kvitteringen og fyller inn butikk, dato, beløp og varelinjer for deg. Du kan rette feltene etterpå hvis noe ble lest feil.

Kvitteringene samles i en tydelig liste der du kan søke på butikknavn, se beløp og åpne bildet i full størrelse. Appen foreslår også kategori, for eksempel dagligvarer, restaurant, transport, bolig, elektronikk, klær eller helse. Du kan alltid velge en annen kategori selv.

Alt lagres bare på telefonen din. Kvittering + har ingen konto, ingen sky og ingen analyseverktøy. Bildene og opplysningene forlater ikke enheten.

Passer når du vil ha oversikt over utlegg, beholde kvitteringen til reklamasjon, eller bare slippe å lete i lommeboka etter en krøllete lapp.

Slik virker det:
• Trykk + og ta bilde av kvitteringen, eller velg et bilde du allerede har
• Butikk, dato, beløp, varelinjer og kategori fylles inn automatisk
• Rett det som eventuelt ble feil, og trykk Lagre
• Søk i listen, åpne kvitteringen, eller slett den når du ikke trenger den lenger

Lesing av tekst skjer på enheten med innebygd tekstgjenkjenning for norsk og engelsk.

name: LANDVAS
description:
The real world is one giant game board, and every playstyle has a home on it.

The whole planet is split into house-sized plots. Claim the ones around you, then make them yours: a mural, a creature sanctuary, an arcade, a farm, a minigame arena. Create, raise, explore, compete, build or collect, and mix them however you like.

CLAIM YOUR PIECE OF THE WORLD
Your explorer stands where you really are. Claim the plots around you; every plot hides a surprise rarity and its own minigame. Prefer it simple? Simple mode lets you roll plots from one screen, with no map or location needed.

ROLL FOR RARITIES
Six rarities, rare shinies and ultras that change the map around them. Merge neighbouring plots into bigger places with worlds of their own.

GET ENCHANTED
Some rolls come out Enchanted: a living creature that bends the rules on its plot. Guard a Golden Goose's egg from the fox, fold a plot into your Origami Pocket and unfold it somewhere new, let the Puppeteer play a plot's minigame on strings, splice two enchantments into a hybrid, and level them up to five stars.

EXPLORER'S EYES
Drop into first person and walk your world: streets, buildings, glowing plots, ultras standing as monuments, and the real sky above you.

PAINT IT
Brushes, palettes, trace guides and mirror mode. Merge plots into giant murals the whole world sees on the live map.

RAISE INKBORN
Draw any creature and watch it come to life. Pet it, feed it, play with it, and build it a sanctuary.

PLAY
Arcades with dozens of cabinets, plot minigames, PvP duels, Draw & Guess, Sketch of the Day, space missions to real planets, a daily wheel and a daily streak.

TOGETHER
Start a party with anyone, join public lobbies, chat on the map and in arcades, play house party games, watch friends play live, join a clan and meet players worldwide.

Plots are virtual: owning one never means owning real land.

name: Laneclasp
description: Laneclasp ਇੱਕ ਸਥਾਨਕ ਐਸਿੰਕ ਸਟੈਂਡਅੱਪ ਬੋਰਡ ਹੈ। ਕਲ, ਅੱਜ ਅਤੇ ਰੁਕਾਵਟ—ਤਿੰਨ ਕਾਲਮਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਲਿਖੋ; ਟੀਮ ਇੱਕੋ ਨਜ਼ਾਰੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੇਖਦੀ ਹੈ। ਲੰਬਿਤ, ਜਮ੍ਹਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਛੁੱਟੀ ਵੱਖ-ਵੱਖ ਦਿਖਾਈ ਦਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ; ਰੁਕਾਵਟਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਨਿਸ਼ਾਨ ਲਗਾਓ ਤੇ ਯਾਦ ਦਿਵਾਓ। ਪੁਰਾਣੇ ਦਿਨ, ਟੈਂਪਲੇਟ ਅਤੇ ਐਕਸਪੋਰਟ ਸਭ ਇਸੀ ਫ਼ੋਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ—ਬੰਦ ਕਰੋ, ਫਿਰ ਖੋਲ੍ਹੋ, ਅਜੇ ਵੀ ਉਥੇ।

name: LanternSeasons
description:
Follow the light through a year of seasons.

Draw a path between matching lanterns. Travel up, down, left or right without crossing another path, and light every tile to solve the board. As the puzzles get trickier, an easy-looking route can leave the next lantern stranded.

Twenty-four puzzles follow China’s traditional solar terms from the Start of Spring to Greater Cold. Solve each board to collect a note on the season. Find spring tea at Grain Rain, clay cats in Hangzhou, a Zhuang harvest festival and red paper cuttings for the Lunar New Year.

• Twenty-four seasonal puzzles with a gradual difficulty curve  
• A daily puzzle and replayable chapters  
• Undo and hints when you need them  
• Play offline in English or Simplified Chinese  
• All content included with one purchase, with zero ads or in-app purchases

name: Last CatSlime Hunter
description:
A peaceful life ended the day the Boss CatSlime appeared.
Your girlfriend was sealed away and carried off, and only one thing can break the seal: defeating the boss.

Become the last CatSlime Hunter. Control weapons with your bare hands, gather loyal pets, and stand against an endless CatSlime horde.

- BARE-HANDED COMBAT
Direct floating weapons with simple gestures. Combine swords, spears, bows, wands, and more to create your own battle style.

- PETS THAT GROW WITH YOU
Collect and raise pets that attack, heal, defend, and support your hunter.

- PROGRESS WHILE YOU ARE AWAY
Rewards keep building while the game is closed, so even a short session makes you stronger.

- PLENTY OF WAYS TO GROW
Summon weapons and skills, upgrade gear, train mastery, challenge dungeons, run the mine and village, and sew new outfits.

- DRESS UP YOUR HUNTER
Collect outfits and make your hunter your own.

- CUTE BUT DANGEROUS CATSLIMES
From squishy CatSlimes to overwhelming bosses, a wide range of enemies awaits.

This game is free to download and offers optional in-app purchases. Odds for randomized items are shown in the game.

name: LatentLab
description:
LatentLab is a darkroom journal for people who still load film — one roll from loading to contact sheet, kept entirely on your device.

ROLLS AND EXPOSURES
Register cameras, lenses and rolls. Each roll gets a fixed ID and moves from Loaded to Shooting to Exposed. Log each frame with aperture, shutter, ISO, compensation, metering, filter and a reference image; EV and EV100 are stored. The exposure calculator turns EV100, ISO and compensation into equivalent aperture and shutter pairs you can save for the field.

YOUR OWN DEVELOPMENT
No universal recipe is supplied. Enter the target parameters from your developer's label, then set every stage yourself or load a template. Stages start, pause, resume and finish independently with real elapsed time. Review actual temperature, agitation, anomalies and attachments, then save the finished development explicitly.

CHEMISTRY
Products store label data, concentrations, expiry, PPE notes and SDS attachments you can open in place. The dilution calculator works by volume ratio or by verified concentration, with units stated plainly. Batch records keep the original calculation snapshot, and the usage log enforces remaining volume.

SCANS AND SHEETS
Import scans by roll and frame — originals are never overwritten, processed images arrive as separate versions. Select, reject, rate and order frames, then build contact sheets with your own columns, spacing, numbering, background and captions. Export a paginated PDF or one PNG per page. Compare scan versions with shared viewing controls, compare rolls, and record experiments against preserved session and scan snapshots.

JOURNAL AND REPORTS
Dated entries with equipment, location, weather and photos, filterable by date, roll or camera. Statistics keep film formats and processes apart and show real cost per roll, with cost per recorded frame. Export CSV, JSON or paginated PDF reports.

NOT LOSING YOUR WORK
The archive is a committed local file, replaced atomically alongside a safety snapshot. A failed save keeps your input in place for a retry. Duplicate frame numbers, broken links, malformed stages and overused chemistry are rejected, and deleting a record others depend on is blocked. Backups carry SHA-256 checksums; restore validates files and record relations before committing.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking. Photos come through the system picker, files through the document picker, timers are opt-in notifications. No camera access and no full photo-library permission are requested.

name: Law Chronicle
description:
Law Chronicle brings India’s legal developments into one precise, organised reading experience. Follow judgments and updates by court, state, jurisdiction and practice area, so the law relevant to your work is easier to find and understand. 

FOLLOW THE COURTS THAT MATTER Browse Supreme Court, High Court and other supported legal developments through clear jurisdiction-led navigation. 

SEE YOUR STATE IN CONTEXT Move from national coverage to state and local legal updates without losing the wider legal context. 

TRACK YOUR PRACTICE AREAS Follow supported topics such as arbitration, corporate law, tax, labour, consumer law and other practice areas available in the app. 

SPECIALIZED MICROSITE DESKS 

Track legal updates specific to your States and Specialty practice areas, all at one place. 

READ PRECISE, SOURCE-LED REPORTING Each update is written for clarity and legal accuracy, with court, issue and source context shown wherever available. 

CONTROL YOUR READING EXPERIENCE Use the preferences, saved-reading, language and notification features included in your release to tailor Law Chronicle to your work. Feature availability may vary by version and configuration. 

Law Chronicle application provides legal news and information. It does not provide legal advice and is not a substitute for reviewing the official judgment, legislation or other primary source, or for obtaining advice from a qualified professional.

name: lazy chef ai
description:
Too tired to think about dinner? Show Lazy Chef AI what you have and let it do the thinking.

Open the camera, take as many photos as you like of your fridge, your kitchen counter and your pantry, and keep going. Each photo is read in the background and the ingredients drop into your list one after another. When you are done, review the list, fix anything that looks off, and tap once to get your recipes.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Scan: photograph your fridge, counter or pantry. No need to stop between photos.
2. Review: check the ingredients the AI found, and add or remove anything.
3. Cook: get ten recipes written for what you actually have. The first ones use only the ingredients in your photos.

WHAT YOU GET
• Recipes written by AI for your ingredients, in your language
• Classic dishes from your own country, so you cook food that feels like home
• Step-by-step cooking mode with timers
• Smart shopping list: add what a recipe is missing in one tap
• Pantry list for the staples you always keep
• Diet, allergy and cooking-time preferences that shape every recipe
• Save your favorite recipes
• Available in 19 languages
• Light and dark mode

MADE FOR LAZY COOKS
No typing long ingredient lists. No searching through hundreds of recipes you can't make. Photograph, confirm, cook.

SUBSCRIPTION
Lazy Chef AI requires a subscription to use the recipe features. Choose the plan that fits how often you cook (prices shown for the United States and may vary by country):
• Basic: $4.99 per month
• Pro: $7.99 per month
• Annual: $39.99 per year

Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time in your Apple ID account settings after purchase.

A NOTE ABOUT AI
Photos and ingredient lists are processed by an AI service to recognize ingredients and write recipes. Recipes are generated automatically and can contain mistakes: always check ingredients, allergens, cooking times and food safety before you cook. Nothing in the app is medical or dietary advice.

Privacy Policy: https://lazy-chef-ai.vercel.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Leafiloom
description:
Leafiloom er en rolig og lokal plantepleieapp for virkelige hjem og skiftende årstider.

Velg en planteart, legg inn lys, pottestørrelse og rom, og juster temperatur og luftfuktighet. Leafiloom beregner en nyttig rytme for vanning, næring, beskjæring og ompotting, og tilpasser den når årstiden endrer seg.

EN OMSORGSPLAN SOM FØLGER HJEMMET
Plantestell er sjelden ett fast intervall. Leafiloom starter med artens naturlige behov og justerer deretter for lys, pottediameter, temperatur, luftfuktighet og årstid. Resultatet er et praktisk neste steg, ikke et løfte om perfeksjon.

FEM ROLIGE ROM
• Hjem viser dagens rytme, neste nyttige oppgave, inneklima, plantehyllen din og et årstidsnotat.
• Rytme samler sen og kommende omsorg i en tydelig 45-dagers oversikt med filtre for hver oppgavetype.
• Planter kombinerer hagen din med et søkbart bibliotek med 13 stueplanter og grundig omsorgskunnskap.
• Dagbok samler omsorgshistorikk, observasjoner, stemninger og små milepæler på en tidslinje.
• Profil lar deg justere inneklima, årstid, påminnelsestid, språk og personvern.

EN DAGBOK SOM HUSKER
Noter et nytt blad, en duft, en potte som er flyttet eller en liten endring. Omsorgsoppgaver som fullføres i Leafiloom eller fra et varsel, registreres automatisk, slik at mønstre blir lettere å se.

LAGET FOR NORDISK LYS
Engelsk og norsk bokmål er inkludert, med veiledning for lite vinterlys, tørr inneluft og langsommere vekst i de kalde månedene.

PRIVAT FRA STARTEN
Ingen konto. Ingen reklame. Ingen analyse. Ingen skylagring. Planter, notater og innstillinger lagres lokalt på iPhonen. Varsler planlegges lokalt gjennom Apples varselsystem.

Leafiloom er en veileder for plantestell, ikke en garanti for plantehelse. Hvert hjem er forskjellig, så sjekk alltid jord, blader og røtter før du gjør en større endring.

name: Lesson Notes by MSA
description:
Lesson Notes by MSA keeps private dance lessons organized, for the teacher and the student.

FOR TEACHERS
• Students: keep each student's level, schedule and lesson history in one place.
• Notes: write a recap after each lesson and what to work on next. Share any note with the student, or keep it private.
• Exercises, drills and music: assign exercises, pull drills and moves from the MSA library, and save the songs you use in lessons.
• Schedule: set your weekly hours (several blocks a day), the lessons you offer, and your booking rules. Share your booking link, or list yourself in teacher search.

FOR STUDENTS
• Find your teacher, pick a lesson and a time, and book. Payment is handled between you and your teacher.
• Add lessons to Apple, Google or Outlook calendar, or subscribe once and every lesson shows up on its own.
• See the notes and exercises your teacher shares with you.

Switch between Teacher and Student mode any time on your Profile; many dancers do both.

ONE MSA LOGIN
Lesson Notes uses your MSA account, the same email and password as the MSA Hub and Training Groups.

Questions or problems? Email myswingacademia@gmail.com.

name: Lexibro
description:
Lexibro helps you remember the words you meet in real life: in a book, a film, a series or a conversation.

SAVE WORDS WITH THEIR SOURCE
Create a source for every book, film, series or conversation and add the new words you find there, with their translation and an optional example sentence. Your words stay organised by where you learned them.

REVIEW AT THE RIGHT TIME
Lexibro uses the proven Leitner method of spaced repetition. Words you remember come back after longer and longer breaks; words you forget come back tomorrow. You review in short batches, so a few minutes a day is enough.

DAILY REMINDER
Choose a time and Lexibro reminds you when it is time to review.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR DEVICE
No account, no login, no ads, no tracking. Lexibro works fully offline. Export a backup file whenever you want and import it on another device.

PRINT YOUR WORD LISTS
Export the words of a source to a PDF with the date of the next review.

AVAILABLE IN 6 LANGUAGES
English, Polish, German, Italian, Spanish and French.

A short interactive tutorial with sample words shows you everything on the first launch.

name: LifeLogDuck - 1日を自動で記録
description:
仕事、移動、睡眠、自由な時間。今日の 24 時間は、どこへ消えたのでしょう？

LifeLogDuck は、iPhone を持ち歩くだけで1日を自動で記録し、ひとつのドーナツにして見せます。入力もタイマーの操作もいりません。記録は iPhone の中だけに保存し、外には送りません。

● リングを押すと、まとめに
リングの真ん中を押すと、時刻の並びからカテゴリごとのまとめにくるりと切り替わります。

● 何もしなくても記録
訪れた場所、移動（徒歩・自転車・車や電車）、睡眠とワークアウト（ヘルスケア）から、1日の時間の使い方を自動でまとめます。GPS を使い続けないので、電池への負担はわずかです。

● よく行く場所は名前とカテゴリで
自宅・職場・いつものカフェなどを登録すると、滞在がそのカテゴリで記録されます。近くのお店や施設から名前とカテゴリを選べます。

● あとから直せる、メモも残せる
タイムラインの区間をタップして、カテゴリを変えたり、2つに分けたり、前の区間とつなげたりできます。読書や家事など、自分のカテゴリも作れます。区間には「誰と会った」「何をした」などのメモを残せます。

● ウィジェット
ホーム画面とロック画面で、今日のドーナツといまのカテゴリ、経過時間を確認できます。

● 画像で共有
その日のリングを、1枚の画像にして友だちや SNS に送れます。

● 夜型にも
1日の始まりを 0:00〜6:00 から選べます。

● バックアップ
すべての記録を1つのファイルにまとめて、iCloud Drive などに保存できます。機種変更やアプリの入れ直しの後も、そのファイルから戻せます。

● Premium（買い切り。定期購入ではありません）
・7 日より前の記録もすべて見られます
・週・月・年ごとのカテゴリ別の1日平均と、前の期間からの増減
・睡眠の平均と、寝る・起きる時刻
・曜日ごとの傾向（仕事がいちばん長いのは何曜日か、など）
・ミニドーナツのカレンダー
・月と年のまとめを画像で共有（年末には「今年のまとめ」をお知らせ）
・CSV で書き出し
・8 つの配色を選べる（浜辺・水色の池・森・桜・和紙・ポップ・夕暮れの海・夜空）。リングの色も配色ごとに変わる

無料版でも記録はすべて保存され、自分のカテゴリ・メモ・バックアップも使えます。Premium にすると、それまでの記録もすぐに見られます。

● プライバシー
記録は端末の中だけに保存し、外部のサーバーには送りません。

name: Lifto: Workout Log & Gym Plans
description:
Log every set. Build your routine. Know what to lift next.

Lifto brings your strength training plans, workout log and progress together. Record weights and reps, check your last session and turn completed workouts into targets for your next one—at the gym or at home.

Start with your own routine or an empty workout. Explore over 1,300 exercises with muscle information and available animated demonstrations, then build a plan around the way you train. No account required.

WHY LIFTO?
• Record weights, reps and completed sets, with previous performance right beside your current set.
• Track warm-up and working sets, log RPE and RIR, and organize supersets.
• Keep your session moving with rest timers, a plate calculator, a countdown timer and a stopwatch.
• Create routines with individual set targets and arrange them around your training days.
• Search the exercise library, save favorites and add your own custom exercises.
• Review personal records, training volume, workout duration and exercise trends.
• See your training history in a calendar and follow your consistency over time.
• Keep workout notes, photo and video attachments, and daily progress photos.
• Switch between kilograms and pounds to match your equipment.
• Resume an unfinished workout on the same device.

PLAN YOUR NEXT STEP
Use completed working sets and your chosen progression rule to get suggested targets for your next session. Review the suggestions and decide whether to apply them. Free access includes automatic progression for one chosen routine; Pro extends it to all your routines.

YOUR RECORDS, WITH YOU
Core workout logging works offline, and your training records are stored on your device. Export a backup or import supported training data. Exercise demonstrations may need an internet connection when they are not already available on your device.

APPLE HEALTH
Choose to connect Apple Health and save completed strength workouts, including their start time and duration. Health access is optional and can be managed in Settings.

LIFTO PRO
Start free with up to four routines and seven custom exercises. Upgrade to Pro for:
• Unlimited routines and custom exercises.
• Automatic progression for every routine.
• Annual and long-term training trends.
• Muscle-balance analysis and plateau insights.

Lifto offers monthly and yearly auto-renewing subscriptions and a lifetime one-time purchase, subject to availability. Prices are shown in the app before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account upon confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings. A lifetime purchase does not cancel an existing subscription. You can continue using the free features without purchasing Pro.

Terms of Service: https://sites.google.com/view/lifto-app-legal/terms
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/lifto-app-legal/privacy

name: Lightbox: Trace Photos
description:
Trace any photo onto real paper with your iPhone and a pencil.

Set up with a few books. Put your paper on the table, stack books on both sides about a hand high, and lay your phone across, screen up.

Get clean lines. Pick a photo from your library and choose how much detail the line art keeps: Simple, Medium or Detailed.

Lines stay pinned to the paper. Lightbox finds your paper through the camera and keeps the lines on it, even when the paper moves. Drag and pinch to place them where you want.

See what's left. Tap What's left and Lightbox marks the lines you haven't drawn yet.

Keep your drawings as tickets. Each finished drawing gets a numbered ticket with your photo, your drawing, when you drew it and how long it took.

Lightbox needs the Lightbox pass, an auto-renewing subscription: $29.99 a year or $4.99 a month. Both include unlimited traces and 30 AI line art a month. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://lightbox-greenery.vercel.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://lightbox-greenery.vercel.app/privacy

name: listen&Learn work and love
description:
listen&Learn records the conversations you are part of, so a coach can debrief how you spoke. In this first version, the coach is for job interviews.

How it works
• Tap Start listening before the conversation. The phone holds the last hour of sound, or the length you choose, in an encrypted file on the phone and drops older sound as it goes.
• When it's over, tap Keep the last hour. Review it, trim it to the part you want, and say what it was.
• Tap Send. A few minutes later, a debrief summary appears in the app: scores, one strength and one thing to change, with the full debrief on the Interview coach's site.

You stay in control
• Listening starts only when you tap it, and a recording bar shows on every screen while it is on. It cannot be hidden.
• "Someone objected" is always one tap away. It stops recording and deletes what was captured.
• Nothing leaves your phone until you send it. The audio is deleted as soon as it is turned into text.
• Your conversations are never used to train AI.
• Delete your account in the app at any time, and your recordings, transcripts and debriefs go with it.

Before you record, you agree to tell the people you talk with that you are recording, and to record only conversations you are part of. In California and many other states, everyone in a conversation must agree before it is recorded.

For adults 18 and over.

name: Little Reunion Photos
description:
Your photo library holds both moments to remember and documents you will need again.

Little Reunion Photos brings your photos, favorites, and personal document photos together.

PHOTOS
Browse your library and compare similar shots. You decide what to keep.

FAVORITES
Keep your favorite moments easy to revisit.

DOCUMENTS
Organize photos of IDs, medical paperwork, certificates, and other important documents. Combine pages, find your files, and export a PDF when you need it.

Text recognition runs on your device. No account is required. Recognition helps you organize; check important details against the original image. Documents are stored locally. Keep original photos and export important files for backup.

MEMBERSHIP
Optional membership adds automatic similar-photo grouping, automatic document filing, and an expanded scanning range. Basic browsing, favorites, manual filing, scanning the latest 100 photos, and exporting existing documents remain free.

You can choose to start a seven-day local trial. It ends automatically without an Apple transaction or charge. Monthly and annual auto-renewable subscriptions are available separately. Prices and billing periods are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings. Restore purchases in the app.

Privacy Policy: https://www.yuwenpingye.com/xiaotuanyuan/en/privacy
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Liusheng: Audiobook Player
description:
Listen to your own audiobooks on iPhone. Import MP3, M4A, M4B, or WAV from Files, or import a folder of audio files as a single book. Each file in a folder becomes a chapter. Imported audio is copied to your iPhone for offline listening.

Pick up where you left off with automatic progress saving. Browse chapters, jump within the current chapter, change playback speed, or skip back 15 seconds and forward 30 seconds.

Keep listening in the background and control playback from the Lock Screen. Set a sleep timer for 5 to 60 minutes and see the countdown below the moon icon. Collapse the player to keep browsing your bookshelf while audio plays.

name: LiveCard: Model Motion Cards
description:
Give your models their moment to shine. LiveCard turns photos of figures, toys, and models into animated collectible cards.

Choose a photo, adjust the framing, and let on-device subject detection place effects around your model. Explore 74 effect styles, including lightning, flames, smoke, energy, manga-inspired motion, and metallic finishes.

Build your collection, arrange your cards, and enjoy their animated effects. Export a card as a Live Photo, save it to Photos, or share it through the system share sheet.

Try three successful creations or effect edits for free. Card Effects Pack is a one-time purchase that unlocks unlimited creation and the fixed base set of 74 effects. There is no subscription. Future separately sold packs are not included.

No LiveCard account is required. Photo processing and your card collection stay on your device. Apple photo services, device backups, purchases, and sharing destinations work according to your system settings.

name: Lounge Scout: Airport Lounges
description:
Know which airport lounges you can get into before you get to the airport.

LoungeScout shows the lounges your credit cards, memberships, elite status and tickets open, and what it costs when they don't. Add what's in your wallet once, then check any airport in seconds.

FIND YOUR LOUNGE
- See every lounge at an airport, with free ones marked for you
- Filter by terminal, concourse and amenities like showers, food and quiet rooms
- Get the location, gate, hours and how to get in
- Know the price of a day pass or guest fee when your cards don't cover it

PLAN EVERY TRIP
- Add one-way, round-trip and multi-city trips
- See which lounges you can use at each airport along the way, including layovers
- A countdown and boarding-pass style ticket for your next flight

GET MORE FROM YOUR CARDS
- See the travel perks and credits for each card you carry
- Learn how far your credit card points go when moved to airline and hotel programs
- Find which card would open the most extra lounges

SHARE WHAT YOU SEE
- Add your own lounge photos to help other travelers
- Every photo is reviewed before it appears

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Your cards, trips and visits stay on your device. LoungeScout never asks for card numbers.

Lounge access rules change often. Always confirm with the lounge or your card issuer before you travel. LoungeScout is not affiliated with any airline, lounge or card issuer.

name: Luciole: your trips, mapped
description:
Luciole records your trips and draws them in light on the map. Trip after trip, your neighbourhood, your country and your world light up.

ONE BUTTON, AND YOU'RE OFF
Pick how you're moving (car, motorcycle, bike, walk, run or other) and tap Start. Your route is drawn live with distance, time and speed, even with the screen locked. Pause, resume, finish: your summary is ready, with the route, distance, moving time, average and top speed, and elevation gain.

THE EXPLORED MAP
All your trips add up on a single map. The streets you take every day glow brighter, holiday roads draw your own geography. Zoom from your neighbourhood to your country and see where you've really been, on a colour or greyscale base map.

NO ACCOUNT, WORKS OFFLINE
Open the app and start: no sign-up. Your trips stay on your phone, and recording, history and the explored map all work without a connection.

ON YOUR WRIST
On Apple Watch, Luciole records with the watch's GPS, even without your iPhone, or shows the trip started on your iPhone. A complication shows your week.

ALWAYS AT HAND
• Widgets: your week, your last trip on its map, and one-tap start
• Live Activity and Dynamic Island while recording
• Siri and Shortcuts
• Control Center controls and the Action button

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• Import your past activities (GPX from Strava or Garmin, KML and KMZ from Google, ITN from TomTom) and export your trips as GPX
• History filtered by type and period
• Dark mode where routes truly glow
• No ads, no trackers, no usage analytics
• Location is only read while recording

An optional account lets you find your trips on several devices and on your computer, at luciole.banelhaq.com (with Apple, Google or email). You can delete it at any time in Settings.

The app is in French for now. Luciole is not a navigation app: don't handle your phone while driving.

name: Luckdrop: Daily Fortune Card
description:
One card in the morning, one line at night.

Luckdrop shows you one card each morning with a short reading for the day. In the evening you record whether it matched your day. As your records build up, you see your own hit rate and the cards that fit you best.

MORNING — TODAY'S CARD
• One card a day from a deck of 120 hand-drawn cards in 10 suits
• A one-line reading, what it means, and one thing to try today
• More readings: Money, Love, Work and People

EVENING — YOUR RECORD
• Matched, Partly or Missed, with an optional one-line note
• Choose when recording opens (5 PM by default)
• An evening reminder so you don't forget

YOUR HIT RATE
• Your overall hit rate appears after 5 recorded days (Matched = 1, Partly = 0.5)
• This week at a glance and your recording streak
• Collection: how many of the 120 cards you have met

SHARE
• Share today's card or a month of records as an image

PREMIUM (one-time purchase, not a subscription)
• Hit rates by card and by suit, month by month
• Your full history (free shows the last 7 days)
• More readings always open
• Choose your reminder time
• Report colours, card back designs and app icons

In the free version you can choose to watch an ad to open more readings or detailed hit rates for the day. Drawing and recording never need an ad.

No sign-up. Your records stay on your iPhone, and you can also save them to your own iCloud.

For fun only. Readings are not advice about health, money or big decisions.

name: Lumenstrata
description: Lumenstrata તમારા ઘરની દરેક ખંડ માટે ઉદ્દેશ્યપૂર્ણ ફરતા, ખિડકી-જમીન ગુણોત્તર અને અવરોધ ગુણાંકથી સરળ સરેસર પ્રકાશ ગુણાંક અંદાજ બનાવે છે. ઘોંઘાટ, દિવસનો અથવા સ્પષ્ટ શ્રેણીમાં પરિણામ જુઓ, અસરકારક ખિડકીઓ સાથે તુલના કરો, ટિપ્પણી લખો અને સ્કેચ દોરો — બધું તમારા ફોન પર સંગ્રહિત રહે છે. શરૂઆતના આર્કિટેક્ચર ડિઝાઇન અને સરળ દિવાળટ પ્રકાશ તપાસ માટે યોગ્ય; અહીં ફક્ત અંદાજ છે, સત્તાવાર સમયું પ્રમાણપત્ર નહીં.

name: Lumi Light: Laser Puzzle
description:
Lumi is a tiny lamp with a big glow — and its beam of light needs your help.

Rotate mirrors, split rays with prisms and slip through portals to guide the light to every crystal. Each level is a small, calm puzzle: easy to start, satisfying to master.

• 250 levels in 10 chapters: mirrors, prisms, colors, portals and shadows, half-mirrors, rainbows and more
• Colored beams and crystals: send the right color to the right place
• Earn up to 3 stars by solving in the fewest moves
• A new daily puzzle every day and weekly events with special skins
• A daily gift for coming back — bigger every day in a row
• Light up the lanterns of Glowhollow Valley with the stars you collect
• Dress Lumi in glowing skins
• Earn gems for perfect 3-star solves and spend them on hints; undo any move
• Color symbols for color-blind players
• No timers and no lives — play at your own pace, even offline
• Progress syncs between your devices through iCloud
• Game Center leaderboards and achievements
• 12 languages

Lumi Light is free to play. It contains optional ads and in-app purchases (remove ads, gems, starter pack).

name: Lumora - FIND YOUR LIGHT
description:
Lumora — Illuminate Your Path

Pause, reflect, and find a question to carry into your day. Explore daily fortunes, simplified western sun-sign horoscopes, illustrated tarot, compatibility reflections, and name ideas.

• A daily card and three-card tarot spreads about relationships, work, money, or a general question.
• Twelve sun signs and a 2027 outlook with monthly themes. Sun-sign readings are simplified and are not a full natal chart.
• Gentle compatibility prompts and prenatal nickname or given-name suggestions.
• Save readings on your device and share illustrated images. Birth details are excluded from share images by default.
• Start as a guest. Birth details are optional. Korean, English, and Japanese are available.

FREE READINGS AND OPTIONAL ADS
Try each feature once on your first day. Afterward, one new result per local day is free across all features. Optionally finish a rewarded ad for one additional reading, up to five rewards per day. Reopening and sharing existing results does not use an allowance. Some free screens display banner ads. New readings and reward verification require internet access; previously saved results remain available offline.

OPTIONAL ONE-TIME PURCHASE
The detailed 2027 report offers twelve monthly reflection chapters, four perspectives, exercises, and closing questions. It is shared, prewritten AI-assisted editorial content, not a personalized prediction based on birth details. The store displays your local price. Restore the purchase with the same Apple account. Later-year reports are separate products. No subscription is required.

Lumora is for entertainment and self-reflection. Readings do not guarantee outcomes or replace medical, legal, or financial advice.

Privacy: https://nextlinecode.github.io/nextlinecode-Legal/Lumora/privacy.html
Support: https://nextlinecode.github.io/nextlinecode-Legal/Lumora/support.html

name: M3 Theme & Colors
description:
Pick one color. Get a complete Material Design 3 theme — and the code to drop straight into your project.

PICK A SEED, WATCH A REAL APP REPAINT

Tap a shade from the Material palette, or open the picker and enter any color you like. All 48 Material 3 color roles are generated for both light and dark, then rendered on genuine Material 3 components — filled, tonal and outlined buttons, chips, a switch, elevated and filled cards, a floating action button, an app bar. You see an app, not a grid of swatches.

Change the seed on the palette page and the preview repaints as you go.

NINE STYLES, THREE CONTRAST LEVELS

One color can produce nine different schemes: Tonal spot, Neutral, Vibrant, Expressive, Content, Fidelity, Monochrome, Rainbow and Fruit salad. Each at standard, medium or high contrast.

Flip between the light and dark preview without touching your device settings, so you can check both halves of a theme in one sitting.

CHECK THE CONTRAST

Every foreground and background pair in the generated scheme is measured against WCAG 2.1 and graded AA or AAA. You get the exact ratio, plus a live sample of text in that color on that background — because a number tells you whether it passes and the sample tells you whether it is comfortable.

Raise the contrast level and watch the grades climb.

EXPORT IN THE FORMAT YOU ACTUALLY USE

• Jetpack Compose — a Theme.kt with lightColorScheme and darkColorScheme, ready to paste
• XML — colors.xml for values/ and values-night/, named the way Material Theme Builder names them
• CSS — --md-sys-color-* custom properties, with dark in a prefers-color-scheme block
• JSON — both schemes plus all six tonal palettes at thirteen tones each

Copy it to the clipboard, or share it to mail, chat or notes and pick it up on your computer. Every individual role can be copied as a hex code too.

THE MATERIAL PALETTE, STILL HERE

All 19 Material Design palettes and 254 shades, each with its name and hex code, one tap to copy. It is where the app started and it is still the fastest way to grab a color — it just doubles as the seed picker now.

PRACTICAL THINGS

• Free, no account, no sign-in
• Works offline — the color engine runs on your device
• Follows your system light or dark appearance
• Available in 15 languages

Built for developers and designers who would rather hand over a working theme than a screenshot.

Material Design is a design system published by Google. This app is an independent tool that generates color schemes compatible with it.

name: Magnetic Reformas
description:
Magnetic Reformas es el área cliente de tu reforma en el móvil. Todo lo que pasa en tu obra, ordenado y a un toque.

PARA CLIENTES
• Presupuestos: consúltalos en su versión visual o tradicional, descárgalos en PDF y fírmalos desde la app.
• Plan de pagos: ve las cuotas, los importes y lo que queda pendiente.
• Planos y renders: revisa cada versión del proyecto.
• Facturas y documentos: siempre disponibles, sin buscar entre correos.
• Cronograma: en qué fase está la obra y qué viene después.
• Reuniones, visitas e incidencias: con fotos, fechas y responsables.
• Chat con el equipo: habla directamente con las personas que llevan tu reforma.

PARA EL EQUIPO
• Partes de trabajo, visitas y fotos de obra.
• Gastos con foto del ticket.
• Tareas, avisos e incidencias.
• Fichajes y horas.
• Gestión de residuos.

Diseño cuidado, modo claro y oscuro, y la imagen de tu empresa en toda la app.

El acceso es con la cuenta que te facilita tu empresa de reformas (código de empresa, usuario y contraseña).

name: Mail: All Your Inboxes
description:
Mail is a clean, fast email app for all your mailboxes. Add Gmail, Yahoo, iCloud, Yandex, Mail.ru, GMX, Zoho, Fastmail or any other IMAP account and keep everything in one place, on iPhone and iPad.

ALL YOUR MAILBOXES, ONE TAP APART
• A combined inbox for every account, plus all unread and all starred mail
• Switch accounts with the chips under the title, a swipe on your avatar or the sidebar
• Each account has its own color, so you always see where a message came from
• Switching keeps you in the same folder: from Sent to Sent, from Drafts to Drafts

EVERYTHING YOU EXPECT FROM EMAIL
• Conversations: replies are grouped with the original message
• Archive, delete, mark as read, star, move or report spam for one message or many at once; every action can be undone
• Sender photos from your contacts and Gravatar, company logos, and your own photo for each account
• Folders, labels, archive, spam and trash, with all changes synced to the server
• Search on your device and on the server at the same time
• Attachments: preview with Quick Look, save to Files or share
• Unsubscribe from newsletters in one tap

WRITING
• Bold, italic, underline, lists, quotes and links
• Address suggestions from your contacts and past mail
• Signatures and aliases for each account
• Undo send and send later
• Drafts sync with your mailbox on the server
• A reminder when you mention an attachment but forget to add it
• Share text, links, photos and files from other apps straight into a new message

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with your unread count and latest mail
• Find messages with Spotlight; the search index stays on your device
• Unread count on the app icon
• Three-column layout on iPad, with support for multiple windows
• Mark as read, archive or delete right from a notification

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No ads, no analytics, no accounts with us
• The app connects straight to your mail provider. Your mail never passes through our servers, because we don't have any
• Remote images are blocked until you allow them, so senders can't track when you open their mail
• Emails are shown without scripts, and links open in Safari
• Passwords are kept in the iOS Keychain

MAKE IT YOURS
• System, light or dark theme, with an optional pure black background
• 10 accent colors
• Five text sizes, three list densities and up to three preview lines
• Choose what happens after you delete a message
• Dark mode for bright emails too
• 10 languages: English, Russian, Ukrainian, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Polish and Turkish

NEW MAIL
• While the app is open, new mail arrives instantly (IMAP IDLE)
• In the background, the app checks for mail as often as iOS allows, and notifies you about new messages
• Notifications are grouped by account

GOOD TO KNOW
• Gmail, Yahoo, iCloud and some other providers need an app password; the app shows where to create one
• Works with standard IMAP and SMTP. Exchange ActiveSync and POP3 are not supported

name: Manne : Versets de la Bible
description:
La Parole de Dieu, un verset à la fois.

Comme la manne que Dieu donnait chaque matin dans le désert, Manne t'offre chaque jour ta portion de Parole. Fais défiler des versets de la Bible en plein écran, lis-les dans leur contexte et garde ceux qui te touchent.

DES VERSETS CHOISIS POUR TOI
• Glisse vers le haut pour découvrir le verset suivant, à l'infini
• Un fil adapté à ce que tu vis : paix, espérance, force, pardon, sagesse, joie…
• Touche deux fois pour enregistrer un verset
• Partage-le en un geste à tes proches
• Une musique douce pour méditer (désactivable)

UN QUIZ BIBLIQUE CHAQUE JOUR
• 10 nouvelles questions sur la Bible et la foi chrétienne
• Une explication et une référence biblique à chaque réponse
• Garde ta série de jours d'affilée et bats tes records

TOUTE LA BIBLE, MÊME HORS LIGNE
• La Bible Louis Segond 1910 complète : 66 livres, 1 189 chapitres
• Ouvre le chapitre d'un verset pour le lire dans son contexte
• Suis ta progression, livre après livre

TON VERSET DU JOUR
• Choisis l'heure exacte de ton rappel
• Reçois chaque jour un nouveau verset en notification

TON ESPACE
• Tes versets enregistrés, tes séries et tes statistiques au même endroit
• Aucun compte à créer, aucune publicité, aucune donnée collectée

Que tu découvres la Bible ou que tu la lises chaque jour, Manne t'aide à prendre un moment avec Dieu, chaque jour.

« Ta parole est une lampe à mes pieds, et une lumière sur mon sentier. » - Psaume 119:105

ABONNEMENT MANNE PREMIUM
Manne est accessible par abonnement :
• Annuel : 7 jours gratuits, puis 39,99 €/an
• Mensuel : 6,99 €/mois, sans engagement

Le paiement est débité sur ton compte Apple à la confirmation de l'achat, ou à la fin de l'essai gratuit. L'abonnement se renouvelle automatiquement, sauf annulation au moins 24 heures avant la fin de la période en cours. Tu peux gérer ou annuler ton abonnement à tout moment dans les Réglages de ton compte Apple.

Conditions d'utilisation : https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Politique de confidentialité : https://melodious-sprite-936db4.netlify.app/confidentialite.html

name: Mayor Island: City Builder
description:
Become the mayor of your own island and grow it from a quiet outpost into a booming megalopolis. Mayor Island is a deep 3D city builder where every coin counts: start with a small budget and a few plots of land, balance taxes and upkeep, take loans when you need them and buy new districts as your city grows.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag roads from the highway and zone homes, shops and factories next to them.
• Give your city power, water and garbage disposal so buildings can grow.
• Build police, fire stations, clinics, schools, libraries, hospitals and a university.
• Keep an eye on jobs, pollution, crime and traffic: citizens tell you what they think.
• Balance the budget: taxes, service funding, monthly reports and bank loans.
• Buy neighbouring districts to expand across the island.
• Reach Hamlet, Village, Town, City, Metropolis and Megalopolis to unlock new buildings and skyscrapers.

FEATURES
• Beautiful hand-crafted 3D isometric graphics
• A real economy: start small, avoid debt and climb to the top
• 25+ buildings: wind turbines, coal and solar plants, water pumps, landfills, recycling, bus stations, plazas, stadium and a sky tower
• Data maps for land value, pollution, crime, traffic, education, health and fire cover
• City stats with happiness factors and population history
• Avenues for heavy traffic and high-rise towers for dense neighbourhoods
• Simple drag-to-build controls made for touch screens
• Your island keeps running while you are away
• Play offline, anytime
• English and Turkish

Mayor Island is free to play and supported by ads. Optional purchases add city funds or remove ads.

name: Meal Deck: What To Eat
description:
The hardest question of the day isn't at work. It's "what should I eat?"

What To Eat hands the decision to luck. Every deck holds 50 cards, and every card is a dish. Tap the button, the deck shuffles, a card flips over, and dinner is decided.

■ Decks for every mood
Weekday lunches, weekend treats and holiday food are different lists. Keep a separate deck for each and switch with one tap.

■ You set the odds
Love beef noodle soup? Give it 8 cards. Salad only now and then? Give it 1. Every dish shows its exact chance of being drawn. Need more room? Make a deck with 100 cards.

■ Set-meal decks
Split dishes into courses such as main, side and drink, and draw one from each in a single tap. Name the courses however you like, perfect for your regular restaurant.

■ Explore ready-made decks
Not sure where to start? Add a themed deck in one tap: Taiwanese street food, Japanese, light & healthy, late night, date night, breakfast, budget, world tour and a lunch set.

■ Share decks with friends
Send a whole deck by AirDrop or Messages. Your friend opens it and it's added to their app, ready to draw.

■ Share the result
Turn what you drew into an image and send it to friends or post it to your story.

■ Draw history
See what comes up most often and spot your eating habits.

■ English and Traditional Chinese
Follows your device language, or switch inside the app.

■ Clean, offline, no fuss
No sign-up, no ads, no data collection, works offline. Everything stays on your phone.

Completely free, with nothing locked. If you enjoy it, you can buy the developer a coffee in Settings.

name: Melanur – KKTC Balıkçı Rehberi
description:
Melanur, Kuzey Kıbrıs (KKTC) balıkçıları için tasarlanmış kapsamlı bir balıkçılık platformudur. Avlarınızı kaydedin, meraları keşfedin, deniz koşullarını takip edin ve adanın balıkçı topluluğuyla bağlantıda kalın.

AV GÜNLÜĞÜ
Yakaladığınız balıkları tür, ağırlık, boy ve konum bilgisiyle kaydedin. Fotoğraf ekleyin, kişisel istatistiklerinizi ve trofelerinizi takip edin.

TÜR TANIMA
Balık fotoğrafını yükleyin; yapay zeka destekli tür tanıma ile kaydınızı hızlıca oluşturun.

MERA HARİTASI
Kuzey Kıbrıs kıyılarındaki avlak noktalarını harita üzerinde görüntüleyin, kendi meralarınızı kaydedin ve balıkçılığa kapalı koruma alanlarına yaklaştığınızda uyarı alın.

DENİZ HAVA DURUMU
Rüzgâr, dalga, akıntı ve deniz suyu sıcaklığı gibi verilerle av planınızı güvenle yapın.

TOPLULUK VE TURNUVALAR
Av raporlarını paylaşın, diğer balıkçılarla mesajlaşın, kulüplere katılın ve turnuvalarda yarışın. Rozetlerle deneyiminizi sergileyin.

İKİNCİ EL PAZAR
Kullanmadığınız olta, makine, yem ve ekipmanı satışa çıkarın; mağazalardan yeni ürünlere göz atın.

MEVZUAT VE GÜVENLİK
Kuzey Kıbrıs balıkçılık kurallarına, avlanma yasaklarına ve koruma alanları hakkındaki güncel bilgilere tek yerden ulaşın.

Türkçe, İngilizce ve Rusça dil desteği.

Not: Denizde güvenliğiniz önceliklidir. Hava durumu verileri bilgilendirme amaçlıdır; resmî meteoroloji uyarılarını dikkate alın ve avlanma kurallarına uyun.

name: Memo - O amigo que te lembra
description:
Fala do jeito que vier. O Memo guarda, organiza e te lembra na hora certa.

O Memo é o amigo que guarda tudo o que passa pela sua cabeça, sem você parar para anotar. Segure o microfone e fale: ideias, coisas para fazer, o que aconteceu no dia, aquilo que você não quer esquecer. O Memo transforma em notas e coloca cada uma no tema certo, sozinho.

FALE, ESCREVA OU FOTOGRAFE
• Segure para gravar, deslize para cima para travar e fale à vontade.
• Prefere escrever? Também pode.
• Foto de um slide, de um papel ou de um quadro vira nota, com o texto transcrito.
• Falou em inglês? A nota sai em português e guarda o original.

TUDO ORGANIZADO SEM VOCÊ FAZER NADA
• Cada registro vira uma ou mais notas, uma por assunto.
• As notas entram numa árvore de temas que você vê como um mapa.
• Mudou uma nota de tema? O Memo aprende e acerta da próxima vez.
• Busca em todas as notas, como um Ctrl+F da sua vida.

O MEMO TE LEMBRA
• "Ligar para o dentista amanhã às 9h" vira pendência com data, na lista Pra fazer.
• Notificação na hora certa, e a revisão do dia para fechar o que ficou aberto.

PERGUNTE PARA O MEMO
• "O que eu falei sobre a viagem?" O Memo responde a partir das suas notas.

SEUS DADOS SÃO SEUS
• Nenhum fornecedor usa o que você registra para treinar inteligência artificial.
• Exporte tudo quando quiser, ou exclua a conta direto no app.

Instagram: @meuamigomemo · Site: amigomemo.com

name: Mendrel
description:
Mendrel helps fishing crews and net repair workshops organize maintenance for trawl, gill, and seine nets. Map damage, plan repairs, and keep a history of the work done on each net.

Map damage and record inspections
Create a profile for each net with its vessel, mesh size, condition, and photos. Mark damage on a row-and-column grid so you can find the same spot during inspections and repairs.

Plan repairs and track twine
Choose a patch pattern and twine, estimate how much you’ll need, and follow a repair checklist. Save your progress as you work, then record the actual twine used and time spent when you finish.

Compare results and share reports
Review repair history by net, see material usage and active repair time, and compare up to four completed repairs side by side. Export workshop logs, summaries, and comparisons as PDFs.

name: Meter Timer: Visual Timer
description:
Meter Timer turns your iPhone into a small desk timer you can read from across the room.

A big meter fills the screen and drains one cell at a time, with the exact time in small digits underneath. Half gone, a third left, almost done: you know where you are with a glance, without stopping to read a clock.

■ A timer that looks like a real thing
Turn your phone sideways and it becomes the device itself: an LCD window, chunky keys along the top, a little lamp that lights while it runs. Keys sink when you press them, with a click you can feel and a beep you can hear.

■ Two taps to start
Tap 10 min, 1 min, or 10 sec to add time. Press Start. That's the whole manual.

■ It keeps going on the Lock Screen
Lock your phone and the timer stays in view on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island, with pause, resume, and reset right there. The alarm rings on time even if the app is closed.

■ A widget you can press
Put the timer on your Home Screen. Its keys work right from the widget, so you can start a countdown without opening the app.

■ Quiet when you need it
Flip the sound switch and the timer goes silent, including the alarm at the end, just like the mute switch on a real timer.

■ Pick your model
Standard is included. Charcoal, Mint, and Night are one-time purchases, each with its own body, keys, display color, and app icon. Try any model on screen before you buy.

■ Made for
- Study sessions and homework
- Focus blocks and Pomodoro-style work
- Cooking, laundry, and tea
- Screen time and turn-taking with kids
- Anyone who finds a shrinking bar easier to read than a ticking clock

Free with a small banner ad on the timer screen. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns ads off for good.

name: Mi Bebé Crece
description:
Mi Bebé Crece te ayuda a seguir el crecimiento de tu bebé durante sus primeros dos años. Anota el peso, la talla y el perímetro de la cabeza de cada consulta y ve en qué percentil está, según los Patrones de Crecimiento Infantil de la Organización Mundial de la Salud (OMS).

• Percentil de peso, talla, cabeza y peso para la talla, explicado en palabras sencillas.
• Curvas de la OMS con las mediciones de tu bebé a lo largo del tiempo.
• Edad corregida para bebés que nacieron antes de tiempo.
• Historial de mediciones y un resumen listo para compartir con tu pediatra.
• Varios bebés en la misma app.
• Sección "Aprende": qué es un percentil, cómo medir bien y cuándo preguntar al pediatra.

PRIVACIDAD
Sin cuentas y sin internet. Tus datos se guardan solo en tu teléfono; no recopilamos ni enviamos ninguna información.

AVISO
Herramienta informativa para familias. No da diagnósticos ni recomendaciones y no sustituye la valoración del pediatra.

Fuente: WHO Child Growth Standards, Organización Mundial de la Salud, 2006–2007.

name: MIAXPro
description:
MIAXPro is a gym workout log built so that logging never gets in the way of training: you log a set in a few taps, and what you did last time is right there in the same row.

TRAINING
- Previous results next to every set, with suggested weight and reps for the next one
- Rest timer starts on its own after a set, with +10 and −10 seconds
- Supersets, warm-up and working sets, RPE or RIR
- Exercises with weight, bodyweight, added weight, assistance or duration
- Plate calculator for your bar and the plates you have
- An interrupted workout (a call, a dead phone) picks up where it stopped

SCHEDULES
- Ready-made programs: Full Body, Upper / Lower and Push / Pull / Legs
- Your own schedules with cycles and rest days
- Reminders on fixed days or flexibly, when it suits you
- Change just the current cycle without touching the plan

EXERCISE CATALOG
- Nearly 600 exercises with looping animations and step-by-step instructions
- Search and filters by muscle, equipment and movement type
- Your own exercises, with a photo

PROGRESS
- Personal records: weight, volume, reps, duration and distance
- Estimated 1RM and a progress chart for every exercise
- Volume per muscle, training frequency and a body heatmap
- Body measurements with a chart for each one

ON THE LOCK SCREEN
- Live Activity while you train: the set, the rest timer, and buttons for weight, reps and confirming a set
- Widgets for your next workout, this week, body weight, your last workout and records
- A control to start a workout



YOUR DATA
- Export to CSV and JSON at any time
- Workouts, plans and measurements stay on your device

name: Mile Supervisor
description:
Mile Supervisor is the operations app for supervisors who manage delivery and route-sales teams on the Mile platform. See your fleet, orders, loadouts and driver requests in one place, and act on them from your phone or iPad.

LIVE FLEET & LOADOUTS
• See live vehicles and what each driver is carrying
• Review and edit loadouts by driver
• Track orders by driver and route

ORDERS & REQUESTS
• Create new orders for customers
• Approve, hold or reject requests and exceptions sent by drivers
• Handle returns and damage with evidence and an approval timeline

SETTLEMENT
• Reconcile vans at the end of the day: cash, cheques, credit and coupons
• Issue and follow up discrepancy invoices
• Check posting status to the ERP

COUPONS & ASSETS
• Manage coupon books and bulk coupon redemption
• Track bottles, coolers and deposits issued to customers

TRACEABILITY & PERISHABLES
• Batch and lot records sorted by expiry (FEFO)
• Planning advice so the soonest-expiring stock goes out first

REPORTS & COMMUNICATION
• KPIs and reports by date range, with PDF and Excel export
• Chat with drivers directly from the app
• Push notifications for new requests

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
• Works offline and syncs automatically when you're back online
• Barcode scanning for products and assets
• English and Arabic

Mile Supervisor requires a supervisor account from your company on the Mile platform.

name: Minesweeper: No Guess Classic
description:
The minesweeper you remember, made calm and fair.

EVERY BOARD CAN BE SOLVED BY LOGIC
No more 50/50 guesses at the end of a long game. With No Guessing on, each new board can be finished by reasoning alone. Your first tap is always safe.

A NEW PUZZLE EVERY DAY
The Daily Puzzle is the same board for everyone. Solve it to keep your streak going.

EASY ON THE EYES
Big, clear squares and numbers. Turn on Big Cells for even larger squares. Light and dark modes.

TWO LOOKS
Walnut: polished wood, brass and cream felt, like a board game on your table.
Retro 90s: the grey bevels and red counters you grew up with.

MADE FOR FINGERS
Tap to dig, press and hold to flag, or switch between Dig and Flag at the bottom. Tap a number to open everything around it once its flags are placed.

CLASSIC LEVELS
Beginner 9x9, Intermediate 16x16, Expert 16x30, or make your own size.

PLAYS OFFLINE
No account, no sign-in, no internet needed to play. Your game is saved if you leave.

CALM, NOT PUSHY
No ads while you play. A short ad may appear between games. Need help? Watch a short video for a hint that opens one safe square. Remove ads forever with one small purchase.

Also: statistics and best times, how-to-play guide, soft sound effects, VoiceOver support.

name: MiniScrap: Scrapbook & Journal
description:
Create Freely. Dream Boldly. Bring Your Vision to Life.

No rules. No limits. Just you and your imagination. MiniScrap makes vision boards, goals, notes and journaling simple and fun, so you can see what you imagine and start making it real.

IMAGINE: YOUR VISION BOARD
Put your vision on a page: photos, stickers, quotes and goals, placed exactly where you want. Start from ready templates like Vision Board, Manifest and Intentions.

WRITE: NOTES AND JOURNAL
Tap anywhere to write. Mix notes, lists, checklists and photos on one free-form page. Choose plain, dotted, grid or lined paper. Every page looks like a magazine, no design skills needed.

MAKE IT REAL: HABITS AND MOODS
Turn your vision into small daily steps. Tick off habits, pick today’s mood, and keep your week in sight with a home-screen widget.

21 TEMPLATES, READY TO USE
Manifest, Journal, Health, Outfit, Travel, Finance, Creator and Habits. Each one comes filled with real plans and photos: change a few words and start today.

SHARE AND GET INSPIRED
Use templates other people share, share your own pages, and collect stamp badges as you inspire others.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Open the app and start. Your pages stay on your phone; back them up whenever you like.

MINISCRAP PREMIUM
Free: up to 5 pages and the free sticker packs. Premium: unlimited pages and every designed sticker pack, including new ones.

Premium is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation and renews unless turned off at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage it in your Apple ID settings.
Terms of Use: https://maryn-cloud.github.io/miniscrap-legal/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://maryn-cloud.github.io/miniscrap-legal/privacy-policy.html

name: MoaURL - 링크·사진 저장 아카이브
description:
나중에 봐야지 하고 캡처만 쌓아두고 계신가요?
MoaURL은 흩어진 링크, 사진, 영상을 한 곳에 모아두는 개인 아카이브 앱이에요.

■ 공유 버튼 한 번으로 저장
인스타그램, 유튜브, 스레드, X, 사파리, 사진 앱 등 어디서든 공유 버튼에서 MoaURL을 고르면 바로 저장돼요. 사진 여러 장과 영상도 한 번에 보관할 수 있어요.

■ 내 방식대로 정리
맛집·카페, 여행·장소, 아이·육아, 쇼핑 등 기본 카테고리가 준비되어 있고, 원하는 카테고리를 직접 만들 수도 있어요. 메모와 태그를 붙여 두면 나중에 찾기 쉬워요.

■ 사진 속 글자까지 검색
제목, 메모, 태그는 물론 이미지 속 텍스트까지 인식해서 찾아줘요. 글자 인식은 기기 안에서 처리돼요.

■ 보기 편한 화면
2열 그리드, 3열 미디어 그리드, 리스트 중 원하는 보기로 훑어보세요. iPad에서는 큰 화면에 맞춰 더 많이 보여줘요.

■ 내 기기에만, 안전하게
회원가입도 광고도 없어요. 저장한 내용은 개발자 서버로 전송되지 않고 내 기기에만 보관돼요. Face ID 앱 잠금으로 나만 볼 수 있게 지킬 수 있어요.

■ 이런 분께 추천해요
· SNS에서 본 맛집, 여행지를 모아두고 싶은 분
· 육아 정보, 레시피, 할인 정보를 정리하고 싶은 분
· 캡처와 북마크가 여기저기 흩어져 있는 분

문의: ljh8779@gmail.com

name: Molkky Scoreboard
description:
Mölkky Scoreboard keeps score for the Finnish throwing game so you can keep your eyes on the pins. Tap the pins that fell, and the app does the math, follows the rules, and puts a scoreboard worthy of the big screen in front of everyone.

TAP THE PINS, WE DO THE MATH
• One pin scores its number; several pins score how many fell.
• Overshoot 50 and you drop back to 25, automatically.
• Three misses in a row and you're out, unless you've turned on unlimited misses.
• Undo any throw with one tap.

FOUR WAYS TO PLAY
• Individual: everyone for themselves.
• Teams: shared scores, with throwers rotating on every turn.
• Tournament: keep playing rounds and track round wins for each team.
• Family Championship: enter ages and players are grouped into Toddler, Children, Pre-Teen, Adult and Senior brackets. Little ones get a closer line and can't be knocked out by misses. The first exact 50 finishes the round, ties go to overtime from 25, and every bracket crowns its own champion.

CHANGE THE GAME MID-GAME
• Someone arrives late? Add them, or a whole team, at any time.
• Someone has to leave? Remove them and the turn passes on correctly.
• Wrong score entered? Edit any score or miss count on the fly.
• Turn on unlimited misses for one player, or for everyone.

MADE FOR THE BIG SCREEN
• A full-screen scoreboard with the top three, the current thrower and rotating stats: hot hand, bust magnet, clutch zone, favorite number and more.
• AirPlay or plug into a TV and the scoreboard appears there automatically.

EVERYONE FOLLOWS ALONG
• Turn on sharing and other phones, tablets, laptops and smart-TV browsers on your Wi-Fi can open the scoreboard. Just scan the QR code, no app needed.
• Changes from any device appear everywhere instantly.
• No Wi-Fi in the park? Use your iPhone's Personal Hotspot.

BRAGGING RIGHTS, SAVED
• Every finished game is archived with final scores and every throw.
• Championship history shows last year's winners in every bracket and tracks who's building a dynasty.
• Export your history as a file for safekeeping, or import it on a new phone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking.
• Your games stay on your iPhone. When you share, the scoreboard travels only between your own devices on your own network.

Mölkky Scoreboard is an independent scorekeeping app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Tuoterengas Oy, maker of the original Mölkky® game.

name: Monkey: Love New Friends
description:
Keep every monkey meet-up organised, private and meaningful. Monkey: Love New Friends is a personal diary for owners who want to plan social visits, record behaviour, and save photos and memories in one calm, easy-to-use app.

Whether you are keeping track of a planned introduction, noting how your pet behaved before and after a visit, or storing favourite moments with friends and family, this app helps you stay on top of everything without public feeds, ratings or pressure.

Key features
- Plan meetings with friends and family - save the person, date, place and prep notes in one place
- Track each visit - record planned, completed and cancelled meetings with clear status labels
- Log behaviour observations - note when your pet approached, moved away, hid, showed interest and more using your own custom notes
- Build a private people list - store profiles, relationships, restrictions and visit history for each person
- Keep a private gallery - upload photos and videos from your device or camera, organise by people or meetings, and mark favourites
- Save pet profile details - add name, species, birthday or estimated age, special traits and reminders from a specialist
- Stay organised with reminders - get prompts for upcoming meetings and return to important notes quickly
- Protect your data - lock the app with a PIN code or biometrics and delete profiles, entries or all data whenever you need

Perfect for
- Pet owners who want a simple way to plan introductions and keep detailed notes
- Families and close friends who share regular visits and want a private record of each meeting
- Owners who value privacy and want a personal journal rather than a social network or chat app

Why choose us
Monkey: Love New Friends is built as a private companion for careful planning, thoughtful observation and treasured memories. There are no public comments, no automatic emotion scoring, no contact matching and no pressure to rate anyone. Just a clean, colourful space for your monkey's profile, people list, meeting log and photo gallery.

If you want a private, beautifully organised way to plan visits and save memories, download Monkey: Love New Friends today.

name: Monoculture: B&W Photo Editor
description:
Monoculture is a black-and-white darkroom for the photographs you make with your Leica M and Q cameras. Import DNG and JPEG files straight from the card, and turn them into rich, expressive monochrome prints on Mac, iPad and iPhone.

MADE FOR M AND Q SHOOTERS
• Reads DNG and JPEG files from the Leica Q, Q2, Q2 Monochrom, Q3, Q3 43, M10, M10 Monochrom and M11.
• DNG + JPEG pairs from the same frame are kept together, with the DNG as the master.
• Colour files get true black-and-white conversion with yellow, orange, red, green and blue filters and an 8-band channel mixer — just like glass filters on the lens.
• Monochrom files are recognised and handled as the panchromatic originals they are.
• Crop with the in-camera digital frame lines of your Q (35, 50, 75, 90 mm and more), straighten, and choose classic print ratios.

LOOKS FOR EVERY KIND OF PICTURE
Apply a finished look in one tap and preview every look on your own photo before you choose. 23 looks, crafted in the spirit of classic rangefinder black and white:
• Portrait — High Contrast Portrait, Window Light, Low Key, High Key, Lamplight
• Street — Grit, Midday Street, Push 1600, Night Street, Documentary, Overcast
• Architecture — Red Sky, Concrete, Fine Art Minimal, Glass & Steel, Old Stone
• Timeless — Classic, Natural, Silver, Contrast, High Contrast, Matte, Soft, Selenium
Dial in each look's strength, save your own edits as looks, and share them as simple look files.

A REAL DARKROOM, WITHOUT THE CHEMICALS
• Tone, grain, selenium, sepia, platinum and cyanotype toning
• Zone System placement with a live zone map and clipping warnings
• Dodge and burn with radial and graduated masks, plus edge burn
• Every edit is a layer you can show, hide, copy to other photos or export on its own
• Unlimited undo and redo, with named snapshots — your history is saved with every photo

EXPORT WITHOUT COMPROMISE
• JPEG with adjustable quality and an optional file-size limit
• PNG at 8 or 16 bits with selectable compression
