• DNG that keeps your original raw data and opens with your edits as editable settings in Adobe Lightroom and Photoshop — or a DNG with your edits baked in

YOUR PHOTOS STAY YOURS
• No personal data is ever collected. No analytics, no tracking, no accounts.
• No cloud storage and no online services — everything happens on your device.
• No subscription. Buy it once and it's yours.

Leica, M and Q are trademarks of Leica Camera AG. Monoculture is an independent app by Future Pixels Studio and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Leica Camera AG.

name: Moonfest: Color Sort Puzzle
description:
Light up the night.

Moonfest is a calm color-sorting puzzle. Paper lanterns glow on lacquered poles in a festival square. Tap a pole to lift its top lantern, tap another to place it — on an empty pole or on a lantern of the same color. Light every pole in a single color and the whole festival shines.

RELAXING, FOR REAL
• No timer, no lives, no pressure. Play at your own pace.
• Undo, hints and an extra pole are always there when you need them.
• Soft music, gentle sounds and satisfying little celebrations.

FAIR BY DESIGN
• Every level is checked by a solver before it reaches you: it can always be solved, without the extra pole.
• Ads never interrupt a level. No ads at all before level 6, then at most one short break between levels, spaced out.
• Reward videos are always your choice. A one-time purchase removes banners and breaks for good.

A LOT TO PLAY
• 1,000+ levels that grow from 3 to 12 colors, with an easy "breather" level every few levels.
• New ideas as you go: unlit lanterns that reveal their color when they reach the top, locked poles, taller and shorter poles.
• A daily challenge with streaks and bonus coins.
• Endless levels after that.

MADE FOR EVERY EYE
• 12 colors tested for all common types of color blindness.
• Turn on Color symbols to add a small emblem to each color.
• Reduce motion setting, large touch targets, works on phones and tablets.

COLLECT THEMES
• Lantern Festival, Origami, Zen Garden, Pâtisserie and Paper Moon — same puzzles, a whole new look.

Plays offline. No account needed.

Moonfest is free to play, shows ads and offers optional in-app purchases (remove ads, coins, theme packs).
Privacy policy: https://moonfest.emergestudio.ch/privacy

name: Moonlet: Mood & Sleep Diary
description:
Moonlet is a cozy mood and sleep diary. A few seconds a day, and over time you'll see how you sleep and how your mood changes. The whole app is free.

SIMPLE LOGGING
• Mood in one tap, with cute little moons
• Sleep: tap I’m up and Going to bed, or pick a time
• Tags like sport, work or friends
• Morning and evening note with a question of the day
• A photo for every day

OVERVIEW
• Weekly sleep and mood overview
• Calendar by month
• Badges and day streaks

CALM BACKGROUNDS
A living night city and sky that change with the time of day. Set the card transparency to your taste.

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
No account and no server. Entries stay on your phone and, if you like, in a backup in your own iCloud. The author can't access them. You can lock the app with Face ID.

This version is completely free. I plan to add more features in a future update as a paid extension; what's free stays free.

Moonlet is not a medical device and does not replace a doctor.

name: Moonlight Pass: Tower Defense
description:
Hold the mountain passes against marching shadow spirits and keep the village lights burning!

Moonlight Pass is a tactical tower defense game set across 24 hand-crafted night stages. Build traditional guardian towers, position soldiers along winding roads, and lead 5 distinct heroes.

■ 4 CHAPTERS, 24 HAND-CRAFTED STAGES
Fight through Reed Ford, Forgotten Wall, Bridge of Night, Mist Island, and into the Heart of Eclipse—from single S-bends to four-front sieges.

■ 4 UPGRADABLE GUARDIAN TOWERS (3 TIERS EACH)
- Totem: Single-target shots that slow swift raiders
- Lantern: Explosive AoE blasts that shatter armored brutes
- Sotdae: Rapid long-range volleys with knockback every 3rd hit
- Garrison: Deploys guards directly onto the road to block foes and strip boss shields

■ 5 PLAYABLE HEROES WITH ACTIVE SKILLS
Unlock and upgrade Capt. Gangnim, Shaman Seoyeon, Archer Haesol, Gen. Muak, and Mystic Baekran. Move your hero freely and unleash ultimates to interrupt deadly boss seals.

■ SCOUT WAVES & FOCUS HIGH-VALUE THREATS
Inspect upcoming enemy timings in the Wave Scouting ledger, focus banner bearers shielding nearby mobs, and earn fast-call gold bonuses.

■ SINGLE-PLAYER, NO LOGIN OR IAP
Play with no account creation or in-app purchases. Progress saves locally on your device. Contains optional rewarded ads and occasional interstitial ads between stages. Supports 7 languages.

Support: cs@footer.kr

name: Moves: Local Events
description:
Moves shows you what's happening around you: trivia nights, live music, fitness classes, markets, art walks and deals from local businesses, all on one map.

FIND SOMETHING TO DO
• Browse events near you on the map, or switch the map off for a simple list
• Filter by today, tomorrow, this weekend, distance, type of event or discounts
• Search any address or ZIP code, or use your location
• Get directions in Apple Maps with one tap

SEE WHO'S GOING
• Find friends by name or username, with friends of friends suggested
• See which friends are going on every event
• Tap a friend to see what they have coming up
• Add a profile photo and bio

REAL PHOTOS FROM REAL PEOPLE
• The Buzz: a feed of photo reviews from events near you
• Every review needs a real photo, so you know what it's actually like
• Star ratings show what's worth going to

POST YOUR OWN EVENT
• Businesses and organizers can post events with a time, place, price, discount and photo
• Every event is reviewed by a Moves host before it goes live
• Businesses subscribe to post: 1 event a day, every one checked by a host
• Post friends-only events, like a house party, that only your friends can see (free)

MOVES POSTING SUBSCRIPTION
• $19.99 a month, $99.99 for 6 months or $174.99 a year, charged to your Apple Account
• Renews automatically unless turned off at least 24 hours before the period ends; you're charged within 24 hours before renewal
• Manage or cancel any time in Settings → your name → Subscriptions
Terms of use: https://movesapp.netlify.app/terms.html
Privacy policy: https://movesapp.netlify.app/privacy.html

SAFE BY DESIGN
• Report any photo, event or person
• Block anyone
• Offensive language is filtered, and reports are reviewed within 24 hours
• Delete your account any time from the Me tab

Dark mode by default, with a light mode if you prefer.

name: Moxtasar Learning
description:
Moxtasar Learning brings free online courses to your iPhone and iPad, in Kurdish (Sorani), Arabic and English.

WATCH
• Short video lessons, organised into clear course curricula
• Sign in to save your progress and pick up where you left off
• Courses you have opened still show when you are offline

TEST YOURSELF
• Timed quizzes for each course
• See your score, then review every answer
• Follow your results and compare on weekly and all-time leaderboards
• Download course files and read them in the app

ASK YOUR TEACHER
• Message the teacher of a course you are enrolled in
• Block or report a teacher at any time

ALL FREE
Every course is free. There are no purchases, subscriptions or ads.

You can browse courses and watch lessons as a guest. Exams, course files and messaging need a free account, which you can delete at any time from your profile.

Videos: NASA (public domain). Moxtasar Learning is not affiliated with or endorsed by NASA.

Support: https://learning.moxtasar.com/support
Privacy Policy: https://learning.moxtasar.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://learning.moxtasar.com/terms

name: MQRcore
description:
MQRcore is a private plant care journal for your iPhone. Keep each plant, its care schedule, and its growth in one place, without an account or an internet connection.

Your garden Add plants with a photo, species, room or balcony, pot size, light, and soil. Indoor, balcony, and outdoor plants sit together in one photographic grid. Sample plants are labeled and can be edited or removed.

Care, on your schedule Plan watering, fertilizing, pruning, and repotting as a one-time task or a repeat. Pause a plan, mark it done, and note what you actually did. Optional reminders stay on this iPhone.

Watch it grow Record height, leaves, new shoots, flowers, and fruit, then follow the change on a chart. Each point opens the original note. Save a before-and-after photo comparison when you want to see the difference.

A journal you can search Write notes, attach photos from the camera or your library, and record temperature, humidity, and light yourself. MQRcore does not read sensors or invent measurements. Search by plant, date, title, or note, and filter by record type.

Yours to keep Export a PDF, CSV, or a full JSON backup that includes your photos. Restoring a backup asks you to confirm first and saves a safety copy of the current garden. Everything is stored on your device. There is no account, no advertising, and no cloud sync.

name: MSA Training Groups
description:
MSA Training Groups is the training tool for My Swing Academia's West Coast Swing groups. Coaches run their groups from it, and dancers see their own progress.

FOR COACHES
• Groups and rosters: add dancers, invite them by link, and see each dancer's MSA class and WSDC level at a glance.
• Scoring: run scored exams and free-flow scoring, with topic scores that build a picture of each dancer over time.
• Notes: keep private coaching notes, or share a note with the dancer.
• Session plans: build a session step by step, reuse it, and save premade sessions from the MSA library.
• Spotlights and Tempo Tests for focused practice.

FOR DANCERS
• See your scores and how they change.
• Read the notes and resources your coach shares with you.
• Join your coach's group from their invite link.

ONE MSA LOGIN
Training Groups uses your MSA account, the same email and password as the MSA Hub and Lesson Notes.

Questions or problems? Report them from inside the app, or email myswingacademia@gmail.com.

name: Murk Diver
description:
চল্লিশ বছর আগে এক রাতেই ডুবে গিয়েছিল লুমেন রিচ (Lumen Reach) শহর। শহরের বাতিগুলো জ্বলত মুক্তার আলোয়, আর আজও মুক্তাই একমাত্র মুদ্রা যার দাম আছে। এইমাত্র আপনার নামার দড়ি ছিঁড়ে গেছে। এখন আপনি অন্ধকারে এক উদ্ধারকারী ডুবুরি, আর নিচে কিছু একটা আপনাকে লক্ষ্য করেছে।

Murk Diver একটি টার্ন-ভিত্তিক পিক্সেল রোগলাইক গেম: ডুব দিন, লুট সংগ্রহ করুন আর মার্জ করুন। প্রতিটি পদক্ষেপ একটি চাল, প্রতিটি চালে খরচ হয় চাপ, আর প্রতিটি তলা আলাদা।

পাঁচটি ডুবে যাওয়া তলায় নামুন চারটি এলাকা জুড়ে পাঁচটি তলা: ডুবে যাওয়া নর্দমা, প্লাবিত জলাধার, পাম্পিং স্টেশন আর অতলের দ্বার। প্রতিবার ডুব দিলে প্রতিটি তলা নতুন করে তৈরি হয়, নিজস্ব দানব, ফাঁদ আর গোপন কক্ষ নিয়ে।

লুট মার্জ করুন একটি জিনিস হুবহু একই আরেকটি জিনিসের ওপর ফেলুন, তার বিরলতা এক ধাপ বেড়ে যাবে: Scrap থেকে একেবারে Legendary পর্যন্ত। একই স্লটের দুটি ভিন্ন সরঞ্জাম রিফোর্জ করে পেতে পারেন সম্পূর্ণ নতুন কিছু। যা কাজে লাগে না, তা ভেঙে আবার Scrap বানিয়ে নিন।

চাপের দিকে নজর রাখুন আপনার স্যুট দিয়ে বাতাস চুঁইয়ে বেরিয়ে যাচ্ছে। চাপই আপনার আলো, চাপই আপনার জীবন। ক্যানিস্টার আর বাতাসের পকেট খুঁজুন, অথবা বাড়তি জিনিস গলিয়ে বাতাস বানান। চাপ শূন্যে নামলেই আপনাকে ধরতে আসবে লার্কার।

লড়াই করে এগিয়ে যান ছুরি, স্পিয়ারগান, ফ্লেয়ার পিস্তল আর হুক লাইন। এগারো রকমের দানব: নর্দমার ইঁদুর আর জাল-ইল থেকে শুরু করে ঢাল-কাঁকড়া আর ডুবে মরা ডুবুরি পর্যন্ত। লুকানো ফাঁদ খুঁজে নিষ্ক্রিয় করুন, আর ফাটল ধরা দেয়ালের পেছনে লুকানো সিন্দুক খুঁজে বের করুন।

বেলহাউসে ফিরে আসুন দুই ডুবের মাঝে ফিরে আসুন বেলহাউসে, এক বিশাল ডাইভিং বেলের ভেতরে গড়ে ওঠা উদ্ধার স্টেশনে। ক্রুদের সঙ্গে কথা বলুন, পরের ডুবের জন্য মুক্তা খরচ করে শক্তি বাড়ান, আর ট্রফির দেয়ালে নিজের রেকর্ড দেখুন।

টার্ন-ভিত্তিক: তাড়াহুড়ো নেই, প্রতিটি চাল গুরুত্বপূর্ণ
ছোট রান, এক কাপ চায়ের সময়েই শেষ
রহস্যময় পিক্সেল আর্ট আর শান্ত সমুদ্রতলের সংগীত
পুরোপুরি অফলাইনে খেলা যায়, কোনো বিজ্ঞাপন নেই, কোনো ইন-অ্যাপ কেনাকাটা নেই

name: Muse AI Companion: Your Agent
description:
Make room for your next idea with mise. Bring writing, study questions and everyday work into one place, with focused skills to help you get started.

72 WAYS TO START
Explore skills for business, marketing, IT, education, creative projects and writing. Search the catalog, choose a skill for your task and save favorites for next time.

WRITE, PLAN AND LEARN
Choose Work or Study mode before starting a conversation. Draft an email, build an outline, rewrite a paragraph or work through a topic. Keep the conversation going as you refine what you need.

BRING YOUR MATERIALS
Add photos, PDFs, text files or Markdown documents to a conversation. mise can extract text from images and supported documents, so you can bring relevant material into your task.

KEEP USEFUL CONVERSATIONS
Find previous chats with history and search. Return to an idea, copy an answer or share it when you are ready.

SET A TIME TO RETURN
Schedule a task and receive a reminder. Open mise when reminded to start your task; scheduled work does not run independently while the app is closed.

PREMIUM
Premium provides access to subscription features, subject to usage limits. Available plans, prices and any eligible introductory offers are shown before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled. Manage or cancel your subscription through your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://telegra.ph/Mise-Terms-of-Use-11-18
Privacy Policy: https://telegra.ph/Mise-Privacy-Policy-11-18

name: Museo Archeologico Muro Lucano
description:
L’applicativo Museo Archeologico Muro Lucano, gratuito e scaricabile dai principali store, raccoglie i contenuti del Museo in un unico strumento di consultazione, pensato per accompagnare il visitatore alla scoperta delle collezioni del museo con testi scritti e narrazioni audio tradotti in lingua inglese e nella lingua italiana dei segni.
Scaricato l’applicativo, l’utente può accedere alla sezione “Scansiona” per attivare i contenuti tramite i QR Code presenti sui pannelli informativi del percorso espositivo e selezionare la modalità di fruizione che preferisce.

name: MyGuide Live - Tour Guide App
description:
MyGuide Live turns your smartphone into a complete tour guide audio system.

Instead of renting and carrying whisper systems, receivers and headsets, guides simply speak into their phone – and every guest hears them live on their own phone, with their own earphones.

FOR TOUR GUIDES
• Broadcast your voice live to your entire group
• Guests join in seconds with a QR code or join code – no account needed for them
• Keeps working with the screen locked, so you can put your phone in your pocket
• Ideal for city walks, museums, factory visits, wine regions and noisy places
• Manage your events and groups in one place

FOR GUESTS
• Hear the guide clearly, even at the back of the group
• Use your own phone and earphones – nothing to rent or return
• Audio keeps playing while your phone is locked

EXPLORER
Travelers can discover local guides and tours in the Explorer section. Every guide profile and tour listing is reviewed by our team before it becomes visible.

MyGuide Live is the digital successor to traditional tour guide equipment – lighter, simpler and always with you.

name: MyGuide Live Listener
description:
MyGuide Live Listener lets you hear your tour guide live on your own phone.

Your guide speaks into their phone – you hear every word in your earphones, even at the back of the group or in a noisy street.

HOW IT WORKS
• Scan the QR code or enter the join code your guide gives you
• Plug in your earphones
• Listen live – that's it

WHY YOU'LL LIKE IT
• No account or registration needed
• No rental receiver or headset to carry and return
• Audio keeps playing while your phone is locked
• Clear sound, even in crowded or noisy places
• Rate your tour when it's over

Perfect for city walks, museum visits, factory tours, wine regions and any guided group experience using MyGuide Live.

name: MyNewFaith
description:
MyNewFaith is a Christian learning and personal reflection companion for ages 13 and older, designed for iPhone and iPad. Ages 13–17 use prewritten Guided reflection only; adults 18 and older may explicitly select and consent to optional Apple on-device Personalized reflection on supported devices. People under 13 cannot enter the app, and age ranges are self-declared, not verified. Explore unchanged World English Bible Classic (WEB) Scripture, age-appropriate lessons, prayer, journaling and original audio and video reflections. The authored core works offline and activity is saved locally, with no app accounts, cloud sync or cloud AI fallback. Pay once for the included age-appropriate features; no ads, subscriptions, annual renewal or in-app purchases. MyNewFaith is an educational tool, not counseling, diagnosis, treatment, professional advice or emergency monitoring.

The App Store age rating is 16+ on current operating systems. The app's self-declared minimum usage age of 13 does not replace Apple's age rating or store restrictions.

name: MyRevna
description:
MyRevna è l'app riservata agli hotel clienti di Revna, la società di revenue management per strutture ricettive.

Con MyRevna il titolare e lo staff dell'hotel hanno sempre con sé:

• Documenti e report: i report e i documenti che Revna prepara per la struttura, ordinati e consultabili in ogni momento.
• Assistente AI: fai domande sui documenti della tua struttura e ricevi risposte con il riferimento alla fonte. Ogni risposta può essere segnalata se non è corretta.
• Concierge: il chatbot che risponde agli ospiti sul sito dell'hotel, da gestire anche dal telefono. Domande rapide, stato del servizio e contatti lasciati dagli ospiti che chiedono di essere richiamati.
• Avvisi: comunicazioni e aggiornamenti di Revna, con notifica sul telefono.
• Richieste: scrivi a Revna e segui le tue richieste.
• Blog: gli articoli di Revenue su Misura su prezzi, distribuzione e vendite.

L'accesso è riservato ai clienti Revna: l'account viene creato da Revna e si attiva dal link ricevuto via email. Per informazioni: revna.it

name: nanoDMX
description:
nanoDMX is a compact lighting console for iPhone and iPad. It controls 512 DMX channels of one universe over Art-Net on your local network, with no account and no subscription.

FADERS AND MASTER
Channel faders with a master, blackout with its own fade time and flash keys for every channel. Name your faders and swipe smoothly through all 512 channels.

LOOKS AND CHASERS
Store looks with one tap, combine them and crossfade with a global or per-look fade time. Chasers run at the tempo you set, in BPM or seconds per beat; steps can be named, duplicated and reordered.

SHOW MODE
Show mode puts all looks in a large grid, made for live gigs, churches, theatre and parties.

REMOTE CONTROL
Drive nanoDMX via OSC from other controllers, map MIDI foot switches with MIDI Learn, or open the browser remote on another device on the same network, paired with a PIN or QR code.

ART-NET
Unicast to your Art-Net node with adjustable Net, SubNet and Universe and a selectable refresh rate. A live view shows all 512 output values.

YOUR LOOK
Several color themes, light and dark mode and alternative app icons.

nanoDMX collects no data. Show data stays on your device and can be backed up and restored.

Light output needs an Art-Net node or an Art-Net capable fixture on the same network. The app interface is in German and English.

name: Neatscout: Tidy or Style
description:
Not sure what to buy to get a space under control? Take one photo. Neatscout looks at your closet, shelf, pantry, garage, or desk and suggests the organizing products that are missing.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Take a photo of the space, or choose one from your library.
2. Neatscout suggests 3 to 5 organizing products for that exact space.
3. Each suggestion explains why it helps and where to put it.
4. Tap a store to see matching products at Amazon, Walmart, Target, or The Home Depot.

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
• Suggestions come from what is actually in your photo, not a generic checklist.
• Every suggestion comes with a reason and a placement tip, so you know how to use it before you buy.
• You choose which stores appear.
• No account, no sign-up, and no ads.

GOOD FOR
• Closets with clothes piled on the top shelf
• Garages with boxes on the floor
• Pantries and cabinets where things get lost in the back
• Desks and TV stands with tangled cords
• Entryways, bathrooms, and laundry rooms

PRIVACY
• Your photo is sent to an AI service (Google Gemini) only to analyze the space. It is not stored.
• Neatscout has no account system and does not track you.
• Avoid people, faces, and documents in your photos.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Neatscout is free. You can scan up to 5 spaces per day.
• Store links open in your browser or the store's app. Neatscout does not sell products and does not process payments.
• Some store links are affiliate links. As an Amazon Associate, Neatscout earns from qualifying purchases.
• Suggestions are generated by AI and may not be perfect. Check sizes before you buy.

Questions or feedback: support@aisoftinc.com

name: nebulacoil
description:
Pujota elävä säie pimeän kehdon läpi.

Nebula Coil on pystysuuntainen 3D-lelu. Vedä ohjauskaivoa taivuttaaksesi säiettä ja napauta Leimahdusta, kun linja tarvitsee jyrkän käännöksen. Numeroidut kipinät on kerättävä oikeassa järjestyksessä. Jättämäsi jälki on kiinteä, joten huolimaton silmukka voi vangita kelan. Ontot kaiut näyttävät kirkkailta, mutta niistä ei saa pisteitä. Sytykkeet viilentävät säiettä. Sirpaleet liikkuvat omia reittejään ja lisäävät lämpöä törmäyksissä.

Kehdohakemistossa odottaa neljä aluetta: Mustemetsä, Ioniriutta, Meripihkamyrsky ja Lasiajautuma. Jokaisella alueella on neljä retkeä. Lyhyt lämmittelyharjoitus, Kolme kipinää, opettaa säikeen taivuttamisen. Aamunkoiton siemen luo yhden kehdon tämän laitteen tämänpäiväisen päivämäärän perusteella ja tallentaa vain paikallisen ennätyksesi.

Puhtausarvo vaihtelee välillä 0–100. Suoritus arvioidaan tasoilla Vapaa, Hallittu tai Täydellinen kela. Aseta penkille erilainen säie – neula, koukku, kannus tai lyhty – ja valitse vasen tai oikea ohjauskaivo.

name: Needle: Light Meter
description:
Needle turns your iPhone into a light meter for film and manual cameras. Lock what you set, and the meter turns the rest.

PICK WHAT YOU SET
Lock ISO, aperture or shutter speed, each with its own switch. Everything left unlocked follows the light. Turn a dial by hand and Needle keeps your value and moves the others.

READ THE NEEDLE
Lock all three and the needle shows how many stops over or under you are, the way a match-needle camera does.

SEE WHAT YOUR LENS SEES
Pick your format and focal length, from 35mm to 6x7 and 4x5, and frame lines show its view.

LONG EXPOSURES, CORRECTED FOR YOUR FILM
Choose Portra, Tri-X, HP5 and more. Needle adds the time your film needs past one second, then counts down the bulb.

FLASH, WORKED OUT FOR YOU
Enter your flash's guide number and the distance, and Needle gives the power to set. Or measure the flash itself.

ALSO IN NEEDLE
- Spot, white card and incident metering
- Color temperature in Kelvin, with the filter to use for daylight or tungsten film
- Store readings for the average and how many stops apart highlights and shadows are
- Any camera: set your shutter range, aperture range and full, half or third stops
- Exposure log: the settings of every frame, roll by roll
- Grid lines and a histogram

FREE TO METER, PAY ONCE FOR PRO
The full light meter is free. An ad shows now and then, never while you're metering.
Needle Pro is one payment, never a subscription: no ads, plus long exposures, flash, color, lens frames, highlight and shadow readings and the exposure log.

Questions or ideas: lucy@pixture.io

name: neoFUT
description:
neoFUT is the app for playing football with your friends. Organize the matchday, build the teams, keep score and time live, and let everyone see their goals, games and MVPs.

5 AND 7-A-SIDE
Choose the format for each matchday. neoFUT builds teams of 5 or 7 and manages the line of players waiting.

PLAY NOW
Already at the pitch? Mark who came, draw the teams or build them by hand and kick off. Winners stay on and the next players in line come in — in order, at random or picked by you.

LIVE
Clock, one-tap goals, undo if you slip, and penalties if it ends in a draw. Everyone follows the score on their phone at the same time. Someone arrived late? Add them and they join the end of the line.

SCHEDULE THE MATCHDAY
Pick the day, time and pitch, invite your friends and see who's in, live. Remind them on WhatsApp in one tap.

MVP AND STATS
When it's over, everyone who played votes for the MVP. Nobody saved the matchday? It saves itself after 12 hours and the top scorer is MVP. Each player builds up goals, games, wins, MVPs and their streak, and competes in the friends ranking.

GUESTS WITHOUT THE APP
Add anyone who doesn't have the app with just their name. Their goals are saved, and if they create an account later, they get them back. Invite your group with your personal link (and change it whenever you want).

PLAYS
Learn 5-a-side moves step by step on an animated tactics board: one-twos, building from the keeper, pressing, corners and more.

SHARE
Share the matchday summary as an image on WhatsApp or Instagram.

LIGHT AND DARK MODE
Choose light, dark or automatic (follows your iPhone). Light mode is easy to read even in the sun at the pitch.

Free, no ads.

name: NetScope: IPv4 Subnet Planner
description:
Calculate IPv4 network ranges, split networks into equal subnets, and check whether an address belongs to a network. All calculations run locally; no network scanning is performed.

• Calculate network addresses, masks, address counts and usable ranges for prefixes /0 through /32.
• Split a subnet into equal smaller blocks, up to 256 at a time.
• Check whether an address lies inside a network without contacting that address.
• Browse a complete prefix reference and save named results locally.
• Share a calculation when you choose to.

The /31 usable count follows the point-to-point convention; /32 represents a single host route. This is an offline planning tool, not a network scanner.

Your records stay on this device. No sign-in, advertising or tracking SDK is included. Share only when you choose a destination.

name: Next Train West
description:
All aboard for adventure. The West awaits.

Run a steam railway through the mountains in a solo strategy game where each choice shapes the journey ahead.

PLAN YOUR DISPATCH
Choose delivery contracts, an engine and the cars to carry your load. Balance coal, water, departure costs and delivery deadlines before leaving Central Yard. Start with a guided practice dispatch, or go straight to full planning.

CHOOSE YOUR WAY WEST
Compare routes and stops as weather changes across the mountains. Closed passes, worn equipment and unexpected events can force a wait, a repair or a different route.

MAKE THE RETURN COUNT
Deliver your cargo, then choose work for the journey home. Weigh local freight, express passengers and pickup opportunities against time and running costs.

BUILD YOUR RAILWAY
Successful dispatches grow your treasury. Work toward additional engines and upgrades, manage maintenance and prepare for the next set of contracts.

Painted mountain scenery, animated trains and railway sound bring your chosen engine and cars into the journey. Progress saves on your device so you can return to your railway.

One purchase includes the complete game. No ads, subscriptions or in-app purchases. Play offline, with progress saved on your device.

name: Night Browser: Dark Mode
description:
Night Browser is designed for comfortable browsing in low-light environments.

Use Smart Darkmode to adapt bright pages, keep media playing in the background, set a sleep timer, or switch to blackout mode when you want the screen fully dark. Tabs, bookmarks, favorites, and browsing history stay on your device.

Features:
- Smart Darkmode for bright websites
- Blackout mode with slide-to-exit protection
- Background audio and lock screen media controls
- Sleep timer for web media
- Tabs, bookmarks, favorites, and local history
- Incognito tabs with non-persistent website data
- Adjustable page text size
- iPhone and iPad support

Night Browser does not include analytics, advertising, or tracking SDKs.

name: Northern Lights Aurora Tracker
description:
Never miss the northern lights again.

Aurora Tracker tells you the moment the aurora is visible from your sky, and only then. We check NOAA's live aurora forecast, your cloud cover and darkness for your exact spot, so you get one alert when it matters, not a phone full of false alarms.

GO OUTSIDE NOW, OR DON'T
• One clear answer for tonight: Go outside now, Keep an eye out, or Not tonight
• Visibility score for your exact location, not just your region
• Best time tonight, hour by hour, combining darkness, clouds and the aurora forecast

ALERTS YOU CAN TRUST
• Only when the aurora is likely AND your sky is clear and dark
• Crowd alerts: when people near you post aurora photos, we ping you, even if the forecast missed it
• Choose big storms only, good chances, or every chance
• Quiet hours, so no 3am buzzing unless you want it

CLOUDY? WE'LL FIND YOU A CLEAR SKY
• Clear-sky finder checks the clouds and aurora around you and tells you which way to drive
• One tap for directions in Apple Maps

THE LIVE AURORA, ANYWHERE ON EARTH
• A smooth, live aurora map from NOAA, updated every few minutes
• Northern and southern lights: North America, Europe, Australia, New Zealand and beyond
• Save up to 5 viewing spots, like the cabin or a dark-sky site, and get alerts for each

REAL PHOTOS FROM PEOPLE NEAR YOU
• See photo sightings from aurora chasers nearby, so you know it's really happening
• Swipe through photos and the map flies to each one
• Follow your favorite aurora photographers and get notified when they post
• Share your own photo pin when you see it (pins disappear after 30 days)
• Report and block tools keep the community friendly

SPACE WEATHER, MADE SIMPLE
• Kp index now and a 3-day storm outlook
• Live solar wind and Bz, explained in plain English
• What each Kp level means where you live

ALSO
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Phone camera tips for photographing the aurora
• No ads. Ever.

From the makers of Whale Tracker.

SUBSCRIPTION
Aurora Tracker requires a subscription (monthly or yearly) or a one-time lifetime purchase. There's no free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID account settings.

Terms of Use: https://stephenhartwd-blip.github.io/aurora-tracker/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://stephenhartwd-blip.github.io/aurora-tracker/privacy.html

Aurora data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center. Weather data from MET Norway. Forecasts are guidance, not guarantees.

name: Norwally: Bedtime Expeditions
description:
Bedtime, but make it an expedition.

Norwally is a read-aloud story app where you're the guide and your kids are the explorers. Their beds carry them somewhere wild: down the Amazon, over a waterfall, onto a mountain where the snow has a mind of its own. Something unexpected always gets in the way, and together you get them home.

THE STORY LISTENS
Read aloud and the expedition comes alive around you. Hit the right word and the river roars, the monkeys chatter, the avalanche rumbles in. No narrator, no autoplay. Your voice drives it. Every sound word can also be tapped, so it works however you read.

YOUR KIDS ARE IN IT
Add your kids once and the stories star them, by name. Siblings get roles that fit who they are, with the oldest leading the way.

MORE THAN TURNING PAGES
Blow the crumbs off the page. Wipe the snow off the window. Lean the phone to steer a sled down the mountain. Small moments that pull everyone in.

FIELD NOTES FROM REAL PLACES
Every expedition is set somewhere real, and comes with Field Notes: the facts, animals and places behind the story, for the questions that come after lights out.

A DAD JOKE IN EVERY STORY
Each expedition hides a groan-worthy joke. Find it, and it's added to your collection. Read again for more.

HOW IT WORKS
• Expedition No. 1, Where the River Ends, is free. The whole story, not a preview.
• Season One brings expeditions 2–5, one each month, starting with Below the Roar.
• The Lifetime Pass includes every season, forever.
• One-time purchases. No subscriptions. No ads.

Made for low-light bedrooms: dark, calm, and about ten to fifteen minutes a night.

name: Nostalji Radyo
description:
Nostalji Radyo brings the pocket radios, boomboxes and cassettes of the 1980s to the 2000s to your screen. Pick a radio: its keys, knobs and thumbwheels really work.

15 RADIO DESIGNS
Auto-scan pocket radio, mixtape cassette, leather-cased transistor radio, hi-fi system, world receiver, boombox, car cassette stereo, portable cassette player, clock radio and more. Each one with its own buttons, its own glow, its own sound.

50,000+ LIVE STATIONS
Pick a country and its most-listened stations line up on your dial. More than 50,000 radio stations from around the world. Search by name, or browse by category and city.

DISCOVER
A surprise station every time. Love it? Add it to your favorites. Not your thing? Spin again.

FAVORITES AND PRESETS
Your favorite stations sit at the front of the dial. Press and hold a preset key to save, tap it to play.

SLEEP TIMER AND RADIO ALARM
When your timer runs out, the radio gently fades out and switches off. In the morning, it wakes you with the station of your choice.

LOCK SCREEN AND DYNAMIC ISLAND
The station that's playing shows on your Lock Screen, where previous, next and stop work too.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS
No personal data is collected. Your favorites stay on your device only.

The station list comes from the open Radio Browser database. Streams play directly from each station's own servers.

name: Notch: Hypertrophy Tracker
description:
Most training apps are a notebook. You write down what you did, and next week you decide what to do — usually the same thing again.

Notch decides for you. Open it and today's session is already filled in: the weights, the rep targets, the reps you should leave in reserve. Every number is built from what you actually lifted last time, so the plan moves when you move.

WHAT IT DOES

• Tells you what to lift today, set by set, from your own history
• Never asks for less work than your last session
• Logs load, reps and reps-in-reserve in two taps
• Rest timer on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Counts your weekly sets per muscle and says when that's too few or too many

WORKS WITH APPLE HEALTH

Your scale writes your weight. MyFitnessPal writes your calories and macros. Notch reads both out of Apple Health, so nothing gets logged twice.

It then works out what your body actually burns — your own food against your own scale, measured over 28 days — rather than guessing from a formula with your height in it.

PROGRAMS

Six programs, from two days a week to six. Each one is audited against the volume it really delivers, so you can pick by the number of days you'll genuinely turn up for.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT

No account and no sign-up. Notch makes no network connections at all — your training, your weight and your progress photos never leave your phone.

name: Nove: Add an Item
description: Add items to your clients’ recommendations on Nove in a tap. Shop the web in Safari, and when you find something perfect for a client, save it straight to their recommendations. No copying links, no screenshots, no re-entering details.

name: NumberPath by NOTI
description: NumberPath는 숫자를 순서대로 연결해 하나의 경로를 완성하는 오프라인 퍼즐입니다.- 1부터 마지막 숫자까지 상하좌우로 연결- 5개 챕터, 총 50단계- 단계가 진행될수록 커지는 보드와 줄어드는 안내 숫자- 인터넷 연결, 계정, 광고 없이 플레이힌트를 따라 경로를 완성하고 모든 칸을 채워 보세요.채워 보세요.

name: NVECTA CDP Showcase
description:
Explore customer engagement with NVECTA CDP Showcase, an interactive companion for developers and business teams evaluating NVECTA’s iOS SDK. 

Experience engagement features on your device, explore personalization, and inspect SDK responses directly within the app. 

STAY CONNECTED 
Request push updates in different formats, explore the notification inbox, and view unread notification counts. 

IN-APP EXPERIENCES 
Explore in-app messages, surveys, walkthroughs, native displays and interactive nudges powered by NVECTA campaigns. 

CUSTOMER INSIGHTS 
Set global attributes, track events and screens, and create customer profiles using your own JSON inputs. 

PERSONALIZATION 
Use successfully submitted profile details to personalize supported in-app experiences. 

INSPECT AND COPY 
View SDK callback responses and copy JSON results, your subscription ID and your NVECTA user ID. 

Built for hands-on exploration of NVECTA’s mobile engagement capabilities. An internet connection is required for connected features. Push notifications require notification permission, and available experiences depend on campaign configuration.

name: Nyimbo za Wokovu – NZW
description:
NYIMBO ZA WOKOVU — Recueil complet de chants
Lisez, recherchez et méditez les chants de votre recueil où que vous soyez, même sans connexion Internet.

335 NYIMBO COMPLÈTES
Toutes les strophes sont embarquées localement, avec auteurs et références des recueils sources.

VIKUNDI (ZANA)
Chants classés par thème (21 catégories, tri alphabétique).

TAFUTA
Recherche par titre ou par numéro ; table alphabétique de A à Z.

VIPENDWA
Favoris d’un tap sur le cœur pendant la lecture.

HISTORIA YA KUSOMA
Reprendre vos lectures récentes ; suppression ciblée ou totale.

MUONEKANO
Mode sombre, clair ou automatique ; taille du texte réglable.

WIMBO WA SIKU
Un chant par jour sur l’accueil, et une notification locale chaque matin à 7 h ; un tap ouvre le chant. Un bouton affiche un autre chant sans remplacer celui du jour.

SHIRIKI NA NAKILI
Partagez ou copiez le wimbo entier.

SKRINI IENDELEE KUWAKA
Option pour garder l’écran allumé pendant la lecture.

HORS LIGNE ET SANS PUBLICITÉ
Aucun compte ni connexion n’est requis.

FONCTIONNALITÉS :
- 335 nyimbo hors ligne, avec auteurs et références
- Accueil : Wimbo wa siku, Nyimbo Zote, reprise de lecture, Zana
- Recherche alphabétique et par numéro
- Vipendwa, historia, vikundi
- Baraka, Bonus, Vifupisho
- Partage et copie du chant
- Thème sombre, clair ou système
- Notification « Wimbo wa siku » à 7 h (facultative)
- Taille de police réglable
- Aucune publicité, aucun abonnement, aucun compte

« Mwimbieni Bwana wimbo jipya; mwimbieni Bwana, nchi yote. » — Zaburi 96:1

Langue de l’interface : Kiswahili. Compatibilité : iPhone et iPad (iOS 17 ou plus récent).

name: Oak Calc: Construction Calc
description:
A construction calculator that speaks feet, inches and fractions.

Oak Calc is built for the way lengths are actually called out on a job: 12 feet 7 and 3/8 inches, not a decimal you have to convert in your head. Every length answer is drawn on a tape measure so you can find the mark fast. The full calculator is free, with no limits and no account.

FREE FOREVER
• Feet-inch-fraction entry, with precisions from 1/2" down to 1/128", plus metric
• Fast fraction keys: type 7, tap /16
• Trig keys (sin, cos, tan and their inverses), D°M′S″ angles and π
• Rise, Run, Pitch and Diagonal keys: enter any two, and the others fill in
• A running tape with totals, a Quick List of your go-to sizes, and memory
• Diagonal & Squaring, Area, Volume, Room (length × width × height) and a Length Converter
• When a length isn't exactly on a mark, the display says so
• Press and hold any key for help, or search the built-in guide. It works offline.

OAK CALC PRO: PAY ONCE. NO SUBSCRIPTION, EVER.
• Framing: stairs with stairwell opening and headroom, studs and plates, rake and arched walls, board feet
• Roof: common rafter length and cuts, hip and valley, irregular hips with both jack differences, pitch conversions and roofing squares
• Concrete & masonry: slabs, footings and columns, block walls with mortar and core fill, and material weight
• Finishes & outdoor: drywall and sheets, siding, paint, flooring, decking and fencing, with optional costs
• Trim: miter and crown settings, compound miters, polygons, and arc and radius layout
• Saved jobs with notes and photos that stay on your device, shared as a PDF

Oak Calc Pro is a single $14.99 purchase (US price), not a subscription. Family Sharing is supported, and Restore Purchases brings Pro back on a new device.

RESULTS ARE ESTIMATES FOR PLANNING
Always verify measurements on the job and check local building codes. Oak Calc does not replace a licensed design or a tape on site.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No analytics. Your calculations, notes and job photos stay on your device. Oak Calc does not use the network, except to talk to Apple when you buy or restore Pro. Apple's privacy nutrition label is Data Not Collected.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://oaklinemediaapps.com/oak-calc-privacy.html

name: Oak Clean: Storage Cleaner
description:
A careful, on-device cleaner for Photos and Contacts.

Oak Clean finds duplicates, similar shots, screenshots, selfies, GIFs, blurry photos, bursts, Live Photos, large and similar videos, and contacts that share a phone number or email. You review every change. Everything stays on this iPhone or iPad.

It cannot clear iOS system files, other apps, or caches, and it cannot make your iPhone run faster.

FREE FOREVER
• Scan your Photos library on this device
• A storage overview of how much Photos is using
• Preview groups, keep the sharpest shot, and leave favorites unselected
• Mark a photo Keep so it stays out of the suggested list
• Build a review list before anything is removed
• Find contacts that share a phone number or email, and cards that are missing a name or a way to reach someone
• Save a vCard of contacts before you merge or delete

OAK CLEAN PRO: PAY ONCE. NO SUBSCRIPTION, EVER.
• Delete photos and videos you have reviewed. Deletions use the system Photos confirmation and go to Recently Deleted for 30 days
• Compress videos by saving a smaller copy, then moving the original to Recently Deleted. Quality is reduced
• Turn Live Photos into stills and move the Live Photo, including its short video, to Recently Deleted
• Merge or delete duplicate contacts, and review incomplete cards. Contact changes are immediate

Oak Clean Pro is a single $14.99 purchase (US price), not a subscription. Family Sharing is supported, and Restore Purchases brings Pro back on a new device.

ABOUT DELETED SPACE
Deleting a photo or video moves it to Recently Deleted in the Photos app. It still uses space until you remove it there, or after 30 days.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No analytics. Photos and contacts stay on your device. Oak Clean does not use the network, except to talk to Apple when you buy or restore Pro. Apple's privacy nutrition label is Data Not Collected.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://oaklinemediaapps.com/oak-clean-privacy.html

name: Odatim
description:
Odatim — odatlar, maqsadlar va moliyani bitta ilovada boshqarish uchun o'zbekcha ilova. Har kuni kichik qadam tashlang, natijani o'zingiz ko'rasiz.

ODATLAR
• Odatni bir bosishda belgilang — ketma-ketlik (streak) va XP o'sib boradi
• Har kuni yoki haftaning tanlangan kunlarida, kerak bo'lsa kuniga bir necha marta — o'zingizga qulay jadval
• Eslatmalar: kerakli vaqtda bildirishnoma keladi
• Statistika va kalendar: qaysi kunlar bajarildi, qayerda uzildi
• Yutuqlar, darajalar va reyting

MOLIYA
• Kirim va chiqimlarni tez yozing, toifalar bo'yicha ko'ring
• Oylik hisobot va byudjet
• Bir nechta valyuta, kurs O'zbekiston Markaziy banki bo'yicha

KITOB VA QUR'ON
• O'qigan betlaringizni qayd eting, katta kitoblar katalogi
• Qur'on hifzi: oyatma-oyat yodlash darslari va reja
• Namoz vaqtlari, namoz treker va qazo hisoblagichi

VAZIFALAR
• Kunlik vazifalar rejasi — odatlar bilan bir joyda

WEB VA TELEGRAM BILAN BIR XIL HISOB
Telegram, Apple yoki Google orqali kiring. odatim.uz sayti va Telegram bot bilan bir xil hisob — ma'lumotlaringiz hamma joyda sinxron.

Savol va takliflar uchun: odatim.uz

name: Office Guard Vault
description:
Protect the Documents.

Office Guard Vault keeps important documents stored in one place.

For families
- Keep your family's important documents on your phone.
- The Family plan includes up to 5 people.

For real estate agents with Office Guard Realty
- Keep each deal's documents in its own workspace.
- Invite the other people on the deal and choose what each can do.
- Compare a revised contract with the last version.
- Archive a closed deal to lock its records.

On your phone
- Sign in with a code we email you. Then open Vault with Face ID.
- Add documents from your camera, files or photos.
- Save to Vault from the Share button.
- Earlier versions of each document are kept.

Plans
Vault Individual and Vault Family, monthly or annual. Start with a 7-day free week.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings. If you cancel during the free week, you are not charged.

Privacy policy: https://officeguardvault.com/privacy/
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Terms of service: https://officeguard.co/terms

name: OGCIFlow
description:
OGCIFlow features a clear layout and an orderly interface.
The entries are concise and straightforward, facilitating quick creation, which can be read at a glance and easily retrieved again. The required content can be obtained with just a single click, and there are no screen requirements that exceed the information provided.
A quiet interface that responds identically each time it is opened.

name: Ondahertz
description:
Ondahertz is a sound app. You pick a mix, set a length, and listen. Nothing is hidden behind a login.

WHAT PLAYS
- Binaural tones. Two slightly different tones, one in each ear. Use headphones.
- Ambience. Recordings of rain, ocean, stream, thunder, wind, forest birds, crickets and a fireplace, plus soft synthesised noise.
- Mixes for the moments people ask for: sleep, calm, focus, energy, rest, and more. Each mix is a tone and an ambience together, and you can change the levels.
- Guided sound practices: Hum, Six breaths, Drum journey, Bowl meditation, Water and forest, AUM in four parts, Six sounds, One note, one breath, Bell series and Planet tones. Each one tells you the steps before you start.

HOW IT WORKS
- Type how you want to feel, in your own words, and Ondahertz suggests a mix. What you type is read on your device and is not stored or sent.
- Pick a length, or play until you stop. A sleep fade lowers the sound gently near the end.
- Save the mixes you like on your device.
- Sound keeps playing with the screen locked, and the lock screen shows controls.
- Everything plays with no connection. The recordings and the practice scripts are inside the app.

IN THE APP
- Shortcuts. Ask Siri, or add a Shortcut, to open Ondahertz on a sleep, calm or focus mix.
- A notice when a timed session has ended while the app was in the background. Ondahertz asks permission the first time you start a timed session, and you can say no.

EVIDENCE LABELS, PLAINLY
Every mix and practice carries one label, always visible:
- Research-informed: small human studies or reviews support the idea behind it. Effects are modest.
- Mixed evidence: some trials, but weak, contradictory or indirect.
- Tradition: a cultural or personal practice. It is shown with the words "Not supported by clinical evidence".
Tap a label to read why it was given.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Ondahertz is not a medical device and is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any disease or condition. It does not replace care from a professional.
- Keep the volume comfortable. Do not use it while driving or operating machinery.
- If something feels uncomfortable, stop the sound.

PLANS
Ondahertz is free to use, with a handful of mixes, a few ambiences and short sessions. Plans unlock everything: all mixes, practices, long and sleep sessions, and saved mixes. Choose Monthly or Yearly (the first week of Yearly is free when you are eligible) or buy Lifetime once. Payment is charged to your Apple ID, and Monthly and Yearly renew automatically until you cancel in your Apple ID subscription settings. Prices are shown in the app in your currency. Terms: https://ondahertz.com/terms. Privacy: https://ondahertz.com/privacy.

An account is optional. It lets a plan follow you across devices and signs in with an emailed link, so there is no password. Saved mixes stay on your device.

Questions: https://ondahertz.com/support

name: OneFlow – Quản lý kho
description:
OneFlow là ứng dụng vận hành kho dành cho nhân viên kho, đóng gói và giao hàng của doanh nghiệp đang dùng hệ thống quản lý OneFlow. Mọi thao tác quét mã, lên kệ, nhặt hàng và kiểm hàng làm ngay trên iPhone, số liệu cập nhật tức thời về hệ thống chung của công ty.

QUẢN LÝ KHO
• Quét nhận hàng: nhận hàng theo phiếu nhập hoặc đơn mua, chụp ảnh chứng từ, đưa thẳng lên kệ.
• Quét lên kệ / xuống kệ / chuyển kệ: quét mã vị trí và mã sản phẩm, hệ thống tự ghi sổ vị trí.
• Bổ sung kệ và Sắp vị trí: biết kệ nào sắp hết, đưa hàng từ kho chứa lên kệ nhặt.
• Thùng hàng: quét mã thùng để cho hàng vào thùng, lấy hàng ra thùng và đưa lên kệ.
• Kiểm kho nhanh: đếm lại một kệ hay một mã hàng trong vài giây.
• Nhập kho / Xuất kho thủ công: lập phiếu ngay tại kho, không cần máy tính.
• Truy vấn tồn kho: quét một mã để biết tồn từng kệ, từng thùng, hàng chưa lên kệ.

QUẢN LÝ ĐƠN HÀNG
• Danh sách đơn hàng: tìm theo mã đơn, mã vận đơn, xem chi tiết người nhận và sản phẩm.
• Wave Picking: nhặt hàng theo đợt cho nhiều đơn cùng lúc, chỉ đường theo kệ, báo thiếu hàng ngay khi nhặt.
• Phân loại lần hai: chia hàng đã nhặt về đúng từng đơn.
• Kiểm kệ: đếm lại kệ khi người nhặt báo thiếu hàng.
• Quét kiểm tra đơn, quét kiểm hàng, quét giao hàng: đối chiếu đúng hàng – đúng đơn trước khi bàn giao cho đơn vị vận chuyển.
• Quét nhận đơn hoàn và Nhập hàng hoàn: nhận kiện hoàn bằng mã vận đơn, đưa hàng hoàn trở lại kệ.
• Tạo đơn thủ công cho khách lẻ, khách sỉ.

GIAO HÀNG
• Nhận bàn giao, xác nhận giao thành công hoặc không thành công, chụp ảnh làm bằng chứng.

BÁO CÁO
• Doanh số trong ngày, báo cáo gian hàng, báo cáo đơn hàng, báo cáo doanh số, chi phí quảng cáo — xem nhanh trên điện thoại.

VÌ SAO DÙNG ONEFLOW
• Quét mã vạch và mã QR bằng camera iPhone, không cần máy quét riêng (vẫn dùng được máy quét cầm tay kết nối Bluetooth dạng bàn phím).
• Phân quyền theo vai trò: mỗi nhân viên chỉ thấy đúng phần việc được giao.
• Một tài khoản dùng được nhiều workspace, chuyển workspace ngay trong ứng dụng.
• Kết nối mã hoá HTTPS, chống ghi trùng khi mạng chập chờn.

LƯU Ý
OneFlow dành cho doanh nghiệp. Tài khoản do quản trị viên của công ty bạn cấp trên hệ thống OneFlow; ứng dụng không cho tự đăng ký. Nếu chưa có tài khoản, hãy liên hệ người quản lý kho hoặc quản trị viên của công ty.

name: Oozy Blocks!
description:
Oozy Blocks! is an offline block puzzle on a 9 × 9 grid. Drag colorful jelly shapes onto the board, fill rows or columns to clear space, and see how high you can score.

Place the three available shapes in any order. Make room for the next set and keep your run going as long as you can.

• Clear rows and columns by filling every space.
• Beat your personal best and try a new strategy.
• Play offline and resume your saved run anytime.
• Adjust sound effects and haptics in Settings.

No account required. No ads or in-app purchases in version 1.0.

name: OPEN MD צופה קבצי Markdown
description:
OPEN MD פותחת קבצי Markdown בטלפון ומציגה אותם כמסמך מסודר וקריא, עם עברית מלאה מימין לשמאל

קבצי Markdown הם קבצי טקסט עם הסיומת md, הפורמט שבו נכתבים מסמכי עבודה, סיכומים, תיעוד ורשימות משימות. בטלפון הם נפתחים בדרך כלל כטקסט גולמי מלא בסימנים, וכאן הם נראים כמו מסמך

איך זה עובד
בוחרים תיקיית עבודה פעם אחת, והאפליקציה מציגה את כל קבצי ה-MD שבה ואת תתי התיקיות, עם חיפוש לפי שם בתוך התיקייה. התיקייה נשמרת, ובפתיחה הבאה היא כבר מחכה לכם. אפשר גם לפתוח קובץ בודד, ואפשר לשלוח קובץ md מתפריט השיתוף של אפליקציה אחרת, והוא ייפתח כאן מיד. הבחירה נעשית בבורר הקבצים של המכשיר, כולל קבצים ששמורים בענן

תצוגה עברית אמיתית
כותרות, פסקאות, רשימות, רשימות משימות, טבלאות וציטוטים מיושרים לפי כיוון הקריאה של כל בלוק בנפרד, ולכן מסמך שמשלב עברית ואנגלית נשאר קריא. מילה באנגלית בתוך כותרת עברית אינה הופכת את הכותרת, ובלוקי קוד נשארים משמאל לימין כמו בעורך

נוח לקריאה בטלפון
כפתורי הגדלה והקטנה של הטקסט, גודל שנשמר בין הפעלות, הגדלה בצביטה ומצב כהה לפי הגדרת המכשיר. טבלה רחבה נגללת הצידה בתוך עצמה בלי לשבור את המסמך, ותמונה שמופיעה במסמך בנתיב יחסי נטענת מתוך התיקייה שבחרתם

פרטיות
האפליקציה עובדת במכשיר בלבד. אין חשבון, אין פרסומות, אין איסוף מידע ואין שליחת תוכן לשרת כלשהו. לאפליקציה יש גישה רק לקובץ או לתיקייה שבחרתם בעצמכם

פורמטים נתמכים
md, markdown, mdown, mkd

name: Open Media App
description:
Open Media is a free social app for sharing photos and videos with the people you follow.

WHAT IT DOES
• Post up to 10 photos or videos at once, with a caption and alt text
• See your feed in For you and Following, and like or save posts
• Search posts and tags
• Keep drafts and schedule posts on a calendar
• Share from any app straight into a draft, or start one from the home screen widget or Shortcuts
• Preview Collabs, the upcoming marketplace for creators and brands (labelled examples only for now; nothing is sold yet)
• See simple insights for your own posts

WHY IT IS BETTER
Everything is free for everyone, with no paywalls and no in-app purchases.

WHAT THE AI DOES FOR YOU
AI works for you, never against you. Open Media never scans your face or rates your looks. AI features appear only when they are ready and switched on.

WHY YOU CAN TRUST IT
A native iPhone and iPad app. Analytics stay off unless you turn them on in Settings. Sign in with a link sent to your email. Report any post or account and block anyone in two taps; you can delete your account in Settings at any time.

The Agentic Era Has Arrived.

Help: https://openmedia.fun/help · Privacy: https://openmedia.fun/privacy

name: OrolBioGIS — SMART monitoring
description:
OrolBioGIS — геоинформационная система мониторинга биологического разнообразия Южного Приаралья (Каракалпакстан, Узбекистан). Это полевой дневник для научных сотрудников и инспекторов охраняемых природных территорий.

Возможности:
• Систематический каталог видов — млекопитающие, птицы, пресмыкающиеся, растения — с описаниями и полевыми фотографиями
• Формы полевых наблюдений: животные и птицы, гнёзда, следы, погода, растительность
• GPS-координаты места наблюдения и направление движения животного по компасу
• Фото, видео и запись голосов птиц и животных прямо в запись наблюдения
• ГИС-карта со спутниковым слоем и границами охраняемых участков
• Статистика и отчёты по наблюдениям
• Работа без интернета: записи хранятся на телефоне и отправляются на сервер, когда появляется связь
• Интерфейс на узбекском и каракалпакском языках

Учётные записи выдаёт администрация охраняемой территории. Без входа можно пользоваться каталогом, картой, библиотекой и формами наблюдений — записи при этом остаются только на телефоне.

—

OrolBioGIS — Janubiy Orolbo‘yi biologik xilma-xilligi monitoringining geoinformatsion tizimi. Ilmiy xodimlar va qo‘riqlanadigan hududlar inspektorlari uchun dala kundaligi: turlar katalogi, kuzatuv shakllari (hayvon va qush, uya, iz, ob-havo, o‘simlik), GPS va kompas, foto, video va ovoz yozish, sputnik xarita, statistika. Internetsiz ishlaydi, aloqa paydo bo‘lganda ma’lumotlarni serverga yuboradi. Interfeys: o‘zbek va qoraqalpoq tillari.

name: Orthodox Icons: Home Widgets
description:
Keep Orthodox iconography close, with a quiet place on your Home Screen.

Choose from 145 historic icons from the Russian Orthodox tradition and its Byzantine roots. Browse icons of Christ, the Theotokos, Pascha and the Great Feasts, and saints including Saint Basil the Great.

TWO WAYS TO KEEP AN ICON CLOSE
• Daily Rotation changes the image using the groups and individual icons you choose.
• Custom Icon keeps one chosen icon fixed. Add it alongside a rotating widget.
• Small and large widgets fill their frame with artwork. Wide widgets place the icon beside its title.
• Hold a widget to change its own options. English and Russian titles are available, and square-widget titles are hidden by default.

YOUR OWN COLLECTION
Save favorites, exclude images from automatic rotation, or import an image privately and adjust its square crop. Private imports stay on your device unless you explicitly submit one for the creator to review. Community contributions appear only after approval. The bundled collection and saved icons work offline.

FREE TO USE, OPTIONAL TO SUPPORT
All icon images and basic widgets are free. Optional monthly or annual creator-support subscriptions help maintain the app and provide Parchment and Midnight wide-widget panels while active. Prices are shown by your store before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled through your store account.

No ads. No account is needed for browsing, widgets or private imports. Basic usage counts are optional and off by default; icon choices, favorites, searches and religious preferences are not sent as analytics.

This is an independent app and does not claim church endorsement. Rotation follows your choices; it is not a liturgical calendar.

Privacy: https://us-central1-karalewich.cloudfunctions.net/orthodoxIconsLegal/privacy
Terms of support: https://us-central1-karalewich.cloudfunctions.net/orthodoxIconsLegal/terms

name: Otayori Planner: School Notice
description:
Photograph a school notice, get calendar events.

Otayori Planner reads Japanese school and nursery notices (class newsletters, event letters, fee notices, lunch menus) with AI and turns the dated items into events in your iPhone calendar.

What it reads
- Events and start times (open classes, parent meetings, trips, performances, ceremonies)
- Things to bring and the day to bring them
- Submission deadlines
- Payments and account debits, with amounts
- Schedule changes (postponements, class closures, days off, no school lunch)

Check before adding
Items appear as a checklist. Compare dates with the notice, fix anything by tapping, and add only what you need.

Reminders
Each item gets an alert the evening before (20:00) and the morning of (7:00). Times can be changed. Items go into a separate calendar named "おたより予定帳" that you can share or hide.

Several children
Add each child's school, grade and class, and the app labels which child a notice is for.

Archive and search
Notices are kept with their photos and can be searched. Multi-page notices, photos from your library and PDFs are supported.

Price
- AI reading: the first 10 pages are free.
- "Premium (1,200 AI pages)" is a single purchase. AI reading is limited to 1,200 pages in total; they are used up as you read (no expiry).
- When they run out, buy "1,000 More AI Pages".
- Calendar items and alerts, manual items, saving and search work regardless of pages.
- No subscription. Premium supports Family Sharing.
- To prevent abuse, AI reading is limited to 300 pages a month.

Privacy
- When reading, the notice photos and the children's labels and grades you entered are sent to AI (Claude by Anthropic).
- The app's server does not store photos. Anthropic may keep them for up to 30 days for abuse prevention and does not use them to train AI.
- Photos and results are stored only on this iPhone. No account, no ads, no analytics.

AI can make mistakes. Check dates against the notice before adding.

name: Otter Tower
description:
Stack things on a sleeping otter — without waking him up!

Pinch an item, lower it gently, and let go. Easy… until you're a little too rough and he wakes up.
Wake him and he WILL complain — fully voiced in Kansai-dialect Japanese, with English subtitles.

HOW TO PLAY
• Pinch an item from the top board and lower it gently onto the otter
• When the sleep gauge hits 0, he wakes up and it's game over
• Stack higher, use his head, go right to the edge — the riskier, the more points

FEVER TIME
• Stack 5 of the same item in a column: Super Nap — 10 seconds where nothing wakes him, score ×3
• Stack the 3 Bingo items: Whale Time — 15 seconds of score ×5, plus 1,000 bonus points!

EVERYTHING WANTS TO WAKE HIM
• Kids shouting "Hey, Otter-kun!" — hit "Shh!" at the right moment
• Wind — tap the fan to block it
• Sneezes, hot sun, a crying baby otter, Mama otter…
• Trash goes in the bin. Whales go back to the sea!

PICK YOUR FINGERS
Short, normal, nails or claws — each has its own strength and weakness.

WORLD RANKING
Compete for the high score with players around the world on Game Center.

name: PadLink
description:
PadLink extends a Mac desktop to a compatible iPad over a USB data cable. It requires the separately distributed Mac companion and an Apple silicon Mac. No PadLink login, purchase, or subscription is required. Launch is free in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, and New Zealand. The app's functionality is the same in these five storefronts.

Notarized Mac companion download: https://padlink-support.lucidglobe5.chatgpt.site/downloads/PadLinkMac-1.0.0-10.zip
Mac installation and checksum: https://padlink-support.lucidglobe5.chatgpt.site/support/#download
Physical-device demonstration video: PENDING ATTACHMENT — PadLink-hardware-demo-build10.mp4 (85 seconds, silent). Shows the physical Mac and iPad, USB cable connection, pairing, moving windows between screens, closing/reopening the Mac dashboard, the native motion test, and disconnection. Approximate timestamps: pairing 00:00–00:27, desktop interaction 00:31–00:47, menu-bar reopening 00:49–00:55, motion test 01:01–01:09, disconnect 01:18–01:20.
Support: https://padlink-support.lucidglobe5.chatgpt.site/support/
Privacy: https://padlink-support.lucidglobe5.chatgpt.site/privacy/

Review setup
1. Install the compatible notarized Mac companion in Applications. Connect the iPad with a USB data cable, unlock it, and trust the Mac if requested.
2. Open PadLink on the iPad, full screen in landscape, and tap Start receiver.
3. Select the USB device in PadLinkMac, enter the current six-digit code shown on the iPad, and click Connect. Grant Mac Screen Recording permission when requested; reopen the Mac app if macOS asks. The code expires after five minutes, so use a fresh code if needed.
4. Arrange the extended display in macOS System Settings > Displays. Move an ordinary window onto the iPad and use the Mac keyboard and mouse.
5. Run motion test provides a continuously animated example. Close test returns to normal desktop use. Frame-rate measurements reflect activity and are not a guarantee of sustained 120 fps.
6. Close the Mac dashboard with its red button, then reopen it using the PadLink menu-bar icon. The session remains available. Open iPad Notification Center for 20 seconds and dismiss it; pairing should be preserved.
7. Tap Disconnect on the iPad or choose Disconnect on the Mac to end the session and remove the virtual display. Normal Mac sleep is permitted; after waking, return to PadLink on the unlocked iPad to resume. Force-quitting either app requires a new pairing.

The iPad app uses public frameworks and does not include the Mac adapter. The separately distributed Mac companion uses an undocumented CoreGraphics virtual-display interface and is not submitted to the Mac App Store. The iPad listens on loopback through the Mac's USB service, with no LAN listener or cloud relay.

Build 10 uses the iPad’s native landscape resolution, requesting up to 120 Hz on supported iPads and 60 Hz on others. Hardware HEVC decoding and Metal are required. Resolution is never downscaled. Physical test coverage is stated below.

Physically tested with an M5 Max Mac on macOS 27.2.1 and an 11-inch M4 iPad Pro (iPadOS 27.2.1). Build 1.0.0 (10) was installed through TestFlight and paired with the signed/notarized Mac build 10. Verified streaming at native 2420 × 1668, Notification Center recovery and Mac sleep/wake recovery without a new pairing code. A 30-minute motion run maintained continuous native streaming, with no source drops and Nominal thermals; presentation averaged about 97 fps. Actual frame rate varies; 120 fps is not guaranteed. No other physical iPad model has been verified.

Support contact: padlink.support@gmail.com.

name: Paksuusmittari
description: Paksuusmittari on ultraäänen ja pinnoitteen paksuuden mittaussovellus. Se laskee materiaalin paksuuden ultraäänen kulkunopeudesta, tunnistaa kaiun, huomioi pinnoitteen ja kalibroinnin sekä pinnan esikäsittelyn. Anturin asetuksia ja äänen nopeutta säädetään liukusäätimillä, ja tulokset voi tallentaa ja viedä mittaustiedostona. Pro-versio avataan kertamaksulla ilman mainoksia tai tilausta.

name: Palette Fieldbook: Color Notes
description:
Collect colors from photos and keep the ideas behind them. Choose PNG, JPEG or HEIC images from Files, extract up to five representative colors, or select a point in the working image yourself. Read HEX and RGB codes, edit or lock colors, and add a palette name and purpose note.

Compare text and background combinations with a numeric contrast ratio. Save palettes locally, undo edits and reopen your work later. Preview and share a PNG sheet or an A4 PDF with the photo, swatches, codes and note. Longer PDF names and notes continue onto additional pages. Choose a destination in the iOS share sheet.

Create a JSON backup including your original photos and saved work. Restoring replaces the current local fieldbook after confirmation. Deleting local work does not delete original photos chosen outside the app or copies already shared.

Colors come from a reduced-size sRGB working image and may differ from the original photo, your display or a physical material. Contrast values describe the selected text/background pair; they do not certify the accessibility of an entire design.

Paid download with no in-app purchases, subscription, account or advertising. Photo processing and fieldbook storage stay on your device. Your original photo files remain unchanged.

name: Paper - 개발자가 화나서 만든 PDF
description:
광고 없음. 완전 무료. 결제 유도 없음.
광고로 도배된 문서 뷰어들에 화가 나서 직접 만들었습니다.

■ PDF
· 펜·형광펜·지우개로 필기하고 실행취소
· 페이지 회전·삭제·순서 바꾸기(썸네일 길게 눌러 드래그)
· 확대·축소, 야간 모드
· 원본 텍스트와 벡터를 그대로 두고 편집 내용만 덧입혀 저장

■ 워드(DOCX)
· 문단 단위로 글 고치기, 굵게·기울임 같은 서식 유지
· 그림·링크가 있는 문단은 서식이 깨지지 않게 보호

■ 엑셀(XLSX)
· 여러 시트 보기, 셀 값 바로 고치기
· 01012345678 같은 앞자리 0도 그대로 유지

■ 그 밖에
· 파워포인트(PPTX) 텍스트 보기, 텍스트·CSV·마크다운 편집, 이미지 보기
· 파일 앱이나 다른 앱의 공유 메뉴에서 바로 열기
· 파일 앱의 Paper 폴더 문서를 한눈에 모아 보기
· 아이폰과 아이패드 모두 지원

■ 개인정보
아무것도 수집하지 않습니다. 광고·분석 도구·계정·서버가 없고, 문서는 기기 안에서만 처리됩니다.

name: Paper Path: Number Puzzle
description:
Draw one line. Pass the numbers in order. Fill every square.

Paper Path is a calm number puzzle made to look like cut paper. You start at 1, follow the numbers in order and find the path that covers the whole board. You know how to play after ten seconds. Getting all three stars takes a little longer.

HOW IT WORKS
• Put your finger on the 1 and draw your line.
• Pass 2, 3, 4 and so on in order. How you get from one to the next is up to you.
• The level is solved when the line ends on the last number and no square is left empty.
• The clock runs while you think. Finish quickly and you keep all three stars. A hint costs ten seconds.

SIX WORLDS, CUT FROM PAPER
72 levels lead from 4×4 warm-ups to 8×8 boards with paper walls in the way. Travel through Meadow Vale, the Lagoon, Blossom Grove, the Sea of Dunes, Cloud Peaks and the Moonlit Night. The stars you collect open the next world.

FREE TO PLAY, AND FAIR ABOUT IT
• No ad breaks in the first world.
• Videos only when you want one: watch a short video for a free hint, or to open the next world when you are up to three stars short.
• From the second world on, an ad break may appear after every third level at the earliest, and never twice within two minutes.
• One purchase removes the ad breaks for good. No subscription. You also get a free hint in every level.

NO ACCOUNT, NO CLOUD
There is nothing to sign up for. Your progress stays on your iPhone.

Paper Path is available in English and German.

name: PAT Test Certificate by Boluga
description:
PAT Test Certificate is the PAT testing app for electricians and PAT test engineers in the UK. Record every appliance on site, print a label for each one, and send your customer a clear, professional PAT certificate before you leave.

TEST ON SITE, EVEN WITH NO SIGNAL
• Works fully offline. Everything saves as you type, so nothing is lost if your phone rings or the app is closed.
• Add appliances fast: scan a label's QR code or barcode, or repeat the last item's details with one tap.
• Record the visual inspection, earth bond and insulation readings exactly as your tester shows them, and mark each item pass or fail. You make the call; the app records it.
• Failed items get their own reason and notes, and a separate failed-items report.

PAT LABELS FOR EVERY APPLIANCE
• Print pass and fail labels to supported Bluetooth and Wi-Fi label printers, with the asset number, test date, next test date, your initials and a QR code.
• No printer? Print a sheet of labels from a PDF instead.

CERTIFICATES YOUR CUSTOMERS CAN READ
• A clean PAT certificate, an asset register and a failed-items report as PDFs, with your company details and logo.
• Your customer signs on screen. Share or email the certificate straight from the job.
• Next test dates are worked out for you.

YOUR WHOLE TEAM, ON EVERY DEVICE
• iPhone and iPad, with jobs and certificates kept in sync for every engineer in your company.
• A web dashboard for the office at pat.boluga.com: customers, sites, jobs, certificates and your account.

SUBSCRIPTION
PAT Test Certificate Pro unlocks issuing certificates, printing labels and syncing. Choose monthly or yearly, each with a 14-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the trial ends, and the subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://boluga.com/pat/privacy/

name: PAUSLY: Pause the Urge
description:
Every purchase deserves a second thought.

You know the feeling: that item sitting in your cart — or in your head — for days. You almost buy it. Then you hesitate.

PAUSLY turns that hesitation into a ritual. Before you buy, create a Pause and let a kind, honest community help you see clearly.

HOW IT WORKS
• Create a Pause — the item, the price, and the real reason you want it. Add a photo. Tell your story.
• The community shares anonymous perspectives — "Go for it" or "Hold off" — each with a thoughtful reason why
• Watch the perspectives come in, and see where the crowd leans
• Then decide. Because the final choice is always yours.

WHY PEOPLE LOVE IT
• Honest advice, zero pressure — voters are anonymous, so feedback is real, never people-pleasing
• A judgment-free space — respectful guidance only; this is support, not a lecture
• Private pauses — share your dilemma only with people you trust, via a private link
• Follow pauses that mirror your own temptations, and learn from the crowd
• The quiet confidence that comes from deciding with your eyes wide open

PAUSLY won't tell you what to buy. It gives you the pause you wish you'd taken.

Pause the urge. Choose with confidence.

name: PDFCove: Scanner & PDF Toolkit
description:
PDFCove turns paper, photos, and notes into PDFs, then helps you sort them out. Everything runs on your iPhone: no account, no uploads, no ads.

MAKE A PDF
• Write a note and save it as a PDF. Choose A4, US Letter, or A5.
• Turn photos into a PDF, one image per page. Pick from your library or use the photo picker.
• Scan paper with the camera. Line the page up in the frame, fix the corners, rotate it, and pick a filter: color, grayscale, black and white, or photo. Keep going for the next page.

ORGANIZE
• Merge PDFs. Tap the files in the order you want, then drag pages around or remove the ones you don't need.
• Split a PDF. Tap the pages you want and PDFCove saves them as a new file. The name shows the range, like "Report p3-5,9.pdf".
• Reordering pages saves a copy. Your original is never overwritten.

READ AND LISTEN
• Scan or import a photo and PDFCove reads the English text off it. Copy it anywhere, or save the images as a PDF.
• Read Aloud speaks any PDF a page at a time and highlights the sentence it's on. It keeps going with the screen locked, and you can skip sentences from the lock screen or your headphones. Change the speed or pick another voice.
• In the viewer: search inside the document, jump with page thumbnails, pinch to zoom, print, or share.

PRIVACY
• No account and no sign-in.
• Nothing you make or open is uploaded. Camera frames, photos, and PDFs stay on your iPhone unless you share them yourself.
• Delete a file and it's gone.

name: peilo - guess scale
description:
Peilo – size it by eye.

Every round shows you two things on squared paper. The one on the left is drawn to scale. The one on the right is not – yet: drag it with your finger to the size it would really have next to the other one, fine-tune it on the dial, then lock in your guess. The real size grows into the picture, and a scale shows at once how close you were.

How tall is a giraffe next to a door? How long is the Titanic next to the Great Pyramid? Sounds easy. Your eye will surprise you.

BY EYE, NOT BY NUMBERS
• No typing, no multiple choice: you size the thing itself
• Up to 100 points per round – the closer, the more
• Half as big and twice as big count as equally wrong
• Five rounds make a level, and 250 of 500 points pass it

319 THINGS, FROM A LADYBUG TO THE STARS
• Coins, balls, food and everyday objects
• Animals, instruments, vehicles and sports fields
• Paintings, towers, ships, rockets and mountains
• Islands, moons, planets and stars
• Every picture is drawn by the app itself

THE DAILY LEVEL
• One level a day, the same for everyone
• Five rounds, once through every size: from small to gigantic
• One try – then share your result without giving the answers away

CAMPAIGN
• 150 levels in five worlds: Small, Medium, Large, Huge and Gigantic
• Each world gets harder step by step
• Themes: everything from one field, such as sport, animals or music
• Chains: each target becomes the next reference
• A test after every ten levels
• 750 different pairs, up to three stars per level

FREE PLAY
• Pick a world, a kind and a difficulty
• A brand-new level every time, as many as you like

THE TAPE MEASURE
• Stuck? The tape measure shows the sizes in numbers while you drag
• It costs fire points and leaves one star at most

FIRE, STREAKS AND TROPHIES
• Earn fire points for a good eye
• Play every day and watch your flame grow through ten tiers
• Collect 48 trophies in iron, bronze, silver and gold – and find the hidden ones

MAKE IT YOURS
• Five color themes, from pastel to black & white to a dark red & black
• Meters or feet and inches
• English and German

No ads, no account, no data collection. Peilo works offline and everything stays on your device.

name: Peppe - Matese Makers
description:
P.e.p.p.e. (Pet Elettronico Parlante Programmabile ESP32) è il cagnolino robot open source del progetto didattico di Matese Makers. Questa app è il suo telecomando: lo configura, lo guida e gli dà la voce.

CONFIGURA IN POCHI PASSI
Accendi P.e.p.p.e., collegati al suo hotspot e scegli la rete Wi-Fi di casa: l'app gli passa le credenziali e lo ritrova da sola sulla rete.

PILOTA
Avanti, indietro e curve con la croce direzionale, più tredici comportamenti pronti: dai la zampa, inchino, sdraiati, dondola, salta, stiracchiati e altri.

VOCE
Scrivi una frase e P.e.p.p.e. la pronuncia con la sua voce. Le frasi recenti restano a portata di tocco per ripeterle.

MACRO
Componi sequenze di movimenti, comportamenti e pause, salvale e falle eseguire con un tocco: il primo passo per imparare a programmare.

CALIBRAZIONE
Dopo il montaggio allinea le quattro zampe con una procedura guidata, un grado alla volta.

NIENTE ACCOUNT, NIENTE TRACCIAMENTO
L'app parla direttamente con il robot sulla tua rete locale. Non richiede registrazione, non contiene pubblicità e non raccoglie dati personali.

Per usare l'app serve il robot P.e.p.p.e., basato sulla scheda ESP-HI di Espressif. Istruzioni, firmware e novità del progetto su peppe.matesemakers.it.

name: Petty Court: Couple Judge
description:
Who left the dishes to "soak"? Who ate the last dumpling? Stop arguing in circles and take it to court.

Petty Court is a funny judge for the small fights every couple has. Each of you tells your side, the judge weighs the evidence, and in seconds the court rules: one winner, one GUILTY stamp, and a petty sentence to match.

HOW A CASE WORKS
- Name the charge: "Who finished the ice cream?"
- Tell your side, and theirs as you heard it
- Add a screenshot as evidence if you have receipts
- Call the judge and watch the verdict land

LET THEM DEFEND THEMSELVES
Not fair hearing only one side? Send your partner a summons link. They read the charge and answer in their browser, no app needed, and the judge rules again with both stories.

KEEP SCORE FOREVER
Every ruling goes on the season scoreboard. See who is winning the relationship, case by case.

APPEAL TO THE HIGHER COURT
Think the judge got it wrong? File an appeal and three judges hear the case fresh. They might overturn it. They might make it worse.

SHARE THE VERDICT
Every ruling makes a share card, ready for the group chat.

ONLY FOR THE PETTY STUFF
The court rules on dishes, thermostats and texting back, not on anything serious. Serious topics are declined with a pointer to real help.

FREE TO START
One case a day is free. A single purchase of Lifetime court unlocks unlimited cases, free appeals and a sharper senior judge. No subscription. Single appeals are also available on their own.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://court.slidera.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://court.slidera.app/privacy

name: Pinggo: Who's On My WiFi
description:
Who's on your WiFi right now? Pinggo scans your home network and shows every phone, TV, camera, speaker and printer by name, so you can spot the one you don't recognize.

When a device drops off, Pinggo doesn't just say "offline". It checks your WiFi, router, internet and the maker's cloud service step by step, then tells you in plain English what went wrong and what to try.

Everything stays on your iPhone. No account. No ads. No tracking.

SEE EVERY DEVICE
• Scan your WiFi and see phones, tablets, TVs, cameras, speakers, consoles, printers and smart-home gear
• Devices are named from their own name, services and maker, not just an IP address
• Keep a separate device list for each WiFi network you use

SPOT UNKNOWN DEVICES
• Mark the devices that are yours; anything new lands in "Needs Your Attention"
• Get a notification when a new device joins or one of yours leaves
• See when each device was last online

FIX "WHY IS IT OFFLINE?"
