• Step-by-step diagnosis for any device that stopped responding
• Checks the router, internet, DNS and whether the maker's cloud service is reachable for 25 popular brands
• A clear cause and the fixes to try, written for people who aren't network experts

CHECK YOUR NETWORK
• One-tap network check: router, internet and DNS response
• Internet speed test with download, upload and ping, plus history and a trend chart
• Router security check and a finder for cameras connected to your WiFi
• Device security: flags risky open services such as Telnet or exposed admin pages
• Pro tools: Ping, Traceroute, DNS lookup and Port scan

ALWAYS AT HAND
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Control Center controls and Siri Shortcuts
• Live Activity while a speed test runs
• Light and dark mode, 14 languages

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your device list, device names and history are stored only on your iPhone. The app goes online only for a speed test (run by Measurement Lab), tools you point at an address outside your home, a maker-cloud reachability check during diagnosis, and a small update check.

Please only scan networks you own or have permission to test. iOS does not let any app read other devices' MAC addresses, so Pinggo identifies devices by their name, services and maker instead.

Questions or ideas? Write to elsa101192@icloud.com. We read every message.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://pinggo-app.pages.dev/privacy

name: PinionGleam
description: PinionGleam is a balloon linking puzzle set under an evening sky. Slide through three or more balloons of the same color to pop them. Longer chains score higher. Five in a row creates a bursting balloon, seven clears a whole row, and nine creates a rainbow balloon that matches any color. There are twenty-four levels, each with collection goals and a move limit. Stars depend on leftover moves and score. Popped balloons fill your collection, and coins and your best score stay on this device.

name: Pipeline cake
description:
Connect letters. Create sweet words.

Step into a cozy dessert workshop where candy letters ride a cream-colored pipeline. Slide your finger to link adjacent letters, spell the words on today’s order, and watch each find travel through the candy pipe into your recipe ticket.

Bake through 120 handcrafted recipes across Sweet Basics, Fruit Market, Candy World, Bakery Tools, and the Chocolate Lab. Unlock a gallery of refined desserts, take on a Daily Order challenge, and keep the oven warm with smooth continuous swipes—never tap-and-confirm.

LOOK → CONNECT → SPELL → COLLECT → COMPLETE

A premium word-connect puzzle with frosting trails, candy pipelines, and a bakery that feels uniquely its own.

name: PixShort Dramas
description:
PixShort Dramas is the fastest way to go from a story idea to 3D characters for your short drama.

Type a premise, pick a genre, and PixShort Dramas writes a structured script with episodes, scenes, and dialogue. It then reads your script and builds a profile for every character — role, personality, relationships, and a detailed look. With one tap, each character becomes a realistic, textured 3D model you can rotate, inspect, export, and even place in your room with AR.

WRITE SCRIPTS WITH AI
• Start from a single line: "A billionaire heiress goes undercover as an intern."
• Get a logline, synopsis, cast list, and episodes broken into scenes
• Edit anything by hand — every change is saved as a new version

BUILD YOUR CAST AUTOMATICALLY
• Extract characters straight from your script
• Lead, Supporting, and Minor roles with personality and story function
• Detailed appearance: age, build, hair, outfit, props, palette, and style
• Fields the AI inferred are clearly marked so you stay in control

GENERATE 3D CHARACTER MODELS
• Choose a style: Realistic, Cartoon, Anime, Chinese Style, Sci-fi Realistic, Cyberpunk, or Chibi
• A-Pose, T-Pose, or natural pose, with optional PBR textures
• Generate one character or your whole cast at once
• Jobs run in the cloud — leave the app and come back when they're done

PREVIEW, AR, AND EXPORT
• Interactive 3D viewer: drag to rotate, pinch to zoom
• View models in your space with AR Quick Look
• Export GLB and USDZ files for your animation, game, or previs pipeline

MADE FOR CREATORS
• No sign-up required — start creating in seconds
• Projects, scripts, characters, and models stay organized together
• Works beautifully on iPhone and iPad

Privacy Policy: https://pixapp.pixshort.tv/privacy

name: Plan-Go
description:
Plan-Go is a fast, distraction-free task manager designed around a true-black OLED interface and effortless one-handed gestures. Keep your day clear without bloated menus, subscriptions, or accounts.

BUILT FOR SPEED & CLARITY
• Work & Home Separation: Switch cleanly between professional tasks and personal errands so neither clutters the other.
• One-Thumb Radial Capture: Tap or slide the + button up for Work or left for Home to add tasks in seconds.
• Up Next Spotlight: Automatically highlights your top priority task at the top of your list, or tap the arrow on any item to promote it immediately.
• Smart Swipe Gestures: Swipe left to push a task back by +15 minutes (or pick any custom 1-minute increment). Swipe right to delete with an instant Undo bar.

HOME CHECKLISTS
• Turn on List mode inside Home to create inline checklists for groceries, packing, or quick errands with live progress counters and automatic completion when every item is checked off.

ZERO-DISTRACTION FOCUS & SOUND CONTROL
• Focus Mode: One tap hides extra controls, filters, and alert sounds so you can lock in on what matters right now—restoring your previous sound setting when you exit.
• Quick Sound / Silent Pill: Toggle notification sounds on or off anytime directly from the main screen.
• Custom Reminders: Schedule due dates with push notifications and choose from 5 built-in alert tones.

YOUR STYLE, 100% PRIVATE
• 6 True-Black OLED Accents: Customize your workspace with Cyan, Emerald, Amber, Violet, Rose, or Mono.
• Private by Design: No sign-up, no cloud tracking, and no ads. All of your tasks stay stored locally on your iPhone.

name: Plan7: Planeje a Semana
description:
Organize sua rotina da semana em poucos toques.

O Plan7 junta agenda, lista de tarefas e hábitos num só lugar. Você vê o que fazer agora, o que vem depois e como está indo na semana, sem criar conta.

SEU DIA, ORGANIZADO
• "Meu dia" mostra a atividade de agora, com tempo restante e botão de concluir
• Resumo do dia: quanto já foi feito e qual é a próxima atividade
• Prioridades em destaque (baixa, média, alta e urgente)
• Tarefas sem horário ficam numa lista flexível

PLANEJE A SEMANA
• Tarefas únicas ou rotinas que se repetem nos dias que você escolher
• Visão da semana com o progresso de cada dia
• Sugestão de horário livre ao criar uma atividade
• Aviso de conflito quando duas atividades se sobrepõem
• Categorias com cores para separar trabalho, estudos, saúde e vida pessoal

HÁBITOS QUE FICAM
• Hábitos diários, em dias da semana, em dias do mês ou X vezes por semana
• Metas com quantidade (ex.: 8 copos de água)
• Sequência atual, recorde e calendário de consistência
• Sugestões prontas: beber água, ler, estudar inglês, treinar, meditar, dormir bem

LEMBRETES NA HORA CERTA
• Notificações locais para tarefas e hábitos, na hora ou alguns minutos antes
• Funcionam mesmo com o app fechado

ACOMPANHE SEU PROGRESSO
• Taxa de conclusão da semana comparada com a anterior
• Evolução de cada hábito e metas da semana
• Seus dias mais produtivos e sugestões para planejar melhor

SEUS DADOS SÃO SEUS
• Tudo fica salvo no seu aparelho, sem conta e sem login
• Exporte e importe um backup em arquivo quando quiser
• Tema claro, escuro ou do sistema
• Em português, inglês e espanhol

O Plan7 é gratuito e exibe anúncios.

name: Platypi Arcade: Retro Games
description:
Step into Platypi Arcade: 39 retro arcade, card and dice games under one roof, in hand-made pixel art, and all of them play offline.

Every game pays tickets. Spend them at the prize counter on collectables that change how your games look, chase three goals in every game, and fill your trophy shelf. A new daily challenge waits every day.

CLAW CORNER
A claw machine with real physics. Earn free CLAW PLAYS by playing the other games, steer the claw before the 20-second timer drops it, and go for the golden trophy. Or warm up in PRACTICE.

TICKET TOWN
Prize machines: Tower Stack, Alley Roll, Peg Drop, Coin Shove, Light Chase, Hoop Shot, Air Puck, Gopher Bop and the Big Wheel.
Carnival games: Ring Toss, Balloon Darts, Bottle Knockdown, Water Gun Race, Shooting Gallery and Frog Launch.
Video cabinets: Duck Raid and Ice Fisher. And Coast Run, a racer along the coast.

THE REC ROOM
Three pinball tables, each with its own layout and modes: Grid Conflict, Tavern and Lost Entries. Plus Billiards, and Arc Conflict, a tank artillery duel.

THE TAVERN
Card and dice games: Pinochle Story, Grandma's Solitaire, Speed, War, Pairs, Fudgecicle and Yacht Dice.

THE HANDHELD
Pocket-sized games played upright: Hungry Eel, Lane Dodge, Sky Gunner, Road Crossing, Asteroid Field, Pop Shot and Hit and Blow. The endless ones keep getting harder the longer you last.

THE FROZEN POND
Platypi Dash: race across the ice against the ducks.

FEATURES
• 39 games that play offline, with no account
• Tickets, a prize counter and collectables: card backs, pinball balls, hats, cars, felts, cabinets and more
• Three goals and a trophy in every game
• A new daily challenge every day
• Touch controls with a D-pad or a joystick, card games you play with a tap, or play with a game controller
• Original pixel art, music and sound for every corner of the arcade
• Tickets are only ever won by playing: they can't be bought

Free to play with ads between games. A one-time Remove Ads purchase turns them off for good, and Restore Purchase brings it back on a new phone.

name: Pleno Abierto
description:
Pleno Abierto te enseña, de forma visual y con colores, qué votó cada grupo parlamentario en las leyes y decretos del Congreso de los Diputados.

QUÉ PUEDES HACER
• Leyes: filtra por tema (vivienda, trabajo, impuestos, sanidad…), por partido y por resultado, y mira de un vistazo quién votó sí, no o abstención.
• Vota tú también: lee un resumen neutral de una ley real, vota, y descubre después el resultado y con qué grupos coincides.
• Brújula: 45 preguntas basadas en escalas de investigación académica revisada por pares para conocer tu orientación política y compararla con lo que cada grupo votó de verdad.
• Mis diputados: quién representa a tu provincia y en cuántas votaciones del Pleno participó.
• Partidos: cómo vota cada grupo por tipo de ley y con quién coincide más.
• Avisos: recibe una notificación antes de una votación y otra con el resultado (opcional).
• Comparte tarjetas con el resultado de una ley o de tu Brújula.

TRANSPARENCIA
• Sin publicidad, sin registro y sin recogida de datos personales.
• Software libre (GPL-3.0): todo el código es público.
• Cada ley enlaza a su fuente oficial.

FUENTES DE LA INFORMACIÓN
• Votaciones, resultados y diputados: datos abiertos del Congreso de los Diputados — https://www.congreso.es/es/opendata/votaciones
• Texto de las leyes (resúmenes de «Vota tú también», redactados con ayuda de IA): Boletín Oficial del Estado — https://www.boe.es
• Lista de leyes, temas y agenda: El Congreso en tu mano (licencia CC BY 4.0) — https://www.elcongresoentumano.es

AVISO
Pleno Abierto es una app independiente desarrollada por un particular. NO representa al Congreso de los Diputados, al Gobierno de España, a ninguna administración pública ni a ningún partido político, no está afiliada a El Congreso en tu mano y no ofrece ningún servicio público. No recomienda el voto a ningún partido; la Brújula y «Vota tú también» no son encuestas ni sondeos electorales. Para cualquier uso con efectos jurídicos, consulta siempre la fuente oficial.

Aviso legal: https://mmorellacab-crypto.github.io/pleno-abierto/aviso-legal.html
Código fuente: https://github.com/mmorellacab-crypto/pleno-abierto

name: Polyglot: Learn 4 Languages
description:
Stop choosing between French, German, Italian and Spanish. Polyglot teaches them side by side: every phrase, idiom and grammar structure appears in all four languages at once, so what you learn in one language reinforces the others.

Built for intermediate and advanced learners (B1 to C2), Polyglot goes beyond tourist phrases and into the nuances that separate a learner from a fluent speaker.

REAL STORIES, WORD BY WORD
Read short stories written for B1 to C2 levels with a gloss under every single word. Switch between interlinear, parallel and read-only modes, tap any word for its meaning in context, and save it straight to your flashcard deck.

SMART FLASHCARDS
A spaced-repetition scheduler decides exactly when to review each word — rate it again, hard, good or easy and it schedules the next review for the moment you are about to forget it.

GRAMMAR THAT GOES DEEP
Plain-language guides explain how each structure really works in all four languages: the subjunctive, past tenses, word order and the constructions textbooks skip.

VOCABULARY WITH NUANCE
More than 250 words and idioms come with notes on false friends and fine distinctions: why German has two words for to borrow, what Italian asilo really means, and how actually betrays you in all four languages.

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
Daily streaks, weekly study time, a per-language mastery track and a seven-day review forecast keep you coming back.

Four languages. One app. Zero excuses.

name: Portal by Father of Web
description:
Portal is the client portal of Father of Web. If Luka is building your website or app, this is where your project lives: a chat for each project, your fixes and your approvals, on your iPhone and always in step with the web.

A CHAT FOR EACH PROJECT
Talk with Luka and your team in one place for each project, plus a private chat with Luka. Send words, photos, videos, files and voice messages. Reply to a message, react to it, pin what matters, and see when it has been read.

FIXES, WITH THE SCREENSHOT
Spotted something wrong on your site? Send a screenshot and it becomes a fix. Follow it from Sent to Working, Review and Done, right in the chat, with Luka's note and a screenshot of what changed.

APPROVE IN ONE TAP
When a fix is live or a design is ready, approve it in one tap, or ask for changes in your own words. Today gathers everything that is waiting on you, so nothing slips.

LIVE NOTIFICATIONS
Every message, fix and approval reaches you the moment it happens, grouped by chat. A tap opens it right where it is.

SEARCH EVERYTHING
Find any message, fix or file across all your chats.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your messages and files are stored in the European Union, and you can delete your account yourself in Settings.

BY INVITATION
Portal is for Father of Web's clients. Luka invites the people on each project; you sign in with your email and a one-time code, with no password to remember.

Questions? Write to info@fatherofweb.com.

name: Poulo Machinery
description:
Poulo is the official mobile app for Poulo Machinery sales, catalog, and field operations.

Browse machinery and accessories, submit order requests, and follow progress from your phone. Field teams can log party visits, capture marketing activity with photos and map pins, and stay connected with support tickets.

Key features:
• Product catalog with details and inquiry/order requests
• Order request tracking and account history
• Party visit reports with map location
• Marketing activity logging (photos, cost, and GPS pins)
• Staff field location visibility for managers
• Support tickets and in-app updates
• Role-based access for customers, staff, and admins

Poulo helps your sales and field teams work faster with one app for catalog, orders, visits, and marketing.

name: PP Vault: Private Documents
description:
PP Vault keeps your most important documents in one private place on your iPhone: passports, ID cards, driving licenses, insurance papers, contracts, medical records, receipts and more.

Everything is encrypted and stays on your phone. There is no account to create and no company server, and the app contains no ads, no analytics and no tracking.

Encrypted on your phone
• Every document is encrypted with XChaCha20-Poly1305 before it is saved.
• Your vault key is protected by your PIN or passphrase (strengthened with Argon2id) together with a key held in the iPhone's Secure Enclave.
• The vault is not copied to iCloud backups.

Unlock with Face ID or Touch ID
• Open the vault with Face ID, Touch ID or a 6-digit PIN. Prefer something stronger? Use a passphrase instead.
• The vault locks when you leave the app, or after a time you choose.
• Its content is hidden in the app switcher, and repeated wrong PINs are slowed down.
• Optional: erase the vault after 10 wrong attempts in a row.

Scan paper documents
• Scan pages with the camera, then reorder, rotate, crop or retake them and pick a filter.
• Each scan is saved as one PDF, encrypted the moment it is saved.

Import what you already have
• Add PDFs and images from Files and Photos.
• Send files to PP Vault from other apps with the share sheet, even while the vault is locked.

Organize and find
• Folders, tags and favorites.
• Search titles, notes and tags.
• View documents in the built-in viewer, without leaving the vault.

Encrypted backups you control
• Back up the whole vault to one encrypted file and save it to Files, iCloud Drive or a USB drive, or send it with AirDrop.
• Restore it on a new phone with your recovery key. The app itself never uploads anything.

A recovery key only you hold
When you create your vault, PP Vault gives you a recovery key. If you ever forget your PIN, it lets you back in. We cannot reset your PIN or open your vault: no one but you has the keys.

In 14 languages
English, Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), Spanish, Hindi, French, Portuguese, Russian, Urdu, Indonesian, German, Italian, Japanese and Korean, with full right-to-left layout for Arabic and Urdu.

Free and Pro
PP Vault is free for up to 25 documents (100 MB in total). PP Vault Pro removes the limit and is available as a monthly subscription (new subscribers get a 7-day free trial) or a one-time lifetime purchase. If Pro ends, you keep full access to your documents; only adding new ones needs Pro or free space.

Privacy
We collect no data. Purchases are handled by Apple. The app works fully offline.

Privacy policy: https://ppvault.garsony.cloud/privacy/
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Prakruti — Earth Watch
description:
Prakruti shows what the Earth is doing right now, using measurements from the agencies that make them, and it says where every number came from.

WHAT IT SHOWS

• A 3D globe with the last 24 hours of earthquakes, sized and coloured by magnitude, and active tropical cyclones with their observed tracks and the official forecast cone.
• Earthquakes reconciled across three independent seismic networks: the United States Geological Survey, the European-Mediterranean Seismological Centre and GFZ GEOFON. Filter by the last day, week or month, and by magnitude.
• Tropical cyclones from the official warning centres, relayed by the NOAA National Hurricane Center and GDACS.
• An experimental 48-hour earthquake forecast on a one-degree global grid, re-issued every 15 minutes. Areas where earthquakes have become more likely than usual glow yellow, orange or red. Tap a glow for the probability, the expected number of earthquakes, how that compares with the usual rate, and a plain-language explanation of why.
• The forecast's tested track record, and every formula behind it.

WHAT IT IS NOT

Prakruti does not predict earthquakes. Nobody can. The forecast gives probabilities from a statistical model of past seismicity: most highlighted areas will not have a large earthquake in the window, and earthquakes also happen outside them. It is not an alerting service or an official warning channel, and it must never be waited on in an emergency. Follow the instructions of the authority responsible for your country.

Prakruti is an independent platform. It is not endorsed by, affiliated with, or operated on behalf of USGS, NOAA, NASA, EMSC, GFZ, JMA, IMD or any other agency whose public data it displays.

HOW IT TREATS YOU

• No account, no sign-up, no login.
• No advertising and no tracking.
• The app never asks for your location.
• No payment, no subscription, now or later.

When the app cannot reach the network it says so, rather than showing old data as if it were current.

Prakruti means nature in Sanskrit. Independently developed by Madhusudan Kallur Purushothaman. Free to use, for all humankind.

name: Primiero Nearby
description:
Basta tessere fedeltà dimenticate a casa o perse in fondo al portafoglio. Con Primiero Nearby hai le tessere dei tuoi negozi preferiti sempre con te: punti, premi, coupon e offerte in un'unica app gratuita.

Scrivi l'email che hai lasciato in negozio, inserisci il codice che ti mandiamo ed è fatta: le tue tessere compaiono da sole, in tutti i negozi che usano Primiero. Niente password da ricordare, niente numeri da ricopiare.

ALLA CASSA BASTA UN TOCCO
Apri la tessera, mostra il QR o il codice a barre e i punti si caricano subito. Lo schermo si illumina da solo, così la cassa lo legge al primo colpo. Se preferisci, aggiungi la tessera al Wallet del tuo iPhone.

I TUOI PUNTI, SEMPRE SOTTO CONTROLLO
Saldo, livello e movimenti di ogni tessera: acquisti, premi riscattati e rettifiche. Sai sempre quanti punti hai e da dove arrivano.

IL PREMIO NON TI SFUGGE
Vedi quali premi puoi già riscattare e quanti punti mancano al prossimo. Quando ne sblocchi uno ti avvisiamo noi: niente più premi persi per distrazione.

COUPON E SCONTI IN UN POSTO SOLO
I buoni sconto dei tuoi negozi, con la scadenza bene in vista e un promemoria prima che scadano. Mostri il coupon alla cassa e lo sconto è fatto.

GIRA LA RUOTA, SCOPRI LO SCONTO
Dopo un acquisto, alcuni negozi ti regalano un coupon per la volta successiva: gira la ruota e scopri quanto risparmi. Le condizioni sono sempre lì da leggere, prima di girare.

LE OFFERTE DEI NEGOZI CHE AMI
Promozioni e novità dei negozi dove hai la tessera, appena escono. Se vuoi, l'iPhone ti avvisa quando passi vicino a uno di loro con un'offerta in corso. Lo decidi tu, e puoi cambiare idea quando vuoi.

IL NEGOZIO A PORTATA DI MANO
Orari di apertura, indirizzo, telefono, WhatsApp e sito. Chiami, scrivi o apri le indicazioni in Mappe con un tocco.

OGNI TESSERA CON IL SUO STILE
Le tessere hanno i colori, il logo e la grafica scelti dal negozio, come quelle vere. Le riconosci al volo.

FUNZIONA ANCHE SENZA RETE
L'ultima copia delle tue tessere resta sul telefono: in un seminterrato o con poco segnale, il codice da mostrare alla cassa c'è sempre.

LA PRIVACY LA DECIDI TU
Scegli quali notifiche ricevere e da quali negozi. Le tessere funzionano sempre, anche senza consensi e senza posizione. La posizione serve solo per gli avvisi vicino ai negozi, solo se la attivi, e le coordinate restano sul tuo iPhone.

LE TESSERE DEI NEGOZI DI OGNI GIORNO
• bar, caffetterie e pasticcerie
• panetterie, forni e alimentari
• librerie, abbigliamento e negozi di quartiere
• parrucchieri, estetisti e servizi
• ristoranti, pizzerie e locali

COME INIZIARE
1. Scarica Primiero Nearby, è gratis.
2. Scrivi l'email che usi nei tuoi negozi.
3. Inserisci il codice che ricevi per email.
4. Le tue tessere sono già lì: mostrale alla cassa e accumula punti.

Le tessere compaiono nei negozi che usano Primiero per la raccolta punti. Il tuo negozio preferito non c'è ancora? Chiedigli di provare Primiero: a te basta questa app.

name: PRINT ULTIMATE
description:
PRINT ULTIMATE

Your documents. Your layout. Your rules.

Create. Compose. Save. Share. Print.

Everything you need to prepare documents, organise files and create exactly what you want — all in one powerful app.

Why use several different applications when you can do it all in one place?

PRINT ULTIMATE gives you the freedom to create custom document layouts, scan physical paperwork, arrange photographs, prepare passport pictures, combine different file types and much more.

Start with a blank page or bring in your existing files. Move, resize, rotate and arrange everything exactly where you want it.

When you’re finished, the choice is yours.

Print directly. Save for later. Export digitally. Send by email. Share through WhatsApp or other compatible apps.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE

CREATE & COMPOSE

Build custom pages from scratch. Combine photographs, PDFs, Word documents, spreadsheets and other supported files in one layout. Position every element with precision.

DOCUMENT SCANNING

Turn physical documents into digital files. Automatically detect page edges, correct perspective and scan multiple pages into organised documents.

PASSPORT & ID PHOTO STUDIO

Prepare correctly sized passport and identity photographs using country-specific formats, facial positioning guides and automatic fitting. Create multiple copies on a single photo sheet.

ID & PASSPORT COPY

Create convenient printable layouts of identity cards and passport documents.

FILL & SIGN

Add text, signatures, dates and annotations to documents.

SMART PRINT LAYOUTS

Arrange multiple files and photographs on standard paper sizes. Control dimensions, margins, spacing, alignment and positioning.

YOUR WORK. YOUR CHOICE.

Once your project is ready, you decide what happens next.

* Print: Send your finished composition to a compatible printer.
* Save: Keep your projects and return to them whenever you want.
* Export: Create digital files for storage or further use.
* Email: Send your finished documents directly by email.
* WhatsApp: Share your work with friends, family or colleagues.
* Share: Use compatible sharing applications on your device.

Your work doesn’t have to end on paper. Keep it digital or make it physical.

AVAILABLE IN 13 LANGUAGES

Enjoy an interface designed for an international audience:

English · Spanish · French · Simplified Chinese · Japanese · Dutch · Arabic · Turkish · Portuguese · Hindi · Italian · Russian · Georgian.

ONE APP. COUNTLESS POSSIBILITIES.

From everyday paperwork and business documents to photographs, official ID pictures and custom compositions, PRINT ULTIMATE brings an entire collection of practical tools together.

Stop switching between applications. Start creating your way.

PRINT ULTIMATE

Not just printing. Complete freedom over your documents.

name: Prism – Glowing To-Do List
description:
Prism is a task manager that gets brighter the more you finish.

Tap the circle to complete a task, and it turns into a particle of light that flies into the lens at the top of the screen. As the lens fills, the colors of the screen move toward dawn. Finish everything due today, and the light overflows and fills the screen.

ADD AND COMPLETE IN A MOMENT
• Tap + and start typing right away. Press Return to add, then keep going with the next task
• Set the due date to Today or Tomorrow with one tap
• Swipe right to complete, swipe left to delete
• Undo a completion or deletion right from the button at the bottom of the screen

SEE TODAY AT A GLANCE
• The Today screen shows only overdue tasks and tasks due today
• The number left and the light in the lens show how your day is going
• The All screen groups tasks by due date. Search titles and notes, and filter by category, tag, and priority

REMEMBER WHAT MATTERS
• Get a reminder before a task is due, or at a time you choose
• Complete a task right from the notification

USE IT WITH PEACE OF MIND
• Your data is stored only on this iPhone. No account needed. Your tasks are never sent to an outside server
• Deleting the app also deletes your data
• Deleted tasks stay in Recently Deleted for 30 days so you can restore them. Tasks completed 30 days ago move there automatically
• Supports Light and Dark Mode, larger text sizes, VoiceOver, and Reduce Motion

FREE TO USE
Adding, completing, and editing tasks, due dates and reminders, search and filters, and all the light effects are free. You can create up to 5 categories and 10 tags.

PRISM PRO (ONE-TIME IN-APP PURCHASE)
Buy once and keep these features for good. Prism Pro is not a subscription — there are no monthly or yearly fees.
• Home Screen widgets: see what’s left today and what’s next, and complete tasks right from the widget
• Lock Screen widgets: check what’s left today without unlocking
• Unlimited categories and tags
Use Restore Purchases to get Prism Pro on your other iPhones signed in with the same Apple Account.

Terms of Use: Apple’s standard End User License Agreement (EULA)
Privacy Policy: https://nishimura-future-works.github.io/prism/privacy/en/

description:
Producer Room is the app by Matt Tosi (producer with dozens of gold records) and 71 Audio, made for producers, beatmakers, artists, engineers and DJs.

FREE 71 AUDIO PLUGINS

Free, no ads. The app is in French for now; English and Spanish are coming soon.

name: ProSpray Management
description:
ProSpray Management is the ProSpray Lawn & Pest team app.

• Clock in and out, with your hours for the week and pay period
• See your schedule as a list, week or month; pick up open shifts

• Request time off and see your balances

ProSpray Management is for ProSpray Lawn & Pest employees. Your account is set up by the company.

name: Qevrask Tholnivar
description:
Qevrask Tholnivar brings three classic card games together in a single polished experience: Spit, Pitch, and Alaska. Each game follows its original rules faithfully, with a computer opponent that adapts across three challenge levels.

Spit is a real-time race where both players move simultaneously, dragging and tapping cards onto shared centre piles to empty their stockpiles first. Rounds build tension as card counts shrink and the pace accelerates.

Pitch is a trump-trick game built on claiming and risk. Each hand you bid on how many points you can win, then pitch a card to set trump. Earn High, Low, Jack, and Game points by reading the hand and playing smart — miss your claim, and the points come off your score.

Alaska is a patient, single-player solitaire variant where every card starts in play across seven columns. Build same-suit sequences up or down, move groups freely, and work every card home from Ace to King. Easy mode reveals all cards from the start; Hard removes hints entirely.

A persistent dashboard tracks wins, streaks, fastest times, and average rounds across all three games. Daily quests rotate each day, and a milestone collection rewards long-term progress — from your very first win to a seven-game streak.

The interface is built around calm dark tones, soft glow accents, and smooth card animations. Haptic feedback responds to every move, and four-colour suit mode gives each suit its own hue for easier reading.

name: Qolgap
Quenvaris Crown Code
description:
Quenvaris Crown Code is a trio of calm, single-player card puzzles. Each mode takes a familiar table of cards and turns it into a different thinking challenge. There is no opponent and no clock pressure. You win by reading the layout and refining your plan.

Royal Slide is a spatial puzzle. Cards sit on a grid with one empty space, and you slide neighbouring cards into that space to sort every suit into its own row, Ace first. Every layout has a solution; the challenge is reaching it in as few moves as possible.

Crown Code is a deduction puzzle. A hidden row of cards is dealt face-down, and each guess returns gold and cream clues marking exact matches and misplaced ones. You have a limited number of rows to narrow down the answer. It rewards careful inference over trial and error.

Ace Trail is a path-drawing puzzle. Drag a continuous trail through linked cards. Close a five-card trail that forms a poker hand and the whole trail scores a bonus. The board refills as cells clear, so longer sessions turn into chaining stronger trails and chasing higher stars.

Each mode has Easy, Normal and Hard variants, three-star scoring, and a personal record you can reset at any time. Settings include sound and haptic controls.

name: QuestPlex
description:
WELCOME TO Altoona QuestPlex

The QuestPlex app allows you to manage your account with ease, register for classes, and special events. You'll also receive important notifications about class changes, closings, registration openings, special announcements, and upcoming events.

The QuestPlex app is an easy-to-use, on-the-go way to access everything Altoona QuestPlex has to offer right from your smartphone.

name: Questward: Learn & Master
description:
Talent isn't just something you're born with. It's a spark that gets lit, followed by the right kind of practice, every day. Questward puts that method into your family's day.

START WHERE YOU ARE
A short adaptive check finds where a learner is in math, from counting to the Pythagorean theorem, so nobody starts back at kindergarten. Reading and writing start at the grade you choose. Everything below is credited; everything ahead is mapped.

A JOURNEY ON THE COMMON CORE
Kindergarten through grade 8 math, plus reading informational texts and writing, laid out grade by grade and linked by what builds on what. Each step shows what it builds on and what it leads to, and stays locked until the groundwork is in place.

QUESTS THAT TALK BACK
Story quests put math and science to work: fix an animated film whose clips play at the wrong speed, or research how scientists tell wild whales apart and explain it. A guide reads each step aloud and listens for spoken answers like "three fourths" or "the second one". Speech is recognized on the device.

5 IN A ROW IS MASTERY
Practice runs until five answers in a row are right. A miss shows the reasoning and starts the run again. That's deep practice: slow down, feel the miss, fix it, repeat.

FIND THE SPARK
A short quiz maps what lights a learner up across eight areas, from numbers and science to music, movement and leadership, plus a role model and "when does time disappear?"

PASSION PATHS
Add piano, swimming or any of 200+ subjects, from astronomy to welding and Spanish, as a path on the same journey. Each climbs five levels, and a level counts only at 100%. Anything less is failing forward.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR ME
Connect years of practice to college and scholarships: where a learner fits, a tracker for deadlines, essays and reference letters, a log of wins, and a brag sheet that fills itself in.

YOUR SPACE
Bright Daylight by default, plus Ocean, Orchid and an optional Midnight look, saved for each learner. Motion and lesson text size are yours to set. Made for iPad and iPhone.

FOR PARENTS AND COACHES
In Settings, press and hold For grown-ups to see the week at a glance, progress on the Common Core, who needs a step back, and simple coaching moves, including the Culture Code at home.

PRIVATE
No account and no ads. Everything stays on your device, including the voice. Nothing is sent anywhere.

Questward is free.

Created by one of America's top coaches and a PhD astrophysicist.

Common Core State Standards © Copyright 2010. National Governors Association Center for Best Practices and Council of Chief State School Officers. All rights reserved.

name: Quillo Spin Hit
description:
Quillo Spin Hit is a fun spike-throwing game where you help Quillo the hedgehog stick his spikes into spinning targets. Just tap the screen to throw, but be careful! Spikes already stuck can cause your next throw to miss if you don't time it right.

From oranges and donuts to strange planets, each target has its own spin rhythm. Sometimes they spin steadily, sometimes they suddenly change direction, wobble, or accelerate, requiring you to concentrate to complete the level. Once you've stuck enough spikes, the target will explode, and you'll move on to the next challenge.

Quillo's journey spans eight colorful worlds, each with unique targets and a boss waiting for you. Complete the levels, collect berries, and try to earn three stars by completing targets, collecting rewards, and passing the level within the time limit.

If you want to challenge yourself, step into Endless and see how many targets you can clear in a row, or race against the clock in Time Rush. Bullseye demands precise throws at the glowing lines, while Daily offers a new target sequence each day. You can also challenge your friends to a Duel on the same device to see who clears all the spikes first.

Collected berries are used to unlock new spike types and power-ups. Slow down targets with snails or use bubble shields to save yourself from an unwanted spike hit.

Quillo is always ready with adorable expressions, from cheerful to dozing off if you leave him alone for too long. Throw spikes, dodge slides, and conquer every target in the colorful world of Quillo Spin Hit!

name: QuotaRadar: AI Limit Tracker
description:
How much AI is left, at a glance.

QuotaRadar keeps an eye on your Claude, ChatGPT and Grok chat limits and shows them in the app, in Home Screen widgets and in the Dynamic Island. No more checking web pages, and no more getting cut off mid-conversation.

◆ AT A GLANCE
・Three radar rings show what's left on each AI
・See when each limit resets; widgets and the Dynamic Island count down on their own
・Best now: tells you which AI has the most left, so you know which one to use

◆ KNOW BEFORE YOU RUN OUT
・Pace forecast: works out when you'll hit the limit at your current pace ("At this pace you run out 15:40")
・Alerts at 20% and 5% left
・A heads-up the moment a limit resets
・Outage alerts: when a service is down, it's on their side, not your account (Claude and ChatGPT for now)
・Quiet hours: no alerts from midnight to 7:00

◆ SEE YOUR HABITS
・How much each AI used in the last 7 days
・Your busiest hours and how much you use per day

◆ THREE LOOKS
・Radar rings, Gradient or Battery. Widgets and the Dynamic Island change together.

◆ YOUR SIGN-IN STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
・You sign in on each AI's own page, inside the app, with your usual account
・Your sign-in is kept on this phone only
・QuotaRadar has no server, never sees your password, and has no ads or tracking

◆ WORKS WITH
・Claude, ChatGPT, Grok

◆ FREE + ONE-TIME FULL VERSION
Free: every provider's quota, reset countdowns, widgets, back-in-business alerts and the radar look.
Full version, one payment, yours forever, no subscription: Best now, pace forecast, running-low and outage alerts, 7-day stats and every look.
No sign-up, no ads.

Made for everyday AI chat, not for developers. Fully available in Traditional and Simplified Chinese.

————
QuotaRadar is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Anthropic, OpenAI, xAI, Google or Meta. Claude, ChatGPT, Grok and Gemini are trademarks of their respective owners and are named only to describe which services the app works with. Remaining limits are as reported by each service. Dynamic Island features need an iPhone with the Dynamic Island.

name: Quotura
description: Quotura ଏକ ସ୍ଥାନୀୟ ନିର୍ଣ୍ଯନ ଆପ୍। ଆପଣ ବିକଳ୍ପଗୁଡ଼ିକୁ ଓଜନ ସହିତ ସାଜାଇପାରିବେ, ଓଜନ ଯୁକ୍ତ ଚକ୍ ଘୁଞ୍ଚାଇପାରିବେ, ଚିଠି ବା ପାସା ଜରିଆରେ ବାଛିପାରିବେ, ଏବଂ ଫଳାଫଳର ସାଂଖ୍ୟିକ ତଲାଶ କରିପାରିବେ। ସମସ୍ତ ତଥ୍ୟ ଆପଣଙ୍କ ଫୋନରେ ସଂରକ୍ଷିତ ରହେ; ଦୈନନ୍ଦିନ ବ୍ୟବହାର ପାଇଁ ଇଣ୍ଟରନେଟ୍ ଲାଗେ ନାହିଁ।

name: Quỹ Đạo: Orbit Hop
description:
Orbit Hop is a one-tap arcade game about timing.

Your comet circles a planet. Tap at the right moment and it flies off in a straight line. Land in the next planet's pull and you are safe, for a few seconds. Miss, and you drift into the void.

ONE MAP A DAY, FOR EVERYONE
Every day brings one new map, and every player in the world gets the same one. You have three tries. Then you wait for tomorrow, or keep practising in free play.

EASY TO START, HARD TO MASTER
• One finger. One tap. That is the whole control scheme.
• A countdown ring shows how long you can stay in orbit. It gets shorter the further you go.
• Hit the centre of a planet's pull for a PERFECT. Chain perfects to build a streak and score more.
• Red dwarfs burn through your time. Giant planets give you room to breathe.
• Wormholes are a risky shortcut: hit one and skip three planets.

COMPETE AND SHARE
• Daily ranking with players around the world. No account needed, just pick a name.
• Share your run as a row of coloured squares and challenge a friend to beat it on the same map.

MADE TO BE PLAYED ANYWHERE
• No ads. No in-app purchases. No sign-up.
• Plays in English and Vietnamese.
• A full run takes about a minute.

name: RadarDjin
description:
RadarDjin turns your iPhone into a camera speed radar. Point it at the road and every passing car, truck, bus or motorcycle gets a live speed chip — measured on device, with no extra hardware.

LIVE RADAR
• On-device vehicle detection with per-vehicle speed chips over the camera view
• Every reading shows its uncertainty (±), so you know how much to trust it
• A ground-lock indicator shows when the scene is anchored and speeds are reliable
• LiDAR-assisted ground anchoring on supported devices for faster, steadier locks
• km/h or mph, switchable on screen
• Session peak speed always in view; tap a chip to pin and enlarge it
• Optional strict mode shows speeds only at higher confidence

RECORD AND REPLAY
• One-tap recording of video plus every measurement
• Sessions list with thumbnails, place, duration and peak speed
• Replay with the speed chips re-drawn over the video, exactly as measured
• Per-vehicle summary: peak, average and duration for each track
• Tap a vehicle in the list to jump straight to its fastest moment

RE-ANALYZE
• Re-run the full measurement pipeline over any recorded session on your phone
• Compare the live readings with the re-analysis side by side

EXPORT AND SHARE
• Export video with the speed chips burned in, ready to share anywhere
• Standard iOS share sheet: Files, AirDrop, Messages, Mail and more

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Detection, tracking and speed estimation all run on your iPhone
• Recordings stay on your device — nothing is uploaded, no account, no ads

LANGUAGES
• Available in English, French, German, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Romanian, Dutch, Bulgarian, Slovenian, Slovak, Czech, Polish, Hungarian, Croatian and Greek

Free to try with full functionality for 5 days. Afterwards the free tier keeps the live radar and up to 3 saved sessions with watermarked exports; a single one-time purchase unlocks unlimited sessions and clean exports — no subscription.

Note: RadarDjin provides speed estimates for informational and hobby use. It is not a certified measuring device and must not be used for law enforcement.

name: RadaTV: M3U & Stream Player
description:
RadaTV is a standalone smart media player built for iPhone, iPad, and Apple TV.

IMPORTANT NOTICE: RadaTV is a Bring-Your-Own-Content (BYOC) player. The app does NOT include, host, sell, or provide any preloaded TV channels, playlists, movies, or media streams. You must add your own legally authorized M3U playlists, Xtream Codes credentials, or open-source media URLs.

KEY FEATURES
• M3U / M3U8 Playlists, Xtream API & XMLTV EPG program guide support
• Native hardware-accelerated playback with Picture-in-Picture (PiP), AirPlay, audio & subtitle track switching
• Apple TV Multiview: Watch up to 2 or 4 simultaneous streams with focus-based audio switching
• Instant QR Code & 6-digit PIN pairing between iPhone/iPad and TV devices
• Face ID / Touch ID & 4-digit PIN parental controls for locked categories
• Zero-knowledge AES-256-GCM encrypted cloud sync with iOS Keychain protection
• Built-in 1-tap Open-Source Demo (Blender Foundation CC-BY) to try playback right away

RADATV PREMIUM & FAMILY SHARING
• Single Plans: 1 Phone + 1 TV quota with cloud sync and an ad-free experience
• Family Plans: 3 Phones + 3 TVs quota with Apple Family Sharing support
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in your Apple Account settings.

name: Radical Rush 90s
description:
Blast into a neon-soaked 90s cartoon arcade in Radical Rush — the ultra-responsive, vertical one-thumb vehicle stunt runner built for high-speed fun on phones and tablets!

Carve across 5 wide arcade lanes, launch off glowing ramps for aerial Stunt Combos, spark Elevated Neon Grind Rails, and pilot 24 original 3D cartoon vehicles!

24 ORIGINAL CARTOON VEHICLES ACROSS 6 CLASSES
• Choose any of the 4 fan-favorite starter rides right away: Sky Viper F-94 (Jet), Mega Crusher 4x4 (Monster Rig), Star Viper X-99 (Spaceship), or Neon Blade 900 (Motorcycle)!
• Unlock 20 more wild cartoon Planes, Bikes, Monster Rigs, Starships/UFOs, Hover-Decks, and Arcade Karts simply by earning Coins and Career Points on the Trophy Road — plus unlock 4 custom Paint Wraps per ride and test-drive locked vehicles mid-run through Holo-Morph Portals!

6 DYNAMIC 90s BIOMES, GRIND RAILS & SKY BONUS STAGE
• Race from gentle beginner speeds into thrilling high-tempo runs across Sunset Boardwalk, Laser Mall Atrium, Volcano Dino Canyon, Glacier Half-Pipe, Cyber Grid Highway, and Starlight Orbit!
• Hop onto Elevated Neon Grind Rails for sparks and bonus points, warp into the hazard-free 7-second Sky-Warp Cloud Bonus Tunnel, grab Super Magnets, 2x Score multipliers, and Mega-Crush XL shields, and spell R-A-D-I-C-A-L to crack open +500 Coin Mystery Crates!

ROBO-BUDDY SIDEKICKS, TOY BLASTERS & CARTOON BOSSES
• Fly alongside 4 adorable Robo-Buddy Sidekicks and upgrade kid-friendly toy blasters (Foam Darts, 90s Green Slime, Mega Rainbow Bubbles, and Laser-Tag Prisms) up to Level 10!
• Outsmart Saturday-morning cartoon bosses including Dr. Rewind, Baroness Boombox, and Lord Dial-Up!

DAILY BOUNTIES, 24 HOLO-POGS & CLOUD SYNC
• Complete 6 fresh Daily Quests, open the Daily Sweep Grand Chest, collect all 24 90s Holo-Pogs & Slammers, and sync your progress seamlessly across devices with iCloud & Game Center (iOS) or Google Play Games & Cloud Backup (Android).

100% KID-SAFE & FAMILY-FRIENDLY BY PEBCAK
• Zero accounts, zero personal data collection, zero loot boxes, free 1-Hour & 6-Hour Ad-Free Passes, and adult-gated Parent Controls with optional Radical Club Pro lifetime ad-free unlock.

name: RasGas Loyalty App
description:
RasGas Loyalty app is the official loyalty and wallet app of Ras Gas fuel stations in Lebanon, a member of Rasamny Group. Earn points when you pay, use your RasGas card from your phone, and keep track of every fill-up in one place.

Earn points on every purchase
• Collect points when you pay at Ras Gas stations with the app.
• Move up through membership tiers and earn points faster.
• Redeem your points for rewards and get a voucher code to show at the station.
• See current offers and how to earn more.

Your RasGas card on your phone
• Link your RasGas prepaid card with its account number.
• See your card balance and limit, updated from Ras Gas.
• Pay at the pump with a secure QR code that refreshes every few minutes.
• Top up your card at Ras Gas stations.

Shared vouchers
• Create a voucher for a set amount and service, such as fuel or car wash.
• Send it to family or a driver as a QR picture; they use it at the station.
• Cancel an unused voucher at any time to get the amount back on your card.

Find a station
• See the Ras Gas stations nearest to you on a map.
• Check fuel prices and the services each station offers.
• Get directions in one tap.

History and receipts
• See every purchase, top-up and payment with date, station and amount.
• Download receipts and statements as PDF.
• Get notified about points, wallet activity, vouchers and offers.

Accounts for companies
• A company (parent) account can manage its drivers' accounts (sub accounts), move money to their wallets and follow their fuel purchases.

Simple and secure
• Sign up with your mobile number and a one-time SMS code.
• Day and night themes.
• Edit your profile or delete your account at any time from the app.

Good to know
• The wallet works with RasGas prepaid cards in USD and can be used only at Ras Gas stations in Lebanon.
• Location is used only to show nearby stations, and only if you allow it.
• Need help? Use Contact support in the app.

name: Ravenry: Agents Anywhere
description:
Ravenry puts the coding agents running on your Mac in your pocket.

When Claude Code or Codex needs you (a question, a choice between pictures, a command to approve), it waits at the top of your board. Answer from your iPhone or iPad, and the agent carries on.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• See every project and the live screen of each session
• Answer a question with one tap, or in your own words
• Approve or refuse a command before it runs, with Face ID
• Choose between pictures or videos, circle what you mean and add a note
• Send an agent a photo or a file
• Start a new session from your iPhone or iPad
• On iPad, see your projects beside the one you have open

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your iPhone or iPad talks straight to your Mac, encrypted. There is no Ravenry server and no account.
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking.

WHAT YOU NEED
• Ravenry for Mac, free: patoles.github.io/ravenry (Apple silicon, macOS 13 or later)
• Claude Code or Codex, installed and signed in on your Mac
• The same Wi-Fi as your Mac, or Tailscale to reach it from anywhere

To start, scan the code your Mac shows. That's all the setup there is. No Mac yet? Tap Try the demo on the first screen.

name: RecOfficials
description:
RecOfficials is the companion app for recreation departments and sports officials already registered with RecOfficials.

FOR OFFICIALS
• See every upcoming game you're assigned, with the time, teams, field and directions
• Accept or decline new assignments with one tap
• Sign up for open positions in your leagues
• Mark the days and times you can work on your Availability Calendar
• Get a reminder the morning of each game you've accepted (the evening before for early games)
• Add your games to your phone's calendar so it stays up to date
• Check off your department's checklist items, like W-4s and rules clinics

FOR RECREATION DEPARTMENTS
• Manage officials for every sport and league you run: baseball, softball, basketball, soccer, volleyball and more
• Enter games one at a time, paste a schedule, or import a CSV file
• Assign officials by position, see who's available, and publish assignments
• Cancel or move games and notify the officials affected
• Share documents and track each official's checklist
• Run pay and game reports

This app is for departments and officials who already have a RecOfficials account. Officials receive an invitation from their department to set up their account. New to RecOfficials? Contact us for more information.

name: Reed Bible: Swipe KJV Verses
description:
Reed Bible turns the swipe you already know into time with God's Word.

Swipe through the King James Bible the way you swipe through your favorite feed: the same easy motion, spent on something that helps you grow and draws you closer to God.

ONE SWIPE, ONE PASSAGE
Swipe up and the next passage fills the screen, with the words of Jesus in red. Like a verse, add a note or share it right from the feed. Open the whole chapter whenever you want more. Set a small daily goal of five, ten or twenty verses, and keep it.

A COURTYARD THAT LIGHTS UP
Stay with a verse and a lantern comes on. Keep reading and a small courtyard fills in over the weeks, with buildings you can step inside and keepsakes to find. Miss a day and a grace day covers it.

KEEP THE VERSES THAT MATTER
Keep a passage and it comes back to you after 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30 days, with one word missing. Pick the right word and it moves further out, until you know it by heart. Kept verses can also come back on your lock screen.

NOTES AND LISTENING
Write a note on any verse; it saves as you type. Have a passage read aloud by your iPhone's own voice, with controls on the lock screen. Add widgets for today's verse, your streak and a kept verse.

REED BIBLE PLUS
Reading is free, always. Plus goes deeper:
- Deep Study on every passage: meaning, historical context, life in Bible times and older King James words, drawn from public-domain works (Matthew Henry's Concise Commentary, Easton's Bible Dictionary and Webster's 1913 dictionary). Every note shows its source.
- Cross-references from the Treasury of Scripture Knowledge.
- Every reading plan and short topic journey.
- Threads that follow one passage to the others it connects with.

Plus is $29.99 a year with a 7-day free trial, or $4.99 a month with a 3-day free trial (prices may differ by country). Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your iPhone's Settings under your name, then Subscriptions.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. What you read, keep and write stays on your iPhone.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://reedbible.app/privacy/

name: ReelFile
description:
ReelFile is a home to keep the reels you want to see again.

Share a reel from Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or Facebook and pick ReelFile. It lands in the folder you choose, with a preview frame, ready when you are. No account, no feed, no algorithm — just the videos you decided to keep.

WHAT IT DOES

• Save from the Share Sheet — one tap from the app you are already in
• Organise into folders that make sense to you
• See a preview of every reel at a glance
• Colour-coded folders that match what is inside
• Rename, move and delete anything, any time
• Works offline for your library; opens the original when you want to watch

WHAT IT DOES NOT DO

• No account and no sign-in
• No tracking, no ads, no analytics
• Nothing is uploaded anywhere
• We never see your library

A NOTE ON PLAYBACK

ReelFile stores the link to each reel and shows it using the platform's own player. Some videos are limited to signed-in users; for those, ReelFile offers to sign you in on the platform's own page, or to open the video in that platform's app.

ReelFile is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Instagram, TikTok, YouTube or Facebook.

name: Reems Realty
description:
Reems Realty — your client portal for property bookings, installments, and payments.

Stay on top of your investments with a simple dashboard built for Reems Realty clients. View your units, check outstanding balances, follow your installment plan, and pay online when you’re ready.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• See your units and booking details in one place
• Track outstanding amounts and next installment due dates
• Review your payment plan and payment history
• Pay online securely through the app
• Browse Reems Realty projects and property information
• Message the Reems Realty team when you need help
• Get push reminders for installments still due this month

WHO IT’S FOR

This app is for Reems Realty clients who want quick access to their booking and payment information on the go. Sign in with your client account to view your personal records.

NEED HELP?

Use Ask Admin inside the app to contact the Reems Realty team with questions about your unit, payments, or account.

Reems Realty — manage your property journey with clarity and convenience.

name: Rejuchiol
description:
Get exclusive special offers on the mobile app!

Use the mobile app to enjoy features optimized for mobile devices and access exclusive special offers.



Main features:

Enjoy exclusive coupons and discounts

Use automatic login

Check and track your orders

Manage your shopping cart and shipping info

Receive store notifications

Access social media channels

Contact Customer Service

name: Rescaling Field
description:
Rescaling Field is the work app for Rescaling's field teams: the operators and team leads who run data collection at businesses and with individual workers. It needs an account from your team; there is nothing to do in it without one.

What you can do with it:

• Hand out cameras. Pick a worker, scan or type the camera's ID, and give it. The app checks that the worker's consent is signed, that neither the worker nor the camera has had another hand-over today, and that you are at the business.

• Register workers and businesses. Add a business where your team works, add its workers, and take each worker's consent on the phone, in their language.

• Check SD cards. Connect a camera's SD card to the iPhone with a card reader, pick it in the Files app, and the app checks it in: what is on it and how many hours it holds, before the card goes back out.

• See your day. My deployments shows today's hand-overs and card checks, from this iPhone and your team's other phones, and what is still waiting to be sent.

• Work offline. What you do with no signal is kept on the iPhone and sent as soon as it is back.

The app is in English, Hindi, Chinese and Swahili.

The app uses the iPhone's location at a hand-over, to record where the camera was given, the camera to scan device IDs, and the microphone for the voice note and video of a problem report. It reads only the SD cards you pick, to check them in.

Privacy notice: https://app.rescaling.ai/privacy
Terms of service: https://app.rescaling.ai/terms
Delete your account: https://app.rescaling.ai/delete-account

name: ReviewFire for Business
description:
ReviewFire is the mobile companion to the ReviewFire web portal, for owners, managers and staff of local businesses.

You need an existing ReviewFire account. Your business creates accounts on the web at reviewfire.com. The app has no sign-up, no pricing and no purchases.

NEEDS YOU
Home starts with what needs attention: customers waiting for a call back, reviews with no reply, and replies waiting for approval.

REVIEWS
Triage Google and Facebook reviews by Needs reply, Approvals, Negative or All. Open one to read the thread, add internal notes, and write a reply. The app can suggest reply text for you to edit. Draft, submit, approve and post follow the same roles as the web portal.

PRIVATE FEEDBACK
Customers can send feedback to you privately. The inbox shows what needs attention first. Call, text or email the customer, add notes and tags, and mark it resolved.

ASK FOR REVIEWS
Send a feedback or Google review request in a few taps: type a name and email, or pick one person from your contacts, and credit the staff member who helped. Or show a full-brightness QR code the customer can scan.

KIOSK AND TEAM
Leave a phone or tablet at the front desk showing your feedback form; it resets for the next customer. See a monthly staff leaderboard.

ALERTS AND SECURITY
Optional notifications for new reviews and private feedback open the item when tapped. Lock the app with Face ID or your fingerprint and use two-factor sign-in.

Billing, plans, integrations and reports stay in the web portal.

name: Rivet Drift Depot
description:
Odd jobs. Deep drops. Some assembly required.

Welcome to Rivet Drift Depot, a cozy little maintenance station with a very unusual delivery route: straight down. Guide a cheerful, spread-eagled robot through an old industrial shaft and bring it safely to the dock below.

DRIFT WITH YOUR FINGERTIPS
Look over the robot’s back into a four-walled shaft. The robot falls continuously past obstacles fixed to the shaft walls. Drag across the shaft to steer through the gaps. Hold TUCK to pull your arms and legs inward and slip through an opening. Every drop asks you to read the machinery, choose your line, and decide whether those extra rivets are worth the detour.

A LITTLE LESS ROBOT
A brush against a limb can send that part spinning away. Your delivery continues, but a head or chest impact scatters the whole robot. Keep your core clear, recover with a Repair pickup, and turn a messy landing into a small victory.

SIX SMALL TOOLS, BIG POSSIBILITIES
Shrink with Mini. Ease the descent with Slow. Catch a hit in a Bubble. Reattach a limb with Repair. Gather nearby rivets with Rivet Pull. Slip through danger with Ghost. Collect tools in the shaft or spend saved Mini and Slow charges from your toolbelt.

100 DEEP LITTLE DELIVERIES
The first ten routes introduce copper pipes, torn mesh, steel bars, lodged rocks, crosswind fans, locked pistons, laser barriers, cogwheels, magnetic coils, and bolted hatches. Later sections add diagonal braces, hanging cables, mineral clusters and pressure vents, for 14 types of obstacles. The drop gains speed as you descend. Five difficulty tiers guide you from wider openings to tighter routes that ask for quick changes of direction.

MAKE EVERY LANDING COUNT
Earn a star for reaching the dock, another for keeping at least three limbs, and a third for meeting the rivet target. Replay routes to improve your personal bests on the local leaderboard. Open a daily parcel for extra rivets and tool charges.

Rounded, tactile artwork and playful bursts, breakaways, repair effects, and landing celebrations give each little delivery its own personality.

Built for portrait play on iPhone. Play offline, with no account, advertising, or in-app purchases. Progress and personal records stay on your device. Sound effects, haptics, and decorative motion can be adjusted in Settings.

Handle with a little less care.

name: Riz Bot: AI Texting Coach
description:
Never wonder what to text her again.

Riz Bot is your AI wingman for texting and real life. Ask it anything, or drop in a screenshot of the chat, and get 2–3 replies you can tap to copy and send.

TEXTING
• Left on read? Get a message that brings the convo back without looking desperate
• Drop in a screenshot and Riz reads her energy: is she into it or just being polite?
• Playful, smooth or bold: pick the vibe that fits you
• Ask her out without it being awkward

IN PERSON
• The exact words to open with at the gym, a café or a party
• When to approach, how to read her body language, and when to walk away
• How to get her number and set up the date

HOW IT WORKS
1. Type your question or add a screenshot
2. Get 3 lines written the way people actually text
3. Tap one to copy it and send

Riz Bot keeps it respectful: no manipulation, no pressure, and if she's not interested it'll tell you to move on with your head up. That's confidence.

RIZ PRO
Start with a 3-day free trial, then $9.99/month. Unlimited questions and screenshots. Cancel anytime in Settings at least 24 hours before the trial ends.

For adults 18+.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://rizbot-production.up.railway.app/privacy

name: Roamelyn
description:
Where did you stop on the way home? Start recording and let Roamelyn keep a map of your day. See the distance you covered, how long you were moving and the places where you lingered.

Switch to Workouts for a walk, run or bike ride. Follow your distance and speed on the map, and choose the voice updates you want to hear. Your routes and workouts are stored on your device.

Recording and viewing today’s activity are free. Roamelyn Plus unlocks previous days, route playback with adjustable speed, route files, posters and videos, and manual backup and restore through Files. Choose an auto-renewing annual subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Rollwise: Gallery in Order
description:
Rollwise puts your photos back in the order you took them, and gives you the tools to keep them that way. Everything happens on your phone.

SEE THE RIGHT DATE
• Photos from WhatsApp, old phones, backups and computers are placed by the day they were taken, not the day they arrived
• "Dates to fix" lists photos Apple Photos shows on the wrong day; fix one, or all of them, in one tap
• Change the date and time of any photo, or shift a whole set for a camera clock that was wrong
• Info shows every date found, the camera, lens and exposure

FIND ANYTHING
• Timeline, a calendar of your photos day by day, and smart search for things and words in photos
• Favourites, tags and notes on any photo, all searchable
• People: faces grouped on your phone, so you can name and find them
• Places: where your photos were taken, worked out on your phone with no map service
• Year in review: the best of each year as a slideshow

VIEW AND EDIT
• Full-screen viewer with the date and place on top, slideshow, and Live Photos
• Crop, rotate, straighten, brightness and contrast; edits are saved as a copy, the original stays as it was
• Copy text from any photo

CLEAN UP
• Swipe review: keep or delete, one photo at a time
• Duplicates, even resized WhatsApp copies, and similar shots: keep the sharpest
• Storage: see what uses space and shrink long videos

PRIVATE AND SAFE
• Private vault, encrypted on your phone (AES-256) and opened with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode
• Optional vault PIN, a decoy PIN that opens a second, harmless vault, and break-in photos after wrong PINs
• App lock for the whole app
• Transfer photos to your computer over your own Wi-Fi, nothing goes through the internet
• Back up to storage you own: Nextcloud, a NAS or any WebDAV server

UNDO ANYTHING
• Every change Rollwise makes can be undone for 30 days
• Deleted photos go to Recently Deleted, as usual

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your photos never leave your phone unless you send them to your own computer or server
• No account, no ads, no tracking, no data collected

FREE AND PRO
Free: albums, the timeline, the viewer and editor, favourites, tags, the calendar, fixing dates and cleaning one at a time (swipe review deletes up to 50 for free), and a vault for 10 items. Rollwise Pro is one payment, no subscription: bulk date fixing, People and Places, smart search, bulk cleanup and unlimited swipe review, shrinking videos, auto-file rules, an unlimited vault, year in review, Wi-Fi transfer and backup to your own server.

name: Rondly: Golf Scores
description:
Keep every round together with Rondly, a scorecard for golf and mini golf. Track up to 8 players on one iPhone, record each hole and look back at your results.

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Choose golf or mini golf and set up 1 to 36 holes.
- Save players, groups and custom courses for future rounds.
- Record strokes, putts, penalties and notes.
- Pause a round and continue later.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
- Review saved scorecards and round history.
- Compare completed rounds with personal bests, averages and progress charts.
- Share a scorecard image, with an option to hide player names.
- Export a data backup and import it when needed.

Golf records are saved locally on your device. No registration is required.

SUBSCRIPTION
An auto-renewable subscription is required to start new rounds. You can try a sample round before subscribing. Available plans, prices and any trial offers are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings. Deleting the app does not cancel your subscription.

Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EDUQ2z_JyaVcfnNJ9i_h35kzJMsbjLh_W8G2--URXo4
Terms of Use: https://docs.google.com/document/d/18uLAno4xNhGxBuRQrWUKwm1qIHdWuo-hdWPAwzX4ZQM

name: Rootloom
description:
Little visitors. Clever roots. A garden worth protecting.

Welcome to Rootloom, a lively garden defense game where small choices grow into bright little rescues. Groups of curious visitors arrive on their own and walk toward your flowerbeds. Watch the next wave, plant your roots, and catch the crowd before it reaches home.

THREE SEEDS. A DEFENSE THAT REMEMBERS.

Connect three neighboring cells, then tap Bloom. Stack your seeds to focus your shots, spread across nearby columns, or take a bend to divide your power. Every column planted by your previous Bloom lends an extra root echo to the next attack.

Your path stays planted. Tap Bloom again after its short cooldown, or move your roots where they are needed next.

THREE FREE TOOLS. SO MANY LITTLE RESCUES.

• Dewdrop slows the visitors in one lane for five seconds.
• Bramble holds a lane behind a leafy barrier for six seconds.
• Sunburst deals three damage across the chosen lane and its neighbors.

Choose a tool, then tap a lane. Hold a crowd with Bramble, slow a speedy Runner, then clear neighboring lanes with a bright Sunburst. Every fourth wave brings a small supply refill. Tools are free for each attempt and never use your cosmetic leaves.

100 GARDENS TO PROTECT

Discover ten chapters of explicit wave patterns, from small paired arrivals to busy groups of four. Meet sturdy Shellbacks, springy Runners and resting lanes where fresh shots pause but old echoes keep working. Replay your favorite gardens to improve your stars and personal bests.

A BREATHER WHEN YOU NEED IT

Pause freezes the waves. One Rewind per attempt restores the state before your latest root attack or tool, including time and tool charges. Retry freely, with no energy meters or paid revives.

MAKE IT YOUR LITTLE GARDEN

Collect an optional daily gift, earn leaves from successful gardens, and unlock scarf colors for your turnip companion. Keep your top 20 real winning attempts in Local Records, right on your iPhone.

• Tactile cartoon gardens and lively visitor animations.
• Clear wave previews, lane targeting and impact feedback.
• A full 100-level campaign that works offline.
• Replayable How to Play instructions.
• Optional sound and haptics, plus reduced motion.
• No accounts, advertising, subscriptions or in-app purchases.

Weave a little. Save a garden.

name: RotaRush
description:
Rota Rush is a fast, relaxed top-down driving game set on an endless road. How far can you go before you run out of fuel or wreck your car?

HOW TO PLAY
• The road flows down the screen while you steer left and right.
• Drive by tilting your phone, with on-screen buttons or with a game controller.
• Use gas, brake and nitro as you like. On a controller the right trigger is analog: press halfway to go half speed.
• Collect coins, grab fuel cans, and dodge potholes and rocks.
• Hit speed bumps fast and you take off, flying over obstacles.

CARS AND UPGRADES
• 6 different cars, from a city car to a sports car, an SUV to a 4x4 pickup. Each has its own speed, steering, fuel use and durability.
• Upgrade 7 parts on every car: engine, transmission, suspension, tires, fuel tank, brakes and nitro.
• Every car's engine sounds different.

ROADS
• City exit, country road, snow, desert and mountain: 5 different roads. New ones unlock as your record grows.
• Snow is slippery, the desert has long curves, the mountain is narrow and rocky. Each one drives differently.

MISSIONS AND LEADERBOARD
• Complete 3 daily missions and earn bonus coins.
• Race your friends on the Game Center leaderboard and unlock achievements.

ACCESSIBLE TO EVERYONE
• Works with VoiceOver, Larger Text, Bold Text, Reduce Motion, Increase Contrast, Reduce Transparency and Differentiate Without Color.
• Make driving easier with Auto Gas, lane assist and a slower game speed.
• Engine and effect sounds can be turned off in Settings.

For iPhone and iPad. The game is free and contains ads. You can watch ads to earn extra coins or to continue an unfinished run.

Your feedback makes the game better. Happy driving!

name: Rotavibe
description: Rotavibe is a creative spin wheel for daily missions. Choose Focus, Chaos, Social, Night, or Creative orbits, spin for a clear action, then commit and track it in your vibe journal. Forge custom wheels, complete daily challenges, build streaks, and unlock orbit badges. Sign in with Apple, Google, or continue as a guest. A playful way to break routine and turn tiny prompts into real momentum.

name: Route: Offline Trip Planner
description:
Route is the offline-first trip planner that never loses your plan. Build a day-by-day travel itinerary, map every stop, track your budget, and share it with one link — no login, no surprise fees.

PLAN SMARTER, START FASTER
Don't start from a blank page. Explore 100+ ready-made city itineraries with 4,000+ hand-picked places — Tokyo, Paris, Rome, Bangkok, New York, Seoul, Barcelona, Kyoto, Lisbon, Amsterdam, Istanbul, Dubai, Prague and Osaka among them — each with daily routes and local tips you can copy into your own plan in one tap. Go from idea to a finished route in minutes, not hours.

EVERYTHING IN ONE ITINERARY
• Day-by-day builder with numbered map pins and route lines
• Add places by search, dropped pin, coordinates, or a pasted map link
• Notes, food, sightseeing, shopping and to-dos on one simple timeline
• Reorder days, set times, or keep it loose — plan your way

WORKS OFFLINE — NEVER LOSE A TRIP
Your entire itinerary opens and edits with no internet, on a plane or off the grid. Your device is the source of truth, so a flaky connection never costs you a single plan. This is the offline trip planner travelers actually trust — a travel planner offline and on.

BUDGET & EXPENSE TRACKER
Track spending by category with a clean breakdown and live exchange rates. Multi-currency support means Tokyo, Seoul and Bangkok in one journey — with no math and no surprises.

SHARE WITHOUT FRICTION
Send a private link friends open in any browser — no account, no install. Got the app? They open it in Route with one tap. Or share a QR code, or export a clean PDF.

KNOW BEFORE YOU GO
• Hourly weather forecast for your travel dates
• Culture and etiquette tips for 56 countries, so you arrive prepared
• Essentials in one place: visa, eSIM, transport, stay and car reminders
• Store visas, tickets and reservations, and tick off a packing list as you go
• "Open in local maps" hands navigation to your favorite map app

TRACK YOUR TRAVELS
Paint the countries you've visited on a world map, see your percentage of the world, and share your travel map.

BUILT FOR EVERY TRAVELER
Backpackers, digital nomads, families and weekend road trippers. Whether you need a road trip planner for the coast, a vacation itinerary for the family, or a trip itinerary planner for a multi-country journey across borders and currencies — Route is your travel planner, vacation planner and trip organizer in one.

10 LANGUAGES
English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, Español, Português, Русский, 日本語, 한국어.

WHY ROUTE
• Offline-first, so your plan never disappears
• No login required to view shared trips
• PDF export and sharing — no paywall
• No surprise bills, no dark patterns

Plan your next journey the simple way — the offline travel itinerary planner, itinerary maker and trip organizer that just works.

name: Row & Skein
description:
Row & Skein is a calm, focused companion for your knitting. Keep every project, every skein, and every needle in one cozy place — so you can spend your time knitting, not keeping track.

ROW COUNTER
Tap once to count a row. Track multiple projects at once, see your progress at a glance, and never lose your place in a pattern again.

YARN STASH
Catalogue your stash with brand, colour, dye lot, and yardage. See exactly how many skeins and yards you have left, and which project each yarn is promised to.

NEEDLES
Keep an inventory of every needle and hook you own, so you always know what you have before starting something new.

GAUGE HELPER
Knit a swatch, enter your stitches and rows, and Row & Skein tells you if your gauge is too tight or too loose — and which needle size to try next.

SHOPPING LIST
Note the yarn you need for the next cast-on, check it off at the yarn shop, and add it straight into your stash when it comes home.

WIDGETS
See your active project and next row right on your Home Screen.

Row & Skein keeps everything on your device. No account, no sign-in, no tracking. Happy knitting!

name: Ruach Bible
description:
Ruach Bible lets you read Scripture the way you hold a real Bible — right on your screen.

■ A book, not a page
• Open the leather cover to reveal gilded edges and paper pages.
• Pages bend and turn under your finger; flick to turn quickly.
• Two ribbon bookmarks. Tap a ribbon and the pages riffle straight to your place.
• Jump anywhere with the table of contents and chapter cards, or search for any word.

■ Read and mark
• Highlight verses, and underline, circle, or jot notes by hand with a ballpoint pen. Your handwriting stays with its verse even when you change the text size.
• On iPad, write directly with Apple Pencil.
• Choose your text size, and read at night under a warm desk lamp.

■ 16 languages
Bible texts in sixteen languages — including the King James Version, Louis Segond 1910, and Lutherbibel 1912 — are built in, so you can read without an internet connection.

■ Quiet and private
No sign-in, no ads, no tracking. Your place and your marks stay on your device.

■ Styles (optional)
The Bible text and every reading feature are free. Cover, background, and bookmark ribbon styles, plus a Pen Pack (highlighter and ballpoint colors), can be bought inside the app if you like — buy once and keep it; purchases can be restored.

name: RYKVRY - Sleep Recovery Move
description:
RYKVRY brings your available Apple Health readings into one clear daily view.

Review sleep, resting heart rate, heart rate variability, steps, activity and calories when your connected devices provide them. Compatible watches and apps can contribute through Apple Health.

Recovery combines recent sleep and your personal resting heart rate baseline, with Apple Health HRV when available. Body Charge is an estimate based on recovery after sleep, time awake, timed activity and recorded naps. Missing or outdated data is shown clearly instead of inventing a reading.

Record manual sleep separately, follow trends, and use supported widgets and the Apple Watch companion. Some customization features require RYKVRY Plus.

Apple Health permission is optional. Available metrics depend on the source device, permissions and recorded data. Manual sleep alone does not generate recovery or Body Charge.

RYKVRY provides general wellness information. Estimates are not medical measurements, diagnoses or medical advice.

name: Rynune
description:
You know each person's taken hours. What you do not know is the part that remains when those hours are removed — and the much smaller part that remains for everyone at the same time.

Rynune does exactly that arithmetic, and nothing else:

• Each person gets a few busy blocks: a day, a start, an end.
• Touching blocks are merged into one occupied stretch, so the zero-minute space between 09:00–10:00 and 10:00–11:00 is never offered as free.
• The blocks are subtracted from your working window (08:00–21:00 by default).
• The remainders are intersected across the people you choose.

name: Rynvex
description:
You know the rent. You know that one person earns more, that another has two rooms, that a third joined in June. What you do not know is how much each of them should actually pay, and what to do with the two cents left over when you divide.
Rynvex answers both, and nothing else:

• Each person gets an integer weight — 42, 31, 18, 9, or 1, 1, 1 for equal parts.
• A bill is a title, an amount in cents, and the people who share it.
• Each share is `amount × weight ÷ total weight`, carried to a tenth of a cent.
• The shares are floored to whole cents, and the leftover cents go to the largest fractional remainders — one cent each.

The paid shares therefore always add up to the amount on the bill. That is the app's single promise, and it is checked on screen every time.
