name: Samsung TV Remote: Any TV
description:
Samsung TV Remote is a Wi-Fi remote control for smart TVs on iPhone. It works with Samsung, LG, Sony, Philips and Roku TVs, Roku players, and Android TV and Google TV devices, including TCL, Xiaomi and Chromecast with Google TV. It is for anyone who lost the TV remote, has a dead battery, or has several TVs at home. One app keeps all of them and switches between them in one tap, with no account and no ads.

WHAT ONLY THIS REMOTE DOES
• Several TVs in one remote: save the living-room, bedroom and kitchen TVs and switch between them from the TV name at the top of the screen.
• No account and no sign-in: open the app, pick your TV, confirm once on the TV screen, and you are in.
• Button presses go straight from your iPhone to your TV over your home Wi-Fi, not through a server on the internet.
• No ads, anywhere in the app.
• The remote adapts to your TV: buttons your TV does not have are hidden, and the keyboard, apps and number pad appear only when your TV supports them.

SUPPORTED TVS AND HOW THEY CONNECT
• Samsung Smart TVs (Tizen, 2016 and newer): choose Allow on the TV once.
• LG TVs (webOS, 2014 and newer): choose Allow on the TV once.
• Android TV and Google TV (Sony, Philips, TCL, Xiaomi, Hisense Android models, Chromecast with Google TV, TV boxes): type the code the TV shows into your iPhone.
• Sony Bravia TVs, including older models without Android: type the code the TV shows.
• Philips TVs, Android and Saphi models: type the code the TV shows, if it asks for one.
• Roku players and Roku TVs (including TCL, Hisense and Sharp Roku TVs): no pairing needed.

The app finds TVs on your Wi-Fi by itself. Next time it opens straight onto the TV you used last, the way a real remote would.

EVERYDAY FEATURES
• Power, input, home, back, menu, TV settings, info.
• Navigation pad with OK, volume up and down, mute, channel up and down.
• Play, pause, stop, rewind and fast-forward.
• Touchpad: swipe across the screen to move through menus; a long swipe scrolls several items.
• Number pad for typing a channel number.
• Keyboard: type a search on your TV with the iPhone keyboard instead of picking letters with arrow keys (Samsung, LG, Sony, Roku and Philips models that support text input).
• Apps: open apps installed on the TV with one tap. On Android TV and Google TV, quick shortcuts open YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Spotify and Apple TV.
• Turn on the TV from your phone: when a saved TV is asleep and supports wake over the network, the app shows a Turn On button.
• Haptic feedback on every press, which you can switch off.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Your iPhone and your TV must be on the same Wi-Fi network.
• This is a network remote, not an infrared one. It cannot control older TVs without Wi-Fi, cable or satellite boxes, soundbars or AV receivers.
• Amazon Fire TV, Vizio SmartCast and Hisense VIDAA are not supported.
• On Android TV and Google TV, text input from the iPhone keyboard is not available.
• Some streaming apps use their own on-screen keyboard and ignore typed text from the phone.
• The only permission the app asks for is Local Network access, to find your TV.

PREMIUM
All features are part of Premium, which starts with a free trial. Choose a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase. There is no weekly plan. Every plan unlocks every feature for all your TVs. Cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings.

This app is independent and is not affiliated with Samsung, LG, Sony, Philips, Roku, Google, TCL, Xiaomi, Hisense, Sharp, Vizio, Amazon, Netflix, Disney or Spotify.

Privacy Policy: https://wifi-tv-remote.pages.dev/privacy
Terms of Use: https://wifi-tv-remote.pages.dev/terms

name: Sealed Case: Mystery Phone
description:

Each case hands you the phone of someone who died or vanished. The police have an easy answer. Their family doesn't believe it. You get everything they left behind: messages, photos, notes, mail, voice memos, maps, bank, and the apps only they used.

THE PHONE FIGHTS BACK

BUILD YOUR CASE
Every answer goes on your evidence board: suspects, a timeline of the night, and every clue you've confirmed. When you're sure, name who did it, why, and the one clue you'd put in front of a jury.

FAIR, NOT CHEAP
Every answer is on the phone. Stuck? Ask where to look first, then take up to three hints. Typos and natural phrasing are accepted.

- Complete cases, about an hour each
- Every case open from day one
- No ads, no account, no tracking
- Detective ranks and achievements
- Share a spoiler-free "Case Closed" card with friends

All characters and events are fictional. Cases include mature themes (death, crime, betrayal) without graphic content.

COSA FAI DAL TELEFONO

• Chiudi l'intervento — lavoro svolto, che cosa resta da fare e lo stato dell'impianto. Il resoconto arriva all'ufficio già pronto
• Segnala un guasto — se sul posto vedi altro, lo mandi all'ufficio con le foto
• Spese — fotografi lo scontrino del rifornimento e l'app propone importo, litri e data; registri anche pasti e pernottamenti di una trasferta
• Le mie ore — mese per mese, giorno per giorno, con i chilometri
• I miei dati — documenti e attestati, il contratto da firmare, le buste paga, le richieste di ferie e permessi, l'auto in uso
• Magazzino — chi è stato abilitato dall'ufficio fa carichi, scarichi, spostamenti e inventario con i codici a barre
• Avvisi — un intervento assegnato o spostato arriva come notifica

FUNZIONA ANCHE SENZA RETE
Nei seminterrati e nei locali tecnici il campo manca. Inizia, Termina, i materiali, le foto e la chiusura si salvano sul telefono e partono da soli quando la rete torna.

LA POSIZIONE
L'app legge la posizione soltanto quando tocchi Inizia o Termina, per verificare che l'intervento avvenga sul posto. Non rileva la posizione in sottofondo e non traccia gli spostamenti.

I DATI
I dati sono quelli della tua azienda e restano suoi. Vigil Pro li tratta per conto dell'azienda, come responsabile del trattamento.

name: Sezgi: Mesaj Analizi & Cevap
description:
Ne yazsam? "Hahaha" mı yazdı, görüldü mü attı, story'sine mi cevap vereceksin? Sezgi sohbetinin röntgenini çeker: her mesajın alt metnini, tahmini ilgi skorunu ve "kim daha istekli" dengesini gösterir, sana 6 farklı tonda cevap önerir. Sadece "güzel cevap" değil: sohbetini ölçer ve gerekçesini gösterir.

MESAJ RÖNTGENİ
Ekran görüntünün üstünde her balonun yanına renkli bir etiket gelir: "Burada sana top attı", "Kibar ama mesafeli", "Konu değiştirdi". Etikete dokun, neden öyle düşündüğünü gör.

İLGİ SKORU VE DENGE
0–100 arası tahmini ilgi skoru, iki tarafın ilgi çubuğu ve 3 gerekçe. Mesaj sayısı, soru oranı ve cevap süreleri cihazında hesaplanır. Skorlar tahminidir, yorumlar yorumdur.

6 TONDA CEVAP
Doğal, esprili, flörtöz, özgüvenli, sıcak ve net. Her cevabın yanında tahmini dönüş şansı ve risk etiketi. Kısa↔uzun, soğuk↔sıcak kaydırıcılarıyla ayarla, tek dokunuşla kopyala.

TASLAĞIMI PUANLA
Göndermeden önce yazdığını yapıştır. Fazla istekli ya da fazla uzunsa Sezgi uyarır: "GÖNDERME!" ve yerine 3 düzeltilmiş alternatif önerir.

İLK MESAJ

name: Ship O'Clock: Trip Planner
description:
Pay once, no subscription. One voyage is free; $4.99 unlocks every voyage you ever take. Exporting your itinerary, packing list and spending is free either way.

A cruise ship keeps its own clock. In many ports that clock is an hour off the shore's, and all-aboard is always announced in ship time while your phone quietly switches to local time the moment it finds a signal. A phone reading 3:30 and an announcement saying 4:30 can be the same instant. The difference is a missed ship.

Ship O'Clock keeps both clocks and tells you which one every time is on: "Ship time is 1 hour ahead of Cozumel. All aboard is 9:11 PM ship time — 8:11 PM on your phone ashore."

ALL-ABOARD ALERTS THAT DON'T NEED A SIGNAL
Five warnings before every all-aboard: three hours, ninety minutes, an hour, thirty minutes and fifteen minutes. They're handed to iOS in advance, so they fire with the app closed, in airplane mode and with no data at all. The last two break through Focus, because a phone on a beach is usually on Do Not Disturb. Alerts are never behind the paywall.

A COUNTDOWN THAT ROUNDS DOWN
Fifty-nine minutes is shown as 59 minutes, never "1 hour". When the countdown is the reason you start walking back, rounding up is the wrong direction.

ITINERARY
Day by day, numbered the way your cruise line numbers them, with sea days filled in automatically and tender ports flagged.

PACKING
A list built from where you're sailing, how long, how many of you and how many formal nights. After that it's yours to edit. It covers what experienced cruisers learn the hard way: magnetic hooks, why your power strip gets confiscated, and which sunscreen is banned in which ports.

ONBOARD SPEND
Your onboard account kept separate from cash ashore, with daily gratuities projected from day one so the last-night statement isn't a surprise.

PRIVATE BY CONSTRUCTION
No account. No sign-in. No ads. No analytics. Your voyages live on your device and, if you use iCloud, in your own private iCloud. There's no Vibesoft server holding your cruise history.

Ship O'Clock is not affiliated with any cruise line. All-aboard times come from you or from your ship's daily programme; when Ship O'Clock estimates one, it says so on every screen and in every alert.

name: SlingAngle: Rigging Calculator
description:
SlingAngle turns a lift into numbers you can act on. Enter the load, the sling geometry and the hardware rating, and see the tension each leg actually carries — not the average the load would have if every leg pulled its share.

BUILT FOR THE WAY LIFTS GO WRONG
Dividing the load by the number of legs is the mistake that breaks gear. SlingAngle works from real geometry instead. Give it a sling angle or a set of lugs and a centre of gravity, and it solves the equilibrium the way the load really resolves.

TWO-LEG — ANGLE AND TENSION
Enter the load weight and the included angle between the legs. The per-leg factor k = 1/cos(β/2) and the tension per leg update as you move the slider. A geometry preview draws the sling and marks β so you can check the setup matches the lift before you trust the number.

UNEQUAL LEGS — UP TO THREE, WITH AN OFFSET CG
Place each lug in the plan, set its own leg length, and put the centre of gravity where it actually is. SlingAngle solves a 3x3 stiffness system (k = h²/L³) for force and both moments, then reports each leg's tension, its vertical share as a percentage, and its angle off vertical. The governing leg — the one that will fail first — is called out. Slack legs are detected and dropped, and the system is solved again rather than smearing load across a leg that has gone soft. It flags geometry it cannot resolve, a CG outside the lug polygon, and lift conditions that would tip.

ANGLE FACTOR TABLE
A reference table for 30, 45, 60, 90, 105, 120, 135 and 150 degrees showing the factor and the live tension at your current load. Anything above 120 degrees gets a high-risk warning — that is not a range to size quickly.

CHECK — WLL, DERATING AND A RECORD
Compare the calculated tension against the rated working load limit, with hitch derating applied: vertical 1.00, choker 0.80, basket 2.00. Utilisation is shown as a percentage with a pass or over-capacity verdict. A lift record can only be saved after three on-site checks are confirmed — WLL marking legible, lugs and CG verified, inspection in date. Records are numbered (SA-001, SA-002) and stay on your device.

ROUNDED UP, ON PURPOSE
Displayed tensions round up, never down. A reading of 1,155 means the requirement does not fall below 1,155 — it is never rounded to look better than it is.

METRIC OR IMPERIAL
kg / kgf / kN or lb / lbf, switched with one tap. Your inputs and the calculation survive a relaunch, so a plan is not lost when the phone locks mid-job.

SCOPE OF USE
SlingAngle calculates only the inputs you enter. It does not replace a lift plan, manufacturer data, or approval by a qualified person. Calculations reference ASME B30.9 — follow the current edition and the hardware maker's instructions. Recalculate whenever any input changes.

No account. No network connection. No tracking. Everything stays on your phone.

name: Smart Printer: Print & Copy
description:
Smart Printer lets you print from your iPhone or iPad to almost any Wi-Fi printer. Print photos, PDF files, Word, Excel and PowerPoint documents, web pages, copies and labels in a few taps — wireless printing with no drivers, no computer and no cables.

How it works
1. Open Smart Printer. It finds the AirPrint and network printers on your Wi-Fi by itself.
2. Pick what to print: photos, a document, a copy, a web page…
3. Choose copies, paper and color, then tap Print.

Print anything
• Photos: full page, 2 or 4 per page or a collage, with crop, filters and text
• PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, CSV, text and HTML files
• Web pages, with a clean reader view that drops ads and menus
• Files from iCloud Drive and other cloud drives, picked in the Files app
• Email attachments: share them to Smart Printer from Mail or any mail app
• Contacts, notes and plain text
• Share from any app: tap Share ▸ Smart Printer

Copy pages and ID cards
• Take a photo of a page and print a copy that fits the paper
• ID cards: front and back on one sheet, at real size (85.6 × 54 mm)

Templates and tools
• Puzzles: Sudoku, mazes, word searches and maths sheets, with answer keys
• Calendars, weekly and daily planners, habit trackers
• To-do and shopping lists, greeting and thank-you cards
• Lined, dotted, graph and music paper
• Passport and ID photos at the right size, a whole sheet at once
• Posters: split a large image across several pages

Labels and receipts
• Design labels with text, barcodes and QR codes
• Print to Bluetooth and Wi-Fi thermal label makers and receipt printers
• Set label size, darkness and print speed

Works with your printer
• Most AirPrint and IPP Wi-Fi printers (inkjet and laser), found automatically
• Add a printer by its IP address
• See ink levels, paper and printer status
• Copies, page range, pages per sheet, two-sided, color or black & white, paper size and quality
• Print queue, history and one-tap reprint

Private by design
Your files go straight from your device to your printer. No account, nothing uploaded to our servers.

Smart Printer Pro
The free version prints up to 5 jobs a week and shows ads. Smart Printer Pro unlocks unlimited prints, every template, Pro label designs, hard puzzles, ID photos and posters, and removes all ads. Choose weekly (with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers, where available), yearly, or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and the renewal is charged within the 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel subscriptions in Settings ▸ your name ▸ Subscriptions. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

name: Smart Venue
description:
Smart Venué is the all-in-one app for restaurants, cafés, banquet halls, hotels and party venues in India.

BOOKINGS & CALENDAR
• Week and month calendar of every booking — tap any booking to open its full page
• Turn enquiries into bookings, track advance and total bill
• Free / booked dates update your public listing automatically

QR MENU & TABLE ORDERING
• A separate QR for every table — guests scan, order and see the bill (no app or login needed)
• Orders go straight to the kitchen screen with table number, queue number and total
• Guests can ask for everything together, or choose what comes first
• Queue number and estimated time for every order
• Chef’s special / food of the day shown on top of the menu
• GST and service charge added on the bill
• Guests pay your UPI ID directly or in cash — Smart Venué never touches the money

KITCHEN & BILLS
• Live kitchen screen with a sound on every new order
• Cook → Ready → Served, item by item
• Show a UPI QR with the exact amount at the table, or mark cash

EVENTS & TICKETS
• Publish public events (music, comedy, kids, games…) and sell tickets
• Listing on smartvenue.knobee.app so new guests find you

Log in with your mobile number and OTP. Your venue, your data — delete your account any time from the app.

name: SneezeJump: Clay Climb
description: Explore ten starter courses with a bouncing clay nose. Collect pollen and charge a sneeze to cross gaps. Reach each summit and improve your personal bests.

name: Snooker Swap
description:
Swap two balls, line up three or more of the same colour and watch them drop off the table. Snooker Swap is a fast match-three puzzle played on the baize, with the 15 reds in the rack as your clock.

SWAP, MATCH, POT
• Swap any two neighbouring balls, across or up and down, to make a line of three or more
• Longer lines score more: 100 a ball for three, 200 for four, 300 for five
• New balls drop in from the top, and every cascade doubles the points
• Run out of moves? The table quietly helps, so you're never left stuck

THE RACK IS YOUR CLOCK
• Fifteen reds in the triangle count down your time
• Every ball you pot buys a little time back
• Clear each frame's target to refill the rack and move up a frame
• Stuck? Press Hint, or let the board nudge you after a few seconds

SNOOKER BONUS ROUNDS
• Maximum: hit 147,000 points for 30 seconds of double points
• Rocket round: at 5:08 on the table clock, the time of the fastest maximum ever made, quick moves build a multiplier up to ×5
• Clear the colours: pot yellow through to black in order for triple points and a 27,000 clearance bonus
• Century break: score 10,000 from a single move and win extra time
• Respotted black: run out of time just short of the next frame and get 15 seconds of sudden death to win it

FREE BALLS AND SNOOKERS
• The white free ball matches any colour
• Snookered balls sit in a wooden frame and can't be moved until you pot a line next to them

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Easy: a two-minute rack, a fresh board every frame and no black ball
• Normal: the full game, with the black joining at frame 5
• Hard: sixty seconds on the clock, all seven colours from the start and a faster clock

RETRO TOP 10
• An arcade-style high-score table for every mode
• Make the Top 10 and enter your initials, just like the machines in the pub

MADE FOR PLAYING
• Glossy snooker balls, a mahogany table and the click of ball on ball
• Satisfying vibration on every pot
• Works offline. No account, no sign-up, no ads, and no data collected
• iPhone and iPad

name: Soiree: Inspire and Connect
description:
Soiree is a social platform for performing arts students in Manchester. Showcase your work, find people to collaborate with, and discover performance opportunities, all in one place.
Whether you're a musician looking for a filmmaker, a director casting a show, a composer who needs a project, or just looking for inspiration, Soiree helps you find the right people.

You can:
• Build your profile: share your role, genres, skills and past experience
• Share your Works: upload videos, tracks and projects you've been part of and tag other artists
• Post updates: share rehearsals, progress and behind-the-scenes moments
• Find events and gigs: browse performances, auditions and paid opportunities, from societies to venues outside the uni
• Connect and chat: message other artists directly and start collaborating

Choose your roles and favourite genres when you sign up, and Soiree shows you everything that match your interests. Filmmakers can meet composers, directors can find actors, and musicians can find the stage that fits them.
Soiree is designed around real opportunities and connections, not follower counts.
Soiree is launching with the University of Manchester community. Join us and be part of the first artists on the platform!

name: Solstein: Offline Survival AI
description:
Solstein is your companion when there is no signal: out in a dead zone, in airplane mode, or at home during a power outage. Maps, guides, tools and answers live on your iPhone – not in the cloud.

No account. No ads. No data collection.

KNOW WHERE YOU ARE
• Your situation at a glance: place, coordinates, time until sunset, pressure trend, distance to your target
• Offline maps with roads, trails and water, waypoints and track recording
• Backtrack: follow your own track back to the start
• Coordinates in decimal degrees, degrees/minutes/seconds, UTM and MGRS

KNOW WHAT TO DO
• 117 illustrated guides, step by step: water, fire, shelter, first aid, signals, food, navigation, knots, supplies
• Ordered by time: the first 72 hours, the first week, the first month, the first year
• Every guide with difficulty, materials, safety notes and sources
• Knowledge packs to look things up: Wikipedia Medicine, Wikivoyage, Appropedia and the complete Wikipedia

AI THAT ANSWERS ON YOUR DEVICE
• Ask in your own words: “How do I purify water without a filter?”
• The answer comes from the guides on your iPhone – always with sources you can read
• Uses Apple Intelligence where available, otherwise a local language model you download
• Nothing leaves your device

TOOLS
• Compass with bearing, radar for waypoints, sun and moon, stars to find north
• Light with SOS, whistle, Morse (light, sound, vibration), signal mirror
• Altitude and air pressure with storm warning, level with slope angle, timer, converter
• Messages from device to device nearby, with no mobile network at all

EMERGENCY
• Emergency numbers for your country, your position to read out, an emergency card with your details
• Supply planner for home: water and food for your household
• Emergency phrases in several languages

BUILT FOR THE OUTDOORS
• Red-light mode for night vision, sun mode for harsh light
• Large touch targets for cold fingers and gloves
• Widgets for remaining daylight and emergency number, a Live Activity while recording a track

FREE AND PRO
Always free: emergency numbers, emergency card, first aid, the guides for the first 72 hours, compass and signal tools, one map region, Wikipedia Medicine in your language and 5 AI questions.

Solstein Pro unlocks all map regions, all guides, all knowledge packs and unlimited AI questions:
• Monthly subscription
• Yearly subscription with a 7-day free trial
• Lifetime: pay once, keep it forever

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage and cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

IMPORTANT
Solstein does not replace training, a doctor or emergency services. If life is in danger: call emergency services first. Maps and AI answers can contain errors.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://jeremiah-stueve.com/en/solstein/privacy/

name: Soon
description:
Soon — личный менеджер задач для iPhone и Mac. Задачи появляются в нужный день, а до этого не мешают.

СНАЧАЛА «КОГДА», ПОТОМ «ЧТО»
У задачи есть день, когда вы за неё возьмётесь, и отдельно дедлайн. В «Сегодня» только то, что запланировано на сегодня, и встречи из календаря. Просроченное не кричит красным: задача тихо переезжает на следующий день.

ПИШИТЕ КАК ДУМАЕТЕ
Наберите «Купить цветы завтра до пт #дом», и Soon сам поставит дату, дедлайн и тег. Каждое распознанное слово становится чипом, его можно отменить одним нажатием. Понимает русский и английский.

СПИСКИ
• Входящие: всё, что ещё не разобрано
• Сегодня и Вечером: план на день
• Скоро: неделя по дням с дедлайнами и событиями календаря
• В любое время, Архив и Журнал выполненного
• Повторы: «каждый пн», «по будням», «каждые 2 недели»

ПРОЕКТЫ
Проекты с разделами, задачи с заметками, чек-листами и тегами. Прогресс проекта виден сразу.

НА MAC
• Быстрый ввод поверх любого приложения по сочетанию клавиш
• Поиск по ⌘K
• Работа с клавиатуры

ВАШИ ДАННЫЕ — ВАШИ
Задачи хранятся на устройстве и синхронизируются через ваш iCloud между iPhone и Mac. Без регистрации, рекламы и трекинга. Всё работает без интернета.

name: Sortr: AI File & Photo Sorter
description:
Your camera roll is thousands of photos deep. Sortr puts them into albums the way you would, and gets better every time you correct it.

TEACH IT ONCE
Answer a few questions about how you like photos kept. Sortr learns your way of sorting and handles the rest.

IT LOOKS INSIDE, IF YOU SAY YES
Dates and places only go so far. With your yes, Sortr sends a small copy of each photo, with the date, place and camera details taken off, to an AI that says what it shows: a receipt, a meal, a landmark, a pet. Passports, bank cards and private pictures are held back on your iPhone. Say no and Sortr sorts by date and place alone.

SEE BEFORE ANYTHING MOVES
Every sort starts with a preview of the albums it will make. Nothing happens until you say so.

NOTHING IS EVER DELETED
Sortr has no delete button for photos. It only adds photos to albums. Your library stays exactly as it was.

UNDO, EXACTLY
Changed your mind? Remove the albums Sortr made and every photo is still where it was.

YOU STAY IN CHARGE
Every rule Sortr learns is visible. Keep it, mark it as a one off, or tell Sortr to forget it.

WHEN IT IS NOT SURE, IT ASKS
Sortr only files what it is confident about. Anything else waits for you.

PLANS
Basic, Ultra and Professional are yearly subscriptions bought in the app, each with a yearly number of files. They renew automatically through your Apple Account unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the year. Manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://sortrapp.com/privacy

Sorting that gets smarter. Teach it once. It handles the rest.

name: Sotto AI
description:
Sotto is a personal shopper you talk to.

Say what you are looking for, the way you would to someone in a shop: "a jacket for autumn, nothing too heavy". Sotto asks a question or two, remembers what you tell it, and shows real clothing from UK shops, ranked for you. Every top pick comes with a reason tied to something Sotto knows about you.

IT REMEMBERS, SO YOU SAY IT ONCE
Your sizes, the colours you reach for, what you never wear, what you like to spend. Sotto keeps these as short notes and uses them the next time, so the second search asks less and fits better than the first.

YOU CAN SEE EVERYTHING IT KNOWS
The You screen shows every note Sotto has made, grouped and in plain words. Tap one to make Sotto forget it. Delete everything in one step from Settings.

SPARKS
See something you like? Save a photo or a screenshot as a spark. Sotto works out what it is and what it says about your taste, and you can talk it through or ask for things like it.

RANKED, WITH REASONS
Results are not a wall of products. Sotto ranks them against what it knows about you and tells you why the top ones are there. Narrow them by voice or by typing: "only olive or navy", "under £150".

BUY FROM THE SHOP
Sotto does not sell anything. When you find something, it opens the listing so you can buy from the retailer, with their prices, delivery and returns.

TALK OR TYPE
Voice is the quickest way, and you can switch to the keyboard at any point.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
There is no account and no sign-in. What Sotto learns is stored on your iPhone, or in your own iCloud if you turn sync on. Only what each request needs is sent to the services that answer it, and it is never used for advertising.

GOOD TO KNOW
- Sotto currently covers clothing, shoes and accessories from UK retailers, with prices in pounds.
- Sotto uses AI and can get things wrong. Prices, sizes and stock can change, so check the retailer's page before you buy.
- A conversation needs an internet connection.

SUBSCRIPTION
Your first ten conversations are free. After that, Sotto needs a monthly subscription, which renews automatically each month until you cancel. Payment is charged to your Apple account. Manage or cancel at any time in your Apple account settings.

Privacy policy: https://sivabandi.dev/#/privacy/sotto
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Sotto Note
description:
Sotto Note is a notes app that feels like a chat with yourself. No title, no folder, no blank page: you type, speak or share a thought, and it appears as a message in your timeline. Whatever comes later, you add as a reply.

CAPTURE IN SECONDS
Text, link, photo, PDF, map or voice. Notes arrive from any app through the share menu, from the Lock Screen widget, the Action Button, Shortcuts and Siri (“Sotto”). On Apple Watch, you record a note right from your wrist. On the Mac, Cmd-Shift-N opens a quick-capture window above every app.

SPEAK INSTEAD OF TYPING
- Voice notes keep their audio and are also turned into text
- Transcription on your device, the audio never leaves it
- Background recording with a Live Activity and a Stop button
- Pauses in your speech become paragraphs
- Spoken commands like “heading”, “checklist” or “new item”
- Optional Parakeet model: 25 European languages, detected automatically, offline

THREADS, NOT DOCUMENTS
Add more entries to any note later. A thought grows as a timeline. Threads can be chained, embedded and separated again.

REVIEW WITH A SWIPE
Three decks walk you through what has piled up: New, Revisit and Rediscover Library. Swipe right to keep a note active, or send it to the Library.

APPLE INTELLIGENCE, ON YOUR DEVICE
- Collection and tag suggestions, with a strict second check
- Fix spelling and dictation errors, with a before-and-after view
- Reminders from phrases like “tomorrow at 9”
- Structure voice recordings with paragraphs and lists
- Learns from your corrections, without training
You only apply suggestions when you confirm them. Without Apple Intelligence, everything works by hand. The AI works in the language of the note.

ORGANIZATION
Each note lives in at most one collection, plus up to five tags. Full-text search across notes, threads and attachments, including text in images.

WRITING
Headings, lists, quotes, bold and italic show right in the editor. Notes are saved as Markdown, so they stay plain text. On Mac and iPad with a Format menu and keyboard shortcuts.

OBSIDIAN AND MARKDOWN
Export a note to Obsidian, as a new note with an AI title and tags or appended to an existing one. Back up all notes as Markdown files and import .md files, including from Obsidian.

SECURE AND PRIVATE
- No account, no server, no ads, no tracking
- iCloud Sync only if you turn it on, in your private account
- Lock single notes or whole collections with Face ID or Touch ID
- The Trash empties itself after a period you choose

FOR IPHONE, IPAD, MAC, APPLE WATCH AND APPLE VISION PRO
The app is available in English and German.

PAY ONCE, DONE
Try everything free for 7 days. Afterwards, you unlock Sotto Note once to add new notes. No subscription. Your notes always stay readable, searchable and exportable. One purchase covers iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch and Apple Vision Pro; the Mac has its own unlock.

name: Sotto: AAC Autism Talk Yes/No
description:
When speech is hard, tap instead.

Sotto is a dignified, low-stimulus AAC (Augmentative and Alternative Communication) app built for autism, speech delays, sensory overload, and crisis meltdowns.

Built by a father for his two autistic sons who can speak but not always. During sensory overload or a meltdown, operating a device is difficult. Instead, the caregiver opens Sotto, rotates the screen face-to-face, and the communicator taps Yes, No, or Wait to pinpoint the problem with zero friction.

We use Sotto in two distinct AAC modes:

MODE 1: DAILY INDEPENDENT AAC (Communicator holds device)
For complex thoughts, noisy environments, school, or communicating with new people. The user opens Sotto independently and taps visual cards across Needs, Social, Care, and General categories, or types in the Quick-Speak dock. Tap once to speak aloud with offline system text-to-speech, or long-press for a giant fullscreen card readable across a room without vocalizing.

MODE 2: CRISIS & MELTDOWN PARTNER MODE (Caregiver holds device)
Designed to stop meltdowns at home and in public. Caregivers open Sotto, activate Partner Mode, and flip the screen 180 degrees face-to-face. Your loved one sees giant tactile buttons and taps Yes, No, Wait, Repeat, Not sure, or Stop. No complex branching menus, no confusing symbol trees. That simple tap becomes their voice when speech shuts down.

Why Sotto works for Autism & AAC:
• Direct Yes/No Pinpoint Cards: Giant tactile buttons with clear haptic feedback designed for overwhelmed or shaking hands.
• Two-Way Caregiver Partner Mode: Talk HUD with voice dictation, question bank, read-aloud prompts, and 180-degree flip display on iPhone and iPad.
• High-Contrast Safety Bystander Card: Guided emergency safety setup and amber hero card for nonverbal episodes and community safety.
• 3-Step Welcome Setup: Low-stimulus onboarding flow to configure voices, emergency contacts, and accessibility preferences.
• Single-Row Quick-Speak Dock: Spontaneous typing, fullscreen presentation, and one-tap phrase saving.
• Resilient Speech Recognition: Speech-to-text dictation using on-device Apple speech recognition for private, reliable voice input.
• Low-Stimulus Sensory Design: Dark-neutral color palettes, sensory themes, compact card options, and zero cartoon clutter.
• Multilingual Offline Speech: High-fidelity voice playback across supported system languages using on-device synthesis.
• Private Pattern Logger: After resolution, optionally log Pain, Sensory, Task, or Emotion triggers locally to identify 30-day patterns.
• Offline QR Deck Sharing: Share custom phrase decks across devices via encrypted QR codes with zero cloud dependency.
• Flexible Backup: Category-filtered export and import for custom phrases, question trees, and trigger logs.

Who Sotto is built for:
• Autistic individuals, neurodivergent communicators, and those experiencing sensory overload or autistic burnout.
• Nonspeaking, minimally verbal, or situational nonverbal teens and adults.
• Children and adults with speech delay, apraxia of speech, dysarthria, or aphasia.
• Caregivers, parents, special education teachers, and Speech-Language Pathologists (SLPs) looking for a rapid, low-stimulus communication tool.

100% offline core. Zero accounts, zero ads, zero third-party trackers. All custom cards and personal logs remain strictly on your device.

Sotto is an assistive communication tool and does not provide medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

amhlink.com/sotto

name: sourswat
description:
Give sugar cravings a swat. Sourswat is a 30-day challenge to help you cut back on sweets and see how the small wins add up.

MAKE A PROMISE TO THE CAT
Choose no sweets for 30 days, one treat a day, or one sweet day a week.

SWAT THE SWEETS YOU SKIP
Tap “swat it” when you pass on something sweet. Had a treat? Log it and keep going. See the sweets you skipped, the sweets you ate, and the days you kept your promise.

KEEP YOUR PROGRESS IN SIGHT
Check your progress with a Home Screen widget, share a weekly recap, or set an optional reminder for the time you usually want something sweet.

The tracker requires an auto-renewing subscription. Monthly and yearly plans are available. If you’re eligible and a trial or introductory price is available to you, the app shows the offer and renewal price before you buy. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://www.sourswat.com/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: SPA Booking: Nails & Beauty
description:
SPA Booking brings partner nail and beauty salons together in one app. See who's open now, compare services and prices across salons, and book in a few taps.

FIND A SERVICE
• Search every salon's menu at once: manicures, spa pedicures, Gel-X, acrylics, lashes, facials, waxing and more
• Each result shows the salon, price and time

SALONS AT A GLANCE
• Live "Open now" status in each salon's own time zone
• Call or get directions with one tap
• Pick up where you left off at the salon you used last

BOOK IN SECONDS
• Choose services, a day and a time, with anyone available or your favorite technician
• Instant confirmation, plus "Add to calendar"

CHAT WITH EACH SALON'S 24/7 CONCIERGE
• Ask questions, check availability and book by text or voice, day or night

MANAGE YOUR VISITS
• See, reschedule or cancel bookings with a code texted to your phone

FOR SALON STAFF
• Team members sign in with their salon PIN to see the day's calendar, add and move appointments

name: Spaceroll: Phone Cleaner
description:
Storage almost full? Spaceroll finds what takes up space in your photo library (duplicates and similar shots, screenshots, screen recordings, big videos and Live Photos) and helps you clear it out. Everything runs on your iPhone: no ads, nothing uploaded, nothing deleted without you.

SEE WHAT YOU CAN GET BACK
• One scan shows how much space each category takes, with counts
• Similar photos, screenshots, screen recordings, large videos, Live Photos and blurry shots
• Later scans only look at new photos, so they're quick

SIMILAR PHOTOS, BEST SHOT PICKED
• Bursts and retakes are grouped, exact duplicates included
• Spaceroll picks the sharpest, best-looking shot to keep
• Compare side by side, tap for full screen, then delete the rest in one tap
• The best shot of every group is always kept

SWIPE THROUGH YOUR MONTHS
• Swipe left to delete, right to keep, with undo
• Free: your first 30 deletions, in the current month. Every other month and unlimited deleting come with Pro
• You confirm at the end of each batch

VIDEOS AND LIVE PHOTOS
• Large videos sorted by size; tap one to play it full screen
• Compress a video and keep its date, location and favorite (Pro)
• Keep just the still of a Live Photo (Pro)
• Originals are replaced only after you confirm

YOUR PHOTOS, YOUR CALL
• Nothing is deleted automatically: you choose, then iOS asks you to confirm
• Deleted items go to Recently Deleted, where you can restore them for 30 days
• Blurry photos are shown for review, never pre-selected
• No ads, no account, no analytics, nothing collected. Nothing leaves your iPhone.

SPACEROLL PRO
Unlimited deleting in every category, bulk delete, video compression, Live Photo to still, swiping through any month, and a monthly re-scan reminder. Without Pro you get the full scan, one group of similar photos and your first 30 swipe deletions.

Pro is available weekly with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers, yearly, or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase (after the trial, if you start one). Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings, or right from Spaceroll's Settings.

Terms of Use: https://clausewl.com/apps/spaceroll/terms
Privacy Policy: https://clausewl.com/apps/spaceroll/privacy

name: SpalonPro Events
description:
SpalonPro Events is a dedicated platform for discovering, promoting, and managing events across the beauty industry.

Whether you are an event organizer, beauty professional, trainer, academy, brand, or attendee, SpalonPro Events helps bring the beauty community together.

DISCOVER BEAUTY EVENTS

Explore events, exhibitions, workshops, training programs, conferences, and industry gatherings.

FOR EVENT ORGANIZERS

Build your event presence and connect with your target audience.

Discover opportunities to:
• Create and showcase events.
• Promote events to relevant audiences.
• Manage event registrations.
• Organize attendees and event participation.
• Build your event brand.

EVENT REGISTRATION & EXPERIENCE

Access event information and participate in the beauty ecosystem through a connected event experience.

FOR BEAUTY PROFESSIONALS

Discover learning opportunities, workshops, exhibitions, networking opportunities, and industry events.

WHY SPALONPRO EVENTS?
• Dedicated beauty event ecosystem.
• Discover events and professional opportunities.

name: Speak Tech English
description:
Speak Tech English helps software engineers and tech professionals speak English with confidence at work.

TALK WITH AN AI COACH
Have real spoken conversations, any time. Pick a topic and start talking.
- Today's tech news: read a short story, then discuss it
- Stand-ups, code reviews and incident updates
- Job interviews and salary talks
- Small talk with your team

HEAR REAL ACCENTS
Choose the accent your coach speaks with: British, American, Indian, Singaporean, Chinese or Russian. Get used to the voices you hear in global tech teams.

FEEDBACK AFTER EVERY TALK
- Your grammar mistakes, with a simple rule and examples
- More natural ways to say what you said
- Better words for your level
- Pronunciation tips
- A short quiz on each mistake

LEARN A LITTLE EVERY DAY
- A daily tech news lesson at your level
- Tap any word to see what it means
- Save words and review them with flashcards
- Daily tasks that take a few minutes

FREE TO START
You get free coach minutes every day. Want more? Choose a monthly plan or a one-time top-up.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
- Starter and Pro are monthly subscriptions that renew automatically.
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase.
- Your subscription renews unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period.
- Manage or cancel any time in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://speaktechenglish.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://speaktechenglish.com/privacy

name: Spin Pop: Color Ring Puzzle
description:
Turn the rings, line up the gems and pop them! Spin Pop is a fresh one-tap puzzle: tap a ring to rotate it, and when one color runs all the way from the center to the edge, the whole spoke pops. Clear the board before you run out of moves.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap the right side of a ring to turn it clockwise, the left side to turn it back.
• Line up one color across every ring to pop that spoke.
• Clear all the gems within the move limit.
• Watch out for chained rings: they turn together!

FEATURES
• An original ring-spinning color puzzle
• Hundreds of levels, every one checked to be solvable
• Chained rings, more colors and bigger boards as you progress
• Undo and smart hints when you are stuck
• Juicy pops, satisfying sounds and haptics
• Play offline, anytime
• English and Turkish

Spin Pop is free to play and supported by ads. Remove ads with a one-time purchase, or grab a hint pack.

name: Splutter: Speaker Cleaner
description:
Phone got wet in the rain, the pool or the sink, and now the sound is muffled? Splutter plays special tones through your iPhone speaker so it vibrates and helps push out water and dust.

WATER EJECT
A 165 Hz tone plays for 60 seconds at full volume while your phone buzzes. Lay the phone face down and water has a way out.

DUST CLEAN
A sweep from low to high (100 Hz to 3,000 Hz) shakes loose dust and lint, three times over 30 seconds.

CHECK YOUR SPEAKER
Sound Check plays a short chime and asks how it sounds: clear or muffled. If it is still muffled, Splutter suggests another round and gives honest drying tips. Speaker Test beeps on the left and right sides so you can hear each speaker.

SIMPLE AND HONEST
- Your first clean is free. If it still sounds muffled after that clean, you get one more free.
- Speaker Test and Sound Check are always free.
- No ads, no account and no sign-up.
- Your list of cleans stays on your phone.
- Clear steps before every clean: volume up, Bluetooth headphones off, phone face down, case off.
- Run 2 more rounds in one tap when water needs a few goes.

Splutter helps clear water and dust from your speaker. It can't repair a damaged speaker. If the sound stays muffled after a few tries, take your phone to a repair shop.

SPLUTTER PRO
Unlimited Water Eject and Dust Clean for $5.99 per year, after a 3-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when the trial ends, and the subscription renews each year unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings.

Privacy Policy: https://drytone.app/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://drytone.app/terms/

name: SportBeat
description:
SportBeat 是一间随身携带的节奏工作室。为跑步、散步、专注或放松选择音乐，让粒子球随声音呼吸，也让你亲手塑造每个音色。

即点即播，锁屏继续
内置 32 首完整音乐 Pattern、16 种风格和四张免费 MD。每张 MD 含 8 首曲目，按盘内顺序循环。支持后台与锁屏播放、控制中心、耳机和 AirPlay。离线音乐无需账号或 AI 密钥。

保留细节的声音工作室
六轨合成器与鼓机、钢琴卷帘、滤波器、包络、失谐、延迟、混响及四路 LFO 表情，均可在原生界面调整。多层 Hz 提供双耳节拍、等时脉冲和泛音。双耳效果需要立体声耳机；Hz 属于声音设计，不承诺健康或认知效果。可导出 MIDI 和完整 MD 文件。

持续创作，可由你配置
先选择想做的事和此刻的感觉，AI 可创作新的旋律、节奏及 Hz 设计。每首约 3–5 分钟，播放期间继续准备下一首；新曲采用平滑过渡，底鼓衔接后逐步使用新曲设定。AI 教练支持对话、训练计划和音乐调整，也可清空重新开始。后台 AI 创作需要联网，并受 iOS 调度影响；暂不可创作时由离线音乐接力。

AI 为可选功能：默认连接 AgentLLM，服务地址、模型和推理强度可自行修改。请填写你自己的兼容服务 API 密钥，并明确允许发送创作输入和对话。App 不附带 AI 密钥或额度；服务商可能另行计费。

跟随脚步，参考身体状态
经你授权，可在本机读取 HealthKit 心率、静息心率和 HRV，以及 iPhone 步频。有效步频可带动音乐速度，心率参考可触发你设置的音乐放缓提醒。健康记录与实测步频不会自动附带到 AI 请求。历史或缺失数据会明确提示。

SportBeat 用于音乐与一般运动体验，不提供医疗诊断、治疗或安全保证。心率数据需 Apple Watch 或其他写入健康 App 的数据源；无需健康授权也可播放音乐。

name: Sri Sinharaja Audiobooks
description:
No time to sit down and read? Listen instead.

Sri Sinharaja Audiobooks brings books that change how people think, read aloud in full, to your phone for free.

ON THE SHELF TODAY (41 books, over 240 hours)
- Buddhist teachings: The Dhammapada, The Diamond Sutra, The Gospel of Buddha, The Buddhist Catechism, Verses of the Senior Nuns and Monks, and 15 English translations of the Venerable Rerukane Chandawimala Maha Thera, including The Four Noble Truths and The Method of Satipatthana Meditation
- Wisdom: Meditations by Marcus Aurelius, As a Man Thinketh, The Science of Getting Rich, Acres of Diamonds, Self-Help
- Poetry: The Prophet, Gitanjali, The Light of Asia
- Lives: The Autobiography of Benjamin Franklin, Up From Slavery
- Stories: A Christmas Carol, The Time Machine, Heart of Darkness
- For children: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, Peter Pan, Aesop's Fables, The Giant Crab and Other Tales from Old India

MADE FOR LISTENING ANYWHERE
- Keeps playing with the screen locked and in the background
- Car mode with big buttons
- New books appear on the shelf by themselves, no update needed

Every book links to its printed edition on srisinharaja.com, delivered to your home anywhere in Sri Lanka.

Free. No account. No ads.

name: Stack Calc: RPN & Bit Tools
description:
Keep the values and the steps together. Stack Calc is an offline RPN calculator with a visible stack and calculation tape.

Enter values with ENTER, inspect each successful operation, undo and redo, and save useful command sequences as presets. Exact integers and approximate scientific results are clearly distinguished.

Use scientific functions and angle modes, inspect fixed-width signed or unsigned bits, switch binary/decimal/hex views, and convert supported units.

Your work stays on your device. Export a complete checked backup through Files or the system share sheet, then inspect and confirm a backup before restoring it. A short spotlight guide runs in an isolated example and leaves your personal work intact.

One paid download. No account, subscription, additional feature purchase, advertising or developer analytics. English, Korean and Japanese interfaces.

name: StarChat
description:
StarChat es una app de mensajería para hablar con tus contactos y grupos.

Qué incluye:
- Chats uno a uno y grupos con administradores.
- Canales para publicar avisos a muchas personas.
- Notas de voz, fotos, videos y archivos.
- Estados que desaparecen a las 24 horas.
- Llamadas de voz y de video.
- Chats, grupos y llamadas cifrados de extremo a extremo (los canales y los estados no lo están).
- Mensajes temporales, mensajes destacados y búsqueda.
- Bloquear a una persona y reportar usuarios o mensajes desde la propia app.

Cómo se protegen tus datos: la comunicación con el servidor viaja cifrada (TLS). Los chats uno a uno, los grupos, las difusiones y los mensajes guardados, con sus archivos, notas de voz y llamadas, están cifrados de extremo a extremo: se cifran en tu dispositivo y el servidor solo guarda texto cifrado y no tiene las llaves. NO son de extremo a extremo: los canales, los chats con bots, los estados, las fotos y nombres de perfil y de grupo, los avisos del sistema y los metadatos (quién habla con quién y cuándo). Esos contenidos se guardan cifrados en el servidor con una llave que el servidor administra, así que el servidor puede acceder a ellos para operar el servicio, cumplir la ley o atender reportes de abuso. Los mensajes anteriores a la activación del cifrado de extremo a extremo pueden seguir sin él hasta que la persona los cifre o los borre.

Entras con tu número de teléfono y un código por SMS; no necesitas contraseña. La app es para personas de 18 años o más. Puedes borrar tu cuenta y tus datos desde la app (menú, Borrar mi cuenta) o en la web, en la página de borrado de cuenta.

StarChat es gratuita, sin anuncios y sin compras.

name: Steak. Done well.
description:
Cooking steak for more than one person is a timing problem. One wants a rare fillet, one a medium rump, one a well-done sirloin, and they all need to reach the plate together.

Steak. Done well. sorts it out. Tell it who's eating, what cut they've got and how they like it. It works backwards from the longest cook and tells you exactly when each steak goes on, when to turn it, and when everything comes off to rest.

• 1 to 10 steaks, each with a name, cut, doneness and time
• Suggested times for fillet, sirloin, rump, ribeye and T-bone, from blue to well done
• Nudge any time to suit your hob, then save it as a regular
• One clock, started as the first steak goes on
• An alert for every cue, even with the phone locked
• A rest timer, because resting isn't optional
• Pan, griddle or ceramic barbecue

The house rules: season it before it cooks. Oil the meat, not the pan. Once it's on, leave it alone. Turn it once, half way. No prodding, no squeezing. Rest it.

No account, no ads, no data collected. Suggested times are starting points. Your hob, your call.

name: Stillshape
description:
A few pieces. One perfect fit.

Stillshape is a quiet shape-fitting puzzle for iPhone. Drag the pieces, tap to turn them, and fill the outline completely.

There are no timers, progress meters or right-and-wrong signals while you work. Explore an arrangement at your own pace. The game celebrates only when the whole puzzle is complete.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Play: fresh puzzles at Easy, Medium or Hard
• Packs: 270 puzzles in nine finite collections
• Every puzzle has one solution, allowing a rotation of the whole board
• Pieces rotate but never flip

A LITTLE ROOM TO THINK
• A skippable visual introduction and replayable How to play
• An optional Hint that briefly shows a suggested placement
• Reset to return the pieces to their original scatter
• Local saving and Continue puzzle
• Sound, haptics and Reduced Effects settings

Works offline. No accounts, ads, analytics or in-app purchases. Your progress stays on your device.

Made by LOPL.

name: Stitchspan
description:
Stitchspan — நீங்கள் அறிந்த அளவை ஒரே வரிசையில் US, UK, EU, ஜப்பான், சீனா போன்ற முறைகளுக்கு மாற்றிக் காட்டும் அளவு நிரந்தரக் கையேடு.

மோதிரம், காலணி, ஆடை, தொப்பி, பெல்ட், சூட் ஆகியவற்றுக்கு உள்ளுறை அட்டவணைகள்; பகுதிக் குறியீடு மாற்றம்; வீட்டிலேயே அளவிடும் வழிகாட்டி; பல நபருக்கான தனிப்பட்ட அளவு கோப்புகள் மற்றும் குறிப்புகள்; அடிக்கடி பயன்படும் வரிசைகளை சேமித்தல்.

இணைய இணைப்பு தேவையில்லை — தரவு உங்கள் தொலைபேசியில் சேமிக்கப்படுகிறது. திறந்தவுடன் பயன்படுத்தலாம்.

name: StoryStakes
description:
Read, Learn & Earn. StoryStakes turns reading practice into something young readers actually want to do.

Your child reads each story out loud. Every word lights up as they say it, so they practise saying words correctly and really read the whole story instead of skimming. After every story there are a few comprehension questions to check they understood what they read. Then they earn the rewards you choose: screen time, pocket money, or both.

Ages 4 to 13, from first words to confident readers. Great for families, and totally free.

READ OUT LOUD
• Words light up the moment your child reads them
• Stuck on a word? Tap "Hear word" to hear it, or let the app say it after a few seconds
• Choose a reading font, text size and spacing for each child, including dyslexia-friendly options

LEARN
• Questions after every story check real understanding
• Bonus rewards for getting them right on the first try
• Five reading levels. The app suggests a starting level based on age, and readers can always pick easier or harder stories

EARN
• Parents set the rewards: minutes of screen time and/or pocket money for every finished story
• Pick your currency, set a daily maximum, and mark money as paid out
• Points, stars, daily streaks and over 80 trophies to collect

HUNDREDS OF ILLUSTRATED STORIES
• Every story has its own illustration
• Short stories for beginners up to longer, chapter-style tales
• New daily stories to keep the streak going

MAKE IT THEIRS
• 25 illustrated avatars, with more to unlock by reading
• Six colour themes, including a dark Night mode
• Several children can each have their own reader profile

FOR PARENTS
• A PIN-protected parent area for rewards and settings
• See screen time and pocket money earned, with a full history
• Optional reading reminders

StoryStakes is free to download and use, with no subscriptions.

name: Study Spot Education
description:
Study Spot puts every assignment in one place, so you always know what's due and what to work on next.

Connect Google Classroom, Google Calendar and Blackboard, and your coursework and due dates come in automatically. Add anything else yourself in seconds. Then plan your week, get reminded before things are due, and see your progress add up.
EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE • Assignments from Google Classroom, Google Calendar and Blackboard, plus your own • Unfinished, Completed and Graded lists, with filters and sorting • Overdue and due-today at a glance • Mark work done in Study Spot and turn it in on Google Classroom too
PLAN YOUR WEEK • A month calendar of everything that's due • Drag an assignment to another day to reschedule it • Classes with colors, teachers, rooms and meeting times
NEVER MISS A DUE DATE • Reminders hours or days before each due date, at the times you choose • Do Not Disturb hours for quiet evenings • Live Activity five minutes before class, with a countdown and what's due today
FOCUS • Built-in study timer with focus sessions and short and long breaks • Keeps counting on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island • Your study time is saved to your history
STAY ORGANIZED • Subtasks, notes and progress for every assignment • Points and scores with letter grades, using your own grading scale • Templates for the assignments you create often • Classroom attachments right inside the assignment
STAY MOTIVATED • Streaks for every class: finish everything on time to keep yours going • Insights that show how much you complete each week • An optional leaderboard
WIDGETS • Up Next on your Home Screen and Lock Screen • Your best streak at a glance
PRIVATE AND SECURE • Sign up with just a username — no email address needed • Two-factor authentication with an authenticator app or a passkey • No ads, no analytics, no tracking • Delete your account and all of its data at any time from Settings
ON EVERY DEVICE Use the same account on iPhone, iPad, Android and the web at studyspot.education.
Some schools only allow approved apps to connect to school Google or Blackboard accounts. If yours does, Study Spot can draft an email asking your school's IT team to approve it, and you can always add assignments yourself.

name: Sudoku Solver AI: Scan & Solve
description:
Stuck on the newspaper sudoku? Snap a photo and get unstuck your way: a gentle nudge, a hint that explains the logic, or the full solution.

Sudoku Solver AI reads the grid with your camera, lets you fix any misread digit in one tap, then shows you exactly how the next number is found.

SCAN IN SECONDS
• Point your camera at a puzzle from a newspaper, puzzle book, printout or screen
• Or pick a screenshot or photo from your library
• The grid is found and straightened automatically, and you can drag the corners if needed
• Prefer typing? Enter the grid by hand with a quick keypad

FIX MISREADS IN ONE TAP
• Digits the scanner is unsure about glow yellow, so you check those first
• Tap any cell to change or erase it, with undo always one tap away
• Your starting clues are locked, so you never overwrite them by accident

HINTS THAT EXPLAIN WHY
Choose how much help you want, one step at a time:
• Nudge: shows where to look
• Explain: names the technique and highlights the cells that prove it
• Reveal: fills in that one cell, and nothing more
Hints use real solving techniques: full house, naked single, hidden single, pointing, claiming, naked pairs and hidden pairs. When the next step needs a more advanced technique, the app says so honestly and offers to reveal a single cell instead.

WATCH THE FULL SOLVE
• Tap Solve for an animated reveal, cell by cell
• Show or hide pencil marks (candidates) at any time

HONEST GRID CHECKS
• Duplicate digits in a row, column or box are flagged before you solve
• If a grid has no solution, the app points to the digits most likely misread
• If a grid has more than one answer, you are told so instead of being shown a random one

PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
• Free, with no ads and no account
• Scanning and solving run entirely on your device, even offline
• Your photos never leave your phone

Supports classic 9×9 sudoku.

Built by a small independent studio. Your feedback shapes every update.

Privacy Policy: https://sudokusolverai.2fresh-studio.com/privacy/

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Sumbies: Count the Dead
description:
Three lanes. Three sums. One squad between the horde and the end of the road.
Pick the sum that grows your squad, then shoot through everything that comes.

Drag to choose a lane. Plus adds survivors, minus takes them, times and divide change everything, and sometimes every lane takes and you choose what to lose. The bigger your squad, the harder it hits. Get it wrong and the horde walks through you.

A HUNDRED SECTORS, TWENTY BOSSES
• Twelve places, from the evacuation route to the snow pass
• A boss at the end of every stretch, each with a move of its own to dodge
• Crates to shoot open: miniguns, rockets, an arc lance, a tank
• Trades: give up part of your squad for coins or a weapon, or risk it on a coin toss

TWENTY SURVIVORS
• Your whole squad is the survivor you pick
• Nine ways to shoot: rifle, crossbow, longbow, sniper, shotgun and more
• Every survivor ranks up as you play them

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
• Endless: how far can you go?
• Horde: one road, a horde that never stops
• Boss Rush: all twenty, one after another
• A daily run with a new twist every day
• Ten Threat levels: the whole campaign again, harder, each with a rule of its own

FAIR BY DESIGN
• No ad ever plays unless you tap for it
• Everything that helps you play can be earned by playing. Paid survivors shoot differently, not harder
• No loot boxes, no energy timers, no countdowns
• Plays offline and saves itself: no account, no sign-in

Character models were machine-generated from Sawgrove's own concept art with Tencent Hunyuan 3D 2.0 and then reworked. Tencent is not affiliated with and does not endorse this game.

name: Sumvo
description:
Sumvo brings your sales from different channels together in one calm overview. See at a glance what you sold today, what still has to ship and which deadlines are coming up.

WORKS WITH
• bol (Retailer API)
• WooCommerce
• Etsy
• Shopify
• Amazon (Selling Partner API)

OVERVIEW
• Revenue for today, this week and this month, also across currencies
• Open orders and orders with a shipping deadline that is near or has passed
• Products, quantities and amounts per order
• Widgets on your Home Screen and Lock Screen

PRIVACY FIRST
• Your orders stay on your iPhone
• Keys and access are stored securely in the Keychain
• Sumvo does not retrieve customer details: no names, addresses or email addresses
• No ads, no tracking

SUMVO FREE
• One sales account, on any platform
• Overview, small widget and daily summary
• Demo with fictitious data to look around

SUMVO PRO
• Multiple sales accounts, including several shops on the same platform
• All your revenue and orders together, with a filter per account
• All widgets, including on your Lock Screen
• Notifications for new orders and shipping deadlines
• Monthly or yearly, with a one-week free trial for new subscribers

Sumvo Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy: https://sumvo.app/privacy/
Terms: https://sumvo.app/terms/

name: Sunbound: Planet Merge
description:
Drop planets. Merge pairs. Reach the Sun.

Sunbound is a calm cosmic puzzle about one simple idea: two identical planets merge into the next one. Start with a tiny Asteroid, build up through the Moon, Mars, Earth, Neptune and Saturn, and grow all the way to Jupiter and the Sun — without letting the pile climb above the line.

SIX WAYS TO PLAY
• Classic — play for your best score
• Zen — relax: you can’t lose
• Blitz — two minutes to score as much as you can
• Orbit — gravity pulls everything to the center; launch planets along an arc and keep the pile inside the ring
• Daily challenge — the same setup for everyone: create the target planet in a limited number of moves
• Expedition — 20 levels on a starry map, up to three stars each, asteroid belts and low-gravity Moon zones

WHY YOU’LL LIKE IT
• 11 lovable planets, each with a real fact you unlock
• Surprises: a rare Comet that merges with anything, and a Supernova when you reach the Sun
• Boosters: Bomb and Shake for sticky moments
• Unlock phone tilt with coins you earn and nudge the planets
• Color themes to make it yours
• Missions and ranks, from Stargazer to Galaxy Keeper
• Five languages: English, Русский, Español, Deutsch, Français

CALM BY DESIGN
No ads. No accounts. No timers pushing you. No data collected — everything stays on your iPhone, and the game works offline. Coins are earned by playing and spent only in the game.

Questions? hello@rebusarium.com

name: Sunrise Alarm - Wake Up Light
description:
Wake up to a gradual sunrise from a light you already use with Apple Home.

Create sunrise plans around your schedule. Choose a wake time and repeat days, then set how long the sunrise lasts and how many brightness steps it uses. Preview the progression on screen before saving. Use the plan list to edit, pause, or resume your routines.

Sunrise Alarm saves your plan as Apple Home scenes and automations. Your connected home hub runs them, so the app can be closed when the sunrise starts. If you switch the light off during a sunrise, the remaining steps will leave it off.

A compatible dimmable color light in Apple Home and a connected HomePod or Apple TV home hub are required for real automations. Try Demo Mode from the More menu to explore with sample lights and plans.

name: SunWindow
description:
unWindow arvioi, mihin kellonaikaan suora auringonvalo osuu ikkunaan tai parvekkeelle. Valitse kaupunki tai anna omat koordinaatit ja UTC-aikaero. Aseta ikkunan suunta ja arvioi valoa peittävän esteen korkeus- ja leveyskulma.

Päivänäkymän käyrä näyttää auringon korkeuden ja arvioidut ajat, jolloin aurinko paistaa ikkunaan. Kosketa käyrää nähdäksesi kellonajan, auringon korkeuskulman ja sen, onko aurinko ikkunan edessä tai esteen peitossa. Näet myös suoran auringonvalon kokonaiskeston, päivänvalon pituuden ja aurinkokeskipäivän.

Vuosinäkymä vertailee suoraa auringonvaloa kuukausittain ja näyttää, miten auringon korkeus ja esteet vaikuttavat eri vuodenaikoina. Voit tallentaa useita paikkoja ja vaihtaa esimerkiksi itään avautuvan olohuoneen ja etelään avautuvan parvekkeen välillä. Mukana on 12 esimerkkikaupunkia ja käytännön vinkkejä valaistuksen arviointiin.

Arvio perustuu auringon sijaintiin ja antamiisi kulmiin. Sää ja heijastukset jäävät laskennan ulkopuolelle. Sovellus toimii ilman verkkoyhteyttä, ja tallennetut paikat pysyvät laitteella. Käyttöliittymä on saatavilla englanniksi ja yksinkertaistetuksi kiinaksi.

name: Supur
description:
Süpür, galerini bir oyun gibi temizlemeni sağlar. Fotoğraf ve videoları tek tek kaydır, kararını ver, devam et.

NASIL ÇALIŞIR
• Sağa kaydır: sakla
• Sola kaydır: çöp kutusuna at
• Yukarı kaydır: iOS Favorilerine ekle
• Aşağı kaydır: albüme ekle ya da yeni albüm oluştur
• Yanlış mı yaptın? Geri al ile bir önceki karara dön

GÜVENLİ SİLME
Sildiklerin hemen silinmez. Önce çöp kutusunda toplanır, istediğini geri alırsın, sonunda tek onayla toplu silersin. Silinen öğeler iOS'ta 30 gün boyunca "Son Silinenler" albümünde de durur.

TEMİZLEMEK İÇİN FARKLI YOLLAR
• Rastgele, En yeniler, En eskiler
• Sadece fotoğraf, Sadece video
• Ekran görüntüleri, Ekran kayıtları, Live Photo'lar
• En çok yer kaplayanlar
• Geçmişte bugün
• Bu hafta çektiklerin
• Ay ay temizle

DAHA FAZLASI
• Tam ekran önizleme ve yakınlaştırma
• Video önizleme
• Benzer çekimleri gruplayarak tek seferde karar ver
• Hızlı seçim ile ızgarada çoklu seçim
• Günlük hedef ve günlük seri
• Kaç öğe temizlediğini ve ne kadar yer açtığını gör
• Sonucunu görsel kartla paylaş
• Türkçe ve İngilizce

GİZLİLİK
Süpür hesap istemez, veri toplamaz ve fotoğraflarını cihazından dışarı göndermez. Her şey telefonunda kalır.

name: SWLH
description: provides a streamlined workspace for exploring, reviewing market summaries, organizing, comparing sector performance, and examining movements. Access interactive charts,  and concise research insights while keeping important information and selected symbols in one convenient place.

name: SXP Mobile
description:
SXP Mobile (Spektris Excellence Platform) adalah aplikasi manajemen layanan lapangan terpadu yang dirancang khusus untuk memfasilitasi Field Service Engineer (FSE) dan teknisi PT Spektris Metalab dalam memberikan pelayanan servis terbaik bagi pelanggan.

Aplikasi ini menyederhanakan alur kerja teknisi di lapangan, mulai dari pemantauan jadwal servis instrumen laboratorium, penanganan tiket pelanggan, hingga pembuatan berita acara dan dokumentasi laporan kerja harian.

FITUR UTAMA:

1. DASHBOARD & STATISTIK REAL-TIME
• Pantau status tiket yang sedang dikerjakan, tiket selesai, dan ringkasan laporan harian.
• Metrik performa kerja teknisi dengan penghargaan Hall of Fame.

2. MANAJEMEN JADWAL SERVIS
• Akses kalender penugasan servis berkala dan kunjungan darurat.
• Detail informasi instrumen pelanggan (OES, XRF, dll.), lokasi pabrik, dan kontak pic klien.
• Filter status jadwal (FIX, Tentative, maupun Emergency).

3. PELACAKAN TIKET PELAYANAN (TICKETING)
• Pantau tiket masuk dengan klasifikasi tingkat prioritas (Normal, High, Urgent).
• Catat progres penanganan kendala instrumen secara terstruktur.
• Lampirkan bukti foto pekerjaan teknisi langsung dari kamera atau galeri iPhone.

4. LAPORAN KERJA HARIAN (DAILY REPORT)
• Buat dan perbarui laporan aktivitas servis lapangan secara cepat.
• Dokumentasikan parameter instrumen, pergantian suku cadang, dan catatan teknis.

5. BASIS PENGETAHUAN & FORUM TEKNIS (KNOWLEDGE BASE)
• Akses Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) kalibrasi Valen-X CRM.
• Panduan penanganan troubleshooting instrumen dari para ahli teknisi Spektris.

SXP Mobile memastikan setiap layanan servis analitikal dan kalibrasi laboratorium terekam dengan akurat, transparan, dan profesional.

name: TabiKorea - Korean Phrases
description:
TabiKorea is an offline Korean phrasebook for Japanese travelers (the app is in Japanese).

- 350 phrases: 8 travel scenes x 40, plus 30 phrases for walking around Korea
- Polite level switch: soft polite (haeyo-style) by default, formal (hapnida-style) in Settings
- Hangul, kana reading and Japanese translation for each phrase
- Written form and spoken form side by side where the sound changes (for example 있어요 -> [이써요]); tap to see why
- Sample replies from the other person for many phrases
- Large display to show your screen
- Korean read-aloud using the device's speech synthesis (ko-KR)
- Search and favorites
- Phrase data is stored on your device, so it works without a connection. No ads.

Free to download. Three scenes (airport, general, emergency) are free. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks all phrases. No subscription. A connection is needed only for purchase and restore.

Phrases are for reference, and kana cannot fully show Korean sounds. The spoken form is generated by rules, so it may miss exceptional pronunciations. In emergencies, follow local staff and authorities.

name: Taipal Eats: Taiwan Local Food
description:
Find where Taiwanese people really eat in Taipei—matched to your nearest MRT station and the time of day.
Order with confidence using big Chinese Order Cards (with built-in Mandarin voice readout) and show drivers your destination with Chinese Taxi Cards.
100% free with no sign-up and no ads. Saved shops, order cards, and taxi cards all work offline.

■ Picks by MRT Station, Time of Day & Craving
• Covers 428 local eateries and street food spots within a 15-minute walk of 25 Taipei MRT and high-speed rail (Taipei Main, Nangang, Banqiao) stations.
• Filter by 5 time slots—Breakfast (6–10 am), Lunch (11 am–2 pm), Snack (2–5 pm), Dinner (5–9 pm), and Late night (9 pm–)—or pick a future date to see only places open then.
• Switch effortlessly between Savory meals (beef noodles, lu rou fan, xiaolongbao, Taiwanese breakfast) and Sweet treats (mango shaved ice, douhua, boba).

■ Ranked by Taiwanese Bloggers & YouTubers
• Skip tourist traps: every shop is ranked by how many times Taiwanese food bloggers and YouTubers have featured it.
• Read English digests of what local bloggers say, alongside live Google Maps ratings, opening hours, days off, and cash-only notices.

■ Chinese Order Cards & Voice Readout
• Tap ＋ next to any signature dish to build a high-contrast Chinese order card to show the shop owner.
• Add one-tap requests in Chinese: “No cilantro (bú yào xiāngcài)”, “A little spicy”, “Small bowl”, “Large bowl”, “Eat here”, or “To go”.
• Includes pinyin pronunciation guides, landscape full-screen mode, and built-in Mandarin text-to-speech that reads your full order or “How much? (duōshǎo qián)” aloud.

■ Chinese Taxi Cards & Google Maps Transit Directions
• Show the driver the shop’s name, confirmed Chinese address, and nearest MRT station in oversized text, or tap to let your phone speak the address in Mandarin.
• Includes spoken Mandarin phrases for getting out (“Stop here, please” and “Can I pay with EasyCard?”) plus one-tap address copying.
• Prefer the metro or bus? Tap Directions to open public transit routing directly in Google Maps.

■ Works Offline & Privacy First
• Bookmark shops to organize your personal food list by MRT station—your saved shops, order cards, and taxi cards work without mobile data.
• No account, no tracking, no ads. Your location is used only on your phone to find the nearest MRT station and is never sent to our server.

■ 25 Covered Taipei MRT & HSR Stations (428 Shops)
Longshan Temple, Ximen, Shuanglian, Dongmen (Yongkang St.), Gongguan, Guting, Chiang Kai-Shek Memorial Hall, Beimen, Taipei Main Station, Zhongshan, Shilin, Jiantan, Yuanshan, Xingtian Temple, Songshan, Nanjing Fuxing, Songjiang Nanjing, Zhongxiao Fuxing, Daan, Taipei 101/World Trade Center, Taipei City Hall, Xiangshan, Minquan W. Rd., Banqiao, and Nangang.

name: Talune
description:
Talune plans a gallery wall before a single nail goes in.

You describe the wall — width, height, the margin you want at every edge and the gutter between frames — then list the frames you already own: width, height and how many. Talune sorts them tallest first and packs them into rows. A frame joins the current row while it still fits inside the usable width, otherwise a new row starts. Each row is centred left to right, and the whole block is centred top to bottom.

The result is drawn to scale on a paper-coloured wall, with the margin shown as a dashed guide and every frame labelled with its size. Change one number and the plan is rebuilt immediately.

name: TapFrame: NFC Photo Frames
description:
Put a photo on your battery-free e-ink photo display in seconds. Pick a picture, frame it, and hold your iPhone on the display. TapFrame sends it over NFC and the display refreshes in about twenty seconds. No account, no app sign-up, and nothing leaves your phone.

PHOTOS THAT LOOK RIGHT
See exactly how your photo will look in the display's six colors before you send it. Pinch and drag to frame it, choose portrait or landscape, and tune saturation, contrast and brightness with a live preview.

MESSAGES AND NOTES
Type a message with emoji, pick a font and color, and place the text anywhere on the card. Great for a note on the fridge or a sign on the desk.

SEND AGAIN
Your recent pictures stay on your phone, ready to send again or edit.

COMPATIBILITY
Works with 4-inch Spectra 6 (six-color, 300×400) battery-free NFC photo displays such as the Tapmora photo magnet. Requires an iPhone with NFC.

TapFrame is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Tapmora, Good Display, Fudan Microelectronics, or E Ink.

name: Tarot Academy: Hermetic Tarot
description:
Tarot Academy is a structured, self-paced course on the Tarot in the Hermetic tradition, based on the classic works of Papus (The Tarot of the Bohemians) and Éliphas Lévi (Transcendental Magic).

You start from zero and follow one path to the end: first the meaning of every card, then the links with Kabbalah and astrology, then the art of reading, and finally the work with the cards in ritual.

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
• The structure of the Tarot: 22 Major Arcana and 56 Minor Arcana
• Every Major Arcanum in depth: symbols, Hebrew letter, number and meaning
• The four suits and the court cards, upright and reversed
• The Tarot, the Tree of Life and the planets
• How to ask a good question and read a spread step by step
• Seven spreads, from a single card to the Cross of Papus and the Celtic Cross
• Rituals with the cards for protection, prosperity, love, health, courage and new beginnings

HOW IT WORKS
• 9 levels, 20 modules and 65 lessons, each with a short quiz
• A full study of all 78 cards, with the classic Rider-Waite-Smith images
• Card of the day and interactive readings
• A private reading journal saved to your account
• A library of 26 rituals, explained simply for beginners

FREE TO START
Level 1, Foundations of the Tarot, is completely free. Unlock everything with a monthly or annual subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel them in your App Store or Google Play account settings.

Tarot Academy is an educational course for adults (18+). Readings and rituals are offered for self-reflection and entertainment; they do not predict the future and do not replace medical, psychological, financial or legal advice.

Privacy Policy: https://tarot-academy.expo.app/legal/privacy
Terms of Use: https://tarot-academy.expo.app/legal/terms

name: Tarot Decoded: Learn Tarot
description:
Tarot Decoded teaches you to read tarot, one short lesson at a time. Learn what each card means, practice putting cards together, then use what you know in real readings with your own deck or ours.

LEARN
• A guided learning path that starts from zero and builds real reading skill
• All 78 cards, upright and reversed, with keywords, meanings and the symbols in each picture
• A card of the day to study, plus a library of spreads explaining what each position means

PRACTICE
• Read the Cards: a game where you interpret real card combinations and compare your reading with a model answer
• A daily challenge, a placement trainer for spreads, and quick quizzes
• Streaks and stats that show how your skill grows

READ
• Single card, Past · Present · Future, Mind · Body · Spirit, Celtic Cross and more
• Scan the cards you draw from your own deck with your iPhone's camera
• Clear readings that explain each card in its position and how the cards work together

JOURNAL
• Save readings, daily cards and your own reflections
• Look back on what you drew and what it meant to you

YOUR SKY
• Today's Moon phase, constellation and Sun sign, right on the home screen
• Add your birth details to see your birth chart and the tarot cards linked to it

MADE FOR YOU
• Works without an account. Sign in with Apple, Google or email only if you want backup and sync across devices
• Available in English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German and Italian
• Gentle daily reminders at the time you choose

PREMIUM
Everything above has a free version. Tarot Decoded Premium adds the full learning path, every spread, scanning more than one card, the harder Trios and Story game levels with unlimited games, your full birth chart, and your whole journal history. Premium is $7.99 a month or $59.99 a year, and the yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial. Prices may vary by country.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase (or when the free trial ends). Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.tarotdecoded.app/terms-and-conditions/
Privacy Policy: https://www.tarotdecoded.app/privacy-policy/

Tarot Decoded is for learning, reflection and entertainment. It doesn't predict the future and isn't a substitute for medical, legal, financial or other professional advice.

Questions? Write to support@tarotdecoded.app.

name: TaRZiKa
description:
TaRZiKa is a real-time multiplayer strategy game played on a realistic world map.

BUILD YOUR CASTLE
Upgrade your barracks and train goats, horses, rhinos, bees and ants. Strengthen your castle with a warehouse, a hospital, a research center and a watchtower.

RAISE YOUR COMPANION
Lion, bear, wolf, bull or eagle: choose your companion, level it up and take it into battle with your army.

EXPLORE THE MAP
Hunt monsters, gather Demirkan, Ateşsu and Silver from mines, and set up farms. Send scouts, get to know your enemy and attack at the right moment.

FIGHT WITH YOUR ALLIANCE
Create or join an alliance, send reinforcements to your allies, upgrade the alliance tower and protect your castle with shields.
Rally as a TaRZiKa with your friends: gather your armies under one banner and march on an enemy castle with a power bonus.

CHAT
World chat, alliance chat, private messages and detailed battle reports.

The game is free to play. Nothing earned in the game can be converted into real money and there are no cash prizes.

Support: destek@tarzika.com
Privacy: https://tarzika.com/gizlilik/

name: Ten Up Game
description:
Ten Up is a rummy-style card game where you work through ten phases, one hand at a time. Collect sets, runs and colors, lay your phase down, then play off the table to empty your hand first.

Play against 1 to 5 computer opponents at Easy, Normal or Hard difficulty. Choose a full game of all ten phases, or a random shorter game when you only have a few minutes.

- No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases
- Works fully offline
