- Your game is saved automatically, so you can pick up where you left off
- Built-in rules, plus a Find Phase hint that shows a phase you can lay down

The deck has numbers 1 to 12 in four colors, along with Wild cards that stand in for anything and Skip cards that cost another player their next turn. Cards left in your hand count against you, and the first player to finish the last phase wins.

name: Thai für Touristen
description:
With Thai for Tourists, get ready for your Thailand holiday in just a few minutes a day – and keep the right phrases close at hand on your travels. Saying hello, ordering food, asking for directions, checking in or explaining allergies: the app focuses on exactly what you need when travelling.

HOW YOU LEARN:
• Flashcards with Thai script, transcription, easy-to-follow reading hints and English meanings.
• Original recordings to listen to, with a slow playback option.
• Try it yourself: repeat a phrase and find out straight away whether speech recognition understood you. All processing happens offline on your device; no recording leaves your phone.
• Switch between masculine and feminine polite forms with a tap (ครับ / ค่ะ).
• Quizzes, listening exercises and short dialogues help you test what you have learnt.

ON THE GO:
• Phrasebook: quickly find the right phrase, play it to the person you are talking to or show it in large text on your screen.
• Create your own lists of essential phrases, for example for allergies or your hotel.
• Works without internet – ideal in a taxi, at the market or on the beach.

YOUR TRAVEL COMPANION:
• Choose your destination (e.g. BKK Bangkok, HKT Phuket, CNX Chiang Mai) and get your personal boarding pass each day with your next learning step.
• A daily goal, learning calendar, optional reminders and achievements with travel stamps keep you motivated.
• Over 280 words and phrases covering greetings, numbers and prices, food and drink, allergies, hotels, airports, transport, directions, shopping, excursions, health and emergencies.

START FREE, UNLOCK ONCE:
The free version includes the basics and daily exercises; you can unlock extra exercises by choosing to watch ads. A one-time purchase of the full version gives you unlimited use of the whole app without ads: all topics, learning, practice and personal lists. No subscription, no account required.

Please note: the app uses prepared content. It does not translate freely entered text.

Have a great trip – and enjoy your first “Khop khun khrap”!

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Thai Phonetic Trainer
description:
Thai looks hard until you can hear it. Thai Phonetic Trainer teaches the sounds first, one at a time, and has you say each one out loud.

PHONETICS
• All 44 consonants, 32 vowels and 5 tones, in 8 short lessons
• Each letter shown large, with its name, its sound and an example word
• Hear it in your phone's Thai voice, at normal speed or slowed down

BEGINNER
• 50 everyday phrases: greetings, meeting people, asking and understanding, food and shopping, getting around
• Every phrase broken down word by word, with a tip on when to use it
• Numbers 1 to 10, then 20, 21, 100, 1,000, 10,000 and 1,000,000
• One switch sets the polite ending, khrap or kha, to match how you speak

SAY IT
• Tap the microphone and say the sound or phrase
• The app tells you what your phone heard: clear, close, or try again
• Play your own recording back against the Thai voice
• Listen-and-pick quizzes train your ear

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your progress stays on your phone

The speech check uses your phone's built-in Thai speech recognition and usually needs an internet connection. It checks which word was heard, not the pitch of your voice, so use it as a guide alongside your own ear.

name: The Village Works Coworking
description:
The Village Works member app keeps you connected to your coworking community wherever you are. 

With features like instant booking and room availability, events and news feed, communication, door access, account management, and member services, The Village Works app puts everything at your fingertips.

name: ThinkWorlds עולמות של חשיבה
description:
ThinkWorlds הוא משחק הרפתקה וחשיבה בעברית. נותנים הוראות לרובוט, מחלקים אנרגיה ומים בעיר של מספרים, בונים משפטים שהעולם מבצע מילה במילה, בודקים עדויות כמו בלשים ומרכיבים משחק משלכם. בכל שלב מתכננים, מנסים, רואים מה קרה ומתקנים, וכך מתרגלים לפרק בעיה לצעדים, לבדוק השערה ולנסח הוראה מדויקת.

עשרה עולמות
82 שלבים. שני עולמות פתוחים מההתחלה, והשאר נפתחים בהדרגה ככל שהמוח המרכזי במשחק מתעורר.
• LOGIC WORLD: מפעל שנרדם ורובוט תיקונים שעושה רק את מה שכתוב לו. מתחילים בצעד קדימה ומגיעים ללולאות ולתנאים
• AI LAB: כותבים למכונה הוראה בעברית ורואים איך כל מילה משנה את התמונה שהיא מציירת
• NUMBER CITY: משאב מוגבל כמו אנרגיה, מים או תקציב מתחלק בין כמה צרכנים, והעיר מגיבה לחשבון שנבחר
• WORD KINGDOM: ממלכה שמבצעת משפטים כפשוטם. כל מילה עושה בה עבודה אחרת, וגם סדר המילים משנה את המשמעות
• MEMORY TEMPLE: כל חדר מראה משהו לכמה שניות, מסתיר אותו ומבקש לשחזר אותו בסדר הנכון כדי שהדלת תיפתח
• CODE PLANET: אותה תוכנית בשלוש צורות, בלוקים, הוראה בעברית וקוד, וכל שינוי מופיע מיד בשלושתן
• SCIENCE STATION: משערים, מריצים ניסוי ומשנים דבר אחד בכל פעם, כדי לדעת בדיוק מה השפיע על התוצאה
• DETECTIVE CITY: כמה מקורות מידע, חלקם מכונות שנשמעות בטוחות מאוד. מגלים איזו טענה לא מסתדרת עם האחרות ואיזה פרט עוד חסר לפני מסקנה
• CREATOR ISLAND: מרכיבים משחק קטן מגיבור, מטרה, מכשול וחוק, מכוונים מהירות, מספר מכשולים וזמן, ואז משחקים בו באמת
• MASTER WORLD: שש משימות מסכמות, שבכל אחת מהן כמה עולמות נפגשים בסיפור אחד

שמונה מיומנויות
לוגיקה, תכנון, יצירתיות, מתמטיקה, שפה, זיכרון, עבודה עם AI ופתרון בעיות. כל שלב מחזק חלק מהן, ומפת המוח במסך הראשי מראה איך הן גדלות.

איך לומדים כאן
• רמזים שמכוונים את המחשבה בלי לגלות את הפתרון
• דמות מלווה שעונה על שאלות, וגם כשמבקשים ממנה את התשובה היא מציעה לחשוב יחד
• ניסיון שלא הצליח לא מוריד נקודות ולא מוחק התקדמות. המשחק דווקא סופר ניסיון חוזר, שיפור של הוראה ומציאת טעות לבד
• אחרי כל שלב מוצג מה נלמד, במילים פשוטות וגם כקוד אמיתי שנבנה מהפתרון שנבחר
• אורך ההסברים מותאם לקבוצת הגיל שנבחרה ביצירת הדמות, והפנייה מותאמת לבת, לבן או בלי לבחור

AI LAB: להסביר למכונה
מכונה לא יודעת מה התכוונו, רק מה שנכתב. במעבדה כותבים הוראה חופשית בעברית, המכונה מציירת לפיה תמונה, ומשם לומדים:
• לומר מה רוצים, כמה זה גדול, ממה זה עשוי, איפה ומתי
• שמשפט קצר ומדויק עובד טוב יותר מערימה של מילים
• לכתוב את ההוראה שמתאימה לתמונה שכבר מצוירת
• למצוא מילה שהמכונה הבינה כפשוטה ולנסח אותה מחדש
• להוסיף חוק, מה חייב להופיע בתמונה ומה לא ייכנס אליה
המכונה במעבדה בנויה בתוך המשחק ופועלת על המכשיר, ושום דבר לא נשלח החוצה.

אזור הורים
נפתח אחרי תרגיל כפל קצר, כדי שיישאר מקום של הורים. מה רואים בו:
• זמן משחק, מספר משימות ופעמים של חשיבה מחדש
• מגמה בכל מיומנות, בכוונה בלי ציונים
• מה בולט ומה עוד מתפתח
• דרך הפתרון: ניסיונות לשלב, פתרון בלי רמז ופתרון יעיל
הכל מחושב מתוך המכשיר עצמו, בלי השוואה לאף אחד אחר.

עוד במשחק
• משימה יומית קצרה שנבחרת לפי ההתקדמות
• שישה משחקים מהירים להמתנה או לנסיעה
• אוסף פריטים לדמות שנפתחים ממה שעשו במשחק, בלי כסף ובלי הגרלות
• הגדרות לצליל ולתנועה על המסך

פרטיות
• אין פרסומות ואין רכישות בתוך המשחק
• אין הרשמה, אין חשבון ולא נאסף מידע
• הדמות המלווה עונה לפי כללים שבנויים בתוך המשחק ועם סינון בטיחות, ומה שכותבים לה לא יוצא מהמכשיר
• ההתקדמות נשמרת רק במכשיר, ומחיקת האפליקציה מוחקת אותה
• אין גישה למיקרופון, למצלמה, לאנשי קשר או למיקום
• המשחק כולו ארוז באפליקציה ועובד גם בלי אינטרנט
• מדיניות הפרטיות המלאה נמצאת גם בתוך המשחק, באזור ההורים

name: Thirdstop: Film Light Meter
description:
Thirdstop is a light meter for film cameras. Point your phone at the scene and tap the spot you want to meter. Set the aperture or the shutter speed, and Thirdstop gives you the other one, with the EV.

Thirdstop is a reflected-light meter. It reads the light that comes back from the subject, as your camera's own meter does. The dials move in full, half or third stops, to match your camera. ISO goes from 6 to 25600.

Night mode turns the whole app red on black.

BEFORE YOU BUY
• The live spot reading
• ISO and dial steps
• Night mode
• One film stock

THIRDSTOP PRO (IN-APP PURCHASE)

Metering
• Hold: freeze a reading, then turn the dial to see equivalent exposures.
• Average metering across the whole frame.
• Calibration, to match the meter to your camera or your handheld meter.

Film stocks
• A library of 28 film presets. Each one sets the film name and ISO in one tap.
• Add your own film stocks.

ND filters and long exposures
• Enter a filter in stops, as an ND number or as an optical density. Stack two or more filters.
• Start a countdown for the exposure. It keeps time when the phone is locked, and it rings when the phone is on silent. The countdown shows on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

Reciprocity
• Enter the correction from your film's data sheet, as a formula or as a table. Thirdstop then applies it to long exposures.
• The app doesn't supply reciprocity values. You enter them.

Shot notebook
• Keep a notebook for each roll.
• Log a frame from the last reading with one tap. Add a note and the place if you want.
• Export a roll as text or as CSV.

Studio mode, for painters
• Check how evenly the light falls across your canvas.
• Compare the light on your canvas with the light on your palette or on a reference photo.
• See the approximate color temperature of the light.
• Save a setup, then compare against it at your next session.

WHAT THIRDSTOP MEASURES
Thirdstop reads light through the phone's camera. It gives exposure settings and EV. It isn't a lux meter, and its readings aren't certified. Color temperature is approximate.

PRIVACY
Thirdstop has no ads, no account and no analytics. It collects no data.

name: threee: Daily Top 3
description:
threee is a private, daily top 3 for the people you already talk to. Everyone gets the same question once a day. Post three short answers, then see your friends' lists and tap “same” when you agree.

There is no public feed, search, comments, or direct messages. You only see people you are friends with, and only after you have posted that day’s list. New friends join with a personal invite or a group invite link.

threee is 18+. The app uses an age gate, server-side word filters, and report and block tools. You can delete your account in Settings.

Sign-in uses a 6-digit code sent to your email, not a password.

name: Throatmark
description: Throatmark — ਸਮਾਂ, ਪੈਸੇ ਅਤੇ ਹੁਨਰ ਦੀਆਂ ਸੀਮਾਵਾਂ ਇੱਕ ਥਾਂ ਲਿਖੋ। ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਕੱਸੀ ਹੋਈ ਲਾਗੂ ਸੀਮਾ ਚੁਣੋ, ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਮੌਜੂਦਾ ਸਾਧਨ ਵਰਤ ਕੇ ਅਗਲਾ ਕਦਮ ਬਣਾਓ, ਛੋਟੇ ਛੁਟਕਾਰਾ-ਪ੍ਰਯੋਗ ਕਰੋ, ਟੀਚੇ ਨਾਲ ਜੋੜੋ, ਹਾਲਤ ਅਪਡੇਟ ਕਰੋ, ਸਮੀਖਿਆ ਲਿਖੋ ਤੇ ਟੈਕਸਟ ਐਕspੋਰਟ ਕਰੋ। ਕੋਈ ਖਾਤਾ ਨਹੀਂ — ਸਾਰਾ ਡਾਟਾ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਇਸੀ iPhone ਤੇ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।

name: Ticklines
description:
See today's events, and the gaps between them, on the scale of a gauge.
Ticklines reads the calendar you already use. Nothing to re-enter.
How long until your next event, and how much free time is left today — at a glance.

■ Today
• Event blocks on a ruler, with a needle for now. Your next event and the minutes until it.
• FREE time left today, and the LONGEST FREE stretch.
• A 24-hour dial and a cell for every hour.
• Drag the ruler to see any other time of day.

■ Overview
• See how full each day of the month is from the shade of its tile. Tap a day to see its ruler.

■ Widgets
• Home Screen (small, medium, large) and Lock Screen.
• On medium and large widgets, the button on the right steps through your next and previous events — without opening the app.

■ Looking forward
• Pick one event you're looking forward to and see the days left on a 14-day scale with a flag.

■ Free time, next 7 days
• One ruler per day shows the events and the longest free stretch for the coming week.

■ Which events
• Events in the iPhone Calendar, including accounts such as iCloud and Google that you added to your iPhone.

■ Privacy
• The app only reads your events. It never writes to your calendar or sends anything anywhere.
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking. No account needed.

name: Tickstand: Clock with Seconds
description:
Tickstand is a clock app for people who like to watch the seconds go by. It puts clock faces with live seconds on your Home Screen, in StandBy and on the Lock Screen, turns your iPhone into a night-stand clock, and keeps the time in the cities you care about.

EIGHT FACES, ALL DRAWN BY THE APP
• Glow Tube: cold-cathode style tubes with an orange glow and a wire mesh
• Leaf Flip: split leaves for hours and minutes, seconds on their own leaf
• Segment LCD: seven-segment digits with the unlit segments faintly showing
• Platform: a station-style dial with bold minute bars, a 24-hour inner ring and an arrow second hand
• Hairline: minimal analog with fine hands and twelve ticks
• Spoken: the time in words, to the nearest five minutes ("It's nearly quarter past ten")
• Binary: each digit of the time as a column of lit and unlit dots
• Meridian: your time and two more cities, with day or night and the offset

WIDGETS
Small, medium and large Home Screen widgets, the small widget in StandBy, and round and rectangular Lock Screen widgets. Each widget has its own face, city and seconds setting.

HOW THE SECONDS WORK, HONESTLY
iOS does not redraw a widget every second. Tickstand shows seconds with text that iOS itself keeps up to date (iOS 18 and later) and moves everything else once a minute. That means:
• Digital faces tick every second. Leaf Flip does not animate in a widget.
• Platform and Hairline have no moving second hand in a widget: the hands step once a minute and the seconds are shown as numbers.
• Binary shows hours and minutes as dots and the seconds as numbers in a widget.
• When the screen is dimmed or Always-On is showing, iOS may pause the seconds until you wake the iPhone.
In the app and in night-stand mode the faces run with real ticking or sweeping second hands.

NIGHT-STAND MODE
• Full screen, keeps the screen on while open
• Dims itself after 10 seconds to 5 minutes without a touch, and can lower the screen brightness too
• Red night tint: on, off, or automatically from 9 pm to 7 am
• Burn-in shift: moves the clock a few points every two minutes
• Works upright or sideways; tap to switch faces

CITIES AND TIME ZONES
Pick cities from a bundled list of about 470 places built from the public-domain IANA Time Zone Database, plus large cities added by hand. See the difference from your time, whether it is already tomorrow there, and the UTC offset. Daylight saving changes come straight from iOS.

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no in-app purchases, no analytics and no network access. Your cities and settings stay on your iPhone.

name: Tide Line New
description:
Tide Line is a quiet way to keep a daily water goal.

Set the amount you want to drink, log a glass in one tap, and get reminders only during the hours you are awake. A simple chart shows the last seven days, your streak, and the time of day you usually drink.

Your log stays on this iPhone.

name: TiHole
description:
tihole is a native client for Pi-hole v6. See what every device on your network is looking up, pause ad blocking for a few minutes, and manage your lists from your iPhone or iPad, on as many Pi-holes as you run.

DASHBOARD
• Total queries, blocked queries, active clients and gravity size, live
• CPU, memory, temperature and load at a glance, with health warnings
• Queries over time, query types, upstreams, top domains and top clients

BLOCKING
• Turn blocking off for 5, 10 or 15 minutes, or until you turn it back on
• A live countdown in every tab shows when blocking comes back

QUERY LOG
• A live log of every DNS query, with a domain filter
• Swipe a query to allow or block its domain

LISTS
• Allow and deny domains, exact or regex, with groups
• Adlists, with a streamed gravity update
• Groups, clients and local DNS records (A, AAAA and CNAME)

SETTINGS AND SYSTEM
• Search and edit Pi-hole's full FTL configuration
• System info, diagnosis messages, network devices and the DNS log
• Restart DNS, flush logs and flush the network table

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Talks only to the Pi-holes you add. No accounts, analytics or tracking.
• Passwords are kept in the iOS Keychain.
• Works with HTTPS, self-signed certificates and plain HTTP on your LAN.

tihole needs Pi-hole v6 or later and an app password from its web interface. tihole is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Pi-hole LLC.

name: Tikivela - Football Career
description:
Tikivela is multiplayer football where you are one footballer, not the whole team.

Pick your country, your position and your shirt number. The game gives your footballer a name from that country and a face you can change. Then press Play: you join a match of your national team against another country, six a side, a few minutes long.

One footballer, one thumb
Tap where you want to go. Tap a teammate to pass, tap the goal to shoot, drag to run with the ball, swipe to play it quickly. Tackles and saves happen by themselves when you get close. The pitch stands upright and you always attack upwards, so you can play with one hand.

Real people and bots together
Every place nobody holds is played by a bot, so a match always starts within seconds, whoever is online. When other people join, they take a bot's place, on your side or against you.

Your footballer grows
Every match you really play makes your footballer a little better at what their position does. Each footballer also has hidden talents that grow faster. Nothing tells you which they are: you find out by playing.

Every country has a team
All 193 national teams are in the game. Your country climbs the ranking when its people beat another country's people. See who plays for your country, how every team is doing, and where you stand on the leaderboards.

A rating after every match
At full time every footballer gets a rating out of 10 and the best is the match's most valuable player. Goals count most for a forward, passes for a midfielder, tackles for a defender.

Fair and simple
Free to play. Sign in with Apple or Google: we store nothing about you beyond that sign-in, and you can delete your account in the app at any time.

No connection? You can still play a practice match against bots.

name: Tilt: Block Puzzle
description:
Drag pieces into the box. Every few pieces, the whole box turns 90 degrees, a wall becomes the floor, and everything falls.

Tilt is a block puzzle where the board moves. Fill rows and columns to clear them, line up clears that the tilt will finish for you, and keep the box open as long as you can.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Drag a piece from the tray into the box. Tap it to turn it.
• Pieces fall until they rest on something, so you can slide them under overhangs.
• The glowing wall shows where everything falls at the next tilt.
• Full rows and full columns clear. Clear several at once, chain clears, or let a tilt clear them for big scores.
• Changed your mind? Undo your last move, any time.

MADE WITH CARE
• Built for iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, with layouts made for each screen.
• Your game is saved the moment you leave, so you can pick it up later.
• Gentle haptics on every drop, clear and tilt.
• No ads, no accounts, no tracking. Plays offline.

name: Tiltwell: Marble Tilt Puzzle
description:
Swipe to tilt the board. Every marble rolls at once.
Match each marble to the hollow of its own color.

No ads. Hints and undo are free and unlimited.

Use walls, oak blocks and other marbles to stop the roll. A glass marble drops into its matching hollow and stays. Once filled, that hollow is safe for the others to cross. Send a marble into the wrong hollow and it's lost. Steel balls have no home: keep them out of every open hollow.

A marble may need to help another before it goes home.

Each board gives you a set number of tilts. “Best possible” is the exact fewest that can solve it. Match that number for Perfect.

Undo as often as you like. Restart to try another approach. A hint shades the edge of the tray to show which way to tilt. If you can no longer solve the board in the tilts left, Hint tells you.

The first 15 levels teach the rules a little at a time. Then the puzzles get trickier, and the levels never run out.

Play a new daily puzzle, the same for everyone. Your play history marks solved days with a marble and Perfect days with a gold rim. Keep a daily streak and share your result without showing the board.

No account to create. Play offline, including the daily puzzle. Completed levels and daily results sync with your iCloud when available, so they can come back after a reinstall or on another iPhone. Turn sound and haptics on or off in Settings.

Levels 1–15 and today's daily board are free. A daily you've already started or solved stays free.

Full Game is an optional one-time purchase that unlocks level 16 onward, including the endless levels after level 90, and every past daily board. No subscription.

name: Time Catcher: Rift
description:
The city's clocks have stopped, but its time is still being taken. Become the Time Catcher and explore six connected districts with the Hour Blade and Minute Spear.

Attack, jump, dash, and strike downward in midair. Follow branching paths to recover clock seals, unlock a second jump and an air dash, and reach places that once seemed out of reach.

Freeze enemies and moving hazards, or rewind to recover an earlier position and health. Both powers create time debt that makes enemies faster. Fight back and defeat them to repay what you borrowed.

Choose gifts during each journey, try different contracts, and bring back memory shards to strengthen your life. Your first four victories unlock four original comic chapters. Skip a scene whenever you want, then return to it in the Memory Archive.

Supports English and Simplified Chinese, with system language matching or an in-game choice. This version works offline, requires no account, and contains no ads or in-app purchases.

name: Timelapse 8K
description:
Timelapse 8K is a timelapse camera that gets the most out of your iPhone: the full 48 MP from the sensor, manual controls like a pro camera, and a finished video in up to 8K.

CAPTURE
• 8K, 6K, 4K or Full HD master from the full 48 MP (8K and 6K from a 1.5 s interval)
• Intervals from 0.5 to 30 s, countdown and scheduled start
• Manual shutter, ISO, white balance and focus, exposure compensation
• AE-L, WB-L and AF-L locks against flicker; with a fixed ISO the app adapts the shutter smoothly – from sunset into the night
• 0.5×, 1×, 2× and telephoto lenses, depending on your iPhone
• Histogram, grid, focus peaking and other overlays
• HDR (HLG) and Apple Log profiles in 10 bits, plus 48 MP ProRAW (DNG) with every frame
• Display dimming while recording; heat, battery and storage monitoring
• Recording recovery after a crash or a dead battery

EDITOR
• Playback speed and direction
• Crop and aspect ratio (16:9, 9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 4:3, 2.39:1), pan from point A to B
• Stabilization of shake and tripod drift
• Deflicker
• Color, motion blur, frame blending (long exposure), noise reduction and fades
• The original stays untouched – edits are applied on export

EXPORT
• HEVC, H.264, ProRes 422 / HQ / 4444 and GIF
• JPEG, HEIC, PNG or TIFF image sequences
• Up to 8K at 24–60 fps; keep HDR and Log or convert to Rec.709
• Straight to Photos, to Files or share

LIBRARY
• Timelapses organized in projects
• iCloud Drive archive: move originals to iCloud and free up space on your iPhone

FREE AND PRO
The free version is fully functional with the main 1× lens and a Full HD master – no ads and no time limits. A one-time Pro purchase (no subscription) unlocks all lenses, 4K, 6K and 8K masters, the full 48 MP, HDR, Apple Log and RAW (DNG).

No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Everything is processed on your iPhone.

Requires iOS 18. 6K and 8K need an iPhone with a 48 MP main camera. HDR, Apple Log, ProRAW and ProRes only on iPhones that support them.

name: Timer Door: Work & Study Track
description:
Timer Door: Work Hours & Study Tracker

Track every billable hour or study session with precision, and turn your focused time into professional PDF invoices or motivating study streaks.
Tap Start, pause when stepping away, and tap End. Only the time you truly work is counted.
No accounts. No servers. Your entire history lives securely on your iPhone.

WHY TIMER DOOR
• Quick Start: "Start Work" resumes your active project with one tap.
• Accurate Active Time: Pausing stops the clock, breaks never count.
• Midnight Auto-Split: Sessions past midnight split across both days, keeping daily timesheets accurate.
• Manual Logging: Add missed sessions retroactively with notes. Overlaps are caught before saving.
• Billable vs. Non-Billable: Track internal hours and client work side-by-side; internal time never appears on invoices.

POMODORO & OLED FOCUS
• Customizable Intervals: Classic 25/5 or custom lengths with a draining progress ring.
• Background Alerts: Audio and haptics notify you when breaks begin and end, even with the app closed.
• Minimalist Focus Mode: Ultra-clean, pure black OLED clock (portrait or landscape) for zero distraction.

CLIENTS, PROJECTS & REAL-TIME BILLING
• Organized Hierarchy: Projects sit under clients with hourly rates, colors, and 120 icons.
• Live Earnings: Revenue calculates in real time as you work.
• Client Profiles: Store addresses and tax details once for seamless billing.

PROFESSIONAL PDF INVOICES
• Designer A4 Invoices: Sequential automatic numbering with customizable details.
• Smart Itemization: Pre-written, editable line items derived directly from logged sessions.
• Timesheet Attachments: Append an optional day-by-day hourly breakdown to the invoice.
• Bilingual Ready: Issue invoices in English or Arabic.

STUDY MODE & EXAM COUNTDOWNS
• Academic Focus: Switch to Study Mode for zero monetary distractions, track subjects, topics, and study blocks.
• Progress & Goals: Daily and weekly goal rings, subject targets, calendar views, and streak tracking.
• Session Reflection: Rate sessions with mood tags and log summary notes.
• Deadlines & Exam Timers: Pin exam dates or project deadlines to Home with countdowns and alerts (day of, 1, 3, or 7 days prior). Log test scores and completion outcomes.

INSIGHTS & PERFORMANCE
• Free Insights: Peak productivity hours, busiest days, streaks, month-over-month comparisons, and top clients.
• 120 FPS Fluidity: Silky smooth at 120 frames per second on ProMotion displays.
• Full Localization: 22 languages, native Right-to-Left (RTL) Arabic, and Dark Mode.
• Home-Screen Widget (Pro): View daily totals and goals with quick timer controls from your Home screen.

PRIVACY BY DESIGN
• 100% On-Device: Every session, client, and rate stays on your iPhone.
• Zero Telemetry: No Timer Door servers, no accounts, and no data tracking.

FREE VS. TIMER DOOR PRO
Free tier: 1 client and 1 project (or 3 subjects with 3 topics in Study Mode) and 3 recorded deadline results.

Timer Door Pro unlocks:
• Unlimited clients, projects, subjects, and topics
• Interactive Home-Screen Widget with live controls
• 5 custom break audio tones
• Full CSV import/export for accounting
• Single-file backup and restore
• 12 accent colors and Night theme
• Unbranded invoices (removes "Created with Timer Door" footer)
• Unlimited exam and deadline records

Subscriptions & Purchase:
Monthly and Yearly plans start with a 7-day free trial, then renew automatically until canceled. Payment is charged to your Apple Account after the trial. Cancel in your Apple Account settings at least 24 hours before the trial or period ends. Lifetime is a one-time purchase.

Questions? Open the menu, go to About, and tap "Get in touch".

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://numdoor.com/en/timer-door-privacy.html

name: Timz pro
description:
Timz is the staff app for restaurants that use Mizzz. See your shifts, start and end work, take your breaks and stay in touch with your team – all from your iPhone.

YOUR DAY
• Your current or next shift on the home screen, with your role and the event you work.
• Start and end your shift by scanning your restaurant's staff QR code, or start it normally in the app.
• Start a break and get back to work with one tap; your worked time so far is always visible.
• Reminders around the start and end of your shift, if your restaurant uses them.

YOUR PLAN
• Your week on a timeline, including overnight shifts.
• Tap a day to see who works with you.
• Confirm the weekly plan your manager publishes.
• Mark the days you would like to work, ask to cancel or move one of your shifts, and request time off: sick days, vacation, appointments or a free day.

YOUR TEAM
• Team chat: one chat for everyone and one per team, with pinned messages.
• Answer asks from your manager right in the chat.
• To-dos you can tick off and comment on, and the events you work with their timeline.
• See who is working now and how your team is organised.

YOUR PROFILE
• Your photo, nickname and the details your restaurant needs for your contract and pay. Changes go to your manager for review.
• Your contract details at a glance.
• Work at more than one restaurant? Join with an invite code and switch between them.

ORDERZ TABLETS
Timz can approve an Orderz tablet that shows a sign-in code: scan it, and the tablet opens with your account.

GOOD TO KNOW
• You need a Mizzz account and an invitation from your restaurant. Sign in with email and password, with Apple or with Google.
• What you can see and do depends on your role and your restaurant's settings.
• The camera is used only while the QR scanner is open; the picture stays on your iPhone.
• No ads, no tracking.
• Delete your account in the app (Settings › Delete account) or at www.mizzz.net/account/delete. Working time recorded for your employer stays with your employer.

name: TinyMusic - S3网盘 & 本地音乐播放器
description:
TinyMusic 是一个只播放你自己 S3 存储内容的原生 iOS 播放器。

- 连接 AWS S3、Cloudflare R2、MinIO 等 S3 兼容存储
- 按“前缀/歌单/歌手 - 歌名”浏览和播放
- 缓存指定歌曲或整张歌单，断网也能听
- 10 段 EQ、12 套预设、前级增益
- 歌词、封面、播放队列、后台音频、锁屏控制
- Liquid Glass 界面，支持浅色/深色
- iCloud 同步 S3 配置和 EQ；密钥走 iCloud 钥匙串

TinyMusic 不提供在线曲库、搜索、推荐、平台下载或账号登录。你只能播放自己拥有或有权使用的音频。

name: TisFleX Projects
description:
TisFleX Projects is de werkapp van TisFleX bv voor eigen medewerkers en onderaannemers. De app is alleen te gebruiken met een account van TisFleX.

Wat je ermee doet:
- Uren boeken per project en per dag, ook voor collega's in je ploeg
- Productie vastleggen, zoals meters vlies, pootjes en doorvoeren
- Foto's van het werk maken en bij het project bewaren
- Met "Ik ben op het werk" het juiste project kiezen op basis van je locatie
- De planning van de week bekijken
- Vrije dagen aanvragen
- Berichten en meldingen ontvangen, met een herinnering als je uren nog niet zijn ingevuld
- Werken zonder bereik: boekingen worden later verstuurd

Voor de beheerder maakt de app urenstaten (Manurenregister) als PDF of Excel voor bij de factuur.

De app werkt in het Nederlands, Engels en Pools.

name: TLC Rf Reader
description:
TLC Rf Reader keeps one plate on this iPhone. Sample and reference lanes sit side by side.

Shift the sample spot and the Rf verdict updates. The limit page compares impurity spots with a dilute reference.

There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Top Tier Dispatch
description:
Top Tier Dispatch helps authorized Top Tier delivery teams and management organize appliance deliveries and document each stop.

DAILY DELIVERIES
View assigned jobs by delivery date, open ticket details, review appliance requirements and see team routes on a map.

APPLIANCE DOCUMENTATION
Capture photos and videos for individual appliances, scan serial labels or photograph labels when scanning is unavailable, and keep documentation linked to the correct ticket. Multifamily deliveries can organize appliances by apartment unit.

STOP UPDATES AND EXCEPTIONS
Record arrival and departure, add stop notes and report installation exceptions with appliance details, photos and videos. Management can review exceptions and reopen stops when more information is needed.

OFFLINE PHOTO STORAGE
Keep captured media on the device when service is unavailable. Uploads resume when a connection is available and the app is active.

TEAM COORDINATION
Contact clients by phone or text, document returning appliances and share team location with authorized management when permission is granted and the app is active.

An account provided by Top Tier management is required. Available features depend on your assigned role and permissions.

Support: Operations@top-tierms.com

name: ToWork 待办与日程
description:
ToWork 帮你把口头交代变成待办。接入自己的模型后，按住说「明天下午三点交初稿」，松手发送，就能在待办里核对标题和截止时间。想改口，滑到「编辑」先改文字。

你可以告诉 ToWork「我的周报先列风险」。这类长期偏好会保存在记忆库，供以后的对话使用。你可以查看、修改或删除记忆，也可以开启免记忆模式。

打开「报告」，按本周或本月的实际工作记录生成总结。

本地工作区无需注册。待办、记忆和报告保存在设备上，模型密钥保存在系统钥匙串。首次向所选模型服务发送内容时会征求同意，可在「隐私与权限」撤回。使用模型服务可能产生供应商费用。

name: TRACE
description:
TRACE показывает, как работает ваш ресторан, прямо в телефоне.

• Выручка, заказы, гости и средний чек — сегодня, за неделю или месяц, со сравнением с прошлым периодом.
• Продажи: какие категории и блюда приносят больше всего денег.
• Операции: касса, зал, стоп-лист и проблемы смены в реальном времени.
• Финансы: P&L, себестоимость, зарплата и списания.
• Отзывы из Google, Яндекса и 2ГИС в одной ленте, черновик ответа от AI.
• Сравнение филиалов: кто лидирует и за счёт чего.

Для входа нужен аккаунт TRACE вашего ресторана: подключение — на trace-os.uz.

name: TrackCrafter: Motocross Race
description:
Jump. Nail the landing. Shave off a hundredth of a second.
TrackCrafter is a side-scrolling motocross racer where you race on tracks you build yourself.

BUILD
Lay out kickers, big jumps, slopes, mud, boost pads, fences and walls like tiles. Every track is test-ridden before it is saved, so no track is impossible to finish.

RIDE
Simple controls: throttle, nitro, lane changes and lean in the air. Match the bike to the slope of the ground for a PERFECT landing and refill your nitro. Land badly and you slow down; land really badly and you crash.

COMPETE
- Time Attack: race your best run's ghost
- VS CPU: three CPU riders at Easy, Normal or Hard
- Online races: real-time races for up to 4 players with Game Center
- Leaderboards: global and friends leaderboards for the official tracks

SHARE
Publish your tracks with a 6-letter share code and play tracks made by riders around the world. You can also send a track as a file.

GARAGE
Mix paint, graphics, frame, wheels, exhaust, helmet, gear and race number to make the bike yours. In online races, other riders see your bike too.

FAIR RACING
Every bike performs the same. Only skill makes the difference. No ads.

TRACKCRAFTER PRO (one-time purchase)
- Unlimited saved tracks (5 in the free version)
- Tracks up to 150 tiles long (60 in the free version)
- Unlimited published tracks (1 in the free version)
- Pro garage parts

For iPhone and iPad. Game controllers and keyboards are supported.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: TrainMax
description:
TrainMax är verktyget för gyminstruktörer som planerar och leder pass. Appen samlar allt du behöver mellan passen – ditt schema, gymmets planering, kollegornas pass och chatten – på ett ställe i telefonen.

MINA PASS
Se dina kommande pass i en kalender, med tid, gym och upplägg. Öppna ett pass för att se hela innehållet inför passet.

PLANERING
Följ gymmets veckoschema: vilka pass som är planerade, vem som leder vad och vilka pass som fortfarande behöver en instruktör.

PASSBANK
Hämta inspiration från pass som andra instruktörer i kedjan delat. Filtrera på passkoncept, se vem som skapat passet och plocka upp en egen kopia när tiden inte räcker till.

EVENT
Håll koll på gymmets event och aktiviteter.

CHATT
Prata med de andra instruktörerna i kanaler för hela gymmet och för varje träningsform. Kan du inte leda ett pass? Be om ett byte – de som kan köra passet taggas och kan ta det med ett tryck.

NOTISER
Få besked direkt när någon skriver i chatten, när någon behöver hjälp med ett pass eller när du blir instruktör på ett pass. Du väljer själv vilka notiser du vill ha.

MITT KONTO
Ändra namn, språk och lösenord, slå på tvåstegsverifiering, ladda ner dina uppgifter eller radera ditt konto direkt i appen.

KOM IGÅNG
TrainMax används av gym och deras instruktörer. Ditt konto skapas av gymmet – logga in med samma e-post och lösenord som du fått därifrån. Appen finns på svenska och engelska.



TrainMax is the tool for gym coaches who plan and lead classes. The app brings together everything you need between sessions – your schedule, the gym’s planning, your colleagues’ sessions and the chat – in one place on your phone.

MY SESSIONS
See your upcoming sessions in a calendar, with time, gym and format. Open a session to see everything in it before you lead it.

PLANNING
Follow the gym’s weekly schedule: which sessions are planned, who leads what and which sessions still need a coach.

SESSION BANK
Get inspired by sessions other coaches in your chain have shared. Filter by session concept, see who created it and pick up your own copy when time is short.

EVENTS
Keep track of the gym’s events and activities.

CHAT
Talk to the other coaches in channels for the whole gym and for each type of training. Can’t lead a session? Ask for a swap – coaches who can run it are tagged and can take it with one tap.

NOTIFICATIONS
Know right away when someone writes in the chat, when someone needs help with a session or when you’re made the coach of a session. You choose which notifications you want.

MY ACCOUNT
Change your name, language and password, turn on two-step verification, download your data or delete your account right in the app.

GETTING STARTED
TrainMax is used by gyms and their coaches. Your account is created by your gym – log in with the email and password you received from them. The app is available in Swedish and English.

name: Trouvancec
description:
Trouvancec est un accompagnement doux pour prendre soin de vos objets du quotidien. Vous pouvez y référencer vos cosmétiques, vos bijoux et vos vêtements, puis suivre simplement leurs entretiens réguliers.

L’application vous propose un calendrier des soins, pour ne pas oublier les gestes d’entretien à réaliser. Vous retrouvez aussi un guide des matières, qui rassemble des fiches de soin adaptées à chaque matériau, afin de préserver vos pièces le plus longtemps possible.

C’est un outil calme, pensé pour ceux qui attachent de l’importance à leurs affaires et souhaitent les conserver dans le meilleur état, sans complication.

name: Tube PiP + - video lite
description:
Tube PiP+ is a video player and browser in English and Arabic.

Open your favorite platforms, search or paste links, and browse with a spacious interface. Save favorites and a Watch Later list, revisit history, and import your own video and audio files from Files.

Play imported files and direct media links, skip forward or back 15 seconds, change playback speed and resume your position. Audio and subtitle tracks are available when provided by the media. Choose a sleep timer from 15 to 90 minutes. The built-in player supports background audio, AirPlay and Picture in Picture. Website playback capabilities depend on the provider, content and device. Optional blocking of supported advertising elements can be disabled in Settings; it does not remove every ad.

Start a free 24-hour trial with one tap inside the app. It stays on this device only, without purchase confirmation, Apple sign-in or iCloud sync. The trial does not automatically become a paid subscription. When it ends, browsing and playback stop until you buy lifetime access with one payment; your library remains saved. Your local price is shown before you confirm. Restore purchases from Settings or the membership screen.

The app does not download YouTube videos or provide access to paid provider content without its subscription. Tube PiP+ is independent and is not affiliated with YouTube, Google or the listed platforms. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Support: pipptubeve3334@gmail.com

name: TumbleBud: Bumper Rush
description:
A little top. A whole lot of action.

Meet TumbleBud, a cheerful spinning toy built for big bounces. Steer into colorful arenas, dash through AI rivals, and rebound from inflatable bumpers to turn a close call into a brilliant comeback.

BOUNCE INTO YOUR OWN RHYTHM
Dash into a marked bumper and tap again while Chain Dash glows. Choose your next direction, connect powered rebounds, and send rivals rolling. Quick reactions and smart movement make every arena feel alive.

SWITCH YOUR ORBIT
Keep your orbiting pods close for nimble movement, or spread them wide for extra reach. Change your orbit in the middle of a battle to escape a crowd or finish a daring attack.

100 STAGES. ONE GRAND TOUR.
Travel through ten bright arena themes. Clear rival groups, survive timed rounds, tackle waves, protect a moving parcel cart, and face ten boss encounters with changing attack patterns. Every opponent is AI controlled. This is a single-player action game.

MAKE YOUR BEST RUN COUNT
Earn up to three stars per stage and replay your favorites. Local Records save your best successful runs on this device, with separate Standard, Assist, and Auto Pilot categories. Earlier balance versions stay separate. There are no invented online players or worldwide rankings.

A COLORFUL TOY BOX
Enjoy rounded plastic characters, glossy shells, lively rebounds, and playful sound. Earn Buttons and unlock cosmetic outfits. Daily Check-In adds a small treat, and missing a day keeps your reward progress intact. Every outfit has the same fighting power.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Choose Assist for gentler incoming hits and faster dashes. Switch Auto Pilot on to let your toy steer, dodge, and dash, then switch it off whenever you want to take over. Stage unlocks and stars still count; Auto Pilot records stay separate. Adjust music, sound effects, haptics, motion, contrast, and control layout. A practice playground lets you try the controls without ranking pressure.

READY WHEN YOU ARE
The campaign works offline. No account, advertisements, or in-app purchases are required. Progress, outfits, check-ins, and records are stored locally. Removing the app or deleting local data may remove your progress; operating-system backups are managed separately.

Bounce big. Spin happy.

name: Tuner: Simple, Ad-Free Tuning
description:
Tune your instrument with a clear chromatic tuner for iPhone. See the detected note, frequency, and how far you are sharp or flat. All tuning and calibration features are free, with no ads and no subscriptions.

MAKE IT YOUR TUNER
• Set your A4 reference from 400 to 480 Hz, or reset it to 440 Hz.
• Choose sharps or flats and optional German B/H notation.
• Switch between light and dark appearance.
• Choose from audio inputs available to your device.
• Enable haptic feedback on supported hardware.

LOWER NOTES
Optional bass range extends the detector's lower frequency limit to 30 Hz. Direct input is recommended: an internal microphone may pick up fans and low-frequency room noise. Results depend on your instrument, input, and surroundings.

ON-DEVICE AUDIO
Tuner needs microphone permission to detect pitch. Audio is processed on your device in temporary memory; Tuner does not save audio recordings or upload your audio.

OPTIONAL SUPPORTER ICON
Every tuning and calibration feature is available without a purchase. If you would like to support development, a one-time, non-consumable in-app purchase unlocks an alternate Supporter app icon. It changes the icon only. Choose it in Settings after purchase, or use Restore Purchase for an eligible previous purchase.

name: Turnback: Hiking Trail Compass
description:
Turnback records the path you walk, then points you back along that same path and tells you the latest time to turn around before sunset, with a real map (Pro) when you are online. The core features work without internet. Think of it as a breadcrumb trail for your hikes, walks and treks: you retrace your own steps instead of guessing the way.

START, WALK, TURN BACK
Tap Start at the trailhead. Turnback saves your starting point and draws your trail as you walk. When you want to head back, a flag on the dial marks the way back along the path you came; turn until the arrow meets the flag and walk. You also see the distance left along the path and in a straight line.

A DAY OUT, STEP BY STEP
1. Open Turnback at the trailhead and tap Start.
2. Check the daylight card for sunrise, sunset and twilight. Set your pace and a safety buffer.
3. Walk. Your trail is drawn as you go.
4. Check the latest time to turn around. With Pro, a reminder can reach you before that time.
5. When it is time, turn until the arrow meets the flag and follow the path back.

WHEN TO TURN AROUND
The daylight card shows sunrise, sunset and twilight for where you are, worked out on your phone from the date and your position. Set your walking pace and a safety buffer, and Turnback tells you the latest time to start the walk back so you are home before dark. A planner lets you test a longer route before you leave.

BUILT FOR THE TRAIL
- A compass needle with magnetic declination, tilt correction and a clear warning when the compass is not reliable
- A flag for your goal, an arrow for where you face, and a small red triangle for north, so you never mix them up
- Distance back, bearing and walking time at a glance
- Battery saver mode for long days outside
- Dark theme by default, light theme if you prefer
- Kilometres or miles, your own walking speed
- 19 languages, including Arabic with right-to-left layout

YOUR TRAILS
Save your walks and open them later. Free: record, return and daylight features, and 1 saved trail. Look at any trail on a simple drawn map, share it, or send it as a GPX file.

TURNBACK PRO (ONE-TIME PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION)
- The real map under your trail: roads, paths, forests, water and peaks
- Unlimited saved trails
- Your own named waypoints
- Export as GPX, KML, GeoJSON or CSV; GPX import
- A turn-back reminder that arrives as a local notification before your latest turn-back time
The way back is never locked. Pro is a single purchase and one free preview of the real map is included. Restore Purchases is on every purchase screen.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no analytics and no tracking. Your trails stay on your phone. Location is used only while the app is open, and only after you tap Start or Use my location. The real map loads map tiles over the internet from OpenFreeMap with data from OpenStreetMap contributors; this shows the area you are viewing to that service, but no account or identifier is sent and your location is not sent to us.

PLEASE READ
Turnback is a backup tool, not a safety or rescue device. It records only while the app is open on your screen. GPS and compass readings can be wrong, and sunset times are estimates. Always carry a paper map, a backup compass, water, a light and a charged phone, and tell someone your plan.

Privacy policy: https://denix.studio/legal/turnback
Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: TwineSpace
description:
Welcome to TwineSpace — a home for creativity, stories, photography and conversations.

TwineSpace brings together the world of podcasting and photography, giving you one place to discover engaging content, explore visual stories and experience the creativity of The Fourth Podcast Space and TwineShots.

EXPLORE THE LATEST

Stay up to date with the latest content from across TwineSpace. Discover podcast episodes, photography features and fresh creative releases in one convenient feed.

WATCH SHORTS

Enjoy short-form video content in an easy-to-browse vertical experience. Discover entertaining clips, creative moments and highlights from our content.

SHARE YOUR STATUS

Express yourself and share your moments with the TwineSpace community. Create posts and explore what others are sharing.

DISCOVER MORE

Explore featured brands, creative projects and curated links through our Discover section. Find more of the stories, people and creative experiences behind TwineSpace.

CONNECT WITH US

Find communication channels for The Fourth Podcast Space and TwineShots. Reach out, follow our work and stay connected with the creative teams.

ONE SPACE. MANY STORIES.

Whether you enjoy podcasts, appreciate photography or simply love discovering creative content, TwineSpace brings different forms of expression together.

Download TwineSpace and explore a world of stories, creativity and inspiration.

name: Typekin
description:
Typekin is a typewriter in your pocket.

Pick one of fourteen machines and type on it. Every key presses down, the carriage slides and the paper feeds as you go. When a line reaches the margin the bell rings and the carriage returns on its own, so you never have to press Return mid-sentence.

The machines:
The Standard, Midnight, Poolside '66, Telegram Office, Cloud Nine, Froggy Post, Peachy Cat, Moonbeam, Bat Hour, Strawberry Tea, Ember, Sakura Bloom, Pumpkin Post and Gingerbread Express. Each one keeps its own pages.

• Key sounds and the margin bell, with haptics. Each can be switched off in Settings, and the app remembers your choice.
• Emoji, ink stamps and accents, typed from the keyboard.
• Undo and redo.
• Share a page as a picture, or print your pages. The print screen also lets you save a PDF.
• Send a page as a live letter: a link that opens an envelope and types your letter out for whoever receives it, on the machine you typed it on. Live letters can be sent from any of the fourteen machines, including a page that holds emoji or writing in another script.
• Type in the Latin alphabet on the typewriter keys, or switch to Arabic, Urdu, Hindi, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Korean or Bengali and type with your phone's keyboard.
• Choose how high the keyboard sits: Standard, Raised or Higher. The app remembers your choice.
• Type on a Bluetooth or USB keyboard and hide the on-screen keys.
• Works on iPhone and iPad, and on foldable phones: half-open on a table, the page sits on the upright half and the keys on the flat half; opened like a book, the machine stays clear of the fold.
• Respects Reduce Motion.

Typekin has no account, no ads and no tracking. Your writing stays on your device unless you choose to share it. The app works without a network connection. A live letter is a link you send; the person who opens it needs an internet connection to watch it type.

name: Unenvy
description:
Unenvy — Break the Comparison Cycle

Ever find yourself comparing your life, relationships, appearance, or achievements to someone else's?

You're not alone. Envy and jealousy are human emotions. But when comparison takes over, it can leave you feeling frustrated, inadequate, or disconnected from what you actually want.

Unenvy helps you understand those feelings, regain perspective, and turn comparison into personal growth.

A Different Way to Handle Envy

Instead of judging yourself for feeling envious, learn to recognize what's underneath the emotion. Unenvy guides you through simple, structured exercises to help you understand your triggers and respond more intentionally.

FEATURES

Guided Emotional Check-Ins

A seven-step guided experience that helps you:
- Identify whether you're experiencing envy or jealousy.
- Recognize what's triggering the feeling.
- Rate and track emotional intensity.
- Pause and practice mindful breathing.
- Discover what you actually want.
- Challenge unhelpful thought patterns.
- Choose one meaningful action to move forward.

Guided Breathing

Take a moment to slow down with a simple 4-2-6 breathing exercise. Inhale for four seconds, hold for two, and exhale for six.

Learn

Explore short, approachable educational reads about envy, jealousy, comparison, and emotional awareness.

Track Your Progress

Review your check-in history, recognize recurring triggers, and see how your emotional responses change over time.

Comparison Doesn't Have to Control You.

You don't need to eliminate envy to move forward. You need to understand what it's telling you.

Stop measuring your life against someone else's.

Start focusing on what matters to you.

Notice envy. Start calm.

Welcome to Unenvy.

Disclaimer: Unenvy is a self-reflection tool, not a substitute for professional mental health care, diagnosis, or treatment. If you’re in crisis, please contact a licensed professional or local emergency services.

name: Unfakeable: Discipline Streak
description:
Most discipline apps let you tick a box and call it done. Unfakeable checks. Your steps, workouts, sleep and mindful minutes are verified with your Health data, so every day of your streak is real.

PICK YOUR VIBE
• Grind: dark and competitive. Ranks, XP and a level that never drops.
• Glow: a light theme and the Glow 75 plan: steps, a walk outside, water, reading, self-care and sleep. Steps, walks and sleep are checked by Health; water, reading and self-care you tick yourself.
• Reset: the 66-day Reset, with 3 guided quests a day in three phases. The quests your phone can measure are checked by Health; the others you tick yourself.
• Same proof rules in every vibe. Switch any time in Settings.

PICK YOUR CHALLENGE
• No Excuses: 75 days, two 45-minute workouts (one outdoors), 10,000 steps, 7 hours of sleep, plus reading, water, diet and a progress photo. Miss a day, back to day 1.
• Balanced: 75 days, one workout, 8,000 steps, sleep and mindful minutes. A miss resets the streak, not the challenge.
• Starter: 30 days to build the base.
• Glow 75 and the 66-day Reset work with any vibe.
• Or write your own rules and targets: 21, 30, 66, 75 or 100 days.

VERIFIED, NOT TICKED
• Steps, workouts, exercise minutes, sleep and mindful minutes turn green by themselves when the data is there
• Entries typed into the Health app by hand don't count
• Rules that can't be measured (reading, water, diet) are clearly marked as self-reported and count for half
• Late Apple Watch data? Yesterday stays open until noon
• No Apple Watch? Steps, logged workouts and time in bed still count; the rest you tick yourself

XP, LEVELS AND BADGES
• Earn XP for every proven rule and every complete day; self-reported ticks earn less
• Your level never drops, even after a missed day
• 16 badges to earn, from your first proof to a finished challenge

YOUR WEEKLY CARD
• A Proof Score from 0 to 99 and five stats: Move, Train, Sleep, Mind, Honor
• Ranks from Rookie to Proven: the top rank only goes to fully verified weeks (Glow and Reset have their own rank names)
• Share it to your story or send it to the friend who says they "work out every day"

STAY ON TRACK
• Day X of 75 and your streak, front and center
• Home and Lock Screen widgets: your day, streak and level at a glance
• A heads-up when only a few steps are left (never more than two extra notices a day)
• Proof Shield (flexible mode): every 7 complete days earn one, up to 2. A missed day uses one so your streak survives; the day still counts as missed
• Your whole journey as a road, with a seal at every milestone
• A finale card on your last day, plus a suggestion for what to take on next
• A morning list of today's rules and an evening nudge only when the day isn't proven yet

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Read-only access to Health; nothing is ever written
• Your health data stays on your iPhone. It's never sent to us, to advertisers or to iCloud
• Widgets and heads-ups are worked out on your iPhone, too
• No account, no sign-up

Unfakeable is a habit and discipline tracker. It isn't a medical app and doesn't give medical advice.

SUBSCRIPTION
Unfakeable Pro unlocks the app: verified rules, streaks, quests, XP, levels and badges, the journey, the weekly card, widgets and reminders. Yearly or weekly. A one-time first-year price may be offered in the app; it then renews at the regular yearly price. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel any time in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://vayronapps.com/unfakeable/privacy.html

name: Unmuted: Speaking Confidence
description:
Your first Clarity Score is free.

Do people ask you to repeat yourself? Do you fill gaps with "um," rush when you're nervous, or trail off at the end of a sentence? Unmuted helps you hear it, measure it and fix it, a few minutes a day.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Talk for 30 seconds. Answer a simple prompt like you're talking to a friend.
2. Get your Clarity Score. Unmuted checks five things:
- Filler words: how many "um," "uh" and "like" slipped in
- Pace: whether you rush or drag
- Pauses: long gaps where you lost the thread
- Volume: whether you're loud enough to be heard
- Ending: whether your sentences finish strong or fade out
3. See your top fixes. Plain-English tips on what to work on first.
4. Practice with 5-minute drills. Short daily reps, each focused on one habit, with feedback after every rep.
5. Re-test and watch your score move.

BUILT FOR EVERYDAY TALKING
Class presentations, job interviews, phone calls, meetings and talking in a group. No scripts to memorize and no long lessons. Just short reps you can do anywhere.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account and no login.
- Your clip is sent over an encrypted connection to our speech-to-text service only to make a transcript. We don't store your audio, and we never use it for ads.
- Your scores and history are saved on your phone.

UNMUTED PRO
Your first Clarity Score is free. Unmuted Pro unlocks unlimited Clarity checks, all daily drills, your full score history and progress tracking.
- Yearly: $29.99 per year
- Weekly: $5.99 per week
Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel any time in your Apple ID settings (Settings > your name > Subscriptions).

For ages 18 and up.

Unmuted is a practice tool for everyday speaking. It is not medical advice or speech therapy and does not diagnose or treat any condition.

Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Terms: https://tryunmuted.netlify.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://tryunmuted.netlify.app/privacy/
Support: unmutedcoach@gmail.com

name: Valco Boss
description:
Have you always wanted to be the CEO of a successful company? Good news: Valco hired you. Bad news: nobody said anything about success.

Valco Boss is a card game where you run a real Finnish headphone company from Kajaani. Every workday someone knocks on your door: an employee, a customer, an investor, the tax office or Henri, who has another idea. You decide by swiping left or right. The company lives or dies by it.

ONE DECISION. THEN ONE MORE.
One card at a time, one thumb. Each decision takes seconds, so you can run the company at the bus stop, on a coffee break or in a meeting you're not really listening to.

THE ONLY RULE: DON'T RUN OUT OF MONEY
Hype, Product and Karma decide how much you sell. At the end of the month Saija brings the report and the bills, and she doesn't sugarcoat anything. If the cash is gone by then, the company is bankrupt and you're out of a job.

WHAT LANDS ON YOUR DESK
• Over 7,000 cards and over 40 characters. Some of the cards are even good
• 240 decisions a year, 20 workdays a month
• Consequences that show up right away, and consequences that show up once you've already forgotten them
• Trips with Tonno, while a substitute runs the company at random
• At year end you choose: quit while you're ahead, or carry on even though costs keep growing
• A Hall of Fame where the longest term as CEO wins
• Onboarding with a broken coffee machine, if you want it

NO ADS. NO PURCHASES. NO INTERNET.
No banners and no video ads in the middle of a decision. No in-app purchases, no account, no tracking. The game works in airplane mode, and your save stays on your device. We admit it: the whole game is a bit of an ad for Valco. The menu has a link to real headphones, but it only opens if you tap it yourself.

REAL COMPANY, PRETEND MONEY
Valco is a real headphone company from Kajaani. Henri and Jani are real people. The money in the game is pretend. The headphones aren't.

Free. For phones and tablets. In Finnish, English, Swedish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch and Polish.

The job is open. No salary, but the coffee is free. If the machine works.

name: Varınca
description:
Varınca, konuma göre çalışan bir alarm uygulamasıdır. Otobüste, trende ya da yolculukta uyuyakalma kaygısını geride bırak.

NASIL ÇALIŞIR?
• Haritadan varmak istediğin hedefi seç.
• Uyanma mesafesini (yarıçapı) metre cinsinden belirle.
• Hedefe yaklaştığında Varınca alarmı çalar ve seni uyandırır.

ÖNE ÇIKANLAR
• Haritadan kolayca hedef ekleme
• Ayarlanabilir yarıçap
• Aynı anda birden fazla aktif konum
• Uygulama kapalıyken bile arka planda çalışır
• Sade ve hızlı arayüz

GİZLİLİK
Konum verin yalnızca cihazında işlenir. Hiçbir sunucuya gönderilmez ve üçüncü taraflarla paylaşılmaz.

NOT: Uygulamanın uygulama kapalıyken de çalışabilmesi için "Her Zaman" konum iznine ve alarm iznine ihtiyacı vardır.

name: Về Chùa
description:
Về Chùa is a quiet, on-device space that supports personal Buddhist practice.

- View lunar dates, new and full moon days, and Buddhist holy days.
- Save family memorial days (giỗ) by lunar date and optionally receive gentle phone reminders.
- Choose new/full moon or ten-day vegetarian observances.
- Bow, recite, meditate, read included chants, and keep a practice journal.
- Browse a public temple directory for DC, Maryland, and Virginia.
- Export holy days and memorial days as an `.ics` calendar file.

Personal information such as memorial days, memorial photos, wishes, and journal entries stays on your device. The app requires no account, contains no ads, and collects or shares no data. Map, temple-site, email, and phone links open only when you tap them and are handed to the appropriate app on your phone.

Về Chùa is a practice aid and reference resource. It is not a substitute for visiting a temple or receiving religious guidance.

name: VEdge Speed Test
description:
VEdge checks the speed and quality of your Internet connection in about a minute. Results are measured from your device to the nearest CDN server – where most videos, games and websites are actually delivered from – so they closely match your everyday experience.

EVERY METRIC THAT MATTERS
• Download and upload speed
• Latency (ping) and jitter
• Loaded latency – spots bufferbloat that makes games lag and calls stutter
• Packet loss, measured with 1,000 UDP packets over WebRTC

CLEAR, PRACTICAL RATINGS
VEdge scores your connection for real-world use: 4K streaming, online gaming and video calls, with a short explanation when something falls short.

TRANSPARENT CONNECTION DETAILS
• Your IP address, provider and approximate location
• The CDN server serving you, its distance and round-trip time
• Live charts throughout the test

NETWORK TOOLS
• Ping and traceroute – run from your device or from our server
• Whois lookup for any IP address or ASN, with network owner and abuse contact

A SOUND METHOD
Speed is calculated from many transfers of increasing size and summarised with a representative value rather than a single sample, for stable, trustworthy results.

HISTORY AND SHARING
• Every test is saved on your device so you can compare over time
• Share results with one tap

LIGHT AND PRIVATE
• Free, no ads, no sign-in
• No personal data collected; history stays on your device
• Light and dark themes, English and Vietnamese

Note: each test uses some data (possibly a few hundred MB on fast connections). Use Wi-Fi if your mobile plan is limited.

VEdge is developed by VNETWORK.

name: Velvet Eight
description:
Velvet Eight is 8-ball pool the way it feels on a real table: a deep red velvet cloth, polished wood rails, and balls that roll, skid and spin like the real thing.

PLAY A FRIEND
Create a room and send the four-letter code. Your friend joins from their iPhone, or straight from any web browser with the link you send. No accounts, no sign-up.

PLAY THE COMPUTER
Four levels: Easy, Medium, Hard — and Master, which almost never misses, plays position for the run-out and leaves you nothing when it can't pot. To beat Master, you have to run the table. Works offline.

REAL PHYSICS
Balls slide, then roll. Hit low for draw, high for follow, left or right for english that changes how the cue ball comes off the cushion. Every collision has its own sound, recorded on a real table.

CONTROL EVERY SHOT
• Turn your finger around the cue ball to aim, then fine-tune with the roller
• Pull back the cue lever and let go — the power meter shows how hard
• Tap the cue ball icon to choose exactly where the tip strikes
• Call your pocket: your balls always count, but you only keep shooting if one drops where you called
• Drag two fingers down to lower the camera to table level and look along the shot

MADE FOR EVERY IPHONE
The table takes the shape of your screen. On iPhone Duo, stand it half open and the table fills the top screen while the controls sit below.

Simple, beautiful pool. No coins, no ads, no in-app purchases.

name: Verdant Orbit
description:
Verdant Orbit transforms farm-themed mahjong into a crisp 3D matching experience. Rotate each arrangement, inspect it from every side, and collect identical cubes until the puzzle is solved.

Animals, crops, and familiar farming tools give every match a charming visual identity. The focused play loop is simple to understand while rewarding careful observation and a fresh perspective.

Rotate the structure. Find the matching symbols. Clear each puzzle in Verdant Orbit.

name: Vernáculo
description:
Most translators hand you a sentence that is correct and sounds like nobody. Vernáculo gives you what a local would actually say: the right country, the right tone, the slang people really use. Then it shows you why.

SOUND LIKE YOU LIVE THERE
• Pick the place, not just the language: Mexico City or Medellín, Buenos Aires or Madrid, Rio or São Paulo, and more
• Set the tone, from texting a friend to writing to your landlord
• Notes on every translation: what changed, which words are slang, and when a word is too rude to use
• Snap a menu, a sign or a form and translate the text in the photo

LEARN FROM WHAT YOU TRANSLATE
• Start at your level, with a short placement test for most language pairs
• Bite-size lessons built from real everyday language and from your own mistakes
• Spaced-repetition review brings words back right before you forget them
• Alerts for false friends: words that look alike in two languages but don't mean the same
• Streaks, mastered words and weekly progress

ANY LANGUAGE, ANY DIRECTION
• English, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, French, German, Japanese, Chinese (Mandarin) and Tagalog
• The whole app speaks your language, so nobody has to learn through English
• Learn more than one language at once and switch with one tap

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account needed. Optional sign-in with an email code, only to sync between your devices
• No ads, no tracking, no location
• Delete your account anytime in Settings

Something sound off? Tell us with the feedback button in the app.

name: VezetiCC
description:
VezetiCC puts your company's contact centre in your pocket. Take queue calls and make calls with your company's numbers, wherever you are, with the same account you use on the web.

• Calls: answer queue and direct calls, even when the app is closed or the iPhone is locked; dial with your company's caller IDs; hold, mute, transfer, three-way calls and park.
• Ready and breaks: set your status and breaks; your supervisors see it live.
• The customer on the call: who is calling, their history and notes, and the call's outcome.
• Follow-ups: your callbacks and tasks.
• Chat: team chat with colleagues, and your company's customer messages (WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram, Telegram, SMS, email, web chat and more, as your company has them).
• Your figures: calls, talk time and more for today.
• Secure: encrypted calls (TLS, SRTP), set up with a one-time QR code from your administrator, Face ID lock.

VezetiCC is for companies that use the VezetiCC contact centre from Vezeti Services Limited, an NCC-licensed telecoms operator in Nigeria. Your administrator sets up your account.

name: VibeVn
seller_name: HA LONG CROWN TRADE & SERVICES COMPANY LIMITED
description:
VibeVn là trợ lý AI giúp bạn biến ý tưởng thành website mà không cần viết code.

CÁCH DÙNG
• Nói ý tưởng: ví dụ "trang giới thiệu quán trà sữa có thực đơn và liên hệ".
• AI vẽ các màn hình thiết kế để bạn xem và góp ý, duyệt từng màn.
• Bấm "Bắt đầu code": AI làm thành website hoàn chỉnh và chạy thử ngay trong ứng dụng.
• Muốn nhanh hơn? Chọn "Code luôn" để bỏ qua bước thiết kế.

ĐIỂM NỔI BẬT
• Thiết kế trước, duyệt rồi mới làm: bạn kiểm soát kết quả.
• Chat để chỉnh sửa: nói điều bạn muốn đổi, AI sửa cho bạn.
• Xem thử bản web ngay trên điện thoại.
• Quản lý nhiều dự án và nhiều đoạn chat.
• Có nút báo cáo nội dung và xoá tài khoản ngay trong ứng dụng.

LƯU Ý
• Nội dung do AI tạo ra có thể chưa chính xác, hãy kiểm tra trước khi dùng thật.
• Yêu cầu của bạn được gửi tới dịch vụ AI bên thứ ba để tạo kết quả, chỉ sau khi bạn đồng ý.

name: Video Caption Timing
description:
When a subtitle disappears too quickly, see how much longer it can stay on screen. Caption Review finds lines that overlap, run long or leave too little reading time. Compare a suggested change with the original, then decide what to keep.

Import an SRT or WebVTT file, write your own captions or try the practice transcript. Attach a video from Photos or Files to hear a line in context. Your footage and edits are processed on your device.

Edit the timing
• Find a phrase in the transcript and jump to its cue.
• Follow the audio waveform, step through playback in tenths of a second and edit start and end times.
• Split a cue at the playhead, merge two cues or undo an edit.
• Set your reading-speed and line-length targets. Preview a repair before applying it. Give a line more reading time when there is room, move an overlap into a gap or rebalance a long caption across two lines. Undo a change in the editor.

Deliver the captions
Export a corrected SRT or WebVTT file for your editor. A WebVTT export retains imported cue settings and style blocks. For a clip that needs visible captions everywhere, pick the type style and placement, render a separate MP4 and play it back before sharing. Movie rendering supports SDR footage.

Free includes one active project, subtitle file exports and captioned movies up to one minute. Archive a finished project to make room for the next one.

Caption Timing Pro lets you keep multiple projects active, move a whole subtitle track by a precise offset and correct gradual drift by matching two moments to the video. Pro also unlocks longer captioned movies.

Your Apple Account is charged when you confirm a purchase. Monthly and annual plans renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the period ends. See the price before you buy and manage your plan in Apple Account subscriptions.

name: Video Compressor: SendReady
description:
A client needs a clip under 10 MB. Enter the limit, choose the part to send and export a separate copy. See how much room is left under the limit, then compare the same moment in the original and the smaller file before you send it.

Make a copy that fits
• Import from Photos or Files. Trim the start and end, or keep the whole clip.
• Pick a 5, 10, 25, 50 or 100 MB limit, or enter your own.
• Set a resolution cap and choose H.264 or HEVC. Tight size limits may reduce detail. The app tells you if it cannot reach your target.
• Reopen a saved copy to see its measured size and remaining room under your limit. Keep named versions for different destinations.

Decide which copy to send
Slide a divider across matching frames from the original and the export. Zoom into the center to inspect fine detail. The comparison accounts for the start of a trimmed clip. Play the saved version, share it again or check it against a delivery profile.

Client handoff
Compare the selected file’s frame size, frame rate, audio and HDR status against the profile. Share a CSV or JSON report for the original or the saved copy.

Free includes one active video, standard profiles, individual reports, trimmed exports and target-size compression for selections up to one minute. Compression supports SDR footage with mono or stereo audio. Your video is processed on your device.

SendReady Pro unlocks target-size compression for longer selections, multiple active videos, custom client profiles and batch reports. Archive a finished job and keep its imported video in your library.
