name: 10GeographyQ – Daily Geography
description:
10 questions. Every day. The world made fun.

Play a five-minute geography challenge at your level, from land and water, weather and animal homes to US states, flags of every country, capitals, latitude and longitude, plates and volcanoes, and the world's longest rivers. Miss a question? Get a tip and try again, then see the answer explained.

Everyone playing the same level gets the same daily questions, so families, classes and friends can play along and talk it over. Want another round? Each level has its own daily 10.

No account. No ads. No subscriptions.

10 LEVELS, FROM STARTER TO GLOBETROTTER
• Young explorers: land and water, weather, animal homes, picture maps, north, south, east and west, read aloud
• Growing explorers: continents and oceans, map grids, US states and capitals, flags, map scale, time zones
• Teens and grown-ups: capitals and flags of all 193 countries, latitude and longitude, contour lines, plates and biomes, population, borders and world records

MAPS AND FLAGS DRAWN WITH CARE
• Maps from Natural Earth, with no disputed borders drawn
• Flags of every UN member country
• Facts checked against two sources, with the sources listed in the app

LEARN AS YOU GO
• A gentle tip after a miss, then one more try
• Harder questions have an optional hint
• Tap to hear a question read aloud
• A new set of 10 questions every day
• Study guides included with Levels 6–10

A HABIT, NOT HOMEWORK
• About five minutes a day
• A daily streak that never scolds: miss a day and it simply starts again
• Share your score as 10 little squares, without your name, age or level
• A cheer for every right answer

SAFE AND PRIVATE
• No tracking and no data collected: your progress stays on your device
• Any purchase is behind a grown-up check

FREE TO PLAY
Levels 1–5 are free every day. Levels 6–10 are free for 7 days; after that, Advanced Levels is a one-time purchase. Extra Practice is a separate one-time purchase that adds 10 more questions after the daily round, at any level you can play.

Made by I See, I Spell, I Learn, LLC, makers of 10MathQ, 10WordsQ, 10LogicQ, Picture Sight Words and Picture Homophones.

name: 14million.me: Saju Fortune
description:
Where does your fortune stand today?

14million.me is a saju fortune reading. Saju is the Korean Four Pillars tradition: it reads the flow of your life from the year, month, day and hour you were born.

CHECK IT AGAINST YOUR PAST FIRST (FREE)
Nobody can verify a prediction about the future. So we start with what already happened. Your life fast-forwards from age 0 to today and pauses at the years when your fortune turned. You choose what really happened then. If it matches your memory, trust the rest that much. If it doesn't, take it lightly.
• Just enter your birth date. Not knowing your birth time is fine
• No sign-up, about 2 minutes
• Astrology and Zi Wei Dou Shu are compared alongside, so you can see whether they point the same way

YOUR NEXT 30 YEARS
• Which 10 years are likely to go best for you
• Which years to move through carefully
• The 10-year cycles, the flow of each year, and habits that make up for what your chart lacks

ASK YOUR FATE
"When should I change jobs?" "How will things go with this person?" Type what is on your mind, the way you would send a message, and get an answer based on your own birth chart. You can also ask about compatibility, a choice you didn't make, or a goal you want to reach.

WHEN IT HELPS
When you want to know the timing for love, marriage, work or money, or what the new year looks like for you.

COME BACK TO YOUR READINGS
Log in and everything you received is kept in My results.

HOW TO READ THIS
A reading is not a fixed future. It shows energy and timing, the chances that come your way. People born on the same day still choose differently at every crossroads. If your past went another way than the reading, that is how much you changed your own path. Where you go next is always your choice.

GOOD TO KNOW
• The flow from age 0 to today and the past check are free
• The 30-year reading and Ask your fate are in-app purchases
• One-time purchases with no automatic renewal, usable for 3 months from payment
• Users under 19 need guardian consent before purchase
• Contact: hi@14million.me

name: 179 Golf
description:
179 Golf keeps the score for a golf trip.

Pick the round, pick your fourball, and tap the score in on each hole. The app works out the shots each player gets off the stroke index, keeps the net totals, and runs the team match as you go, so the board is right the moment the last putt drops.

Formats built in:

- Eight against eight on aggregate net score
- Fourballs counting the best two net scores per hole
- Pairs better ball
- Individual Stableford alongside the team match

It works with no signal. The whole app is on the phone and the scores are saved on the phone, so a course with no reception or a phone in aeroplane mode changes nothing. When two people have scored different groups, one taps out a short share code and the other pastes it in, and the cards merge. That works over any messaging app and needs no data on the course.

There is also the trip itself: flights, transfers, tee times, the itinerary day by day, and a countdown to the next tee.

Side pots for twos, nearest the pin and longest drive are recorded so everyone knows where they stand. The app records who owes whom. It never holds or moves money.

No account. No sign-up. No adverts. Nothing is sent anywhere, because the app makes no network connection at all.

name: 1MachineTool
description:
1MachineTool puts every computer in your house on your phone. Pair the phone once with 1MachineTool on your Mac or PC, then see and control its screen, and the screens of the other machines it can reach, from anywhere on your Wi-Fi or your Tailscale network.

SHARE SCREEN
• See a computer's screen live and control it: tap to click, long-press to right-click, two fingers to scroll, pinch to zoom.
• Type with real shortcuts: Ctrl, Alt, Cmd, Esc, arrows and F-keys sit right above the keyboard.
• Turn the phone sideways for a bigger screen.

EVERY MACHINE
• One list of the computers your desktop can open: ready, needs setup or offline, with CPU, memory, disk and battery at a glance.
• Macs over Screen Sharing, PCs over Remote Desktop, other machines over VNC. Your computer speaks to them; the phone only shows the picture.

CLIPBOARD, FILES AND CHAT
• Copy on one, paste on the other: text goes both ways.
• Send photos and files to your computer, and save the ones it offers you. Up to 4 GB each.
• Chat with your computer and whoever is using it, with photos and files.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no cloud, no StoicSoft server. The phone talks only to the computers you pair, directly.
• Everything is sealed end to end with AES-256-GCM. Saved passwords stay on your computer.
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking. Free.

TRY IT FIRST
Open the demo desktop on the first screen to try every feature without a computer.

WHAT YOU NEED
1MachineTool on a Mac, a Windows PC or a Linux machine, free at 1machinetool.com (version 1.7 or later for Chat). The phone and the computer on the same Wi-Fi, or both on Tailscale.

name: 21 Questions: Card Game
description:
Never run out of things to say. Tap once and a great question fills the screen, big enough to read aloud across the table.
21 questions per deck, picked for dates, friends and deeper talks.
No setup, no sign-up. Open it and start talking.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Open the app. The first question is already on screen.
2. Read it aloud and answer together.
3. Tap Next Question for another. Go back anytime.

PICK A DECK TOGETHER
- Starter: easy, fun questions for anyone (free)
- Date Night: get to know each other
- Friends: laughs for the group
- Deep Talk: questions that go further

SAVE YOUR FAVORITES
Bookmark the questions you love and find them all in one list.

MADE FOR REAL CONVERSATIONS
- Large, readable cards for dim restaurants and couches
- Your place in every deck is saved
- Works offline. Every question is built in.
- No account, no ads, no tracking

PREMIUM
Unlock Date Night, Friends and Deep Talk, plus new decks as they're released.

SUBSCRIPTION
Premium is optional: $2.99 per week with a 3-day free trial, or $14.99 per year. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/21-questions/privacy
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/21-questions/terms

name: 25 Pistol: ISSF Match Timer
description:
Train for match day the way it really sounds and looks. 25 Pistols runs complete ISSF 25 m pistol courses of fire with spoken range commands, red and green light timing and Apple Watch haptics, so you can rehearse every series before you stand on the line.

EVERY 25 M EVENT
• 25m Rapid Fire Pistol: 8, 6 and 4 second series across five targets
• 25m Center Fire Pistol and 25m Sport Pistol: 5 minute precision series and the 3 s / 7 s duel stage
• 25m Standard Pistol: 150, 20 and 10 second series
• Half courses for shorter sessions
• Finals simulation with virtual finalists, live leaderboard, eliminations and shoot-offs

REAL RANGE PROCEDURE
• Preparation time, sighting series, "Load", "Attention", unload and pauses
• Seven second red light before every exposure, green for the series time
• Electronic target or turning target timing
• Malfunction handling: repeat series or series completion, as the rules describe
• Strict Match mode keeps every official time; Training mode can shorten waiting periods without touching red and green times

ON YOUR WRIST
• Apple Watch app that runs on its own or follows your iPhone
• A distinct tap for load, attention, fire and time up, so you can keep ear protection on
• Score each series with the Digital Crown
• Heart rate during the session (nothing is saved to Health)

TRAIN WITH PURPOSE
• Focused trainers: duel loop, 8-6-4 ladder, finals repeater, standard sprints, reaction start and ready-raise
• Dry-fire mode
• Six structured training plans, from foundation blocks to match-week taper
• Goals and a competition log

SCORE YOUR WAY
• Quick series totals with inner tens, a shot keypad, or tap your hits on an accurate target face
• Session summary with series table and time-limit breakdown
• Notes, mood, conditions and location for every session

DESIGNED FOR THE RANGE
• Big red and green light panel, large countdown and glove-friendly controls
• Keeps running with the screen locked, with a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and Dynamic Island
• On-device voices for commands, adjustable beeps, or a silent lights-only mode
• Widgets, Siri and Shortcuts, and a Focus filter
• ISSF, USA (including NRA Bullseye 25 yard courses) and India (NRAI categories) rule sets
• iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch

25 Pistols PRO
Every program, trainer, plan and the Apple Watch app are free. Pro adds the tools to measure progress:
• Score projection while you shoot and a 30 day trend forecast
• Unlimited history of every session
• Insights: trends, personal bests, consistency, accuracy by target and group analysis
• Compare up to four sessions series by series
• Export and send: PDF score cards, CSV, full backups and share images
• Range Mode: show the lights and countdown on a TV or projector
• Optional iCloud sync across your devices

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no ads. Your sessions stay on your device unless you turn on iCloud sync.

SUBSCRIPTION DETAILS
25 Pistols Pro is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

25 Pistols is a training aid. Range safety rules and range officers always take precedence. Dry-fire mode assumes an unloaded firearm. 25 Pistols is not affiliated with or endorsed by the ISSF, USA Shooting, the NRA or the NRAI.

name: 3726 MDPL: Summit Rush
description:
Reach the summit before time runs out!

3726 MDPL: Summit Rush takes you up five Indonesian mountains, from Rinjani to Carstensz Pyramid. Every mountain has its own deadline: arrive before sunrise on Rinjani, chase the sunset on Kerinci, and conquer the snow of Carstensz before the white fog rolls in.

Pick Rangga or Andini, then run, jump and dodge along trails full of surprises:
• Rinjani: wild boars, cheeky monkeys and ravines across the savanna
• Semeru: langurs, barking deer and slippery sand
• Lawu: a night climb with kuntilanak, genderuwo and tuyul ghosts
• Kerinci: fruit-throwing siamangs, tapirs, civets, river stone hopping and the Sumatran tiger. If it stares at you, freeze!
• Carstensz: cassowaries, singing dogs, slippery ice slopes, avalanches, giant snowballs on cliff ledges, snowstorms and a suspension bridge over a misty chasm

Manage your stamina, drink and eat. Rest at the posts, shop at food stalls and collect coins along the trail. At the summit, earn an S, A, B or C rank, unlock reward costumes from each mountain, then share your result with friends: who reaches the top fastest?

Features:
• 5 mountains from Easy to Extreme
• 2 characters plus a collection of costumes and accessories
• Day, night, rain, fog and snow that change as you climb
• Indonesian and English
• No ads, no login, plays offline

Ready to climb? See you at the summit!

name: 5F Framework
description:
5F Framework is the companion app for members of Orale Success. It turns the Orale Success 5F Framework into a simple daily system for your life.

Start with a guided interview, one question at a time. Then see your whole life on one page:

• My Dream Life: a short statement of the life you are working to create, in your own words.
• Five priorities, in order: Faith (your mindset and beliefs), Family (your favorite people), Friends (your intentional relationships), Fitness (your strength in action) and Finances (your freedom fund). Each has a Definition of Success and a 1 to 10 satisfaction rating.
• Tracker: weekly habits, projects and tasks, organized by priority.
• Gratitudes: write what you are grateful for, and look back on this day in past years.
• Freedom Fund: see how many months of expenses your savings cover, and which fund you are working toward.
• Your data stays yours: everything is stored on your iPhone, with optional iCloud Sync between your own devices. Writing help uses Apple's on-device model, so what you type never leaves your iPhone.

An active Orale Success membership is required to sign in.

name: Abyssora
description:
Dive into Abyssora, a deep-sea exploration puzzle adventure.

Pilot your submarine across grid-based ocean maps, push through the fog of war, and carefully manage oxygen and battery as you hunt for relics, open sealed gates, and reach the exit.

FEATURES
• 12 handcrafted levels across 5 ocean chapters
• Turn-based grid movement with oxygen and battery pressure
• Fog of war and sonar scouting
• Treasures, oxygen stations, charging stations, electronic gates, pressure switches, currents, and rune puzzles
• Jellyfish, sharks, and urchin hazards
• Star ratings, 32 achievements, ocean journal, and local save progress
• Atmospheric deep-sea visuals with original BGM and SFX

HOW TO PLAY
• Use the directional pad to move one tile at a time
• Press Interact at stations, gates, switches, and runes
• Use Sonar to spend battery and temporarily expand vision
• Collect mission items, avoid hazards, and reach the exit before resources run out

Abyssora is a complete offline single-player puzzle game. No account is required.

name: Acaib: Minyatür Duvar Kağıdı
description:
Müze koleksiyonlarındaki minyatürlerden, telefon ekranına göre kırpılmış duvar kâğıtları.

Bir yaprağı seç, kilit ekranında ve ana ekranda nasıl duracağına bak, Fotoğraflar’a kaydet ve duvar kâğıdı yap. Beğendiklerini favorilerine ekle.

• Her gün değiştir: Kestirmeler’e eklenen “Günün minyatürü” eylemiyle duvar kâğıdın her gün sıradaki yaprağa geçer.
• Özgün tarama: Yaprağın kırpılmamış, yüksek çözünürlüklü taramasını doğrudan kaynak müzeden indir.
• Künye: Her yaprağın eseri, kurumu ve lisansı yazılı; hikâyesi acaib.art’ta.

Görsellerin hepsi kamu malı: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, The Cleveland Museum of Art ve Wellcome Collection’ın açık erişim taramaları. Büyütme yok, filigran yok.

Hesap gerekmez, reklam yok, ücretsiz.

name: Acayork: Acarigua y Araure 3D
description:
Acayork es el mundo interactivo en 3D de bloques de Acarigua y Araure, las ciudades gemelas del estado Portuguesa, Venezuela.

Camina por sus avenidas, plazas, redomas, parques y urbanizaciones reales reconstruidas en bloques sobre el mapa de OpenStreetMap, encuéntrate en vivo con otros jugadores y llena la ciudad con tus fotos.

RECORRE ACARIGUA Y ARAURE EN 3D
• Explora las dos ciudades completas a pie con tu propio personaje personalizable.
• Visita monumentos emblemáticos hechos bloque a bloque: el Monumento a La Espiga, la Estatua de Páez en la redoma de Mamanico, la Plaza Bolívar de Acarigua, la Catedral de Araure y el Parque Musiú Carmelo.
• Ciclo de día y noche con iluminación nocturna, tráfico en vivo con semáforos reales y fauna llanera (chigüires, guacamayas, morrocoyes, garzas y mascotas).
• Usa el minimapa o el buscador para saltar al instante a cualquier sector, avenida o plaza.

COMPARTE FOTOS DE CADA LUGAR
• Acércate a cualquier punto de la ciudad y abre su galería de fotos.
• Sube fotos del lugar o tómate una foto allí para compartirla con la comunidad.
• Todas las imágenes se limpian de metadatos de ubicación antes de subirse y cuentan con moderación y botón de reporte.

JUEGA Y VIVE LA CIUDAD
• Escucha Radio Acayork mientras caminas: música original en vivo (joropo, urbano y pop) y locutor en tiempo real.
• Sacude las matas de mango, recoge agua en las plazas y maíz en los conucos, e inventa recetas criollas en tu mochila.
• Completa la aventura de las 7 Lanzas de Páez por los sitios históricos de Acarigua y Araure.
• Saluda, baila joropo, choca esos cinco y conversa con frases criollas con quienes estén cerca.

CON O SIN CUENTA
• Puedes entrar como invitado con un toque («o pasea sin cuenta») o crear tu cuenta gratuita para elegir tu @usuario y conservar tu progreso.

Hecho en Acarigua-Araure por Web Bonding, C.A.

name: Acorn Diary by AnaSta
description: Acorn Diary is a gentle journaling app: just jot down what you did today, along with the time, and let it pile up like acorns.

name: ACT Prep & Practice: Actvane
description:
ACT prep for the enhanced ACT: practice tests, timed sections, full mock tests and worked solutions for ACT English, Math, Reading and the optional Science test. Actvane follows the current format (English 50 questions in 35 minutes, Math 50 minutes with four answer choices, Reading 40 minutes, optional Science 40 minutes) and builds a short daily plan from the categories you most need. No account, works offline, your progress stays on your device.

ACT PRACTICE THAT YOU DO, NOT JUST READ
- A diagnostic, a personal daily plan and a rough practice score range (a guide, not a predicted score)
- Practice sets by category, timed section practice at the real per-question pace, and full ACT mock tests with the real navigation: question grid, flag for review, strike-through choices, section timer and an optional break
- ACT English with whole-passage sets and numbered underlined portions, ACT Math with computed answers, ACT Reading with long and paired passages, ACT Science with data, research-summary and conflicting-viewpoints passages
- A Full solution on every question: worked steps, why each wrong choice fails and the common mistake
- Spaced review, a mistake notebook, concept cards with retrieval questions and a streak that never nags

INTERACTIVE LABS
Ten hands-on labs (lines, parabolas, trig, chance, dot plots, data, an experiment designer, viewpoints, projectile motion and a revision lab). Each ends with a quiz on what you just built.

WRITING PLANNER AND CALCULATOR
Plan an essay from a prompt with three perspectives, an outline and a 40-minute clock, then get approximate rule-based feedback on our own four-domain rubric. A scientific calculator is built in for practice (no graphing, no computer algebra).

FREE TO START
Practice is free with credits: you start with 2, and you earn more by watching optional short videos. The diagnostic, plan, mistake notebook, concept cards and every Full solution are always free. Ads appear on the main screens and never during a question, a timed section, a mock test, a lab or a solution. Or go ad-free with the monthly plan ($3.99 per month after a 7-day free trial; renews automatically until cancelled). Cancel any time in your App Store account settings. If you cancel, you keep ad-free until the end of the period you already paid for, and you will not be charged again. Prefer not to subscribe? Watch short videos to earn credits and unlock features.

TEENS AND PRIVACY
Actvane is for students aged 13 and over and for adults. If you say you are under 18, it shows only non-personalised ads. Nothing you answer leaves your device.

HONEST LIMITS
All questions and passages are original practice content written for this app, not real exam questions, and they have not been reviewed by a teacher. Our reading passages are shorter than on the real test. Score ranges are our own rough estimates.

ACT is a trademark owned by ACT, Inc., which is not affiliated with, and does not endorse, this app.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-actprep.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-actprep.html
Support: https://equalinformation.com/app-support-actprep.html

name: Adhan Duo
description:
Two moments in every prayer: the adhan, then the iqama. Adhan Duo shows both, for exactly where you are, in a sky that follows the real sun.

TIMES YOU CAN TRUST
• Calculated on your iPhone from the sun's position, for your own location or any city you choose.
• The calculation method is chosen from your country to match its official timetable, the one people compare with their mosque. Elsewhere it uses the method most relied upon there.
• Change anything: method, Asr, high-latitude rule, and minutes to match your mosque.

FROM ADHAN TO IQAMA
• A countdown to the next adhan, then to the iqama.
• Choose your mosque from Apple Maps and set its iqama minutes once; every countdown follows them. Until then, iqama times are clearly marked as estimated.
• Jumuah, Ramadan's Suhoor and Iftar, the Hijri date and upcoming occasions.

NEVER MISS A PRAYER
• A notification at the adhan of each prayer you choose.
• Optional alarms that ring through Silent and Focus for the prayers you pick. Off unless you turn them on.
• A countdown on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

ALWAYS AT HAND
• Widgets for the Home Screen and Lock Screen: the next prayer, or the whole day.
• Ask Siri "When is Maghrib in Adhan Duo?", or add it to Shortcuts and Control Center.
• Turn your iPhone on its side for a desk clock.
• A monthly timetable to share or print, in English or Arabic.
• A compass card with the Qibla and the sun's shadow.

A LIVING SKY
Clouds and stars drift slowly with the real sun; at night you see the real stars and the moon in its place. Prefer it still? One switch keeps the sky still, and Reduce Motion and Low Power Mode are always respected.

ON IPAD
A wide day view with the whole day beside the sky, and a short authentic hadith about prayer with its reference.

IN ENGLISH AND ARABIC
Follows your iPhone's language, or choose one in Settings. Arabic is laid out right to left throughout.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Prayer times are calculated on your device.

name: Aerolux
description:
Aerolux est l'application officielle de Mosaik Floor pour piloter vos dalles et bandes LED Aerolux en Bluetooth, sans compte ni connexion Internet.

COULEUR
• Choisissez n'importe quelle couleur sur la roue chromatique
• Réglez la luminosité
• Passez en blanc et ajustez la température, du chaud au froid

EFFETS ET AMBIANCES
• Plus de 200 effets animés classés par famille : couleurs, mouvements, points, rideaux, cascades et flux
• Des ambiances prêtes à l'emploi : bougie, ciel étoilé, coucher de soleil, cinéma, arc-en-ciel…
• Réglez la vitesse et la luminosité de chaque effet

MUSIQUE
• Vos dalles réagissent au son grâce au micro intégré au contrôleur
• 8 effets musicaux et une sensibilité réglable

PLUSIEURS DALLES À LA FOIS
• Connectez plusieurs dalles et pilotez-les ensemble ou une par une
• Donnez-leur un nom (Garage, Salon, Bureau…) : l'application s'en souvient

MINUTERIES
• Programmez l'allumage et l'extinction automatiques
• Choisissez l'heure et les jours de la semaine

INSTALLATION
• Accédez au plan de pose et à la notice depuis l'application

Respect de votre vie privée : l'application ne collecte aucune donnée. Le Bluetooth sert uniquement à communiquer avec vos dalles.

Une question ? contact@mosaik-floor.fr

name: Aether Aviary
description:
Aether Aviary is a quiet place for a single bird and the three worlds it crosses.

There is no timer, no streak, no one waiting for you. You shape five states — vigor, calm, focus, rest, resonance — through short, low-friction rituals. Feed it a blend. Tune the light and air of its perch. Sit with it through a slow observation cycle. Weave a short sequence of tones. Let it rest. Each act is one gesture, one soft deformation of its linework, one system tone. Then you leave, and it carries on.

Those five states are not a scoreboard. They are the shape of how your next flight will feel.

VEIL TRAVERSE
A single uninterrupted corridor unfolds ahead, drawn entirely in smooth vector lines. One finger guides the bird, with gentle damping rather than snap. Marks of light drift in the current; nodes of turbulence drift against it. A collision does not end the run — it shakes the line, slows the scroll, and gives you room to recover. Only sustained contact ends a passage.

Before every run you see what you have made: Steady & Forgiving, Sharp & Focused, or Fluid Moderate. You can start, or go back and adjust the bird first. Nothing about the difficulty changes once the passage begins.

Grades run S to A, B, C, D. Higher grades return more tokens. A demanding run leaves the bird a little more focused; a scattered one leaves it a little less calm — a nudge back toward the perch, never a scolding.

THREE WORLDS
Lumin Veil — cool, fluid light.
Ember Weft — heavy, warm sediment.
Hush Spire — bare, slow, spacious.

Each world holds its own bird, its own state, its own adornments. Your tokens, triumphs and settings travel with you between them. Switching worlds is one tap and a color dissolve; a quiet note reminds you that nothing is lost.

TOKENS AND ADORNMENTS
Tokens come from one place only: the grade at the end of a passage. They buy pure appearance — contour variants for the bird, line styles for the corridor, shapes for the marks of light, accent lines for the interface. Every item is priced plainly, tied to the world where you exchange it, and has no effect whatsoever on speed, judgement, difficulty or reward. There are no boxes, no odds, no bundles.

RECORDS
A triumph ledger keeps what you have done, revealed only once it happens. A chronicle keeps your state trends, your grade distribution and every passage you have flown, and can copy it all to your clipboard as plain text if you want to look back later.

QUIET BY DESIGN
No account. No connection. No advertising. No analytics. No in-app purchases. No leaderboards. Everything lives in a local database on your device. Animation intensity and touch response can both be softened, for those who find motion or speed uncomfortable.

AetherAviary is made for players who would rather sit with something small and well-made than be pushed through it.

name: Agent Line
description:
Agent Line is a phone for your own AI voice agents.

You run the agents on a server you control. Agent Line connects to it, lists your agents and lets you call any of them with one tap. The call uses the iPhone's own call screen, keeps going when you lock the phone, and works with your headphones.

- Pair a server by scanning its QR code or opening its pairing link.
- Connect several servers and see all their agents in one list.
- See whether the agent is listening, thinking or speaking.
- Give each agent a photo or an icon. These stay on your phone.
- Review your recent calls and call an agent back from the list.
- Light and dark themes.

Agent Line has no account, no subscription and no tracking. It talks only to the servers you add.

Agent Line is open source, with an example server you can run against LiveKit.

name: Agent Pro
description:
Tranquil Agent PRO is the all-in-one sales app for real estate channel partners and agents. Manage your leads, customers, team and earnings in one place, and give your buyers a dedicated portal to track their home purchase.

FOR AGENTS & CHANNEL PARTNERS
• Dashboard: see deals closed, deal value, active leads and total earnings at a glance
• Register Completed Site Visit: add a new lead in seconds
• My Customers: track every customer through Site Visited, Negotiated, Sale and Booked, with quick search and one-tap calling
• Sales Follow-ups & Data Calls: plan your next activity and call leads by category
• Projects & Offers: browse projects, unit plans, galleries and the latest offers
• Creatives: share ready-made marketing images to WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram and X, or save them to your gallery

GROW YOUR TEAM
• Add agents to your direct team and track their performance
• Send associate invite links
• Reach each project's site in-charge with one tap

TOOLS TO SELL SMARTER
• Lead generation tools and social media boosting
• Home Loan EMI, Loan Eligibility, Stamp Duty and Future Value calculators
• AI prompt library for marketing content

REQUESTS & EARNINGS
• Wallet requests to withdraw your commission
• Vehicle and material requests
• Bonanza incentive schemes and sales history

BUYER PORTAL
Buyers sign in with their mobile number to:
• View purchase details, payment schedule, receipts and demand letters
• Track loan status and site construction progress
• Raise customization and service requests and chat with the team
• Share feedback

Secure sign-in with mobile number and OTP.

name: AgentAway: AI Coding Remote
description:
AgentAway lets you keep working with the coding agents on your own computer or server from your iPhone. Start a task at your desk, then follow it, answer it and approve its commands from anywhere.

It works with the agents you already use, such as Claude Code and Codex, signed in with your own accounts. AgentAway does not provide any AI model or agent: your requests are handled on your machine, by your agent.

Follow every session
· All sessions on your machine in one list, with what each one said last
· See which are running and which are waiting for you
· Open any session, including ones started in a terminal, and pick up where it left off

See what the agent did
· Each turn folds into a short summary: files read, commands run, edits made
· Open an edit to see the diff, a command to see its output
· Answers render natively: headings, lists, tables, code and links

Stay in control
· When the agent wants to run a command or edit a file, approve or deny it from your phone
· Choose the agent, the model and how hard it thinks, from the options your agent offers
· Get a notification when a session finishes or needs you

Know your limits
· Plan quotas and usage, read from the agents on your machine

Private by design
· Pair by scanning a code your machine shows. No account, no sign-up
· Everything between your phone and your machine is end-to-end encrypted, through a relay that only forwards it
· AgentAway collects no data. The host program is open source (MIT)

How to start
1. On your computer or server, run: npx agentaway
2. Scan the QR code it shows with AgentAway

Claude Code and Codex are trademarks of their respective owners. AgentAway is an independent open-source project and is not affiliated with them.

name: Agreement Guard
description:
Delivery plans drift when requests are agreed without seeing what they add. Agreement Guard keeps an original effort and date baseline in view while every proposed change goes through a clear decision.

Define deliverables with acceptance conditions, then record actual work and evidence when they are complete. Change Desk previews added or removed effort and target-date shifts before you approve, defer or decline with a reason. Only approved requests change the active plan. Review compares original, active and actual hours, flags overruns, shows pending exposure and preserves a dated decision trail. Share a plain-text summary deliberately when you need to discuss the agreement.

Agreement Guard works offline and includes multiple engagements, search and status filters, light and dark appearance, optional sound and an in-app guide. No account is required.

name: Agriland
description:
Agriland, négociant en pièces agricoles d'occasion à Languidic (Morbihan), dans votre poche.

Chaque jour, nous démontons des tracteurs et des machines agricoles pour proposer des pièces contrôlées, au juste prix. Avec l'application, trouvez la bonne pièce et suivez vos commandes, même depuis le champ.

LES PIÈCES QUI VONT SUR VOS MACHINES
• Choisissez votre tracteur : l'application affiche les pièces compatibles en premier.
• Parcourez le catalogue par catégorie, marque et modèle, ou cherchez par nom et référence.
• Pour chaque pièce : photos, état, prix, référence constructeur, modèles compatibles et machine sur laquelle elle a été démontée.

UNE PIÈCE INTROUVABLE ? DEMANDEZ-LA
• Demandez une pièce du catalogue, ou décrivez celle que vous cherchez.
• L'équipe Agriland vous répond directement dans l'application, avec une notification.

SUIVEZ VOS AFFAIRES PAS À PAS
• Toutes vos affaires en cours, machine par machine.
• Échangez avec l'équipe et envoyez vos photos depuis le téléphone.
• Soyez prévenu à chaque étape : pièce trouvée, devis envoyé, colis expédié.

VOS DOCUMENTS TOUJOURS SOUS LA MAIN
• Devis, commandes, factures et avoirs, à consulter et à partager en PDF.
• Vos machines et vos adresses de livraison et de facturation au même endroit.

SIMPLE ET SÛR
• Connexion par un code reçu par e-mail ou SMS : pas de mot de passe à retenir.
• Déverrouillage par empreinte ou visage si vous le souhaitez.
• Plusieurs comptes sur le même téléphone, pour passer d'une société à l'autre.

POUR L'ÉQUIPE AGRILAND
Préparation des commandes au scan, mise en stock, planning et affaires, avec de gros boutons faciles à utiliser même avec des gants.

L'application est réservée aux clients d'Agriland : votre accès vous est envoyé par notre équipe. Pas encore client ? Contactez-nous sur agrilandtrader.com.

name: AGRO+ CAPACITACIONES
description: AGRO+ Capacitaciones es la app para los usuarios del módulo Capacitaciones de AGRO+ que permitirá a los usuarios registrar las asistencias de sus reuniones y capacitaciones de forma fácil y rápida.

name: AHT Books: PDF Reader & Notes
description:
AHT Books is a private PDF reader, PDF annotator and handwriting notes app for iPhone and iPad. Read and highlight PDFs, write notes with Apple Pencil, study with flashcards, and fill and sign documents, all offline, with no account and no ads.

Built for students, professionals and anyone who reads textbooks, manuals, papers and forms, AHT Books keeps your documents, notes and study progress in one place.

READ PDFs YOUR WAY
• Smooth PDF viewer with continuous scrolling, page-by-page swiping or single-page reading
• Light, Dark, Sepia and Mint page colors, plus a full dark mode for the whole app
• Jump through long documents with the table of contents and bookmarks
• Search the text of any PDF with selectable text
• Always reopen a book on the page where you stopped

HIGHLIGHT AND ANNOTATE PDFs
• Highlight, underline or strike through text in several colors
• Draw on PDFs with pens and markers from a spinning tool dial at the edge of the page
• Add notes and bookmarks, with undo and redo
• Send a passage to your notebook or turn it into a flashcard in one tap
• Share an annotated copy of any PDF

HANDWRITTEN NOTES WITH APPLE PENCIL
• Digital notebooks with blank, ruled, grid, dotted, Cornell, music, checklist and more paper templates
• Low-latency Apple Pencil and finger writing, shape recognition, lasso, text boxes, photos and sticky notes
• Study tape to hide answers while you revise, and a laser pointer for presenting
• Organize notes with folders, tags and search, and export pages to PDF or image

FLASHCARDS AND SPACED REPETITION
• Basic, reversed and fill-in-the-blank (cloze) flashcards
• Spaced repetition schedules every card for the right day, so you remember more with less study time
• A handwriting scratchpad to work out answers before you reveal them

FILL AND SIGN PDF FORMS
• Draw and save your signature and initials
• Add signatures, initials, text, dates and checkmarks to any PDF
• Save a signed copy while your original file stays unchanged

BUILD A DAILY READING HABIT
• Set a daily reading goal and watch your progress ring fill
• Keep your reading streak going and see your whole week at a glance

ORGANIZE YOUR LIBRARY
• Import PDFs from the Files app, or open them from any app with Open In
• Favorites, collections and recently read books
• Search, sort, and switch between grid and list views

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE BY DESIGN
AHT Books has no account, no ads and no tracking, and it does not connect to the internet. Your PDFs, notes, flashcards and signatures stay on your iPhone and iPad.

Good to know: scanned PDFs without a text layer can be read and annotated, but their text cannot be searched.

AHT Books is made by Al Hadaf Tech (AHT). Questions or feedback? Write to aht.apps@alhadaftech.com.

name: Ai Quick Picker
description:
Ai Quick Picker makes it easy to choose lottery numbers that fit your game and your preferences. Set your rules, tap Quick Pick, and get a line in seconds. Save your favourite game formats so your setup is ready the next time you play.

QUICK PICKS FOR YOUR LOTTERIES

Use large, easy-to-read sliders to set how many numbers to pick and choose the range. Ai Quick Picker supports formats used by major lotteries, including Pick 2, Pick 3, Pick 4, Lotto 6/49, custom number pools, and games with a separate Powerball or Grand Number. Save each game you play as a named preset.

LEARN FROM YOUR DRAW HISTORY

Save the lines you played and enter winning results, including a bonus number where applicable. See how your lines matched, filter your history by game, and explore which numbers appeared most or least often in the results you’ve recorded. As your history grows, you’ll get a better feel for the patterns in past draws and more ways to decide how you’d like to build your next line.

MAKE PICKING NUMBERS FUN AGAIN

The optional one-time AI unlock gives you more ways to make a pick your own. Build around your lucky numbers, choose a mix of odd and even numbers, or describe the feel you want in your own words. Try “a hot afternoon sun” and see what Smart Pick comes up with. You can also get a Pick of the Day from one of your saved presets, ask questions about your draw history, or import a winning result from pasted text or a screenshot.

On compatible devices, Apple Intelligence works on-device and can explain how your preferences shaped a pick. Historical results and AI suggestions do not improve the odds of winning.

DESIGNED FOR THE LATEST IPHONE AND IPAD

Ai Quick Picker is optimized for the latest iPhone and iPad models, with on-device Apple Intelligence features on compatible devices. Generous touch controls, clear number displays, and soft green pinstripes give the app a calm, uncluttered look. Move between Picker, History, and Statistics with a tap.

Quick Pick, saved presets, manual draw history, and basic statistics are free to use. Requires iOS 26 or iPadOS 26 or later.

name: AI TrailCam WiFi
seller_name: Beijing Daniu'er Technology Development Co., Ltd.
description:
AI TrailCam WiFi is the companion app for AI TrailCam WiFi trail cameras. Set up, control, and manage your camera
  entirely from your phone — even deep in the field, with no cellular service required.

  ONE-STEP SETUP
  Power on the camera and tap Connect. The app pairs over Bluetooth, then joins the camera's own WiFi hotspot
  automatically. First-time pairing takes about a minute.

  LIVE PREVIEW
  See exactly what your camera sees, in real time. Frame your shot, check mounting angle, and confirm the trigger
  zone before you walk away.

  BROWSE & DOWNLOAD
  Flip through photos and videos captured by the camera over the local connection. Download the shots you want and
  keep them in your phone's photo library.

  REMOTE SETTINGS
  Adjust video resolution, clip length, audio, storage mode and more — then push the changes to the camera instantly.

  BUILT FOR THE FIELD
  The app talks to the camera directly over the camera's local hotspot. No account, no cloud, no subscription. Your
  footage never leaves your devices.

  NOTE: This app requires a compatible AI TrailCam WiFi camera and cannot be used on its own.

name: Airafter: Quit Vaping Now
description:
Life after the last puff.

Airafter helps you notice your vaping habit and cut back or quit at your own pace. One tap turns an unnoticed puff into a moment of awareness. Watch the smoke gather, look back at your days, and make a little more room for yourself.

ONE TAP. ONE PUFF.
• Tap Puff each time you vape. The smoke gathering in the circle shows how your day is going.
• Record from the app, the Home Screen widget, or the Lock Screen with a Live Activity.

A CLEARER PICTURE
• Turn the day wheel to look back at any day since you started.
• See your recent 7 days, your daily puffs, and how today compares with your usual habit.
• Count your vape-free days and see an estimate of the money you’ve saved, based on what your vape costs.

A PACE THAT’S YOURS
• Quit right now, or cut back a little each day. On the gradual plan, yesterday’s count becomes today’s limit.
• Today’s count changes color as you get close to your limit.
• Change your plan whenever you need to.

GENTLE SUPPORT
• If you haven’t vaped by early afternoon, a reminder encourages you to keep it going.
• There’s no perfect streak to protect. Some days are easier than others, and your record helps you notice what’s changing.

YOUR RECORDS, WITH YOUR ACCOUNT
Sign in with Apple to keep your records with your account and pick up where you left off on another device.

AIRAFTER PRO
Record free through day three, starting with your first puff. Keep going with Airafter Pro, available as a monthly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase.

Terms of Use: https://airafter.softclub.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://airafter.softclub.dev/privacy

name: Airlock Rate
description:
Airlock Rate keeps one cellar of fermentations on this iPhone. Tap once for each bubble you hear. The crock shows bubbles per minute.

Log a hydrometer reading. The gravity is corrected for the sample temperature, then attenuation and alcohol update. Shift the timeline to see whether the rate is slowing.

Two readings about 48 hours apart, with a quiet airlock, mark the batch ready to bottle. Priming sugar is the grams to add for the carbonation you want. Share a CSV of the batch. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: AiTopNews
seller_name: Shanghai Meien Jingde Network Technology Co., Ltd
description:
AiTopNews reads a fixed list of AI industry sources, picks out what is worth reading, and puts reports of the same event together — so you can catch up in a few minutes a day.

WHAT YOU GET
• Curated feed — every item shows why it was picked, with the link to the original source
• Grouped events — several reports of one story side by side, so you see the whole picture
• Daily Brief at 08:00 (UTC+8), plus a Weekly edition on Mondays and a Monthly on the 1st
• Search across items, events and editions
• Saves that stay on this device and stay readable offline
• Five languages — English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Vietnamese and Thai — with the original text next to the translation
• Share to any app, native navigation, edge-swipe back
• Read state is local: the app remembers what you have read, on this device only

WHAT IT IS NOT
• No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking or analytics SDKs
• No remote feature switches: copy changes and fixes ship as app updates
• Sources keep their rights — items link to the original, and full text is shown only when the source allows it

The app reads the same publication as aitopnews.wiki, built for reading on a phone.

name: Alderwyn
description: Keep a borderline stem in its original sweep. Record point, sector, species and BAF; remeasure DBH and horizontal range with separate uncertainties without adding a second tree. Confirmed basal area stays apart from unresolved contribution. Trace source revisions, undo original changes and freeze a handover for PDF, JSON or CSV sharing. Optional point coordinates never measure tree range. Landmark photos and timed voice notes stay local under the same point ID, outside counts and frozen exports. Home feedback is a local demo.

name: Alicea Cleaning Service
description:
Alicea Cleaning Service makes it easy to request professional residential and commercial cleaning services.

Browse our cleaning services, get a preliminary cleaning estimate, choose your preferred appointment date, and submit your cleaning request directly from your iPhone.

Our services include standard cleaning, deep cleaning, and more.

Serving New Jersey and nearby communities, Alicea Cleaning Service is committed to reliable service, attention to detail, and customer satisfaction.

Appointments are confirmed after approval by our team.

name: AllTV: Universal TV Remote
description:
AllTV turns your phone into a remote for the smart TVs and streaming players on your Wi-Fi. There's no extra hardware, no account and no sign-in. Open the app, choose your TV, and start pressing.

WORKS WITH
Samsung, LG, Sony, Roku, Fire TV, Vizio, Philips, Panasonic and Hisense, plus TVs and streaming players running Google TV or Android TV. Older Samsung and LG sets work too. Which buttons work depends on your TV, and the app dims the ones your TV doesn't offer, so you can see what's available before you press.

EVERYTHING ON ONE SCREEN
- D-pad and OK, in a round or square style
- Volume, channel, mute and power
- Home, back, menu, guide, source and info
- Play, pause, stop, rewind, fast forward and record
- A number pad for going straight to a channel

TOUCHPAD
Swipe to move, tap for OK, and hold for the menu, without looking down at your phone.

KEYBOARD
Type into your TV's search box from your phone, on TVs that allow it.

OPEN YOUR APPS
See the streaming apps on your TV, open them with one tap, and pin the ones you use most, on TVs that allow it.

EASY TO SET UP
AllTV finds TVs on your Wi-Fi by itself. If one doesn't show up, add it by its IP address. The first time you connect, your TV may ask you to allow the connection or show a code to enter. Your TVs are saved, so next time it's one tap, and a pairing troubleshooter walks you through what each brand needs.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose your button size and D-pad style, turn haptic feedback on or off, and keep the screen awake while you use it. Text sizes follow your iOS settings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
AllTV talks directly to your TV over your own network. It has no ads, no analytics and no tracking, and it collects no data. Pairing keys are kept in your device's Keychain.

GOOD TO KNOW
Your phone and TV need to be on the same Wi-Fi network, and your TV needs to be on. A TV that's fully off can't be turned on from the app. Some guest networks block devices from reaching each other. The newest Hisense firmware isn't supported.

AllTV is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any TV brand or streaming service mentioned here. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/alltv-main/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/alltv-main/privacy-policy

name: Amsterdam Trip
description:
Amsterdam Trip brings Amsterdam’s sights and food stops together in a simple city guide. Explore museums, neighbourhoods, parks and popular places to eat, then save the places you want to visit.

Read short descriptions, practical tips and official visitor links. Allow location access to sort nearby places by approximate distance. Open in Maps takes you to Google Maps.

Save places and daily plans on your device, mark the walking stops you have seen and share individual venues. Switch between Turkish and English whenever you like.

Hours, tickets and menus can change. Check the venues’ official links for current conditions. Amsterdam Trip does not sell tickets or make reservations.

Follow the two-day Amsterdam itinerary or choose a shorter walk. Read practical notes on getting around and museum visits. No account is required.

name: Anamnesis: Private Transcriber
description:
Anamnesis turns what you hear into text you keep. Poems, speeches, stories, talks, plans: whatever is playing on your device, transcribed on the device itself and saved to a private library.

HOW IT WORKS
• Add the Transcribe control to Control Center (the app shows you how), or tap the orb in the app.
• Choose Share Entire Screen in Apple's system sheet, then go back to what you were watching or listening to.
• Stop from the Live Activity, Control Center or the recording indicator. Open Anamnesis and your transcript is in the Library.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Transcription uses Apple's on-device speech recognition. Anamnesis has no account, no servers, no analytics and no tracking.
• It records only the sound other apps play — never your microphone — and never keeps the video.
• Audio is deleted as soon as it has been transcribed. Only the text stays, on your device.

YOUR LIBRARY
• Search everything you've kept, edit the text, add a title, the speaker and a link to the source.
• Copy a transcript, or share it as a card that credits the speaker.
• Write transcripts by hand with the same editor.

GOOD TO KNOW
• English speech only in this version.
• The first launch downloads Apple's English speech model once (a system download; internet needed that one time).
• Locking the screen ends a recording; stop and start again after unlocking.
• Requires iOS 27 or later.

For personal use: transcribe only what you're allowed to listen to, and credit people when you share their words.

name: Anima: Guided Sessions
description:
Anima is a free app of guided sessions made to help you slow down, breathe and feel more balanced in everyday life.

Open the app, pick a session and press play. Every session is a short guided video you can watch whenever it suits you, at home, on a break or before bed.

WHAT YOU GET
• Guided video sessions for relaxation, focus and mindful living
• Courses with step-by-step lessons you can follow at your own pace
• Short story-style highlights for quick daily inspiration
• Gentle reminders and notifications so you can build a steady routine
• A clean, calm design with a soothing dark theme that is easy on the eyes
• Simple sign-in with your email and a one-time code. No passwords to forget.

COMPLETELY FREE
Anima has no subscriptions, no paywalls and no in-app purchases. Everything in the app is free to use.

YOUR PRIVACY MATTERS
You are in control of your account. You can delete your account and data at any time from within the app.

Download Anima today and give yourself a few quiet minutes each day.

name: Antes y Después
description:
Antes y Después es un juego de cartas para dos personas, cada una desde su iPhone.

CÓMO SE JUEGA
• Cada jugador tiene un tablero de 7 filas y 3 columnas: Antes, Medio y Después.
• Al empezar, cada uno elige los 7 números de su columna del medio, del 1 al 8. El otro no los ve hasta que los dos están listos.
• Por turnos, cada uno saca una carta del mazo, del 0 al 9.
• En Antes solo va el número anterior al del medio y en Después solo el siguiente. Con un 5 en el medio: antes el 4 y después el 6.
• Si la carta no sirve, se pasa: va al descarte y le toca al otro.
• Gana quien llene primero los 14 espacios de Antes y Después.

JUGAR CON OTRA PERSONA
Un jugador crea la partida y recibe un código de 4 letras. El otro lo escribe o abre la invitación que le llega por mensaje. La partida queda guardada: si se cierra la app, al abrirla vuelve a la misma partida.

PRÁCTICA
Partidas contra la computadora, sin internet.

DETALLES
• Mesa en 3D con animaciones para cada jugada.
• Sonidos y vibración, que se pueden apagar.
• Sin cuentas, sin publicidad y sin compras dentro de la app.

name: Apex Hyperbike GP
description:
PAY ONCE. RACE OFFLINE.
No ads. No subscriptions. No in-app purchases. No personal data collected by the game.

Apex Hyperbike GP brings arcade motorcycle racing to iPhone and iPad. Lean through banked corners, draft behind rivals to charge your nitro, launch rocket starts, and weave through traffic on six fictional circuits.

RACE YOUR WAY
Climb a six-cup Career from Rookie Cup to the eight-round World Finals. Jump into Quick Race, chase bronze, silver, and gold lap times in Time Trial, or race a friend in same-device two-player split-screen. Four difficulty settings let you choose the challenge.

BUILD YOUR GARAGE
Earn credits through racing to unlock six bikes, choose paint liveries, and improve six performance parts across ten upgrade levels. Every unlock is earned through play.

SIX DISTINCT CIRCUITS
Race through alpine mountains, a coastal sunset, a neon expressway, desert towers, marina streets, and an aurora-lit glacier.

ARCADE ACTION
Use nitro, slipstream drafting, wheelies, rocket starts, shields, EMP, and homing missiles. Choose chase, low chase, helmet, or TV camera views. Enjoy an original synthwave soundtrack.

CONTROLS THAT FIT
Use touch buttons or optional tilt steering, turn on auto-acceleration, or connect a compatible game controller. Two-player split-screen uses one device.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
All racing content is included with installation. No account is required. Career, garage, settings, and records are saved on your device. The game includes no advertising, tracking, analytics service, subscriptions, or in-app purchases. Purchase, download, updates, and opening support pages require internet access.

Support: shehab@shehab.cloud
Privacy: https://shehab.cloud/apex-hyperbike-gp/privacy/
Terms: https://shehab.cloud/apex-hyperbike-gp/terms/

name: Aqar Found
description:
اكتشف العقارات المناسبة لك مع عقاري Aqari.

عقاري هو تطبيق يساعدك على البحث عن العقارات المعروضة للبيع والإيجار واستكشاف تفاصيلها بطريقة سهلة ومنظمة.

**مميزات التطبيق:**

- تصفح العقارات المتاحة للبيع والإيجار.
- البحث عن العقارات حسب المنطقة والميزانية.
- الاطلاع على صور العقارات وتفاصيلها.
- حفظ العقارات المفضلة للرجوع إليها لاحقا.
- إرسال طلب لإضافة عقارك إلى المنصة.
- طلب معاينة العقارات والتواصل بشأنها.

**عقاري — ابحث عن عقارك القادم.**

name: Aress Mice
seller_name: ARESS TURIZM TEDARIK ARAC KIRALAMA INSAAT DANISMANLIK EGITIM ITHALAT IHRACAT TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
Aress Mice is the official app for attendees of congresses, scientific meetings and events organised by Aress Turizm. There is no need to download a separate app for each event: all the events you attend are in one app.

How do you find your event?
• With your phone number: enter the number you registered with and type the code sent by SMS. All the events you are registered for are listed and you are signed in to each of them.
• With an event code: type the code from your invitation e-mail, your badge or the poster at the registration desk.
• With a QR code or invitation link: scan the event QR code or tap the invitation link and your event opens directly.

Inside each event (sections vary by event)
• Scientific programme: sessions, speakers and halls, day by day.
• Announcements with push notifications.
• QR badge: the digital attendee badge scanned at registration and session entrances.
• E-certificate and invitation letter as PDF.
• Questions to speakers and live voting, moderated by the organiser.
• Find My Photos: with your consent, find yourself in the official event photos.

If you attend more than one event, switch between them with one tap. Past events stay in the list for a while so you can download your certificate later.

The programme, announcements and contact details open without signing in. The QR badge, certificate and photo search are available only to registered attendees. The app is free, with no purchases or ads. It provides no medical services, advice or product promotion; it only carries event information.

name: ARGUS Çözüm Stüdyosu
seller_name: ISLER EGITIM VE BILISIM TEKNOLOJILERI TICARET LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
ARGUS Çözüm Stüdyosu, yayınların öğretmenlerinin soru bankasındaki soruları çözüp anlattığı, editörlerin bu çözümleri incelediği uygulamadır. Öğretmen soruyu tabletinde kalemle çözer ve sesiyle anlatır; editör onaylayınca çözüm, ARGUS Yayıncılık uygulamasında öğrencilerin izleyeceği videoya dönüşür.

SANA ATANAN SORULAR
• Görevler ekranında çözülecek, incelemedeki ve sonuçlanan çözümlerin bir arada.
• Her kartta sorunun kendisi, dersi, sınıfı ve yayını.
• Bu ayki sıranı ve onaylanan çözüm sayını ana ekranda gör.

KALEMLE ÇÖZ, SESİNLE ANLAT
• Soru, kareli bir sayfanın üstünde açılır; altına kâğıttaki gibi yaz.
• Kalem, fosforlu kalem, silgi, şekil, grafik ve lazer araçları.
• Dokuz renk, dört kalınlık; geri al ve yinele.
• Kalemle yazmaya başladığında parmak artık çizmez, yalnız kaydırır ve yakınlaştırır: avucun ekrana değse de çizgi bırakmaz.
• Doğru cevabı göz simgesiyle yalnız kendin görürsün; kayda girmez.
• Kayda başla dediğinde çizdiğin her çizgi sesinle birlikte kaydedilir. Kaydı duraklatabilirsin; bir kayıt en çok 15 dakika sürer.

TESLİM ETMEDEN ÖNCE İZLE
• Çözümünü önizlemede baştan izle, hızlandır, ileri geri sar.
• Beğenmezsen yeniden kaydet, beğendiysen tek dokunuşla teslim et.
• Kayıt teslimden önce cihaza yazılır: bağlantı koparsa kaybolmaz, yükleme kaldığı yerden sürer.

EDİTÖR İNCELEMESİ
• Editörler teslim edilen çözümleri tek ekranda inceler: kaydı oynatır, doğru cevabı ve kazanımı görür.
• Çözümü puanlar, onaylar ya da notuyla geri gönderir.
• Geri gönderilen çözümün notu öğretmenin görev kartında yazar.

EMEĞİN GÖRÜNÜR OLSUN
• Onaylanan çözümlerinle aylık, dönemlik ve tüm zamanlar sıralamasında yerini gör.
• Sıralamada adlar yalnız ilk harfleriyle görünür.

KİMLER İÇİN
• Hesaplar yayının yöneticisi tarafından ARGUS Soru Bankası panelinde açılır; uygulamada hesap oluşturulmaz.
• Tablet, telefon ve iPad'de çalışır.
• Reklam ve izleme aracı yok.

name: Arira - Cards
description: Arira is a local-first visual notes app for turning small ideas into beautiful image cards. Write a thought, choose a layout and palette, organize cards into boards, revisit recent or favorite ideas, and share polished card images when you are ready. Optional photo, camera, and voice-note attachments stay on this device and never stand between you and the core card workflow.

name: Arrow Mind: Puzzle Path
description:
Every board is a knot. Find a piece that can leave, tap it, and watch the knot come undone.

ArrowMind is a calm, clever puzzle about reading a board before you touch it. Each arrow flies straight out of its own head — if anything stands in the way, it cannot move. Clear them in the right order and the board empties.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Tap an arrow to fire it along its own direction.
• Blocked arrows stay put, and tapping one costs a heart — you start every level with three.
• Work out which arrows are actually free, then strip the board from the outside in.
• Some boards hide black holes that swallow arrows and change the whole route.
• Rainbow arrows chain: fire one and it sweeps several arrows away at once.
• Run out of hearts and a free revive refills all three, so you can carry on with the same board.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 22,000+ main levels, unlocked in order, from gentle warm-ups to Expert and Master.
• 600+ daily challenges and a rotating set of Fun levels.
• A daily streak that lights up as you play, plus long-running tracks — Level Legend, Perfect Play, Unstoppable and Challenge Trophies — and Star, Target and Skull awards.
• Difficulty labels (Tutorial, Easy, Normal, Hard, Expert, Master) so you know what you are walking into.
• Five languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Korean.
• Dark mode, optional guide lines, sound and vibration toggles.

BUILT TO RESPECT YOU
• 100% offline. Progress is saved on your device only.
• No ads, no energy timers, no purchases. Hints and revives are free.
• Small install, instant start, plays with one thumb.

Take your time. Look first, then move. The path opens as you go.

name: Artem's Dumpling Quest
description:
Choose a hero, collect dumplings and build your next adventure.

EXPLORE AND DISCOVER
Visit twelve themed islands, find hidden weapons, take on missions and face oversized robots, ancient trees, dragons and fire frogs. Ride the roller coaster in first person or take a turn on the Ferris wheel.

MAKE YOUR HERO YOUR OWN
Choose from 48 heroes and 48 weapons. Raise each hero to level 40, discover Fire and Void weapon crystals, and unlock ten outfit themes for each hero using crystals earned through play. No real-money purchases.

BUILD AND BATTLE
Create a town in the single-player building mode. Practise base battles against bots, or invite friends through Game Center for an online team battle. Spend three minutes building walls, gates, archer towers, laser towers and traps, then defend your team's core. The friends lobby supports 2–16 participants, up to eight per team.

KEEP YOUR SCORE
Earn points from collecting and combat. Choose to share your cumulative score on the Game Center all-time leaderboard.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Online team battles require internet, Game Center and compatible game versions. A shared Wi-Fi network is not required.
• One participant hosts the match. If a participant leaves or disconnects, create a new match.
• Expedition, obstacle-course and town modes are single-player.
• Inventory and town progress are saved on the device and do not sync across devices.
• No advertising, in-app purchases, text chat or voice chat.
• English and Russian menus.

An original birthday adventure made for Artem.

name: Aruvita: Step Counter & Weight
description:
Aruvita is a step counter that brings your daily steps and your body records, like weight and blood pressure, together in one place. Open the app and your steps for today appear in a large ring, with the records you care about lined up right below.

■ TODAY'S STEPS AT A GLANCE
• Live step count from your iPhone's pedometer (Apple Watch steps come in through the Health app)
• Go past your goal and the ring starts a second lap
• Distance, active calories, walking time and floors climbed
• Hourly steps as a bar chart — slide your finger to see each hour
• Swipe left and right to look back at past days

■ YOUR BODY RECORDS, TOO
• Log weight, body fat, blood pressure, blood glucose, body temperature and waist size with a tap
• Also shows BMI, resting heart rate, heart rate, blood oxygen and sleep
• Pick up to 6 items (9 with Pro) and arrange them in any order
• Records are saved to the Health app, so they work with your other apps

■ LOOK BACK WITH CHARTS
• Monthly step charts with your daily average and total distance
• Weight shows daily points and a 7-day average line, so trends are easy to see
• Monthly charts for the items on your panel
• Your monthly distance compared with a familiar route or landmark

■ MAKE IT YOURS
• 7 theme colors — your Home Screen icon changes to match
• Units for distance, weight, temperature and more follow your Health settings
• Available in 18 languages

■ PRIVATE AND SIMPLE
• No account needed
• Your steps and body records stay on your iPhone and in the Health app — they are never sent anywhere
• Back up to a file to move to a new phone, even to the Android version
• If a permission is missing, the app shows you exactly where to turn it on

■ ARUVITA PRO (ONE-TIME PURCHASE)
• No ads
• Up to 9 items on your panel (3 rows)
• 30 more items: walking (speed, step length and more), activity (exercise minutes and more), nutrition (calories, nutrients, caffeine), heart rate variability, respiratory rate and more
• Export your steps and body records as CSV (opens in Excel)
Buy once — no subscription.

Aruvita is made by KAIHAWK, an app studio in Japan. We'd love to hear from you — use Contact Us in the app's settings.

This app is not a medical device. Calories, walking time and similar figures are estimates.

Privacy Policy: https://kaihawk.jp/privacy.html

name: Ask Roadie
description:
Ask Roadie is troubleshooting for live-event techs. Pick the gear, say what it's doing, and get one clear answer: the steps to check, in order, for the console, wireless, switcher, projector, LED processor or show software in front of you.

Answers are grounded in real manufacturer manuals and fixes proven by working techs. When another tech has confirmed a fix, you'll see it.

BUILT FOR THE SHOW FLOOR
• Snap the label: photograph a model plate and Ask Roadie picks the gear for you
• Photo of the problem: an error screen or front panel becomes the description
• Ask out loud: dictate the question when your hands are full
• Share a fix with your crew in one tap
• My Fixes: your past sessions, saved on the phone for when the signal drops
• Sign in with Apple or Google

FIELD TOOLS
• Gear power draw: real power draw for show gear, totals for your setup, circuits and phase balance
• LED wall builder: resolution, power and data runs, with a wiring map
• Projector throw and speaker delay calculators
• Connectors & pinouts: XLR, speakON, powerCON, DMX, Ethernet, NEMA and twist-lock
• System cheat sheets for wireless, IEM, Dante, video and LED
• Signal generator: tones, noise, sweeps and full-screen video test patterns on an HDMI or AirPlay display
• RTA with feedback finder and SPL meter
• Ear training drills
• Daily 5 quiz: five quick questions a day on the gear you pick, with XP, levels and a weekly goal. Free on every account

SHOW TOOLS (included with every Ask Roadie plan)
• Stage timer: countdowns on an HDMI or AirPlay screen from your iPhone, with warnings, presenter messages and brand kits
• Remotes: run the Stage timer, Teleprompter and Remote Clicker on askroadie.app from your phone
• Line check meter for interface levels

Many field tools work offline. Troubleshooting needs a connection.

Try it free: create an account in the app or at askroadie.app.

Questions: support@askroadie.app

name: Astravoyage: Space Missions
description:
Astravoyage: Space Missions

Take command of your spacecraft and embark on an exciting journey through space!

Astravoyage: Space Missions brings together space exploration, action, spacecraft upgrades, and mission-based challenges in an immersive adventure designed for mobile players.

**EXPLORE THE UNIVERSE**

Travel through beautiful space environments, navigate challenging missions, and experience the thrill of piloting your own spacecraft.

**COMPLETE EXCITING MISSIONS**

Take on mission objectives, master your flight controls, overcome dangerous obstacles, and improve your skills as you progress.

**BUILD YOUR SPACECRAFT COLLECTION**

Explore different spacecraft, discover their capabilities, and expand your collection as you advance through the game.

**ACTION-PACKED SPACE GAMEPLAY**

Experience responsive spacecraft controls, powerful abilities, visual effects, and immersive space sound effects.

**ASTRAVOYAGE PREMIUM**

Upgrade your experience with Astravoyage Premium, available through monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscriptions.

Premium features include additional spacecraft access and special gameplay benefits. Individual spacecraft purchases may also be available separately.

Subscription pricing is displayed in the app before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account upon confirmation. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

**START YOUR SPACE ADVENTURE**

Launch your spacecraft, explore new challenges, and see how far your skills can take you.

Developed by MBDTECH LTD.

**Terms of Use (EULA):**
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

**Privacy Policy:**
Add your published privacy policy URL here before submission.

name: AstroUhr Astronomical Clock
description:
AstroUhr is the virtual twin of a real mechanical astronomical clock. Like the original, it is driven entirely by its gear geometry: a 24-hour dial, a sun hand, a moon hand and an eccentric date disc with months and zodiac signs, all turning together.

THE CLOCK
- 24-hour dial with noon at the top, Central European Time
- Sun hand with the sun on its holder, moving along the date disc
- Mechanical moon showing the mean moon and its phase relative to the sun
- Ring for true local solar time
- Twilight zones: civil, nautical and astronomical twilight, sunrise and sunset

TRUE MOON
Switch on "True Moon" to see where the real moon is. A ghost moon with a thin hand appears next to the mechanical moon, calculated with the precise lunar theory from Jean Meeus. The offset between the mechanical and the true moon is shown in degrees.

ASTRONOMICAL DATA
- UTC, Julian Date, CET and CEST (summer time highlighted)
- Terrestrial Dynamical Time and Julian Ephemeris Date
- True local time and true sidereal time
- Sunrise, sunset, equation of time and the sun's declination (VSOP87)

TIME TRAVEL
- Set any date and time in UTC
- Step by one day, one hour or one minute
- RUN: time lapse with your own speed in days, hours and minutes per second, forward or backward
- NOW: back to the current time, with smoothly animated hands

SPECIAL EVENTS
Jump directly to the next or previous:
- New Moon, First and Last Quarter, Full Moon
- March Equinox
- Solar and Lunar Eclipses
- Civil Dawn, Sunrise, High Noon, Sunset and Civil Dusk

All calculations are done on the device. The clock is set for the location of the original clock in Switzerland (47 15.3 N / 008 11.5 E) and shows Central European Time.

No account, no ads, no data collection.

name: Atermius
description:
A secure, native remote operations workspace built for developers, sysadmins, and DevOps engineers. Manage SSH, SFTP/SCP, Telnet, RDP, and VNC connections in one unified interface—combining instant offline local vaults with optional zero-knowledge end-to-end encrypted synchronization.

INSTANT OFFLINE ACCESS — NO SIGN-UP REQUIRED
• Launch and connect immediately with zero mandatory registration or login walls.
• Your local encrypted profile is automatically protected by the iOS / iPadOS Keychain and optional Face ID / Touch ID authentication. All host profiles, credentials, and private keys stay encrypted on your device by default.

ALL-IN-ONE MULTI-PROTOCOL WORKSPACE
• SSH Terminal: Responsive terminal emulation with live session switching, split panes, session reconnect controls, hardware keyboard shortcuts, and an ergonomic on-screen modifier bar (Ctrl, Alt, Shift, Esc, Tab).
• SFTP & SCP File Manager: Browse remote directories, upload and download files with transfer progress and resume support, and manage encrypted host attachments.
• RDP, VNC & Telnet Clients: Connect to remote desktops and network gear with SHA-256 certificate fingerprint verification, flexible display scaling, and switchable direct-touch or relative trackpad pointer modes.

BUILT FOR SERIOUS INFRASTRUCTURE WORKFLOWS
• On-Device Keychain & Key Generator: Generate, import, and manage Ed25519 and RSA SSH keys directly on your device.
• Port Forwarding & Jump Hosts: Configure local, remote, and dynamic port forwarding tunnels alongside multi-hop SSH bastion hosts.
• Snippets & Host Organization: Group servers with tags and folders, and save frequently used shell commands as reusable snippets.
• Encrypted Import & Export: Easily back up or migrate configurations via encrypted archives and standard SSH config imports.

OPTIONAL SELF-HOSTED ZERO-KNOWLEDGE SYNC
• Teams and power users running their own self-hosted server can optionally enable cross-device Vault synchronization.
• Powered by client-side AEAD encryption and cryptographic device signatures: every host record, credential, key, and chunked attachment is encrypted before leaving your device. The server stores opaque ciphertext only and never sees plaintext secrets.

DESIGNED FOR iPHONE & iPAD
• Native Liquid Glass & Cupertino experience with full support for iPad multitasking, custom terminal color palettes, adjustable typography, and localized interfaces in English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, and Russian.

name: Audiovisor
description:
See what you hear.

Audiovisor turns your own music into an expressive visual instrument for iPhone and iPad. Choose a track, find a visual world, and watch the sound take shape.

24 VISUAL WORLDS
Explore spectrum bars, liquid metal, nebulas, kaleidoscopes, galaxies and more. Every scene responds to the audio playing in the app.

YOUR MUSIC, CLOSE AT HAND
Import unprotected audio from Files or iCloud Drive. Your private library stays available offline, so your next session is always a few taps away. Try the built-in demo to get started immediately.

MAKE IT YOURS
Explore 32 color themes, tune the sound with the equalizer and audio effects, and double-tap the stage for an immersive view.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Imported audio is analyzed on your device and never uploaded. No account, advertising or tracking is required.

Supports common unprotected audio formats including MP3, M4A, WAV and FLAC, up to 100 MB per imported file. Playback support depends on the file’s codec. Protected downloads from subscription streaming services cannot be imported.

name: Aurnovem: Weight, Runs & Gym
description:
A little, every day.

Aurnovem brings your daily weight, runs, push-ups, and gym sessions into one simple journal.

WATCH YOUR WEIGHT TREND
Log one weight per day, revisit past entries, and see your progress over 7, 30, or 90 days.

TURN A RUN INTO A FORECAST
Enter distance with duration, pace, or average speed. Choose a reference effort to see Riegel estimates for 1-, 2-, and 5-mile finish times and paces, with a prediction graph.

MAKE EVERY PUSH-UP COUNT
Add 1, 5, or 10 reps with a tap, correct a daily total, and see your history in a bar chart.

SHOW UP FOR YOUR GYM ROUTINE
Follow the included six-day routine with fixed sets and reps, editable weights, and set checkboxes. Aurnovem remembers the loads you actually used for each routine, saves unfinished workouts, and keeps your workout history. Suggested starting loads can be adjusted to suit you.

TAKE A MINUTE
Start a one-minute rest from a small button, including inside your workout. The countdown keeps time as you switch screens or reopen the app.

SEE PROGRESS ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
Add weight, race-forecast, and push-up widgets. The push-up widget lets you add reps without opening the app.

YOUR JOURNAL, ON YOUR DEVICE
Use pounds and miles or kilograms and kilometers. Core logging works offline, without an account, advertising, or subscriptions. Aurnovem does not upload your fitness journal. Privacy information and a delete-all-logs control are available in Settings.

Runs are entered manually; Aurnovem does not record GPS routes or connect to Apple Health. Race forecasts are estimates, and gym starting loads are adjustable suggestions. Aurnovem is a fitness journal, not a medical service. The rest timer provides an in-app completion cue, not a background alarm.

name: Auto Hub Zm Pro
description:
GROW YOUR AUTOMOTIVE BUSINESS WITH AUTO HUB ZM PRO

Auto Hub Zm Pro is a dedicated automotive business management application developed for spare-parts suppliers, mechanics, garages, towing operators, fitment centres, car dealers and vehicle hire businesses in Zambia.

Whether you operate an established automotive company or provide specialized vehicle services, Auto Hub Zm Pro helps you showcase your business, connect with potential customers and manage your business presence from one convenient platform.

CREATE YOUR BUSINESS PROFILE

Set up your automotive business profile with your business name, location, contact details, operating information and available services.

Help customers discover your business and learn more about the automotive solutions you provide.

SHOWCASE YOUR PRODUCTS & SERVICES

Create and manage listings for spare parts, automotive services, vehicles for sale and car hire offerings, depending on your business category.

Provide useful descriptions, photographs and relevant information to help customers understand your products and services.

CONNECT WITH CUSTOMERS

Reach motorists searching for automotive products and services through the Auto Hub Zm customer marketplace.

Make your business discoverable to customers looking for spare parts, vehicle maintenance, repairs, towing assistance, fitment services and other automotive solutions.

MANAGE CUSTOMER ENQUIRIES

Stay organized when handling customer requests, enquiries and service-related activity.

Keep track of business interactions and manage relevant information from your provider dashboard.

BUILT FOR AUTOMOTIVE PROFESSIONALS

Auto Hub Zm Pro supports different automotive business categories, including:

- Spare-parts shops and suppliers
- Professional mechanics
- Vehicle repair garages
- Towing and recovery operators
- Tyre and fitment centres
- Car dealerships and vehicle sellers
- Car hire and rental providers
- Other automotive service professionals

YOUR BUSINESS, YOUR DASHBOARD

Manage your business information, update listings and maintain your presence on the Auto Hub marketplace.

Designed to make automotive business management more accessible and convenient.

EXPAND YOUR REACH

Auto Hub Zm Pro connects automotive businesses with customers who need vehicle parts, services and solutions.

Build your business presence and become part of a growing digital automotive marketplace in Zambia.

ONE PLATFORM. MORE AUTOMOTIVE OPPORTUNITIES.

Auto Hub Zm Pro is intended for automotive businesses and service providers.

Customers looking to purchase spare parts, find mechanics, request automotive services or explore vehicles should use the Auto Hub Zm customer application.

Developed by XhuluTechnology Solutions.

name: Auto Post Scheduler
description:
Connect your YouTube channel and add finished videos. Auto Post Scheduler helps you plan uploads, sends them for publishing and shows their status.

THE HOME SCREEN ANSWERS ONE QUESTION
Is everything fine? Instead of a calendar where you hunt for problems, you get the answer in words: "Everything is on track" or "2 problems need you". Below it is a list of what to do, with the actions available for each issue.

SLOTS INSTEAD OF ALARMS
