Each channel has its own publishing times, weekdays and videos per day. A new video lands in the nearest free time by itself. Want another time? Pick it yourself: the app checks that it does not clash with neighbouring posts.

STOCK IN DAYS
For every channel you can see how many days of finished videos are left. The Today screen shows when a channel is running low.

PUBLISHING PACE
Set spacing between videos, a daily limit and a gradual publishing pace for new channels.

FAILURES EXPLAINED IN PLAIN WORDS
If a video did not go out, the app names the reason and offers an action: retry, reconnect the channel, replace the file.

ALL CHANNELS IN ONE LIST
The ones that need attention come first. Each shows its status and next scheduled video.

ALSO
• A two week schedule with a channel filter
• Move a video to the nearest slot or to your own time
• Pause a channel for a day, three days or a week
• Light and dark themes, English and Russian
• A demo mode with no sign up: six channels and every action

This app uses YouTube API Services. By connecting a channel you agree to the YouTube Terms of Service (https://www.youtube.com/t/terms) and the Google Privacy Policy (https://policies.google.com/privacy).

name: Automeliora
description:
Automeliora — Make every drive your own.

Discover car décor, comfort essentials, ambient lighting, cleaning care and thoughtful gifts, all selected to bring more character to every journey.

Shop for your car Browse curated collections, search by product or category, filter by price and availability, and check dimensions, compatibility and installation details before ordering.

Your personal garage Save favourite products, keep your shopping bag across visits, and use Buy Now when you only want to purchase the item in front of you. Your bag, saved items, addresses and orders stay separate for each account.

Delivery across Australia Choose standard delivery or Express post, view delivery costs before placing your order, and follow each order from confirmation to delivery. Card payment and cash on delivery are available.

Find your style Take the Style Finder for personalised recommendations, explore the Gift Guide, and manage your orders, addresses and preferences from your account.

Sign in with your Australian mobile number and make your car feel a little more like yours.

name: Avvi - Charm & Joy
description:
Avvi is a cozy companion app for caring for a digital friend, enjoying playful moments, and keeping small memories close.

Highlights:
- Care for a companion and help them grow through gentle daily routines.
- Enjoy short catch rounds and take your companion on scenic journeys.
- Create keepsake memory cards with photos and optional voice notes.

Make each visit a little brighter.

name: Aykut & Esra ile AYRA
description:
Aykut ve Esra ile yolculuğunuz artık cebinizde.

Ayratown uygulaması, Ayratown hesabınızdaki tüm içerikleri tek bir yerde toplar. Video setleriniz, online kamplarınız, workshoplarınız, sesli kitaplarınız ve hediyeleriniz, kaldığınız yerden devam etmeniz için sizi bekliyor.

İÇERİKLERİM
Sahip olduğunuz tüm programlar, videolar ve kaynaklar tek ekranda. Arayın, kategoriye göre süzün, bir videoyu telefonda yarım bırakıp bilgisayarda kaldığınız yerden izleyin.

GÜNLÜK PRATİKLERİM
Şükür, 20 Neden, Hedeflerim, Yaratım Günlüğüm, Puanlama, Vizyon Panosu ve Hatırlatmalarım her gün yanınızda. Şükürlerinizi sesli söyleyin, kaydedin, dilediğinizde kendi sesinizden dinleyin.

TORPİLLİLER KULÜBÜ
Canlı Podcast, Stargate Meditasyonu, Kundalini Yoga ve Zaman Tüneli yayınlarının haftalık akışı ve kayıtları.

EĞİTİMLERİM
Sertifika sınıfınızın sayfası, ödevleriniz, canlı buluşma bilgileri ve ders kayıtları.

AYROŞ
Aklınıza takılan her soruyu istediğiniz an sorabileceğiniz yardımcınız.

Uygulamayı kullanmak için Ayratown hesabınızla giriş yapmanız yeterli. Hesabınız yoksa uygulamadan ücretsiz üye olabilir, sizin için hazırladığımız hediyelerle başlayabilirsiniz.

Bir sorunuz olursa destek@ayratown.com adresine yazın, hemen yardımcı olalım.

Sevgiyle,
Aykut & Esra

name: Azminph
description: AzminphGain a clear view of how much money you save each month, how those savings accumulate over time, and where they are ultimately spent. Track your daily income, expenses, and account transfers; categorize expenditures—such as those for education, relocation, or emergencies—and attach payment receipts or notes. At the end of each month, reconcile your accounts and record any surplus into your savings ledger. If a shortfall arises, specify which month’s surplus should be used to cover it and link it to the actual expense. For every source of funds, you can view the original amount, the portion already spent, and the current remaining balance; you can also set aside funds for personal goals. Analyze the evolution of your savings and spending through retention curves, the "age" of your funds (how long they have been held), and a breakdown by purpose. The account page allows you to verify both your balances and the origins of your funds, seamlessly connecting your daily record-keeping, monthly closing, and goal planning.

name: B2B Code
description:
B2B Code puts your company's work system in your pocket: tasks, approvals, invoices, projects and client data.

TASKS
• «Today»: what needs attention, my tasks for the day, invoices to approve and to pay
• Task list and board, filters, due-date calendar
• Discussion in a task: comments, photos, files, @-mentions
• Voice tasks and dictation

INVOICES
• Approve an invoice in full or in part, reject with a reason
• Submit an invoice for approval from your phone: a photo or a file, fields recognised
• «To pay» and marking payments

PROJECTS AND DATA
• Projects by funnel stage, project history
• Records of clients, sites and catalogs
• For crane rental: trip plan and crane availability

FOR THE TEAM
• Push notifications about new tasks, mentions, approvals and payments
• Russian, English and German interface

For employees of companies that use B2B Code — a companion to the web version: the same accounts and data, with some sections (for example the payment calendar) only on the web. Accounts are created by the company's administrator. Try the demo to see how it works — no sign-up needed.

name: Baba Ifá
description:
O Baba Ifa e o assistente de estudo do Oluwo Ifatokun. Ele responde as suas perguntas sobre Ifa, os Odu e os itan, sempre a partir do acervo do Oluwo, e mostra de onde vem cada resposta.

O que voce faz no app
• Converse com o Baba e tire duvidas sobre os Odu, os itan e os termos em Yoruba.
• Veja a fonte: no modo Odu o texto vem direto do acervo, identificado como Texto do acervo.
• Retome conversas anteriores e acompanhe o uso do seu acesso.
• Denuncie qualquer resposta que pareca errada ou impropria.
• Exporte seus dados ou exclua sua conta dentro do app.

Importante
• E preciso ja ter uma conta de assinante do Baba Ifa para entrar. O app nao vende nada e nao tem precos nem compras.
• As respostas das conversas sao geradas por inteligencia artificial com base no acervo do Baba Ifa e podem conter erros. Elas nao substituem o Babalawo, o jogo de Ifa nem a orientacao de um profissional de saude.
• O app e pedagogico: ensina a tecnica do curso do Oluwo e nao se apresenta como a verdade absoluta sobre Ifa. Existem outras tecnicas e linhas.
• Conteudo para adultos: os itan sao apresentados fielmente, sem suavizar.

name: Baby Monitor - Bebek Telsizi
description:
Bebek Telsizi turns two phones you already own into a baby monitor in minutes. Put one phone near your baby, keep the other with you: listen live, get an alert when your baby cries, and check in on mobile, not only at home. No ads, no extra gadget. Sound recognition runs on the phone itself, so the audio is never uploaded to a server.

FEATURES
• Live listening: hear your baby in real time from anywhere in the house
• Cry alerts: crying and loud sounds are detected on the device itself and you are notified instantly
• Push to talk: soothe your baby with your own voice
• Lullabies, white noise and stories to help your baby fall asleep
• Room status: noise level and battery of the baby device at a glance
• Web Panel: listen from a browser on any device on the same network
• Quick pairing with a QR code

TWO WAYS TO CONNECT
• At home: both phones on the same Wi-Fi (or one phone's hotspot). The parent phone finds the baby phone automatically and the sound goes straight from phone to phone. No account, no internet needed.
• Mobile: listen over the internet when you are away from home, even on mobile data. The connection is direct between the two phones (WebRTC); when a direct route is not possible, an encrypted relay is used. The parent signs in once with Google. Mobile is free for everyone, with a daily live-listening limit on the free version.

PRIVACY
• Audio is processed on the phone and is never stored on a server.
• At home needs no account. For Mobile, only the parent signs in with Google; the baby phone uses an anonymous ID.
• Anonymous crash reports are collected to fix bugs. Usage statistics are only collected if you allow them.
• You can delete your Mobile account and pairings inside the app.

PREMIUM
Cry alerts and Baby Mode are free. Premium is a one-time purchase (no subscription) and unlocks unlimited listening, push to talk, automatic listening on crying, remote screen dimming, stories from YouTube and the Web Panel.

Baby Monitor is a helper tool. It does not replace parental supervision and is not a medical device.

name: Baby Reveal - Gender Reveal
description:
Make your baby's gender reveal a moment to share.

Baby Reveal turns the gender you enter into an interactive surprise. Choose a gift box, balloon, Polaroid, Starlight, Lucky Draw, or Party Popper reveal, add a letter to your baby, and share the joy with family and friends through a link.

An interactive surprise
- Tap the gift box three times to open the news.
- Blow into the microphone to fill the balloon and reveal your baby's gender.
- Rub the Polaroid photo to bring the surprise into view.
- Awaken the glowing stars to reveal the news in a celestial scene.
- Let the Lucky Draw balls roll out the big news.
- Pull the Party Popper to burst out the news with confetti.
- On-screen buttons let you continue if blowing or rubbing is difficult.

Share the joy with loved ones
- Add your baby's nickname and a personal letter.
- Guests can open the shared link, experience the reveal, and leave a heartfelt wish.
- Wishes are visible only to parents with management access.
- Save the result image to Photos.

Manage your memories
- Recover management access with your recovery code and PIN.
- Hide or delete wishes, report messages, or block their authors.
- Delete your reveal and its records from the management screen.

Good to know
Reveals, letters, and wishes are kept for 60 days from creation. Anyone with the shared link can view the revealed result and letter, so share it only with people you trust.

The microphone detects blowing for the balloon reveal. Audio is not recorded or sent to a server. You can use the on-screen buttons if you decline microphone access.

Some styles require watching an ad or making an in-app purchase.

Support: support@devpastudio.com

name: Balança Expert
description:
Balança Expert é o aplicativo de conferência de pesagem da Digmídia, para iPhone, iPad e Mac. No balcão de açougue, laticínios e outros pontos de peso, o operador lê a etiqueta e o aplicativo cruza código, peso e horário com o ERP/PDV da loja, devolvendo na hora o resultado: vendido, desistência, possível roubo, não encontrado ou pendente de sincronização.

O que você pode fazer
• Ativar o aparelho com o código e a senha gerados no painel, em Terminais, e entrar com o crachá da filial (CNPJ e código do usuário).
• Ler a etiqueta pela câmera ou digitá-la, inclusive o EAN-13 de balança, que preenche o peso ou o preço.
• Registrar coleta, devolução/desistência, consumo e avaria, conforme o perfil do operador.
• Manter uma fila local quando o aparelho estiver sem rede e reenviar as leituras automaticamente.
• Ver o histórico das leituras enviadas, na fila ou recusadas.
• No Mac, usar a câmera do computador, a Câmera de Continuidade do iPhone ou um leitor USB no campo focado.

O servidor é https://erp.balancaexpert.com. É necessário um terminal e um crachá emitidos no painel da loja. Não há anúncios, compras no aplicativo nem identificador de publicidade.

A câmera é usada apenas para ler o código de barras da etiqueta e do crachá. O aplicativo não grava foto nem vídeo. No Mac sem câmera, a digitação ou o leitor USB são o caminho principal.

Desenvolvido pela Digmídia. Publicado pela Bessa Sistema.

Política de privacidade: https://erp.balancaexpert.com/privacidade.html

name: Ball Destroyer - Cat Cannon
description:
Aim, release and watch the chaos! Ball Destroyer is a bright, satisfying arcade game where a brave little cat fires volleys of bouncing balls at numbered blocks. Every hit counts down: clear the board before the blocks reach your cannon.

- 100 hand-tuned levels across 5 worlds: Green Valley, Desert Storm, Frozen World, Lava World and Space World
- Epic boss blocks at the end of every world
- Endless Rift: an infinite roguelite run. Clear a wave, pick one of two power cards and build a crazy combo: thunderstorms, meteor showers, shockwaves, chain reactions and 50+ more powers
- Daily Rift: one shared challenge every day
- Explosive blocks, coin blocks, shields, drill balls and blast balls
- Combos, slow-motion finishers and juicy effects
- Upgrade your power, extra balls, critical hits and coin bonus
- Collect ball skins, cannons, cat outfits (pirate, ninja, wizard, astronaut, king...) and FX
- Daily rewards, daily and weekly missions and achievements
- Plays offline. No account needed.

Premium (optional auto-renewable subscription, monthly or yearly): no ads at all and +150 coins every day. Payment is charged to your Apple ID and renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Privacy: https://rubenmarti.es/legal/balldestroyer
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Bao & the Cloudkeepers
description:
A small courier. A very big sky.

Bao's first delivery becomes an adventure through a world that has forgotten how to change. With a wind-sailing scarf and Pip, a tiny companion with a big heart, help the Cloudkeepers bring the breeze back.

JUMP INTO AN ORIGINAL 3D ADVENTURE
Explore 40 stages across eight sky worlds, including eight boss encounters. Cross floating gardens, copper docks, moonlit paths, snowy heights and a silent citadel. Find 120 optional windseeds, wake windbells and discover routes beyond the main trail.

ONE SCARF. LOTS OF POSSIBILITIES.
Jump across gaps, hold to glide and send a gust through sleepy windbells and grumpy cloud creatures. Ride moving decks, catch rising breezes and learn each keeper's warning before making your move.

YOUR PACE IS THE RIGHT PACE
Learn by playing with step-by-step opening guidance and helpful reminders when a new obstacle appears. Gentle Journey, checkpoints and free retries help you keep exploring. Optional time and collection badges give confident couriers another reason to return.

MAKE BAO YOUR OWN
Earn Suncoins through play for scarf, heart and magnet upgrades, plus helpful supplies. Dress Bao in optional outfits, from an autumn explorer to a starlight keeper. Preview the actual outfit before choosing it.

BUILT FOR A LITTLE ESCAPE
• Original 3D characters, world art, animations and music.
• Touch controls with compatible game-controller and keyboard support.
• Offline adventure gameplay after installation.
• No advertising or required player account.

FREE TO EXPLORE
The full campaign can be unlocked through play without a purchase. Optional in-app purchases offer Suncoins and permanent outfits. Real-money purchases are behind a grown-up check. Internet access is required for purchases and restoration.

Your adventure is saved on this device. Progress and spent consumables do not sync between devices. Permanent outfits can be restored using the Apple Account that purchased them.

Website: https://www.trisphereapps.com
Support: https://www.trisphereapps.com/contact

Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Barberia Arechi
description: Barberia Arechi è un’app di prenotazioni intuitiva e facile da usare. Con questa app potrai prenotare tutti i tuoi appuntamenti con semplicità, da qualsiasi luogo e in qualsiasi momento. Grazie alla sua interfaccia utente moderna e dinamica, potrai cercare e prenotare i tuoi servizi preferiti con una semplice pressione del dito. L’app di Barberia Arechi ti permette di avere il controllo completo delle tue prenotazioni, visualizzando le date disponibili e molto altro ancora. L’app di Barberia Arechi ti aiuta a risparmiare tempo e a organizzare la tua routine in modo semplice ed efficiente. Scarica l’app di Barberia Arechi oggi stesso e inizia a prenotare i tuoi appuntamenti con tranquillità!

name: Bastoryx: Castle Battles
description:
Two castles stand at the ends of one battle road. Send your armies forward, time every wave and build the forces that break the enemy's walls.

Bastoryx is a castle battle game built on one clear idea: the road between the two fortresses is fixed, so timing and army composition decide the outcome.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• A training course that teaches the basics step by step
• A campaign of sieges across a map of castles
• A weekly battle to test your strategy
• An army you shape with units that fit your plan
• Missions to complete along the way

HOW IT PLAYS
Decide when each unit sets off down the road. The right timing and strong units can turn a battle you were losing. Plan your army before each fight and learn from every defeat.

Play in English or Turkish. You can change the language from the menu at any time.

Simple to learn, deep to master. Start your first battle in minutes.

Questions: https://alperapps.com/support/

name: BayGo: Train Times
description:
Your train time. Your next connection. One quick glance.

BayGo makes everyday travel easier to check:
• See upcoming departure times and minutes from now.
• Keep scheduled times visible alongside live delays when available.
• Follow connections with line colors, train destinations, and platforms.
• Set your commute once. Home is the reverse of Work.
• Use Anywhere for occasional trips, with your two most recent routes.
• Check departures on Apple Watch.
• No account, advertising, or third-party analytics SDK.

Live information depends on BART feed availability and matching timetable data. When live information cannot be verified, the app labels scheduled information accordingly. Platform assignments and connections can change; check station displays and official service updates.

Transit data is provided by BART. BayGo is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by BART.

name: BCargo
description:
The app is in Mongolian.

BCargo is the customer app of BCARGO, a cargo service that brings goods bought from Chinese online stores (Taobao, Pinduoduo, 1688 and others) from our Ereen warehouse to our branches in Mongolia.

• Your China address — copy the Ereen warehouse address with your personal code and paste it into the online store, so every parcel is matched to you.
• Register track codes — add the track codes of your orders before they arrive; you will see each parcel as soon as it is received in Ereen.
• Follow every parcel — arrived in Ereen, on the way, arrived at your branch, ready for pickup, handed over.
• Notifications — get a push notification when your parcels arrive in Ereen, when they reach your branch and when an order is ready to pay.
• Pay online — pay for your shipment with QPay from your banking app and pick it up without waiting at the counter.
• Home delivery — order delivery of arrived parcels to your address.
• Parcel check requests — if a parcel does not arrive, send the store's shipping receipt; staff check it and reply in the app.
• Choose your branch — switch between our branches and see the prices and addresses.

You can delete your account at any time in Profile → Personal information → Delete account.

name: Beacon: Scan Check Test
seller_name: Wuhan Tuohengxun Information Technology Co., Ltd
description:
Beacon is a network toolkit. Test your speed, check the Wi-Fi you're on, see what's connected to your network, and find out whether your email has turned up in a data breach.

SPEED TEST
• Download, upload, ping and jitter
• Runs against Cloudflare and LibreSpeed servers. Pick one yourself or let Beacon choose the one with the lowest latency
• History with a 7-day trend, per-server averages and CSV export
• Warns you before testing on cellular

WI-FI CHECK
Six checks on the network you're connected to: connection, gateway, DNS hijacking, HTTPS interception, captive portal and router admin security. When something fails, Beacon tells you what it means and what to do about it.

DEVICE SCAN
• Lists the devices on your local network, identified through ping, Bonjour, SSDP and NetBIOS
• Rename devices and mark the ones you trust, so anything new stands out

FULL SCAN
One tap runs the Wi-Fi checks, device scan and breach check together, then gives you a security score and a list of things to fix.

BREACH CHECK
• Search public data breaches for your email address
• Turn on monitoring and Beacon checks again each time you open the app

MORE TOOLS
• DNS Test: compare resolver speed and check for hijacking
• Site Check: DNS, TCP, TLS and first-byte timing, plus reachability from probes in other regions
• Traceroute: every hop to a server and its latency
• Port Check: see which ports your router has open
• IP Info: public IPv4 and IPv6, ISP and approximate location
• Password Generator: random, memorable or PIN, created on your device

PRIVACY
• No account, no ads, no analytics SDKs
• Speed history, device lists and settings stay on your device
• Scanning needs Local Network access only. Beacon does not ask for your location
• Some features rely on public third-party services (speed test servers, IP lookup, Globalping, XposedOrNot). The in-app Privacy Policy lists what each one receives

Please use Device Scan and Port Check only on networks you own or have permission to test.

name: Beadie
description:
Beadie offers a relaxed creative space for adults who enjoy working with fuse beads and pixel art. Transform your everyday inspiration—starting with a favorite photo—into a step-by-step fuse bead pattern, where tiny, colorful pieces come together to form a unique creation of your own.

Select an image from your phone, preview how it will look as a fuse bead design, and choose your preferred grid size (24×24, 32×32, or 48×48) along with a color palette (8, 16, or 24 colors). Find the perfect balance between pattern detail and the number of colors used as you prepare for your next crafting project.

Save your generated patterns to your personal collection, allowing you to revisit them or continue refining your ideas at any time. Use the built-in craft calendar to schedule your projects, track the time spent, and log your completed works—keeping a clear record of every creative endeavor.

name: Beauty Club Premium
description:
Приложение клиники Beauty Club во Владивостоке.
Запись онлайн: выберите услугу и специалиста, посмотрите свободное время по расписанию клиники и запишитесь за минуту.
Ваши визиты: ближайшие и прошедшие записи, напоминания за 2 дня, за сутки и за час, подтверждение визита в одно касание.
Команда клиники: врачи и косметологи с профильным образованием, их опыт, услуги и свежие отзывы пациентов.
Клубная карта: статус Silver, Gold или Platinum зависит от ваших посещений, привилегии открываются автоматически.
Подарочные сертификаты: оформите сертификат в подарок и следите за остатком прямо в приложении.
Вход по номеру телефона с кодом в Telegram, защита PIN-кодом или Face ID.
Адрес: г. Владивосток, ул. Авроровская, 30. Ежедневно с 9:00 до 20:00.

name: Bedtime Routine for Kids
description:
See the next bedtime step at a glance. One tap checks it off and shows what comes next.
Pajamas, teeth, a story: set up your family's routine once and stop repeating yourself every night.
Ready in under a minute, and ready again every evening.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Start with a ready-made routine: pajamas, brush teeth, story time.
2. Make it yours. Rename steps, add or delete them and drag them into your order. Changes save as you type.
3. Tonight, the next step fills a big card. Tap Done, and the checklist moves on. Undo is one tap away.

BUILT FOR REAL EVENINGS
- Large buttons you can tap with one hand while the other holds a toothbrush
- Clear progress, like "3 of 5 done", so everyone knows how close bedtime is
- A gentle Goodnight screen when the last step is done
- The routine resets each evening and keeps your steps. Bedtimes that run past midnight still count as tonight.
- An optional nightly reminder. It's a local notification, and it's set only when you turn it on.

PREMIUM
- A separate routine for each child
- Different steps on Friday and Saturday nights
- Extra reminders, like a heads-up before bath time

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Made for parents. No account, no ads, no tracking. Your routines and reminder times stay on your iPhone.

SUBSCRIPTION
Premium is optional: $2.99 per week with a 3-day free trial, or $14.99 per year. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/bedtime-routine/privacy
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/bedtime-routine/terms

name: BeforeYouMove
description:
BeforeYouMove helps you find a home and know what you are walking into, before you spend a day or a Naira on a visit.

Every cost, up front
Each listing shows the full move-in total: rent, agency and legal fees, caution deposit and service charge, added up for you. No surprises when you sit down with the agent.

Honest photos
Photos taken through the app carry a seal showing when they were taken, so you can tell a fresh picture from an old one.

What the street is really like
Street reports cover road condition, flooding, power, water, security, transport and parking, each with where the finding came from. Unlock a report with credits when you want the detail.

Check a home you saw elsewhere
Found a place on another site or from an agent? Paste the link or what the advert says, and we will tell you what we know about the area and whether the price is fair.

Rent, lease, buy or short stay
Browse homes to rent, long leases paid upfront, homes for sale and shortlets, plus shops, offices and other commercial space. Filter by area, budget, bedrooms and type, and save the ones you like.

Talk to agents in the app
Message agents directly, keep every conversation in one place, and get notified when they reply.

For agents and landlords
List a property in a few steps, take photos in the app, and see how your listings perform and who is asking about them.

Built for Nigeria, open to everyone
Our listings and street reports start in Nigeria, and anyone, anywhere, can browse.

name: Belanio Headline
description: Build your own professional wrestling shows in a strategy-driven booking simulator. Create match cards, design event sequences, and shape rivalries between unique wrestling characters. Every decision affects audience interest, character popularity, and the direction of your season. Simulate matches to discover how pacing, surprises, and storytelling influence crowd reactions. Manage show duration, balance your main event, and avoid repetitive storylines that weaken audience engagement. Review past decisions, refine successful strategies, and experiment with alternative outcomes. Turn individual matches into compelling long-term stories and build a season that keeps the audience invested.

name: Bentlo
description:
Bentlo makes weekday lunch and dinner planning simpler, more balanced, and easier to keep up with.
Build each meal box with up to five compartments, mix and match foods by category, or add your own favorites with photos. Get clear, practical balance tips for every box and each day, so you can make thoughtful meal choices without the guesswork.
In Prefs, weekly, monthly, and yearly patterns help you discover your packing habits over time, making suggestions increasingly relevant to the way you eat.
Designed for the rhythm of workdays, Bentlo helps turn everyday meal packing into a simpler, more consistent habit—not another recipe app or grocery list.

name: BepViet Emasi
description: App quản lý đặt suất ăn cho học sinh và staff cho trường học EMASI Plus. Cho phép học sinh và nhân viên đặt cơm và quản lý theo dõi suất ăn mình đã đặt. Để giúp học sinh và nhân viên nhận suất ăn nhanh hơn.

name: Bevel Rub
description:
Bevel Rub keeps one turning blank on this iPhone.

Set the bevel and the depth, then take a pass. When the bevel leads and the depth stays at 0.25 or under, the diameter drops by the depth times 6. At 0.45 the edge digs in and the diameter stays. Deeper than 0.25, or a cut that would leave less than 8 mm, also leaves the diameter.

Rename a spindle, start another, delete one, and share four lines: the name, the diameter, the mark, and the note.

Spindles stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not turn wood on a real lathe.

name: Biblionar
description:
The Fellowship of the King is a journey on foot through the story of the Bible.

Sixteen places, each one a 3D scene you walk through yourself: the burning bush in Midian, Pharaoh’s court, the night of the Passover, the sea parted, the Tabernacle at Sinai, the walls of Jericho, David and Goliath, Solomon’s Temple, the manger at Bethlehem, the last week in Jerusalem, the hill of Golgotha and the garden with the empty tomb.

Seven more stories stand off the road, each a place of its own: the six days of creation and the garden of Eden, Noah’s ark on Ararat, Joseph in Egypt, Jonah’s Nineveh, Daniel’s Babylon, Esther’s Susa and the scroll caves of Qumran by the Salt Sea.

AT EVERY STOP
• Stations that tell the story in a few lines, with its Bible passage and a question
• Someone who needs your help, and something to find for them
• Hidden treasure jars, each with a verse
• Gems off the path, which buy a hint when you are stuck
• A sealed chest with a riddle: numbers to count, a name to spell, or things to set in order
• In every chest, an artefact found nowhere else: a shepherd’s staff, a ram’s horn, an olive leaf. Twenty-three to gather in your cabinet
• Riddle stones in the writing of the place: wedge marks in Babylon, picture signs in Egypt
• Houses, tents and caves to step into, where a guide’s voice tells you how people lived there: bread, oil, writing, the family table

THE STORY COMES ALIVE
Watch the sea open, the walls fall, the giant go down, the sky fill with light over the shepherds’ field, and the stone rolled away at dawn. In Jerusalem you can climb to the roofs and cross the city above the streets.

ONE THREAD
Each stop gives you a seed, a verse to keep, and shows how that story points forward to Jesus: the lamb, the rock, the tent, the king. He is never shown close up. You follow the road, and he comes into view.

MADE FOR
Families, Sunday schools, Bible study groups and anyone who wants to see the story in order. Texts are faithful to Scripture and quote it directly.

ALSO INSIDE
• English and Romanian
• A map of the Bible lands that grows as you travel, and a timeline that sets every place in order, from Eden to the first churches
• My Journal, for your own notes
• A pearl of great price hidden somewhere new each day
• A leaderboard with a podium, and rooms for playing with friends (optional)
• Works offline once installed; portrait or landscape

No ads. No purchases. Nothing is required to play: a name is asked only if you choose the leaderboard.

name: Bin & Tag
description:
Bin & Tag is a simple inventory and profit tracker for people who resell kids' clothes: thrift flippers, consignment shoppers, and parents clearing out outgrown sizes.

Give every piece a short code, drop it in a bin, and find it again in seconds when it sells. Record each sale with its shipping and fees, and Bin & Tag shows you what you actually made, item by item and lot by lot.

TAG IT
• Every item gets an automatic code like K0001. Write it on the tag and you can always look it up.
• Track size, category, condition, bin, ask price, notes, and photos.
• "Save & add another" remembers size, bin, lot, and condition, so cataloguing a bag of 2T tops takes minutes instead of an evening.
• Sizes, categories, conditions, and bin names are all editable.

BIN IT
• Type a code on the Home screen to jump straight to the item and see which bin it's in, shown big and bold.
• Statuses for Available, Listed, Sold, Kept, Gifted, and Missing keep your counts honest.

KNOW WHAT YOU MADE
• Record a sale with price, shipping charged, shipping paid, and fees.
• Leave the marketplace fee blank and Bin & Tag estimates it from that marketplace's fee settings. Rates and fixed fees are fully editable, and you can add your own.
• Sales tax collected by a marketplace is kept out of your net by default, because it was never your money.
• See net proceeds, profit, and days-to-sell for every item.

TRACK YOUR LOTS
• Bought a whole bag, a bin haul, or a consignment-sale armful for one price? Record it as a lot.
• Cost is spread across the items in the lot automatically, either by the count you expected or by the items you've actually logged.
• Each lot shows what you spent, what you've earned back, your recovery percentage, and how many more sales it takes to break even.

YOUR DASHBOARD
• Totals for items, listed, sold, cash spent, net proceeds, profit, and recovery, all on one screen.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no ads, no tracking.
• Your inventory stays on your iPhone and is included in your regular device backups.

Light and dark mode supported.

name: Biravto.az – Avto Köməkçi
description:
BirAvto — avtomobil sahibləri üçün hər şeyi bir yerə toplayan tətbiqdir. Xatırlatmalardan yolüstü xidmətlərə, usta axtarışından sənədlərə qədər bütün ehtiyacların bir ünvanda.

ƏSAS İMKANLAR

• Xatırlatmalar — Mühərrik yağı, sığorta və digər vacib tarixləri izlə, vaxtı çatanda xəbərdarlıq al.
• Avtomobillərim — Avtomobilini əlavə et, yürüşünü və bu ayın xərclərini bir baxışda gör.
• Yolüstü yerlər — Yaxınlıqdakı yanacaq stansiyalarını, WC-ləri, restoran və kafeləri xəritədə tap, marşrut qur.
• Səyahət xərci — Məsafə, yanacaq sərfi və litr qiymətinə görə səfərin təxmini xərcini hesabla, nəfər başına böl.
• QR ilə mesaj — Avtomobilin şüşəsindəki BirAvto QR kodunu skan edib sürücüyə mesaj göndər. Nömrə görünmür, mesaj anonim gedir.
• Usta və servislər — Avtoservis, usta, rəsmi diler və evakuator xidmətlərini tap; sifariş sorğusu göndər və ya birbaşa zəng et.
• Elanlar — Xidmət və məhsul elanları arasında axtar.
• Cərimələr və sənədlər — Cərimələrini və avtomobil sənədlərini bir yerdə saxla.
• Park etdiyim yer — Avtomobili harada saxladığını yadda saxla, sonra xəritədə yolu tap.
• Təcili yardım (SOS) — Çətin anda lazım olan əlaqələrə sürətli çıxış.
• Ailə planı — Avtomobil idarəetməsini ailənlə birgə et.
• Tətbiq kilidi, tünd/açıq rejim və dil seçimi.

NİYƏ BİRAVTO?
Hər iş üçün ayrı tətbiq axtarmağa ehtiyac yoxdur. BirAvto ilə avtomobilinlə bağlı hər şeyi sadə və müasir interfeysdə həll edirsən.

Sual və təklifləriniz üçün: biravto.az

name: Birdman: Sky Jelly
description:
Pull the slingshot, let go... and FLY!

Birdman is a wobbly jelly hero who sleeps in a wooden slingshot on a floating island. Wake him up, aim, and launch him across a sky full of floating islands. You have 60 seconds: how far can you go?

HOW TO PLAY
• Pull back anywhere on the screen to aim, let go to fly
• Swipe up in the air to jump, swipe down to drop
• Land on an island: he flips into its slingshot, ready for the next launch
• Skip islands for big bonuses, catch the slingshot posts with your stretchy arms

UPGRADE AND GO FURTHER
Every run pays coins. Make your SLINGSHOT stronger, your JUMP higher and your REWARDS bigger, then smash your record. Reach the finish to unlock the next world.

MAGICAL WORLDS
• Sky Meadows: waterfalls and green islands
• Amber Heights: golden sunset, bouncy mushrooms, moving islands
• Frost Peaks: ice, crystal boost rings and the northern lights
A surprise waits at the end of each one, and more worlds are on the way!

THE JETPACK
Double tap in the air: a shiny jetpack unfolds on your back. Steer with your finger and land wherever you want.

RACE YOUR FRIENDS
Create a race in one tap and share the code. Up to 4 players, 3 rounds: the first to the finish wins!

Free to play. Optional in-app purchases (Jetpack, Double Coins, No Ads, Birdman VIP weekly subscription, coins). Ads are shown.
Terms: https://birdman.thiollywood.com/terms · Privacy: https://birdman.thiollywood.com/privacy

name: BlackCaw
description:
BlackCaw es tu oficina de agentes de IA. Cada agente tiene su nombre, su cara y su especialidad (marketing, ventas, desarrollo, finanzas…) y trabaja en tu computadora con Claude Code, Cursor o Codex. Con la app de iPhone los llevas contigo.

HABLA CON TU EQUIPO
• Escríbele o díctale a cualquier agente y mira en vivo lo que está haciendo.
• Responde, abre un hilo nuevo o cambia de tema cuando quieras.
• Llámalos por voz, como una llamada normal.

TE AVISA CUANDO TERMINA
• La bandeja te muestra quién te espera (verde) y quién está trabajando (ámbar).
• Avisos al terminar, al pedirte permiso o cuando un agente te llama.
• Dynamic Island y pantalla bloqueada con el avance en vivo.
• Widget para la pantalla de inicio.

TÚ DECIDES
• Cuando un agente quiere correr un comando en tu computadora, te pide permiso: «No», «Una vez» o «Siempre».
• Puedes detenerlo en cualquier momento o pedirle que te llame cuando termine.

PRIVADO DE VERDAD
• Tus conversaciones están cifradas de punta a punta: solo tú puedes leerlas, ni siquiera BlackCaw.

TU OFICINA EN 3D
• Mira a tu equipo trabajando en su oficina.

Para usar BlackCaw necesitas la app BlackCaw en tu Mac o PC (se descarga gratis en blackcaw.com) con Claude Code, Cursor o Codex instalado.

name: Block Extraction
description: BLOCK EXTRACTION is a challenging tactical sliding-block puzzle game. Move obstacles along their lanes, clear the escape path, and guide the red core to the exit. Complete 20 unique sectors, sharpen your logic, and plan every move carefully. Think ahead, control the grid, and extract the core!

name: Block SCP Clash io
description:
Collect blocks. Steal them. Throw them. Contain the anomaly!

Block SCP Clash io is a fast and funny blocky brawler. You have 45 seconds to fill your cart with blocks while rivals race you for every piece. Then step into the containment cell and throw everything you gathered at an SCP that keeps walking toward you. Drop its HP to zero before it reaches you!

■ HOW TO PLAY
• Drag anywhere to move. Blocks are picked up automatically.
• A club spins around your character. Time your moves so it hits rivals.
• Knock a rival out and grab their whole cart plus 50 bonus blocks.
• When time is up, tap or hold to throw blocks at the SCP. It is coming closer, so do not stop!

■ BLOCKS & POWER
Wood, Stone, Iron and Gold, plus rare Emerald, Ruby and Diamond. Every block adds power. Later stages drop more rare blocks, and each SCP you capture three times leaves its own signature block on the field.

■ ITEMS & BATTLE ROUNDS
Magnets pull in nearby blocks, sneakers boost your speed, hearts heal, and the giant club doubles your reach. Block piles burst into showers of blocks. In surprise Battle Rounds there are no blocks at all, so the only way to get rich is to knock others out!

■ 34 SCPs TO CONTAIN
From the friendly Tickle Monster and the Eye Pods to the Plague Doctor, the Old Man, the Shy Guy and the Hard-to-Destroy Reptile. Every creature has a 3D model, a kid-friendly file and its own containment record. Capture one 3 times to unlock its signature block, and 5 times to earn a permanent perk.

■ ENDLESS STAGES
Stages never end. After all 34 SCPs, a new round begins and every anomaly comes back stronger.

■ UPGRADES & CUSTOMIZATION
Upgrade your magnet range, sneakers and club speed with coins. Dress up your character with 200+ parts: skins, tops, pants, hats like bunny ears, propellers and viking helmets, and dozens of faces.

■ PLAY YOUR WAY
• Short rounds that are perfect for quick breaks
• Simple one-finger controls
• 9 languages: English, Korean, Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Thai, Turkish, Spanish and German

Can you contain them all?

—
This game is based on content from the SCP Foundation Wiki (scp-wiki.wikidot.com), licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0. The game is also distributed under CC BY-SA 3.0. Creature models are original works based on the article descriptions. Full credits and source links are in the in-game Settings.

name: Block Skins Maker & Editor
description:
Make your own skin in minutes. Paint pixel by pixel on a 3D model you can spin and zoom, then export a ready-to-use 64×64 PNG.

Start from 96 original characters, nearly 1,800 free community skins or a blank body. Every pixel is yours to change.

PAINT IN 3D OR 2D
• Paint right on the rotating 3D character: one finger paints, two fingers turn and zoom
• Front, back and side buttons jump straight to the view you need
• Switch to the flat 2D texture with a grid to fix single pixels
• Pencil, eraser, fill bucket and eyedropper color picker, 1 or 2 pixel brush
• Mirror mode paints the left and right side together
• Edit the base layer or the outer layer for hats, hoods, jackets and sleeves
• Hide or isolate the head, body, arms or legs to reach hidden spots
• Undo and redo as much as you like

CHARACTERS TO START FROM
• 96 original characters in 8 groups: adventure, armor, sci-fi, critters, everyday, sports, seasonal and fantasy
• Community: 1,776 free skins shared under Creative Commons licenses, searchable by name or creator and credited in the app
• Mix a character: combine a head, an outfit and legs from different characters
• Classic (4 px) or Slim (3 px) arms, switch at any time

YOUR SKINS, YOUR WAY
• Save every design in My skins, then rename or duplicate it to try variations
• Import a new 64×64 or older 64×32 PNG skin from your photos
• Export a standard PNG to Photos or share it with friends
• See your character standing in your room with AR on supported devices

PRO
• Every character in the gallery
• Shade brush for natural texture and a one-tap recolor tool
• Unlimited AR views
• No ads

Some characters and AR views can also be unlocked one at a time by choosing to watch a short video.

SUBSCRIPTION
Pro is available as a weekly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, and eligible new subscribers may begin with a free trial. Your Apple ID account is charged when you confirm the purchase. Renewal happens automatically unless you switch off auto-renew at least one day before the current period ends, and the renewal charge is made within the final 24 hours of that period. Manage or cancel any time in your App Store account settings.

This is an unofficial app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or approved by Mojang AB or Microsoft. Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang AB. All characters, icons and screenshots were made for this app.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://codevalley.cc/blockskins-terms
Privacy Policy: https://codevalley.cc/blockskins-privacy

name: BlueBay Case
description: A local US TV companion: Plaza notes, Charts, Rec desk, and watch journal. No accounts, no cloud sync, no streaming. AI mood covers only. Bundled samples are labeled Sample; your content stays on device.

name: BlueTab
seller_name: Shenzhen Kstar Science & Technology Co., Ltd.
description:
A smart and convenient app designed to manage your EV charger through Bluetooth.

Monitor charging status in real time, remotely start or stop charging within Bluetooth range, and easily configure your charger settings. Enjoy a simple, reliable, and efficient charging experience.

name: BMM Conecta
description:
BMM Conecta is the local-network companion for Berea Master Media (BMM). Live use requires BMM 3.0.1 or later running on a Mac.

MUSICIANS
Follow current lyrics and chords, with a preview of the next section. Read-only access does not control playback. Audio is not streamed.

OPERATORS
Use the BMM remote portal to manage presentation and playback. Controls are provided by the BMM server.

CONNECT YOUR TEAM
Discover compatible servers on the local network, connect over Wi-Fi or Ethernet, enter an address manually, or use an optional QR code. On Mac, open a QR image. On iPhone and iPad, scan with the camera when supported.

LOCAL ACCESS
No Conecta account or subscription is required. Enter the PIN displayed by the main BMM app. The last server address is saved only on your device.

Try the clearly labeled interactive demonstration without a server. Demo controls do not play audio or change real services.

For live use, enable remote access in BMM and connect both devices to a reachable local network. The Mac server can serve Wi-Fi and Ethernet clients simultaneously. Guest-network isolation or firewall rules may prevent connection.

name: BoardPeek
seller_name: Sichuan Infinite Variable Technology Co., Ltd
description:
BoardPeek brings InteractiveHtmlBom HTML exports to iPhone and iPad, so you can inspect a board, find components, and keep track of assembly at your workbench.

INSPECT YOUR BOARD
• Select a component in the board preview or parts list to highlight its footprint and pads.
• Switch between front and back, pinch to zoom, pan, rotate, and focus on a selection.
• Choose whether to show silkscreen, references, values, fabrication drawings, and placed components.

TRACK ASSEMBLY
• Check off placed and sourced parts, with progress saved on your device.
• Group identical components or view them individually.
• Filter by board side, search references, values, or footprints, and hide placed parts.
• Live Activities can show progress and the next component on the Lock Screen, with Dynamic Island support on compatible devices. Availability depends on system permission and Live Activity time limits.

ORGANIZE PROJECTS
• Import compatible HTML from Files or open it in BoardPeek from another app.
• Revisit recently opened boards and organize documents in folders and subfolders.
• Rename, move, delete, or share the original HTML through the system share sheet.

BUILT FOR YOUR SCREEN
• A board-above-list layout on iPhone in portrait.
• A side-by-side workspace on iPad and wider windows.
• Native controls with light and dark appearances.

No account, internet connection, or advertising. Board data and progress are processed locally and are not uploaded to the developer. System backups, external file providers, and services you explicitly share with are governed by their own settings and policies.

Requires a compatible HTML file exported by InteractiveHtmlBom. Does not directly open .kicad_pcb files, schematics, or Gerber files. This is not a PCB editor or a general web browser. Imported HTML scripts are not executed. Tracks and copper zones are not displayed. Sharing exports the original HTML, not the checkmarks saved in BoardPeek.

The current app interface is in Simplified Chinese. English text here describes the features, not an English-language interface.

BoardPeek is an independent app, not affiliated with or endorsed by the KiCad project.

name: Bold Portrait - Camera Editor
description:
Make your photo your own.

Bold Portrait combines an adaptive iPhone camera with a versatile photo editor. Take a photo in the app or import one from your library, then shape your look step by step.

YOUR CAMERA
Use the lenses available on your iPhone, the front camera, adaptive auto flash, flash on or flash off. Choose your aspect ratio, exposure, timer or photo sequence. The display can provide light for selfies.

COLOR AND DETAIL
Explore curated filters and adjust their intensity. Control temperature, exposure, highlights, contrast, saturation, sharpness and clarity. Experimental reference looks help you recreate the colors of another photo.

REFINE YOUR PORTRAITS
Adjust retouching, tan, teeth whitening, eyes and redness reduction individually. Refine supported effect masks with a brush and erasers for more control.

DEPTH AND ATMOSPHERE
Shape blur and bokeh, tap to choose focus, and add film grain, a vignette, lighting effects or overlays. Detection depends on the scene and available image data; masks can be refined manually.

YOUR LOOK, AGAIN
Save complete edits as your own presets or as the starting point for new shots. Apply presets to multiple photos, then save or share the results.

ON-DEVICE PROCESSING
Image analysis and reference matching run on your device. The reference file is not saved or uploaded. No app account required.

TRY IT FREE
The free download includes ten distinct photo exports. After that, Pro is required for new captures, imports and edits. Previously counted photos can still be exported; existing photos remain viewable and deletable.

Pro is available as an auto-renewing monthly subscription or a one-time purchase. Both unlock the same features. Prices are shown before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled and can be managed in your Apple subscriptions. Buying lifetime access does not automatically cancel an existing monthly subscription.

Privacy: https://www.cinema-luts.com/privacy/
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Bolo 360: Italian & German
description:
Learn Italian or German with explanations in your own language.

Bolo 360 explains every lesson in Urdu, Roman Urdu, Hindi, Punjabi (Gurmukhi) or Bengali. A little every day: you listen, read, write, speak and review your words, and you practise for the exams.

WHAT YOU GET
• Two courses, Italian and German, from A1 to B1: each course has 58 units, 812 lessons and about 2,090 words
• Explanations in Urdu, Roman Urdu, Hindi, Punjabi (Gurmukhi) and Bengali; the app can also be used in Italian and English
• Placement test: it tells you which level to start from
• Listening, reading, writing and pronunciation exercises: say the sentence out loud and the app recognises it
• Spaced word review: the words you forget come back at the right time
• Timed practice exams, with correction. Italian: level A2 (the level asked for the long-term residence permit) and level B1 (citizenship). German: A1, A2 and B1
• "Are you ready?": an estimate in percent of how ready you are, and a PDF report in your own language
• Civics: for Germany, the 460 questions of the "Leben in Deutschland" test with our own explanations; for Italy, 117 questions written by us
• Study certificate at the end of each level, to show or print
• Hands-free listening: words and sentences even with the screen off, using the buttons on your headphones
• Study reminders

MADE FOR YOU
• No hearts, lives or energy: study as much as you want
• Works on phones, tablets and foldables
• No account
• Free, no ads and no purchases

IMPORTANT
The practice tests and exams in Bolo 360 are our own and are not official tests. The certificate is not an official language certificate. "Are you ready?" is only our own estimate, not a promise. Bolo 360 is not connected to the BAMF or to any other authority or university. The "Leben in Deutschland" questions come from the public catalogue of the BAMF (Bundesamt für Migration und Flüchtlinge). Translations and explanations are prepared with the help of artificial intelligence and may contain mistakes.

Website: https://bolo360.pages.dev
Email: sgcodestudio@gmail.com
Privacy: https://bolo360.pages.dev/privacy
Terms of use: https://bolo360.pages.dev/termini

name: Bolt Stack: Nut Sort Puzzle
description:
Tap a bolt to lift its top nuts, then tap another bolt to stack them. Nuts can only go onto an empty bolt or onto the same color. Sort every color onto its own bolt to finish the level!

Bolt Stack is a relaxing, satisfying color sort puzzle you can play in a minute or for an hour.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a bolt, then tap where the nuts should go.
• Stack nuts only on an empty bolt or the same color.
• Fill each bolt with one color to clear the level.
• Stuck? Undo a move, get a hint or add an extra bolt.

FEATURES
• Hundreds of levels, from 2 colors up to 11
• Every level is checked by a solver, so it is always solvable
• Mystery levels where only the top nut is visible
• Bright, clean design and smooth animations
• Relaxing music and crisp sound effects
• Haptic feedback
• Play offline, anytime
• English and Turkish

Bolt Stack is free to play and supported by ads. You can remove ads with a one-time purchase.

name: Book Club Party
description:
Book Club Party is the easy, pretty way for a book club to pick its next read.

START A CLUB IN SECONDS
Name your club, add your name and a photo, and you're in. No email, no password.

INVITE WITH A LINK
Send your club's link to the group chat. Friends tap it, add their name, and join.

ADD BOOKS
Search by title. The cover, description and page count fill themselves in, with a link to the book on Goodreads.

RANK, DON'T JUST VOTE
Everyone ranks the books from favorite to last. Numbers you've used are greyed out, so there's no double-counting.

TWO ROUNDS, ONE WINNER
Close voting and the top three go to a final. Close it again and the winner is revealed, with confetti. Scores stay hidden until the very end. Ties are settled fairly, with a tiebreaker round if it comes to that.

YOUR HISTORY
Your profile keeps how you ranked every book in every past vote.

More than one club? Switch between them from your profile.

name: Border Wait Times: Canada-US
description:
Know the line before you leave. Border Wait Times shows live wait times at every US–Canada land crossing that publishes them, straight from U.S. Customs and Border Protection and the Canada Border Services Agency, and tells you exactly how old each reading is.

SEE HOW FRESH EACH READING IS
Border agencies don't always update every crossing on time. Some readings are minutes old; others haven't changed in hours. Border Wait Times shows the age of every reading and flags anything more than three hours old, so you never plan around a number that's out of date.

BOTH DIRECTIONS, EVERY LANE
• Wait times into the U.S. and into Canada
• Passenger, NEXUS and commercial lanes, wherever they're reported
• NEXUS waits into Canada at the Niagara bridges and Lower Mainland crossings, which CBSA doesn't publish
• Lane closures and port hours, plus notices like Ready Lane schedules
• 33 crossings from British Columbia to New Brunswick, including the new Gordie Howe International Bridge

NEAREST CROSSINGS FIRST
Allow location access and the closest crossings move to the top, with distances that update as you drive. The app also picks the direction for you: in the U.S. it shows waits into Canada, and in Canada it shows waits into the U.S. Tap to switch anytime.

ASK SIRI, HANDS-FREE
• "Check Border Wait Times": waits at your nearest crossings
• "What are the Border Wait Times at Peace Bridge"
• "NEXUS wait at Blue Water Bridge in Border Wait Times"
• "Check my crossings in Border Wait Times": your favorites
Siri tells you when a reading is out of date, too.

MORE
• Favorites for the crossings you use most
• Search by crossing, city or highway (try "I-5" or "Soo")
• Highlight waits longer than a limit you choose
• Directions to any crossing in Apple Maps
• Six color themes, including light, dark and high contrast

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. We never collect or store your location.

Wait times are reported by CBP and CBSA, with NEXUS waits into Canada from the Niagara Falls Bridge Commission and the Washington State Department of Transportation. They're for information only, can be delayed or wrong and can change quickly, so always allow extra time. Don't use the app while driving; use Siri instead. Border Wait Times is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by any government agency or bridge operator. Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.

name: Bovlda - American Football Pro
description:
Plan, build, replay and learn American football schemes in one clean offline tool. Bovlda - American Football Pro lets you draw plays, organise your playbook, and train your memory with interactive study modes that help you understand every route, block and movement.

Key features
- Build plays on a proper football field - place up to 11 players per side, draw routes, add blocks and manage offence and defence separately.
- Edit with precision - drag players, zoom and pan the field, switch grid snap on or off, undo changes, and autosave drafts as you work.
- Rehearse your schemes - play, pause and step through each sequence at 0.5x, 1x or 2x speed with clear route highlighting.
- Study and test your memory - choose a difficulty level, hide a route, rebuild it, and compare your answer against the reference.
- Organise your playbook - save to favourites, group schemes into collections, duplicate templates, and keep everything easy to find.
- Export and back up securely - share plays as PNG images, create backups in your own format, and restore data with file checks.

Perfect for
- Players who want to learn formations, routes and assignments away from the field
- Coaches who need a fast way to sketch, store and review football plays
- Teams looking for a simple offline playbook builder and training companion
- Anyone who wants to create offence and defence diagrams without clutter

Why choose us
Bovlda focuses on the essentials that matter: clear visuals, fast editing, structured play management and genuine offline access. The app is designed as a practical working tool, not just a viewer. Every main action is built to help you create, store, revisit and study schemes with confidence.

You also get a complete experience from the start, including guided onboarding, a profile setup flow, template libraries, learning stats, session history, help guides and data management tools. Whether you are building from scratch or refining a saved play, Bovlda keeps your football schemes organised and ready when you need them.

Start building your playbook today, train smarter, and turn your ideas into clear, usable American football schemes.

name: BRACED Ride: Cycling Coach
description:
BRACED Ride is a cycling coach in your pocket. It plans each week, tells you what to ride today and how hard, and changes its mind when your body or the weather says it should.

A PLAN BUILT TO KEEP YOU RIDING
• Train for a gran fondo, a century, a crit or road race, a time trial, or just to get fitter.
• Sessions are in time on the bike and a range to ride to: watts from your FTP, heart rate from your threshold, or feel out of 10 if you have neither.
• Safety first: no week jumps more than 10% in time or training stress, hard days never go back to back, and every third or fourth week is lighter.
• Miss a day and the week reshapes. It never resets, and nothing missed is piled onto later days.
• Sick, sore or did something else: one tap on Today.

READS YOUR BODY, AND THE SKY
• With Apple Health connected, sleep, HRV and resting heart rate decide how hard today goes.
• The forecast for the hours of your ride: temperature, rain, wind and gusts, UV. Storms, extreme heat or a gale bring an offer to ride on the trainer or swap days. You decide; nothing is ever cancelled for you.
• Wind on your route: where it's in your face and where it's behind, and whether the loop is better the other way round.

RECORD EVERY RIDE
• Three modes: Road, Off-road and Indoor. Auto-pause that understands traffic lights and slow trail climbs.
• Big-number ride screen for a handlebar mount. The screen stays on.
• Works with no signal. A ride is saved to the phone as you go and survives a crash.
• Bluetooth power meters, heart-rate straps, speed and cadence sensors, and smart trainers (read only).

MAPS AND ROUTES
• Road and trail maps made for bikes, with areas you can save for offline use.
• Draw a route, ask for a loop of a set distance, or bring one in from a GPX file.
• Follow it with turn prompts, distance to go, and a buzz if you leave the route.

A COACH IN YOUR EAR
• Two recorded coaches. They call each effort, each turn, and when to eat and drink. Quiet on descents.
• Ask your coach a question in chat (optional, signed in). Answers are written by an AI, and it only ever proposes plan changes for you to confirm.

FUEL
• Carbs an hour on the bike, what to drink when it's hot, and daily calorie and carb targets that move with the ride.
• Food search and barcode scan.

PROGRESS
• Fitness, fatigue and form from your own rides. Weekly hours, bests, FTP history.
• Bring in past rides from Apple Health, or from GPX, TCX and FIT files and Strava or Garmin export ZIPs, with their power.

ON YOUR WRIST
• Apple Watch app: power or speed, time, distance, heart rate, the next turn, and Pause, Resume and Finish.

YOUR DATA
• Apple Health data never leaves your phone. No ads, no tracking.
• An account is optional (Sign in with Apple) and only backs up your plan, ride log and food log.

BRACED RIDE PRO
Looking at your plan, readiness and history is free. Starting a ride, Fuel and coach chat need BRACED Ride Pro:
• Yearly, with a 1-week free trial for new subscribers
• Monthly
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://braced-ride-api.vercel.app/privacy

BRACED Ride gives general training and nutrition guidance. It is not medical advice. Check with a doctor before starting a new training programme, and stop if you feel unwell.

name: Brain Games: Puzzle Pack
description:
Brain Games packs eleven different brain and skill games into one app. Every game has 64 levels and a daily puzzle that refreshes each day; levels climb through 8 tiers from easy to hard, and each tier introduces a new idea.

Number games
• Number Target: combine the given numbers with the four operations to reach the target.
• Number Grid: a number puzzle where every row and column equation must hold, using each digit once.
• Slide Merge: slide and merge equal numbers to reach the goal tile; every tier adds a new rule (walls, move limits, blocked directions…).
• Slide Down: the reverse of 2048 — halve big numbers by merging them until the board is empty.

Logic and planning
• Circuit Connect: rotate the wires and link the whole circuit to the source.
• Sokoban: push the crates onto the targets; one wrong push can lock a level.
• Matchsticks: move the sticks to turn a wrong equation into a true one.

Skill and strategy
• Coin Soccer: the schoolyard coin football. Pass your coins through each other, work up the pitch and shoot past the keeper. Play the computer or a friend on the same phone.
• Area Capture: draw lines to claim the field, dodge creatures and fireballs, grab power-ups for freeze, speed and laser.
• River Run: fly down the river, shoot the enemies and bring down the bridge before the fuel runs out.
• Mangala: Turkish mangala against the computer.

Features
• Eight languages: Turkish, English, Russian, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese
• Star ratings: up to 3 stars per level
• Light and dark themes, optional timed mode
• No ads, no purchases, no account; works offline

name: Brain Rush: Mini Games
description:
Brain Rush brings six classic games together in one app to get your brain going in just a few minutes.

The games
• Hangman: 15 themes and ever-changing words. Each game has 5 words and just one hint.
• Tic-tac-toe: against the computer, with two players on the same phone or online.
• Chess: against the computer at 4 levels or online against other people.
• Checkers: classic Portuguese checkers, also with 4 levels and online.
• Flags: which country does this flag belong to? 15 questions against the clock, at 3 levels.
• Math: mental math at 3 levels. The faster you answer, the more points you score.

Rankings
• In Hangman, Tic-tac-toe, Flags and Math, your response time and your mistakes count.
• Chess, checkers and online tic-tac-toe have ELO rankings: your rating goes up when you win and down when you lose, more so against stronger opponents.

Play online
• Find an opponent at your level or create a room with a code to play with a friend.
• Every game has a clock, rematches and quick reactions.

Simple and hassle-free
• Play against the computer without an account, even offline.
• Create a free account with email, Apple or Google to join the rankings and play online.
• In 7 languages: English, Portuguese (Portugal and Brazil), Spanish, French, German and Italian, with hangman words and country names in each language.
• In your Profile you can export your data or delete your account at any time.

No ads and no in-app purchases.

name: BranchPebble
description:
Turn a routine into a clear next step.

BranchPebble lets you write personal operation guides with instructions, questions and finish steps. Connect each answer to its next step, validate the graph, and save a ready version before running it.

• Write and reorder up to 60 steps in a guide.
• Check for missing connections, cycles and unreachable steps.
• Run one step at a time and choose the answer that matches your situation.
• Add notes, go back when needed, and resume an unfinished run.
• Keep completed and abandoned paths as separate, frozen records.
• Generate and share a PDF or CSV of the path you actually followed.

Later guide edits do not change a run already in progress. Validation checks the connection structure; it does not verify the correctness or safety of instructions you write. The app does not execute scripts or sense conditions automatically.

Your guides, runs and generated files are stored locally.

name: Brand Teamwear Designer
description:
Tạo và trình bày bộ đồ thi đấu cho đội rugby hoặc bóng rổ ngay trên iPhone. Chọn màu, thêm họa tiết, đặt số áo, logo đội và logo tài trợ, rồi lưu lại bản thiết kế đẹp mắt để so sánh, chỉnh sửa và xuất ảnh chỉ trong vài bước.

Từ mẫu tham khảo có sẵn đến bản thiết kế hoàn chỉnh, ứng dụng giúp bạn xây dựng trang phục đội bóng theo cách trực quan, dễ hiểu và luôn xem trước được kết quả ngay trên mô hình vận động viên.

Tính năng nổi bật
- Tạo dự án cho rugby hoặc bóng rổ, chọn trang phục sân nhà và sân khách - làm việc rõ ràng theo từng bộ.
- Chỉnh màu, họa tiết, số áo, logo đội và logo tài trợ - mọi thay đổi hiển thị tức thì trên trang phục.
- Kéo thả và tinh chỉnh vị trí từng thành phần - dễ kiểm tra, dễ sửa, hạn chế sai lệch khi lưu ảnh.
- Thư viện mẫu và ví dụ có sẵn - học nhanh cách dùng trình chỉnh sửa và lấy cảm hứng từ nhiều bố cục khác nhau.
- Chế độ xem trước, so sánh và kiểm tra dự án - phát hiện logo chồng lấn, vượt vùng hoặc thiếu hạng mục cần có.
- Xuất ảnh và chia sẻ từ màn hình trình bày - lưu thiết kế đẹp để dùng trong nội bộ, giới thiệu đội hoặc gửi cho đồng đội.
- Hoạt động ngoại tuyến, lưu tự động - tiếp tục công việc bất cứ lúc nào mà không cần tài khoản.

Phù hợp cho
- Huấn luyện viên, nhà thiết kế đội bóng và người phụ trách đồng phục cần phác thảo nhanh mẫu áo thi đấu.
- Học sinh, sinh viên và người yêu thể thao muốn thử nhiều ý tưởng màu sắc, số áo và logo một cách sinh động.
- Người làm nội dung, sự kiện hoặc thương hiệu cần bản trình bày rõ ràng cho đồng phục đội nhóm.

Vì sao nên chọn ứng dụng này
Ứng dụng được xây dựng như một phòng thiết kế thể thao chuyên nghiệp với giao diện tối, điểm nhấn đỏ và hình ảnh trang phục lớn, giúp bạn tập trung vào sáng tạo. Bạn có thể bắt đầu từ mẫu có sẵn, tạo dự án riêng, đổi giữa các bộ trang phục, kiểm tra vị trí logo và xuất hình ảnh trình bày ngay khi hoàn tất. Tất cả đều được tổ chức gọn gàng trong một không gian làm việc trực quan, nhanh và dễ dùng.

Hãy bắt đầu thiết kế bộ đồ thi đấu của riêng bạn ngay hôm nay, thử các mẫu có sẵn và tạo ra bản trình bày ấn tượng chỉ trong vài phút.

name: BraxuniVelqor
description: Crystallisation calculator: solubility, supersaturation, mass balance, thermal power, MSMPR and crystallisation types.

name: BrewnoteXS
description:
Brewnote is a coffee brewing companion for the home barista. It brings together a ratio calculator, a guided pour timer, a brew journal and a bean shelf, laid out like a coffee magazine.

RATIO CALCULATOR
• Set coffee, water or ratio (1:12 to 1:18) and choose which value stays fixed while you change another
• Steppers, exact input or a ratio slider
• A strength note, estimated cup yield and mug count

METHODS AND RECIPES
• V60, Chemex, AeroPress, French Press and Cold Brew, each with a default stage plan, dose, ratio, grind and temperature
• Edit any method's plan and reset it to the original
• Create your own recipes with their own stages, star favourites and load one into the calculator with Brew this

GUIDED POUR TIMER
• A full-screen timer where the cup fills ring by ring for each stage
• The current stage, a pour-to target weight, a stage countdown and what comes next
• Pause, resume, skip a stage or finish early; the timer keeps going if you leave the app
• Haptics, optional stage sounds and optional stage alerts while the app is in the background

BREW JOURNAL
• Save a finished brew with method, recipe, dose, ratio, grind, temperature, time, a 1 to 5 rating, tasting tags, notes and the bean used
• Search and filter by method and minimum rating
• Brew count, average rating, brews this week and your most-used method
• Brew again from any entry

BEAN SHELF
• Name, roaster, origin, process, roast date, bag weight and optional price
• Days off roast and freshness: resting, peak, fading or past best
• Remaining grams go down automatically with each saved brew, and are restored if you edit or delete it
• Cost per dose and the brews made with each bag

Celsius or Fahrenheit, plus your choice of currency for bean prices.

WORKS OFFLINE, ACCOUNT OPTIONAL
Brewnote works fully offline and never asks you to sign up. Tap "Continue as guest" on the welcome screen and every feature is available straight away, with your recipes, journal and beans saved on this device.
If you would like a backup, create a free account with your email address and a password. Your data then syncs securely so you can restore it on another iPhone or iPad, and anything you made as a guest is merged into your account. You can delete your account and its backup at any time from Settings.

PRIVATE, FREE AND SIMPLE
• Completely free: no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions
• No tracking and no analytics; your data is never shared with other users
• Export all of your data as JSON from Settings whenever you like
• Light and dark mode, with haptics you can switch off
• Designed for landscape on iPhone and iPad (iOS 15 or later)

name: Brickster Exam
description:
Practice for the Databricks certification exams on your iPhone. Brickster Exam has 1,718 original questions across all eight exams, written from each official exam guide and checked against the documentation. After every answer it teaches: why your pick is wrong, why the answer is right, a worked example, and the one rule to remember. No account, no sign-in, no ads.

EIGHT EXAMS, ONE APP
• Data Engineer Associate and Data Engineer Professional
• Data Analyst Associate
• Associate Developer for Apache Spark
• Machine Learning Associate and Machine Learning Professional
• Generative AI Engineer Associate
• Context Engineer Associate
Every question names the guide objective it tests, and each exam's bank covers every objective in its guide.

TRY FREE, PAY ONCE
• Every exam has 30 free questions, with every explanation, and a 10-question timed sampler.
• An Exam Pass unlocks one exam's whole bank and its full mock exams, for good.
• One pass covers both Data Engineer exams, and one unlocks all eight.
• One-time purchases through Apple. No subscription. Restore them on a new iPhone.

LEARN FROM EVERY ANSWER
• Why your answer is wrong, in the terms the documentation uses.
• Why the right answer works, so you can answer a different question on the same idea.
• A worked example in a new situation. 564 examples are code that ran on Apache Spark, with the output it printed.
• One rule to remember, short enough for a flash card.
• Why each other option is wrong, and the documentation page behind the answer.

CODE THAT RAN
246 code questions were run on Apache Spark with ANSI mode off and on, and the run decided the answer. Code is set in a readable monospace font with line numbers, and long lines wrap so nothing scrolls sideways.

MOCK EXAMS LIKE THE REAL ONE
With an Exam Pass, each mock has the guide's number of questions, spread across its sections by the guide's weights, on the guide's clock. Nothing is marked until you finish. Then see your score by section on a chart, and review every question.

KNOW WHEN YOU ARE READY
• Readiness: your latest answers, weighted by the exam guide's sections, against an 80% target. Databricks publishes no pass mark, so the app shows a target, never a pass mark.
• Practice sets of the size you choose.
• Mistakes: the questions you last got wrong.
• Due for review: right answers come back on a spaced schedule.
• Saved: keep any question with the bookmark.
• An optional daily reminder, at a time you pick.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
Studying works without a connection. Your progress stays on your phone. The app has no account, no analytics and no ads; purchases go through Apple. If a question looks wrong, one tap opens your mail app with its id, so you can tell us.

Brickster Exam is an independent study app, not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Databricks, Inc. Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog and Lakeflow are trademarks of Databricks, Inc. Apache Spark and Spark are trademarks of the Apache Software Foundation. Questions are original and never taken from certification exams.

name: Brinkcasters
description:
Damage won't win here. The edge will.

Brinkcasters is a spell-brawler on a crumbling hex island above a sea of lava. Every hit you land heats your rival up, and a hot caster flies farther. Build the heat, then shove them over the brink before the island falls away under you both.

FIGHT ON THE BRINK
• Quick rounds for 2 to 4 casters: Team Battle (2 v 2), Duel (1 v 1) and Free for All
• Play online, or practise against computer casters from Easy to Brutal
• Heat, not health: every hit makes the next one throw them farther
• The island fights back: glowing tiles crack and fall, magma vents erupt, thin ice gives way and rift gates fling you across the arena

THE CODEX
Between rounds, draft one card of three: a new spell, a stronger tier or a charm. At tier III every spell splits into one of two forms, so no two builds play alike.

12 SPELLS TO MASTER
Ember Bolt, Arc Lance, Wisp Seeker, Moon Glaive, Starfall, Singularity, Rift Splitter, Phase Swap, Soul Tether, Mirror Ward, Blink and Comet Dash. Pull, swap, trap, reflect and dash your way to the last stand.

FOUR ARENAS, THREE WORLDS
The Crucible and the Ember Ring over the lava of the Caldera, Glasswater on the slick ice of Frostmere, and Riftgate in the Voidreach.

MAKE IT YOURS
Earn robes, knockout flourishes, stickers and titles on the Brinkpath and in the Bazaar. Everything is earned by playing.

• A guided first match, The First Push, teaches the whole game in a few minutes
• No ads, no real-money purchases, no account needed
• Even the loading screen is a toy: shove the loose stones into the lava while the island rises

https://cuneydi33.github.io/brinkcasters-site/support/
EULA https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: BrunelDrumfeld
description: BrunelDrumfeld on hammashihnavetojen suunnittelusovellus, joka yhdistää profiilin, välityssuhteen, esijännityksen, voimansiirron, geometrian sekä kulumisen tarkastelun. Liukusäätimillä säädetään jakovalia, hammasmäärää, kireyttä, tehoa, nopeutta ja lämpötilaa, ja asetukset voi tallentaa tai viedä käyttötiedostona. Pro-versio avataan kertamaksulla ilman mainoksia tai tilausta.

name: Brutalist: Concrete Art Studio
description:
Step into a minimalist architectural studio with Brutalist. Designed for lovers of modernist architecture, spatial design, and tactile calm, Brutalist turns your iPhone into a serene workshop for crafting monolithic concrete sculptures and exploring dramatic light.

BUILD FORMWORK & POUR CONCRETE
Construct geometric molds from raw timber boards and steel panels. Pour viscous liquid concrete and feel subtle CoreHaptics vibrations as air bubbles rise to the surface.

STRIP & REVEAL BÉTON BRUT
Pull away the wooden planks once cured to uncover authentic architectural textures—delicate wood-grain imprints, raw air pockets, crisp chamfered edges, and structural seam lines.

MONUMENTAL LIGHT & SHADOW STUDY
Control the angle of a harsh architectural sun. Watch long, razor-sharp shadows sweep across massive cantilevers and recessed voids in real time, inspired by the timeless massing of Le Corbusier and Tadao Ando.

TABLETOP MONOLITH STANDBY
Mount your device horizontally to transform your desk into an ambient architectural installation where natural shadows slowly drift across your custom concrete sculpture throughout the day.

Built native for iOS with zero internet required, zero ads, and absolute offline privacy.

Download Brutalist and sculpt with concrete and shadow today.

name: BS Chess
description:
Around the kitchen table, on a trip or on a quiet afternoon, there's always time for chess. BS Chess helps children learn their first moves and gives adults a place to get back into the game, practise an opening or challenge someone in the family.

PLAY TOGETHER OFFLINE
Play face to face on one screen, or use Bluetooth and Wi-Fi to connect two nearby Apple devices without internet access. Go straight into a rematch when the game ends. Separate profiles keep everyone's results and progress in their own place.

PLAY THE COMPUTER AT YOUR PACE
Pick a difficulty or let the game adapt to your rating and recent results. Automatic difficulty changes in small steps between games. Board hints help beginners get started, and experienced players can choose a stronger opponent.

LEARN ON THE BOARD
Learn the rules and piece moves, solve puzzles and practise endgames. Study openings in three steps. Watch the moves, practise with guidance, then play from memory. After a game, open the analysis and tap “Practise this moment” to revisit a position. Only have a little time? Choose “I have 3 minutes”.

TAKE ON THE ADVENTURE
Follow a trail of 100 tiles with lessons, puzzles, openings and endgames. Every fifth tile is a duel with a character. Earn trophies and see how the family is doing on the family leaderboard.

The main play modes work offline and are available without a purchase. The full version unlocks Adventure, training content and game analysis. No ads or subscriptions.

name: Bubble Level Tool: Angle Meter
description:
