Is it level? Open the app, rest your iPhone on the shelf or frame, and know in under five seconds.
A big, easy-to-read angle and a classic bubble show exactly how far off you are.
When it's level, the screen turns green and says so.

EDGE OR FLAT
Stand your iPhone on its long edge against a shelf, a picture frame or a door frame, or lay it flat on a table, washing machine or countertop. Bubble Level Tool switches mode on its own and tells you how to hold the phone.

A STEADY READING
Readings are smoothed so the number doesn't jitter, and the green "Level" state won't flicker on and off at the edge.

CALIBRATE IN ONE TAP
Phone cases and camera bumps can add a small offset. Set the current position as zero, and reset it any time.

PREMIUM
- Set a target angle for slopes, stairs, ramps or drainage
- Feel a tap the moment you reach the target
- Save named measurements for every project, like "Living room shelf"

No account, no ads. Your readings stay on your iPhone.

Bubble Level Tool is a handy guide, not a certified measuring instrument. For work where precision matters, check with a physical level.

SUBSCRIPTION
Bubble Level Tool Premium is available as a weekly subscription at $2.99 with a 3-day free trial, or an annual subscription at $14.99. Prices may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/level-tool/terms
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/level-tool/privacy

name: BuildNext
description:
BuildNext is the estimating and project app built for contractors, GCs and builders. Turn a plan set into a priced bid in minutes, send a proposal your client signs on their phone, and run the whole job — costs, schedule, change orders and billing — from your pocket.

ESTIMATE FASTER
• AI plan takeoff: upload your PDF plan set and get a full quantity takeoff, sheet by sheet, priced from your own pricing library and supplier quotes. Review confidence flags, verify, and add it to your bid in one tap.
• Trade-focused takeoffs for roofing, concrete, sitework and framing, with your waste factor built in.
• AI estimate from a description, a voice walkthrough or job-site photos.
• Edit a bid by just saying what to change: "swap LVP for tile in the bathrooms."
• Your pricing library, assemblies (a whole wall or roof system in one tap) and reusable bid templates.

PRICE IT RIGHT
• Upload supplier quotes as a PDF, photo or CSV and every line lands in your material database.
• See price trends and which supplier is cheaper for the same product.
• Check prices online when you don't have a quote.
• Request bids from subs and suppliers with a private link. They price your scope or upload their bid, and it lands right on your lines to compare.

WIN THE JOB
• Branded proposals with your logo and colors.
• Clients review, sign by typing their name and approve change orders from a private link — no account needed.
• Export polished PDF proposals and invoices from the share sheet.

RUN THE PROJECT
• Project file for plans, photos, documents and bills.
• Job costing by trade against your bid budget, with gross profit at a glance.
• Scan a receipt or vendor invoice and AI files it to the right trade.
• Vendor upload link so subs and suppliers send invoices straight into the project.
• Schedule with phases and a client-facing timeline, daily logs, and client selections that create change orders automatically.
• Invoices and draws with a running balance, plus QuickBooks export.
• "This week" shows every task, invoice and selection that needs you.

BUILT FOR THE FIELD
• Works offline and syncs when you're back in service.
• Face ID lock, push alerts when a client opens or approves, and team roles for admins, estimators and view-only users.
• Spanish on sub and supplier links.

BuildNext — a CCS Developments app.

name: BusDak
description:
BusDak brengt twee werkruimtes samen: één voor voertuig­netwerken en één voor metingen rond plantenbakken op het dak. Bereken, registreer en bekijk uw gegevens op uw eigen apparaat.

**Voertuignetwerken**

Bereken CAN-bittiming met uw eigen controllergegevens en zoek naar kandidaten binnen opgegeven bereiken. Importeer een DBC-bestand om ondersteunde gehele signalen uit handmatig ingevoerde framebytes te decoderen. Daarnaast kunt u onder meer foutcodes, sessies, meetomstandigheden en gatewaygegevens handmatig vastleggen.

**Dak en plantenbak**

Kies een meetonderwerp en leg vooraf uw persoonlijke meetafspraak vast. Bewaar oorspronkelijke meetwaarden en omstandigheden, bekijk afzonderlijke uitkomsten en vergelijk herhaalde metingen. Ontbrekende informatie blijft zichtbaar als onvoldoende bewijs.

**Uw gegevens**

Bekijk uw registraties op het apparaat en maak een JSON-back-up om te bewaren of te delen. Een ondersteunde back-up kunt u vooraf bekijken en weer importeren.

BusDak werkt zonder account. De app maakt geen verbinding met een voertuig en leest geen live voertuiggegevens uit. Berekeningen en persoonlijke meetafspraken vervangen geen controle van hardwaredocumentatie of professioneel advies.

name: ByteHollow
description:
Look inside the files you choose with ByteHollow. Keep an independent local copy, browse hexadecimal bytes and printable ASCII, and inspect signed or unsigned integers with explicit byte order.

• Import regular files up to 8 MiB each.
• Move through a file by byte offset and inspect 8-, 16-, 32- and 64-bit integer values.
• Mark named ranges with notes for later reference.
• Compare files at matching offsets and review changed ranges and extra tails.
• Save raw byte ranges, readable hex dumps and comparison CSV files.
• Reopen your local records and share only the files you explicitly choose.

ByteHollow does not execute, repair or certify files. Comparison uses matching offsets; it does not align insertions. Core file inspection works offline.

name: CaipuDaquan
description:
菜谱大全 —— 冰箱里有什么，就能做什么

菜谱大全，76 道家常菜，一个一个讲清楚。

【怎么用】

• 今日：一天一道推荐，外加这一周七天的桌
• 菜谱：12 个菜系，按耗时、难度、场景筛
• 冰箱：勾选手头有的食材，反查出能做哪些菜
• 我的：收藏、做过什么、买菜清单

【里面有什么】

76 道菜，分家常菜、川菜、粤菜、湘菜、江浙、东北菜、西餐、日韩、汤羹、主食、
小吃、烘焙甜品 12 个菜系。每一道都写清了用料、火候、关键点和要用的锅具。

【冰箱反查】

冰箱页按「要买的东西」判断：主料和实质辅料算，葱姜蒜、油盐酱这类基础备料不算。
所以「还差一样」的意思是——买一样就能做，而不用为缺一把葱去一趟超市。
结果排序把能做的放在最前面，其次是缺一样、再其次是缺得多。

【素材说明】

本 App 的菜谱文字全部原创编写；菜图全部随 App 内置，其中 74 张是真实照片，
2 张是按菜谱生成的写实示意图。这些照片来自开放版权图库，每一张的作者与许可协议
逐条列在「我的 → 图片来源与授权」里。本 App 不打包任何受版权保护的第三方字体、
音频或视频素材。

【隐私】

不登录、没有账号、没有任何权限请求。你的收藏、做过记录和购物清单只存在你自己的
手机里，卸载即彻底删除，我们看不到也拿不走。

联网只有一类，全部指向开发者自建服务器：首启时发一条安装来源统计，用来判断这次安装
归属哪个推广渠道。请求里只有一个随机设备标识与设备参数，不含姓名、邮箱、电话、位置、
照片，也不含剪贴板内容；除此之外全程离线。不接入第三方 SDK，不含广告与统计代码，
不收集任何类别的用户数据。菜谱数据、照片与音频素材全部随 App 一起打包，在设备本地读取。

【适合谁】

想做饭、尤其是常常站在冰箱前不知道能做什么的人。

版本 1.0

name: Cairn Coil Citadel
description:
One small citadel. A horde on every side. A guardian that keeps getting stronger.

Step into a ceramic-and-brass mech and defend a miniature fortress in Cairn Coil Citadel. Four automated coil turrets protect the walls while you weave between raiders, gather relics, and connect a powerful defensive circuit.

MOVE THE MECH. MAKE THE CIRCUIT.
Drag anywhere in the arena to move. Your guardian automatically aims at the nearest enemy and keeps firing, so you can focus on positioning. Visit all four relay towers in any order to release a field-wide electrical burst. Each relay also adds charge and a little wall repair. When the towers recharge, plan your next circuit.

COLLECT SHARDS. CHANGE YOUR FIREPOWER.
Gather five amber coil shards to evolve your mech, change its appearance and weapon, and recover some hull. Discover twelve forms with distinct attacks: piercing bolts, spreading fire, heavy mortar blasts, spinning chains, frost shards, jumping lightning, returning blades, orbiting drones, gravity wells, and more. Try every form in the Foundry's free practice mode.

SAVE OVERDRIVE FOR THE MOMENT THAT MATTERS
Defeated enemies, relays, and batteries build your charge. At 100%, tap Overdrive to send out a powerful shockwave and gain brief protection. Collect castle gears to strengthen all four turrets, recover repair hearts, and use elemental relics to turn a crowded battlefield in your favor.

HOLD THE WALL THROUGH 100 SIEGES
Fight through ten regions, from the Brass Verge to the Crown of Cairn. Changing field rules bring crosswinds, falling cinders, frost tides, armored raiders, gravity wells, and more. Every stage has a finite horde and a boss with warning zones you can dodge. Defeat them both while keeping your mech and the citadel standing.

RETURN FOR A BETTER RUN
Protect your hull and walls to earn up to three stars. Replay stages to improve your personal best scores, times, and circuit counts. Your records stay on your device. Every attempt includes one free repair, daily supplies offer optional reserve kits, and retries are unlimited.

YOUR OWN LITTLE STRONGHOLD
Play offline with no ads, accounts, or in-app purchases. Enjoy portrait play on iPhone, illustrated brass-and-ceramic artwork, sound effects, and haptics. Adjust sound and vibration or enable Calm Motion for quieter decorative effects. Your progress and preferences are saved locally.

Hold the wall. Close the circuit. Keep evolving.

name: Cakranexio
description:
Cakranexio is an desk for one independent practice year. File slips, watch benefit land, and run the figures before you spend.

Open on the desk. Benefit so far is turnover, minus charges, minus a set-aside you choose. An objective sits beside it so the year has a line to aim at. Unfiled slips wait in a queue: read the merchant, tap a category, and the books move. Later sends a slip to the back of the queue.

The calculator keeps quick figures within reach. Paste, percent, add, and copy sit above a full keypad. Add files the result as a slip without typing a name. Cash or installments discounts a monthly plan into today’s money and tells you whether paying cash saves more. Compound interest sketches a starting sum plus a monthly deposit.

The shelf holds the rest of the year: pots you reconcile by hand, a mileage log at your own rate, a studio card, closing marks, and the set-aside. Turnover shows receipts month by month. The year pack is a plain summary on this phone. Desk rates are a fixed table stored in the app, not a live market.

Nothing here is a tax filing, a bank connection, or an account. There is no network, no login, and no place to type your own stories. Practice names, merchants, and categories come from the desk. Reset brings back the sample year.

name: Calculus AB AP: Derivane
description:
Prepare for the AP(R) Calculus AB exam with practice tests, free-response practice, simulations you can move with your fingers, and a daily study plan that counts down to exam day (May 10, 2027).

START IN A MINUTE. Take a 24-question starting check, see which of the eight units are strong or weak, pick a target score of 3, 4 or 5, and get a daily plan of 10 to 40 minutes. No account. Works offline.

LEARN BY DOING. Fourteen interactive labs (limits, secant to tangent, derivative follower, rules blocks, implicit and inverse slopes, related-rates ladder, motion, curve sketching, Riemann sums, accumulation tank, average value and motion, slope fields, volume by discs) plus a graphing-calculator practice tool each end with questions built from the values you set.

PRACTICE THAT STICKS. About 800 original multiple-choice questions (about 300 of them calculator-allowed) across all 81 topics of the course, 61 free-response sets with a rubric you mark yourself, spaced-repetition review, a mistake notebook that clears itself once you get an item right twice, and a full worked solution beside every answer, always free.

TEST LIKE THE REAL THING. Timed mock exams follow the May 2027 format: 42 multiple-choice questions (29 without a calculator, 13 with) and 6 free-response questions, each part on its own clock. Results are a rough practice estimate, never a promise.

SOURCES YOU CAN CHECK. Every topic and solution has a References button that cites the College Board course and exam description and OpenStax Calculus.

FREE, FAIRLY. Core study is free with ads placed only at natural breaks, never inside a question, test or simulation. Watch an optional short video to earn credits, or subscribe for $3.99 per month (7-day free trial) to remove ads. Cancel any time in your App Store or Google Play account settings. If you cancel, you keep ad-free until the end of the period you already paid for, and you will not be charged again.

All questions are original, computer-generated and checked, and have not yet been reviewed by a subject expert. Derivane does not contain real exam questions.
AP is a trademark registered and owned by the College Board, which is not affiliated with, and does not endorse, this product.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-derivane.html

name: Calculus BC AP: Taylorine
description:
Prepare for the AP(R) Calculus BC exam with practice tests, free-response practice, interactive labs and full mock exams in the 2027 format. Taylorine takes you through all ten units, from limits and derivatives to polar curves, parametric motion and infinite series.

PRACTICE THAT ADAPTS
- A 20-question diagnostic builds your unit map and a daily plan weighted like the exam
- Adaptive practice, spaced review and a mistake notebook that brings missed questions back until you master them
- Every answer has a Full solution: worked steps, why each wrong choice fails and the common mistake

INTERACTIVE LABS
Slide, drag and see calculus move: secant to tangent, Riemann sums, parametric tracer, polar graphs, Taylor polynomials with error, series convergence, slope fields with Euler's method, power series radius, and a graphing practice calculator. Each lab ends with questions about what you just did.

REAL FORMAT MOCK EXAMS
Full mock tests with 29 no-calculator and 13 calculator multiple-choice questions plus 2 calculator and 4 no-calculator free-response questions, separate part timers, flag and review, and a rough practice estimate afterwards. Free-response practice with a self-scoring rubric. No ads during mock exams.

SOURCES YOU CAN CHECK
Every topic lists references: the official course description and open textbooks.

FREE TO START
Practice, review, solutions and references are free. Watch short optional videos to earn credits for extra mock tests and labs, or choose the monthly ad-free subscription ($3.99 per month, 7-day free trial). Cancel any time in your App Store or Google Play account settings. If you cancel, you keep ad-free until the end of the period you already paid for, and you will not be charged again. Prefer not to subscribe? Watch short videos to earn credits and unlock features.

Your practice data stays on your device. No account needed.

All questions and explanations are original practice material. Scores are rough practice estimates, not predictions.

AP is a trademark registered and owned by the College Board, which is not affiliated with, and does not endorse, this app.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-taylorine.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-taylorine.html

name: Callsign: Ham Exam Prep
description:
Learn amateur radio well enough to pass Technician, General and Amateur Extra — and to understand what you’ll be doing on the air afterward.

Callsign covers all three US license exams, built on the official NCVEC question pools:
• Technician (Element 2), 2026–2030 pool: 409 questions
• General (Element 3), 2023–2027 pool: 423 questions
• Amateur Extra (Element 4), 2024–2028 pool: 599 questions

LESSONS, NOT JUST FLASHCARDS
Each of the 120 question groups has its own lesson. Read it, see the diagram or pool figure, try it in the Lab, or have it read aloud.

SAY HOW SURE YOU ARE
Before an answer is revealed, set the certainty dial: Guessing, Leaning or Sure. A lucky guess barely counts. A confident wrong answer is logged as a misconception, and you’ll see it until you’ve put it right.

NOW — WHY?
Get one right and Callsign may ask why it’s right, with three possible reasons. A topic counts as mastered only once you can explain it.

SIGNAL METER READINESS
Each exam has an S-meter. S9 is the pass mark: 26 of 35 for Technician and General, 37 of 50 for Extra. The meter also lists the topics holding your needle down.

PRACTICE EXAMS
Full simulations drawn the way the real exam is, one question from each group. Flag, skip and change answers, then get a debrief by subelement. The timer is optional; the real exam has none.

THE LAB
Band plan explorer (privileges by license class, from FCC Part 97), Ohm’s law and power, reactance and resonance, antenna length, wavelength, decibels, SWR and propagation.

Spaced review brings back what you missed. Everything works offline. No account, no ads, no tracking: your progress stays on your device.

Question pools are public domain, released by the NCVEC Question Pool Committee. Callsign is not affiliated with the FCC, NCVEC or any VEC.

name: Came Butt
description:
Came Butt keeps a came only when both ends meet another came or the border.

An end that lands in the glass springs back and is not written in. A came that is too short, or one that lies along a came already there, springs back too.

Solder stays on a joint. Tap a soldered joint to lift it. A piece of glass keeps a name only when every joint around it is soldered. The names cycle Amber, Cobalt, Ruby, Forest, Opal, and Gold.

Change the width or the height and a came whose ends no longer meet springs back. The border stays.

Panels stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: CampusTrump: School App
description:
CampusTrump is the official app for schools that run on CampusTrump. Enter your school code, sign in with the details your school gave you, and the app takes on your school's name, crest and colours.
For students
• Lessons from your teachers: notes, video and audio, at your own pace
• Save lessons on Wi-Fi and study them later with no data
• Quizzes, CA tests and exams on your phone, with a timer you can trust
• Tests keep going when the network drops: every answer is saved on your phone and sent to your school when you're back online
• See your scores, report cards and position as soon as your school publishes them
• University and college students see their GPA, CGPA and class of degree
For parents
• One account for all your children at the school
• Follow each child's lessons, test scores and results
• Download report cards, bills and receipts as PDFs
• See what's billed, paid and still to pay
• Pay school fees online, to your child's own account number, or by bank transfer, then send the school a photo of your transfer slip
• Get notifications for new results, fee reminders and school notices
Made for real school life
• Works on low data and patchy networks
• Your school's own branding, not ours
• Ready for Nigerian secondary schools and universities (JSS, SSS, 100–600 Level, CGPA) and Philippine high schools and colleges (DepEd grading, GWA)
CampusTrump is for students and parents of schools that use CampusTrump. Your school creates your account; ask your school for your school code and sign-in details. Schools can book a free demo at campustrump.com.
Need help? Visit campustrump.com/help or email hello@campustrump.com.

name: Canalla App
description:
Canalla App es la app de la hinchada que nunca abandona. Una aplicación NO oficial, hecha por hinchas de Rosario Central, que no tiene relación con el club ni con la AFA.

• Partidos y resultados: fixture, próximo partido con cuenta regresiva, resultados y posiciones.
• Pronosticá cada partido y sumá puntos en tu Fan Zone.
• Aliento: alentá junto a miles de hinchas en tiempo real.
• Noticias, efemérides, títulos e historia del club.
• Plantel con fichas de cada jugador y el cuerpo técnico.
• Mapa del hincha: filiales y zonas donde hay canallas.
• Cánticos y memes propuestos por la hinchada.
• Mini juegos: Fabigol, Rosario Abandon Cup, Bowling Pinguins y La Palomita, el gol de cabeza de Aldo Pedro Poy.
• Aviso antes de cada partido.

Podés entrar como invitado sin crear cuenta, o ingresar con tu correo, con Google o con Apple para comentar, pronosticar y guardar tus puntos. Podés borrar tu cuenta desde la app cuando quieras.

name: Cane Notch
description:
Cane Notch keeps a height mark for each plant in the garden, on this iPhone.

Set a cane beside one plant and name it. Slide the brass ring up the cane and let go. A notch is cut at that height, in centimeters, and the ring drops back to the soil. Slide it again on another day and the older notch stays. Tap a notch to open its tag: the date and time, the height, and how many centimeters it gained or lost since the mark before.

Swipe the cane sideways when more than one plant is in the bed. Each plant has its own cane and its own marks.

Nothing leaves this iPhone. There is no account and no sample garden. The numbers are the heights you notch yourself. Cane Notch does not tell you how to garden, and it does not diagnose a plant.

name: Cape Fear Compass - Events
description:
Cape Fear Compass lists what's on in New Hanover County: Wilmington, Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach and Kure Beach. Live music, comedy, theater, markets, family events and more, plus the places that host them.

Everything is in time order, earliest first. Pick tonight, this weekend or any date, then narrow it down by area, type, price, age, indoor or outdoor, or a specific venue. Near Me shows what's close by.

- The map shows where each listing is.
- Saved events are kept on your phone, so the list works offline.
- Add an event to your calendar or share its link.
- Venue pages show opening hours when they're known, and what's coming up.
- Weekend Picks sends a notification on Thursdays, if you turn it on.

Every event page says where its details came from. When a source doesn't give a price, an end time or an age limit, the page says "Not listed" instead of guessing.

It's free, with no account. Businesses can pay for a spot at the top of a day, marked "Sponsored".

If something's wrong, every event page has Report a Problem at the bottom.

name: Cape Kart
description:
Race go-karts on real Cape Town roads! Every track in Cape Kart is built from the real streets, coastline and buildings of a Cape Town-area place.

10 REAL TRACKS
Killarney Raceway, Green Point Stadium, Sea Point Beachfront, Signal Hill Drive, Chapman's Peak Drive, Bo-Kaap Streets, V&A Waterfront, Camps Bay, Muizenberg Village and Durbanville Village. Each track shows the real road names it uses.

EASY ONE-THUMB CONTROLS
Your kart accelerates by itself. Hold the left or right side of the screen to steer. Hold a hard turn to drift, then let go for a mini-turbo boost.

RACE FIVE RIVALS
Six karts, three laps. Grab item boxes for a Boost, an Oil slick to drop behind you or a Shield, and pick up coins on the racing line. Finish on the podium to unlock the next track.

DAILY CHALLENGE
A new challenge every day, from a time trial to a top-3 finish. Keep your streak going for bonus coins.

YOUR GARAGE
Spend coins on new paint, kart bodies, helmets and trails.

NO SIGN-UP
No account, no email, no password. Just open the app and race. Your progress stays on your device, and your own location is never used.

Cape Kart is free to play with ads. A one-time "Remove Ads" in-app purchase turns off the banner and between-race ads. Optional reward ads (such as double coins) are always your choice.

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database Licence (ODbL), openstreetmap.org/copyright.

name: Capy Sudoku
description:
Capy Sudoku is classic 9×9 sudoku with a cozy twist: a capybara who lives in a little room you fill as you play. No third-party ads, no tracking, no sign-up. Just the game.

HOW TO PLAY
• Fill the grid so every row, column and 3×3 box has the digits 1 to 9.
• Every puzzle has exactly one solution, and you can always get there by logic.

CAPY'S ROOM
• Every solved puzzle earns oranges: more for harder levels.
• Spend them on cozy things for the room: a rug, a sofa, a paper lantern, a hot spring for Capy.
• The more puzzles you solve, the more friends come to visit: a duck, a frog, an otter, a red panda and more.

HELPERS WHEN YOU WANT THEM
• Pencil marks for candidates; a placed digit clears itself from the notes around it.
• Undo, erase and hints when you are stuck.
• The count of each digit left on the board.

LEVELS
• Easy: 40 clues. Free forever.
• Medium: 32 clues.
• Hard: 26 clues.
• Daily: one puzzle a day, the same for everyone. Free forever.

MADE FOR PLAYING
• No pop-ups and no third-party ads.
• No tracking and no sign-up: your games, stats and room stay on your phone.
• Works offline.
• Leave a puzzle and come back later: it waits for you, the clock stops.
• Best times, puzzles solved and your daily streak.
• Badges and Game Center achievements.
• Share your result as a picture.

EASY GAMES PRO
Easy and the Daily are always free, and Medium and Hard give you a few puzzles to try. Easy Games Pro opens every level with no limits, and every other Easy Games puzzle too. Monthly or yearly, with a free week on the yearly plan. Cancel any time in the App Store settings.

Terms: https://easy-games.app/terms
Privacy: https://easy-games.app/privacy

name: CaratIQ
description:
CaratIQ brings your customer conversations and team chats together in one place, so you can reply to customers and coordinate with colleagues from your iPhone or iPad.       
                                                                                                                                                                                
  CaratIQ is for teams that already use the CaratIQ platform. Your organization's administrator creates your account.                                                           
                                                                                                                                                                                
  CUSTOMER INBOX                                                                                                                                                                
  • Reply to customers over SMS, email, WhatsApp, Facebook and Instagram                                                                                                        
  • See every channel for a customer in one unified conversation                                                                                                                
  • Unread counters for each conversation and channel                                                                                                                           
  • Organize conversations with tags                                                                                                                                            
  • Attach photos, videos and files, or send voice notes                                                                                                                        
  • Dictate messages instead of typing                                                                                                                                          
  • Schedule SMS and email messages                                                                                                                                             
                                                                                                                                                                                
  TEAM MESSAGING                                                                                                                                                                
  • Direct and group chats with your colleagues                                                                                                                                 
  • Mention teammates to get their attention                                                                                                                                    
  • Add internal notes to customer conversations that only your team can see                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                
  NOTIFICATIONS                                                                                                                                                                 
  • Push notifications for new messages                                                                                                                                         
  • Tap a notification to open the conversation

name: Carb Tach
description:
Carb Tach keeps one machine on this iPhone. Needle turns and engine speed stay in a local card.

Raise the peak reading and the card names a richer H-needle setting. Idle shows whether the screw should move in or out.

There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Card Keeper: Cards & Barcodes
description:
Keep your payment cards and membership barcodes in one place, ready when you need them. No account required.

■ Add cards
• Point your camera at a card. Card Keeper shows the card number, expiration date, and cardholder name as it reads them, then moves to a review screen when it's done.
• Check and correct what was read before you save, or type everything in yourself.
• Add a photo of the back to fill in only the fields that are still empty.
• Card Keeper tells you if a card number isn't valid.
• Recognizes Visa, Mastercard, American Express, JCB, UnionPay, and Discover.

■ Fill checkout forms in Safari
• On a checkout page, open the Card Keeper extension and pick a card. After you confirm with Face ID, Touch ID, or your device passcode, Card Keeper enters the card number, expiration date, name, and CVC into the form.
• You can choose just the fields you want filled.
• Fills only on https pages.
• Pages that use a secure keypad or a separate payment window (such as Korean app card or ISP checkout) can't be filled. Copy the values in the Card Keeper app and paste them instead.

■ View and copy
• The expiration date is always visible. Viewing or copying the card number, name, or CVC requires authentication.
• Copied values can be pasted only on this iPhone and are cleared from the clipboard after 60 seconds.

■ Membership and library card barcodes
• Add a barcode by pointing your camera at it or choosing an image from Photos or Files. You can also type in the number.
• Codabar, Code 39, Code 128, EAN-8, EAN-13, QR Code, PDF417, and Aztec are displayed as barcodes. Other types are shown as the number in text.
• Add the Barcode widget (medium or large) to your Home Screen to show a barcode you choose without opening the app. If you have more than one, page back and forth right in the widget.

■ Storage and sync
• Cards and barcodes are stored in your iPhone's keychain and sync to your other devices that have iCloud Keychain turned on.
• For any card or barcode, turn on the option to keep it on this iPhone only, and it won't sync through iCloud Keychain.
• There's no developer-run server, and the app doesn't send your card information anywhere.
• Camera frames and photos you choose are only read on your device and are never saved.

■ Before you start
• Your iPhone needs a passcode set to view or fill card details.
• Turn on the Safari extension in Settings > Apps > Safari > Extensions > Card Keeper, and allow it on the sites where you pay.

name: Care4Her
description:
Care4Her gives you one small, concrete thing to do for your partner each day.

Each day has four parts:
• The idea — one line to keep in mind
• Do — something practical you can actually get done
• Say — one sentence, worded so it lands
• Avoid — the thing that usually makes it worse

Don't like today's idea? Swipe for others and pick the one that fits. Every move shows why it works, based on published relationship research — quiet help, fair share of the load, turning toward her, celebrating her good news, and more.

If she tells you how she is — tired, in pain, needs space — the day's move changes to fit. Only what she told you. Never a guess.

DATES ARE OPTIONAL, AND SHE SHOULD KNOW
Care4Her can keep one thing that is hers: the dates her cycle starts (Day 1). The app asks you to tell her you use it. If she'd rather you didn't, use it without dates — you'll get everyday moves instead. With dates, it shows where she likely is in her cycle and adjusts the moves, and it's always labelled as a guess. Her word outranks the calendar.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up, no servers. Nothing is sent anywhere.
• Everything stays in this iPhone's Keychain — not in backups, not in iCloud.
• A PIN, with optional Face ID.
• Lock the moment you leave, and optionally erase everything after 10 wrong PINs.
• A neutral app icon option for your home screen.
• The app switcher shows a blank screen, never your content.
• "What this keeps" in the app lists every piece of data, and you can erase all of it at any time.

NOT MEDICAL ADVICE
Care4Her is not a medical tool and does not predict fertility, diagnose, or treat anything. Cycles vary. If she has severe pain, very heavy bleeding, or anything that worries you, she should see a clinician.

name: Caregiver Shift Notes
description:
Leave the next person a thoughtful, useful update.

PREPARE THE NEXT SHIFT
Choose a four-, eight-, twelve- or 24-hour handoff. See recent updates, overdue and upcoming tasks with their owners, and work completed during the shift.

Caregiver Shift Notes brings everyday care notes, responsibilities, visits and expenses into a calm workspace on your device.

MAKE THE HANDOFF CLEAR
Write dated journal updates with observations and follow-up context. Keep routines and preferences beside the recent notes.

KEEP RESPONSIBILITIES IN VIEW
Record tasks, an assignee and due dates. Mark completed work and see what still needs attention. Add a calendar event when you choose.

REMEMBER THE EVERYDAY COSTS
Record itemized expenses and keep useful photos with the care journal. Plus includes readable PDF summaries and itemized CSV exports that you can share yourself.

YOUR RECORDS, WITH YOU
Saved journals are stored on your device. Export and restore a workspace backup from Settings. Sharing is through exported files; the app does not provide a shared online family account.

A SMALL FREE START
Free access includes three care journals and watermarked PDF previews. Plus unlocks continued journal creation and complete exports. Existing saved journals remain readable and editable after expiry.

This is an organizer, not a medical service. It does not diagnose conditions, recommend treatment or monitor emergencies.

Subscription prices and billing periods are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple subscription settings. Restore Purchases is available in the app.

Website: https://www.trisphereapps.com
Support: https://www.trisphereapps.com/contact
Privacy Policy: https://www.trisphereapps.com/privacypolicy
Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Carteirinha Digital Pet
description:
Organize a saúde dos seus cães e gatos com a Carteirinha Digital Pet.

Mantenha as informações importantes sempre à mão, mesmo sem internet, com uma interface simples e sem necessidade de cadastro.

• Cadastre vários pets com nome, foto, espécie, raça, nascimento e peso.
• Registre vacinas, datas de aplicação e próximas doses.
• Organize medicamentos, vermífugos e próximos cuidados.
• Guarde consultas veterinárias e observações.
• Receba lembretes locais nas datas cadastradas.
• Exporte a carteirinha em PDF para consultar ou compartilhar.

Sem anúncios, assinaturas ou mensalidades.

A sincronização pelo iCloud depende da conta do usuário, conexão e espaço disponível. Exclusões também são sincronizadas.

Os registros são informados pelo tutor. O aplicativo não substitui a orientação veterinária nem emite certificados oficiais de vacinação.

name: Cartesian Plan
description:
A simple DWF viewer, with the ability to highlight linework.
Optimised for service locating.

name: CasinoPedia: कैसीनो गाइड
description:
कैसीनोपीडिया दुनिया के कैसीनो की पूरी जानकारी हिंदी में देता है। मकाऊ से लास वेगास, सिंगापुर से गोवा और मोनाको से काठमांडू तक — 23 देशों के 102 कैसीनो, एक ऐप में।

कैसीनो की पूरी जानकारी
• रेटिंग, स्थापना वर्ष, टेबल और स्लॉट मशीनों की संख्या
• उपलब्ध खेल और दांव की न्यूनतम व अधिकतम सीमा
• ड्रेस कोड, खुलने का समय और सुविधाएं
• वेबसाइट, फ़ोन और Apple Maps में रास्ता

आपके पास
लोकेशन चालू करें और देखें कि सबसे नज़दीकी कैसीनो कितनी दूर हैं। आपकी लोकेशन केवल आपके फ़ोन पर इस्तेमाल होती है।

नक्शा
सभी कैसीनो एक नक्शे पर। किसी देश के कैसीनो देखें या अपने आसपास से शुरुआत करें।

मेरी यात्राएं
जिन कैसीनो में आप जा चुके हैं, उन्हें दर्ज करें — तारीख, अपनी रेटिंग और नोट के साथ। कितने देश और कैसीनो घूमे, सब एक नज़र में। पसंदीदा और यात्राएं iCloud के ज़रिए आपके दूसरे Apple डिवाइस पर भी दिखती हैं।

खेलों की आसान गाइड
ब्लैकजैक, रूलेट, बैकारेट, पोकर, क्रैप्स, सिक बो और दूसरे खेलों के नियम, हाउस एज और शुरुआती लोगों के लिए सुझाव।

और भी
• तीन कैसीनो तक की साथ-साथ तुलना
• कैसीनो उद्योग की खबरें और विश्लेषण
• Spotlight में कैसीनो खोजें
• हर शनिवार "इस सप्ताह का कैसीनो" (वैकल्पिक सूचना)
• लाइट और डार्क थीम

आपकी गोपनीयता
कोई खाता नहीं, कोई विज्ञापन नहीं, कोई ट्रैकिंग नहीं। हम आपकी कोई जानकारी एकत्र नहीं करते।

केवल जानकारी के लिए
कैसीनोपीडिया एक संदर्भ और यात्रा गाइड है। ऐप में कोई जुआ नहीं खेला जाता, कोई दांव नहीं लगता और पैसे का कोई लेन-देन नहीं होता। जुआ केवल वहीं खेलें जहां यह कानूनी है, और अपनी उम्र की कानूनी सीमा का पालन करें।

name: Catnap: Smart Nap Alarm
description:
Catnap is a nap alarm for your lunch break. Tap Tuck in on your watch and lie down. The minutes you spend lying awake don’t count: Catnap starts the timer when your wrist motion says you’ve fallen asleep, then wakes you with taps that go from gentle to strong.

The timer starts when you fall asleep
· Tap and lie down. No guessing how long it takes you to drift off
· Sleep onset is estimated from wrist motion, and Catnap stays silent when it decides, so it won’t wake you
· Nap 10, 20 or 30 minutes. 20 is the default, short enough to wake up clear

No oversleeping
· The latest wake-up time is set the moment you start: max wait plus nap length, even if the estimate is off
· Gentle-to-strong taps, and no snooze button
· If you never fall asleep, a light tap lets you know. It isn’t logged as a nap

Try it first
· Test the alarm: your watch wakes you in 1 minute, just like a real nap. Not logged
· Tap Start nap on iPhone and your watch starts with it. Your nap’s progress shows on iPhone too

Should you nap today?
· At 9:10 every morning: how last night compares with your own usual, and how long to nap
· No scores. Only you vs. you

Saved to Health
· Only the part from falling asleep to waking up
· Dozed off without starting a nap? Catnap asks first and logs it only if you confirm

Full version, one-time purchase
· Trends: time to fall asleep, how naps affect your night, which length leaves you clearest
· Watch face countdown and export
· The nap alarm, log and morning tip stay free

No sign-up, no account.

Catnap is not a medical device. Sleep onset is an estimate. Requires Apple Watch.

name: CertDate
description:
Keep certificates, domain dates and DNS answers together. CertDate helps you check your endpoints, understand saved results and plan local reminders for important dates.

• Check TLS certificates: expiry, issuer, hostname and this device’s trust assessment.
• Compare DNS answers from selected resolvers, including Cloudflare, Google and Quad9. Supports A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, TXT, NS and CAA.
• View public domain information through RDAP, with its source and available dates. Add your own dates as manual reminders.
• Sort targets by domain, expiry date or warning status, and filter them with search, groups and favourites. Your selected order is saved. Distinguish notices, older observations and failed checks.
• Follow saved results and changes in the history.
• Transfer configurations as JSON and export results as CSV. JSON excludes observation history and is not a complete backup. Exports are unencrypted.
• Explore the interface with a separate offline demo, without an account.

ON IPHONE AND IPAD
Open the app for fresh checks. Local reminders use saved dates; CertDate does not promise continuous background server monitoring. The interface adapts to iPhone and iPad.

DATA AND REMINDERS
Targets and results are stored locally on your device. Netensio operates no checking server for CertDate. Live queries connect to your target servers and the selected DNS or RDAP services. These receive the queried names and connection data, including your IP address. The app shows enabled data flows before the first live request.

Reminders need notification permission and rely on saved data. Domain dates may be missing or differ from payment deadlines. DNS comparisons show the selected resolvers’ answers, not proof of worldwide propagation.

Available in German, English, French and Spanish, with light, dark and system appearance.

name: Cfpld
description:
Thanks for downloading and trying it out—your support is our motivation, and your feedback shows us the way forward.


Cfpld is the bridge between every part of your trip: one travel folder, typed in by you and readable at the gate even with no signal.

Start a trip with its dates and the places you'll pass through, then add each leg: flights, trains, buses, stays, car hire, event tickets and plain notes. Cfpld prints every leg as a small boarding pass and spans them day by day, from the first departure to the last arrival.

THE NEXT CROSSING, ALWAYS ON TOP
Upcoming shows your next booking as a big pass with a live countdown ("Departs in 4 h 05 m"), plus everything coming up over the next days, across all your trips. On every timeline the next leg is punched in copper.

EVERY BOOKING, PROPERLY PRINTED
Flights keep the airline, flight number, from and to, terminal, gate, seat and confirmation code. Trains and buses keep operator, number, platform, coach and seat. Stays keep the address, room, phone, check-in and check-out. Car hire, tickets and notes have their own fields. A live preview shows the pass while you type.

LOCAL TIME FOR EACH LEG
Both ends of a leg have their own local time zone, so a 23:30 departure from New York stays on that New York day, and an overnight flight shows "+1" on arrival. Cfpld also shows what a leg's time is on your phone's clock when you're set to another zone.

CODES IN ONE TAP
Copy a confirmation code from the next-up pass or the leg's page with a single tap, ready to paste at the desk or in an airline app. Confirmed bookings carry a steel-blue mark, so you can see at a glance what's still unbooked.

PAPERS CHECKLIST
Every trip has a documents checklist: passport, visa, insurance, driving licence and anything else, each with a note. Only ticks and notes are kept. Nothing is uploaded.

SHARE A DAY
Share any day's plan as plain text with the people you travel with.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Start straight away with "Plan as guest", or create an account with email and password to keep your folder across devices. Guests can move their plans to an email account later from the Lounge. Your folder works offline and syncs when you're back online. Delete your account and every trip, booking and checklist from the Lounge at any time.

BUILT LIKE A TICKET
Departure-board headings, perforated tear lines and a boarding-stub navigation bar stamped with the Cfpld bridge, on warm paper and charcoal ink, with an optional Red-eye night theme. Gentle stamp, chime and paper sounds and haptics can be switched off.

No ads. No tracking. No analytics. Cfpld doesn't connect to airlines or read your email. Everything in it is what you typed.

name: Change Order Ledger
description:
Put every extra in writing before the work moves on.

COMPARE SIGNED AND CURRENT WORK
Compare signed and current totals, scope, quantities, markup and tax. See which labor and material lines were added, edited or removed.

Change Order Ledger brings scope, job photos, itemized prices and on-device signatures into one focused workspace for contractors and small crews.

PRICE THE EXTRA CLEARLY
Add quantities, labor and material rates, markup and tax. See the itemized total before reviewing it with your customer.

PRESERVE WHAT WAS APPROVED
Collect a signature on your device. Each saved approval keeps that revision's scope, prices and signature together. Editing the work requires a fresh approval, while earlier approved versions stay available.

FOLLOW THE JOB THROUGH
Track draft, approved, invoiced and paid work. Keep notes, photos and a dated activity history with the job. Payment status is recorded by you; the app does not collect customer payments.

SHARE A PROFESSIONAL RECORD
Plus includes complete PDF and itemized CSV exports. Review the document before sharing it through your device's share sheet.

START WITH ONE CHANGE ORDER
Free access includes one saved change order and watermarked PDF previews. Plus unlocks continued creation and complete exports. Existing saved records remain readable and editable after a subscription ends.

Subscription prices and billing periods are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple subscription settings. Restore Purchases is available in the app.

Website: https://www.trisphereapps.com
Support: https://www.trisphereapps.com/contact
Privacy Policy: https://www.trisphereapps.com/privacypolicy
Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Chaptera: Book Tracker
description:
Every book you own, read or want to read, spine by spine on a shelf that's yours alone.
Scan a barcode, photograph a spine or type a title. Chaptera speaks 34 languages and finds the edition in yours; anything the catalog misses goes in by hand in seconds.
No account to create, no ads, no AI. Your library stays on your device, and importing a CSV from another reading app is free.

ADD ANY BOOK
• Scan the barcode, or photograph the spine or cover; the text is read on the device
• Search by title, author or ISBN, or paste a link to a book page
• Editions with year, pages and language, so you keep the one you own
• Nothing found, or offline? Type the title; a photo can be the cover
• Paper, e-book or audiobook, in pages, percent or minutes

THE SHELF
• Spines drawn from each book's title, author and cover color
• Sort by color, author, date or rating, or drag books into your own order
• Shelves, tags, series, half-star ratings, rereads, and lending with a due-back reminder
• Two shelves and two themes free; more shelves, themes and décor with Pro

READING
• A reading timer; with Pro, also a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• A journal of every sitting, with your pace and the day you'll finish
• A reading calendar of the spines you picked up each day
• A daily goal in minutes or pages, and a streak
• Ten reading sounds made on the device: three free, all ten with Pro

GOALS AND YOUR YEAR
• A yearly goal that shows whether you're on track
• Your year: books, pages and hours; months, authors and records with Pro
• Share cards for your year and your quotes (Pro)

NOTES AND QUOTES
• Notes and typed quotes on any book
• Quotes from a photo of the page: tick the lines you want (Pro)
• Highlights from a Kindle's My Clippings.txt file, matched to your books (Pro)

YOUR DATA
• No sign-in and no tracking; only catalog searches and cover images go online
• CSV import shows what it found before anything is added
• CSV and JSON export and a backup file, free, always
• Face ID, Touch ID or a passcode keeps your shelf private

WIDGETS AND SHORTCUTS
• Widgets: Current book and a Lock Screen streak; Bookcase, Reading goal and Quote of the day with Pro
• Control Center buttons for the timer and scanner (iOS 18 or later)
• Siri and Shortcuts to log pages or start the timer
• Books and quotes in Spotlight, which you can switch off
• On iPad: a full-width shelf, and the list beside each book

CHAPTERA PRO
Without Pro, Chaptera keeps up to 20 books at a time, with no time limit: full tracking, CSV import, export, backup, the yearly goal and your year's totals. Pro removes the limit and unlocks everything marked Pro above.
$4.99 a week, $7.99 a month, or $34.99 a year with a 7-day free trial for eligible accounts; Lifetime is $59.99 once. The yearly plan and Lifetime work with Family Sharing. These are US prices; in other countries the app and Apple's purchase sheet show the price in your currency.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation or when the trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/chaptera/privacy
Terms of Use: https://sites.google.com/view/chaptera/terms

name: Charge center
description:
Charge center is a calm matching puzzle set in a boutique zipper workshop. Study tooth shape, spacing, tape color, and material — then choose the only half that truly fits.

Each level shows an open zipper waiting for its match. Compare subtle differences among fabric samples, tap or drag the correct piece into place, and watch the teeth engage as the slider rises in a smooth closing animation.

Features

Refined atelier style with fabric, metal, and stitch details
Observation puzzles based on zipper teeth, pitch, color, and material
Satisfying tooth-by-tooth closing animation
60 levels across 6 themed chapters
Star ratings for careful, efficient clears
Soft sound and haptics with full settings control
A little detail makes a perfect match.

name: Charmius Holo Music Fest
description:
Step into a world where music meets light.
 Charmius Holo Music Fest brings together a futuristic performance programme, a digital art gallery and stories about the technology behind virtual entertainment.
 Browse 15 shows across a six-month schedule. Explore holographic concerts, electronic performances and immersive experiences, with dates, times, venues and show descriptions in one place.
 Discover virtual singers, robotic musicians and luminous characters. Explore their visual identities and the ideas behind each exhibit.
 Use the interactive festival map to explore stages, exhibition spaces and services. Filter locations and jump from a show or exhibit to its venue.
 Read about projection systems, motion capture, spatial sound and interactive visuals. Discover English-language articles and videos, and save resources to revisit later.
 Choose a performance date and guest count, save a local reservation and view its QR record. Manage or cancel your saved reservations directly in the app.
 Access the built-in catalogue, map and saved reservations without an internet connection. External articles and videos require internet access.
 No account is required. Reservations are stored on your device and are local planning records, not externally issued admission tickets.
 Discover the artists. Explore the stages. Get closer to the technology.

name: Chaupat Samrat
description:
Four cowrie shells, a 5×5 board, and four sogtī trying to get home. Chaupat Samrat™, also known as Ashta Chamma, Chowka Bara, Daayakattam and Katte, is the Indian board game that has been played on courtyard floors for centuries, in the same family as Pachisi and Chaupar. Now you can play it with the people you actually know.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS, ONLINE
Send an invite link and your friend is at the same table seconds later. Or enter a room code. Two to four players online, with chat while you play. No account needed to start, and no waiting for strangers, though you can play a random opponent too.

PLAY ON CALL
Talk while you play, the way you did on the floor at home. Tap Call at an online table and your friends join one group voice call: up to four players, everyone hears everyone, with a mute button.

AN OFFLINE BOARD GAME WHEN YOU NEED ONE
No signal? No problem. Play the bots at four difficulties, or pass one phone around the table for two to four people. No network and no account needed.

SIX LANGUAGES AT THE TABLE
English, हिन्दी, मराठी, தமிழ், తెలుగు and ಕನ್ನಡ. Pick yours and the app, the rules and the bots at your table all speak it.

LIVE ROOMS AND FAMILIES
Open a room anyone can join, or sit down with a bot. Make a family with your cousins, then take on another family in quick 2v2 boards, and take the Maharaja League crown each month.

CLIMB THE LEAGUE
Win online matches against real players and earn points towards a weekly league, from Clay through Wood, Brass, Silver and Gold to Ivory. Reach the higher divisions and you unlock sogtī that cannot be bought, only earned.

COLLECT BOARDS AND SOGTĪ
Earn coins just by playing: a daily spin, every finished match, every win. Spend them on new boards and gem sogtī. All cosmetic. Nothing you earn ever changes who wins.

HOUSE RULES, YOUR WAY
Every family plays it differently, so set it up the way yours does: kill to enter, grace throws, an extra throw on a capture, and jodī pair protection.

LEARN AS YOU PLAY
Never played before? Guided play walks you through your first game: the throws, the safe squares, the crossing, and when to break a pair.

ALSO INSIDE
• Play in English, Hindi, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu or Kannada
• 2 player and 4 player games, online or on one device
• Group voice call for up to four players at the table
• Pick your board and sogtī in the lobby: the table plays on the board you choose together
• Friends list, invites and private messages
• Turn-based games: take a move whenever you have a minute
• Family mode: canned chat, no shop
• Weekly league and all-time leaderboards

Ashta Chamma is a game your grandmother knows the rules to, and an Indian board game your friends can join from anywhere. Throw the cowries.

Free to play with ads. Optional purchases include Chaupat Plus, an auto-renewing subscription (monthly or yearly) that removes ads. Payment is charged to your Apple ID and the subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://beyond-play-studios.web.app/privacy

name: Cheat Companion for GTA 6 & 5
description:
Stop scrolling through web pages mid-game. Cheat Companion puts cheat codes for the Grand Theft Auto series in one fast, searchable list.

FIND IT IN SECONDS
• Pick your game, then search it instantly
• Type plain words like "tank", "money" or "cops"
• Filter by Player, Weapons, Vehicles or World

MADE FOR YOUR PLATFORM
• Switch between PlayStation, Xbox and PC with one tap
• Button sequences shown as clear controller icons
• Keyboard codes and in-game phone numbers where the game has them

BUILT FOR PLAYING
• Hear a code read aloud while your hands stay on the controller
• Share a code with a friend in one tap
• Works with no internet connection
• New codes are added automatically, with no app update needed
• No account, no ads, no tracking

FREE AND PRO
• Free: search everything and use the most popular codes for each game
• Pro: every code, new codes as they are confirmed, and saved favourites
• Choose Pro Yearly, which starts with a 7-day free trial, or pay once for Pro Lifetime

Pro Yearly renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://cheat-companion.vercel.app/privacy

GAMES COVERED
• Grand Theft Auto VI: codes are added as soon as they are confirmed
• Grand Theft Auto V
• Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas
• Grand Theft Auto: Vice City

Using cheats can disable trophies and achievements for that session, and they do not work in online modes. Save your game first.

Cheat Companion is an unofficial, fan-made guide. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by any game publisher or console maker. All game titles and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

name: Cheats 6 – Cheat Codes
description:
Cheats 6 is the cheat app that belongs next to your controller: tap a code, see the buttons big and clear, press along. Done.

THREE GAMES
• GTA VI – codes appear as soon as they are tested and confirmed in the game
• GTA V – all 36 codes, including the in-game phone numbers
• GTA: San Andreas – 87 codes, from the jetpack to the tank

TESTED CODES ONLY
No made-up lists. A code only makes it into the app once it really works – cross-checked against several sources.

ALWAYS UP TO DATE
New codes arrive right in the app, without waiting for an update.

YOUR PLATFORM
PlayStation, Xbox or PC: the app shows the buttons the way they look on your controller. On PC you get the matching cheat word, ready to copy.

BUILT FOR PLAYING
• Large, numbered button sequences
• Search and categories: player, weapons, vehicles, wanted level, weather and more
• Favorites for the cheats you use most
• Works without an internet connection
• The screen stays on while a code is open

FAIR
The app is free and shows ads. If you don't like them, a one-time purchase removes them for good. No subscription, no account.

GOOD TO KNOW
Cheats only work in Story Mode and can disable trophies and achievements for the current session.

Cheats 6 is an unofficial fan app and is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

name: CheatZero 귀 점검
description:
CheatZero 귀 점검은 시험 감독관이 응시자의 귀에 숨긴 초소형 이어폰을 확인하도록 돕는 앱입니다. 별도 장비 없이 지금 쓰는 iPhone 만 있으면 됩니다.

■ 쉽게
• 좌석을 고르고, 화면 안내대로 iPhone 을 응시자의 귀 가까이 가져가면 됩니다.
• 왼쪽과 오른쪽 귀를 따로 확인합니다.
• 의심되는 귀만 한 번 더 확인해 결과를 정합니다.
• 소리를 내지 않고 진동으로만 알려 시험 분위기를 해치지 않습니다.

■ 교실 단위로 함께
• 안드로이드용 CheatZero 의 교실 QR 이나 참여 코드로 같은 교실에 들어갈 수 있습니다.
• 다른 감독관 폰의 점검 결과가 교실 배치도에 함께 보여, 이미 점검한 좌석을 건너뛸 수 있습니다.
• 교실 연결 없이 혼자 써도 됩니다.

■ 기록
• 좌석별 결과를 폰에 남기고 CSV 파일로 공유할 수 있습니다.
• 보청기·인공와우 사전 신고자는 점검 제외로 기록합니다.

■ 개인정보
• 측정 중 영상과 사진을 저장하거나 보내지 않습니다.
• 응시자의 개인정보를 입력받지 않습니다.

자기장 센서가 있는 iPhone 에서 쓸 수 있습니다.

name: CHEER ME
description:
CHEER MEは、自分の気持ちに気づき、気持ちを整える方法を自分で選んで練習するアプリです。

【5つの気持ちとキャラクター】
・いらいら：Reddy（レディ）
・かなしい：Blu（ブルー）
・つかれた：Mellow（メロウ）
・どきどき：Wimi（ウィミ）
・もやもや：Misty（ミスティ）

【CHEER MEでできること】

■ 今の気持ちを選ぶ
自分がどんな気持ちなのか、キャラクターを選びながら考えます。

■ 気持ちを整える方法を選ぶ
深呼吸、休憩、体を動かすなど、気持ちに合った対処法を自分で選びます。

■ キャラクターと一緒に練習する
イラストやアニメーションを見ながら、自分のペースで取り組めます。

■ 気持ちを振り返る
練習の後には、気持ちがどう変わったかを振り返ります。まだ落ち着かない場合は、もう一度練習したり、別の方法を選んだりすることもできます。

【CHEER MEが大切にしていること】

気持ちを無理に変えることが目的ではありません。

自分の気持ちに気づくこと。
自分に合った方法を選ぶこと。
必要なときに、自分で対処できる力を育てること。

CHEER MEは、そんな小さな練習を応援するアプリです。

name: Chezoo
description:
Chezoo brings the party games you already love to your phone, in English and Kiswahili, for any group of friends or family.

Pass one phone around the circle, play on your own phones over the same Wi-Fi or a hotspot, or start an online room and send friends an invite link, wherever they are. No ads and no sign-up needed. Just open it and play.

Games for every crowd

• Charades: act it out, no words
• Heads-Up: phone on your forehead, guess from your friends' clues
• Who Am I?: ask yes-or-no questions to guess your secret card
• Trivia: history, geography, culture, music, sport, wildlife and more
• Imposter: one player doesn't know the secret word. Find them
• Mafia: find the Mafia before they find you
• Taboo: say it without the banned words
• Hangman: guess it letter by letter
• Bomu!: hot potato with a hidden fuse
• Hot Takes: pick a side, then defend it
• Red Flag, Green Flag: red or green? Say it on three
• Riddles (Vitendawili): Kitendawili? Tega! Crack it, or give a town
• Proverbs (Methali): finish the Swahili proverb
• Most Likely To (Nani Zaidi): point at the usual suspect
• Never Have I Ever
• Two Truths and a Lie
• Truth or Dare
• Would You Rather
• Hot Seat: one minute, no hiding
• Bottle Match: crack the secret order
• Tic Tac Trivia: earn every square
• Rock Paper Shoot: count in, throw, settle it

Local packs, built in

Thousands of questions, words and dares ready to play, with packs that know local food, music, slang, places and sayings, not just translations of foreign games. Switch between English and Kiswahili any time.

Make your own with the AI you already use

Pick a game and a topic, copy the prompt into the AI you already use, and bring the pack back to play. You can also write your own cards, build a whole pack in a table on an iPad, import a pack from a friend, or share yours.

Votes and secret draws

Run your own awards night: everyone votes in secret on their own phone, then the winners are revealed one by one. Or hold a secret draw for a gift swap, a secreto, a swap and steal, or who brings which dish, and only you see who you got.

Keep score together

Start a group to keep every game, win, award and vote in one place, and see who tops the board this month.

Pick the mood

Choose how bold the game gets. Mild keeps it easy for everyone, Spicy adds some cheeky fun, and Wild is an optional 18+ level that stays off until an adult turns it on.

Make it yours

• Save your players and track your stats
• Use your own photo, or pick a face
• Pick your categories, rounds and timers
• Pause a game and pick it up later
• Sign in with Apple or Google if you like, to back up your games and bring your groups to a new phone
• Big, roomy layouts on iPad
• Sounds, vibration and reduced motion settings

Play offline

One-phone and same Wi-Fi games, votes and draws don't need the internet.

Perfect for house parties, family gatherings, office parties, road trips, school breaks, weddings and any time friends are together.

Chezoo: tucheze pamoja.

name: Chorelane
description:
Chorelane rotates named chores across the people in your home and keeps a log of who actually did them. Daily chores move with the day of the year. Weekly chores move with the week of the year. Names are sorted alphabetically before the calendar picks an index.

The week strip shows seven days. A logged chore shows the person you saved, even if that is not the person on rotation. Fairness bars add effort points from the last 28 days of logs, not from assignments that nobody marked done.

Chorelane does not send reminders and does not pay anyone. Points are a household comparison. The notebook stays on this iPhone.

name: Christmas Lights: Tree Puzzle
description:
The Christmas tree is up, but the lights are a tangle. Tap a piece of wire to turn it and lead the power from the trunk to every bulb. When the last one glows, the star on top shines and the whole tree sparkles.

- 40 levels, from a tiny tree with a handful of lights to a giant tree with thirty
- Earn up to three stars per level by being quick
- High score mode: a new random big tree every time, beat your own best time
- Made for phones and tablets: a tall tree in portrait, a wide tree in landscape
- Cheerful Christmas music and sounds, each with its own off switch
- Seven languages: English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese

Easy to learn for children, and the big trees are a real puzzle for grown-ups. No ads, no purchases, no account, and nothing is collected. Works without internet. Happy holidays!

name: Chuchotage Studio
description:
Chuchotage Studio turns an iPhone or iPad into a live broadcast source for conference translation and streaming.

Connect the room's mixer or a microphone, enter your server address and stream key, and tap Go Live. The app sends the audio to Chuchotage or to any RTMP or RTMPS server.

Made for audio first
• Audio-only mode uses very little data and keeps streaming with the screen locked
• Large level meter with a dBFS scale, peak hold and clip warning
• Gain control, mute, and hold-to-mute
• USB-C and Lightning audio interfaces, with mono, stereo or single-channel routing
• Optional whistle filter and noise gate
• Listen in headphones

Video when you need it
• Camera mode, front or back camera
• Title card mode for platforms that require a picture
• 480p to 4K, H.264 or HEVC, adaptive bitrate

Built for event days
• One profile per room or language
• Set up another device by scanning a QR code
• Automatic reconnection if the network drops
• Live timer and upload rate
• iPhone and iPad, portrait and landscape
• English, Romanian and Russian

No account, no ads, no tracking. The app sends your audio and video only to the server you enter.

name: Cinder Caravan
description:
The desert asks for more than a lucky hand. In Cinder Caravan, every poker pattern becomes a practical decision: travel farther, replenish your stores or mend the wagon.

Choose five cards from eight, compare two visible routes and plan around tomorrow's weather. Hearts conserve water, clubs support foraging, diamonds strengthen repairs and spades carry you onward. Balance water, food and wagon integrity to reach the jade city before the seasonal sandstorm.

EVOLVE YOUR EXPEDITION
At each oasis, recover supplies and choose how to grow: install a relic, draft an ace or leave a weak card behind. Combine four relics with distinct effects and shape a deck that supports your strategy.

THREE DESERT CROSSINGS
Begin with the five-stage Amber Passage, plan carefully through the seven-stage Salt Frontier or test your reserves in the nine-stage Night Crossing. Six kinds of encounters offer resource tradeoffs along the way.

A NEW TRAIL EACH DAY
Try a daily journey generated from the date on your device. The same date gives you the same starting seed, while your route and card choices shape the outcome.

PLAY AT YOUR OWN PACE
Every decision is saved automatically. Return to your active caravan whenever you like, and revisit your last 30 completed travel journals with scores, best hands and outcomes.

Includes an illustrated field guide, poker hand rankings, deck and relic inspection, English and Simplified Chinese, system/light/dark appearance and optional sound.

Fully offline and single-player. No account, ads, analytics or in-app purchases. Progress and preferences stay on your device. Poker hands power your expedition; there is no betting, real-money wagering or cash prizes.

name: Cinema Note
description:
Cinema Note is a quiet place to keep what you watch. Browse posters for short dramas, mini series, and indie films, then save your own ratings, tags, and private notes — all stored only on your iPhone.
WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Discover titles by trending, new, genre, or search
• Log status (To Watch / Watched / Dropped), star ratings, tags, and reviews
• Build local watch lists and reorder them anytime
• Browse a month-by-month diary and a personal library of favorites
• Switch dark mode and colorful accents in Settings
WHAT IT IS NOT
Not a streaming app. No video playback, no ads, no accounts, no sharing, no cloud upload. Your notes stay private on device.
Perfect for viewers who want a calm, private journal for short-form stories — nothing more.

name: Civil Lapse
description:
Civil Lapse conecta la información de tus proyectos de construcción para consultar y registrar el avance de obra.

• Organiza proyectos, planos y puntos de captura.
• Consulta fotografías y panorámicas 360° con su historial.
• Explora modelos 3D y sus propiedades BIM cuando el proyecto dispone de ellos.
• Registra observaciones y da seguimiento a actividades y cronogramas.
• Consulta documentos, reportes y evidencias del proyecto.
• Usa las funciones de campo y ubicación según tus permisos.

Necesitas una cuenta proporcionada por tu organización. Cada usuario accede únicamente a las empresas y proyectos asignados. La descarga no incluye una suscripción ni habilita proyectos automáticamente.

Se necesita conexión para cargar el espacio de trabajo. Las funciones de campo sin señal requieren descargar previamente el proyecto; no hay sincronización de iOS con la app cerrada.

En Apple puedes tomar o seleccionar fotos y subir panorámicas compatibles. El control nativo de la cámara Insta360 X5 es exclusivo de Android. Las funciones de cámara y ubicación dependen del dispositivo y requieren tu permiso.

Soporte: gerencia.desarrollo@code4bi.com
Privacidad: https://planos.code4bi.com/privacidad
Términos: https://planos.code4bi.com/terminos

name: Claimslip
description:
Claimslip is a local notebook for purchases and the warranty dates you calculate from them.

Each slip stores the item, brand, store, price, serial, where you keep it, the day you bought it, and the warranty length in months. The app adds those months to the purchase date and groups slips as covered, expiring within 45 days, expired, or no term. Claims are repair or return notes you write yourself, with the cost you actually paid.

A plain-text page copies one slip onto the pasteboard so you can paste it into a message you write in another app. Claimslip does not contact stores, register products, or decide whether a repair will be free.

Your slips stay on this phone.

name: Clean Camera Roll
description:
Thousands of photos feel impossible to sort. One month doesn't.
Pick a month, swipe through its photos, and delete the ones you don't need, all in a few minutes.
Nothing is deleted until you review your picks and iOS asks you to confirm.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a month. Your photos are grouped by the month you took them.
• Swipe left to mark a photo for deletion, right to keep it. Or tap the big Keep and Mark for Deletion buttons.
• Made a mistake? Undo brings back the last photo.
• Review every marked photo in one grid. Tap any photo to keep it after all.
• Delete. iOS shows its own confirmation, and deleted photos go to Recently Deleted for 30 days.

PICK UP WHERE YOU STOPPED
Your progress is saved for each month. Close the app halfway through and continue later from the exact photo you stopped at. Finished months are marked done, so you can see how far you've come.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos are shown and deleted only on your iPhone. They are never uploaded, copied or sent anywhere. Works with full or limited photo access. No account, no ads, no tracking.

FREE AND PREMIUM
Clean one month of your choice for free, with your progress saved. Premium lets you clean every other month and resume any month in progress.

Premium is an optional subscription: $2.99 per week with a 3-day free trial, or $14.99 per year. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase or when the free trial ends. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Cancel anytime in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://motleystudio.site/clean-camera-roll/terms
Apple's Standard License Agreement (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/clean-camera-roll/privacy

name: Cleanroom Class
description:
Cleanroom Class keeps one set of rooms on this iPhone. Enter the floor size and the target class. The plan marks how many sample points that area needs.

Import the counts from each location. Limits show the concentration allowed at each diameter, and how much air each point must collect.

The verdict compares every point with that limit. A bar past the line is over. The seal names the class the room actually reaches. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Clear Maze! Kitty Journey
description:
Clear the arrows. Free the path. Send the kitty exploring!

Clear Maze! Kitty Journey is a relaxing yet brain-teasing puzzle game that blends the classic Arrow Escape mechanic with a cozy travel-themed journey. Tap arrows to clear the way, open up the maze, and guide your adorable kitty companion through sunny beaches, cherry-blossom streets, snowy towns, and many more scenic stops along the way.

HOW TO PLAY
Every level is a maze made of arrows. Tap any arrow and it slides out in the direction it points — but only if the path ahead is clear. Figure out the right order, remove the arrows that block the way, and carve out a safe route for your kitty. Stuck? Undo your last move or restart the level and try a fresh approach.

GAME MODES
• Classic Arrow Escape — Dozens of handcrafted arrow puzzles with a smooth, satisfying difficulty curve.
• Kitty Journey — Travel from stop to stop with your kitty, collect souvenirs and travel stickers, and unlock beautiful new scenery.
• Daily Challenge — A brand-new puzzle every day, with exclusive rewards and streak bonuses.
• Achievements — Complete milestones, earn badges, and collect them all.

FEATURES
• Easy-to-learn tap-and-clear arrow puzzles
• Two ways to play: classic arrow escape + kitty travel levels
• Fresh daily challenges, every single day
• Achievements and badge collection
• A cute kitty travel buddy
• Calming visuals and soothing sound
• Play offline, anytime, anywhere
• No timers — solve at your own pace

Perfect for fans of logic puzzles, brain teasers, casual games, and of course, cats.

Download Clear Maze! Kitty Journey today and help your kitty find the way — one arrow at a time.

name: ClearFace AI
description:
ClearFace AI helps you understand your skin and build a targeted, ingredient-aware routine in seconds.

Scan your skin from a photo, explore personalized AI insights, ask skin and product questions, and evaluate how foods and daily habits impact your skin barrier.

KEY FEATURES:

• Instant Skin & Acne Scan: Snap or upload a photo to analyze potential breakout zones, visible blemishes, and skin tendencies with AI-assisted precision.

• AI Skincare Q&A: Have questions about active ingredients, routines, or specific products? Ask the built-in skincare assistant for clear, actionable answers.

• Food & Diet Scan: Photograph a meal to see ingredient-level nutritional context and how foods may interact with your skin health.

• Skin Profile Quiz: Complete a quick skin quiz to personalize recommendations for your exact skin type, sensitivity level, and daily goals.

• Evidence-Backed Ingredients: Discover targeted active ingredients (like Salicylic Acid, Niacinamide, Azelaic Acid, and Centella) matched to your specific skin needs.

• Progress Tracking: Save scan history locally on your device to monitor your skin journey over time.

PRIVACY FIRST:
Your scans and questions are processed securely and your scan history stays stored privately on your device. ClearFace AI requires your explicit permission before any image or question is analyzed.

IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER:
ClearFace AI provides cosmetic and educational skincare information only. It is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any medical condition or disease. Always consult a board-certified dermatologist or healthcare provider for medical concerns.

name: Clickgate
description:
Clickgate is a headcount and tally counter built like a box-office clicker. Big IN and OUT keys, rolling mechanical digits, and a timestamp on every tap, so you always know how many people are inside, when the rush hit, and whether you are close to capacity.

Made for door staff, event volunteers, teachers on school trips, and anyone doing a stock count.

COUNT AT THE DOOR
• Huge red IN and cyan OUT keys you can hit without looking
• Occupancy = in minus out, shown on tall tally-counter digits that roll as you count
• Optional capacity per counter, with a bar, a warning line and a turnstile clunk when you get close
• Step size per counter: 1 for people, 6 or 12 for packs and boxes
• Undo the last tap, or reset a counter after a confirmation

SESSIONS FOR EVERY EVENT
• Group counters into a session, such as "Saturday market: Gate A, Gate B" or "Year 6 trip: Coach 1, Coach 2"
• Give each counter a name, a colour, a capacity and a step size
• Run several live sessions at once and switch between them
• Archive a session to History when the doors close. Its totals and peak are kept, and you can reopen it later

REPORTS THAT SHOW THE RUSH
• Arrivals per 15-minute block as a bar chart, with exits alongside
• The peak block, with its arrival count and share of the day
• A session receipt with arrivals, exits, inside now, taps and counting time
• Occupancy for each counter against its capacity
• Share a plain-text summary through the share sheet

BUILT FOR A BUSY DOOR
• Works offline. Counts are saved on the phone and sync when you are back online
• Optional "keep screen awake" while counting
• Mechanical clicker sounds and haptics, each with its own on/off switch
• Three themes: Box Office, Venue Dark and Fair Day
• Choose whether the capacity warning starts at 80%, 90% or 95%

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
• Sign in with email and password, or tap "Count as guest" to start straight away
• Guests can keep their counts later by adding an email and password in Booth > Keep my counts
• Delete your account, with every session, counter and tap, from Booth > Delete account

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking and no analytics. Your counts are stored in your own private space and nobody else sees them unless you share a summary yourself.

Clickgate is a counting aid. For safety rules at your venue, check with the people in charge of the event.

name: Cloakreach
description:
Cloakreach is a portrait 3D hop through a sunny valley. A small cloaked keeper stands on floating grass ledges. Two hops are always waiting: Stoop reaches the near ledge, Leap reaches the far one. Dotted arcs show both paths before you tap. Land on the castle step to finish the ridge.

Coins on the true trail set a purse par. Bells are checkpoints. A prickle bush or an open gap costs a heart and sends you back to the last bell. Leap three times in a row and the ribbon snaps, so the next leap falls short. Gusts bend the picture. Some ledges slide. The arcs still tell you where you will land.

Four vales open as your stars grow: Greenfold, Ambercut, Frostcomb, and Cinderwell. Each trail peg is a fresh ridge. Stars are Spark, Banner, and Crown — the castle, the purse, and a clean hop. Chests on trails 3, 7, and 11 dye new scarves. Dawn Ridge is one local challenge for the calendar day, with a best star kept on this device only.

name: Clock Whiz
description:
Clock Whiz is a playful app for children who are just learning to read a clock.
Kids grab the hands with a finger and turn them, so they can see for themselves how the hour hand and the minute hand move.

My Clock
- Shows the current time on a big, clear clock.
- Turn the hour and minute hands and the time is written out as you go.
- The hour hand is blue, the minute hand is red, and the second hand is green, so they are easy to tell apart.

Learn the Clock
- Introduces the hour, minute, and second hands one at a time.
- Four short lessons: The Slow Hour Hand, One Tick One Minute, The Speedy Second Hand, and Moving Together.
- Tap a button or turn a hand and the explanation changes right away.

Quiz Time
- Tell the Time: look at the clock and choose the right time.
