- Set the Clock: read the time and turn the hands to match.
- Find the Clock: read the time and pick the clock that shows it.
- Three levels, Easy, Normal, and Hard, with 10 questions per round.
- Daily records show how many questions were solved and how many were right.

Made with care
- Exact hours are shown as "o'clock" so children are not confused by zero minutes.
- Praise for right answers, encouragement for wrong ones.
- Sound effects and vibration can be turned off in settings.
- Available in English, Korean, and Japanese.
- Works on iPhone and iPad.

A banner ad is shown at the bottom of the screen. Ads are set to be suitable for children and for general audiences only.

name: CMBcore Ads
description:
CMBcore Ads là ứng dụng di động của CMB Marketing (ads.cmbcore.com), giúp chủ shop và người chạy quảng cáo theo dõi và điều chỉnh quảng cáo Facebook, TikTok mọi lúc, mọi nơi.

TỔNG QUAN TRONG MỘT MÀN
• Chi tiêu, kết quả, chi phí/kết quả, CTR, CPM của mọi tài khoản quảng cáo
• Đơn hàng và doanh thu thật quy về từng quảng cáo, ROAS thật
• Biểu đồ theo ngày, so sánh với kỳ trước, cảnh báo quảng cáo kém hiệu quả

QUẢN LÝ QUẢNG CÁO NGAY TRÊN ĐIỆN THOẠI
• Xem chiến dịch, nhóm quảng cáo, quảng cáo; lọc theo thời gian, tài khoản, trạng thái
• Bật/tắt, chỉnh ngân sách, nhân bản, thao tác hàng loạt
• Trình sửa đầy đủ, xem lịch sử thay đổi và hoàn tác
• Tạo quảng cáo mới (mặc định tạm dừng để bạn kiểm tra trước khi chạy)
• Mọi thao tác tốn tiền đều có bước xác nhận ghi rõ số tiền

BÁO CÁO AI MỖI SÁNG
• Tóm tắt kết quả hôm qua, điểm nổi bật, chiến dịch tốt/cần xem
• Đề xuất tăng, giảm ngân sách hoặc tạm dừng — áp dụng một chạm hoặc sửa trước

LỊCH ĐĂNG BÀI
• Lên lịch bài cho Trang Facebook và TikTok, xem theo lịch hoặc danh sách
• Gợi ý nội dung bằng AI, thư viện ảnh/video, đăng hàng loạt
• Theo dõi trạng thái đăng, thử lại khi lỗi

Ứng dụng dùng chung tài khoản CMBcore (CMBcore Seller, CMBcore Chat, ads.cmbcore.com). Đăng nhập bằng email/tên đăng nhập hoặc Facebook. Chưa có tài khoản? Đăng ký tại app.cmbcore.com.

name: Coating DFT Survey
description:
Coating DFT Survey keeps one coating job on this iPhone. Five spots on an area each take three readings.

Lower a thin spot and the area verdict updates. The section page shows the minimum band beside the point means.

There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Coatsum
description:
Know exactly how many tins, rolls and packs to buy before you reach the decorating aisle.

Coatsum is a quantity estimator for DIY decorators. Measure a room once — wall by wall, or as a quick box room — cut out the doors and windows, and it works out the paint, wallpaper and flooring for you, with a cost for every room and a single shopping list for the whole project.

MEASURE THE WALLS
• Enter each wall's width and the height, or length × width × height for a simple box room.
• Tap a preset to subtract a standard door, double door, small or standard window or patio door — or add your own custom size.
• A live wall diagram draws your walls unfolded side by side, with every opening cut out, so you can see what you've entered.

PAINT, PAPER AND FLOOR — WORKED OUT
• Paint: paintable area, litres for the number of coats you choose, at the coverage rate on your tin, rounded up to whole tins. Add the ceiling with one switch.
• Wallpaper: drop length from the wall height, trim and pattern repeat, drops per roll, and the number of rolls — with a cutting plan that shows how every roll is used and what's left as offcut.
• Flooring: floor area plus your waste allowance for tiles, laminate or carpet, rounded up to whole packs.

PRICES AND A SHOPPING LIST
• Keep a shelf of products — paint with coverage and tin size, wallpaper with roll size and repeat, flooring with coverage per pack — each with its price.
• Every room gets a total, every project gets a summary, and the shopping list pools tins and packs across rooms that share a product.
• Share the list as plain text with the share sheet.

METRIC OR IMPERIAL
Switch between metres, litres and m²/L or feet, gallons and sq ft/gal at any time, and choose the currency you shop in. Numbers follow your device's formatting.

MADE FOR THE WORKBENCH
A paint-chip fan in the corner takes you between Projects, Estimate, Products and Toolbox. Three colour themes, gentle sound effects and haptics you can switch off.

YOUR DATA
• Sign in with email — or simply measure as a guest, no account needed. Guests can save their measurements to an email account later.
• Projects sync to your private account and keep working offline.
• Delete your account and all of its data from Toolbox at any time.
• No ads, no tracking, no in-app purchases.

Coatsum gives estimates — always check against the manufacturer's guidance and keep a little extra for touch-ups.

name: Cocktail Muse
description:
For when you can't decide what to drink.
Find a cocktail by mood: sweet, low-alcohol, after dinner and more.
When ordering at a bar, or making one at home.

◾Know the look
Recreated in 3D. Move it to see it from different angles.

◾Know the taste
What's in it, what it tastes like, and when to drink it.

◾Know the story
The stories behind each drink, to share with whoever you're drinking with.

◾Know how it's made
Which glass, what ice, and how to mix it.

◾Know what's next
Liked it? Try this next. A close taste, or a lighter one.

name: CocoWash: Photo Cleaner
description:
What matters stays.

CocoWash helps you organize your iPhone’s photos and videos with quick decisions and one last look before deleting anything. Coqui keeps you company, photo by photo.

YOUR CAMERA ROLL, YOUR PACE
Keep, mark as a favorite, save for later or send to review. Use the card gestures or the buttons. Undo lets you correct recent decisions while sorting.

ONE LAST LOOK
Discarding a photo only puts it in your review queue. Recover anything you want to keep, then confirm what you want to delete in Apple Photos. CocoWash checks favorites again before deleting. After a confirmed deletion, recovery depends on Recently Deleted in Photos, rather than Undo in CocoWash.

PHOTOS AND VIDEOS
Browse photos, play videos and use the available filters to organize your library. Local similarity and quality tools can help you choose; the decision is yours. Some analyses depend on your iOS version and whether the file is available.

ON YOUR IPHONE
Your library is analyzed on the device. CocoWash does not upload your photos for analysis or advertising. Grant full access or choose only some photos. iCloud originals need a connection when they are not downloaded. Decisions and settings are stored locally.

FREE, WITH WAYS TO SUPPORT
CocoWash includes ads and in-app purchases to remove them for a year or forever. The one-year pass is a one-time payment and does not renew automatically. You can also leave a coffee as a thank-you; a coffee does not remove ads. Regional prices and availability appear in the app.

Advertising uses Google services and may process identifiers, interactions and technical data according to your permissions and consent. See the privacy policy for details.

Made to help you enjoy what you keep. Take your time; a gesture never deletes a photo.

name: Colicine:short
description:
Enjoy unlimited free short dramas, mini movies and vertical TV series with zero ads.
MovieShort collects addictive live-action short stories packed with plot twists, romance, thriller, fantasy, mystery and comedy. Every cover uses authentic live drama posters.
Perfect for your commute or break — each episode is crafted for fast, immersive binge watching. No subscriptions, no ads, no paywalls. Just pure entertainment for ages 13+.
Features:
• 100% Ad-Free & Totally Free
• Real live-action movie & drama posters for every title
• Vertical short drama optimized for mobile
• Save favorites, track watch progress & browsing history
• Rich genres: Romance, Thriller, Mystery, Fantasy, Crime, Comedy, Adventure
• Smooth HD playback with a simple, cinematic UI
• Preferences saved safely on your device

name: Color Relay: Block Puzzle Game
description:
Breathe. Drop. Unwind.

Color Relay is a relaxing block puzzle made for calm minutes. Soft colors, gentle water-drop sounds and slow ocean waves turn every game into a little break just for you.

Drag a block onto the 8x8 board. Fill a row or a column and it melts away into a stream of bubbles. Every piece lands with its own soft note, so a good turn sounds like a little melody. It's simple to learn and deeply satisfying to master.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag one of your three blocks onto the board.
• Fill a whole row or column to clear it.
• Clear lines back to back to build a combo, up to x10 points.
• Fill a whole line with one color for a Relay: double points, a glassy chime and a shimmer of light.
• Empty the entire board for a perfect clear and a shower of confetti.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY
• Relax: no game over, no timer and unlimited undo. Smaller, friendlier blocks, and a fresh set whenever nothing fits. Just play.
• Classic: the full block puzzle at your own pace. One undo per game, and one second chance when the board fills up.
• Daily: a brand-new puzzle every day, the same for everyone. Keep your streak alive and see the countdown to the next one.

A REWARD AROUND EVERY CORNER
• 3 new daily missions, from easy to hard. Finish all three for a bonus.
• 10 trophies with bronze, silver and gold medals: 30 to collect.
• Level up as you play and unlock 7 block styles: Glossy, Jelly, Bubble, Gem, Neon, Retro and Crystal.
• A Daily streak with a countdown to tomorrow's puzzle.
• A best score for each mode, celebrated when you beat it.
• Your game saves automatically. Pick up right where you left off.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 3 game modes
• 8 painted scenes: Serene, Northern Lights, Ocean, Mountains, Sakura, Desert Dunes, Misty Forest and Cosmos
• 7 block styles, 11 block shapes and 5 soft colors
• Water-drop notes, bubble pops and rising combo chimes
• An optional calm ocean ambience

MADE TO RELAX
• No timers, no energy, no accounts.
• Plays offline, anywhere.
• Colorblind mode with a symbol on every block.
• Reduced motion, haptics and sound settings.
• Light and dark mode.
• A short tutorial on first launch that you can skip.

WHO IT'S FOR
Anyone who wants a few quiet minutes: a break at work, the commute, or winding down before bed. Made for fans of classic block puzzles, brain teasers and oddly satisfying sounds, and easy enough to pick up on your very first game.

Free to play with ads, and everything in the game is free: every block style and all eight scenes are earned by playing. No purchases, ever.

name: Colorist Formula Book
description:
Colorist Formula Book is a record-keeping tool for independent colorists. It stores what you mixed for each client; it does not recommend formulas, and manufacturer instructions always come first.

Open a client and find last time's formula in seconds. When they return, copy the last visit as a starting point and adjust it.

• Client cards with notes and a history of visits
• Services include full color, root touch-ups, highlights, toner, bleach, and gloss
• Zones such as roots, mid-lengths and ends, each with brand, line, shade and amount
• Developer volume, mix ratio and processing time per zone
• Units in g, oz or ml; ml is treated as roughly equal to g
• Before and after photos for each visit
• Processing timers with a notification when time is up
• Works offline, no account, no ads. Your data stays on your device, and only anonymous crash and usage statistics are sent

Free: up to 15 clients, unlimited visits, zones, photos and timers. Pro: unlimited clients, scale a mix to a new total amount, share a client card as PDF, export all visits as CSV, and export a backup file. Pro is monthly, yearly, or a one-time lifetime purchase. The lifetime purchase comes in three supporter tiers; the amounts differ only as a way to support development, and every tier unlocks the same features.

Subscription information
Colorist Formula Book Pro is an auto-renewing subscription (monthly or yearly). Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings. Pro is also available as a one-time lifetime purchase in three supporter tiers: the amounts differ only as a way to support development, and every tier unlocks the same features.

Privacy Policy: https://wind-flow.github.io/hair-formula-cards/privacy.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Support: cleverlywittyapps@gmail.com

[:mav: 1.0.0]

name: Colour Flow: Ball Drop
description:
Colour Flow is a quick one-thumb game: spin the rings so the falling ball only ever lands on its own colour.

HOW TO PLAY
A coloured ball drops down a shaft through rings split into coloured segments. Tap the left side of the screen to turn the next ring one way and the right side to turn it the other way. Line up the segment that matches the ball before it passes through. Hit the wrong colour and the run is over.

IT GETS TRICKIER
The ball falls faster with every ring. Then come rings with four colours, diamond gates that change the ball's colour, rings that spin by themselves and linked double rings that turn together.

PERFECT PASSES
Set a ring early for a clean pass and build a combo for bonus points. Pick up coins on the way down.

DAILY RUN
A new run every day with the same rings for every player. Play it daily to keep your streak going and earn bonus coins.

TRAILS AND COLOUR SETS
Spend coins on trails (Comet, Pixels, Sparkles, Ribbon, Rainbow) and colour sets (Neon, Sunset, Ocean, Candy).

COLOUR-BLIND FRIENDLY
The free "Clear shapes" colour set puts a shape on every colour, and a setting adds shapes to any colour set.

NO SIGN-UP
No account, no email, no password. Just open the app and play. Your progress stays on your device.

Colour Flow is free to play with ads. A one-time "Remove Ads" in-app purchase turns off the banner and between-run ads. Optional reward ads (a second chance, double coins) are always your choice.

name: ComicPageFit
description: ComicPageFit jakaa sarjakuvasivun ruutuihin paperikoon, rytmin ja ruutumäärän mukaan. Se näyttää millimetrit, lukujärjestyksen ja mahtuuko sivu A4-arkille. Työkalu on geometriaa, ei painostandardi. Se ei piirrä sarjakuvaa eikä ohjaa tulostinta.

name: Common Ground Network
description:
Common Ground turns a room full of strangers into a short list of people worth meeting.

Your host gives you a room code. Join with your email, no password, and answer one partnership form: what you sell, who you sell to, the problems you are working on, what you can offer and what you are looking for.

Every other person in the room is then scored against your answers. You see who to find first and the reason for each match, written out from what you both said: they sell the fix for a problem you named, you share a customer, they have a stage you want, or they are simply your ideal client.

In the room:
- The room, ranked, with filters for customers, referral partners, stages and people who solve your problems
- Tap to call or text anyone who chose to share their number with the room
- A give and ask board for the whole room
- Private notes, follow-up dates and a simple pipeline for the people you met
- Drafted openers and follow-ups based on what you both wrote down
- Introductions through people who match well with both of you

Hosting an event? Create a room in a minute, print the QR for your tables, and watch who is in demand. Seat the room so the best matches share a table and direct competitors do not.

Your profile is visible only to people in the same room. You can delete your account and everything in it from inside the app.

name: CommVoy: Offroad Maps & Comms
description:
CommVoy keeps your group together on the trail: push-to-talk, one live map, trails to follow and maps that work with no signal. The app works on its own on your phone: no extra hardware needed.

Talk to the whole group
- Hold to talk on a shared channel. Every vehicle in it hears you, near or far, over the internet.
- Create a channel for the ride, or join by name, invite code or ride QR code.
- Give a channel a password, list it for riders nearby, or keep it unlisted.
- Channel creators can remove or mute members.
- Channel history: replay what was said. New channels keep voice and text, and riders agree when they join.

Everyone on one map
- Live positions on satellite, topo or the standard map. You share only with your channel, and only while sharing is on.
- See the path each rider has driven today, and follow a rider to keep them in view.
- Set one destination for the group. Everyone gets a prompt to go there.
- Drop pins, sort them into folders, and send a pin to the group.

Maps that work with no signal
- Save an area before you lose coverage, or let the app offer when you arrive somewhere new.
- Save the standard, satellite and topo looks at once.
- Your saved maps, your trails and your own position keep working with no signal.
- Talking and live positions between vehicles need an internet connection.

Follow the trail
- Follow the line the vehicle ahead drove. The app tells you when you are on it and how far ahead they are.
- Follow a saved trail and see how far you are from the line.
- Record your ride: distance, moving time, climb and top speed, with elevation and speed graphs.
- Import GPX, KML and KMZ files, export GPX, and share a trail with your channel or by a link.

Your dashboard, your way
- Speed, trip, heading, climb, elevation, clock, ETA and more, in tiles you arrange over the map.
- The map turns direction-up and tilts on its own.

Join a ride in one scan
- Riders scan the ride's QR code with the phone camera to join. The creator can approve each person.
- Print the code as a card, or send an invite by text from your own phone.

Your data, your choice
- CommVoy is a free service with a free account. Sign in with Apple, Google or email and password. Your name and phone are required; your address is optional. Your trails, pins and paired devices stay with your account.
- No ads and no analytics. The app shares your position only with your channel, and only while sharing is on.
- Delete your data from the app at any time.

Please do not handle your phone while driving. Let a passenger run the app, or use a mounted phone.

name: Compact: Mirror & Light
description:
Compact turns your iPhone into a lighted pocket mirror. The mirror and its light are yours at no cost. One purchase, made once, unlocks everything else. No subscription, no ads.

Open it and you see yourself, clearly, in soft light. There is no account and nothing to set up.

INCLUDED FOR EVERYONE
• A clear mirror from the front camera.
• A soft glow around the mirror that lights your face. Make it wider when you need more, or turn it off for a plain mirror.
• Every iPhone Duo layout.

ONE PURCHASE UNLOCKS THE REST
Compact Complete is a single one-time purchase. It is not a subscription and it never renews. It adds:
• Warm to cool light. Slide from cool daylight to warm evening light to match where you are going.
• Zoom to 2× or 3×, or pinch for anything in between: lashes, liner, lenses, lipstick.
• Hold still. Tap the glass to freeze the picture. Tap again to let go.
• As others see you. Switch from the mirror image.
• Five finishes: Pearl, Blush, Sage, Lilac and Onyx.
Buy it once and it is yours on every iPhone you own.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
• Half open, Compact works like a real compact: the mirror on the half that faces you, the light and controls on the other.
• Flat open, it is a large vanity mirror with light on both sides.
• Closed, it is a quick mirror on the outside screen.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Compact uses the front camera only to show you the mirror.
• Nothing is recorded, saved or sent. There is no account and no tracking.

ONE PAYMENT, YOURS TO KEEP
No subscription. No ads. Nothing that renews. Pay once for Compact Complete and it stays yours.

name: Confidey Pro: For Therapists
description:
New clients find you on Confidey, and you see how each one is doing between sessions.

NEW CLIENTS

Your profile appears in Confidey’s search for free, with your photo, your approach, your languages and how you work. When someone wants to start with you, the contact request lands in your Today, and you accept or decline in one tap. Once your professional registration is checked, your profile shows the verified badge.

BOOKED AND PAID THROUGH CONFIDEY

People can book a time from the schedule you publish and pay right away. Your share reaches your account 14 days after the session, and the rule for a missed or a failed session is the same for both sides.

AVAILABLE NOW

When you are free, switch on Available now: someone who needs a professional right away calls you, at the price you set. Saying no costs nothing, and the request goes first to whoever has waited longest.

THE SESSION ROOM

Online sessions happen in the Confidey room, by video or by voice only, opened at session time. Nothing is recorded.

BETWEEN SESSIONS

The people you work with use Confidey day to day. You see what each one allowed you to see: the days they showed up, the tasks done, the mood of the week and their goal. Assign exercises from the catalog, or a task you write yourself, and see when it was done.

PROGRESS IN PLAIN SIGHT

Each client’s progress since the last session, side by side with the intervals before, and the measure they repeat, drawn over time. With five or more clients sharing, your results appear in combined numbers that never point to anyone, ready to share.

LESS ADMIN

Session notes with drafts and signing. The agenda with the next session and the video link, and your calendar receives upcoming sessions with initials only. The contract between you and each client, encrypted so that only the two of you can read it. Export clients, progress and sessions to a spreadsheet when you need to. With the person’s written permission and your confirmation, Confidey listens to the session and drafts the note in SOAP (subjective, objective, assessment, plan), DAP (data, assessment, plan) or BIRP (behavior, intervention, response, plan) for you to review and sign; the audio is not kept.

INVITATION AND CONSENT

Invite by email, by link or with your code. The client accepts on Confidey and chooses what to share; they can take it back at any time, and ending the work together is one tap on either side.

PRIVACY BY PRINCIPLE

The app never shows the content of a client's conversations with Confidey: no permission opens that. You only see what they chose to share.

BE PART OF IT

Share your profile and your results, bring colleagues into your practice, and recommend Confidey through the affiliate program.

WHO IT IS FOR

Psychologists, therapists, coaches and other professionals who support people from one meeting to the next.

Create your account in the app, or sign in with your Confidey account.

Terms of Use: https://www.confidey.com/en/terms
Privacy Policy: https://www.confidey.com/en/privacy-policy

name: Converti File - MakaLab
description:
Converti File trasforma foto, documenti e PDF in quello che ti serve, direttamente sul tuo iPhone o iPad. Nessun file viene caricato online: tutto avviene sul dispositivo, anche in modalità aereo.

CONVERTI CON UN GIRO
Invece di scegliere tra decine di formati, scegli dove andrà il file sulla ghiera: WhatsApp, Email, Instagram, Stampa, Portali o Pulito. L'app sceglie formato, dimensioni, peso e privacy giusti per ogni file dell'elenco.

STAI SOTTO I MB CHE VUOI
Il portale accetta solo PDF sotto 1 MB? L'email non parte? Imposti il peso massimo e l'app abbassa qualità e dimensioni finché il file ci sta. Un PDF troppo pesante diventa più leggero e il testo resta cercabile.

SCANSIONA I DOCUMENTI

CONDIVIDI PULITO

name: Corner Rod
description:
Corner Rod is for two people already standing at a hallway corner with one rigid piece.

Write the width of the hall you are leaving, the width of the hall you are entering, and the length of the piece, in centimeters, and name the corner. Turn the rod by 15 degrees. This iPhone writes how many centimeters fit at that angle, how much room is left or how many centimeters the piece is too long, and the tightest turn from 1 degree to 89 degrees. A piece no longer than that tightest turn clears the corner.

The corner stays on this iPhone for the two of you. There is no account, no network, and no file to share. Centimeters are used in every region. The lengths are arithmetic from the two halls and the angle. This does not say the piece is safe to carry, and it does not replace the two people standing in the hall.

name: Countdowns: Photo Widgets
description:
Countdowns puts the days you're waiting for on your Home Screen, over your own photos.

Pick a date, give it a name and choose a photo. Your countdown becomes a full-screen poster in the app and a widget on your Home Screen that ticks down the days, hours, minutes and seconds.

Count down to anything: a vacation or a trip, a wedding, a birthday, a baby's due date, an anniversary, graduation, retirement, Christmas, or the day you see someone you love again.

• Countdown widgets in three sizes: small, medium and large
• Your own photo behind every countdown, or a built-in gradient
• A short description under the title, for the plan or the promise
• A darken slider that keeps the clock readable over any photo
• A different countdown on each widget
• Once the day arrives, it counts up: the days since
• Ask Siri: "Create a countdown in Countdowns"
• In English and Portuguese

No account, no ads, no tracking. Your countdowns and photos stay on your iPhone.

name: CountWeave
description:
Plan two dance sequences on one beat board and find the count where both groups can join. CountWeave helps choreographers, teachers, and dance teams work through staggered starts, repeated phrases, and required moves before rehearsal.

Build and rehearse an arrangement

1. Create a project or open the editable formation change example. Add actions to Group A and Group B. Give each action a beat length, add notes, and mark the counts at which dancers can exit the action to join the other group.
2. Arrange each group's opening, loop, and closing sections. Set separate starting counts and the number of repeats. Lock movements that must be completed or repeat counts that must be preserved.
3. Check the beat board for a shared finish, or enter a target count. Use Find a join beat to search a range, cap the maximum wait for either group, and compare options by earliest join or shortest wait. Each result shows when each group can finish and how long it must hold before joining.
4. Preview an option, apply it to your working arrangement, or save it as a candidate. Open Plans to compare waiting times for different arrangements side by side.
5. Open Follow the score to practice the selected arrangement. Step through the counts or play at an adjustable tempo. Each group can see its current action, next cue, and when to hold or join.
6. Open Rehearsal card to review the running order and share a PDF for Group A, Group B, or both. The card includes the planned counts, repeats, waiting time, and teacher notes when available.

Try the formation change example to see how this works. Group B starts on beat 2 and Group A must complete its final formation. At beat 24, Group A finishes at 23 and holds for one count, while Group B finishes at 24 and joins immediately.

Projects and reusable actions are stored on your device. Planning and rehearsal work offline without an account. Share or restore a local backup from the More menu.

name: Coupette: Cocktail Recipes
description:
Stop scrolling recipes you can't make. Add the bottles you own and Coupette shows the cocktails you can mix right now.

• My Bar: tap your bottles or scan a label with the camera. Labels are read on your iPhone.
• What Can I Make?: every cocktail your bar covers, and the ones a single bottle away.
• 82 recipes: IBA classics, Italian aperitivo, German bar favorites, sours, highballs and mocktails.
• Clear steps, the right glass, ice and garnish, and an estimated strength for every drink.
• cl, ml or oz, with clean bar measures.

Coupette Pro
Unlimited bottles, every matching cocktail, "Almost There" ideas, unlimited label scans and party batches from 2× to 8×. Available as a monthly or annual subscription (annual includes a 3-day free trial) or as a one-time lifetime purchase.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://coupette-app.pages.dev/privacy

Please drink responsibly. For adults of legal drinking age only.

name: Course Stick
description:
Course Stick lays one wall as courses and joints on this iPhone. Lock the joints that cannot move. The open courses share the height that is left. If a joint is outside the limits, the stick says how many more courses to unlock.

Set a sill and a lintel. If the opening misses a course line, raise the sill, lower the lintel, or change the joint so both heights land on a course.

Attach a photo of the brick. Share a PDF or CSV of the course sheet. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Courtside - Shared Scoreboard
description:
Stop asking "what's the score?" in friendly matches.
Courtside connects the iPhones placed around the court directly, so a point added on any device shows the same score on every screen.

THE SAME SCORE FOR EVERYONE
• The host creates a match; others join by scanning a QR code or entering a code
• No internet or account needed. Nearby devices talk to each other directly
• Scoring continues if the connection drops and catches up when it returns. If two devices recorded the same rallies, you can sort it out in a tap

SET IT DOWN, IT'S A SCOREBOARD
• Turn your iPhone sideways for a big scoreboard you can read from across the court
• Shows who serves and when to change ends, automatically
• Live score on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island

FOUR SPORTS, REAL RULES
• Tennis: advantage or no-ad, tiebreaks, match tiebreak
• Padel: golden point and star point
• Badminton: 21 points (capped at 30), doubles service courts handled for you
• Table tennis: 11 points, serve every 2 points, every point from deuce

APPLE WATCH
• A remote on your wrist to add points and check the score
• Saves the match to Health as a workout with heart rate and active energy

HISTORY
• Look back at how each match unfolded in a chart, and share the result as an image

PRICING
• Scoring on one device and joining other people's matches are free
• To connect other devices to matches you create, use a ticket (each lasts 24 hours; your first 3 are free) or Pro (one-time purchase)
• Pro connects every match and adds the Apple Watch remote and your full history. Joining is always free, so one purchase connects your whole group

No ads. Match records stay on your device and are never sent anywhere.

name: Cratemap
description:
Cratemap is a moving box inventory. Number your boxes as you pack, list what is inside, send each one to a destination room and follow it from Packing to Sealed, Loaded, Delivered and Unpacked. Search for any item and Cratemap tells you the box and the room.

MOVES
• Name, moving day, from and to, with a countdown to the big day
• Several moves, with one active on the board
• A move checklist with eight ready-made tasks you can add to

ROOMS
• Destination rooms with a tape colour, added from presets or by hand
• Rename, recolour, reorder or delete rooms
• Progress for every room and for the whole move

BOXES
• Automatic numbering per move, so numbers are never reused
• Room, size, fragile and heavy markers, notes and a contents list
• Quick entry understands lines like "6x mugs" or "Books x 20"
• A five-step status from Packing to Unpacked
• Delete with undo

BOARD
• One column per destination room, with box counts and progress
• Cards show the number, size, contents preview, FRAGILE and HEAVY stamps and status
• A one-tap next step on each card, with a packing-tape animation when a box is sealed
• Filter by status, fragile, heavy and room
• Select several boxes to change their status together

SEARCH
• Find any item, box number, note or room name
• Results show the box, room, status and whether it is fragile
• An A to Z index of every packed item

LABELS
Share box labels as text, one box or many at once, with number, room, FRAGILE and HEAVY lines, size and optional contents.

You can also export your inventory as text.

WORKS OFFLINE, ACCOUNT OPTIONAL
Cratemap works fully offline and never asks you to sign up. Tap "Just start packing" on the welcome screen and every feature is available straight away, with your moves and boxes saved on this device.
If you would like a backup, create a free account with your email address and a password. Your data then syncs securely so you can restore it on another iPhone or iPad, and anything you made as a guest is merged into your account. You can delete your account and its backup at any time from Settings.

PRIVATE, FREE AND SIMPLE
• Completely free: no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions
• No tracking and no analytics; your data is never shared with other users
• Export all of your data as JSON from Settings whenever you like
• Light and dark mode, with haptics you can switch off
• Designed for landscape on iPhone and iPad (iOS 15 or later)

name: CREIS
description: CREIS is a quoting app for tradespeople and freelancers who price jobs one at a time. It takes a job from its costs to a priced PDF quote, keeps track of each client's answer, and fits a win-rate curve to the markups of quotes that were won and lost.

name: CrossOff – Kids Chore Chart
description:
CrossOff turns your kids' day into something they can see, check off, and be proud of.

• Each child gets their own colorful daily schedule: school, homework, chores, sports and free time
• Kids tap to cross off what they've done and earn points for every task
• Points become doubloons they can spend in the Treasure Chest on rewards you choose
• Parent View (protected by a parent PIN) lets you add events, set repeating routines, and give or take doubloons with a note or photo
• A family scoreboard shows everyone's progress for the day and week
• Kids can request activities and pick meals from options you set
• Invite a caregiver or grandparent with their own login

Kids use a simple 4-digit PIN: no email, no ads, no tracking. Set up your family in a couple of minutes.

name: Crown Of Bounties
description:
Step into an illustrated royal court where every resource matters. Lock and reroll your dice, fulfill exact bounty requests and use a timely decree to reshape your expedition.

Explore 18 progressively unlocked chapters, return for a daily seeded trial, and discover six contract families. Invest earned medals in three court talents and revisit your recent expeditions in the royal chronicles. A complete seven-day adventure offers clear goals, resource decisions, results and replay.

Play offline with automatic local saves, optional sound effects and light, dark or system appearance. No accounts, ads or in-app purchases. All rewards are fictional game progress without cash value.

name: CSLB Contractor License Exam
description:
Kalyta is an AI-native study companion for the California contractor license exams. It adapts to what you keep missing, explains every answer, and organizes your study by the CSLB study guide for your license.

THE EXAMS
Most new California contractor licenses need two exams at a PSI test center: Law and Business, plus the trade exam for your classification (a C-61 Limited Specialty license needs Law and Business only). Each is closed book, four-option multiple choice, with 3 1/2 hours to finish. Kalyta follows each exam's own study guide, section by section, at the weight the guide gives it.

EVERY EXAM CSLB PUBLISHES A STUDY GUIDE FOR, IN ONE APP
- Law and Business, taken by nearly every new license applicant
- A General Engineering, B General Building and B-2 Residential Remodeling
- The C specialty trades, from C-2 Insulation to C-60 Welding: electrical, plumbing, HVAC, painting, landscaping, concrete, roofing, solar and the rest
- The asbestos (ASB) and hazardous substance removal (HAZ) certifications

WHAT YOU GET
- Adaptive practice: questions are chosen around your current level and mixed with spaced review, so your time goes where it moves your result.
- An explanation on every question: why the right answer is right, why each of the others is wrong, and the rule, code or reference it rests on.
- Concept lessons on the rules and the reasons behind them, so they stick when you cannot look anything up.
- An AI tutor you can steer: ask why a rule exists, ask for another example, or tell it to slow down.
- Timed rehearsals on the 3 1/2-hour clock, with review question by question and your results in each section of the study guide.

HONEST BY DESIGN
CSLB's study guides and Examination FAQ give no passing score and no question count, and a passing candidate is told only that they passed, so Kalyta does not predict your result or your chance of passing. A rehearsal shows what you got right in each section, never a predicted score. We publish no pass rates, score improvements or testimonials.

Kalyta is an independent study tool and is not endorsed by or affiliated with the Contractors State License Board (CSLB) or the State of California. Exam facts come from CSLB's study guides and Examination FAQ at cslb.ca.gov.

HOW THE FREE ACCESS WORKS
Your first seven study days are free. No card, no payment details and nothing to cancel: a study day counts only on a day you answer a question. This is free access to the app, not a trial attached to the subscription below.

SUBSCRIPTION
CSLB Exam Monthly is an auto-renewing subscription at $24.99 per month, and it unlocks every CSLB course in the app. The subscription has no introductory or free trial period. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://kalytalabs.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://kalytalabs.com/privacy

Start free and see your first plan in minutes.

name: Cubby
description:
Find anything in 3 seconds.

Cubby is a photo-first home inventory for moves, seasonal storage, garages, closets, and all the things you put somewhere sensible and then forgot.

SNAP AND STASH
Point the camera at an item and tap the shutter. Cubby saves it immediately with your last location, then lets you add a name, quantity, barcode, or note if you feel like it. No forms in the way — a saved item is always one tap away.

A HOME FOR EVERYTHING
Organize with a simple Room → Shelf → Box tree. Add rooms, shelves, and boxes as you pack. Every item shows its full path, like Garage › Shelf 2 › Box A.

FIND IT LATER
Search names, notes, barcodes, and location paths at once. Scan a barcode to jump straight to an item, or scan an unknown code to add something new. Recent searches and recent items keep retrieval quick.

LEND WITHOUT LOSING TRACK
Keep a simple loan log with a borrower and due date. Cubby can nudge you on the due date and once if it’s overdue. Return an item with one tap and undo for five seconds if you change your mind.

KNOW WHAT’S RUNNING LOW
Set a threshold on batteries, filters, hooks, or anything consumable. Cubby tells you once when it crosses that line. No repeated nagging.

Cubby is free, local, and built for the small, satisfying act of knowing exactly where something is.

Cubby requires camera access to photograph items. Notifications are optional and only used for loan and low-stock reminders.

name: Curbnote
description:
Curbnote is a notebook for the parking spots, permits, and curb rules you write down yourself.

Save a street, garage, lot, or driveway with the level and row. Permits have a start, an end, and a cost, and the list shows how many days remain. Sweep rules are the weekday and hours you copied, not a feed from the city. A stay records when you parked and how many hours you planned to remain. While the stay is open, its ring compares elapsed time with that plan and updates once a second on screen. It is not a legal parking meter.

Curbnote does not use location, does not read signs for you, and keeps every note on this phone.

name: Curtain Shop Pro - Quotation

Less paperwork and fewer scattered notes. More professional quotations and better records.

Curtain Shop Pro - Measure clearly, quote professionally, and keep every detail organized.

name: Cutout Studio: Product Photo

Cutout Studio turns everyday product photos into clean, professional images for your online store, marketplace listings and social posts, right on your iPhone or iPad.

REMOVE BACKGROUNDS ON YOUR DEVICE
• Automatic subject detection that runs on your device

name: CWin LiveStudio
description:
LiveStudio convierte tu iPhone o iPad en un estudio de producción y transmisión en vivo, profesional y fácil de usar. Crea escenas, combina cámaras, agrega rótulos y transmite a Facebook, YouTube o cualquier servidor RTMP, sin equipo costoso ni conocimientos técnicos.

FUNCIONES PRINCIPALES
• Multicámara: usa la cámara frontal y trasera; en dispositivos compatibles, dos a la vez.

• Cámara remota: usa otro iPhone o iPad como cámara adicional.
• Asistente de Facebook: obtén tu clave de transmisión en un paso.

IDEAL PARA
Iglesias (servicios en vivo, coros y versículos), negocios (presentaciones a clientes y distribuidores), eventos, clases y creadores de contenido.

name: CyberJobs: Cybersecurity Jobs
description:
CyberJobs is a job board for cybersecurity work only. It reads the hiring systems of about 700 employers every hour and lists the security roles they have open: security engineering, SOC and incident response, cloud and application security, identity and access, penetration testing and red team, threat intelligence, GRC, security architecture and leadership.

Every role shows the salary range its posting states, so you can compare offers before you apply. You apply on the employer's own application, linked from each role's page.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Search by title, tool or skill: SOC, Splunk, cloud, FedRAMP, pentest.
- Filter by specialty, by the country you can work from, and by a yearly salary floor.
- Sort by the board's order, newest first or highest pay.
- Save roles to come back to.
- Set an alert: the app checks for new roles that fit it and notifies you when some open.

NO ACCOUNT, NO TRACKING
There is nothing to sign up for. Your saved roles and your alert stay on your phone. The app asks the board's public jobs API for roles and nothing else.

CyberJobs.cc is free for job seekers. Some hiring partners pay CyberJobs.cc a referral fee; that never changes the salary shown.

name: cyberscaler
description:
cyberscaler is the business phone app for companies on the cyberscaler phone system. Sign in with the account your company gave you and your work lines are on your iPhone, ready to call and text from your business numbers.

CALLS
- Call and answer on your company's numbers and extensions, not your personal number
- Clear HD calls, with Bluetooth, speaker and headset support
- Hold, mute, keypad, transfer and merge calls
- Park a call and pick it up from another phone
- Recent calls with recordings and transcripts when your company turns them on

TEXTING
- Send and receive texts and pictures from your business numbers
- Every conversation in one place, synced with your desktop apps

VOICEMAIL
- Listen to voicemail in the app
- Read voicemail as text

CONTACTS
- Your company's contacts plus, if you allow it, the contacts on your phone
- See who is calling before you answer

AI ASSISTANT
- Ask questions about your calls, texts and voicemail in plain language
- Get summaries of long conversations
- Talk to the assistant with your voice

ONE ACCOUNT EVERYWHERE
cyberscaler also runs on Windows, macOS, Linux and Android, with the same lines, history and settings.

The app needs a cyberscaler account, which your company's administrator creates. To set up your business, visit cyberscaler.ai.

name: Daily Bag
description:
Daily Bag is your app for groceries and everyday shopping from local stores.

Browse products, compare shops, and order what you need for home. Add items to your cart, choose a delivery address, and check out in a few steps. Use your location to fill the current address and see whether delivery is available in your area.

Track orders from placement to delivery, open order details, and keep invoices handy. Save favourite products so you can reorder faster. Get notifications about your orders and account.

Create an account with your phone number or Google, manage your profile, and save more than one delivery address. Message support when you need help with an order.

Daily Bag brings multiple vendors into one place, so groceries and daily essentials are easy to find, order, and receive.

Features
• Browse shops, categories, and products
• Cart and secure checkout
• Delivery address with location
• Order tracking and order details
• Favourites and notifications
• Phone and Google sign-in
• In-app support

name: DailyDesk : My Daily Space
description:
Bring your ideas, writing, finances, and focus sessions together in one beautifully designed app. DailyDesk offers four practical offline tools to help you stay organized and make the most of your day.

NOTES & IDEAS

Capture important thoughts, meeting details, personal plans, and everyday reminders. Create, edit, search, and pin notes for easy access. Choose note accent colors and keep your ideas organized.

WORD COUNTER

Write with confidence using a clean writing workspace. Instantly count words, characters, sentences, and paragraphs. Explore reading and speaking estimates while your draft is automatically saved.

EXPENSE JOURNAL

Keep track of your personal finances. Record income and expenses, organize transactions by category, and review monthly balances. Understand your spending with simple financial summaries.

FOCUS TIMER

Make time for meaningful work. Choose a focus duration, start a session, take breaks, and monitor your completed sessions and total focus time.

WHY CHOOSE DAILYDESK?

• Four useful tools in one app
• Clean and intuitive interface
• Offline functionality
• No account or registration required
• No unnecessary permissions
• Local storage for your personal information
• Simple navigation and customizable preferences

Whether you're capturing an idea, refining your writing, reviewing expenses, or concentrating on an important task, DailyDesk provides a calm and practical space for everyday activities.

https://cleverlysoftwarellcapps.blogspot.com/2026/11/privacy-policy.html
https://cleverlysoftwarellcapps.blogspot.com/2026/11/terms-of-use.html

name: Darkslide: Camera Collection
description:
Darkslide is a catalog for people who love cameras. Keep every camera and lens you own in one place, with photos, specs, notes and history, in a chunky pixel-art style that feels like an old handheld game.

ADD GEAR IN SECONDS Take a photo of a camera or lens, or pick one from your library. Darkslide reads the markings on it, right on your iPhone, and looks it up. You can also type a model name, or enter everything yourself. You always review the details before anything is saved, and every field can be edited.

FREE SPEC LOOKUP Darkslide fills in year, mount, format, weight, dimensions and more from open sources (camera-wiki.org, Wikipedia and Wikidata), plus a built-in camera and lens database that works offline. Every item shows where its facts came from, so you can check them.

YOUR COLLECTION, YOUR WAY

Photos with a cover image, notes, tags, favorites and ratings
Purchase date, price, condition and current value
Search across everything, even offline
Sort and filter your collection
Insights: see your brands, formats and mounts at a glance

CAMERA DEX Thirty-five famous cameras wait in the Dex, a collector's field guide for photographers. Cameras you own are marked automatically. Mark the others as seen and watch the dark silhouettes turn into pixel cameras.

QUIZ YOURSELF How well do you know your gear? Questions are made from the cameras and lenses you own, in four difficulty levels, with points, streaks and medals. Or take the World Challenge on famous cameras.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Your collection and photos stay on your iPhone
No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking
Only a model name is sent when you look something up
Back up everything to one file and restore it any time

MADE FOR PHOTOGRAPHERS An 8-bit look, tiny pixel cameras, and little retro sounds you can switch off.

Specifications come from public sources and may contain mistakes, so please check anything important. Darkslide is not affiliated with any camera or lens maker.

name: DashDeck
description:
REQUIRES A MAC: DashDeck works together with the free DashDeck Helper app on your Mac (macOS 14 or later). Download it from our support page, which has a step-by-step setup guide with pictures:
https://ngh723.github.io/dashdeck-support/

DashDeck turns the iPad next to your Mac into a live dashboard and control deck.

Keep your Mac's screen for work, and put everything else on the iPad: launch apps, open files, control music, and watch your Mac's status at a glance.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Launch and switch Mac apps from an iPad launcher, sorted by how often you use them
• Browse your Mac's folders, preview photos and documents, and play music and video (MP4, MOV) right on the iPad
• Control music: now playing, playlists, albums, play and skip
• Quick controls: volume and sound output, Wi-Fi, Dark Mode, Focus, AirDrop and more
• Mac widgets: CPU, memory, storage, network, battery, top processes, Time Machine, clipboard, recent files, downloads
• Bring your Safari or Chrome bookmarks bar to the iPad and open sites on your Mac with a tap
• iPad widgets that work on their own: clock, world clock, weather, calendar, reminders, notes, timer, health
• Arrange widgets across pages in small, medium and large sizes

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no cloud. Your Mac and iPad talk directly over your own network
• The connection is encrypted and paired with a code only you see
• Health data never leaves your iPad

REQUIREMENTS
• The free DashDeck Helper app on your Mac (macOS 14 or later), from the support page above
• Mac and iPad on the same Wi-Fi network, or connected by USB cable

DASHDECK PRO
Everything is free for 7 days. After that, iPad-only widgets stay free, and features that connect to your Mac need DashDeck Pro:
• Monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase
• Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions.

User Guide (every screen and widget explained): https://ngh723.github.io/dashdeck-support/manual.html

Privacy Policy: https://ngh723.github.io/dashdeck-support/privacy.html

name: Dawcade FunTools
description:
Dawcade FunTools is a music toolbox: six tools in one app, chosen from a shelf of cartridges. Plug one in and it opens. Key, tempo and A4 are shared, so the drone, the chords, the metronome and the tuner always agree.

TUNER
• Chromatic and instrument modes (guitar, bass, ukulele, violin and more)
• Strobe-style display, cents readout, custom A4 and AUTO CAL

METRONOME
• Accents, subdivisions and a large STAGE view for playing live

DRONE
• A sustained pad on any note of the session key, with a moving sacred-geometry screen

EAR
• Intervals, chords, scales and rhythm, step by step, with your own instrument sound

CHORDS
• Pads for every chord in the key, voicings, strum, bend and a piano roll
• MIDI Out to other apps and to Bluetooth or USB MIDI devices

SAMPLER
• 16 pads, keys, a 16-step sequencer, recording and resampling

One settings page holds the session and the options of every tool. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

Requires iOS 17 or later.

name: DayCircles-Mood Journal
description:
A thought after a conversation, a photo worth keeping or a feeling from today can all find a place in DayCircles. Give yourself time to look back on the moments you have written down.
WRITE ABOUT TODAY  Record your thoughts and moments with photos and a mood. Drafts save as you write, and you can add weather that you choose for the day.
REVISIT YOUR DAYS  Browse your journal by date or search for a phrase. Review your recorded moods over time, open a random entry or revisit a past entry from the same day.
MAKE SPACE TO WRITE  Set a writing reminder and play rain, waves or white noise while you spend time with your thoughts.
EXPLORE FULL ACCESS  Unlock personal and relationship profiles to write, edit and revisit reflections about yourself and your connections. Paid members also enjoy an ad-free experience.

name: Dayline: Voice Journal
description:
The sound of the rain on your walk home. Something your friend said over dinner. Open Dayline, tap today's circle and tell the story in your own voice. Set a reminder for a time that suits you.

Your recordings form a line of days. Scroll into the calendar to find a date, listen again or share a memo you choose. If you missed yesterday, you can still add a recording. Today and the previous three days are free, even when you first open Dayline.

Dayline Plus lets you fill in older missed days and transcribe past recordings on your iPhone. On-device speech recognition requires a supported device and language. Dayline transcribes on this iPhone. Your device backup settings determine whether backups include recordings and transcripts. You can share individual recordings.

Plus is an optional monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription. Your App Store price appears before purchase. Manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings. Eligible subscribers can try the yearly plan free for one week. It renews at the yearly price shown before purchase unless canceled.

Terms of Use — https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy — https://readyyyk.com/dayline/privacy.html

name: Days & Moments
description:
Free forever. No ads, in-app purchases, subscriptions, or usage fees.

Days & Moments makes important dates simple to remember. Add birthdays, anniversaries, trips, events, or any day that matters to you. Pair each event with a photo and see how many days remain or have passed.

FEATURES
• Clear countdowns and elapsed day counts.
• Personal photos, categories, and notes for each event.
• Local reminders and yearly anniversaries.
• 12 themes, with Obsidian and a gold calendar icon as the default.
• iPhone and iPad layouts that adapt lists and details to the available space.
• Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean. Follow your phone’s App Language setting or choose a language in the app.
• No account required. Your data stays on your device and works offline.
• Manually export and import backups of events and photos.

DATA AND REMINDERS
Automatic sync between devices is not available. Export a backup before updating, changing devices, or deleting the app.
Reminders require notification permission and are affected by system and Focus settings. Annual reminders calculate candidate dates for the next 50 years and schedule only the next 60 reminders. Open the app regularly to refresh the schedule.

Keep the days that matter.

name: DB Flow
description:
DB Flow è un editor di diagrammi di flusso strutturati che si eseguono davvero. Si costruisce l'algoritmo a blocchi, lo si segue passo passo e se ne ottiene il codice. È pensata per insegnanti di informatica, tecnologia ed elettronica e per chi impara a programmare.

COSTRUISCI
• Blocchi standard: dichiarazioni, lettura e scrittura, assegnazioni, se/altrimenti, cicli while, do-while e for, commenti.
• Si tocca «+» nel punto giusto e si sceglie il blocco: il diagramma si dispone da solo ed è sempre ben strutturato.
• Gli errori (variabili non dichiarate, tipi sbagliati) sono segnalati prima di eseguire.
• Annulla e ripeti, salvataggio automatico, scorciatoie da tastiera su iPad e Mac.

ESEGUI
• Esecuzione passo passo, con il blocco attivo evidenziato, le variabili, la console e l'inserimento dei dati.
• Velocità regolabile, oppure fino alla fine.

GENERA IL CODICE
• Pseudocodice, Python e C, pronti da copiare.
• Esportazione del diagramma in PNG, SVG e PDF; condivisione del file .flow.

ARDUINO
• Diagrammi con setup() e loop(), digitalWrite, analogWrite, digitalRead, analogRead, delay e millis().
• «Pin e scheda»: disegno interattivo di Arduino Uno, Nano, Pro Mini, Micro e Mega 2560, con LED, pulsanti e potenziometri.
• Simulazione del circuito: il LED si accende e si regola, i pulsanti si premono, i potenziometri si girano.
• Sketch .ino pronto per l'Arduino IDE.

ESERCIZI CON VERIFICA
• L'insegnante scrive la consegna e i casi di prova (anche nascosti) e la condivide come file.
• Chi risolve verifica il proprio diagramma: l'output viene confrontato con quello atteso.
• 10 esercizi e 9 esempi inclusi.

PRIVACY
Nessun account, nessuna pubblicità, nessuna raccolta dati. I diagrammi restano sul dispositivo e l'app non usa la rete. Il codice è pubblico (source-available, licenza PolyForm Noncommercial): chiunque può verificarlo.

Gratuita, per iPhone, iPad e Mac, in italiano, inglese, francese, tedesco e spagnolo, con tema chiaro e scuro.

Realizzata dal Prof. Davide Bertolino.

name: Dear Me: Affirmations App
description:
Dear Me is a gentle daily affirmations app that helps you speak to yourself with a little more kindness — every single day. Like a warm letter to yourself, each affirmation begins with “Dear me…” and meets you exactly where you are.

Build self-love, ease anxiety, grow your confidence, or simply start a calmer daily habit — affirmations, a gratitude journal, and calming tools live together in one beautiful, distraction-free app.

AFFIRMATIONS, YOUR WAY
• Grow your confidence with thousands of positive affirmations across self-love, calm, abundance, motivation, and better sleep — and feel more like yourself again.
• Feel steadier by hearing them out loud — a soothing voice reads each affirmation aloud, female or male, fully offline.
• Make them truly yours — record affirmations in your own voice and listen back to settle whenever you need it most.

BUILD A KIND DAILY HABIT
• Notice the good with a gratitude journal — write what you’re grateful for, track your mood, and watch a gentle streak grow.
• Stay consistent with quiet, gentle reminders, so a kind word finds you without any effort.
• Keep calm close with a home and lock-screen widget — so peace of mind stays one glance away.

CALM ON HARD DAYS
• Slow racing thoughts and ease anxiety with a simple breathing exercise.
• Soften self-criticism with a “reframe a thought” practice that turns pressure into kindness.
• Set the mood with beautiful, calming themes — and share any affirmation as a card worth sending.

MADE FOR EVERYDAY WELLBEING

Dear Me is here for positive thinking, daily motivation, self-care, and anxiety relief — in the morning to set the tone for your day, in a hard moment to steady yourself, or at night to wind down and rest lighter. Available in 14 languages.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Your content stays on your device first. No account and no email required — just open the app and begin. Optional cloud backup keeps your journal and favorites safe if you ever change phones.

FAIR, HONEST PRICING

Dear Me is free to start. Premium unlocks every category, every theme, and your own voice — with a one-time Lifetime option that’s honored forever, no subscription required.

Be as gentle with yourself as you are with everyone else — Dear Me helps you begin.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://bytelunalabs.com/dearme/privacy.html

name: Debrifly
description:
Debrifly is flight school management software for ATOs, DTOs and flying clubs. Instructors, students and school staff use it on the same records, on the ground and in the air.

DEBRIEFS
Instructors dictate a debrief, Debrifly structures it against the syllabus, and the instructor reviews, edits and signs. AI is decision support only; it never grades students. Signed debriefs cannot be altered, and corrections are added as new entries.

TRAINING
Follow syllabus and course progress, exercises trained and grades for every student.

BOOKINGS AND FLEET
Book flights with aircraft documents, inspections and defects taken into account.

STUDENTS AND RECORDS
Track expiries for licences, ratings, medicals and radio. View the student wallet and ledger, and keep audit-ready records.

Debrifly requires an account from your flight school. Don’t have one? Visit debrifly.com.

name: Deepfelt: Poker Night Tracker
description:
Put the phone on the table. It keeps the score.

Deepfelt is a manager for real poker nights, played with your own cards and chips. It keeps track of who bought in and how many times, who cashed out, who is up and who is down, and who pays whom at the end.

SAY IT, AND IT IS LOGGED
• Start a night and leave the phone on the table. Say simple phrases: "Sam buys in", "Jo buys in for 200", "Alex cashes out 340", "Priya wins the pot", "undo that"
• Every change appears on screen with the words it heard and a big Undo
• Try it free: 10 minutes of listening every month, no sign-up. Pro keeps it listening all night

THE END OF THE NIGHT, SORTED
• It asks each player for their chip count, one at a time. Say the number or type it
• It checks that the chips add up, and if they do not, you choose: recount, the bank keeps or covers the difference, or split it
• The shortest list of who pays whom, ready to share to the group chat

FREE, BY TAP
Keeping a night by tap is free with no limits: one tap for a buy-in, chip sales between players, early cash-outs, the count, the settle-up, your history and every regular's running total. No account. Works without a connection.

FREE LISTENING, THEN DEEPFELT PRO
Everyone gets 10 minutes of listening each calendar month. Deepfelt Pro removes that limit: listening for the whole night and the guided voice count. Optional subscription, monthly or yearly, with a one-week free trial. Includes up to 40 hours of listening a month. When the free minutes are used and you do not have Pro, voice stops and taps carry on. Listening works best with an internet connection; English only for now.

YOUR TABLE, YOUR CALL
Listening starts only when you start a night, and a red Listening pill is on screen the whole time. Audio is sent to Deepgram to be turned into text. Deepfelt records no audio and has no account system. The night's text stays on your phone and is deleted when the night is done. Tell your table before you turn it on.

A SCOREKEEPER
Deepfelt keeps numbers. It moves no money, connects to no payment service and offers no gambling of any kind.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, after the free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.
Privacy: https://deepfelt.vercel.app/privacy
Terms: https://deepfelt.vercel.app/terms

name: DeepTrust SFTP
description:
DeepTrust SFTP is a secure SFTP client for iPhone and iPad. Connect to the SFTP servers you are authorized to use, browse remote folders, and upload, download, and manage files over encrypted SSH connections.

Built by SecureLetter for administrators, developers, and anyone who needs reliable access to server files from a mobile device.

SERVER MANAGEMENT
• Save multiple servers with a name, IP address or domain, port (default 22), and username
• Edit, duplicate, and delete saved servers
• Saved server information is stored in encrypted storage protected by the iOS Keychain

AUTHENTICATION
• Username and password login
• SSH public key login with RSA and Ed25519 private keys
• Passphrase-protected private keys
• Choose whether to save your password or private key. If you don't save it, the app asks each time you connect.

SERVER IDENTITY VERIFICATION
• Shows the server's SHA256 host key fingerprint on first connection so you can verify it before trusting the server
• Saves trusted host keys and warns you if a server's key changes, helping protect against man-in-the-middle attacks
• View and delete saved host keys at any time

FILE TRANSFER
• Upload files you choose from the Files app
• Download files to the Files app under On My iPhone > DeepTrust SFTP
• Large files are streamed instead of loaded into memory
• Progress, transferred size, and percentage are shown during transfers, and you can cancel at any time
• If the connection drops, the transfer resumes from where it stopped when you return to the app

REMOTE FILE MANAGEMENT
• Browse remote directories and follow symbolic links
• Create folders, rename files and folders, and delete files and folders

CONVENIENCE
• Light, dark, and system themes
• English and Korean

PRIVACY
• No account or sign-up required
• No ads, analytics, or tracking
• The app reads only the files you choose
• Your credentials and files go only to the servers you connect to. SecureLetter does not receive them.

DeepTrust SFTP is a file transfer tool. Use it only with servers you are authorized to access.

name: Derek Global
description:
Derek Global es la app de los clientes de Derek para seguir sus equipos, herramientas y maquinaria con los rastreadores Derek. 

Mapa:

• Ubicación de todos tus equipos en el mapa, con la última transmisión de cada uno.
• Trayectos por día con el calendario de recorridos.

Equipos:

• Batería y días estimados restantes, próxima transmisión y última ubicación reportada.
• Gráficas de distancia recorrida, horas de uso, temperatura, impactos y batería.

Alarmas:

• Movimiento, impacto, temperatura fuera de rango, llegada y salida de geo-sitios, batería baja,
  sin comunicación y mantenimiento.
• Notificaciones push: elige qué alarmas de cada equipo llegan a tu teléfono.

Configuración:

• Nombre, ícono y grupo de cada equipo; intervalos de transmisión y disparadores.
• Geo-sitios: crea zonas y recibe alarmas al entrar o salir.
• Mantenimiento por kilómetros u horas de uso.
• Usuarios: crea sub-usuarios, asígnales equipos y decide si pueden editar.

name: DeskBridge: Remote for Mac
description:
DeskBridge turns your iPhone or iPad into a remote screen, trackpad and keyboard for your Mac on the same local network.

HOW IT WORKS
• Install the free DeskBridge Connector on your Mac (macOS 13 or later). Tap “Share Link for Mac” to AirDrop the download page to your Mac.
• Allow Screen Recording and Accessibility on the Mac, then click Start Sharing.
• Pick your Mac in DeskBridge, compare the six-digit code on both screens and approve on both devices.

REMOTE CONTROL
• See your Mac desktop and tap exactly where you want to click.
• Built-in trackpad: move, click, double-click, right-click, drag and two-finger scroll.
• Pinch to zoom and pan for small text.
• On-screen or hardware keyboard with Unicode text, ⌘ ⌥ ⌃ ⇧ modifiers and common Mac shortcuts.
• Choose a picture quality that suits your network.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works on your local network only: no account, no cloud relay and no internet remote access.
• Encrypted connection with six-digit code approval on both devices.
• Paired identities stay in each device’s Keychain. Revoke a device on the Mac at any time.
• Sessions end when the Mac locks or sleeps. DeskBridge cannot unlock a Mac.

DESKBRIDGE PREMIUM (OPTIONAL)
• No ads
• Mac system audio on your iPhone or iPad
• Switch between all of your Mac’s displays
• Best picture quality, up to 1920 pixels
• Pair several Macs
Premium is offered as weekly, monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscriptions. The free plan includes secure pairing, the remote screen, trackpad, keyboard and one paired Mac, with a banner ad on the Home screen only.

REQUIREMENTS
• iPhone or iPad with iOS or iPadOS 17 or later
• A Mac with macOS 13 or later running the free DeskBridge Connector
• Both devices on the same local network. Guest Wi-Fi that isolates devices can block connections.
• Up to 12 frames per second, designed for everyday desktop work, not games or video.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://diponten.com/2026/11/18/deskbridge-terms-of-use/
Privacy Policy: https://diponten.com/2026/11/18/deskbridge-privacy/

name: Destinasjon Steinkjer
description:
Destinasjon Steinkjer brings together what's on in Steinkjer, Norway – concerts, theatre, talks, family events, festivals and places you can visit.

• PROGRAMME – everything that's on, day by day, with photo, venue and time.
• CATEGORIES – pick what you're in the mood for: music, culture, children, food, history, outdoors and more.
• SEARCH AND DATES – find events by name or venue, or pick your own dates.
• FAVOURITES – tap the heart to save an event. The app reminds you the day before.
• TICKETS – jump straight to ticket purchase where available.
• Norwegian and English. No account needed. Free.

Events come from the organizers' own calendars and ticketing systems, and organizers can also add them themselves. The app updates continuously. Are you an organizer? Under «About us» in the app you'll find the link to register your event.

Destinasjon Steinkjer is run by Steinkjer Utvikling AS. The app is provided by Margareto Software AS on the HvaSkjerKalender platform.

name: Detour SSH
description:
Detour is an open-source SSH client for people who run servers. Your hosts, keys, passwords and snippets live in a vault encrypted on your device, and sync between your phone, your computers and your team without any server of ours.

TERMINAL
• A full SSH terminal with themes and output highlighting: prompts, paths, addresses, sizes and statuses stand out
• A key bar of your own: Esc, Ctrl, Tab, arrows and the keys you add
• Sessions connect again by themselves after the phone sleeps or changes networks
• Passwords and SSH keys, jump hosts and proxies

FILES
• Browse a server's files over SFTP, open them in Quick Look, share or save them
• Upload from Files, make folders, rename and delete

SYNC AND TEAMS
• Sync your vault with Detour on Windows, macOS and Linux through a Git repository or a folder in OneDrive, Google Drive or Dropbox
• Scan the QR code from your computer to set up the phone in seconds
• Share hosts with your team: everyone gets their own access, enforced by encryption
• The storage only ever sees encrypted, signed files

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No accounts, no analytics, no tracking
• Unlock with Face ID
• Open source: github.com/INotSleep/Detour

name: Dibs: Run Voice Notes
description:
Your friends cheer you on. You run faster.

Before your run, share a link. Each friend picks a kilometer and records a quick voice message. When you hit their km, your music pauses and you hear them. Then your music comes right back.

Your friends don't need the app. They just open the link and record.

Great for your first 5K, race day, or any run that needs a little push.

Your location stays on your phone, and only you can hear the messages sent to you.

name: Diel: Sleep Schedule
description:
Want to wake up earlier, or later? Your body clock can't jump: moving your sleep by hours at once feels like jet lag. Diel moves it a few minutes each night, then keeps you there.

HOW IT WORKS
Tell Diel when you wake up and fall asleep now, when you want to wake up and how long you want to sleep. It builds your plan night by night and shows it on a chart before you start. You choose the pace: a number of minutes a day, or the date you want to get there.

EVERY EVENING, CONCRETE TIMES
• Tonight's bedtime and tomorrow's wake-up, on the home screen.
• Reminders before bed that move with your plan. Make any of them a notification or a full-screen alarm, or switch it off.
• A wake-up alarm that rings through silent mode.

WHEN LIFE GETS IN THE WAY
Fell asleep later than planned? Enter what really happened and the plan continues from today. Nights already lived stay as they were. Want a new target? Change it; you can undo it for a day.

AFTER YOU GET THERE
The plan doesn't just end. Diel keeps the same schedule every day with daily alarms and reminders, so you stay where you arrived.

YOUR PLAN, YOUR WAY
• Three strategies for when your sleep length changes too. The recommended one moves both ends of your sleep a little every night.
• Three themes: Starry night, Moonlit pastel, Aurora.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Everything stays on your iPhone; the app doesn't connect to the internet.

Diel helps you plan sleep times. It is not a medical device. If you have a sleep disorder, talk to a doctor.

name: Digital OMS Sheba
description:
Digital OMS Sheba is an authorized dealer distribution and inventory management application developed, hosted, and maintained by Spectrum IT Solutions Ltd.

Engineered for authorized fair-price commodity distribution dealers, Digital OMS Sheba digitizes the verification, quota tracking, and delivery process for essential food grains (including rice and flour/atta) to eligible citizens.

KEY FEATURES:

DEALER INVENTORY & ALLOCATION TRACKING
- Real-time monitoring of monthly commodity allocations, dispatched quantities, and remaining point stock.
- Automated balance calculations across distribution cycles.
- Transparent transaction summaries and end-of-day sales logs.

BENEFICIARY VERIFICATION & QUOTA VALIDATION
- Fast verification of national identification cards (NID) and citizen beneficiary records.
- Instant retrieval of entitled family quotas, subsidised pricing, and allocation eligibility.
- Built-in proxy collection handling for authorized family representatives.

BIOMETRIC IDENTITY CONFIRMATION
- Photo-based verification to ensure food grains reach the rightful beneficiary and prevent duplicate allocations.
- Temporary on-device camera framing assistance for quick, accurate photo capture.
- Transparent digital delivery receipts and confirmation timestamps.

SECURE & AUDITABLE RECORDS
- Encrypted communication with secure servers maintained by Spectrum IT Solutions Ltd.
- Offline-ready sync architecture to ensure operations continue smoothly even in areas with low connectivity.
- Built-in audit trail and daily delivery reports for full accountability.

ABOUT SPECTRUM IT SOLUTIONS:
Digital OMS Sheba is proprietary software designed, developed, and maintained by Spectrum IT Solutions Ltd. to empower efficient supply chain distribution.

SUPPORT & ASSISTANCE:
- Support Email: info@spectrum.com.bd
- Official Website: https://spectrum.com.bd
- Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/digitalomssheba/

name: DingJian Manager
description:
DingJian Manager is a companion app for restaurants using DingJian digital services. It helps store managers review business performance, manage devices, and handle day-to-day operational tasks on the go.

Key features:
• Business data overview and basic reporting
• Device management for in-store terminals
• Store operations support for daily management

This app is intended for merchants who already use DingJian restaurant SaaS. Sign-in requires an account issued by your company.

name: Display2
description:
Display2 turns your iPhone (with iPhone Duo in mind) into a second screen for your Mac, and helps you work with more focus and less strain.

EXTRA DISPLAY FOR YOUR MAC
• Drag windows to your iPhone like any other monitor. Extend or mirror, in portrait or landscape, on either side of your Mac.
• Connect over Wi-Fi or with a USB cable for the smoothest image.
• Tap to click, drag, scroll with two fingers and hold for a right click. Works with a physical keyboard.
• Up to 6 shortcut buttons next to the image: open apps on your Mac, run keyboard shortcuts and control your music.

FOCUS & HEALTH
• 20-20-20 eye breaks: every 20 minutes, look 20 feet (6 m) away for 20 seconds. Your Mac dims with "Look away" and a sound tells you when you're done.
• Pomodoro with calm breaks: when a focus block ends, a relaxing veil covers your Mac and iPhone with positive phrases, and "WORK!" welcomes you back.
• Mindful moments: 2-minute box breathing when the day runs long. Saved to Apple Health as Mindful Minutes.
• Move more: a nudge to stand up after long stretches of sitting, and a short walk if your steps are low. Best with Apple Watch.
• Deep work log: earn bronze, silver and gold medals for your focused days and see your streak on a calendar.
• Disconnect time: a gentle heads-up before your work hours end, then a calm closing veil on both screens.
• HomeKit: dim and warm your lights for rest, brighten them for focus, or open the blinds during eye breaks.
• Work Session: use the reminders and Pomodoro on their own, even while you work in other apps, with a Live Activity on your Lock Screen.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts and no servers. Your metrics stay on your iPhone, and the image travels encrypted directly between your Mac and your iPhone.

ONE PURCHASE, EVERYTHING INCLUDED
No subscriptions and no in-app purchases.

Requires the free Display2 for Mac app: medclic.mx/d2

Display2 is a wellness and productivity tool, not a medical device. It does not replace professional medical advice.

Terms of Use: medclic.mx/display2/terms

name: Dive Deco & Gas Planner
description:
Deco & Gas is a free decompression and gas planner for trained technical divers: open circuit, trimix and nitrox, 15 to 56 m. Type the dive on a keypad and read the runtime, every deco stop and the gas plan on one screen. No ads, no purchases, no account.

An example. A 15-minute swim at 10 m, then 45 m for 10 minutes and 51 m for 4, on 18/45 with EAN50: runtime 58, deco 19, first stop 24 m, CNS 27%. Under that, every stop in one table and the gas in another: fill 190 bar of 18/45, minimum gas 100 bar from 51 m, 140 bar of EAN50 in the deco bottle.

TYPE THE DIVE

• Depth, bottom time, bottom gas and deco gas in one row, on a keypad built for it: type the figure, or step the depth by 3 m
• A swim to the drop-off and a second deep segment are rows of the same kind
• Up to three dives before this one, each with its surface interval
• Air, 21/35, 18/45, EAN32, EAN28, triox 30/30, or a mix you type from your analyser
• One deco gas, EAN50 or oxygen, in an AL80, AL50 or AL40 deco bottle

READ THE PLAN

• Runtime, deco time, first stop and CNS at the top
• The schedule: depth, minutes, runtime, gas and ppO2 on every row. One tap turns it into a profile
• Back gas: fill, minimum gas, turn pressure and the reading at the switch, in 10 bar steps
• Deco bottle: what the schedule needs plus the reserve
• Bottom gas: MOD with the limit it was worked at, END, ppN2 and density
• On the fly: 5 minutes more or less, 3 m deeper or shallower, each one solved again with what it costs in deco minutes and in bar

If the cylinders or the CNS clock do not cover the bottom time you typed, the plan reads Not planned, with what covers how long.

SET ONCE

Bühlmann ZH-L16C. Gradient factors per plan, 20/85 by default. Pragmatic decompression per plan, off by default. Working ppO2 per plan, 1.2 bar by default, 1.6 at a stop. Descent, ascent and between-stop rates. Your SCR. Metric or imperial.

BRIEF THE TEAM
