Save a dive as a brief. Send a plan for signatures: each diver signs by finger on your iPhone, and the plan goes out as a picture or a one-page PDF. A wetnote page gives the schedule and the gas checkpoints to copy onto your slate. Free and unlimited.

YOUR DATA

Briefs, plans, divers and dive sites sync through your own iCloud, and are the same ones Time to Surface shows if you use both apps. The planner works offline.

WHO IT IS FOR

Divers trained in staged decompression, planning open-water dives at sea level with one deco gas, to 56 m, with 51 m the recommended maximum. When a gas passes its oxygen limit or a surface interval is under an hour, the app stops and says why. Plan with it before the dive; your training and your dive computer run the dive.

iPhone, iOS 17 or later. English.

name: Diving Dave
description:
Meet Dave. Moustache, red trunks, bit of a belly, and absolutely no fear of heights.

Diving Dave is a one-thumb high diving game. Leap from the board, pull off somersaults and twists on the way down, then straighten up for a clean, feet-first entry. Five judges score every dive, just like the real thing.

SIMPLE TO PLAY, HARD TO MASTER
• Tap to jump
• Hold to tuck and somersault
• Swipe sideways to add a twist
• Let go to open up and straighten
• Dave glows green when he's lined up for the perfect entry

FIVE STUNNING SPOTS
Work your way up from the 10 m Harbour Wall to the Chalk Cliffs, Canyon Lake and Sunset Bay, all the way to the 27 m Midnight Lagoon.

REAL DIVING SCORES
Five judges mark every dive. The highest and lowest scores are dropped, and the rest are multiplied by the difficulty. Bigger dives score more, but only if you land them.

EARN STARS
Every spot has three stars to win: two score targets and a signature dive challenge, from a Forward Double to the mighty Quintuple Somersault. Stars unlock new spots and new trunks for Dave.

SPLASHES, SLAPS AND CANNONBALLS
Rip a perfect entry and the crowd goes wild. Get it wrong and you'll hear all about it: belly flops, back slaps and cannonballs all get Dave's own commentary.

• Smooth, hand-animated diving
• Slow-motion entry cam
• Pay once, play forever: no adverts, no in-app purchases
• Works offline

name: DMV Permit Practice Test: Qwok
description:
Qwok is an independent practice app by AZM Tech Pty Ltd. It is not a government app and does not represent any government entity or state DMV.

Practice for your DMV permit test (the written knowledge test). Pick your state and see only its questions, test format and official links.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 17,000+ questions: 300+ for each state and DC
• Mock tests in your state's format and pass mark
• Road sign questions and an explanation for every answer
• A road sign trainer: what each sign shape and color means, with a picture drill
• Right-of-way puzzles: 12 intersections drawn out, from four-way stops and left turns to roundabouts and emergency vehicles
• Your state at a glance: permit age, supervised practice, alcohol limits, phones, school buses and move-over rules
• Review your mistakes, a readiness score, daily goal and streak
• Light and dark mode. Works offline. No account needed.

FREE TO USE
Every question is free. The app shows a small banner ad and an occasional full-screen ad after a mock test. You get 2 free mock tests a day and can watch a short ad for one more. An optional one-off purchase removes all ads and unlocks unlimited mock tests.

WHERE THE QUESTIONS COME FROM
Each state's official driver manual. The questions are our own wording, and the app links your state's manual, practice test and booking page. Laws change, so always check your state's manual. You take the real test with your state.

IMPORTANT
Qwok is an independent practice app made by AZM Tech Pty Ltd. It is not affiliated with, or endorsed by, any state DMV or government agency.

Support: services@azmtech.com.au
Privacy: https://azmtech.com.au/privacy

name: DocSigna: Sign PDF Documents
description:
DocSigna is the fastest way to sign a PDF from your phone. No printing, no scanning, no account.

ADD YOUR SIGNATURE YOUR WAY
• Draw it: sign with your finger on a full-screen canvas. Choose from five colours and three pen thicknesses, and undo or clear at any time.
• Use paper: sign on plain white paper and take a photo, or choose an existing image. DocSigna removes the paper background so only your ink remains.

PLACE IT EXACTLY WHERE IT BELONGS
• Open any PDF and add your signature to any page.
• Drag to move, pinch to resize and twist to rotate.
• Add more than one signature to the same document.

SHARE IN SECONDS
• Save the signed copy and send it by email, chat or cloud storage.
• Find your recent documents on the home screen.

KEEP SEVERAL SIGNATURES
• Save a full signature, initials or variations, and rename them to find the right one fast.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your documents and signatures stay on your device. DocSigna has no accounts and does not upload your files.

Sign contracts, forms, rental agreements, permission slips and invoices in under a minute.

name: Docwise: Sign & Shrink PDF
description:
Docwise is the paperwork app for your phone: sign a PDF, fill a form, scan a page, and shrink a file or photo to the exact size an upload form asks for.

SIGN & FILL PDFs
- Draw your signature with a finger or Apple Pencil, or photograph one on paper
- Keep up to 3 signatures and 3 initials ready for next time
- Add the date and your own text anywhere on the page
- Fill PDF form fields: text boxes, checkboxes and drop-downs
- Export a flattened PDF, so your signature and text become part of the page

SHRINK PDFs AND PHOTOS TO A TARGET SIZE
- Type the size a form asks for, for example 200 KB, and Docwise compresses a PDF or JPEG to fit
- Or resize to exact pixels, in px, mm, cm or inches
- Includes a US visa photo preset, and you can save your own presets

PASSPORT & VISA PHOTOS
- Size presets for US passport and visa, US DS-160, UK (printed and digital), Schengen, Japan, Canada, Australia and India
- Change the background to white, off-white, light grey, cream or light blue
- Oval face guide, with manual crop, nudge and zoom
- Print sheets in 4x6 inch or A6 at 300 DPI
- Export to a file-size limit; location data is removed from exported photos
- Check your country's current photo rules before you submit. Docwise is not affiliated with any government.

SCAN DOCUMENTS
- Multi-page scanning with automatic edge detection and perspective fix
- Filters: Original, Enhanced, Black & White and Greyscale
- Rotate, reorder and delete pages, and add pages from Photos or Files
- Scan an ID card: front and back on one page at real size, on A4 or Letter
- Text recognition runs on your device

MORE PDF TOOLS
- Merge photos and PDFs into one PDF
- Split a PDF by range, by selected pages or into single pages
- Redact: draw boxes or search for a word; redacted pages are re-rendered so the covered text cannot be copied

OPEN IT FROM ANYWHERE
- Share a PDF to Docwise from Mail, Files or Safari to sign or shrink it
- Open PDFs and images from Files, or drag and drop them on iPad

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No account, no ads, no tracking
- Scanning, signing, shrinking and the photo tools work on your device
- Optional Face ID lock

FREE AND PRO
- Free: 2 signed exports, 5 scans and 2 shrinks, so you can try the tools before paying
- Docwise Pro: unlimited signing exports, scans and shrinks, as a monthly or yearly subscription
- Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.
- Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Does It Really Work Diary
description:
Does that serum actually work? Most of us judge a product on memory and mood, in different light every time. Does It Really Work Diary gives you a fair test.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Start a trial: add the product, what you paid and what you hope it will do.
2. Take your first photo. A face outline helps you line up, and from week two a faint overlay of your first photo keeps every picture in the same position.
3. Check in once a week. Take the guided photo and rate up to three things, such as redness, dark spots or texture. It takes under a minute.
4. See the change. Slide between any two weeks and watch your ratings over time.
5. Get your verdict. At the end of 8 or 12 weeks, see the result side by side, decide whether to keep, switch or stop, and see what continuing would cost each month.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos are stored privately on your phone. They are not added to your photo gallery and are never uploaded. No account is needed, and the app works without internet. We collect no data.

GENTLE REMINDERS
Choose the day and time for your weekly check in, so your photos stay consistent.

PLEASE NOTE
Does It Really Work Diary records your own observations. It does not analyse your skin or give medical advice. For a skin condition that worries you, please see a doctor or dermatologist.

name: Doom Count: Deadline Countdown
description:
Every deadline in sight. Doom Count is a countdown for work that slips: launches, exams, submissions, ship dates. Put the days left on your Home Screen and Lock Screen, and see how much time is really gone.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Add a deadline and its start date
2. Add checkpoints along the way, or let Doom Count space them out
3. Put it on your Home Screen, Lock Screen or wallpaper
4. At each checkpoint, answer: ahead, on track or behind?
5. At zero: did you make it, or did the date move?

FEATURES
• Checkpoints and check-ins: Doom Count asks if you're on track at each checkpoint. Answer right from the widget or the notification.
• Shipped or moved: at zero, mark it done or move the date. Your record of finished and moved deadlines stays with you.
• 12 styles: Day grid, LED, Ring, Bar, Fill, Board, Gauge, Weeks, Clock, Calendar, Hourglass and Squares, in warm LED and dot-matrix looks.
• Widgets everywhere: small, medium and large Home Screen widgets, plus Lock Screen widgets.
• Daily wallpaper: a Lock Screen wallpaper that updates itself every night, set up with a ready-made Shortcut.
• This month, this year, your life: watch the month and the year run out day by day, and your life in weeks.
• Private by design: no account, no ads, no data collection. Your countdowns stay on your iPhone.

FREE
Two countdowns with checkpoints and check-ins, three styles, four colours, the small widget, every Lock Screen widget and the daily wallpaper (with a small Doom Count mark). This month, this year and your life are free in every style.

DOOM COUNT PRO
Unlimited countdowns, all 12 styles, all six colours, the wallpaper without the mark, and six app iconcolours.
• Lifetime: pay once, yours for good.
• Yearly: an auto-renewable subscription.
Family Sharing included on both.

The yearly subscription is charged to your Apple Ac purchase and renews automatically unless cancelledat least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://doomcount.com/privacy

name: Doomsday Larder
description:
How long would your household last on what is in the cupboards right now? Doomsday Larder counts your real supplies and gives you one honest number. Then it helps you raise it, a few pounds at a time, in a game played with actual tins.

Made for the United Kingdom: the guidance, sources and phone numbers are UK ones.

HOLDOUT TIME
One readout: how many days and hours your stash would last, and which system gives out first. It comes from your water and food by a weakest-link model, and every modelled figure is labelled as an estimate.

BEST BUY AND SUPPLY RUNS
Set a weekly budget, from as little as £5, and the app ranks purchases by hours of holdout per pound. Tick a purchase off and it joins the stash. Guide prices are dated and editable.

DRILLS
Timed practice with surprise event cards, a Live Activity timer, a score and an after-action report that turns each gap into a mission. Drills are simulations: they never ask anyone to switch off mains power, gas, heating, a fridge or freezer, or medical equipment, or to go without water, food or medicine. Each one starts with a safety briefing, the Stop button is always on screen, and children take part with an adult.

THE SIMULATOR
Pick a scenario and watch it play out hour by hour against your stash: when light, phones, hot food, water and food run out, and the three fixes that buy the most hours per pound. It is a game model, not a forecast.

STORAGE WARDEN
Spots risky storage, such as gas in the loft. Shows the official advice and its source, with the app's own reading labelled.

LIGHTS-OUT MODE
Black and deep red, big buttons, the torch, your plan, your contacts and the official UK numbers. Open it from the Bunker, or press and hold the app icon. It needs no signal.

THE DOSSIER
Your household plan in one place: meeting points, contacts, a Priority Services Register checklist, a medicines list, a cash note, and Recon missions to photograph the stopcock, gas valve and fuse box. Export it with your kit list as an A4 PDF. Lock it with Face ID if you like.

THE GAME
XP comes from real things only: stocking up, fixing a storage problem, finishing a drill, filling in the Dossier. Never for opening the app, and no daily streaks. Climb six ranks from Sitting Duck to Last One Standing, stamp medals into the cabinet, and share a report card that shows your Holdout time, rank and medal count. Dent, a dented tin in a tin helmet, keeps most of his opinions about your cupboards to himself.

ALSO IN THE TIN
- A stash list by system or by storage place, with best-before dates
- Your own barcode book: scan once and it is remembered, with no lookup service
- Optional reminders for best-before dates and the Muster, a check of dates and batteries when the clocks change
- Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
- Calm Mode: plain colours, no sound, and every joke swapped for a plain sentence

FREE, AND HONEST ABOUT IT
Everything that keeps a household safe is free: the Holdout reading, the Stash, Supply Runs, the Storage Warden, Lights-Out Mode, the Dossier and its PDF, two drills and one Simulator scenario. The Full Kit is a single optional purchase that adds more game: three more drills, five more scenarios (one involves zombies, probably), a second household, extra share card styles and the rest of the medal cabinet. No subscription, no adverts, and Restore purchases is always in the Service Record.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no analytics, no tracking. The app sends nothing anywhere: what you enter leaves your iPhone only if you share it yourself, and the one optional purchase goes through the App Store. Recon photos, contacts and medicines never appear on a share card.

SOURCES
Every safety statement comes from an official UK source, shown with its link and the date it was checked. The app gives no medical advice. Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.

Doomsday Larder is an independent app. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the UK Government.

name: Dorin: Sound Postcards
description:
Dorin is a sound postcard app for the moments a photograph cannot hold on its own.

Choose a photograph, record up to 30 seconds of the sound around it - rain on a window, a kettle, a street at night - and add a short caption. Dorin turns the three into one postcard you can keep, or share to the public feed or to a circle of people who listen for the same things.

- A postcard is a photo, a recording and a caption, published in one pass
- Circles gather postcards around a place, a season or a mood
- Reply to a postcard, save the ones you want to come back to, and follow the people whose ears you trust
- Report a postcard or an account, or block someone, from the same menu
- The draft - photo, sound and words - stays on this iPhone until you publish it
- Sign in with an email address to publish, reply, save or join a circle; browsing and listening need no account

Recordings are limited to 30 seconds, so a postcard stays a fragment rather than a file. Items marked Sound study use synthesized preview audio and say so in the caption.

Dorin is made for iPhone.

name: DormGuard
description:
DormGuard is a local visitor ledger used for dormitory front desk, dormitory management, and night shift duty. You can use it just by opening it.
Who is suitable for using it
Registration of external visitors at the dormitory duty desk
Check who is still in the building and who has exceeded the time limit
• Record on-site situations such as unregistered entry and overstaying
Export the daily ledger as CSV or text report, share it with colleagues through the system
[Usage Process]
1. Open the application
Enter the homepage 'Front Desk'. The top gear can be filled in with the building name first and saved (can be changed at any time). You can register directly without filling in.
2. Issue a pass (sign in)
Click on 'New Visitor' and fill in: Visitor Name, Host, Room (required); Choose the reason for the visit; Choose a scheduled departure time, or use a shortcut duration (30 minutes/1 hour/2 hours/4 hours/22:00). The ID number and vehicle are optional. Click on 'Issue Pass'. After saving, it will enter the "Visitor" page, and this person will be displayed as inside the building.
3. Check who is inside the building
The 'Visitor' page lists all on-site passes. You can search for (name, room, receptionist), or filter for 'all/timeout'. Visitors who exceed the time limit will be marked in orange. Click on a certain item to see details; Click 'Check Out' or swipe left to 'Check Out', confirm and transfer the pass to 'File'. This operation cannot be revoked.
4. Extend Stay
In the details of the pass, you can extend the planned departure time by "+30 minutes/+1 hour/+2 hours". After exceeding the time limit, it is still possible to extend or process the check-out. The trash can in the upper right corner can be used to delete incorrect passes.
5. Registration violations
Open the 'Violation' page, select the type (unregistered entry, overstaying, document abuse, other), and choose to fill in the description, room number, or attach a photo (camera or system album selector). After clicking 'Save Violation Record', it will jump to the violation list in 'File'. Photos are optional and registration can be completed without authorization of the camera.
6. View files and export
The "File" is divided into two columns: "Visitor" and "Violation". Checked out visitors appear in the visitor bar. Click 'Export' to share: visitor CSV, violation CSV, complete text report. Send the system sharing table to email, file, or air delivery. Swipe left to delete a single incorrect record.
7. Chart
Click on the "Front Desk" card or "Today's Registration" on the homepage to view the check-in bar chart and violation type composition for the past 7 days. The data only exists locally. After changing the record, you can refresh it by returning to the homepage and entering the chart.
8. Setting and Clearing
Gear entry settings: modify building name, view version and privacy statement. To clear all visitors, violations, and photos on this machine, use 'Clear Local Data' (to be confirmed, non recoverable). After uninstalling the application, the local logs will also be deleted together.

name: Dovan
description:
Dovan is a local-first ledger for the camera batteries, chargers and kits you carry between takes.

ARCHIVE A PACK
Record brand, model, capacity, chemistry, serial suffix, tape number, cycle count, health rating, purchase price and the kit it belongs to. Attach a label photo or a spoken field note, and keep a change log for every correction.

FOLLOW THE BOARD
Move packs across To Charge, Charging, Ready and Quarantine. Every move has a five-second undo. Start and finish charge sessions against a real charger bay, with fast-charge flags and start/end bar counts.

LOOK AFTER THE RISKY ONES
Mark a swelling pack, isolate it from every picker, attach evidence, and retire a cell with its recycling destination. Health notes and cycle history stay with the record.

REPORTS AND EXPORTS
Build a cell report image and save it to your photo library, or export the whole archive as CSV. Search, count and swap views are free. One cell report and one voice note are free each day; after that, reports, exports and extra pack photos use Volts, which you can add in Shop.

EVERYTHING STAYS ON THIS DEVICE
All records, images, voice notes and the Volts balance are stored locally with file protection. The archive starts empty. You can clear all data at any time from Me.

name: Downbell: Uptime Alerts
description:
Downbell watches your websites, APIs and scheduled jobs from three continents, and rings your phone the moment one goes down. Know before your customers do.

WHY DOWNBELL
• Built for your phone. Add, edit, pause and check monitors right in the app. You don't need a laptop to deal with an outage.
• Alerts you can trust. Send a test alert and see how fast it arrived. If phone alerts ever stop reaching you, Downbell tells you.
• No false alarms at 3 a.m. Every site is checked from North America, Europe and Asia, and you're only alerted when two regions agree it's down.
• Every alert channel on the free plan: phone push, email, Slack, Discord, Telegram and signed webhooks. No alert credits that run out.

WHEN SOMETHING BREAKS
• A push alert with the cause: "HTTP 503 from 3 of 3 regions."
• Acknowledge it from the notification, so your team knows you're on it.
• A timeline of each incident: when each region saw it, when you were told, when it came back.
• A "back up" alert when it recovers, with how long it was down.

MORE THAN UP OR DOWN
• Website and API checks, plus keyword checks that make sure a page shows what it should.
• Heartbeat checks for cron jobs and backups: get an alert when a job doesn't run.
• Warnings before an HTTPS certificate or a domain registration expires.
• Response time charts per region, uptime for the last 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days.
• Public status pages on your own domain.
• Two-step sign-in, and Google sign-in.

FAIR FROM DAY ONE
• Free for 50 monitors, with every alert channel.
• Delete your account and all its data from the app at any time.

Terms: https://downbell.app/terms
Privacy: https://downbell.app/privacy
Support: https://downbell.app/support

name: DrakonTovelius
description: DrakonTovelius on sorvin kolmileukaistukoiden mitoitus- ja tarkistussovellus. Se arvioi leukojen puristusvoiman, keskitystarkkuuden, sallitun pyörintänopeuden, momentin siirron, painotasapainon ja kulumistarpeen. Liukusäätimillä säädetään puristusta, halkaisijaa, momenttia ja kierrosnopeutta, ja tulokset voi tallentaa tai viedä teknisenä tiedostona. Pro-versio avataan kertamaksulla ilman mainoksia tai tilausta.

name: Drama Depo
description:
Drama Depo is a local production desk for short-drama creators. Plan scenes, structure episodes, manage shoot costs, and collect visual references—without signing in or uploading your work.
REEL BREAKDOWNS
Annotate hooks, camera moves, performance notes, sound cues, tension, and tags for every scene. Search across titles, series, and notes when you need a beat fast.
EPISODE DRAFTS
Outline cold opens, scene lists, cast beats, and cliffhangers. Mark drafts locked for shoot so your team knows what is ready.
PRODUCTION LEDGER
Track planned vs actual spend across talent, location, costume, gear, and post. Filter open and paid lines and keep episode budgets under control.
MOODBOARD
Pin lighting, costume, and grade references with notes and optional photos from your library. Everything stays on this device.
LOCAL ONLY
Your vault is stored on your iPhone or iPad. Export or import a JSON backup when you want a copy. No accounts, no tracking SDKs, no network sync.
Whether you are breaking down a vertical short or packing a weekend shoot, Drama Depo keeps your creative and production notes in one clear English workspace.

name: Drawerline
description:
Drawerline is a map of cabinets, drawers, and the things you put in them. The first screen is a search box. It matches item names and the keywords you typed, and it stays quiet until you type. Cabinets open as a grid of drawers. Empty drawers are listed on their own so you can see the gaps.

Move an item when it changes drawers. Rooms group cabinets by the room words you typed. Keywords can be browsed and opened as their own lists.

Drawerline does not scan barcodes or photos. It only searches what you wrote. The map stays on this iPhone.

name: Drink Street: Idle Tycoon
description:
Start with a little lemonade cart and build the city's favorite drink chain!
A cozy idle tycoon and drink shop game, from juice bar to café, that you can play offline. No loot boxes.

Sell, earn, grow
Tap your cart to sell lemonade and upgrade with what you earn. Open a juice bar, a kiosk, a café, a bottling workshop and an ice cream parlor, each with its own recipes and look.

Sell for the weather
Iced drinks on hot days, hot chocolate in the rain… Recipes that fit the weather sell more.

Fresh ingredients, better prices
Buy fresh ingredients at the market and your recipes sell for more.

Build your team
Hire cashiers, chefs and barkers. Managers keep selling while you're away.

Make the recipe yourself
Prepare each drink's real recipe step by step: squeeze the lemon, mash the strawberries, stir, add ice. Master a recipe and it sells for more.

Make customers happy
Serve customers waiting for their favorite drink and collect tips. Fresh ingredients mean bigger tips.

Discover secret recipes
Try ingredients at the Mixing Bench, solve the hints and find secret recipes.

Seasonal festivals
The Harvest Festival, the Winter Market and the Spring Festival around April 23, Children's Day: each brings new recipes, tasks and permanent badges.

Quests, league and profile
New quests every day, a recipe of the day and a lemon garden to harvest. Race rival shops in the weekly Street League and climb from Bronze to Diamond. Pick one of your managers as your character and decorate your street.

Day and night
Your street follows your phone's clock: orange sunsets, glowing windows and street lamps at night, and flags on national holidays.

Street by street, city by city
Open branches from Neighborhood Street to the Town Square, then travel across Türkiye: İzmir, Antalya, Malatya, Trabzon and İstanbul. Every city has its own streets, landmark and local recipes: Mastic Lemonade, Bitter Orange Sherbet, Apricot Nectar, Rosehip Tea, Cornelian Cherry Sherbet…

Branch skills and the recipe album
Earn skill points with every new branch and improve your offline earnings, tips and market prices. Master recipes to complete album sets and unlock permanent rewards and awning colors.

A new season every month
Every month has its own theme and a 30-level reward track. Play daily, collect season points and claim your rewards.

• 69 real recipes plus seasonal ones, each with ingredients and steps
• Earn while you're away
• Plays offline
• Turkish and English
• Designed for ages 8+: no account needed, ads are never personalized and only play when you choose
• No loot boxes: everything you can buy shows its contents first

name: Drive Tech Inspecciones
description:
Drive Tech acompaña el trabajo de inspección y mantenimiento de equipos industriales.

• Consulta equipos por cliente, planta y área.
• Revisa el estado de los equipos, sus inspecciones y mediciones.
• Registra inspecciones y adjunta evidencia fotográfica según tus permisos.
• Consulta informes y documentación técnica disponible.
• Identifica equipos mediante códigos QR y enlaces NFC.
• Prepara rondas para trabajar sin conexión y sincroniza los registros cuando recuperes la conectividad.

El acceso requiere una cuenta proporcionada por tu organización. Las funciones y los equipos disponibles dependen de los permisos asignados. Para trabajar sin conexión debes descargar previamente la ronda y sus datos.

La lectura y escritura NFC requieren un iPhone compatible y etiquetas compatibles. En iPad y Mac puedes consultar los equipos y utilizar las demás funciones disponibles sin lector NFC.

Los datos y estados registrados sirven de apoyo al trabajo de mantenimiento; las decisiones de intervención corresponden al personal técnico responsable.

name: Drop Drop Who is There
description:
Drop Drop Who is There is a one-tap timing game. A ball waits at the top. A door slides left and right below. Tap at the right moment and the ball drops.

Land inside the door: 1 point. Land square on the doormat: Perfect, 3 points, and the one who lives there opens the door with a grin. Miss the door: the run is over.

Perfects in a row build a multiplier: ×2 at 3, ×3 at 5, ×4 at 10. One Good or one miss and it resets, so every drop counts.

Doors change as you go, one new kind at a time:
• Fast doors move quicker.
• Narrow doors leave less room.
• Breathing doors speed up in the middle and slow down at the edges.
• Pausing doors stop at each edge before turning back.
• Bobbing doors move up and down too.
• Shutter doors open and close; land while they are open.
• Golden doors are narrow and rare: a Perfect there is worth 9.

Every 20 hits the street changes color. From the fourth door on you hear three knocks. On the third knock the ball drops by itself, so do not wait too long.

Every door is checked before it appears: there is always a landing window a human can hit, and a script proves it on thousands of runs for every build. A miss is a timing mistake, never bad luck.

Eight balls to unlock by playing. They only change how the ball looks.

The game is free and shows ads between runs. A single one-time purchase removes them for good. Watching an ad to continue after a miss is optional and stays optional. No account, no sign-in. Your best score stays on your device. Works on iPhone and iPad, offline.

name: Drunk Tug
description:
Drunk Tug is the tug of war you play with your thumbs.

Everyone joins the same room on their own phone. A red flag sits on a knot in the middle, with a rope reaching out to every player. When the countdown hits zero, tap as fast as you can – the faster you tap, the harder you pull the flag toward your circle. First flag in your circle wins.

• 2 to 26 players – every new friend adds a new branch to the rope
• Join with a 4-letter code or an invite link – friends without the app can play from their browser
• Classic mode: one wild round, first to pull the flag wins
• Elimination mode: the slowest tapper's rope snaps every round until two face off in the final
• Add a selfie and see your face on your end of the rope
• Win tally in every room – crown the champion of the night
• Practice against computer players any time
• The knot has a mind of its own – it sways like it had one too many

No accounts, no ads, no tracking. Just tap, pull, win.

name: DryVisit Ledger
description:
Record drying visits as you move from room to room. When the job is ready to hand over, turn those records into a property PDF.

• Log initial, follow-up, and final visits with readings, notes, and before-and-after photos.
• Repeat the same measurement location and meter scale to see how readings changed.
• Add an optional drawn signature before exporting.
• Preview your PDF, then save a copy or share it from your iPhone.

Field records are stored on your iPhone and can be entered offline. The first property you export is free. Each additional property requires one App Store purchase for PDF exports, including updated reports for that same property on this device.

name: Dubai eVisa: Apply UAE Visa
description:
Apply for your UAE visa from your phone in about 2 minutes. Our team checks every document before we submit it, and your approved eVisa arrives by email as a PDF.

CHOOSE YOUR VISA
• 14-day tourist visa – short trips and business visits
• 30-day tourist visa – holidays and family visits
• 60-day tourist visa – longer stays
• 30-day multiple-entry visa – come and go as often as you need
• 60-day multiple-entry visa – frequent visits over two months
• Express visa – a 30-day tourist visa handled first, for last-minute trips
• 96-hour transit visa – turn a layover into a short stay

Every visa is valid in all seven emirates, including Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Fill in one short form – choose your visa and add each traveller’s passport and trip details.
2. Upload and pay – add a face photo and passport scans straight from your phone camera, then pay securely by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay.
3. We check everything – a person on our team reviews every document before submitting, so small mistakes don’t cause delays.
4. Get your visa by email – print it or keep it on your phone for check-in.

FEATURES
• Photo and passport guides with good and bad examples for your own passport, so your documents are accepted first time
• Apply for the whole family in one application
• Urgent processing available as an add-on
• Track every application with its live status and expected date
• One all-in price per traveller in US dollars, UAE government fee and our service fee included, no hidden charges
• Sign in with Google or a code sent to your email
• Help by WhatsApp, phone or email

UAE immigration makes every decision. Processing times are estimates and approval cannot be guaranteed.

IMPORTANT
Apply eVisa Dubai is a private, licensed visa assistance company in Dubai, owned and operated by Brillsmac Consultants and Tourism L.L.C-FZ (Dubai trade licence no. 2648704.01). We are not a government app and are not affiliated with GDRFA Dubai or ICP. You can apply directly through the official UAE government portal (u.ae) at a lower cost. Our prices include the government visa fee plus our service fee for document checking and application support.

name: Dunefit: Workout & Nutrition
description:
Dunefit is your Arabic-first workout and nutrition coach.

Answer a few questions and get a complete plan built around your days, level and equipment — gym or home.

WORKOUTS THAT GROW WITH YOU
• Upper/Lower, Push/Pull/Legs or Full Body, based on your schedule
• Automatic weight progression when you hit your reps, and lighter loads when you struggle
• 6-week cycles with a deload week to protect your joints
• Rest timer, supersets and personal records

EVERY EXERCISE IN 3D
• 49 exercises with 3D visuals highlighting the working muscle
• A body map of the muscles you trained this week

SIMPLE NUTRITION
• Calorie and protein targets for your goal (cut, bulk or maintain)
• Built-in Gulf dishes like machboos and harees
• Barcode scanner
• Water and body-weight tracking

FOR EVERY SEASON
• Ramadan plan: short and light, after iftar
• Travel plan: no-equipment hotel workouts

MOTIVATION THAT KEEPS YOU GOING
• XP, levels and badges
• Weekly streaks and challenges

Dunefit is not a substitute for medical advice. Consult your doctor before starting any training or diet program if you have a health condition.

name: Duo Calcomatic
description:
Duo Calcomatic turns your iPhone Duo into the desk calculator you remember.

Half fold it and stand it like a little laptop: the display sits on the upright half, the chunky keys lie flat on the desk. The numbers glow in seven-segment digits, every unlit segment still faintly etched in the glass, the way the real ones looked.

KEYS THAT CLICK
Every key plays a recording of a real mechanical keyboard switch, from clicky to smooth. Choose the one you like. Hold the phone and you feel each press too.

SIX THEMES
Office '82, Night Shift, Disco '75, Field Unit, Schoolbag and Bubblegum. Or mix your own: case colour, grey LCD, green glow, red LED, amber or blue backlight, slanted digits, square, round or slab keys, and your own words on the nameplate.

SIMPLE OR SCIENTIFIC
Simple works left to right as you press, just like a four-function machine. Scientific adds brackets, powers, sin, cos, tan, logs, π, 1/x, n! and EXP, with INV for the opposite of every key.

THE DETAILS
• A paper tape that prints each sum as you go. Tap it to tear it off.
• Memory keys, percent, square root and a delete key.
• A solar cell that shows your battery, and fades the display when you cover it with a finger.
• Closed, the outside screen is a pocket calculator that carries on the same sum, or a clock.

SECRETS
There are two hidden games inside, in the spirit of the game calculators of 1980, and a few other tricks. Can you find them?

No account, no ads, no tracking. Works entirely offline.

name: DuoPhotos - Face-to-Face Album
description:
When you show photos to someone sitting across a café table, stop turning your phone back and forth.

Unfold iPhone Duo fully and lay it flat on the table. DuoPhotos splits the screen at the fold: your half shows the photo upright for you, and the other half shows the same photo turned 180° so it's upright for the person across from you. Swipe on either side and both halves move together.

■ Look at photos together, face to face
• Swipe on either side and the other side moves to the same photo.
• Pinch or double-tap to zoom, and the other side shows the same spot at the same zoom.
• Touch and hold to show a pointer at that spot on both sides.
• Lines you draw with your finger appear in the same place on both sides.
• Videos play in sync, with sound from just one side.

■ Show only the photos you choose
• Pick just the photos you want to show, and they appear in the order you picked them.
• Browse by album, or play a slideshow.
• See the date and place each photo was taken.

■ And more
• Share a photo with your drawing on it, or save it to your library.
• On iPad, tap Face to Face to split the screen in half the same way.
• On other iPhone models, the screen splits into top and bottom halves the same way.
• Photos and videos stay on your device and are never uploaded.

DuoPhotos is free and shows an ad below the photo grid. A one-time purchase removes the ads.

name: Dustwink
description:
A crescent moon hangs over the observatory. For a moment, two golden eyes appear in the dark. Can you tap them before they fade?

Follow the ghost’s trail across the floor. Tap the piles of stardust to mark them blue, then press U to turn your selection into glass and watch it scatter. A room is complete when the ghost is caught and every pile is cleared.

Every hunt asks for a little more timing and a little tidier thinking. The eyes move faster, their glow grows briefer, and the trail gets busier. Miss a glimpse and the ghost will return. There’s no game over.

Play at your own pace with one-tap controls, a soft original soundscape, and progress saved between rooms. Dustwink works offline.

name: Duzzonku Cookie Shop Tycoon
description:
Open a small Dubai chewy cookie shop and turn the morning rush into a thriving pixel-art business.

Shop for ingredients at the market as prices change from day to day. Guide your chef through the kitchen, pack the finished cookies, and stock the counter for the customers waiting upstairs.

Sell the last cookie, check your receipt, and read the evening paper for tomorrow's prices and crowd. Hire staff, install conveyor belts and a lift, and expand into a basement factory. If word reaches the stars, you can run a shop on the Moon, too.

Play without an account. An optional one-time purchase in Settings removes interstitial ads.

name: Eatto - Restaurant Partner
description:
The Eatto Partner App empowers restaurant owners and managers to efficiently run, monitor, and grow their food business on Eatto.

Key Features:
• Real-time Order Management: Accept, prepare, and dispatch food orders instantly.
• Live Order Tracking: Monitor pickup drivers and delivery status in real-time.
• Menu & Pricing Control: Easily update food dishes, categories, stock availability, and prices.
• Business Insights: Track daily revenue, order volume, and top-selling dishes.
• Instant Alerts: Never miss an incoming customer order with loud sound notifications.

Partner with Eatto and serve more happy customers every day!

name: EdiosEkigai
description:
Edios Ekigai is a private, offline-first career and livelihood studio built for adults, career changers, and independent professionals. Map what you love, what you do well, what the market needs, and what pays sustainably into a clear 90-day transition plan—buy once and own forever with zero accounts, zero subscriptions, and zero cloud tracking.

FIRST-DAY ESSENTIALS (15-MINUTE GUIDED START)
Start calmly with 6 curated Day-1 stations—zero setup friction and zero cloud sign-in:
1. Step 1A - 4-Circle Purpose & Career Map: Pinpoint what is out of balance and model your 80/20 workflow shift across Love, Skill, Market Need, and Pay.
2. Step 1B - 4-Dimension Strength Micro-Labs: Benchmark your Spatial/Mechanical, Systems/Pattern, Empathy/Human Connection, and Creative/Story strengths.
3. Step 2A - Career Matches & Dual Livelihood Tracks: Compare tailored W-2 leadership paths alongside a 3-client independent practice.
4. Step 2B - 1-Page Portfolio Case Study Builder: Generate a clear before/after impact brief ready to share with hiring managers or clients.
5. Step 2E - Dual-Path Livelihood Charter: Draft a clean W-2 First-90-Days Value Charter or Independent Retainer Statement of Work (SOW).
6. Step 3C - Family Freedom Calculator & 90-Day Roadmap: Calculate your household baseline coverage and track your 30/60/90-day transition milestones.

EXPAND ALL 20 STUDIO STATIONS ANYTIME
Tap Expand All 20 Studio Stations to open all 4 structured chapters (Discover Purpose, Build Portfolio Proof, Land Role or Clients, and 90-Day Plan & Family Freedom), including Monday queue triage, 60-second spoken pitch teleprompter, 3-touch warm outreach, 48-hour client audit ROI calculator, 3-tier scope-lock negotiator, 28-day sprint board, 4-bucket tax/revenue planner, and household debt-elimination tracker.

100% ON-DEVICE PRIVACY & PORTABLE EXPORTS
• Buy Once, Own Forever: Every station, PDF formatter, and template is unlocked immediately from first launch.
• 100% Local Execution: All calculations, micro-labs, and documents run privately on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac.
• Print PDF & One-Tap Files Backup: Print or save a clean formatted Career Launch Plan PDF, share Markdown kits, and save or reopen your .ekigai.json session backups directly from the Files app.

name: Edu-TO - Terapia Ocupacional
description: Evolua na Terapia Ocupacional com cursos completos, trilhas de conhecimento, estudos de caso e supervisões. Cada aula acompanha e-book, resumo e mapa mental.

name: Eduko
description:
Eduko es la aplicación para las familias de las escuelas que usan Eduko. Lo que antes había que preguntar en la salida o por WhatsApp, acá está en el teléfono.

CÓMO VA MI HIJO
Al abrir ve el resumen: lo que se debe, las tareas de esta semana y lo último que dijo la escuela. Sin buscar en ninguna parte.

LAS NOTAS, COMO EN LA BOLETA
Las notas de cada materia con sus componentes (cotidiano, extraclase, pruebas y concepto) y el promedio del periodo. Los mismos números que la boleta de papel, el día que la maestra los entrega.

ASISTENCIA, Y JUSTIFICAR UNA AUSENCIA
El registro de entradas, ausencias y llegadas tardías. Si hubo una ausencia, puede justificarla desde la aplicación y adjuntar la foto de la constancia, en vez de mandar una nota en el cuaderno.

TAREAS
Lo que hay que entregar y para cuándo, con la materia y la descripción. Y en el calendario del mes, para ver de un vistazo cómo viene la semana.

PAGOS
El estado de cuenta del año: los meses pagados, lo que está pendiente y el recibo de cada pago para descargarlo.

LO QUE DICE LA ESCUELA
Comunicados y circulares, con sus adjuntos para leerlos adentro de la aplicación. Las circulares que necesitan su firma quedan marcadas hasta que las firme.

MENSAJES
Una conversación con la maestra o con la dirección para lo que necesita respuesta, y el canal del aula para los avisos del grupo.

CALENDARIO
Las tareas, las pruebas, las reuniones y los feriados en un calendario de mes, no en una lista.

TALLERES Y RE-MATRÍCULA
Inscribir en los talleres cuando abre el periodo, y confirmar la matrícula del año siguiente desde el teléfono.

AVISOS EN EL TELÉFONO
Le llega una notificación cuando entran una nota baja, una ausencia, una incidencia, un cobro por vencer, un comunicado nuevo, una circular por firmar, una tarea nueva o un mensaje. Al tocarla, abre justo donde pasó.

VARIOS HIJOS
Si tiene más de un hijo en la escuela, cambia de uno a otro desde el encabezado y todo lo demás cambia con él.

Para usar Eduko, la escuela tiene que haberle creado la cuenta. No se puede registrar por su cuenta: la cuenta la crea la escuela y usted recibe una invitación por correo.

name: Edvona: Learn Anything
description:
Tell Edvona what you want to learn and it builds a course for you: units, short lessons, checks after each part, and a clear path from where you are now to where you want to be.

Any subject. A school syllabus, a university paper, a skill for work, or something you have always wondered about. Edvona is for learners aged 13 and over.

HOW IT WORKS
• Say what you want to learn, in your own words.
• For school and university subjects, Edvona looks up the official syllabus for your country, board, programme and term, cross-checks it and shows you what it covers. If it is not sure, it asks you.
• A placement check finds where you are, so you start at the right lesson instead of the first one.
• Your first lesson opens as soon as it is built. The next ones are prepared ahead of you while you learn.

EVERY LESSON
• Short and focused: one idea at a time, with a quick check after each part.
• Every answer is marked straight away. Tap Explain for a clear walkthrough, or ask for the idea another way.
• A hint when you are stuck, and a recap of anything you missed at the end.
• Graphs, geometry, number lines, timelines and flows are drawn by our own code, never guessed by AI. Many of them you can move.

BUILT TO BE TRUSTED
• Facts are grounded in cited sources and reviewed by a second, independent check before a lesson reaches you.
• Maths answers are computed, not guessed. When Edvona is unsure, it says so.
• Spot a problem? Report it in one tap and it goes to our review queue.

WHAT YOU KEEP
• Spaced review cards bring back what you learned, just before you would forget it.
• A library of open textbooks and notes behind each course. Copyrighted books are recommended for you to find, never copied.
• Exam dates with a countdown, so you can see how much time you have.
• A certificate when you finish a course.

A CALM DAILY HABIT
• Set a daily goal in lessons or minutes, and change it whenever life changes.
• Streaks with freezes, so one busy day does not erase your progress.
• An optional reminder at a time you choose, and nothing else nags you to come back.
• Optional weekly leagues and challenges with a friend, using a nickname only. There is no chat.

A COMPANION
A small, friendly alien keeps you company. He is glad when you get it right and steady when you do not. Swipe him aside when you want to focus, or mute him in a tap.

YOUR DATA
No ads, and your data is never sold. Your email address and account ID are never sent to the AI provider. You can download a copy of your data or delete your account at any time from Profile.

PLANS
Pick how many courses you want to learn at once. Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial.
• Plus 5: up to 5 active courses, $9.99 a month
• Plus 10: up to 10 active courses, $14.99 a month
• Plus 20: up to 20 active courses, $24.99 a month
Prices are in US dollars and may differ in your country; the store shows your local price. You can move between plans or cancel any time.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, at the end of the free trial. The subscription renews automatically each month unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.
Terms of use: https://edvona.com/terms
Privacy policy: https://edvona.com/privacy

You must be 13 or older to create an account.

Questions: info@edvona.com

name: EggsWikis
description:
鸟蛋百科 —— 认蛋形 · 听叫声 · 看从蛋到成鸟

鸟蛋百科，39 种鸟的蛋，从捡到手里那一刻讲起。

【怎么用】

• 认蛋：按长宽、宽窄与壳色，帮你认出手里那枚蛋
• 蛋库：39 种鸟的蛋，尺寸、壳色、孵化天数逐项列清
• 图解：胚胎发育、破壳、成长，一天一天看过来
• 鸣声：每一种鸟自己的叫声
• 我的：孵化批次、翻蛋与温度记录，只存在本机

【里面有什么】

39 种鸟的蛋。每一种都记了蛋长、蛋宽、蛋重、壳色与斑纹、每窝几枚、孵化天数、
育雏天数、孵化温度与湿度、每天翻蛋次数、照蛋日、巢型与叫声类型。

【认蛋是怎么认的】

野外捡到一枚蛋，能问的只有三件事：多大、什么颜色、长什么形状。
App 把库里的每种蛋按这三项各算一个匹配分，加权求和后排序 ——
尺寸 40 分、形状 35 分、颜色 25 分。形状用长宽比而非外形轮廓，
因为长宽比是野外最容易量准的一项（卡尺量长除以量宽）。

【孵化记录】

「我的」页可以开一个孵化批次，记录每天的翻蛋打卡、温度与出壳情况。
这些记录全部写在 App 沙盒内的 Application Support 目录，只在这台设备上。

【素材说明】

照片与录音来自开放许可的公共来源（维基共享资源、iNaturalist），
每份素材的作者与许可协议在「设置 → 版权与授权」逐条列出。
本 App 的蛋内剖面、发育阶段图、识别页的示意蛋与图标全部由代码画成。

【隐私】

不登录、没有账号、没有任何权限请求。你的孵化批次、翻蛋打卡和温度记录
全部保存在这台设备上，不会上传到任何服务器，也不会与他人同步。卸载 App 即全部删除。


【适合谁】

喜欢鸟、喜欢在野外辨认、对「蛋里正在发生什么」好奇的人。

版本 1.0

name: EggTally: Chicken Egg Counter
description:
Tap + for each egg. Watch your month fill up.
EggTally is an egg counter for backyard chickens. It opens to today's count with a big + button, and under it a month calendar where every day shows the eggs you collected. Counting takes a few seconds each morning — or tap + on the Home Screen widget without opening the app.

■ Eggs: today and your month
Tap + once for each egg. Know who laid it? Tap her chip instead — or sort it out later.
The month calendar fills up day by day. Tap a day to set the total, split it between hens, note cracked or unused eggs, and add a note or photos.
"No eggs today" marks a zero day, so you know it wasn't forgotten.

■ Home Screen widget
Small and medium widgets with a + button. Count eggs right at the coop.

■ Flock: every hen, by name
Name, photo album, species, breed, color morph, hatch date, leg band, coop and egg color. Status: laying, pullet, molting, broody, sick or injured, retired. Ducks, quail, geese, turkeys and guinea fowl too.
Add several chicks from one hatch at once. Sort by recently laid, most this month, name or age.

■ Costs: do your hens pay off?
Log feed, bedding, treats, vet and health costs, and setup costs like the coop and the birds. EggTally shows your cost per egg and per dozen (or per 10) — feed only or all routine costs.
Enter what a carton costs at the store to see how much you've saved so far and when your setup pays back at this pace.
Keep track of eggs you gave away, sold or ate.

■ Stats
Totals, eggs per day, laying rate and usable eggs. A hen ranking with the Hen of the Month. Month by month against last year, by season, and by egg color.

■ Hatches
Follow a batch from set to hatch day, in an incubator or under a broody hen. Reminders for candling, lockdown and hatch day, with typical days for each species (your incubator's manual comes first). Add the chicks to your flock in one tap.

■ Health notes and care routines
Note what you did for one hen or several at once, with an optional egg hold date. Recurring care routines, like cleaning the coop. A record only — no advice.

■ Reminders
Egg collection time, hatch milestones, the end of an egg hold and care routines. All optional.

■ Share cards
Month in Eggs, Hen of the Month and Year in Eggs, in square, portrait, story or landscape.

■ Try the sample coop
See a filled month right away: 6 made-up hens and 45 days of eggs. Clear it with one tap.

■ Your data stays on your iPhone
No account. What you log is not sent to any external server. Export a ZIP backup with all your days, hens, photos, health notes, costs, given and sold eggs, hatches and care routines, and use it to move to a new iPhone.
Already counting in a spreadsheet? Import your past days from a CSV (date, eggs).
Dozen or 10-egg cartons, lb or kg, and your own currency. English, German and French. Dark mode. iPhone and iPad.

■ Pricing
Every feature is free. The free version holds 60 days with eggs. Zero-egg days, hens, costs, health notes and hatches don't count and have no limit.
At 60 days, nothing is lost: your past days, costs and stats keep working.
EggTally Pro is a one-time purchase. It removes the 60-day limit and the watermark on share cards. No subscription.

name: EGIS Remote
description:
EGIS Remote controls Mac and Windows PCs from iPhone, iPad and Mac.

Key features
- Access ID and password: Connect with the access ID and password shown in EGIS Remote on the remote computer. A device connected once is added to the allowed list and connects without a password afterwards.
- Connection across networks: Connects directly on the same network. On different networks, a direct NAT-traversal connection is tried first, then a relay server is used.
- End-to-end encryption: Screen, input and files are encrypted between devices. The relay server cannot read the content.
- Connection status: The list shows whether each registered computer is available and when it was last connected.
- Touch and trackpad control: Trackpad mode and direct touch mode, with two-finger scroll and zoom, right click and drag.
- Keyboard input: On-screen keyboard, special key bar (esc, tab, ⌃ ⌥ ⌘ ⇧, arrow keys) and system shortcuts (Start menu, app switching, Task Manager and more). Windows PCs can be controlled with Mac shortcuts (⌘C → Ctrl+C).
- Multiple monitors: Select which monitor of the remote computer to display.
- File transfer and clipboard: Send files to the remote computer and receive files and clipboard content copied on the remote computer.

Requirements
- The Mac or Windows PC to be controlled needs the EGIS Remote host program with remote control and password access enabled.
- The App Store version (iPhone, iPad and Mac) is used to control other computers.

name: Elev8 Club
description:
Elev8 Club is an AI-powered, all-in-one gym management platform designed to simplify daily operations for gym owners, trainers, and fitness centers while delivering a seamless experience for members. From membership management to attendance tracking and smart insights, Elev8 Club helps you run your gym efficiently, intelligently, and professionally.

Whether you manage a small fitness studio or a large multi-branch gym, Elev8 Club brings automation, accuracy, and control right to your fingertips.

name: EMA Maintenance
description:
EMA Maintenance is the maintenance app for hotel teams that work with EMA Hospitality. Technicians, chief engineers, general managers, front desk and housekeeping staff use it to report problems, get work assigned and close jobs from their phones.

Sign in with the account your hotel gives you. Accounts are created by your hotel; there is no public sign-up.

REPORT A PROBLEM
- Scan the EMA tag on a room or piece of equipment, or choose the room or area
- Speak It: say the room and the problem in English or Spanish, and the app fills in the work order for you to confirm
- Add photos and videos
- Follow your reports from Sent to Fixed

DO THE WORK
- Start your shift and get the next job offered to you by priority
- Accept, start and stop the clock, mark Awaiting Parts, and close with a cause
- Life Safety and Guest In House work comes first
- End your shift and hand off open jobs with a note or a voice note

STAY IN TOUCH
- A conversation for every room and area, your team's Shift Handover, and direct messages
- Notifications for work assigned to you, messages that need you and safety alerts
- Catch up on what happened since your last shift

FOR CHIEF ENGINEERS AND GENERAL MANAGERS
- Dispatch Board: who is on shift, what each person is working on, and the queue by priority
- Assign, reassign or return work to the queue

MADE FOR THE TEAM
- English and Spanish
- Face ID or Touch ID to open the app
- Works with larger text sizes

Help: emamaintain.com/support
Privacy: emamaintain.com/privacy

name: Employee Self Service (IND)
description:
Employee Self Service (ESS- IND)
Stay connected with your workplace anytime, anywhere. The ESS app empowers employees to manage their own work-related tasks with ease and convenience.
With ESS, you can:
Apply for leave instantly.
Submit manual attendance
View and download job card
Access and update your employee profile
Stay informed with workplace updates
Designed for simplicity and efficiency, ESS makes your day-to-day work transactions faster, smarter, and hassle-free.
Take control of your work life — all from your mobile device.

name: Endless Alap
description:
Slow Indian classical music that never ends, for the background.

Endless Alap plays an alap, the slow, free opening of a Hindustani raga: a bansuri (bamboo flute) wanders over a tanpura drone, phrase after phrase, with no beat to follow and no fixed ending. It never repeats and it never needs a playlist.

EIGHT RAGAS, FROM MORNING TO DEEP NIGHT
Todi, Bhairavi, Desh, Bhupali, Yaman, Marwa, Darbari and Malkauns, each tuned in just intonation so the flute sits cleanly against the drone. Pick one, or switch on rotation and let the day move from morning to night on its own, about ten minutes at a time.

WHAT YOU HEAR
- A bansuri made from recorded notes, bent from note to note the way a player's breath and fingers do, with soft breaths between phrases
- A tanpura drone that never plays the same cycle twice
- A quiet sarod-like string layer that follows the raga
- Muted, tabla-like taps that drift in pace, now and then build for a few bars, and fall away
- Every so often, a bar or two of just flute and drums

MADE FOR THE BACKGROUND
- Keeps playing with the screen locked
- Play and pause from the lock screen or your headphones
- Sleep timer that fades out after 30 minutes, 1 or 2 hours
- Sliders for the flute, the drone, the taps and the silence between phrases
- Choose your own Sa, the key everything is tuned to
- Works offline: the music is made on your device, nothing is streamed

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking, no analytics. Everything stays on your phone.

PRICE
Endless Alap is free for 30 minutes of listening every day. Unlimited Listening is an auto-renewing subscription: $0.99 per month or $7.99 per year (prices vary by country). Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, and the subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it any time in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://apopov.de/alap/privacy/

CREDITS
The flute is made from bansuri recordings by PhonosUPF on Freesound, released under the CC0 public domain dedication.

name: EPIX TOEIC
description:
EPIX TOEIC là ứng dụng luyện thi TOEIC trên điện thoại, đủ cả Listening, Reading, Speaking và Writing.

THI THỬ NHƯ THI THẬT
• Full Test 200 câu trong 120 phút, chấm điểm thang 990 ngay khi nộp
• Thi riêng Listening hoặc Reading, hoặc chọn từng Part
• Thi thử Speaking và Writing đúng cấu trúc đề

LUYỆN NGHE ĐỌC
• Luyện từng Part 1 đến 7, xem đáp án và lời giải sau mỗi câu
• Luyện theo chủ điểm: ngữ pháp Part 5, dạng văn bản Part 6 và 7
• Marathon: làm liền nhiều đề cùng một Part
• Sổ lỗi sai gom lại các câu đã làm sai để ôn

LUYỆN NÓI VIẾT CÓ AI CHẤM
• Ghi âm Speaking ngay trên điện thoại
• AI chấm theo tiêu chí, nhận xét lỗi và gợi ý bài tốt hơn
• Luyện từng câu Nói Viết, có bài mẫu theo từng mức điểm

TỪ VỰNG VÀ NGHE
• Vũ Trụ từ vựng: thẻ có hình, chia theo level, ôn đúng lúc sắp quên
• Nghe chép và nói nhại để luyện tai, luyện phát âm
• Tra từ, dịch câu ngay trong bài

THEO DÕI TIẾN BỘ
• Lộ trình hành tinh: mỗi mốc điểm là một hành tinh, đi dần tới 990
• Lịch sử bài làm, điểm từng Part, gợi ý bài nên làm mỗi ngày

Tạo tài khoản hoặc đăng nhập để bắt đầu.

EPIX TOEIC là đơn vị luyện thi độc lập, không liên kết với ETS. TOEIC là nhãn hiệu của ETS.

Hỗ trợ: epixtoeic.admin@gmail.com

name: ESCIST
description:
ESCIST brings stock and ETF research, everyday finance tools together in one iPhone app.

**Follow the markets**  
Search for stocks and ETFs, build a personal watchlist, and explore interactive price charts from one week to one year. Open any symbol’s research page to view company profiles, key statistics, financial statements, earnings dates, dividend and split history, and trading hours.

**Practice trading**  
Start with $100,000 in virtual cash. Review simulated buy and sell orders, track your holdings and available cash, and see how your paper portfolio changes over time.

**Read market news**  
Browse headlines with publisher names clearly displayed. Open articles in the built-in reader and bookmark stories to revisit later.

**Use practical finance tools**  
Explore how recurring deposits and compound interest affect a savings projection. Calculate trade returns after fees, or photograph receipts and organize them by merchant, amount, and category.

ESCIST supports light and dark appearance on iPhone.

name: EventPixel: QR Photo Sharing
description:
EventPixel gathers every photo your guests take at your wedding, party or event into one gallery, with one QR code.

Your guests don't need this app. They scan your QR code with their phone camera and upload straight from the browser: no app to install, no account to create.

This app is for the host. Use it to:
• Show your event's QR code full screen, even with no signal
• Get a notification when guests add new photos
• Watch the gallery fill up live, during the event
• Save photos to your iPhone, or share them with AirDrop, Messages and Mail
• See your RSVPs and guest list
• Sign in with Apple or Google

Made for weddings, birthdays, baby and bridal showers, reunions, corporate events and every party in between.

Already use EventPixel on the web? Sign in with the same account: your events and galleries are all here.

name: Evergreen: Christmas Tree
description:
Design the tree you have in mind, then shop with a plan instead of guessing. Try ornaments, lights and toppers in different sizes, move things around until it looks the way you imagined, and get a list of what to buy, with sizes and quantities.
• Decorate by hand. Pick a tree height, then add ornaments, lights, toppers and more. Drag things around and swap sizes until the tree looks right.
• Start with a style. Ten ready-made looks, from Classic Christmas to Gingerbread House. Choose a tree height, then change anything you like.
• Describe your idea. Tell Tree Stylist what you're picturing, like a snowy woodland tree, and pick from two suggested designs.
• Get your shopping list. Every decoration in your design, grouped by type, with sizes or lengths and quantities. The list is based on the front of the tree, so plan on extra for the sides and back.
• Save and share. Name your designs, keep them in My Trees, or share a picture of the finished tree.
A countdown on the home screen shows how many days are left until Christmas.

name: Everyone Gift: Holiday List
description:
The holidays are right around the corner again, and your gift list is still just in your head? Don’t worry this app will help you remember everyone and get everything done without the extra stress.
Christmas, New Year’s, family birthdays, friends’ weddings, or Secret Santa at work when there are plenty of gifts to manage, it’s easy to get lost. Scattered notes, misplaced wishlists, and that last-minute question, "Did I already order this, or do I still need to buy wrapping paper?" are officially a thing of the past.
This is your calm, private space that guides every gift from the very first random thought to a wrapped box with a ribbon on top.
Get ready for the holidays with joy, and rest assured that everyone gets a gift this time.

name: Exitway: Arrow Escape Puzzle
description:
Clear the jam, one arrow at a time.

Exitway is a clean, clever arrow escape puzzle. Every arrow can only leave the board through its head — tap one whose road is clear and it slides out along its own path. Tap one that's blocked and it bounces back… and costs you a heart. Find the right order, empty the board, and roll on to the next level.

FAIR ADS — A PROMISE, NOT A SLOGAN
• Never an ad in the middle of a level, never when you open the game
• No ads at all during the first levels
• Rewarded videos only when YOU ask for them (free hint, refill your hearts, double your coins)
• Remove ads once, for good — rewarded videos stay optional
• Ads are muted whenever the game is muted

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Aim, then release: press to preview an arrow's path, release to send it, slide away to cancel — no more mis-taps
• Undo your last move
• View the whole board in one tap, pinch to zoom on big levels
• Optional grid, dark mode, and a colourless high-contrast theme
• No timer, no energy, no forced leagues. Your board is saved the moment you leave

A REAL CHALLENGE
• Thousands of unique levels that get genuinely harder: bent arrows, longer chains, tricky board shapes
• A "Hard" level every ten — with a bigger reward
• A new Daily Puzzle every day, the same board for every player. Build your streak!
• Earn stars and coins, unlock 4 more visual themes

DESIGNED TO FEEL GOOD
• Road-sign graphics that stay readable on any screen
• Snappy animations, short sounds and gentle haptics — each can be turned off
• Plays fully offline, no account, no sign-in

Every level is checked by a solver before you see it: there is always a way out.

name: Export Contacts: Excel CSV PDF
description:
Export Contacts turns the contacts on your iPhone into a file you can use: an Excel workbook, a CSV file, a vCard or a printable PDF. It also does the reverse and turns a spreadsheet into contacts. Everything happens on your iPhone.

SEE IT BEFORE YOU PAY
The preview shows your own contacts exactly as they will appear in the file. The free version then writes the first 10 contacts, so you can open the file where you need it. One purchase unlocks everything. It is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.

EXPORT
• Excel (.xlsx): one row per contact, a header row, and phone numbers stored as text, so leading zeros and plus signs are kept
• CSV: a standard layout, or the column names that Outlook and Google Contacts expect for import
• vCard (.vcf): for moving contacts to another phone, computer or account, with photos
• PDF: a compact list or a detailed directory, on A4 or US Letter
• All contacts, chosen lists, chosen accounts, or people you pick one by one
• Choose which fields to include

COMPLETE FIELDS
Every phone number, email address and postal address of a contact, each with its label. Company, department and job title. Birthday and other dates. Websites, social profiles, related names and lists. Names in any script, including right-to-left names and emoji.

IMPORT
• From Excel (.xlsx), CSV or vCard
• Columns are matched by their names; change any match with a tap
• A review shows which contacts will be added and which look like duplicates
• Undo removes the contacts the last import added
• The app only adds contacts. It never changes or deletes the ones you have
• A spreadsheet template is included

PRIVATE
• The app makes no network requests. Your contacts are not uploaded anywhere
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• A file leaves your iPhone only when you share or save it yourself

GOOD TO KNOW
• Notes are not included in this version. Apple grants apps access to contact notes separately
• Spreadsheets cannot hold photos; vCard and PDF can
• If you gave the app access to only some contacts, only those can be exported. The app shows how many it can see
• Old .xls files and .numbers files are not read; save them as .xlsx or CSV first

FREE AND PAID
Free: full previews, files with the first 10 contacts, and imports of the first 10 contacts.
Unlock Everything, a one-time purchase: all contacts, every format, export and import.

Questions: arcticstudios.co/support

name: FahrPrep: Führerschein Theorie
description:
FahrPrep teaches the German car driving theory (class B) in plain English, German or Arabic.

Most apps give you a pile of questions to memorise. FahrPrep explains each rule first, shows it in an animated traffic scene, and checks at once that you understood.

IT LEARNS FROM YOUR MISTAKES
Every wrong answer tells FahrPrep which rule you missed and why. Those rules come back after 1, 3 and 7 days until they stick. Before the exam you get a personal exam-day sheet: one page with your weakest rules first.

WHAT IS INSIDE
• 14 chapters covering the class B curriculum: right of way, signs, speed and distance, parking, other road users, the points system, breakdowns and accidents, car technology and trailers
• 77 short lessons, each part about two minutes
• 442 exam-style practice questions with explanations
• Animated traffic scenes you can play step by step
• A tutor that answers your questions and knows which rules you keep missing
• An exam simulation scored in error points like the real exam
• English, German and Arabic, switchable at any time

FREE AND PRO
The first lesson of every chapter is free, along with smart practice and 5 tutor questions a week. FahrPrep Pro opens every lesson, the exam simulation, repeat-mistakes rounds, your exam-day sheet and 50 tutor questions a month.

GOOD TO KNOW
FahrPrep uses its own exam-style questions. They are not the official question catalogue, and FahrPrep is not connected to TÜV, DEKRA or any authority. The compulsory lessons at a driving school are still required. The traffic regulations (StVO) always have the final word.

Subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled in your store account.
Terms: https://fahrprep.com/terms
Privacy: https://fahrprep.com/privacy

name: Falcı AI – Coffee Reading
description:
Turn your cup over, let it cool, take a photo. Falcı AI marks every shape it sees in the coffee grounds right on your photo and reads it like a real Turkish coffee fortune teller.

COFFEE CUP READING
• Birds, roads, rings, hearts… each shape is shown on your photo
• Love, near future, work and money, home and family, travel and news
• Good signs and warnings alike, told honestly and kindly
• Listen to your reading aloud or send it to a friend with a code

DREAM INTERPRETATION
• Tell your dream and get a symbol-by-symbol interpretation based on traditional dream books
• Pick the most important moment and watch your dream become a painting
• Share your interpretation and dream painting as a card

5 LANGUAGES
English, Türkçe, Deutsch, العربية, Русский. The app asks which language you prefer on first launch, and readings are written in that language.

FREE AND DETAILED READINGS
• 3 short readings and 1 dream interpretation free every week
• Buy a single detailed reading any time
• Weekly Premium: 3 detailed readings a week, 3 dream interpretations a day and finer dream paintings

Start right away without an account, or save with Apple or Google to see your readings on any device.

Readings are for entertainment only and are not advice on health, legal or financial matters.

Privacy: https://ofistra.com/falciai/gizlilik
Terms of use: https://ofistra.com/falciai/kosullar

name: Fan Clacker
description:
Fan Clacker is where live EDM sets get rated by the people who listen to them.

Every night it finds the newest festival and club sets from official YouTube and SoundCloud uploads, across the biggest festivals and hundreds of artist channels. Each one plays right in the app, with a rating out of ten that comes from fans rather than an algorithm.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Browse by stage: dubstep, house, techno, trance, hardstyle, drum and bass
• See what is hot right now and what fans rated highest
• Rate any set from 1 to 10 while it plays
• Clack the sets you love to keep them
• Build playlists of full sets
• Pick your artists and get a notification when one of them drops a new set
• Let the radio run: a line-up of the hottest sets in your genres
• Comment on sets, and report or block anything that does not belong

HOW IT WORKS
Fan Clacker does not host music. Sets play through the official YouTube and SoundCloud players, so every listen counts for the artist and the channel that posted it.

An account is free and optional. Sign in with Apple, Google or Discord to rate, clack, comment and build playlists, or browse and listen without one.

name: Fantasy Lineup
description:
Most of your league is still guessing. You just got ten seasons of NFL data and a model with one job: your best lineup, every week.

Connect your ESPN, Yahoo or Sleeper league once, and Fantasy Lineup works out your week:

• Your best lineup under your league's exact slots, FLEX and SUPERFLEX included, with the swaps to make
• Set it on ESPN or Yahoo with one tap, only after you've seen and confirmed every move
• Your chance to win this week, and every close call flagged, so you know which decisions are coin flips
• Live: your matchup as the games are played, every player's points, where the score is heading and your chance to win, updated every half minute
• Waivers: who to add, who to drop, what each pickup adds this week and over the rest of the season, and what to bid in FAAB leagues
• Trade ideas that help both teams
• News: every projection the news has moved this week, yours first, with the reason for each
• Player cards: our projection beside ESPN's and Vegas', the season week by week, and the news on him
• Your playoff chances, the season ahead and your roster's grades, S to F
• 74 themes, from five looks to your favorite team's colors, dark or light

FREE AND PRO
Home and setting your lineup are free, every week. Pro unlocks Live, Waivers, News and player cards. Pro is $4.99 a month through your Apple account; cancel anytime in Settings.

YOUR LEAGUE, SAFE HANDS
Your league sign-in stays in your iPhone's Keychain and is never saved on our servers. Nothing in your league changes unless you tap it and confirm.

Fantasy Lineup isn't affiliated with ESPN, Yahoo, Sleeper, DraftKings, Kalshi or the NFL.

Terms of Use: https://fantasy-lineup.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://fantasy-lineup.com/privacy

name: Fast IPTV
description:
Fast IPTV, kendi IPTV aboneliğindeki canlı TV kanallarını, filmleri ve dizileri hızlı ve sade bir arayüzle izlemeni sağlayan bir oynatıcıdır.

ÖNEMLİ: Fast IPTV herhangi bir yayın, kanal ya da içerik sağlamaz. Uygulamayı kullanmak için bir IPTV sağlayıcısından aldığın Xtream Codes bilgilerini ya da M3U listeni eklemen gerekir. Hemen denemek için uygulamadaki telifsiz demo listesini kullanabilirsin.

ÖZELLİKLER
• Xtream Codes ve M3U (bağlantı ya da dosya) desteği
• Canlı TV, filmler ve diziler ayrı bölümlerde; kategoriye göre düzenli
• Aynı anda 4 yayına kadar çoklu ekran
• Favori kanallar: ekle, sürükleyerek sırala
• Kaldığın yerden devam et: film ve dizi bölümlerinde
• Altyazı ve ses dili seçimi
• Kanal değiştirince program bilgisi (EPG)
• 40'tan fazla dil
• Google ya da Apple ile giriş: listelerin, favorilerin ve izleme geçmişin iPhone, iPad, Windows bilgisayar ve LG webOS akıllı TV'de aynı

ÜYELİK
Yeni kullanıcılar ücretsiz deneme süresiyle başlar. Deneme sonrası "Kalıcı üyelik" ile uygulamayı süresiz kullanabilirsin. Satın alma Apple hesabına bağlıdır; "Satın alımları geri yükle" ile başka iPhone ya da iPad'de geri yükleyebilirsin. Otomatik yenileme yoktur.

Demo listesindeki filmler Blender Foundation'ın Creative Commons Attribution (CC BY) lisanslı açık filmleridir (© Blender Foundation, www.blender.org).

name: Feed Our Team
description:
Feed Our Team is the free catering directory built for traveling teams. Search the town, venue or tournament site you're headed to and see the restaurants that take team-sized orders, with the price per person, lead time, minimum order and delivery fee shown before you ever pick up the phone.

FIND A KITCHEN THAT CAN FEED THE ROSTER
• Search any city, venue or tournament site, or use your current location
• Filter by per-person budget, meal and dietary needs: gluten-free, nut-free, vegetarian, vegan, halal, high-protein
• See results as a list or on a map, nearest first

KNOW THE TERMS UP FRONT
• Price band per person
• Lead time, minimum order and delivery fee
• The full catering menu with prices

BUILD THE ORDER AND SEE THE COST PER HEAD
• Add items from the menu to a lineup
• Enter your headcount and get the cost per person instantly
• Share a kitchen with team parents or the booster club in one tap

SHORT ON TIME? WE'LL BOOK IT
Send the date, headcount and budget, and a real person at Feed Our Team finds a restaurant that fits and replies by email, usually within one business day. No charge.

BUILT FOR COACHES, TEAM MANAGERS AND TRAVEL COORDINATORS
• No account needed
• No ads, no tracking
• Save your go-to kitchens for the next road trip
• You order from and pay the restaurant directly. We never sit in the middle of your order

We're signing charter restaurants town by town. If we're not in your town yet, tell us where your team travels and that's where we go next.

name: feelsogood
description:
해외에서 혼자 지내는 날, 바쁜 하루 끝에 잠깐 숨 돌릴 곳이 필요할 때.
필쏘굿은 작은 다람쥐가 사는 아늑한 공원이에요. 해야 하는 일도, 연속 기록도, 재촉하는 알림도 없어요. 들어와서 잠깐 쉬다 가면 돼요.

■ 다람쥐와 함께하는 공원
· 내 동네 날씨와 계절에 맞춰 공원이 바뀌어요. 눈이 오면 공원에도 눈이 와요.
· 다람쥐에게 이름을 지어 주고, 도토리를 나눠 주고, 산책하는 모습을 지켜봐요.
· 다람쥐네 집을 가구로 꾸미고, 트리에 오너먼트를 달아요.

■ 마음 산책
· 오늘 할 일을 적으면 연못에 연등이 떠요. 다 하면 하늘로 날아가요.
· 숨 고르기: 원을 따라 1분만 천천히 숨 쉬어요.
· 걱정 묻어두기: 적은 걱정을 다람쥐가 땅에 묻어 줘요. 어디에도 저장하지 않아요.
· 오늘 마음 날씨: 탭 한 번으로 오늘 마음을 남겨요.
· 고마운 일을 적으면 광장 꽃밭에 꽃이 피어요.

■ 랜덤 편지
· 어딘가의 누군가에게 따뜻한 편지를 보내고, 답장을 받아요.
· 이름 대신 익명 별명으로만 오가요. 불편한 편지는 바로 신고·차단할 수 있어요.

■ 다람쥐 신문
· 매일 아침 7시, 우체부 새가 신문을 가져다줘요.
· 어제의 나, 오늘의 운세, 내 동네 날씨와 옷차림, 오늘의 여행지, 낱말 퀴즈(영어·프랑스어·일본어)가 실려요.
· 내가 아는 동네 맛집을 독자 추천으로 알려 줄 수 있어요.

■ 다람쥐 백화점과 광장
· 놀이터에서 모은 도토리로 오너먼트, 가구, 꽃씨를 사요. 모든 물건은 앱 안 도토리로만 사요.

필쏘굿은 의료 서비스가 아니에요. 마음이 많이 힘들 때는 가까운 전문가나 상담 기관에 꼭 이야기해 주세요. 한국 109, 미국·캐나다 988에서 24시간 이야기를 들어 줘요.
