name: FeltChute--Baffle chute run
description:
FeltChute premieňa malé plstené ihrisko na logickú hru s presným plánovaním dráhy.

Otáčajte mosadzné odkláňacie prvky v presne určených uhloch, nastavte poradie štartov a nasmerujte každú farebnú guľôčku do žľabu rovnakej farby. Sklony a vodiace lišty určujú smer pádu, no rozhodujúci je jednorazový odraz: každý náklon odkláňa guľôčku doľava alebo doprava podľa vášho zámeru.

Prechádzajte jednotlivými rozloženiami kampane v atlase a postupne odomykajte nové ihriská. Každodenná výzva prináša nové počiatočné rozloženie. Na bočnom stolíku si precvičujte prácu s uhlami, pri náročných rozloženiach využite nápovedy a po úspešnom dokončení ihriska odomknite ďalšiu úlohu.

Bez účtu. Váš postup zostáva uložený vo vašom zariadení. Hra je ideálna na krátke hranie, pri ktorom sa viac cení premyslené mierenie než rýchle klepanie na obrazovku.

name: Fener Adası
description:
Denizin ortasında küçük bir ada, ışığını kaybetmiş bir bahçe ve elinde pirinç bir fener.

Fener Adası sakin bir ışık bulmacasıdır. Her bölümde oyma traverten taşlar karışık durur; bir taşa dokunduğunda çeyrek tur döner. Kanalları birleştir, fenerden çıkan altın ışığı her taşa ulaştır — son taş da ışığa kavuştuğunda bahçe uyanır, çiçekler açar.

DOKUN, DÖNDÜR, IŞIK AKSIN
• Tek dokunuşla oynanır, tek elle rahat.
• İlk bölümler oyunu sana gösterir: parlayan taşa dokun, ışığın aktığını izle.
• Süre sınırı, can, enerji ya da bekleme yok. Geri alma ve ipucu her zaman ücretsiz.

HER BÖLÜM ADANI BÜYÜTÜR
• Çözdüğün her bahçe adaya kalıcı bir çiçek diker; her beş bahçede avluda yeni bir fener yanar, martılar geri döner.
• Çiçek Defteri'ni doldur: gelincik, papatya, begonvil, lavanta… Üç yıldızla uyanan bahçeler nadir renkleri açar.

HER GÜN YENİ BULMACA
• Her gün yeni bir günlük bahçe. Çözdüğün her günlük bulmaca gökyüzüne bir takımyıldız ekler.
• Seri baskısı yok: bir gün kaçırırsan hiçbir şey eksilmez.

ÜCRETSİZ VE DÜRÜST
• İlk 20 bölüm ve her günün bulmacası ücretsizdir.
• Uzak Adalar (tek seferlik satın alma): 21–60. bölümler, kırk yeni bahçe ve daha büyük tahtalar.
• Gün Batımı (tek seferlik satın alma): gökyüzünü ve denizi sıcak bir gün batımı paletine boyar.
• Abonelik yok, reklam yok, oyun içi para yok.

RAHAT VE ERİŞİLEBİLİR
• Az Hareket ayarı (iPhone ayarına da uyar), ekran parlamasını azaltma, ses ve titreşim ayarları.
• Işık akışı yalnız renkle değil, parlaklık ve desenle de ayrılır.

GİZLİLİK
• Hesap yok, veri toplama yok, takip yok. İlerlemen yalnız kendi cihazında saklanır.

Fenerini al; ada seni bekliyor.

name: Ferrum Halo Pilgrim
description:
A small pilgrim. A heavy circle of possibility.

Enter a desert civilization of weathered iron, copper ruins and sleeping sun arches. Two forged weapons circle your cloak. Steer through the ruins, choose your encounters and shape your halo to survive the journey north.

MAKE EVERY ORBIT COUNT
Your weapons strike automatically; your movement makes the difference. Land a surviving iron ball on a guardian's body to defeat them. When weapons collide, higher grades break lower grades, while equal grades shatter together. Read the ranks, judge the distance and decide what you can afford to lose.

SHAPE YOUR HALO
Fold your orbit for faster, close-range strikes. Expand it for greater reach. Reverse its spin to change your approach. Collect copper prisms to strengthen your surviving weapons and twin relics to grow your halo from two balls to as many as six.

CROSS 100 DESERT TRIALS
Travel through ten chapters across five visual regions. Navigate stone-rib passages, winding terraces, broken causeways and gatekeeper courts. Teleport wells, crosswinds, magnetic pylons, sun seals and crowned guardians change the challenge along the way. Clear each crossing's objectives and reach its sun arch before the sun clock runs out.

TEMPER TEN DISTINCT WEAPON GRADES
Progress from Basalt and Copper Gear to Frost Prism, Storm Star, Moonwing and the Eclipse Sovereign. Each grade has its own color and silhouette, with higher ranks gaining larger forms and animated energy halos.

TURN RELICS INTO OPPORTUNITY
Activate WARD to briefly protect your weapons and armor. Use SLOW to reduce guardian movement and spin while you keep moving at full speed. Charges are limited, so choose your moment.

RETURN TO THE CARAVAN
Claim daily supplies, explore the interactive field guide and revisit crossings to improve your stars and personal records. Your progress and best completed runs are saved locally on your iPhone.

Built for portrait iPhone play. Play offline, with no account, ads, in-app purchases or tracking.

Shape your iron. Find the sun.

name: FieldPrism
description:
FieldPrism er et verktøy for automasjonsingeniører, vedlikeholdsteknikere og andre som kontrollerer endringer i industrisensorer. Sammenlign en grunnkonfigurasjon med én eller flere kandidater, se hvilke signaler som berøres, og dokumenter resultatet av kontrollen.

• Sammenlign sensorkonfigurasjoner. Importer IODD-filer i XML- eller ZIP-format. Bruk bitkartet til å se hvilke felt som har endret bitbredde, posisjon eller egenskaper.

• Finn berørte signaler. Importer PLS-tilordninger fra CSV eller registrer dem manuelt. Skill mellom tagger med samme navn ved å se hvilken arbeidsstasjon, port og hvilket felt de er knyttet til.

• Undersøk eksempelkurver. Sammenlign referansen og avlesningen målepunkt for målepunkt. Øv på å gjenkjenne trykkavvik, manglende avlesninger og signaler fra feil arbeidsstasjon.

• Dokumenter og følg opp. Lagre kontrollresultater og merknader for hvert signal. Knytt et opprinnelig målepunkt fra et eksempel til kontrollen som bevis, og åpne det igjen direkte fra arkivet.

Gjenbruk tilordninger med maler, og eksporter en Markdown-rapport med utstyrskilder, endringer, kontrollresultater og åpne punkter til overlevering.

name: Find My Bluetooth Devices Clap
description:
Can't see your phone, but you know it's close? Clap or whistle and Find My Bluetooth Devices Clap plays a loud alarm. Lost your earbuds instead? Follow their Bluetooth signal until you are right next to them.

Find My Bluetooth Devices Clap puts two simple ways to find things in one free app, with no ads, no purchases and no account.

CLAP OR WHISTLE TO FIND YOUR PHONE
• Tap Start listening, put the phone down and carry on. When you need it, clap (two or three times, depending on sensitivity) or whistle.
• Find My Bluetooth Devices Clap plays an alarm and can also vibrate and flash the flashlight, so you can hear or see where the phone is.
• Choose what it listens for: claps, whistles or both.
• Five sensitivity levels and a 10-second Test detection help you tune it for your room.
• Pick the alarm sound, volume and duration, or import your own sound (MP3, M4A, WAV or AIFF).
• Optional auto-off timer: 1, 3 or 8 hours.
• Listening keeps working with the screen locked, as long as Find My Bluetooth Devices Clap stays open in the background.

FIND NEARBY BLUETOOTH DEVICES
• Nearby lists devices around you that advertise Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE), such as many earbuds, headphones, watches, speakers and tags.
• Open a device to see a live signal meter with an estimated distance and a warmer or colder hint as you walk.
• Turn on proximity haptics to feel the signal getting stronger.
• Play a 10-second tone on your current Bluetooth audio output to hear connected headphones.
• Search, filter by signal strength, sort, and rename the devices you save.

REMEMBER WHERE A DEVICE WAS LAST HEARD
• Save a device with the star. While Find My Bluetooth Devices Clap is open and scanning, it marks on a map where your iPhone was when that device was heard.
• See when and where it was last seen, open walking directions in Maps or share the spot.
• Location history stays on your iPhone, can be turned off and can be cleared at any time.

HISTORY
• Every alarm and every device you mark as found is listed in History, with filters.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Sound is analyzed on your iPhone. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
• Saved devices, locations, history and imported sounds stay on your device.
• No account, no ads, no analytics, no tracking.
• English and Vietnamese, light and dark appearance.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Distance is an estimate based on signal strength. Walls, people and cases change the signal, so use it as a guide, not a measurement.
• iOS lets apps discover Bluetooth Low Energy devices only. Devices that use only Bluetooth Classic, or that are switched off, out of battery or out of range, will not appear.
• Listening uses the microphone continuously and uses more battery. Swiping Find My Bluetooth Devices Clap away in the app switcher stops listening, and phone calls pause it.
• Clap and whistle detection works best in a fairly quiet room. Loud noise can cause missed or false alarms.
• No Bluetooth devices around? Turn on Demo Bluetooth in Settings to try Nearby with simulated devices.

Find My Bluetooth Devices Clap is free: no subscription and no in-app purchases.

name: Flash Riders Racing
description:
Your next ride is part of the course. Race a bike down a trail, cross a change gate, and carry on by skateboard. On flight sections, the ground drops away and wings take over.

Hold to accelerate and drag to steer through riders, bends, ramps and tunnels. The course changes your vehicle as you go, so a stretch of road can lead into a very different kind of descent.

Nitro builds during the run, with extra charge from jumps and drifts. Watch the meter, then tap the boost control when it fills to make your move on the pack.

Ride across mountain roads, snowy slopes and volcanic tracks. Launch over gaps, pass through tunnels, and race beneath dragons sweeping over a lava course.

Between runs, upgrade your bike's frame, fork, shocks and wheels. Choose your rider and mix helmets, tops, pants and shoes in the wardrobe before heading back to the course.

Flash Riders Racing features solo races against computer-controlled opponents.

name: FleetHive
description:
FleetHive is the phone app for companies that run vehicles and the people who drive them: trucks, vans, buses, couriers, field service, hire cars and farm vehicles.

When the app opens it asks who is using the phone.

FOR DRIVERS
• Log in with your company code and a 4-digit PIN
• Slide to clock on, take breaks and clock off; your hours are recorded for you
• Do the pre-trip check and photograph any damage
• Snap fuel slips and expenses and send them to the office
• See today's jobs, follow the route and capture a signature at the drop
• Report an accident or breakdown, or press SOS to alert your managers with your location
• Get your payslips and read and sign warnings in the app
• No signal? Photos wait on the phone and upload when signal is back

FOR OWNERS AND MANAGERS
• Every vehicle on a live map, from the drivers' phones; no trackers to fit
• Push alerts for SOS and serious incidents
• Approve fuel slips and expenses, match traffic fines to the driver
• Licence, permit and document expiry reminders
• Job cards and repairs from failed checks
• Payroll-ready hours, overtime, allowances and deductions

FleetHive works with your company's FleetHive account. Drivers get their company code and PIN from their manager; owners and managers sign in with their email.

Location is used only while a driver is clocked on, to show the vehicle on the company's map and to attach a location to SOS and incident reports. It stops when they clock off.

name: FlnCarpBaits
description:
FlnCarpBaits este aplicația oficială a magazinului flncarpbaits.ro: nade și momeli pentru pescuitul la crap, din rețete proprii, fabricate în România, din 2008.

Ce găsești în aplicație:

• Căutare rapidă și categorii cu poze.
• Coș și comandă direct în aplicație, cu plata ramburs sau cu cardul.
• 10% reducere la comenzile făcute din aplicație.
• Notificări despre oferte și produse noi.
• Contact rapid pe WhatsApp și navigație către atelier.

Rețete proprii, verificate pe baltă.

name: Flood & Snow Weather Globe
description:
Explore a world of weather, then zoom into the places that matter.

Flood & Snow Weather Globe brings an interactive 3D Earth, regional Apple Maps, dated NASA observations and Apple Weather forecasts together.

FROM THE WORLD TO YOUR AREA
Rotate the globe, tap a region or pinch closer to open Apple Maps. Search for a city without granting GPS access, inspect the regional map and open a forecast for its center.

WATCH RAIN AND SNOW OBSERVATIONS
View NASA IMERG precipitation estimates. Colors distinguish estimated rain and snow intensity; Plus unlocks the half-hour observation timeline and playback. Satellite processing introduces a delay, shown with the observation time. This is not live radar.

EXPLORE FLOOD AND SNOW COVER
Plus includes NASA flood observations and snow-cover layers, with legends and available daily history. Flood observations use a three-day window. Snow cover shows detected cover, not existing snow depth. Missing or uncolored data does not establish safe or snow-free conditions.

FOLLOW PRECIPITATION AT YOUR LOCATION
Choose a city and scrub forward through its Apple Weather hourly forecast. A marker sits at the city's coordinates on both 3D Earth and Apple Maps. Predicted type and liquid-equivalent amount determine its rain streaks, snowflakes, sleet or hail. The chance, forecast hour and local time zone sit beside the map. Reduce Motion keeps the forecast symbol still.

FIND THE NEXT CHANGE
Choose a 30%, 50% or 70% chance and see the first continuous window that reaches it. Inspect the peak chance and hour. Compare current conditions with the hourly forecast, predicted snowfall and available advisories from regional authorities. Plus extends the daily outlook to ten days.

KEEP YOUR PLACES CLOSE
Free access includes one saved place, the globe, latest rain-and-snow observations, cloud imagery, current conditions, hourly forecasts and today's outlook. Plus includes up to 100 saved places, the ten-day outlook, premium observation layers and history. Data coverage and freshness vary by region and source.

Use official local warnings and emergency guidance for safety decisions. The app is for weather exploration and planning.

Subscription prices and billing periods are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple subscription settings. Restore Purchases is available in the app.

name: Flooring Takeoff Scan
description:
See the boxes behind your flooring quote.

Flooring Takeoff Scan turns reviewed room measurements into floor area, waste allowance, whole-box quantities and estimated material and labor cost.

SCAN OR ENTER YOUR ROOMS
Scan visible room surfaces on supported LiDAR-equipped iPhone and iPad models, or enter dimensions manually. Organize rooms and floors in a saved project and review the plan.

MAKE THE ASSUMPTIONS VISIBLE
Set waste, package coverage, package price and labor rate. The takeoff rounds up to whole packages, so you can see how the measured area becomes the quantity to order.

REFINE THE PLAN
Edit room shapes, dimensions, positions and levels. Mark dimensions verified after checking them on site. View plan labels and area in metric or imperial display units.

KEEP THE JOB TOGETHER
Save photos, notes and material settings with the project. Plus includes complete PDF exports for reviewed takeoffs.

TRY ONE PROJECT
Free access includes one saved flooring project and watermarked PDF previews. Plus unlocks continued project creation and complete exports. Existing projects remain readable and editable after expiry.

Measurements and quantities are estimates. Verify critical dimensions, product coverage and installation requirements on site. The app does not optimize roll seams or cutting patterns.

Subscription prices and billing periods are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple subscription settings. Restore Purchases is available in the app.

Set a room goal and review each saved room’s detected wall coverage. Shape a room in 3D, label it, and place doors or windows on a wall you choose. Optional photos stay with the room where you took them.

Website: https://www.trisphereapps.com
Support: https://www.trisphereapps.com/contact
Privacy Policy: https://www.trisphereapps.com/privacypolicy

name: Floppy Match
description:
Match colorful pieces, clear cookies, and help Floppy explore three garden scenes. Swap neighboring pieces to make a match, then combine special pieces to tackle tougher boards.

Play at your own pace, replay levels to improve your stars, and decorate Floppy’s garden with the items you collect.

name: Florivanta
description:
Florivanta turns your plant collection into a living greenhouse. Every plant you own appears as a hand-drawn potted illustration on a wooden shelf — succulents, ferns, palms, flowering plants, cacti and trailing vines are each drawn procedurally, so no two look alike. A small water droplet under each pot empties as watering day comes closer, so you can see who is thirsty at a glance.

CARE THAT ANSWERS BACK
Open a plant and log care with one tap: Watered, Fertilised, Misted or Repotted. The plant blooms, its care ring refills and the next due date is set from your own schedule. Forgot to tap? Log earlier care on the day it actually happened and the schedule recalculates.

THE CARE VINE
Flip the leaf toggle to see one vertical vine across all your plants: what needs care now, everything coming up in the next two weeks, and every care moment you've logged. Mark tasks done straight from the vine.

GROWTH, HEALTH AND A PHOTO JOURNAL
- Height measurements with an animated growth chart, change since the first measurement and growth per month (centimetres or inches)
- Health notes (thriving, doing OK, needs attention) — the newest note sets the plant's status
- Photo journal built from progress photos and notes, oldest to newest
- Plant profiles with name, species, kind, room, light, acquired date, pot glaze and an optional photo

ORGANISED YOUR WAY
- Hanging tags filter the shelves by room, plant kind or "needs care"
- Search by name, species or room; sort by thirstiest, name, newest or room
- Archive plants you've gifted or retired without losing their history

REMINDERS
Local notifications on the day a plant needs water or food — one per plant, or a single daily digest at the time you choose. Turn reminders off per plant.

WORKS OFFLINE, OPTIONAL CLOUD BACKUP
Everything works without a connection. An optional private cloud backup keeps a copy of your records under an anonymous identifier — there is no account, no sign-in and nothing to register. Full-size photos stay on your iPhone. Turn backup off or delete the cloud copy any time.

YOUR DATA
Export a full JSON backup, your care log or your plant list as CSV. No ads, no tracking.

Light and dark appearance, haptics, Dynamic Type friendly text and VoiceOver labels throughout.

Care intervals are your own choices plus general starting points per plant kind — not professional horticultural advice.

name: Flow Life
description:
اكتشف تجربة الاسترخاء والعناية مع تطبيق Flow Life.
يوفر لك التطبيق طريقة سهلة وسريعة للتعرف على خدمات فلو لايف، استعراض الخيارات المتاحة، واختيار ما يناسبك بكل راحة.
