name: Flow Pilates | فلو بيلاتس
description:
Flow Pilates House is a premium reformer Pilates studio in Jeddah, offering small-group classes designed to give you personalized attention in every movement.

At Flow, we focus on proper technique, mindful movement, and effective training. Every class is thoughtfully designed around your level, goals, and body so you can move better, feel stronger, and build a deeper connection with your body.

name: Fly: AI Notes
description:
fly is the AI notes app that files itself.

Type it, say it or share it into one box. fly puts each thing on the right page and the right list, so you never organize a folder again.

JUST WRITE
Jot down a messy thought, a grocery run or a voice note. fly turns it into to-dos, reminders and tables on the page where it belongs.

JUST ASK
Can't find it? Ask. fly answers from your own notes and links straight to the line.

NOTHING CHANGES WITHOUT YOUR OK
Every edit the AI suggests shows up in green and red. Keep it or toss it with one tap.

WORKS WITH THE AI YOU ALREADY USE
Connect Claude or ChatGPT once, and they can read your notes and suggest edits that wait in fly for your approval. Hand any page or to-do to the assistant you like in one tap.

SAVE ANYTHING, FROM ANYWHERE
Share a photo, link or file from any app. fly picks the page, and you review it.

YOUR FILES, ANSWERED
Attach a PDF or spreadsheet and ask. fly reads it and does the math.

PLAN IT TOGETHER
Share a page or a whole folder with people you invite. See who is on the page and what they changed.

SET IT ONCE
Meal plans, list refreshes and a weekly recap can run on a schedule.

YOU STAY IN CHARGE
fly asks before any of your notes go to its AI, and you can lock any page. Locked pages stay private from the AI and from connected apps. Without AI, you can still write and organize by hand.

Privacy policy: https://useflynotes.com/privacy/ · Terms: https://useflynotes.com/terms/

name: FocusSpindle
description:
Give each task a time budget and work one session at a time. Choose a task, start the timer, pause when needed and finish to record the time you used. The timer calculates elapsed time from saved timestamps, including time in the background. It does not send completion notifications.

Review session history and compare recorded time with task budgets. Edit tasks, mark them complete, delete sessions and export records as JSON. Completed task records and session history remain separate, so deleting a task does not erase its past sessions.

Core features work offline. Free, with no account, ads or in-app purchases. Choose English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese or Italian, and System, Light or Dark appearance. Sample records are optional; new collections start empty.

name: Fold Nook: Origami Guide
description:
Learn origami and paper craft with illustrated instructions and videos that follow each step.

START WITH THREE SIMPLE PROJECTS
Fold a Triangle, a Kite, or a Chevron Strip. Then explore 224 projects across origami, modular paper, kirigami, paper crafts, and paper strips.

WATCH AT YOUR OWN PACE
Tap a step to jump straight to it. Pause, rewind, or change the playback speed. Download videos to watch them offline.

PRACTICE WITH FOLDING CHALLENGES
Match the target outline in 50 challenges. Save your favorite projects and pick up a lesson where you left off.

TRY IT FREE
Start with 25 lessons and 10 challenges. A one-time Lifetime Access purchase unlocks every lesson, video, challenge, and paper design.

Terms of Use
https://sites.google.com/view/foldnook/terms-of-use

name: Foldwell: Contacts Cleaner
description:
Foldwell tidies your contacts without the fear. It finds duplicates, shows you exactly what the merged card will look like, and saves a backup before every change, so you can undo or restore at any time.

SAFE BY DESIGN
• Preview every merge and choose, field by field, which phone, email or address wins
• A backup is saved before every change. Undo right after, or restore any past backup later
• Never auto-merges contacts with different birthdays or different last names

PRIVATE
• Everything happens on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking, no network

MORE THAN DUPLICATES
• Contact checks: no phone, no email, no photo, placeholder names, shared numbers
• Tidy phone number formats (country code optional)
• Suggested groups by company or email domain, and empty-group cleanup
• Light, dark or system appearance

FREE TO TRY
Scanning is free, with 3 free merges. Unlock everything once with Foldwell Plus. No subscription.

Note: Apple does not let apps read or write Notes, caller photos, ringtones or pronouns on contacts. Foldwell tells you before a merge so you can copy them first.

name: Foliofold: PDF Booklet Studio
description:
Good pages. In the right order.

Foliofold is a dedicated pocket print studio designed to transform standard multi-page PDF documents into correctly imposed booklet sheets ready for double-sided printing, center-folding, and saddle-stitch binding.

Whether you are crafting personal zines, music score booklets, workshop manuals, poetry collections, or pocket journals, Foliofold handles the intricate mathematics of signature imposition automatically on your iPhone.

KEY FEATURES:
• Seamless PDF Import: Select any readable PDF up to 240 pages and 30 MB.
• Mathematical Imposition: Automatically arranges pages in landscape facing pairs with 24 pt safe margins and automated blank padding per signature.
• Paper & Binding Standards: Support for A4 and US Letter sizes with left-to-right or right-to-left binding orientations.
• Range Selection & Page Exclusions: Pick custom page ranges (e.g. 1-4, 7, 10-12) or selectively exclude front and back covers with full undo support.
• Preflight Document Check: Verify crop boxes, rotation, mixed page geometries, and scale before sending to the printer.
• Print Checklist Calculator: Estimate sheet requirements for 1 to 99 copies and track your printing batches signature by signature.
• Native Sharing & Export: Export imposed PDFs directly to AirPrint, Files, or external print services.
• 100% Offline & Private: All PDF rendering and signature imposition operate locally in your device sandbox without server uploads or external accounts.

FOLIOFOLD PLUS (One-Time In-App Purchase):
• Extended document capacity up to 240 source pages.
• Multi-signature split binding options (8, 12, 16, 24, or 32 pages per signature).

PRINTING GUIDE:
When printing exported booklet PDFs, select Actual Size (100%), Landscape orientation, and Two-Sided printing with "Flip on Short Edge" in your printer dialog. Disable printer-side booklet features to maintain exact imposition geometry.

name: FolioRoll
description:
FolioRoll lays out one saddle-stitched booklet on this iPhone. Choose 4, 8, or 12 pages, name the quire, and roll a brayer across the fold. Each side of the sheet picks up the page numbers that land there when the paper is folded. Flip the sheet, pull the next one, and keep the quire here.

FolioRoll does not print, export a PDF, or plan a perfect-bound book. It does not ask you to sign in. The numbers stay on this phone until you delete the quire or remove the app.

name: Fonbest
description: Tengok padang anda secara menyeluruh sebelum latihan bermula. Fonbest membantu jurulatih belia menyusun latihan ke dalam zon ruang yang terhad, mengawal berkongsi peralatan dan memutarkan kumpulan dengan presisi. Masukkan lakaran padang, letak stesen, tetapkan saiz kumpulan dan laluan transisi; aplikasi mengira semua konflik peralatan dan pemotongan laluan secara deterministik. Lihat bagaimana setiap susun atur mempengaruhi jarak transisi dan bilangan konflik, kemudian bandingkan pilihan bersebelahan untuk membuat keputusan terbaik. Simpan carta putaran padang dan jadual peralatan anda sebagai dokumen kerja yang boleh dibuka semula atau disalin untuk sesi akan datang yang berbeza.

name: Forest Sounds Timer
description:
Tap once and hear the forest. Soft rain, night woods or morning birds start playing straight away.
Set a 15, 30 or 60-minute timer and the sound fades out gently on its own, even with your screen locked.
No sign-up, no setup. A calm background sound that helps you wind down.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Open the app and tap the big play button.
2. Pick a timer, or leave it playing.
3. Lock your phone. The sound keeps going and fades out when the timer ends.

FREE SOUNDS
- Forest Rain: soft rain on leaves
- Night Woods: low wind and crickets
- Morning Birds: birdsong in a gentle breeze

PREMIUM SOUNDS
- Stream: water over stones
- Wind in Pines: gusts through the needles
- Distant Thunder: far rumbles and light rain
- Campfire: crackling logs

MADE FOR THE END OF THE DAY
- One screen: play, pause, sound and time left are always in view
- Seamless loops with smooth fades, no sudden starts or stops
- Plays in the background and from the lock screen
- Pauses by itself when you unplug your headphones
- Remembers your last sound and timer
- Works offline. Every sound is built in.
- No account, no ads, no tracking

PREMIUM
Unlock all seven sounds, custom timers from 5 minutes to 4 hours, and saved sound-and-timer presets for your favorite combinations.

Forest Sounds Timer plays relaxing background audio. It is not a medical device and doesn't diagnose or treat any condition.

SUBSCRIPTION
Premium is optional: $2.99 per week with a 3-day free trial, or $14.99 per year. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/forest-sounds-timer/privacy
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/forest-sounds-timer/terms

name: Forge Social
description:
You have started on a Monday before. This time your friends are watching.

Forge Social is a bet on yourself. Pick one goal, decide how often and for how long, and put your pride on the line. Every time you do it, you prove it with a photo. Your squad sees every proof, every streak and every day you skip.

PROOF, NOT PROMISES
Back camera, then front camera, seconds apart: one shows what you are doing, the other shows it is you. No gallery, no old pics, no stock photos.

WINNERS AND THE WALL OF SHAME
Your feed shows who is on track this month and who is not. Nobody wants to end up on the Wall of Shame.

MISS A DAY, NOT THE BET
Life happens. Hit 80% of what you promised and you are safe. Miss more and your squad will know.

ONE GOAL, ANY GOAL
Gym, running, reading, deep work, no sugar, getting up early, cold showers, a language, a side project. Every day, four times a week or twelve times a month: you choose.

BEAT YOUR SQUAD
Invite your friends, react, comment and verify each other's proof. One leaderboard shows who is ahead on their bet.

A FEED THAT ENDS
Your squad, plus a few public missions if you want them. No endless scroll. Check in, cheer them on, done.

REMINDERS AT YOUR TIME
Forge learns when you usually get it done and nudges you then, not at a random hour.

THE STAKE
Set a stake from 0 to 45 euros when you start. It is a promise only: no payment details are collected, nothing is ever charged, and no money changes hands, not with us and not between friends.

PRIVATE WHEN YOU WANT
Squad only by default. Make a mission public, or take your whole profile private with one switch. Report or block anyone; every report is reviewed within 24 hours.

Terms of Use: https://forge-social.geiser-paul.workers.dev/terms
Privacy Policy: https://forge-social.geiser-paul.workers.dev/privacy

name: FormCairn: Custom Forms
description:
Build the form you need, then keep the details that matter.

FormCairn helps you collect your own structured records on iPhone. Add text, number, date, choice and yes-or-no fields, mark required answers, and record entries without a product account.

• Define your own fields and arrange their order.
• Keep previous entries tied to the form version they used.
• Search records across your forms or within one form.
• Review counts, number summaries, choices and date ranges for one version.
• Generate real CSV and PDF files, preview them, and share with the iOS share sheet.

Your forms, entries and generated reports are stored locally. Files are shared only when you choose to share them. Spreadsheet-safe CSV text may include a leading apostrophe to reduce formula execution when opened in a spreadsheet.

name: Fralonio
description:
Welcome! We look forward to providing you with a high-quality experience—we’re eager to hear your feedback.


Fralonio keeps your goals pointed at true north. Write an objective for the quarter, set two to five measurable key results beneath it, and log a quick check-in each week. Every key result is drawn as a compass needle whose steps fill as you move, and its north star lights up with an orbit ring when you reach the target.

SEE IF YOU'RE ON COURSE
Fralonio compares your progress with how much of the period has passed. Each objective and key result shows its percentage climbed, the level expected for today's date, and a clear status: on track, behind by a number of points, or summited.

KEY RESULTS THAT FIT REAL GOALS
Track numbers in your own units (kilometres, testers, lessons, euros) from a start value to a target, including targets where lower is better, such as open bug reports or a budget. Or use a simple 0–100% milestone for work that doesn't count neatly.

WEEKLY CHECK-INS WITH CONFIDENCE
Each check-in records the new value, how sure you feel about reaching the target on a 1–10 scale, and a short note. The Check-ins section draws your weekly confidence trend, lists what's due this week, and keeps a log you can edit or remove.

GRADE AND ARCHIVE
When a period ends, grade every key result from 0.0 to 1.0. Fralonio suggests grades from your progress and you adjust them to what really happened. Archive the period to keep its grades in your history, then start the next stretch.

QUARTERS OR ANY STRETCH YOU CHOOSE
Start this quarter or next in one tap, or set your own dates. Run more than one period at once and switch between them.

CALM, FOCUSED DESIGN
A route on the left edge takes you between Climb, Objectives, Check-ins and Basecamp. Three themes: North Star (deep night teal with starlight cyan), Base Camp and Glacier. Gentle sound effects and haptics, both easy to switch off.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Plan as a guest straight away, no sign-up needed. Create an account with email and password whenever you want your plan on every device, and save a guest plan to that account without losing anything. Fralonio works offline and syncs when you're back online.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no analytics tools. Your goals are visible only to you. Delete your account from Basecamp at any time to erase every period, objective, key result and check-in.

Good for personal growth, study plans, training blocks, side projects and small-team goals you manage yourself.

name: Frame Gate
description:
Frame Gate is for the moment the camera back is still open. Name the roll, set 24 or 36, and push the tongue into the gate. Hold the shutter until it fires, write what was in that frame, and slip it back. When you stop, drag the crank to the can.

The contact sheet stays on this iPhone. It lists every note, how many frames you wrote, and how many are still in the dark. Nothing is uploaded, shared, or saved as a file.

There is no account and no connection to a camera. The notes are only for the person holding the phone.

name: FreeCell Solitaire: Big Cards
description:
FreeCell solitaire made to be easy on the eyes.

FreeCell Solitaire: Big Cards is the classic patience game with big cards, large numbers and clear colours. Pick up a deal, play at your own pace and enjoy a game that is simple to read and simple to use.

READABLE BY DESIGN
- Large and extra-large card faces
- A four-colour deck: spades black, hearts red, diamonds blue, clubs green
- Heavy, easy-to-read card numbers
- Text follows your device's text size
- Left-hand mode puts the controls where your thumb is

EVERY DEAL CAN BE WON
Every deal in the app is checked to be winnable, so a stuck game is never the game's fault. Take your time and look for the way through.

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Every card is dealt face up: think it through and find the way home
- Four free cells hold a card each while you work
- Move a whole run at once when there is room for it
- Tap a card to send it to its best place, or drag and drop
- Cards go home on their own when it is safe
- Unlimited undo and free hints, as many as you like
- A new daily deal every day, with a streak calendar
- Sound and vibration you can switch off

KEEP TRACK
See your games played, wins, win rate, streaks, best time and fewest moves for each mode.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose a card back and a table colour from the free looks, or add the Garden, Evening and Seaside packs. Every look keeps the cards bright and easy to read.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Vietnamese and Thai.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
- Works offline
- No account, no sign-in
- Your game stays on your device

name: Fresh Baked Bread Defense
description:
Trouble in Milbora: a soggy Fog has settled over the village.
And for bread, soggy is… well, the worst thing there is.

So the breads lined up in front of the hearth. Best to fight while you're still warm.

Fresh Baked Bread Defense is a cozy 3D tower defense. Top the dough with ingredients, bake a squad of breads, and keep the hearth's embers safe from the Squishies drifting in with the Fog.

■ THE ORDER IS THE RECIPE
Salt, butter, red bean, sugar, and then baking. The same dough becomes a completely different bread depending on what you add, and when.
Croissy the dependable all-rounder, Anko who lights up at the sight of a captain, Pretzel who watches the sky, Sir Baguette who cracks the hardest shells. Nineteen breads in all, starting with humble little Doughy.

■ READ THE FORECAST, BAKE THE ANSWER
Every wave tells you who is coming: the ones wrapped in a film, the ones that fly, the ones with hard shells.
You don't need fast fingers. You need the right bread.
In a pinch, call the Warm Wind and blow the Fog right back off your doorstep.

■ 26 STAGES, 26 CAPTAINS
A different Fog captain waits on every stage. Each stage you hold brings back one thing the Fog swallowed from the village.
And this story has an ending. Hold the last stage, and morning comes to Milbora.

■ A STORY READ ALOUD
Ttusin and the villagers tell their tale in pictures and voices, and every chapter leaves one empty line for you to fill in.
(The voices are synthesized.)

■ NO POWER FOR SALE
• Hearth decorations bought with flour are looks only. They never make you stronger.
• Ads appear only when you choose them. For the first three stages there isn't even a button.
• One optional purchase, the Golden Apron, gets you every reward without ads.
• Play to the end without the internet. (Ads and purchases need a connection.)
• 한국어 · English · 日本語 · 繁體中文 · Français

Today's bread gets defended today. Before it goes soggy.

name: FreShield
description:
FreShield is for commercial kitchens that use the FreShield prep station. It puts the kitchen's cooling checks and on-hand inventory on the phone a cook already carries, and it keeps working inside a walk-in cooler with no signal.

REQUIRES A FRESHIELD STATION
This app works with the FreShield station in your kitchen. Your kitchen manager gives you the account to sign in with.

RECORD A COOLING CHECK IN SECONDS
Tap the reusable FreShield label on a pan, or pick the pan from the list, and type the probe temperature. The reading is saved against the right batch with the time it was taken.

WORKS WHERE THE FOOD IS
A walk-in cooler has no signal. FreShield keeps the list of open checks on the phone and stores each reading until you are back in range, then sends it. Nothing is lost if the connection drops.

REMINDERS BEFORE A CHECK IS DUE
The phone reminds you when a round of checks comes up and again shortly before a deadline, even with no connection. Reminders for checks already done are cancelled.

SEE WHAT IS ON HAND
Every batch in the kitchen with its prep time, use-by time and weight, sorted so that anything needing attention is at the top.

WALK THE COOLER
Tap the labels as you walk the cooler to confirm what is physically there.

FOR MANAGERS
Reports, exports and kitchen settings open in your browser from the Reports tab.

FreShield records the checks your kitchen takes. It does not replace a food thermometer, your food-safety plan, or the judgement of the person in charge.

NFC is used to read FreShield labels. Every feature except tapping a label works on a device without NFC.

name: FRIDAY – AI Assistant
description:
FRIDAY is an AI assistant that answers anything, keeps your lists and gets things done on your iPhone. You don't need an account.

CHOOSE YOUR ASSISTANT
Start with FRIDAY, GAMER or NOVA, or build your own. Give each one a name, a personality, a voice and a theme color, and decide what it is allowed to do. Switching assistants re-themes the whole app around a living particle core.

TALK OR TYPE
Ask questions, brainstorm, plan your day or get help with a photo. Replies stream in as they are written, and FRIDAY can read them aloud. Hold the mic to dictate in English or Norwegian.

LISTS THAT UPDATE THEMSELVES
Say "add milk and eggs to the shopping list" and it's done. FRIDAY creates lists, adds and checks off items, and shows a receipt of every change.

REMINDERS, CALENDAR AND SPOTIFY
Connect Apple Reminders and Calendar, and FRIDAY can see what's coming up and add reminders and events for you. Connect Spotify to play, pause, skip and queue music by asking. (Spotify control requires Spotify Premium.)

MEMORY AND AUTOMATIONS
FRIDAY remembers lasting facts you share, so you don't repeat yourself. You can see and delete every memory. Set up automations, such as a morning briefing, that ask before they run.

ON YOUR PC TOO
Link a computer with a 6-digit code and use the same assistants, chats and lists in your browser at friday-desktop.rork.app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No login, no email, no tracking. Each assistant only uses the permissions you give it, and Delete all data removes everything from the server and your iPhone.

FRIDAY PRO
Free: 50 AI messages a day. FRIDAY Pro: 300 AI messages a day, as a monthly auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple ID and renews unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in Settings > Apple ID > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://friday-ai-lhc64vm.rork.app/privacy

name: Frost Wake: Scrape Alarm
description:
Your alarm rings earlier only on mornings when you’ll need to scrape the windshield. Every other day, you sleep in.

Stop setting your alarm 15 minutes early “just in case” all winter. Every evening, Frost Wake works out whether your car will be frosted when you leave, and sets your alarm accordingly.

WHAT CHANGES YOUR MORNINGS
• A real system alarm that rings even in silent mode
• Moved earlier only when there will be frost, by just the time you need
• Your usual time on frost-free mornings
• Light frost: a few minutes. Heavy frost or snow: a bit more

SMARTER THAN A WEATHER APP
• Estimates your windshield temperature, not just the air: under a clear sky, glass often gets 5–7 °F colder
• Hour-by-hour until you leave: clouds, wind, humidity, dew point
• Every morning explained in one sentence: why, how many minutes, how thick
• It learns: answer “was there frost?” and forecasts adapt to your car and parking spot

THE NIGHT BEFORE
• An evening alert suggests covering the windshield: tap “I covered the windshield” and your alarm goes back to normal

ALSO
• Tonight’s windshield chart and the next 7 mornings
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets: “Scrape tomorrow?”
• Siri and Shortcuts: “Do I need to scrape tomorrow?”
• Up to 4 cars, different times for different days
• Shareable winter stats
• °F or °C, 10 languages

PRIVACY
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your addresses, schedules and answers stay on your iPhone
• Only your car’s coordinates are sent to Apple Weather to get the forecast

FREE AND FROST WAKE PRO
The frost forecast, chart, 7-morning list, widgets and Siri are free. The smart alarm, evening alert, multiple cars and winter stats are part of Frost Wake Pro: $9.99/year with a 7-day free trial, or $1.99/month. Auto-renewing; cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

Frost Wake estimates frost on your car using Apple Weather data. It does not forecast road conditions — drive carefully.

Support: https://schmittutility.fr/assistance/
Privacy: https://schmittutility.fr/confidentialite/
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Frostbin
description:
Frostbin is a freezer inventory for real kitchens. Tell it what's in each drawer, and it tells you what to eat first, so nothing gets lost under the ice.

USE SOON, AT A GLANCE
The home screen puts the item closest to its best-within date at the top, with a big "Take one out" button. Everything else follows in use-first order, split into "to use soon" and "plenty of time". Search finds anything by name, drawer, category or note.

THE FROST METER
Every item carries a thin frost meter. Fresh food shows teal; as it nears its best-within date the bar frosts over to red, with tiny ice crystals settling along it. One look and you know what needs eating this week.

YOUR FREEZER, DRAWER BY DRAWER
Set up one freezer or several (kitchen, garage chest, the little one in the utility room). Name the drawers and shelves the way they really sit, top to bottom. Pull a drawer open in the app to see exactly what's inside, how many portions, and how long each has left.

ADD IN SECONDS
Name, category (meat, fish, veg & fruit, meals, bread & bakes, desserts, other), portions, the day it went in and a best-within time in months. Frostbin suggests sensible months for each category, and you can change those defaults in settings.

BATCH COOKING
Made a big pot of chili? Switch on Batch cook, choose how many containers and portions each, and Frostbin adds them all in one go, numbered so you can tell them apart.

ONE PORTION AT A TIME
Take out a single portion, use the lot, or log what you threw away. When the last portion is gone the item clears itself.

A LOG THAT CUTS WASTE
The monthly log shows portions used versus thrown away, which categories go to waste most, and how you compare with the month before.

LABELS
Share any item's label as plain text: name, portions, frozen date, best-by date and where it lives.

MAKE IT YOURS
Two colour themes, gentle sound effects you can switch off, and haptics you can switch off too.

ACCOUNT OPTIONAL
Start straight away with "Open the freezer as guest", or sign in with email and password to keep your freezer in sync. A guest can save their freezer to an email account later without losing anything. Works offline and syncs when you're back online.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your data is stored in Google Firebase under your own account and nobody else can read it. You can delete your account and every item, drawer and log entry from the Plug settings drawer at any time.

Best-within times are general guidance for home freezers, not food-safety advice.

name: Frostellum
seller_name: STEEL WOOL: A BEARD BRAND LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY
description: Put your phone down. Let your focus crystallize. Frostellum helps you make space for uninterrupted work through a simple face-down focus ritual. Choose a session from 15 to 120 minutes, keep the app open, and place your iPhone screen down to begin. Three strictness levels let you choose a forgiving grace period or a challenge that ends the session when you lift your phone. Complete focus sessions to unlock five geometric ice relics and explore them in your personal vault. Create your own soundscape with four offline ambient sound layers, individual volume controls, and ready-made presets. Follow your progress with daily summaries, 7-, 14-, and 30-day charts, your longest focus streak, and a 16-week activity heatmap. Personalize your experience with four color themes, adjustable haptic feedback, and optional completion reminders. Your settings, collection, and focus history stay on your device.

name: Fruitoom
description: Fruitoom is a fresh fruit puzzle game built around the Juice Loom. Swap neon fruits, rotate gravity, and weave the board to ripen and juice matching groups. Clear handcrafted orchard levels, chase stars, play the Daily Blend, and explore the Fruit Codex. Sign in with Apple, Google, or continue as a guest and start weaving today.

name: fulltext library
description:
Your whole ebook collection, searchable at lightning speed.

Point the app at a folder on your NAS (WebDAV) or in iCloud Drive and add every book in one go. No more importing file by file.

Add everything: import entire libraries from WebDAV, NAS shares, or iCloud folders.
Smart indexing: the database is many times smaller than your library, yet every book stays full-text searchable. 50,000 books fit in just 2.5 GB, including covers.
Search: full-text search across titles, authors, tags, publishers, and the words inside your books.
Find: results appear instantly, and you can filter and sort by author, title, tag, or publisher.
Use the query builder for more interesting query’s. Examples included.
Fast, private, and built for large collections.

English Nederlands Deutsch Español Français Português (Brasil) Italiano

name: FurrowCue
description:
Thanks for opening FurrowCue. We keep refining the field desk so seasonal work feels clearer; if something feels off, reach out and we will look into it.

FurrowCue turns hollow calendar alerts into today’s single field work order — one plot, one task, one closeable window.

The season arc shows which solar term is active. You pin a ridge, open one order for that window (sow, frost cover, bag, drain…), work Prep · Do · Check, then close the slip. Late orders never silent-fail — they move to Late Ridge.

ONE RIDGE, ONE ORDER
• Home holds a single stake slip for the active term — not a long chore list
• Pin plots by kind (veg, orchard, grain, mixed) with a short field note
• Open an order with a verb, reason, and window countdown
• Tick Prep · Do · Check on the Order Desk as you walk the ridge

KNOW THE TERM
• Browse all 24 solar terms on the Term Ring
• Open a Term Brief for meaning and suggested verbs
• Season Lab adjusts region offset and window padding

CLOSE THE WINDOW
• Seal the slip with an optional field note
• Ridge Log keeps closed orders grouped for review
• Late Ridge surfaces missed windows so nothing slips past quietly
• Optional local reminders while a work window is still open

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-in, no ads, no analytics, no cloud sync
• FurrowCue does not read location, camera, Contacts, or Messages
• Plots and orders stay in the app sandbox on this iPhone
• Clear samples or wipe all local data anytime in Silo

FurrowCue is a calm field desk for seasonal work — not a farm ERP, weather feed, or habit streak.

name: Gara Nord — Bus Tickets
description:
Gara Nord is the app of Gara Auto Nord, the bus station in the north of Chișinău: check the station's departures board, find your trip, pick your seats and pay from your phone, and the ticket stays in the app.

THE DEPARTURES BOARD
The board on the first page shows the next daily buses leaving the station — the destination, how long until each one leaves, the journey time and the fare it starts from — and updates itself every minute.

SEARCH AND COMPARE
Search starts from Chișinău. See the day's departures with their times, carrier and price, filter them by time, price and amenities and sort them as you like. The Schedule tab shows every route from the station, with the days each one runs, and you search them by city.

BUY FROM YOUR PHONE
Add the passengers with their discounts and pick your seats on the coach's seat map. At the end you see everything you are buying and what it costs, and you pay by card.

YOUR TICKETS ON YOUR PHONE
Your orders stay in the app, in the My tickets tab, with the ticket, the QR code for boarding and a PDF you can pass on.

PASSENGER INFORMATION
The Information tab holds what is good to know before the journey: where to buy tickets and how refunds work, discounts, travel documents, luggage, travelling with children and with animals, passengers with reduced mobility, getting to the station, its services and lost property.

AT THE STATION
The At the station panel on the first page shows the address, the phone numbers, how to get there, the platforms, what is in the building and how tickets are sold. The station's contacts — its phone numbers and email address — and its story are in the app too.

YOUR ACCOUNT
Your personal details, phone numbers confirmed by SMS and saved passengers stay in your account. On your next purchase, your email and phone fill in for you, you pick your saved passengers from a list, and all your orders are in one place.

LANGUAGE AND CURRENCY
The app is available in Romanian, Russian and English, and you choose the currency you see prices in from your profile.

name: Gavelo
description:
Gavelo keeps meetings on the clock. Plan a timed agenda, run it with one tap per item, and walk out with minutes and a list of who does what — without a second app or a notebook.

Made for team leads, club secretaries, committee chairs and parent councils who want meetings that start with a plan and finish when they said they would.

PLAN THE AGENDA
- Give the meeting a title, a date and time, and a place or call link
- Type in the attendees once; their names become one-tap owner suggestions
- Add timed items with a topic, an owner and the minutes each deserves
- Reorder items, see the total length and the planned finishing time
- Save any agenda as a template and start next week's meeting from it

RUN THE ROOM
- A big, wide countdown for the item on the floor; one tap moves to the next
- Overtime turns the timer coral and a low double knock tells the chair
- The drift ribbon stretches teal when you are ahead and coral when you are behind, with the projected finish time underneath
- Record decisions, action items (task, owner, due date) and notes against the item being discussed
- Adjourn early whenever you like; unreached items are marked as skipped
- The run room survives leaving the app: the clock is based on real time

MINUTES THAT WRITE THEMSELVES
- Every item with planned versus actual time, decisions and actions
- Totals for the meeting and its final drift
- Share the minutes as plain text through the share sheet — email, notes, chat, anything

ONE ACTIONS BOARD
- Every action from every meeting in one place, sorted by due date
- Overdue actions are flagged; tick them off, edit them or delete them
- Add standalone actions that don't belong to a meeting

YOUR WAY
- Three palettes: Boardroom, Night Session and Lime Memo
- Sound effects, haptics and the overtime knock can each be switched off
- Choose the default length for new agenda items

ACCOUNTS AND PRIVACY
- Sit in as a guest and start straight away — no account needed
- Or create an account with email and password to keep your meetings on every device
- Guests can keep their data later by adding an email and password in Chambers
- Works offline; changes sync when you're back online
- Delete your account and every meeting, action and template from Chambers at any time
- No ads, no tracking, no analytics

Gavelo is free, with no in-app purchases.

name: Gellio: Music for Jellyfin
description:
Gellio plays the music on your Jellyfin server, with a player that feels right at home on iPhone. Sign in with your server address, username and password, or approve a Quick Connect code from another Jellyfin device. Your playlists, artists, albums, songs and favorites show up just as they are on your server.

Never lose your place
Gellio saves your queue, the current song and your spot in it, so closing the app or restarting your phone won't lose them. Songs over 20 minutes, like long mixes and radio shows, also save their spot on your server.

Take it offline
Download a song or a whole album and play it on a plane, on the subway or anywhere without signal. Downloads are grouped by album.

Control it from anywhere
Play, pause, skip and favorite from the Lock Screen and Control Center. Next and previous stay put, even on long tracks.

Shape what plays next
See what's coming up, reorder it, and add songs with Play Next or Play Last from anywhere in the app.

A Now Playing worth looking at
A full-screen player tinted from the album art, with AirPlay and a sleep timer.

Lyrics that follow along
If your server has synced lyrics, they scroll with the song. Tap a line to jump to it.

Find anything fast
Search results are split into artists, albums, songs and playlists, and your recent searches are kept.

A Home screen that knows you
Rows picked from what you play and favorite. That listening history stays on your phone.

Private by design
No Gellio account, no analytics and no ads. Gellio only talks to the server you sign in to.

What you need
A Jellyfin server with a music library. At home, Gellio can reach it over your Wi-Fi. Away from home, your server needs an https:// address.

Questions or bugs? Email hello@forkbomb.studio.

Made by Fork Bomb.

name: Genius Password
description:
GENIUS PASSWORD – YOUR DIGITAL SECURITY

Keep your passwords, login credentials and confidential information in one secure, elegant and fully customizable space.

Genius Password gives you control over your data, combining security, simplicity and a carefully designed user experience.

SECURITY AND PRIVACY

• AES-256-GCM encryption.
• Personal vault protected by a dedicated password.
• Biometric access with Face ID or Touch ID on compatible devices.
• Personal recovery key.
• Contents encrypted directly on your device before synchronization.
• The developer cannot read your vault contents without your vault password or recovery key.

EVERYTHING IN ONE PLACE

• Passwords and login credentials.
• Website addresses.
• Private notes.
• Protected photos and images.
• Customizable categories.
• Favorites for quick access to your most important information.

SYNCHRONIZATION AND BACKUP

Access your vault on compatible devices using your Genius Password account. Your contents are synchronized in encrypted form.

You can also use encrypted iCloud backups to keep a copy of your vault.

PERSONALIZE YOUR EXPERIENCE

Choose your preferred font, background color and interface element sizes.

Organize your credentials into custom categories, choosing colors and symbols for instant recognition.

An elegant interface designed for iPhone and iPad and Mac.

FREE AND AD-FREE

Genius Password is free, with no mandatory subscriptions, no advertising and no advertising tracking.

If you enjoy the app, you can voluntarily support its continued development through an optional contribution. No additional features are reserved for contributors.

AVAILABLE IN FIVE LANGUAGES

English, Italian, French, Spanish and German.

Genius Password – Your data. Your security. Your control.

An app from the SteGenius family.

name: Gestione Nautica
description:
The companion app for boatyards that use the Gestione Nautica management system. You need an account from your boatyard: the administrator creates it in Gestione Nautica.

FOR YARD STAFF
• Log the day's hours on the right job in a few taps.
• Take photos of the work: they go straight to the job.
• Add the materials used to the daily report.
• Open a job: boat, tasks, status, documents.
• Everyone sees only what their role allows.

FOR BOAT OWNERS
• See your boat: work in progress, progress and launch date.
• Browse photos of the work taken in the yard.
• Approve a quote or extra work after seeing items and prices.
• Open documents and invoices, and send requests to the yard.

The app shows the same data as the management system. No ads, no tracking. The app is in Italian.

name: Ghosted: Unfollow Tracker
description:
Ever wonder who quietly unfollowed you? Ghosted tells you, without asking for your password.

WHO DIPPED?
Check now, check again next week, and Ghosted shows exactly who stopped following you in between. No guessing, no scrolling through lists.

YOUR PASSWORD STAYS YOURS
Most unfollow trackers make you type your Instagram password into their app, which can get your account flagged or locked. Ghosted never sees it. You sign in on Instagram's own page, ask Instagram for your follower lists with its official download tool, and Ghosted reads them right on your iPhone.

EVERYTHING ON ONE SCREEN
• Dipped: who stopped following you since last time
• New followers: who showed up
• Not following back: people you follow who don't follow you
• Your fans: people who follow you that you don't follow back
• Follower, following and mutual counts, plus a history of every check

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your lists never leave your iPhone. No accounts, no servers, no tracking, no ads.

FREE FOREVER
Every feature is free for everyone. If Ghosted saves you some scrolling, you can buy the ghost a snack with a one-time in-app purchase. It just makes the occasional thank-you note go away.

How it works: tap Connect, sign in on Instagram's page, request your Followers and following list, and come back when Instagram has it ready (usually within the hour; Ghosted reminds you). Tap Download and you're done.

Ghosted isn't affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Instagram or Meta.

name: GifTailor: Video to GIF
description:
GifTailor turns a moment from your videos into a GIF that's the right size for where you're posting it. No need to know anything about megabytes, resolution or frame rates.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a video from Photos, or send one from the Share button of any app.
• Drag the yellow frame to the moment where it should start and pick a length: 2, 3, 5 or 8 seconds.
• Tap what it's for and see roughly how big it will be, and whether it fits, before you make it.
• Tap Make GIF, then share it or save it.

THE RIGHT SIZE, AUTOMATICALLY
• Messages & posts: a GIF up to 8 MB that fits almost everywhere.
• Emoji: a small GIF up to 128 KB for custom emoji.
• Looping video: a video that plays over and over, for networks that don't accept GIF files.
• Your own size: set the limit yourself, from 1 MB up to no limit.
The app picks the best quality that fits, and the file never goes over the limit you chose.

A CLEAN PICTURE
• Its own GIF encoder, made for smooth colours without flicker.
• Portrait videos stay upright, with no cropping and no stretching.

FREE AND PRIVATE
• Completely free: no watermark, no ads, no purchases, no subscription.
• Everything happens on your iPhone. Your videos are never uploaded and the app collects no data.
• It sees only the video you pick; it never asks for access to all your photos.

In English and Greek. Questions or ideas: socialmailuse@proton.me

name: Giftlane
description:
Giftlane plans gifts against a budget you set for each occasion. A gift is an idea, bought, or given. Spent money is the sum of bought and given prices. Remaining budget is the occasion budget minus that sum, and it can go below zero.

Occasion cards show the progress. Upcoming lists how many days are left. People collect the gifts attached to them across occasions.

Giftlane does not pay anyone and does not open a store. It is a personal budget, not financial advice. The list stays on this iPhone.

name: Giftory
description:
Giftory is a gift planner for the people you care about. Keep gift ideas, budgets and occasions together, with birthday countdowns and a warning before you give the same gift twice.

PEOPLE
• Name, relationship, birthday (with optional year to show the age they turn), likes, sizes, notes and colour
• Sorted by soonest birthday, with a countdown
• Open gift ideas and a list of gifts given before, so you can avoid repeats

OCCASIONS
• Birthdays appear automatically from your people
• Add anniversaries, holidays and celebrations that repeat every year, fall on a set weekday such as the second Sunday of May, or happen once
• Quick-add presets
• An upcoming list grouped by month, with countdowns and how many gifts are ready

GIFT IDEAS
• Title, person, price, where to buy, notes, occasion and year
• A board with Idea, Bought, Wrapped and Given columns, with totals for each
• A wrapping animation as a gift moves to Wrapped and Given
• Filter by person, search, and hide given gifts

REPEAT GIFT WARNING
As you type a gift idea, Giftory checks earlier gifts to the same person and shows a Possible repeat warning with when it was given.

BUDGETS
• Set a budget for an occasion, such as a holiday this year, or for a date range
• A ring showing spent and planned amounts, what is left and any overspend
• A warning when planned ideas would go over budget

REMINDERS
Optional notifications a chosen number of days before each occasion and on the day, mentioning how many gifts are still to buy or wrap. Permission is only requested when you switch them on.

WORKS OFFLINE, ACCOUNT OPTIONAL
Giftory works fully offline and never asks you to sign up. Tap "Just browsing" on the welcome screen and every feature is available straight away, with your people and gift plans saved on this device.
If you would like a backup, create a free account with your email address and a password. Your data then syncs securely so you can restore it on another iPhone or iPad, and anything you made as a guest is merged into your account. You can delete your account and its backup at any time from Settings.

PRIVATE, FREE AND SIMPLE
• Completely free: no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions
• No tracking and no analytics; your data is never shared with other users
• Export all of your data as JSON from Settings whenever you like
• Currency follows your device's region and can be changed in Settings
• Light and dark mode, with haptics you can switch off
• Designed for landscape on iPhone and iPad (iOS 15 or later)

name: GifWidget: Animated GIF Widget
description:
Put your favorite GIFs on your Home Screen as widgets that actually move.

GifWidget brings your Home Screen to life. Find a GIF, frame it and add the widget: it starts playing right away. Pets, reactions, memes, cartoons, your own clips: if it's a GIF, it can live on your Home Screen.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Find a GIF or sticker, or bring your own
2. Pinch to frame it, trim it and set the speed
3. Add the GifWidget widget to your Home Screen. Done!

FIND THE PERFECT GIF
• Browse trending GIFs and stickers right in the app (Powered by GIPHY)
• Search in your own language
• Bring animated GIFs from Photos or the Files app, or paste one
• Share GIFs straight from other apps

MAKE IT YOURS
• Pinch and drag to frame it, previewed at real Home Screen size
• Trim it to the moment you love
• Speed from 0.5× to 2×, or Boomerang for a seamless back-and-forth loop
• Choose a background color for transparent GIFs and stickers
• Small, Medium and Large widgets
• Name your GIFs and re-edit them anytime

MADE FOR THE HOME SCREEN
• Every widget can play a different GIF
• Tap a widget to pause it, tap again to resume
• New widgets play your newest GIF automatically
• A step-by-step guide shows you how to add your first widget

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. The GIFs you save stay on your device.

GIFWIDGET PRO
The free version animates one widget at a time. Pro animates every widget on your Home Screen at once, unlocks custom backgrounds, and includes every future premium feature.

Choose a monthly or yearly subscription (the yearly plan includes a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers) or a one-time Lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within the 24 hours before it ends. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://michaelzhang1994.github.io/photowidgets/

name: Gilded Blocks
description:
Arrange warm gold pieces on a quiet midnight board. Fill rows and columns, make space, and see how far a thoughtful placement can take you.

Play an endless round at your own pace, or return for the daily arrangement: the same 30-piece sequence for everyone, refreshed at midnight UTC. A round may end before all 30 pieces when none fit. There is no timer pressure, rotation or undo.

• An 8 × 8 puzzle board
• Tap or drag to place pieces
• Simultaneous row and column clears
• A fresh shared daily sequence
• Local scores, streaks and a saved unfinished round
• VoiceOver labels, a large-button placement list and scalable text

Endless rounds offer one optional video continue that clears the board and keeps your score. If an ad cannot load, the continue is free. Daily arrangements have no continue.

A one-time Remove Ads purchase removes banner and between-round ads and makes optional continues free. Ordinary gameplay works offline. Ads and purchases require internet access. No game account is required.

Basic usage analytics help improve the game. Settings includes controls to turn collection off and request deletion. Advertising privacy choices are separate.

name: Gilded Escape
description:
Clear a path for the gold block. Slide each piece along its track, open a route to the exit, and see if you can get there in the fewest moves.

• Solve 64 levels, from quick warm-ups to longer puzzles.
• Aim for the move target to earn three stars. Replay to improve your best.
• Play the shared daily puzzle and build a streak.
• Undo a move for free, restart the board, or pick up where you left off.
• Take your time. You can finish any puzzle after passing its move target.

If you get stuck, ask for a hint. A short video may unlock the next move. When video is unavailable, the hint is free. The one-time Remove Ads purchase removes ads between puzzles and gives you hints without videos. Restore it from Settings.

Play offline with no account. Your progress stays on your device.

name: Gilded Sort
description:
Pour jewel-colored layers into glass bottles until each color has a bottle of its own. Tap a bottle, then pour into an empty bottle or onto a matching color. There’s no countdown, so you can take your time with every move.

• Work through a series of levels and unlock the next one as you go.
• Return for a shared daily puzzle that refreshes at midnight UTC.
• Aim for the pour target to earn three stars. Replay to improve your rating.
• Undo for free, restart your attempt, or pick up where you left off.
• Track your best ratings, daily streak, and best daily pour count on your device.
• Add color symbols, use VoiceOver bottle descriptions, or turn gentle haptics off.

Every successful pour counts toward your rating, even if you undo it. Restarting the same puzzle resets your count. You can keep playing and finish after you pass the target.

An optional video can reveal a hint. If a video is unavailable, the hint is free. A one-time Remove Ads purchase removes the banner and between-puzzle ads and gives you hints without videos. You can restore the purchase in Settings.

No game account is required. Basic play works offline. Ad and purchase availability depends on your connection. Settings lets you turn off usage analytics and request deletion.

name: Gistory: Record & Transcribe
description:
Gistory turns the conversations of your day into text you can search, translate and act on.

RECORD ON IPHONE OR APPLE WATCH
• Record from your wrist or your phone, with a Live Activity on the Lock Screen
• Use a Bluetooth headset on your Apple Watch
• Watch recordings sync to your iPhone and leave the watch only after they are safely saved
• Import audio you already have

LIVE TRANSLATION (iOS 26 AND LATER)
• Turn on live translation while you record and see each line in two languages, original first, translation below
• Pick the spoken language and the language to translate to
• Translation runs on your device with Apple's Translation, and works offline once the language is downloaded
• Recording is never interrupted if a translation is late; missing lines are filled in afterwards

TRANSCRIPTS YOU CAN SEARCH (iOS 26 AND LATER)
• Transcripts are written on your device with Apple's speech recognition. Your audio is not uploaded.
• Tap any line to hear that moment
• Search by keyword and jump to the exact spot
• Recordings without a transcript can still be found by date and source

KNOW WHO SAID WHAT
• Separate speakers automatically, then rename them (teacher, parent, Alex)
• Fix any line with one tap
• Speaker analysis runs on your phone. The speaker models download once on first use.

FOLLOW-UPS AND REMINDERS
• Pull the to-dos out of a conversation, each one linked to the line it came from
• Add a follow-up to Reminders with one tap

COLLECTIONS AND BRIEFS
• Group recordings into collections, then ask about one recording or a whole collection
• Turn an answer into a brief you can edit
• Share a brief as a PDF or as images, or copy it as text

OPTIONAL AI SUMMARIES AND CHAT
• Add your own AI provider and key to get summaries and ask questions about your recordings
• Every answer shows its sources; tap one to hear the original moment
• Gistory shows exactly what will be sent before it sends anything
• Skip it and everything else works the same

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• Recordings and transcripts stay on your device
• Deleted recordings wait in Recently Deleted before they are gone

Available in English, Chinese, Japanese, German and French. Requires iOS 18 or later; transcription and live translation need iOS 26 or later. Apple Watch app included.

name: Glancemint: Matching Widgets
description:
Widgets that match your wallpaper, automatically.

Pick any photo, or one of ours, and Glancemint reads its colors right on your iPhone and dresses every widget to fit: clock, calendar, countdown, battery, photos and more. Change the picture and the whole set changes with it. Your photo never leaves your device.

MATCHED TO YOUR PICTURE
• Glancemint finds the main colors of a picture and builds a full widget set from them
• Soft, Deep, Pop and Mono moods restyle the whole set in one tap
• Text colors are checked for contrast, so every widget stays readable

WORLDS TO START FROM
• 186 original themes in 38 collections: magic and fantasy, enchanted nature, neon nights, glam, deep space, anime skies, cozy felt characters and more
• Every theme comes with an HD wallpaper and six widgets in its colors
• 14 themes are free, plus a different Pro theme free every day

LOCK SCREEN WALLPAPERS THAT MOVE
• 61 animated scenes, saved as Live Photos for your Lock Screen
• Each one moves when you wake your iPhone, then rests on the picture
• Charging animations: a scene with your battery level, opened by a Shortcuts automation when you plug in

FIFTEEN WIDGET TYPES
Clock (digital or analog), date and calendar, countdown and D-day, photo, photo shuffle, quote, daily affirmation, mood, moon phase, week, battery, year progress, world clock, contacts you can call in one tap, and to-do list. Small, medium and large, plus Lock Screen widgets.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Studio: paint your own wallpaper from gradients, aurora, paper waves and more, and widgets match it too
• Patterns, frames, stickers, textures and five fonts
• Character skins that keep the time or date in a clear corner

NO ADS. NO ACCOUNT. WORKS OFFLINE.
No ads, no sign-up and no tracking. Your widgets and photos stay on your device.

GLANCEMINT PRO
The free plan keeps up to 6 widgets with 14 themes, a free Pro theme each day and core styles. Pro unlocks unlimited widgets, all 186 themes, every moving wallpaper and charging animation, the Contacts, World clock and Photo shuffle widgets, and every Studio style, font, texture, pattern and frame.
• Weekly, with a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers
• Yearly

Prices are shown in the app in your currency before you buy. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. If you start a free trial, it converts to a paid subscription when the trial ends unless you cancel before then. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings at any time.

Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://mdgoaltech-web.github.io/glancemint-legal/privacy.html

name: GlanceSplit
description:
GlanceSplit is a race timer for Apple Watch built for one thing: being readable when you're out of breath.

Fitness races with 8 runs and 8 workout stations are hard enough – squinting at small numbers shouldn't be part of it. GlanceSplit shows only what matters, in digits large enough to read mid-sled-push:

• Countdown of the planned time for the current segment
• Heart rate (turns red above your limit)
• Your total delta to plan – green when you're ahead, red when you're behind
• A progress ring along the display edge that closes when the planned segment time is up

HOW IT WORKS
1. Enter your planned time for each of the 16 segments in the iPhone app – or set a target total and let GlanceSplit scale all segments proportionally.
2. Start the race on your watch. The plan is already there; no iPhone needed during the race.
3. Double-tap the screen or use the Double Tap gesture to move to the next segment. Accidental double inputs are ignored for 3 seconds.
4. Swipe up for pause, undo segment and end.
5. After the finish you see every split and its delta to plan. The race is saved as a workout in Apple Health.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Heart rate, distance and your splits stay on your devices and in Apple Health.

Requires Apple Watch with watchOS 26 or later.

name: Glimmer - Feel presence
description:
Some days there is nothing to say. Glimmer is for those days too.

Once a day, press and hold the rings. They spin up, fall into one, and the light comes on. That is all you need to do, and it means one thing: I'm still here.

The people you connected with see that your light is on today. You see theirs. There is no chat, no feed, no likes and nothing to answer. You don't need to speak for someone to know you are there.

• One gesture a day. A few seconds, and the day is marked.
• The colour is yours. Pick the colour of today before you light up. It is the only thing you say, and you never have to explain it.
• Close ones, quietly. Connect by a six-character code or a QR. See who is here today and how their last weeks went.
• A thought for the day. After the light comes on there is one short thought. Keep the ones that speak to you, or share one as a picture.
• Every day stays. Each day your light was on remains beside it as a small spark. A missed day takes nothing away.
• Send your light. Once a day you can send your light to someone as a quiet "I'm with you".
• A widget for the Home Screen and the Lock Screen shows whether today's light is on.
• No e-mail, no password, no ads, no tracking. Delete everything about you with one button.

Glimmer is not a medical or emergency service. If you are in danger, call your local emergency number.

name: Glimt - Deeper Breathing
description:
Glimt is a quiet place to come back to your breath.

Open it on a break, before sleep or between meetings. Swipe through a deck of breathing sessions, turn the dial to pick how many rounds, and press Start. Glimt guides every inhale, hold and exhale, so all you have to do is follow.

FEEL YOUR BREATH
Glimt's haptics are composed around the breath itself. With Tidal, a gentle swell rises as you inhale and settles as you exhale, so you can breathe with your eyes closed. Prefer something steadier? Metronome gives you a soft tap on every count. You can set the strength exactly how you like it.

BREATHING SESSIONS
• Just Breathe (Coherence): an even 5-5 rhythm for beginners and daily use
• Box Breath: four equal phases for calm and focus
• 4-7-8: a long hold and slow exhale for winding down
• Trikona A and Trikona B: an easy hold on the inhale or the exhale
• Playlists that chain sessions into a longer practice
• An optional get-ready countdown before the first breath

MAKE YOUR OWN
Create your own breathing patterns, setting each phase to a tenth of a second. Start from scratch, or open a built-in session as a copy and adjust it.

SEE YOUR PRACTICE
See your practice by week, month, year or all time: sessions, breaths taken, minutes spent breathing, the days you practiced, your rhythm and the time spent in each part of the breath. Streaks are there if they help you, and you can turn them off if they don't.

MADE TO FEEL CALM
• A smooth 3D orb that grows and softens with each breath
• Living backgrounds that follow light and dark mode
• A floating glass tab bar and interactions that respond to your touch
• A short haiku or your streak progress when a session ends

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-up. Your sessions and statistics stay on your iPhone.

WHY GLIMT
Glimt began with a developer who burned out after long days at a laptop, and found their way back through yoga and breathwork. It's made for anyone who spends their days in their head and wants a simple, beautiful way to return to their body.

Glimt also comes as a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that reminds you to breathe while you work. Learn more at glimtapp.io.

Glimt is a wellbeing tool, not a medical device. If you have a medical or respiratory condition, check with your doctor before trying breath holds.

name: GlowBough
description:
GlowBough is a calm winter puzzle about wiring Christmas lights on a frosted bough.
Tap or drag ribbons between matching lanterns. Finish every color group without crossing paths or cutting through branch covers. Later boughs add one-way facing bulbs, shared hubs that belong to two colors, and blizzard tiers that thaw in order.
No timers. No ads. No account. Play fully offline.
FEATURES
• Four chapters: Evergreen Paths, Shared Glow, Blizzard Order, Masterwork
• Daily Bough seeded from today’s date
• Practice Grove for a quiet first try
• Hints, undo/redo, favorites, and local board snapshots
• Stars for efficient clears; Merits for real milestones
• Field Guide, Lantern Key, Privacy Pledge, and Workshop settings
• Festive ornaments throughout—Santa hat, gift, stocking, cane, and more
HOW TO PLAY
1. Select a bulb, then connect it to another that shares its color.
2. Ribbons cannot cross each other or pass through green bough plates.
3. Arrow bulbs only accept wiring in the marked direction.
4. Dual-ring bulbs must finish inside both color families.
5. Frozen bulbs thaw after you use every bulb in the current wave.
Progress, stars, hints, and drafts stay on your iPhone. GlowBough never asks for a network connection to play.
Settle in. There is no clock—only the glow of a finished bough.

name: Glowtiles
description:
Tap a tile and it flips, along with every tile touching it. Your goal: light up the whole board.

Simple to learn, surprisingly deep. Glowtiles starts gently with a five-level tutorial, then builds from tiny 3x3 boards to fiendish 7x7 grids across 500 hand-tuned levels.

• 500 levels that get steadily harder
• Earn up to 3 stars by beating par
• Satisfying glow animations and haptics
• Quick to play: perfect for a tea break
• Works on iPhone and iPad
• Play offline
• One-off purchase to remove ads forever. No subscriptions.

Made by All About Home.

name: GlueMap
description:
Το GlueMap είναι υπολογιστής πεδίου για κολλώδεις σανίδες. Δίνετε χώρο, ίχνη και συνθήκες και παίρνετε πλήθος σανίδων, απόσταση στον τοίχο, κατάσταση κόλλας και επόμενο έλεγχο. Για επαγγελματίες απεντόμωσης, διαχειριστές κτιρίων και κατοικίες.

Πώς χρησιμοποιείται
1. Στην αρχική πατήστε Νέος υπολογισμός ή ένα εργαλείο.
2. Κάλυψη: μήκος και πλάτος, ένταση, τύπος χώρου, μέγεθος σανίδας. Εμφανίζονται σανίδες σε τοίχους, εσωτερικά σημεία, απόσταση και απλό σχέδιο.
3. Ιξώδες: τύπος κόλλας, θερμοκρασία και υγρασία. Βλέπετε αν η κόλλα είναι σκληρή, στη ζώνη ή πολύ μαλακή.
4. Θερμοκρασία: καμπύλη απόδοσης στο κρύο και στη ζέστη.
5. Δόλωμα: κατάταξη ανά κουζίνα, αποθήκη και παρόμοιους χώρους.
6. Χάρτης: σημεία τοποθέτησης· πατήστε μια τελεία για τον λόγο.
7. Πρόγραμμα ελέγχου: επόμενη επίσκεψη και αλλαγή σανίδας.
8. Καταγραφή στο ιστορικό της συσκευής. Σχόλια επάνω δεξιά.

Σημείωση
Ο υπολογισμός είναι βοήθημα σχεδιασμού, όχι υπόσχεση σύλληψης ούτε άδεια εργασίας. Κρατήστε τις σανίδες μακριά από παιδιά και κατοικίδια. Τα δεδομένα μένουν στη συσκευή.

name: Goal Bingo 2027: Resolutions
description:
This year, your resolutions won't be forgotten by February: they become a game.

Goal Bingo 2027 turns your goals into a bingo card. Fill your squares, check them off through the year, and hit BINGO every time you complete a line. Confetti included.

FILL YOUR CARD IN ONE MINUTE
• Pick up to 3 themes: health, travel, learning, money, friends…
• Your iPhone's AI suggests a full card, right on your device (Apple Intelligence devices; otherwise 200+ ideas curated by our team)
• Drag squares to rearrange, add an emoji and a note
• 3×3, 4×4 or 5×5 cards with a free center space, like real bingo

CHECK IT, CALL BINGO
• One tap stamps a square, with satisfying haptics
• Rows, columns, diagonals: every BINGO is a party (double, triple, blackout!)
• Repeat goals: "Read 12 books" moves forward book by book
• Always know if you're ahead or on track, with zero guilt

ALWAYS IN SIGHT
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets
• Check a square right from the widget
• A quick monthly check-in and gentle reminders
• Siri & Shortcuts support

SHARE AND CHALLENGE FRIENDS
• Export a beautiful image of your card for Stories or posts
• Create a challenge, send the code and follow the leaderboard all year

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS
Your cards stay on your iPhone. No sign-up, no ads, no tracking.

GOAL BINGO PREMIUM
One 3×3 card is free forever. Premium unlocks unlimited 4×4 and 5×5 cards, advanced widgets, friends challenges, 8 themes, repeat goals and watermark-free export. Monthly or yearly subscription (7-day free trial on yearly) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage them in your Apple account settings.

Privacy: https://schmittutility.fr/confidentialite/
Support: https://schmittutility.fr/assistance/

name: Goblin Scrapyard
description:
Bolt more firepower onto your scrapyard rig!

Hold the line against enemy vehicles with automatic fire. Tap a floating weapon model once to target it. Break it open, watch the part snap onto your vehicle, and build a wider barrage as the battle grows.

• Build during battle: combine six weapon families, including machine guns, electric coils and missiles, with temporary armor.
• See your upgrades: add turrets, widen your barrage and evolve your chassis.
• Grow across runs: keep blueprints, permanent weapon upgrades and chassis progress. Extra turrets and battle bonuses are rebuilt each deployment.
• Take on 30 areas and 15 elite contracts with stronger enemies and gatekeeper bosses.
• Manage special weapons: recover limited deployments from bosses or craft new supplies. Failed deployments preserve special-weapon uses.

No login is required. Progress is stored on your device. Optional rewarded ads and a one-time Shredder Pass are available. The pass skips the same reward ads and unlocks gold paint; existing reward eligibility and use limits still apply. No subscription.

name: Goedhart Zorgt
description:
Deze Goedhart Zorgt App biedt eenvoud en gemak in het proces!

Met deze App kan je als flexwerker van Goedhart Zorgt o.a. diensten en opdrachten bekijken en accepteren, gewerkte uren registreren, urenstaten en de agenda inzien.

De App is gekoppeld aan het systeem waardoor informatie altijd up-to-date is, via een overzichtelijk dashboard. Bovendien komen belangrijke meldingen, als nieuw beschikbare opdrachten, via een push melding binnen op het apparaat. Zo zie je niets over het hoofd. Ook wijzigingen worden direct zichtbaar, ook in de agenda. Je bent dus altijd op de juiste plaats aanwezig.

Bovendien kun je direct contact opnemen met Goedhart Zorgt via de Chat binnen deze App. Ideaal als je toch nog ergens vragen over hebt.

De App van Goedhart Zorgt is er voor jou, om te zorgen dat jij je werk zo makkelijk mogelijk kan doen!

name: GoFindLive: Live Entertainment
description:
Somebody's playing. Go hear it.

GoFindLive is the easiest way to find live entertainment near you: tonight, this weekend, or whenever you're free. See what's on, who's performing, where, and when, all in one place. We're starting with live music and adding more kinds of live entertainment as we grow.

FIND SOMETHING TONIGHT
See what's live right now, what's starting soon, and what's on later, color-coded so you can tell at a glance. Tap any show for the venue, the performer, the cover charge, and directions.

EXPLORE IT YOUR WAY
Browse tonight's lineup, search by performer, venue, or genre, or open the map to see what's happening around you.

FILTER FOR YOUR KIND OF NIGHT
Filter venues by type (bar, dive bar, lounge, restaurant, outdoor space), whether they serve food, and age requirements. Filter performers by genre, where they're from, and solo act or full band.

KNOW THE ROOMS AND THE PEOPLE IN THEM
Every venue has a page with what kind of place it is, photos, hours, the address, and upcoming shows. Every performer has one too, with bio, links, genres, and where they usually play.

KEEP UP WITH THE ONES YOU LIKE
Follow venues and performers to hear about new shows. Save the ones you want to go to and add them straight to your calendar.

NOW COVERING WILMINGTON AND CHARLESTON
Wilmington, Wrightsville Beach, Carolina Beach, Kure Beach, Surf City, Hampstead, Leland, Southport, and Charleston, South Carolina. More cities coming.

FREE FOR FANS. FREE FOR PERFORMERS.
No account needed to browse. Performers get a free page they can claim and run themselves. Venues get a free page too, and can post their lineups and set up weekly nights.

Find it. Fill it. Play it.

Made in Wilmington by people who go to these shows.

Questions, corrections, or a show we're missing? gofindlive@gmail.com

name: GoHanin
description:
GoHanin is a Korean-language app for Korean communities in the United States and Canada. We are starting with Seattle and Washington State, and more regions are on the way.

News
- Local news (Seattle and Washington first) plus major U.S. and Korean headlines, summarized in Korean every day.
- Browse by topic: Seattle, U.S., World, Business, Sports and more.
- Optional morning reminder and email newsletter.

Korean businesses
- Find Korean restaurants, markets, clinics, salons, realtors and more by name or category.
- Call or get directions in one tap.

Community boards
- Community: questions, restaurants, parenting, meetups.
- Jobs: browse by area, job type and pay.
- Marketplace: buy and sell used items with photos.
- Rentals: rooms, homes and commercial space.
- Chat with the poster inside the app.

Account
- Sign up with Apple, Google or email. The same account works on gohanin.com.
- Report inappropriate posts and comments, and block other members.
- Delete your account at any time from the My Info tab.

You must be 13 or older to create an account.

name: Goldmend
description:
Mend broken pottery with lacquer and gold, one stage at a time.

Goldmend is a workshop log for kintsugi, the Japanese craft of repairing broken ceramics with urushi lacquer and finishing the seams in gold. A traditional mend takes weeks of joining, filling, coating and curing. Goldmend keeps track of every piece, every stage and every day in the curing box.

THE BENCH
• Add a broken bowl, plate, cup, vase or tile and note its material, size and story.
• Draw where it broke: trace each crack with your finger over the vessel and tap to mark chips. Goldmend measures the total seam length for you.
• See every piece in progress, its current stage and how long is left in the cure, plus a shelf of your finished mends.

STAGE BY STAGE
• Choose traditional urushi or modern epoxy, and Goldmend lays out the stages: dry-fit, join with mugi-urushi, kokuso for chips, sabi fill, sanding, the black coat, the red line and gold dust, and the final rest.
• Each stage explains what to do. Start a cure with one tap, adjust the time, and see a countdown ring until it's ready.
• Add another coat when a fill needs it, take a piece out early, and leave a note on any stage.
• Optional reminders tell you when a cure has finished.
• Add before, during and after photos of each piece.
• Share a one-page PDF mend record with the seam map, the story and every stage date. It travels with the piece.

MURO
Urushi hardens in a warm, humid box called a muro. Log the temperature and humidity, see them on a dial and a chart, and get plain advice when the box is too dry, too humid or too cold. The page also shows what is curing right now, and explains how to build a simple muro at home.

GOLD
Work out how much gold or silver powder a mend needs, from a piece's seam map or a typed length. Choose the line width, the powder (keshi-fun, hira-fun, maru-fun, silver or brass) and a reserve, and add a price per gram to estimate the cost. Goldmend checks the result against the powder in your kit.

KIT
Keep track of lacquers, powders, fillers, tools and gloves, and see what's running low.

GUIDE
Safety first: how to avoid urushi rash and when to see a doctor, and which mends are display-only. It also covers the two ways to mend, every traditional and epoxy stage, and a glossary of kintsugi terms.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account or login. No ads, analytics or tracking. Everything you record stays on your iPhone.

name: Good Light: Pose Camera
description:
Find your light and feel more confident in front of the camera. Good Light brings simple guidance to the moments before and after you take a photo.

FIND YOUR LIGHT
Use the live selfie preview to find a brighter direction for your face.

EXPLORE POSE GUIDES
Choose from 15 guides for standing portraits, seated poses, headshots, and photos with two people. Open How to Pose for tips for the person in front of the camera and the photographer.

FRAME YOUR SHOT
Use composition guides and a thirds grid with select poses. Flip a guide to suit your shot, or use the three-second countdown for group photos.

MAKE IT YOURS
Preview background blur as you compose, then choose Soft Light and Background Blur after capture. Compare your edit with the original before saving.

MADE FOR YOUR IPHONE
On iPhone Duo, use Outer Preview to share the framing with your subject and try Auto Capture with supported poses. Availability varies by pose and device.

Photos and effects are processed on your device. You choose when to save a photo to your Photos library.

name: Goodly Chat
description:
Goodly Chat is a private team-chat app for agencies and the clients they work with.

For teams
• Rooms, direct messages and threads
• Tasks and due dates inside each room
• Voice and video calls and meetings
• Files, photos and voice messages
• Push notifications, with the unread count on the app icon
• Optional app lock with Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode
• Send photos and files into Goodly Chat from any app with the iOS Share sheet
• Sign in with Apple, Google or your company email

For clients
• Join your agency's private room with an invite code
• Send photos, logos and files straight from your phone
• See only your own room; leave and delete your data at any time

Goodly Chat is for teams that already have an account from their administrator and for clients invited by them. There is no public sign-up.

name: GOOSE MOVIE
description:
Goose Movie（鵝電影）是一個用繁體中文打造的電影與影集資料庫，也是影迷的評論社群。

不管是好萊塢、日韓、歐洲還是華語電影，你都可以在這裡查資料、記錄自己的觀影、看大家怎麼評。

【查電影、查影集】
・電影與電視劇的簡介、演職員、劇照、上映資訊
・影人頁：導演、演員的完整作品
・影展與獎項資料
・熱映中、即將上映，以及排行榜（總榜、年度、類型、地區、一週口碑）

【記錄你的觀影】
・把作品標記成「想看」「在看」「看過」
・打分數、寫評論（短短一句或長篇都可以）
・觀影日記、年度回顧
・建立自己的片單，也能追蹤別人的片單

【和影友交流】
・看別人的評論、投「有用」、留言討論
・追蹤你喜歡的影友
・鵝聊：和朋友一對一私訊，或建立小群組聊電影

【搬家不用重來】
・可以把豆瓣、Letterboxd、IMDb 匯出的觀影紀錄匯入（檔案只在你的手機上讀取，不會被整份上傳），也能隨時匯出自己的資料

【三種字形】
・台灣正體、香港繁體、大陸簡體，隨時切換，作品名稱會依地區顯示習慣的譯名

【安全與隱私】
・沒有廣告，不追蹤你
・每一筆標記與評分都可以設成僅自己可見
・評論、討論、圖片、訊息都能檢舉，也能封鎖其他使用者
・可以在 App 內自己刪除帳號

本產品使用 TMDB API，但未經 TMDB 認證或背書。
電影與影集的基本資料與圖片來自 TMDB，部分影展資料整理自維基百科（CC BY-SA）。

name: GPS Coordinates: Where Am I?
description:
See exactly where you are, in the format you need.

GPS Coordinates shows your position the moment you open it. Switch between decimal degrees, degrees-minutes-seconds, degrees-decimal minutes, UTM, MGRS and Plus Code, then copy or share the result in one tap.

FREE
• Coordinates in DD, DMS, DDM, UTM, MGRS and Plus Code
• Copy and share your position
• Altitude and GPS accuracy
• Compass heading
• Street address when you are online
• Coordinates work offline, without signal
• Three saved places
• SOS texting is always free. Hold the button for two seconds and a message to your chosen contacts opens, ready to send, with your coordinates and a map link. Nothing is sent until you press send. The app does not replace calling emergency services.

PRO
• Unlimited saved places
• Find-back arrow that points to a saved place, with live distance
• Export to GPX, KML and CSV
• GPS camera that stamps photos with coordinates, address, altitude, compass heading, date and time
• Apple Watch app and widgets (coming in this version)

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no sign-up. Your location stays on your phone. Only Apple's address lookup receives coordinates, and only when you are online.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
GPS Coordinates Pro is $29.99 per year, with a 7-day free trial, or $7.99 per month. The monthly plan has no trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or at the end of the free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Gradelift
description:
Gradelift is a weighted grade and GPA tracker for high-school and university students. Copy the weights from your syllabus once, enter marks as they come back, and always know where you stand and what the final has to look like.

WEIGHTED GRADES THAT ADD UP
Add terms and courses with their credits. For each course, add assessments with a weight and a score out of any number of points. Gradelift shows the running weighted grade, how much of the course is already earned, how much is lost and how much is still open, all in one grade gauge with your target marked as a notch.

WHAT DO I NEED?
Set a target for each course and Gradelift solves for the average you need on everything still ungraded. It shows the points needed on each remaining assessment, your best and worst possible final, and a ladder with what every letter grade would take. When a target becomes reachable you hear a light chime; when it slips out of reach you get a calm low tone and a clear message.

WHAT-IF MODE
