Slide hypothetical scores on any assessment and watch the projected course grade, term GPA and cumulative GPA move. Nothing in What-if is saved, so you can experiment freely before exam week.

YOUR GRADING SCALE
Each course reports in percent, letter grades or 4.0 / 5.0 GPA points. Edit the letter mapping yourself: letters, minimum percentages and grade points. Term GPA and cumulative GPA are weighted by credits.

CLEAR WARNINGS
If a course's weights don't add up to 100%, Gradelift says so on the course and explains how the grade is scaled until you fix it.

BUILT FOR STUDY DESKS
A graded ruler along the bottom takes you to Overview, Courses, What-if and Desk. Three themes (Exam Paper, Library Night, Citrus Desk), subtle pen-click and eraser sounds, haptics, and tabular numbers that line up.

ACCOUNTS, GUESTS AND OFFLINE USE
Start right away with Calculate as guest, or create an account with email and password. Guests can save their marks to an email account later from Desk. Your data syncs through your private account and stays usable offline.

PRIVACY
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your marks are private to your account. Delete your account and every term, course and mark from Desk at any time.

name: Grand Finale: Fireworks Puzzle
description:
Turn the fuse. Light the match. Enjoy the show.

Each level is a fireworks show at night: a board of fuse pieces, a match at the bottom, and a row of rockets waiting on the rack. Tap a piece to turn it. Fuse joined to the match glows, and every rocket it reaches lights up with its beat: how many squares the spark must burn to get there.

The show card says the order the rockets should go off in. The spark burns one square a beat, so a longer fuse means a later rocket. When the quickest route sends a rocket up too soon, break the shortcut and send the spark the long way round. Get the plan right, light it, and watch the spark race along the fuse as each rocket climbs and bursts in turn, ending in a grand finale.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a fuse piece to turn it. Join every rocket to the match: joined fuse glows.
• The spark burns one square a beat, so a longer fuse goes off later. A rocket's number is its beat.
• Make the rockets go off in the card's order. Side by side on the card: together, on the same beat.
• Too soon? Break the shortcut, so the spark goes the long way round. Bolted pieces don't turn.
• Light it! Hold the screen to speed the show up. Right on the first light: three stars.

FEATURES
• Easy to learn, with a real puzzle in every level
• Levels that never run out, bringing in one new idea at a time: the order, rockets that go off together, spare fuse, bolted pieces
• Short tips that point out each new idea as it arrives
• Stars for every level, and a Levels screen to go back and better any of them
• A show worth the wait: the spark runs along the fuse, rockets climb and burst in six neon colors, and every right answer ends in a grand finale
• No timer and no way to lose: light it as often as you like, and undo or restart any time
• Crisp sounds and haptics as pieces turn and rockets burst

Grand Finale is free to play, with ads. One optional purchase, No Ads, ends the ads between levels for good.

Questions or ideas? We'd love to hear from you at onedeskstudios.com/grand-finale/support

name: Grid Pop: Block Puzzle
description:
Grid Pop is a calm, colourful block puzzle that is easy to learn and hard to put down.

HOW TO PLAY
Drag blocks from the tray onto the 8x8 grid. Fill a whole row or column and it pops. Use all three blocks and you get three new ones. The game ends when none of your blocks fit anywhere, so plan ahead and keep space open.

COMBOS AND BIG SCORES
Pop several lines with one block for a bigger score, and keep popping move after move to build a combo. Clear the whole grid for an ALL CLEAR bonus.

NO TIMER, NO RUSH
Take your time over every move. Play a quick game on a break or a long one on the couch.

DAILY BOARD
A new starting board every day, the same for every player. Come back daily to keep your streak going and earn bonus coins.

SKINS AND BOARDS
Earn coins as you play and unlock new block styles (Pastel, Wood, Jelly, Gems, Neon) and new boards like Lagoon, Paper Desk, Moss Forest, Sunset Pier and Deep Space.

NO SIGN-UP
No account, no email, no password. Just open the app and play. Your progress stays on your device.

Grid Pop is free to play with ads. A one-time "Remove Ads" in-app purchase turns off the banner and between-game ads. Optional reward ads (a rescue when you run out of room, double coins) are always your choice.

name: Grub Wars
description:
Grub Wars is a turn-based artillery game for iPhone. You command a team of grubs against a team of beetles or ants, on a battlefield you can blow holes in. On your turn you have 45 seconds to crawl, jump, aim and fire. Then the other team gets a turn. You win when the other team is knocked out or in the water.

The game is free to download and has no ads.

28 WEAPONS AND TOOLS
You start with five: Rocket, Grenade, Homing, Dynamite and Air strike. You are given the other 23 as you win your way through the worlds. Each battle gives you a set of up to ten.
• Rocket: explodes on what it hits. The wind pushes it, and the wind changes every turn.
• Grenade: bounces, then explodes.
• Drill: digs a tunnel the way you aim.
• Kill shot: one straight bullet that does 100 damage on a direct hit.
• Teleport, Jetpack and Grapple: get to places you cannot crawl to.
• Sword and Wallop: for when the enemy is standing right next to you.
• And more, including Shotgun, Cluster, Mine, Sticky bomb, Fire bottle, Wasp nest, Laser, Freeze, Shield, Earthquake, Black hole and Drone.

Every explosion takes a piece out of the ground, so the battlefield is different after each shot. Some battlefields have portals. A shot that goes into one portal comes out of the other.

PLAY ON YOUR OWN
• Worlds: 30 worlds and 343 levels across islands, sky islands, caves, ships at sea and portal maps. You win a world to open the next one. Each world ends with a fight against a crowned boss twice the size of a normal soldier. On some levels one of your grubs starts buried underground, and you drill or blast it out to get it back on your team. Your grubs get 5 more health for every world you win.
• Quick battle: pick the battlefield, the portals, who you fight and one of four difficulty levels.
• Daily battle: one battle a day, the same one for everyone. You get one try, and you can share your result.
• Weapon range: try every weapon, with unlimited shots, against targets that do not shoot back.
• You can pause any battle that is not online.

PLAY WITH OTHER PEOPLE
• Pass the phone: two players on one iPhone. You do not need to sign in.
• Play at your own pace: a two-player match through Game Center. You take your turn when you have time.
• Play live now: a two-player match through Game Center with 45 seconds a turn.
• Party match: two to eight players in two teams, with both teams firing at the same time.
• You can play as grubs, beetles or ants.
• A Game Center leaderboard counts your online wins.

COINS AND THE STORE
You earn coins in the worlds: for knocking out an enemy, for knocking out two or three in one turn, for winning a battle, for beating a boss, and for reaching a loot chest before the enemy does. Win a battle in the worlds each day and you also earn a daily prize. Seven days in a row wins a free weapon upgrade.

You spend coins in the Store:
• Weapon upgrades: each of the three levels gives you one more shot a battle and makes the weapon hit harder.
• Hearts: if you lose a battle in the worlds, a heart brings your whole team back at half health so you can carry on.
• Hats for your grubs. Colours are free.
During a battle in the worlds you can also tap your coins to patch up a grub, take one more shot or call in a supply crate.

Upgrades, hearts and the battle shop only count in the worlds, against the computer. Online matches are always even.

If you want coins sooner, you can buy a pack of 300, 1,000 or 2,200 coins. You do not have to. Everything coins buy can be earned by playing.

Grub Wars does not collect any information about you.

name: GSArvethion
description: 個人の家計を整理する際、取引内訳表を活用すれば、お金がどこに使われたかを容易に追跡できます。 表示は月別、口座別、あるいはタグ別に切り替えることが可能です。 特定のカテゴリの合計額をクリックすると、その内訳となる個別の取引を確認できるほか、現在のフィルタ設定を維持したまま新しい取引を追加することもできます。 1回の支払いが複数の目的を兼ねている場合は、1つの記録の中で金額を適切に割り振ることができ、返金については元の支払いと紐付けることが可能です。 未入力の取引が溜まっている場合は、ワークシート形式で1行ずつ入力し、収入と支出の合計を確認した上で、まとめて記録できます。 また、期間の長さが同じ2つの時期を比較することで、その差額から具体的な取引内容まで詳細に掘り下げて確認することが可能です。 よくある質問とその回答を保存しておけば、次回以降、すぐに最新の回答へアクセスできます。 さらに、照合機能（リコンシリエーション）を活用することで、未分類の取引や重複の可能性があるデータ、口座残高の不一致などを効率的に処理できます。

name: Guard Still Up
description:
Cone Pack watches three witness cones, cooler to hotter.

A hotter cone cannot bend farther than the cooler cone beside it. That bend springs back. The guide cone bends first, then the firing cone, then the guard.

Draw the kiln only when the firing cone is down and the guard cone is still up. If the guard cone goes down, the firing is overfired and cannot be saved as a successful draw. A finished firing stays as it is.

Each firing stays on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Guide & Tricks for GTA 6
description:
Your pocket guide to the new open-world game set in Leonida. Everything works offline.

• CHEATS BY PLATFORM: button sequences for PS5 and Xbox, phone numbers, favorites and a step-by-step mode that shows each button large while you enter it. Until GTA VI codes are confirmed, it includes the classic, verified GTA V cheats. Story mode only.
• ILLUSTRATED MAP: Leonida's six regions and their places, with filters, search and saved places.
• SECRETS: easter eggs and collectibles with spoiler protection and progress tracking.
• GUIDES: characters, world, vehicles, editions and tips, with sources cited.
• Spanish, English and Portuguese. No sign-up.

UNOFFICIAL fan-made guide. Not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto, GTA and Rockstar Games are trademarks of their respective owners and are mentioned only to identify the game.

Terms of use and license (EULA): https://viz-ia.com/apps/guia-gta6/en/eula
Privacy: https://viz-ia.com/apps/guia-gta6/en/privacy

name: HaldenHalvmark
description: HaldenHalvmark on venturiputkien ja differenssipaineeseen perustuvien virtausmittausten apusovellus. Se laskee putken koon, beta-suhteen, paine-eron, tilavuusvirran, nesteen ominaisuudet sekä painehäviön ja tarkkuuden. Liukusäätimillä säädetään halkaisijaa, kurkkua, painetta, virtaamaa ja lämpötilaa, ja tulokset voi tallentaa tai viedä virtaus tiedostona. Pro-versio avataan kertamaksulla ilman mainoksia tai tilausta, ja kaikki toimii offline-tilassa.

name: HandoffAtlas
description: Create a dated property inventory and carry it through check-out. Add rooms and fixtures, record arrival and departure conditions independently, and attach notes and photographs from Photos. The inventory distinguishes changed conditions, unchanged conditions and items still awaiting check-out. Preview a paginated PDF with room summaries, dated observations and labeled photo pages, then send a copy to the people handling the handoff. Working records stay on your iPhone or iPad.

name: HangulTalk Korean Conversation
description:
Learn Korean the way it is actually spoken — at the airport, in a café, on the subway, at the hotel, while shopping and with friends.

HangulTalk turns everyday situations into short comic scenes. Tap any speech bubble to hear it, move freely through the conversation line by line, and repeat the parts you want until they feel natural.

• 12 everyday situations × 4 scenes each, all free — no locks, no hearts, no subscription
• Tap a bubble to listen; replay one line or a whole section
• Timeline player: jump to any line, slow down the speed
• Role-play: take one side of the conversation and answer at your own pace
• Show or hide Hangul, romanization and translation separately
• Save useful sentences, add your own notes and review them later
• Works offline, no sign-up — audio uses your iPhone's text-to-speech

Great for travelers, students planning to study in Korea and fans of K-dramas and K-pop who want to start speaking.

No ads, no account, no tracking.

Illustrations were created with an AI image model and reviewed by the developer.

name: Hapli: Shared Grocery List
description:
Hapli is a grocery list that shows exactly what to buy. Add a photo to an item and whoever does the shopping grabs the right brand, size and flavor the first time.

LISTS THAT MATCH THE STORE
• Items are grouped by category, so you walk the store once instead of doubling back.
• Check items off as you go; finished lists move out of the way.
• Make as many lists as you like: weekly shop, the warehouse store, the party.

PHOTOS SO NOBODY HAS TO GUESS
• Snap the product or pick a photo from your library.
• Add a quantity and a note, like "the low-sodium one".

WORKS WITHOUT SIGNAL
• Lists keep working in the back of the store with no signal. Changes sync as soon as you're back online.

SHOP TOGETHER
• Join a list someone shares with you and see changes as they happen.
• Reply on an item ("they're out, get the other one?") and get an alert when someone adds or checks things off.
• Block or report anyone, any time.

HAPLI PREMIUM
Free includes unlimited lists and one photo per item. Premium adds:
• Your pantry: save the things you buy often, with their photos, and add them in one tap.
• Share your lists with family and friends.
• Up to 4 photos per item: the front, the back, the label.
• Your own photo as a list icon.
• Custom categories, named and ordered the way your store is laid out.
Premium is a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription, charged to your Apple Account. It renews until you cancel, at least 24 hours before the end of the period, in your App Store account settings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your lists are only visible to you and the people you invite. Download your data or delete your account any time in the app.

Terms of Use: https://hapli.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://hapli.app/privacy
Questions or ideas? support@hapli.app

name: Haptic Box Breathing Timer
description:
Tap Start and follow a box breathing session by feel. Every phase has its own haptic cue, so you can keep your eyes off the screen.

The default session is ready the moment the app opens: breathe in for 4, hold for 4, breathe out for 4, hold for 4, three times. About 48 seconds from start to finish.

A pacing timer that counts for you. One screen, one button, nothing to set up.

HOW IT WORKS
- A square traces each phase: up while you breathe in, across while you hold, down while you breathe out, back while you hold again
- The phase name and a large countdown are always on screen
- Distinct haptics: a rising hum to breathe in, one soft tap to hold, a falling hum to breathe out, two quick taps for the second hold
- Preview every cue in Settings, or turn haptics off and follow the text
- Pause, resume or stop at any time. The timer and the cues stay in step
- Your last session is saved and shown when you come back

PREMIUM
- Set the length of every phase: 2 to 12 seconds to breathe in or out, 0 to 12 seconds to hold
- Run longer sessions, up to 30 cycles
- Save your favorite rhythms by name
- See your full session history

No account and no ads. Your sessions and rhythms stay on your iPhone.

Haptic Box Breathing Timer is a pacing timer, not medical advice. Breathe at a comfortable pace, and stop if you feel dizzy.

SUBSCRIPTION
Haptic Box Breathing Timer Premium is available as a weekly subscription at $2.99 with a 3-day free trial, or an annual subscription at $14.99. Prices may vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase or when the free trial ends. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings > your name > Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/box-breathing-timer/terms
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/box-breathing-timer/privacy

name: Harvest Fair: Big Merge
description:
A village fair to merge your way through, at your own pace.

MERGE AND DELIVER
Tap a supply to get something simple. Put two of the same thing together to make the next: flour becomes dough, dough becomes a bread roll, all the way to a prize layer cake. Hand the stalls what they ask for to earn stars and coins.

FOUR SEASONS OF THE FAIR
Spring Fête, Summer Fair, Harvest Festival and Winter Market, forty orders in all. Each season brings a new supply and decorations to buy for the fairground.

NOTHING IS TIMED
- No energy, no waiting, no countdowns
- Supplies refill when you deliver, and a free delivery arrives if you ever run dry
- Big items with a tier number on each one
- Play by tapping or by dragging

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose a board and backdrop from the free looks, or add the Garden, Evening and Seaside packs.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Vietnamese and Thai.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
- Works offline
- No account, no sign-in
- Your game stays on your device

name: Heads or Tiles: Fruit Stand
description:
Heads or Tiles: Fruit Stand is a word game where every tile has a letter on one side and a fruit on the other.

Roll the die, flip that many tiles, and spell a word with the board and your own seven tiles. Every board letter you use drops the fruit hidden behind it into your fruit stand. Get three of each fruit to fill your stand.

FLIPPIN’ FACE-OFF
Play against Pip, the computer, on easy, normal or hard. The first full stand ends the game after the round, and the most fruit wins.

FLIPPIN’ SOLO
Just you and the clock. Fill your stand as fast as you can and beat your best time.

DAILY CHALLENGE
A new board every day, the same for everyone, and one try. Share your time.

BIG WORDS AND JEWEL FRUIT
A word of six letters or more wins a bonus fruit. Spell a jewel fruit into a word of four letters or more and it fills that whole fruit stand at once. If your stand of that fruit is already full, the jewel wipes out Pip's.

NO ACCOUNT, NOTHING COLLECTED
No sign-up, no ads, nothing to buy, and it plays offline. Your scores stay on your phone. Privacy: https://headsortiles.com/privacy/

Words are checked against the public-domain ENABLE word list, about 150,000 English words.

Terms: https://headsortiles.com/terms/

name: Health History Import
description:
Bring the history you recorded elsewhere into Apple Health.

You moved to an iPhone or an Apple Watch, and years of steps, sleep, weight, heart rate and workouts stayed behind in another app. Health History Import reads the data file that service lets you download and writes its history into the Health app, on your iPhone.

FILES IT READS
• Samsung Health: the "Download personal data" folder or a ZIP of it
• Fitbit: the Google Takeout download, or the older MyFitbitData.zip
• Google Fit: the Google Takeout download
• Health Connect: the Health Connect.zip backup
• Garmin Connect: the "Export Your Data" ZIP
• Any spreadsheet saved as CSV, with columns you map yourself

SEE IT BEFORE YOU PAY
Choosing a file and scanning it is free. The preview shows exactly what was found: how many records of each type, from which dates, and what Health already holds for the same days. You decide what goes in. One purchase then imports everything, from every file, now and later. No subscription. No account.

WHAT COMES OVER
Depending on what your file holds: steps, walking and cycling distance, flights climbed, active energy, workouts with their type, time, distance and energy, sleep with its stages, heart rate, resting heart rate, blood oxygen, respiratory rate, blood pressure, blood glucose, weight, body fat, height and water. The app lists, for each service, what it brings over and what it leaves out, before you start.

NOTHING COUNTED TWICE
• When a phone and a watch both recorded the same steps or the same workout, they are imported once.
• Every record has a stable identity. Import the same file again, or a newer download that includes older days, and no second copy is created.
• One control deletes everything this app wrote. Data from other apps and devices is never touched.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your file is read on your iPhone. The app has no account, no analytics and no server, and your health data never leaves the device.

HONEST LIMITS
• Some services store only one total per day; those days come over as daily totals.
• Garmin's download has no sleep stages and no minute-by-minute data outside its sensor files.
• Workout routes (GPS), nutrition logs, stress scores and heart rate variability are not imported.
• Calories are not imported from services that record resting and active energy as one figure.
• The Health Connect reader follows the published layout of that file; check the preview before importing.
• This app does not read an export made by Apple Health itself.

Long imports resume where they stopped if the app is interrupted.

Health History Import is made by Arctic Studios and is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by Samsung, Google, Fitbit or Garmin. Samsung Health, Google Fit, Fitbit, Health Connect and Garmin Connect are trademarks of their respective owners and are named only to say whose files the app reads.

name: HealthSights
description:
HealthSights adds insights to the health tracking you already do. It reads your steps, sleep, heart and workout data and turns them into patterns, trends and plain-English findings, each one honest about how sure it is.

TODAY IN CONTEXT
• Your steps so far against your typical day for this weekday: a Thursday is compared with your Thursdays.
• A dashed line shows where today is heading, from the steps you usually take in the rest of the day.
• Press and drag the chart to read any hour: today, your usual and your pace.
• A "right now" line: how far ahead or behind your usual you are, and the hour you normally catch up.
• Weekly goal rings that count a week with five goal days out of seven, so a rest day never breaks a streak.

CHARTS YOU CAN EXPLORE
• Drag across any trend to read an exact day, week or month, from the last 30 days back to all time.
• Tap a bar to see what's behind it: a day this week opens hour by hour, and a part of the month opens the months it came from.
• Choose what "usual" means: your recent weeks, all your history, or since a date you pick.

FIND YOUR PATTERNS
• Which day of the week you move most, and whether you fade at the end of the month.
• Morning, afternoon or evening: where your steps really come from, hour by hour.
• What your best days have in common.
• A written week in review, with one thing to try.

TEST WHAT CHANGES YOUR SLEEP
• Tag days with late caffeine, a late workout, a late meal or anything you like.
• After five tagged days, HealthSights compares them with the rest: the night's sleep, the next morning's resting heart rate and HRV, and your activity.

EVERY FINDING TELLS YOU HOW SURE IT IS
Each finding shows how many days it rests on and is marked Clear, Likely or Could be chance. Things that move together are called connections, never causes.

WIDGETS
Today's pace on your Home Screen and Lock Screen, free.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your health data stays on your iPhone and is worked out on the device. There's no account, no server, no ads and no tracking, and HealthSights never writes to your health data. Works with or without an Apple Watch.

FREE AND PRO
HealthSights is free with every measure, every trend, today's pace, patterns, best days, the week in review, the monthly recap, one tag and the pace widget.

HealthSights Pro is $2.99 a month or $19.99 a year, with a free week on the yearly plan, and adds:
• Every insight, including connections such as sleep and resting heart rate
• Unlimited tags
• Goal planner: a target and a date, with a plan built from your own weeks
• Guided experiments: a two-week test with a daily check-in and a verdict
• Before and after: mark a date and see what changed since
• Workout types: what each kind of workout does to your sleep and heart
• Sleep timing: how regular your nights are, and which bedtime suits you
• Busy days: how full calendar days change your steps and sleep
• Compare any two measures, or any two periods
• Saved periods, such as "Summer" or "New job", to compare and use as your usual
• Your marked dates, tests and tags drawn on the trend charts
• Year in review and milestones, with cards to share
• A one-page report and spreadsheet to take to your doctor
• Widgets for last night's sleep, this week's goal days and your test check-in

WHERE YOUR DATA COMES FROM
HealthSights reads steps, distance, active energy, exercise minutes, flights climbed, sleep, resting heart rate, heart rate variability and workouts from the Health app, with your permission. You choose what to share and can change it at any time in Settings.

HealthSights is not a medical device and doesn't diagnose, treat or prevent any condition. Talk to a doctor about any health concern.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions. Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: HearOnce
description:
One completely random sound a day. You hear it exactly once — then guess what it was from memory.

Every morning at 8am ET a new sound arrives, drawn from a library of over 1,000 real-world sounds. Tap play, listen carefully, and pick what you heard from 5 options. The title stays hidden until you solve it — and with golf scoring, solving on your first try is worth 1 point, your second is worth 2, and so on. Fewest points wins.

No replays. No second chances. Just you, one sound, and your ears.

• One random sound every day, from over 1,000 real sounds
• Hear it once, then guess from 5 options
• Golf scoring — fewest tries wins
• New sound every morning at 8am ET
• Optional daily reminder so you never miss a sound
• No sign-up, no ads — just listen and guess

name: Hearthbook: Home Care & Costs
description:
Hearthbook is the logbook for your house. Add your water heater, furnace, AC, dishwasher and the rest, and Hearthbook keeps track of how old they are, when they need care, when their warranties end and what they really cost you.

SCAN A LABEL, GET THE FACTS
Point the camera at an appliance's rating plate. Hearthbook reads the brand, model and serial number on your iPhone and, for many water heaters and HVAC units, works out when it was made from the serial number.

A CARE PLAN THAT FITS YOUR HOME
Every appliance comes with a starter maintenance plan: furnace filters, smoke alarm tests, flushing the water heater, cleaning the dryer vent. Seasonal jobs follow your climate, such as winterizing hose bibs before a freeze or hurricane prep. Reminders arrive at 9 AM; mark a job done right from the notification.

RECALL WATCH
Hearthbook checks the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission's recall list for your appliances every week and tells you if one of yours is affected, with what to do next.

THE TRUE COST OF YOUR HOME
See one honest monthly number: fixed costs like mortgage, insurance and utilities, plus your repairs averaged over the year, plus what to set aside for replacing appliances as they age. A 10-year forecast shows what is likely to need replacing and when.

DOCUMENT VAULT
Scan receipts, manuals, warranties and insurance papers. Hearthbook reads a receipt's store, date and total and fills in the appliance's price and warranty for you, then reminds you before a warranty or policy runs out.

HOME HEALTH SCORE
One score that shows how your home is doing: overdue jobs, appliances near the end of their life and open recalls.

HOME HISTORY REPORT
Make a PDF of your home's appliances, care history, costs and documents to share with a buyer, an insurer or a contractor.

ASK YOUR HOME
With Apple Intelligence, ask questions like "When did I last service the furnace?" or "How much did I spend on repairs this year?" Answers come from your own records, on your device.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your data stays on your iPhone and in your own iCloud. Text recognition and Apple Intelligence run on your device.

WIDGETS AND SIRI
See your score and the next jobs on your Home Screen, or tell Siri you've done a job.

HEARTHBOOK PREMIUM
Free: one home and up to 15 appliances, care plans, reminders, recall checks, costs and the vault.
Premium adds unlimited appliances, AI reading of labels and receipts, the Home History Report and Ask your home.
- Monthly: $4.99
- Yearly: $34.99, with a 7-day free trial
- Lifetime: $79.99, one payment
Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://kumi20.github.io/hearthbook-legal/privacy.html

name: HeatZone: Room BTU
description:
HeatZone: Room BTU is your offline-first interactive room heat loss calculator, radiator section estimator, and radiant floor heating planner. Designed for homeowners, HVAC installers, plumbers, and DIY renovators, HeatZone turns thermal engineering math into a clear, stress-free routine.

Interactively mark exterior cold walls and windows on a 2D room floor plan, drag radiators or radiant floor loops into place, and visualize real-time thermal heat distribution heatmaps without needing an active internet connection.

Key Features and Heating Utility Tools

Interactive SpriteKit Thermal Room Canvas
- Touch-to-Place Radiators & Heaters: Drag aluminum, cast-iron, or steel panel radiators under windows to neutralize cold drafts.
- Real-Time Heat Distribution Heatmap: Visualize warm air convection and cold corner spots across any room shape.

Heat Loss & BTU Calculation Engine
- Wall, Window & Ceiling Factor Scaler: Account for ceiling height, corner exterior walls, double/triple glazing, and insulation quality.
- Radiator Section & Pipe Length Estimator: Compute exact radiator section counts (Watts / BTU) and radiant floor pipe spacing.

Heating Project Vault & Export
- Multi-Room Thermal Journal: Store custom heating calculations for apartments, houses, and basements offline.
- 100% Offline Field Access: Calculate heating loads directly inside unfinished buildings or basements with zero cellular signal.

Designed for:
- Homeowners sizing new radiators before winter renovations without overpaying.
- HVAC and plumbing technicians verifying room BTU loads on-site offline.
- DIY builders planning hydronic or electric underfloor heating zones.

name: Hello Sinhala!
description:
Learn to speak everyday Sri Lankan Sinhala in just 5 minutes a day.

Hello Sinhala! is made for complete beginners: people with Sri Lankan family, partners, travellers and anyone who wants to chat with Sri Lankan friends. Instead of grammar tables, you learn the phrases people actually use, with Aliya the baby elephant cheering you on.

NATIVE SRI LANKAN VOICES
Every phrase comes with natural Sinhala audio at normal speed and slowly, plus the Sinhala script and an easy English-friendly pronunciation. All audio is built in, so you can learn offline.

9 BITE-SIZED LESSONS
Follow a friendly lesson path from Greetings to Simple Conversations: getting to know someone, everyday questions and answers, food and eating, family and friends, daily activities and feelings. Each lesson ends with a quick review and stars to earn.

PRACTISE SPEAKING
Tap Repeat after me, say the phrase out loud and play your voice back to compare it with the native audio. You get gentle, encouraging feedback.

REAL CONVERSATIONS
Join Nimal and Sara in short everyday chats. Listen to each line, choose the right reply and say it yourself.

GAMES THAT MAKE IT STICK
Match Up, Listen & Guess, Best Reply and a Daily Quiz keep your new words fresh. Save favourites in My Words and keep your daily streak going.

PRIVATE AND FREE
No account, no ads and no tracking. Your progress stays on your device.

Download Hello Sinhala! and say your first "Ayubowan!" today.

name: Hem Press
description:
Hem Press is the board beside the iron. A raw edge is still out. Fold it up, then fold it again until that edge is inside.

Drag the hem tab. The first fold locks between 15 and 40 millimeters. Fold again and the second fold covers the raw edge. The board then shows five measurements: the first fold, the second fold, the hem showing, the cloth taken up, and how far inside the raw edge sits. Name the piece and keep it. The hem stays on this iPhone, so the next time you press the same cuff or hem you can see how deep it was.

Open Pages to see every hem kept on this phone, then return to the board. Press another hem when you want a fresh edge. Lift a hem when it should leave this iPhone.

Hem Press works offline. There is no account, no sample hem, and no file to share. Measurements are millimeters only, and they remain on the phone.

name: Hen Heights – Chicken Climb
description:
A little pixel hen wants to go up. Between two house fronts she hops from balcony to awning, from window sill to gondola – higher and higher, over the rooftops and all the way to space.

HOW TO PLAY
• Walk with the joystick: put your thumb down on the left and drag sideways.
• Jump with the red button. Hold it longer to jump higher.
• Press again in mid-air for a double jump as a rolling hen ball.
• At the wall, kick off with your double jump.
• Missed a jump? You fall to the next ledge below.

THE CITY
Balconies, awnings, window sills, crumbling scaffold boards and moving window-cleaner gondolas. Bounce plants launch you up. Rooftops have a plastic pool: don’t fall into the water, but you can bounce high off the beach ball. Pick up corn along the way.

HAZARDS
• Cats sit on the balconies and swipe with their paw. Land on them from above and they run off.
• Eggs come rolling down from above.
• Air conditioners blow you sideways.
• From some windows, a hand reaches out for you.
You have 3 hearts. Every new level refills them, and the feed bowl gives you one more.

6 LEVELS, 2 WORLDS
Henyard, Cat Roofs, Egg Avalanche, Air Con Alley, Above the Roofs and Space – from day through night up to the space station, where the hen wears a space helmet. At the very top, an air shaft leads to the second world: Harbour Town.

FAIR
• Free with ads. A short ad break comes at most after every second game over, never during play.
• The one-time purchase “Ad-free” removes the ad breaks. No subscription. Optional videos (continue with one heart) stay available.
• No account, no sign-up, works offline. Your record stays on your device.
• 14 languages.

name: Hereabouts Wayfinder
description:
Hereabouts shows you the map of a venue you are visiting, where you are on it, and how to get where you are going, floor by floor.

Scan the code at a venue that uses Hereabouts and the app shows:

- Where you are, from the venue's own network, with a steady blue dot
- Walking directions across floors by stairs or lift, step by step, spoken if you like, on the lock screen and on your Apple Watch
- Search for toilets, food, rooms and help, and "Take me to the toilets" with Siri
- How busy each area is right now and the usually quietest time, as estimates
- Opening hours, announcements, and anything out of service, with routes that go round it
- Offers from the venue near you, only if you say yes, with a code to show staff
- Meet a friend: share where you are for a set time and get directions to each other or to a point halfway
- Find my car, your meeting room from your calendar, and event trails to collect stamps
- Help me: ask the venue's staff for help and they can see where you are and come to you
- The venue's emergency alert, with the nearest way out that avoids lifts

No venue nearby? Tap "Try the demo venue" to walk round a made-up centre with a simulated position.

Your choices stay on your phone. The app has no account, sells nothing and has no advertising networks. Venues see only what the privacy policy describes.

name: Hey Charlie Staff
description:
Hey Charlie est l'application de HC Interim, agence belge de staffing événementiel, pour les étudiants et les jobistes (les « Charlies ») qui travaillent sur ses événements : hôtesses, promo, staff et bien d'autres missions.

Tout ce qu'il te faut pour tes jobs, au même endroit.

TROUVE ET POSTULE
- Découvre les événements et missions disponibles, avec les dates, les lieux et les infos pratiques.
- Postule en quelques secondes et suis l'état de tes candidatures.
- Retrouve tes jobs planifiés dans ton calendrier.

SUIS TES MISSIONS
- Déclare tes heures prestées après une mission.
- Consulte tes missions passées et les évaluations de l'équipe.

RESTE EN CONTACT
- Discute avec l'équipe de l'agence.
- Rejoins les conversations de groupe de tes événements : messages, photos, vidéos, messages vocaux, fichiers, réactions et sondages.
- Reçois des notifications pour ne rien rater : nouvelle mission, message, rappel.
- Lis les actualités de l'agence et réponds à ses sondages.

TON PROFIL
- Crée ton compte et complète ton profil (photo, langues, tailles, permis, etc.). Ton profil est validé à la main par l'équipe de HC Interim avant que tu accèdes aux missions.
- Tu peux modifier ton profil ou supprimer ton compte à tout moment depuis l'application.

BON À SAVOIR
- L'application est gratuite, sans publicité et sans paiement.
- Elle est disponible en français et pensée pour les missions en Belgique.
- Elle ne lit pas la position de ton téléphone.
- Un compte est nécessaire. Les inscriptions sont validées par l'équipe, ce qui peut prendre un peu de temps.

Une question ? Écris-nous directement depuis la messagerie de l'application.

Hey Charlie est éditée par HC Interim SRL (Rixensart, Belgique).

name: Hidden Word Bible Memory
description:
“I have hidden Your word in my heart.” (Psalm 119:11)

Hidden Word helps you memorize Scripture and keep it for life. Each verse moves through proven stages: read it aloud, fill in the blanks, use first-letter cues, then recite it from memory. Smart spaced-repetition reviews bring each verse back right before you’d forget it.

LEARN ANY PASSAGE
• Browse every book, chapter and verse, and add a verse, a chapter or a whole book
• 13 English translations built in and fully offline (BSB, KJV, WEB, ASV, YLT and more)
• NIV and ESV for the 112 featured memory verses and verses of the day (other passages use the BSB)
• Bibles in Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Russian, Korean and Vietnamese
• Themed packs: Strength for Those Who Serve, Anxiety & Peace, Marriage, Grief & Comfort, Recovery & Freedom, Kids, Psalm 23 and more

PRACTICE YOUR WAY
• Four difficulty levels with word-by-word feedback
• Listen mode: hear verses read aloud with a hands-free recite loop
• Daily reminders on the days and time you choose

STAY MOTIVATED, GROW TOGETHER
• Streaks, a progress calendar, XP, levels and 40+ trophies
• Group and church challenges you can share with a link
• Friends, nudges and leaderboards
• Share beautiful verse cards

KEEP YOUR PROGRESS
• Optional free account (email) syncs your progress to all your devices
• Backup & Restore by email or backup code

Hidden Word is completely free: no ads, no subscriptions. It’s a ministry of The Creed of Ink, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit in Cartersville, Georgia that provides therapeutic tattooing for veterans and first responders.

Unless otherwise indicated, Scripture quotations are from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB), dedicated to the public domain.

Scripture quotations marked (NIV) are taken from The Holy Bible, New International Version® NIV® Copyright © 1973, 1978, 1984, 2011 by Biblica, Inc.™ Used by permission. All rights reserved worldwide.

Scripture quotations marked (ESV) are from the ESV® Bible (The Holy Bible, English Standard Version®), © 2001 by Crossway, a publishing ministry of Good News Publishers. Used by permission. All rights reserved.

name: Hitnote: Pitch & Ear Training
description:
Hitnote listens while you sing and shows, live, whether you're on the note, sharp or flat. A 5-minute lesson every day trains your ear and your voice together, and you can watch your accuracy improve.

SEE YOUR PITCH LIVE
• Sing "ah" and watch your voice move onto the target line
• Green when you're on the note, orange when sharp, blue when flat
• How far off you are, in cents
• A pitch monitor for warming up or checking any note

A DAILY 5-MINUTE LESSON
• Warm-up: hear a note, sing it, hold it in the centre
• Ear training: higher or lower, intervals and chords by ear
• Voice: sing intervals and scales
• Challenge: hear a short tune and sing it back
• Every exercise adapts to you and stays inside your own voice range

FIND YOUR VOICE
• Range test: your lowest and highest comfortable notes and your voice type
• Accuracy test: how many cents off you sing today, and whether you tend to go flat or sharp
• A 21-day plan built from your results

STAY ON TRACK
• Streaks and a daily reminder at the time you choose
• Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets with your streak and accuracy
• Progress charts for pitch accuracy and ear training
• Share your progress card

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Your voice is analysed on your iPhone while you sing. It is never recorded, stored or uploaded.
• No account needed.

Note names in C D E or Do Re Mi. Reference tones in piano, soft or organ sound.

HITNOTE PRO
The lessons, exercises, pitch monitor and progress are part of Hitnote Pro: yearly (with a free trial for new subscribers), weekly, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; manage or cancel them in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.

Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://vayronapps.com/hitnote/privacy.html

name: Hollowmarch Survivor Roguelike
description:
Hollowmarch is an offline survivor roguelike in pixel art. Your weapons attack on their own, so you steer your hero through monster hordes, collect crystals, level up and pick one of three upgrade cards. It plays without wifi or mobile data and a full stage takes 15 minutes.

WHAT'S IN THE GAME
• 30 playable characters, unlocked through achievements, each with its own bonuses and starting weapon
• 12 stages: Dark Forest, Autumn Orchard, Forgotten Crypt, Hollow Village, Glimmer Caverns and Wreck Shore are free (each opens as you survive in the one before it), and six more can be bought once each (Moonlit Graveyard, Sunken Quarry, Sand Temple, Rotting Marsh, Frozen Pass, Ashen Caldera) or all together in the 6-Map Pack
• 23 weapons and 13 passive items. Bring a weapon to max level while carrying its matching passive item, and a chest turns it into one of 22 evolved weapons
• 5 bosses whose attack patterns change as their health drops, among them the Bone Harvester
• Frenzy and Endless modes for experienced players. In Endless, every loop makes the horde stronger
• 29 permanent power-ups and 100 achievements to unlock

CONTROLS AND SETTINGS
• Touch controls with a virtual joystick, in portrait and landscape
• Layouts for iPhone and iPad
• A 30 FPS mode and a switch for damage numbers help on slower devices
• The game text is available in 17 languages: English, Turkish, Hindi, Portuguese, Indonesian, Spanish, Japanese, Russian, Urdu, Filipino, Arabic, German, Vietnamese, Bengali, Thai, French and Polish

HOW TO PLAY
Move with the virtual stick. In landscape it sits on the left; in portrait it works anywhere in the play area. Dodge the hordes, pick up crystals and gold, and open chests to evolve your weapons. Survive 15 minutes and defeat the Bone Harvester to clear a stage.

OFFLINE PLAY
After installation Hollowmarch needs no internet connection, so a run works on a plane, on the subway or anywhere without signal. There are no accounts and no forced ads. The game contains optional one-time in-app purchases (single maps or the 6-Map Pack); you can restore them from Settings.

Hollowmarch is made for fans of survivor-like games and bullet heaven roguelites who want a pixel action RPG that keeps working offline.

name: HolyHim: Daily Bible for Men
description:
A word to stand on, every morning.

HolyHim is a daily Bible app for young men. One short lesson a day, about five minutes, in plain words. No hype, no lectures and no ads.

EVERY LESSON, FOUR CARDS
• Scripture: the World English Bible, word for word.
• What it means: the setting and the point, simply explained.
• For your life: one honest step you can take today.
• Prayer: a short prayer. Then hold to say Amen.

THE ROAD
Walk through the Bible a day at a time, chapter by chapter, on a road you can see: Joshua's courage, Joseph's integrity, David and Goliath, Daniel's line in the sand, the Psalms, Proverbs on work and anger, the Sermon on the Mount, Paul's letters to young Timothy, and the hope of Revelation. 365 lessons speak honestly about the things men face: temptation, anger, fear, loneliness, pressure, failure, money, friendship, fathers and purpose.

BROTHERS
Share a word from today's reading, ask for prayer, or post a win. Say Amen to each other, reply, and climb the board by streak or days read. Every post is checked before it appears, and you can report or block anyone.

STAY ON TRACK
• A daily note at the time you choose, with a verse in it.
• Streaks with grace days, so one missed day does not wipe you out.
• Nineteen struck medallions to earn along the way.
• Save the verses that hit home and share them as clean cards.
• A home screen widget with today's verse.
• Eight themes with matching app icons, from First Watch dark to Limestone light.

MADE FOR YOU
A short welcome asks what you need most, where you are in life and how well you know the Bible. Your answers shape your reminders and your first week. Your progress syncs across devices when you sign in with Apple, Google or email.

MEMBERSHIP
HolyHim membership opens every lesson. New members can start with a free week. Membership is one yearly price, shown in your currency before you confirm. Payment is charged to your Apple account when you confirm, or when the free week ends. It renews automatically each year unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it any time in your App Store account settings.

Scripture quotations are from the World English Bible (public domain).

Privacy Policy: https://holyhim-app-production.web.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://holyhim-app-production.web.app/terms

name: Home Systems Blueprint
description:
A useful map of the home you know.

Home Systems Blueprint combines a saved room plan with your own fixture, shutoff and equipment markers, so useful details stay connected to the right space.

SAVE THE SHAPE OF YOUR HOME
Scan rooms on supported LiDAR-equipped devices or enter them manually. Organize rooms by floor, adjust their positions and review the measured plan.

MAP SYSTEMS AND SHUTOFFS
Place categorized markers on rooms, label a fixture or shutoff, and record its circuit or reference number and service notes. Filter the plan by system when you need a clearer view.

EXPLORE THE HOUSE IN 3D
Orbit the saved house model, select floors and step inside individual rooms. The model is based on recorded dimensions; illustrative materials and furnishings are not a photographic capture.

KEEP THE CONTEXT
Save project photos, scope notes and activity history. Plus includes complete PDF, SVG, DXF and USDZ exports. Review every exported file before sharing it.

TRY ONE HOME MAP
Free access includes one saved home map and watermarked PDF previews. Plus unlocks continued creation and complete exports. Existing saved maps remain readable and editable after expiry.

The app records information you provide. LiDAR measures visible surfaces; it does not detect hidden pipes or wiring. Verify locations and measurements before service work.

Subscription prices and billing periods are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple subscription settings. Restore Purchases is available in the app.

Set a room goal and review each saved room’s detected wall coverage. Shape a room in 3D, label it, and place doors or windows on a wall you choose. Optional photos stay with the room where you took them.

Website: https://www.trisphereapps.com
Support: https://www.trisphereapps.com/contact
Privacy Policy: https://www.trisphereapps.com/privacypolicy
Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Homileto Notes
description:
Take notes in church the way you always meant to.

Homileto Notes is a free notes app for sermons, Bible studies and devotions. Type or write by hand, and every verse you jot down becomes a link that opens in your Bible app.
TYPE A VERSE, TAP TO READ IT Write "Rom 8:28" or "Juan 3:16" and it becomes a link. Tap it to open the passage in YouVersion or Bible Gateway, in the version you choose: NKJV, NIV, ESV, KJV, NLT, CSB, RVR1960, NVI and more.

SCAN THE SERMON CODE When your pastor or teacher shares a QR code from Homileto, scan it and the sermon's title, series and Scripture land in your notes. Some sermons come as a fill-in outline: fill in the blanks as you listen.

WRITE BY HAND Switch any note to Handwritten and write on real pages: lined, grid, dotted or blank. On iPhone and iPad you get Apple's own pen tools, with Apple Pencil, palm rejection and pinch to zoom.

KEEP WHAT MATTERS • My takeaway: the one thing to remember from the message • Prayer requests, right in the note • Notebooks for Sunday sermons, Bible study, devotions and conferences • A Scripture index that gathers every note on a passage • Search across all your notes

PRIVATE AND FREE No ads. No purchases. No AI writing your notes. Your notes stay on your device; a free account is optional and only backs them up and syncs them to your other devices. Works offline. In English and Spanish.

Homileto Notes works with any church and any preacher. You never need a code to take notes.

name: Honk Push
description:
Honk Push brings notifications from your scripts, servers and services into one app. Create a bot for each source and keep deployment updates, monitoring alerts and automated reports in their own channels.

EVERY SERVICE GETS ITS OWN CHANNEL
Give each bot a name and avatar, then browse its messages in a dedicated conversation. Search your channels and find the updates you need.

SEND FROM YOUR OWN TOOLS
Use a simple HTTP request or curl command to send a notification. Connect Honk Push to scripts, CI pipelines, monitoring systems and other tools that can call an API.

RICH MESSAGE CARDS
Send structured HTML cards with text, tables, links and buttons. Open a message to see the details behind the notification, and update card data from your service when the status changes.

NOTIFICATIONS YOU CAN RECOGNIZE
Bot names and avatars help you identify the source of each notification. Choose notification levels for routine updates and time-sensitive alerts, subject to your device settings.

YOUR OWN GATEWAY
Connect to a Honk gateway, including one you host yourself. Set a custom gateway address in the app and test the connection.

Honk Push supports English and Simplified Chinese, with light and dark appearances. A reachable Honk gateway and internet connection are required to receive messages. Enable notifications to receive push alerts.

name: Hoop Batch
description: Check machine embroidery designs before preparing an order. Import up to 50 PES and DST designs together, select a hoop, and review dimensions, stitched previews, long jump sequences, and missing thread information. Export one batch CSV for your production checklist. Preview colors are illustrative and hoop fit uses the centered stitch bounds.

name: HostSpica Identity
description:
HostSpica Identity puts the things that prove who you are in one app, and keeps every one of them on your iPhone. No account to create, no cloud sync, no analytics: there is no server for your data to be on.

FOUR TOOLS, ONE PLACE
• Authenticator: TOTP and HOTP two-factor codes. Add accounts by scanning a QR code (or choosing one from your photos) or by typing the details. Import straight from Google Authenticator, search, favorite and group your accounts.
• Passkey: turn on HostSpica Identity as a passkey provider and sign in to websites and apps with Face ID. Keys are made in your iPhone's Secure Enclave and never leave it.
• AirAuth: approve a sign-in on another screen by scanning its QR code and confirming with Face ID. A short history shows what you approved or denied.
• Vault: passwords and secure notes, encrypted on your phone. Built-in password generator, search and favorites, with an optional extra Face ID check before a password is shown or copied.

SEE EACH ACCOUNT ONCE
The Identity tab groups a service's 2FA code, passkey and saved password together, so your GitHub, your Google or your bank shows up as one card. A security health check flags passwords that are reused or weak and accounts with no second factor, all computed on your phone.

BUILT TO KEEP SECRETS
• Secrets are encrypted with a key protected by the Secure Enclave and stored for this device only
• Passkey private keys are generated in the Secure Enclave and can never leave the phone
• The app asks for Face ID, Touch ID or your passcode every time you open it, with a choice of how long it may stay in the background
• The app itself never connects to the internet
• Copied codes and passwords stay off Universal Clipboard and are cleared after 30 seconds
• One password-protected backup file for your Authenticator accounts and Vault, so you can move to a new phone

GOOD TO KNOW
• Passkeys stay on the phone they were created on. They are not part of the backup file.
• Password autofill into Safari and other apps is not available yet.
• If you lose your backup password it cannot be recovered by anyone, including us.

Questions or feedback: contact@hostspica.com

name: Hotseat Booking
description:
Hotseat Booking is the free app for clients of salons and barbershops that use Hotseat. Sign in with the mobile number your shop already has, and everything is there.

ALL YOUR APPOINTMENTS IN ONE PLACE
• Your next appointment front and centre, with the time, your stylist and the shop
• Every Hotseat shop you visit, and everyone who books on your phone (kids, partners)
• Add any appointment to your calendar in one tap

BOOK AGAIN IN ONE TAP
• Your usual stylist is always one tap away
• See the whole team, their services and their prices before you choose
• Prices are shown before you pick a time, and they never change after you book

LIFE HAPPENS
• Move or cancel a visit without calling the shop
• Join a waitlist when your favourite time is full

NOTIFICATIONS YOU WON'T MISS
• Turn on notifications and get your confirmation, a reminder the day before, and a heads-up if anything changes

GIFT CARDS AND RECEIPTS
• See every gift card sent to you and what's left on it
• Add gift cards to Apple Wallet
• Every past visit: what you had, who did it, and what you paid

NO PASSWORDS
• Sign in with a 6-digit code sent by text. Nothing to remember.

Hotseat Booking is for clients of shops that use Hotseat. If your salon or barbershop doesn't use Hotseat yet, you won't find your appointments here.

name: Hourbridge
description:
Hourbridge lines up teammates' working days across time zones on one shared timeline and finds the hours that work for everyone.

PEOPLE AND TEAMS
• Add people with a name, role, city, time zone, working hours, working days, colour and favourite
• Search every time zone by city, country, zone name or abbreviation
• Overnight working hours are supported
• Save teams with members and notes; each shows today's shared hours and everyone's current local time

PLANNER
• One band per person for the chosen date, showing their local hours coloured as night, dawn, day or dusk
• Working hours outlined, and the overlap when everyone is working highlighted
• Drag the cursor to see every person's local time, day shift and whether they are working
• Handles half-hour offsets and daylight saving changes
• Filter by everyone or a team, with meetings from 15 minutes to 2 hours

BEST SLOTS
• Meeting times ranked by how many people are within working hours for the whole meeting, then by how comfortable the time is for each person
• Tap a slot to jump to it on the planner

INVITE
• Title, start time and length, with a check of who is in working hours
• The invite text lists the date and time in every attendee's zone, with familiar abbreviations
• Copy or share

CONVERTER
• Pick a zone and a date and time, nudge it, or use Now
• See the same moment in your pinned zones and your teammates' zones, with next or previous day badges and offsets
• Copy or share all the times

SETTINGS
24-hour clock, default meeting length, slot step and home zone.

WORKS OFFLINE, ACCOUNT OPTIONAL
Hourbridge works fully offline and never asks you to sign up. Tap "Continue as guest" on the welcome screen and every feature is available straight away, with your teammates and teams saved on this device.
If you would like a backup, create a free account with your email address and a password. Your data then syncs securely so you can restore it on another iPhone or iPad, and anything you made as a guest is merged into your account. You can delete your account and its backup at any time from Settings.

PRIVATE, FREE AND SIMPLE
• Completely free: no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions
• No tracking and no analytics; your data is never shared with other users
• Export all of your data as JSON from Settings whenever you like
• Light and dark mode, with haptics you can switch off
• Designed for landscape on iPhone and iPad (iOS 15 or later)

name: House Blueprint Measure
description:
Your home, measured, saved and ready to explore.

House Blueprint Measure combines room plans and a dimension-based 3D house walkthrough in one workspace for renovation planning and home documentation.

BUILD THE HOUSE ROOM BY ROOM
Scan connected rooms in one session on a supported LiDAR-equipped device, or add rooms manually. Continuous scans retain their relative placement; separate sessions can be positioned in the room editor.

REFINE YOUR MEASUREMENTS
Edit room shapes, height, openings, position and floor level. Mark measurements verified after checking them on site. View room outlines and labeled dimensions together.

STEP INSIDE THE PLAN
Orbit a 3D dollhouse, select a floor, walk inside individual rooms or take a room tour. Detected furnishings provide spatial context. Materials and furniture are illustrative; this is a measured model, not a photographic walkthrough.

TAKE YOUR PLAN WITH YOU
Plus includes complete PDF, SVG and DXF plan exports, plus a USDZ 3D model. Keep saved plans and workspace backups for later reference.

TRY ONE HOUSE PLAN
Free access includes one saved house plan and watermarked PDF previews. Explore the clearly labeled example house before scanning. Plus unlocks continued creation and complete exports. Existing saved plans remain readable and editable after expiry.

Scans are estimates for planning and documentation. Verify critical dimensions on site. Plans are not certified surveys, structural designs or permit approvals.

Subscription prices and billing periods are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple subscription settings. Restore Purchases is available in the app.

Set a room goal and review each saved room’s detected wall coverage. Shape a room in 3D, label it, and place doors or windows on a wall you choose. Optional photos stay with the room where you took them.

Website: https://www.trisphereapps.com
Support: https://www.trisphereapps.com/contact
Privacy Policy: https://www.trisphereapps.com/privacypolicy
Terms of Use (Apple Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: House Extension Shop RB
description:
Discover the potential in every property. House Extension Shop RB brings property search tools and extension planning together, so you can see what a home could become before you make a move.

This app is a partnership demonstration between House Extension Shop and Rampton Baseley.

EXPLORE A PROPERTY
Add a home you're considering, with its price, bedrooms and photo, and keep everything about it in one place. Book a viewing or send a purchase enquiry in a couple of taps.

BUY & EXTEND CALCULATOR
Combine the purchase price with an estimated extension cost to see the total investment, an illustrative value after the work and how extending compares with buying a bigger home.

PROPERTY VALUE CALCULATOR
Get an illustrative before-and-after value range for a rear, side, wraparound or first-floor extension, loft conversion or garden studio, based on the postcode and property details.

AI PROPERTY VISUALISER
Upload a photo and see a conceptual AI image of how the property could look once extended.

PROPERTY POTENTIAL REPORT
Bring the property details, Buy & Extend figures, visualisation and general planning considerations together in one PDF you can save or share.

THE RIGHT TEAM FOR EACH ENQUIRY
Viewing, purchase, selling and valuation enquiries go to Rampton Baseley. Construction, planning, supplier and trade enquiries go to House Extension Shop and 30 Day Extensions.

EVERYTHING FROM HOUSE EXTENSION SHOP
You also get every House Extension Shop tool: the instant extension cost calculator, smart planning checker, trade-priced kitchens, bathrooms, tiles, patio doors and appliances, Garden Studios, specialist trades, and quote requests sent straight to the right supplier.

NO ACCOUNTS, NO PAYMENTS IN THE APP
There's no sign-up and no payment is taken in the app.

Please note: all figures are illustrative and subject to property-specific assessment. They are not a formal valuation, survey, mortgage or financial advice. AI images are conceptual. Planning information is general guidance and is not a planning decision.

name: HPvrmiop
description: HPvrmiop helps users ensure the accuracy of their account balances by aligning daily income and expenses with their actual account totals. When recording income, expenses, or transfers between accounts, you can preview the resulting balance before saving the entry. During the reconciliation process, enter the actual account balance and review the transactions recorded since the last verification. You can narrow down the list by amount or date, check off individual transactions, or compare the net total of multiple entries against your own calculated sum. If you discover missing or incorrect entries, you can add, edit, or delete them—with the system tracking both the original and updated amounts. Once the discrepancy is resolved, you can save a reconciliation checkpoint, allowing you to look back at confirmed balances and their associated transactions for specific periods. If any historical transactions are subsequently modified, the system will prompt you to re-reconcile. Various charts visualize your income and expenses, balance fluctuations, and the distribution of unreviewed transactions, making it easy to plan your next steps for verification.

name: Huelace
description:
Huelace is a small colour workshop built in the Bauhaus manner: red circle, blue square, yellow triangle and a lot of thick black rules. There is a lab for making colours, a game for training your eye, and a palette for keeping the good ones.

THE LAB
Build a colour with RGB or HSB sliders, or type a three or six digit hex code and load it. The HEX, RGB and HSB readouts follow every drag, and Copy hex puts the value on the clipboard, ready to paste into a design file or a stylesheet. Save it with a name and it joins a palette of twelve swatches that you can reorder, load back into the lab or delete.

CONTRAST
Switch the lab to Contrast, pick a text colour and a background from your palette or the workshop inks, and read the ratio. It is worked out with WCAG 2.x relative luminance and marked pass or fail for AA and AAA at normal and large text sizes, next to a live sample. Worth a look before you ship a grey button that only you can read.

THE GAME
Mix Match shows a target colour and gives you five pigments: cyan, magenta, yellow, white and black. Add up to eight drops, pour, and the mix is scored out of 100 by its ΔE distance from the target. The daily set is five targets, the same for everyone on a given date, with a best total and a streak; free play deals random targets for as long as you care to keep pouring.

THE PRINT RUN
The interface comes in four print runs: Classic, Night, Riso and Mono. Turn on Follow system and it switches to Night whenever iOS is dark. Only the paper and ink change, so your swatches, pigments and scores print exactly the same in every run.

You move between sections with a drawer of shapes at the bottom of the screen. There is no account to create and no ads. Everything works offline, and your palette and scores sync quietly to an anonymous ID.

name: HuellaID
description:
HuellaID es una identificación con código QR para quienes más quieres: tus abuelitos, una persona que puede desorientarse, niñas y niños, alguien con una condición de salud y también tu mascota.

Quien escanea el QR con la cámara de su celular ve qué hacer y a quién llamar, sin instalar nada ni crear una cuenta, y tú recibes el aviso.

CÓMO FUNCIONA
• Crea un perfil para una persona o para una mascota.
• Genera su código QR en la app. Desde el panel web puedes descargarlo e imprimirlo para llevarlo en una pulsera, una tarjeta, un colgante o la placa del collar. También puedes activar una placa física con el código que trae.
• Cuando alguien lo escanea se abre la página pública del perfil y tú recibes el aviso.
• Quien escaneó puede compartir su ubicación y dejarte un mensaje con su contacto.

PARA PERSONAS
• Perfil con nombre, foto, edad aproximada, idiomas, comuna o ciudad y una nota de "cómo ayudarme" (por ejemplo: "me desoriento, háblame con calma").
• Información de salud opcional: grupo sanguíneo, alergias, condiciones, medicamentos con su dosis, previsión de salud y médico tratante.
• Contactos de emergencia en orden de prioridad, con botón para llamar.
• Centro médico de preferencia, con las indicaciones de la familia y un botón "Cómo llegar" que abre la app de mapas.
• La página pública de una persona incluye un botón para llamar al 131 (SAMU, Chile) y un enlace para buscar urgencias cercanas.
• Si no sabes dónde está, repórtala como extraviada: su página muestra un aviso destacado y tus datos de contacto.

PARA MASCOTAS
• Perfil con nombre, especie, raza, color, foto, descripción y notas médicas.
• Alergias, medicamentos, veterinario y clínica veterinaria de preferencia, si quieres mostrarlos.
• Modo perdida con recompensa opcional. Cuando la encuentres, toca "¡Ya la encontré!" y todo vuelve a la normalidad.

TÚ DECIDES QUÉ SE VE
• Cada dato de salud y cada contacto de emergencia aparece en la página pública solo si activas su interruptor. Todo parte oculto.
• Elige si la página muestra tu nombre, tu teléfono o tu correo.
• La ubicación la comparte quien escanea, desde su navegador y solo si acepta. La app no rastrea tu ubicación ni la de tu familiar.

HISTORIAL DE ESCANEOS
• Cada escaneo queda registrado por día, con mapa, mensaje y contacto de quien escaneó.
• Con la app abierta, los escaneos aparecen al instante.

TU CUENTA
• Varias personas y mascotas en una sola cuenta.
• Cambia tu contraseña, edita tus datos o elimina tu cuenta, con todos sus perfiles, cuando quieras desde Ajustes.
• Sin publicidad.

IMPORTANTE
HuellaID no es un servicio de emergencias ni un dispositivo médico, y no entrega indicaciones médicas. Solo muestra la información que escribió la familia y avisa cuando alguien escanea el código. Ante una emergencia, llama al número de emergencias de tu país.

Política de privacidad: https://huellaid.aindox.cl/privacidad

name: Hugram
description:
No baby scale at home? You don't need one.

Step on your scale once on your own and once holding your baby. Copy the two numbers and Hugram does the subtraction, keeping your baby's weight — and yours.

■ Weigh together
・Slide a ruler like a scale's dial, or tap the number to type it
・If you weighed yourself a moment ago, there is no need to step on again
・A weight from the clinic or a baby scale can be entered directly
・A daily reminder at the time you choose

■ Watch them grow
・Behind your baby's line, a soft band shows where most children of the same age are (WHO Child Growth Standards, under 3 years)
・See how many times the birth weight your baby is now, and the daily gain over recent weeks
・Month-by-month changes, one line each
・Changes are put in words, like "Grew 0.2 lb"

■ The whole family
・Two adults and your baby on one screen
・Invite your family and every phone keeps the same records, whatever phone each of you has

■ When your hands are full
・Tap "Enter by voice" and say what the scale shows
・Or say "Log weight in Hugram" to Siri

■ Your records are yours
・No sign-up
・Records are also kept on the server, encrypted so that only your family's phones can read them, not the server
・Get your records back on a new phone with a recovery link
・Export and import your records as a file
・Kilograms or pounds

Hugram is not a medical device. The comparison with other children is for reference only.

name: Hush Atlas
description:
Hush Atlas is a small hub for four calm puzzle games. Each round is short enough for a coffee break, and every round can be paused, saved and picked up later.

FOUR GAMES, ONE HUB

Match Blast — an 8×8 board of five symbol tiles. Tap one tile, then a touching tile to swap. Three or more in a line clear, and cascades multiply the score. Six stages move from 900 to 3,000 points while the move limit tightens from 24 to 20.

Number Puzzle — a 4×4 merge board. Swipe to slide, equal numbers combine, and every merge adds to the score. Five builds ask for 128, 256, 512, 1,024 and 2,048 tiles. Three-step undo and a directional hint sit one tap away.

Reaction Dodge — steer a blue orb with your thumb while shapes fall past. Three hearts, a 1.8-second shield after each hit, and a 3.5-second slow-motion hint. Five stages last from 30 to 90 seconds.

Strategy Solve — drag from the dot to the flag on grids that grow from 6×6 to 9×9. Walls block the way, the step budget stays close to the shortest path, and dragging backwards retracts your last step. Six routes, with a reset counter that decides whether the run was perfect.

BUILT FOR REAL BREAKS
• Rounds save automatically. Leave mid-round and come back from Home with Resume — the board is exactly as you left it.
• Pause any round to resume, restart, or save and exit.
• The finish screen shows score, best and any new awards, then lets you replay right away.
• 13 awards, per-game personal records, and a history of your last 200 rounds.
• Daily streak tracking, with an optional 9:00 reminder you can switch off anytime.

QUIET BY DEFAULT
• No ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, no loot boxes.
• Fully offline. Progress is stored on this device; iCloud backup is optional and uses your own Apple ID.
• Sound effects, ambient music, haptics, larger text, reduce motion, and light / dark / system appearance are all switchable in Settings.
• Interface is in English.
• Game Center sign-in is optional. Personal records work without it.

HappyCenter is made for short, unhurried sessions. Nothing here rushes you.

name: Hushwick
description:
Hushwick is a lantern at dusk.

It is a small, quiet place to sit for a few minutes at the end of the day. Nothing asks for your attention. There are no accounts to make and no alerts to answer.

The screen is a tall evening sky. Swipe up and you go lower, layer by layer: the sky, then the shore, then the river, then the deep.

On the shore you will find Breathe, a simple pacing guide for relaxed breathing. A glowing orb swells as you breathe in and settles as you breathe out, with a word and a soft count beneath it and a light tap at each change. Choose a rhythm, choose 1, 3 or 5 minutes, and begin. You can pause, or end early, whenever you like.

On the river there is a slow little game called Lantern Drift. Hold anywhere and the lantern rises on warm air. Let go and it drifts gently down. Glide through the glowing gaps in the reeds to gather fireflies. Brush the reeds three times and the lantern rests, and you can light it again.

In the deep, a journal keeps your minutes: the total, your day streak, a bar for each of the last seven days, your recent sessions, and your best drift.

Inside:
· Box breathing, 4-4-4-4
· Relax, 4-7-8
· Coherent, 5-5
· Custom, with your own counts for in, hold, out and rest
· Sessions of 1, 3 or 5 minutes
· Lantern Drift, hold to rise and release to drift
· A journal of minutes, streaks and the last seven days
· Skies: Dawn, Dusk, Midnight and Aurora, or Auto, which follows the hours

Tap the small moon in the corner to change the sky. Dawn is pale and rosy. Dusk is navy, plum and ember. Midnight is silver and full of stars. Aurora has slow green and violet ribbons. Auto moves from dawn in the morning to dusk in the evening and midnight late at night.

Everything works offline. Your journal, your best drift and your chosen sky are kept on your phone and quietly backed up under an anonymous ID. You can erase all of it from the same moon sheet.

Hushwick is for relaxation only. It is not a medical device.

Sit a while. The lantern will keep.

name: Hypnotic: Abstract Art
description:
Hypnotic turns rings, colours and shapes into mesmerising abstract art, in one tap.

• Hypnotize: a brand-new composition every time. Close the lock to keep the pattern and colours you love, and let everything else vary.
• 24 original patterns: orbits, spirals, waves, rainbows, mosaics, nautilus shells and more.
• 112 palettes, or pick your own colours and background.

No account, no ads. Your creations stay on your device.

name: IAPP Prep
description:
Prepare for the CIPP/E, CIPP/US and AIGP certification exams, a little each day.

IAPP Prep puts three complete study guides in one app. Switch between exams at any time, and each keeps its own progress.

FREE IN EVERY EXAM
- The complete study guide: 247 CIPP/E, 307 CIPP/US and 115 AIGP lessons, with links to primary sources
- Exam guides: how to pass, the blueprint, a four-week study plan and more
- A searchable glossary and key-term flashcards

- CIPP/E: 1,122 questions and a 90-question, 150-minute timed set

BUILT FOR IPHONE, IPAD AND IPHONE DUO
Works offline. Progress syncs through your own iCloud, with no account. Nothing is sent to us.

IAPP Prep is an independent study aid. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by IAPP. CIPP/E, CIPP/US and AIGP are IAPP certifications and trademarks of their owner. The app does not reproduce IAPP training material or live exam questions, and no result predicts an exam outcome.

name: iCalc Kids: Count & Learn Math
description:
iCalc turns every sum into something your child can see and count. Tap 3 + 2 and five apples pop onto the board, one by one, while a friendly voice says "3 plus 2 equals 5". Pay once: no ads, no subscription, no accounts.

SEE THE MATH
- Addition shows both numbers in two colours, so children see how they join up
- Subtraction crosses out what is taken away
- Multiplication lays out rows of equal groups: 3 groups of 4
- Division shares objects into equal groups
- Objects appear one at a time so children can count along

BUILT FOR LITTLE HANDS
- Big, colourful keys with gentle sounds and haptics
- Voice narration reads numbers and answers aloud
- Friendly hints instead of errors, like "Tap a number first"
- Works with a keyboard on iPad

GROWS WITH YOUR CHILD
- Preschool (3 to 5): add and subtract up to 20
- Kids (6 to 8): adds multiplication, numbers up to 100
- Advanced (8 to 10): all four operations up to 1000

COUNTING THEMES
Magic Garden, Space Adventure, Animal Kingdom, Toy World, Ocean Friends, Dinosaur Valley or a Surprise Mix. Each theme fills the board with its own objects and colours.

BADGES TO EARN
Celebrate milestones from the very first sum to 100 solved: First Steps, Number Explorer, Math Star and more.

SAFE FOR KIDS

- No ads, no tracking, no accounts, no data collected

Questions or ideas? Parent Settings > Send feedback, or write to contact@dowble.com.

name: IELTS Prep Coach 2026
description:
Get ready for IELTS with full mock tests that work like the real computer-delivered test.

LISTENING AND READING MOCK TESTS
• 4 full Listening tests: 4 parts, 40 questions, British, Australian, American and other accents

INSTANT BAND SCORE

WRITING

SPEAKING

VOCABULARY AND DAILY DRILLS
