Pay once to unlock everything. No subscription. Your progress stays on your iPhone.

IELTS is a registered trademark of the University of Cambridge, the British Council and IDP Education Australia. IELTS Prep Coach is not affiliated with, approved or endorsed by them. All practice material is original.

name: Im here: 4-hour location
description:
Let your loved ones know where you are. Im here shares your current location with selected, accepted contacts for up to 4 hours.

Both people install the app and connect with a single-use invitation. Choose recipients, allow location access and tap “I’m here”. Your loved ones receive a notification and can open the map. Stop sharing early or remove a contact whenever you choose.

Background updates depend on iOS, permissions and connectivity. Force-quitting the app can interrupt updates. Stopping offline turns GPS off, but the last uploaded position may remain visible until connectivity returns or the original session expires. Im here is not an emergency service.

Your profile belongs to this device; version 1.0 does not recover it on another phone. You can delete your account and data in Settings.

The interface supports 30 languages. Optional one-time support purchases through Apple do not unlock features and are not subscriptions.

name: Imposter Game: Football
description:
Everyone gets the same football word. One player doesn't. Can your group spot the imposter?
Pick how many are playing, tap Start Round and pass the phone. The first word is on screen in seconds.
One phone, 3 to 12 players, no sign-up and no internet needed.

HOW TO PLAY
1. Pass the phone. Each player taps to see the secret word, then hides it.
2. One of you is the imposter and only knows the deck, not the word.
3. Go round the group giving one clue each while the countdown runs.
4. Vote out loud, then tap Reveal Imposter. Play Again deals a new word and a new imposter.

MADE FOR PASS-AND-PLAY
- A neutral hand-over screen between players, so nobody sees someone else's word
- The word card and the imposter card look identical from across the room
- No going back to an earlier player's word
- Words don't repeat until you've played the whole deck

DECKS
- Football Basics: corner kicks, offside, hat tricks and more (free)
- Positions & Tactics: false nines, low blocks, the offside trap
- Matchday: turnstiles, floodlights, the final whistle
- Football Culture: chants, sticker albums, five-a-side
- Your Words: add your group's own phrases and inside jokes

Football here means the game played with your feet: soccer. All words are original and generic. Imposter Football isn't affiliated with any club, league or competition.

PREMIUM
Unlock Positions & Tactics, Matchday and Football Culture, plus custom word lists for your group.

SUBSCRIPTION
Premium is optional: $2.99 per week with a 3-day free trial, or $14.99 per year. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.

description:
The world has fallen. Lastwall is all that stands between humanity and the dark — and Aran is about to find out what holding the line really costs.

Imradris is a story-driven puzzle RPG. Match shards on the board to charge your heroes, and when your companions fight as one, unleash Team Attacks that turn the tide.

■ A STORY WORTH FINISHING
• Nine chapters of illustrated scenes and cinematics
• Follow Aran and his companions from the walls of Lastwall into drowned marshes, storm-lashed peaks and beyond
• The whole story can be cleared with the heroes you meet along the way

■ PUZZLE BATTLES WITH DEPTH
• Match five kinds of shards to fill your heroes' mana and fire their skills
• Build Resonance and launch Team Attacks such as Duet, with full-screen cut-ins
• Bosses that bend the rules: guardians no blade can touch, turn delays, back rows and more

■ HEROES YOU EARN, NOT BUY
• No gacha. Heroes are never sold — every one is recruited through play
• Endless Recruit: defeat monsters, collect their shards and add them to your company
• Hero Festa: event stages where featured heroes can be recruited

■ BUILD YOUR BASE

name: iMusician: Play Together
description:
iMusician is a social network where musicians record songs together without ever meeting.

Every session starts with an a cappella vocal or a backing track. Pick a song, put on headphones and record your part along with everyone who has already played. The app lines your part up with the song and mixes all the videos into a collage clip you can share on social media.

PLAY ANYTHING
Guitar, bass, keys, drums, violin, brass, lead and backing vocals. Record with the iPhone microphone, a headset or an audio interface — switch the source with one tap.

MIDI KEYBOARDS AND PADS
Connect a MIDI controller via USB-C and the app offers the built-in ATØMIZE synth (240 sounds: basses, leads, pads, keys) or drum kits with a drum on every key. Notes are recorded along with your video and your part's sound is rendered from them — clean, without room noise. Stumbled? Open the note editor: quantize to the grid, delete stray notes, move them.

ALWAYS IN TIME
Recording, backing track and camera run on one clock, so your part lands in the song without manual alignment. Recorded just a section? It appears in the clip only where it plays.

CLIP FEED
Finished clips gather in a feed. Like, comment, follow musicians and message them — that's how you find people for your next song.

SAFE
Community guidelines with zero tolerance for objectionable content, one-tap reporting and blocking. Delete your whole account right in the app.

name: Inchfall: Rain Gauge & Totals
description:
How much rain fell at your place? Inchfall turns NOAA radar rainfall estimates and Iowa State University's daily rainfall analysis into a clear record for your yard, garden or field.

Start with one place, no account needed. Without any purchase, that place gets live radar totals for the last 1 to 72 hours, a morning-to-morning daily ledger, week and month totals, this month vs normal, the last 30 calendar days, recent storms with cards to share, gauge logging with a side-by-side list, the small and Lock Screen Rain check widgets, rain-start alerts and a morning summary.

HONEST NUMBERS
Each daily report covers the 24 hours ending at 12:00 UTC on its date. Live radar totals are separate rolling windows and are never added to it. Every number shows its source. Values less than 3 days old are preliminary and may be revised; today's report shows as pending until Iowa State publishes it. Missing days stay missing: never filled in, never shown as zero, and a total with a missing day says so.

"Normal" is NOAA's 1991–2020 climate normal, the newest 30-year average, provided through Iowa State University. Comparisons with normal are hidden when too much data is missing.

INCHFALL PRO
• Up to 25 places
• Season and year against the 1991–2020 normal
• Season vs last year: the same dates last year on your season chart (radar estimate, gaps shown) and the difference on mornings known in both years
• Daily history from your season start, up to 400 days, and calendar dates beyond 30 days
• Every storm of the season, ranked
• Water or skip: seven mornings of rain against your weekly watering target. An optional National Weather Service forecast is shown apart and never changes the verdict. A general guide; ask your local extension service about your plants and soil.
• Gauge comparison chart, with optional correction after enough paired wet readings
• More widgets: medium Rain check, Water or skip, Rain ledger and Places
• Heavy-hour and day-total alerts, and alerts for more places
• CSV export of your rainfall record and gauge readings

ALERTS
Alerts are optional and use NOAA radar estimates, updated about hourly, so one can arrive up to about an hour after the rain. Rain-start alerts need at least 0.02 in (0.5 mm) in an hour and are not sent from 10 pm to 7 am. Alerts are not safety warnings.

Widgets for the Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy, Control Center controls, and Shortcuts actions.

Radar estimates rain over an area; your gauge measures one spot. Single days can differ, and no exact agreement is promised.

Inches or millimeters. Downloaded history works offline; new data and alerts need internet. Version 1 covers the lower 48 US states only, not Alaska, Hawaii or Puerto Rico.

PRIVACY
No account, ads, analytics or tracking. Place names, precise pins and gauge readings stay on your iPhone. To fetch rainfall, Inchfall sends coordinates rounded to 3 decimals to NOAA and Iowa State University; Water or skip also sends them to the National Weather Service for an optional forecast. Address search uses Apple Maps. Optional alerts use a small Inchfall server that stores random identifiers, a push token, Pro status, preferences and coordinates rounded to 2 decimals, and never place names.

Inchfall is not affiliated with or endorsed by NOAA, the National Weather Service or Iowa State University.

SUBSCRIPTIONS
Inchfall Pro is an annual or monthly auto-renewing subscription, or a one-time Lifetime purchase. The annual plan includes a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the current period ends; manage them in your Apple Account settings. The app shows current prices and trial terms.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://inchfall.app/privacy/

name: Inkwisp
description:
Inkwisp is a quiet ink notebook. It opens like a real book: tap the cloth cover, read the contents page, choose a chapter and the page turns. A vermilion ribbon hangs from the top of every chapter, and a tug on it brings you back to the contents.

The first chapter is Today's Line. Each day you get one line, 140 characters at most, written in one of five inks. Midnight is still, Vermilion is fierce, Moss is growing, Ochre is warm and Iris is dreaming. Choose the ink that suits the day. You can revise the line until midnight, and then it rests.

Down the margin, your days gather as blots of ink. A longer line leaves a larger blot, and tapping one opens that day again. In the chapter called Margins the book keeps a few notes about itself: how many days in a row you have written, how many words in all, an ink calendar for the month and the ink you reach for most.

When the mind wants something to hold, turn to Single Stroke. There are twelve figures, from a simple Kite to the Labyrinth, and each one can be drawn in a single unbroken line without going over any line twice. Euler worked out the rule for the bridges of Königsberg, and the book quietly lets you in on it. Finish a figure and it is stamped with a red seal. The next one opens, and your best time is pencilled beside it.

In Paper & Binding we laid out four papers on the desk: Cream in indigo buckram, Parchment in oxblood leather, Rice in charcoal linen, and Night in midnight velvet. Every page re-inks to match the sheet you choose. Turn on Follow the evening and the book changes to Night paper whenever your phone is in Dark Mode.

There is no account to make. The notebook lives on your iPhone first and works offline. An anonymous ID, with no name or email behind it, keeps a quiet cloud copy of your lines, seals and paper. Reset my data in the Colophon tears out every page, here and in the cloud.

We made Inkwisp for the few minutes at the end of a day. One line, one figure, and the book closes.

name: Instant TV Remote

Instant TV Remote turns your iPhone into a fast, beautiful remote for your smart TV. It works with Samsung, LG, Roku and Sony TVs and connects directly over your home Wi-Fi: no account, no ads, no tracking.

WORKS WITH YOUR TV

name: INTECH Terrain
description:
INTECH Terrain met le module Dolibarr « Interventions Techniques » dans la poche du technicien.

Retrouvez le bon dossier, photographiez, saisissez la visite et faites signer le client sur place — même dans une cave, en montagne ou dans une zone blanche. Tout ce que vous faites est gardé sur le téléphone et part seul dans Dolibarr dès que le réseau revient, dans le bon dossier, sans jamais être envoyé deux fois.

VOTRE JOURNÉE, PRÊTE LE MATIN
• Les rendez-vous de votre calendrier, rapprochés tout seuls du bon dossier Dolibarr : par la référence citée, par le passage planifié, par le client ou par la machine nommée.
• Les passages planifiés dans Dolibarr, avec la pièce à emporter écrite sur la ligne.
• Les rendez-vous personnels restent dehors : seuls ceux qui concernent une intervention s'affichent.

SUR PLACE
• Photos réduites et débarrassées de leur position GPS, rangées dans les documents de l'intervention.
• Saisie de la visite : heures, travail fait, pièces remplacées, issue. Un passage prévu dans Dolibarr se complète, il ne se double pas.
• Signature du client au doigt, téléphone tourné ; le bon signé est produit dans Dolibarr. La signature peut aussi venir plus tard.

UN ACCUEIL CLAIR, UNE COULEUR PAR ACTION
• Quatre vignettes : Intervention, Livraison, Dépôt, PV de recette. Chacune dit ce qui attend une signature.

BONS DE LIVRAISON ET DÉPÔTS
• Le client signe la réception d'une livraison sur le téléphone : le bon passe à « Réceptionné ».
• Matériel confié en atelier : signature au dépôt (panne, diagnostic, délai, conditions), puis à la restitution.
• Chaque signature produit dans Dolibarr un bon signé et scellé, distinct de l'original.

PROCÈS-VERBAUX DE RÉCEPTION (avec le module « PV de recette »)
• Réserves ajoutées ou levées sur place, photo du défaut, signature de chaque partie sur le téléphone ; le PV se scelle tout seul après la dernière.

SANS RÉSEAU
• Tout ce qui est saisi attend sur le téléphone et part seul au retour de la couverture. L'onglet « En attente » montre ce qui n'est pas encore parti.
• La journée préparée la veille se rejoue le matin hors ligne.
• Dossiers, bons de livraison, dépôts et PV mis en favori s'ouvrent sans réseau, même des mois après.
• Serveur injoignable : l'application le constate une fois et continue avec ce qu'elle a gardé, sans attendre à chaque geste.

SÛRE
• Face ID, Touch ID ou code du téléphone à l'ouverture.
• Chaque téléphone a son propre jeton, inscrit depuis Dolibarr par un QR, révocable seul en cas de perte.
• L'application ne parle qu'à votre Dolibarr, en https : aucun compte, aucun serveur tiers, aucun suivi.

CE QU'IL FAUT
Un Dolibarr 22 ou plus, accessible en https, avec le module « Interventions Techniques » d'INTECH (Dolistore). L'application est gratuite ; elle ne fonctionne pas sans ce module.

name: Intelli Calculator Offline

Intelli Calculator Offline

Speak it. Scan it. Solve it.

Your personal math assistant, completely offline.

name: Iron County
description:
Fort Sentinel is the last stop on the convoy's route. Choose your ground, line up your defenses, and hold through 20 waves.

Deploy scouts, Ironclad tanks, artillery, anti-air defenses, Falcon jets, and support relays. Upgrade ordnance and systems, set targeting priorities, and choose when to call in the fully upgraded Falcon's one-use strike.

Download free and play one run on Red Mesa Pass. You can resume that run from its wave checkpoint. One in-app purchase unlocks all five sectors and lets you replay them anytime.

name: Is He Marriage Material? Test
description:
Is he the one, or just the one right now? This relationship test checks whether he is husband material, not whether he likes you.

Answer 16 honest questions about how he actually behaves and get a marriage material score out of 100 across five things that decide the long run. The deal-breakers are named, clearly.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Take the 16-question test about how he acts with you and with others.
2. Add your chat if you want a sharper read. It can only lower a score.
3. See your score, a radar of five dimensions and the warning signs.

FIVE SCORES, NOT ONE
• Commitment: does he talk about a future, and mean it?
• Reliability: does his word hold when it is hard?
• Conflict: how he fights, and whether he repairs.
• Respect: your limits, your people, and how he treats others.
• Alignment: kids, values and the life you each want.

RED FLAGS AND DEAL-BREAKERS, NAMED
Some patterns outweigh everything else: keeping you from your friends, pressure until you give in, contempt, days of silence. When one shows up it gets its own warning card, and the total is capped so a good score elsewhere cannot hide it. Warning signs are never behind a paywall.

HONEST, NOT HARSH
This is a long-term compatibility test, not a love quiz that tells everyone they found their soulmate. Low scores are warnings, not insults. The test describes patterns and what they usually lead to. It never tells you to leave or to stay. The decision is yours.

FULL REPORT
All five dimension cards, a 90-day watch list, the messages behind the score and a PDF export. Buy one report, or every report forever. One-time payments, no subscription.

GOOD TO KNOW
Your test answers are scored on your phone and never sent anywhere. If you add a chat, it is sent over an encrypted connection to be labeled by an AI classifier and is not stored. Results are for reflection, not a verdict on anyone.

Questions or ideas: contact@bytelunalabs.com

Con ella puedes:
- Abrir o cerrar tu comercio con un toque.
- Ver los pedidos que te llegan y seguirlos hasta que el conductor los entrega.

name: Iztream Go Live

description:
Iztream Go Live is a broadcasting studio on your iPhone. Preview the camera, set up a scene, and go live.

• Switch between the front and back cameras, or show both at once
• Mute the microphone and check stream health
• Add photo overlays, alerts, and goals
• Chat with viewers while you are live
• Confirm a broadcast with a 6-digit security code sent to your account
• Sign in with Apple, Google, or your Iztream email

You name each stream and mark it 18+ when it is not for younger viewers. The camera, microphone, and photos you pick are used for that broadcast. Iztream does not sell this data.

To delete the account on this phone, email baakhapaa@gmail.com from the address on the account and include your username.

name: J&G Detailing MN
description:
Your car, detailed by hand — booked in seconds.

J&G Detailing has been keeping cars spotless in Golden Valley, MN since 2021. Now you can book, move or cancel your appointment right from your phone. No calls, no back-and-forth.

SIGN IN FAST
Enter your mobile number and the code we text you. No passwords to remember.

BOOK IN A FEW TAPS
• Pick your service and vehicle type, and see the price up front
• Choose a day and an open time slot
• Review and confirm. You'll get an update as soon as the shop confirms your visit.

OUR SERVICES
• Luxury Hand Wash: foam bath, hand dry with plush microfiber, wheels and tires dressed
• Complete Interior: carpets and upholstery shampooed, console and glove box cleaned
• Complete Basic Detail: hand wash, express interior and a high-speed wax
• Ultimate Enhancement: full detail with buff and polish, hand wax, interior shampoo and basic engine cleaning

Pricing for sedans, SUVs, trucks and vans.

PLANS CHANGED? NO PROBLEM
Reschedule or cancel your visit yourself, right in the app.

STAY IN THE LOOP
Get a notification when your appointment is confirmed, moved or cancelled.

REWARDS
When our rewards program is running, every finished visit counts toward a free service, and you can use your reward when you book.

name: Jagannath Yatra Announcement
description:
Jagannath Yatra Announcement keeps everyone who pulls and guides the rath on the same signal.

Organisers switch between GREEN and RED. Every phone in the team changes colour, vibrates and speaks the instruction in a calm Hindi voice:

GREEN: "Jai Jagannath, aage badhiye"
RED: "Rath rokiye, kripya rokiye"

It works even when the phone is locked or in a pocket. Green and red also vibrate differently, so you can tell them apart without looking.

ANNOUNCEMENTS
Organisers can send a short text or voice announcement to the whole team. Text is shown on screen and read aloud. Announcements clear themselves after five minutes, and organisers can clear them for everyone at once, so every phone shows the same, current information.

ALWAYS IN SYNC
Every phone shows whether it is connected and when it received the last signal. A message that arrives late is marked as expired instead of being played out of order.

NO SIGN UP
Open the app and it connects. No account, no phone number, no ads.

FOR ORGANISERS
Organiser mode is protected by a password from the yatra committee. Organisers see how many phones are online and how many received each signal.

name: Jatlk - Shop All You Want
description:
Jatlk is a shopping platform that brings thousands of products together in one place: electronics, fashion, home, beauty, kids and more.

Why Jatlk?
• Clear prices from the start, with no hidden fees at checkout.
• See the delivery date before you place your order.
• Track your order and every parcel step by step, with a notice at each update.

One account for the app and www.jatlk.com: your orders, favorites and notices go wherever you sign in.

name: JBONMX
description: JBONMX offers a simple and convenient user experience, an intuitive interface layout, orderly content organization, and practical tools. The application includes functions such as analysis, flow stability, unit cost, loading capacity and inventory flow. It supports the input, calculation, classification, organization and viewing of relevant data, and provides data summary, indicator comparison and historical records, etc., which is convenient for users to view and manage various data.

name: JetPunk: Geography & Trivia
description:
Build your geography memory with Quiz Atlas, an independent type-in quiz game.

TYPE A NAME. FILL YOUR ATLAS.
Recall countries and US states in any order. Correct answers light up your offline map. Known English names and documented aliases count; duplicate guesses never add points.

FIVE COMPLETE FREE QUIZZES
• Countries of the World: 195 countries (193 UN members and two observer states)
• US States: all 50 state names
• World Capitals: 191 country prompts, with explicit multiple-capital notes
• Flags of the World: identify 195 bundled flags, with accessible text clues
• Countries of Europe: 44 countries, with transparent regional scope

Play timed or untimed, pause and resume, retry missed answers, and keep your best scores and recent rounds on your device. A rotating Daily Challenge offers a shorter round. No login, ads, cloud scoreboard or linked JetPunk account is required. The native quiz engine and content work offline.

OPTIONAL LIFETIME PRO
One non-consumable purchase unlocks six additional packs: Africa, Asia, North America, South America, Oceania and European Capitals. Pro also adds custom seeded challenges, custom timers, saved-mistake study and richer device-local progress and streak history. No subscription or free trial. US base price: $6.99 once; your app store displays the actual localized price before purchase. Restore Purchases is available on the paywall and in Settings.

COUNTS AND SOURCES YOU CAN CHECK
The country scope, territorial exclusions, European classification and capital exceptions are explained in the app and on our Credits page. Maps use licensed/public-domain geography; prompts and curated packs are independently assembled. Quiz Atlas is developed by Starter Studio, Inc. and is not an official JetPunk app or partner.

name: JianfeiCan
description:
减脂餐大全 —— 照单做，也能照单买

减脂餐大全，24 道减脂食谱，一周的饭一次排好。

【怎么用】

• 今日：一天三餐推荐与热量环
• 食谱：按热量、蛋白、耗时筛
• 计划：一周七天的三餐表，食材自动汇总成购物清单
• 我的：热量目标、过敏原排除、收藏

【里面有什么】

24 道食谱，分早餐、午餐、晚餐、加餐四类，每道都标了热量、蛋白质、碳水、脂肪、
膳食纤维，以及每份克重、耗时、难度、用料与步骤。

【一周计划】

「计划」页把一周七天的三餐排成一张表：一天一行，早/午/晚三列。
空格点一下就用当天的推荐，一步排入。排好后，食材自动汇总成购物清单 ——
「照单买」的意思就在这里。手动加的条目会保留，不会被自动汇总覆盖。

【隐私】

不登录、没有账号、没有任何权限请求。你的热量目标、过敏原设置、计划与购物清单
只存在你自己的手机里，卸载即彻底删除，我们看不到也拿不走。

联网只有一类，全部指向开发者自建服务器：首启时发一条安装来源统计，用来判断这次安装
归属哪个推广渠道。请求里只有一个随机设备标识与设备参数，不含姓名、邮箱、电话、位置、
照片，也不含剪贴板内容；除此之外全程离线。不接入第三方 SDK，不含广告与统计代码，
不收集任何类别的用户数据。食谱数据与插画全部随 App 一起打包，在设备本地读取。

【适合谁】

想控制饮食、又不想每天重新想「今天吃什么」的人。

版本 1.0

name: Jingle Jars: Coin Sort Puzzle
description:
Pour coins from jar to jar and merge three of a kind into a bigger coin. Jingle Jars is a bright, cheerful coin puzzle with no ads and no timer. It plays offline on iPhone and iPad.

EASY TO START
Tap a jar, tap another one and pour. Three equal coins merge into one bigger coin. The first level shows you how, with a helping hand.

ALWAYS SOMETHING NEW
Every few levels bring a twist: locked jars, frozen coins, one-way jars, a conveyor that drops new coins and rainbow coins that copy their neighbour. Jars grow taller as you learn, and the levels never run out.

SUNNY WORLDS
Travel from Cloud Park through Sunny Fields, Candy Hills and Toy Town to Starry Night. A new place every ten levels.

PLAY YOUR WAY
Earn up to three stars, use boosters when you are stuck, collect a gift every day and play the Daily Jar. Dress up your coins with colourful looks. Compare how far you got on the Game Center leaderboards.

NO ADS
No ads, no timer, no wifi needed. Purchases are optional and always ask a grown-up first.

JAR PASS (optional subscription)
Unlimited hearts, double daily gifts and every look. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it in your Apple ID settings.

name: Jivlet
description:
JivletTurn your favorite photos into puzzles worth coming back to.
Jivlet is a cozy jigsaw app for puzzle lovers, photo enthusiasts, and anyone who wants a quiet break from a busy day. Rediscover a favorite trip, a beloved pet, or an everyday moment as you put each piece in place.
Create a puzzle from your photo library or camera, crop it your way, and choose from five sizes, ranging from 16 to 1,024 pieces. You can also explore illustrated scenes when you feel like something new.
Sort pieces by edge, color, or region, organize them in trays, and zoom in for a closer look. Reference images and hints help when you get stuck.
Your progress and trays are saved when you leave, so a few spare minutes are enough to get started. Set the mood with background music, personalize your space, and enjoy a little companion along the way.

name: Jollune
description:
Jollune is a calm route-building card experience for players who want short, thoughtful sessions without rushed reactions. Each turn, choose one of three cards and place it on a five-by-five board. Adjacent cards connect when they share a suit or number, lighting a road across the parchment tableau.

Your goal is to guide four woodland friends—the penguin, rabbit, fox, and bear—from their homes to the central stage before the turn limit runs out. Every placement can extend an existing route, open a new branch, or link distant sections through a matching number. A one-use Lucky Card can rescue a difficult layout, while Undo lets you reconsider the latest move.

Animated arrivals bring each completed route to life. A built-in visual guide explains symbol and number matching, and the Sticker Book records milestones from successful journeys. With clear placement rules, readable card interactions, and multiple routes to balance at once, each run rewards planning rather than speed.

name: JOVFX
description:
JOVFX keeps site photos, notes, and follow-up details together in numbered records that are easy to review and share.

CAPTURE THE CONTEXT

Create a quick record with a photo and a note, or use a guided three-step flow for a more detailed record. Group records by project and add the site address, date, and contact details as needed. Take photos in the app or choose them from your photo library.

MARK UP CHANGES

Add boxes, arrows, and text directly to photos to show where a change is needed or what has been completed. Keep multiple before-and-after photos together in the same record.

FIND AND FOLLOW UP

Each record gets a number within its project. Search the project records or filter by area and status. Add a location, priority, assignee, and due date when those details help with follow-up.

EXPORT A PDF

Create a concise PDF with photos and descriptions, or choose a detailed layout and select the fields to include. Preview the PDF on your device, share it with the system share menu, or reopen the latest report from its project.

KEEP A LOCAL BACKUP

No account is required. JOVFX stores your working records on your device. Export a backup of your projects, records, photos, and annotations, then restore it in JOVFX on another device.

JOVFX supports English and Simplified Chinese and is designed for site communication and condition records.

name: Joyclip
description:
Joyclip is a nearby Bluetooth controller for adults using compatible J-Nova personal-care devices. The current app interface is in Simplified Chinese.

CONNECT YOUR OWN DEVICE
Power on your device, allow Bluetooth access, and select your J-Nova. Compatibility depends on the model and firmware. One J-Nova device has been physically tested; support for other Bluetooth devices is not implied.

CHOOSE YOUR INTENSITY AND RHYTHM
Adjust intensity and choose steady, wave, or pulse rhythm. The default intensity limit is 30%, and every new connection starts at zero. Raising the limit does not increase the current intensity.

STOP AND RESET
A stop button remains available at the bottom. Leaving the app attempts to stop and disconnect the device. A successful Bluetooth transmission is not confirmation that the device has stopped; check the physical device.

EXPLORE DEMO MODE
Try the controls without connecting to or activating real hardware.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, ads, or tracking SDKs. Connection information is processed temporarily on your device. Control commands are sent over Bluetooth to the device you choose, not to a developer server.

REQUIREMENTS
A Bluetooth-capable iPhone or iPad and a compatible J-Nova device are required for hardware control. This app is intended for adults and does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment.

Joyclip 是一款面向成年用户的近距离蓝牙控制应用，适用于已验证兼容的 J‑Nova 个人护理设备。

连接自己的设备
打开设备电源，允许蓝牙并选择自己的 J‑Nova。兼容性取决于具体型号和固件，目前已完成一款 J‑Nova 实物测试，并不支持所有蓝牙设备。

按自己的节奏调节
提供强度调节，以及恒定、波浪和脉冲三种页面节奏。默认强度上限为 30%，连接后从零开始；调高上限不会自动提高当前强度。

随时停止并归零
底部始终保留停止按钮。离开页面时会尝试停止并断开连接。蓝牙发送成功不代表设备已经确认停止，使用时请留意实物状态。

先体验，再连接
演示模式只预览操作，不会连接或驱动真实设备。

简单、私密
无需注册账号，没有广告或追踪服务。设备连接信息在手机上临时处理，控制指令通过蓝牙发送至你选择的设备，不上传开发者服务器。

使用要求
需要一台支持蓝牙的 iPhone 或 iPad，以及兼容的 J‑Nova 设备。当前应用界面为简体中文。应用用于成年人个人护理设备控制，不提供医疗诊断或治疗功能。

name: JRide Driver
description:
JRide Driver is the app for drivers and couriers on the JRide platform. Go online whenever it suits you, accept ride and parcel requests near you, and keep track of everything you earn, all in one place.

GETTING STARTED
• Sign up with your phone number or email
• Add your personal details and vehicle information
• Upload your documents, such as your driving licence and vehicle registration, for review
• Start taking trips as soon as your account is approved

RIDES
• Receive requests from nearby customers, with pickup, drop-off, distance and your earning shown before you accept
• Send your own fare offer when a customer proposes a price
• Navigate to the pickup and drop-off points
• Confirm pickup with the customer's one-time code
• Rate your customers after each trip

PARCEL DELIVERY
• Deliver parcels alongside rides
• See the parcel type, weight, size and the sender's notes
• Complete deliveries with the receiver's code, a delivery photo or a signature
• Collect cash on delivery when the sender requests it

SCHEDULED TRIPS
• Browse rides and deliveries booked for later that match your vehicle
• Accept the ones that fit your plans and keep taking other trips until pickup time
• Your scheduled trip opens on your trip screen shortly before pickup

EARNINGS AND WALLET
• See your earnings for today, this week and this month, including tips and bonuses
• Check the fare, commission and your net earning for every trip
• Top up your wallet and request withdrawals to your saved account
• Follow every transaction in your wallet history

STAY CONNECTED AND SAFE
• Chat with your customer in the app
• Get instant notifications for new requests and messages
• Send an SOS alert if you feel unsafe during a trip
• Reach support or raise a complaint from the Help Center

GROW WITH JRIDE
• Earn reward points for completed rides, deliveries and referrals
• Exchange your points for wallet money
• Invite other drivers with your referral code
• Track your rating, acceptance rate and completion rate

The app is available in English, Arabic, French and Spanish, with light and dark themes.

ABOUT LOCATION
While you are online, JRide Driver uses your location, including when the app is in the background. This is how we send you nearby requests and show your customer where you are during a trip. Location tracking stops when you go offline. Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease battery life.

A JRide driver account is required. Your account must be reviewed and approved before you can accept trips.

name: Julia Bakery

Julia Bakery es una panadería y café en la zona 10 de la Ciudad de Guatemala. Con la app pedís tu bebida antes de llegar y la recogés a la hora que elegís.

PEDÍ Y RECOGÉ
• Elegí tu café, té o bebida fría del menú.
• Escogé la hora de recogida.

EL MENÚ DEL DÍA
Mirá lo más pedido de la panadería y la pastelería. El pan y los pasteles se eligen en la tienda, porque lo que sale del horno cambia cada día.

JULIA COFFEE CLUB

Lunes a domingo, de 7:00 a. m. a 6:00 p. m.

name: Just Jigsaw by Nonnie Games
description:
Just Jigsaw is a calm picture-jigsaw app from Nonnie Games—part of the “Just…” series built for quiet play, not carnival engagement.

Open the app, choose a photo, and assemble the pieces at your own pace. No ads. No timers. No lives. No push to “watch a video for a hint.” Your puzzle auto-saves so you can leave and return whenever you like.

MADE FOR COMFORTABLE PLAY

* Large, readable pieces sized for real screens—not hundreds of tiny tabs on a phone

* Separate board and piece tray: zoom the workspace while tray previews stay easy to see

* Pan, zoom, and generous snap so placement feels forgiving, not fiddly

* Pick a session length that fits your day—from a quick break to a longer sit-down puzzle

* Optional piece rotation when you want an extra challenge

TWO WAYS TO PLAY

Relaxed: neighbor snap, slot snap, and optional gentle assists like a faint board ghost and reference preview.

Classic: free assembly with movable groups on a roomy board.

HELP WHEN YOU WANT IT

Hints, preview, edge-only tray filter, high contrast, reduced motion, tray placement, surface themes, and soft sounds are included. Comfort tools are not sold back to you.

FREE TO START

The General collection is included. You get a full, unlimited jigsaw experience with no catches.

MORE PICTURES, YOUR CHOICE

* Optional one-time collections such as Holiday Magic, Wild & Wonderful, and Fantasy & Mythical Worlds

* Bundle offers when you want several collections at once

* Download owned collections for offline play once they are on your device

FROM NONNIE GAMES

If you enjoy calm, trustworthy apps like the rest of the Just… family, Just Jigsaw is built the same way: respectful of your time, your eyes, and your quiet.

name: KamPals: Hangouts & Friends
description:
Life's better with your people. KamPals gets you out of the house and into small hangouts with verified people near you: rooftop dinners, weekend hikes, football, game nights, watch parties, brunch and everything in between.

Made for people who live here and love their city. Just moved back or new in town? Pull up. There's always a seat.

Find your plan
Browse hangouts happening near you tonight, this weekend or whenever you're free. See the vibe, the place, rough cost and who's going, then request a seat. Small groups of 4 to 8 mean real conversations, not crowds.

Host your own
Got an idea? Turn it into a plan in under a minute. Pick a ready template like Movie night, Watch party or Football game, set the time and place, and let your people find you. You choose who joins.

Everyone is verified
Every member confirms their ID and a selfie before joining a hangout, and gets a blue tick. You know the people you meet are who they say they are.

Public places, your rules
Hangouts happen in public places. The exact venue is shared only once the host lets you in. Share your trip with a trusted contact, and let them know when you're home safe.

Friendship, not dating
KamPals is about good company: new friends, old hobbies, more nights out. Respect everyone, show up when you say you will, and keep it friendly.

Football, meetups and more
Join a pickup game, find your side, or catch a community meetup. If you can do it with friends, you can do it on KamPals.

Free to join
Browsing, joining hangouts and every safety feature are free. KamPals Plus adds extras like seeing everyone who waved at you, early access to new hangouts, hosting meetups and more filters. Your first month is free.

You need to be 18 or older to use KamPals. Starting in Kampala, with more cities coming soon.

Questions? support@kampals.com

name: Karaoke Sing: Mic to Speaker
description:
Turn your iPhone into a karaoke mic to speaker — sing live through any Bluetooth speaker.

Connect a Bluetooth or wired speaker, paste a link to your favorite karaoke video and sing. Your voice comes out of the speaker with studio-quality effects, right over the music.

CLEAN VOICE, AUTOMATICALLY
• Tap the mic: the music pauses, you hear 3 soft beeps, and the app tunes itself to your room and speaker
• Keeps buzz, feedback and speaker echo away — no settings needed
• Settings stay fixed for the whole song, so your voice never fades out

STUDIO VOICE EFFECTS
• Presets in one tap: Studio, Concert, Stadium, Echo, Choir, Hard Tune
• Fun voices: Robot, Chipmunk, Giant
• Fine-tune reverb, room size, echo, pitch shift, harmony, bass and air
• Voice volume up to 400% — your voice stays on top of the music

SING ANY SONG YOU LOVE
• Paste a karaoke video link — you're on stage in seconds
• Build your setlist, mark favorites, search your songs
• Adjust the music volume so your voice always shines

MADE FOR EVERY SCREEN
• Live voice waveform shows how loud you sing
• Made for iPhone Duo: fold it like a laptop — the song on top, your voice and effects below
• Works with Bluetooth speakers, AUX cables and USB audio

EASY TO START
• A short interactive tutorial shows you everything
• No account, no sign-up, no ads
• Your songs stay on your device

Tip: keep the speaker 2–3 meters away from you for the cleanest sound.

Grab your phone, turn up the speaker — the stage is yours!

name: Katari Routes
description:
Katari es la app donde llevas el viaje a Japón que te preparamos a medida.

No es una guía genérica ni una lista de sitios que ya conoces. Un equipo experto en Japón prepara tu viaje solo para ti y al detalle. Tú decides los días, la temporada, el ritmo y lo que os apetece ver. Nosotros montamos la ruta de cada día, elegimos dónde comer y te decimos dónde merece la pena comprar. Te lo entregamos aquí dentro, día a día.

QUÉ ENCUENTRAS CADA DÍA

• El plan del día, hora por hora, con las paradas en orden, cómo se va de una a otra y cuánto se tarda.
• La ficha de cada parada, con lo que es, cómo llegar y lo que conviene saber antes de ir.
• Audioguías de los sitios que lo merecen, para escuchar mientras paseas. El texto se resalta a la vez que suena, así que puedes leer en vez de escuchar, o las dos cosas.
• El tiempo de cada parada a la hora en que vas a estar allí, no el del sitio donde estás ahora.
• El mapa del día con todas las paradas y un toque para abrir la ruta en Google Maps.
• Una guía práctica por temas, desde cómo comportarte hasta dónde merece la pena comprar.
• Frases en japonés para los momentos en que hacen falta.
• Las cuentas del viaje en yenes y en euros, con el reparto entre todos ya calculado.

FUNCIONA SIN COBERTURA

En Japón el móvil no siempre tiene datos, y todo el diseño parte de ahí. El viaje se descarga una vez y se queda en el teléfono. El plan, las audioguías, los textos, las fotos, las frases y la guía funcionan en modo avión.

Solo hace falta conexión para actualizar la previsión del tiempo y para abrir una parada en Google Maps.

CÓMO SE CONSIGUE UN VIAJE

Cada viaje se prepara a mano para quien lo pide, así que primero hablamos. Nos cuentas tus fechas y tus gustos, te enseñamos la ruta y nos dices qué cambiar. Cuando está lista, entras con tu cuenta y la descargas desde la propia app.

PRUÉBALA ANTES

La app trae un día entero en Tokio, con sus audioguías, para que veas cómo es un día de viaje con Katari. No hace falta cuenta para verlo.

SIN SORPRESAS

• Sin anuncios.
• Sin seguimiento ni analítica.
• Un viaje ya descargado se usa sin cuenta.
• Las voces de las audioguías se generan con inteligencia artificial a partir de los textos que escribimos.

Las audioguías, los textos y las rutas son contenido propio. Los mapas son de OpenStreetMap y sus colaboradores, y la previsión del tiempo viene de Open-Meteo.

name: Kelir - Tamil Voice & Video
description:
Kelir is a Tamil app to text, voice call and video call real people, one to one.

Choose who you want to talk to:

FRIENDS
Verified people who are here to listen and talk. Share your day, your thoughts or just have a good conversation in Tamil.

STARS
Instagram creators you follow. Text them or call them directly.

EXPERTS
People with knowledge in their field. Book a 30 or 60 minute voice or video session.

HOW IT WORKS
- See who is online and open a profile.
- Send a text, or start a voice or video call.
- Calls are one to one and private.
- You see the price per minute before every call.
- Add money to your wallet and use it for calls and text packs.
- Your wallet shows your balance and about how many minutes it gives you.

SAFE AND RESPECTFUL
- Every Host is verified before they can take calls.
- Kelir is not a dating app.
- Report or block anyone from their profile or from a chat.
- Community guidelines apply to everyone.

YOUR ACCOUNT
- Sign in with your mobile number.
- See your wallet history, call history and chats in one place.
- Delete your account at any time from your profile.

Questions or help: https://kelirapp.in/contact/

name: Kemono LIFE
description:
Be born as a dog or cat and live a whole life through their eyes.

You can't choose where you're born. It could be in snow country, on a southern island, in the city, in a mountain town, in the suburbs, or in a port town. Your life may begin in a home, in a shelter, or outdoors. You can't choose who you'll live with, either. Some lives are long and spent with kind people. Others end sooner. Each life unfolds one choice at a time.

See through their eyes

People tower above you. When they crouch down, their faces are right in front of you. Tap “See through my eyes” to view the world from your animal's eye level.

A world of scents and sounds

Sniff, listen, or look closely to catch a glimpse of what a dog or cat senses.

Kemono LIFE Notes

Short notes in each scene draw on veterinary and animal behavior research.

A life remembered

At the end of a life, a card preserves your memories and feelings about the people you lived with. You can save the card as an image.

Kids mode

Turn on Kids mode for fewer distressing events and a gentler ending.

Play for free

Play two lives from start to finish for free. Lives that end by age 3 don't count toward the limit. You'll be born in the city or the suburbs. The full version is a one-time purchase that lets you start as many lives as you like and be born in four more regions: snow country, a southern island, a mountain town, and a port town. It includes new regions and events as they're added.

Supporting animals

Each year, Kemono LIFE donates 10% of the proceeds from full-version sales after Apple's fees and taxes to animal welfare organizations. We report the recipients and amounts in app updates. The app does not collect donations from players.

Some stories include lives that end through illness or accidents. These moments are handled gently, and we recommend that young children play with an adult.

No ads or analytics. You can play offline. An internet connection is needed for purchases and restores.

name: Kerf Mark
description:
Kerf Mark is for the moment a board is already on the sawhorses and the pencil is still in your hand.

Write the board length, the piece length, and the kerf in millimeters, then name the board. Drag the pencil across the next piece. That piece is marked, and one kerf is eaten. Drag again for the next piece. When the remainder is shorter than a piece, that remainder is the offcut.

Keep the board on this iPhone. Open the boards kept here to see how many pieces were marked, how many millimeters of kerf were eaten, and how much offcut is left. Lift a board when you no longer want it on this phone.

Kerf Mark does not create an account, connect to the internet, or make a file. It does not run a saw or tell you how to use one. The numbers stay in millimeters everywhere. Only the language of the screen changes.

name: Kerf Side
description:
Kerf Side keeps one board and its saw kerf on this iPhone.

Draw along the waste side of the chalk line. The stroke holds when it stays past the line and reaches the far end. A sample that crosses into the face stays into the face, even when later samples return. A drift wider than 0.200 must come back to 0.120 before the window closes, or the kerf is left wide. A stroke that stops short of the far end is short.

Name a board, rename it, delete one, and share four lines: the name, the mark, the waste side, and the note.

Boards stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not saw a real board.

name: Kettlestitch
description:
Kettlestitch is a planning bench for hand bookbinding. Tell it how many pages your book has, what paper you are folding and how you want to bind it, and it works out the sections, the page order on every sheet, the spine thickness, the pieces to cut and where to punch the sewing holes.

FOLD THE PAGES INTO SECTIONS
Choose folio, quarto or octavo folding and how many sheets to nest in each section. Kettlestitch shows how many sections and sheets you need, whether blank pages are added, and the exact page numbers on both sides of every sheet, including the pages that print upside down. Copy the full printing order as text for your printer.

KNOW YOUR TEXT BLOCK
Pick a sheet size such as A4, US Letter or Tabloid, or enter your own, then add the paper weight and bulk or a measured leaf thickness. You get the folded leaf size and an estimated spine thickness, plus a grain check that tells you whether the paper grain will run with the spine.

CUT LIST FOR THE COVER
For case bindings, Coptic, long stitch, stab and pamphlet bindings, Kettlestitch lists every piece to cut: boards, spine strip, covering cloth with turn-ins, endpapers and spine lining. Squares, joint gap, setback and turn-in are all adjustable, and a drawing shows the boards laid out on the cloth.

SEWING STATIONS AND THREAD
Set the number of tapes or stations and the kettle inset to get each punching position measured from the head, drawn on the spine, with an estimate of how much thread to cut. Stab bindings show the hole pattern and the thread path around the spine.

A SHELF OF YOUR BOOKS
Save each project as a volume on your shelf, with its own cloth colour, plan, notes and a step-by-step bench checklist for its binding style. Share a complete spec sheet as text whenever you need it.

REFERENCE
A paper grain guide with three simple tests, an overview of each binding style, and a searchable lexicon of bookbinding terms.

ALSO INCLUDED
• Millimetres or inches, with fractions to 1/32
• Dark Mode and Dynamic Type support
• Works offline, with no account and no data collection

Measurements are planning estimates. Fold a test section before cutting your best materials.

name: Ki Master: Astral Clash
description:
Assemble your mecha squad on the battlefield of Ki and become a true Ki Master.
Traverse the Ember Frontier, the Tidal Wastes, the Glazed Sand Sea, and the Void Spires, and challenge wave after wave of stages. Tap to strike, build up energy, unleash your ultimate, and team up with your allies to defeat powerful enemies. The higher your stage rating, the richer the star rewards.
[Core Gameplay]
• Stage Progression: Scout enemy intelligence, assess combat power, and engage with caution.
• Real-Time Combat: Combos, shields, healing, and boss enrage phases.
• Squad Development: Appoint commanders, adjust your three-person frontline, and cultivate bonds.
• Star Core Gacha: Recruit rare mechas and raise your combat power cap.
• Daily Tasks: Login rewards, daily actions, and star milestones.
[Resources & Growth]
Gold, relics, stamina, and diamonds form a complete progression loop. Upgrade commanders in the Barracks, replenish supplies in the Vault, and keep your squad growing stronger.
Assemble your mechas and set forth on your journey—where Ki leads, victory is assured.

name: Kimi Ocean
description:
Dive into a pastel world with Kimi, an explorer axolotl, and five friends: Bela, the open-sea whale; Nina, the river otter; Tico, the rainforest toucan; Lola, the garden bunny; and Tuga, the lagoon turtle!

Tap to swim, fly or hop, slip between the obstacles and grab the coins with Kimi's face on them. The challenge grows little by little, with easier levels along the way to catch your breath.

• Lots of levels across 6 worlds: reef, open sea, river, rainforest, garden and lagoon
• Finish a world to meet the next friend
• Kimi's infinite mode with monthly and all-time online rankings: how far can you go?
• Spend coins on pre-level boosts and colourful trails (bubbles underwater; feathers and petals in the sky and garden)
• Crashed? Revive up to 2 times per level, right where you stopped, with an optional video each
• 3D scenery with its own music in every world
• In Portuguese, English and Spanish
• No forced ads: the only ads are optional videos you choose to watch to revive, double coins, get +50 coins or more infinite-mode attempts
• No-Video Extras subscription (monthly or yearly): those extras take one tap, no video. Auto-renews; cancel anytime in Settings › Subscriptions.

Only the name you choose appears in the ranking.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Kindhours
description:
Kindhours is a tidy logbook for volunteer and community-service hours. It is built for students who need a set number of hours for school or an award, scouts and guides working toward a badge, and adult volunteers who want a clear record for an employer or a reference.

LOG A SHIFT IN SECONDS
Pick the organisation, choose your role, set a start and end time or just a duration, and add a line about what you did and who supervised you. Roles you type are remembered for that organisation, so the next shift takes a couple of taps.

GET HOURS SIGNED OFF
When your supervisor confirms a shift, stamp it as signed off with their name and the date. The teal stamp sits on the shift, and your totals always show how many hours are signed off and how many are still waiting.

SET A GOAL AND WATCH THE BADGE FILL
Set a target such as 40 hours by June, with the date counting starts from. A stitched badge ring fills as you log hours and shows the signed-off share inside it. Kindhours tells you how many hours are left and roughly how many a week you need to finish on time.

KEEP YOUR ORGANISATIONS IN ONE PLACE
Save each charity, club, school or event with a contact name, phone and email, plus the roles you do there. Each organisation card shows its share of your hours, its number of shifts and when you were last there, along with hours by role and every shift logged with it.

SHARE A CLEAN HOURS REPORT
Choose a date range (this month, last month, this year, the last 12 months, all time or your own dates) and one organisation or all of them. Kindhours adds up totals by organisation, month and year, and builds a plain-text report you can send through the share sheet as an email, a message or a note. You can include every shift with its sign-off details, or just the totals.

MADE TO BE PRIVATE
- Sign in with email and password, or tap "Log as guest" to start straight away without an account.
- Guests can save their hours to an email account later from the Office pin.
- Your logbook syncs to your private account and keeps working offline.
- No ads, no tracking, no analytics.
- Delete your account and every organisation, shift and sign-off from the Office pin at any time.

THOUGHTFUL DETAILS
Four badge pins along the top take you to Hours, Orgs, Report and Office. There are three colour themes (Warm Canvas, Evening Shift and Spring Drive), gentle sound effects and haptics you can switch off, and optional starter examples so you can try every screen before logging your own hours.

name: Kinetic: Workout & Food Log
description:
Kinetic is your simple, private, offline workout tracker and food diary. Built for home and gym training, Kinetic combines a distraction-free weightlifting log with an intuitive calorie counter and macro tracker—100% offline and without requiring an account.

SMART WORKOUT TRACKER & PLANNER
• 100 strength and bodyweight exercises with step-by-step instructions, form cues, common mistakes and alternatives.
• 12 ready-made routines or build unlimited custom workouts tailored to your goals.
• Personalized plans for home dumbbells, barbell gym setups, or bodyweight training.
• Visual target-muscle maps highlighting primary muscles and prescribed set emphasis.

EASY GYM LOGGING & REST TIMER
• Log sets, reps, weights, and timed holds with quick keypad entry or steppers.
• Reference your previous session weights and reps while logging.
• Large workout timer and rest countdown with quick +30s and Skip controls.
• Pause, resume, and recover active workouts reliably on your device.

OFFLINE FOOD DIARY & CALORIE COUNTER
• Track calories, protein, carbs, and fat with exact gram portions and quick portion multipliers (0.5x–2x).
• Attributable food catalog including popular meals and Indian dish estimates.
• Add custom food labels, copy meals from yesterday in one tap, or save favorite meals for reuse.
• Optional meal photos from Camera or Photos for your personal visual reference.
• Set manual calorie targets without restrictive diet algorithms.

Food photos do not identify meals or calculate portions automatically. You select the food and grams. Kinetic does not provide automated diet prescriptions or intake recommendations.

CUSTOMIZE YOUR EXPERIENCE
• Choose between Dark, Light, or System appearance for comfortable logging anywhere.
• Update vitals, training preferences, and metric (kg/cm) or imperial (lb/in) units anytime.
• Optional local workout reminders on scheduled training days.

100% PRIVATE & OFFLINE BY DEFAULT
• All workout history, body measurements, and food logs stay securely on your iPhone and iPad.
• No account registration, login credentials, or Kinetic cloud database required.
• Optional password-encrypted backups saved to Files or iCloud Drive, plus readable JSON export anytime.

AD-SUPPORTED CORE WORKOUTS
• Free access to full core workouts, food diary, and offline planning.
• Non-intrusive banner ads on overview screens only; strictly no ads during active sets, rest timers, or meal entry.
• No subscription or credit card needed.

FITNESS INFORMATION, NOT MEDICAL CARE
Kinetic is intended for adults aged 18 and over. Exercise instructions and routines have not yet been professionally reviewed. Muscle maps illustrate intended targets, not measured muscle activation.

Kinetic is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent medical conditions. Consult a healthcare professional for medical advice and before exercise if you have health concerns. Choose movements suited to your ability and stop if you feel pain or unwell. Food calories are estimates, not a diet prescription.

Terms (Standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://kinetic-app.in/privacy/

name: Kismet Receipt: Goals & Year
description:
Welcome to the Kismet Machine.

Answer seven quick questions: what did you spend the most on, how many times did you say “I’ll start tomorrow”, what was your word of the year? The machine prints your answers as a receipt, then cuts a kismet coupon for what comes next: “This coupon is good for one (1) COURAGE.”

• Monthly or yearly receipts: the date updates itself
• My goals: lose weight, finish books, don’t text your ex… or your own
• Reach one and the machine prints an Achievement Receipt: “WILLPOWER: PAID IN FULL”
• Share your receipt to your Instagram story
• Gentle reminders at month end and before a goal is due
• English and Turkish

Kismet Receipt is a game that works offline and is played using your phone’s own settings. Free. No account, no ads, no in-app purchases; no data collected.
These results are not guidance. It’s just a game.

name: KnightMind
description:
Play a game of chess on a handcrafted wooden board. Play White against Stockfish in 3D, or switch to a top-down view to read the position at a glance.

CHOOSE YOUR CHALLENGE
Pick Casual, Club, or Expert difficulty. Tap a piece to see its legal moves, undo a move, and review the move list. KnightMind saves your game on your device so you can pick it up later.

LEARN WHILE YOU PLAY
In Play mode, Rook reacts as the game unfolds. Switch to Teach mode to hear what changed on the board and get ideas for your next move. Open Rook's notes for a hint, an explanation of the last move, or a reminder of a chess rule.

LISTEN OR READ
Rook's English voice is bundled and works offline. Follow along in captions or mute the voice in Settings. On compatible devices with Apple Intelligence available, Rook can generate coaching on device. Built-in coaching works on other supported devices.

KnightMind is open source under the GNU General Public License v3. Computer moves and hints use Stockfish. Spoken commentary uses KittenTTS.

name: KnocDownTV
description:
Welcome to KnocDown TV, your destination for independent entertainment.

Explore captivating movies, original series, and exciting shows that celebrate creativity, diversity, and unique storytelling. Discover independent creators and stories that bring fresh perspectives to your screen.

With KnocDown TV, you can:

• Browse movies and shows by category.
• Search for titles in the catalog.
• Watch videos directly on your iPhone.
• Explore other episodes in the same category while watching.

Whether you enjoy compelling dramas or discovering new creative voices, KnocDown TV brings independent entertainment to your fingertips.

Discover your next story with KnocDown TV.

name: KolejRehberim: Okul ve Kolej
description:
KolejRehberim, Türkiye'deki özel okul ve kolejleri anaokulundan liseye tek haritada toplar. Uygulamayı açtığın anda harita konumuna iner, en yakın kolejler mesafeyle sıralanır. 81 ildeki 6.602 kampüsün bilgisi telefona gömülüdür; arama internet olmadan da çalışır.

• Harita ve en yakın kolejler: kademe seçerek süz, 1-3-5 km halkalarıyla mesafeyi gör, haritadaki okula dokunup özetini aç.
• Okul ara: ad, il, ilçe, kademe ve kurum türüyle süz; anaokulundan liseye dört kademenin bir arada olduğu kampüsleri tek dokunuşla bul.
• Kampüs sayfası: adres, dokunup arama, yol tarifi, resmi web sitesi, MEB kurum kodları, aynı markanın diğer kampüsleri.
• Kaydet ve karşılaştır: iki ya da üç kampüsü yan yana koy, karşılaştırmayı görsel kart olarak ailenle paylaş.
• Okul gezisi planı: kaydettiğin okulları bulunduğun yerden en kısa sırayla diz, tüm durakları harita uygulamasında rota olarak aç.
• Ziyaret kartım: her okulda kendi puanını ve notunu tut, ziyarette sorulacak soruları işaretle; karşılaştırmada görünür.
• Ev + iş arası: iki adresine toplamda en yakın okulları bul.
• Marka ağları: bir kolejin tüm kampüslerini haritada gör, sana en yakını başta.
• Okula başlama yaşı: çocuğunun hangi yıl anaokuluna ya da 1. sınıfa başlayabileceğini MEB kuralına göre hesapla.
• Ana ekran widget'ı: son konumuna en yakın üç kolej ve LGS takvimi bilgisi ana ekranında; iPhone'da kilit ekranında da. Okula dokun, sayfası açılsın.
• LGS takvimi ve hatırlatıcı: MEB tarihleri açıklandığında önemli günlerden önce bildirim; veli kontrol listesi.
• Okul ekle / bilgi düzelt: eksik okul ya da yanlış bilgiyi birkaç dokunuşla bildir; okul yönetimleri de kullanabilir.
• Kullanım rehberi ve ilk açılış turu.

Hesap yok, reklam yok, sponsorlu sıralama yok. Konumun, kayıtların ve notların yalnız bu telefonda kalır. Okul bilgileri MEB özel öğretim kurumları kaydına ve kurumların resmi duyurularına dayanır; ücret ve kayıt koşullarını okuldan teyit edin. KolejRehberim MEB ya da listelenen okullarla bağlantılı değildir.

name: Kometenknuff
description:
Your little crew is stranded on Mochi-7, with a swarm of asteroids between them and home. Find the right angle and bounce a path through.

AIM, BOUNCE, KEEP GOING
Send your volley ricocheting off the walls, clear blocks and plan the next shot. Each new row changes the board. Special tiles, tough rows and limited lives give familiar angles fresh consequences.

EARN STARS, UNLOCK GEAR
Collect stars by playing and completing achievements. Unlock new balls, improve your current flight or use the aiming guide. Saved stars stay with you for the next attempt. Gameplay upgrades use earned stars only.

A CREW TO CARE ABOUT
Your first companion is included. Three more purely cosmetic companions are available as optional one-time in-app purchases. They change your look, not your chances.

START YOUR FLIGHT FOR FREE
Replay rounds 1–49 as often as you like. From the start of round 50, one in-app purchase unlocks the full game. You can always choose a new free flight from round 1 instead. No subscriptions, no ad breaks and no stars sold for cash.

MADE FOR A LITTLE BREAK
• Offline gameplay
• Dark and light themes
• German, English and French
• Skippable tutorial
• Local progress, no separate login

An internet connection is required for purchases, restoring purchases, the optional games catalogue and help pages. Progress is stored on this device; cross-device save sync is not currently included.

name: Kosol Energie
description: ERP Solution provided by DevERP. This app provides complete mobile solution to its ERP clients. Which makes the business operation easy for users to use from anywhere from mobile devices.

name: KrosvaMestarit
description: KrosvaMestarit on mittakellojen ja tarkkuusmittauksen apusovellus sentaukseen ja heiton tarkastukseen. Se arvioi mittausalueen, toistotarkkuuden, mittapaineen, nayttovirheen, telineen vakauden seka kalibrointitarpeen. Liukusaatimilla saadetaan aluetta, painetta, ulottumaa ja lampotilaa, ja tulokset tallennetaan tai viedaan mittatiedostona. Pro-versio avataan kertamaksulla ilman mainoksia tai tilausta.

name: KruqesaJolvin
description: Lightning protection calculator: risk class, lightning density, air terminals, down conductors, earthing, equipotential bonding, warning devices and costs.

name: Krystaleen
description:
KRYSTALEEN

Olet laakson viimeinen kristallimestari. Syvistä kaivoksista löytyvät kiviin uponneet kristallien jäljet, ja laakson asukkaat tuovat sinulle toiveensa: heille on valmistettava oma talismani.

Peli rakentuu viidestä vaiheesta, ja jokainen vaihe vaatii eri taitoa.

SUKELLUS
Syvissä käännät kivilevyt yksi toisensa jälkeen ja sovitat niiden kuviot pareiksi. Lampun öljy on rajallinen: jokainen virhe polttaa yhden pisteen, ja mitä syvemmäksi menet, sitä enemmän levyjä ja sitä vähemmän öljyä. Osa kuvioista on pelkkää kuona, ja ne näyttävät hyviltä vasta kun ne on jo avattu ja katsottu. Syvemmät kerrokset antavat puhtaampaa ainetta, mutta vaativat enemmän varovaisuutta ja lampun öljyä.

LEIKKAUS
Raakakivi halkaistaan tai hiotaan valitsemallasi tavalla. Leikkaus ei ole painikkeen painallus, vaan ajoituksen taito: osoitin kulkee voimakkuusasteikolla edestakaisin, ja terä on pudotettava juuri merkityn alueen sisään. Tarkka osuma nostaa sirpaleen luokkaa, huono osuma pudottaa sitä ja voi rikkoa kiven. Jokaisella tavalla on oma hintansa ja oma vaaransa, ja ennen leikkausta näetkin, mitä olet tekemassa.

PIIRUSTUS JA SULATUS
Valmis piirustus asetetaan pöydälle, sirpaleet sijoitetaan oikeisiin paikkoihin, ja talismani sulatetaan hiilessä. Sulatusnäyttämössä kulkee resonanssisykli: kun osoitin osuu kirkkaaseen ikkunaan, sytytetty sielunsydin tuottaa kaksinkertaisen luokkabonuksen. Sielunsydintä on niukasti, ja jokainen sytytys on punninta: luokka ylös vai luokka alas.

TOIVEET
Laakson asukkaiden toiveet odottavat Toivepöydällä. Jokainen toive sisältää piirustuksen, palkinnon ja kolme mahdollista vastausta. Ennen vastaamista voit vetää merkinen, joka muuttaa palkintoa, ja huonoa merkkiä voi torjua ottamalla vain varmuuspalkinnon. Toiveen voi myös kieltää, ilman rangaistusta, mutta tuo toive katoaa silloin ikuisesti. Kaikki valmiit teokset, vastaukset ja tarinat kokoillaan Kronikkaan.

EDISTYMINEN
Viisi lukua, viisitoista toivetta ja viisi maineen tasoa, vieraasta tulokkaasta Laakson suulliseksi. Voima palautuu ajan kuluessa, joten voit sukellella silloin kun sinulle sopii, eikä kiirettä ole.

Kaikki tapahtuu omalla laitteellasi. Ei ostoksia, ei mainoksia, ei viestittelyjä muiden kanssa.

name: Kstep: Video & Camera Moves
description:
Give each camera move a clear plan and each take a careful review. Kstep brings video files, editing tools and phone filmmaking practice together, so you can move from opening a clip to studying the shot and sharing what you noticed.

Open and organize your footage
Import a video from Files or Photos and work with a separate local copy. Find recently opened videos with real thumbnails and file names. Search your library and browse imports, offline videos, exports and favorites. Open supported video links and save eligible videos for offline playback.

Look closely at the movement
Play, pause and scrub through your footage. Adjust playback speed, save a named range and loop the section you want to study. Revisit the same moment to examine framing, timing, focus and subject movement. Saved ranges stay with the video and can be used as the starting point for a trim.

Compare a shot in three frames
Inspect the start, middle and end of a marked range together. With Kstep Plus, export the frames as separate JPEG images or create one comparison image with the range name and timestamps. Share it with a friend or collaborator to discuss exactly where a camera move works and where the next take could improve.

Shape the clip
Trim a video, change its speed, rotate or mirror the image, and choose an original, portrait, square or landscape frame. Preview your changes before exporting. Kstep Plus includes MP4 video export up to 1080p and M4A audio extraction. Finished video and audio files appear in Exports and can be shared or saved through the system share sheet.

Turn a guide into your own practice
Explore follow, reveal and parallax examples with clear shooting steps. Plan a camera movement, target duration and focus choice, then film with your camera app. Log takes, outcomes and notes, and import your recording directly into the practice record. Mark a section, loop it and compare its frames while the planned shot is still fresh.

Keep useful details for the next take
Filter practice records by movement or find sessions still waiting for a video. Export a practice record as CSV, and use Plus shot presets to reuse movement, duration and focus settings. Share an edited clip or comparison image through the apps you choose and bring specific visual details into the conversation.

Subscription Information

Kstep Plus is an optional auto-renewable subscription that removes daily online viewing and offline download limits and unlocks video and audio exports, JPEG stills, three-frame comparison images and saved shot presets. Plus also skips opening ads. Downloads and exports depend on supported formats and source availability.

name: Kurimo: Photo Cleaner
description:
Kurimo finds the duplicate photos, near-identical shots, screenshots and big videos that fill your iPhone, then helps you remove them in a few swipes. Everything is checked on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded, and there is no account.

DELETING IS ALWAYS FREE AND UNLIMITED
- Exact duplicates, similar shots (the best one is kept for you), screenshots and large videos
- Swipe through your library month by month and toss what you do not need
- Deleted items go to Recently Deleted, so you can still get them back for 30 days
- Works with Limited Access too: Kurimo only looks at the photos you allow

SEE WHAT YOU GAINED
- Your free space is measured by iOS, not guessed
- Each month shows how much you cleaned
- A Toss basket collects everything first, and nothing is deleted until you confirm

COMPRESS VIDEOS, KEEP THE DATE AND PLACE
- Smaller copies that keep the original date, location and favorite
- The original is only deleted after you check the new one

MERGE DUPLICATE CONTACTS, WITH A BACKUP
- Exact copies merge for free
- Every merge saves a vCard backup first, and Undo brings the old contacts back

WHY IS MY IPHONE STILL FULL?
- An honest guide to System Data: what it holds, and the real steps that help. No app can clear System Data, and Kurimo does not pretend to.

KURIMO PRO (optional)
Pro adds advanced video compression (many videos at once, choose quality and size) and smart contact merge (likely matches with different details).
- Pro Yearly: $14.99 per year, renews automatically until you cancel
- Pro Lifetime: $29.99, one purchase, no subscription
Prices are for the United States and may differ in your country. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. A yearly plan renews unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions, or from Kurimo > Settings > Manage subscription.

PRIVACY
Kurimo collects no data. Photos and contacts never leave your iPhone.

name: L’Éventail spirituel
description:
L’Éventail spirituel est l’adaptation numérique de l’ouvrage de Fabrice Erard, « Harmonie, Équilibre & Fluidité ». Vingt-deux lames, vingt-deux textes et vingt-deux peintures originales de l’auteur, à lire régulièrement, comme un livre de chevet, pour se recentrer et cheminer sereinement.

CE QUE CONTIENT L’APPLICATION
• Les 22 lames de l’ouvrage, avec l’ouverture et la postface
• Les peintures originales de Fabrice Erard, au recto de chaque lame
• Les textes lus par l’auteur, sur une musique originale
• La possibilité de couper la voix pour n’écouter que la musique

DEUX FAÇONS DE LIRE
• Dans l’ordre : dépliez l’éventail et suivez le fil, de la première à la dernière lame
• Au tirage : posez votre intention et choisissez une lame, ou trois — ce que je suis, ce que je traverse, ce vers quoi je vais

SIMPLE ET RESPECTUEUX
• Aucun compte à créer, aucune publicité, aucun traceur
• Lecture et écoute possibles hors connexion une fois l’accès ouvert

ESSAI GRATUIT, PUIS ACHAT UNIQUE
Découvrez l’intégralité de l’ouvrage gratuitement pendant 7 jours, sans paiement, sans abonnement et sans prélèvement automatique. À la fin de l’essai, vous pouvez débloquer l’ouvrage définitivement par un achat unique. Rien n’est facturé si vous ne faites rien.

L’ouvrage propose les réflexions personnelles de son auteur. Il ne remplace pas un avis médical ou psychologique.

Conditions d’utilisation : https://eventail.orionwebdesign.fr/legal/conditions-utilisation.html
Confidentialité : https://eventail.orionwebdesign.fr/legal/confidentialite.html

name: Lamma: Game Night & Events
description:
Lamma is the easiest way to bring your people together. Plan a gathering, send one invite link, see who is coming, and keep the night going with party games that work on everyone's own phone.

PLAN YOUR EVENT IN MINUTES
- Create an event with a title, date, time and place, then pick a theme that fits the mood: birthday, game night, family lunch, graduation, a night out with friends.
- Share a single invite link on WhatsApp or anywhere else. Guests can open it in the app or in the browser.
- Guests answer going, maybe or can't make it, and you see the guest list update live.
- Turn on reminders so nobody forgets the plan.

PARTY GAMES FOR THE WHOLE GROUP
- Imposter (مين الدخيل؟): everyone gets the same secret word except one person. Give clues, vote, and catch the imposter. 3 to 12 players.
- Trivia Time: fast multiple-choice rounds with live scores and a winner. Up to 20 players.
- Quarter Mile: a head-to-head car card game for two. Take the car you can see or risk it on the hidden one, and build the best garage.
- Lamma Icebreakers: questions that rotate around the group to get everyone talking. 2 to 30 players.

Start a room, share the room code, and friends join from their own phones. The host controls the pace of each round. All games are just for fun: there is no betting and no real money.

MADE FOR EGYPT
- Full Arabic and English, with right-to-left layout.
- Light and dark mode.
- Game content written in Egyptian Arabic, with trivia and prompts your group will actually recognise.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
- Start as a guest with no sign-up, or sign in with Apple or Google to keep your events across devices.
- No ads. We do not sell your data.
- You can delete your account and your data from inside the app at any time.

Need help or have an idea? Write to zynovatech.eg@gmail.com. Lamma is made by Zynova Tech.

Download Lamma and make the next get-together the one everyone talks about.

name: Landwerk Zuhause
description:
Landwerk Zuhause – Tradition zuhause neu erleben.

Mit Landwerk Zuhause mietest du ausgewählte Geräte für die traditionelle Lebensmittelverarbeitung – flexibel für Tage, Wochen oder Monate. Entdecke Ölpressen, Dörrgeräte, Mühlen, Fermentierungsgefäße und mehr.

Auf einen Blick:
· Transparente Mietpreise, Lieferkosten und Kaution  
· Details zu Ausstattung, Mindestmietdauer und Verfügbarkeit  
· Standard- und Expresslieferung  
· Buchungen, Adressen und Kautionen im Konto verwalten  

Wähle dein Gerät und den passenden Mietzeitraum und lass es dir nach Hause liefern. Bezahlt wird bar oder mit Karte bei der Übergabe.

Verfügbar in Berlin, Potsdam und ausgewählten Orten in Brandenburg. Für dein nächstes Projekt – ohne das Gerät direkt kaufen zu müssen.

name: Lantern: Korean QR Table Order
description:
Lantern is QR table ordering for restaurants and cafés that serve international guests.
Guests scan the QR on the table and order from a menu in their own language (15 languages) — no app, no sign-up. You and your staff receive orders in this app and mark them cooking, ready and paid. Guests still pay at the counter, so there are no payment fees.

■ New-order and staff-call alerts
· Push alerts for new orders, even on the lock screen
· Guests can call for water, utensils or the bill — like a table pager
· Use a tablet as the order board and staff phones as remotes

■ Your menu from one photo
· Take a photo of your current menu; Lantern reads items and prices and builds a multilingual menu
· English, Japanese, Chinese (Simplified/Traditional), Thai, Vietnamese, Spanish, Arabic and more
· Allergen, spice, halal and vegetarian labels

■ Staff remote and table devices
· Staff connect by scanning a pairing QR — no owner password needed
· Turn a spare tablet into a table menu with the screen pinned

■ Stop prank orders from outside
· Register your location and first orders from outside need staff confirmation

■ Estimated cooking time, tips and loyalty points

Core features are free to use.
Contact: lantern@hblood.co.kr · Privacy: https://lanternmenu.com/privacy

name: LapnoteX
description:
Lapnote is a lap and split recorder built for coaches who time more than one athlete at once. Start one clock, give each athlete a big lane, and tap the lane every time they cross the line. Lapnote does the arithmetic while you watch the track, the pool or the river.

ONE CLOCK, UP TO EIGHT LANES
Pick up to eight athletes from your squad and open the lane board. A single shared clock starts with one tap. Every tap on a lane records that athlete's split; touch and hold a lane to finish them. Each lane shows the lap number, the last split, the running average and the difference to the lap before, in large scoreboard numerals you can read at arm's length. Tapped too soon? Undo the last lap.

SPLITS YOU CAN READ AT A GLANCE
Every lap becomes a thin split bar: green when it was faster than the lap before, orange when it was slower, with the difference written at the end. Set the lap length in metres, yards, kilometres or miles, and Lapnote shows pace per km, per mile or per 100 m - handy for track, swimming, cycling and rowing alike.

A SQUAD WITH A MEMORY
Add athletes with their training group and the events they race. Each athlete page keeps a session history, trend bars from session to session, and personal bests per event: best finish and best lap. When someone beats their best lap on the board, Lapnote marks it with a green PB tag and two quick beeps.

COMPARE AND EXPORT
Put any two saved sessions side by side and see each athlete's laps in two columns, with the total or pace difference spelled out. Rename a session, change its event or correct the lap length later. Export a full session as plain text through the share sheet to send to athletes or paste into your training log.

WORKS ON THE TRACK, EVEN OFFLINE
Your squad and sessions are saved as you go and stay available without signal; they sync when you are back online.

SIGN IN OR JUST START
Create an account with email and password, or tap "Time as guest" and start straight away. Guests get every feature and can keep their splits later by adding an email from the Clubhouse.

YOUR DATA, YOUR CALL
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your athletes' times are private to your account. Delete your account and every session, lap and athlete from the Clubhouse at any time.

Two looks: Track Chalk for bright days, Floodlights for evening sessions. Optional sound effects and haptics, both easy to switch off.

name: Lapora
description:
Lapora keeps a swimmer’s training the way it is written on a pool deck.
Build a set in coach notation, such as 8 × 100 freestyle on 1:40, descend 1–4. At the wall, run the send-off or the rest, then close each repeat with the clock, stroke count, and any splits you choose to write down. Planned distance and swam distance stay side by side. Only lengths you actually finish count toward the week. Pace is shown per 100. Short-course yards, short-course meters, long-course meters, and a custom pool each keep their own length, so a yard session is not treated as a meter session.
Four sections cover the week:
Swim shows today’s whiteboard, the send-off clock, and the repeats you just finished.
Plans holds the season, its phases, named drills, and the lines of a set.
Technique keeps your clips, a mark on the frame you choose, notes for each stroke, a coach’s written remark, and a side-by-side look at two clips of the same stroke.
Progress shows distance, pace, CSS, personal bests, and a comparison of two training phases. A personal best updates only for an unaided swim of the same stroke and distance in the same course.
