The first time you open Lapora, a small balance is waiting. Saving a clip, exporting the training record, and saving a coach note draw from it. Comparing two clips, pinning a fault, and turning a note into a drill line do not.
Lapora does not score your stroke from the video, diagnose an injury, or enter you in a race. The mark on a frame is one you place.

name: LaserDesk - Réglages laser
description:
LaserDesk est le carnet de réglages des professionnels du nettoyage laser (décapage, dérouillage, préparation avant soudure, rénovation de pierre…).

TES RÉGLAGES, PAS CEUX DES AUTRES
L'appli est livrée vide : aucun réglage tout fait. Tu notes ceux que tu as validés sur TA machine, pour les retrouver en un geste sur le chantier.

MATÉRIAU PAR MATÉRIAU
Crée tes matériaux (rouille sur acier, peinture sur alu, oxydation inox, pierre calcaire…) et enregistre pour chacun un ou plusieurs réglages : couche légère, couche épaisse, finition…

TOUS LES PARAMÈTRES
Puissance (%), fréquence (kHz), durée d'impulsion (ns), vitesse de balayage (mm/s), largeur, nombre de passes, forme du laser (ligne, zigzag, rectangle, cercle, spirale, sinus…) et tes notes (lentille, distance, résultat).

ÉNERGIE PAR IMPULSION
Indique la puissance de ta source : LaserDesk calcule l'énergie par impulsion de chaque réglage (mJ) et te prévient si elle dépasse le maximum de ta source.

PHOTOS AVANT / APRÈS
Prends la surface en photo avant et après le passage du laser et joins-les au réglage : tu sais tout de suite ce qu'il donne.

FICHE PDF
Partage la fiche d'un matériau en PDF (réglages + photos) avec un collègue, un client ou ton fournisseur.

RECHERCHE
Retrouve un réglage en tapant un nom de matériau ou un mot de tes notes.

Gratuit, sans publicité, sans compte. Tes réglages et tes photos restent sur ton iPhone : rien n'est envoyé.

LaserDesk ne remplace pas la notice de ta machine : teste toujours un réglage sur une petite zone cachée et porte les protections adaptées.

name: Leapling: Kids Languages
description:
Meet Pip, your friendly language-learning buddy! Leapling helps children practise one small step at a time through playful lessons, listening, matching, speaking, and everyday conversations.

Choose Spanish, French, English, Mandarin Chinese, Japanese, or Arabic. Learn greetings, food, and places and directions with short lessons, clear audio, and helpful examples. Practice activities revisit words and help learners build confidence.

No account and no sign-up. Progress and settings stay on the device, and lessons and audio work offline. Speaking practice is optional and only uses the microphone when the child chooses it. Anonymous usage stats (no names, no recordings) help us improve Leapling and can be turned off in Settings.

Leapling has no ads. Come learn a little every day with Pip!

name: Lectern: Slides & Scripts
description:
Lectern is an iPad app for people who speak from a script and show slides while they do it: pastors, teachers and lecturers.

It has four modes.

READ
Open a manuscript and read it. Pages run in one continuous scroll and Lectern remembers your place. Apple Pencil only scrolls in Read, so a stray touch never marks or selects anything.

WRITE
Start a note on ruled, dotted or graph paper and write with Apple Pencil. There is one pen and no tool palette. Handwriting stays handwriting and is never converted to text. A note can be exported as a PDF.

EDIT
Mark up an imported document with Apple Pencil, highlights and comments. The PDF you imported is never changed. Your markup is kept beside it, can be shown or hidden while you read, and can be exported as a marked-up copy.

PRESENT
Keep your script on the iPad and put your slides on a second display over AirPlay. Step through the slides with the arrows while the script scrolls independently. Use the pointer pad to point at the slide. Lock the slide orientation and the script orientation so nothing turns as you move. Leaving Present takes a press and hold, so a brush of the hand does not end it. If the display disconnects, the slides return where they were when it reconnects.

IMPORT
PDFs import as they are and look exactly as you made them. Word documents and text files are converted to PDF. PowerPoint files (.pptx) can be imported as well: Lectern converts them to PDF, and the conversion can change fonts, layout and pictures in ways you may not want. We strongly recommend exporting a PDF from PowerPoint, Keynote or Google Slides and importing that instead.

PRIVATE
Your documents stay on your iPad. There is no account, no advertising and no tracking, and Lectern collects no data.

Requires iPadOS 26 or later. Handwriting needs Apple Pencil. Showing slides needs a second display connected with AirPlay.

Scripture quotations in the screenshots are from the ESV® Bible (The Holy Bible, English Standard Version®), © 2001 by Crossway, a publishing ministry of Good News Publishers. Used by permission. All rights reserved.

name: Lendhook
description:
Lendhook keeps track of things you lend and who still has them.

Add the people and the items on your shelf, then write a loan with the day it went out and the day you want it back. Out, Due, and Returned split the same notebook: due means overdue or due within seven days. An item that is already out cannot be lent again until you mark it returned, with the condition you saw when it came back.

Review counts open loans, overdue loans, and the item that has been lent most often. Names and phone notes are typed by you. Lendhook does not read your contacts.

The slips stay on this phone.

name: Let’s call
description:
Máš chuť si s někým popovídat? Let’s call ukáže, kdo z tvých přátel má právě čas na hovor.

ZAVOLEJ MI NA HODINU
Přepni ze stavu Nerušit na Zavolej mi. Dostupnost platí nejvýše jednu hodinu a zbývající čas vidíš přímo v aplikaci. Potom se automaticky vrátí Nerušit.

PŘÁTELÉ Z TVÝCH KONTAKTŮ
Povol přístup k adresáři a najdi kontakty, které už používají Let’s call. Dostupní přátelé jsou zvýraznění tyrkysově. Hledej podle jména nebo části telefonního čísla. Ostatní kontakty můžeš pozvat standardním sdílením odkazu.

WIDGET NA PLOŠE
Malý widget zobrazí telefon s počtem dostupných přátel a přepínač tvé dostupnosti.

STAČÍ KLEPNOUT A ZAVOLAT
Klepnutím na číslo dostupného přítele otevřeš běžný telefonní hovor. Let’s call nezajišťuje internetové volání; cenu hovoru určuje tvůj tarif. Po návratu můžeš potvrdit, zda rozhovor proběhl. Přátelé pak vidí dobu od posledního potvrzeného hovoru, nikoli obsah ani druhého účastníka.

BEZ HESLA A SMS
Zadáš vlastní číslo a aplikace se spojí s profilem tohoto zařízení. Číslo není ověřené a aplikace nepotvrzuje totožnost uživatelů. Jména kontaktů zůstávají v telefonu; pro nalezení přátel se serveru předávají otisky čísel. Profil lze kdykoli odebrat v Nastavení.

Pro synchronizaci je potřeba připojení k internetu. Widget se obnovuje podle možností systému.

name: Let's Learn! English
description:
Learn English you can use in real life.

Let's Learn! English brings lessons, vocabulary, grammar and illustrated reading together. Start with your first conversation, then follow a course that builds on what you know.

LEARN BY DOING
Answer questions, build sentences and practise useful expressions. Clear explanations help you understand mistakes and keep going.

FOLLOW A CLEAR COURSE
Explore courses from absolute beginner through A1, A2, B1, B2 and C1. Choose a starting point and learn at your own pace.

READ AND UNDERSTAND
Discover illustrated stories at different levels. Use translations for support and listen to stories with available narration.

BUILD YOUR VOCABULARY
Save useful words and return to them in practice. Explore grammar explanations and examples when you need help.

YOUR LANGUAGE, YOUR SUPPORT
Use the interface in English, Japanese, Korean or Spanish, with translation support where available.

START FOR FREE
Begin as a guest and explore free activities. Add an email to keep your account across devices. Optional Premium unlocks all lessons, readings and unlimited practice.

PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTIONS
Choose a 1-month, 3-month or 12-month subscription. The App Store displays local prices and billing terms before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account subscription settings.

Privacy: https://letslearnenglish.app/privacy
Terms: https://letslearnenglish.app/terms
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: LetterHelp
description:
Every month, the mail brings letters that are hard to understand: bills, insurance notices, appointment letters, government forms, and texts, emails and voicemails that might be scams. For many people that means calling a son, a daughter or a neighbor and asking, "What does this mean?"

LetterHelp started because my family calls me with these questions all the time. I wanted something so simple they could use it on their own: point the phone at the letter, press one button, and hear what it means in their own language.

SOUND FAMILIAR?
• Your mom calls every week: "I got a letter from Medicare, what does it mean?" Now she takes a photo and hears the answer herself, right away.
• Your grandpa gets a text saying a package is on hold until he pays $1.99. LetterHelp warns him it's a scam before he clicks.
• Your uncle gets a voicemail saying his Social Security is suspended. LetterHelp tells him it's a scam.
• Your dad gets a letter about a doctor's appointment. One tap, and his phone reminds him the day before.
• Your aunt reads only Spanish, but the electric bill is in English. LetterHelp explains it in Spanish and reads it out loud.
You still get to help, but they don't have to wait for you.

HOW IT WORKS
Take a photo of any letter, bill or notice, or share a text, email or voicemail with it. In seconds, LetterHelp tells you in simple words:
• What it is: "This is your electric bill from Sunshine Electric."
• How urgent it is, with clear color labels: Not urgent, Do this soon, or Urgent.
• What to do: "Pay $84.20 by December 3."
• If it might be a scam: warnings about fake bills, fake delivery texts and other tricks.
Then press "Listen" and LetterHelp reads it out loud, slowly and clearly.

WHO IT'S FOR
• Parents and grandparents who find letters confusing
• People who speak little English, or have trouble reading small print
• Adult children and caregivers who want their loved ones to feel more independent

BUILT TO BE SIMPLE
Two big buttons: Take a photo and Listen. No accounts, no menus to learn. A family member picks the language once, and that's it.

YOUR LANGUAGE
English, Español, Kreyòl ayisyen, Русский, 中文, Tiếng Việt, Português, Français, 한국어, Tagalog, العربية and about 100 more. LetterHelp can also explain letters written in other languages.

NEVER MISS A DATE
Doctor's appointment or bill due date? One tap and your phone reminds you the day before and on the day.

KEEP EVERY LETTER
Every letter you read is saved on your phone in "My saved letters," so you can open it again anytime. Tap "Send or save" to keep it in Notes or send it to a family member.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos are never kept on our server. Saved letters stay only on your own phone. No ads. We never sell your information.

PRICING
Choose a plan:
• Just me: $4.99/month, for one person.
• Family: $7.99/month, for up to 6 people.
Each person can read up to 25 letters a day.

HOW THE FAMILY PLAN WORKS
One person buys the Family plan, and everyone in their Apple Family Sharing group gets LetterHelp on their own iPhone. Only the buyer is charged. It's perfect for adult children helping parents and grandparents: you pay, and they just download the app and use it.
• Family members must be in your Apple Family Sharing group (Settings → your name → Family).
• If it doesn't unlock right away on a family member's phone, they tap "Restore purchases" on the subscribe screen.

Subscriptions renew monthly unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings → your name → Subscriptions.

PLEASE NOTE
LetterHelp explains documents in plain language. It is not legal, medical or financial advice. Always check important details like amounts and dates on the original letter.

Terms: https://letterhelp.ghosty-nyc.workers.dev/terms
Privacy: https://letterhelp.ghosty-nyc.workers.dev/privacy

name: Libo: Fruit Hero Battle
description:
Jump out of the plane, open your parachute and land anywhere on a huge island shaped like Libya. 80 fruit heroes drop in. Only one is left standing.

BATTLE ROYALE FOR 80 PLAYERS
• Land in Tripoli, Benghazi, Misrata, Sabha, Kufra and many more towns
• Find guns, armour, juice and med kits in houses, fridges and airdrops
• Stay inside the safe zone - in the south it closes in as a sandstorm
• Heal in the desert oases of Waw an Namus and Gaberoun
• Race to the Treasure of Leptis Magna when it appears mid-match
• Drive cars, ride zip lines and bounce on jelly pads

REAL SHOOTER FEEL
• Rifles, SMGs, shotguns, snipers, LMGs and launchers, each with its own range and damage
• Knee slide, dive roll, climb ledges and wall jump
• Clear hit markers, aim assist you can tune, and a camera that follows you when you run
• Put a marker on the map, lock the run with AUTO RUN and follow the beacon

CITY WARS
• Pick your city once a week and every win counts for it
• Watch the weekly table and push your city to the top

THE CUP
• Finish in the top 15 of a full battle royale to reach the Sky Cup
• Defend your castle on a flying fruit island
• The best five meet in THE FINAL in the jelly stadium

MORE WAYS TO PLAY
• Castle War: 20 players fire cannons to knock down each other's castles
• Arena 2v2 and 4v4: short rounds, first team to 5 wins
• Play with friends using a room code, talk to your team with push-to-talk voice
• Training range to practise every move
• Touch controls or a game controller, with buttons you can move and remap

FRUIT HEROES
• Ninjas, knights, astronauts, pirates, footballers and many more
• Every look is shown before you buy it. No random boxes, ever
• Coins come from playing and buy most items. Gems are for special heroes and looks

Smooth on phones: choose Smooth, Balanced or HD graphics and 30, 60 or 90 FPS.
Your progress is saved in the cloud. Add an email to keep it on a new phone.

Questions or ideas? support@hivefixa.com

name: Libre BM6 Battery Monitor
description:
Libre BM6 is an open-source reader for a Bluetooth car-battery monitor. It has no account, no ads, and no tracking.

WHAT IT SHOWS
• Voltage, live
• Temperature in °C and °F
• State of charge
• Status: Normal, Low, or Charging
• A chart of voltage over the last few minutes

HOW IT WORKS
• Find a nearby battery monitor and save it with a name you choose.
• Save more than one battery monitor and switch between them.
• The app reconnects by itself when the battery monitor comes back in range.

PRIVACY
We treat you and your data the way we want to be treated. The app stores only the battery monitors you save. Nothing leaves your phone unless you choose to report a bug or ask for support.

OPEN SOURCE
The source code is available under the Mozilla Public License 2.0. Anyone can read it to check these statements.

PLEASE NOTE
Libre BM6 is an independent project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by the manufacturer of any battery monitor. Readings are for information only and may be inaccurate. Do not rely on this app for any safety decision, and never use it while driving.

name: Lid Turn
description:
Lid Turn is for the moment the jar is full and the lid still turns. You write what is inside, the month and day to open it, and your name and contact. Twist the lid shut. This iPhone counts the days from the day you twist to that month and day, and paints them on a lid picture with your name and contact. The picture stays on this iPhone for the person who takes the jar. You hand it over with the system share sheet.

The day count is only the number of days between the day you twist and the month and day you typed. Lid Turn does not say the food is safe, and it does not tell you what to cook. There is no account, no network, no sample jar, no recipe, and no reminder. The picture stays on this iPhone and is deleted with the app.

name: Lift Ride
description:
Lift Ride keeps one lift on this iPhone. Each ride is split into phases and scored against a limit set.

Move the steady-travel boundary and A95 updates. Repeated side jolts at the same height are marked as a rail joint.

There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: LiftRadar: Ski Resort Status
description:
LiftRadar shows the status of over 700 ski resorts in 12 European countries, straight from the resorts' own reports: which lifts and slopes are open, how much snow there is, and the avalanche danger.

EVERY RESORT AT A GLANCE
• Open lifts and slopes, and how many km of slopes are open
• Snow depth on the mountain and in the valley, fresh snow and the last snowfall
• Avalanche danger from the official avalanche services
• Charts of the season so far

MAP AND 3D
• All resorts on one map, with their areas, pistes and lifts
• Each resort in 3D: its mountains, every lift and every piste

YOUR RESORTS
• Keep your favourites at hand: they open even without a signal on the mountain
• Search, filter by country and status, and sort by open lifts, snow or fresh snow

FREE AND PRIVATE
• No account, no ads, no tracking
• The data is updated twice a day
• In English, German, French, Italian and Polish

Austria, Switzerland, France, Italy, Germany, Norway, Finland, Czechia, Spain, Poland, Slovenia and Slovakia.

LiftRadar isn't an official source: reports can be late or wrong, so check the resort's own website before you go, and read the full avalanche bulletin before going off-piste.

Lifts, pistes and ski areas: OpenSkiData (ODbL) and OpenStreetMap contributors.

name: Light Up My House
description:
See your house lit up before you buy a single strand, and know exactly what to buy.

Snap your house, trace the roofline, windows or door with one finger: the lights switch on instantly, on a realistic winter night. Compare styles on YOUR house, not on a catalog photo.

WHY PEOPLE LOVE IT
• The wow moment in under a minute: night falls, your house lights up
• Clean lines: your finger drawing is straightened automatically
• A real shopping list, not just a pretty picture
• A before/after video ready to share
• No subscription, no account, no ads

HOW MANY FEET? IT TELLS YOU
• Measures every line with the camera (even more precise with LiDAR), or from the height of your front door
• Margin of error always shown, honestly
• Automatic shopping list: light strands in store lengths, outdoor extension cords, gutter clips, splitters and timers
• Feet or meters, following your settings
• Reminder on install day, with your list

LIGHTS THAT LOOK REAL
• 20 styles: warm white, multicolor, icicles, retro C9, candy cane, café globes, rope light…
• 6 animations: steady, twinkle, chase, wave, color fade, sparkle
• Adjustable night simulation and a Before button to compare in one touch

SHARE THE BEFORE / AFTER
• A vertical video where night falls and your house lights up, line by line
• Perfect to win over the family… or impress the neighbors
• Photo export too

ALSO
• Works with a photo from your library
• Christmas countdown widget
• iPhone and iPad, VoiceOver and large text

FREE TO TRY
Draw, compare and share for free with 2 styles. One purchase unlocks all 20 styles, 6 animations, measurements, the shopping list and HD export without watermark. Family Sharing included.

PRIVACY FIRST
No account, no ads, no data collected. Your photos stay on your device.

Questions? https://schmittutility.fr/assistance/

name: Linelore
description:
Linelore is a one-line-a-day diary that stacks the years. Write a single short line about today, and the same date from up to four earlier years sits right beneath it. A year from now, today's line will be waiting for you.

ONE LINE, EVERY DAY
Each day holds one entry of up to 280 characters. It is small enough to keep doing on busy days and still enough to bring a whole afternoon back. Add one of six hand-drawn mood marks (Bright, Calm, Tender, Tired, Restless, Pensive) and up to three tags such as #walks, #family or #work.

FIVE YEARS ON ONE PAGE
The Today page shows the date you are on across five years: this year in magenta, earlier years in sky blue. Swipe or use the arrows to move between days and fill in a day you missed. When an earlier year already has a line for today, an On This Day card appears with a soft bell so you can reread it.

BROWSE YOUR WAY
- Months: a calendar where every day carries a tiny five-line stack, so you can see at a glance which years have a line for that date.
- Year strip: twelve rows of ticks, one per day, showing how many days you wrote, your moods for the year, and five years side by side.
- Tags: every tag with its count, the lines that carry it, and a search across all your words.

GENTLE HABITS
A streak counter shows how many days in a row you have written. Turn on an optional daily reminder at a time you choose. Linelore only asks for notification permission when you switch the reminder on yourself.

MADE TO FEEL LIKE YOURS
Three themes (Morning Paper, Lamplight and Seaglass), light pen and page sounds, and haptics, each with its own on/off switch. Navigation is a bookmark ribbon hanging from the top corner: tap it and choose Today, Months, Tags or Nook.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Sign in with email and password, or tap Write as guest and start right away with no account. Guests can save their diary to an email account later from the Nook without losing a line. Your diary syncs to your own private account and keeps working offline. There are no ads, no tracking and no analytics. You can delete your account and every line in it at any time from the Nook.

Linelore is free, with no subscriptions and no in-app purchases.

name: Lineup Lab: Fantasy Football
description:
Lineup Lab sets the fantasy lineup that wins, built on real NFL data. Plus The Daily Drive: a new NFL trivia game every day.

CONNECT IN 30 SECONDS
Link your Sleeper or ESPN league and Lineup Lab works on your real roster. No spreadsheets, no typing in players.

START/SIT
Who to play this week, with the matchup and weather behind every call.

WAIVERS
The pickups that actually beat your bench, ranked for your roster.

TRADES
See which offers raise your playoff odds before you hit accept.

LIVE SCORES
Follow every one of your players during every game.

BIG BOARD
Rest-of-season rankings at every position.

LEAGUE CHAT
Talk trash with your leaguemates in one place.

OUR OWN NUMBERS
Matchups are graded on what each defense allows to each position (pass defense for QBs, run defense for RBs), backtested on five seasons of real games. Not a copied points-allowed chart.

THE DAILY DRIVE
Seven NFL trivia plays a day, easiest first. Name a player who fits each prompt. Name the star and pick up a few yards. Name the guy nobody remembers and it's a 100-yard Highlight Reel TD.
• Daily streaks and a daily leaderboard
• Share your drive with friends, spoiler-free
• Free, and you can play without an account

Lineup Lab is not affiliated with the NFL, Sleeper or ESPN. Fantasy advice only; no betting.

name: LinkLattice: Clean Links
description:
Make URL changes you can review.

LinkLattice helps you inspect HTTP and HTTPS URL text, understand repeated query keys and create deliberate cleanup rules. It works on your text without visiting those links.

• Inspect the scheme, host, port, path, query entries and fragment.
• Keep original parameter order and raw percent encoding visible.
• Create literal key or prefix removal rules, keep the first or last repeated key, and remove fragments when you choose.
• Review each removed entry before copying a result.
• Organize link collections and save independent TXT, CSV or JSON exports.
• Reopen real output files and share them through the system share sheet.

A valid structure does not mean a website is available or safe. Removing parameters can change how a link works. Review every result before sharing. Plus signs are treated as literal plus signs, not spaces.

Support: asher11223366@gmail.com

name: Linkodium CRM
description:
Linkodium CRM: бесплатная CRM для заявок, чатов и почты компании. Заявки с сайта, сообщения из Telegram и MAX, чат на сайте, письма и звонки попадают в один список, а сотрудники разбирают их с телефона.

CRM бесплатная: тарифов и пробных периодов нет, банковская карта не нужна. В компании может работать до 100 сотрудников, число заявок и переписок не ограничено.

Заявки
• Единый список заявок со всех каналов: формы сайта, чаты, почта, телефония
• Статусы, ответственные, комментарии с файлами, архив и спам
• Повторное обращение добавляется в активную заявку клиента, а не плодит дубли
• Фильтры и поиск, выгрузка списка в XLSX, загрузка заявок из XLSX и CSV

Чаты с клиентами
• Боты Telegram и MAX вашей компании и чат-виджет на сайт в общем инбоксе
• Сотрудники отвечают от имени бота: личные аккаунты клиент не видит
• Файлы, фото и голосовые сообщения в обе стороны
• Заявка из первого сообщения, автоответы по расписанию

Почта
• Рабочие ящики по IMAP и SMTP: Яндекс, Gmail, Mail.ru и свои серверы
• Чтение и ответы из CRM, заявки из писем, переписка в карточке заявки

Звонки
• Звонки и записи разговоров из вашей АТС через API
• Заявка по входящему звонку, расшифровка разговора текстом в карточке

Команда и права
• Приглашение сотрудников по email, роли владельца, администратора и менеджера
• Права на заявки и каждое действие с ними: правка, статус, архив, выгрузка, импорт
• Режимы доступа к чатам: все видят всё или сотрудник видит свои чаты
• Несколько компаний в одном аккаунте

Уведомления
• Push-уведомления о новых заявках, назначениях, комментариях, сообщениях в чатах и письмах
• Нажатие на уведомление открывает нужную заявку или переписку
• Какие события присылать, каждый сотрудник настраивает сам

Для разработчиков
• HTTP API с ключами сотрудников: заявки с форм любого сайта, звонки, выгрузки
• Подключение ИИ-ассистентов по MCP с правами сотрудника

Удобно и безопасно
• Вход по коду из письма, без паролей: первый вход и есть регистрация
• Один аккаунт в приложении и в веб-кабинете crm.linkodium.com
• Данные хранятся на серверах в России, обмен только по HTTPS
• Вложения и записи звонков скачиваются только сотрудниками вашей компании

Микрофон нужен только для записи голосовых сообщений в чатах, уведомления — чтобы сообщать о новых заявках и сообщениях. Для работы нужно подключение к интернету.

Справка и вопросы: crm.linkodium.com/help

name: Liquid Chaos
description:
Enter Liquid Chaos, a creative mixing simulator where every experiment brings something new.

Take on unique production orders, discover colorful ingredients, follow recipes, and create a wide variety of virtual liquids and mixtures. From refreshing drinks and vibrant colors to cosmetics, automotive fluids, and unusual slimes, every category introduces new challenges and ways to experiment.

MIX. CREATE. TEST. IMPROVE.

Explore different laboratory stations, measure ingredients, control mixing intensity, and fine-tune your creations. Then send each mixture through quality control to see how accurately you completed the order.

FEATURES

Creative Mixing – Combine different ingredients and watch colors, textures, and liquid effects change in real time.

Varied Challenges – Complete production orders with unique recipes, target properties, and requirements.

Multiple Lab Categories – Explore beverages, colors, cosmetics, automotive mixtures, slime, and more.

Different Game Modes – Follow recipes, solve mystery mixing challenges, race against the clock, or experiment freely.

Quality Control – Evaluate ingredient accuracy, proportions, color, texture, and mixing performance.

Unlock New Equipment – Earn rewards, upgrade your laboratory, and discover new tools and ingredients.

Build Your Collection – Save your creations, track your best results, and revisit completed experiments.

Daily Experiments – Take on a fresh challenge and put your mixing skills to the test.

Every experiment is an opportunity to discover something unexpected. Can you create the perfect mixture?

Start mixing and let the chaos begin!

name: Lirra: Bookshelf & TBR Tracker
description:
Lirra is a cozy bookshelf for every book you own, read or want to read. Add your books, watch them line up on the shelf, and decorate it your way.

SEE IT BEFORE YOU PAY
• Your shelf is free, with unlimited books.
• No account, no ads, no subscription.
• Extra decor is a one-time purchase. You can preview it on your own shelf first.

YOUR BOOKSHELF
• Every book stands on the shelf, with a spine made from the colors of its cover.
• Show spines or covers, arrange your books by hand and keep a series together.
• Pick the wood and the wall, then add plants, candles and little objects.
• Share a picture of your shelf.

ADD A BOOK IN SECONDS
• Scan barcodes one after another.
• Search by title, author or ISBN.
• Can't find it? Add it by hand with your own photo of the cover.
• Bring your library from a Goodreads export file.

TBR, READING, FINISHED
• To read, reading, finished and did not finish.
• Paperback, ebook and audiobook.
• Quarter-star ratings, private notes and rereads.
• Change any start or finish date, any time.

YOUR READING YEAR
• Books and pages for every month and year.
• A calendar that fills with covers.
• A yearly goal, and a year-in-books card to share.

WIDGETS AND ICLOUD
• The book you are reading on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.
• iCloud keeps your library on all your devices.
• Export all your books to a file whenever you want.

LIRRA PLUS, A ONE-TIME PURCHASE
• Every decor theme and every object.
• The spine editor: colors and typefaces for each book.
• The bookshelf widget.
• Detailed stats.
• Your year card and shelf picture without the Lirra signature.

Your books stay on your devices and in your own iCloud. Lirra collects nothing about you.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: LitePhotoPaint
description:
PhotoPaint turns a photograph into a painting on your iPhone.

Choose a photo and apply one of five styles: oil painting, watercolor, pencil sketch, charcoal or pop art. Each style has its own set of controls — brush and surface for oil, wash and pigment for watercolor, line and graphite for pencil, and so on — fifty-four parameters in total, grouped the way you would reach for them.

Everything is rendered on your device with Core Image and custom Metal shaders. There is no account and no upload. Your photos never leave the phone.

Hold the canvas to compare against the original. Switch styles freely; every style you touch keeps its own settings. Put a piece down, open another, come back later — the original photo and your adjustments are saved together so nothing is a dead end.

Export as JPEG, HEIC or PNG at a size and quality you choose. Save to Photos or share from the sheet. Preview resolution, auto-save and haptics are configurable in Settings.

Requires iOS 15 or later.

name: Little Timer
description:
A clock for your desk. Timers for everyday life. A beat to practise with.

Little Timer brings a readable clock, countdown timers, alarms, stopwatch and metronome together in one calm, practical app.

MAKE YOUR CLOCK AT HOME
Use a large portrait clock with favourite timer controls, or turn your phone sideways for a minimal clock. Swipe between clock styles and available backgrounds. Choose a solid colour, photograph or illustration, and adjust dimming. Optional Keep Screen Awake applies only while the Clock is visible and the app is active.

TIMERS READY WHEN YOU NEED THEM
Start a basic countdown or use Quick Start. Save up to three timer presets for free and favourite them for easy access from the portrait Clock. Pause, resume or stop without deleting a saved timer. Run more than one timer when life needs it.

TIME AND TEMPO ON YOUR HOME SCREEN
The small Metronome widget shows BPM and lets you start or stop playback. The large Clock Dashboard shows the time, active timers and upcoming alarms. Timer controls and the Stopwatch are available inside the app.

ALARMS, STOPWATCH AND METRONOME
On iOS and iPadOS 26 or later, create native alarms with system permission, chosen schedules and snooze. Pause all Little Timer alarms with one master switch while keeping their individual settings. Use the stopwatch or practise with a metronome with an accented first beat. Older systems do not offer native wake-up alarms; ordinary countdown notifications follow iOS notification settings.

FREE TO USE, WITH OPTIONAL PLUS
Free includes unlimited basic countdown use, three saved timer presets, five saved alarms on supported systems, Botanical and Monochrome colour themes, and included clock styles, wallpapers and sounds.

Little Timer Plus is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. Add unlimited saved timers and alarms, multi-set timers, custom Quick Start buttons, more clock styles, wallpapers and sounds, four additional themes, polyrhythms and visual pulse. Prices are shown in your local App Store currency. Restore Purchases is available.

Availability of alerts and system controls depends on OS support and permissions.

name: Little Tracks
description:
Welcome to Little Tracks, a wooden toy train set you build and play with, made for little hands.

BUILD YOUR OWN RAILWAY
Drag track pieces from the tray and drop them on the mat: straights, curves, switches, a three-way switch, crossings, bridges, ramps, tunnels, stations, signals, level crossings and buffer stops. Tap a piece to turn it, tap a switch to change its way.

SET THE TRAINS RUNNING
Steam engines, diesels, an express and a little shunter, with coaches, tankers, logs, coal, cows and container wagons. Drop them on the track and off they go. Tap a train to stop it, tap again to turn it round. Trains wait for each other, stop at red signals and stop at the station.

A WHOLE LITTLE WORLD
Houses, a school, a church, a fire station, a lighthouse, trees and flowers, and lots of animals: cows, pigs, sheep, a horse, chickens, ducks, a bunny, a dog, a cat and a fox.

FOUR MAPS
• Meadow: a sunny green mat to fill with track
• Mountains: tunnels through a rocky ridge and a river to bridge
• Harbour: cranes load the container ship until it's full and sails away, while lorries bring more containers to the pile (in-app purchase)
• Freight: a big station with lots of switches, a container pile with its own crane, and a logistics centre where cranes lift containers onto lorries (in-app purchase)

UP TO FIVE GAMES
Every game is saved, so you can come back to your layouts. Turn and tilt the view, zoom in and out.

• No ads, no accounts, no data collected
• Harbour and Freight are optional one-time purchases, behind a grown-ups' check
• No reading needed

name: Little While – Time with Kids
description:
Put your phone face down, and we'll count the time you spend with your kids.

Ever answered your child while staring at your phone? Little While is a habit app that helps you put your phone down and be there for the little moments.

■ How it works
· When you're with your kids, tap "Stay a little while" in the app or on the Home Screen widget.
· Lay your phone face down and the count begins. The screen turns off while it's down.
· If something urgent comes up, go ahead and pick it up. The count pauses, and picks up again when you put the phone back down.
· When you're done, pick up the phone and tap Finish.

■ Little whiles add up
· See your time together today, this week and this month.
· Look back with a bar chart by day and a list of your sessions.
· Encouraging messages change as your time grows.

■ Badges
· Start with first-step badges like your first session, 30 minutes in a day and three days in a row.
· Weekly and monthly badges you can earn again and again keep the habit going.
· Set a weekly goal and see how much is left this week.
· Add your child's birthday (month and day only) to earn a birthday badge. It stays on your phone.

■ Widget
· Put the "Today's Ring" widget on your Home Screen. See today's time at a glance, and tap to start right away.

■ Share
· Turn today's, this week's or this month's time and badges into a card image and send it through Messages or social media, in feed (4:5) or story (9:16) size.
· Cards never include names, photos, location, session times or the birthday badge.

■ Your records stay on your phone
· No account, no server. Your records are stored only on this phone, and the app never sends them anywhere.
· Free, with no ads and no in-app purchases.

■ Good to know
· Sessions shorter than 1 minute are not saved.
· If the phone stays picked up for 30 minutes, the session ends on its own.
· Switching to another app or locking the screen pauses the count.
· Requires an iPhone with iOS 17 or later.

Privacy Policy: https://little-while.pages.dev/en/privacy/

name: LiveWall 实况壁纸
description:
选一段视频，做成锁屏上真的会动的实况壁纸。

很多视频直接设成壁纸，锁屏上只有一张静止的图，或者动起来一顿一顿。LiveWall 按 iPhone 锁屏播放实况的规则挑帧、定尺寸、配颜色，存进相册的就是能动的实况照片。

• 自动挑起点：从你选的封面往前，找到最远还顺的那一段；色条标出哪里会跳
• 锁屏预览：存之前先看锁屏上会怎么动
• 完整或铺满：横拍、竖拍的视频都能放进锁屏
• iPhone 自己拍的 HDR 视频也能用
• 在 iPhone Duo 上：合上、展开、横拿都能用，内屏和外屏共用一张壁纸
• 全部在手机上完成，不联网，不收集任何数据

设成壁纸：设置 › 墙纸 › 添加新墙纸 › 照片，选刚存的这张实况。

name: Loft by OVO
description:
Loft is the OVO Talent team's office, in your pocket.

Everyone has a desk on one pixel-art floor. Each desk shows what that teammate is doing right now: editing, running tests, thinking, just shipped, or waiting on a person. Teammates who need input glow amber and jump to the top of the list, so you can unblock them fast.

Chat
- Channels, direct messages and group messages
- Threads, reactions, mentions, edits and file sharing
- Search and unread counts
- Notifications when someone mentions or messages you

Huddles
- Walk your character into a room to start or join a voice huddle
- Turn on your camera or share your screen
- Knock on a teammate's desk to call them over
- Huddle notes saved to the channel

Catch up
- Ask Loft what you missed in a channel, thread or huddle
- Pause notifications when you clock out

Safe for work: report any message to an OVO admin, or block a teammate so you no longer see their messages.

Private by design: only one status word ever leaves a teammate's computer. Never prompts, code, files or screen.

Loft is for invited OVO teammates. Sign in with your OVO Google account or open your invite link once. Without one, tap See the demo floor to look around a made-up team.

name: LokalB
description:
Your usual coffee. Fresh bread from the bakery. Lunch around the corner. With LokalB, collect stamps at your favorite local places and keep all your stamp cards in one free app — at home and when you travel.

A full card means a reward, like a free coffee. Enjoy it yourself or give it to a friend. Your choice.

COLLECT STAMPS AS YOU GO
• Scan the QR code at the register or on the poster in the shop to get your stamp right away.
• No code to scan? Show your own code using 'Mijn QR-code' (My QR code).
• Use the same card at every location of the same business.
• Keep your card in Apple Wallet too. No more paper cards.

DISCOVER YOUR NEIGHBORHOOD
Find offers and campaigns from local cafés, bakeries, lunch spots, and hair salons that use LokalB in Ontdek (Discover). Get personal treats too, like a birthday offer.

The more people join in, the more offers local businesses launch. Businesses see how many people nearby want to collect stamps with them and send offers to their regular and returning customers. Each place has a crown for its most loyal customer.

A NEW CITY, A WARM WELCOME
Planning a day trip or a city getaway? Use Reizen (Travel) to add places in that city to your list before you go. Those places can send you a welcome offer, so a treat can be waiting when you arrive. One app for local spots at home and abroad.

GIVE A FRIEND SOMETHING NICE
Add friends, see them in the app, and give a full card or reward as a gift. Your full card can become a fun surprise for someone else.

FREE, WITH NO ADS
LokalB is free, with no ads and no paper cards. We never sell your data. A business only sees your first name and the stamps you collect there.

Sign in with your phone number and date of birth. No password needed.

Business owner? Visit lokalb.io.

name: Lonely Survival.io
description:
You wake up in a park tent. The city is overrun by zombies.
No home, no friends, no safe place. Scavenge, dodge and fight to survive!

■ Real survival
- Manage hunger, thirst, sleepiness and sickness
- No base! Hide and sleep in bushes, tents or buildings
- Night brings more zombies, and fiercer ones

■ Anything can be a weapon
- Kitchen knife, baseball bat, steel pipe, fire axe, pistol, bow, shotgun
- Every weapon has durability and limited ammo
- Auto-attack the nearest zombie, dash to dodge and control the distance

■ Explore multi-floor buildings
- Search dark buildings for drawers, fridges and lockers
- Each building shows how much you have searched

■ Find the key, escape to the next town
- Find the hidden bus key, fuel can or pass to board the escape bus
- Every town is tougher: police and hunter zombies, zombie dogs, rat swarms
- Roaming mini bosses and main bosses guarding the exit

■ Every night is different
- Midnight horde raids: hold out until dawn to claim the raid reward
- Supply airdrops fall from the sky, and a loyal dog is waiting to be rescued
- Chain your hits into combos for bonus dollars

■ New survival skills every day
- Survive a day and pick 1 of 3 roguelike skills

■ Death is not the end
- Earn dollars from kills and days survived for permanent upgrades
- Collect 152 cosmetics: outfits, hats, back items and pets, each with bonuses
- Your run is saved at the start of each day, so you can continue later

Become the last survivor today!

name: LookPin
description:
LookPin helps you scout places before you arrive—and remember where you left the car.

• Browse the map, search places, and check Nearby
• See a walking route drawn on the LookPin map
• Open Apple Look Around where Apple has coverage
• Save a scouting card with a tag, a short note, and one photo
• Tap Park Here to store your parking spot with the time, a note, and a photo

Look Around is Apple Maps immersive imagery. LookPin only opens it where coverage exists. When it isn’t available, you get an honest empty state—we don’t fake panoramas. Search, the walking route, Save, and Open in Maps still work.

Scouting cards, photos, Park Here, and Recents stay on your device. Nothing is uploaded for an account—there is no login.

name: Loom Check
description: Review a WIF draft before setting up your loom. See the drawdown, choose the number of shafts and treadles available, and check for capacity or setup issues. Export a printable PDF with the threading and tie-up plus treadling, or the lift plan for compatible drafts. Open the included twill to try the workflow without an account.

name: LoomDraft
description:
Design a four-shaft rising-shed weave and take a legible plan to the loom. Thread each warp end, choose its yarn color, and specify which shafts rise on every pick. Experiment with stripe orders, mirror your threading by hand, or duplicate a design before trying a new colorway.

The drawdown shows the actual visible yarn at every crossing. Preview up to eight repeats in each direction. Export a two-page PDF with the color drawdown and numbered threading and lift instructions. Includes two editable starting drafts.

One purchase. Projects stay on this device. No account or subscription.

name: LotGig Staff
description:
LotGig Staff adalah aplikasi resmi LotGig yang dirancang khusus untuk membantu penyelenggara acara, pengelola venue, dan petugas operasional dalam mengelola akses masuk pengunjung secara praktis dan efisien.

Mulai dari konser, festival, seminar, workshop, beach club, tempat wisata, hingga berbagai atraksi, kelola proses check-in langsung melalui perangkat Anda.

FITUR UTAMA

• QR Ticket Scanner
Pindai QR code pada e-ticket LotGig menggunakan kamera perangkat Anda.

• Real-Time Ticket Validation
Verifikasi keabsahan tiket secara langsung dan deteksi tiket yang sudah digunakan untuk mencegah penggunaan ganda.

• Event & Venue Check-In
Kelola akses masuk peserta acara maupun pengunjung venue dalam satu aplikasi.

• Attendee Management
Cari peserta, lihat informasi tiket, dan pantau status check-in pengunjung secara real-time.

• Staff Account Access
Masuk menggunakan akun staf yang diberikan oleh penyelenggara acara atau pengelola venue.

• Sound & Vibration Feedback
Dapatkan notifikasi suara dan getaran berdasarkan hasil pemindaian tiket.

• Network Status
Pantau status koneksi internet selama proses verifikasi tiket.

• Customer Support
Hubungi tim bantuan LotGig langsung melalui aplikasi.

LotGig Staff merupakan bagian dari ekosistem Event & Venue Ticketing LotGig.com. Aplikasi ini memerlukan akun staf yang telah diotorisasi serta koneksi internet untuk melakukan verifikasi tiket.

Scan. Verify. Welcome.

LotGig — Event ticketing, simplified.

name: LOYA OS
description:
The phone half of your own OS. Your chats keep running on your Mac; this app puts them on your iPhone.

When a chat needs you, your phone buzzes with its question. Press and hold the alert, tap Yes or type a reply, and confirm with Face ID. Your answer goes to that chat on your Mac without opening anything.

The lock-screen card shows how many chats are working and which ones are waiting on you, each with a running timer. On iPhones with the Dynamic Island, it sits up there too.

Open the app for the full view of your Mac: every chat, its files, and what it's doing right now.

It's named after you. Your Mac tells the app your name, so inside it says Danny OS, Maria OS, or whatever yours is.

Works with the OS app on your Mac, which comes with a Loya OS membership. Pair once by scanning the code your Mac shows. There's no account to make on the phone.

Your chats go between your phone and your own Mac. Alerts pass through our server on their way to Apple and are never stored.

name: LSN News
description:
LSN News is the official app for lsn.news, an Asia and Southeast Asia news outlet that publishes original reporting and aggregated stories. Aggregated stories credit and link to their original sources. South East Asia · Unfiltered.

Follow the day's news across Asia and Southeast Asia in a native iPhone reader.

• Today — a native list of the latest stories from lsn.news, with thumbnails, kicker and time-ago
• Regions — browse 12 Asia and Southeast Asia bureaus plus World
• Sections — Politics, Business, Technology, Sport, Culture, and Spotlight
• Saved — bookmark stories on your device, with no account, and read them offline
• Breaking news alerts — optional push notifications, with an on/off switch in Settings

Pull to refresh any feed. Share a story with the iOS share sheet, or long-press to save or share. A welcome tour walks you through the app on first launch. When you are offline, a native screen lets you retry, and saved articles remain available.

Stories open in a reader limited to lsn.news. Ads, trackers, comment forms and newsletter sign-ups are blocked. Links off the site open in an in-app Safari sheet. Settings includes About and the in-app privacy page.

LSN News is published by Altas Media Group LLC. There are no in-app purchases, no subscriptions, no login and no ads.

name: Lucky Sam: Ludo & Ladders
description:
Lucky Sam brings two family classics to your iPhone and iPad: Ludo and Snakes & Ladders. Play with friends anywhere in the world using a simple 6-digit room code, challenge the computer, or pass one device around the table.

LUDO
• 2 to 6 players: the classic board for up to 4, a big hexagon board for 5 or 6
• Classic rules: roll a 6 to start, capture opponents, safe stars and bonus rolls
• Smart computer players can fill any empty seat

SNAKES & LADDERS
• 2 to 4 players
• 8 boards, each with its own layout and style: Sunny Garden, Sweet Shop, Coral Reef, Wild Jungle, Frozen Peaks, Desert Temple, Galaxy Quest and Neon Arcade
• Easy, Medium and Hard boards

PLAY WITH FRIENDS ANYWHERE
• Create a room, choose how many players and share the 6-digit code
• Friends join from any country, with no region lock and no accounts
• A turn timer and autoplay keep the game moving, and you can rejoin if your connection drops
• React with emojis (there is no chat)

MADE TO FEEL GREAT
• Smooth animations, glossy pieces and satisfying sounds
• Looks great on iPhone and iPad
• Easy on your battery

Free. No ads. No purchases. No sign-up.

name: LuckyCourt
description:
LuckyCourt is a jigsaw puzzle set in a marble palace. Place the crown, diamond, emerald, rose, gift, and fountain in the niches so that every ruling is correct.

— 24 campaign halls along the corridor, from King Albrecht to Princess Fleur
— Daily hall with its own color and rhythm
— Live rulings: green is good, red requires a different spot
— Hints that help step by step
— Stars, treasury with relics, and a family portrait
— Warm Dutch voice, soft sounds, and vibration

Quiet game, no account, no purchases. Just you, the drawer, and the hall.

name: LuckyNote - Expense Tracker
description:
LuckyNote is a tiny expense tracker. Type an amount, tap a stamp — the note lands on your paper. No budgets, no bank links, no complexity.

• One-tap entry with a pocket calculator
• Monthly, quarterly and yearly stats
• A luck garden — every four notes grows a four-leaf clover, every logging day earns a star
• Mood notes after each save
• Widgets, Apple Watch and Siri shortcuts
• Papers, colors and app icons to make it yours
• Private iCloud sync
• Year in Review — your whole year on one page
• Export everything to CSV anytime

Free to track; Pro unlocks personalization, widgets and private sync.

Private by design — your notes stay on your device and your own iCloud. Nothing is collected, nothing is tracked.

Track your spending. Nothing more.

Privacy Policy: https://jwapp.top/jizhang/privacy
Terms of Use: https://jwapp.top/jizhang/terms

name: LuDock: Desk & Bedside Clock
description:
Turn the iPad on your desk or nightstand into a display worth looking at.

LuDock shows the time on eight carefully drawn faces and keeps the screen on while your iPad or iPhone charges. Every face comes in light, dark and night.

FACES
• Flip: split-flap cards that really flip
• Mono: big modern type
• Tube: glowing tube digits behind glass
• LCD: the pocket-calculator look
• LED: a 1980s alarm clock
• Dial: a quiet analog dial
• Matrix: amber dot matrix
• Daylight: a sky that follows the time of day

BESIDE THE CLOCK
• Calendar: this month and your next events
• Photo frame: shows the photos you pick
• Timers: three kitchen timers at a glance

MADE TO STAY ON
• Night mode turns everything deep red on black and dims the backlight, by hand or on a schedule. Your own brightness comes back when you leave the app.
• The picture shifts a few points every minute, so nothing stays in one place.
• Controls fade away when you leave the screen alone.

WIDGETS
The same faces as Home Screen and Lock Screen clock widgets.

GOOD TO KNOW
• iPadOS does not let an app open by itself. LuDock walks you through a one-time Shortcuts automation that opens it when you plug in.
• iPads with an LCD screen still give off a faint glow at the lowest brightness; OLED iPads go fully black.

PRIVACY
No account. Your photos and calendar are read on your device and never leave it.

FREE AND PRO
The free version includes the Flip and Mono faces, night mode with its schedule, and the widgets. It shows a banner ad on the menus and while you use the controls; the ad hides when the clock is left alone and in night mode. You can try any Pro face for 90 seconds.
LuDock Pro is a one-time purchase that removes ads and unlocks the six other faces, the calendar, the photo frame and the timers. No subscription.

name: LuMagnet: Logic Puzzle
description:
Tap a magnet. Every ball of its color slides to it. Clear the tray.

LuMagnet is a calm logic puzzle with one simple rule and a lot of depth. Each magnet sits on one edge of the tray and pulls only its own color. Balls slide until something blocks them, so the order you fire the magnets in is the whole puzzle. Each magnet has a limited number of pulls.

No timers. No lives. No video ads that interrupt you. It works offline and needs no account.

WHAT YOU GET
- 60 free levels in six chapters, each with a new idea
- A new daily puzzle every day
- Iron balls that follow every magnet
- Ice that stops a ball once, then shatters
- Twin magnets that switch color after every pull
- Bumpers that turn a rolling ball
- Two-tone balls that answer to both colors
- Unlimited undo, and hints that show the next good move
- Every level is checked by a solver, so every level can be solved
- English, Turkish, German, Spanish and French

FREE AND PRO
The free game shows one small banner at the bottom of the screen, below the board and the buttons. It never covers the puzzle and there are no full-screen ads.

LuMagnet Pro is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. It removes the banner and adds 120 extra levels in two Pro packs, every past daily puzzle, unlimited hints and three extra themes.

Made by Lu Apps.

name: LumaMeter: Film Light Meter
description:
LumaMeter turns your iPhone into a tactile, pocket-sized optical exposure, color temperature, and illuminance meter built for manual analog film cameras, cinematographers, and lighting setups.

KEY FEATURES
• Real-Time Matrix & 1° Spot Metering: Measure full-scene average EV100 or tap anywhere on the live viewfinder (with 3x optical zoom) to meter skin tones and shadows.
• Dual-Point Dynamic Range (ΔEV): Tap highlight (H) and shadow (S) regions to instantly check scene contrast against your film emulsion's latitude.
• Hardware Color Temperature & Lux Meter: Read 50K-stepped ambient Kelvin (CCT) with green/magenta Tint shift, plus switchable Lux and Foot-candles illuminance.
• Vintage Full-Stop & Fractional Ratchet Dials: Effortlessly toggle between 1 Stop (for classic mechanical lenses), 1/2 Stop, and 1/3 Stop increments with crisp haptic clicks and instant HOLD lock.
• 12 Film Reciprocity Curves & Darkroom Red Bulb Timer: Automatically calculates compensated exposure seconds when shutter speed exceeds 1s, complete with a pure black-and-red darkroom countdown timer.
• Offline Roll Logbook & Sunny 16 Mode: Save 36-frame exposure notes with reference thumbnails in your private app sandbox and export clean CSV sheets—100% offline with zero data collection.

LumaMeter Pro is available as a monthly or annual subscription (the annual plan includes a 3-day free trial for eligible new subscribers) or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://aimlrouter.com/lumameter/legal/privacy.html

name: LumiSub (Live Translation)
description:
LumiSub translates the subtitles and speech in games, films and series into your language, instantly. Translation runs on your device; your picture, sound and subtitles are never sent to any server.

START WITH ONE TAP
Pick a source and a language, tap Start. The translation appears on screen right away.

WHAT CAN IT TRANSLATE?
• Audio: Films, series, videos and anything spoken. It listens and turns speech into live subtitles.
• Camera: Point your device at the screen and frame the subtitles in the orange box. Works with any screen.
• Console (Wi‑Fi): Connect your console over your home network; no cable needed. Compatible with PS5.
• Xbox: The Xbox remote play page opens inside the app.
• Cable: Connect a console, computer or TV box to an iPad or Android tablet with an HDMI capture card.
• Demo: Try LumiSub right away with sample subtitles.

TWO TRANSLATION MODES
• Subtitles: The text in the area you choose is shown as clear subtitles.
• Full screen: Menus, quests and dialogue are translated in place, at their original size.

SHOW IT ON YOUR TV
The translation can also appear on a TV on the same Wi‑Fi. Your phone and TV talk only over your home network.

READ ALOUD
Have the translation read in your device's most natural voice; you choose the voice and speed.

MADE FOR YOU
Text size, text colour, background colour and opacity, 1–3 lines, bold text. See every change in a live preview.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no analytics. Picture, sound and subtitles never leave your device. Once a language pack is downloaded, translation works offline.

TV COMPATIBILITY
• Google TV / Android TV (Android 7.0+): with the LumiSub TV app on Google Play, the translation appears on top of the game or film. Works on Google TV / Android TV models from TCL, Sony, Philips, Hisense and others.
• Samsung and LG: TV app coming soon. For now, use the TV's web browser.
• Other TVs, tablets and computers: open the address shown on your phone in a web browser; the translation is shown full screen.

REQUIREMENTS
• iOS 18 or later. The Cable source works on iPad only (USB‑C).
• For Console, Xbox and TV, your device and the TV/console must be on the same Wi‑Fi.

PS5 is a trademark of Sony Interactive Entertainment Inc. Xbox is a trademark of Microsoft Corporation. LumiSub is not affiliated with Sony Interactive Entertainment or Microsoft.

name: Lumo: Mac Remote Desktop
description:
Your Mac is at home. You're not. Lumo puts it in your hand.

Lumo shows your Mac on your iPhone or iPad and lets you use it like you're sitting in front of it: tap, scroll, drag, type, and use every Mac shortcut. It's fast enough to feel local, up to 120 frames a second.

WHAT IT SOLVES
• Left a file on the Mac at home? Open it from anywhere.
• Mac mini with no screen? Lumo is its screen.
• Need the Mac while you're on the couch, in bed, or at the office? Pick up your phone.
• Tired of squinting at a laptop-size desktop on a phone? Lumo gives each device a Mac display of its own, shaped to fit it, so text is readable and nothing is cut off.

WHY LUMO
• A screen of its own: your iPhone or iPad gets its own Mac display, not a tiny copy of your monitor.
• Phone only: one tap turns your Mac's screens off and puts everything on your device, then puts every window back when you're done.
• Touch or trackpad: tap where you look, or move a pointer like a MacBook trackpad. Two-finger scroll, right-click, drag, pinch to zoom.
• A real Mac keyboard: Esc, Tab, arrows, Command, Option, Control, plus one-tap Spotlight, App Switcher and Mission Control.
• From anywhere: at home it finds your Mac by itself. Away, it connects over the internet or Tailscale.
• Built for iPhone Duo: laptop mode puts the Mac on top and a keyboard and trackpad below.
• Sound and clipboard: hear your Mac, and copy and paste between devices.
• Unlock your Mac remotely, with your saved password behind Face ID.
• Widgets, Siri and a Live Activity: connect in one tap, see your session on the Lock Screen.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Lumo connects your devices directly to each other, encrypted end to end. There's no account to make and no Lumo server in the middle. Pairing needs a code from your own Mac, on your own network.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Download the free Lumo app for your Mac (macOS 15 or later).
2. Allow two permissions when it asks.
3. Scan the code it shows with your iPhone or iPad. Done.

LUMO PRO
Try everything free for 7 days. Then $4.99 a month or $34.99 a year. Cancel anytime in Settings.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://commonerapps.com/lumo/privacy/

name: LumoLeap
description:
LumoLeap: Starbound Quest is an original offline puzzle adventure about a tiny magical rabbit and a sky full of floating stones.

Lumo does not bounce on their own. You choose each hop. Up, down, left, or right moves Lumo exactly one tile along a smooth arc. Plan a route across safe platforms, collect every required star seed, and step into the waking portal before the timer runs out.

The stones are more than a path:
- Glow tiles light up when Lumo lands.
- Crumble tiles disappear after Lumo leaves.
- Arrow tiles slide Lumo one extra step when the next stone is safe.
- Switch gems open or close linked magical gates.
- Spinning blades and shadow orbs follow readable patterns.
- Shields absorb one hit. Moon crystals raise your score. Time sparks add seconds.

Thirty handcrafted levels are split into Moonmeadow, Violet Arch, and Starbound Rift. Easy stages teach one idea at a time. Later stages combine gates, one-way cracks, arrows, and drifting orbs. Every level has a real solution. Clearing a level awards one to three stars from your seeds, leftover time, bonus crystals, and how direct your route was. Your best stars and scores are saved on the device.

Five places to explore:
- Celestial Home, where Lumo waits above the stones.
- Moon Map, a winding trail of thirty star islands.
- Star Chamber, the full puzzle board and one-hand direction pad.
- Star Journal, with real totals, region bars, and recent clears.
- Moonlight, with sound, music, haptics, reduced motion, a written guide, and a tiny playable lesson.

name: Lunar Leaf: Vietnam Calendar
description:
Lunar Leaf brings the tear-off calendar of every Vietnamese home (tờ lịch) to your phone, wherever you live. The app is in Vietnamese. Each morning, tear off a sheet: the solar and lunar date, the lucky hours of the day, a folk saying, and a Vietnamese folk painting chosen to go with it.

A SHEET A DAY
• Solar and lunar dates, with the can chi of the day, month and year
• Solar terms (tiết khí), the day's trực, lucky (hoàng đạo) or unlucky (hắc đạo) days, clashing ages and days to avoid
• Lucky hours of the day; tap the lunar date for the full almanac of the day
• Holidays, Tết, the first and fifteenth of each lunar month
• Swipe to tear off tomorrow's sheet or go back to yesterday, or jump to any date

FOLK SAYINGS AND FOLK PAINTINGS
• A ca dao, proverb or quote on every sheet; tap it to read what it means
• Sayings follow the occasion: Tết, the Hùng Kings' day, Mid-Autumn, Teachers' Day, the first day of each solar term
• Paintings follow the saying: a saying about buffaloes and rice fields gets a ploughing scene, one about mothers a lullaby, Mid-Autumn the moon and its lanterns
• Classic Đông Hồ and Hàng Trống woodblock prints (in the public domain), plus new paintings in the Đông Hồ manner: rice planting, the village market, the ferry landing, wrapping bánh chưng and more

A LIBRARY OF PROVERBS
• Nearly 8,000 Vietnamese ca dao, proverbs and idioms, including Sino-Vietnamese idioms
• 84 sayings of Laozi's Tao Te Ching, with the classical Chinese text and its Sino-Vietnamese reading
• Proverbs of 80 peoples of the world, translated into Vietnamese
• Search without diacritics, filter by topic and origin, save your favourites
• Read them page by page, like a book

FAMILY TREE AND MEMORIAL DAYS
• Record your family tree: grandparents, parents, siblings, children
• Dates of passing are kept in the lunar calendar, and memorial days (ngày giỗ) appear on the calendar every year

PRIVATE, NO ADS
• No ads, no account
• Your family tree and saved sayings stay on your device

name: LuShot: Redact Screenshots
description:
Hide personal data in a screenshot before you share it.

LuShot finds emails, phone numbers, card and account numbers, IBANs, names and addresses in a screenshot and covers them with solid blocks. It all happens on your iPhone or iPad: your images are never uploaded and never stored.

Numbers, emails and cards are caught reliably. Names can be missed — review before you share.

Tap any word to hide it or show it again, so the final say is always yours.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Solid covers, not blur: blurred small text can be recovered
• Cover any area by hand with the Box tool
• Arrows, text, highlighter and Apple Pencil drawing
• Device frame and backgrounds
• Join several screenshots into one long image
• Open your latest screenshot in one tap, paste from the clipboard, or drag an image in on iPad
• Works from the share sheet and from Shortcuts ("Hide Personal Data in Image")
• Optional: use your contacts, on device only, to find the names of people you know

PRIVACY
Text recognition runs on your device with Apple's own frameworks. LuShot has no account and keeps no copies of your images.

FREE AND PRO
The free version shows a banner ad, adds a small LuShot mark to exported images, joins up to 3 screenshots and includes 2 backgrounds. LuShot Pro is a one-time purchase that removes the ads and the mark, removes the limit and unlocks all backgrounds. No subscription.

name: Lwanj
description:
Tout kantik yo, Chants d'Espérance ak lòt liv, deja anndan aplikasyon an. Pa gen entènèt. Pa gen piblisite. Pa gen kont. Li ouvri sou kantik kote ou te rete a, menm san rezo.

• 1,725 kantik nan 22 liv, an Kreyòl ak an Fransè: Chants d'Espérance, Mélodies Joyeuses, La Voix du Réveil, Réveillons-Nous, Écho des Élus, Gloire à l'Agneau, Haïti Chante avec Radio Lumière, L'Ombre du Réveil, Les Cantiques de Béraca, ak lòt ankò.
• Ale nan: tape « CE 145 » epi kantik la parèt touswit, menm lè pastè a fèk anonse l.
• Chèche: jwenn yon kantik pa tit li, pa yon mo nan pawòl yo, oswa pa tèm.
• Menm kantik la, de lang: pase de Kreyòl a Fransè nan yon sèl tap.
• Make kantik ou renmen yo, mete koulè sou yon kouplè, ekri nòt.
• Pataje yon kouplè kòm bèl imaj sou WhatsApp oswa lòt kote.
• Twa aparans pou li: Jou, Nwit, Sepya. Chwazi gwosè tèks ou.
• Nou pa ranmase okenn enfòmasyon sou ou. Tout bagay rete sou telefòn ou.

Gratis. Pou tout legliz. Kantik yo deja la.

—

The Haitian hymn book, offline. Chants d'Espérance and other hymnals, already inside the app. No internet. No ads. No account. It opens on the hymn where you left off, even with no signal.

• 1,725 hymns from 22 books, in Haitian Creole and French: Chants d'Espérance, Mélodies Joyeuses, La Voix du Réveil, Réveillons-Nous, Écho des Élus, Gloire à l'Agneau, Haïti Chante avec Radio Lumière, L'Ombre du Réveil, Les Cantiques de Béraca, and more.
• Go to any hymn: type "CE 145" and it's on screen the moment it's announced.
• Search by title, by any word of the lyrics, or by theme.
• Same hymn, two languages: switch between Creole and French with one tap.
• Save favourite hymns, highlight a stanza, add notes.
• Share a stanza as a beautiful image on WhatsApp or anywhere.
• Three reading themes (Day, Night, Sepia) and adjustable text size.
• No data collected. Everything stays on your phone.

Free, for every church.

—

Le recueil de cantiques haïtien, hors ligne. Chants d'Espérance et d'autres recueils, déjà dans l'application. Pas d'internet. Pas de publicité. Pas de compte. Elle s'ouvre sur le cantique où vous vous êtes arrêté, même sans réseau.

• 1 725 cantiques dans 22 recueils, en créole et en français : Chants d'Espérance, Mélodies Joyeuses, La Voix du Réveil, Réveillons-Nous, Écho des Élus, Gloire à l'Agneau, Haïti Chante avec Radio Lumière, L'Ombre du Réveil, Les Cantiques de Béraca, et d'autres.
• Allez à n'importe quel cantique : tapez « CE 145 ».
• Recherchez par titre, par un mot des paroles ou par thème.
• Le même cantique, deux langues : passez du créole au français d'un geste.
• Gardez vos cantiques favoris, surlignez une strophe, ajoutez des notes.
• Partagez une strophe en image sur WhatsApp ou ailleurs.
• Trois thèmes de lecture et taille du texte réglable.
• Aucune donnée collectée. Tout reste sur votre téléphone.

Gratuit, pour toutes les églises.

name: M1 Eco POS
description:
M1 Eco POS turns an iPad into a dedicated till for your Odoo Point of Sale (Odoo 17 and 18), and prints straight to the receipt printer on your shop network.

Browsers can't talk to a network receipt printer from a secure Odoo page without certificate workarounds or an IoT box. M1 Eco POS solves that: receipts, kitchen tickets and cash-drawer kicks go directly from the tablet to the printer.

DIRECT PRINTING
- Works with the standard "Epson ePOS" printer type in Odoo - nothing to install on the server.
- Epson TM printers (TM-m30, TM-T20, TM-T82, TM-T88 and others with ePOS) over the shop network.
- Other brands (Xprinter, Rongta and similar) in ESC/POS mode on port 9100.
- The app finds an Epson printer again by its network (MAC) address when the router gives it a new IP.
- Find printer and Test print built in.

ONE APP, EVERY ROLE
- Main POS: takes payment and opens the cash drawer.
- Waiter tablet: takes orders for the kitchen; payment stays on the main POS; the drawer never opens.
- Customer kiosk: Odoo's self-order screen with no switch button and links kept inside (use Guided Access to lock the iPad to the app).

SEVERAL BUSINESSES OR BRANCHES
- Add as many tills as you need, each with its own Odoo login, role and printers.
- Switch with one tap from the corner button.

MADE FOR THE SHOP FLOOR
- Full screen, screen stays on, the Odoo login is remembered.
- Setup is protected by a PIN so staff can't change tills or printers.
- Bilingual-friendly: receipts print exactly as Odoo lays them out, including Arabic.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts with us, no analytics, no ads, no tracking. Your sales data goes only to your own Odoo.

Try it without an Odoo of your own: tap "Try the demo café" on the welcome screen.

M1 Eco POS is made by MomentumTech, Abu Dhabi and Dubai. Odoo is a trademark of Odoo S.A.; M1 Eco POS is an independent app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Odoo S.A. Epson is a trademark of Seiko Epson Corporation.

name: Maisonnée : Tâches du foyer
description:
Maisonnée aide les parents à partager équitablement les tâches de la maison, et donne envie aux enfants de participer.

POUR LES ADULTES
• Ajoutez une tâche en deux touches grâce aux modèles : poubelles, lessive, courses, lave-vaisselle, bain…
• Répétitions souples : tous les jours, certains jours de la semaine, toutes les deux semaines, chaque mois…
• Rotation automatique : les tâches alternent entre les adultes, sans tableau à tenir à jour.
• Écran « Aujourd'hui » : ce qui reste à faire, ce qui est en retard. Glissez pour valider ou reporter.
• Calendrier par semaine et par mois.
• Rappels à l'heure choisie, avec des heures de calme pour ne pas être dérangé.
• Synchronisation instantanée entre les téléphones du foyer.

POUR LES ENFANTS (sur le téléphone d'un parent)
• Un mode enfant verrouillé par un code parent : l'enfant ne voit que ses missions.
• Grandes images et lecture à voix haute, même pour ceux qui ne savent pas encore lire.
• Des étoiles à gagner, échangeables contre des récompenses que vous choisissez : l'histoire du soir, le dessert, une sortie au parc…
• Pikou, le petit hérisson, grandit au fil des missions accomplies.
• Un objectif commun pour toute la famille.

RESPECT DE VOTRE VIE PRIVÉE
• Pas de publicité, pas de pistage, pas d'achat intégré.
• Données hébergées dans l'Union européenne.
• L'enfant n'a pas de compte : un simple prénom et un emoji suffisent.
• Export et suppression de vos données à tout moment, directement dans l'app.

Maisonnée est conçue pour être utilisée par les parents et les adultes du foyer.

name: Makine Gönder
description:
MakineGönder, iş makinesi kiralamayı telefonuna taşır. Şantiyene en yakın makineyi haritada bul, saatlik fiyatını gör, tarih ve süreyi seç, kirala. Makine yola çıktığında konumunu ve tahmini varış süresini canlı izle.

HARİTADA KEŞFET
• Yakınındaki müsait makineleri harita üzerinde gör
• Kategoriye göre tek dokunuşla filtrele
• Yolda olan makineleri canlı olarak izle
• Sık kullandığın makineleri "Tekrar çağır" ile yeniden kirala

18 KATEGORİDE İŞ MAKİNESİ
Ekskavatör, mini ekskavatör, kazıcı yükleyici (bekoloder), lastikli yükleyici, dozer, greyder, silindir, asfalt finişeri, damperli kamyon, mobil vinç, teleskopik yükleyici, forklift, beton pompası, transmikser, mini yükleyici, delgi makinesi, makaslı platform ve lowbed.

NET FİYAT, SÜRPRİZ YOK
• Saatlik ve günlük ücretleri, minimum kiralama süresini ilan sayfasında gör
• Makine, operatör, nakliye ve KDV kalemlerini rezervasyon öncesinde tek tek incele
• Teknik özellikleri, müsaitlik takvimini ve kullanıcı değerlendirmelerini karşılaştır
• Şehre, fiyat aralığına, puana ve operatör dahil olma durumuna göre sırala ve filtrele

CANLI TAKİP
• Makine yola çıktığında haritada konumunu, kalan süreyi ve mesafeyi izle
• Kiralamanın her adımını takip et: onay, yolda, şantiyede, çalışıyor, tamamlandı
• Durum değişikliklerinde anlık bildirim al
• Operatörü uygulama içinden tek dokunuşla ara

TESLİM KODU VE TUTANAK
• Makine şantiyeye vardığında teslim kodunu göster ya da QR kodunu okut; çalışma saati o an başlar
• Başlangıç ve bitiş teslim tutanaklarını fotoğraflarıyla birlikte uygulamada sakla
• İş uzarsa kiralama süresini uygulamadan uzat

TEKLİF AL
Aradığın makineyi bulamadın mı? İhtiyacını yaz, uygun makinesi olan firmalar sana fiyat versin. Gelen teklifleri karşılaştır, sana uygun olanı seç.

FIRSATLAR
Boş dönüş fırsatlarını takip et, nakliye maliyetini düşür.

ÖDEME VE CÜZDAN
• Kredi kartı, havale/EFT, nakit, cari/fatura veya cüzdan bakiyesiyle öde
• Cüzdanına bakiye yükle, harcamalarını tek yerden gör
• İptal koşullarını ve varsa kesinti tutarını iptalden önce gör

KURUMSAL KULLANIM
• Kiralamaları kurumunun şantiyelerine göre takip et
• Ekip üyelerinin taleplerini kurum onayından geçir
• Tüm aktif ve geçmiş kiralamaları tek ekranda yönet

FİRMALAR VE OPERATÖRLER İÇİN
• Firma hesabıyla giriş yap, yönetim paneline uygulamadan ulaş
• Operatör hesabıyla sana atanan işleri gör, navigasyonu başlat, teslim kodunu doğrula ve tutanakları doldur
• Müsaitlik durumunu tek dokunuşla güncelle

DİĞER ÖZELLİKLER
• Beğendiğin makineleri ve firmaları favorilerine ekle
• Firma profillerini, puanlarını ve değerlendirmelerini incele
• Tamamlanan kiralamaları değerlendir
• Arkadaşlarını davet et

Konum izni, yakınındaki makineleri göstermek ve şantiye konumunu belirlemek için kullanılır. Kamera izni, teslim tutanağına fotoğraf eklemek ve teslim kodunun QR'ını okutmak içindir.

Daha fazla bilgi: makinegonder.com

name: Mạng Việc Làm
seller_name: ARB VIET NAM JOINT STOCK COMPANY
description:
Mạng Việc Làm giúp người đi làm biết mức lương thị trường và tìm việc phù hợp, dùng chung dữ liệu với mangvieclam.com.

TRA LƯƠNG
Xem mức lương phổ biến theo vị trí, ngành và tỉnh thành, lấy từ tin tuyển dụng thật. Biết mình đang ở đâu trước khi thương lượng lương.

TÍNH LƯƠNG GROSS – NET
Nhập lương Gross hoặc Net, số người phụ thuộc và vùng lương. Ứng dụng tính bảo hiểm xã hội, bảo hiểm y tế, bảo hiểm thất nghiệp, thuế thu nhập cá nhân và số thực nhận.

TÌM VIỆC THEO NGÀNH, THEO TỈNH
Lọc tin tuyển dụng theo tỉnh thành và mức lương. Mỗi tin ghi rõ mức lương, hình thức làm việc, yêu cầu kinh nghiệm và địa chỉ làm việc.

HỒ SƠ ỨNG VIÊN
Tạo hồ sơ một lần, đính kèm CV, dùng lại cho mọi lần ứng tuyển. Ứng dụng gợi ý việc phù hợp với hồ sơ và cho biết nhà tuyển dụng đã xem đơn hay chưa.

LƯU TIN
Bấm Lưu để giữ tin trên điện thoại, xem lại được cả khi mất mạng.

ĐĂNG TIN TUYỂN DỤNG BẰNG CÁCH DÁN BÀI
Nhà tuyển dụng dán nội dung đã soạn sẵn. Ứng dụng tự tách vị trí, nơi làm việc, mức lương, hình thức thành từng ô để xem lại rồi đăng. Mỗi tài khoản có 3 tin miễn phí mỗi tháng.

AN TOÀN
Mỗi tin có nút Báo tin để báo tin sai hoặc có dấu hiệu lừa đảo; ban quản trị xem trong 24 giờ.

Một tài khoản dùng chung cho Mạng Việc Làm, Nhà Đất Số và Xe Việt. Xoá tài khoản ngay trong ứng dụng.

name: Map Guesser Game
description:
How well do you really know the world? MapGuesser turns geography into a game you'll want to play every day.

DRAW ANY COUNTRY
Trace a country's outline from memory with your finger, then watch your drawing morph onto the real border. You get an instant accuracy score, up to three stars and points. Try the whole world, or the states, provinces and regions of 49 countries.

10 QUIZ MODES
• Place the capital: drop a pin where you think the capital is. The closer you get, the more you score.
• Place the city: find major cities on the map.
• Find the country: tap the right country on the world map.
• Which country?: pick the right answer from four choices.
• Type the name: name the highlighted country yourself.
• Flags: match each flag to its country.
• Find the feature: rivers, straits and seas.
• Tap the members: find every member of the EU, NATO, ASEAN, OPEC and more.
• Select the state: tap the right state, province or region.
• Name the state: type the region's name.

DAILY CHALLENGE
A Daily Quiz and a Daily Draw every day, the same for everyone. Play each day to build your streak.

LEVEL UP
Earn stars, coins and XP every game. Climb the levels, beat your best score and follow your progress in your stats.

PLAYS OFFLINE
Every map is built into the app, so you can play on a plane, on the subway or anywhere without a connection.

MADE FOR EVERYONE
• Four difficulty levels, from Easy to Expert.
• Available in 14 languages.
• Light and dark themes.
• Smooth maps you can pan and zoom, with haptics and sound.

MapGuesser is free to play with ads. A one-time purchase removes all ads.

name: Mapvello: Land Area Measure
description:
Mapvello turns a satellite map into a measuring tape and a materials calculator.

MEASURE IN SECONDS
• Tap the corners of a yard, field, driveway or lot on Apple satellite maps
• Drag any corner to fine-tune it, add points on a side, undo and redo
• See area, perimeter and every side length as you go
• Distance, circle and marker tools for fence runs, ponds and pins
• Add several areas to one job and subtract cut-outs like pools or patios
• Search an address or paste coordinates to jump straight to a property
• Acres, hectares, square feet, square meters and more. Switch any time

PLAN THE MATERIALS
• Mulch, gravel, road base, topsoil, concrete, sod, seed, fertilizer, erosion blankets, pavers, fence posts and rails, string lights and edging, and per-visit services like mowing or snow
• Depth, extra allowance and compaction are built in
• Add your own rates to get a total with labor, discount and tax

DESCRIBE IT, MAPVELLO PLANS IT
• Type something like "3 inches of mulch with 10% extra and sod at $4 a roll" and get a ready-to-edit list of materials
• Draft a short scope of work for your estimate in one tap
• Without a connection, a built-in planner still works offline
• Quantities are always calculated by Mapvello from your outline, never guessed by the AI

SHARE A CLEAR ESTIMATE
• Create a PDF with an outline sketch, side lengths, materials, quantities and totals
• Add your business name and client
• Export GeoJSON, KML, GPX or CSV for other mapping tools

NO ACCOUNT, NO LIMITS
• Every feature is free. No account, no ads, no tracking
• Your jobs are saved on your device
• Location is used only when you tap Locate or start a walk

Results are estimates for planning, based on the points you place and on map imagery. They are not a legal survey. For boundaries, sales or permits, use a licensed surveyor.

Privacy Policy: https://avengerstudio.com/privacy-policy?app=mapvello
Terms of Use: https://avengerstudio.com/terms-of-use?app=mapvello

name: Marbat Horse Market
description:
Marbat is the horse market for the Gulf. Owners list horses for sale, buyers browse and contact them directly.

• Three categories: Jumping, Racing and Beauty
• Every horse shows its price – no "price on request"
