• Filter by country and by sex: mare, gelding, stallion, filly, colt
• Photos and video for every listing
• Contact sellers by WhatsApp, phone or email
• Kuwait, Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar and Bahrain

Selling takes minutes: add photos, a short video, the details and your price.

Always see the horse, have it vetted and check its papers before you pay.

name: Margin - Classic Reading
description:
Margin is a calm place to build a daily reading habit with the great public domain classics.

DAILY GOAL, QUIET TIMER
Choose 15, 30, 45 or 60 minutes, or set your own. Time counts only while you are reading: it pauses after two minutes without a scroll or tap, and whenever you leave the app. When you reach your goal there is no pop-up, just a hairline bar that fills and a single soft haptic. Keep reading as long as you like.

A LINE OR TWO WHEN YOU CLOSE THE BOOK
After meeting your goal, closing the book invites a short reflection of up to 160 characters. Save it or skip it; either way the day is marked on your calendar.

READ AGAIN, COMPARE YOUR THOUGHTS
Finish a book and start a second read-through. Earlier notes are kept, and Compare Thoughts lays your first-read and second-read notes on the same chapter side by side.

TEN PUBLIC DOMAIN CLASSICS ON THREE SHELVES
Scripture & Wisdom: the Bible (Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, John), the Dhammapada, the Tao Te Ching
Philosophy & Strategy: Meditations, Pensées, Thus Spoke Zarathustra, The Prince
Classic Literature: Paradise Lost, Crime and Punishment, The Metamorphosis
Each is divided into readings of about ten minutes.

A READER LIKE PAPER
Paper, white and dark themes with adjustable type.

THREE LANGUAGES
English, 한국어 and 繁體中文. Switch in the app and both the interface and the books change.

No account, no ads, no subscription. Everything stays on your device.

name: MarginStack
description:
Turn a chain of dimensions into a clear worst-case interval with MarginStack. Enter your own nominal sizes, asymmetric deviations and addition or subtraction directions, then follow the calculation from each term to the complete result.

• Create dimension chains in millimeters or inches.
• Enter up to 40 signed terms with independent minus and plus deviations.
• See minimum, nominal, maximum and interval width.
• Compare the complete interval with target limits you enter.
• Review each term’s contribution and compare two or three scenarios in millimeters.
• Preserve fixed calculation reports and share genuine PDF or CSV files.

Calculations use decimal values and deterministic one-dimensional worst-case sums. MarginStack does not supply industry standards, statistical probabilities, professional certification or safety approval. Core calculations work offline.

name: Marinobus Urbano
description:
Viaggia con Marinobus Urbano, scarica subito l'app!
Questa app ti permette di cercare ed acquistare le soluzioni di viaggio, di visualizzare i tuoi biglietti, di visualizzare il QRCode del biglietto per la validazione a bordo, di effettuare le operazioni di annullamento e cambio data sui tuoi biglietti e di ricercare le fermate intorno a te!

name: Mashal Supermarket
description:
Mash'al Supermarket is the official free loyalty app for Mash'al Supermarket customers.

Collect cashback on every purchase and use your bonuses for future shopping. Your discount card is always with you — just show the QR code at the checkout.

Features:
• Digital discount card with QR code for fast checkout
• Cashback balance and bonus history
• Purchase statistics for the month and quarter
• Promotions and discounts of Mash'al Supermarket
• Link an existing plastic card or create a new virtual card
• Push notifications about bonuses and offers
• Uzbek, Russian and English languages

Sign in with your phone number — no passwords needed.

name: Masque: Imposter Game
description:
Everyone knows the secret word, except one player: the impostor. Can your crew find them before they blend in?

HOW IT WORKS
Pass one phone around. Each player presses and holds a card to see their secret role in private. Then take turns giving one clue about the word: not too obvious, not too vague. Vote, then rip the mask off. The impostor wins by escaping, or by guessing the word.

MADE FOR GAME NIGHT
• 13 categories: places, movies, food, games, sports, world landmarks, pop culture, office life, animals, family, holidays and night out
• Twist cards that change a round: opposite day, whisper mode, speed round and more
• Dramatic reveals, with a mask-ripping unmasking
• 1 to 3 impostors, timer per turn, clue rounds you choose
• Session scoreboard with awards and a shareable results picture
• 3 to 10 players, no accounts, no ads, works offline

MASQUE PRO
• Every category, now and in the future
• Up to 10 players (free: 5)
• 7 exclusive masks with a gold aura and a fancy name

Free forever: 2 categories, up to 5 players and the full game.
Masque PRO is an auto-renewing subscription: $14.99 per year or $3.99 per month (prices may vary by country). Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID settings. Categories can also be bought one at a time.
Terms of Use: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1toA0CEAc8Y0ZnX9LH6dPdotQgzuaLpmLAtqfI6D2L14/view
Privacy Policy: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1_2e-49SyMQwWpzmqg2rViay0DgdLe9btLcRSmvBSwDs/view

name: Materiality Assessment
description:
Find your material topics and defend them.

Materiality Assessment walks you through a double materiality assessment in 6 guided steps, aligned to ESRS and built for CSRD sustainability reporting. No blank spreadsheet, no scattered surveys, no matrix drawn by hand.

THE 6 STEPS
1. Context & Scope: company, industry, countries, size, business model and boundaries, plus starter impacts, risks and opportunities (IROs).
2. IRO Identification: import topics from ESRS and SASB-style sector packs, or add your own. A built-in helper drafts a topic description from its title so you can edit it.
3. Stakeholder Input: build a panel of internal and external stakeholders (executives, employees, suppliers, customers, investors, NGOs) and record their ratings on both lenses.
4. Dual-Lens Scoring: impact materiality (scale, scope, irremediable character, likelihood) and financial materiality (magnitude, likelihood), averaged across stakeholders, with thresholds you set.
5. Matrix & Thresholds: the double materiality matrix is plotted for you. Topics past either cutoff are flagged Material; filter by stakeholder group, time horizon and value-chain stage.
6. Validation & Reporting: leadership, sustainability-lead and auditor sign-off, peer benchmark notes, and a full audit trail of every decision.

START FROM YOUR SECTOR
Eight sector packs (manufacturing, financial services, technology, agriculture & food, energy & utilities, healthcare, retail & consumer goods, construction & real estate) explain why each topic matters and which lens drives it. Import a sector into your assessment in one tap.

EXPORTS FOR YOUR REPORT
One tap each: a printable HTML report (print to PDF), the IRO register, survey responses, an ESRS datapoint mapping table and the audit log as CSV, ready for your sustainability report and for assurance.

TRY IT IN SECONDS
A fictional sample company, Aurora Precision Manufacturing, is loaded on first launch so you can see every step filled in. Tap New assessment to start your own.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no sign-in, no ads, no tracking. Your assessments are stored only on your device and never sent to a server.

WHO IT IS FOR
Sustainability and ESG managers, consultants, finance and compliance leads, internal auditors and students of sustainability reporting who want a structured, evidence-based materiality assessment without an enterprise suite.

An assessment tool, not advice. You set the thresholds and make the judgement; the app keeps the evidence. Topic summaries are for assessment purposes and do not replace the official ESRS, SASB or ISSB standards or professional advice.

name: Materials: Paint & Tile
description:
Work out how much material to buy for painting and covering surfaces, in seconds and offline.

PAINT
• Walls by length × height or direct area, with a room helper (4 walls + optional ceiling).
• Deduct doors and windows from their own wall.
• Set coats, the label's spread rate and a margin: get liters and containers to buy, surplus and cost.

CERAMIC & PORCELAIN TILE
• Tile size in in, ft, cm, mm or m.
• Pieces needed, boxes, coverage purchased and surplus, with waste always visible.

FLOORING BY THE BOX
• Uses the coverage stated on the box (laminate, vinyl, floating floors).

CLEAR RESULTS
• “Estimated purchase: 6 boxes”, followed by area, surplus and cost.
• Step-by-step formula with the data you used.
• Exact decimal math: purchases are rounded up only, and only once.
• m² with the ft² equivalent when you use imperial units.

PROJECTS (1 FREE)
• Organize rooms and material lines, with one currency per project.
• Job details (address, client, site manager) and cost per room.
• Shopping list for the store: tick off what you bought and send the order via WhatsApp.
• Free result PDF with measurements and job details.
• JSON backup with an integrity check.

PRO — ONE-TIME PURCHASE
• Unlimited projects, rooms and lines.
• Consolidated shopping list: adds compatible materials and rounds once (1.2 + 1.2 boxes → 3, not 4).
• Project PDF report for your client and an Excel spreadsheet with details and totals.
• Shopping list as PDF and CSV.
• Full history.

No ads, no account, no data collected. You enter spread rates and prices. This is a purchase estimate — not a certified measurement or a substitute for the manufacturer's instructions.

name: Math Ninja Education
description: This App is meant for learners enrolled at Math Ninja and Instructors of Math Ninja. On this App instructors can conduct live sessions and learners can join them. Instructors can also add content and share that with learners. Additionally, instructors can create and conduct tests and quizzes which can be attempted by learners.

name: Maugate
description:
Tap and the ball switches lanes. Pass every gate on its open side. That is the whole game, and it gets a little faster with every gate.

Pass a gate by a hair and the points double. Keep doing it and they climb to ×3, then ×4.

Now and then a rainbow arch crosses the road. Roll under it and for five seconds you smash every gate and wall in your way, faster than ever, until the energy fades.

Roll through a paint curtain and your ball takes its color. A wall in that color cannot stop you: smash right through it. Painted gates work the same way, and breaking one pays extra.

The gates do not stay simple. Some slide into the other lane, some come in pairs, some charge at you, some arrive on a beat. A ring gate never hurts; go through the ring itself for a close call.

Every 40 points the world changes: paper, desert, forest, night, ice, candy, sea, volcano, autumn, city. Each one has its own sounds. The order is shuffled every run.

Gates follow one rule: the open side always shows up early enough to react. Thousands of runs are played on every build to test it.

Every run starts in the world you see on the home screen, with a different ball. Grab a color and your next run starts with it. The road ahead is always in view, gates lined up to the horizon.

Free, with ads between runs. One purchase removes them for good. Without internet, free runs are practice (no best score); the Offline Mode purchase saves them anyway. Watching an ad to continue after a crash is always optional. No account, no sign-in. Your best score stays on your device.

name: Maze Buddies: Kids Mazes
description:
Little explorers, meet the Maze Buddies! These small, round, squishy friends love an adventure, and they need your child's help to find the way through twisty mazes.

Pick a buddy, pick a world, pick a maze size, then swipe, drag or tap to explore. Every maze is brand new, so there is always another one to solve. Along the way your child collects three shiny stars and reaches a happy surprise at the end.

WHY PARENTS LIKE IT
- No ads and no pop-ups. The whole game is free and nothing is ever locked.
- Works fully offline: great for car rides, flights and waiting rooms.
- No accounts, no sign-in, no tracking.
- No reading needed to play: big picture buttons that small hands can tap.
- Grown-up settings behind a 2-second hold, so little fingers stay in the game.
- Pause instead of quit: a stray tap never throws a maze away.
- Gentle practice of planning, spatial thinking and problem solving, at your child's own pace.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- 9 lovable buddies to choose from, each with its own happy chirp.
- 7 colourful worlds: a flower garden, a sunny river, a little toy town, a coral reef, a candy land, outer space and a toy-block castle.
- 5 maze sizes, from a tiny 7 x 3 maze for first-time solvers to a giant 35 x 16 maze for confident explorers.
- Endless mazes: a fresh maze is made every time you play.
- Your child finds the way: swipe to move one square, drag to keep walking, or tap along a straight path.
- Little hints: up to 3 per maze, each showing just the next few steps.
- Big mazes open with a fly-over that shows where the goal is.
- Collect 3 stars, celebrate with confetti, and try to beat your best time.
- A short how-to-play animation the first time you open the game.
- Cheerful music and sounds you can switch on or off.

GROWN-UP SETTINGS
Choose which maze sizes your child can pick, add on-screen arrow buttons, switch on high-contrast mazes, and turn sound effects or music on or off.

Start with tiny mazes and move up when your child is ready. No countdowns, no lives to lose and nothing scary, just calm, happy exploring.

Grab a buddy and start your first maze today!

name: Mazeward: Roguelike TD
description:
Build the maze. Hold the gate.

Mazeward is a tower defense where the towers are the walls. Enemies take the shortest way from IN to OUT, and every tower you place bends their path. Build a longer road, keep them under fire, and pick a relic after every wave.

YOU DRAW THE ROAD
• An open board: build anywhere, and the path bends around your towers
• See the new path before you commit to a square
• Upgrade, sell and choose who each tower shoots first

A DIFFERENT RUN EVERY TIME
• 25 relics: keep one of three after each wave
• Forked lightning, bigger shells, interest on your gold, an extra rocket in every salvo
• 15 waves a run, about ten minutes, with a Warden on waves 5, 10 and 15

8 TOWERS, 10 ENEMIES
• Bolt, Frost, Mortar, Tesla, Lance, Venom, Flare and Rocket
• Shooters hit Swift enemies harder, Blasters hit Hordes harder, Hexers hit Heavies harder
• Menders heal, Hives hatch, Chargers speed up when hurt: the wave ahead shows what is coming

MORE TO COME BACK FOR
• 10 boards, each with five levels of heat once you have cleared it
• A Daily Challenge with every tower unlocked
• Endless mode
• A Workshop with five towers and four permanent perks to unlock with stars
• 14 feats, board records, and a Field Guide for everything you have met

FAIR BY DESIGN
No energy. No timers. No loot boxes. No banners and no ads between runs. Nothing you can buy makes a tower stronger.

Three optional rewards come with a video you choose to watch: a second chance when the gate falls, double stars at the end of a run, and a relic reroll.

MAZEWARD PLUS
One purchase, not a subscription: every reward without the ad. Once you own Plus, the game stops loading ads.

PRIVATE
No account and no analytics of our own. Your progress stays on your iPhone.

Terms of Use: https://saith96.github.io/mazeward-site/terms.html
Privacy Policy: https://saith96.github.io/mazeward-site/privacy.html

name: MeatyBox Halal Meat
description:
MeatyBox brings premium halal meat to your door at wholesale prices.

Shop beef, lamb, chicken, offal, ready-to-cook favorites and fresh fish, all processed in halal-certified facilities and sourced from farms in New Jersey and the surrounding region.

WHY MEATYBOX
- 100% halal, naturally raised meat
- Wholesale prices for every household, no business account needed
- Refrigerated local delivery in New Jersey on Tuesday, Wednesday and Friday
- Nationwide cold shipping in insulated boxes sized to your order
- Enter your ZIP code once and see the right price and delivery option for your address

IN THE APP
- Browse every category and add to cart in a tap
- Check out securely with Apple Pay and other payment methods
- Get notified about weekly deals and limited-time offers
- Order on WhatsApp or call us with one tap

Questions? Email info@meatybox.com or call or WhatsApp +1 551-422-9900.

name: Meeplume
description:
Meeplume helps you organize your board game collection, choose what to play, and remember every game night.

Keep owned games, wishlist items, borrowed and lent titles, favorites, and archived games in one personal library. Add player ranges, playing time, complexity, modes, tags, shelf locations, ratings, and your own notes. Search by title, tags, or notes, then filter and sort your shelf to find what you need.

Looking for your next game? Browse suggestions for two players, family nights, quick plays, co-op games, and games you have yet to try. Use Random Pick when you want a surprise.

Start a session from a game card or detail page. Add players, choose solo, cooperative, competitive, or team mode, and record a scenario or variant. Track time with pause and resume controls, adjust scores, undo the last score change, and select a winner when it makes sense. Add notes as you play; active sessions save automatically so you can return to the table later.

Save each session to your play history. Review scores, winners, duration, notes, and timeline events. Search past sessions by game, player, winner, scenario, or note, and share a text recap using the iOS share sheet.

Save recurring players and see their play counts, wins, and win rates. Review play counts, average durations, and recent winners for each game, and export a text summary of your collection.

A starter library of fictional games lets you explore right away. Add your own games whenever you are ready, or remove the sample games in settings.

Meeplume works offline with no account required. Games, players, sessions, and settings are stored on your device. Choose English or Simplified Chinese and use light, dark, or system appearance.

Your shelf. Your stories.

name: MeetingPricer
description: MeetingPricer räknar vad ett möte kostar utifrån antal personer i tre lönenivåer, minuter och timpriser du själv skriver in. Du ser totalsumma, persontimmar och belopp per person. Tröskeln visar bara skillnaden. Det är en lokal uppskattning, inte lön och inte en kalender.

name: Memory Space: Memory Keeper
description:
Rediscover your favorite moments and keep your photo library organized with simple and convenient tools.

Turn Photos into Memory Videos

Bring your favorite photos together and turn them into memorable videos. Create a collection of moments from a family gathering, a birthday celebration, a holiday, or a weekend trip. Revisit special occasions and enjoy your favorite memories through photos and videos.

Explore Photos Through a Timeline

Browse your photos in chronological order and revisit different stages of your life. Look back at last year's vacation, find pictures from a special celebration, or see how everyday moments have changed over time. The timeline makes it easier to explore and rediscover older photos.

Swipe to Manage Photos

Make photo organization simple with intuitive swipe gestures. Review pictures one by one, keep the ones you love, and remove unwanted photos. Quickly sort through screenshots, duplicate-looking pictures, old downloads, and photos you no longer need.

Keep Private Photos in a Private Space

Keep personal pictures separate from your regular photo library. Whether they are personal moments, private snapshots, or photos you prefer not to browse alongside other pictures, organize them in a dedicated private space.

Clean Up Your Photo Library

Over time, your photo library can become filled with screenshots, blurry pictures, and unwanted images. Find photos you no longer need and clean up your collection to make more room for new pictures and everyday memories.

Make Every Photo Easier to Enjoy

From revisiting family moments and remembering past travels to organizing everyday snapshots and keeping personal pictures private, enjoy practical tools that help you manage your photos in one place.

Keep the moments that matter and make room for new ones.

name: Meow Lab Books: Math & Python
description:
Meow Lab Books is a bookshelf of textbooks that teach math, data analysis, AI and physics together with Python. Think it through with paper and pen, then check it with Python. Lessons are cards with one idea each, and every chapter ends with a quiz.

14 BOOKS IN 4 SERIES • Math & Python (4 books): from integers, equations and functions to trigonometry, probability, sequences, calculus and vectors • Data Analysis (4 books): foundations of statistics, data analysis with pandas, machine learning, deep learning • Artificial Intelligence (2 books): the math behind AI systems; attention, Transformers and RAG • Physics (4 books): mechanics, oscillations and waves, electromagnetism, and the gateway to quantum mechanics

LEARN WITH CARDS AND MOVING FIGURES • More than 3,000 lesson cards: text, formulas, tables, figures and code, one idea at a time • More than 400 interactive figures: move a slider and the graph, wave or vector field changes on the spot • Key terms and key points on each card • More than 5,000 quiz questions, each with an explanation. After a wrong answer you can go back to the card it comes from

A PYTHON CONSOLE INSIDE THE APP • Open the code from a lesson in the console and run it, or type your own • numpy, sympy, matplotlib, pandas, scikit-learn, scipy and networkx are built in and work offline • Draw graphs right in the app • The limits of the console are listed under Help (code that needs PyTorch runs in Google Colab)

ALSO INCLUDED • Scientific calculator that keeps fractions and roots exact • Progress: your place in each lesson and your quiz results, chapter by chapter • Colab notebooks: files that run each book's code in Google Colab can be downloaded from https://chic.institute/app-file-downloads/ • Light and dark appearance

THREE LANGUAGES Read every book in Japanese, English or German, and switch at any time.

FREE AND PAID Chapter 1 of every book is free. The rest of a book is a one-time purchase, and a series bundle unlocks every book in that series, including volumes added later. There is no subscription. Purchases can be restored on another device.

PRIVACY No sign-up, no login, no ads. Your progress is stored only on your device and is never sent anywhere. Lessons, quizzes and the built-in Python work offline. A connection is used only for purchases and restores, and for Python libraries that are not built in.

Questions or problems? Write to info@chic.institute.

name: Merani
description:
Merani shows you how you ride. Put your iPhone in a mount on your motorcycle, tap Start, and ride. Afterwards, Merani takes you through every corner and every braking zone of the ride.

No extra hardware: Merani uses your iPhone's own motion sensors and GPS, and learns how your phone sits in its mount.

AFTER EVERY RIDE
• Max lean angle, left and right, and where on the map it happened
• Every corner: lean, speed, turn-in and when you got back on the gas
• Every braking zone: how hard, how long, and whether you trail-braked into the corner
• Wheelies: angle, duration and distance (phone on a firm mount)
• Tire lean view: where on the tire you were riding
• Replay the whole ride, or a single corner, with a bike that leans as you did
• The same corner across your rides, and your personal bests

HONEST NUMBERS
Merani checks its own work. The accuracy card compares independent estimates of your lean, and ride notes tell you when the phone moved in its mount or GPS dropped out, and what that affected.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
Rides are recorded and analyzed on your iPhone and stay there. No ads, no tracking, no analytics. An account is optional: you only need one to add friends and share rides with them. Before a ride is shared, places near its start and end and your privacy zones are removed on your iPhone.

TRY IT FIRST
No ride yet? Open a sample ride to see what Merani finds.

RIDE SAFELY
Merani is for reviewing rides afterwards. The recording screen is kept minimal, and the lock screen shows your ride without unlocking the phone. Don't touch your phone while riding, and ride within your limits and the law. Merani's stats are no reason to ride faster or lean further.

name: Merge Garden: Grow & Merge
description:
Merge Garden is a relaxing idle game: plant seeds, drag matching plants together and watch your garden grow.

HOW TO PLAY
Tap an empty plot to plant a seed from your seed bag. Drag a plant onto an identical one and they merge into the next stage: a seed becomes a sprout, a sprout a leafling, then a clover, a daisy, a tulip and on up to a Golden Blossom tree.

33 PLANTS TO DISCOVER
Three plant families with 11 stages each. Grow the Bloom family first, then unlock the Harvest family (beans, pumpkins, melons, fruit trees) and the Desert family (cacti, agave, saguaro and the Crystal Cactus). The plant guide shows what you've found and what's still hidden.

COINS, EVEN WHILE YOU'RE AWAY
Every grown plant earns coins. Close the app and your garden keeps earning at half speed for up to four hours, ready to collect when you come back.

GROW YOUR GARDEN
Spend coins on plants in the shop, unlock new plots behind the hedge, upgrade your seed bag and drag plants you don't need to the basket to sell them.

QUESTS AND DAILY REWARDS
Three quests at a time and a daily reward with a 7-day streak.

DECORATE
Add a picket fence, bird bath, paper lanterns, a lily pond, a windmill or a fountain (each one boosts your coins) and switch between Meadow, Autumn, Twilight and Blossom gardens.

NO SIGN-UP
No account, no email, no password. Just open the app and plant. Your progress stays on your device.

Merge Garden is free to play with ads. A one-time "Remove Ads" in-app purchase turns off the banner and the occasional between-break ads. Optional reward ads (a coin boost, a free rare seed, double offline coins) are always your choice.

name: Merge Worlds: Sky Islands
description:
Merge your way across a sky full of floating islands.

Tap, drag and merge three of a kind to make something better (five at once make two!): logs become planks, pebbles become arches, snowflakes become ice sculptures. Use what you make to raise buildings, clear the fog and open new islands.

MERGE
• Eight item chains, four tiers each: wood, stone, flowers, crystals, food, ice, wool and embers
• Chain your merges into combos, and join the weekly event for prizes
• A cosy 7 x 7 board where everything can be moved, merged or sold
• Friends on the order board ask for items and pay well

BUILD
• Four islands to open: green Greenhaven, sandy Sunny Cove, snowy Frost Peak and fiery Ember Isle
• Thirteen buildings to raise and upgrade, each earning coins while you are away
• Decorate with trees, snowmen, shells and more; turn and place them where you like

HATCH
• Befriend creatures and watch them wander your islands
• Put two in the nest to hatch a hybrid; ten hybrids to discover, and five rarer ones from pairs of hybrids
• Feed them to help them grow; the first five evolve into new forms
• A small chance of a rare colour with every egg
• Give each one a name

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Turn, tilt and zoom the world with one finger
• Portrait or landscape
• A daily gift that grows over seven days
• Quests, achievements, a level ladder with 20 levels, and a collection album
• A story to follow: help Elder Moss relight the four lights of the sky
• Plays offline; your progress is saved on your device

Merge Worlds is free to play. It offers optional in-app purchases and optional rewarded ads: you only ever see an ad when you choose to watch one for a reward.

name: Mergeroid: Planet Merge
description:
Launch planets into a gravity well from any direction and watch them tumble to the middle. When two of the same planet touch, they fuse into a bigger one. Asteroids become Moons, Moons become Mercury, and it keeps going through Earth, Saturn and Jupiter all the way to the Sun.

Drag around the ring to aim, let go to launch. That's the whole game, and it's very hard to put down.

• Aim from any angle. The pile grows in every direction, so every launch is a small puzzle.
• Set off chain reactions. Fuse quickly to build a combo of up to x8.
• Ten planets to discover, each with its own little face.
• Fuse two Suns for a SUPERNOVA that blasts the pile apart.
• Zap a planet that's in the way, Grow one to the next size, or Quake the whole pile to shake matches loose.
• Daily gift and three new missions every day.
• Plays offline. No account, no ads.

The run ends when the pile stays past the rim, so keep the middle tidy and think one planet ahead.

Every run is free. Optional gem packs buy boosters and let you continue a great run.

Terms: https://renaissanceapps.com/terms-conditions
Privacy: https://renaissanceapps.com/privacy-policy

name: MeskenPlus Yönetim
description:
MeskenPlus Yönetim is for the teams of buildings and residential complexes that use MeskenPlus: managers, accountants, block managers and field staff. With the same records as your web panel, you keep work moving while you are on site.

SUMMARY AND APPROVALS
• See the property's current state and what is waiting on one screen
• Approve expenses and payments from your phone

SERVICE REQUESTS
• See residents' requests, assign them and close them
• Open a request on a resident's behalf

COLLECTIONS AND DEBTS
• See what each unit owes and which payments are late
• Record payments received in person

FIELD WORK
• Enter meter readings even without a connection; they are sent once you are back online
• Start an expense by taking a photo of the invoice
• Complete compliance calendar tasks with evidence

ANNOUNCEMENTS AND PEOPLE
• Publish announcements and see who has read them
• Reach units and people quickly

NOTIFICATIONS
• Get notified about pending approvals, new requests and upcoming deadlines. No advertising notifications are sent.

Each user sees only the properties and actions they are authorised for. Subscription management is on the web panel. Personal data is processed in line with Türkiye's data protection law (KVKK).

name: MimiQ
description:
mimiQは、ギターやベースの耳コピを効率化する、耳コピ・採譜・練習支援アプリです。

手持ちの音源を読み込んで、聴き取りたいフレーズを繰り返し再生したり、ピッチを保ったまま速度を落として細かく確認したり、分かった音をその場でタブ譜やメモに記録できます。

・音源のインポートと管理、再生履歴からの呼び出し
・ピッチを維持したまま再生速度を変更（プリセット＋スライダー）
・再生速度に追従するクリック（BPM表示つき。原曲との音量バランスを調整して練習できます）
・A-Bリピートで気になるフレーズを繰り返し再生
・指の上下移動で感度を変えられる高精度シーク
・再生位置に紐づくメモ（シークバー上に表示、タップでジャンプ）
・6弦タブ譜メモ（単音・コード対応、コード名やコメントも記録）
・ローカルLLMによる実験的な採譜支援
・ボーカル分離・EQ調整
・曲ごとのチューニング記録（レギュラー／ドロップD・C／半音下げ・全音下げ／カスタム）

【作ったのは、耳コピするギタリスト本人】
mimiQは、ギターを弾く開発者自身が、自分の耳コピ練習のために作ったアプリです。クリックを聴きながら原曲との音量バランスを変えて練習するなど、実際の耳コピの流れに沿った使い勝手を大切にしています。

【ローカル完結】
音源は端末内で管理し、クラウドへアップロードしません。アカウント登録も不要です。

※ローカルLLMによる採譜支援は実験的な補助機能です。正確な自動採譜を保証するものではなく、最終的な音の判断はご自身の耳でお願いします。

name: Minesweeper by NOTI
description: 클래식 지뢰찾기를 깔끔한 화면으로 즐겨 보세요.- 초급: 9×9, 지뢰 10개- 중급: 16×16, 지뢰 40개- 깃발 표시와 기록- 인터넷 연결, 계정, 광고 없이 오프라인 플레이모든 안전한 칸을 열고 지뢰를 피해 보세요.피해 보세요.

name: Minglo.
description:
Minglo helps one host run a real get-together from the first plan to the last score.
Build the night before anyone arrives. Name the occasion, add people and portraits, seat them as individuals or teams, and line up the rounds. Uneven teams can still start. Choose a ready-made game, a question deck, or a challenge, or write your own rules and scoring. A private practice draw lets you try a question without writing a score.
On the night, Minglo keeps the current round in front of you. Draw the next question, run the countdown, pause and resume, skip, and award or remove points for a person or a team. A dispute can be ruled, replayed, or left unscored. Ending a round does not end the night. When the night is actually over, confirm the final result once.
Afterward, open the record of that night: the roster, the ranks, the score history, the photos, and the short voice notes. Listen back, pause, and resume a note. Copy the plan into a new night without bringing over old attendance or scores. Share a short written recap.
Pinning a photo, saving a night as a reusable plan, and importing a batch of questions spend embers.

name: Mini Penguin
description:
Name your tiny penguin, feed it, bathe it and tuck it into bed!

Mini Penguin is a cozy virtual pet game. Your penguin has four needs: food, cleanliness, energy and fun.

• Feed it in the kitchen – tap a snack and watch it drop right into its mouth
• Give it bubble baths in the bathroom
• Turn off the lamp in the attic bedroom and let it sleep
• Play Fish Catch in the playroom to earn coins
• Dress it up with bow ties, flowers, scarves, beanies, party hats and crowns
• Change its color: Midnight, Mint, Ice Blue, Cotton Candy, Gold and Lavender
• Watch it grow

Its needs keep changing even when the app is closed, and your penguin sends you a gentle reminder when it needs you – never spammy.

No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything is saved on your device.

Mini Penguin is free to play. Optional in-app purchases are available for coins and potions.

name: ministryLENS
description:
Share the moment. Care for the people.

ministryLENS helps church communications teams prepare photos on iPhone. Keep or remove face blurs, cover identifying details and preview a finished copy before saving.

• On-device face detection, without identity memory.
• Detected faces start blurred. Keep, remove or adjust each blur directly.
• Face-shaped blur, pixelation and solid covers, plus a brush for name tags and other details.
• Original, square, portrait, story and widescreen crops with manual positioning.
• An optional church logo stored on your device, with corner and size controls.
• A simple Edit → Preview & Save flow and optional original comparison.
• Prepare batches, save finished copies to Photos or share a ZIP of reviewed copies.
• New image copies without the original photo's location metadata.

Three photos per week are free. Unlimited Photos is an optional one-time in-app purchase, with no monthly subscription. Restore purchases from the app's upgrade screen.

This version does not estimate age. Detected faces start blurred; you decide which blurs to keep. Detection can miss faces, and blur does not guarantee anonymity. Check the finished photo and follow your ministry's permission and safeguarding policies.

Photo processing stays on your device. Originals remain unchanged. Your device may retrieve cloud-stored originals, saved copies may sync with iCloud Photos, and destinations you choose for sharing may upload the edited copy.

name: MirageWheel
description:
Every turn has a destination.

Guide a caravan around a luminous desert wheel, collecting amber, jade and silk for the merchants waiting at the gates. Every station is visible. Every move is yours to choose.

Travel one space to gather a useful good, or cross two spaces to save a turn. Watch your water, visit the wells and leave room in your hold for what comes next. A clever return route can turn a difficult delivery into a graceful journey.

THREE WAYS TO PLAN

• Caravan Journey: master 18 different circuits across three regions. Later routes introduce wells that refill only once and sandy landings that cost extra water.
• Night Bazaar: choose the order of three deals across six market challenges. Every contract has a deadline measured in moves. Plan around the urgent delivery before collecting the next cargo.
• Twin Caravan: coordinate A and B across six shared-supply routes. Each contract belongs to one caravan, cargo stays separate, and a well reached by either caravan restores water for both.

TOOLS FOR THOUGHTFUL PLAY

• Read an arrival preview before committing a move.
• Choose between a larger water reserve and extra cargo space.
• Undo a decision, retry a route or request guidance from the route planner.
• Learn with an illustrated field guide and a clear opening example.
• Earn caravan seals, collect regional relics and improve your personal records.
• Open the travel journal to review the supplies and arrival history of your fastest completed trip.
• Resume a saved route after leaving the app.

Every destination and cost is visible before you move. Deadlines advance when you travel, so take your time to find the route that keeps every promise.

name: Mission Alarm: Math Wake Up
description:
Solve a quick math problem to finish waking up.
Mission Alarm is for people who switch off the alarm on autopilot and wake up an hour later.
Stop the alarm without solving and it rings again a minute later, until you do.

TRY IT FIRST
Pick a wake time and your repeat days, then try the demo. Solve one problem and you'll see exactly how your alarm behaves before Mission Alarm asks to set alarms.

HOW THE ALARM WORKS
• Your alarm rings at the time you choose, even when the app is closed, through the iPhone's own alarm system.
• Tap Start Mission on the alarm to open the app straight to your math problem.
• You can always stop the alarm, but it rings again a minute later until you solve your mission.
• Solve it and the follow-up alarms stop. Turning the alarm off in the app stops them too.

FREE
• One repeating alarm
• The basic math mission

PREMIUM
• More alarms for workdays, weekends and naps
• Medium and hard math
• Memory mission: remember a short sequence of colored tiles and tap them back in order

Your alarms and settings stay on your iPhone. No account, no ads, no tracking.

Keep your volume up and test an alarm before you rely on it. Mission Alarm can't guarantee that you'll wake up.

Premium is an optional subscription: $2.99 per week with a 3-day free trial, or $14.99 per year. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase or when the free trial ends. It renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Cancel anytime in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://motleystudio.site/mission-alarm/terms
Apple's Standard License Agreement (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/mission-alarm/privacy

name: Mobil La Foa Fidélité
description:
Mobil La Foa Fidélité est la carte de fidélité numérique officielle de la station Mobil La Foa, en Nouvelle-Calédonie.

Pour chaque tranche de 5 000 F d’achat en station, présentez votre carte en caisse : un tampon est ajouté. Au bout de 10 tampons, un bon d’achat est créé pour vous, automatiquement.

VOTRE CARTE, TOUJOURS SOUS LA MAIN
• QR code et code-barres prêts à être scannés en caisse
• Luminosité de l’écran poussée au maximum quand vous présentez votre carte
• Carte disponible même sans réseau à la pompe, dès votre première connexion

VOS AVANTAGES
• Suivi de vos tampons, de vos achats et de vos bons d’achat
• Paliers Standard, Premium, Gold et Diamant : plus vous êtes fidèle, plus vos bons sont généreux
• Parrainage : invitez un proche, vous êtes récompensés tous les deux dès son premier plein de 5 000 F

LA STATION DANS VOTRE POCHE
• Promotions de la station
• Horaires, services et itinéraire vers la station dans Plans
• Notifications pour ne rater aucune offre, uniquement si vous les activez

DES JEUX POUR PATIENTER
Course, arcade, réflexion : des jeux gratuits aux couleurs de la station, sans publicité, sans achat et sans lot à gagner.

VOS DONNÉES
Aucune publicité, aucun traceur publicitaire. Vous modifiez vos informations ou supprimez votre compte à tout moment depuis l’application.

Application éditée par EazyWebNC pour la station Mobil La Foa (SARL TFPP). Mobil est une marque d’Exxon Mobil Corporation ou de ses sociétés affiliées.

name: Mobility Frotas
description:
O Mobility Frotas é o aplicativo oficial para motoristas e gestores de frotas corporativas realizarem a recarga de veículos elétricos com facilidade, agilidade e controle.

Integrado à infraestrutura de eletropostos da rede Mobility e parceiros credenciados, o aplicativo permite que sua empresa centralize o abastecimento elétrico de forma transparente e eficiente.

Recursos principais:

Início Ágil de Recarga
Inicie sessões de recarga em segundos lendo o QR Code do conector na estação ou aproximando a tag RFID corporativa cadastrada.

Mapa de Estações em Tempo Real
Localize eletropostos disponíveis, visualize tipos de plugues, potência (kW), status dos conectores e trace a rota até a estação mais próxima.

Veículos Corporativos Vinculados
Visualize com clareza o veículo corporativo sob sua responsabilidade (placa e modelo), garantindo a identificação e conformidade de cada recarga.

Acompanhamento ao Vivo
Monitore o andamento da carga em tempo real: porcentagem da bateria, potência entregue, energia acumulada (kWh) e tempo decorrido.

Faturamento Corporativo Centralizado
Sem necessidade de pagamentos individuais no app ou burocracia de reembolsos: o consumo é faturado diretamente para a empresa gestora da frota.

Notificações e Alertas
Receba avisos no seu dispositivo quando a recarga for iniciada, concluída ou em caso de qualquer eventualidade operacional.

Suporte Integrado
Conte com canal de atendimento e suporte técnico diretamente no aplicativo.

name: Mochi Mates: Sorting Puzzles
description:
Sort a bento full of expressive mochi. Lift matching mochi together and move them into an empty well or onto their own kind. Fill each well with four matching mochi to finish.

Play 100 levels across ten areas, from small starter boards to larger sorting challenges. Undo a move, restart a puzzle, and earn stars and gold as you play.

Spend earned or purchased gold on eight kinds of charms, including Bell, Feather, Clock, Star, Spring, Swap, Rainbow and Side plate. Gold packs are optional Apple in-app purchases.

The campaign works offline. Purchases need an internet connection. Progress, gold and charms are stored on your device; no Mochi Mates account is required.

name: Mokifun: Kids Coloring Books
description:
Mokifun Coloring is a happy shelf full of coloring books for kids. Pick a book, pick a page and start coloring!

Over 800 coloring pages in 28 books:
• Animals: Cats & Dogs, Horses & Ponies, Baby Animals, Birds, Forest Friends, On the Farm, Jungle & Safari, Under the Sea, Bugs & Butterflies
• Fantasy: Unicorns, Dinosaurs, Princesses & Castles, Knights & Dragons, Fairies & Magic
• Seasons: Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter
• Holidays: Christmas, Halloween, Easter, Love & Hearts, Happy New Year, Birthday, Mother's Day, Father's Day, Back to School
• First Words: 50 first words to color and read

More than just coloring:
• Color by number: tap the right color for every number
• Color by sum: solve the sum to find the color, including times tables
• Dot-to-dot and draw-the-other-half pages
• First Words: one simple picture with its word in big letters

Easy for little hands:
• The bucket fills an area with one tap
• The marker colors with your finger and stays inside the lines
• Zoom in for small details, undo with one tap
• A hint button shows where to color next

For every age: choose ages 2–4, 4–6, 6–9 or 9+ and see the pages that fit. From big, simple shapes for toddlers to detailed pages and mandalas for older kids.

Make it your own: collect your favorite pages in your own coloring book and find any page quickly with search.

Your drawings are saved automatically, so you can always continue later. Finished? Share your drawing or save it to your photos.

Available in 7 languages: English, Dutch, German, French, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese.

• Works without internet
• No ads
• No in-app purchases
• No data is collected

name: Molenwind
description:
Molenwind is a free app for windmill millers and windmill lovers in the Netherlands.

MY MILL, FOR THE MILLER
• Pick your own windmill; with your location, nearby mills are listed first.
• Wind compass: where the wind comes from and which way to turn the cap.
• Wind force in Beaufort and m/s, gusts shown separately, and a milling verdict: too little wind, good milling weather, strong or stop.
• Warning when the wind is set to shift by more than 45° in the next 12 hours.
• Hourly forecast and a satellite map zoomed in on your mill, with a wind arrow.
• Notifications for a wind shift (30 minutes ahead) and for strong wind (1 hour ahead).

DISCOVER, FOR EVERYONE
• More than 1,200 Dutch windmills on the map, grouped by region.
• Mill page with photo, type, purpose, year built and whether it is a good day for turning.
• Opening hours with "open now" where known, plus directions and a link to allemolens.nl.

PRIVACY
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your location stays on your phone.

OPEN SOURCE
The source code is on GitHub (EdCafferata/molenwind). All features are free. If you like, you can leave an optional tip in the app.

Sources: windmill data from the Dutch Cultural Heritage Agency (RCE), opening hours from OpenStreetMap, weather data from Open-Meteo.

name: MonuDrive – Measure Your Drive
description:
Put numbers on how your car or motorcycle accelerates, brakes and corners — using the phone you already have.

MonuDrive records a ride in your car or on your motorcycle and works out the figures on its own: acceleration, braking distance and cornering g-forces. All it needs is a phone held firmly in a mount. No extra hardware.

WHAT IT MEASURES
• 0–60 mph, rolling acceleration such as 50–70 mph, and 60–0 mph braking distance — picked out of the recording automatically
• Or in metric: 0–100 km/h, 80–120 km/h and 100–0 km/h. Units follow your region and can be switched in Settings
• Peak g-forces under braking, acceleration and cornering
• Each vehicle's best measurements, with dates — tap one to open the ride it came from

AN HONEST "±" ON EVERY RESULT
A phone's GPS reports once a second, so MonuDrive fills the gaps from the accelerometer and shows an estimated uncertainty next to every figure. Runs that fail its checks — a signal dropout, sensors that disagree — are not counted among your best measurements. Dedicated test equipment is more accurate; MonuDrive gives you a good picture with no extra equipment.

TWO LIVE SCREENS
• Dynamics: your speed, a live g-force diagram and the route colored by speed
• Calm driving: a 0–100 score with comfort and smoothness, for the last five minutes and for the whole ride

Recording carries on with the screen off. On iOS 18 or later, a Live Activity shows the ride on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.

AFTER THE RIDE
• Your route drawn on a clean canvas — no map underneath — marking harder braking, acceleration, sharp corners and bumps
• Summary: distance, moving and stopped time, average and highest recorded speed, elevation profile
• Conditions: road surface, temperature, tires
• GPX export of the ride

YOUR DATA STAYS WITH YOU
No account, no server, no analytics, no ads. Everything stays on your device. Save a complete backup to a file and restore it whenever you like — on a new phone, for instance.

FREE
Unlimited ride recording, both live screens, the ride list and ride overview, the calm-driving score, each ride's measurements, your vehicle's best measurements, one vehicle, built-in summer, winter and all-season tires, GPX export, complete backup and restore, light and dark appearance, and a choice of app icon.

MONUDRIVE PREMIUM
A one-time purchase with no subscription. You can try the Premium features in the app for 14 days first; nothing is charged automatically afterwards, and everything that is free keeps working.
• Acceleration and braking curves step by step (0–20, 0–30 … and 60–0, 50–0 …) — from a single run, or composed from several rides
• Acceleration between any two speeds you pick
• Your vehicle's profile split by tires, surface and driver: summer against winter tires, dry against wet
• G-forces along the car's axes and the strongest moments of each ride
• More vehicles
• Your own tire sets and drivers
• A results card to share (no location, no driver name) and CSV export of your rides

Available in 29 languages and regional variants.

SAFETY
MonuDrive only records and measures. On public roads, always obey traffic laws. Acceleration and braking measurements belong on a closed course or on private land with the owner's permission. Do not operate the app while driving. The driver is responsible for how they drive.

MonuDrive by MonuMake.

name: MoonBee - Kids Bedtime Stories
description:
MoonBee puts a calm, beautifully illustrated bedtime story on the screen and reads it aloud to your child, in English or Vietnamese.

FREE STORY BANK
• Ready-made stories for ages 0-2, 3-5, 6-8 and 9-12, in English and Vietnamese
• Full-screen picture slideshow read by a warm voice
• Reading speed, sleep timer and soft sleep sounds under your control

STORIES MADE FOR YOUR CHILD (Plus and Pro)
• Type a topic and MoonBee writes a gentle story, draws every page and reads it aloud
• Make your child the hero of the story
• Stories stay calm and safe: violent, scary or adult topics are refused before anything is made
• Nothing is sent to AI without asking you first

FAMILY LIBRARY
• Keep your family's stories in one private library
• Share a story with other families, or listen to stories other parents shared
• Report or hide any shared story and block its author

PLANS
• Free: the whole story bank, unlimited
• MoonBee Plus: 60 credits a month, long stories, 2 child profiles
• MoonBee Pro: 150 credits a month, multi-part series, 5 child profiles

Plus and Pro are auto-renewing subscriptions, billed monthly or yearly to your Apple ID. A subscription renews automatically unless it is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://store.tinybee.ai/legal/moonbee/terms
Privacy Policy: https://store.tinybee.ai/legal/moonbee/privacy

name: Moroccan Flame
description:
Moroccan Flame brings Moroccan street food to Greenville Avenue in Dallas: charcoal-grilled kefta and brochettes, warm batbout and flaky msemen, rice bowls, and couscous every Friday.

THE MENU
Every dish with its photo, price and combo price. Tap a dish to see what's in it and order it for pickup.

THIS WEEK'S SPECIAL
See the special meal as soon as it's announced, and turn on notifications to hear about the next one.

REWARDS
Scan the code at the truck window each time you visit. 5 stamps get you a free Moroccan mint tea, or keep going to 10 for a free sandwich. Your card is kept for you, even if you reinstall the app.

FIND THE TRUCK
The address, a map, and directions in one tap.

CATERING AND SPECIAL ORDERS
Ask about catering for your office, party or family gathering, or a special order for a particular day.

No sign-up and no password: the app is ready the moment you open it.

name: Morse I/O
description:
Morse I/O turns your iPhone into a Morse code transmitter and receiver.

Inspired by the secret signals of spy movies, it's a gadget full of romance. It's also designed for practical use:
• Backup communication where there's no signal — in the mountains or at sea
• Airsoft and survival games — silent team signals by light

SEND
• Type up to 50 characters and send them as Morse code
• Output by screen flash, flashlight, or 700 Hz tone — or any combination
• Loop sending, haptic feedback, adjustable speed

RECEIVE
• Decode blinking light with the camera (zoom up to x10, contrast filter)
• Decode Morse tones with the microphone

Works completely offline — useful in the mountains, at sea, or anywhere without signal.

Try everything free for 24 hours, then unlock forever with a one-time purchase. No subscription.

name: Morse Lens: Code Translator
description:
A little light. A clear message.

A blinking flashlight can be saying something. Morse Lens helps you read it. Point your iPhone camera at a light sending Morse code and watch the message appear, letter by letter.

READ THE SIGNAL
No need to count every dot and dash. Morse Lens finds a light in the camera view and adapts to the sender's timing. Tap a light to follow it, see the decoded words alongside their Morse code, then copy the message.

SAY IT WITH LIGHT
Type a message and let your iPhone flashlight send it in Morse. Choose the speed, repeat the message, and follow its progress. An SOS shortcut is included.

MAKE SENSE OF MORSE
Turn words into dots and dashes, or translate Morse back into text. Copy the result or send your translated message straight to the flashlight. Useful for practice, puzzles and trying light signals with a friend.

YOUR CAMERA. YOUR PRIVACY.
The app works offline. No account and no ads. Camera frames and your messages are processed on your iPhone and are never recorded or uploaded. Anonymous usage statistics help us fix problems.

For best results, keep a clear view of a light sending Morse code and hold the camera steady. Decoding depends on the signal's timing, visibility and surrounding light. The flashlight sender requires a supported iPhone. SOS sends a light signal; it does not contact emergency services or guarantee that someone will see it.

Questions or feedback? info@yuzi.nl

name: Mosoecfut
description:
Thanks for downloading! We look forward to your feedback, which helps us keep making progress.

Mosoecfut keeps a big writing project in orbit: one fair word count for today, worked out from your target and your deadline.

Set up a project — a novel, a thesis, a blog series, a month-long challenge — with a word target and a deadline, and Mosoecfut spreads what's left across the days you have. Write in your usual editor, come back, log the words, and your quota, projected finish date and streak update straight away.

TODAY ON THE DESK
The Desk puts today's words next to today's quota across every project. A row of lime strokes fills as the words arrive and finishes in a green orbit check once the quota is met. Underneath: your current streak, your best day and this week's total.

QUICK LOGGING
Enter the words you wrote today, or just the new total from your manuscript and Mosoecfut works out the difference. Add minutes and a short note if you like. Log for an earlier day, edit a session, or delete it.

STRAIGHT PACE MATHS
Today's quota is set at the start of the day, so it doesn't shrink while you write; tomorrow it adapts to what's left. Every project shows its daily quota, days left, average words a day and the date you'll finish at your current pace, ahead of or behind the deadline.

WRITING SPRINTS
Choose a project and a length from 10 to 60 minutes. The sprint dial runs down as you write; pause, resume or finish early, then record the words the sprint added.

CHAPTERS AND MILESTONES
Split a book into chapters, acts or checkpoints with their own word marks, or divide the whole target into equal chapters in one tap. A milestone stamps itself when your logged total passes it.

THE CALENDAR
Each month is shaded by the words written each day, with green days where the quota was met. Every project also gets a twelve-week heat strip. Tap a day to see, edit or delete its sessions.

SET UP YOUR DESK
Two looks: the dark Orbit theme and the light Cream theme. Sounds and haptics can each be turned off. Pick your default sprint length and whether weeks begin on Monday.

ACCOUNT OPTIONAL
Sign up with email and password, or tap "Write as guest" and begin right away. Guests can save their desk to an email account later from Study and keep everything. Your data syncs through your own private account and keeps working offline. Delete your account and all of its data at any time from Study.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads. No tracking. No analytics. Mosoecfut stores numbers and short notes, never the text of your manuscript.

name: Mowajahah
seller_name: Company THAQA OUEMAR For Information Technology
description:
«مواجهة» لعبة أسئلة جماعية تجمع الأهل والأصدقاء في تحدٍّ ممتع بين فريقين على شاشة واحدة. سواء كانت جمعة عائلية أو سهرة شباب أو استراحة، «مواجهة» تحوّل الجلسة إلى منافسة حماسية.

كيف تلعب؟
* كوّنوا فريقين واكتبوا اسم كل فريق.
* كل فريق يختار 3 فئات بالتناوب، فتتكوّن لوحة من 36 سؤالًا.
* اختاروا السؤال وقيمته (200 أو 400 أو 600 نقطة) وجاوبوا قبل انتهاء الوقت.
* استخدموا وسائل المساعدة بذكاء: مضاعفة النقاط، البحث عن الإجابة، والوقت الإضافي.
* في النهاية تُعلن النتيجة ويتوَّج الفريق الفائز.

فئات متنوعة تناسب الجميع:
القرآن الكريم (أكمل الآية بالكلمة الناقصة ثم تظهر الآية كاملة)، السعودية، معلومات عامة، تاريخ، علوم، رياضة، إسلاميات، لغة عربية، عواصم ودول، حيوانات، تقنية، أكلات، ألغاز، وغيرها، وتتجدد الأسئلة باستمرار.

ليش «مواجهة»؟
* واجهة عربية بالكامل، مصممة للجوال والآيباد والشاشة الكبيرة.
* آلاف الأسئلة، ولا تتكرر عليك في الألعاب القادمة.
* قواعد تقدر تخصّصها: السرقة، والخصم عند الخطأ، ومدة الوقت، والمؤثرات الصوتية.
* احفظ اللعبة وكمّلها لاحقًا، وتابع ألعابك ونتائجك من «حسابي».
* تسجيل سريع برقم الجوال ورمز تحقق برسالة نصية.
* زر للإبلاغ عن أي سؤال لنحسّن المحتوى باستمرار.

جهّز فريقك… والمواجهة تبدأ الآن!

name: MU - 마음 비우기
description:
無(무)는 화가 나거나 마음이 복잡할 때, 버튼을 한 번씩 눌러 108번 마음을 비우는 앱이에요.

· 108번 비우기: 지금의 감정과 그 정도를 고르고, 한 번씩 누르며 마음을 내려놓아요.
· 중간 성찰: 27번째, 54번째, 81번째, 108번째에 스스로에게 짧은 질문을 던져요.
· 명상 소리: 싱잉볼, 빗소리, 파도 등 차분한 소리와 함께할 수 있어요.
· 마음 기록: 남긴 기록을 달력에서 돌아보며 내 마음의 흐름을 살펴봐요.
· 한국어, English, 中文, 日本語 지원

無는 일상의 감정을 돌아보도록 돕는 자기 관리 도구이며, 의료 행위나 심리 상담을 대신하지 않습니다.

이용약관: https://leesanghee-dev.github.io/terms.html
개인정보처리방침: https://leesanghee-dev.github.io/privacy.html

name: Multiband Station
description:
Your radio-controlled watch can't reach its time signal? Multiband Station turns your iPhone into a pocket transmitter, so the watch can sync right on your desk.

Made for Casio watches with Multiband 5, Multiband 6 or Wave Ceptor reception. Lay the watch on the iPhone's speaker, tap Start and start a receive on the watch. Within a few minutes it picks up the exact time, as if the real station were nearby.

KEY FEATURES
• One tap – the big Start button begins transmitting straight away
• Auto station – picks JJY, WWVB, MSF, DCF77 or BPC from your time zone, and follows you when you travel
• All six stations – JJY 40, JJY 60, WWVB, MSF, DCF77 and BPC, each with its official time-code format
• Accurate timing – every pulse follows your iPhone's network-synced clock
• Readiness checklist – live volume meter, audio output check and the Home City your watch needs
• On-air view – see each second's pulses as they are sent, with a countdown and live signal glow
• Hands-off – stops automatically after 5–30 minutes and keeps going with the screen locked
• Built-in guide – step-by-step syncing, Home City table and troubleshooting tips

WHO IT'S FOR
• You live outside a time-signal area, or the signal is blocked indoors
• Your watch missed its overnight sync and you want it right now
• You're travelling and want to set your watch for a new region

HOW TO USE
1. Set the watch's Home City to a city served by the station (shown in the app)
2. Turn the iPhone volume all the way up
3. Lay the watch face-up on the bottom speaker, or rest a wired earbud on it
4. Tap Start
5. Start a manual receive on the watch and keep still for 2–10 minutes

PRIVACY
Multiband Station works entirely on your iPhone. It collects no data, needs no account, asks for no permissions and makes no network requests.

NOTES
• The signal reaches only a few centimetres, so keep the watch right on the speaker or earbud
• Reception depends on your iPhone's audio hardware and your watch model. If the speaker doesn't work, wired earphones often do. Bluetooth and AirPlay won't work
• Multiband 5 watches receive every station except BPC
• Never wear earphones while transmitting: the tone plays at full volume

Multiband Station is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Casio Computer Co., Ltd. Casio, G-SHOCK, MULTI BAND 6 and Wave Ceptor are trademarks of their respective owners.

name: MundoVia
description:
MundoVia is a simple, private travel tracker, where you're in full control of your data.
Keep the countries you've been to, the trips and journeys that took you there, the places you saw and the souvenirs you brought home, on a map of the world that works even without a connection. No account. No ads. No tracking. Just you and your travels, on your device.

name: Mushafna
description:
Make the Quran a daily habit, and keep each other going.

Mushafna is a Mushaf in the King Fahd Complex script that remembers your place and counts your daily reading, whether you read, listen or recite.

Read
• One place you always return to. Browse freely without moving it.
• A daily goal you choose. Each day starts fresh, with nothing piling up.

Listen
• Verse-by-verse recitation by well-known reciters, carrying on from your place and counting toward your goal.

Recite
• Recite from memory with the page hidden, and each word appears as you say it.
• It runs on your phone, and your voice never leaves it.

With friends
• Start a group and invite family and friends with a link or a code.
• Everyone sees today's progress live, and one reading counts in all your groups.

A daily reminder at the time you choose. No ads, no purchases.

name: MX Store
description:
MX Store — приложение магазина техники и гаджетов. Весь каталог, корзина и заказы теперь в телефоне.

Что можно делать:

• Выбирать товары в каталоге: смартфоны, умные часы, наушники, техника для дома, аксессуары и многое другое. Работают поиск, фильтры по моделям и сортировка.
• Смотреть цены и наличие в своём городе. Город выбирается в профиле, и приложение показывает актуальные товары, адреса и условия именно для него.
• Оформлять заказ с самовывозом, доставкой по городу или через СДЭК. Оплата: наличными или онлайн. 
• Следить за заказами в личном кабинете, отменять заказ и получать уведомления о смене статуса.
• Писать менеджеру в чат: отправлять сообщения и фотографии.
• Сохранять товары в избранное.
• Оставить заявку на выкуп своей техники: опишите устройство, приложите фото и получите предложение.
• Если нашли товар дешевле, оставьте заявку, и мы постараемся снизить цену.
• Читать статьи в блоге о технике и выборе устройств.

name: My Little Deen: 365 Stories
description:
In the evening, you settle in and a gentle voice tells a story of the prophets, with no music. The little ones listen, and so do the grown-ups.
My Little Deen brings together 365 stories of Islam: the prophets, the life of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم and beautiful values, narrated and illustrated.
No prophet and no human face is ever shown.

THE PROPHETS AND THE LIFE OF THE PROPHET صلى الله عليه وسلم
Adam, Nuh, Ibrahim, Ismail, Salih, Yusuf, Musa, Sulayman, Yunus and the others. Then Zamzam, the Kaaba, the Year of the Elephant and the rest of the life of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وسلم, season after season.

THE VALUES OF ISLAM, IN STORIES
• Tawhid: Luqman's advice.
• Kindness: The thirsty dog.
• Good behavior: The thorny branch.
• Loving your parents: Your mother, then your mother.
• Sharing: The three dates.

TO DO TOGETHER
• A quiz after each story, to remember what you heard.
• A chest to open after 7 days of activity.
• Night-light mode: during the story, the screen becomes a night light and you can put the phone down.

AND ALSO
• A profile for everyone in the house.
• Offline: what you have already listened to stays available without a connection.
• No ads.

SUBSCRIPTION
The first 3 stories are free, forever. The rest opens with My Little Deen Plus, monthly or yearly, with a 3-day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of use: https://app.mylittledeen.com/appli/conditions
Privacy policy: https://app.mylittledeen.com/appli/confidentialite

name: My Workout Log - متتبع تماريني
description:
متتبع تماريني هو سجل تدريبي محلي متكامل يساعدك على تسجيل تمارينك، متابعة تطور أوزانك، وتحليل تقدمك الرياضي بوضوح وسرعة على جهازك مباشرة دون الحاجة إلى إنشاء حساب أو تسجيل دخول أو اتصال بالإنترنت.

المميزات الرئيسية:

- تسجيل سريع للتمارين: ابدأ جلسة فارغة أو انطلق مباشرة من قوالب تدريب جاهزة ومخصصة مثل Push وPull وLegs وUpper Body، مع إمكانية تعديل التمارين والمجموعات والتكرارات والأوزان بسهولة أثناء الجلسة.
- دعم كامل لأنواع المجموعات: سجل مجموعات التسخين والمجموعات الأساسية والدروب سيت والمجموعات حتى الفشل العضلي، مع تسجيل مستوى الجهد (RPE) وملاحظات كل جلسة.
- كشف الأرقام القياسية تلقائياً: يحسب التطبيق الحجم التدريبي الكلي والتقدير الأقصى للتكرار الواحد (1RM) ويميز الأرقام القياسية الجديدة (PR) فور تحقيقها.
- مؤقت راحة تلقائي: يعمل تلقائياً بعد إتمام المجموعة مع أزرار لضبط الوقت سريعاً وإمكانية إبقاء الشاشة مضاءة أثناء التمرين.
- رسوم بيانية وتحليلات دقيقة: استعرض منحنى تقدم كل تمرين، والحجم التدريبي الأسبوعي، وتوزيع المجموعات حسب العضلات، وتقويم الانتظام وسلسلة الأيام التدريبية.
- متابعة قياسات الجسم: سجل وزن الجسم ونسبة الدهون ومحيط الخصر والصدر والذراع مع رسم تاريخي للتغيرات.
- مكتبة تمارين جاهزة وقابلة للتخصيص: تضم 40 تمريناً مصنفاً حسب المجموعة العضلية ونوع الأداة باللغتين العربية والإنجليزية، مع إمكانية إنشاء تمارينك الخاصة.
- أدوات تدريب مدمجة: حاسبة التقدير الأقصى للتكرار الواحد (1RM) وحاسبة توزيع الأوزان والألواح على البار بالكيلوجرام أو الباوند.
- نسخ احتياطي وتصدير بياناتك: صدّر سجلاتك بصيغة CSV أو احفظ نسخة احتياطية كاملة واستعدها بصيغة JSON في أي وقت.
- خصوصية كاملة وتخصيص مرن: يعمل التطبيق محلياً بنسبة 100% دون إعلانات أو تتبع، ويتبع لغة الجهاز تلقائياً (العربية أو الإنجليزية) مع دعم الوضع الداكن والفاتح ووحدتي kg وlb.

name: Nasum: Leaving Home Checklist
description:
"Did I lock the door? Did I turn off the stove?" Settle that worry with one photo.

Nasum helps you photograph the door, stove and other things before you leave, then reminds you to double-check once you walk away from home.

■ How it works
1. Before you go, tap "Check before leaving" and take a photo of each item
2. When you leave home, you get an alert. Tap it to check once more
3. When you worry while out, open your saved photos and see for yourself

■ Why it helps
• Choose your own items: front door, stove, hair iron, windows, AC, heater, pet food, boiler… add notes too
• Only the latest photo per item is kept, with the time it was taken ("Yesterday 8:12 PM")
• Tell Nasum when you usually leave and it reminds you 30 minutes before
• Large text, large buttons, simple screens
• Weekly report: see which items you forget most, as a score

■ Your photos and location stay on your phone
• No sign-up, no servers — photos and your home location are never sent to a server
• Photos live only inside the app and are deleted after 7 days (not saved to your photo library)
• Nasum uses location "Always" only to tell when you leave home (it never keeps a location history). You can turn it off anytime

■ Good to know
• Leaving alerts can arrive a few minutes late (a trait of iPhone location features)
• Allow location "Always" with "Precise Location" on to get leaving alerts
• Nasum is a convenience tool to help you check, not a treatment for anxiety

■ Free and Lifetime Pass
• Free: 5 items, ads on the home screen, weekly report for your first month
• Lifetime Pass (one-time payment): unlimited items, no ads, weekly report forever

Privacy policy: https://morup.kr/web/upload/morup/nasum/privacy.html
Contact: dormall01@daum.net

name: Natankováno: Tank Beer Pubs
description:
Natankováno is a map of Czech pubs that pour tank beer – unpasteurized, fresh beer delivered straight from the brewery into big tanks in the pub.

FIND A TANK PUB
• Map of tank beer pubs all over the Czech Republic
• Search by pub name, address, town or beer brand
• "Near me" shows the closest pubs around you
• Your favourite one is missing? Add it yourself

ARE YOU AT THE PUB?
The app notices when you're sitting in a tank pub and offers to let your friends know. Your location stays on your phone and is never sent anywhere.

WITH FRIENDS
• Add friends with their friend code
• See which of them are out for a beer right now, and where
• You choose who can see you

WHAT'S ON
Birthdays, live music, a new beer on tap – anyone can add an event. Pubs with something happening right now glow on the map.

SAFE AND RESPONSIBLE
For adults only (18+). You can report inappropriate content and block anyone. Please drink responsibly and never drink and drive.

Čeština, English, Deutsch, Русский, Українська.

name: Natura-Alert
description:
Natura Alert notifies you on your phone when you enter a protected area in Greece, and shows its boundaries on a map. For hikers, hunters, anglers, sailors and anyone out in nature.

WHAT IT DOES
• Entry alerts: a message on your phone as soon as you enter a Natura 2000 area, even with the screen off, if you allow location access “Always”.
• Hunting and fishing restriction areas: wildlife refuges, reserves and marine parks, shown in red. The groups are indicative.
• A map with the real boundaries: land and sea Natura 2000 areas, with names when you zoom in, and Posidonia meadows.
• Map layers: switch land areas, sea areas, restriction areas and Posidonia meadows on or off.
• Search for areas: find any Natura area by name or code and see it on the map.
• It follows your position: the map turns to the direction you are facing, like navigation apps.
• Area passport: keep a list of the areas you have visited, with milestones and categories.
• Greek and English.

PRIVACY
No accounts, no ads and no analytics. Your position is checked on your phone, against boundaries built into the app, and is not sent to any server.

IMPORTANT
This is not an official app of NECCA or of the Greek government. The boundaries and restrictions are indicative and are not legal information, nor a permit to access an area or carry out an activity. GPS accuracy varies near boundaries. Alerts with the screen off need the location permission set to “Always”. If the app is fully closed, alerts are not guaranteed.

Boundary data: NECCA. Map: © OpenStreetMap contributors, © OpenSeaMap contributors.

name: Navtrix: GPS Tracker
description:
Navtrix is the GPS tracking platform for your fleet, now on iPhone.

• Live map with every tracked vehicle and phone
• Trip history, stops, drivers and mileage
• Push alerts: geofences, speeding, vehicle offline, maintenance and telemetry
• Geofences, maintenance, fuel logs and exportable reports
• Live location sharing by link
• Track this phone: turn your iPhone into a fleet tracker. Location is sent only while you keep the feature on — iOS shows the location indicator — and you can stop at any time.

Sign in with Apple, Google or e-mail. Questions: navtrix@navtrix.app

name: Nealey Tire & Auto
description:
The Nealey Tire & Auto app puts our five Maryland shops in your pocket: Edgewater, Deale, Owings, Pasadena and Rockville.

Sign in with your cell number. We'll find your cars from your past visits.

• Book a visit: pick your shop, the service, your car and a time.
• Your garage: your cars, past visits, invoices and the work we recommended.
• Recall check: see open safety recalls for your car.
• Message your shop: send text, photos or a short video of a warning light or a noise.
• Ask Nealey: quick answers about your cars, visits, hours and booking, any time.
• Rewards: every 5th oil change is free, at all five shops.
• Siri: say "Book an oil change with Nealey."
• Tire prices, and one tap to call your shop.

Questions? Email app@nealeytire.com or call your shop.

name: Nemo Aquarium: Idle Fish Tank
description:
Nemo Aquarium is a cozy 3D fish tank you can turn, zoom and decorate: a relaxing idle aquarium simulator for your iPhone.
Collect 42 fish in 126 colour looks, care for them like virtual pets and design your own reef with 24 decor pieces and plants.
Your fish earn coins while you are away, and your real-life goals and habits pay coins too.
Free to play. Some fish, decor and tank looks need pearls or Reef Club.

A TANK YOU CAN TURN
Drag to look around your glass tank and pinch to zoom. Choose from four tank sizes and place 16 decor pieces and 8 plants where you want them. Change the sand, frame, stand and background, pick a lighting mood or let it follow the clock, and move the tank between four cozy rooms.

42 FISH, 126 COLOUR LOOKS
Common, rare, epic and legendary fish, each in its original look and two more colour looks: one to buy, and a rare one that opens with a 7-day Today streak or 50 claimed goals (a few are pearl looks). Feed them, keep the water clean and watch them grow up. Fish can get sick if neglected, but a little care brings them back. Nothing ever dies.

IDLE COINS AND THE CHEST
Fish earn coins all day. The chest fills while you are away (8 hours of coins at first, more with upgrades), and a welcome-back card shows what needs care.

TODAY: REAL-LIFE GOALS PAY COINS
The Today board turns your day into goals. Connect Apple Health and your steps, exercise, Activity rings, sleep and mindful minutes become goals you claim for coins. A daily streak adds up to 50%, and finishing all of a day's three or more goals earns a Perfect day bonus. Apple Health is optional and read-only, and the game is fully playable without it. The readings stay on your iPhone. Only what you earn is saved with your game. Nemo Aquarium is a game, not a medical or fitness tool.

HABIT PLANNER
Plan up to eight habits of your own, like drinking water or a stretch. Choose the days, a time and an optional reminder, tick each one off for coins and see your week at a glance. Your day also earns Tide Points for food and care items, and streaks unlock special fish.

WIDGET, PHOTOS, ICLOUD
- A tank widget for your Home Screen and Lock Screen, with a Feed button.
- Photo mode: frame your tank, then share the picture or save it.
- Optional reminders for hungry or sick fish, a full chest, a streak or a habit, with quiet hours.
- Your progress syncs through your own iCloud. No account needed.
- Made for iPhone Duo too: the cover screen, and side panels when unfolded.

REEF CLUB (OPTIONAL SUBSCRIPTION)
The game is free to play. Some fish, decor and tank looks need pearls or Reef Club. Reef Club adds:
- 2x idle coins
- A chest that holds 4 hours more
- 10 pearls every day (claimed when you first open the game that day)
- A club fish each month you are subscribed
- Every tank style, while you are a member
- A club badge beside your tank name

Plans (prices in US dollars; prices vary by region):
- Weekly: $1.99 per week
- Monthly: $4.99 per month, with a 3-day free trial
- Yearly: $29.99 per year, with a 3-day free trial
The free trial is for eligible new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase, or when the free trial ends. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel it any time in Settings › your name › Subscriptions. When Reef Club ends, the bonuses stop; the fish and pearls you already received stay, and the look on your tank stays until you change it.

PEARL PACKS (OPTIONAL)
Pearls unlock special fish, decor and tank looks. Packs: 80 pearls $0.99, 450 pearls $4.99, 1,000 pearls $9.99, 2,400 pearls $19.99 (prices vary by region). Pearl packs are one-time purchases with a fixed number of pearls. They have no cash value.

Terms of Use: https://www.zeusqolivar.com/terms-nemo-aquarium
Privacy Policy: https://www.zeusqolivar.com/privacy-nemo-aquarium

name: Newer Times
description:
Social Media. The Way It Should Be.

Newer Times is a friendly place for adults to keep up with friends and family, reconnect with people you've lost touch with and share what's happening in your life. It's 100% free, and your News Feed will never have ads in it.

YOUR NEWS FEED
- Share posts, photos and short video Clips
- Choose who sees each post: Public, Friends or Only me
- React, comment, add photos to comments and use big 3D emojis
- Switch between Most Recent, Friends and Following

FRIENDS AND FOLLOWERS
- Add friends, or follow people without being friends
- Find a Friend helps you look up people you know
- Spot a Friend in your photos and posts
- Post on a friend's wall and see who's celebrating a birthday

BIRTHDAYS DONE RIGHT
- Never miss a birthday with the Birthday Center
- Send birthday cards and gifts, or a wish on their wall

MY MOOD
- Let friends know how you're feeling with one tap
- Your mood fades after 24 hours
- Friends can send you a hug

GROUPS AND EVENTS
- Join public or private groups around what you love
- Create events and see who's going

MESSAGES
- Private conversations with your friends
- Share photos in chats

A PROFILE THAT'S REALLY YOU
- Show off your favorite teams, hobbies, music and artists
- Pick who can see your details
- Change your look with seasonal backgrounds

THE GAME ROOM
- Milo's Banana Jungle: swing on vines, collect bananas and unlock silly outfits
- Color Craze: a colorful match-3 puzzle with 300 levels
- Daily Movie Trivia, the Daily Brain Challenge and Tic-Tac-Toe
- See how your scores stack up against your friends in Milo's Banana Jungle and Color Craze

YOUR PRIVACY MATTERS
Newer Times is built around real friendships, not selling your personal information.
- We never sell members' personal data
- No ads in your News Feed, ever
- Control who sees your posts and profile information
- Block and report members when needed
- Download your information or delete your account right in the app

SAFE FOR GROWN-UPS
- Newer Times is for adults 18 and older
- Report any post, comment, clip, profile, message or group
- Real moderators review reports

Newer Times is currently available to members in the United States.

name: NeXT Terminal
description:
NeXT Terminal macht aus einem iPad am Tresen das Kundendisplay deines Betriebs – für Friseur, Praxis, Werkstatt, Amt, Kiosk oder jeden Laden mit Laufkundschaft.

Deine Kunden wählen am iPad den gewünschten Mitarbeiter und scannen den QR-Code mit dem eigenen Handy. Die Wartemarke wandert aufs Handy, niemand muss im Laden warten.

So verbindest du das iPad
Beim ersten Start zeigt die App einen Kopplungscode. Melde dich auf next-ticketsystem.de an und gib den Code in der Verwaltung unter „Displays“ bei „Terminal-App“ ein. Danach zeigt das iPad dauerhaft dein Kundendisplay.

Gut zu wissen
• Über das iPad kommt niemand in deine Verwaltung – die App zeigt nur das Kundendisplay.
• Vollbild, der Bildschirm bleibt an.
• Farben, Logo und Mitarbeiter stellst du wie gewohnt in der Verwaltung ein, das iPad übernimmt alles von selbst.
• Entkoppeln geht jederzeit in der Verwaltung. Danach zeigt das iPad wieder einen Code.
• Tipp: Mit „Geführter Zugriff“ (Einstellungen → Bedienungshilfen) bleibt das iPad fest in der App.

Voraussetzung
Ein Konto auf next-ticketsystem.de. Die App selbst ist kostenlos und enthält keine Werbung.

Fragen? info@next-ticketsystem.de

name: NextTime: Remember Better
description:
NextTime remembers what you want to do differently the next time you repeat something.

The coffee was too sweet. The barber cut the sides too short. The gym seat was set wrong. Write the small change in one line, and it's there the next time you need it.

• Write a card in seconds: "Next time, ask for one pump of syrup."
• Add a photo, a voice note, a place or a note when it helps.
• Find any card fast with search, categories, pinned cards and places.
