• Tap "I used this" and NextTime asks once whether the change worked, so your cards stay right.
• Place reminders: give a place a location and NextTime reminds you when you arrive. Your iPhone notices the arrival; your location never leaves it.
• Archive what you don't need now and restore it any time.

Private by design: no account, no ads, no analytics. Your cards, photos and voice notes stay on your iPhone, and you can save a backup file whenever you like.

Free for up to 10 active cards. A single in-app purchase, not a subscription, unlocks as many as you like.

In English and French.

name: Nhà Đất Số
seller_name: ARB VIET NAM JOINT STOCK COMPANY
description:
Nhà Đất Số giúp bạn xem quy hoạch, định giá và mua bán nhà đất trên toàn quốc, dùng chung dữ liệu với nhadatso.com.

BẢN ĐỒ QUY HOẠCH
Mở bản đồ, phóng tới thửa đất cần xem: loại đất theo quy hoạch, đường dự kiến mở, lộ giới, ảnh vệ tinh. Tìm theo phường xã, dự án, địa chỉ hoặc toạ độ. Dữ liệu quy hoạch từ các Sở Quy hoạch – Kiến trúc và cổng thông tin của tỉnh thành.

ĐỊNH GIÁ NHÀ ĐẤT
Nhập tên đường, diện tích và chiều ngang, ứng dụng ước tính khoảng giá thị trường của thửa đất. Cách tính hiện rõ từng dòng: giá đất nhà nước mỗi mét vuông, hệ số quy đổi thị trường, hệ số mặt tiền, hệ số hình dáng, kèm giá rao thực tế của khu vực theo từng năm và nghị quyết giá đất dùng làm nguồn.

BẢNG GIÁ ĐẤT NHÀ NƯỚC 2026
Tra giá đất theo từng tuyến đường của 34 tỉnh thành, hơn 72.000 tuyến đường. Dùng để tính thuế, lệ phí trước bạ, tiền sử dụng đất.

TÌM NHÀ NHANH
Lọc theo bán hay thuê, tỉnh thành, loại nhà đất (nhà riêng, căn hộ, nhà mặt phố, đất nền, biệt thự, kho xưởng, văn phòng), khoảng giá, diện tích và pháp lý. Sắp xếp theo giá hoặc theo giá trên mỗi mét vuông để so nhanh.

ĐỌC TIN ĐỦ Ý
Mỗi tin có ảnh, diện tích, số phòng ngủ, hướng, tình trạng sổ, giá trên mét vuông. Ứng dụng tính sẵn chi phí sang tên ước tính (lệ phí trước bạ, thuế thu nhập cá nhân, phí công chứng) theo giá rao, và mở bản đồ quy hoạch quanh vị trí tin.

TÊN PHƯỜNG XÃ MỚI
Tin ghi theo đơn vị hành chính mới, kèm tên phường xã cũ để dễ nhận ra khu vực.

LƯU TIN ĐỂ SO SÁNH
Bấm Lưu để giữ tin trên điện thoại, xem lại được cả khi mất mạng. Mục Vừa xem giữ các tin đã mở gần đây.

ĐĂNG TIN BẰNG CÁCH DÁN BÀI
Dán nội dung đã soạn sẵn như khi nhắn tin. Ứng dụng tự tách loại nhà, địa chỉ, diện tích, giá thành từng ô để chủ nhà xem lại, thêm ảnh rồi đăng. Mỗi tài khoản có 3 tin miễn phí mỗi tháng.

AN TOÀN
Số điện thoại người đăng được che, chỉ hiện khi người xem chủ động bấm. Mỗi tin có nút Báo tin để báo tin sai, tin trùng hay dấu hiệu lừa đảo; ban quản trị xem trong 24 giờ.

Một tài khoản dùng chung cho Nhà Đất Số, Xe Việt và Mạng Việc Làm. Xoá tài khoản ngay trong ứng dụng.

name: Night Mumbles: Sleep Talk
description:
Find out what you really say in your sleep, and share the funniest moments as a video.

Put your iPhone by the bed. Night Mumbles listens through the night and keeps only what matters: your talking, laughing, snoring and coughing. Silence is never recorded.

YOUR NIGHT, LIKE A MORNING EPISODE
• The Top 3 funniest moments of your night
• Everything you said, transcribed automatically
• A clear timeline, hour by hour
• "Your night in a word" to sum up the vibe

A SHAREABLE VIDEO IN ONE TAP
• Vertical video with karaoke-style subtitles
• 3 looks: Midnight, Neon, Pyjama
• Share to your socials, Messages or Photos

WHO SNORES THE MOST?
• Snore score from 0 to 100 with a nightly chart
• 7- and 30-day trends and personal records
• Couple mode: tag the clips and settle the weekly duel

BUILT FOR THE NIGHT
• Fall-asleep delay and auto stop at your chosen time
• Dark, discreet recording screen
• Live Activity on the Lock Screen, widgets and Siri shortcuts
• Resumes automatically after a phone call

100% PRIVATE
Detection, transcription and videos all happen on your iPhone. No account, no server, no data collected. Nothing leaves your phone unless you choose to share it.

FREE TO START
Record as many nights as you like and listen to 2 clips per night, plus a full demo night and one free video.

NIGHT MUMBLES PREMIUM
Every clip of every night, unlimited watermark-free videos, trends and the couple duel. 3-day free trial on the weekly plan, then $3.99/week, or $29.99/year. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage them in your Apple Account settings.

Night Mumbles is an entertainment and tracking app, not a medical device. Only record people who agree.

Support: https://schmittutility.fr/assistance/
Privacy: https://schmittutility.fr/confidentialite/
Terms: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: NightClips: Sleep Recorder
description:
Some nights are quieter than others. NightClips is a sleep sound recorder for iPhone and iPad that lets you hear a little of what you slept through. Start a recording at bedtime and, in the morning, listen back to short clips of snoring, sleep talking, or coughing.

One night might surprise you. After a few, you can look back at when sounds happened and compare how long you snored from night to night. If you keep a weight log, you can see it alongside your snoring trend on days with both records.

Set a bedtime reminder for when you like to turn in, or choose when the recording should stop and save. Once you start recording, you can lock your screen and put your device down. NightClips analyzes sound on your device and keeps your recordings there. Save a favorite clip or share one you’d like someone else to hear.

Your first successful recording starts a free week. After that, you can choose a monthly or annual subscription to keep recording. Your saved nights stay available. Subscriptions renew automatically until canceled. See local prices in the app and manage your plan in your Apple Account.

Sound labels are estimates. A clip can also pick up other people in the room.

Privacy Policy
https://xian-888.github.io/nightclips-site/privacy.html

Terms of Use
https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Nightglide Driver App
description:
Nightglide is a driving coach that keeps your data to yourself.

It records your drives automatically and gives you a score out of 1000, so you can see how smoothly you drive and whether you're improving. Everything is worked out and stored on your iPhone. There is no account to create, no server holding your journeys, no adverts and no insurer looking over your shoulder.

WHAT IT MEASURES
• Harsh braking
• Sharp acceleration
• Hard cornering
• Phone handling while moving
• Speeding (against real road limits if you switch that on)

WHAT YOU GET
• An overall score and five category scores, over 14 days or a year
• A coach card that names the one habit to work on next
• Every trip with its route, events and where they happened
• A points ledger for each trip: see what every event cost, and dismiss any that weren't fair
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets with your score
• A Lock Screen banner when you start a drive from the app or Shortcuts
• Siri and Shortcuts actions, so your car's Bluetooth or CarPlay can start the recording
• Units, speed limits and renewal names that follow your country
• Layouts that use both displays of iPhone Duo
• Trends, weekly highlights and your best and worst days
• Estimated fuel cost and CO₂ for each drive
• Reminders for MOT, road tax and insurance dates
• Mark any trip "I wasn't driving" so passenger journeys don't count

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Drives are stored only on your iPhone
• No account, no analytics, no tracking, no adverts
• Export all your trips to a file whenever you like
• Optional extras (street names, road speed limits) are clearly labelled and can be switched off

HOW IT WORKS
Nightglide uses your iPhone's GPS and motion sensors. Set location access to "Always" and it notices when you set off, records the drive and stops when you park. You never need to touch your phone in the car.

Continued use of GPS running in the background can decrease battery life. Scores are estimates for your own interest. Don't use your phone while driving.

name: NINZYA Board M
description:
NINZYA Board M is a modular groovebox for iPhone and iPad. Connect instruments, effects, MIDI and controls to build your own music-making setup.

CONNECT AND CREATE
Place modules on the Canvas and wire them together. Play built-in instruments including PCM, 2 OSC, SAW, Bass, OneShot and Chop. Shape your sound with Reverb, Delay, Graphic EQ, Compressor, Dist, Particul and Shimmer.

WRITE PATTERNS AND PLAY
Edit notes in the Piano Roll and show only the notes in your chosen scale. Play the on-screen keyboard, sequence patterns, and use Step, Bipolar and Mapping to control how your sound changes.

PERFORM WITH FOUR TRACKS
Switch patterns across Tracks A–D and eight banks in Box mode. Mix with vertical faders, stereo peak meters and macros, and follow each track's loop progress as you perform.

HOST AUv3 INSTRUMENTS AND EFFECTS
Load compatible AUv3 plug-ins installed on your device and combine them with built-in modules. Keep the on-screen keyboard in front while playing an AUv3 instrument. Third-party AUv3 apps are obtained separately.

SAVE AND TAKE YOUR MUSIC WITH YOU
Save and load Boards, recover your work with autosave, and export portable copies with your audio and MIDI files. Import and export through the system file picker, including iCloud Drive. External AUv3 plug-ins and their libraries are installed separately on each device.

LEARN BY MAKING MUSIC
Follow five guided tutorial tours covering instruments, wiring, effects, patterns and four-track Box performance. An illustrated manual is included. The interface, tours and manual are available in English and Japanese.

Requires iOS 17 or later on iPhone, or iPadOS 17 or later on iPad. No account registration or external license key is required.

name: nodelings
description:
Connect, loop and pop your way through a world of cheerful little nodes. Works on iPhone Duo.

Drag through two or more nodes of the same colour to clear them. Join a line back to where it started and every node of that colour pops at once. Draw a bigger loop around others and they turn into bombs. It's simple to pick up and endlessly satisfying to master.

14 WORLDS, 14 COMPANIONS
Travel from a snowy owlery to a coral reef, a moonlit fair and sunset dunes. Every world has its own scenery, music and wildlife, and its own companion: fill their meter with heart nodes and they unleash a power that changes the board.

350 TUNED LEVELS, THEN ENDLESS
Work through 350 levels that gently grow in challenge, then keep going with endless levels created as you play. Every one is checked to be solvable.

DOZENS OF PIECES TO MASTER
Ice, snow, honey, currents, prisms, lasers, magnets, balloons, clocks, fireflies, linked pairs and more, each introduced with its own little live demo.

HANDY POWER-UPS
Swap two nodes, paint a few to the colour you need, jump-start your companion, or sweep a whole colour off the board in a gust of wind. Win with three stars to earn suns and spend them on power-ups and boosts.

COSY AND CALM
No timers and no ads. Original generative music for every world, gentle sound and haptics, and backgrounds full of little surprises.

The first 30 levels are free. A single one-time purchase unlocks every level, for good.

name: Nooktap
description:
Nooktap is a dashboard for running Telegram groups and channels through your own bot, and this app puts it in your pocket.

Posting and scheduling
Write a post once and send it to many groups and channels, now or at a time you pick, with repeating posts, polls and a media library.

Moderation and protection
What members report reaches your moderation cases: reply to the message, delete it, or warn, mute or ban its author. Rules against spam and links, and checks for newcomers.

Member support
Members message your bot, your team replies from one inbox, and every ticket has an owner.

Rewards and contests
Points, seasons and leaderboards, plus contests with a recorded draw.

Statistics
Each group's growth, activity, posts and moderation in clear numbers.

Your team and bot
A bot in your own name, and a team that works with you, each with their own role and rights.

On your phone
• Notifications for what matters to you: answers from support and news about your account.
• Sign in with your password and an authenticator code, a passkey, or with Apple, Google or Telegram.
• In Arabic and English, right to left where it should be.
• Delete your account from inside the app whenever you want.

You need a Nooktap account and a bot that is an admin in your group to manage it. You can create the account in the app.

Nooktap is an independent product and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Telegram.

name: North cushion
description:
All aboard Tiny Railway — a cozy color-matching train game for kids and anyone who loves little locomotives!

Check the mission colors at the top, then drag wagons from the tray onto your smiling engine. Couple them in the correct order and watch your train chug away along a winding wooden track.

How to play • Read the color sequence for each level
• Drag the matching wagons to the locomotive
• Avoid the wrong colors — choose carefully
• Complete the train and enjoy the departure

What’s inside • Dozens of bite-size levels across themed railway chapters
• Bright wagons in many colors — more choices as you go
• Soft animations, gentle feedback, and a friendly training guide
• Simple controls: drag, couple, and go

No accounts. No complicated rules. Just cheerful tracks, colorful wagons, and the joy of building the perfect little train.

name: Nova Bastion: Tower Defense
description:
A lone mining base on the edge of the galaxy runs on its energy Core. Alien swarms pour out of the rift to devour it. Build turrets on the deck plates, mine the paths and hold the line!

• Campaign full of missions, bosses and a final showdown
• Turrets and road defenses to upgrade, research and a tech tree
• Daily challenge and Endless mode
• Achievements, records and skins

name: NRM – No Regret Machine
description:
Regret usually comes from either rushing or never trying.

NRM doesn't decide for you. You run one decision through the machine: pull the lever, answer five short questions, and your own answers are printed back to you as a receipt.

• A regret-risk reading based on your mood, the 10-10-10 test and whether the decision can be undone
• Do, Wait or Drop: the decision is still yours
• Weeks or months later, it checks back: "How do you feel now?"
• After 5 check-ins, see your own patterns by area of life and by mood

NRM is a game that works offline and is played using your phone's own settings. No account, no ads, no subscription. Your data stays on your phone.

These results are not guidance. It's just a game. NRM is not a substitute for psychological, medical, financial or legal advice.

One-time purchase.

name: NSight Vendor
description:
NSight Stores is the app for store employees of companies that run product surveys with NSight. Show a shopper the survey for the product they just bought, and hand over their reward when they come back with it.

SHARE A SURVEY
• See your company's active products and which ones have a live survey.
• Open a product to show its survey QR code.
• The shopper scans it with their own phone, verifies their own number and gets the survey link by SMS.
• When a survey is offered as audio and text, ask the shopper which they prefer and switch before they scan.

REDEEM A REWARD
• Scan the shopper's reward QR code with the camera, or type the code printed under it.
• Review the reward before you hand over the item.
• Confirm the handoff. Each reward can be redeemed only once.
• Clear messages when a reward was already redeemed or does not belong to your store.

TRACK YOUR ACTIVITY
• See the surveys you shared and the rewards you redeemed today, in the last 7 days or in the last 30 days.

MADE FOR THE COUNTER
• Sign in with your mobile number.
• Join your store with a staff code from your manager or your work email.
• English and Spanish.
• Light and dark themes.

WHO CAN USE IT
NSight Stores is for employees of companies that use NSight. You need an invitation from your store manager to join a store team. Shoppers do not need this app.

Staff never enter a shopper's phone number or give consent on a shopper's behalf.

name: Numbers Door: Math Puzzle Game
description:
Numbers Door: Math & Logic Puzzles

Every station hides a new number puzzle. Hop aboard, spot the rule, and feel that moment when logic clicks into place.
20 puzzle modes. 20,000 handcrafted levels. Playable 100% offline.

Numbers Door turns math and logic into an engaging mental transit journey. Pick a station along the railway line, advance through its levels, and sharpen your deductive reasoning, mental arithmetic, and working memory—one puzzle at a time.

20 WAYS TO PLAY
• Patterns: Uncover hidden rules and complete numerical sequences.
• Equations: Balance formulas by filling in missing digits or operators.
• Sudoku: Pure deduction grids from approachable 4x4 to classic 9x9.
• Minesweeper: Pure logic board-clearing where every flag is deduced without guessing.
• Mystery Number: Deduce a secret value through range, digit, and divisibility clues.
• Reach the Number: Combine arithmetic cards strategically to hit the target total.
• Number Logic: Solve cross-sum grids from row and column totals.
• Number Rush: Rapid-fire yes/no mental calculation sprints against the clock.
• Sequence Memory: Memorize flashing digit series and recall them forward or in reverse.
• Find the Number: Eliminate distractors to locate the only number fitting all clues.
• Number Balance: Calculate balance weights to level algebraic scales.
• Odd One Out: Identify the rogue number that breaks the governing rule.
• Higher or Lower: Rapidly compare dynamic expressions, fractions, and negative values.
• Closest to Target: Sharpen estimation skills by choosing the value nearest the target.
• Number Maze: Trace a continuous path through number tiles that sums to the goal.
• Number Lock: Crack secret numerical combinations clue by clue.
• Equation Lock: Uncover a hidden algebraic equation with every strategic guess.
• Number Ladder: Climb from a start number to the goal using arithmetic operation tiles.
• Number Chain: Follow a chain of mental operations and calculate the final result.
• Magic Squares: Fill missing cells so every row, column, and diagonal shares the same sum.

DAILY CHALLENGES & STREAKS
• Today's 5: A curated daily lineup across five different game modes with shareable results.
• Weekly Number Hunt: Solve daily puzzles to reveal clues uncovering a secret weekly number.
• Streak Protection: Streak freezes and Streak Rescue ensure a missed day never erases your progress.

DESIGNED FOR STEADY MASTERY
• 20,000 Total Levels: 1,000 verified levels per mode with a gentle difficulty ramp.
• Smart Guidance: 3-step progressive hints that guide without spoiling, plus rule explanations.
• Rewarding Milestones: Collect stars, earn Brain Points, unlock 92 trophies, and build streaks.
• Inclusive Numerals: Switch between Western (123) and Arabic-Indic (١٢٣) digits across 22 languages.
• Comfort Settings: Optional timer, Dark Mode, and Reduce Motion accessibility options.

INSTANT, 100% OFFLINE PLAY
Every board loads instantly the moment you choose a station. Puzzles scale cleanly across all iPhone and iPad screen sizes, and unfinished levels wait right where you paused. With all 20,000 levels built into the app, enjoy seamless offline play without downloads or internet access.

FAIR & SIMPLE
• No Accounts Needed: Open the app and begin playing immediately.
• Clean Monetization: Supported by a small banner and occasional ads between levels, with a single one-time in-app purchase to remove ads permanently.

All aboard. Your next numerical puzzle is waiting.

name: Nurelia Menú
description:
Nurelia Menú es el panel de gestión del menú semanal para restaurantes clientes de Nurelia.

Desde el móvil puedes:
• Editar los platos de cada día de la semana (dos opciones por día).
• Marcar etiquetas como Sin gluten o Vegano.
• Hacer fotos de los platos con la cámara y subirlas al momento.
• Publicar un mensaje destacado para la semana.

Los cambios aparecen al instante en la web de tu restaurante.

La app requiere una cuenta de panel de Nurelia. Si eres cliente y no tienes tu dirección de acceso, escríbenos a info@estudiowebnurelia.com.

name: Oakby
description:
Oakby helps you remember the dates you saved for food already on your shelves.

Open Horizon to see Overdue, Today, This week, and Later. Filter by place, group by date or place, and open Calendar or History when you need a wider view. Tap + to add an item, read a label photo, ask AI for a draft, or reuse a Usual template.

Each item can have a name, quantity, place, opened-on and use-by dates, a note, one label photo, and an optional local reminder. Swipe to mark Used or Discarded, nudge the date by a day, or cycle the place. Nothing from Ask AI or Read label is stored until you confirm and Save.

Usual templates stay on this iPhone so you can add everyday items again quickly. Settings shows a snapshot of overdue and monthly Used / Tossed counts, and lets you clear items with confirmation.

The date you saved. Not a safety judgment. Oakby does not say whether food is safe to eat, estimate calories, or suggest recipes.

Works offline for adding, editing, marking, Usual, Calendar, History, and clearing. Ask AI and Read label need a network for that one request.

name: oboly
description:
oboly is a flashcard app that helps you learn something and keep it. Turn a topic, your notes or an Anki deck into cards, or design your own, and oboly brings each one back just before you would forget it.

How to design cards:
Place text, images and audio wherever you want them on either side of a card. Style each part with its own font, size, colour and alignment, and save the layout as a template for the rest of the deck. Combine text, images, audio, type-in answers, multiple choice, fill in the blank, hints, example sentences, image occlusion, formulas, code and a drawing pad. Readings can sit above words, as in Japanese.

How to start:
• Generate with AI: chat with oboly. Name a topic, paste your notes, or add photos and PDFs, and it writes the cards.
• Import from Anki: open an Anki deck file and keep studying, with its card templates, pictures and audio.
• Build your own: start from an empty card or one of your templates.

Share your amazing decks with the community:
Publish your decks or find one someone else made. Search by name, topic or tag, preview the cards, rate decks, comment on cards, and send anyone a link to a deck.

name: OGA - Okul Güvenlik Ağı
description:
OGA - Okul Güvenlik Ağı, okul giriş-çıkışlarını, yoklamaları, izinleri ve acil durumları tek uygulamada birleştirir. Kapıdan geçen her öğrenci kaydedilir, veli anında bilgilendirilir, yönetim okulda kimin olduğunu canlı olarak görür.

Uygulamayı okul yöneticileri, öğretmenler, kapı ve nöbet görevlileri ile veliler kullanır. Öğrencilerin uygulama kullanması gerekmez; okula NFC kart veya QR kimlik ile girip çıkarlar.

KAPI VE KİOSK GEÇİŞİ
• Telefon veya tablet, okul kapısında kiosk olarak çalışır; ek donanım gerekmez.
• NFC kart, dinamik QR ve basılı QR kimlik okur.
• İnternet kesilse de çalışır; bağlantı gelince kayıtları eşitler.
• Turnike sistemlerine bağlanabilir.

CANLI MEVCUT TAKİBİ
• Şu an okulda kaç öğrenci, öğretmen, personel ve ziyaretçi olduğunu anlık görün.
• Giriş, çıkış ve reddedilen geçişler canlı akışta listelenir.

YOKLAMA VE ÇAPRAZ DENETİM
• Sabah yoklaması: gelmeyen ve geç kalan öğrenciler otomatik çıkar.
• Ders yoklaması öğretmen tarafından birkaç dokunuşla alınır.
• "Okulda ama derste yok": Kapıdan girip derse girmeyen öğrenci saniyesinde listelenir ve ilgili yöneticiye iletilir.

İZİN, MAZERET VE ÇIKIŞ FİŞİ
• Veli talep eder, idare onaylar, kapı dijital çıkış fişini doğrular.
• Öğle arası izni, belirlenen saat penceresinde otomatik işler.
• Kâğıt dilekçe ve imza takibi ortadan kalkar.

VELİ BİLGİLENDİRME
• Giriş, çıkış, devamsızlık ve izin bildirimleri veliye anında ulaşır.
• Okul duyuruları tek ekrandan gönderilir.

ACİL DURUM VE TAHLİYE
• Deprem, yangın, güvenlik ve tahliye alarmı tek dokunuşla seçilen kişilere iletilir.
• Toplanma alanında "güvende" teyidi canlı sayılır; sınıf sınıf kimin eksik olduğu görülür.
• Tahliye listesi tek dokunuşla hazırlanır.

OKUL YÖNETİMİ
• Nöbetçi öğretmen planlama ve nöbet yerleri
• Ziyaretçi kaydı ve veli-öğretmen randevuları
• Personel giriş-çıkış takibi
• Analitik: geç kalma eğilimi, devamsızlık ve kronik geç kalanlar
• TV ve pano ekranı için canlı görünüm
• e-Okul listelerinden öğrenci aktarımı

YATILI OKULLAR VE YEMEKHANE (ek hizmet)
• Pansiyon: evci ve çarşı izni, erken dönüş, etüt ve gece yoklaması
• Yemekhane: kart veya QR ile yemekhane girişi ve günlük takip

AZ VERİ, KVKK ODAKLI
• Öğrenci için yalnızca ad, soyad ve sınıf bilgisi tutulur; fotoğraf isteğe bağlıdır.
• Rol bazlı yetkilendirme, iki aşamalı doğrulama ve değiştirilemez geçiş kaydı.

iPhone, iPad ve Mac'te aynı hesapla çalışır; telefonda hızlı kontrol, büyük ekranda tam panel.

ÖNEMLİ
OGA, okulların kurum hesabıyla kullandığı bir sistemdir. Uygulamaya giriş için okulunuzun size kullanıcı tanımlaması gerekir. OGA okul güvenliğine yardımcı bir kayıt ve bilgilendirme aracıdır; okulun kendi güvenlik tedbirlerinin yerine geçmez.

OGA - Okul Güvenlik Ağı bir BAF Dijital ürünüdür.

name: Ojo al hueco: Reporta baches
description:
Ojo al hueco es el mapa ciudadano para visibilizar los baches y desperfectos de las calles y carreteras. Toma una foto, márcalo en el mapa y lleva la cuenta de cuántos días lleva sin arreglarse.

SIN CUENTA NI TU NOMBRE
• No pide registro, correo electrónico, cédula ni teléfono.
• Antes de subir cualquier foto, la app elimina en tu propio teléfono todos los metadatos EXIF (ubicación incrustada, fecha y modelo del dispositivo).
• Tu teléfono usa un identificador aleatorio convertido en huella anónima únicamente para evitar duplicados y spam.

MAPA EN VIVO DE TU CIUDAD
• Explora los huecos reportados cerca de ti clasificados por gravedad: Pequeño (se puede esquivar), Mediano (obliga a frenar) y Peligroso (daña carros o tumba motos).
• Filtra por gravedad o revisa los huecos que ya fueron arreglados en los últimos 90 días.
• Busca cualquier avenida, calle, urbanización o sector.

SUMA TU REPORTE Y CONFIRMA ARREGLOS
• Si ya hay un hueco reportado a menos de 15 metros, la app te muestra su foto y pregunta «¿Es este?» para sumar tu reporte al mismo punto.
• En la ficha de cualquier bache puedes tocar «Yo también lo vi (+1)» para confirmar que sigue abierto.
• Cuando reparen la vía, toca «Ya lo arreglaron»: al confirmarlo 3 personas distintas, el pin pasa a verde en el mapa.

RANKING Y TARJETA PARA COMPARTIR
• Consulta el ranking de los huecos abiertos a 20 km de ti ordenados por más días sin arreglar o por más reportes.
• Genera al instante una tarjeta vertical lista para compartir en WhatsApp e historias de Instagram con la foto, los días sin arreglar y la dirección aproximada.
• Recibe avisos cuando otra persona confirme un hueco que reportaste o cuando lo marquen como arreglado.

Desarrollado por Web Bonding, C.A. · ¿Dudas o sugerencias? En Ayuda te atiende nuestro equipo.

name: Okayfon: Phone Check & Test
description:
Buying a used iPhone? Check it right at the meeting — before you pay.

Okayfon walks you through 24 hardware checks one by one and tells you exactly what to do at each step. Short on time? The quick check covers what breaks most often in about five minutes.

SCREEN
• Dead pixels — solid colors reveal stuck dots, spots and stripes
• Burn-in — even grays show ghost images left on OLED screens
• Touchscreen — paint every square of a grid to find dead zones
• Multi-touch

SOUND
• Bottom speaker, top speaker and the earpiece used for calls
• Every microphone, one at a time
• Recording quality — record your voice with each microphone and listen back
• Vibration motor
Speakers and vibration play a random number of beeps or pulses — answer the right number and the part works. No guessing.

CAMERAS
• Every lens, front and back, with a live picture
• Autofocus — the lens must focus near and far
• Flashlight

SENSORS AND BUTTONS
• Face ID or Touch ID
• Proximity sensor, accelerometer, gyroscope, compass, barometer
• Volume and side buttons

BATTERY AND PERFORMANCE
• Charging port or wireless charging
• Performance — iOS slows down phones whose battery is worn out. Okayfon measures processor speed and compares it with a new phone of the same model.

CONNECTIVITY
• NFC — the chip Apple Pay uses
• Wi-Fi, cellular, GPS and Bluetooth

BEFORE YOU BUY
iOS doesn't let any app read battery health, IMEI, Activation Lock or repair history. Okayfon shows you exactly where to find each of them in Settings and what to look for.

A REPORT YOU CAN TRUST
Share the report as a picture or PDF. Every report has a number and a QR code: scan it in Okayfon to see the original results, so an edited picture won't fool you.

SELLING YOUR PHONE?
Switch to Selling, run the full check and attach the report to your listing. Buyers can verify it in seconds.

COMPARE PHONES
Looking at several phones? Scan each one's report and compare them in History.

ALSO INCLUDED
• Speaker cleaner — low tones that push water and dust out of the speaker grille
• Sound meter

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Free. No account, no ads, no tracking, no data collected. Works fully offline; results stay on the phone.

Okayfon checks whether the hardware responds. It can't detect every hidden fault, so also look the phone over carefully and check the items in Before you buy.

name: Okey Open
description:
Carry the traditional Okey experience in your pocket with Okey Açak—featuring a modern, fluid, and fast-paced design! Practice offline against smart AI bots, or join online tables to compete against real players and friends.

KEY FEATURES:
• Single-Player & Online Modes: Play against AI whenever you like, or create an online room and invite your friends to the table.
• Fluid and Intuitive Table Design: Easily drag and drop tiles, and organize your sets (runs) and pairs with zero hassle.
• Multi-Round Play & Clear Score Tracking: Set the number of rounds; automatically track revealed hands, the value of remaining tiles, and your overall score.
• Turkish and English Language Support: Switch your language preference within the app at any time.

Take your seat at the table, arrange your tiles, and enjoy the game!

name: Omni Hub: Everyday Tools
description:
Omni Hub is an all-in-one toolbox for everyday tasks: a private PIN-locked Vault, Subscription Calculator, Sleep Mode, Debt Tracker, calculator, notes and more, all in one clean, fast app. No clutter, no account required.

NO ACCOUNT NEEDED
Sign-up is never required to use Omni Hub. Everything you create is stored on your iPhone, and you are always in control: back up your data to a file whenever you like, or clear it all with one tap. No ads, no tracking.

OPTIONAL: SYNC ACROSS YOUR DEVICES
Want your data on more than one device? Sign in with Apple or Google, entirely optional, to sync Notes, Checklist, Expense Tracker, Budget, Subscription Calculator, Debt Tracker, Alarms and your private Vault. Your Vault stays protected: only your already PIN-encrypted data leaves your device, and your PIN never does. Nothing is shared or sold. You can delete your account and its synced data from inside the app at any time.

26+ TOOLS

Essentials
• Calculator, with a history of your past calculations
• Scientific Calculator: trig, logs, powers and constants
• Percentage Calculator: X% of Y, percent change and more
• Unit Converter: length, weight, temperature, volume, speed, area and data
• Timer: a simple countdown
• Stopwatch, with lap times
• Alarm: alarms with optional backup rings, delivered as time-sensitive notifications
• Sleep Mode: bedtime reminders that talk you into putting the phone down

Utilities
• Compass
• Flashlight
• QR Scanner
• Barcode Scanner

Productivity
• Notes: write, edit, pin and search
• Checklist: multiple lists, check items off, reorder them

Finance
• Expense Tracker: log spending by category with a monthly breakdown
• Budget: monthly limits per category, tracked against your spending
• Tip Calculator
• Split Bill
• Subscription Calculator: track recurring costs
• Debt Tracker: who owes you, and who you owe

Time & Date
• Age Calculator
• Date Calculator: days between dates, or add and subtract days
• Time Zone: a world clock for the cities you care about
• Time Difference: how far ahead or behind two cities are

Fun
• Random Generator: dice, coin flip, random number, or pick from a list

Plus a private Vault, locked with a PIN and Face ID or Touch ID, for notes, photos and files you want extra protected.

FIND WHAT YOU NEED, FAST
Start typing in the search bar. Omni Hub understands what you mean, not just tool names: "split" finds the bill splitter, "how old" the age calculator, "cm to inches" the converter. Pin your most-used tools to the Home screen and drag to reorder them.

A CLEAN, FOCUSED APP
Fast and simple, with a dark and a light theme. Every permission Omni Hub asks for is used only for the feature that needs it; the privacy policy says exactly what each one does.

name: OmniSQL
description:
OmniSQL is a client for Microsoft SQL Server, built for iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo. Connect to your own server, run queries, and work with the results. Everything is included. There is no paywall, no row limit and no account.
QUERY
• SQL editor with colored syntax, line numbers and several queries open at once
• Table and column suggestions as you type
• Statement Templates that fill in Select, Insert, Update, Delete, Join and more for the table you pick
• Library with saved queries, a history of what you ran, and .sql files
RESULTS
• Fast grid with sorting by any column
• Pie chart of any result
• Edit a value in the grid, or edit and delete a single row, with the statement shown before it is saved
• Export as CSV, Excel, PDF with the chart, JSON or SQL Insert, or copy to the clipboard
SCHEMA
• Tables, views, procedures and functions with their columns and parameters
• Switch database, view Create and Alter statements, create a table, drop a table or view
• ER Diagram of your tables and their relationships, exportable as a picture
• Find Anywhere searches for a value across every table and column
SAFETY
• Try Changes runs an Update or Delete, shows the rows it affects before and after, and undoes it automatically
• Read-Only Mode blocks every statement that changes data
• Single-row edits are saved only if exactly one row changed
• You approve a server's certificate before the first sign-in, and the app remembers that one certificate
• Passwords are kept in the device Keychain and can require Face ID or Touch ID
• App Lock covers the whole app until you unlock it
SERVER
• Server Health shows database sizes, active and blocked sessions and last backups, with charts
• SQL Server Agent jobs: run status, run history report with export, start a job, create a job
PRIVATE BY DESIGN OmniSQL connects directly from your device to your server. There is no OmniSQL account, no analytics, no advertising and no tracking. We never see your connections, queries or results.
TRY IT WITHOUT A SERVER A built-in Sample Database lets you try the editor, results, charts, exports and schema tools right away.
OmniSQL is designed for iPhone Duo, with layouts that keep content clear of the fold, and supports Light, Dark and System appearance.
Microsoft and SQL Server are trademarks of the Microsoft group of companies. OmniSQL is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft.

name: On Time Fashions
description:
Shop On Time Fashions Birmingham from your phone. Explore streetwear and dresswear, discover new arrivals, and find pieces for your next look.

Browse denim, matching sets, accessories, Big & Tall, kids' styles and women's clothing. View product photos, prices and available options, save favorites to your wishlist, and shop through our Shopify store.

Find store hours, contact details, shipping information and return policies in one place.

Need help with an order or a visit? Reach us at customerservice@ontimebirmingham.com.

name: One Habit Check-In
description:
Pick one habit. Tap Done. See today's square fill in.
One Habit Check-In is the simplest way to build a single habit: one big button, one calendar, one streak.
Two taps take you from first launch to your first check-in.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Name your habit, or tap an example like Read, Walk or Practice.
2. Each day you do it, tap Done. Today's square fills in with a checkmark.
3. Watch your streak grow and browse every month of your history.

MADE TO KEEP GOING
- A big streak number, plus your best streak and total days
- A month calendar where every done day is filled and checked, so it reads without color
- Undo is one tap away if you tapped too soon
- One check-in per day, no matter how many times you tap
- Works across midnight and time-zone changes: each check-in belongs to the day you saw on your phone
- An optional daily reminder, offered after your first check-in and set only when you turn it on

PREMIUM
- Track more than one habit, each with its own calendar and streak
- Separate reminders for each habit, and more than one a day
- Export your full history as a CSV file

If Premium ends, nothing is deleted. Every habit and its history stays readable.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your habits, check-ins and reminder times stay on your iPhone.

SUBSCRIPTION
Premium is optional: $2.99 per week with a 3-day free trial, or $14.99 per year. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/one-habit-check-in/privacy
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/one-habit-check-in/terms

name: OnixMail
description:
OnixMail est l'application mobile de votre messagerie professionnelle OnixMail, un produit Tornixtech. Retrouvez votre boîte, lisez vos messages et répondez où que vous soyez.

LIRE
• Votre boîte de réception avec des catégories : Principal, Réseaux sociaux, Promotions et Agents IA
• Un repère d'importance sur les messages qui comptent pour vous
• Une lecture sûre : le contenu des messages est nettoyé et les images distantes sont bloquées tant que vous ne les affichez pas
• Les pièces jointes s'ouvrent ou se partagent en un geste
• Recherche dans vos messages et actualisation par tirage
• Lecture hors connexion : les messages déjà ouverts et la dernière liste de chaque dossier restent disponibles sans réseau

AGIR
• Répondre, répondre à tous et transférer
• Écrire un message avec des fichiers ou des photos, depuis l'appareil photo ou votre galerie
• Brouillons enregistrés
• Glisser un message pour l'archiver ou le supprimer

ÊTRE PRÉVENU

name: Only Notas
description:
O Only Notas é o espaço de trabalho da sua equipe: documentos, wiki, quadros de tarefas, bancos de dados e quadros brancos num lugar só. É o mesmo Notas do computador, agora com o que só o iPhone e o iPad fazem.

No iPhone e no iPad:
• Compartilhar → Notas: mande um link do Safari, um print, fotos ou um PDF de qualquer app para a nota do dia ou para uma página nova.
• Escanear documento: fotografe contratos, recibos e anotações; a câmera recorta e endireita as folhas e o PDF entra na página.
• Avisos com o app fechado: menções, tarefas atribuídas a você, comentários e prazos. O número de pendências do Inbox aparece no ícone.

• Links do Notas abrem direto no app, inclusive o código curto das tarefas (ex.: CLI-17).

E todo o Notas:
• Páginas com títulos, listas, tabelas, imagens, PDFs, vídeos, diagramas e menções a pessoas e páginas.
• Quadros de tarefas com responsáveis, prazos, etiquetas, subtarefas, comentários e histórico.
• Bancos de dados em tabela, quadro, lista, calendário, linha do tempo, galeria e gráfico.
• Inbox com o que precisa de você: limpe o que resolveu e adie o resto.
• Busca em tudo, inclusive pelo código da tarefa.
• Páginas verificadas, permissões por página e grupos.
• IA do Notas, que conversa com o conteúdo do espaço e cria quadros, fluxogramas e páginas.

O acesso é por convite: quem administra o espaço da empresa convida as pessoas da equipe.

name: OonaRestore: Old Photos
description:
Bring old, cracked, creased, torn, faded, and black-and-white family photographs back to life in seconds. OonaRestore repairs physical photo damage while keeping every face, expression, and pair of eyeglasses 100% authentic.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Sign in with Apple or Google (includes 5 free photo restorations every month) and pick a photograph with the iOS Photos Picker or scan a printed photo with your camera.
2. Choose 1. Restore Only (Keep Tone & Colors) or 2. Restore & Add Colors, optionally add a custom cleanup note, and select Original Size, 1K, 1.5K, or 2K HD.
3. Every restored photo is automatically saved inside your My Pictures tab in OonaRestore (encrypted client-side with AES-256-GCM across your devices). Drag the interactive Before/After split slider, pinch to zoom up to 5×, or tap Save a Copy to Photos anytime.

PLANS & AUTO-RENEWABLE SUBSCRIPTIONS
• Free Plan: 5 photo restorations per month at 1K resolution + encrypted cross-device gallery sync.
• OonaRestore Plus ($3.99/month): 100 photo restorations per month + Enhanced Medium HD quality + Original Size, 1K, 1.5K & 2K HD.
• OonaRestore Pro ($9.99/month): 300 photo restorations per month + Enhanced Medium HD quality + Original Size, 1K, 1.5K & 2K HD.

Subscriptions are billed monthly to your Apple Account and renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in iOS Settings → Apple Account → Subscriptions.

PRIVACY & DATA CONTROL
• Zero ads, zero third-party tracking SDKs, and no broad photo library read permissions (uses the system Photos Picker).
• Saved gallery photos sync encrypted with AES-256-GCM. We never sell personal data or train AI models on your family photos.
• Tap Settings → Delete Account & Data anytime to permanently delete your account, encrypted gallery, and server records immediately.

name: OPAN Work
description:
OPAN Work là ứng dụng làm việc nội bộ dành cho nhân sự hệ thống OPAN (thiết kế, thi công, nội thất). Mọi công việc trong ngày nằm gọn trong một ứng dụng, đồng bộ với bản web work.opanvietnam.com.

TÍNH NĂNG CHÍNH

name: Open Regatta
description:
Open Regatta is a free 3D sailing game for 8 to 15 year olds who sail an Optimist, or dream of it. Have fun while learning everything you do at the sailing club: read the wind, trim your sail, tack and get a good start.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY

• Sailing school: 16 short guided lessons with stars to earn. Wind, points of sail, trim, tacking, rounding marks, the start… Perfect for beginners, or to revise before the club.
• Free sailing: pick the weather, from light airs to strong wind, sail anywhere in the bay and take on challenges.
• Regattas: race against Optimists sailed by the computer, or play a three-race championship (windward–leeward, triangle, then trapezoid). Up to 20 boats on the line.

ONLINE REGATTAS WITH YOUR FRIENDS

Create a regatta, pick the course and the weather, then give the 6-digit code to your friends. You can also join a public regatta, or fill the fleet with computer boats.

WHAT YOU LEARN

• Points of sail, from close-hauled to running downwind
• Sail trim: sheet in, ease out, watch the telltales
• Tacking and gybing, hiking out, and righting the boat after a capsize
• The start sequence: the signals, the line, and not crossing too early
• Basic racing rules: port and starboard, windward and leeward, and penalties

MADE FOR KIDS

• Free: no ads, no in-app purchases
• No account, no email, no first name: online, everyone is just their sail number, like on the water
• No chat and no free text between players
• No trackers and no analytics
• Sailing school, free sailing and regattas against the computer work offline
• Steering aids adjust to each player's level

name: Open Sesame: Vault Puzzle
description:
Rocco the raccoon is the world's sneakiest safecracker — and every vault in town is begging to be cracked.

OPEN SESAME is a feel-good heist puzzle about spinning chunky brass dials, lining up their glowing notches, and popping every red bolt until the vault swings open in a shower of loot.

HOW TO PLAY
• Drag a dial to spin it. It clicks into 12 notches.
• When the notches of TWO dials line up under a bolt at the same moment — ka-CHINK! The bolt rockets out.
• Pop every bolt and the door creaks open. Most vaults hide another, trickier door inside…
• Crack the vault in as few moves as you can to earn 3 stars. Par is the safe-cracker's honor code.

A PUZZLE THAT FIGHTS BACK (POLITELY)
• Geared dials counter-rotate together — one grab spins two dials, and planning the perfect cascade is pure joy.
• Rusted dials refuse to budge until you free them by popping the right bolt first.
• Gang bolts are chained together and only blow when everything aligns at once.
• Two-notch dials, multi-door vaults, and 45 handcrafted-and-solver-verified levels across 3 chapters: The Piggy Bank Job, The Museum Caper, and The Casino Vault.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT
• That ka-CHINK never gets old: pitch-ladder pops, combo counters, tumbling dials, confetti heists.
• No timers, no energy bars, no accounts. Just you versus the vault at your own pace — with optional Laser Sight hints whenever a tricky mechanism stumps you.
• Plays offline, saves locally, one-thumb friendly portrait controls.
• Rocco reacts to everything. He's very proud of you.

PLAY ANYWHERE
Crack vaults offline on commutes or flights, save progress automatically on your device, and jump right into the heist with zero sign-up required.

Spin. Pop. Crack. The vault is waiting.

name: OpenLounge: Airport Lounges
description:
Know which airport lounges you can enter before you walk to the gate.
Add the cards, memberships and airline status you hold. OpenLounge shows every lounge at your airport and the ones that open to you.
More than 2,500 lounges at 933 airports in 164 countries. The lounge data works offline.

NOW
Open the app at the airport and it finds the nearest one from your location. A map puts a pin on each lounge. See what is open right now, and an hours chart for the whole day.

EXPLORE
Search any airport by code, city or country. Browse the airports with the most lounges, or go country by country.

WALLET
Add what you hold: premium credit cards such as Amex Platinum, Chase Sapphire Reserve and Capital One Venture X, memberships such as Priority Pass, and airline elite status. Each item shows how many lounges it opens and its rules: guests, guest fees and visit limits.

EVERY LOUNGE
- Terminal and where to find it
- Opening hours
- Amenities, such as showers, hot food, quiet areas and sleep rooms
- Who gets in, and with how many guests
- A link to the official page

PASSPORT
Log your visits and rate them. Your log is yours alone and syncs through your iCloud.

WHAT IS INSIDE
2,827 places, among them 2,568 lounges and 229 restaurants and other Priority Pass experiences. Airline lounges of Star Alliance, oneworld and SkyTeam. Card-issuer lounges. Pay-in lounges.

The lounge data is on your phone, so it works without a connection. The map needs one. The data updates by itself.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No purchases. OpenLounge collects nothing. Your location stays on your phone. The app stores card names only, never a card number.

OpenLounge is an independent app. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by or endorsed by any airline, airport, lounge operator, card issuer or membership program. Names are used only to identify them.

name: OpenScr
description:
OpenScr (Open Smartphone Code Runner) is a learning and developer tool. Write small web programs in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, keep them in your own GitHub repository, and run them on your iPhone or iPad to see how they behave on a real device.

A program for OpenScr is called an OpenScrapp. It is a folder with an openscr.json file and your web files, stored in a GitHub repository that you own.

HOW IT WORKS
- Sign in with your own GitHub account.
- Add one of your own repositories. OpenScr only loads repositories owned by the account that is signed in. Repositories of other people or organizations are rejected.
- Open your OpenScrapp. It runs on your device while a development bar stays visible with Back and Source.
- Tap Source at any time to read the HTML and JavaScript files that are running.

BUILT FOR LEARNING
- The source code of what runs is always one tap away, so you can see exactly what your program does.
- A built-in first example shows how storage and vibration work.
- The running program uses at most 80% of the screen height, so the development environment stays visible.

DEVICE ACCESS FOR YOUR OWN CODE
Your OpenScrapp can use local storage, HTTP requests, accelerometer and gyroscope, Bluetooth Low Energy and vibration. Each of these needs your one-time consent. OpenScr does not give your code access to the file system, contacts or your location.

PRIVACY
There is no OpenScr account and no OpenScr server. The app has no ads and no analytics. Your GitHub token stays on your device and is sent only to GitHub. Signing out deletes it.

OpenScr is a tool for people who write their own code. Think of it as a small playground for web programs on your phone.

name: Orginfo Maps
description:
Orginfo Maps is the map of Uzbekistan from Orginfo. Find places, organisations and addresses, see opening hours, phone numbers and reviews, and plan your trip by car, on foot or by public transport.

SEARCH

name: OROX : Fitness Course Hybride
description:
OROX, c'est l'app des simus de course hybride : trouve ta prochaine compétition, ton binôme et ta salle d'entraînement, au même endroit.

Course + ateliers fonctionnels (SkiErg, sled push, sled pull, burpees, rameur, farmers carry, fentes, wall balls) : le format explose et les simus organisées par les salles se multiplient partout en France. OROX les rassemble pour que tu n'en rates plus aucune.

L'AGENDA DES SIMUS

• Filtre par ville et rayon, période, prix et format : Solo, Double, Relais
• Fiche complète : date, lieu, tarifs par catégorie, parcours et charges, places restantes quand elles sont connues
• Itinéraire, inscription chez l'organisateur et partage en un geste

TROUVE TON BINÔME

• Score de compatibilité pour trouver le bon partenaire
• « Je suis dispo » : envoie ta demande, et les coordonnées s'échangent seulement quand elle est acceptée

OÙ S'ENTRAÎNER
• Plus de 1 000 salles en France où préparer ta compétition
• Carte, recherche par ville ou code postal, coachs de la salle
• « Je m'entraîne ici » : retrouve les sportifs de ta salle

ALERTES

• Plus que quelques places sur une simu en favori
• Rappel avant la clôture des inscriptions
• Nouvelle demande de partenaire ou demande acceptée
Chaque alerte se règle dans l'app, avec un rayon au choix.

PENSÉ POUR LES SPORTIFS

• Consultable sans compte : le compte sert seulement pour les favoris, les annonces et les alertes
• Connexion avec Apple, Google ou email
• Ta position n'est jamais enregistrée : seule ta ville sert à trouver ce qui est près de toi
• Suppression du compte en un geste depuis le profil

Que tu prépares ta première simu ou que tu vises un chrono en catégorie Pro, OROX t'aide à trouver la course, le partenaire et la salle.

OROX est une app indépendante : elle n'est ni affiliée ni approuvée par un organisateur de courses ou une marque de compétition.

name: Orrelis
description:
Orrelis is a small offline wardrobe tracker. Add the garments you actually own — a category, the price you paid, an optional care note — and log one wear each time you put something on.
From those two things it answers two questions. What should I wear today? The piece you have worn least in the last ninety days, and the longest ago. Has this earned its keep? The price divided by the number of wears you logged.

name: Orvynex Seal TacticsPro
description:
Orvynex Seal TacticsPro: Challenge Fate bundles three original strategy card games into one hand-illustrated world of gold, parchment, and starlight. Each game asks you to think a few moves ahead, not react.

Sealbound: Travel through eight gates. Build card combinations to break each seal before your turns run out. Fate Shifts change the rules mid-run, and at every Crossroads you pick a path that reshapes the gates ahead.
Orrery of Cards: A 3D puzzle with cards mounted on four brass rings around a glowing core. Rotate the rings to line matching cards along the meridian. Every turn drags the neighbouring rings, so each move needs a plan.
Fate Duel: A one-on-one tactics game against six computer rivals, each with a distinct style. Place cards across three lanes, plan lane by lane, and reinforce at the right moment. Climb the ladder to face the final rival.
Daily rewards, quests, and hand-crafted Portal challenges keep each session fresh. Crowns are earned only through play. Spend them in the Treasury to unlock new card backs, and watch your Constellations light up as achievements fall. The Observatory tracks every seal broken, every ring aligned, and every ladder climbed. Adjust sound, haptics, reduced motion, and gameplay tips in your Profile.

name: PaceTock: ADHD Visual Timer
description:
See time pass. Learn how long things really take you.

PaceTock is a visual timer designed with ADHD and time blindness in mind. Make a time estimate, watch the liquid timer, and compare your guess with the actual time. Use it for studying, work, chores, or getting ready, with a calm companion and no streaks to maintain.

START WITH ONE SMALL TASK
Choose a task, make a time guess, and start. If procrastination makes starting hard, try Just 2 Minutes. No account or setup needed.

SEE TIME PASS
Watch the visual countdown or open full-screen Focus view. Pause when you need to, add more time, or finish early. If you go past your guess, PaceTock keeps counting without calling it a failure.

KEEP YOUR TIMER CLOSE
Check time on your Lock Screen or Dynamic Island on supported devices. Add time or finish without opening the app. Use widgets to start a task from your Home Screen.

GROW SOMETHING THAT LASTS
Every finished timer adds a flower to PaceTock's garden. Flowers never wilt. There are no lost streaks and no punishments for taking a break.

LEARN YOUR REAL TIMES WITH PACETOCK PRO
Compare your guesses with how long tasks took. See weekly totals, time by task, and patterns you can use for your next estimate.

PLAN ROUTINES WITH PACETOCK PRO
Put tasks in order for getting ready, cooking, or winding down. Add an optional finish time to see when to start. Run your routine one step at a time.

MORE WITH PRO
Turn on Timer Chimes for milestone cues, set Overtime Reminders, and choose more colors for PaceTock. Chimes play while the app is open; cues arrive as quiet notifications when it is not.

FREE TO START, WITH NO TIMER LIMIT
The visual timer, Focus view, pause, Just 2 Minutes, Lock Screen controls, widgets, and PaceTock's garden stay free. PaceTock Pro adds insights, routine planning, timer chimes, overtime reminders, and companion colors.

Choose a yearly subscription or a lifetime purchase. Prices and any available free-trial terms appear before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation, or after a free trial if one applies. The yearly subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Any unused portion of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription. Manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings. Lifetime is a one-time purchase, not a subscription.

Made for iPhone and iPad. PaceTock is a planning tool, not medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

name: Paddlecubit
description:
A Greenland paddle has always been measured off the paddler. The length is your arm span plus a cubit, the loom is your shoulder width plus a fist, and the blade is as wide as your palm. Paddlecubit turns those old rules into a full drawing you can carve from.

Start with Measure Me. Six measurements, each with a sketch showing where the tape goes: arm span, cubit, shoulder width, fist, palm and wrist. The app builds the paddle straight away: overall length, loom, blade length, a 40 mm shoulder transition, blade width at the tip, and a thickness taper from 28 mm at the shoulder to 14 mm at the tip.

Then shape it the way you want. The Profile Editor shows the blade from above and from the side, with a station every 50 mm. Drag any point or type a number in millimetres or inches; both blades follow.

How stiff, and how heavy?
Pick one of 16 woods: western red cedar, Sitka spruce, eastern white pine, yellow cypress, Port Orford cedar, firs, redwood and more. Paddlecubit treats the blade as a beam clamped at the shoulder with 100 N on the tip, integrates the curve numerically along every station, and plots the deflection. It also adds up the mass of both blades and the loom. Change one station and both numbers update.

Will the board do?
Blank Check compares the widest and thickest sections with your board вЂ” a 38 Г— 89 mm two-by-four by default. It tells you whether the paddle fits, how many edge-glued lamellae you need when the blade is wider than the board, or that the board is too thin. An end-grain view shows the section inside the board and how to orient the growth rings.

Print it at full size
Templates come out at 1:1 on A4 or Letter: the top profile, the side profile, a cross-section for every station, and a station map for marking the blank. Long profiles are split across sheets with registration crosses and an overlap ruler. Every template sheet carries a 50 mm check square and a 100 mm bar so you can confirm the scale before you cut.

Included without paying: one paddle, every calculation, and printing of all templates.
Paddlecubit Pro, a single purchase, adds the Storm paddle, glued blanks of two or three lamellae, your own wood species, several saved paddles with a side-by-side comparison of flex and mass, and export of the whole template kit as one PDF.

Wood figures are typical reference values at 12% moisture content. Every board is different, so weigh and flex-test yours as you go.

Paddlecubit works entirely on your device. No account, no ads, no tracking.

name: Page Assistant
description:
Page Assistant adds a chat panel to Safari that answers questions about the page you're reading.

Ask a question and get a short answer, with source buttons that scroll to the passage it came from. Tap "Key points" for an overview and a few bullet points. On a long article, Page Assistant reads the whole page in parts, and if an answer isn't in the part it read first, "Search the whole page" looks through the rest.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Answers come from Apple Intelligence on your device. The page and your questions never leave it.
• No account, no tracking, no analytics. Chats disappear when you leave the page.
• The extension runs only on the page where you open it.

MADE FOR SAFARI
• Open it from the toolbar button or with Option-Shift-A on Mac.
• Select text, then ask about just that part.

REQUIREMENTS

name: Paint Measure Estimate
description:
Build a painting estimate you can explain.

Paint Measure Estimate connects room measurements, doors and windows, coats, coverage and labor in one saved project.

CAPTURE THE ROOM
Use room scanning on supported LiDAR-equipped devices or enter dimensions manually. Review wall lengths and height, then correct the geometry before relying on it.

ACCOUNT FOR THE OPENINGS
Enter door and window dimensions and quantities. Opening deductions reduce the paintable wall area. Include ceilings when the job requires them.

SEPARATE THE COLORS
Keep room colors and finishes organized. Container quantities round up separately for each color, so unused paint for one color does not silently offset another.

USE YOUR OWN RATES
Set coverage, coats, waste allowance, container size, material price and labor rate. Review the quantities and estimated cost before exporting a PDF with Plus.

TRY ONE PROJECT
Free access includes one saved painting project and watermarked PDF previews. Plus unlocks continued project creation and complete exports. Existing work remains readable and editable after expiry.

Results are estimates. Surface condition, application method and manufacturer specifications affect actual usage. Verify measurements and coverage before ordering.

Subscription prices and billing periods are shown before purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel in your Apple subscription settings. Restore Purchases is available in the app.

Set a room goal and review each saved room’s detected wall coverage. Shape a room in 3D, label it, and place doors or windows on a wall you choose. Optional photos stay with the room where you took them.

name: Panelnote
description:
Panelnote is a household notebook for the directories inside your electrical panels.

Write each panel, the slot numbers you can read on the door, the rooms those breakers feed, and the appliance watts you want to remember. When something goes dark, add a short outage note that points at the slot you reset. Lookup finds a breaker from a room or appliance name without opening every panel door.

The watt check adds the watts you typed for one breaker and compares them with amps times 120 for a single pole, or amps times 240 for a double pole. That figure is notebook arithmetic. It is not an electrician's load calculation, and it does not know your local code.

Everything stays on this phone. There is no account,  and no connection to the panel itself.

name: Papiee: PPT & Question Solver
description:
Papiee is two study tools in one: an AI PPT maker that builds presentations people believe you designed yourself, and a question solver that answers any question the way a top student writes it.

WHY PAPIEE IS DIFFERENT
• Slides that don't look AI-made. No templates and no generic stock look. Every deck gets real photos, charts and diagrams in a design made for its topic.
• Built from your own material. Drop in lecture PDFs, Word files, slides, notes or photos of the board, and the deck follows what your class actually taught.
• Answers that sound like you, not a chatbot. Your question's own numbering, only the working that earns marks, sized to the space on your paper.
• Every answer is double-checked before you see it.
• Diagrams drawn for you to copy, and handwritten copies of any answer in one tap.
• No account, no ads, no tracking.

PPT MAKER
• Type a topic, or attach your notes and lecture files
• Papiee researches, writes and designs the whole presentation
• Change anything by asking ("make slide 3 shorter", "add my name") or edit text and photos yourself
• Present from your phone, or export to PowerPoint (PPTX) and PDF

QUESTION SOLVER
• Any subject: maths, physics, chemistry, biology, law, economics, accounting, literature, engineering and more
• Calculations, theory, multiple choice, fill-in-the-gap and essay questions
• Snap a whole page: Papiee finds every question and straightens tilted photos
• Short, standard or full answers, and ask for "shorter", "more steps" or "simpler words" anytime
• Learn mode explains the key idea, answers follow-up questions and makes practice questions

CREDITS
Papiee runs on credits: 1 credit solves a photo and 15 credits make a presentation. New users get free credits to try it. Get more with Papiee Pro (weekly, monthly or yearly) or one-time credit packs that never expire.

Papiee Pro renews automatically until cancelled. Cancel anytime in your iPhone's Settings at least 24 hours before the renewal date. Payment is charged to your Apple ID.
