Privacy Policy: https://papiee.199-247-28-116.sslip.io/privacy.html

name: Parcelry
seller_name: SUN TECH M & E SDN. BHD.
description:
Parcelry is a hand-kept logbook for everything you order online and everything you send back. Type in the shop, what you bought, the price, when it should arrive and how many days the shop gives you to return it. Parcelry does the counting and tells you what needs you today.

No inbox scanning. No carrier logins. Nothing leaves your account except what you choose to type in.

YOUR DOORSTEP, SORTED BY URGENCY
The home screen puts the right parcels first: deliveries running late, parcels arriving today, return windows closing in the next three days, and refunds still pending after you sent something back. A daily manifest shows how many parcels are due, travelling and closing at a glance.

EVERY ORDER ON A SHIPPING LABEL
Each order is a label with a dotted route of five checkpoints: ordered, shipped, out for delivery, delivered and refunded. A small box moves along the route as you update the status with one tap. Copy a tracking number in one tap to paste into the carrier's site.

RETURN WINDOWS, COUNTED DOWN
Mark an order delivered and its return window starts ticking. The Returns screen lists every open window with the days left and the last day to send it back, then follows each parcel on its way back until the refund arrives. Log the refunded amount, including partial refunds.

SPEND BY SHOP
See what you spent each month, shop by shop, along with refunds received and the net total. Step back through earlier months any time. Choose from ten currencies.

GENTLE REMINDERS
Switch on return reminders and Parcelry schedules a local notification one, two or three days before a window closes. Permission is only asked when you switch it on.

WORKS OFFLINE, SYNCS WHEN YOU'RE BACK
Add and update orders without a signal. Changes sync to your private account when you reconnect.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Start straight away with Track as guest, or create an account with email and password. Guests can save their parcels to an email account later from Depot without losing a single order. Delete your account and every order from Depot at any time.

MADE TO FEEL LIKE THE DEPOT
Warm kraft paper, courier-brown ink, label-blue stamps and rose warnings, with a shipping-label navigation along the bottom. Choose the Depot Night theme for evenings. Soft tape, thump and doorbell sounds and light haptics can be switched off.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your orders are stored privately in your own account and are never shared or sold.

name: Parcheggia
description:
Parcheggia mette in contatto chi sta lasciando un parcheggio con chi lo sta cercando lì vicino.

Quando stai per andare via tocchi «Sto uscendo» e indichi tra quanto liberi il posto. Chi cerca in zona lo vede comparire sulla mappa, con la distanza e il tempo che manca, e può raggiungerlo.

COME FUNZIONA
• Stai uscendo: segnali il posto in pochi secondi, anche qualche minuto prima di arrivare all'auto.
• Stai cercando: la mappa mostra i posti che si stanno liberando entro il raggio che scegli tu, da 150 metri a 1 chilometro.
• Tocchi «Ci vado» e l'app ti indica la strada. Quando arrivi dici se il posto c'era oppure no.
• Se in zona non c'è nulla, tocchi «Avvisami» e ricevi una notifica appena se ne libera uno.

LA TUA AUTO
• L'app ricorda dove hai parcheggiato e ti riporta all'auto.
• Promemoria per la scadenza della sosta a pagamento e per la pulizia della strada.
• Se vuoi, ti ricorda di segnalare il posto quando torni verso l'auto.

GRATIS, DAVVERO
Parcheggia è gratuita e resta gratuita. Non ci sono abbonamenti, acquisti o pubblicità.

LA TUA PRIVACY
• Gli altri vedono solo modello e colore dell'auto che sta uscendo. Mai il tuo nome, mai la targa.
• La posizione in cui ti trovi mentre cerchi non viene salvata sui nostri server.
• La posizione dell'auto parcheggiata resta solo sul tuo telefono.
• Nessun tracciamento a fini pubblicitari.

BUONO A SAPERSI
• Parcheggia non prenota il posto: è di chi arriva per primo.
• Chi segnala guadagna crediti. Con almeno un credito vedi i nuovi posti 20 secondi prima degli altri.
• Usa l'app solo a veicolo fermo e rispetta sempre il codice della strada.

Entri con Apple, con Google oppure con la tua email e un codice a 6 cifre: nessuna password da ricordare.

name: Parkbook: Park Day Journal
description:
Parkbook turns your Orlando theme park trip into a day-by-day journal you can actually use in the park.

PLAN EACH DAY
• Build every park day from a guide of attractions, shows and dining across the four Walt Disney World® parks, or add your own stops
• Set times, drag to reorder, and follow a simple checklist with progress for the day
• Add free days for resorts, shopping and slow mornings

IN THE PARK
• Check stops off as you go, or skip them
• Live wait times, powered by ThemeParks.wiki, as an unofficial reference
• Park maps with every stop on them
• Lightning Lane return reminders as notifications on your phone
• Works offline

TOGETHER
• Share a trip with your group by invite link: no accounts
• Everyone rates and comments on what you did
• A shared ledger splits costs fairly

MEMORIES
• Collect a stamp for each day and spot animals in the field guide
• A ratings book ranks your favourites
• Turn any day into a long memory card to save or share

Everything is free. If Parkbook makes your trip easier, you can leave an optional tip, which unlocks nothing.

Parkbook is an unofficial app. It is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by The Walt Disney Company. Park and attraction names are used only to identify them.

name: Parts Plus
description:
THIS APPLICATION IS INTENDED FOR PROFESSIONAL CLIENTS OF PARTS PLUS WHO HAVE A CLIENT NUMBER AND HAVE BEEN GRANTED ACCESS TO THE APPLICATION BY A SALES REPRESENTATIVE

With Parts Plus, you gain fast and precise access to automotive parts from trusted suppliers. The app combines a B2B catalog with a cloud-based database, ensuring prices, availability, and new products are always up to date. It works on smartphones and tablets (Android/iOS) as well as in the browser – wherever workshops and customers need it.

Key features:
• Multi-criteria search: by vehicle, OE/alternative numbers, EAN, ERP code, VIN + “Exact” mode.
• Quick access to detailed product cards: images, technical specifications, replacements, stock levels.
• Customer Area: order history, invoices and payments, returns, complaints, loyalty program, and rankings.
• Online ordering and real-time data access.
• Industry integrations: TECDOC, HaynesPRO, DAT (catalog data, repair times, part ↔ vehicle relations).
• ERP integration – prices, stock, and availability pulled directly from your system.
• GearCode AI Assistant – artificial intelligence to support choosing the right car parts.

name: Passage Gate
description:
Give the next person everything they need to take over. Passage Gate puts the context, expected outcome, and acceptance criteria in one shareable handoff packet.

• Build a packet. Add a recipient, due date, expected outcome, and acceptance checklist. Include relevant links or notes and see which required details still need to be filled in.
• Send and receive. Share a packet through the iOS share sheet. The recipient copies the shared text and pastes it into Passage Gate to import it.
• Review the work. Check off each item, accept the handoff, or explain what still needs to be added.
• Send the result back. The recipient can share a receipt. When the sender imports it, the result appears on the original packet. If more information is needed, the sender can revise and share the packet again.
• Find past handoffs. Search by title or person and review activity across incoming, outgoing, and archived packets.

Records are stored on your device. You can create, edit, and review packets offline without an account.

name: Past Guardians
description:
A lost civilization is waiting beneath the golden stone.

Past Guardians turns treasure hunting into an expedition of careful observation. Read row and column clues, survey promising ground, brace fragile chambers, and uncover every relic before the city gives way.

• Explore 30 campaign chambers across six distinct city districts.
• Plan your dig with limited energy, structural stability and two free row surveys.
• Return each local day for a new seeded excavation and improve your personal best.
• Recover district seals and rotate image fragments to restore six museum objects.
• Replay completed sites for better medals and browse your latest 40 expedition records.
• Continue an unfinished dig automatically with local saving.

Play offline without accounts, advertising, in-app purchases or real-money rewards. All progress stays on your device.

name: Paw Notebook
description:
Paw Notebook is a home notebook for more than one pet.

Keep a card for each animal, then log meals, care tasks, doses you gave, weight marks, and vet visits. Today shows one pet and one day at a time, with chips to switch animals and a stepper to move between days. Health lines up the latest weight against the goal you typed, the last dose, and the next visit date.

Age is the time from the birthday you entered. Weight difference is the latest mark minus the goal. Paw Notebook does not give veterinary advice, does not remind you with push notifications, and does not send records anywhere.

The notebook stays on this phone.

name: Pawpath - Dog Walk Tracker
description:
Pawpath records every walk with your dog and turns it into points, streaks and a happy pup.

WALKS
- Start a walk with one tap. Pawpath draws the route on the map.
- See time, distance and your dog's steps. A small dog takes more steps than a big one, so the count fits your dog.
- Take photos during the walk. They stay on the map.
- Focus mode dims the screen, so you look at your dog, not your phone.

DAILY GOAL
- A daily walking goal based on your dog's size, age and energy.
- A streak and a weekly view keep you going.
- Your dog's avatar is happy after a good walk and sleepy at night.

FAMILY
- Share your dog with your partner or family. Invite them with a code, a QR code or a link.
- Everyone sees the same walks, photos and care plan.
- No sign-up and no password.

FRIENDS
- A weekly leaderboard with your friends.
- Public or private profile. Private profiles show only name, age and points.
- See where your friends walked.

CARE
- Reminders for vaccines, deworming, tick protection and vet visits.
- Add your own appointments with date, time and a note.
- A home screen widget with today's progress.

PAWPATH PLUS
Pawpath is free. Plus adds more dogs and household members, the full walk history with a yearly summary, private leaderboard groups, a photo collage, a vet report as PDF and a food guide with a safety score for 60+ foods. One subscription covers the whole household.
Plus is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or yearly. The yearly plan starts with a 7 day free trial. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. It renews unless you cancel it at least 24 hours before the end of the period in your App Store settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://pawpath.eu/privacy.html

IMPORTANT
Pawpath is not a vet. Dates and amounts in the app are general suggestions, not medical advice. Ask your vet before any vaccine, medicine or treatment.

name: Paycheck to Plan: A Money Lab
description:
What happens to a paycheck before it reaches your bank account? Should your first car be leased, new, or used? Rent or buy? What's the cheapest way to pay a surprise repair bill? How do you file a simple tax return?

Paycheck to Plan follows the money from a first paycheck to a plan for everything it has to cover, and puts students in charge of the decisions along the way. It was created by a classroom teacher and is used in class. It brings five hands-on projects together in one app, with one home screen and one nickname, and each project saves its own progress.

THE FIVE PROJECTS
• The Budgeting Project: pick a path and a career, work out gross and take-home pay, fill out a W-4, choose insurance and retirement, then build a monthly budget and see how it holds up when life happens.
• The Car Project: price the same car three ways (lease it new, buy it new, or buy it used), run the payment math, see what depreciation does to a loan, and defend your choice.
• The Housing Project: set a budget, shop fictional listings, compare 15- and 30-year mortgages with renting, and decide what fits.
• The Emergency Project: the car breaks down. Compare four ways to pay for the repair (savings, family, a credit card, a quick-cash loan) and see what each one costs over the next year.
• The Tax Project: read a W-2, choose a filing status, fill out a simplified Form 1040 line by line, and find out whether you get a refund or owe.

HOW IT WORKS
• Real math, step by step. Short checks give hints when an answer is off, and the built-in calculator is always one tap away.
• Points and badges reward getting it right the first time.
• Every project ends with a report students can share with their teacher using the share sheet.
• Do the projects in order or jump to any one. The home screen shows progress for each project.
• Resetting one project never touches the others.

BUILT FOR THE CLASSROOM
• Students enter a nickname only. No accounts, no email, no sign-in.
• Works fully offline. No ads, no tracking, no data collection.
• Classmates sharing a device can each keep their own progress under their own nickname.
• Progress codes let a student move one project's progress to another device.

For educational purposes only. This app is not financial, tax, or legal advice. All people, places, companies, and listings are fictional, and dollar amounts, rates, and tax figures are simplified examples.

name: PDF Editor - No Internet
description:
A complete PDF editor that works without an internet connection. Every tool runs on your iPhone or iPad: your documents are never uploaded, and you don't need an account.

EDIT & SIGN
• Edit text that is already on the page
• Highlight, draw, add notes and shapes
• Type anywhere, place photos or logos
• Draw your signature and place it on any page
• Fill in PDF forms
• Change title, author and keywords

ORGANIZE
• Merge several PDFs into one
• Split a PDF into smaller files
• Reorder, remove, rotate and extract pages

CREATE & CONVERT
• Scan paper documents with the camera
• Turn photos into a PDF
• Recognize text (OCR) to make scans searchable
• Find words inside a document
• Export pages as images or text
• Convert local HTML files into PDFs

OPTIMIZE & PROTECT
• Compress PDFs to reduce file size
• Add a password, or remove one you know
• Redact supported text in a copy
• Remove metadata, attachments and actions before sharing

POWERED BY RUST
• A PDF engine written in Rust, a modern language built for speed and memory safety
• Opens, edits and saves documents directly on your device, with no server involved
• Undo, redo and earlier versions let you step back from any change

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Works offline, on a plane or anywhere without Wi-Fi
• No account, no ads, no analytics, no uploads
• Optional App Lock with Face ID or passcode

WORKS THE iOS WAY
• Save PDFs from other apps with the Share sheet
• Recent PDFs widget on your Home Screen
• Siri, Shortcuts and Spotlight support
• Designed for iPhone and iPad, in light and dark mode

FREE, WITH EVERY TOOL INCLUDED
No subscriptions and no in-app purchases.

Privacy policy: https://stackattack.store/privacy-pages/pdf-editor-ios/

name: PE Exam: Civil, Power & More
description:
Kalyta is an AI-native study companion for the NCEES PE exam. It adapts to what you keep missing, works every problem through step by step, and, when the answer is in your reference, shows you where to find it in the references you get on exam day.

THE EXAM
The PE is a computer-based exam of 80 questions in a 9-hour appointment, with the NCEES reference handbook and, for the civil and power exams, the design standards supplied on screen. Kalyta is organized by NCEES's own exam specification for each discipline, knowledge area by knowledge area.

ELEVEN PE EXAMS IN ONE APP
- PE Civil: Water Resources and Environmental, Transportation, Structural, Construction, and Geotechnical
- PE Electrical and Computer: Power
- PE Mechanical: HVAC and Refrigeration, Thermal and Fluid Systems, and Machine Design and Materials
- PE Environmental
- PE Chemical

FIND IT IN YOUR REFERENCE
The PE is closed book with an electronic reference, so the skill is finding the right equation, table or provision fast. When the answer is in your reference, Kalyta names where it lives after you answer: the handbook section, or the section, table or figure of the design standard, at the edition NCEES lists.

WHAT YOU GET
- Adaptive practice: questions are chosen around your current level and mixed with spaced review, so your time goes where it moves your result.
- A worked solution on every question: why the right answer is right, and why each of the others is wrong.
- Every question type the PE uses: multiple choice, multiple correct, fill in the blank, point and click, and drag and drop.
- Concept lessons on the ideas behind the problems.
- An AI tutor you can steer: ask why a method works, ask for another example, or tell it to slow down.
- Timed rehearsals in the exam's format, with review question by question and your results in each knowledge area.

HONEST BY DESIGN
NCEES reports the PE as pass or fail and publishes no cut score, so Kalyta does not predict your result or your chance of passing. A rehearsal shows what you got right in each knowledge area, and nothing more. We publish no pass rates, score improvements or testimonials.

Kalyta is an independent study tool and is not endorsed by or affiliated with NCEES. NCEES is a trademark of the National Council of Examiners for Engineering and Surveying.

HOW THE FREE ACCESS WORKS
Your first seven study days are free. No card, no payment details and nothing to cancel: a study day counts only on a day you answer a question. This is free access to the app, not a trial attached to the subscription below.

SUBSCRIPTION
PE Exam Monthly is an auto-renewing subscription at $29.99 per month, and it unlocks every PE course in the app. The subscription has no introductory or free trial period. It renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://kalytalabs.com/terms
Privacy Policy: https://kalytalabs.com/privacy

Start free and see your first plan in minutes.

name: Pemora: IPTV Lite Player
description:
Pemora is a quiet evening player for two things you already own: the TV playlist from your provider, and the videos on your phone.

TURN THE WHEEL
A slim wheel stands at the right edge of the screen: Home, Live, Films, Series, My videos and Search. Flick it or tap a name and the page changes underneath. Settings sits behind the gear on Home.

LIVE, FILMS AND SERIES
• Every group of your playlist becomes a round reel under the section title; "All reels" opens an index with search, sorting, counts and pins.
• Channels show as tag rows with their number; films and series as matted prints with year and rating.
• Hearts keep channels, films and series in Saved; Continue brings back the film or episode you stopped; Recent channels remembers what you zapped through.
• Series pages list seasons with episode codes like 2.04 and play the next one for you.

A PLAYER WITH A NOW CARD
The picture sits on top, a white card under it holds the title, the time bar and the keys: previous, back 10 seconds, play, ahead 10 seconds, next, tracks and full screen. Below, the other channels of the same reel wait in a grid, so changing channel is one tap. Sound and subtitle tracks, picture fit and speed live in one sheet.

MY VIDEOS
Add family clips, recorded lessons or any video you own from Photos or Files, several at once, no playlist needed. Pemora keeps its own copy on this device, sorts them into folders, remembers where you stopped, marks the ones you finished and plays .srt subtitles that you can shift by half a second. Nothing is uploaded.

TWO WAYS TO ADD A PLAYLIST
Name it first, then unfold Login details for an Xtream Codes account (server URL, username, password) or A link for an M3U address or a file. Add as many playlists as you like and switch between them in Settings.

BRING YOUR OWN PLAYLIST
Pemora comes empty. It includes no channels, films, series or playlists and is not tied to any provider. To watch TV you need a playlist from a service you are allowed to use; My videos works with your own files.

NO ACCOUNT, NO ADS
No sign-in, no ads, no tracking and nothing to buy. Your playlists, hearts and positions stay on this device.

Terms of Use (Apple standard EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy policy: https://pemora.pages.dev/privacy
Support: support@pemora.app

name: Penwagon: 3D Print Design
description:
Penwagon is a design app for tablets and phones. Draw a part that does a job without knowing CAD, and get a print-ready file for your own printer and filament.

A broken clip, a foot that fits the shelf, a hook for the cupboard. Anything you can measure.

DESCRIBE IT, SKETCH IT OR MEASURE IT
Write what you need, sketch it roughly with a pencil or start from a ready model. You give the sizes.

DESIGN
The part comes out at its real size. Drag to change a length, a hole or a wall; parts that fit together get the clearance your printer needs.

PREPARE THE PRINT
The file is sliced for your printer and filament and the parts are laid out on the plate. A file that fails the checks is never handed to you.

SEND
Take the STL, 3MF or print file, or send it by e-mail or the share menu.

Penwagon keeps the plate type, plate temperature, brim, walls and infill, spacing between parts and fit clearance fixed on every print. AI only helps the app understand what you want; it cannot touch these settings.

Today, 441 FDM printers from 67 brands: Bambu Lab, Prusa, Creality, Elegoo, Anycubic, Qidi, Sovol, Flashforge and more. If yours is missing, ask for it in the app.

FREE
Every design tool and ready model, STL, 3MF and print files (with an account), 5 slices in 24 hours, one printer, 3 AI credits a month.

PRO
Any number of printers, 100 slices in 24 hours and first in the queue, 50 AI credits a month. Monthly or yearly; the yearly plan starts with a 14-day free trial. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends; manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of use: https://penwagon.com/en/terms/
Privacy: https://penwagon.com/en/privacy/

name: Periodly
description:
Periodly is a class timetable and homework planner built for students. It tells you which class you're in, where the next one is and exactly how long until the bell, and it keeps every piece of homework, every test and every exam in one tidy planner.

NOW: THE BELL, COUNTED DOWN
Open the app and the Now card shows your current class with its room and teacher, a live countdown to the bell and a semicircular bell arc that fills as the period runs. Between lessons it shows what's up next. When the school day is over it tells you the first class tomorrow. Below, today's periods are listed in order, with the one on now marked in violet, plus the homework that is due in the next two days.

WEEK: YOUR TIMETABLE ON ONE GRID
Add your subjects with teacher, room and a colour, then drop periods into the week grid with start and end times. Tap a day to see its classes, tap any block to edit it. Periodly warns you if two classes overlap.
Two-week timetable? Turn on A/B week rotation, tell Periodly whether this is Week A or Week B, and give each period Every week, Week A or Week B. The grid and the Now card always follow the right week.

HOMEWORK: PLANNED BY DUE DATE
Add homework or an assignment, link it to a subject, choose the due day (or tap Next class to use the subject's next lesson), set a priority and add notes. The planner groups everything into Overdue, Due today, Due tomorrow, This week and Later. Tick the circle and the task is highlighted in lime and moves to Done.

TESTS AND EXAMS
Tests and exams get their own tab with a big day countdown for each one, so the next assessment never sneaks up on you.

OPTIONAL REMINDERS
Turn on evening-before reminders in the Locker and Periodly sends a local notification the night before something is due, at the hour you pick. Permission is only asked when you switch it on.

MADE TO FEEL LIKE SCHOOL, NOT WORK
Navigate with the bell pull cord on the right edge: pull it to drop the NOW, WEEK, HOMEWORK and LOCKER tags. Gentle school sounds (a bell ding when a period starts, a pencil tick, a locker clang on save, an eraser swipe on delete, a paper flip between days) can be switched off, as can haptics. Pick from three themes: Notebook, Late Study and Peach Locker.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Sign in with email and password, or tap Try as student guest and start straight away, no account needed. Guests can later save their planner to an email account from the Locker. Your data syncs through Google Firebase and works offline. You can delete your account and every subject, period and task from the Locker at any time.

No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases.

name: Perpend Course
description:
Perpend Course keeps one masonry course on this iPhone.

Drag the perpend off the joint below, then lay a closer. If the perpend lands on that joint, the brick slides off. A closer under 0.15 is too short. A closer over 0.50 is too long. Only a clear perpend and a closer from 0.15 to 0.50 bonds the course.

Rename a course, start another, delete one, and share four lines: the name, the perpend, the mark, and the note.

Courses stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. This does not lay real bricks.

name: PFM: Pocket Football Manager
description:
Found a football club from nothing and lead it from the Fourth Division to the top of the game.

Pocket Football Manager is a fast football management game made for your phone. A match takes a couple of minutes, a season fits in a coffee break, and every decision is yours.

BUILD YOUR CLUB
• Name your club, pick its city, crest colours and kits
• Start in the Fourth Division of one of 10 football countries
• Grow your stadium, training ground, scouting network and youth academy

WATCH EVERY MATCH LIVE
• Follow the action on a live 2D pitch at 1x, 2x or 4x speed
• Change tactics and make substitutions while the match runs
• Choose from 17 formations and 6 tactical styles

TRANSFERS AND SCOUTING
• Search the market, send scouts and bid for the players you want
• Negotiate fees and wages, and expect clubs and players to counter
• List your own players and sell to the best offer

DEVELOP YOUR PLAYERS
• Train each player's skills and teach them new positions
• Send youth scouts abroad to find the next star
• Promote youngsters from your academy into the first team

WIN EVERYTHING
• League titles, promotions, national cups and continental cups
• Seasonal objectives and achievements with rewards

MORE
• 3 save slots for 3 careers at once
• Colour themes, plus colourblind and high-contrast modes
• English, Português, Español, Français, Deutsch and Italiano

The whole game can be played for free. Optional packs and short reward videos help you go faster.

All clubs, players and competitions are fictional.

name: Phẳng: Document & Book Scanner
description:
Phẳng turns your iPhone into a flatbed scanner. Snap a document, a book page or an ID card, and the app crops the edges, straightens skewed shots, removes lamp shadows and gives you a clean PDF to share or print.

DOCUMENTS
• Finds the paper edges and straightens skewed shots.
• Removes shadows and dark patches for even white paper and crisp black text.
• Four filters: Original, Enhanced, Grayscale, Black & White.

BOOKS

description:

Get it right and pink current races through the circuit as the energy core comes alive. Get it wrong and the system denies access—adjust and try again.

name: PiP Meter: CPU & RAM Monitor
description:
PiP Meter keeps your iPhone or iPad's vital signs in a small Picture in Picture window that floats over every app.

Playing a heavy game and wondering why it stutters? Testing your own app on a real device? Just curious how hard your device is working? Start PiP and keep CPU and memory usage in view at all times.

IN THE PIP WINDOW
• CPU usage of the whole device
• Memory in use and how much is available
• Updates every second, even while you use other apps
• Drag it to a corner, resize it, or slide it off the edge
• Pause updates from the window itself
• Choose and order the items you want to see

IN THE APP
• Live CPU and memory gauges with a one-minute graph
• Usage of every CPU core
• Memory breakdown: app, wired, compressed and cached
• Network data per second, download and upload
• Free storage, battery level and thermal state
• Device information: model identifier, system version, cores, memory, storage, uptime

PREMIUM (one-time purchase)
• Up to four items you choose in the Dynamic Island and on the Lock Screen, while the app or its PiP window is open (Dynamic Island on supported iPhone models)
• Graph style: the last minute at a glance
• Detailed style: up to six metrics and every CPU core
• Network, storage, battery and thermal state in the PiP window
• Accent colors

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
Works in portrait and landscape, with a sidebar layout on iPad.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
PiP Meter never connects to the internet and does not collect any data. No ads, no account, no tracking.

GOOD TO KNOW
All values are for the whole device, as reported by iOS. iOS does not report usage per app, GPU usage or temperature, so PiP Meter does not show them. PiP Meter only shows numbers; it does not change how your device works.

name: Planetary Cycles
description:
Planetary Cycles finds the days when the sky came back to the one you were born under, and when it will come again.

Enter your birthday, the time if you know it and the city where you were born. The app works out where the Sun, the Moon and the planets stood against the stars at that moment, then where they stand today.

Sky draws both skies on one wheel, with a reading written on your iPhone by Apple Intelligence. It lists the days since your birth when the seven planets you can see came closest to where they stood when you were born, the next ones in the coming thirty years, and the days when the sky was most like today's.

Cycles follows each of the ten bodies, from the Moon to Pluto, on its own: where it stood at your birth, where it is today, how far round it has come, every time it came back to its birth place, and the next one.

Ask answers questions about any day or planet, such as "When is my next Saturn return?" or "When was the sky like it was on 12 June 2015?" The answers come from the app's own sky search, written on your iPhone.

A reading gives what tradition says a return means and makes no predictions.

"The same sky" means the same places against the stars. Every place is computed on your iPhone in a frame fixed to the stars, signs are named the sidereal way, and the calculations were checked against Swiss Ephemeris.

Keep several birthdays, for yourself and the people you name. They stay on your iPhone: no account, no tracking, and only the place you type goes to Apple Maps.

Planetary Cycles needs iOS 27 and an iPhone whose Apple Intelligence model is AFM 3 Core Advanced, with Apple Intelligence turned on. On other iPhones it shows one screen that says so.
