• Nothing due? You still see when the next check is.

JOURNAL
• Log watering, checks, fertilizing, pruning and repotting, with a note and photos.
• When you water, the app suggests the next check and you can adjust it before saving.
• Older entries don't move your schedule unless you choose to.

REMINDERS
• One reminder a day, at the time you choose, with how many plants to check.
• Pause a plant's reminders or archive it without losing its history.

YOUR DATA STAYS ON YOUR IPHONE
• Works offline. No accounts, ads or tracking.
• Manual backup to a file you keep wherever you like, plus restore.
• Export or delete your whole library at any time.

FREE AND PRO
Free includes up to 5 active plants, reminders, notes, photos, full history and backup.
Plant Journal Pro, a one-time purchase with no subscription, adds:
• Unlimited active plants.
• Group by space, combined filters and saved views.
• Export the journal as PDF.

Plant Journal doesn't identify species or diagnose diseases: it's a schedule and a diary so you can care for your plants your way.

name: Plarog
description: Keep a living journal for every houseplant. Record species, placement, purchase date and portraits, log watering, feeding, repotting, pruning and growth, review each plant timeline, and set the next care reminder.

name: Platvis
description:
Platvis is de app van de Platvis Groep (Platvis, Nordpesca en Cefalux) voor medewerkers en partners met een account op het portal.

Wat je kunt:
• Het complete Platvis-portal, ook onderweg: productie, orders, kasstroom, debiteuren, kwaliteit en meer, alleen wat jij mag zien.
• Inloggen met Face ID of Touch ID in plaats van je pincode.
• Widgets voor je beginscherm en vergrendelscherm: banksaldo, kasstroom, productie, omzet, orders, debiteuren en meer.
• Siri: "Banksaldo Platvis", "Productie Platvis", "Dagoverzicht Platvis".
• Foto of scan: leveringsdocumenten, CMR's en bonnen scannen en direct in het Postvak van het portal zetten, ook via de deelknop vanuit Foto's of Mail.
• Pdf's en Excel-bestanden openen, delen en afdrukken.
• Tabletstand voor de werkvloer.
• Werkt op iPhone, iPad en Mac.

Je hebt een uitnodiging of account van de Platvis Groep nodig om in te loggen.

name: PlayDuo: 2-Player Party Games
seller_name: TITAN INTERNATIONAL TRADING SERVICE COMPANY LIMITED
description:
PlayDuo is where two friends play quick mini-games and talk with their real voices on the same screen. No separate call, no account to create.

HOW IT WORKS
• Tap "Rủ bạn chơi" (invite a friend), pick a name and get a room code.
• Share the link on Messenger, Zalo or any chat app, or read out the 6-character code. Your friend opens it and is in the room.
• Turn on the mic and talk while you play.
• Vote on a game together. Rounds last 1–3 minutes: play again, or switch games.
• At the end, if you both tap "Kết bạn" (add friend), you become friends: see when the other is online and invite them next time.

72 GAMES FOR TWO
• Board: five-in-a-row (caro), connect four, Ô ăn quan (Vietnamese mancala), battleships, dots and boxes, flip discs, territory…
• Flick and toss: mini pool, mini golf, bowling, penalty kicks, archery, curling…
• Drawing: draw & guess, draw one half each, finish the drawing, one-line drawing, colour together…
• Get to know each other: taste ranking, how well do you know me, taste map, two truths and a lie, question box, think alike…
• Words and quizzes: quick trivia, word chain, true or false, taboo words, riddles…
• Memory, reflex, luck and co-op: memory pairs, spot the difference, tug of war, racing, cut the wire, code pairs, treasure dig…
Every game has rules you can read in seconds and its own sticker-style artwork. The interface and game content are in Vietnamese.

TALK WITH YOUR VOICE
• Voice travels between the two players through a voice server and is not recorded on our servers.
• Mute yourself or the other player at any time.

SAFETY
• A red flag button on every game screen: block instantly (closes the room and cuts the voice) or report.
• When reporting you can attach the last 60 seconds of audio your own phone keeps temporarily. It is sent only if you choose to, and deleted after 30 days.
• No ads, no data selling, no email or phone number needed.
• Delete your account in the app: Tôi (Me) → Xoá tài khoản (Delete account).

This version is for playing with friends by link. It has no matching with strangers.

Support: https://alexleai.com/playduo/support.html

name: PlayType
description:
Tired of endless, boring typing courses that feel like they never end? 

PlayType is a minimalist, distraction-free 10-finger touch typing trainer designed for speed, focus, and instant momentum. With 51 bite-sized, single-line lessons, you can build real muscle memory and finish the core curriculum in just 15 minutes.

WHY PLAYTYPE?
• Fast & Rewarding Curriculum: 51 structured one-line lessons take you step-by-step from the Home Row (ASDF JKL;) to full-keyboard mastery without fatigue.
• Falling Words Arcade Game: Test your reflexes! Type falling words before they hit the bottom, build combos, level up, and beat your personal high score.
• Custom Lessons & File Upload: Practice what matters to you. Type or paste your own text (one lesson per line).
• Interactive Finger Map Guide: Visual color-coded keyboard map shows exact finger placement and tactile bump anchors (F & J) so you never have to look down.
• Keyboard-First Navigation: Navigate the entire app effortlessly using quick keyboard shortcuts ([G] Game, [H] Help, [S] Settings, [ESC] Back) alongside satisfying typing sound effects.
• 100% Offline & Private: No accounts, no subscriptions, no ads, and zero tracking. 

PERFECT FOR:
• Beginners learning 10-finger touch typing from scratch.
• Students and kids practicing on iPad with an external keyboard.
• Writers, coders, and professionals looking for a clean, retro-terminal daily warm-up tool.

Pay once, own it forever. Start typing faster today with PlayType!

name: Plotfellows
description:
Some plants are better together. Plotfellows is a calm hex-tile puzzle about companion planting: place each new tile next to friends, keep rivals apart and watch your garden fill up with seeds.

Plant with purpose
Basil makes tomatoes happier. Onions keep carrot flies away. Fennel would rather be left alone. Each of the 16 vegetables, herbs and flowers has its own friends and rivals, and every one comes with a short note from real gardening lore.

Discover classic combos
Grow the Three Sisters, a Pizza Garden, a Salsa Patch, a Bee Meadow and more. Find a combo and you earn bonus seeds

Play your way
- Season: a full garden with new plants to unlock as you level up
- Daily Plot: a new garden every day, and a streak to keep
- Quick Plot: 20 tiles when you only have a few minutes
- Free Garden: no score, just plant whatever you like

Made to unwind
Hand-printed riso-style art, soft ambient sound and a short guided tutorial. No timers, no ads, no in-app purchases. Plays fully offline.

name: Plumplet: Squishy Shared Pet
description:
Poke it and it squishes. Plumplet is a soft 3D bun pet that dents where you press, slowly puffs back up and bounces when you let go. Hold it, drag it, give it a gentle squeeze.

It never dies, never gets hungry, never nags and never sulks. Its mood shows in the shape of its steam: calm, happy, thrilled, sleepy or curious. Over the days it grows from Sprout to Bun to Big Bun to Wise Bun, and it stays with you.

While you're away, it goes exploring and brings back finds for an 8-week seasonal album: the Meadow, the Brook, Mushroom Wood and more.

• One daily event, the same for everyone: a visitor, the weather, or 3 hidden things to find
• A picture of your pet's day, ready to share
• Seed Shower: catch seeds on its head
• Your own room to decorate
• Outfits and colors, many free, some in packs
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets (they refresh on the schedule iOS sets)
• Works on iPhone and iPad

For people far apart
A sister in another country, grandkids abroad, a friend who moved away, a partner in another time zone. Add each other with a 6-character code, a QR code or an invite link. Your pets visit each other, leave gifts and wave. Two friends can share a room and decorate it from their own phones, whenever each of them has a moment.

Gentle by design
No free-text chat, no photos, no public search. Block and report from the Friends tab. No email or phone number needed.

Free to start
Plumplet is free with a small banner ad and an optional short video for a bonus explore. One-time purchases: No ads, Cozy Pack, Pastry Pack, Steam Garden Set, and Everything, forever (all current and future items, plus no ads). No subscription.

name: PLUS by Proasa Saúde
description: O app PLUS by Proasa Saúde reúne conteúdos e cursos de saúde e bem-estar para beneficiários da Proasa Saúde. Acesse aulas e materiais onde estiver, direto do seu celular.

name: Plytorque
description:
Plytorque is a workbench for people who spin yarn on a treadle wheel. It answers the question every spinner asks at the wheel: how many times do I treadle for each draft to get the twist I want?

The answer depends on your wheel, so Plytorque starts by measuring it.

Your wheel, measured
Enter the drive wheel and whorl diameters and the drive band thickness, and Plytorque works out the ratio of every groove along the band's centre line вЂ” for scotch tension, double drive (with the draw-in between flyer and bobbin) and bobbin-lead wheels. Then run the ten-treadle slip test: tie a ribbon on the flyer, treadle ten times, count the turns. The measured ratio and the belt slip are kept with that whorl and used in every calculation from then on.

From yarn to rhythm
Tell Plytorque the yarn you are after вЂ” wraps per inch and a twist angle or twists per inch вЂ” and the length of your draft. It returns the twist, the angle and the number of treadles per draft, with a twist angle scale from 15В° to 45В° drawn for that yarn's thickness. Tap a row on the scale to aim for it. The Spinning Bench shows the count in large figures and keeps a tally of drafts while you spin.

Plying that hangs straight
Plan 2-ply, 3-ply or Navajo ply from your singles twist, then calibrate the balance factor from a sample of your own that hangs straight in a loop.

Fibre and samples
A library of 40 wool breeds lists staple length, micron range, typical yarns and a twist hint for each, filtered by staple and fineness. The figures are guidance ranges вЂ” spin a sample first. Record your samples as yarn passports: wraps, singles and ply twist, plus a skein's length and weight, give yards per pound or metres per 100 g, and Plytorque works out how much fibre to prepare for a project, waste included.

Printed at true size
Print a twist angle card with lines from 15В° to 45В° for your yarn diameter, WPI windows of 1 inch and 2 cm with rulers, and sample tags with a slot for a length of yarn. Every page carries a 50 mm control square and a 100 mm bar, so you can check the scale before you measure with it.

Inches or centimetres
Switch between inches (WPI, TPI) and centimetres (wraps per 2 cm, TPcm) at any time. Measurements are stored in millimetres and grams and rounded only when shown.

Plytorque Pro
One wheel, every calculation, slip tests, the breed library, printed cards and up to three samples and three recipes are free. A one-time Pro purchase adds more wheels, unlimited recipes and samples, a printable PDF yarn passport and CSV export of your samples.

Your wheels, recipes and samples stay on your device. Plytorque has no account and asks for no permissions.

name: Pocket Business by MEC
description:
Prepare a quote on site, then turn it into an invoice when the customer goes ahead. Type the job details or dictate them when on-device speech recognition is available. Check the quantities, prices and total before approving the PDF.

Save repeat jobs as templates. Find past work by customer or project, schedule a follow-up call, and record expenses in US dollars or Lebanese pounds. Money reports keep the two currencies separate and can be shared as a spreadsheet.

Work in English or Arabic. Pocket Business stores your records on your device. You choose which files to export or share. To move your records to another device, save an encrypted backup in Files and keep its password.

name: pocketlendor
description:
pocketlendor is a cozy tabletop strategy game for 2–4 players. Gather colorful charms, befriend little creatures and evolve them into stronger forms.

HOW A TURN WORKS
On your turn, choose one action:
• Gather charms: take one each of three different colors. If fewer than three colors remain, take one charm, or one of each remaining color. You can also take two of one color from a pile of four or more.
• Reserve a creature: keep a card in your hand for later and take a wild Prism charm while any remain.
• Befriend a creature: pay its cost in charms and add it to your team.

Every creature you befriend gives a permanent bonus that lowers the cost of future creatures, so small early choices grow into a strong team. At the end of your turn, you may evolve one creature without paying anything, as long as your bonuses meet its requirement and the next stage is on the board or in your hand.

When a player ends a turn with at least 18 stars, finish the current round so everyone has played the same number of turns. The highest score wins.

WAYS TO PLAY
• Pass and play: 2–4 people share one phone or tablet.
• Computer opponents: choose Easy or Normal, and mix them with human players.
• Random match: join an online table for 2, 3 or 4 players. Everyone at a random table appears under a generated name.
• Private room: invite friends with a six-digit code.
• Save a local game and continue it later.
• If your connection drops, your online seat is held for five minutes.

A WORLD OF ORIGINAL CREATURES
• 55 original creatures in a bright, friendly art style.
• 15 creature families that evolve through three stages.
• 5 rare and 5 mythic creatures that give double bonuses and require a Prism charm.
• Four keepers to choose from.
• A creature journal that records every creature you befriend on this device.

MADE FOR THE TABLE
• Landscape layout for phones and tablets.
• Tap any card for a larger view.
• Built-in, step-by-step rules.
• English and Korean, switchable at any time.
• No ads and no in-app purchases.

ACCOUNTS
Play as a guest, or sign in with Apple or Google so your online seat is linked to your account. Other players never see your email address: friends in a private room see the nickname you choose, and random tables use generated names. Saved local games and your creature journal stay on this device. You can delete your account in the app at any time.

Games on one device work without an internet connection. Online play requires an internet connection.

Questions or feedback? Use the support link on this page.

name: Poljjak - Mochi Pond Hop
description:
Hold down and a red dot runs forward and comes back. Let go when it sits on the next lily pad, and your mochi hops.
One thumb is all it takes, yet no two rounds are the same.

■ One thing to learn
· Hold, then let go to hop.
· Land dead center for a "Perfect!" and extra points.
· Stand too long and the pad sinks. Keep moving!

■ A different pond every round
· Weather, zones and surprise gifts change each round.
· Stack 5 small mochi for a Mad Dash. Tap faster to run faster.
· In Two-Pad Zones, clearing two pads in one jump doubles your points.
· 22 ponds to cross, from a river in the city to the Arctic and the Moon.

■ Today's Pond
· Everyone hops the same pond today. A new one arrives once a day.
· Country, team and clan rankings, with no sign-in.
· Ten teams. Everyone on the day's top team gets a draw ticket.

■ Dress up your mochi
· Over 200 hats, glasses, outfits, shoes and special effects.
· 33 Special Mochi that change the whole body (1 in 100 draws), and 3 Mythic Mochi (1 in 1000).
· Paint your mochi any color by mixing red, green and blue.
· The draw odds are shown inside the game.

■ Play together
· Every round ends with an 8-digit challenge code. A friend who enters it gets the very same pond.
· Tap anyone in the rankings to visit their mochi and stand side by side.
· Start a clan at level 10.

■ Good to know
· There is nothing to buy. Stars and tickets come from playing or from watching an ad.
· The game shows ads.
· Your ranking name is typed by you or made at random. Bad words are filtered, and any name can be reported. There is no chat.
· Link Game Center and your name and costumes follow you to a new phone.
· Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

Contact: nabakgood@gmail.com

name: Pool Traxker
description:
Settle it on the table.

Pool Traxker is for clubs, offices and friends who keep score. Set up a private group in a minute, record a result before the next rack, and finally know who leads, who's on a streak and who you've never beaten.

RECORD IN THREE TAPS
Pick the group, pick your opponent, set the score. Singles or doubles, from best of 1 to race to 5, or any score you like. Your opponent confirms it, so every result is one both sides agree on.

RANKINGS THAT MEAN SOMETHING
Group leaderboards by points, for all time, this month or this week, plus an Elo rating for singles and doubles that rewards beating the best player in the room.

HEAD-TO-HEAD THAT NEVER FORGETS
Your record against every opponent: wins, frames, form, streaks and how much Elo you've swung. See your nemesis, your favourite opponent and your best doubles partner.

PRIVATE GROUPS FOR YOUR CREW
Invite people with a link or a code. Admins manage members, approve results and settle disputes. Add guests who aren't on the app yet; their history moves over when they join.

FRIENDLIES TOO
Play someone outside a group? Record a friendly. It counts for both of you, never for a group board.

STAY IN THE LOOP
A feed of results, streaks and rivalry milestones from your groups and friends, and a notification in the app when a result is waiting for you.

No ads. No tracking. Your data is yours, and you can delete your account at any time.

name: Porttimatka
description:
GateVoyage muuttaa kiertoratojen ajoituksen rauhalliseksi strategiseksi haasteeksi.

Jokaisella reitillä useita kiviä sijoitetaan sisäkkäisille kehille, joilla on yksi porttikaari. Säädä vaihepaikkoja ja nopeusvaihteita ja laske, milloin kivet kohtaavat ensimmäisen kerran, ennen kuin käynnistät simulaation. Suoritat tason, kun kaikki kivet saavuttavat portin täsmälleen samaan aikaan.

Tutki satamaa ja jatka reittisi rakentamista, avaa kartta nähdäksesi käytettävissä olevat reitit, harjoittele vapaasti suunnittelupöydällä ja kehitä pienimmän yhteisen jaettavan ymmärrystä jaksojen käsikirjan avulla. Tavoittele nopeampia suorituksia, avaa seuraava reitti ja seuraa, kuinka laivueen liikkeet asettuvat yhä tarkemmin suunnitelmasi mukaisiksi.

name: Postalgia
description:
Got photos piling up on your phone that you never look at anymore?
Postalgia turns them into a little brain exercise every day.

At set times, a letter arrives from your old photos.
"Which country was this?" "Where was this taken?" "When was this taken?" "Who were you with?"
Answer one question and the photo opens. As you look at it, that day's scenery and the people you were with come back to you.

The photos you see are sorted by year automatically.
While you exercise your memory, your old photos get tidied up too.

■ A daily brain workout
A set number of letters arrive each day. The more photos you remember, the further back in time your letters go.

■ How it works
1. Choose the times your letters arrive
2. When a letter arrives, open it and answer the question
3. Look at the photo and remember that day. Photos you see collect in Memories, by year

■ Features
・Large text and simple steps
・Photos sorted by year and by type, automatically
・See your progress in photos remembered and points

■ Your photos stay on your phone
Your photos are used only on your phone. They are never sent anywhere.

■ Price
Try it free for 7 days. After that, pay $4.99 once and keep using it for good. No subscription.

name: Pozea: Pose Camera
description:
Never miss the shot.

Pozea shows you how to pose. Pick a pose from the library and the camera opens with a see-through mannequin guide over your live preview. Line up with it, tap the shutter, and your photo saves without the guide.

POSE LIBRARY
• Scene cards with a faceless ivory mannequin posing in real places: café tables, terraces, city streets, beaches, sunsets
• Categories: Selfie, Café, Movement, Sitting, Together, Street, Outdoors, Lying
• Solo and couple poses
• 2–4 short steps for every pose
• Browse by category, search and save your favorites

POSE CAMERA
• The mannequin appears as a see-through guide over the live camera
• Drag and pinch to move and resize the guide
• Opacity slider, or switch to outline only
• 4:5, 3:4 or 9:16 frame, timer, flash, front and back camera, 1×, 2× and 4× zoom
• The pose steps stay with you inside the camera
• Photos save to your Photos library with no guide and no watermark

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your photos stay on your device. No account, no sign-up.

POZEA PRO
Pozea requires a Pozea Pro subscription. After a short setup you choose a plan; Pozea Pro unlocks the full pose library, the pose camera and new poses as they are added.

Pozea Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. If an introductory price is offered, it applies to the first period only; the regular price applies after that. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://lightwellgames.com/privacy-policy

name: Practice Note
description:
I make this app for my gf, always 100% free while I still maintain my developer account :) Optimized for IPad, Iphone Duo compatible, working best with apple pencils or similar.

Practice Note là cuốn vở tập viết trên iPad và iPhone, làm cho người học tiếng Trung và các ngôn ngữ cần luyện chữ. Viết bằng Apple Pencil hoặc ngón tay, trên đúng loại giấy bạn vẫn dùng để tập viết, rồi ôn lại bằng thẻ ghi nhớ do chính tay bạn viết.

GIẤY TẬP VIẾT ĐÚNG KIỂU
• Bảy mẫu ô chữ Hán: 田字格, 米字格, 九宫格, 回宫格, 方格, ô có dòng phiên âm, giấy làm văn.
• Giấy kẻ ngang, ô vuông, chấm, Cornell và giấy trơn.
• Tự chỉnh cỡ ô, độ đậm và màu đường kẻ, màu giấy.
• Dùng ảnh trong máy hoặc chụp một tờ giấy thật làm nền.

CHÍN LOẠI BÚT, CHỈNH THEO TAY BẠN
• Bút bi, bút kim, bút máy, ngòi dẹt, bút lông, bút chì, dạ quang, nét đứt, chấm bi.
• Đổi màu, cỡ nét, độ đậm; chỉnh độ mượt và độ nhạy lực nhấn.
• Tiếng bút sột soạt khi viết, bật tắt tuỳ ý.
• Lưu bút hay dùng vào thanh yêu thích, chạm một lần là đổi.
• Thước kẻ, giấy nháp nổi và đồng hồ đếm ngược ngay cạnh trang viết.

VIẾT THẲNG LÊN PDF VÀ WORD
• Nhập giáo trình, bài tập dạng PDF, DOC, DOCX: mỗi trang tài liệu thành một trang để viết lên.
• Tô sáng từ mới, điền bài tập, ghi chú bên lề bằng nét chữ của bạn.
• Thêm, xoá, sắp xếp trang; xuất trang thành ảnh.

THẺ GHI NHỚ VIẾT TAY
• Viết mặt trước và mặt sau như viết lên thẻ giấy, hoặc gõ chữ, chèn ảnh.
• Chạm để lật, chấm mức độ nhớ: app tự hẹn ngày ôn cho từng thẻ theo phương pháp lặp lại ngắt quãng.
• Thư viện báo bộ thẻ nào còn thẻ cần học hôm nay.

GỌN GÀNG VÀ DỊU MẮT
• Màu giấy và mực dịu, không trắng gắt, để ngồi viết lâu không mỏi mắt.
• Nhãn màu, tìm theo tên, mở nhiều ghi chú trong các tab.
• Nhiều hồ sơ trên một máy, mỗi hồ sơ có ghi chú và bút riêng.

CỦA BẠN, TRÊN MÁY BẠN
• Chạy hoàn toàn không cần mạng. Không tài khoản, không quảng cáo, không thu thập dữ liệu.
• Sao lưu toàn bộ dữ liệu ra một file khi bạn muốn.
• Tuỳ chọn: cho trợ lý AI trên máy tính của bạn, trong cùng mạng nội bộ, đọc và soạn ghi chú, bộ thẻ giúp bạn. Tính năng này tắt sẵn và chỉ chạy khi bạn bật.

Giao diện tiếng Việt.

name: Precalculus AP: Funcrest
description:
Prepare for the AP Precalculus exam with adaptive practice, interactive labs you can move with your finger, an on-device graphing calculator and full-length timed mock tests in the 2027 exam format.

PRACTICE THAT ADAPTS
- A 24-question starting check builds your unit map and a daily plan back-planned from your exam date.
- Adaptive drills for all 44 topics of Units 1 to 3 (polynomial and rational functions, exponential and logarithmic functions, trigonometric and polar functions), weighted like the exam.
- Spaced review, a mistake notebook that clears questions after two correct answers, and a streak that encourages without guilt.
- More than 1,200 original multiple-choice questions with graphs and tables, 32 original free-response sets with rubric self-scoring, and a worked "Full solution" for every question.

INTERACTIVE LABS
- Transformations, polynomial builder, rational functions, exponential growth, logarithm studio, sinusoid builder, unit circle, polar graphs, parametric motion and regression fits. Every lab ends with a quiz about the values you set.

GRAPHING CALCULATOR BUILT IN
- Plot functions, make tables, find zeros, extrema and intersections, run regressions and use sliders. A calculator trainer practises the skills the calculator parts of the exam use.

FULL MOCK EXAMS
- Section I: 42 multiple-choice questions in 105 minutes (29 without a calculator, 13 with). Section II: 4 free-response questions in 70 minutes (format as published for May 2027; details can change, so check the College Board exam page). Separate part timers, mark for review, and a rough practice estimate when you finish.

REFERENCES AND TRUST
- Every topic lists its sources: the College Board Course and Exam Description and open textbooks.
- Your progress stays on your device. No account needed.
- Free to use: watch optional short videos to earn credits, or subscribe to Precalculus AP Ad-Free Monthly ($2.99 per month, 7-day free trial) to remove all ads and open every lab and mock. Cancel any time in your App Store or Google Play account settings. If you cancel, you keep ad-free until the end of the period you already paid for, and you will not be charged again.

AP is a trademark registered and owned by the College Board, which is not affiliated with, and does not endorse, this app. All questions are original practice content; readiness ranges are rough practice estimates, not predicted scores.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-funcrest.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-funcrest.html

name: PrépaMoto - Permis moto A2
description:
PrépaMoto t'aide à préparer le permis moto A2, puis le passage au A. Chaque jour, une séance d'environ 15 minutes te fait réviser le code moto, les manœuvres du plateau et les fiches de l'épreuve en circulation. Mets-toi ensuite en situation avec le code blanc et le plateau blanc.

L'app suit le plateau en vigueur depuis le 1er novembre 2025 : 6 manœuvres notées A, B ou C, et deux essais pour l'enchaînement.

TA SÉANCE DU JOUR
• Trois petites tâches par jour : une étape du plateau, une série du code et une fiche de circulation
• Adaptées à ton avancement : au début tu découvres, à la fin tu t'entraînes comme le jour J

LE CODE MOTO (ETM)
• 274 questions avec corrections expliquées, sur les 9 thèmes : circulation routière, conducteur, route, autres usagers, réglementation générale, moto et mécanique, équipements de protection, environnement, premiers secours
• Des panneaux et des situations en images
• Séries de 10 questions par thème, avec la correction après chaque question
• Code blanc : 40 questions chronométrées, réussi à partir de 35 bonnes réponses

LE PLATEAU PAS À PAS
• Les 6 manœuvres, de la manœuvre sans moteur à l'enchaînement : 13 étapes en photos
• Pour chaque étape : ce que tu fais, le repère, l'erreur à éviter et ce qui donne B ou C
• Les chiffres du plateau à connaître (S au pas, 3e engagée, 50 km/h, slalom à 40 km/h, pieds posés…), avec un mode test où ils sont cachés
• « Remets dans l'ordre » pour retenir l'enchaînement sans erreur de parcours

LA MOTO EN PHOTOS
• 6 vues de la moto et 36 points à connaître, à lire ou à écouter
• 6 thèmes : commandes et témoins, freinage, pneus, éclairage et signalisation, entretien et contrôle technique, équipement du motard

L'ÉPREUVE EN CIRCULATION
• 12 fiches, de l'installation sur la moto à la conduite autonome
• À lire ou à écouter, avec vitesse réglable, ou toutes à la suite comme un podcast
• Entraînement à voix haute : la question est lue, tu réponds au micro, tu te réécoutes, tu compares avec la réponse modèle et tu te notes

LE PLATEAU BLANC
• Après une séance sur la piste, donne-toi A, B ou C à chaque manœuvre
• L'app applique les règles des essais du jour J et te donne un score indicatif
• Ce que l'expert regarde, manœuvre par manœuvre, et l'équipement exigé

DU A2 AU A
• Le parcours du permis A2, étape par étape
• Le passage au permis A : une formation de 7 heures après 2 ans de A2, sans examen
• L'examen pas à pas et un lexique des mots du permis moto

AU QUOTIDIEN
• Date du plateau facultative et compte à rebours
• Rappel quotidien à l'heure de ton choix
• Progression, points à revoir et badges

GRATUIT POUR ESSAYER
La vue de gauche de la moto, la manœuvre sans moteur et le S au pas, les chiffres et le déroulement du plateau, les fiches de circulation 1 à 3 avec leur lecture audio et l'entraînement à voix haute, 2 questions par thème, un code blanc, un plateau blanc et le parcours du A2 au A. L'achat unique débloque tout le reste, à vie. Sans abonnement.

SANS PUB, SANS COMPTE
Aucune publicité ni compte à créer. Ta progression et tes enregistrements restent sur ton téléphone. Les questions, les photos et les fiches restent disponibles hors connexion ; l'achat et la restauration nécessitent une connexion aux stores.

Les photos sont des illustrations pédagogiques générées par IA : repère aussi les éléments sur la moto de ton école de conduite. Les panneaux reprennent les dessins du Cerema.

APPLICATION INDÉPENDANTE
PrépaMoto est une application indépendante, sans lien avec l'État ni les organismes chargés des examens du permis de conduire. Son contenu est pédagogique, rédigé d'après les textes publics en vigueur : il ne remplace pas la formation en école de conduite, la réglementation ni les consignes de l'expert. Nous ne garantissons pas la réussite à l'examen.

name: Present: Mindful Moments
description:
Most days slip by on autopilot. Present brings you back, a few times a day, for just a moment.

Now and then, a short prompt arrives:

"Look around. Notice three things you haven't paid attention to."
"Relax your jaw. Drop your shoulders. Take one slow breath."
"Listen carefully. What can you hear right now?"

Read it, pause, and carry on. That's all.

WHY PRESENT FEELS DIFFERENT

• Gentle by design. Moments arrive at slightly different times each day, so they stay a pleasant surprise rather than another alarm.
• Nothing to keep up with. No streaks, no scores, no reminders about reminders. A missed moment simply never happened.
• Your rhythm. Choose how often Present finds you, the hours it may speak up, and a quiet break for lunch or meetings. Pause it for an hour or until tomorrow with one tap.
• Five kinds of moments: Notice, Breathe, Feel, Listen and Gratitude. Keep the ones that suit you.
• In the Dynamic Island. An open moment follows you to the Dynamic Island and Lock Screen, with an icon you choose: a calm face, a candle, a cup of tea, stones and more.
• On your Home Screen. A small widget offers a new prompt each hour.
• A quiet look back. See today's moments, the past week and the prompts you've kept as favourites.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT

Present works entirely on your iPhone. There is no account, no tracking and no network connection. Your moments never leave your device.

Don't just go through the day. Be there.

name: Prêt: French Civic Exam 2027
description:
Prepare for the French civic exam (examen civique), compulsory since 1 January 2026 for the multi-year residence card (CSP), the resident card (CR) and naturalisation.

JUST LIKE THE EXAM
• Knowledge questions from the lists published by the French Ministry of the Interior, word for word, for your type of document.
• Everyday-life situations, like those on the exam.
• Mock exam: 40 questions, 45 minutes, pass or fail (32 correct answers out of 40).

UNDERSTAND AND REMEMBER
• Questions stay in French, as on the exam; a translation and a short explanation are one tap away.
• Languages: Arabic, Russian, Ukrainian, Turkish, English and French.
• Five themes: principles and values of the Republic, institutions, rights and duties, history and geography, living in France.
• Review your mistakes and see your readiness for each theme.
• Dictionary of the difficult French words in the questions.
• Works offline.

FREE AND FULL ACCESS
• Free: the whole "Principles and values" theme and one mock exam.
• Full access for 90 days: one payment, no subscription, no auto-renewal, no account.

PLEASE NOTE
The knowledge questions come from the lists published by the French Ministry of the Interior. The app is not affiliated with the ministry; the answer options and explanations were written by the app's authors. The app does not issue certificates and does not guarantee a pass.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://yurgon.app/pret/privacy/

name: Print Calendar – PDF & Export
description:
Print Calendar turns the calendars on your iPhone or iPad into paper and files.

PRINT OR SAVE A PDF
• Month, week, day, list and year pages
• Letter or A4, portrait or landscape, three text sizes, colour or black and white
• Choose the calendars and the dates
• Busy days are not cut short: long titles wrap, and anything that does not fit a month box is printed in full on the next page
• Day and week pages show the hours your events need, not a fixed 8 to 6
• Repeating events, all-day events, time zones and clock changes appear as they do in the Calendar app
• Print with AirPrint or share the PDF

EXPORT WITH HOURS ADDED UP
• Excel (.xlsx), CSV and ICS files, one row per event
• Title, start, end, duration, calendar, place, notes and attendees
• Hours per calendar and per title, on screen and on a second sheet of the Excel file
• For timesheets, invoices and records requests

IMPORT A FILE
• Add events from an ICS file or a spreadsheet saved as CSV
• See what the file holds and choose the calendar first
• Undo the last import with one tap

SEE IT BEFORE YOU PAY
The preview of your own calendar, the event count and the hours totals are free, and so is one printed sample page. One purchase unlocks printing, sharing, exporting and importing. No subscription, no account, no ads.

PRIVATE
Everything happens on your device. The app makes no network requests. It reads your calendars to make the pages and files you ask for, and changes a calendar only when you import a file.

Works with every calendar the Calendar app shows, including iCloud, Google, Exchange and subscribed calendars.

Help: arcticstudios.co/print-calendar/support

name: Print Text Messages to PDF
description:
Print Text Messages to PDF turns a conversation into a document: a dated, page-numbered PDF that looks like the conversation, plus a transcript you can search, print or open as a spreadsheet.

HOW IT WORKS
iPhone apps are not allowed to read your messages, so you give the app the conversation in one of three ways:
• Screenshots. Take overlapping screenshots of the conversation. The app puts them in order and joins them into one continuous conversation.
• A screen recording. Record the screen while you scroll. Best for long conversations.
• An exported chat file. Chat apps such as WhatsApp can save a chat with “Export Chat”. The app reads that file, with the exact time of every message.

WHAT YOU GET
• A PDF with pictures: the conversation as it looked, cut into pages between messages, with page numbers, the export date and an optional cover page. The text in it can be searched.
• A PDF transcript: who said what, under the time shown on screen.
• A spreadsheet (CSV) and a plain-text file.
• Print, save to Files, AirDrop or email from the share sheet.

SEE IT BEFORE YOU PAY
Joining, reading and the full preview are free. You see your own conversation, joined and transcribed, before you decide. One purchase then unlocks every export of every conversation. It is a one-time purchase. There is no subscription and no account.

PRIVATE
Everything happens on your iPhone. Your screenshots, recordings and chat files are never uploaded, and the app collects no data.

HONEST ABOUT WHAT IT IS
• Where two screenshots do not overlap, the app tells you and marks the place in the PDF, so a missing message is never hidden.
• You can correct names, dates and any line of the transcript before exporting.
• Text is read by the iPhone’s own text recognition. It is accurate on clear screenshots but not perfect, which is why the picture pages are always part of the PDF. Emoji stay in the pictures but are not in the transcript.
• Messages shows a time only above each group of messages. Each message is listed under the time shown before it.
• An export is a faithful copy of what the screen showed, with the date it was made. It is not a certified document. Ask the court or office you send it to what they accept.

WORKS WITH
Any app that shows a conversation on screen, in light or dark mode, at any text size. The transcript has been tested in English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Japanese, Korean and Chinese.

Made by Arctic Studios.

name: Priors: Quant Games & Contests
description: Priors is where quant aspirants train probability and market intuition, one quick game at a time. • Games: guess the correlation, price the odds, read the data and beat the clock. Each game adapts to your level. • Puzzles: probability and expected-value problems. Guess first, solve, then see the truth with a simulation. • Today's set: a daily question, Drop and Fermi of the day. • Rated contests: daily at 9 PM IST, plus weekly and monthly contests, with one contest rating and named ranks. • Duels: challenge a friend to the same rounds. • Club Battle: play for your college and climb the clubs board. • Markets: Open Book, a weekly market players make for each other. • Learn: options, expected value, statistics, market making and more, built on real market data. Play without signing in. Sign in with Apple, Google, GitHub or an email link to save your progress, streaks and rating. Turn on a daily reminder whenever you like. Questions: hello@priorslab.com

name: Privacy Blur – Redact & Censor
description:
Privacy Blur helps you hide personal details in photos and screenshots before you share them. Everything runs on your device: no account, no login, no uploads, and it works offline.

AUTO DETECT – YOU STAY IN CONTROL
Privacy Blur scans your image on-device and suggests what to hide:
• Faces
• Phone numbers and email addresses
• Postal addresses
• Payment card numbers (checksum-validated)
• Bank, IBAN and account numbers
• ID-style numbers
• Text that looks like a license plate
• QR codes, barcodes and links

Detection is a helpful assistant, not a guarantee. Every suggestion is shown for review: deselect anything that doesn't need hiding and mark missed areas by hand.

EDITING TOOLS
• Blur, pixelate and solid redaction
• Rectangle selection and freehand brush
• Tap a word to redact it
• Find text: redact every occurrence of a word
• Face blur with adjustable intensity
• Undo/redo, zoom and pan, before/after compare
• Redact All in one tap, with preview and confirmation

PERMANENT REDACTION
Edits are flattened into the exported pixels, so there are no layers anyone can remove. For sensitive text, use solid redaction – the app reminds you that blur and pixelate are weaker.

CHECK BEFORE YOU SHARE
A privacy checklist appears before export and warns you if detected items are still uncovered.

PHOTO METADATA, FREE
See what a photo reveals – location, device and date – and remove it: remove all, location only, or keep. Metadata removal is free.

EXPORT YOUR WAY
Export PNG or JPEG and save to Photos or Files, or use the share sheet. Your originals are never modified.

FREE VERSION
• Up to 3 photos per batch, or watch an optional ad to unlock one bigger batch
• Quick Protect preset
• 5 saved recent projects
• A small banner ad on the app's Home screen only – no ads in the editor or during export

PRIVACY BLUR PRO
• Personal name detection (on-device language analysis)
• Watch words: add your own name, address or other words and they're flagged automatically every time
• Deep Scan for tiny text in large screenshots
• Large batches
• More presets – Screenshot Safe, Social Share, Documents & IDs, Faces Only – with per-category style rules
• Unlimited recent projects
• HEIC export plus quality and resize options
• No ads

Work you've already saved always stays accessible.

Works on iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo.

SUBSCRIPTION INFO
Privacy Blur Pro is an auto-renewable subscription, available weekly, monthly or yearly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in your Account Settings on the App Store.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://diponten.com/2026/11/18/privacy-blur-privacy-policy/

name: Private Vault: Silo
description:
Silo keeps your private photos, videos and files in a vault that only you can open.

Everything is encrypted on your phone before it is saved. There is no account to create, and Silo never sees your files, their names or your PIN.

NOTHING LOST
Every item is read back and checked before Silo offers to remove the original from your photo library. Vault health checks your vault and tells you if anything is wrong.

YOURS TO TAKE OUT
Export full-resolution originals at any time, on every plan, free. The file format is published, with a free tool that opens a vault without Silo.

LOCKED WHEN YOU LEAVE
Unlock with a 6-digit PIN or your face or fingerprint. Silo locks when you leave it and hides itself in the app switcher.

A RECOVERY PHRASE
Write down your recovery phrase once. It brings your vault back on a new phone, and it is the only key to your backup.

SILO PRO
• No limits on photos and videos
• Files of any kind: documents, PDFs and more
• Encrypted backup to your own cloud storage
• A passphrase instead of a PIN
• Emergency PIN: a second PIN, set up in Settings. Entering it on the lock screen permanently erases the vault on this phone and opens an empty one
• Alternative vaults: more vaults, each with its own PIN. Entering a vault's PIN on the lock screen opens that vault

The free plan holds up to 100 photos and 10 videos. Pro is weekly, yearly or a one-time lifetime purchase.

NO ADS. NO TRACKING.
No ads and no analytics identifiers. Error reports are sent only if you say yes.

Silo Pro is a weekly or yearly subscription, each with a 14-day free trial for new subscribers, or a one-time lifetime purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; you can manage or cancel it in your store account settings. Prices are shown in the app before you buy.

Terms of Use: https://silo-private-vault.fyi/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://silo-private-vault.fyi/privacy/

name: Promise Box: Bible Verses
description:
Tap the box and receive a promise from the Bible.

Promise Box is the traditional box of Scripture cards, now on your phone. One tap, one coloured paper, one word from God for your day. Say Amen to keep it, and send a promise to someone with their name on it.

A PROMISE FOR YOUR DAY
• Tap the box and watch the paper come out, like the promise box on the kitchen table.
• More than 500 promises, chosen one by one. None repeats until you have seen them all.
• Morning verses arrive in the morning. Verses of rest, at night.
• Get the day’s promise in full in the notification, at the hour you choose. You do not even need to open the app.

SEND ONE TO SOMEONE YOU LOVE
• Type their name and say what they are going through: anxiety, health, family, work, grief, tiredness, a decision, a birthday.
• The card carries their name: “A promise for Mary”.
• Send it in a message, post it to your story or save the picture.
• A ready invitation for your story: “Reply with your name and I’ll draw a Bible promise for you”.

A PROMISE FOR 2027
• From December 15 to January 15, draw your promise for the new year. Just one, kept with you all year.
• Draw one for each person in your family: “Anna’s promise for 2027”.

MADE WITH CARE
• Large, beautiful type that is easy to read. Light and dark themes.
• Kept: every promise you answered with Amen.
• No account. What is yours stays on your phone.
• Few ads, rated for general audiences, never before the Word. One payment removes them all, forever. No subscription.

Bible text: Berean Standard Bible or King James Version (your choice), both public domain.

name: ProofSheet Print
description:
Choose up to 12 photos from Files and arrange them on A4 or Letter paper. Adjust the grid, margins and photo size, choose fit or crop, and add photo numbers or filenames.

Preview the PDF, share a copy or open the iOS print dialog. Use Actual size / 100% and check the printed 100 mm line with a ruler. Printer settings can change the final scale; the app does not guarantee the physical size of a print.

Your selected source files stay unchanged. The working sheet and copied originals are stored on your device. No account, advertising or subscription is required.

name: ProofSpindle
description: ProofSpindle is a personal editorial correction tracker for writers and editors. Create a manuscript record with its author and revision, then record corrections with a specific location and severity. Resolve and reopen issues, inspect remaining critical items in the review queue, and read a revision report based on your real records. Search titles or authors, edit and delete records, and export your data as JSON. The app tracks issues you enter; it does not open document files, generate corrections or certify an error-free manuscript.\n\nFree, no account, advertising or in-app purchases. Core records work offline and stay on this device. Optional fictional sample records are available on an empty collection. Supports English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian, with system, light and dark appearance.

name: ProSport Prague
description:
PROSPORT is the home of amateur tennis tournaments in Prague.

• Find the next tournament or league and sign up in a tap.
• Pay the entry fee by bank transfer from the organiser's QR code in your own bank app.
• On match day see your court and time, get a notification when you're called to court, and enter the score in two taps.
• Follow the draw, groups and play-off live.
• Season rating and your match history.
• Organisers run everything from the same app: registrations, payments, draw, schedule, courts and results.

Sign in with Apple, Google or Telegram.

name: Prüfungskompass AEVO
description:
Prüfungskompass AEVO unterstützt dich bei der Vorbereitung auf die schriftliche Ausbildereignungsprüfung. Du bearbeitest 600 fallbezogene Lernfragen mit Lösungen und Erklärungen aus allen vier Handlungsfeldern:

• Ausbildungsvoraussetzungen prüfen und Ausbildung planen
• Ausbildung vorbereiten und bei der Einstellung mitwirken
• Ausbildung durchführen
• Ausbildung abschließen

Lerne kapitelweise, markiere schwierige Fragen und wiederhole sie im Trainer. Im Prüfungsbereich kannst du einzelne Themen oder ein schriftliches Gesamttraining mit Zeitvorgabe üben. Dein persönlicher Lernplan hilft dir, bis zum Prüfungstermin regelmäßig zu lernen.

150 Fragen stehen kostenlos zur Verfügung. Mit einem einmaligen In-App-Kauf schaltest du den vollständigen Katalog frei. Kein Abo. Bereits gekaufte Inhalte kannst du wiederherstellen.

Dein Lernfortschritt bleibt auf deinem Gerät. Zum Lernen ist kein Konto erforderlich; die Fragen sind offline verfügbar. Hinweise zu Fragen kannst du über ein Formular als vorbereitete E-Mail senden.

Die App behandelt die schriftliche Prüfung. Sie ersetzt keine Vorbereitung auf die praktische Durchführung oder Präsentation und das Fachgespräch. Die Aufgaben sind eigenständiges Übungsmaterial, keine offiziellen IHK-Prüfungsaufgaben. Keine Verbindung zu IHK oder DIHK und keine Bestehensgarantie.

name: PS Travel: Read Signs & Menus
description:
PS Travel is the travel helper in your pocket. Point your iPhone at a sign, menu, label or ticket in any language, and it tells you what it says and what it means for you, in your own language, out loud.

LOOK: READ ANYTHING
• Take a photo or pick one from your photo library.
• PS Travel reads the text, translates it and explains it: "Pharmacy, open 24 hours", "Contains peanuts", "No entry after 10 pm".
• Menus are translated item by item, with prices.
• The answer is read aloud, so you can keep your eyes on the street.
• Shops, hotels and addresses in a photo become a place card you can save.

ASK: YOUR TRAVEL CHAT
• Ask anything about your trip: tipping, transport, food, what to do in an emergency.
• Type or speak your question; ask about a photo you just read.
• Turn on location and the answers fit the city you are in.
• "How do I say...?" gives the phrase in the local script, with an easy pronunciation guide and a speak button.

SAY IT FOR ME
Type what you want to say. PS Travel shows it big on screen in the local language and plays it aloud for the person in front of you.

GET THERE
• Navigate opens Google Maps with the place.
• Show the driver puts the destination full screen in the local script, with "Please take me here". Saved places work without internet.
• Nearby: one tap to find a pharmacy, ATM, toilet, hospital or station in Google Maps.

SMART SEARCH (OPTIONAL)
Turn on Smart nearby search for real places from Google Maps, or Smart web search for fresh facts like opening hours, with sources shown under the answer. These need billing on your Gemini key and are off by default.

HISTORY
Your scans, chats and saved places stay on your iPhone, so you can open them again later, even offline.

YOUR LANGUAGE
Answers, translations and speech come in your choice of 78 languages, including English, Burmese, Thai, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Malay, Filipino, Arabic, Spanish, French and German.

YOU PAY GOOGLE DIRECTLY, ONLY FOR WHAT YOU USE
PS Travel uses Google's Gemini API with your own API key, created free in Google AI Studio in a few minutes; the app guides you. Most people can start on Google's free tier with no card; free-tier keys have a daily limit. If you turn on billing with Google, Google charges you directly.
Note: a Gemini app subscription (Google AI Pro or Ultra) does not include API use.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• The developer collects nothing: no account, no analytics, no ads.
• Your key stays in the iPhone Keychain. Photos and questions go only to Google's Gemini API.
• Location is off until you turn it on, and only your approximate area is used.

GOOD TO KNOW
• Requires an internet connection (except saved places and History) and a Gemini API key.
• Available only where Google offers the Gemini API.
• Answers come from Google's Gemini models and can be wrong. Check important things, such as allergens, opening hours or medical instructions, with the place itself or a qualified person.

PS Travel is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google. Gemini and Google Maps are trademarks of Google LLC.

name: Pull My Finger: Fart Match
description:
Go on... pull my finger!

Pull My Finger is the silliest memory game on your phone. Every card is a finger waiting to be pulled. Pull one and it lets rip. Pull another: is it the same fart? Then you've found a pair!

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a card to pull the finger and hear the fart
• Pull a second finger and try to find its match
• Remember where every fart is hiding
• Find all the pairs in as few pulls as you can

TWELVE GLORIOUS FARTS
The Squeaker, the Trumpet, Thunder, the Machine Gun, Silent but Deadly, the Question, the Tuba, the Duck, the Motorboat, the Bubbler, the Door Hinge and the Balloon. Collect them all in your Fart Collection and play them back any time.

EARS ONLY MODE
Think you're a true connoisseur? In Ears Only mode there are no clouds and no clues. You'll have to match every fart by sound alone.

SIX LEVELS
Start with 6 fingers and work up to 24. Earn up to three stars on every level in both modes.

MEET UNCLE PARP
Your host. He's always got a finger out, and he's always got one more in the tank.

• Real, hilarious fart recordings
• Great for kids, parties and long car journeys
• Pay once, play forever: no adverts, no in-app purchases
• Works offline

Turn your sound up!

name: Pulsefold
description:
Pulsefold is a tempo lab. One glowing core, five nodes in orbit. Tap the core, pick a node, get to work.

Practise with a click. Find a song's tempo by tapping along. Then find out if your hands really sit on the beat. That last part is the game.

IN THE LAB
• Metronome from 40 to 220 BPM. Spin the dial, or nudge it one beat at a time.
• Tap tempo. Tap along with a record and the dial lands on its BPM.
• 2/4, 3/4, 4/4 and 6/8. Accent on the one.
• Eight presets. Name them after songs. One tap to recall.
• Optional haptic pulse, so you feel the beat in your hand.
• The click plays with the silent switch on and sits on top of your music.

IN THE GAME
• Fold. Rings collapse onto the core, right on the beat. Tap as they land.
• Three tempos. Calm at 80, Drive at 110, Rush at 140.
• Perfect inside 50 ms. Good inside 120 ms. Anything else is a Miss.
• Chain hits. Every 10 in a row bumps your multiplier, up to x4.
• 30-second rounds, a four-beat count-in, accuracy at the end.
• A top 10 for each tempo, under a handle you pick. No account.

Then there's the lights. Turn the Palette dial and the whole lab re-lights: Synthwave, Ice, Toxic or Sunset. Every screen. Every ring.

No sign-up. No email. Your presets, best scores and palette sync quietly under an anonymous ID. Everything works offline; the leaderboard catches up when you're back on signal. Want a clean slate? Info, Reset my data. Done.

Count it in. Play.

name: Pyramid Solitaire: Big Cards
description:
Pyramid solitaire made to be easy on the eyes.

Pyramid Solitaire: Big Cards is the classic patience game with big cards, large numbers and clear colours. Pick up a deal, play at your own pace and enjoy a game that is simple to read and simple to use.

READABLE BY DESIGN
- Large and extra-large card faces
- A four-colour deck: spades black, hearts red, diamonds blue, clubs green
- Heavy, easy-to-read card numbers
- Text follows your device's text size
- Left-hand mode puts the controls where your thumb is

EVERY DEAL CAN BE WON
Every deal in the app is checked to be winnable, so a stuck game is never the game's fault. Take your time and look for the way through.

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Remove two open cards that add up to 13; a king goes on its own
- Jacks count 11 and queens 12
- Pair with the waste card from the stock, with three passes through it
- Clear the pyramid to win
- Unlimited undo and free hints, as many as you like
- A new daily deal every day, with a streak calendar
- Sound and vibration you can switch off

KEEP TRACK
See your games played, wins, win rate, streaks, best time and fewest moves for each mode.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose a card back and a table colour from the free looks, or add the Garden, Evening and Seaside packs. Every look keeps the cards bright and easy to read.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Vietnamese and Thai.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
- Works offline
- No account, no sign-in
- Your game stays on your device

name: QQFIT: дневник тренировок
description:
QQFIT — дневник тренировок, в котором прогресс видно сразу. Записывай подходы в зале или дома, а каждая группа мышц получит ранг по твоим реальным результатам — от Камня до Олимпии. Карта тела покажет, что прокачано, а что отстаёт.

Программы тренировок для зала и дома
• Готовые программы под цель: набрать мышечную массу, стать сильнее, рельеф, снизить вес, держать форму без зала. 17 программ и 64 тренировки, у каждой три уровня сложности.
• Тренировки в тренажёрном зале, дома, на турнике и в поездке.
• Раздел «Дома»: 24 тренировки без зала — со своим весом, гантелями и резинкой.
• 285 упражнений с описанием техники, у многих — показ движения кадрами.
• Комплексы дня: разминка, растяжка, разгрузка спины.

Дневник тренировок
• Подходы отмечаются галочкой: вес, повторы и таймер отдыха под рукой.
• Упражнения можно переставлять прямо в тренировке, если тренажёр занят.
• Личные рекорды и их история.
• После каждой тренировки видно, что выросло: рекорды и повышения рангов. Картинкой ранга можно поделиться.
• Кардио с расчётом калорий. Шаги — из приложения «Здоровье», только чтение.

Ранги мышц и мотивация
• 10 рангов с медалями для каждой группы мышц — от Камня до Олимпии. Ранг растёт от твоих результатов и не падает.
• Огонёк серии за любую активность: тренировку, разминку, воду или запись еды. Есть пауза на время болезни или травмы.
• Уровни, опыт и монеты за активность — без покупок за деньги.

Питание и калории
• Дневник питания и счётчик калорий: встроенная база продуктов, свои блюда, КБЖУ, вода.
• Калькуляторы нормы калорий, БЖУ и воды.

Удобно
• Текущая тренировка — на экране блокировки и в Dynamic Island.
• Виджеты на экран «Домой»: вода в один тап и «Начать тренировку».
• Напоминания о тренировке, взвешивании и еде, недельный отчёт — каждое включается отдельно.
• Копия прогресса: сохрани файл и восстанови данные на новом телефоне.
• Тёмная и светлая темы.

Просто и честно
• Без регистрации и аккаунта.
• Все данные хранятся на твоём телефоне. Наружу они уходят только по твоему действию: когда сохраняешь копию, делишься картинкой или пишешь нам.
• Без рекламы и аналитики. Бесплатно.

Важно
QQFIT не является медицинским изделием и не предназначено для диагностики, лечения или профилактики заболеваний. Нормы калорий, нагрузки и ранги считаются по общим формулам и приблизительны. По вопросам здоровья, перед началом занятий и при изменении питания посоветуйся с врачом.
Приложение для пользователей от 16 лет.

Политика конфиденциальности: https://letsdoingyt-cpu.github.io/qqfit-legal/privacy.html

name: QRDKEY — Keys on your phone
description:
QRDKEY is an access key ring for your phone. It stores the keys sent to you by the manager of your car park, residents' association, holiday rental or office, and opens the door when you show a QR code that changes every few seconds.

HOW IT WORKS
1. The site manager sends you your key (a link or an enrolment QR code).
2. In the app, tap «Añadir llave» (Add key) and scan the QR code or paste the link.
3. Show the app's QR code to the reader at the door or barrier. Done.

WHY IT IS SECURE
• The QR code is renewed every few seconds: a photo or a forwarded screenshot will not get anyone in.
• The code is generated on your phone, offline: it works in a basement or in the middle of the countryside.
• The key is only shown after you unlock with Face ID or Touch ID.
• The key is hidden in the app switcher, and a screenshot is useless: the code expires in seconds.

ONE APP FOR EVERYTHING
• Car park, holiday home, office, self-storage unit, gym… several sites in a single key ring.
• Guest keys with an expiry date and single-use keys, for example for a delivery.
• If you change phones, the manager simply sends you the key again. Nothing to copy or return.

PRIVACY
QRDKEY has no user accounts, sends no data to any server and uses no analytics or advertising. Keys are stored only on your device. The camera is used solely to read the enrolment QR code.

FOR MANAGERS AND INSTALLERS
QRDKEY comes with a management panel and a controller compatible with any existing barrier, door or lock. Keys can be issued and revoked instantly, with schedules per key, RFID cards, opening by phone call and a log of every access. More information and a demo at www.qrdkey.com.

QRDKEY is a product of VOIPMINIC S.L.U. (Manacor, Balearic Islands, Spain).

name: QRultra
description:
No ads. No in-app purchases. Completely free.
QRultra is a QR code reader built for one thing: scanning the moment you open it. There are no ads, no paid upgrades and no account to create. Every feature is free, now and later.

- Instant
The camera starts with the app. Point at a QR code anywhere on screen and it's read—no frame to line up. You get a clean cut-out of the code and the result right away.

- One-tap actions
Open links, join Wi-Fi networks, add contacts and events, call, email, message, or open a location in Maps. Copy or search plain text.

- Safety at a glance
Plain HTTP links, short links and look-alike domains are clearly marked. Dangerous links such as javascript: are never opened.

- History and search
Scans are grouped by day and can be searched, filtered by type and starred. Turn history off or clear it at any time.

- Scan from photos
Read codes in screenshots and photos. On iPad, drag and drop an image.

- Quick launch
Open the scanner from Control Center, the Action button or the Lock Screen.

- Privacy
No accounts, ads, analytics or network access. History stays on your device.

- Free forever
No ads, no in-app purchases, no locked features.

Works on iPhone and iPad, in English and Japanese.

name: Qu Student
description:
An independent app for Qassim University students, not affiliated with the university. The app is in Arabic, with an English option.

Qu Student brings everything a Qassim University student needs for the semester into one simple app.

Build your timetable in minutes
• Import the offered courses straight from the university portal after you sign in.
• Pick sections and watch your weekly timetable take shape.
• Add more than one section of the same course (lecture, lab, tutorial).
• Instant warnings for time clashes and shared final-exam periods.

Timetable summary and exam periods

Export and share

GPA calculator
• Semester and cumulative GPA on the 5-point or 4-point scale.

Absence calculator
• See your absence percentage and how many hours you have left in each course.

Academic calendar

Qeeem

Home

name: Quelix
description:
Quelix is a small offline ledger for loans between people: a book, a ladder, a camping lantern, a cake tin. You write one row for each thing — what it is, who has it, which way it went, when, and when you agreed it should come back. When it comes back, you mark the return.

From those rows it answers two questions. **Who has what?** Every person gets a single folded number: what you lent them and have not got back, minus what you borrowed and have not returned. Positive means they hold more of yours; negative means you hold more of theirs; zero is settled. **What is still out?** Rows stay open until you close them, so nothing quietly disappears.

Pick a subject, start a focus session and take a real break when it ends. Quiet Hours keeps time for you, even when the app is closed, and tells you when a phase is over.

FOCUS, THEN A REAL BREAK

SEE WHERE YOUR STUDY TIME GOES

name: Quran Maqasid
description:
Read the Quran, and understand what it is driving at.

Quran Maqasid puts the full Arabic text of the Quran on your phone, readable without a connection, and opens every verse onto the classical scholars who explained it. The name means "the aims of the Quran": for each surah, the app shows what its commentators said the surah is about, so you read a chapter as one message rather than a string of verses.

THE QURAN, OFFLINE • All 114 surahs in clear Arabic script, stored on your phone. • A translation under every verse in English, Indonesian, Turkish or Urdu, kept on your phone once you have read the surah. • Search the whole Quran in Arabic, instantly and offline. No need to type the vowel marks. • Save the verses you want to come back to.

UNDERSTAND EACH VERSE • Tap any verse to open its page: the classical tafsirs in Arabic, among them al-Razi, al-Qurtubi, al-Zamakhshari, al-Alusi and Ibn Ashur. • The aim of each surah as al-Biqa'i stated it, with book and page, beside what other commentators said of it. • Notes on method where a word is often misread, so the verse is understood as its commentators understood it. • The great Arabic dictionaries for the Quran's words: Lisan al-Arab, Maqayis al-Lugha, al-Raghib's Mufradat and Umdat al-Huffaz.

LEARN QURANIC ARABIC • Reading basics: the letters, their sounds and the marks you need to read the Quran. • Surah by surah: all 114 surahs word by word, with meanings and quizzes. • Essential Quranic words: the most frequent words of the Quran, a small vocabulary that opens a large part of the text.

A VERSE EVERY DAY • An optional daily reminder with a short verse, at the time you choose. It is set up on your phone itself: no account, no server.

IN FIVE LANGUAGES Arabic, English, Indonesian (Bahasa Indonesia), Turkish (Türkçe) and Urdu (اردو), right to left where the language needs it.

FREE, WITHOUT ADS, WITHOUT AN ACCOUNT No sign-up, no advertising, no payments. Your settings and saved verses stay on your phone.

Privacy policy: https://quranmaqasid.com/privacy

name: Radar Leonida
description:
Playing through Leonida right now? Radar Leonida is the fast, offline companion built to sit right beside your controller — zero ads, zero clutter, straight to the answer.

■ VERIFIED GUIDES FOR REAL GAMEPLAY
• Master the systems that matter: the 5 criminal profile tiers (from Professional to permanent Irredeemable), smart police searches, vehicle trackers and garage re-registration.

• Instant global search in milliseconds and dark theme by default.
• 100% offline and private: no account, no sign-up, no tracking. Interface in 10 languages (guides in EN, PT-BR and ES).

■ FREE TO START, ONE UNLOCK FOR EVERYTHING
Try the opening guides, map pins, checklists and all cheats for free. A single one-time purchase (never a subscription) unlocks every guide, story chapter, map pin and collectible.

Unofficial fan companion guide. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

name: Raven Studio
description:
Raven Studio is where your business approves its content.

Raven turns one idea into native drafts for LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, your newsletter, your blog, short video scripts and your Google Business Profile, written in your brand voice. The app puts every draft in front of you so nothing goes out under your name until you approve it.

APPROVE ON THE GO
See every draft waiting for you, grouped by channel. Read it in a preview of how it will look, change any word, then approve it or turn it down.

WRITE FROM YOUR PHONE
Drop in a topic, an offer or an old article, pick the channels, and Raven writes a draft for each one in your voice and sends it to Approvals.

SEE WHAT HAPPENED

name: RCFly: Helicopter Flight

Take off, find your hover and bring it home.

RCFly is a focused RC helicopter control training simulator set in a 3D model flying field. Practise smooth control through 12 lessons covering takeoff, hovering, navigation and precision landing. Retry quickly, earn stars and improve your own best results.

CONTROL YOUR WAY
Use the on-screen twin sticks on iPhone and iPad, a compatible game controller, or keyboard controls on Mac. Adjust sensitivity, stick response and flight assistance to suit your experience.

LEARN AT YOUR PACE
Start with beginner assistance, then explore assisted and manual control. Switch between a ground pilot view and a following camera, pause when needed and restart a lesson with a tap.

A SIMPLE, COMPLETE TRAINING EDITION
All included lessons are free. No account, advertisements, in-app purchases or subscriptions. Progress and settings are stored locally on your device. English and Simplified Chinese are available.

name: rDriftfolio & Cue the Slope
description:
Driftfolio muuttaa lumisen laakson tarkkuutta vaativaksi suunnittelukentäksi.

Määritä jokaiselle lumipallolle oma alamäkeen johtava toimintaketju ja valitse hetki, jolloin se lähtee liikkeelle harjanteelta. Seuraa sitten ennalta määräytyvää reittiä tuoreen lumen, tiiviiksi pakkautuneiden polkujen, jään ja kallioiden halki.

Jokaisen reitin on päätyttävä oikeanmuotoiseen hahmoon täsmälleen oikealla lumimäärällä. Tuore lumi kasvattaa pallon massaa vain kerran, minkä jälkeen se tiivistyy. Yhteisillä rinteillä lähtöajat on porrastettava huolellisesti, jotta reitit eivät törmää tai risteä keskenään.

Avaa uusia lukuja aamun lumisilta rinteiltä revontulten valaisemille solille, harjoittele jo läpäistyjä kenttiä, kerää talvisia muistiinpanoja ja palauta hiljaiset maamerkit entiseen loistoonsa samalla, kun suunnittelutaitosi kehittyvät.

name: RE:DELIVER: Time Loop Puzzle
description:
You have one short shift and one parcel to deliver. It is not enough time. So you do it again, and this time the you from a moment ago is still there, doing exactly what you did.

RE:DELIVER is a puzzle game about working with your own earlier selves. Play a loop. Loop again. Your past run walks the same steps while you take new ones: it holds the door you could not hold, stands on the plate you had to leave, and passes the parcel through the counter to where you are waiting now.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Step by step. Nothing moves until you do, so there is always time to think.
• Every loop you keep becomes a colleague who repeats it exactly.
• One, two or three of you. Each room has a smallest number of couriers it can be done with, and a star for matching it.
• Doors, pressure plates, counters that pass a parcel through a wall, switches that let go by themselves, and parcels that each have a right address.

61 ROOMS, SIX CHAPTERS
Each chapter is about one new idea. Every room has been checked by an exact solver: each one can be delivered, and none can be done with fewer couriers than it says.

A NEW ROOM EVERY DAY
The daily delivery is one more proven room, the same for everyone, and free. Keep a streak, see how you did against the best known delivery, and share the result.

SOMETHING TO EARN
• A star for the fewest couriers, a swift mark for nearly the fewest steps.
• Seven ranks, from Trainee to Loop Master, each with a uniform of its own.
• Nineteen stamps for things worth doing once.

MADE TO BE FINISHED
• Step back one move at a time, or take a whole loop back.
• Hints show the next step, and they come back every day.
• Stuck? After a few tries the game offers a hint on the house, and then a way round the room.
• Your progress stays on your device.

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Swipe across the room or use the on-screen pad. A hardware keyboard works too.
• Music that fills out as more of you are at work, and haptics on iPhone.
• English, Türkçe, Deutsch, Français, Español and 日本語.
• Plays offline. No account.

ONE PRICE, NO TRICKS
The first two chapters, 19 rooms, are free. A single purchase opens everything else and is yours to keep. No ads, no subscription, no timers, nothing to collect.

Send a friend a challenge: any delivery can be shared as a short code that replays your run in their game.

name: ReamRoute
description:
ReamRoute helps recycling teams plan what to keep and what to remove from a batch of waste paper. Compare different sorting plans against the receiving depot's limits, see how much usable paper each plan would take out, and keep a record of what was actually moved.

HOW A SORTING SESSION WORKS

1. Weigh the batch. Add loose materials or numbered bags and record the weight of each material. Work in kilograms or grams and set the increment your scale uses. If a weight is still unknown, leave it pending until you can check it.

2. Enter the receiving rules. Classify materials as paper, contaminants, or unconfirmed. Set a limit for total contaminants and add material-specific limits when the receiver specifies them. Reuse a previous receiver's rules for a new batch and confirm the material matches before saving.

3. Try a sorting plan. On the sorting belt, select a material to remove part of it or transfer it in full. To plan a partial pick, choose a rule and a source and calculate the minimum removal at your scale's increment. To plan whole-bag moves, select up to 16 available bags and look for combinations that meet every configured limit.

4. Compare the trade-offs. A combination that saves the most paper can weigh more to carry. Compare candidate plans by remaining weight, weight moved, paper moved, and contaminant share. See how the remaining mix changes and which rules pass, exceed their limits, or need review.

5. Record the result and share it. Open the sorting checklist to see each transfer in order. Record actual weights separately, then preview the checklist as a PDF or share CSV details for the handoff. Back up and restore your records with a local JSON file.

Open the built-in sample to try a 100 kg campus paper batch. ReamRoute works offline and stores records on your device. No account is required.

name: Relais Distant
description:
Relais Distant transforme ton iPhone et ton iPad en télécommande pour ton Mac.

UN COMPTE, TOUS TES APPAREILS
Connecte tes appareils une fois : ton Mac apparaît dans « Mes appareils ». Touche-le, son écran s'affiche, tu en prends le contrôle.

PAS DE CODE À RETENIR
Pour connecter un nouvel appareil, saisis un code à usage unique de 6 caractères ou scanne un QR code. Plus d'identifiants à 9 chiffres à recopier.

CHEZ UN AMI, RIEN À INSTALLER

name: Relaypad
description:
Turn your iPhone sideways and use it as a trackpad and shortcut keyboard for your Mac. Move the pointer, click, drag, and scroll while keeping your most-used keys within reach.

Keep a vibe coding session going between sets at home. Leave the cursor in Claude Code or Codex on your Mac. In Relaypad, open Keyboard, dictate your next prompt with the iPhone keyboard, then tap Send to insert the text at the cursor.

The keypad starts with Fn, Control, Option, 1, 2, 3, and a wide Space key. Remap any key to a shortcut, hold a modifier while you tap another key, or double-tap Fn for Mac apps configured to use that gesture.

Get the free Relaypad for Mac companion from the project website. Put both devices on the same local network, start the Mac receiver, and enter its pairing code on your iPhone. Enable Accessibility for the receiver so it can deliver pointer and keyboard input. The devices reconnect using the saved pairing.

Relaypad uses an encrypted local connection. There is no account, subscription, advertising, or analytics. The iPhone app and Mac receiver are open source under the MIT license.

name: RelaySlate
description:
Keep the next person informed. Create a handoff with an owner, priority, notes and a checklist. Confirm each step before closing it; reopen a closed handoff when work resumes.

RelaySlate keeps open work, an archive and completion summaries in separate views. Search by name or owner, filter urgent work, edit checklist items and export records as JSON. This is a local handoff notebook on one device, with no team sync or messaging service.

Core features work offline. Free, with no account, ads or in-app purchases. Choose English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese or Italian, and System, Light or Dark appearance. Sample records are optional; new collections start empty.

name: RemindDart: Quick Reminders
description:
Get a thought out of your head and into Apple Reminders.

RemindDart is a quick-entry companion for the reminders you already use. Type a title, add a note, choose a list and save. No RemindDart account is required.

CAPTURE WHILE IT IS FRESH
Write one reminder and move straight on to the next. Your unfinished draft stays on the device. Undo a just-saved reminder to bring it back for editing.

PICK A TIME YOUR WAY
Tap a favorite clock time or a relative-time preset. Set a specific date, make a reminder all-day, or choose a repeating schedule. Customize your presets and default dates for individual lists.

TYPE EVERYDAY SCHEDULES
Use common English, French and German date and repeat phrases. Natural-language parsing works offline and shows a preview before you save. You can also turn it off and use the date controls.

REMEMBER IT IN THE RIGHT PLACE
Save named places and attach an arrival or departure alert. Search for an address, enter coordinates, or choose your current location. Address search needs an internet connection. Alert delivery is handled by Apple Reminders and depends on system permissions and settings.

KEEP YOUR LISTS TOGETHER
Choose from your writable Apple Reminders lists, set a default, and arrange the list order. Review saved reminders, search, edit, mark them complete or delete them. Changes also appear in Apple Reminders.

START FROM WHERE YOU ARE
Capture text and links from the share sheet. Use Shortcuts to start a draft or save a reminder with parameters. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets and Control Center entries provide quick access. Optional notifications can nudge you about an unsaved draft.

MAKE CAPTURE COMFORTABLE
Choose light, dark or system appearance. Adjust what the Return key does, use title suggestions, and enable duplicate warnings before saving.

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
RemindDart has no advertising, analytics or developer-operated account service. Reminder access is required to read lists and save tasks. Current location and draft notifications are optional. Apple Reminders manages any account synchronization; address search and link-title previews use system services.

Requires iOS or iPadOS 26 or later and a writable list in Apple Reminders.

name: Reply: Instant Chat Replies
description:
One press. Your reply is written.

Reply is a keyboard that reads the chat you are in and writes your answer. Press the Action Button (or double-tap the back of your iPhone), and the reply is waiting in the message field. Send it, or change it with one tap.

HOW IT WORKS
• Open any chat, in any app.
• Press once. Reply reads who said what and what needs an answer.
• Your reply appears in the message field, ready to send.

SOUNDS LIKE YOU
Reply writes in your tone and at your length, with your kind of emoji. Not happy with the first one? Ask for another, or make it shorter, more casual, more formal, longer, funnier, or a polite no.

KNOWS WHO YOU ARE TALKING TO
Work, friends or family: Reply picks the right voice. It can keep short notes about the people you talk to, so the next reply fits the person. The notes stay on your iPhone, and you can read, edit or delete every one.

ANY LANGUAGE
Write in your language, send in theirs. Reply translates as it writes.

START FROM A FEW WORDS
Type or say a rough idea and press Generate. Reply turns it into a finished message.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Screenshots are never stored.
• Saved details such as your address or phone number never leave your iPhone.
• No account, no sign-up, no tracking.
• Nothing is sent until you agree, and the app tells you exactly what is.

FREE TO USE
Every feature is free for 10 replies a day. Reply Pro raises that to 100 replies a day with one simple monthly subscription. No trials, no tricks.
