Replies are written with Anthropic's Claude. The chat on screen is sent only to write your reply.

Privacy Policy: https://cevapla-api.safelibrahim.workers.dev/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: ReplyShelf: Seller Keyboard
description:
"How much is it?" "Is it in stock?" "Can you send a photo?"

If you sell on social media or chat apps, you answer the same questions all day. ReplyShelf is a keyboard that answers them for you, with the price and stock you have right now.

ADD YOUR PRODUCTS ONCE
Name, price, stock (in stock, out of stock, pre-order), details and a photo. That's your catalog.

REPLIES THAT STAY UP TO DATE
Write your reply templates with placeholders like {product}, {price}, {stock} and {details}. Change a price in the app and every reply uses the new price. No more fixing saved texts one by one.

ANSWER FROM THE KEYBOARD
In any chat, including Instagram and WhatsApp DMs, switch to the ReplyShelf keyboard, pick a product and a question, and insert the reply. Tap the photo button to copy the product photo, then paste it into the chat.

GENERAL REPLIES
Save texts you send often, like your IBAN, shipping times or return policy, and insert them with one tap.

A REAL KEYBOARD, TOO
ReplyShelf includes a full letter layout, so you can keep typing without switching keyboards.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no server, no ads, no analytics.
• Your catalog stays on your iPhone.
• The keyboard never connects to the internet and doesn't record what you type.
• Full Access is needed only so the keyboard can read your catalog and copy product photos. Without it, the letter keyboard still works.

FREE AND PRO
Free: up to 5 products, with the keyboard, all question types, general replies and photo copying included.
ReplyShelf Pro: unlimited products. A one-time purchase, not a subscription.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://paspal.net/replyshelf/privacy-policy

name: REPSTOKE
description:
REPSTOKE is a strength training log for recording your workouts and seeing how your lifts progress over time.

• Log the weight, reps, and sets for each exercise. Refer to your previous sets as you train.
• View your workout history in a calendar and add entries for past dates.
• Track your heaviest lifts, total training volume, and estimated one-rep max for each exercise.
• Save your favorite routines and load them for your next workout.
• Time your rest between sets. The timer remembers the last duration you used.

name: Rest Recovery Tampa
description:
Rest Recovery Tampa is the members app for our recovery studio in Tampa, FL. Book cold plunge, sauna and other recovery sessions, manage your membership, and check in at the studio.

Book sessions
See open times at your studio and reserve a spot in a few taps. Upcoming bookings show on your home screen.

Take your booking with you
Add a booking to your calendar.

Notifications
Get a confirmation when you book and a reminder before your session. Tap the notification to open the booking.

Sign in with Face ID
After your first sign-in, use Face ID to get back into your account.

Manage your account
See your membership, credits and passes, update your details, and share your referral link with friends.

A Rest Recovery Tampa account is required. All sessions take place in person at our Tampa studio.

name: RetroFold: Pocket Console
description:
Fold your phone shut, pick a cartridge on the cover, unfold it, and you're holding a 90s handheld console.

Made for iPhone Duo: the screen sits above the fold, the controls below. Fold it to pause, unfold it to play.

• 12 cartridges: Brick Breaker, Retro Racer, Snake, Falling Blocks, Pixel Invaders, Mine Sweep, Paddle Duel, Tower Stack, Maze Muncher, Frog Hop, Astro Drift and Lunar Hinge (fold your phone to fire the thrusters!)
• A Daily round for every game: the same level for everyone, new every day
• A curved CRT that bends with the hinge, with scanlines and glow, or a green Pocket LCD, a Trinitron tube and an arcade monitor
• Console skins: Classic Grey, Atomic Purple, Cyberpunk Neon, 90's Arcade Cabinet and more
• Chiptune music, sound packs, haptic buttons, achievements and records
• Draw your own 16×16 cartridge labels

Try everything free for 1 day. Then RetroFold Pro is a one-time purchase, no subscription: every cartridge, every skin, every sound pack and screen, forever.

No ads. No account. No data collected. Works offline. Also playable on any iPhone.

name: RF Limit Check
description: Check a two-port Touchstone S2P sweep against your acceptance limits. Choose the frequency band, enter an S11 maximum and S21 minimum, and inspect the measured traces and any points outside a limit. The report identifies incomplete band coverage and exports measured results to CSV. The app evaluates the supplied measurement points and supports full-matrix two-port S-parameters.

name: Rhoora
description:
Rhoora keeps the order of a shared job. Each chore holds a list of names and a marker. The marker points at exactly one person — the person who has it now. Only two buttons move it.
writes a turn for the person holding the marker, with the time, and passes the marker to the next name. When the marker moves past the last name it returns to the first, and a round closes.

name: Rhoune
description: Rhoune keeps a fuel log that stays honest. At every fill you write two numbers that matter: the reading on the odometer and the litres that went in. The app does the rest.

name: RiffPace
description:
RiffPace is a practice player for electric guitar. Bring a backing track or lesson from Files, pick the passage you want to work on, and play along at your pace.

• See your audio as a waveform. Zoom in and mark exactly where a clip starts and ends.
• Slow down or speed up a track without changing its pitch.
• Loop one clip or play several clips in order. Add a count-in or a pause between clips.
• Keep your tracks in folders and playlists. RiffPace remembers your practice settings and playback position for each track.
• Export a clip at the original speed. Save it to Files, share it, or add it back to your library.

Imported audio works offline. No account needed. For iPhone and iPad.

name: Rilllace Works
description: Rilllace Works is a personal rain-chain design studio for makers and homeowners who want to create beautiful, functional outdoor water features. Build custom hanging designs by arranging copper cups, rings, bells, funnels, and connectors in an interactive vertical composer. Organize each component with dimensions, finishes, material details, inventory quantities, and cost notes. Plan the length and placement of a design while viewing a live illustrated preview that updates as the sequence changes. Record water-flow tests with manually entered flow rates, splash observations, sound impressions, drainage details, and adjustments. Document installation locations, hanging heights, gutter connections, maintenance plans, and reference photos for completed or planned projects. All designs, measurements, photos, test records, and installation notes stay privately on your device and remain accessible without an internet connection.

name: Ringpost-Twin Ring Mail
description:
Ringpost kutsuu sinut ylläpitämään pilvien yllä leijuvaa postitoimistoa.

Kahdella rinnakkaisella ympyränmuotoisella radalla odottaa sinetöityjä kirjeitä, jotka tarvitsevat tarkasti ajoitetut lähdöt.

Aseta lähtö-, odotus- ja vaihto-ohjauskortit numeroidulle aikajanalle ja seuraa, kuinka postivaunut kulkevat hyllyiltä oikeisiin postilaatikoihin.

Vain merkityt risteyskohdat ovat yhteisiä, kun taas muut radat kulkevat erillään siltojen kautta.

Vältä törmäykset, toimita kaikki lähetykset aikataulussa ja palauta taivaallisen postitoimiston eri osat entiseen loistoonsa kokoelmasi kasvaessa.

name: Rocket Play Courts
description:
Book a court, reserve equipment and keep score with a convenient sports companion. Explore 12 courts across four sports, with three courts each for padel, pickleball, squash and tennis.

Switch between the four sport tabs to browse the courts. Each listing shows a photo, court name, indoor or outdoor setting, playing surface and price. Open a court to read the full description, then choose a date, check the available times and confirm your booking.

Browse three equipment options for each sport. Each listing includes a photo, name, material and rental price. Open an item to read more and reserve it.

Get to know all four sports in the guide. Tap a sport’s card to read about how it’s played, its basic rules and how scoring works.

Find your active court and equipment reservations in one place under My Bookings. A red dot marks a new court booking, and each reservation card shows what you booked, along with the date and time. You can cancel a reservation from its card.

On the court, choose your sport in the scorekeeper and tap either side to add a point. Start scoring right away without entering player names. Set your game’s end time to start a countdown and receive a notification with vibration five minutes before your session ends.

name: RoloVault: Card Scanner
description:
RoloVault is for people who meet a lot of people. Scan a business card, add a quick note about the conversation, and it keeps the contact, the context and the next step together.

SCAN IN SECONDS
Photograph a card and the details are read for you: name, title, company, phone, email, website and social profiles. QR codes from digital cards work too. Start a scan from the Action button or Control Center, or share a photo of a card from another app.

KEEP THE CONTEXT
Write or dictate what you talked about. Notes stay on the contact, so months later you still know who they are and why they matter.

NEVER DROP A FOLLOW-UP
Promises in your notes become follow-ups with dates. Get a reminder on your iPhone the morning one is due, and have the email drafted for you.

BUILT FOR EVENTS
Turn on event mode at a conference and every scan is filed under it, with a Live Activity on your Lock Screen showing how many people you have met. Afterwards, see everyone in one place.

ASK YOUR CONTACTS
The assistant has read every card and note. Ask who you met from a company, who is due a follow-up, or have it sort people into groups.

YOUR OWN CARD
Make a digital card with a QR code anyone can scan. Keep it on your Home Screen or Lock Screen as a widget, or add it to Apple Wallet.

ON YOUR IPHONE
• Lock the app with Face ID
• Save contacts straight to your iPhone's Contacts
• Photograph cards with no signal and they are read when you are back online
• Widgets for your card and your next follow-ups

FREE AND PRO
RoloVault is free for 10 scans a month. RoloVault Pro adds unlimited scanning, events, voice notes, drafted emails, briefings and saving to your phone. Pro is an optional subscription managed on rolovault.co.

Privacy: https://rolovault.co/privacy
Terms: https://rolovault.co/terms

name: Root Harvest
description:
Root Harvest uses your mobile device to record the day's harvest.

A harvest supervisor checks out today's harvest instruction onto the device, then records every bag a picker brings in. Scan the picker's tag, read the weight off a Bluetooth scale, and save. If a tag is damaged, enter the worker number instead.

Every bag is saved on the device first, so recording carries on without signal. Bags are sent as soon as there is signal, and you can always see how many are still waiting to upload.

Track bins as they fill, and change bin when one is full. Each bag carries the worker, the weight, the bin, the time and where it was recorded.

See the team's pace against the block's picking target as the bags come in, for every worker and every team. Several supervisors can work the same instruction, and their bags count toward one ranking.

At the end of the day, hand the instruction in. The app first makes sure every bag is uploaded, then shows the day's totals and who finished below target.

Managers and office staff can view any day's instruction without checking it out.

Root Harvest is part of the Root platform. You sign in with your Root account, and what you can do follows the permissions your organisation has set. After your first sign-in with a password, you can sign in with Face ID, Touch ID or your fingerprint. Use the app in English or Afrikaans.

You need a Root account to use this app. Ask your organisation's administrator for one.

name: Rotate Rescue: Ring Puzzle
description:
Spin the rings. Save the crew.

Rotate Rescue is a clever ring-rotation puzzle. Concentric rings carry little crew members. Drag a ring to spin it, line everyone up with the gate of their own colour and send them home, before you run out of moves.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Drag a ring to rotate it. One drag is one move, however far you turn it.
• Crew members step outward by themselves when the slot ahead is free, and are rescued at the gate of their colour.
• Rocks block the way. Heavy rings only turn one or two notches at a time. From level 15 a rescue queue decides which colour may leave next.
• Earn up to three stars by matching the best possible number of moves.

100 LEVELS, EVERY ONE CHECKED
Every level is verified solvable by an exact solver, and most of the hard ones have exactly one best solution. New ideas arrive gradually: heavy rings, the rescue queue, a fourth and fifth colour, a fourth ring, rings with different limits.

BOSS LEVELS
Every tenth level from level 20 is a real brain-teaser. Stuck? Send the level to a friend and ask them to find the solution, or share how few moves you needed.

FEATURES
• 100 hand-checked levels with a steadily rising challenge
• Undo, and hints when you get stuck
• Leaderboards and achievements with Game Center
• Play offline, no account needed
• Available in English, Tiếng Việt, Español, Português (Brasil), Deutsch, Français and 日本語

IN-APP PURCHASES
• No Ads + 10 Hints: removes the ads between levels and adds 10 hints.
• Hint packs: 10 or 30 hints.
• Encore Pack: 5 extra moves when you run out.
• Hint Pass, an auto-renewing monthly subscription: unlimited hints and no ads between levels while it is active. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://maivika.com/en/rotate-rescue/terms
Privacy Policy: https://maivika.com/en/rotate-rescue/privacy

name: Row & Stitch Counter: Rowfinch
description:
Rowfinch is a row and stitch counter for crochet and knitting. Tap anywhere to count a row, keep your pattern open with a marker on the row you are on, and keep each project's counters, notes and photos in one place.

COUNT ROWS AND STITCHES
- Tap anywhere on the screen to count, and every tap is saved at once
- Undo the last tap across all of a project's counters
- Linked counters: a repeat counter that resets and moves your rows on
- Reminders on the rows they are due, such as "change colour every 4 rows"
- Rows or rounds, with a start value and step for each counter
- A quick counter for anything else
- Time spent on each project

YOUR PATTERN BESIDE THE COUNT
- Add a PDF pattern from Files, or photos of a printed one
- The marker moves down a row each time you count
- Zoom and scroll freely: Rowfinch reopens at your row
- On a wide screen such as an iPad, the pattern sits beside the counter
- "Open in Rowfinch" from the share menu of other apps, or share photos of a pattern to Rowfinch

PROJECTS
- Every project with its counters, notes, photos and progress
- Recently Deleted keeps anything you delete for 30 days
- Back up everything to one file and restore it on a new phone

HANDY REFERENCE
- Crochet and knitting abbreviations in US and UK terms
- Hook and needle sizes in metric, US and old UK sizes
- Yarn weights and the hooks and needles that suit them

FREE, WITH NO FORCED TRIAL
Three projects with every counter feature, one pattern each, the quick counter and backups are free for good. No ads and no account.

ROWFINCH PRO
- Unlimited projects, and more than one pattern per project
- Highlight the rows for your size and strike through the ones you have done
- A searchable library of every pattern
- Your yarn stash, hooks and needles, and which ones are in use
- iPhone and iPad kept in step through your own iCloud

Rowfinch Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-off lifetime purchase. The yearly plan starts with a one-week free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and are charged to your Apple Account. You can manage or cancel them in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://rowfinch.app/terms
Privacy Policy: https://rowfinch.app/privacy

name: Rowline: Knitting Row Counter
description:
Rowline keeps your place in a knitting or crochet pattern. Count a row with one tap, and a saffron line on your pattern moves down to the next row with you.

YOUR PATTERN, YOUR PLACE
• Bring in any PDF pattern, or photos of a book page
• A line sits on the row you're working on and moves down with every row you count
• Drag it, make it as tall as one row, or touch and hold to put it anywhere
• The rows you've done are greyed out

COUNTERS THAT THINK AHEAD
• A big row counter with a target: see how many rows are left
• Extra counters for repeats, decreases or pattern rows. They can move with your rows and start over by themselves, counting the repeats for you
• Row notes: "Row 30: start the heel", or every 6 rows: "decrease row". They show up when you get there
• Undo, type a row in, keep the screen on, click and vibration

MADE FOR BUSY HANDS
• A big tap target, on iPhone and iPad
• On iPad, the pattern and your counters side by side

ROWLINE PRO
• Count from the Lock Screen and the Dynamic Island
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, Control Center, the Action Button and Siri: "Add a row in Rowline"
• Any number of projects and patterns
• A project timer and progress photos

QUIET BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no survey, no tracking. Your projects and patterns stay on your device, and you can back them up to a file whenever you like.

Rowline is in English, German and Dutch.

Terms of Use: https://brkaydev.com/rowline/terms
Privacy Policy: https://brkaydev.com/rowline/privacy

name: Rowlock: Block Puzzle
description:
Rowlock is a calm block puzzle that plays fair. Drop pieces on an 8x8 board, fill a row or a column, and watch it clear. Take your time. There's no timer and nothing jumps out at you.

WHY IT FEELS DIFFERENT

• Fair deals. Before you get three new pieces, Rowlock checks there's a way to place all of them. When the board is nearly full, you still get a piece that fits whenever one can. Your score never changes what you're dealt.
• Undo. Placed a piece one square off? Take it back. Classic and Daily give you one undo, Zen lets you undo as much as you like.
• No ads. None. No pop-ups after a game, no videos to skip, no banner over the board.
• No account, no tracking. Play offline, any time. Your games stay on your device, and buying or restoring Pro goes through the App Store.

THREE WAYS TO PLAY

• Classic: play until the board fills up and chase your best score.
• Daily: one puzzle a day, with the same pieces for everyone. Keep your streak going and watch the days fill in on your Daily calendar.
• Zen: no game over. Just you, the board and a cup of tea.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS

• Share your result as a few lines of text: your score, what you cleared and your Daily streak.
• Every game has a six-character game code. Send it to a friend and they get the very same pieces, so you can see who does better.

MADE FOR YOUR SCREEN

• iPhone and iPad, portrait or landscape.
• Ready for foldables. On iPhone Duo, half-fold it like a tiny laptop: the board sits up top and you place pieces from a touch pad below, so your thumb never hides the grid.
• On big screens, a side panel shows your next three pieces, your combo and your recent moves.

EASY ON EVERYONE

• Colour-blind marks put a clear shape on every block, so colours are easy to tell apart.
• Works with VoiceOver: every piece and square is described, and you can place a piece without dragging.
• Dynamic Type, Reduce Motion and a soft landing preview you can turn on or off.
• Three block styles: shiny Enamel, soft Clay and frosted Glass.

ONE OPTIONAL PURCHASE: ROWLOCK PRO

Everything above is free. If you love Rowlock and want a little more, Rowlock Pro is a single purchase. Buy it once and it's yours. No subscription.

• Play any past day's Daily puzzle from the calendar.
• Your score history, with a chart and averages for every mode.
• Four more sets of tile colours: Dusk, Candy, Retro and Neon.

LITTLE THINGS

• Combos for clearing lines move after move.
• Gentle sounds and haptics, both easy to turn off.
• Stats for your best score, lines cleared and boards wiped clean.
• Your game saves after every move, so you can stop any time and pick up right where you left off.

Rowlock is made by Fork Bomb, a small studio that makes small, careful apps. If something feels off or you have an idea, we'd love to hear from you.

name: Royal Mahjong - Tile Match
description:
Welcome to Royal Mahjong Match – your ultimate tile matching puzzle adventure!

Enjoy a relaxing and exciting Mahjong experience! Match identical tiles, challenge your mind, collect coins and discover a world of fun puzzles.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE ROYAL MAHJONG MATCH

FUN TILE MATCHING

Find and match identical Mahjong tiles to clear the board and enjoy satisfying puzzle gameplay.

POWERFUL BOOSTERS

Use exciting boosters to help you overcome challenging puzzles:

Chain Booster
Type Eliminator
Super Shuffle
Undo
Shuffle
Hint
COLLECT COINS

Earn and collect coins to get useful boosters and keep your adventure going.

ENJOY MORE LIVES

Keep playing and enjoy your Mahjong journey with exciting life offers.

BUILD YOUR ROYAL WORLD

Use your coins to enjoy castle decorations and make your adventure even more exciting.

CHALLENGE YOUR BRAIN

Improve your focus, test your matching skills and enjoy fun puzzle challenges.

FEATURES

Enjoyable Mahjong tile matching gameplay
Beautiful tile designs
Helpful power-ups and boosters
Exciting coin packs and special offers
Relaxing casual puzzle experience
Fun for puzzle and Mahjong lovers
Ready to become a Mahjong master?

Download Royal Mahjong Match today and start your royal tile-matching adventure!

name: Rubin · Explore Bible Verses
description:
Rubin takes you from a Bible verse to a matching song – and on to the next verse.

Rubin is German for ruby: a stone with eight facets, one for each part of the Bible – the five books of Moses, History, Psalms, Wisdom, Prophets, Gospels, Letters, Revelation. Turn the stone, and the facet in the light releases a verse. It builds up in front of you: letter by letter, out of the mist, or line by line like on an old screen. You choose how.

• A verse for every day – "Today", and back to yesterday with the arrows
• Turn it by hand or let it turn, with a pause for reading
• German, English, or both side by side
• Who is speaking? Words of God and words of people in colour, if you like
• Where it is worth it, the wider passage to read on
• Search by reference or word
• For many verses a song by Græy Witness – tap and listen
• Typeface, size and spacing to suit your eyes

The English text is the Berean Standard Bible (public domain). The German text is our own rendering, following the BSB, read and approved by a human.

The songs come from the Græy Witness catalogue: an AI-generated music project, human-initiated, curated and answered for. The whole catalogue is in the app Agagos.

Rubin collects nothing. No account, no ads, no tracking. The verses come from agagos.one, the audio from archive.org.

name: RuckLog: Ruck Tracker & Walk
description:
RuckLog is the field-grade weighted walking and rucking instrument built for weighted vest walkers, GORUCK athletes, and Zone 2 hikers.

WHY RUCKLOG?

• 1-TAP RETRO-LOG IMPORT: Forgot to start an app, or prefer recording with your Watch's native Outdoor Walk? Import any walk or hike from the past 30 days, pick the weight you carried, and recalculate true weighted calories without double-counting Move Ring energy.

• VO2 MAX SHIELD: Walking with 20–45 lbs elevates heart rate at slower paces, causing standard cardio estimators to misread your fitness level. RuckLog logs weighted sessions as Hiking activities in Apple Health so your VO2 Max trend stays clean.

• USARIEM PANDOLF + SANTEE MATH: Powered by the military Pandolf load-carriage metabolic equation with Santee downhill braking correction, terrain factors (pavement, trail, sand/snow), and indoor treadmill incline calibration.

• TRACK RUCK TONNAGE & LOAD RATIO: Quantify progressive overload in pound-miles (lb·mi) or kilogram-kilometers (kg·km), monitor your safe load-to-bodyweight ratio (under 15%, 15–30%, over 35% caution), and adjust weight mid-ruck when shedding water or plates.

• CRASH-SAFE GPS & WATCH COMPANION: 5-second SQLite coordinate backup protects long rucks against iOS background termination, plus a high-contrast Watch companion for pace, heart rate, and load adjustments on your wrist.

• STRAVA & GPX READY: Export clean GPX tracks or share structured battle summaries with carried weight and tonnage.

PRICING:
Core live GPS tracking, built-in presets plus up to 3 custom loadouts, LB/KG switching, VO2 Max protection, and your first Retro-Log import are completely free.

Upgrade to RuckLog Pro via a one-time $14.99 Lifetime purchase (Family Sharing included) or $9.99/year (7-day trial) to unlock unlimited Retro-Log imports, treadmill incline & off-road terrain factors, unlimited custom loadouts, mid-ruck weight splits, lifetime tonnage trends, and Strava watermark exports.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period in your Apple ID Account Settings.

Privacy Policy: https://www.sun-apps.com/rucklog/privacy.html
Support: https://www.sun-apps.com/rucklog/support.html

name: RudderSync
description:
RudderSync is an offline drafting puzzle about watertight subdivision. Study a top-down hull, then lay plates so every drain valve sits in its own sealed tank.
HOW IT PLAYS
• Place watertight plates on seams between cabin cells
• Match the yard order: tank count, size, and often shape (rotation and mirror count)
• Keep shaft alleys, cargo blocks, and cable trunks uncut
• Work around fixed brass plates already riveted in place
• On flood stations, contain torn planks so wet area stays under the limit
FOUR HULL CLASSES
Sloop, freighter, submarine, and lifeboat—each with its own frame book, valve seats, and keep-open fabric. Twenty-four stations, unlocked along the yard list. No clock. Take the quiet desk time you need.
BUILT FOR THE CHART TABLE
• English interface with clear tank orders and coach tips
• Local voyage log, achievements, and par plate marks
• Fully offline after install—progress stays on device
• Cold nautical line style with real vessel photography
RudderSync is a logic game, not professional ship design or emergency guidance. Seal the book one frame at a time.

name: Rudolph, Snowman and Santa
description:
Bring a little Christmas magic to your Apple Watch.

Rudolph, Snowman & Santa is an Apple Watch app with a cozy Christmas night scene: a cheerful snowman winds a string of fairy lights around Rudolph's antlers while the snow falls. The lights twinkle, Rudolph's red nose glows, and when you tap the screen, Santa slides in, waves at you and says "Ho ho ho!". A big snowy-capped clock, the date, the weather and your daily stats are always at hand.

FEATURES
• Animated Christmas scene with Rudolph and a snowman
• Twinkling fairy lights and Rudolph's glowing red nose
• Falling snow over the whole scene
• Tap the screen and Santa slides in to wave, with a "Ho ho ho" (the sound can be turned off)
• Big festive clock with snow on the digits
• 30 Christmas color themes for the time, date and stats
• Current weather with day and night icons
• Heart rate, steps and battery at a glance
• 12-hour or 24-hour time
• Dimmed always-on look that keeps the time and date easy to read

CUSTOMIZE FROM YOUR IPHONE
Open the app on your watch, then use the companion iPhone app to pick one of 30 color themes. A live preview shows the look before you send it to the watch. You can also turn the falling snow, the twinkling lights, Rudolph's glowing nose, Santa's sound and the weather on or off, and choose 12-hour or 24-hour time.

WATCH APP AND WATCH FACE
Rudolph, Snowman & Santa is a watch app: the animated scene shows while the app is open on your Apple Watch. From the iPhone app you can also install a matching Apple photo watch face with two pictures of the snowy scene, one of them with Santa waving. It includes a complication that opens the app with a single tap. You can also add the complication to your favorite watch face or to the Smart Stack.

Tip: to keep the app on screen longer, open Settings on your watch, go to General, then Return to Clock, and choose After 1 hour.

WEATHER AND HEALTH DATA
The weather comes from Apple Weather and uses your watch's location while the app is open. Rudolph, Snowman & Santa reads your steps and heart rate from Apple Health to show them on your watch. Your data stays on your devices.

HELP AND SUPPORT
The iPhone app includes a FAQ section with answers to common questions and a contact page if you need us. The More tab shows our other animated watch faces.

REQUIREMENTS
Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or newer, paired with an iPhone running iOS 17 or newer.

Merry Christmas!

name: Ruling Matrix
description: כל יצרן קטן מכיר את המחיר הסמוי של ההחלטה הלא נכונה: להעביר ממלטש לרסס, או לטבול בשמנת? Ruling Matrix מחליף את ההערכה בליבך בחישוב מדויק. הטבלה הדו-כיוונית יודעת שמעבר מסכין למלטש לוקח 15 דקות, אך הכיוון ההפוך הוא 8 דקות בלבד. שינוי סדר אחת בלוח משנה מיידית את הסכום הכולל ומציג את הדדלים בסיכון. עם הסבר ברור לכל פסיקה, התוצאה היא לא רק רשימה אלא רצף עבודה חכם שמקטין את הזמנים. שני רצפים מוצבים זה לצד זה להשוואה טיפוסית לפני שמירה. הכל מקומי, מהיר ומכוון להחלטה אחת נכונה: איך סוגרים את המפעל עם הפחות זמן הפסקה האפשרי.

name: Running Aroundme
description:
Running AroundMe brings runners together where they live: find partners at your level, join a group or a club, and never run alone again.

FIND
• Runners, groups, clubs, coaches and shops around you, by town or around your position
• Upcoming group runs, races and events, filtered by activity (road, trail, Nordic walking, hiking…) and level
• Search by the name of a race or a club

RUN TOGETHER
• Plan a group run: meeting point, date, pace, number of places
• Draw the route on the map following the paths, or import a GPX / TCX file: distance and elevation computed
• Elevation profile, participants, comments
• Running groups with member approval and members-only runs

ROUTE LIBRARY
• Routes shared by the community, searched by place, activity, distance and elevation
• Map, elevation profile and downloadable GPX file
• Plan a group run on any route in one tap
• 5 free routes, then unlimited with the €0.99 monthly option

SHARE
• News feed from the runners and clubs you follow
• Private messaging
• Classified ads between runners

FOR CLUBS, COACHES AND ORGANISERS
• A profile to present your organisation
• Yearly subscription: publish your races and events, promote them to runners within 100 km, unlimited route library and no ads for the profile's managers
• Organising associations publish their races for free

Subscriptions
Subscriptions (Club, Coach, Organisation, Unlimited library) renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Manage or cancel them in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.

Terms of use: https://running-aroundme.com/informations/cgu
Privacy: https://running-aroundme.com/confidentialite

name: RVlogy: RV Travel Map
description:
RVlogy shows every place an RVer actually needs: dump stations, propane, fresh water, campgrounds and RV parks, rest areas and RV washes, on one fast map.

TRUST THE MAP
When you pull into a stop, RVlogy asks one question: is it open and working? One tap from you keeps the map honest for everyone, and each RVer gets one vote per stop. Green means RVers confirmed it lately, orange means mixed reports, red means reported closed.

THE DETAILS THAT MATTER
• Dump stations: fee or free, potable and rinse water, who can use it
• Propane: price per gallon, refill or exchange, fills built-in motorhome tanks
• Campgrounds: nightly price, hookups, 30/50 amp, max RV length, public dump on site
• RV washes: bay height, so you know if your rig fits

FITS MY RV
Enter your RV's height and length once. RVlogy hides washes with low bays and campgrounds that are too short.

GET THERE
Every stop has an address. Tap it to open Apple Maps, Google Maps or Waze.

MADE BY RVERS
Add prices, photos and tips. Add a missing stop. Updates are dated, so you always know how fresh the information is.

CRYSTAL RV FAVORITES
Our hand-picked sights and stops across the West, marked with a gold star.

WORKS WITHOUT SIGNAL
All 53,000 stops are stored on your phone, so the list and details work in the backcountry.

Free, no ads, no account needed to browse. Posting uses your iCloud account. Stop data includes OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL), Recreation.gov and the U.S. Department of Energy.

Made by Crystal RV Rentals in Mountain View, California.

name: Sacred Walk
description:
Sacred Walk is a calm, sunlit church you visit together with people from around the world.

Walk through a spring plaza full of blossoms, step into the white Sanctuary to hear the homily read aloud, and see the people praying with you in real time.

PLACES TO VISIT
• Spring Plaza, Sanctuary, Blossom Garden and the Lourdes Grotto
• Adoration Chapel, Bible Room, Bell Loft and the Stations of the Cross
• Tea Lounge and the Stillness Room under the stars

PRAY AND PRACTISE
• The Rosary, the Angelus at morning, noon and evening, the evening Examen and Lectio Divina
• Nine-day novenas, a private gratitude book and a shared wall of prayer intentions
• Guided breathing for quiet time with a mindfulness bell every minute

LISTEN
• Homilies and the Word of God read in a warm voice, in English or Vietnamese, with subtitles

TOGETHER
• Choose your character, offer the sign of peace, light candles and bring flowers
• Daily tasks, prayer streaks, badges and a friendly members' leaderboard

Safe by design: chat is filtered, you can report or block anyone, and you can delete your account at any time inside the app.

Sacred Walk is free to use.

name: Safehouse: GTA Cheats & Map
description:
Safehouse puts every Grand Theft Auto cheat, collectible and money guide in one place, so you can stop pausing to search the web.

CHEATS, BUTTON BY BUTTON
• Every cheat for GTA V, San Andreas, Vice City and GTA IV
• Shown as real PlayStation and Xbox buttons, plus PC codes and phone numbers
• TV mode shows one big button at a time and keeps your screen on while you play
• Save the cheats you use most

MAPS OF EVERY COLLECTIBLE
• 828 locations: spaceship parts, letter scraps, spray tags, oysters, hidden packages, pigeons and more
• Filter by type, search the map, and mark what you've found
• Track your progress in every area
• Spoiler-free mode hides what's at each pin until you tap it

GUIDES THAT ACTUALLY HELP
• GTA V stock market plan for Lester's assassination missions
• GTA Online: best ways to make money now, heists, businesses and what to buy first
• 100% completion checklists, secrets and beginner tips for every game

WORKS OFFLINE
Everything is saved on your phone. New cheats, pins and guides are added as players find them.

SAFEHOUSE PRO
GTA V cheats and guides are free. Pro unlocks every cheat for the classic games, all guides, map tracking and TV mode.
• Monthly: $19.99 per month
• Yearly: $119.99 per year, with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers
Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.

Terms: https://leonida-guide.expo.app/terms.html
Privacy: https://leonida-guide.expo.app/privacy.html

Safehouse is an unofficial fan guide. It is not made by, endorsed by or connected to Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Grand Theft Auto and related names are trademarks of their owners and are used only to describe which games the guide covers.

name: Sales Coaching
seller_name: ROIGEN CONSULTORIA EM TECNOLOGIA DA INFORMAcao  LTDA
description:
O ROIgen no bolso, para vendedores que usam a plataforma ROIgen.

FALE COM O AGENTE
Pergunte e mande fazer, por voz: "o que eu tenho essa semana?", "marca uma call
com o Tomas quinta às dez", "em que pé está o negócio da Acme?". O agente
consulta e atualiza sua agenda e seu CRM.

GRAVE A REUNIÃO
Toque em gravar e guarde o celular. A conversa é transcrita ao vivo, com quem
falou o quê — mesmo com a tela bloqueada. No fim sai o resumo: dores,
objeções, próximos passos, compromissos e tarefas, já no negócio certo.

NOTÍCIAS DAS SUAS CONTAS
O Radar mostra o que saiu sobre as empresas que você acompanha.

É preciso ter uma conta na plataforma ROIgen.

name: Salon: Learn Art History
description:
Find your taste in art, then learn to really see paintings, five minutes a day.

START WITH YOUR TASTE
Swipe yes or no on famous paintings. Salon names your eye: your type, the movements you lean to, your closest painter, and the one painting you would take home. You get a taste card made to be shared.

LEARN TO SEE
Movement by movement, from the Renaissance to the avant-garde, in the order of your own taste. Each lesson takes about five minutes: what to look for, shown on the paintings themselves, with things to find and a short test. You can listen instead of reading.

GO DEEP
Deep dives take one painting or one painter slowly, in six short chapters. Paintings, among them The Starry Night, Las Meninas, The Night Watch, The Birth of Venus, The Scream, The Great Wave, Girl with a Pearl Earring, Liberty Leading the People and American Gothic. And painters, among them Leonardo, Michelangelo, Raphael, Titian, Dürer, Bosch, El Greco, Caravaggio, Artemisia Gentileschi, Rembrandt, Vermeer, Goya, Turner, Hokusai, Monet, Degas, Cézanne, Van Gogh, Klimt and Kandinsky.

PLAY
The Run: questions against the clock until three mistakes. How far can you go? The Daily: ten questions, the same for everyone that day. Every right answer adds a painting to your album.

MEDALS AND TITLES
Win medals in bronze, silver and gold for what you learn and how well you play, and climb seven titles, from Visitor to Old Master.

BROWSE
Thousands of paintings from the public domain, with their painters and movements, to look at closely.

ALSO
A home-screen widget with a painting a day. A daily reminder if you want one. Made for iPhone and iPad. No account. No ads.

WHAT IS FREE
The taste test, your card, Browse, the Daily, three Runs a day, your first lesson and the deep dive on The Starry Night. One payment opens every lesson, every deep dive and unlimited Runs, for life. There is no subscription.

The short descriptions of paintings come from Wikipedia, under the CC BY-SA 4.0 licence.

name: Saphix
description:
Saphix dates a small project from two facts per task: how long it takes, and what it has to wait for. You never type a date.

Add a task with a duration in whole working days. Tick the tasks it waits on. Saphix orders the plan so every predecessor comes first, runs the schedule forwards to find when each task can start, then backwards from the end date to find the latest each task could start. The difference is float: the days a task can slip without moving the end.

name: SAT Prep Digital: Satwick
description:
SAT prep for the digital SAT, with adaptive practice, mock tests and full worked solutions for math, reading and writing. Satwick builds a short daily plan from the topics you need most, brings questions back just before you would forget them, and keeps every miss in a mistake notebook with its solution. No account, it works offline, and your progress stays on your phone.

DIGITAL SAT PRACTICE AND MOCK TESTS
Start with a free diagnostic, then practise by topic or run timed section and full-length mock tests built like the digital SAT: Reading and Writing in two modules, Math in two modules, and the second module adapts to how you did in the first. Flag questions, cross out choices, use the question navigator and review everything before you submit. Results show a rough score range per section (never a predicted score) with a breakdown by content area and a full solution for every question.

MATH, READING AND WRITING QUESTIONS
910 original practice questions: 551 math, 210 reading and 149 writing. Math includes student-produced (grid-in) responses. Skills are grouped under the eight digital SAT content domains: Algebra, Advanced Math, Problem-Solving and Data Analysis, Geometry and Trigonometry, Information and Ideas, Craft and Structure, Expression of Ideas, and Standard English Conventions.

WORKED SOLUTIONS ON EVERY QUESTION
After any answer, open the full solution: the rule used, numbered steps, why each wrong choice fails, a common mistake to avoid and a similar question to try. Solutions are never locked behind credits or ads.

GRAPHING CALCULATOR AND 15 INTERACTIVE LABS
A built-in graphing calculator opens from every math question: plot up to three functions, drag and zoom, read a table of values, find intercepts, minimums, maximums and intersections, and use sliders for letters such as a, b, c and m. A basic calculator tab is included. Fifteen labs (line, parabola, circle, unit circle, systems, transformations, exponential growth, line of best fit, probability, similar triangles and trig, spread, mean and median, joining sentences, transitions, finding evidence) give you a goal, live feedback and a short quiz.

STUDY THAT ADAPTS
Topic mastery map with key ideas, spaced review based on the published FSRS-4.5 model, difficulty that steps up and down per topic, a daily plan ("10 minutes today: these 3 topics"), a streak that never nags, timed drills, and export or import of your progress as a file.

FREE TO START
You start with 3 credits. Your first four practice sets each day are free, then a practice set costs 1 credit, a section mock costs 1 and a full mock costs 3. The diagnostic, the daily warm-up, the mistake notebook, the labs and every explanation are always free. Watch an optional short video to earn another credit. Ads appear on non-critical screens and never during a question. Or choose the ad-free monthly plan ($2.99 per month, 7-day free trial): no ads and unlimited sessions. Cancel any time in your App Store account settings. If you cancel, you keep ad-free until the end of the period you already paid for, and you will not be charged again. Prefer not to subscribe? Watch short videos to earn credits and unlock features.

HONEST LIMITS
All questions and mock tests are original practice items, not real exam questions. Score ranges are rough estimates from your own practice, not predictions of a real score. English only.

SAT is a trademark registered and owned by the College Board, which is not affiliated with, and does not endorse, this app.

Privacy Policy: https://equalinformation.com/privacy-satactprep.html
Terms of Use: https://equalinformation.com/terms-satactprep.html
Support: https://equalinformation.com/app-support-satactprep.html

name: Say Merhaba
seller_name: SARPER DIJITAL TEKNOLOJILER VE KIRALAMA ANONIM SIRKETI
description:
Say Merhaba is a first course in Turkish for adults. It is made for people with a Turkish-speaking partner, family or friends, and for people who live in Türkiye or are about to visit.

You don't collect points here. You learn 40 small, real-life things to say, such as greeting someone at the door, introducing your family, asking for the salt, or making a plan for Saturday. A skill only counts when you can do it yourself, with no hints. Skills are confirmed by written and listening checks; speaking practice is optional and is not scored.

HOW IT WORKS
• Start with the six letters English doesn't have: ç, ğ, ı, ö, ş and ü.
• Take short lessons: listen and repeat, match, build words from their endings, put sentences in order, then type or say your answer.
• Follow the scenes. Each unit has two short conversations with Elif, her mother Ayşe and the people around them. You choose what to reply.
• Finish each unit with “Can you do it?”, a check with no hints and no word bank.
• Keep it. Reviews bring each skill back in a new situation after 1, 3, 7, 16 and 35 days.

MADE FOR YOU
• The course uses your name, country, city and job, so the sentences you learn are your own.
• When you make a mistake, a short note explains why.
• Speaking is optional. You can type every answer.
• “Use Turkish” gives you 30 ready-made sentences for taxis, food, hotels, shopping and getting help. Play them or show them on your screen.
• More than 780 recorded Turkish audio clips.

HONEST BY DESIGN
• No account.
• No ads and no tracking.
• Lessons work offline. Speech recognition depends on your device.
• Your profile and progress stay on your iPhone.

FREE TO START
The letters lesson, Units 1 and 2 and the travel sentences are free. A one-time purchase unlocks Units 3 to 10. There is no subscription.

Lessons are taught in English. Say Merhaba is a beginner's course: it will not make you fluent, but it will get you through your first real conversations.

Terms of Use: https://sarperlabs.com/apps/say-merhaba/terms
Privacy Policy: https://sarperlabs.com/apps/say-merhaba/privacy

name: Sayakat
description:
Sayakat — всё для путешествий по Кыргызстану в одном приложении: туры, природные места, жильё и аренда авто.

ТУРЫ
• Туры по Кыргызстану и за рубеж от туроператоров и гидов
• Фильтры по стране, области, датам, цене и типу отдыха
• Подробная программа, даты, длительность и маршрут

МЕСТА
• Природа: озёра, ущелья, водопады, перевалы, ледники и горячие источники — с описанием, лучшим сезоном и ссылкой «Как добраться»
• Где остановиться: базы отдыха, юрточные лагеря, гостевые дома, хостелы, кемпинги, форелевые хозяйства и конные прогулки
• У каждого природного места — список жилья рядом
• Отзывы путешественников

АРЕНДА АВТО
• Внедорожники, минивэны и седаны от владельцев
• Фильтры по марке, коробке, типу кузова и месту передачи
• Владельцы, которые пригонят машину куда скажете

БЕЗ ПОСРЕДНИКОВ
Sayakat не берёт комиссию и не принимает оплату. Связывайтесь с владельцем объявления напрямую — звонок, WhatsApp, Telegram или Instagram в одно касание.

РАЗМЕСТИТЕ СВОЁ ОБЪЯВЛЕНИЕ
Туроператор, хозяин юрт или гестхауса, владелец авто? Добавьте объявление за пару минут — бесплатно. Контакты подтянутся из вашего профиля.

УДОБНО
• Русский, кыргызский и английский языки
• Светлая и тёмная тема
• Вход по коду из письма — без паролей

БЕЗОПАСНОСТЬ
Пожаловаться на объявление или заблокировать автора можно в одно касание. Жалобы рассматриваются в течение 24 часов.

Откройте Кыргызстан с Sayakat!

name: Scanplicity
description:
Bring your old prints home.

Scanplicity turns the photos in your albums and shoeboxes into clean digital copies in your Photos app. Point your iPhone or iPad at a print: Scanplicity finds the edges, straightens it, and saves it to an album in Photos, on the date it was taken.

WE NEVER CHANGE FACES
Restoration is one even color correction for the whole photo, like a darkroom reprint. Dust cleanup skips faces entirely. There is no generative AI, nothing is invented, and your original scan is always kept.

FREE: 10 SCANS WITH EVERYTHING THAT MATTERS
• Automatic edge detection and perspective correction, or place the corners yourself
• Color restoration for faded and yellowed prints, with a before and after slider
• Dust and speck cleanup that fills small white specks from the pixels around them
• Glare check that warns about reflections and tones them down
• Full-resolution saves to an album in Photos
• Date, caption, place and people written into the photo, so the Photos app can find them
• Every scan stays saved and editable, even after the free scans are used

SCANPLICITY PRO: PAY ONCE, KEEP IT
• Unlimited scans
• Album pages: one shot of a whole page or a table of prints, each photo saved on its own
• Batch mode for getting through a shoebox
• Back of the photo: keep the handwriting with the picture
• PDF and ZIP export to share an album with family
• Search across all your albums, favorites and slideshows

Scanplicity Pro is a single $14.99 purchase (US price), not a subscription. Family Sharing is supported, and Restore Purchases brings Pro back on a new device.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No analytics. Everything is processed on your device and nothing is uploaded.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://oaklinemediaapps.com/scanplicity-privacy.html

name: ScopeStitch: Remodel Costs
description:
A contractor sent a change order. See how the new charges compare with your signed scope before you decide.

ScopeStitch helps U.S. homeowners review remodel changes and track the agreed total.

• Import PDFs and images or paste the wording from your agreement and change order.
• Compare each charge with the signed scope, see shared wording highlighted, and tap an excerpt to open its page.
• Review suggested charges and credits, compare the itemized sum with the stated change, and draft questions for your contractor.
• See how a change would affect the agreed total before recording your decision.
• Try the built-in bathroom remodel sample or review the first change on your own project for free.

ScopeStitch Plus is a one-time purchase for additional projects, more change orders, and shareable PDF summaries.

Text is read on your device. Verify extracted wording and amounts against your original documents before making decisions.

name: Scout - Matchup Analytics
description:
Know who you're playing before the first whistle.

Scout gives youth lacrosse parents and coaches a clear, honest read on any opponent, built from public game results for thousands of club teams across the country.

TWO WAYS IN
Pick your team once, then choose what you want to see.

SINGLE GAME OUTLOOK
Search any opponent and see:
• Who's favored, in plain words
• How often you'd win a game like this ("about 3 out of 10")
• A projected score
• What happened when you played them
• Their recent results

TOURNEY OUTLOOK
Upload a screenshot of your team's tournament schedule and Scout looks at every opponent:
• Your odds in every game
• Your chances to finish top 2 in your pool
• Where you might play next and your odds to win the title
Add the pool standings and bracket as the weekend goes on.

GAME ANALYSIS FOR COACHES
Tap Game Analysis for offense and defense ratings adjusted for schedule strength, scoring trends, head-to-head history and a full game history.

TEAMS, NEVER KIDS
Scout works only at the team level. It never shows or analyzes individual players.

HONEST BY DESIGN
Predictions are tested against real results. They're estimates, not guarantees, and upsets happen. That's the fun of it.

Free. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

Scout is not affiliated with US Club Lacrosse or any league or event.

name: Screamburb
description:
Your face is the controller.

The suburbs have gone quiet. Too quiet. The lawns are hungry, the gnomes are organized and the Homeowners Association has a plan for everyone. Grab your loudest friends, get on the Drip Bus and save the neighbors.

PLAY WITH YOUR FACE
• Turn your head to move.
• Open wide and SCREAM to blast monsters back. The wider your mouth, the bigger the blast.
• SMILE at a neighbor to rescue them, then walk them to the bus.
• LAUGH when your meter is full to unleash a Laugh Riot.
• Blink hard to dash. Raise your eyebrows to throw what you're holding. Hide your face to play dead.

SEVEN CHAPTERS, SEVEN BOSSES
From Maple Court to the Clubhouse: a bounce castle with an appetite, a smooth-jazz trio that sings you to sleep, a monster in the storm drain, a foreman on a runaway mower, a radio tower that whispers at midnight and the Association's own Madam Chair. Every chapter has its own street, its own monsters and its own story scene.

PLAY WITH FRIENDS
Team up with up to three friends in co-op: send a link, pick your heroes, save the street together.

VERSUS
Deathmatch for up to eight, Team Deathmatch two-on-two or four-on-four, and Capture the Flag, on six arenas. Squad up with friends or quick-match with players from anywhere.

FOUR HEROES
Decibel screams the widest. Big Gus can take a hit. Pip rescues from twice as far. Moxie fills her laugh meter fastest.

CLIMB THE HALL OF SCREAMS
Sign in with Vidrip to put your best street on the leaderboard, keep your progress on every device and add friends.

Your camera is only used to read your expressions while you play. The picture never leaves your phone.

name: Screw bag
description:
Water with care. Grow with love.

A cozy garden puzzle where you drag a watering can, spot the right pots, and follow each care routine. Start with simple watering, then tackle ordered sequences and fertilize-or-water challenges across 90 calming levels.

Short (App Store subtitle)
Water pots in order. Care for your garden.

Promotional
Step into a peaceful courtyard garden. Read the day’s task, find the right flower pots on the ground, and guide your watering can with a real pour. Mid levels ask you to water in the correct order. Later levels mix watering and fertilizing, so every move takes a little judgment. Soft visuals, gentle feedback, and a quiet sense of progress—perfect for a mindful break.

name: SEAL - RedOcean
description:
SEAL (Swift Emergency Aquatic Lifeline) es la app de seguridad marítima de Red Ocean Service, pensada para pescadores, navegantes y sus familias.

S.O.S. CON UN TOQUE
• Pide ayuda con un solo botón. SEAL envía tu posición, la hora y la batería de tu teléfono a tu familia, a las embarcaciones cercanas y al equipo de rescate de RedOcean.
• Una cuenta atrás de 20 segundos evita las falsas alarmas: puedes cancelarla o enviar el S.O.S. al instante.
• ¿Quieres comprobar que todo funciona? El S.O.S. de prueba llega a RedOcean marcado como prueba, sin movilizar a nadie.
• Avisa también cuando otra persona está en peligro en el agua.

TU FAMILIA SABE DÓNDE ESTÁS
• Seguimiento en tiempo real durante la travesía, también con la pantalla apagada.
• Tu familia ve tu posición en vivo y recibe un aviso si tu travesía deja de reportar.
• Tú eliges cada cuánto se registra tu posición.
• Recibe un aviso si alguien pide auxilio cerca de ti.

EL MAR EN TU PANTALLA
• Viento, olas, corrientes, temperatura del agua y mareas sobre el mapa.
• Sin señal, sigues viendo lo que ya cargaste.

TU BITÁCORA
• Tus travesías y alertas recientes, en un solo lugar.

En español, inglés y portugués. Inicia sesión con tu correo o con Apple.

SEAL es una herramienta de apoyo: no reemplaza los medios oficiales de comunicación y seguridad en el mar ni los equipos que exige la autoridad marítima.

Política de privacidad: https://redoceanservice.com/privacidad
Términos y condiciones: https://redoceanservice.com/terminos

name: SeamLedger
description:
Plan rectangular fabric projects with a clear cut list and an honest use-of-fabric estimate.

DEFINE YOUR FABRIC
Record measured width, purchased length, edge margins, spacing and price per meter. Keep materials and project notes together.

BUILD A CUT LIST
Add named finished rectangles, seam allowances and quantities. Keep grain-sensitive pieces locked, or allow a quarter-turn when your material permits it.

INSPECT THE LAYOUT
See each copy placed on a scaled fabric diagram. Review cut sizes, top-left coordinates, required length, area utilization and estimated material cost. Oversized pieces and short fabric are clearly flagged. The deterministic shelf arrangement follows your piece order and does not claim an optimal layout.

TRACK MAKING STEPS
Maintain ordered steps, mark them complete with local timestamps, and confirm resets. Duplicate a project for an alternate plan without copying completion history.

TAKE A CUTTING SHEET WITH YOU
Save a plain-text cutting sheet through Files when the plan fits your entered fabric. Export and import versioned JSON backups while preserving existing project IDs.

FREE AND OFFLINE
No account, network service, cloud sync, advertising, analytics, subscription or in-app purchase. Read privacy, terms, support and the planning guide offline.

SeamLedger handles rectangles only. It does not create garment patterns or model curves, fit, shrinkage, nap or print-repeat matching. Independently verify measurements, grain and allowances before cutting.

name: Seat Rush: Color Bus Puzzle
description:
The bus is here — but who gets on? Tap a rider with a clear path to send them to the bus. If their color matches, they take a seat. If not, they wait on the bench. Fill every bus and get everyone home before the bench runs out of space!

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap a rider who can walk out of the plaza.
• Riders that match the bus color climb aboard; others wait on the bench.
• Full buses drive off and the next one pulls in — waiting riders of that color hop on automatically.
• Don't let the bench fill up!

FEATURES
• Hundreds of levels with growing crowds and more colors
• Every level is checked by a solver, so it is always solvable
• Mystery riders whose colors show only when their path opens
• Undo, hints and an extra bench seat when you need them
• Bright, cheerful design and smooth animations
• Relaxing music and satisfying sounds
• Play offline, anytime
• English and Turkish

Seat Rush is free to play and supported by ads. You can remove ads with a one-time purchase.

name: Seat Washer
description: Seat Washer is for the moment a tap is apart and the old washer is out. Turn the brass seat through 12, 15, 19, and 24 mm, then drag a washer onto it. Clearance is the washer minus the bore. A smaller washer drops through, the same size sits flush, and a larger one stands proud. When a washer sits flush, name the tap and keep that fit on this iPhone. Open the washers kept here to see the name and the size again. The record stays on the phone. There is no account and nothing is uploaded.

name: SeatLine
description:
SeatLine is the field and office app for companies that run their work on SeatLine. It puts each person's jobs, schedule and paperwork on their phone and keeps the office up to date as the work happens.

SeatLine is for the people of companies that already use SeatLine. You need an account from your company to sign in; there is nothing to buy in the app.

ON THE JOB
• Today and Jobs: the jobs you are assigned to, where they are, who is on the crew and what is planned for the week.
• Daily logs: type or dictate what happened on site, add photos and files, and send it to the office. Dictation is transcribed on your phone; only the text is sent.
• Time: clock in and out, take breaks and send your hours for approval.
• Receipts: photograph a receipt; the amount, vendor and date are read on your phone so you only check and send. (Your company can turn this section off.)
• Time off: ask for days off and see what was approved.
• Location sharing: in contractor mode the office sees where the crew is while the app is open, so arrivals and travel can be planned. You can turn it off in Settings.

IN THE OFFICE
• Contacts for every project, gathered from your company's records.
• Log work calls and texts against the right project.
• The company phone system, when your company uses it: place work calls from the app and answer them while the app is open, with every call kept on the job record.

FOR EVERYONE
• Chat with your crew and the office, by project or person.
• Alerts for schedule changes, approvals and messages while the app is open.
• Light and dark appearance that follows your company account.
• Delete your account from inside the app at any time (Account → Delete my account).

Your company decides what each role can see. Crew locations, phone numbers and costs are never shown to your company's customers.

name: Seats Movie: Best Cinema Seats
description:
Seats Movie finds the best cinema seats still free in every show near you, and lets you see the view from the seat in 3D before you book.

Pick your city and a film. Seats Movie checks every showtime and scores each free seat for viewing angle and distance from the screen. It then ranks the best block of seats together for your group: two, four or more, side by side.

WHY SEATS MOVIE
• Best seats, found for you: centred, the right distance back, seats together
• See the view first: flip any hall into 3D and sit in the seat before you pay
• Every show at a glance: compare times, cinemas and formats like IMAX, 4DX and Dolby
• Filters that matter: centre seats only, not too close, time of day
• Seat alerts: get an email or a notification when good seats open up
• Films in Malayalam, Tamil, Hindi, Telugu, Kannada and English
• Cinemas in Kochi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Pune, Kolkata, Ahmedabad and more Indian cities

HOW IT WORKS
1. Choose your city, or let the app find the nearest one once
2. Open a movie and pick the day, language and number of seats
3. See every show ranked by its best seats, open the seat map, switch to 3D
4. Tap Book to buy tickets on the booking site

No login needed. Sign in with Apple or Google only if you want seat alerts on every device.

Seats Movie doesn't sell tickets and isn't affiliated with any booking site or cinema. Tickets are bought on the booking site.

name: Secret Phantoms
description:
TAKE THE ROOM
Drag anywhere to move your Commander. The squad follows and fires on its own. Walk into a door to breach it and stun the room, or throw a flashbang first.

EVERY CONTRACT IS DIFFERENT
Rescue hostages, retrieve intel, take down armoured targets. Fight through urban blocks, desert compounds and arctic bases, then hold the landing zone while the counter-attack closes in.

A MERC LEFT BEHIND STAYS BEHIND
Downed mercs bleed out unless someone gets them up. Anyone outside the landing zone when the bird lifts off is gone for good. Hire, level up and promote your squad from Recruit to General.

BUILD YOUR OUTFIT
Spend the war chest on new hires, sentry guns and armory upgrades. New to it? Boot Camp is free and nobody gets hurt.

• One-thumb controls
• Free, with no ads and no in-app purchases
• No account, plays fully offline
• Your progress stays on your iPhone

name: SelaVoice - Traducao ao Vivo
description:
O SelaVoice traduz eventos ao vivo, em voz e texto, para o idioma de cada pessoa. Igrejas, conferências, palestras, treinamentos, feiras e reuniões: o público escaneia o QR Code, escolhe o idioma e acompanha em tempo real, sem criar conta.

• Ouça a tradução em voz ou leia a transcrição ao vivo
• Entre escaneando o QR Code ou digitando o código do evento
• Histórico de eventos e apostilas em PDF publicadas pela organização
• Para organizadores: transmita pelo celular ou computador, acompanhe o uso e gerencie eventos, equipe e planos pelo painel
• Eventos privados protegidos por senha
• Filtro de ruído que prioriza a voz principal do palestrante

A tradução é automática e pode conter erros; não substitui intérprete certificado em situações críticas.

Política de privacidade: https://selavoice.com/legal/privacidade

name: Sendit,
description: When you return to a climb and can’t remember which holds worked, Sendit lets you look up your past attempts and route notes before you get back on the wall. Use the climbing journal to record attempts and successful climbs on boulder problems and roped routes, mark holds on photos, and save voice notes about moves you want to try again. Log hangboard and technique sessions alongside your climbs, then use the calendar to see how many days you climbed, how many climbs you completed, and how much time you spent training each month.

name: Sentence Kit: German Grammar
description:
Sentence Kit turns German grammar into something you build with your hands.

Every topic is a short blueprint: rules, interactive tables and real examples you can listen to. Then you build: drag der, die or das into place, snap words into the right order, fill gaps with the right ending, and type answers with a built-in umlaut row.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 10 units organised by what you want to say: name things, talk about people, tell what happened, link your ideas and more
• 38 grammar topics from articles and plurals to Passiv and Konjunktiv I & II
• 4,000+ exercises in four formats: drag & drop articles, sentence building, multiple choice and typing
• Mistake box: every wrong answer comes back on a smart schedule until you really know it
• 60-second speed round: swipe right if the sentence is correct, left if it isn't
• German audio for every answer, generated on your device, no internet needed
• Ask AI why: after a wrong answer, an AI tutor explains the rule behind it (needs internet)
• Explanations in English, Spanish, Russian, Ukrainian and Turkish
• Progress you can see: a level for every topic, a weekly chart and a wall that fills up as you learn
• No account, no ads; lessons and exercises work offline

SENTENCE KIT PRO
The first two units are free. Pro unlocks all 10 units and 38 topics, plus more AI tutor questions. Choose a monthly or yearly subscription; the yearly plan starts with a free week and the monthly plan with 3 free days. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase or after the free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://zgdevelopment.ch/privacy_policy/privacy-policy-sentence-kit.html

name: Sepiaglow: Old Photo Scanner
description:
Sepiaglow turns the prints in your shoebox and family albums into clean digital photos with your iPhone camera. Glare from glossy paper disappears, edges are found and straightened, and every photo is saved to Photos with the year it was taken.

NO GLARE, FULL QUALITY
• Glare-free mode: take up to four shots from slightly different angles and Sepiaglow combines them into one picture without reflections
• Edges are found automatically and the perspective is corrected; adjust the crop by hand if you like
• Full camera resolution with the right lens, Macro for small prints, no watermarks

WHOLE ALBUM PAGES
• Photograph an album page and Sepiaglow cuts it into separate photos, each one straightened
• Scans are kept in batches, with the originals, so every edit can be undone

THE RIGHT DATE IN PHOTOS
• Exact date, about a year, a decade, or “I don't know”: Photos shows the scan in the right place on your timeline, not on scan day
• Add a place and a caption; they are written into the file too
• Save one photo or the whole batch to a “Sepiaglow” album in Photos

SEPIAGLOW PRO
A one-time purchase of $14.99, no subscription. Family Sharing included:
• Restore faded colors, color casts, dust and small spots — without generative AI: faces are never redrawn, and a before/after slider shows every change
• Scan the back of a photo: handwriting is recognized on your iPhone and suggested as the caption and date
• One date, place and caption for a whole batch at once
• Export for the family: a ZIP, a folder in Files or a PDF album, with captions in CSV and JSON
• Alternate app icons

Free forever, without limits: scanning, glare-free shots, album pages and saving to Photos with dates and places.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Everything happens on your iPhone. No account, no Sepiaglow server, no analytics, no ads. Your scans stay in the app and in your Photos.

Privacy Policy: https://time-design.web.app/privacy/sepiaglow.html
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Seraxo - Retail & Staff
description:
Seraxo is an all-in-one retail showroom and staff management application designed to streamline daily store operations, employee attendance, and sales tracking.

Key Features: • Smart Attendance: Accurate attendance punch-in and punch-out verified through showroom geofencing to ensure staff presence on-site. • Sales Management: Easily create and log new retail sales with product and service invoice photos. • Income & Cash Tracking: Role-based views for owners, cashiers, and sales staff to view daily collections and pending payments. • Expense Recording: Track day-to-day showroom expenses and petty cash with instant receipts. • Staff & Customer Insights: Monitor employee shifts, track performance, and manage customer records seamlessly.

Simplify your retail business management and keep your team aligned with Seraxo.

name: Sergio Fabbri Card
description:
Sergio Fabbri è l'app della tessera fedeltà di Sergio Fabbri Calzature ed Emporio Fabbri, i nostri due negozi di Verucchio, in Piazza Europa.

Con l'app hai sempre in tasca la tessera e tutto quello che la riguarda, e in cassa basta mostrarla prima di pagare.

COSA PUOI FARE

• Mostrare la tessera in cassa: la trovi al centro dell'app, a tutto schermo, pronta da far leggere.
• Avere lo sconto in negozio: lo sconto è uguale per tutti i livelli e si applica quando mostri la tessera prima di pagare, secondo le condizioni del regolamento.
• Raccogliere punti con i tuoi acquisti: in negozio con la tessera e, dalla sua attivazione, sul sito. I punti si calcolano sul prezzo pagato per la merce, secondo le condizioni del regolamento: il saldo è sempre aggiornato nell'app e nel dettaglio di ogni acquisto vedi i punti che ti ha dato.
• Salire di livello: Base, Argento e Oro. Il livello dipende da quanto hai speso negli ultimi 12 mesi, e più alto è il livello, più punti raccogli per ogni euro. In ogni momento vedi a che punto sei e quanto manca al successivo.
• Trasformare i punti in un buono sconto: scegli tu quanti punti usare, il buono si crea in un attimo e lo mostri in cassa dall'app.
• Rivedere i tuoi acquisti: gli scontrini dei negozi collegati alla tessera e gli ordini del sito fatti con la stessa email, con il dettaglio di ogni acquisto.
• Scoprire le novità: i prodotti arrivati negli ultimi 30 giorni sul nostro sito, con foto, marca e prezzo.
• Ricevere le notifiche che vuoi: punti ricevuti, buono pronto, buono in scadenza e, se lo desideri, le novità e le promozioni. Le notifiche si accendono e si spengono dal tuo profilo, e all'iscrizione sono spente.
• Usare più telefoni con lo stesso account: tessera, punti, buoni e acquisti sono in comune, per esempio in famiglia.

COME SI ENTRA

Non serve una password. Scegli «Continua con l'email»: ti mandiamo un codice, lo inserisci e sei dentro. Se preferisci puoi accedere con il tuo account Apple, Google o Facebook. Alla prima volta ti chiediamo di dichiarare di avere almeno 14 anni e di accettare il regolamento; con l'email anche nome e cognome.

LE TUE REGOLE, SEMPRE A VISTA

I valori del programma in vigore (sconto, punti per ogni euro, soglie dei livelli, valore e durata dei buoni, scadenza dei punti) sono sempre indicati nell'app, nella schermata «Livello e punti». Se cambiano, ti mandiamo un avviso nell'app con i valori prima e dopo. I punti già maturati restano sul tuo saldo e i buoni già creati conservano valore e scadenza.

LA TUA PRIVACY

Non facciamo profilazione e nell'app non ci sono pubblicità. Puoi eliminare l'account in ogni momento dal tuo profilo («Elimina l'account»): cancelliamo subito, su tutti i telefoni, tessera, punti, buoni e accessi. Se non hai più l'app puoi chiedere l'eliminazione dalla pagina dedicata del nostro sito: manager.sergiofabbri.com/loyalty/delete-account.

IL PROGRAMMA

Il programma fedeltà è riservato a chi ha almeno 14 anni, è gratuito e vale nei nostri due negozi di Verucchio. Sul sito sergiofabbri.com vale dalla sua attivazione: l'app indica se è già attivo. Il regolamento completo e l'informativa sulla privacy sono sempre consultabili nell'app.

Sergio Fabbri Calzature, Piazza Europa 32, Verucchio (RN).

name: SetPointPro
description:
SetPoint är en poängtavla för tennis, padel och pickleball. Välj sport och matchformat och ange namn på spelarna eller lagen. Tryck på den sida som vann bollen. Tavlan visar poäng, game, set och serve. Du kan ångra den senaste inmatningen om du trycker fel.

I tennis kan du välja bäst av tre eller fem set, med fördel eller avgörande poäng vid 40 lika. I padel kan du välja Star Point eller Golden Point. Ett matchtiebreak till tio kan ersätta det avgörande setet i båda sporterna.

I pickleball får bara det servande laget poäng. Välj singel eller dubbel och spela till 11, 15 eller 21 poäng med två poängs marginal. Vid dubbel visar tavlan om lagets första eller andra spelare servar. Du kan spela ett game eller bäst av tre.

Spara avslutade matcher i historiken. Filtrera efter sport och se resultat, speltid och antal spelade poäng. Dela en match som text via enhetens delningsmeny. I appen finns också 15 regelkort om bland annat serve, tiebreak och sidbyte.

Poängräkning och historik fungerar på enheten utan internetanslutning eller konto. Gränssnittet finns på engelska och förenklad kinesiska.

name: Shade Band
description:
Shade Band keeps one fabric lot on this iPhone. Each roll is compared with the standard using CMC colour difference.

Rolls inside the tolerance get a three-digit shade code and sit in a band. Widen the step to regroup them. The lay plan counts marker lengths in each band.

There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Sheave Face
description:
Sheave Face reads four feeler gaps on the adjustable pulley. Top, bottom, left, and right become angular misalignment and parallel offset, then a front or rear foot shim and an axial move. Compare an earlier reading on the same drive and export a CSV. Photos of the face stay on this iPhone.

Works offline. No account. No in-app purchases.

name: Shellshore Sort
description:
Collect a little calm by the coast.

Shellshore Sort is a seashell sorting puzzle for iPhone. Move shells between strings, bring matching colors together, and fill woven baskets. Each completed level adds a piece to your next seaside scene.

• Play 125 levels, from gentle introductions to layered sorting challenges.
• Discover 10 shell varieties and build your collection.
• Uncover six illustrated coasts and choose your favorite backdrop.
• Work around hidden shells and locked strings as the puzzles develop.
• Try a different route with Undo, Hint, an extra string, or Restart.
• Enjoy animated basket collections, celebrations, sound, and optional haptics.
• Pick up where you left off with progress saved on your device.

Play at your own pace, with no countdown. The game works offline and requires no account. Free to download, with no ads, subscriptions, or in-app purchases.

Shellshore Sort is in English. Your progress stays on your device; there is no in-game cloud sync.

Voice and sound effects generated with ElevenLabs (elevenlabs.io).

name: Shift Bench
description:
A laundry-room shift bench: pick laundromat, hotel, gym & spa or clinic, lay out washers and dryers, and keep a load queue while machines are quiet or running. Drum Ear works on this iPhone — live analysis, nothing recorded. Microphone access is off shows Open Settings.

Work moves in batches, with tags, a ticket, totals, Tag Lens, Bleed Radar, Basket Scan and Lone Sock. Tools cover stain by fabric, dose and wash temp, mixer and chemistry, dryer time and line dry, moisture and cool-down, shrinkage, fold cards, load cost, and a symbol drill for care labels.

The shift book is handover, a machine log you mark done, milestones, and a journal PDF that never leaves this iPhone unless you share it. Settings store laundry type, products, currency, water hardness and theme. No account.

name: Shift by Mneme
description:
Keep work shifts, classes, and personal plans together in one schedule. Use Agenda to see what’s next and Planner to create and edit recurring shifts, classes, and events.

• Set local reminders and see upcoming events in iPhone widgets.
• Show events from selected Apple calendars alongside plans you create in Shift.
• Ask Leno what’s next or use it to prepare schedule drafts for your review.
• Plan trips with transport, stays, activities, and ideas. Save turnover tasks alongside a connected property calendar.
• Add an optional weather forecast using a city you choose or your approximate location.

Your plans are stored on your device. Core planning works offline with no account. Live weather and opening external links require an internet connection.

name: Shipzap
description:
Steer with your left thumb. Fire with your right. Stay alive.

Shipzap is an offline space shooter built for short, repeatable arcade runs. Small enemy ships weave through the arena, warn before firing, and sometimes raise red shields that deflect your shots. Pick your moment, line up a hit and earn 50 points.

An encounter grows from one enemy to four, adding another every ten seconds. Clear the final group and face the next encounter with your score intact. Pressure rises as you survive, then reaches a defined limit.

Destroy an enemy after the shield-drop interval to earn a blue pickup. Catch it as it drifts down the screen for ten seconds of protection. Collect another to extend your remaining time.

• Manual single-shot firing and independent left/right steering
• Moving enemies, temporary red shields and earned blue protection
• Five local high scores with remembered pilot names and rank titles
• Pause, restart and end-game controls
• Separate music, effects and haptics settings
• Offline play with no accounts, ads or additional purchases

Made by Zerostrike.

name: Shotimer - Sport Shot Timer
description:
Shotimer is a high-precision athletic timing tool designed for target shooting athletes, Action Air / GBB Airsoft competitors, and safe home dry-fire practice.

Powered by real-time acoustic impulse detection, Shotimer captures live range shots, GBB airsoft cycling, and hammer/striker clicks directly via your microphone, measuring your first-shot reaction and split times with millisecond accuracy.

KEY FEATURES:

• MULTI-PURPOSE DETECTION:
  - Live Fire & GBB Airsoft Mode: Calibrated for range fire and gas blowback airsoft cycles. Built-in echo filter eliminates acoustic reflections.
  - Dry Fire Mode: Ultra-sensitive threshold captures subtle hammer falls and striker clicks. Features Par Time dual-beeps to beat the buzzer at home.

• BUILT-IN ATHLETIC DRILLS:
  - Free Shooting: Open practice session with no limits.
  - Mozambique Drill: 2 body + 1 head shot tactical drill with auto-finish.
  - Bill Drill: 6 rapid shots to gauge recoil control and split cadence.
  - 1 Magazine (15 Rounds): Magazine capacity rhythm and split analysis.
  - Draw to 1st Shot: Optimize reaction speed from buzzer to trigger break.

• REALISTIC START COMMANDS:
  - Voice RO (Range Officer): Authentic "Shooter ready?", "Standby..." commands followed by a randomized start buzzer.
  - 3-2-1 Countdown & Instant Beep modes.

• LIVE AUDIO CALIBRATION:
  - Real-time decibel input meter lets you easily calibrate detection thresholds for any room or range.
  - Customizable Par time, shot counts, and delay intervals.

• PRIVACY-FIRST & 100% OFFLINE:
