  - Fully functional without an internet connection or account.
  - Microphone audio is analyzed in volatile memory (RAM) in real time solely to calculate decibel spikes. Audio is NEVER recorded, saved, or uploaded.

SAFETY & DISCLAIMER:
Shotimer is strictly an athletic stopwatch utility created for competitive target sports (such as IPSC, Action Air, USPSA) and safe sports training. It does not sell, promote, or encourage the dangerous use of firearms. Users are strictly expected to follow all firearm safety rules and local regulations.

name: SideA – Polls & Opinions
description:
SideA – Share Your Opinion

SideA is a community platform where you can create polls, share your opinions, and discover what others think. Whether you're making everyday decisions, exploring different perspectives, or simply curious about people's preferences, SideA makes it easy to ask questions and participate in polls.

Key Features

Create Your Own Polls
Have a question on your mind? Create your own polls and invite others to share their opinions. Choose topics that interest you and see how people respond.

Vote and Participate
Explore polls shared by other users and cast your vote. Every poll is an opportunity to express your perspective and take part in a conversation.

Discover Different Opinions
Browse a variety of topics and see how opinions differ. Learn about other perspectives through community-created polls.

Share Your Thoughts
Post your opinions and engage with topics that interest you. Exchange ideas and enjoy discovering what others think.

A Space for Every Opinion

SideA brings questions and opinions together in one place. Create a poll, cast your vote, and discover a different point of view.

Download SideA and make your opinion part of the conversation!

name: Sift Recipes
description:
Any recipe you can screenshot or paste becomes one you can cook from.

Sift Recipes reads the messy version, a chat reply, a social post, a photo of a page, and turns it into a clean recipe with a title, ingredients, amounts and steps. You check it, fix anything, and save it to your table.

WHAT IT DOES

• Reads pasted text and screenshots. Pick several screenshots for one long recipe and Sift joins them.
• Share a screenshot or text to Sift Recipes from any app.
• Photograph a dish and Sift guesses the recipe for you to check and correct.
• Scales to the number of people you are feeding. Amounts change in the ingredient list and inside the steps.
• Cook mode shows one step at a time, with the amounts written into the sentence and timers taken from the recipe.
• Sends ingredients to a grocery list in Reminders, combines amounts across recipes, and tells you which recipe each item is for.
• Plans lunches and dinners for the week as events in Calendar, and offers to add the ingredients to your groceries.
• Answers "What should I cook tonight?" from the recipes you have saved, with a reason for each pick.
• Gives every recipe a plate, painted for you or from your own photo.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

• There is no account and no sign-in.
• Reading, sorting and suggesting happen on your iPhone.
• Sift runs no servers and collects no data.

GOOD TO KNOW

• Works best on iPhones with Apple Intelligence. On other iPhones, or when Apple Intelligence is off, Sift uses a simpler built-in reader.
• Groceries live in Reminders and meal plans live in Calendar, so they also work in those apps. Sift asks for access the first time you use each one.

SIFT PLUS

Ten of your own recipes are free, with every feature included. Sift Plus removes the limit with one payment. It is not a subscription and never renews.

name: Signal Torch
description:
Signal Torch – Công cụ ánh sáng đa năng, biến điện thoại của bạn thành thiết bị phát tín hiệu tiện lợi.
Các tính năng nổi bật:
Đèn pin LED mạnh mẽ.
Tín hiệu SOS Morse khẩn cấp.
Đèn nháy với nhiều chế độ và tốc độ.
Cảnh báo nhanh bằng ánh sáng.
Màn hình phát sáng với nhiều màu sắc và tùy chỉnh độ sáng.
MUSIC SYNC – Đồng bộ đèn flash theo nhịp điệu âm nhạc.
Giao diện hiện đại, dễ sử dụng, sẵn sàng hỗ trợ bạn trong nhiều tình huống hằng ngày.

name: Signkoi
description:
Signkoi is the simple way to get documents signed.

Upload a PDF from your phone, add the people who need to sign, place the signature fields and send. Your recipients sign right in their browser — no account, no app, no password — and you get back a sealed PDF with a complete audit trail.

SEND FOR SIGNATURE IN MINUTES
• Upload one or several PDFs and combine them into one envelope
• Add signers, approvers, in-person signers, viewers and CC recipients
• Set a signing order, or let everyone sign at once
• Quick Place puts signature, date, name and initials fields for each signer in one tap
• Add a private message, reminders and an expiry date

TRACK EVERY SIGNATURE
• See who has viewed, signed or declined — in real time
• Send reminders, correct a recipient's details or resend a link
• Void an envelope if plans change
• Download the signed PDF and the certificate of completion

TRUSTWORTHY BY DESIGN
• Tamper-evident seal and trusted timestamp on every completed document
• Full audit trail of every view, signature and change
• Optional identity checks for signers: access code or one-time email code
• Anyone can check a signed PDF at signkoi.com/verify

TEMPLATES AND TEAMWORK
• Save documents you send often as templates and reuse them in seconds
• Share templates with your team
• Keep a contact list of the people you send to

FOR EVERYONE
• Works in 12 languages: English, Español, Français, Deutsch, Português, Italiano, Nederlands, Polski, Русский, 日本語, 中文, हिन्दी
• Light and dark mode
• Free to start

Your signers never need to install anything. Signkoi works for contracts, offer letters, NDAs, permission slips, leases, invoices and any PDF that needs a signature.

name: SimplStream
description: No banners, no pop-ups, no in-app purchases, no nonsense! Just a simple, easy-to-use internet radio tuner with over 50,000 stations available. Create and edit a favorites list and stop paying monthly fees! I tried to find a nice basic internet streaming tuner and was so put off that I decided to make my own. Completely free, no subscriptions. Enjoy!

name: Sincely
seller_name: SUN TECH M & E SDN. BHD.
description:
When did you last get a haircut? Call Grandma? Clean the fridge? Sincely answers in one glance. Every thing you care about gets a desk-calendar tile with a big split-flap number that counts the days since it last happened. When it happens again, tap Reset and the number flips back.

YOUR DAYS-SINCE BOARD
- One tile per counter, each with a large flip number for the days since.
- Tap Reset to log that it happened today, or pick an earlier day on the built-in calendar to backdate it.
- Add an optional note to any reset: "tried the new barber", "she's planting tulips".
- Sort by most overdue, freshest, or A to Z.

IDEAL RHYTHMS
- Give any counter an optional "ideal every N days" (weekly, every two weeks, monthly or any number).
- Tiles stay sky blue while you're on track and turn tangerine once they're overdue.
- The Overdue card lists the most slipped counters first, then what's coming up, then what's on track.
- Choose how many days ahead a counter counts as "coming up".

HISTORY THAT MEANS SOMETHING
- Every counter keeps its own log of resets with notes.
- See the average gap, longest gap and how often you kept to your ideal rhythm.
- The History card shows every reset across all counters, month by month, with totals for this month, the last 30 days and all time, plus your steadiest habit.
- Edit the day or note of any entry, or remove it. The count adjusts by itself.

BOARDS
- Group counters into boards like Home, People, Self-care and Car.
- Add, rename, reorder or delete boards. Counters on a deleted board move to another one, so nothing is lost.

A DESK CALENDAR, NOT A MENU
Move around with the little flip calendar at the top: tap it to flip to the next card (Board, Overdue, History, Drawer), or press and hold to see all four and jump straight to one.

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
- Start counting as a guest with no sign-up at all.
- Or create an account with email and password to keep your counters across devices. Password reset is built in.
- Guests can save their counters to an email account later from the Drawer.
- Works offline and syncs when you're back online.
- Delete your account and all of its data at any time from the Drawer.

THOUGHTFUL DETAILS
- Calendar Mist and After Dark themes.
- Soft paper sounds and gentle haptics, each with its own switch.
- Starter examples you can load with one tap, then edit or delete.

No ads. No tracking. No analytics. Your counters stay private to your account.

name: Sip & Dare
description:
Posez l'iPad ou le téléphone au milieu de la table, entrez vos prénoms : en 30 secondes, votre soirée est lancée.

Sip & Dare enchaîne les défis, les votes et les duels en citant vos amis par leur prénom. Touchez l'écran, la carte suivante se retourne. C'est tout.

POURQUOI VOUS ALLEZ L'ADORER
• Prêt en 30 secondes : des prénoms, un mode, et c'est parti
• Chacun son tour : personne n'est oublié, personne n'est visé deux fois de suite
• Des cartes géantes, lisibles depuis l'autre bout de la table
• Avec ou sans alcool : tout le monde joue, vraiment
• Un prix honnête : payé une seule fois, sans abonnement obligatoire

5 AMBIANCES
• Apéro : pour démarrer en douceur (gratuit)
• Sans alcool : toute l'énergie, des gages à la place des gorgées (gratuit)
• Soirée : le grand classique taquin
• Hot : coquin et piquant, jamais gênant
• Chaos : règles folles et défis express

8 FAÇONS DE JOUER
• Défis personnalisés avec vos prénoms
• Action ou Vérité
• Je n'ai jamais
• Qui pourrait… : le groupe vote
• Règles virales qui durent plusieurs cartes, toujours affichées à l'écran
• Duels en face à face
• Mini-jeux contre la montre
• Cartes « Tout le monde ! » avec confettis

VOTRE GROUPE, VOS CARTES
• Enregistrez vos groupes et rejouez en un seul tap
• Écrivez vos propres cartes avec vos blagues internes, puis partagez-les à vos amis
• Fin de partie : podium, titres drôles et image à partager au groupe
• Un appel, l'app fermée ? La partie se rouvre toute seule là où vous l'aviez laissée

PENSÉ POUR L'IPAD AU CENTRE DE LA TABLE
• Mode table : la carte se lit des deux côtés
• Ambiance néon, cartes qui se retournent, sons et vibrations
• Fonctionne aussi parfaitement sur iPhone, en portrait comme en paysage

JOUER RESPONSABLE
• Chaque carte peut être passée, sans pénalité
• Joker eau : un joueur remplace ses gorgées par de l'eau
• Rappel d'hydratation toutes les 20 minutes
• Nombre de gorgées plafonné et intensité réglable
• Page de prévention avec les numéros utiles

GRATUIT, PUIS UN SEUL PETIT ACHAT
Apéro, Sans alcool, l'éditeur de cartes, les groupes et le podium sont gratuits, sans publicité. Débloquez Soirée, Hot, Chaos et toutes leurs futures cartes pour 1,99 €, payés une fois. Un pass annuel facultatif existe aussi. Pas d'essai qui se transforme en abonnement. Partage familial inclus.

VOS DONNÉES RESTENT CHEZ VOUS
Aucun compte, aucune publicité, aucune donnée collectée. Prénoms, cartes et statistiques restent sur votre appareil. Fonctionne sans connexion.

Sip & Dare est réservé aux personnes majeures. L'abus d'alcool est dangereux pour la santé, à consommer avec modération. Ne prenez jamais le volant après avoir bu.

Assistance : https://schmittutility.fr/assistance/
Confidentialité : https://schmittutility.fr/confidentialite/

name: Site Qwality
description:
Site Qwality pages you when a monitor fails or someone declares an incident, and lets you work the incident from your phone.

When you're paged
- Acknowledge or resolve the incident, and reopen it if it comes back.
- See which monitors failed, from which locations, and the reason each check gave.
- Page a teammate, whoever is on call for a schedule, or an escalation policy.
- Add notes for your team, or post an update to your status page.
- Declare an incident and page a service's on-call.

On call
- See who is on call now for every schedule, and your own shifts for the next 30 days.
- Take someone's shift, cover a gap, or go on call now for an hour, 4 hours or the rest of a shift.

Monitors
- Every HTTP, heartbeat and browser monitor with its status and 24-hour uptime.
- Uptime over 24 hours, 7 days and 30 days, response times, recent outages and recent checks.
- Run a check now, or pause and resume a monitor.

Pages arrive as time-sensitive notifications.

You need a Site Qwality account to use the app.

name: Site Sums: Paint & Tile
description:
Work out paint and tiles on site, in seconds.

Site Sums is built for painters, decorators, tilers and serious DIYers. Big buttons you can hit with gloves on, high-contrast results you can read in bright sun, and it works with no signal.

FREE CALCULATORS, FULL RESULTS
• Paint: walls and ceilings, doors and windows taken off, coats, the coverage from your tin, and textured or porous surfaces. You get litres needed and the tins to buy (10 L, 5 L, 2.5 L).
• Tiles: floor or wall area, tile size, layout waste (straight, diagonal, herringbone, large format), spares, and tiles per box. You get exact tiles and boxes.
• Every assumption on screen in one line, so you can check the maths.

PRO: ONE-TIME PURCHASE, NO SUBSCRIPTION
• Saved jobs: keep every room's calculations together, e.g. "Kitchen, 14 Elm Road".
• Shopping list: one combined list for the job, with tins and boxes. Tick items off at the merchant.
• Share: send a job summary as a PDF or text, with an optional VAT line.
• Imperial units (feet, square feet, gallons).
• All future calculators.
• Works with Family Sharing.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account. No ads. No tracking. Your jobs stay on your iPhone.

Results are estimates. Always check against the product label and your project requirements.

name: SixCourt
description:
SixCourt on lentopallon taktiikkataulu harjoituksiin ja kentän laidalle. Suunnittele pelaajien paikat, piirrä liikkeet ja käy kuvio läpi joukkueen kanssa.

Katso rotaationäkymästä kaikki kuusi kiertojärjestystä, eturivin pelaajat ja syöttövuorot. Muokkaa kokoonpanoa pelaajien nimillä ja pelinumeroilla sekä merkitse passari ja libero. Sovellus huomauttaa samoista pelinumeroista, sallitun alueen ulkopuolisista numeroista ja eturiviin merkitystä liberosta.

Siirrä kuutta pelimerkkiä kentällä ja piirrä nuolia liikkeille, syötöille ja torjunnoille. Lisää, kopioi tai poista vaiheita ja toista kuvio vaiheittain. Anna taktiikalle nimi ja laji, kuten vastaanotto, puolustus, hyökkäys tai aloitussyöttö. Voit kirjata myös vastustajan ja erän.

Tallenna omat kuviot taktiikkakirjastoon. Kirjastossa on lisäksi kymmenen valmista mallia, esimerkiksi vastaanottomuodostelmia, kiertopuolustus ja pipe-hyökkäys. Tee mallista kopio, kun haluat muokata sitä. Hae taktiikkaa nimellä tai vastustajalla ja suodata lajin mukaan.

Taktiikat tallennetaan laitteelle. Sovellus toimii ilman verkkoyhteyttä tai käyttäjätiliä. Käyttöliittymä on saatavilla englanniksi ja yksinkertaistetuksi kiinaksi.

name: Sizekin
description:
Sizekin is a size book for the whole family. Measure once, then shop for clothes and shoes without guessing, standing in the store or ordering online.

EVERYONE IN ONE BOOK
Add the people you shop for: yourself, a partner, the kids, grandparents. Give each one a name, a thread colour and, if you like, a birthday so their age shows next to their sizes.

EVERY SIZE THAT MATTERS
Record tops, trousers, dresses, shoes, socks, hats, gloves, bras and rings in the sizing system on the label: letters, EU, UK, US, waist/leg or kids' ages. Add body measurements too: height, chest, waist, hips, inseam and foot length, in centimetres or inches.

WATCH THEM GROW
Every reading keeps its date. Open any size to see its growth history: a measuring tape slides to the newest reading, a growth line shows how fast the kids are shooting up, and a mint "Grew" tag tells you when shoes or trousers have moved up a size.

THE SHOPPING CARD
One tap shows a person's current sizes in large type, easy to read in a busy aisle. Share the card as plain text with grandparents or friends who want to buy a gift that fits.

SHOE SIZE CONVERTER
Slide the tape to a shoe size and read it in EU, UK and US, for children and adults, along with the foot length it fits. If you've recorded a foot length, Sizekin jumps straight to a size that leaves a little room to grow. Save the result to anyone's shoes in one tap.

BRAND NOTES
Remember that one label runs small and another runs large. Keep short notes per person, such as "size up in winter coats".

YOUR ACCOUNT, YOUR CHOICE
Start straight away with "Peek as guest", no account needed. When you're ready, save your sizes to an email account and sign in on another phone. Sign in or create an account with email and password at any time, with password reset built in.

WORKS OFFLINE
Your size book works without a signal and syncs when you're back online.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your sizes are stored privately under your own account, and you can delete your account and every size from the Closet whenever you want.

Gentle sound effects and haptics can each be switched off, and a calm Bedtime theme is there for late-night online shopping.

name: SKÅL – Selskabsspil
description:
SKÅL is a party game for adults where everyone plays on their own phone. One person starts a party, the others join with a four-letter code – and the host picks the games.

The games are in Danish.

GAMES IN THE APP
• Bomben (The Bomb) – solve the task and pass the bomb on before it goes off
• Hvem er mest … (Who is most likely …) – vote for the one who fits best
• Reaktionsduel (Reaction duel) – tap when the screen turns green
• Detektiv (Detective) – everyone has the same word, except the bluffer
• Mellemspil (Interludes) – small surprises between the games

SKÅL MEDLEM
With a membership the whole group gets 7 extra games and secret missions all evening. When the host is a member, everything is unlocked for everyone in the room.

SKÅL Medlem is a subscription for 1 month or 1 year. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at purchase and renews automatically at the same price unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period. You can cancel in your App Store settings.

The loser takes a sip – but drink responsibly. A sip can always be water. For people aged 18 and over only.

Terms: https://skaal.pixlo.dk/vilkaar
Privacy policy: https://skaal.pixlo.dk/privatliv

name: Skyline Dash
description:
Lace up your skates and race across the city rooftops at dusk. Skyline Dash is an endless runner you can play for a minute or chase a high score all evening.

SWIPE TO SURVIVE
Swipe left or right to change lanes, up to jump and down to slide. Hop over crates and barriers, slide under shop signs, washing lines and pipes, steer round air-con units and watch out for maintenance carts coming your way. Leap the gaps between buildings. The faster you go, the closer the obstacles get.

POWER-UPS
Grab a Magnet to pull in coins, a Jetpack to fly over everything, a Shield that saves you from one hit and 2x Score to double your distance and your coins.

DAILY RUN
A new course every day, the same for every player. Come back daily to keep your streak going and earn bonus coins.

MISSIONS
Three missions at a time, like collecting coins, jumping or sliding a set number of times in one run. Complete them for coins and a new mission takes their place.

SKATERS, TRAILS AND ROOFTOPS
Spend your coins in the shop on new skaters (including Pip the Possum), colourful trails and new rooftops: Neon Night, Sunrise and Snowfall.

NO SIGN-UP
No account, no email, no password. Just open the app and skate. Your progress stays on your device.

Skyline Dash is free to play with ads. A one-time "Remove Ads" in-app purchase turns off the banner and between-run ads. Optional reward ads (continue a run, double your coins) are always your choice.

name: SkyMood
description: With this weather app, you can plan your trips with confidence and ensure your safety while on the go. It serves as a reliable companion for accessing precise weather information and organizing your daily life. Whether you need to check the local weather or plan an international journey, you can get the most accurate forecasts anytime, anywhere—with coverage extending across nearly the entire globe.

name: Skypose: Body Progress Photos
description:
Skypose is a private progress photo journal for the gym. Take the same four photos, front, back, left and right, on each date, line them up with a ghost of your last photo, and see how far you’ve come.

• Same pose, every time: the camera shows a faint ghost of your last photo, and with the timer one tap takes every angle hands-free.
• See the change: compare two dates with a slider, make a timelapse of every date, or a collage to share.
• Track your numbers: weight, body fat, height and 11 body measurements, with charts and BMI.
• Apple Health: when you choose, Skypose imports your past weight, body fat and height from Apple Health. It only reads, never writes to Apple Health, and keeps what it imports on your iPhone, out of iCloud Backup.
• Widgets and Siri: days since your last photos, a measure on your Home or Lock Screen, and “Take photos in Skypose”.
• Private by design: no account and no servers. Your photos and measurements stay on your iPhone and, if you turn on iCloud Backup, in your own private iCloud. Lock Skypose with Face ID.

Free to start: your first two photo dates are free, with everything Studio and Progress do. To add more photo dates, subscribe to Skypose Yearly, with a 2-week free trial for new subscribers, or Skypose Monthly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.mjxstudio.com/skypose/privacy/?platform=ios

name: Sleep Sounds: Meditation Calm
description:
When sleep won't come, let the night sky turn off the lights.

Meditation Sleep is a minimalist sleep companion — deep-space aurora visuals, real field recordings, and classic 4-7-8 breathing guidance. Open it and listen: no plans, no streaks, no scoring.

◆ Tonight's pick
Open to tonight's sound — one tap and the atmosphere settles in seconds. Scene cards and Sleep School below, all playable offline.

◆ 26 layers of real recordings
Rain, ocean, forest, campfire, stream, evening wind, distant thunder and a summer pond — plus wet markets, street vendor calls, night markets, Christmas markets, metro trains, cafés, restaurants, malls, city streets, playgrounds, schoolyards, harbors, temple bells, morning chants, church bells, buskers and lion-dance drums. Layer them freely in the Mixer Lab and save your own soundscape. Every layer is a real recording, seamlessly looped, bundled in the app — nothing to download, works offline.

◆ Breathing guidance
The classic 4-7-8 method: inhale 4s, hold 7s, exhale 8s. A glowing orb pulses with the rhythm and a soft chime marks each phase. Follow eight rounds at your own pace.

◆ Sleep School
A genuinely slow lecture: a professor takes one algebra definition apart again and again — plus physics and chemistry read aloud. Understanding doesn't matter; it just guides your thoughts back to the seat until you drift off.

◆ Designed for deep night
· Background and lock-screen playback with controls
· Sleep timer: 15/30/45 min with a natural fade-out
· Deep-space dark UI — no sudden bright flashes
· No account, no analytics, no ads, no tracking

Sleep early tonight.

◆ Apple Watch companion
Keep a simple sound player on your wrist. Swipe vertically through all 26 nature, city and contemplative recordings and four courses. Matching sound icons and gentle animations bring each scene to life. Tap the central orb to play, pause, or resume. Audio is bundled for offline listening.

One-time purchase. No subscriptions or in-app purchases.

name: Slide Out: Arrow Puzzle
description:
Tap an arrow and it slides out of the board in the direction it points — but only if nothing is in the way. Clear every arrow to finish the level.

Slide Out is a calm, satisfying logic puzzle you can play in a minute or for an hour.

HOW TO PLAY
• Tap an arrow to slide it out.
• Blocked arrows bump into others and cost a heart.
• Clear the board with no mistakes for 3 stars.
• Stuck? Use a hint to light up a free arrow.

FEATURES
• Hundreds of levels that slowly grow from 4×4 to big 10×8 boards
• Every level is guaranteed to be solvable
• Bright, clean design and smooth animations
• Relaxing original music and crisp sound effects
• Haptic feedback
• Play offline, anytime
• English and Turkish

Slide Out is free to play and supported by ads. You can remove ads with a one-time purchase.

name: Slip Out: Tap Away Puzzle
description:
Tap a tile and it slides the way its arrow points, straight off the board. Unless something is in the way.

Slip Out is a calm tap-away puzzle about order. Every tile carries an arrow. Tap it and it slides out in that direction. If another tile blocks its path, it bumps back and you lose one of your three lives. Read the board, find the tile that can leave first, and clear them all.

HOW IT PLAYS
• One tap, one move: the tile slides the way its arrow points
• A blocked tile bumps and costs a life. You have three per board
• Every level is generated and checked to be solvable
• Clear a board within par and without a bump for three stars

TWO WORLDS
• Arrows: learn to read the board, one blocked path at a time
• Chained pairs, from level 21: two linked tiles leave together, or neither does

WHEN YOU ARE STUCK
• Hint lights a tile that can leave right now
• Undo bump takes back a blocked tap
• One more life lets you keep going after the third bump
Levels 1 to 3 give hints at no cost. After that, hints, undo and the extra life are optional short videos.

THE DAILY BOARD
A new board every day, the same for everyone. One scored attempt with no hints or undo, then replay it as often as you like. Keep your daily streak going and share your result as a spoiler-free line of stars.

ALSO IN THE GAME
• A progress screen with your stars, boards cleared, dailies and streak
• Sound and vibration switches
• Screen-reader labels on the board and every tile
• 17 languages

ADS AND REMOVE ADS
Slip Out is supported by ads: a banner on the menus and, from level 4, at most one ad between levels. Ads never show during a board. Remove Ads is a one-time purchase that removes the ads between levels and the banners. Hint videos stay available as an optional choice. There is no subscription.

Privacy Policy: https://yalintech.com/legal/slipout/privacy
Terms of Use: https://yalintech.com/legal/slipout/terms

name: Slovíčko: Learn Slovak
description:
Learn Slovak on a road trip from Bratislava to Košice, with Róza the goat as your guide.

Slovíčko ("little word") takes English speakers from their very first "ahoj" to confident everyday Slovak. Every stop on the trip is a real Slovak town, with bite-size lessons, a dialogue and a checkpoint that earns a stamp in your passport.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 15 stops and 60 short lessons: new words, listening, picture questions, sentence building, typing with a Slovak accent bar, and say-it-aloud practice
• Four Slovak voices to choose from, two women and two men, built into the app so they work offline
• Spaced repetition that brings each word back just before you would forget it
• Practice for your mistakes, flashcards, a searchable dictionary and five mini-games
• A plain-English grammar handbook with quizzes, the alphabet and its sounds, and a phrasebook for travellers
• Stories about Slovak food, folklore, traditions, places and history, plus a timeline, a map, name days, proverbs and tongue twisters
• Daily goals, streaks, achievements and levels named after Slovak mountains
• Light and dark themes, and larger text when your phone asks for it

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Everything works offline and your progress stays on your phone. The daily reminder is optional and comes from your phone, not from a server.

FREE TO START
The first three stops of the trip (Bratislava, Trnava and Nitra) with all their lessons, the alphabet, the numbers game and the calendar, practice of every word you learn, all four voices, and a taste of the stories, phrasebook, games and grammar are free for good. One optional in-app purchase unlocks the whole trip, once and for good. No subscription.

The Slovak audio is computer-generated speech.

name: Smart Flash Link
description:
Smart Flash Link is the companion app for compatible Bluetooth Mesh smart devices. Pair and control lights locally via Bluetooth—no account or cloud required.

Key features:
• Add and control lights, panels, curtains, and more
• Adjust brightness, color temperature, and color; control devices in groups
• Create scenes for one-tap lighting moods
• Organize by home and room; enjoy rhythm and music sync modes
• Multi-language support

Works only with compatible Flash Link Bluetooth Mesh devices. Enable Bluetooth and follow in-app pairing steps.

name: SMOX Simulator
description:
SMOX Simulator estimates what an on-site waste-to-energy plant based on SMOX technology can do for a specific site.

Choose a site — a town, a prison, a resort, a hospital, an island, a military base or an industrial district — or enter your own. Describe the waste by composition or by industrial waste codes (EER), pick the location and its climate, and the simulator works out, step by step, the mass and energy balance:

• how much energy the waste contains
• how much heat and electricity are recovered, average and month by month
• how much natural gas and grid power the site no longer buys, at regional average energy prices
• storage, plant size and an indicative layout
• ash, metals and flue-gas residues, CO₂ and emissions compared with EU limits
• high-efficiency cogeneration (CAR/PES) checks for Italy

Every assumption is visible and can be changed. Results can be saved as a one-page PDF sheet and shared, or sent as a scenario link.

Works offline. Four languages: English, Italian, Spanish and French. US or metric units.

SMOX Simulator is an engineering tool for professionals. Figures are estimates to be confirmed by Pure Organica for each project; they are not an offer and not a performance guarantee.

name: SnapVoiceKeyboard
description:
SnapVoice Keyboard is a keyboard that listens only while you hold a key. Instead of toggling a microphone on and off, hold "Hold to talk", speak, and let go — your words are typed right away.

• Dictation only while you hold the key
• Korean (2-set) and English layouts with numbers and symbols
• Korean and English speech recognition (switch with the 한/A key)
• Adjustable keyboard height, key haptics, and a default-language setting
• Action Button and Shortcuts support to turn the voice session on and off
• No accounts, ads, or analytics. The developer collects no data

How it works: iOS does not let keyboards use the microphone, so the SnapVoiceKeyboard app keeps a voice session open while you choose to. The microphone indicator is shown the whole time, and the session turns off automatically when unused (1 minute by default).

To dictate, turn on Allow Full Access for the keyboard and turn on a voice session in the app. Typing works without Full Access.

name: SolariumSalak
description:
Salak Solarium

A bright glass-garden escape for short sunny sessions.

After a storm rattled the dome, dew stalled on the panes and cheerful pests wandered the flower lanes. Step in as the orchard guide, restore three gentle rites, and watch noon return to the glass canopy.

WHAT YOU'LL PLAY
• Bloom Bastion — plant smiling sunflowers along winding paths and hold soft beetle waves at bay.
• Glasshouse Labyrinth — swipe through mint-and-cream mazes, gather sparkling dew, then claim the golden exit.
• Petal Duel — choose Sun, Dew, or Petal cards each round and outscore a giggling rival.

PROGRESS WITH WARMTH
Clear stages to fill your Sunnectar jar. Trade nectar in the Outfit Wardrobe for companions like Honey Courier, Sunhat Sprout, and Petal Faire—then walk the maze and cheer duels in a look you love. Peek at the Garden Chronicle whenever you want the story of the cracked dome and the promise of noon.

WHY IT FEELS GOOD
Soft pastel scenes, cute character cutouts, short stages with rising challenge, and rewards that unlock new faces—not endless chores. Perfect for a bright pause between real-world errands.

Come back for the morning Sunnectar gift, polish every lane, and let the solarium sing again.

name: Solitaire, Sudoku & Mahjong
description:
Four favourite games in one beautiful app: Solitaire, Yukon, Sudoku and Mahjong Solitaire. No ads, no in-app purchases, no tracking and no sign-in. Pay once and play forever, even offline.

FOUR CLASSICS
• Solitaire (Klondike): turn one card or three
• Yukon: no stock and no luck of the draw, just skill
• Sudoku: Easy, Medium, Hard and Expert, every puzzle solvable by logic, with hints that explain the next step
• Mahjong Solitaire: seven layouts, from the classic Turtle to the Pagoda

A NEW CHALLENGE EVERY DAY
• One Daily Challenge a day, taking turns through the four games
• The same challenge for everyone that day
• Keep your streak going

TROPHIES AND STATISTICS
• 24 trophies to win across all four games
• Wins, best times and streaks for every game, level and layout

PUT YOURSELF ON THE CARDS
• Take, or choose, photos of family and friends and use them on the Jack, Queen and King cards in Solitaire and Yukon
• Your photos stay on your phone and never leave it

MAKE IT YOURS
• 9 card backs and 5 hand-painted court card sets
• 6 table scenes, from a cosy card room to a winter village
• Portrait or landscape, on iPhone and iPad
• Undo, hints and restart in every game; leave any time and carry on where you left off

EASY ON THE EYES
• Large cards and four-colour suits
• Left-handed layout

From Door Nine Games, the studio behind Door Nine Classics: the card and puzzle games you know, done properly.

name: Solkrukke
description:
Solkrukke er en butik til dig, der holder af grønne planter og smukke krukker. Her finder du et udvalg af husplanter, krukker, færdige sæt og tilbehør, sorteret i tydelige kategorier som bladplanter, sukkulenter og kaktus. Hver plante har sit eget pasningskort med praktiske oplysninger om pleje, lys og placering, så du nemt kan se, hvad den trives bedst med.

Du kan handle trygt med betaling ved modtagelse, og vi leverer til din dør. Som medlem optjener du point på dine ordrer, får fri levering fra 499 kr., adgang til medlemsfordele og ekstra hjælp til pasning af dine nye planter. Du kan gemme dine favoritplanter, følge dine ordrer og søge blandt varerne, når du leder efter noget bestemt.

Appen er lavet til plantevenner i et roligt tempo, uden unødvendige funktioner. Den hjælper dig med at finde de planter og krukker, der passer til dit hjem, og giver dig den vejledning, du skal bruge for at passe dem godt.

name: Solo Five: Paintball Tactics
description:
One player. Whole team.

Solo Five is a 3D paintball tactics game where you play all five members of your team. A point is the same 20-second fight, replayed up to five times. Each take you control a new player, while every earlier take runs again beside you, exactly as you played it.

USE YOURSELF
Send take 1 straight into the opponents' sight to pull their eyes, then run take 2 down the side nobody is watching. Opponents only see inside their vision cones, and the cones turn to follow whoever walks in.

SAVE YOURSELF
A player who gets hit keeps running so the take is recorded to the end. Take out the shooter before it happens in a later take, and that earlier you is back in the game.

STOP TO SHOOT
Drag the stick to run. Stand still for a moment and your marker fires at the nearest opponent it can see. Running never shoots, so every position is a decision.

READ THE TAPE
Every earlier take is drawn on the field like a coach's replay: where it has run, where it will run next, and where it will be hit if nobody helps.

- 96 levels in eight chapters, each with one new thing to outwit: lane shooters, callers, paired guards, limited paint, low snakes, dark zones, patrols
- Every chapter ends with a three-point final played on nine shared takes
- Three marks to earn on every level
- A daily point with a new theme each day of the week: everyone plays the same field
- A playbook of every point you win
- Three short lessons to start, no account needed
- Share a replay code so friends can watch your winning play

No ads, no account, no energy. Every level is free as you progress: win a chapter to open the next. One optional purchase opens every chapter at once.

name: Somna:Where Dreams Meet
description:
A house that keeps returning. A train with no final stop. A voice you still remember after waking. Keep those fragments in Somna and discover who else recognizes a little of your dream world.

Capture the details
Record dreams with text, photos and voice notes you choose to record. Add tags for places, objects and emotions. Entries are private by default, drafts save automatically, and keyword and date filters help you revisit earlier dreams.

Share the parts you choose
Select the text, attachments and tags you want to make public, then preview your fragment before publishing. Explore community dreams, save images and stories that stay with you, leave responses and follow people whose imagination feels familiar.

Talk in dream lounges
Create or join a themed voice lounge. Describe your dream in real time, share scene cards with text and images, and hear how the same idea takes shape in someone else's mind.

Keep the conversation going
Exchange text, photos and short voice messages in private chats. Start a one-to-one video call with mutual consent and get to know the person behind a familiar dream.

Let an old dream grow
Add a new dream or a real-life coincidence to an earlier entry and build a journal that develops over time. You can also report content, block accounts and review your related records.

name: Sool Business
seller_name: AMJAD ABDUL RAOUF YASSIN AL SABBAGH
description: The work app for Sool's team and wholesale merchants. Drivers run delivery trips, capture serial numbers and record cash collections; sales representatives plan visits, check in at shops and place orders for merchants; managers follow live KPIs, approvals and broadcasts; merchants follow their orders. Sign-in requires an account issued by Sool.

name: Sora Defence: Castle Defense
description:
Darkness has fallen. Undead armies march on the walls of the last fortress, and only one wizard stands between them and ruin: you.

Sora Defence is a fast, one-handed castle defense game. Pick your spells, combine them and stop endless waves of skeletons, bats, stone golems and terrifying bosses before they break through your walls.

◆ 7 POWERFUL SPELLS
Magic Bolt, Fireball, Chain Lightning, Frost Barrier, Meteor Shower, Poison Cloud and Tower Archers. Level up during battle, choose new spells and upgrade each one up to level 5. Every run is a new combo!

◆ 100 STAGES, ENDLESS CHALLENGE
Every stage brings bigger and stronger hordes. Some stages can only be beaten with the right gear and the right spell build.

◆ THE BONE KING AND EPIC BOSSES
Every 10 stages a giant boss marches on your walls: casting volleys, summoning minions and charging your defenses. Can you stop him?

◆ PERMANENT UPGRADES
Spend your gold on the Ancient Staff, Rune Walls, Focus Crystal, Eagle Eye and Dragon's Hoard. Even a lost battle makes you stronger.

◆ UNLOCK NEW POWERS
Treasure Hunter, Soul Harvest, Lethal Strike, Multicast and more unlock as you progress.

◆ DAILY REWARDS
Log in every day for gold and gems on a 7-day calendar. Keep your streak alive for bigger rewards!

◆ PLAY ANYWHERE
Quick battles, one-handed controls, no internet connection required.

Sora Defence is free to play. It contains optional in-app purchases and ads. Rewarded ads are always optional, and the "Remove Ads" pack removes interstitial and banner ads.

Privacy Policy: https://sorayazilim.com/sora-defence/gizlilik

name: Southwind Flight
description:
Kiko is a kiwi, and kiwis can't fly. Each flight starts on a wooden ramp on a sea cliff. Kiko slides down, leaves the lip and flies out over the water until coming down in the sea. Distance, height and time in the air pay coins. Spend them on upgrades and go again.

HOW A FLIGHT WORKS
Two buttons on the right tilt the nose up and down. Climbing costs speed, diving gives it back. Once you own a rocket, hold the button on the left to burn its fuel. Hit the water fast and nearly level and Kiko skips off it like a stone. Sky coins hang in the air along the way, and from about 120 m up there are stars worth 25 sky coins each.

THE ROAD TO THE SOUTHERN ISLE
The Southern Isle is 18,000 m from the cliff. Checkpoint isles at 4,500, 9,000 and 13,500 m pay a bonus the first time you pass them. There are 10 ramps, and each has four goals for distance, height, speed and time in the air. The first distance goal is 40 m, the last one 16,200 m. Goals pay coins and open the next ramps. Flights from ramps 6 to 10 pay 15% to 80% more.

UPGRADES
There are ten: Glider, Rocket, Fuel Tank, Ramp Height, Slide Wax, Aerodynamics, Tail Fins, Skip Boots, Launch Spring and Coin Magnet. You get eight gliders, from the Patchwork to the Nova, and eight rockets, from the Firecracker to the Nova Drive. Three of each are on sale from the start, and from ramp 3 each new ramp opens one more.

THE SKY CHANGES AS YOU CLIMB
Gulls fly low over the sea, and dolphins jump when Kiko skims the water. Higher up you pass hot air balloons and planes. Above 160 m the sky fills with stars, then the moon shows at 280 m and a ringed planet at 420 m. Above 400 m satellites drift by, now and then a flying saucer. At 560 m you are in space.

AWARDS AND DAILY GIFT
42 awards, from a 100 m flight to catching 150 stars. Each one pays coins. The Daily Gift grows over a seven-day streak and starts over if you miss a day.

STORE
Every upgrade can be earned by flying. The Store sells coin packs sized to how far you have got, a Starter Pack in your first 48 hours, and the Golden Feather, which doubles the coins of every flight, sky coins included.

- No ads
- Plays offline, no account
- No data collected, progress stays on your device
- iPhone and iPad, portrait

name: Sowtide
description:
Sowtide turns two dates into a whole year of sowing. Tell it your average last spring frost and first autumn frost once, choose what you're growing, and it lays out when to sow indoors, when to sow outdoors, when to plant out and roughly when you'll be picking — for every crop in your plot.

YOUR FROST DATES RUN EVERYTHING
Every window is counted from the frost dates you enter, nothing else. Change them and the whole calendar moves with them. A season strip shows your frost-free days at a glance, with frosty months shaded in blue.

THIS WEEK, AT A GLANCE
Open the app and see what to sow and plant out this week, how many days each window has left, which seedlings should be up by now, what's ready to pick and which windows open in the next three weeks. Log a sowing straight from the list.

A SEED SHELF OF 57 CROPS
Vegetables, herbs and flowers — tomatoes, chillies, courgettes, peas, lettuce, carrots, basil, parsley, sunflowers, zinnias, sweet peas and many more — each with indoor, outdoor and planting-out weeks, days to sprout and days to first pick. Tune any crop to match your own seed packet, or make your own from scratch.

YEAR STRIPS FOR EVERY CROP
The Calendar shows a 12-month strip per crop: sow indoors, sow outdoors, plant out and harvest, with frost months shaded and a marker for today. Flip to next year to plan ahead.

A SOWING LOG THAT GROWS
Log each sowing with the day, where it went and how many seeds. Mark it sprouted, planted out and harvested, and a little line-drawn sprout grows stage by stage. Keep notes for each bed, pot or patch.

GENTLE REMINDERS
Turn on Monday-morning reminders and get a short local notification listing the week's sowing jobs. You decide; nothing is asked until you tap.

MADE TO FEEL LIKE A GARDEN NOTEBOOK
Seed-packet navigation, soft soil and sprout sounds you can switch off, haptics you can switch off, and a Night Garden theme for evening planning.

SIGN IN YOUR WAY
Create an account with email and password, or tap "Peek at the beds" to use Sowtide as a guest. Guests can link their garden to an email account later from the Shed, keeping every crop and sowing. Works offline and syncs when you're back online.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your garden is visible only to you. Delete your account and everything in it from the Shed at any time.

Sowtide does not give growing advice: its dates come straight from your own frost dates and the timings you choose. The weather always has the final word.

name: Spam Koruma: SMS Engelleyici
description:
Her gün gelen "deneme bonusu", "kazandıran kupon", sahte kargo ve hızlı kredi mesajlarından bıktın mı? Spam Koruma, bilinmeyen numaralardan gelen bu SMS'leri Mesajlar uygulamasındaki Gereksiz klasörüne ayırır. Bildirimleri gelmez, mesajlar silinmez; istediğin zaman bakabilirsin.

NELER AYRILIR
- Bahis, iddaa ve casino mesajları (deneme bonusu, kupon, çevrimsiz bonus, yeni giriş adresi)
- Dolandırıcılık mesajları (sahte kargo, ceza, aidat, ödül ve hesap güncelleme tuzakları)
- Kredi ve para teklifleri
- İstersen firma reklamları (RET, B001 ve İYS içeren ticari SMS'ler)

NELER KORUNUR
- Doğrulama kodları hiçbir zaman engellenmez.
- Banka, kargo, operatör ve e-Devlet bildirimleri istersen Mesajlar'daki İşlemler bölümünde ayrı toplanır.
- Rehberindeki kişilerden gelen mesajlar filtrelenmez.

NASIL ÇALIŞIR
- Mesajı telefonun içinde, Türkçe spam kalıplarına göre inceler. "b.a.h.i.s" ya da "b4his" gibi gizlenmiş yazımları da tanır.
- USOM'un zararlı bağlantı listesini ve link kısaltıcı listesini telefonda saklar; mesajdaki linki internete çıkmadan kontrol eder.
- Koruma seviyesini Düşük, Orta veya Yüksek olarak seçersin.
- Kendi engellediğin ve izin verdiğin kelime ve gönderen listelerini oluşturursun.
- "Kontrol et" ekranına bir SMS yapıştırıp filtrenin ne yapacağını ve nedenini görebilirsin.

GİZLİLİK
Mesajların telefonundan çıkmaz. Filtrenin internet erişimi yoktur. Hesap, reklam, analiz ya da takip aracı yoktur; hiçbir kişisel veri toplanmaz.

KURULUM
Ayarlar › Uygulamalar › Mesajlar › Bilinmeyen ve Spam › SMS Filtreleme bölümünde Spam Koruma'yı seçmen yeterli. Uygulama sana adım adım gösterir.

Not: Apple'ın kuralları gereği SMS filtreleri yalnızca bilinmeyen gönderenlerden gelen SMS ve MMS mesajlarına uygulanır; iMessage mesajları filtrelenmez.

name: Spider Solitaire: Big Cards
description:
Spider solitaire made to be easy on the eyes.

Spider Solitaire: Big Cards is the classic patience game with big cards, large numbers and clear colours. Pick up a deal, play at your own pace and enjoy a game that is simple to read and simple to use.

READABLE BY DESIGN
- Large and extra-large card faces
- A four-colour deck: spades black, hearts red, diamonds blue, clubs green
- Heavy, easy-to-read card numbers
- Text follows your device's text size
- Left-hand mode puts the controls where your thumb is

EVERY DEAL CAN BE WON
Every deal in the app is checked to be winnable, so a stuck game is never the game's fault. Take your time and look for the way through.

PLAY YOUR WAY
- Play with one suit to relax, two to think a little more, or four for a real challenge
- Build a run of one suit from king to ace and it clears itself
- Tap a card or a run to send it to its best place, or drag and drop
- Deal a new row whenever you are ready
- Unlimited undo and free hints, as many as you like
- A new daily deal every day, with a streak calendar
- Sound and vibration you can switch off

KEEP TRACK
See your games played, wins, win rate, streaks, best time and fewest moves for each mode.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose a card back and a table colour from the free looks, or add the Garden, Evening and Seaside packs. Every look keeps the cards bright and easy to read.

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese, Vietnamese and Thai.

SIMPLE AND PRIVATE
- Works offline
- No account, no sign-in
- Your game stays on your device

name: Spill: Text & Chat Analyzer
description:
Your chat, with receipts.

Spill reads a WhatsApp chat export and writes an honest report about it. Not vibes: every claim in the report quotes the real messages that prove it, and anything the AI can't back up with a message is dropped.

WHAT YOU GET
• A score card for two people, or Chat Awards for a group, ready to save to Photos or share
• The real numbers, counted on your phone: who texts first, reply times, late-night messages, longest silence, sorrys and "love you"s
• The full report: turning points, six traits for each of you with proof, inside jokes, a verdict and one thing to do this week
• Three tones: Blunt, Soft or Savage
• Both Sides: invite the other person to add their side and get a joint report

HOW IT WORKS
1. In WhatsApp, open a chat, tap its name, tap Export Chat, choose Without Media, and pick Spill in the share sheet. Or pick an export from Files.
2. Spill reads and redacts the chat on your iPhone. Phone numbers, emails, links, addresses, surnames and long numbers become tokens, and you see exactly what would be sent.
3. Only if you agree, the redacted text is sent to Google's Gemini AI to write your report. The chat is deleted from our servers as soon as the report is ready, always within 24 hours.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up
• Photos, videos and voice notes are never sent
• Reports are kept for 30 days and you can delete one any time
• No ads, no third-party tracking

PRICING
The card, the stats and the opening are free. The full report is a one-time in-app purchase per report. No subscription.

For adults (18+). Reports are written by AI for fun and reflection, not advice. Only upload chats you're part of.

Privacy: https://spill.pratikpoddar.in/privacy
Terms: https://spill.pratikpoddar.in/terms

name: Spinning Pickaxe
description:
No arms? No problem. The pickaxes spin on their own!
Pickaxes orbit an armless little miner and smash every rock they touch.
Ore pops out of the broken rocks, and your miner slurps it right up.

Idle mining that keeps going
Let go of the screen and your miner finds the way to the mine and digs by itself.
Even while the game is closed, you collect up to 8 hours of offline rewards.

Endless floors underground · 30 kinds of ore
From stone, copper, iron, gold and crystal to mithril, orichalcum, adamantium, dragon scale and void stone!
Dirt tunnels → stone caves → crystal caves → ice caves → lava caves → ancient ruins → the void. Every floor has its own layout.
The deeper you go, the better the grade of the same ore.
Reach floor 15 to open the Second Mine… where rocks with eyes run away from you!

Travel through portals
Village · Miner School · Forest (chop trees too!) · Lake · Bamboo Grove · Waterfall · Beach · Cave · Market Street · Hangar · Windmill Hill · Quarry · Spirit Meadow…
Find the hidden masters to unlock new paths.

31 jobs, from 1st to 5th class
Graduate from Miner School, then choose just one path: Dual Wielder or Thrower?
Triple Blade, Driller, Bomb Thrower, Dog Miner, Drill Robot Pilot, Windmill Swordsman, Summoner…
At 5th class, giant robots stomp and a dragon sweeps across the screen with its breath.
Up to 7 pickaxes spinning at once!

Grow your pickaxes: levels · enhancement · merging
Pickaxes level up as you use them. Enhance them at the forge, or merge 3 of the same into the next tier!
From +10 they start to sparkle.
8 gold upgrades (attack, critical hits, armor pierce, ore price…) with no level cap, plus a skill tree for your own build.
6 potions for a quick boost.

200 costumes
52 hairstyles, 48 hats and accessories, 100 outfits.
Afro with a space helmet? Hanbok with cat ears? Dress up your miner — every outfit changes what your miner mutters.

Leaderboards ·  Chat
Deepest floor, weekly mining and richest miner leaderboards — check out other miners' outfits and pickaxes.
Chat with miners in your language. (Google Play Games / Game Center sign-in)

Daily check-in
Stamp once a day for free sapphires, with a bigger reward on day 7!

Ads are optional
Double offline rewards, free sapphires, potions, a gold pouch — watch only when you want. An ad removal pack is available.

No random paid items
Every paid item has fixed contents. We do not sell loot boxes.

Contact: cs@flamehammer.games

name: SplitClip
description:
Video too long for your Status, Story or Shorts? SplitClip cuts it to the right length in seconds.

HOW IT WORKS
• Pick a video from your photo library
• Choose a length: 15, 30 or 60 seconds – or set your own
• Mark your section and fine-tune it to a tenth of a second
• Or split the whole video into equal parts
• Done: your clips land in the “SplitClip” album, ready to share

MADE FOR
WhatsApp Status, Instagram & Snapchat Stories, TikTok and YouTube Shorts.

SMALL & FAST
Optionally compress your clips to 720p – perfect for messengers.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-up
• No ads, no tracking, no data collection
• SplitClip only sees the videos you choose
• Everything happens on your iPhone

FREE OR FULL VERSION
Create 3 clips per hour for free. The full version gives you unlimited clips and the Lime, Sky and Stone color schemes – a one-time purchase, no subscription.

Questions or feedback? ollifolio.com/splitclip

name: Spoke True
description:
Spoke True keeps one wheel's hop and dish on this iPhone.

Drag one spoke's turns. The hop moves before the dish. The stamp reads True, Hop, Dish, or Both. Save a measured hop and the next spoke's target turns change.

Wheels stay on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy. The stamp does not replace the shop specification.

关键词：

name: Spotter HQ: Gym Management
description:
Spotter HQ is gym management for small and growing gyms and personal trainers. Fees, dues, receipts, check-ins, staff and client plans in one simple app, with no subscription software and no paper register.

COLLECT FEES IN TWO TAPS
• Pick the member, pick the plan, done. The new expiry date is set for you.
• Cash, card or the payment methods used in your country.
• A branded receipt goes out on WhatsApp, with your gym logo.

NEVER MISS A RENEWAL
• See who is due today, this week, and who has lapsed.
• Send friendly payment reminders to everyone due, one tap each.
• Membership plans: monthly, quarterly, yearly, or your own.

RUN THE GYM
• Member check-in and attendance.
• Staff, salaries and advances.
• Expenses and monthly profit.
• Equipment list with service reminders.
• Reports: income by plan and payment method, in vs out.

BUILT FOR PERSONAL TRAINERS TOO
• Trainer mode: your PT clients, their sessions and your PT income, kept apart from gym cash.
• Personal plans in under a minute: calories, protein / carbs / fat, a veg or non-veg meal plan, and a weekly workout split built from the client's body and goal.
• Log sets and weights, track weigh-ins, and share plans as a PDF or on WhatsApp.
• Clients can open their plan in the free Spotter member app.

WORKS WORLDWIDE
Choose your country and Spotter HQ sets the currency, payment methods, phone codes and BMI cut-offs to match: US$, £, €, ₹, AED, A$, C$ and more.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
Everything stays on your phone. No account, no login, works without internet. Back up to WhatsApp or Drive whenever you like.

Made for gym owners, fitness studios, CrossFit boxes, yoga and martial-arts studios, and independent personal trainers.

name: Sprue Band
description:
Sprue Band keeps a wax tree honest before the metal is poured.

Each pattern stays where you drop it. A center under 18 sits in the button band and is hot. A center over 82 sits in the tip band and is hot. Centers 18 and 82 stay in the middle.

Two patterns are too close when the gap is shorter than the thicker wall. A gap equal to that wall is still clear. The thinner wall does not set the limit.

Pour only when nothing is hot and nothing is too close. A sound tree stays as it is.

Each tree stays on this iPhone. There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: SPS Indore Alumni
description:
SPS Indore Alumni – Stay Connected, Stay Together!

Welcome to the official SPS Indore Alumni app, a dedicated platform that brings together former students, teachers and the wider SPS Indore community.

Reconnect with old classmates, revive cherished memories, build meaningful connections and stay updated with everything happening in the SPS alumni network.

*Key Features:*

•⁠  ⁠*Alumni Network:* Connect with fellow SPS alumni and discover old friends and classmates.

•⁠  ⁠*Stay Connected:* Keep in touch with your school friends and expand your professional and personal network.

•⁠  ⁠*Alumni Updates:* Get the latest news, announcements and updates from the SPS Indore alumni community.

•⁠  ⁠*Events & Reunions:* Stay informed about alumni meets, reunions and upcoming community events.

•⁠  ⁠*Share Memories:* Celebrate your school journey and cherish unforgettable moments with fellow alumni.

•⁠  ⁠*Community Engagement:* Participate in alumni activities and contribute to strengthening the SPS community.

*Once an SPSian, Always an SPSian!*

Whether you graduated recently or years ago, SPS Indore Alumni helps you stay connected to your roots, friendships and the memories that last a lifetime.

Download the app and become a part of the growing SPS Indore alumni family! **

name: Stack Rush
description:
Stack Rush is a one-thumb tower game: tap to drop, line it up and build as high as you can.

HOW TO PLAY
A block swings from a crane above your tower. Tap anywhere to drop it. The part that lands on the block below stays, the overhang is sliced off and tumbles away, so every sloppy drop makes your tower narrower. Miss completely and the round is over.

PERFECT DROPS
Line a block up exactly for a PERFECT drop: it snaps on at full width with a flash and a chime. Chain perfect drops for a combo and bonus points. From the third perfect in a row, each perfect makes your block a little wider again.

FASTER AS YOU CLIMB
The swing gets quicker the higher you build, and the sky changes as you climb, all the way up to the stars.

DAILY TOWER
A new tower every day with the same swing pattern for every player. Play it daily to keep your streak going and earn bonus coins.

THEMES AND BLOCK SKINS
Earn coins as you play and unlock new looks: Mint Breeze, Candy Pop and city skylines like Harbour Dusk, Neon Night, Metro Noon and Midnight Gold, plus Glass, Brick, Office, Stripes and Gem blocks.

NO SIGN-UP
No account, no email, no password. Just open the app and stack. Your progress stays on your device.

Stack Rush is free to play with ads. A one-time "Remove Ads" in-app purchase turns off the banner and between-round ads. Optional reward ads (keep your tower after a miss, double coins) are always your choice.

name: StageONN
seller_name: LAICOS BILISIM YAZILIM VE BILGI SISTEMLERI ITHALAT IHRACAT LIMITED SIRKETI
description:
StageONN is the call app for actors and crews working with theatre companies, production companies and casting agencies. Your organization invites you or gives you a join code; your rehearsal, show and shoot calls come to your phone.

TODAY AND TOMORROW
The first screen tells you where and when you need to be today and tomorrow. Without a connection, the last known plan still shows.

ONE-TAP ANSWERS
Confirm your call, say you can come partly, or send your excuse. An answer given offline waits and goes by itself when you are back online.

CHANGES RIGHT AWAY
If the time or place changes, you get a notification; your earlier confirmation is reset and you are asked again. Between 23:00 and 07:30, non-urgent notifications wait until morning.

SEVERAL ORGANIZATIONS, ONE CALENDAR
Working with several theatres or productions at once? All your calls are in one calendar. Organizations never see each other's work; when there is a clash, only "busy" is shared, and only with your permission.

BUSY TIMES AND CALENDAR SUBSCRIPTION
Add your own busy times and subscribe to your calls in Apple Calendar or Google Calendar.

YOUR PROFILE
Fill in your profile so your organizations and StageONN members can get to know you. You choose who sees each field; your contact details stay hidden unless you open them.

PRIVACY
Your data is shared only with the organizations you work with, with your permission. No ads, no tracking. You can delete your account in the app.

Planners manage rehearsals, shows and calls on the web at app.stageonn.net.

name: Stampoir: Stamp Identifier AI
description:
Point your camera at a postage stamp and Stampoir tells you what it is. In seconds you get the title, country, year, face value, rarity and an estimated value range. Then you save it to your own album.
Stampoir is for collectors, beginners and anyone who found a box of old stamps in the attic.

SCAN A STAMP
• Point the camera at a stamp, pick a photo, or try a built-in sample stamp
• Stampoir finds the stamp in the picture and straightens it
• AI identifies it and writes the result in your language

WHAT YOU GET
• Title, country, year, face value, colour and series
• Catalog numbers (Scott, Stanley Gibbons, Michel, Yvert & Tellier) when known
• Mint or used condition notes
• Estimated value range in US dollars
• Rarity: common, uncommon, scarce or rare
• Confidence: Best guess, Likely match or Sure match, so you know how far to trust the result
• A short history fact and a collector's tip

YOUR ALBUM
• Every stamp is saved with its photo on your device
• See the total value of your album, plus stamp and country counts
• Filter by country. Search by title, country or catalog number
• Sort by newest, value, country or year
• Add a quantity and notes to each stamp
• Share a stamp
• Export the album to CSV (Pro)

IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Results appear in English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese or Vietnamese.

VALUES ARE ESTIMATES
Values are AI estimates for reference only. They are not an appraisal. Real prices depend on condition, demand and the market. For a valuable stamp, ask an expert.

PRIVATE
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your photo is sent only when you scan, to Stampoir's server and OpenAI to identify the stamp. It is not stored. Your album stays on your device. Scanning needs an internet connection.

FREE TO TRY
Download for free and make 3 free scans. Stampoir Pro lets you scan every day (150 scans a month) and export your album to CSV. Made for iPhone and iPad.

SUBSCRIPTION
Stampoir Pro is a monthly or yearly auto-renewing subscription (yearly includes a 7-day free trial). Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Account Settings.

name: Star Chain Labs
description:
The Star Chain Labs app is the dedicated CRM and internal workspace designed exclusively for Star Chain Labs employees and authorized personnel.

• Role-Based Access: Secure, customized portals tailored for HR, IT, Marketing, and Sales departments.
• Smart Dashboard: Track your daily attendance, active work hours, and pending tasks at a glance.

name: StarterClock
description:
StarterClock hjälper dig att planera nästa surdegsbak. Ange när du matade surdegsgrunden, matningsförhållandet och rumstemperaturen. Du får en uppskattad tid till toppen och ett tidsfönster då grunden kan vara redo att använda. Tidslinjen visar hur långt jäsningen har kommit enligt uppskattningen.

Använd omräknaren för att fördela en given vikt mellan surdegsgrund, mjöl och vatten. Räkna ut hydreringen från mängden mjöl och vatten, eller se hur mycket vatten som behövs för en viss hydrering. Skala någon av de 14 bakmallarna efter din mjölmängd och för över beräkningen till bakloggen.

I bakloggen kan du anteckna recept, jästider, rumstemperatur, hur brödet reste sig i ugnen och hur inkråmet blev. Filtrera tidigare bak efter mall och jämför dina anteckningar. Du kan exportera loggen som en JSON-fil via enhetens delningsmeny.

Tidslinjen är en uppskattning. Surdegsgrundens styrka, mjölet och hydreringen påverkar jäsningen. Titta också på hur grunden faktiskt utvecklas. Bakmallarna räknar på mjöl, vatten, salt och surdegsgrund. Andra ingredienser ingår inte i omräkningen.

Beräkningar och anteckningar hanteras på enheten. Appen fungerar utan internetanslutning eller konto. Gränssnittet finns på engelska och förenklad kinesiska.

description:
Compare football clubs with Stat Duel, a powerful football analytics app.

Explore top football leagues, select your favorite teams and discover detailed club comparisons.

name: Statistics AP: Sampleford
description:
Prepare for the AP Statistics exam (revised five-unit course) with adaptive practice questions, full-length timed mock tests, free-response practice and hands-on simulations of sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis tests, regression and chi-square. Every answer has a full worked solution and a source reference.

STATISTICS PRACTICE THAT MATCHES THE 2027 EXAM FORMAT
- 1,580 original multiple-choice questions with four choices, numbers computed and checked by two independent methods
- Diagnostic and personal plan: unit weights from the official course framework, spaced review, mistake notebook, readiness range after 40 answers
- 5 full-length mocks: 42 multiple-choice questions in 90 minutes, then 4 free-response questions in 90 minutes, with a review grid and no ads while the clock runs
- 61 free-response questions with rubric self-scoring and approximate feedback on the pieces a good answer needs
- 16 labs you can drag: dotplots, binomial and normal models, sampling distributions and the central limit theorem, confidence interval coverage, sampling bias, hypothesis tests with power, t versus normal, regression and residuals, chi-square, regression output, experiment design, conditions and conclusions. Each lab ends with a quiz built from your own numbers

ALL FIVE UNITS
Exploring one-variable data and collecting data; probability, random variables and probability distributions; inference for proportions; inference for means; regression analysis.

FREE TO STUDY, FAIR TO SUPPORT
- Practice, review, the mistake notebook, six labs, every worked solution and every reference are free
- Watch an optional short video to earn credits for mocks and the other labs, or subscribe for $3.99 per month (7-day free trial) to remove ads and open every mock, lab and the free-response pack. Cancel any time in your App Store or Google Play account settings. If you cancel, you keep ad-free until the end of the period you already paid for, and you will not be charged again.
- Prefer not to subscribe? Watch short videos to earn credits and unlock features.

PRIVATE AND OFFLINE
Everything stays on your device. No account. Content is based on the College Board course framework with references to OpenStax and OpenIntro open textbooks; questions and explanations are original. Scores shown are rough practice estimates, not predictions.

AP is a trademark registered and owned by the College Board, which is not affiliated with, and does not endorse, this app.

name: Steepworks
description:
Fill each tea order before the coal runs out.

Steepworks is a single-player puzzle game set in a hillside tea workshop. Five reels assign tasks to five stations. Each pull costs one coal and spins the unlocked reels. Keep up to two reels when they show the tasks your leaves need. Leaves wilt when they get stuck and spoil after four consecutive waits.

Starting in level 4, spend a ticket to shift a reel by one position. Ship tea without letting the leaves wilt to earn more tickets. Green and black tea follow different processing steps. In level 6, choose which type of tea to make with each new leaf.

- Six levels in Hillside Garden, unlocked in order
- A guided first level and optional gameplay tips
- Replayable levels with best scores stored on your device
- Settings for haptics, tips and reduced motion

Play every level offline, with no accounts, ads or in-app purchases. The game is in English and plays in portrait on iPhone.

name: Stickerer
description:
Turn any video or GIF from a tweet into animated WhatsApp stickers, in seconds and entirely on your iPhone.

HOW IT WORKS
• Paste a tweet link, or a direct link to a video or GIF
• Or share a tweet to Stickerer from the share sheet in X: the app opens and starts converting right away

MADE FOR STICKERS
• Animated 512×512 stickers that fit WhatsApp's size limit automatically

YOUR STICKER LIBRARY

name: Stitchwyn
description:
Stitchwyn is a calm, thoughtfully designed studio for knitters, crocheters, and sewing makers. Keep your projects, row counts, yarn stash, patterns, needles, fabrics, and measurements organized in one private, offline space—with zero sign-up, zero ads, and zero subscriptions.

TRACK PROJECTS & COUNT ROWS WITH PRECISION
• Manage knitting, crochet, and sewing projects with Planned, In Progress, and Finished status tracking
• Interactive Stitch Session row counter with a live progress ring, repeat tracker, and keep-screen-awake option
• Pin reminders to any row so you never lose track of decreases, pattern changes, or shaping notes

SMART STUDIO: SWATCH TEXTURE & GAUGE
• Analyze yarn or fabric swatch photos right on your device using your Photo Library or built-in swatches
• Switch between Texture mode (fibre, craft, weight, stitch density) and Gauge mode (stitches & rows per 10 cm, recommended needle size)
• Use the built-in Cast-On Calculator to convert target garment dimensions (cm) into exact cast-on stitches and row counts
• Save analyzed yarn or create a ready-to-stitch project in one tap

ORGANIZE YOUR YARN STASH & TOOLKIT
• Track skeins, grams remaining, meters remaining, fiber type, yarn weight, color swatches, and storage locations

ESTIMATORS, PATTERNS & INSIGHTS

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account or login required

name: Story Owl: Bedtime Stories AI
description:
A brand-new bedtime story every night, starring your child and their favourite cuddly toy, read softly by a warm storyteller voice until they drift off.

Story Owl writes a tale just for them in seconds: their name, their teddy coming to life, the place they dream of and, if you like, a gentle lesson woven in (feeling brave in the dark, sharing, trying something new…).

WHAT MAKES IT DIFFERENT
• No credits or coins: one simple subscription, unlimited stories
• Stories in 10 languages, ideal for bilingual families
• Calm and reassuring: no baddies, no violence, always a peaceful ending

• Sequels with the same characters the next night
• Bedtime routine checklist and a guided owl breathing moment
• Family library, favourites and several child profiles

Stories are written by Apple Intelligence on your device. Story Owl collects no data, needs no account and shows no adverts.

name: StowFit: Packing List Planner
description:
Will it all fit, and will it pass the weigh-in? Find out before you sit on your suitcase. Drag your things into a virtual bag drawn to real scale and see where space runs out, where weight goes over, and what can’t go in the cabin.
Start with your bags. Enter inner dimensions, weight limit and empty weight, and mark each one as carry-on or checked. Presets cover a carry-on, an underseat bag, medium and large suitcases, and a backpack. Build a catalog of your items with weight and rough size. Flag what matters: soft, liquid with volume, lithium battery, sharp. Common items like jeans or a laptop fill in with one tap.
Packing works like the real thing, only with an undo button. The suitcase is shown from above on a centimeter grid. A green outline means the item fits, red means it overlaps or doesn’t fit. Pack in layers and see the outline of the layer below. Rotate items, stand them on edge, move them between layers or bags, or tap an item to place it automatically.
Weight, free volume and layer depth are tracked, so you know whether the lid will close. Carry-on rules are checked too: liquids over 100 ml, total liquid volume, batteries in checked bags, sharp items in the cabin. Most problems have a one-tap fix, like moving a battery to your carry-on or unloading an overloaded bag.
Also included:
• Packing list with filters and progress
• Weight breakdown by category, plus a luggage scale check
• Camera measuring: mark two edges to get dimensions
• Photos of your packed bag, handy if luggage gets lost
• PDF plan with layer diagrams and item tables, or a plain text list to share
• Templates for a city weekend, beach week, business trip, skiing or hiking
For frequent flyers, carry-on-only travelers and anyone who has paid for overweight bags.

name: Stravell
description: Keep the original convention behind each plane. Enter dip direction or right-hand strike, reference north and any supported declination. Project poles and great circles, then inspect one unoriented axis with two antipodal expressions. View rotation never creates a reading. name: Stringwise: Violin & Viola
description:
Pick up your violin or viola and play. Stringwise listens to every note and shows you, as you play, whether it was in tune and on the beat.

LISTEN, THEN PLAY

Every lesson plays for you first, so you know how it should sound. Then it's your turn: after a count-in, follow the music as each note lights up. A pitch meter shows whether you're low, in tune or high, and a timing meter shows whether you're early, on the beat or behind.

A COURSE THAT GROWS WITH YOU

Twenty levels in four stages, Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced and Concert, take you from your first open strings to shifting, vibrato, double stops and concert pieces. Every level has warmups, scales and ten songs, and every song comes in two versions: Learn, a little slower, then Perform, at full speed. That's 600 scored lessons.

MUSIC YOU KNOW

Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star, Ode to Joy, Minuet in G, the Can-Can, Eine kleine Nachtmusik and many more famous classical melodies, in new arrangements made for learners.

FIX THE NOTES THAT MATTER

After every run, Match the Pitch brings back just the notes that were out of tune. Hear each one, then hold it until it's right.

STARS THAT SHOW REAL PROGRESS

Finish a lesson for one star. Play 70% of notes in tune and 65% on time for two. Three stars take a clean, full-length, in-tune performance. Two stars on every song opens the next level, and your best result always counts, so practice never goes backwards.

PRACTICE, NOT HOMEWORK

Choose a guided 10-, 20- or 30-minute session of a warmup, a scale and songs. A practice journal keeps every session, 109 badges mark your milestones, and there are no streaks to break.

VIOLIN OR VIOLA

Choose your instrument when you start. Viola players get the whole course in alto clef, tuned to C, G, D and A.

YOUR OWN MUSIC

Import MusicXML scores, for example from MuseScore, and play them with the same scoring.

EVERY DEVICE

Play on iPhone, iPad or Mac. Your stars, badges and journal follow you through your own iCloud account.

BUILT-IN TUNER

Tune each string before you play, with A = 440 or 442 Hz.

TRY EVERYTHING

The tuner, the How It Works guide and all of Level 1 come with the app. A 14-day trial opens everything else, and it starts only when you first open it. Afterward, one lifetime purchase unlocks Levels 2 to 20 for violin and viola, and MusicXML import, on all your devices, and for your family through Family Sharing. No subscription.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

No account, no ads and no tracking. The microphone listens only while you tune or play, and the sound is analyzed on your device and never recorded or sent anywhere.

name: Study Guides: Bible Books

name: STYLE ME FREE
description:
STYLE ME is a personal stylist in your pocket. Tell it the occasion — a wedding in Capri, a business dinner, a first date — and it builds complete outfits from real pieces you can shop in one tap.

Every look is put together for you: silhouette, colour palette and budget come from a short style consultation you take once. Choose your figure, the events on your calendar, the aesthetics you love, and how much you like to spend. Your answers shape every look the app builds.

THE STYLIST
Describe the occasion in your own words and get three complete looks — each with pieces, prices, a must-have note and styling direction. Swipe between looks, tap any piece to shop it, and love the ones you want in your closet.

DISCOVER
A seasonal edit of real pieces curated for your taste, styled into full looks you can copy. New edit every two weeks.

LOOKBOOK
Save the looks that inspire you. Everything lives on your device — only you can see it.

YOUR CLOSET
The pieces you love, in one place, ready for the stylist to build around.

STYLE DNA
A private profile of your figure, sizes, occasions, aesthetics and budget that keeps every recommendation personal.

name: Stylerobe: Outfits & Packing
description:
Stylerobe is a calm, simple wardrobe app for people who want to dress well and pack light. Your whole closet is free, with no item limit, no ads and no surprise paywall halfway through setup.

YOUR WHOLE CLOSET, FREE
• No item limit and no limit on saved outfits, on the free plan, for good
• Snap a piece or choose a photo: it's lifted from its background on your iPhone
• Paste a shop link to import the name, brand, price, colour and a clean photo
• Paste several shop links, or the text of an order-confirmation email, and add up to 30 pieces at once
• Import a whole camera roll of pieces in one go
• Filter by category, colour and season; watch cost per wear fall each time you wear something

OUTFITS THAT ACTUALLY MATCH
Every morning Stylerobe reads the weather and your plan (casual, work, dinner or active) and suggests three looks from your own clothes.
• Dress-code rules: no trail shoes at work, no shorts at dinner, no heels at the gym
• Colour rules: no three competing colours, no clashing brights
• Your rules: mark colours you don't wear, pairs that never go together and pieces not to suggest, and they're never broken
• Love a look and similar ones rise; turn one down and it doesn't come back

PACK A CAPSULE FOR ANY TRIP
Tell Stylerobe where you're going, when, and what you'll do. It checks the forecast for every day and picks the fewest pieces that cover everything.
• A packing checklist grouped by category, with progress
• An outfit for every day and activity
• Carry-on weight estimate and editable airline limits
• Essentials you might forget, from chargers to passports

YOUR FIGURE, YOUR OUTFITS
Build an illustrated figure in your skin tone, shape, height and hair, then mix and match your pieces on it. Drag, pinch and rotate to adjust.

YOUR DATA IS YOURS
• No account. No ads. No tracking. Your closet stays on your iPhone.
