• Export a readable copy of your data whenever you like

STYLEROBE PRO
• A stylist chat that plans outfits and trips with you, using your closet and the forecast
• See real clothes on a realistic model of you before you buy or wear them
• Unlimited trips, including multi-city
• AI tag suggestions and the outfit calendar
Free includes your whole closet, unlimited outfits, daily outfit ideas, 1 trip, unlimited saved videos and links, share cards, and backups. Pro is a monthly or yearly subscription; the yearly plan includes a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel anytime in your Apple Account settings.

description:
Styliora AI is your personal style studio: a digital wardrobe, outfit planner, colour studio and AI stylist in one elegant app.

DIGITAL WARDROBE
• Add clothes with your camera or photo library

FASHION CALENDAR

DAILY STYLE PICKS, EVEN OFFLINE

COLOUR STUDIO

AI STYLIST (POWERED BY GOOGLE GEMINI)

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account and no tracking. Your wardrobe, photos, outfits, calendar and journal stay on your iPhone, and everything except AI works offline. AI features are optional and ask for permission first. They send your style preferences and a text list of your wardrobe, never your photos or your name. Export or delete your data at any time.

Styliora never asks about or assumes body shape, size, skin tone or health. AI suggestions can be imperfect.

name: Subbo aoo: AI Sky Planner
description:
Make a plan for your next night under the stars.

Subbo brings sky information, observing plans, and an observing log together on your iPhone. Choose a city, explore the night ahead, and keep track of what you see.

EXPLORE TONIGHT'S SKY
See the Moon phase, illumination, and hours of astronomical darkness for your selected city. Explore an interactive sky map, select targets, and move through the night to see how their positions change.

FIND DARKER EVENINGS
Compare upcoming nights using Moon and darkness information. Browse a built-in calendar of major annual meteor showers and organize your plans around the events you want to watch.

PLAN WITH PULSE AI
Ask Pulse to suggest observing nights and targets. Turn its suggestions into saved plans, then edit or undo them. You control whether your sky plan summary is shared with Pulse.

KEEP YOUR PLANS TOGETHER
Create observing sessions with dates, targets, gear, viewing windows, and direction notes. Set reminders and track each session as Planned, Clouded Out, or Observed.

BUILD YOUR OBSERVING LOG
Record what you saw and revisit your past sessions. Track your observed targets and export your plans as a CSV file.

CHOOSE YOUR CITY
Select a built-in city or search for one manually. Subbo calculates sky information on your iPhone without requesting device location access.

Saved plans and sky calculations work offline. Sign-in, Pulse AI, and online city search require an internet connection.

Sky information and meteor shower dates are approximate. Subbo does not provide live weather forecasts. AI suggestions may be inaccurate; review your plans and check local conditions before heading out.

name: Subtitle Handoff
description:
Check a translated SRT against the source before you hand it over.

Import both subtitle files from Files and review possible missing translations, mismatched timecodes, overlaps, and lines that exceed your reading-speed limit. A two-track timeline shows where findings occur. Cue matching handles split and merged captions.

- Compare source and translated cues in one review
- Filter findings by issue type and inspect the related captions
- Open a reference video at the issue timecode
- Save the full report as a CSV with cue numbers and caption excerpts

Try the included subtitle pair and reference clip to see the complete workflow. The app works on your device and leaves your original files in Files.

name: SunWin Galaxy
description:
Bước vào SunWin Galaxy và khám phá năm khoang giải trí cùng một phong cách khoa học viễn tưởng trắng–cam–xanh băng.

Kích hoạt ba xúc xắc trong Tài xỉu Lõi Lượng Tử. Đấu với nhà cái máy ở Xì dách Đấu Trường Quỹ Đạo theo biến thể Blackjack 21. Ngắm bắn cá cơ khí, ghép biểu tượng trên Guồng quay hành tinh hoặc điều khiển tàu bảo vệ trạm trước thiên thạch.

Ứng dụng được thiết kế để chơi offline, không đăng ký hoặc đăng nhập, không quảng cáo, thanh toán hay subscription. Bắt đầu với 12.500 điểm ảo; khi ví còn tối đa 500 điểm, nhận thêm 12.500 miễn phí ngay trong Cài đặt, không chờ. Hướng dẫn và ví dụ từng bước giải thích cách tính điểm; Nhật ký chuyến bay lưu tối đa 200 kết quả gần nhất. Ván, bài và cài đặt lưu trên thiết bị.

Trò chơi mô phỏng. Chip không có giá trị tiền tệ và không thể đổi thưởng

name: TABISAKI
description:
TABISAKI brings everything you need before and during a trip abroad into one calm, easy-to-read app: safety, entry requirements, money and culture for about 200 countries and regions.

SAFETY
- Travel advisory levels from the US, UK, Canadian and German governments, plus Japan's Ministry of Foreign Affairs, updated daily
- Set your passport country to get a direct link to your own government's travel advice
- Emergency numbers, regional information and the latest notices

ENTRY AND LOCAL RULES
- Visa estimates based on your passport
- Local rules, laws, taboos and etiquette
- Real cases where travelers got into trouble, so you know what to avoid

MONEY
- Daily exchange rates for about 150 currencies, cached for offline use
- Typical local prices
- Trip cost converter

KNOW THE COUNTRY
- About 4,000 fun facts on culture, history and proverbs
- Major cities: how they began and why they are worth a visit
- Local character and tips for meeting people
- Basic phrases with audio

HANDY TOOLS
- Compare up to 10 countries side by side
- Pre-departure checklist
- Favorites, history, adjustable text size, customizable home screen
- On-device translation into 58 languages

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Free, no ads, no login
- No location tracking

Safety information is based on public government sources. TABISAKI is an independent app and is not affiliated with any government. Always check official government advice before you travel.

name: TabiThai - Thai Travel Phrases
description:
TabiThai is an offline Thai phrasebook for Japanese travelers (the app is in Japanese).

- 350 phrases: 8 travel scenes x 40, plus 30 phrases for walking around Thailand
- Kana readings and tone guides for every phrase (a guide only; tones cannot be fully shown in kana)
- Sample replies from the other person for many phrases
- Polite endings switch between male and female speakers
- Large display to show your screen
- Thai read-aloud using the device's speech synthesis
- Phrase data is stored on your device, so it works without a connection. No ads.

Free to download. Three scenes (airport, general, emergency) are free. A one-time in-app purchase unlocks all phrases. No subscription. A connection is needed only for purchase and restore.

Phrases are for reference. In emergencies, follow local staff and authorities.

name: Tahdinheiluri
description:
Tahdinheiluri kutsuu messinkikehyksiseen heilurityöpajaan.

Jokaisella palkilla on eripituisia varsia. Säädä heilurin pituutta ja käynnistysviivettä, heilauta riviä ja seuraa kaaria tulipunaista keskilinjaa vasten.

Kun kaikki heilurit ylittävät yhdessä, yhteinen tahti lukittuu ja asetelma tallentuu Tahtimuistioon. Jos ikkuna menee ohi, pehmeät ohjeet auttavat säätämään uudelleen.

Siirry aulasta Synkkapöytään, käytä Kohdista-ajoitusta, avaa Vihje jokaisella tasolla ja tavoittele yhtä sydämenlyöntiä Kolmipalkin, Nelipalkin ja Viisipalkin läpi.

name: TaiBloom: Tai Chi & Chair Yoga
description:
Gentle chair yoga and tai chi for seniors and beginners. TaiBloom guides you with a calm voice through short, low-impact exercise sessions at home, standing or seated in a chair. Every move has a seated version, so you can practice on the days you feel steady and on the days you don't.

• Chair yoga for seniors: seated exercises, stretching, breathing and strength moves, with standing moves that use the chair for support.
• Tai chi for beginners: learn the 8-form, Baduanjin (Eight Brocades) qigong and the 24-form, one step at a time.
• A 28-day path that fits you: Tai Chi or Chair Yoga, picked from a few simple questions.
• Every move has a seated version. Tired, or not steady today? Switch to the chair in one tap, and the session still counts.
• Short, low-impact sessions of 5, 10 or 15 minutes, with spoken step-by-step guidance, breathing counts, large text and big buttons.
• Learn mode: go slowly and learn each move one step at a time.
• Balance and mobility routines, guided breathing and calm evening sessions to wind down before bed.
• Tap Pain at any time and the move changes or is skipped.
• Every move, cue and safety rule is reviewed by NamNv before it is added to the app.
• Your health notes stay on your phone.
• The first week of each path is free. Premium unlocks every level, the whole path and offline downloads.

TaiBloom offers general well-being exercise, not medical advice. Talk to your doctor before you start if you have a health condition.

Premium: yearly (with a free trial when offered), monthly, or lifetime. Payment is charged to your store account; subscriptions renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the period.

Terms: https://chairyoga.butterapps.store/legal/tai-chi/terms · Privacy: https://chairyoga.butterapps.store/legal/tai-chi/privacy

name: Take Handoff
description:
Check a day's field recordings before handing them off to post-production.

Select multiple WAV files from Files. Take Handoff reads embedded iXML to show the scene, take, sound roll, and track names when available. Review missing fields and possible duplicates, then save or share a CSV or PDF sound report.

- Batch import WAVs from Files
- Filter recordings that need a second look
- Inspect scene, take, roll, and available track names
- Share a CSV or PDF sound report
- Practice with a bundled sample batch

Scene and take are available when the recorder included iXML. Take Handoff checks metadata on your device and reads the original recordings without editing them.

name: TalkTown: Til o'rganish
description:
TalkTown — rus tilini o'zbek tilida, qisqa video darslar orqali o'rganing.

Har bir dars — hayotiy vaziyat: tanishuv, oila, do'konda, ishda, sayohatda. Qahramonlar gaplashadi — siz tinglaysiz, takrorlaysiz va mashq qilasiz.

ILOVADA NIMALAR BOR
• Video darslar — A1 boshlang'ichdan, har bir ibora o'zbekcha tarjimasi bilan
• Iboralar — ovozli talaffuz, sekin tinglash imkoni
• Mashqlar va testlar — o'rganganingizni shu zahoti tekshiring
• Gapirish mashqi — iborani ovoz chiqarib ayting
• Aqlli takrorlash — unutilayotgan iboralar o'z vaqtida qaytadi
• AI suhbatdosh — real vaziyatlarda rus tilida yozishma mashqi
• Chat — boshqa o'quvchilar bilan umumiy va kurs guruhlari
• Gaplashish sherigi — o'zingiz kabi o'rganayotgan sherik bilan mashq qiling
• Kunlik zanjir va XP — har kuni oz-ozdan, lekin muntazam

Kurslar: rus tili va arab tili, yangi darslar muntazam qo'shiladi.

Har kursning dastlabki darslari bepul. Qolgan darslar, AI suhbatdosh va gaplashish sherigi — TalkTown Premium obunachilari uchun.

Saytdagi hisobingiz bilan kirsangiz, natijalaringiz, XP va zanjiringiz ilovada ham saqlanadi.

Savollar: @TalkTownAppBot (Telegram).

name: Tap Density
description:
Tap Density keeps a powder lot on the bench. Set a tap target, hold the phone on the cylinder, and count only valid vertical taps. Enter the bulk volume and the tapped volume to read bulk density, tapped density, the Hausner ratio, and the Carr class. Compare two lots and export a CSV. pharmacopeia

Works offline. No account. No in-app purchases. Photos stay on this iPhone.

name: Tap Out Arrows: Pet Rescue
description:
Unwind your mind with TapOut Arrows: Pet Rescue - the ultimate satisfying arrow jam and tap-away maze puzzle designed to smash stress away while you save adorable furry companions!

Take a deep breath, listen to soothing sounds, and find your zen. Can you solve every arrow jam, tap away blocked arrows, and smash through tricky obstacles to bring trapped pets to safety? Tap arrows in the direction they point, untangle calming color patterns, and enjoy a peaceful tap-out puzzle escape whenever you need a break.

TAP AWAY THE MAZE & SMASH STRESS
Escape the daily rush with smooth, tactile gameplay. Simply observe the maze, unjam the grid by tapping arrows away, and watch them glide smoothly off the screen. With no rushed countdown timers or stressful penalties, you can smash through tap-out puzzles at your own pace, relax your mind, and enjoy every gentle tap.

HEARTWARMING PET RESCUE
Every tranquil arrow jam you untangle sets a lovely pet free! Tap away the maze blockers to rescue cuddly cats, playful pups, and other charming animal friends. Feel the warm satisfaction of giving each rescued pet a peaceful, happy home.

HANDCRAFTED MAZES & SATISFYING ARROW JAMS
Immerse yourself in hundreds of lovingly handcrafted levels:
- Dynamic arrow jam layouts with harmonious color palettes and clean geometric shapes.
- Smooth, satisfying animations paired with gentle sound feedback that make every tap-away action feel like a stress-smashing triumph.
- Thoughtful layouts that gently challenge your brain without overwhelming you.
- Responsive pinch-to-zoom and pan controls to unjam and tap out even the densest arrow mazes with ease.

POWERFUL BOOSTERS TO SMASH THROUGH TOUGH JAMS
Never worry about getting stuck in an arrow jam! A set of handy boosters is always ready to keep your journey relaxing:
* Hint: Gently reveals the next arrow that is ready to fly free and unjam the board.
* Eraser: Easily remove any stubborn arrow blocking your tranquil flow.
* Magic Wand: Smash through tricky arrow clusters and tap away obstacles instantly!
* Grid Scale: Comfortably scale and adjust dense maze grids for a clear, effortless view.

REWARDING ACHIEVEMENTS & LEADERBOARDS
For when you want to smash your personal records and celebrate:
- Unlock delightful Game Center Achievements as you unjam boards, tap away arrows, and rescue more pets.
- Friendly Global Leaderboards let you compare puzzle milestones with players worldwide.
- Offline Play: Smash boredom anytime, anywhere - full offline support with no Wi-Fi required!

HOW TO PLAY:
1. Observe the arrow jam and see which direction each arrow is pointing.
2. Tap away arrows with a clear, unobstructed path to let them glide out of the maze.
3. Pinch to zoom and drag the board to inspect tricky arrow jams comfortably.
4. Call upon Hint, Eraser, or Magic Wand whenever you need to smash through a block.
5. Tap out every arrow to rescue the pet and celebrate your victory!

WHY YOU WILL LOVE TAPOUT ARROWS:
- Pure Relaxation: Soothing visuals, gentle tap-away flow, and stress-free logic.
- Brain Training: Unjam complex puzzles, tap out tricky mazes, and keep your mind sharp.
- Cozy Companions: Adorable animal rescues that bring a smile to your face.
- Play at Your Own Pace: Perfect for a quick puzzle break, your daily commute, or unwinding before bed.

Take a calming pause, tap away the arrow maze, and smash through relaxing challenges while rescuing lovely pets.

Download TapOut Arrows: Pet Rescue today and enjoy your peaceful tap-away arrow jam journey!

---
Privacy Policy: https://aadityainteractive.com/privacy-policy/
Support: support@aadityainteractive.com
Website: https://aadityainteractive.com

name: TaqwaHub: Quran Khatam
description:
Finish the Quran one page at a time, on a page that looks like your mushaf.

TaqwaHub is a calm, offline tracker for your khatam and your hifz. Set a finish date, read on a real 15-line Madinah page, and let the app work out how many pages you need each day. Miss a day and nothing resets: only the pace adjusts.

A REAL MUSHAF
• 604 pages, 15 lines per page, the same line breaks as the printed Madinah mushaf
• Go to any surah, juz or page
• Light background on the verses you have already read

A KHATAM PLAN THAT FORGIVES
• Pick a finish date, or a number of pages a day
• Today shows your pages and how far you are, juz by juz
• No streaks. Progress is a record of pages read and never goes down
• Stopped mid-page? Long-press a verse and continue from there next time
• Read on paper? Log those pages in seconds

REMINDERS THAT LISTEN
• One quiet reminder a day, timed around when you usually read
• Silent once today's pages are done
• Gentle nudges after a quiet week, then it stops
• Optional reminders for Al-Kahf on Friday and for Ramadan

TAQWAHUB PRO
• Mark pages while you recite: an on-device speech model follows your reading and marks the page. No internet, no server
• Hifz: track the surahs you know and get a simple review schedule
• Home Screen, Lock Screen and StandBy widgets, plus Control Center buttons
• More than one khatam at a time

Pro is a one-time lifetime purchase, or a yearly or monthly subscription.

NO ADS, EVER. NO ACCOUNT.
TaqwaHub is made by one developer. Pro pays for it, so the app never shows ads and has no tracking. Your data stays on your iPhone and in your iCloud. Export a backup file any time.

In English and Bahasa Indonesia.

Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your Apple ID settings.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://taqwahub.id/privacy

name: Tarla
description:
Tarla — Azərbaycan fermerləri üçün hər gün lazım olan alətlər bir tətbiqdə.

SAHƏNİ ÖLÇ
• Peyk, hibrid və adi xəritə
• Künclərə toxun və ya sahənin sərhədi boyu GPS ilə gəz — hektar və sot avtomatik hesablanır
• Sahələri yadda saxla, sonra açıb sərhədi dəyiş

MEXANİZATOR ÇAĞIR
• Biçin, şum, kultivasiya, əkin, çiləmə, daşıma
• Öz qiymətini təklif et, mexanizatorların əks-təkliflərini müqayisə et, uyğununu seç
• İşin gedişini xəritədə izlə, sonra qiymət ver və rəy yaz

MEXANİZATORLAR VƏ TEXNİKA SAHİBLƏRİ ÜÇÜN
• Texnika parkını əlavə et: növ, marka, il, at gücü, qiymət, şəkillər
• Onlayn / Məşğul / Oflayn statusu
• Yaxınlıqdakı uyğun sifarişləri gör və təklif göndər

BAZAR
• Məhsul, toxum və texnika elanları: sort, miqdar, qiymət, rayon və kənd, çatdırılma
• Sertifikatlı toxum: sənədi yoxlanılmış satıcılar xüsusi nişanla göstərilir

MƏHSULDARLIQ
• Əkin və biçin qeydi: toxum, gübrə, suvarma, dərmanlama, məhsul
• Hektara məhsuldarlıq və xalis gəlir avtomatik hesablanır, illər üzrə müqayisə
• Rayon və kənd üzrə məhsuldarlıq reytinqi

HAVA VƏ TÖVSİYƏLƏR
• Sahən üçün 7 günlük proqnoz
• Bitkinə görə xəbərdarlıq: şaxta, dolu, çiləmə üçün uyğun gün

BİLİK
• 15 bitki üzrə bələdçi: əkin vaxtı, sortlar, gübrələmə, xəstəlik və zərərvericilər, xərc-gəlir hesabı
• Heyvandarlıq: cinslər, peyvənd və doğuş xatırlatmaları
• Gübrə kalkulyatoru, aqro-təqvim, fermer gündəliyi

XƏBƏR VƏ DƏSTƏK
• Kənd Təsərrüfatı Nazirliyinin xəbərləri 9 kateqoriyada, yeni xəbər gələndə bildiriş
• 1652 Çağrı Mərkəzinə bir toxunuşla zəng, subsidiya və dövlət dəstəyi haqqında sadə izahlar, rəsmi e-xidmətlərə keçidlər

OFLAYN İŞLƏYİR
Sahələr, qeydlər və gündəlik telefonda saxlanılır; internet gələndə avtomatik sinxronlaşır.

PULSUZDUR. Reklam yoxdur.

Qeyd: Tarla müstəqil tətbiqdir və heç bir dövlət qurumunu təmsil etmir. Nazirlik xəbərləri agro.gov.az saytından götürülür və mənbəyə keçid verilir.

name: Tars: AI Chat Assistant
description:
Tars is a chat assistant with one box for everything you want to ask.

ASK ANYTHING
Type a question, take a photo of something, attach an image or a file, paste a link, or hold the mic button and talk. Tars reads what you send and answers in plain words.

SEARCH THE WEB
Turn on web search and answers come with their sources, so you can open the page and check. Turn on deep thinking for questions that need more reasoning, like math, code or a tricky decision.

SWITCH MODELS
Tars picks a model for each question. If an answer isn't what you wanted, ask another model to answer again. Or ask several models at once, compare the replies and get one combined answer. Keep chatting from the one you like.

YOUR CHATS
Chats are listed on your phone with search, favorites, swipe to delete and text size settings. Dark mode is supported, and the app is available in 17 languages.

NO ACCOUNT
Open the app and start. Your chats are stored on your phone. Our server passes your messages to the AI model and does not keep them.

FREE TO USE
Tars is free. Every day you get some free messages; when they are used up, come back tomorrow. Heavy use may be slowed down to keep the service fair for everyone.

Terms of Use: https://huaxiaoman.com.cn/tars/legal/terms
Privacy Policy: https://huaxiaoman.com.cn/tars/legal/privacy

Answers are written by AI and can be wrong. For health, legal or money decisions, check with someone who knows.

name: TateGaki - 縦書きブラウザ
description:
TateGaki is a web browser that lets you read Japanese web pages in vertical writing (tategaki), the way Japanese books and newspapers are printed.

Use it as a regular browser in horizontal mode, and switch any page to vertical writing with a single tap when you want to settle in and read.

VERTICAL READING
- Rearranges text, headings, and photos into vertical columns that read from right to left
- Keeps the page's own font sizes, weights, colors, and link styles
- Supports ruby (furigana) reading aids
- Works with in-page links and pages that load more content as you read
- Tap the status bar to jump back to the beginning

A FULL BROWSER
- Tabs with a Safari-style overview
- Favorites (bookmarks) and a custom start page
- Address bar at the top or bottom; it shrinks as you scroll to give the page more room
- Pull down at the top of a page to reload
- Per-site text size, Find on Page, and Share
- Works on iPhone and iPad, including the outer and inner displays of iPhone Duo in any orientation or split view

PRIVACY
Vertical reading happens entirely on your device. TateGaki does not store or send the contents of the pages you read, and no account is required.

name: Tazyo: Random Picker
description:
A decision to make? A challenge with friends? Let chance decide with Tazyo.

Pick a restaurant, choose who goes first, split into teams or challenge your friends in mini-games on the same iPhone.

DECIDE
• Yes or no: one question, a random answer
• Number: draw a number in the range you choose
• My choices: build your own lists and spin the wheel
• Who?, Order, Teams: everyone puts a finger down to pick a player, set an order or form teams
• Shake: shake your iPhone to pick someone at random

FINGER GAMES
Test your reflexes, timing and nerves with Last finger, Counter, Elimination, False start, Hot potato and Don’t move.

DUELS AND PARTY
• Tug of war: tap faster than your opponent to win ground
• Bubble duel: attack and intercept your opponent’s bubbles in a two-player duel
• Musical chairs: up to 9 players, with a built-in tune or your Apple Music

WHY TAZYO
• Fair draws, with no hidden weighting
• 3 free games per mode, then a one-time purchase to unlock everything for life, no subscription
• Games that work offline, with no account and no ads
• Your player groups, with names and colors, saved on your iPhone
• Rules available in every mode
• Available in French, English and Spanish

So, who goes first?

name: tchoutchou party
description:
Lay your phones side by side on a table. Each one becomes a stretch of railway — and the train really does cross them, leaving one screen to enter the next.

The train reaches you: it's your turn. It picks up whatever sits by the track, drops off what the depots are waiting for, and moves on to your neighbour.

At a switch it stops, and nothing will start it again but a finger. Yours. The others watch, the others shout, but you're the one who touches — and that's enough to make a table loud.

Then night falls and the scenery goes dark. Then fog rolls in and wipes out what you were meant to collect. Remember the track.

· Two to twenty phones
· Everyone joins by scanning a QR code — no account needed
· Six difficulty levels, from tutorial to nightmare
· A game lasts about as long as a round of drinks
· No ads, no purchases, no personal data collected
· An internet connection is required to link the phones

name: TeachOne
description:
Thanks for opening TeachOne. We keep refining the teach seat so one clear lesson sticks; if something feels off, reach out and we will look into it.

TeachOne seals one tiny teach-out — seat a learner, script three beats, deliver a Teach Pass, stamp Taught.

Learning sticks when you’ve taught it once. Home is a Teach Seat with an empty chair under a spotlight. Claim a topic, put one learner in the chair, write Hook · Point · Check, walk the Teach Pass, then stamp the roster.

SEAT ONE LEARNER
• Reserve the chair for a colleague, friend, future self, or imaginary student
• Claim a single topic you will teach — not a course catalog
• See script readiness before you start the pass

SCRIPT THREE BEATS
• Hook · Point · Check — short lines you can say aloud
• Polish any beat to keep it speakable
• Stage Lab sets length and timer preferences

TEACH, THEN STAMP
• Teach Pass guides delivery beat by beat
• Check Moment lets you Pass or Retake
• Stamp Taught seals the session; browse everything on the Taught Roster
• Optional local reminders when topics are still waiting to be taught

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No account, no sign-in, no ads, no analytics, no cloud sync
• TeachOne does not record audio or read Contacts, Photos, or Messages
• Topics, scripts, and stamps stay in the app sandbox on this iPhone
• Clear samples or wipe all local data anytime in Backstage

TeachOne is a one-person teach stage — not a notes dump, flashcard deck, or habit streak.

name: Team360 HR
description:
Team360 brings your company's HR to your iPhone. Connect to your company's Team360 server by typing its address or scanning the QR code from your HR team, then sign in with your usual account.

• Leave — see your balances, request leave or an hourly permission, attach a sick note, follow each request from your manager to HR, and cancel while it's pending.
• Attendance — sign in and out at the office with one tap. Your location is checked only at that moment to confirm you're inside the office area. See today's hours and your history.
• Payslips — every paid payslip with earnings and deductions, year-to-date totals, and a PDF to share.
• HR requests — salary certificates with a verification QR code, travel requests, expense claims with receipts, staff loans and resignation, each followed from your manager to HR.
• Internal vacancies — apply with your CV and follow your application; HR reviews applicants in the app.
• Approvals — managers and HR approve or reject leave, certificates, loans, travel, expenses and resignations, with a team-overlap warning.
• Notifications, announcements, your profile and dependents, the staff directory and public holidays.

Fully native, in English and Arabic with right-to-left layout, light and dark mode, Dynamic Type and an optional Face ID lock. Your data stays on your company's own server.

Team360 for iPhone requires your employer to use Team360 (server version 1.66.0 or later) with the mobile app switched on. Some modules need newer server versions and appear only when your company uses them.

name: TeamUp Coach
seller_name: The Washington State Coalition Against Domestic Violence
description:
TeamUp Coach is the companion app for coaches and athletic mentors in Team Up Washington, the program that helps high school coaches build stronger teams, teach healthy relationship skills, and prevent sexual assault and dating abuse.

Coaches lead short, meaningful conversations with their athletes through three programs: Coaching Boys Into Men, Athletes as Leaders, and CHAMP Excellence. TeamUp Coach keeps the whole season organised so you can spend your time with your team, not on paperwork.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Follow your curriculum lesson by lesson, with the talking points, activities and videos ready to use at practice.
- Mark lessons delivered and see your season progress at a glance on your dashboard.
- Answer the short survey after each lesson so the program keeps improving.
- See upcoming trainings and events, and add them to your calendar in one tap.
- Find guides, handouts and videos in the resource library.
- Talk with other coaches in the community, share ideas and ask questions.
- Get reminders and announcements from your program team.
- Reach the Team Up Washington team through in-app support.

WHO IT IS FOR
TeamUp Coach is for coaches and mentors who are part of Team Up Washington. After you create an account and choose your organisation and curriculum, a program administrator approves your access.

Team Up Washington is a program of the Washington State Coalition Against Domestic Violence. Learn more at teamupwa.org.

name: Telecraft
description:
Telecraft is an unofficial chat app for Minecraft: Java Edition multiplayer servers.
Read and send server chat from your phone, without launching the game.

NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT.

Features
• Server list with player counts and MOTD
• Joining a server needs a Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition (bought, or through Game Pass). You sign in on Microsoft's own sign-in page, and the app never sees your Microsoft password
• Pick the account for each server (free: 2 accounts and 3 servers; Pro: more)
• Works with online-mode and offline-mode servers (you sign in with that Microsoft account for both)
• Colored, formatted chat and commands
• Alerts when someone mentions your name (while the app is open and you are not looking at that chat)
• Reply right from that alert (opens the app with your text ready to send)
• Quick command buttons for each server: tap to send once, long-press to edit first
• Chat saved on your device; scroll back to it inside the chat
• Skins tab: look up a player's skin in 3D, and make gradient color codes for chat and nicknames
• Optional helper you turn on yourself (off by default): auto login for login-plugin servers (the password stays in the device's secure storage)
• Pro (in-app purchase, one time, no subscription): keyword alerts, auto reconnect (also after kicks if you turn that on), the chat log screen (read, search, share), more than 2 saved accounts and 3 servers, messages on connect, repeating messages, AFK-kick prevention, the minimap
• Tips to support development (in-app purchase, unlock nothing)
• Block players and report messages, and a profanity filter you can turn on in Settings; it masks received swearing and warns before sending
• Reconnects automatically when you return to the app

Supported versions: Java Edition 1.7.2 to 26.3 (new versions are added in updates)

Good to know
• It does not show the game world and has no movement, building, combat, inventory or cheat features. It shows your health and food, and has a Respawn button when you die. Auto login, messages on connect, repeating messages and AFK-kick prevention are optional helpers you turn on yourself (off by default); use them only where the server's rules allow.
• Chat, commands, quick command buttons, block and report, alerts for your name and replying from them, auto login, 2 accounts and 3 servers are free. Payments go through the App Store only.
• Server chat is the responsibility of each server's operators. Follow your server's rules.
• Your accounts and chat history stay on your device.

Contact: msgcraft1@gmail.com
Privacy policy: https://msgcraft.github.io/privacy/

Minecraft is a trademark of Mojang Synergies AB.

name: Teleprompter with Voice Follow
description:
A teleprompter that listens, and it's completely free: no in-app purchases, no subscription, no ads. Start talking and your script scrolls with you. It waits when you pause, catches up when you skip a line, and never sends a word of it online.

THREE WAYS TO READ
• Read: your script full-screen with a clear reading line. Use voice follow or a steady speed, mirror the text for glass prompter rigs, and control it from a Bluetooth keyboard or presentation remote.
• Film: record yourself while your lines scroll right beside the lens, so you keep eye contact. Hold your iPhone upright or sideways and the script stays next to the camera either way. Make the script panel as big and as see-through as you like, turn on a framing grid, and every take is saved to Photos in 1080p.
• Float: keep your script in a small Picture in Picture window on top of other apps, for video calls or for recording in your favorite camera app.

VOICE FOLLOW, RIGHT ON YOUR IPHONE
It uses Apple's on-device speech recognition to keep your place as you speak. It copes with ad-libs, skipped lines and restarts, works in many languages, and detects your script's language automatically. If voice follow can't run, the script simply scrolls at a steady speed.

NOTES TO YOURSELF
Put directions in [square brackets], like [smile] or [show the product]. They appear in color, and voice follow knows not to wait for them.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Text size, line spacing, margins and alignment
• Move the reading line up or down
• White on black, yellow on black, or black on white
• Countdown before you start
• Dim the words you've already said
• Paste a script, or import one from Files (.txt, .md, .rtf)

FREE. REALLY.
Every feature is included for everyone. There are no in-app purchases, no subscription, no ads and nothing to unlock or upgrade.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no tracking. Your scripts, your voice and your videos stay on your iPhone.

name: Temoto Magnifier & Read Aloud
description:
Can't read the small print without your glasses? Temoto Magnifier uses your iPhone camera to make medicine leaflets, food labels, receipts, ingredient lists, serial numbers and manuals big and clear.

OPENS STRAIGHT INTO THE MAGNIFIER
The full-screen magnifier appears the moment you open the app, at the zoom you used last time. You can also open it from Control Center, the Lock Screen or Siri.

SHARP UP CLOSE
On supported iPhones it switches to macro automatically when you get close. Tap the screen to focus on a spot and lock it.

FOUR BIG BUTTONS
- Light: for dim shops and cupboards
- Freeze: hold the image steady, then pinch to zoom or save it to Photos
- Color: normal, sharp gray, white on black, yellow on black
- Read: recognizes the text and shows it in large type, then reads it aloud line by line or all at once

ZOOM 1x TO 10x
Use the slider, the + and - buttons, or pinch.

NOTHING LEAVES YOUR PHONE
Text recognition and speech run on your iPhone. Images and text are never sent anywhere. No account needed.

HONEST PRICING
- Every feature is free. Nothing is locked behind a paywall
- One banner at the bottom, kept away from the buttons
- A full-screen ad appears only when you close Read, at most once every few minutes, never while you are looking or listening
- Remove ads forever with a one-time purchase. No subscription

Contact: support@algorist.jp

name: Tempo Card Duel
description:
Two duelists, one shared clock.

Tempo is a duel of timing and reads. Every card costs tempo, and playing it moves your clock forward: whoever is behind acts next. Your opponent sees how much tempo you commit, so they know when it lands, but never what it is.

Each tempo has one attack and one defence, so every read comes down to a single question: is that an attack? Short cards buy information and the next move. Long cards buy damage, and hand your opponent time to react.

• Eight cards: Jab, Sidestep, Slash, Riposte, Feint, Read, Cleave and Barrier. Fifteen in your deck, twelve hearts each.
• Face the bot at Novice, Duelist or Master. It weighs its guesses by the cards it has seen and by your habits, so it reads you back.
• No solved lines: every fixed strategy we scripted, including all-attack and all-defend, does worse than playing at random against the Duelist bot.
• Stick-figure duelists under a moon, with sound and haptics.
• Plays offline. No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

Tempo is also a card game for the table, and the app plays the same, step for step.

name: Temponest
description:
Temponest is an offline clock studio for iPhone — a compact bench for time, focus, and ambient sound without accounts or cloud sync.

Built for people who want a calm, local toolkit: check the time, run a focus block, keep a short countdown, glance at other cities, or play a soft procedural tone while you work.

WHAT YOU GET

• Bench Clock
Live local time with switchable faces (Stencil, Phosphor, Bench). Pick a look that fits your desk and keep working.

• Focus Block
A Pomodoro-style 25-minute focus timer. It pauses when you leave the Focus page so a runaway timer does not keep running in the background of your session.

• Timers
Two simple tools on one bench: a fixed five-minute countdown and a stopwatch with reset controls.

• World
A live world-clock list. Add cities, watch offsets update every second, and swipe to remove a row you no longer need.

• Noise
On-device procedural tones — rain hush, brown soft, pink desk, fan hum. Generated locally; leaving the page stops the engine.

• Desk
Workshop drawer for Privacy Policy, Help guide, erase-local-data, and about information. Preferences stay on this iPhone.

name: Tenka: Three Kingdoms Strategy
description:
A turn-based Three Kingdoms strategy game you can finish in about 20 minutes. Fight over 39 regions of ancient China with generals, tactics and schemes.
No ads, no premium currency, no gacha, no energy timers, and it plays fully offline.

HOW IT PLAYS
• Each season, every general gets one order: develop, recruit, train, attack, move, recruit officers, scheme, reward or negotiate
• Take and hold your target number of regions within 24 turns (six years) to win
• Short campaigns that fit a commute or a coffee break

THREE-ROUND BATTLES
• Five tactic cards with counters: Charge, Ambush, Hold, Fire Attack and Naval
• See the card your enemy played last round and read their next move
• Every famous general has a signature tactic — 28 unique ones, from Guan Yu's Green Dragon Blade to Zhou Yu's Red Cliffs Blaze
• First-round duels, and armies rout when morale breaks
• "Auto-resolve" when you are in a hurry

103 GENERALS
• Every general drawn in a cute chibi style
• Generals grow stronger as they fight and govern
• Low loyalty can lead to betrayal — reward the ones you want to keep
• Persuade captured officers to join you

SCHEMES AND EVENTS
• Spread rumors, set fire to supplies, or sow discord among enemy officers
• Historical events like the Peach Garden Oath, the coalition against Dong Zhuo and Red Cliffs, plus famine and plague
• Timed missions with rewards in every scenario

TRY BEFORE YOU BUY
• Play the 190 AD coalition scenario as Liu Bei from start to finish without buying anything
• Full version (one in-app purchase): every ruler, the 208 AD Red Cliffs scenario and Hard difficulty. Not a subscription
• No account or login; your progress stays on your phone

Available in English, Korean, Japanese and Traditional Chinese.

name: Terra Sudoku
description: Класичне судоку 9 × 9. 320 задач від легких до дуже складних. Грай офлайн.

name: Tessly Folio: PDF e preventivi
description:
Tessly Folio è l'app per i PDF e per il lavoro tecnico: leggi e annota le tavole, prepari il preventivo, fai i calcoli e segui il cantiere, su iPhone, iPad e Mac.

PDF E APPUNTI (GRATIS)
• Libreria con cartelle, preferiti e ricerca, sincronizzata con iCloud
• Note a mano con Apple Pencil o con il dito, evidenziatore, forme, testo e firma
• Riconoscimento della scrittura, se lo vuoi
• Converti in PDF documenti Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Pages, immagini e pagine web
• Testo e tabelle da una foto, da esportare in Word, Excel o CSV
• Appunti da un video YouTube, flashcard e quiz dai tuoi documenti
• Trasferimento Wi-Fi con il computer, archivi ZIP, esportazione in Word, Excel e PowerPoint

PREVENTIVI E CANTIERE (PRO)
• Preventivo guidato in 6 passi: le quantità arrivano dai calcoli, i prezzi dal listino o dai prezzari regionali
• Prezzari ufficiali di Lombardia e Toscana, aggiornati da soli quando esce una nuova edizione
• Firma del cliente sul dispositivo, invio per email e promemoria della scadenza
• Giornale dei lavori con foto, rapportini firmati, SAL e stato finale
• Dichiarazione di conformità secondo il DM 37/2008

CALCOLI TECNICI E PROGETTO 3D (PRO)
• Travi su più campate, pilastri, plinti e tetti in legno secondo le NTC 2018, con diagrammi e progetto 3D
• Percorso strutturale guidato: il carico del tetto e delle travi passa da solo al pilastro e al plinto
• Impianto elettrico: contratto, quadro, circuiti, sezioni dei cavi, differenziali e schema unifilare
• Impianto idrico-sanitario: portate, tubi, scarichi, quote di installazione dei sanitari e schema
• Fotovoltaico: moduli, stringhe, inverter, batteria e cavi
• Dispersioni termiche, radiatori e pavimento radiante
• Compensi di avvocati, ingegneri e architetti; conto degli interventi e tariffa oraria per gli artigiani

MISURE E STANZE (PRO)
• Misure in scala sulle tavole, cavi e tubi con sfrido, 43 simboli tecnici, livelli stile CAD, computo in Excel
• Rilievo della stanza con il LiDAR, progetto di sanitari e impianti sulla pianta e vista nella stanza vera in realtà aumentata
• Registrazioni con trascrizione, chat con le note e cronologia delle versioni

PRIVATO
Niente account e niente pubblicità. I documenti restano sul dispositivo e nel tuo iCloud; riconoscimento del testo, trascrizioni e riassunti avvengono sul dispositivo.

TESSLY FOLIO PRO
Abbonamento mensile o annuale (con un mese di prova gratuita per i nuovi abbonati) oppure acquisto a vita. Il Pro vale su iPhone, iPad e Mac con lo stesso Apple ID ed è condivisibile in famiglia. Gli abbonamenti si rinnovano automaticamente salvo disdetta almeno 24 ore prima della scadenza, dalle impostazioni dell'Apple ID.

I calcoli sono stime di predimensionamento: non sostituiscono il progetto, le verifiche e la firma di un tecnico abilitato.

Condizioni d'uso: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://tesslyfolio.netlify.app/privacy.html

name: Tessly Mail
description:
Tessly Mail riunisce tutte le tue caselle in un'unica app, ordinata e veloce: iCloud, Gmail, Outlook, Exchange e qualsiasi casella IMAP.

SMART INBOX
Le email delle persone vengono prima. Newsletter, notifiche e promozioni finiscono in gruppi separati che puoi segnare come fatti con un tocco.

LEGGI E AGISCI SUBITO
• Riconosce date e orari e li aggiunge al Calendario
• Banner per disiscriverti dalle newsletter senza cercare il link
• Allegati che si aprono dentro l'app
• Posticipa una mail a quando ti serve davvero
• Fissa le email importanti in cima

TUTTO SOTTO CONTROLLO
• Ricerca con filtri: mittente, oggetto, periodo, allegati, casella
• Solo non lette o tutte, in ogni casella
• Selezione multipla e azioni rapide con gli scorrimenti, personalizzabili
• Cartelle da creare, rinominare, nascondere
• Numero sull'icona: tutte le non lette o solo quelle di oggi
• Loghi ufficiali dei mittenti, colori per ogni casella, tema chiaro o scuro

SU IPHONE, IPAD E MAC
Le tue caselle e le preferenze si sincronizzano con iCloud. Le password restano nel Portachiavi.

TESSLY MAIL PLUS (abbonamento facoltativo)
• Apple Intelligence: riassunto di ogni email, cosa devi fare e risposte pronte; scrivi o riscrivi un messaggio partendo da una frase
• Spese in Tessly Note: ricevute e conferme d'ordine diventano spese nel Budget, con importo, negozio e giorno già compilati
• Collega le email ai progetti e alle note di Tessly Note
Plus è disponibile con abbonamento mensile o annuale, con prova gratuita. Il pagamento viene addebitato sul tuo ID Apple; l'abbonamento si rinnova automaticamente se non viene disdetto almeno 24 ore prima della scadenza, dalle impostazioni del tuo ID Apple.

PRIVACY
Nessun server nostro: l'app si collega direttamente al tuo provider di posta e il testo delle email non lascia mai il dispositivo, nemmeno per Apple Intelligence. Nessuna pubblicità, nessun tracciamento.

Termini d'uso: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy: https://tesslynote.netlify.app/mail/privacy.html

name: Tetra Educación
description:
Retoma la clase donde la dejaste, sigue tu progreso y conversa con tu grupo en Tetra, la app de estudio de tu institución.

- Mira las clases, escucha los materiales en audio y consulta los archivos de cada curso.
- Continúa donde te quedaste: la portada del curso lleva a las pantallas de Progreso y de Aula, ya en la clase en curso.
- Entra con Face ID, sin escribir la contraseña en cada acceso.
- Recibe avisos de clase nueva, certificado, comunicados de la escuela y alertas de seguridad de tu cuenta, y revisa todo en el centro de notificaciones. Las notificaciones son opcionales y tú eliges cuáles recibir.
- Resuelve dudas en la comunidad del curso, con comentarios y respuestas, y administra en tu perfil a las personas que bloqueaste.
- Sigue tu racha de estudio y tus puntos.

El acceso requiere una cuenta registrada previamente por la institución. Los cursos y recursos disponibles dependen del acceso concedido a tu cuenta.

name: Thalix
description:
Thalix helps backpackers plan multi-day meals offline. Build a reusable food library with weight and calories per serving, assign foods to each day of a trip, and see total pack weight plus calories per person per day. Each trip includes a gear checklist you can tick off at home.

Thalix does not provide maps, GPS, or weather. It is a planning notebook that lives entirely on your iPhone.

name: The Conflict Resolution App
description:
Find common ground, together.

The Conflict Resolution App is a calm, guided space for two people to talk through a disagreement and leave with a plan you both agree on. Whether it's a partner, roommate, family member, friend, or co-worker, the app walks you through a proven, step-by-step method so each person is truly heard.

HOW IT WORKS
• Set the stage: agree on ground rules and how long each person has the floor.
• Take the floor: one person shares while the other listens, with a gentle timer.
• Reflect back: the listener sums up what they heard, in the speaker's own words, and checks they got it right. Then you switch.
• Ask clarifying questions: curiosity, not rebuttals.
• Share your needs: what each of you needs to move forward.
• Brainstorm solutions: your own ideas, plus optional suggestions.
• Agree and plan: turn agreed ideas into an action plan with owners and dates.
• Follow up: choose a check-in date together and get a reminder.

TWO WAYS TO TALK
• Live session: see and hear each other in real time. Each person decides when to turn their camera and microphone on.
• Standalone session: exchange thoughtful text and audio messages at your own pace. Record, review, then send.

THOUGHTFUL WORDING
An optional wording coach reviews your message before you send it and suggests calmer "I" statements, like turning "you never" into something the other person can actually hear. It runs on your device, and you always choose what to send.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No accounts. Your sessions are stored on your device.
• Messages, audio, and video travel directly between your two devices, encrypted in transit.
• Only what you choose to send is shared, and only with the person you invite.
• Private notes are never sent. Delete any session at any time.

MEMBERSHIP
Starting sessions requires a membership, billed monthly or yearly, with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. The person you invite always joins free. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://theconflictresolutionapp.com/#/terms
Privacy Policy: https://theconflictresolutionapp.com/#/privacy

IMPORTANT
The Conflict Resolution App is an educational, self-help tool. It is not therapy, mediation, legal advice, or a substitute for professional help, and it is not intended for situations involving danger or abuse. If you are in immediate danger, call 911 or your local emergency number. In the U.S., call or text 988 for crisis support.

name: The Huangover
description:
The party is over when the stock hits zero.

Guide Jensen through an endless arcade scramble, throw glowing GPUs to waiting customers, and keep the NVIDIA stock price climbing. Honeypots chase, charm, slow, and intercept your deliveries. Every completed level adds more enemies and raises the sales target.

FEATURES

• Fast touch controls built for landscape play
• Endless levels with escalating speed, enemy count, and GPU goals
• One clear score: your all-time NVIDIA stock-price high
• Online high-score leaderboard when connected
• Local run history when offline
• Pause, resume, and offline play
• Comic charm, chase, and slap sequences with sound effects

The Huangover is a fictional work of parody and satire. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by NVIDIA or any person, company, or government depicted or referenced in the game.

name: The Oalculator
description:
Oalculator is a retro-style calculator, with a typewriter on iPhone Duo.

Round keys and a seven-segment display, with memory keys, percent, percent change and square root. It follows your light or dark setting.

MADE FOR IPHONE DUO
• On the inner display, a typewriter prints each sum on a sheet of paper.
• Tear the sheet off when you're done. It goes into an archive you can flip through.
• Every sheet has a line for you on its back. Turn it over to read it.
• Keep the ones that matter. Save or share either side as an image.

The typewriter needs the inner display of iPhone Duo; other iPhones don't have it.

PRIVACY
Everything stays on your device. No account, no servers, no analytics, no ads.

name: The Unsent Project
description:
Write the text you shouldn't send. Unsent seals it for 24 hours.

When the urge hits, open Unsent and write it (or record it) exactly like a real text: to your ex, your boss, the group chat. Tap send, and instead of going anywhere, it's sealed on your iPhone for 24 hours. When it unlocks, you decide with a clear head: burn it, keep it in your vault, or copy it and send it yourself if you still mean it.

Unsent can't send anything. Nothing you write or record ever leaves your phone.

• Write or record a voice message, the way you would in your messaging app
• A 24-hour seal you can't skip
• A notification when it's ready to read again
• Burn it, keep it, or send it yourself
• A vault of the messages you kept, grouped by person
• Stats on every text you didn't send
• Face ID lock, light and dark mode
• No accounts, no tracking, no servers

Subscription & refunds
Unsent Pro is an auto-renewing subscription: yearly with a 7-day free trial, or weekly. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase (or when the free trial ends). The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your iPhone's Settings › your name › Subscriptions.

No refunds. Unsent does not issue refunds, and there are no refunds or credits for unused time. Cancelling stops future renewals; you keep access until the end of the current period. Any refund request is handled solely by Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com.

Privacy Policy: https://unsent-site.vercel.app/privacy/
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Thirdeye Cybersecurity
description:
Thirdeye Cybersecurity helps you understand online threats and protect yourself, your family and your work, with short, practical lessons anyone can follow.

Phishing messages, fake charity appeals, social media scams and data breaches can affect anyone. Thirdeye turns cyber security into clear, everyday knowledge, with articles, structured courses, quizzes and games that make what you learn stick.

LEARN WITH ARTICLES
• Easy-to-follow articles on scam awareness, social media safety, data breaches, cloud storage and more
• Bookmark articles to read again later

TAKE COURSES AND EARN CERTIFICATES
• Learn step by step with structured courses
• Check your understanding with a quiz after each module
• Earn a verified certificate of completion when you finish a course

ASK AI
• Ask your personal cybersecurity assistant anything about staying safe online and get instant answers tailored to you

PLAY AND DISCOVER
• Sharpen your instincts with game-based cyber challenges
• Pick up bite-sized cyber security fun facts

TRACK YOUR PROGRESS
• See your learning progress and keep your streak going
• Get notified about new articles, courses and updates

LEARN IN YOUR LANGUAGE
• Choose the language you want to learn in

WHO IT'S FOR
Students, parents, employees, small business owners and anyone who wants to feel more confident online. No technical background needed.

Create a free account to track your progress, play cyber games and ask the AI assistant. Start learning today and make yourself a harder target for scammers.

name: Thistle & Thyme: Cozy Tea Shop
description:
Thistle & Thyme is a free, cozy tea shop game that works fully offline, with no ads. Run a little herbal tea shop at the edge of the mountains: grow herbs, brew teas, help your neighbours and celebrate the seasons.

GROW A GARDEN
Plant mint, chamomile, lavender, rosehip, ginger and more: 12 herbs in all. They grow in real time, even while you're away, and each season favours different plants.

BREW TEAS
Combine herbs at the workbench and pour at just the right moment for a perfect cup. Discover 20 recipes, from Peppermint Tea to the legendary Moonlight Elixir.

HELP YOUR NEIGHBOURS
Villagers wander in with their worries: sleepless nights, nervous days, winter sniffles. Serve the right brew, earn their trust and unlock 40 heartfelt little stories with 8 villagers.

CELEBRATE THE SEASONS
Spring, summer, autumn and winter each bring a village festival: the Blossom Fair, Midsummer Picnic, Harvest Supper and Lantern Night, each with one-of-a-kind decorations.

MAKE IT YOURS
Decorate your shop with lanterns, rugs, a cosy stove and more. And of course there's Biscuit, the shop cat, who naps wherever he likes.

BECOME A MASTER HERBALIST
Fill your journal, befriend everyone and complete every festival. Then keep playing into the years ahead.

No ads. No timers you have to rush. No internet required. Just tea, plants and good company.

The teas in this game are part of a cozy story and are not health advice.

name: Threefold Atlas
description:
Threefold Atlas brings together three distinct skill experiences in one refined, offline collection. Each world features its own rules, visual identity, and 12-stage progression, rewarding precision, planning, and adaptability.

AMUSEMENT PRECINCT

Strike illuminated plots to collect resources before time runs out. Connect adjacent plots of matching colors to build chains and increase your yield. Read each plot’s changing state, avoid interference nodes, and maintain your rhythm as the field evolves.

FARMSTEAD VEIL

Rotate a network of paths to create a continuous route from the entrance to the exit. Every turn matters: some nodes allow only a limited number of rotations, while amber gates open and close over time. A structurally complete route may require patience as well as careful planning.

OCEANIC DRIFT

Guide your vessel with smooth drag controls, evade intelligent hunters, and remain within contracting safe waters. Activate Slow, Leap, and Pulse markers, each with its own tactical purpose and cooldown. Survive until the timer ends, or reach the exit when it appears.

PROGRESS AND PERSONALIZATION

Earn performance ratings, improve your results, and unlock increasingly demanding stages. Complete achievements, review your local session history, and follow your development through visual growth records.

Successful sessions award tokens based on your rating. Tokens can be exchanged for cosmetic vector ornaments only—they never alter difficulty, scoring, or stage unlock requirements.

FEATURES

- 36 stages across three independent worlds
- Distinct timing, spatial-routing, and evasion mechanics
- Dedicated tutorials for each world
- S, A, B, and C performance ratings
- Linear stage progression and meaningful unlock requirements
- Achievements, session history, and growth charts
- Global themes and purely cosmetic ornaments
- System sounds and haptic feedback
- Fully offline play with local data storage
No accounts. No advertising. No in-app purchases. No analytics or third-party tracking. Your progress, settings, tokens, and cosmetics remain on your device.

name: ThrustLattice
description:
Thrust Lattice is an offline vector-trim bench for players who like spatial reasoning more than reflexes.
Each airframe mounts fixed-thrust stations. You cannot change power—only angle. Linked gimbals lock, mirror, or follow a master dial. Your job is to rotate the free stations until the resultant force and moment cancel weight, gusts, and offset torque. Stay inside the trim band and file the hold. Cross the tumble limits and the frame rolls.
THREE FRAMES, PROGRESSIVE UNLOCK
• Ash Rail — rocket stack with rail stations and stage separation
• Cinder Fold — fighter planform with wingtip mirrors and canard locks
• Meridian Glide — orbiter lattice with OMS pods, flaps, and RCS
WHAT YOU GET
• Multi-stage sorties with changing mass, wind, and travel limits
• Lateral gust interference and a Gust Yard practice bay
• Live vector board with force and moment residuals
• Scratch saves, filed holds, field notes, and a local logbook
• Primer, console settings, and fully offline play
No timers. No accounts. No ads. Progress stays on your device.
Built for pilots of the mind: if you enjoy balancing vectors in space, open the bay and trim the lattice.

name: THXO KDS
description:
THXO KDS คือจอครัวสำหรับร้านอาหารและคาเฟ่ที่ใช้ระบบ THXO วางแท็บเล็ตไว้ในครัว ออเดอร์จากโต๊ะ หน้าเคาน์เตอร์ และแอปส่งอาหาร ขึ้นจอทันทีโดยไม่ต้องรอใบพิมพ์

ใช้ง่ายในครัวที่วุ่นวาย
• แตะรายการ: ส่งแล้ว → กำลังทำ → พร้อม
• ใบด่วนขึ้นก่อน หัวใบเปลี่ยนสีเมื่อรอนาน
• เสียงเตือนเมื่อมีออเดอร์ใหม่
• แตะค้างรายการเพื่อดูวิธีทำและวัตถุดิบตามสูตร

แยกตามสถานี
• ครัวร้อน เครื่องดื่ม ขนม แต่ละจอเห็นเฉพาะของตัวเอง
• จุดรวมอาหาร: เห็นทั้งใบ ปล่อยเสิร์ฟเมื่อทุกสถานีทำครบ
• ยอดรวมที่ต้องทำ: รู้ทันทีว่าต้องทำอะไรอีกกี่ที่

ไม่สะดุดเมื่อเน็ตหลุด

name: TI-SKIN
description:
TI-SKIN® is Pure Organica's passive energy management platform: thin panels that absorb heat during the day and release it at night, smoothing out heat and cold peaks in buildings.

The TI-SKIN configurator runs an hourly dynamic simulation over 12 months of your building with and without TI-SKIN:
• Location: 10 years of real climate data from Open-Meteo and NASA POWER; design extremes are the 10 hottest days and 10 coldest nights of the decade.
• Building: house, apartment block or non-residential; masonry, reinforced concrete, wood frame or CLT.
• Insulation, windows, temperatures and ventilation: set your own values or keep the suggested ones.
• Results: indoor temperatures, loads, peak power and estimated savings, month by month.
• Metric or US units (m² / sq ft, °C / °F).
• Solar panels: a dedicated page for TI-SKIN under photovoltaic modules.

The project report in PDF includes the technical installation drawing, with dimensions and installation notes.

When you want a quote, tap "Request a quote from Pure Organica": your configuration reaches our technical team, who will reply.

No account is needed. Calculations run on your device; only the location name is sent to the weather services. After a request, "Delete my data" lets you erase the data you left at any time.

Results are engineering estimates: final values are confirmed by Pure Organica in the quote.

name: TileCourse: Tile Cut Planner
description: Take a rectangular room from measurements to a printable tile worksheet. Enter the clear tiled area, stock tile dimensions and joint width in millimeters. Compare balanced perimeter cuts with an edge start. See each distinct piece size and its quantity, then round the order up to full boxes with your chosen spare allowance. Keep separate rooms on your device and share a dimensioned PDF from the job site. The order estimate budgets one stock tile per placement and excludes offcut reuse.

name: TileCraft: Tile Estimator
seller_name: Shenzhen Weiyan E  Commerce Co., Ltd.
description:
Plan tile quantities and prepare project estimates from the measurements and prices you enter.

- Add walls and floors as non-overlapping rectangles. Deduct doors and windows with a quantity for repeated openings.
- Enter measurements in metres, centimetres, millimetres, feet or inches.
- Use the manufacturer's coverage per box, or enter pieces per box and tile dimensions.
- Combine surfaces using the same material before rounding up to whole boxes. Set waste and spare-stock allowances separately and see the extra coverage caused by box rounding.
- Price materials per box or per square metre. Set a labor rate and, when needed, a separate agreed labor billing area.
- Preview rectangular straight-lay patterns with centre or edge alignment, tile rotation, grout joints, zoom and pan.
- Save multiple projects on your device, duplicate or delete them, and export or restore JSON backups.
- Create a PDF quote with material quantities, labor, notes and the tax rate you enter, then choose how to share it using your device's sharing options.
- Choose English, Arabic or Simplified Chinese for the interface and select the quote language independently. No sign-in is required.

Check measurements and the actual box label before purchasing. The layout is a guide: it does not position openings, optimize offcut reuse or cover complex laying patterns. Quotes are cost estimates, not tax invoices; the app does not determine which tax rules apply. Keep a backup before changing devices or reinstalling.

name: TileMint
description:
Plan a tile project from real dimensions. Enter room length and width, tile size, grout spacing, waste allowance and tiles per box. TileMint calculates a straight-layout grid, whole-tile allowance and rounded-up box count.

Save projects, compare tile orientations and review materials by project. Edit notes, search estimates and export your records as JSON. Estimates assume full grid positions with an added waste allowance; they do not optimize reuse of offcuts. Verify site measurements and cuts before ordering.

Core features work offline. Free, with no account, ads or in-app purchases. Choose English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese or Italian, and System, Light or Dark appearance. Sample records are optional; new collections start empty.

name: TileTaper
description: TileTaper helps DIY renovators prepare material orders for rectangular tiled surfaces. Save a project with several surfaces, tile dimensions, joint width, waste allowance, tiles per box and your box price. See per-surface grid counts, compare tile orientation, and calculate whole boxes, spare tiles and estimated cost. Search saved projects, revise measurements and export your records as JSON. Each surface rounds up separately; the estimate does not reuse offcuts or deduct openings. Confirm site measurements, cutting plans and quantities with your installer. Cost follows your entered box price and currency, with no exchange-rate service.\n\nFree, no account, advertising or in-app purchases. Core records work offline and stay on this device. Optional fictional sample records are available on an empty collection. Supports English, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Brazilian Portuguese and Italian, with system, light and dark appearance.

name: Tima - CRM Lender
description:
Tima - CRM Lender là ứng dụng nội bộ dành riêng cho nhân viên kinh doanh và quản lý của Tima, giúp quản lý quan hệ với nhà đầu tư ngay trên điện thoại.

Ứng dụng chỉ dùng được với tài khoản do Tima cấp. Không hỗ trợ đăng ký tài khoản mới.

DÀNH CHO NHÂN VIÊN KINH DOANH
• Danh sách nhà đầu tư: tìm kiếm, lọc theo trạng thái, nguồn và thời gian; thêm và cập nhật thông tin.
• Cập nhật trạng thái tư vấn và ghi chú trao đổi với từng nhà đầu tư.
• Giỏ công việc hằng ngày: check-in tại chỗ bằng ảnh chụp và vị trí GPS.
• Lịch hẹn: đặt, xem theo ngày và huỷ lịch hẹn với nhà đầu tư.
• Dự kiến đầu tư: ghi nhận số tiền, sản phẩm và ngày dự kiến; tạo hợp đồng từ dự kiến.
• Hợp đồng: xem chi tiết, cập nhật thông tin, tải ảnh chứng từ lên.

DÀNH CHO QUẢN LÝ
• Phê duyệt hoặc huỷ hợp đồng chờ duyệt.
• Theo dõi danh sách nhân viên và nhà đầu tư mỗi nhân viên phụ trách.
• Xem toàn bộ nhà đầu tư trong hệ thống với bộ lọc chi tiết.

THÔNG BÁO
• Nhận thông báo về hợp đồng, lịch hẹn và công việc; xem lại trong hộp thư thông báo của ứng dụng.

Hỗ trợ: liên hệ bộ phận IT của Tima.

name: TimeFixed
description:
TimeFixed makes booking a local appointment quick and easy, and gives small businesses a simple way to take bookings.

FOR CUSTOMERS
- Find barbers, physios, salons and other local services by name, city, suburb or category
- See real free times and book the one that suits you
- Choose who you book with, when a business has more than one person or service
- Ask for a time when a business takes requests
- Get a notification when your booking is approved, changed or cancelled
- See your upcoming and past bookings in one place, and cancel if plans change
- Save your favourite businesses and rate the ones you've visited
- Get directions to your appointment

FOR BUSINESSES
- List your business and set your days, hours, breaks and slot lengths
- Add a section for each staff member, chair, room or service
- See today's bookings at a glance
- Approve or decline booking requests, and get a notification for each new one
- Mark customers as arrived, and switch bookings off when you're closed
- Customers who have visited can verify your business, so new customers can trust you

Sign in with Apple, Google or your email address. You can delete your account at any time from your profile.

name: Times Tables Trainer - Math
description:
Times Tables Trainer helps children master the times tables from 1 to 15. Practise when it's time to learn, play when it's time for fun.

Practice
• Pick your tables: one table or several mixed, from 1 to 15
• In order or mixed, 10 or 20 sums, with or without a timer
• Choose from four answers or type the answer yourself
• A sum you got wrong comes back later in the round
• "My tricky sums": a round with exactly the sums you still find hard

Three games, each with its own high score
• Rocket Race: every right answer adds fuel. How high can you fly? Past the Moon, Mars and Saturn
• Balloon Pop: you see a number, pop the balloon with the sum that matches it
• Block Tower: build your tower with right answers, no timer and no rush

Stars and shops
• Earn stars by practising and playing
• Every game has its own shop: rockets, balloons, pop effects, blocks and a flag or crown for the top of your tower

For the whole family
• Up to six players on one device, each with their own progress and records
• In English and Dutch
• Works offline
• Free, no ads and no in-app purchases

name: TintRelay
description:
Know how much paint to mix, transfer, and keep in every cup of a gradient. TintRelay turns your tested color recipes into a weighing plan you can follow at the workbench.

FROM SWATCH TO BATCH

1. Set up your shades
Create a project and enter your base paints and any stock weights you know. Add one cup per shade, assign its tested swatch, and enter the recipe in grams or weight parts. Set how much finished paint you want to keep in each cup.

2. Link cups that share a mix
When a lighter shade starts with paint from an earlier cup, select that cup as an ingredient. TintRelay calculates how much to mix in each cup, how much to send onward, and how much to reserve. Use the gradient workbench and flow map to follow the transfers.

3. Check what is on hand
Compare base paint demand with the stock you entered. See which paint is short and which inventory still needs checking. Change the total batch weight or fit the batch to checked stock, preview the new weights for each cup, and save the result as a separate plan for comparison.

4. Weigh, mix, and record
Start with the first cup in the weighing order. Mark it mixed, record the actual net weight, and log how much paint you transfer. The workbench points to the next step. If a cup weighs less than planned, you can see how much is available to send after setting aside its keep target.

5. Take the plan to the bench
Preview and share a PDF weigh sheet, or export the plan as a CSV. The sheet lists targets in weighing order and marks amounts that do not match the chosen scale increment. Back up projects, plan versions, and actual records to a file you can restore later.

Try Open example to see a three-shade gradient from clay red to porcelain. TintRelay is designed for mural painters, art teachers, and craft studios preparing real paint from tested recipes. Planning and record keeping work offline, with no account required.

name: Tiny Chute
description:
A little leap. A big adventure.

Tiny Chute is a colorful parachuting game about timing, precision and sticking the perfect landing. Guide a tiny aviator through birds, swinging cargo and rooftop hazards, then touch down inside the bullseye.

HOLD, GLIDE, LAND
Hold to slow your descent. Drag left or right to steer. Release to glide with the wind. Simple controls make every safe landing feel earned.

FIVE WORLDS TO EXPLORE
Fly over a sunlit harbor, city rooftops, snowy mountains, tropical beaches and a glowing nighttime carnival. Complete 20 campaign levels with wind zones, updrafts and moving boat, truck and platform landings.

FIVE EPIC BONUS DROPS
Clear each world to unlock a longer descent through a new landscape. The camera follows your parachutist through the clouds, revealing the ground and landing target during the final approach.

MAKE EVERY DROP COUNT
Collect stars, earn near-miss bonuses and complete missions. Aim for a bullseye, land without braking or build a streak of safe landings. Replay a course to race a translucent ghost of your fastest successful flight.

YOUR NEXT ADVENTURE
Try a daily course with a shared date-based layout. Earn landing stars to unlock new pilots and parachutes, and track your personal bests and local trophies.

MADE FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
The artwork fills the screen and adapts to portrait, landscape and supported folding-device layouts. Play offline with your progress saved on your device.

One purchase. No ads. No in-app purchases. No account required.

Support: flipnoteduo@gmail.com

name: Tiny Planet: Kids Feelings
description:
"How was today?" "Fine."

I made Tiny Planet for that moment. It gives children a playful way to show how their day felt, and gives you a gentle way in.

Pip lives on a tiny planet with eight little friends, one for each feeling: Bunbun (happy), Zoom (excited), Puff (okay), Nap (sleepy), Mist (meh), Brolly (sad), Wiggle (worried) and Spike (cross). Each evening your child picks the friend that matches their day, says what it was about (school, friends, family, playing and more), and can hold the star to tell Pip in their own voice.

FOR KIDS
• Pick a feeling in a couple of taps
• A planet that fills with friends as the days go by
• A sticker book with little stories that grow each time a friend visits
• Calm corner: big breaths with Pip, 3, 6 or 10 at a time
• Slide to sleep, then blow Pip a goodnight kiss

FOR GROWN-UPS
• A private corner behind a PIN or Face ID
• This week's sky and the month's calendar at a glance
• A question to ask tonight, like "Who did you sit with at lunch?"
• A bedtime reminder and a home screen widget
• A monthly postcard to share with family

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• Everything stays on this phone
• No account, no ads, no tracking

TINY PLANET FAMILY (optional)
The kid side is always free. Family adds patterns Pip notices, gentle questions to ask, your child’s voice notes, up to 4 planets and a monthly look back. $29.99 a year with a 7-day free trial, or $4.99 a month.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage or cancel in your Apple Account settings.

Tiny Planet is a family feelings diary. It is not a medical or therapy tool.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://goyalaakashdeep.github.io/tiny-planet/privacy.html

name: Titration Endpoint
description:
Titration Endpoint keeps one V–pH run on this iPhone. The curve marks the derivative peak and concentration.

Drag the endpoint mark and the concentration updates. Replicates show Accept or Reject against the RSD limit.

There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: Tmolvo
description:
Tmolvo is an iPhone application designed for daily measurements. Open the camera, mark two points on the screen, and it can estimate the distance between them. Whether you want to measure the width of the table, check the height of the wall, or understand the available space before purchasing furniture, you can quickly view the approximate dimensions using Tmolvo. You can save the measurement results in a project for easy future reference. There is no need to log in to start the measurement. The measurement results are affected by light, surface texture, and the tracking status of the device, and are suitable for daily reference.

name: Tofu Game
description:
Tap to drop a friend and build a tower toward the sky!

From rolled omelets and pudding to sushi and space mochi, meet expressive little friends as you climb. Time your tap on the swinging crane and keep your tower balanced.

SIMPLE TO PLAY
• One-tap controls: jump straight into the game
• Earn comeback bonuses when your tower barely survives
• Build combos with well-placed drops
• Discover changing scenery and friends as you climb

COLLECT AND CUSTOMIZE
• Record the friends you meet in your collection
• Complete sets for bonus coins and discover hidden friends
• Spend earned coins on tables and cranes

PLAY YOUR WAY
• Start immediately as a guest
• Link Apple, LINE, Google or Kakao to keep your progress across devices
• Compete on the leaderboard with your nickname
• Play offline; online features require an internet connection
• Korean, English and Japanese
• Choose between two music tracks and adjust sound and vibration

Includes ads and optional rewarded ads. No in-app purchases.

name: Tokyo Rail Live
description:
Watch Tokyo's trains, subways and flights move on a 3D map in real time. Every train running right now is shown where it actually is, with its delay.

LIVE, ACROSS TOKYO
• JR, Tokyo Metro, Toei and private railway trains on a 3D map
• Delays and suspensions shown line by line as they happen
• Flights arriving at and leaving Haneda and Narita

WHILE YOU RIDE
• Tap "I'm on this train" for the next stop and the minutes to it
• An alert and a tap on the wrist before your stop
• A full-screen display like the screens above the train doors
• Your next stop on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• Where to change, with the next train and its platform

STATIONS AND ROUTES
• Tap a station for its departures, exits and connecting lines
• Search routes with changes and see them on the map
• Step-free routes by lift at some stations
• A reminder for the last train home

FAVOURITES AND APPLE WATCH
• Widgets for your favourite stations, home and work
• Departures on Apple Watch, even without your iPhone nearby
• iPhone and Apple Watch work together: the train you ride on your iPhone shows on your wrist, and a train or Go home picked on the watch starts the ride on your iPhone
• Ride countdown and stop alert on your wrist, and Go home in one tap

IPHONE DUO AND IPAD
• On the foldable iPhone Duo the 3D map fills the screen, closed or open
• Room to explore on iPad's big screen

SHARE
• Share your train or route as a card with the 3D map behind it

Public transportation data comes from the Public Transportation Open Data Center (ODPT). Its accuracy and completeness are not guaranteed. Please do not contact the operators about the content of this app.

name: Tomdoku: Animal Logic Puzzle
description:
Place one animal in every row, column and color — and no two animals may touch. Tomdoku is a cozy queens logic puzzle: no guessing, no math needed, just clean deductions and a cast of cute animal friends cheering you on.

HOW TO PLAY
• Double-tap a cell to place an animal. Tap once to mark it with an X.
• Every row, column and color region holds exactly one animal.
• Animals can't touch — not even diagonally.
• Each puzzle has one solution you can reach by logic alone.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 1,000 levels, from quick 5×5 boards to tricky 10×10 grids.
• A new Daily Challenge every day, with a calendar and a monthly trophy.
• A 7-day Daily Reward with coins and hints.
• 17 animal friends to collect, and a new house every 10 levels.
• Hints that explain the next step, Undo, and automatic X marks.

WHY PLAYERS LOVE IT
• No timers — play at your own pace.
• Three hearts per level, and a second chance when you need one.
• Short boards for a quick break, big grids for a long evening.
• Every color region also has its own pattern, and VoiceOver is supported.
• Plays offline, on iPhone and iPad.

Tomdoku is free to play with ads. Optional videos give a free hint, a second chance or extra coins — only when you choose. One small purchase removes the banner and between-level ads for good; coin packs are optional.

Privacy Policy: https://sarfarajskdev.github.io/privacy-policy/privacy-tomdoku.html
Terms of Use: https://sarfarajskdev.github.io/privacy-policy/terms-tomdoku.html

name: Tomopi
description:
Tomopi does one thing: it makes logging your weight fast. Open it, slide the ruler, and today's weight is saved. Keeping you company is Tomopi, a round little bathroom scale whose display is its face.

QUICK TO LOG
• Slide the ruler to your weight instead of typing numbers, with a light tap on every tick
• One entry per day: saving again on the same day replaces it, so your log stays clean
• Need to add a past day? Pick it on the monthly calendar and log it

TOMOPI IS WITH YOU
• A small Tomopi sits at the top of Home, keeping you company as you look back over your days
• During first-time setup, Tomopi gets rounder or slimmer with the BMI from your height and weight, and wears a bow tie or a bow
• Once you've logged, Home gets a "Logged" stamp. Miss a day, and Tomopi takes a nap on it
• BMI levels use neutral wording (Low, Standard, Slightly high, and so on). They describe a number, not your body

CLEAR AT A GLANCE
• Five items on Home: Last 7 days (today on the far left, earlier days to the right), This week, BMI, This month, and Weight goal. Choose what to show and in what order in Settings > Show on Home
• Stats for 30 days, this month, last month, 6 months, this year, or last year: average, lowest, highest, and change
• Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets. Tap one to log
• Optional daily reminder that skips days you've already logged

THREE THEMES
• Paper Planner: paper tones and a monospaced font, like a notebook on your desk
• Frosted Glass: translucent cards floating over a soft frosted background
• Crayon Book: cream paper, wobbly hand-drawn frames and crayon texture, like a picture book
• Tomopi and the app icon change with the theme
