• Dark Mode: On, Off, or System. Switch any time in Settings

YOUR DATA STAYS YOURS
• No account, no sign-in
• Your entries, height, gender, goal and settings stay on your iPhone and in your own iCloud (sync is on by default and can be turned off in Settings). There is no developer server, and no one else can see your entries
• Optional Face ID / Touch ID lock
• Export your weight log anytime and take it with you. The file opens right in Numbers or Excel
• Got a new phone? Import an exported file back in. It only fills days that are empty and never changes entries you already have
• No data collection, no ads, no third-party analytics

PRICING
• Free to download, with a free 7-day trial of every feature
• After the trial, a one-time purchase (Unlock Tomopi) lets you keep adding, editing and importing entries. No subscription, no automatic charges
• Don't want to buy? Your entries stay viewable and exporting always works
• Prices are shown in the App Store

MORE
• Units: kg, lb, and stone; height in cm or ft/in
• 10 languages: Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Vietnamese, English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German

BMI and other numbers are for reference only and are not medical advice. If you have questions, please talk to a doctor. Tomopi is not a medical device.

name: Top Tactical
description:
Top Tactical is an online tactical shooter for phones. Two teams of six meet on one map: the attackers try to plant the bomb at site A or B, the defenders try to stop them. First to 11 rounds wins; after round 10 the teams change sides.

EVERY ROUND IS A PLAN
In the ten-second buy phase, spend what you earned on weapons, armour and grenades. When the walls drop, give orders over the radio, read the map and hold the angles. A fallen player drops his weapon: pick it up and swap it for yours.

NINE MAPS
A depot, a market, a harbour, an outpost, a factory, a village, an oasis, a seaside town and a castle, each with its own plan, weather and time of day.

LEAGUES AND MONTHLY SEASONS
Six leagues from Bronze to Legend. A new season starts every month and everyone climbs again from zero.

WITH YOUR FRIENDS
Add friends with a friend key, form a lobby of up to six and play on the same team. Team and all chat, radio commands and map pings.

MADE FOR TOUCH
The left stick walks, the right stick aims. The gun fires by itself when it is on an enemy; turn that off if you prefer.

NO WAITING
Tap Find match and the match starts soon. Seats nobody takes are filled by AI-controlled players.

No ads, no in-app purchases. An internet connection is required. The game is in Turkish for now.

name: Torqfolio: Car Log
description:
Torqfolio is a quiet, reliable home for everything your car has done and everything it needs next. Log services with dates, mileage, shops and costs, attach the actual receipts, and let Torqfolio remind you when maintenance comes due — by miles or by date.

Everything works offline, right on your iPhone. No account needed.

WHAT YOU GET

• Garage — every vehicle you own with its current odometer, spending to date, and the next recommended service.
• History — a clean, chronological record of every oil change, tire rotation and repair, with photos and PDF receipts attached.
• Upcoming — reminders that come due by mileage, by date, or either one first. Set your own targets; Torqfolio never assumes a manufacturer interval for you.
• Share a vehicle's history as a polished PDF or a private web link, with exactly the details you choose — dates, mileage, costs, notes, receipts, and at most the last four characters of your VIN.
• Light and dark themes, including a true system-follow mode.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT

Your records live on your iPhone. Sign in with Apple or Google only if you want an encrypted-at-rest private backup you can restore on a new phone — and share links you can turn off with one tap.

Download Torqfolio and give your car the record-keeping it deserves.

name: TRACE Employee
description:
TRACE Employee — приложение для команды ресторана, который работает в TRACE.

• Смена в одно касание: открыть, закрыть и пройти чек-лист.
• Свой график на неделю: отдать смену коллеге или взять свободную.
• Чат команды и лента новостей ресторана: объявления, премии, дни рождения.
• Обучение: меню, материалы и тесты.
• Зарплата и премии: сколько уже заработано в этом периоде.
• Заявки на выходной, отпуск и аванс.

Вход по номеру телефона и паролю из SMS, который присылает ваш ресторан.

name: Track-R (c1087d)
description:
Track-R is where Relific's product team and the clients it builds for keep their work: tickets, sprints, code reviews and the health of every app in production. This is Track-R on your phone, with an alarm for the moment production needs someone.

WHEN SOMETHING BREAKS, YOUR PHONE KNOWS
• A failed deploy, an app or API that goes down, or an AI fix queue that has stopped sounds an emergency alarm: a full-screen alert with its own siren that keeps going until someone acknowledges it.
• On Android the alarm can sound through Do Not Disturb, once you allow it in Settings.
• Everything else that needs attention, such as a billing warning, arrives as an ordinary notification.
• The same alerts as the website's top bar and Needs attention list, so the phone and the website always agree.

YOUR WORK, WHEREVER YOU ARE
• Tickets: search by code, title, person or app; filter by stage; see what is assigned to you; move a ticket on and reply to its comments.
• Sprints: this week's progress, and every sprint's tickets by stage.
• Claude queue: what the AI is fixing now, what is queued, and what is waiting for an answer. Open or close the queue.
• PR reviews: ask for an AI review of a pull request and read its verdict.
• Dashboard: open and in-progress work, what needs a decision, two weeks of tickets opened and closed, and the team's workload.
• Admin: Needs attention, services, backups and every app at a glance.

BUILT FOR TEAMS
Track-R shows each person what their role allows, exactly as the website does. Accounts are created by your Track-R administrator; there is no public sign-up. Sign in with your email and password, or with Google if your account uses it.

Privacy policy: https://relific.io/privacy

name: TrackPeek: GPX & KML Viewer
description:
Someone sends you the GPX of Sunday's ride, the route of a gran fondo or a hiking trail from the park website. TrackPeek opens it in a second and shows you what you really want to know: how long it is, how much climbing there is, and where it hurts.

TrackPeek is not another outdoor app. No account, no feed, no recording. It is the clean, fast viewer for the track file itself, and the pocket knife to get it ready for your GPS.

OPEN ANY TRACK
• GPX, KML, KMZ and FIT, recognised from the content, even when WhatsApp sends a GPX as .xml or with no extension
• Open from Mail, WhatsApp, Telegram, Files or Drive with "Open with TrackPeek", or from the app
• Every track you open stays in your library with its map thumbnail, distance and elevation gain

SEE IT CLEARLY
• Map of the whole route with start, finish, direction arrows and waypoints
• Elevation profile linked to the map: drag your finger along the profile and a dot runs along the route, with altitude, distance from the start and grade
• Tap the map and the profile jumps to that point
• Climbs highlighted, each with length, gain, average and maximum grade
• Distance, elevation gain and loss (smoothed, so a noisy GPS does not inflate the numbers), highest and lowest point
• From activity files: total and moving time, average and max speed, heart rate, cadence and power
• Walking time estimate for hikes

TRACKPEEK PRO
• Simplify: bring a 48,000-point track down to the number of points your Garmin or Wahoo accepts, without changing its shape
• Convert between GPX, KML, KMZ and GeoJSON, and FIT to GPX
• Trim the start or the end, split, join and reverse tracks
• Track colored by grade, altitude, speed or heart rate, on a shaded-relief topo map
• A beautiful image to share: map, profile and the key numbers, in post or story format, without a watermark

Pro is available as a monthly or yearly subscription (the yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial) or as a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel them in your account settings.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your tracks never leave your phone. No account, no cloud, no tracking. The map uses OpenStreetMap data (© OpenStreetMap contributors) served by OpenFreeMap.

Made in Tuscany by a small studio that rides and hikes. Questions or a file that does not open? Write to dev@neurafit.it.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://www.neurafit.it/trackpeek/privacy/

name: TraKing
description:
TraKing – Smart Fleet Management & Vehicle Tracking
Take control of your fleet with TraKing, a powerful vehicle tracking and fleet management application designed to give you visibility, control and insights into your fleet operations.
Whether you manage a few vehicles or a large fleet, TraKing helps you monitor vehicle movements, track journeys, manage fuel consumption and stay informed about your fleet's activities, all from your mobile device.
KEY FEATURES
Real-Time Vehicle Tracking
View your vehicles on a live map and monitor their current locations and movements. Stay informed about where your vehicles are and their operational status.
Vehicle Monitoring
Access important vehicle information, including speed, movement status, location and other essential monitoring details.
Trip History & Playback
Review completed journeys, explore historical routes and replay vehicle movements to understand how your fleet operates.
Fuel Monitoring
Monitor fuel levels, fuel consumption and refuelling activities to gain better visibility into fuel usage and help identify unusual consumption patterns.
Fleet Reports & Analytics
Access fleet reports and operational insights to understand vehicle utilisation, trip activity, mileage and overall fleet performance.
Instant Alerts & Notifications
Stay informed about important fleet events and receive notifications that help you respond to activities requiring attention.
Geofence Monitoring
Monitor vehicle activity around designated geographical areas and stay informed about relevant location-based events.
Manage Your Fleet Anywhere
Access your fleet information conveniently from your mobile device, helping you stay connected to your operations wherever you are.
WHY CHOOSE TRAKING?
Real-time fleet visibility.
Better monitoring of vehicle movements.
Improved fuel management.
Convenient access to trip information and reports.
Timely notifications about fleet activities.
Data-driven insights for better fleet management.
Stay Connected. Stay In Control.
Download TraKing and experience smarter, more informed fleet management.

Note: Access to vehicle information and tracking features depends on your organisation's account, assigned permissions and compatible tracking devices.

name: Travel Atlas: Sights & Food
description:
A picture guide for collecting what you want to see before your trip.

Swipe up and down through sights, food and souvenirs one at a time, and swipe sideways to the map, where to stay and the seasons. Tap "Save this place" on anything you like. Your picks are grouped by destination and can be shared as text with your travel companions.

DESTINATIONS (24)
Japan: Okinawa Main Island, Yaeyama, Miyako Island
Abroad: Taiwan, Seoul, Busan, Jeju, Hong Kong, Macau, Bangkok, Phuket, Chiang Mai, Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Da Nang, Hanoi, Ho Chi Minh City, Bali, Cebu, Guam, Oahu (Hawaii), New York, Paris, Rome

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Swipe through sights, food and souvenirs in large photos
- Choose an area to stay and see who it suits
- Check the climate, what to wear and highlights for each season
- Find each sight on the map
- Collect saved places by destination and share the list
- Open destinations you have viewed even when offline

PRIVACY
No accounts, no ads and no analytics. Your saved places stay on your device.

Opening hours and prices can change. Please check official websites before you go.
More destinations are on the way.

name: TravelBook: Budget & Journal
description:
Reisebuch brings travel budgeting and a personal travel journal together. Plan your trip costs, record expenses on the road and keep your places, photos and memories afterwards.

TRAVEL BUDGETS AT A GLANCE
Create trips with dates, a budget, travellers and a base currency. Track planned, booked, on-trip and final costs separately. See totals, remaining budget, categories and costs per person and day. Your available daily budget also accounts for costs you still plan to incur.

YOUR PERSONAL TRAVEL JOURNAL
Search your archive and filter by year or trip type. Save accommodation, rooms, booking platforms and your own details. Use templates for different trips, including cruises and holiday parks. Rate stays, places and trips. Keep highlights and notes on what to repeat or avoid. Collect photos and crop your own cover images.

MAKE HOME AND STATISTICS YOUR OWN
Choose the trip and metric in focus. Adjust trip filters, sorting and visible information. Build your statistics dashboard with charts for spending over time, budgets and cost breakdowns. Filter by trip, date range, currency and cost phase, then choose the order and presentation of your charts.

SIX CONFIGURABLE WIDGETS
Budget Pro includes trip budget, daily budget, trip countdown and category costs for your Home Screen. Travel Journal adds photo memories and archive statistics. Supported variants are also available for your Lock Screen. Depending on the widget, choose a trip, colours, visible amounts, memories or statistics.

MAPS AND ROOM FOR MORE
Explore saved places on an interactive map and open their journal entries. Adaptive layouts use larger views on iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo: trip selection beside details, filters beside charts and a places list beside the map. Narrow views arrange content in a single column.

EXPORTS, BACKUPS AND ICLOUD
Export budgets and journals as PDF or CSV. Back up your journal with photos and import your backup again. Use iCloud sync and shared trips or archives. Copy budget trips into the journal and refresh their costs later without overwriting photos or memories.

CHOOSE YOUR UNLOCK
The base app includes one budget trip. Budget Pro unlocks unlimited budget trips, budget statistics, exports, custom categories, multiple travellers, more currencies, cloud features and the four budget widgets. Travel Journal is an independent one-time purchase that works without Budget Pro. It includes the complete journal with photos, templates, map, archive statistics, exports, backups, iCloud, shared archives and the two journal widgets. No subscription. Alternatively, Reisebuch Complete unlocks both modules and all six widgets with a single one-time purchase.

No separate app account required. Cloud features require an available iCloud account. The app supports 15 languages.

name: Trial Blocks
description:
Trial Blocks keeps a randomized complete block trial on this iPhone. Each block is shuffled on its own. Enter the yield of each plot.

Mark one plot missing. The estimate uses the rest of its block and treatment so the table stays balanced. Means carry compact letters from the least significant difference.

There is no account and nothing to buy.

name: TRUSSORA: Bridge Builder
description:
A STRONG BRIDGE BEGINS WITH A SMART IDEA.

A single beam can change everything. One misplaced connection can weaken an entire structure. In TRUSSORA: Bridge Builder, your challenge is to transform simple construction materials into bridges capable of standing up to the pressure.

TRUSSORA is a distinctive 2D structural engineering puzzle game that combines creative construction, logical thinking and experimental problem-solving.

Each challenge presents a new structural problem. Study the available space, plan your design, connect the right components and discover whether your creation can withstand the load.

DESIGN WITH PURPOSE

Every successful structure begins with thoughtful planning.

Construct bridges using beams, vertical supports, diagonal bracing and reinforced structural elements. Consider how each component connects to the others and how those connections influence the strength of your overall design.

Building more is not always building better. Sometimes, the smartest solution is a carefully positioned support.

PUT YOUR STRUCTURE TO THE TEST

Construction is only half the challenge.

Activate the load test to examine how your bridge responds under pressure. Observe the structural stress, identify vulnerable connections and discover how weight travels through your creation.

A bridge that looks strong might hide a critical weakness. Testing reveals what your design can actually withstand.

LEARN THROUGH EVERY ATTEMPT

When a structure fails, the experiment is not over.

Reconsider your approach, adjust your supports, improve the distribution of weight and test another solution.

Explore structural principles inspired by tension, compression, balance and load distribution through interactive puzzles that reward careful observation and experimentation.

EVERY MATERIAL MATTERS

With limited building components available, each construction decision has consequences.

Choose where additional reinforcement is needed, avoid unnecessary connections and find efficient ways to build stable structures.

DISCOVER NEW ENGINEERING CHALLENGES

Progress through multiple levels featuring different structural layouts, building constraints and increasingly demanding puzzles.

Each new challenge encourages you to rethink familiar techniques and develop more effective solutions.

GAME FEATURES

Creative 2D bridge construction using different structural components.

Interactive load testing with visual stress feedback.

Structural puzzles involving balance, tension, compression and weight distribution.

Limited materials that encourage efficient engineering decisions.

Multiple levels with varied layouts and increasing difficulty.

Opportunities to redesign, experiment and improve failed structures.

Clean architectural visuals and engaging structural animations.

Completely offline gameplay with progress saved directly on your device.

No advertisements or tracking.

THINK. BUILD. REINFORCE.

TRUSSORA is about more than connecting beams. It is about understanding why a structure stands, recognising why it fails and finding a smarter way forward.

Every connection has a purpose. Every load reveals a lesson.

Build your bridge, challenge your design and discover the satisfaction of creating a structure that holds.

Your next engineering challenge begins in TRUSSORA: Bridge Builder.

name: TrustTags Verifier
description:
TrustTags Verifier helps you check that the product in your hand is genuine.

Simply open the app and scan the QR code on a TrustTags-protected product pack. The app verifies the QR code with TrustTags and shows you the product details: brand, batch number, manufacturing and expiry dates, manufacturer, and the scan history of the pack.

• Fast verification with your phone camera
• Clear product details after a successful check
• Scan history to see where and when the pack was checked
• No sign-up or login needed

TrustTags Verifier works with product packs that carry TrustTags security printing. For any help, contact TrustTags support.

name: Truthify - AI Fact Checker
description:
Truthify checks the facts in what you read and hear. Paste text, snap a screenshot, share a post from Safari or any app, or let it listen live. Truthify finds each factual claim, searches the web for independent sources and rates how well they support it.

WHAT YOU CAN CHECK
• Text you type or paste
• Photos and screenshots (the text is read on your iPhone)
• Web pages and posts shared from Safari and other apps
• Live speech: TV, podcasts, debates and meetings
• Audio and video files (Pro and Max)

CLEAR RATINGS WITH SOURCES
Every claim gets a score from 1 to 10: Supported (7 to 10), Mixed (4 to 6) or Refuted (1 to 3), with a short explanation and the sources behind it, so you can read them yourself. Claims with no reliable sources are marked Unverified.

HISTORY
Your checks are saved on your iPhone for 15 days, and you can share any result as an image.

PLANS
• Free: 3 checks and 3 minutes of live listening to try Truthify
• Pro: 15 checks and 15 minutes of audio a day, including audio and video files
• Max: 30 checks and 30 minutes of audio a day, with files up to 30 minutes long
Pro and Max start with a 3-day free trial for new subscribers.

Subscriptions renew automatically every month unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings.

Ratings are made with the help of AI and cannot be always right. Always read the sources shown with each claim.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://rishib42.github.io/19-fact-check-truthify-support/privacy.html

name: TüfTüf
description:
Tüftüf is a fast-paced team shooter you can play with friends in the same room — no internet required. Phones find each other over the local network: no setup, no accounts, no ads.

RED vs BLUE
• Team matches from 1v1 up to 3v3 — up to 6 players.
• Missing someone? Fill empty slots with bots. No friends around? Practice against bots.
• The team with the most knockouts wins.

PICK YOUR STYLE
• Long tube: fewer shots, long range, heavy hits.
• Short tube: big magazine, fast bullets, close combat.
• Slow and tough, or fast and agile? Choose your build and your look.

READ THE ARENA
• Prison, Graveyard and Factory: three maps full of cover.
• Grab the ammo and health packs that pop up and turn the tide.
• Toggle the midfield wall, play by time or by score.

OFFLINE MULTIPLAYER
• No Wi-Fi or mobile data needed; devices connect directly.
• No personal data is collected and nothing is sent to any server.

Gather your friends, build your team — tüf tüf tüf!

name: TuinMeting
description:
Jouw tuin. Van vraag naar inzicht.

Waar krijgt een plantenbak direct zonlicht? Blijft er voldoende ruimte vrij bij de afvoer? Kloppen de afmetingen op je schets? Met TuinMeting plan je waarnemingen, leg je meetgegevens vast en vergelijk je resultaten. Een overzichtelijk meetboek voor je tuin, binnenplaats of dakterras, op iPhone en iPad.

TIEN GERICHTE MEETVRAGEN
Onderzoek vrije ruimte, controleer afmetingen en vergelijk zonlicht op verschillende plekken. Leg veranderingen vast rond een muur, bladverlies of het verplaatsen van een plantenbak. Werk met tijdstippen, afstanden, luxwaarden en gekalibreerde stapmetingen.

EERST PLANNEN, DAN METEN
Leg je meetpunten, methode, instrument, waarnemer en persoonlijke grens vooraf vast. Elke regelversie krijgt een tijdstip. Bij latere wijzigingen blijven eerdere regels, oorspronkelijke waarnemingen en opgeslagen beoordelingen terug te vinden.

BEWAAR WAT JE WERKELIJK WAARNEEMT
Voeg meetwaarden, tijden, omstandigheden, notities, foto’s en eigen schetsen toe. Ontbrekende waarden blijven herkenbaar: een leeg veld wordt geen nul. Bekijk welke waarnemingen nog nodig zijn en controleer herhalingen, spreiding en vergelijkbaarheid.

VERGELIJK EN MEET OPNIEUW
Bekijk de berekeningen en de volledigheid van je gegevens. Bij voldoende bewijs leg je zelf een keuze vast: behouden, aanpassen of stoppen. Start een gekoppelde hermeting en vergelijk meetrondes, met aandacht voor verschillen in meetpunten, instrument en omstandigheden.

NEEM JE VERSLAG MEE
Selecteer de gegevens die je wilt delen en bekijk het verslag vooraf. Exporteer als PDF, CSV of JSON, met optionele foto’s en schetsen. Bewaar je verslag in Bestanden of deel het via het deelmenu van iOS.

GEMAAKT VOOR JE EIGEN MEETBOEK
• Werkt offline, zonder account.
• Nederlandse formulieren en datumselectie.
• Foto’s, notities en tekenbare schetsen.
• Optionele lokale herinneringen.
• Donkere weergave en een ruime indeling op iPad.
• Meetgegevens en bijlagen worden lokaal op je apparaat bewaard.

TuinMeting ondersteunt handmatig vastgelegde waarnemingen. Luxwaarden neem je over van een externe lichtmeter; de app meet niet automatisch. De app berekent geen draagkracht of DLI en voorspelt geen plantopbrengst. Persoonlijke grenzen zijn geen officiële normen. Sfeerfoto’s dienen ter illustratie en zijn geen meetbewijs.

name: Tumbori Play - 사고력 게임과 과학 이야기
description:
정답보다 중요한 건, 스스로 생각하는 힘.

AI가 무엇이든 빠르게 답해 주는 시대.

아이들에게 필요한 건 정답을 외우는 능력보다, 스스로 질문하고 생각하며 문제를 해결하는 힘이라고 믿습니다.

텀보리 플레이는 그 힘을 놀이로 키워갑니다.

숨은 단서를 찾아 추리하고, 도형을 이리저리 맞추고, 빛과 무게의 원리를 직접 실험해요. 아이는 손끝으로 움직이고, 결과를 관찰하며, 다음에는 어떻게 해야 할지 스스로 생각합니다.

때로는 엉뚱한 방법을 시도하고, 실패하기도 하겠죠. 괜찮아요. 다시 해보는 과정에서도 새로운 것을 발견하니까요.

■ 놀이가 생각이 되는 시간

관찰하고, 추리하고, 규칙을 발견하고, 문제를 해결하는 다양한 놀이가 기다리고 있어요.

처음에는 쉽게 시작하지만, 익숙해질수록 조금 더 깊이 생각해야 해요. 막힐 때는 작은 힌트가 도와주고, 틀려도 부담 없이 다시 도전할 수 있습니다.

■ 호기심이 과학이 되는 이야기

공룡의 세계부터 우리 몸속, 치아와 꿀벌의 이야기까지.

흥미로운 이야기를 듣고 끝나는 것이 아니라, 아이가 직접 움직이고 실험하며 그 속에 숨은 원리를 발견해요.

■ 스스로 발견하는 즐거움

텀보리 플레이는 아이가 얼마나 빨리 정답을 찾았는지보다, 답을 찾아가는 과정에 집중합니다.

AI와 함께 성장할 아이들에게 필요한 건 더 많은 정답이 아니라, 스스로 생각하고 새로운 질문을 던지는 경험이니까요.

작은 호기심이 깊은 생각으로 자라도록.

텀보리 플레이와 함께 즐겁게 탐험해 보세요.

■ 이용 안내

- 유치원생부터 초등 저학년까지
- iPhone 및 iPad 지원 (가로 화면)
- 계정 없이 이용 가능
- 인터넷 연결 없이 플레이 가능
- 놀이 진행 기록은 기기에만 저장

개인정보 처리방침: https://tumbori.com/play/privacy

이용약관: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: Turnfold
description:
Cue Contrast reads one family—canopy, ground, water, daylight, or wildlife—across spring, summer, autumn, and winter, with notes on the tagged season.

• Read Season Desk: see the season that contains today, the days until the next boundary, and which marker windows include this month.
• Filter Markers: open a bundled cue by season, read where to stand and what to look for, then start a note from that card.
• Keep a Field Log: save a title, date, season, and cue on this device, then edit it or confirm a swipe delete.
• Open Contrast: one cue becomes four season cards, and a pinned note opens from the card you tagged.
• Switch Glossary boundaries: choose meteorological or astronomical dates and the desk recomputes today's season.

Marker and glossary catalogs are bundled in the app. Field notes and the boundary choice stay on the device and load again at the next launch. There is no account and no network sync.

The record is what you noticed on the path, not a forecast of the sky.

name: TwentyFour Game
description:
Can you make 24 from four numbers?

Use each number once. Add, subtract, multiply or divide to reach 24.

Play at your own pace in Classic mode or race the clock in 60s mode. Choose Easy, Medium, Hard or Random to vary the challenge.

Stuck on a puzzle? Use Hint for a clue or Solution to see one way to reach 24.

Unlimited Hints is available as an optional one-time in-app purchase.

name: Tyler Bowman Photography
description:
Your game, school and family photos from Dothan and the Wiregrass, ready to buy, save and share.

YOUR PHOTOS, READY TO SAVE
Sign in with your email. No password needed. Your player's photos, the albums you bought and your session photos are all here, full size with no watermark. Tap Save All to put them in your Photos app, or share them in a tap.

KNOW WHEN THEY'RE READY
Get a notification the moment your photos are in.

NEW ALBUMS FROM GAMES AND SCHOOL EVENTS
Browse albums from games, homecoming, prom and school performances. Tap any preview to see it full screen, then pick your favorites on tylerbowmanphotos.com. Turn on new album alerts to hear when a new album goes up.

REGISTER BEFORE THE GAME
Sign your player up for an event in a minute. Pay with Apple Pay, card or Zelle on a secure page. Registering before the game costs less than after.

REQUEST A SESSION
Sports players, families, schools and teams, portraits and seniors, and events. Send a request; nothing is booked until we confirm the day and time by text or email.

Questions? Call or text (334) 655-0130.

name: TynpheroDusmik
description: Nitrogen generator calculator: flow, purity, PSA and membrane design, compressor energy and buffer reserve.

name: U Collections
description:
Build a personal archive you can search, organize and enrich over time. U Collections brings together an inventory register, themed collections and a loan register for the objects you want to keep.

1.Object catalog  
Each record receives a stable accession number. Record category, condition, storage location, source, material and quantity. Add photos, voice notes, text, tags and an optional location, then keep dated care and observation notes.

2.Themed collections  
Group botanical specimens, minerals, postcards or other objects into collections. Browse related records together and mark favorite objects for quick filtering.

3.Loans and returns  
Record a borrower and expected return date in an object's passport. Review outstanding loans by due date and see overdue items. Record a return while retaining the loan history in the original passport. The app does not send return reminders.

4.Search and export  
Filter the inventory by category or favorites. Search names, tags, accession numbers, sources and storage locations. Export the current filtered inventory as CSV or share illustrated object cards.

5.Local storage  
No account is required. Core collection management works offline, with local backup and restore including media attachments. Designed for iPhone and iPad with light and dark appearances. Choose system language, English or Simplified Chinese in Settings. Startup version checks require internet.  
  
Privacy policy:https://docs.qq.com/doc/DVmF5T2Z3ektpdVVE

name: UlbranTip
description: UlbranTip helps you remember the small but important jobs that keep a home running smoothly—from HVAC filters and smoke alarm tests to appliance cleanups and seasonal checks.

name: Umatchi
description:
Umatchi is a matchmaker, not a feed.

Tell Umatchi who you hope to meet, in your own words. It introduces people who fit, and tells you why each one could be right for you.

OPEN NOW: DATING
- Chat with your matchmaker by text, voice, photo or video.
- Get introductions with the reasons each person fits. Like or pass, or ask for more.
- See who liked you, and know when it's a match.
- Set the ages you'd like to meet and what matters most to you.

COMING NEXT
The same matchmaker is coming for jobs, events, restaurants, venues, real estate, businesses and investors. Join the waiting list for any of them from your profile, and we'll email you as soon as it opens.

LETTERS
When you match, talk in Letters: messages, voice notes, photos and files, reactions, replies, read receipts and typing indicators. Pin, mute or archive conversations, and call your matches with voice or video.

YOUR PROFILE, YOUR PREFERENCES
- Build a profile with photos, prompts and the details that describe you.
- Set your preferences and how much each one matters.
- Verify your face to show you are who your photos say you are.

SAFE AND IN CONTROL
- Report or block anyone, unmatch at any time.
- Choose who can find you: everyone, discreetly with blurred photos, or no one.
- Delete your account whenever you want.

Umatchi is available in English and Arabic.

Umatchi is for adults 18 and over.

name: Unora: Table Rotation
description:
Make every round easier to host.

Unora helps you plan table rotations for small gatherings, reading groups and adult social activities. Add guest display names, set your table capacities and create one to six rounds. Generate a suggested plan, adjust it yourself and see which pairs share a table more than once.

A complete planning flow:
• Organize gatherings and reuse table and round setups.
• Add guests one by one or paste a list of names.
• Set table capacities and fixed tables for individual rounds.
• Review each round, move guests to open tables or swap two guests.
• See repeated pairs, the rounds where they meet and each guest’s different tablemates.
• Keep named plan versions and restore a previous arrangement with its matching inputs.
• Preview host table sheets or personal route cards as PDF, on A4 or Letter paper.
• Choose Modern or Classic print typography for international guest names.
• Export table assignments as CSV and back up your library as JSON.

Your planning stays on your device. Core features work offline, with no account, advertising, payment or cloud service. Files leave the app only when you choose to save or share them.

Unora supports up to 48 guests, 12 tables and six rounds per gathering. Suggested plans aim to reduce repeated co-seating; they do not guarantee a globally optimal or repeat-free result. Review your final arrangements before your event.

Try the editable fictional sample, then build a gathering of your own.

name: UrbanTrip Corridas
description:
UrbanTrip is a ride-hailing app made for Brazilian cities, with an AI assistant on board every ride.

REQUEST A RIDE IN SECONDS
- Choose your destination and see the price before you confirm. The price is locked for a few minutes.
- Categories for every need: Trip, Trip Comfort, Trip Mulher (women drivers for women passengers) and car deliveries.
- Add up to 2 stops, schedule rides up to 7 days ahead, or request a ride for someone else.
- See the driver arriving on the map, with name, photo, car model and plate.

SAFETY FIRST
- Boarding PIN: the trip only starts after you give the driver your 4-digit code.
- Share your trip with trusted contacts and use the SOS button at any time.
- Route monitoring: you are alerted if the car leaves the expected route or stops for too long.
- All drivers have their documents checked before driving.

AWNI, YOUR AI ASSISTANT
- Ask Awni about your ride, payments, credits and lost items.
- Accessibility mode for visually impaired passengers: request a ride by voice and hear the trip information.

PAY YOUR WAY
- Pay the driver directly, using the payment methods accepted in your city.
- Rate your driver and add a tip.

UrbanTrip operates in partner cities in Brazil through local franchises. Prices are shown in Brazilian reais (R$).

name: UrbanTrip Driver
description:
UrbanTrip Driver is the app for approved UrbanTrip drivers in Brazilian cities, with Awni, an AI copilot, on board.

RECEIVE RIDES
- Go online and get ride offers with pickup distance, trip distance and how much you earn per km, before accepting.
- Built-in navigation to the pickup point and to the destination.
- Boarding PIN: confirm the passenger's 4-digit code before starting the trip.

AWNI, YOUR AI COPILOT
- Daily report: earnings, kilometers, fuel and car costs, and what was left in your pocket.
- Daily and weekly goals, high-demand alerts and the best regions to go.
- Car cost calculator to know your real cost per km.

SAFETY
- Trip monitoring, SOS button and identity check with a selfie.
- Documents (driver's license, vehicle registration and proof of address) checked by AI and by the local office.

YOUR WAY
- Up to 2 vehicles (own or rented): choose which car you will drive before going online.
- Earnings history by day, week and month.

UrbanTrip operates in partner cities in Brazil through local franchises. Values are shown in Brazilian reais (R$).

name: US Citizenship Test: Qwok
description:
Qwok is an independent practice app made by AZM Tech Pty Ltd. It is not a government app and does not represent any government entity.

Get ready for the US citizenship test: the civics part of your naturalization interview with practice built on the official 2025 civics test from USCIS.

THE REAL TEST
The civics test is spoken. The officer asks you up to 20 of the 128 official questions, and you need 12 correct answers to pass. The mock test in this app asks 20 questions with the same pass mark. If you filed Form N-400 before October 20, 2025, you take the older 2008 test instead (10 questions, 6 to pass).

WHAT'S INSIDE
• 330+ multiple-choice questions built from the 128 official civics questions
• Every answer explains the accepted answers USCIS lists, not just one
• Mock civics tests with the real pass mark
• 65/20 mode: if you are 65 or older and have been a permanent resident for 20+ years, study only the 20 marked questions and take a 10-question mock test (6 to pass)
• Practice by topic or all questions, review your mistakes and save tricky questions
• A readiness score, daily goal and streak
• Official USCIS study materials, answer updates and Form N-400 information, one tap away
• Interview practice: the 128 civics questions read aloud, you answer out loud and mark yourself, and it stops at 12 right or 9 wrong, like the officer (65/20 mode too)
• Your state's answers: your senators, governor and state capital, plus the President, Vice President, Speaker of the House and Chief Justice
• English test practice: reading and writing (dictation) using only the official USCIS vocabulary lists
• Light and dark mode. Works offline. No account needed.

Some answers change with elections or depend on where you live (for example, your state's governor). Check the USCIS answer updates page, linked in the app, before your interview. The speaking part of the English test is your interview itself, so practice answering out loud.

FREE TO USE
Every question is free. The app shows a small banner ad, kept clear of the answer buttons, and an occasional full-screen ad after a mock test. You get 2 free mock tests a day and can watch a short ad for one more. An optional one-off purchase removes all ads and unlocks unlimited mock tests.

WHERE THE QUESTIONS COME FROM
128 Civics Questions and Answers (2025 version), USCIS form M-1778, a US government work in the public domain.
Official source: https://www.uscis.gov/citizenship-resource-center/naturalization-test-and-study-resources/2025-civics-test

IMPORTANT
Qwok is an independent practice app made by AZM Tech Pty Ltd. It is not affiliated with, or endorsed by, US Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) or any government agency. It does not give legal or immigration advice. You take the real test at your naturalization interview, not through this app.

Support: services@azmtech.com.au
Privacy: https://azmtech.com.au/privacy

name: Usverra
description:
Usverra is a dating app for adults who want to get to know the person behind the profile. Discover people through their interests, stories and answers while photos stay private.

MEET PEOPLE NEARBY
GPS is required to use Usverra. Discover people in the same region, within a maximum distance of 50 km. Your exact location is not shown to other members.

TALK BEFORE REVEALING
When you match, start a conversation. After both people send a first message, spend two weeks getting to know each other before choosing whether to reveal photos. Both people must agree.

CHOOSE YOUR PACE
Standard photo reveal is free after 14 days. An optional paid Reveal Pass can make a pair eligible from day 7, with both people’s consent. After revealing, you have two more months to chat before choosing whether you would like to meet. Meeting is always optional.

STAY IN CONTROL
Pause discovery, block or report a member, and delete your account from the app.

Usverra is for adults aged 18 and over.

name: Vairalens Translate
description:
VairaLens Translate turns the world around you into readable text — AR scenes, short dramas, menus, signs, documents, videos, web pages and live speech.

• AR — point your camera at the world and see translations overlaid on the scene
• Short Drama — translate short-form videos: audio-to-subtitle, translated on the original timeline
• Text & Photo — type or snap anything to translate instantly
• Document — translate PDF, DOCX and more while keeping the original layout
• Subtitle — import SRT/VTT files and translate them with timing preserved
• Web — translate any website in place and keep browsing
• Talk & Live — bilingual conversations, plus real-time PiP subtitles that follow you into any app

On-device-first processing via Apple Translation, with an optional cloud engine — no account required, no personal data collected.

Switch languages on the fly, review your history, and pick a speaking style for voice playback.

Questions? Contact us at 19151016285@163.com.

Website: https://vairalens-translate.pages.dev
Support: https://vairalens-translate.pages.dev
Privacy Policy: https://vairalens-translate.pages.dev/#privacy
Terms of Service: https://vairalens-translate.pages.dev/#terms

name: VC2C: Visiting Card to Contact
description:
Turn a visiting card into a phone contact, and follow up the same day.

Scan the front of the card, and the back if it has details. VC2C reads the text on your phone, fills in the name, job title, company, numbers, email, website and address, and marks anything that needs a second look. Check the details, then save.

SCAN A WHOLE PILE
Back from a trade fair with a stack of cards? Scan them one after another and save all the clear ones in one go. Event Mode tags every new card with where you met.

READS QR CODES TOO
When a card carries a contact QR code, VC2C uses its exact details.

FOLLOW UP IN ONE TAP
Send your own WhatsApp message or email, with the person's name and where you met filled in. Set a reminder so no lead goes cold.

READS ON YOUR DEVICE
Text is read on your phone, so scanning works at a trade show or meeting with no signal. On Android, Google's scanner component may need to download once first.

READS INDIAN LANGUAGES
Hindi and Marathi cards are read straight away. Add Telugu, Tamil, Gujarati, Kannada, Bengali, Assamese, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia or Urdu in Settings, up to two at a time: each is a one-time download, then works offline. For a card the phone can't read well, signed-in users can tap Read with AI. The app asks first, the photo is read by our own AI server and not kept, and you check every field before saving.

KEEP EVERY CARD
VC2C keeps both sides of the card with your notes, tags and where you met. Find any card by name, company, number, notes or event.

YOU STAY IN CONTROL
VC2C doesn't read your address book. It opens your phone's own New Contact screen, and you decide what gets saved. Or turn on Save to Contacts Automatically, which asks for permission to add contacts. Lock VC2C with your fingerprint, face or screen lock.

EXPORT TO EXCEL, GOOGLE SHEETS, ZOHO AND HUBSPOT
Export all your cards, or just one event, tag or search, as a file for Excel or Google Sheets, Google Contacts, Zoho CRM or Bigin, HubSpot or Salesforce. Import a contact file (.vcf) or spreadsheet (.csv), or save a full backup file with the card photos and restore it on any phone.

FIND DUPLICATES, WORK WITH MANY CARDS
VC2C finds cards that share a mobile number or email, and you choose which to keep. Select many cards to tag, export or delete together.

SHARE YOUR OWN CARD
Keep your own details in My Card and share them as a QR code, a contact file or a WhatsApp message.

TEAMS
Invite up to 25 colleagues by email and share the cards you choose, with their photos. Everyone in the team can search them and save any to their own list.

OPTIONAL ACCOUNT
No account is needed. Sign in with your email to back up and sync, open your cards on a computer at vc2c.aravir.in/cards, or share chosen cards with a team. Team members see each other's email addresses and the cards shared with the team.

The app is available in English and 22 Indian languages, including Hindi, Bengali, Telugu, Tamil, Marathi and Urdu. The card image is always kept, whatever language it is printed in.

name: VedNexor
description: VedNexor provides a simple and intuitive interface for recording inventory discrepancies, tracking corrective actions, and reviewing resolution results. It also includes reference calculators for warehouse operations, covering loading, retrieval, delivery, capacity, and resource metrics. All records are stored locally on the device for convenient access and management.

name: Velquari Star Stacks
description:
Velquari Star Stacks brings three original tile-sorting puzzles to your fingertips, each with its own layout, rules, and rhythm.

In Helix Weave, unwind a spiral braid of tiles and build eight towers by suit from Ace to King. Five holders refill from the braid while you manage a recycling stream — timing your draws is key.

Lantern Core hides thirteen tiles in a glowing core at the center of the board. Free them through five rotating crowns, route tiles across three streams, and fill eight towers before your single recycle runs out.

Windspire arranges holders on an elliptical ring around a central hub. The hub climbs from Ace upward and wraps back around, while four vanes descend from King. Moving tiles between vanes and hub opens new paths as the mill turns.

Every day, all three puzzles share the same global layout so everyone faces the same challenge. Complete the Daily Weave trio or play unlimited free rounds with fresh shuffles.

Each tile you place rings a synthesized chime tuned to a pentatonic scale — building a tower produces a rising melody. Haptic feedback accompanies every move and milestone.

Track your sessions in the Chronicle, review solve rates and streaks in Insights, and light stars on a constellation map as you reach twelve milestones — from your first solve to a sub-six-minute finish. Stars connect with golden lines as more milestones unlock.

Hints highlight valid moves when you are stuck, and unlimited undo lets you rewind freely without penalty. A glow rating rewards clean, fast solves while keeping the experience welcoming for all skill levels.

name: Veluto Meloora
description:
Discover trending movies and TV shows, watch official trailers, capture your memorable moments, and listen to your own music, all in one personal app.

DISCOVER MOVIES & TV SHOWS
Stay up to date with trending and popular movies every day. Search by title or browse by your favorite genres, and explore detailed info, seasons, and official trailers. Save your favorite movies to revisit anytime.

CAPTURE YOUR MOMENTS
Create moments with photos, videos, music, and your thoughts. Add hashtags to organize and revisit memories with ease, and search and filter your moments by topic in a single tap. View each moment in detail, complete with its photos and soundtrack.

YOUR MUSIC
Import songs from your device and listen anytime, anywhere. Use a full-featured player with shuffle, repeat, and seek, and jump back into recent tracks with your listening history.

PERSONAL PROFILE
Customize your avatar and display name, and track your stats: songs, favorite movies, and saved moments.

DESIGN & LANGUAGES
An elegant dark interface that's easy on the eyes, available in English, French, and Spanish.

Your data is stored right on your device, so your moments, music, and favorites stay private.

Download now and make every moment, movie, and song your own.

name: Veylwind
description:
Veylwind is a casual top-down sailing race game. You steer a small sailboat across open water, trim the sail to catch the wind, pass checkpoint buoys, avoid rocks and driftwood, and reach the finish as fast as you can.

Unlike normal racing games, you do not press a gas pedal. Speed comes from reading the wind and adjusting your sail angle. Short races, clear controls, and star ratings make every level easy to learn and rewarding to replay.

Features: • Wind-based sailing physics — sail angle truly affects boat speed
• Touch controls for steering and sail trim
• Multiple challenge levels with rising difficulty
• Checkpoint buoys, ocean obstacles, and timed finishes
• Star ratings and best-time tracking
• Fully offline — no account, no ads, no network required
• Music, SFX, haptics, and sensitivity settings

Catch the wind. Beat the tide. Master Veylwind.

name: Viktory Boutique
description: Retrouve Viktory, ta boutique de mode féminine de Battice, directement sur ton téléphone  Découvre nos nouvelles collections et pioche des idées de looks casual chic pour le quotidien et les occasions. Du jean qui va avec tout à la robe que tu as envie de sortir le samedi soir, retrouve des pièces faciles à porter et à associer. Explore la collection et commande tes coups de cœur directement dans l’appli Viktory.

name: Vintelle: Film Photo Editor
description:
Turn everyday photos into beautiful, nostalgic edits with Vintelle — your free, offline photo editor for film-inspired looks, digicam colors, dreamy sunsets, and subtle editorial finishes.

Discover 24 carefully crafted photo filters, customize your favorite looks, and create photos worth sharing. No subscriptions, no accounts, and no internet required.

24 FILTERS. FOUR DISTINCT MOODS.

DIGICAM & FLASH
Bring back the nostalgic charm of digital cameras with Y2K colors, night-out contrast, cool tones, and warm flash-inspired effects.

FILM & VINTAGE
Give your photos a timeless, analog-inspired finish with film grain, faded colors, soft highlights, and disposable-camera aesthetics.

DREAMY & SUNSET
Create warm, atmospheric photos with golden tones, soft glow, pastel colors, and dreamy sunset-inspired filters.

EVERYDAY & EDITORIAL
Make everyday moments stand out with refined colors, natural-looking tones, subtle contrast, and elegant editorial presets.

EDIT YOUR PHOTOS YOUR WAY

- Explore 24 unique photo filters across four collections.
- Apply beautiful filters with a single tap.
- Adjust filter intensity to create your perfect look.
- Fine-tune brightness, contrast, saturation, warmth, and more.
- Crop, zoom, and reposition photos to improve composition.
- Compare your edited photo with the original.
- Undo and redo changes while editing.
- Save high-quality JPEG photos to your device.
- Revisit your saved creations in My Edits.
- Share your favorite edits with friends.

YOUR PHOTOS. YOUR PRIVACY.

Vintelle processes your photos directly on your device. Your images are never uploaded to our servers.

Enjoy photo editing with:

- All 24 filters completely free.
- No subscriptions or in-app purchases.
- No advertisements.
- No account registration.
- No cloud processing.
- No generative AI.
- No internet connection required.

Your original photos remain unchanged, so you can explore different looks without losing your memories.

MAKE EVERY MOMENT A MOOD.

Whether you're editing a sunset, a night out, a travel memory, a portrait, or an everyday snapshot, Vintelle helps you create the aesthetic that feels right for you.

Discover your favorite look. Make it yours. Save the moment.

Vintelle — Photography, with feeling.

name: Vireludo
description:
Vireludo is a quiet corner for small games. Classic patience card layouts, a curling-inspired aiming match, a paddle rally that measures the steadiness of your hand — three distinct ways to pass the time, all wrapped in the same gentle garden and timed by the same sundial.

Built for the moments between everything else. A short break between meetings. A late evening on the couch. A quiet afternoon with no agenda. Vireludo opens straight into play, remembers every game you start, and never pushes you forward with timers unless you ask for one.

 WHAT'S INSIDE

• Patience card layouts with hints on tap and undo on demand. Start a quick run, step away mid-game, and come back exactly where you left off.

• A curling-inspired table where you aim, nudge, and read the lie of the ice. Short rounds for short breaks, longer runs when you want to settle in.

• A paddle rally that scales with how steady you keep the volley. No pressure, no leaderboards — just you and the arc of the ball.

• A single garden hub that remembers your matches across all three modes. Every run goes into the history view, every milestone marked by a sundial that keeps time without hurrying you.

MADE WITH CARE

• Hand-crafted card art and chapter illustrations
• Light and dark themes that drift with the garden's mood
• Landscape-only layouts tuned for both iPhone and iPad
• Sound design that sits quietly in the background — on by default, one tap to silence

 RESPECT FOR YOUR TIME

• Fully playable offline — no account, no sign-up, no interruptions during a round
• No forced notifications
• All of your progress stays on your device

Vireludo is designed to feel like a place you can return to. The deck will always be shuffled. The curling ice will always be waiting. The paddle will always be in your hand. Open it when you need a breath, close it when you're done.

Questions, feedback, or just saying hello? Reach out through Settings → About.

name: VisitFlow: Visitor Sign-In
description:
VisitFlow turns an iPad into a clean, simple sign-in kiosk for your reception. Visitors sign themselves in on arrival and out when they leave, so you always know who is on site.

HOW IT WORKS
• Visitors tap Sign in, enter their name and company, and can be handed a visitor pass or key
• When leaving, they tap Sign out and choose their name
• In admin (protected by a PIN) you see who is in, who visited today and which passes are out

PRIVACY FIRST
• Everything stays on the iPad: no account, no cloud, no tracking
• Records are deleted automatically after the retention period you choose
• Visitors cannot see who came before them
• Log of all admin actions
• PIN with lockout after too many wrong attempts

MADE FOR RECEPTION
• Works without internet
• Visitors choose their language: English, Dutch, German, French or Spanish
• Evacuation list in one tap: on screen, printed or shared as PDF
• Export to a spreadsheet (CSV)
• For iPad and iPhone; combine with Guided Access for a true kiosk

FREE
Sign-in and sign-out, up to 10 numbered passes, evacuation list, export, log and retention period are free, with no limit on the number of visitors.

VISITFLOW PRO
Make the kiosk truly your organisation's own:
• Your own logo and colours, including the name in "Welcome to"
• Your own welcome text
• Unlimited passes and keys, with custom names
• Have visitors accept house rules or confidentiality, with signature
• Share the setup with other iPads
• Without the "Made with VisitFlow" footer

Pro costs €1.99 per month or €19.99 per year (or the equivalent in your currency), with the first month free. The subscription renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period in your Apple Account settings. If you stop Pro, your settings are kept and the app keeps working.

Privacy policy: https://visitflow.website/en/privacy
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

name: VisuTodo: Your life on a desk
description:
VisuTodo shows your Todoist tasks as cards on a desk.
Drag them, group them and see your whole day at once.

• Infinite desk with zoom.
• Projects mode: each project is a block, with areas for its sections.
• Dates mode: columns for overdue, today, tomorrow and the week. Drop a card in another column and the due date changes in Todoist.
• Drawer mode: up to 7 tasks on the desk, the rest put away.
• Links between tasks, sticky notes and quick search.
• Type the way you talk: "Call the client tomorrow at 9 !! #Work" becomes a date, priority and project.
• Works offline.

Privacy: your Todoist access stays on your device. No ads, no tracking.

No account? Tap "Try without an account".

App languages: English and Portuguese.
Independent project, not affiliated with Doist, the company that makes Todoist.

name: VLXFlow
description:
Good records should not feel like extra work. This app keeps the numbers that matter in one place, so the day closes with a clear picture rather than a pile of notes.

Costs, prices and what is still owed settle together as the work moves on. What was spent, what came in and what is left stay close to one another, and nothing has to be written twice.

It is meant to be opened briefly and understood at a glance, with nothing to arrange and nothing to keep tidy. No subscription: the figures stay where the work happens.

name: Voice Dream Journal
description:
Dreams fade within minutes of waking. Tap one big button and say what you saw, before it's gone.
Every recording is saved with today's date as a private voice entry on your iPhone.
No typing, no account, no setup. Just wake up, tap Record and talk.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Open the app. The Record button is right there.
2. Tell your dream out loud. The clock shows how long you've been talking.
3. Tap Save. Your dream is in your journal, dated and ready to replay.

SAVE DREAMS BY DATE
Your journal is a simple list, newest first, grouped by month. Each dream shows its day, time and length.

LISTEN BACK ANYTIME
Play any dream with one tap, scrub through it, and give it a title when you're awake enough to name it.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- Recordings stay on your iPhone. Nothing is uploaded.
- No account, no ads, no tracking
- Rename or delete any entry whenever you like
- If a call interrupts you, what you already said is kept

PREMIUM
- Tag dreams like Lucid, Recurring or Nightmare
- Filter your journal by tag to find patterns
- Export many recordings at once with the share sheet

SUBSCRIPTION
Premium is optional: $2.99 per week with a 3-day free trial, or $14.99 per year. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings › your name › Subscriptions.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://motleystudio.site/voice-dream-journal/privacy
Terms: https://motleystudio.site/voice-dream-journal/terms

name: VoiceFlying
description:
Pilotez sans quitter le ciel des yeux, ou sans le voir du tout : VoiceFlying annonce à la voix, dans votre casque, tout ce que vos instruments affichent.

Conçue avec et pour les pilotes aveugles et malvoyants, elle sert tout autant aux pilotes voyants qui veulent garder les yeux dehors.

CE QUI LA REND UNIQUE
• Tout se fait à la voix : posez une question (« cap ? », « altitude ? », « distance ? »), l'app répond.
• Entièrement utilisable avec VoiceOver, un clavier Bluetooth ou le bouton de votre casque.
• Les alertes ne sont jamais coupées : une file d'annonces donne toujours la priorité à la sécurité.
• Fonctionne écran verrouillé, sans abonnement, sans compte, sans publicité.

EN VOL
• Cap, altitude QNH, hauteur sol estimée, vitesse sol et vario annoncés en phraséologie aéronautique.
• Horizon sonore : un bip qui accélère avec l'inclinaison, aigu en montée, grave en descente.
• Alertes vocales de vitesse, d'altitude, d'inclinaison et d'assiette, avec vibrations distinctes.
• Détection automatique du décollage et de l'atterrissage.

NAVIGATION
• Routes à plusieurs points tournants : cap, distance et heure d'arrivée estimée annoncés.
• Annonce de chaque verticale et du point suivant, conseils de correction de cap.
• Carte de la trace et de la route.

CHECK-LISTS VOCALES
• Lues point par point, validées en disant « vérifié » ou d'une touche.
• Proposées au bon moment : avant décollage, croisière, approche, après atterrissage.
• Entièrement modifiables pour coller au manuel de votre appareil.

RAPPELS ET MÉTÉO
• Changement de réservoir, autonomie carburant, temps de vol, chrono.
• QNH du terrain le plus proche en un geste (METAR), annonce de la météo.

VOTRE APPAREIL, VOS UNITÉS
• Profils ULM, avion, planeur, parapente : vitesses clés, seuils et carburant.
• Pieds et nœuds, ou mètres et km/h.

CARNET DE VOL
• Chaque vol est enregistré automatiquement : durée, distance, altitude maximale.
• Statistiques, records, heures par appareil, export PDF, CSV et GPX.

PRISE EN MAIN GUIDÉE
• Un tutoriel vocal explique comment fixer le téléphone, calibrer l'horizon, associer un casque ou un clavier, et parler à l'app.
• Très grands caractères, thème jaune sur noir à fort contraste.

CONFIDENTIALITÉ
• Vos vols, routes et réglages restent sur votre iPhone.
• Aucun compte, aucun pistage, aucune publicité.
• Seule votre position est transmise, sans aucun identifiant, aux services publics de relief et de météo pour calculer la hauteur sol et trouver le METAR le plus proche.

IMPORTANT
VoiceFlying est une aide complémentaire. Elle ne remplace ni les instruments de bord certifiés, ni la préparation du vol, ni le pilote ou l'instructeur présent à bord. Respectez toujours la réglementation en vigueur.

Assistance : https://schmittutility.fr/assistance/

name: VP Restock Center
description: Integra tus facturas en un calendario de flujo de caja, realizando un seguimiento del saldo al cierre de cada jornada para cada cuenta. Al identificar los descensos en la línea temporal, podrás determinar con precisión cuándo es necesario realizar transferencias de fondos con antelación. Compara distintas estrategias de financiación —como transferir el importe total de una sola vez frente a realizar varias transferencias de menor cuantía— analizando los saldos diarios proyectados, y elige la opción más adecuada. Una vez procesado un pago, puedes asignar un mismo gasto a varias facturas, registrar pagos a plazos y desglosar por separado los recargos por demora que se hayan generado. Al finalizar el mes, compara tu plan inicial con los importes efectivamente pagados; podrás rastrear cada transacción hasta la factura original para verificar si hubo pagos reprogramados, importes ajustados o saldos pendientes.

name: WA 五笔
description:
WA 五笔是一款原生 86 五笔输入法，包含 iPhone 和 iPad 系统键盘扩展。添加键盘后，可在支持第三方键盘的 App 中使用。内置码表支持离线输入，基本打字无需开启完全访问。

按自己的习惯输入
• 保留熟悉的 26 键位置。可设置候选字号、横竖布局和自动调序。
• 在手机或浮动键盘上，按住字母键左右滑，松手前可以改选按键。可另行开启空码就近纠正。
• 上滑输入键帽角标，双击 Shift 锁定大写，长按空格左右滑动移动光标。

为大屏安排双手键位
• iPad 和 iPhone Duo 大屏可左右分区。符号在左，数字小键盘在右。
• 双指捏合可缩成小键盘，再用底部手柄在键盘区域内移动。

带上你的词库
• 支持导入搜狗细胞词库、Rime 码表与文本词表，并可浏览在线词库。
• 可开启自动加词。允许完全访问后，扩展才可向主 App 的共享词库写入学习结果。
• 可选用 iCloud 同步设置和词库，与同一 Apple 账户下的 WA 五笔 Mac 版共享。

主 App 提供练习、词库管理和设置。系统听写由 iOS 提供，是否显示取决于系统和当前输入场景。

name: Waddle Pop: Duck Puzzle
description:
Meet your hungry little pixel duck in Waddle Pop — a fast, charming 8x8 grid collecting puzzle!

Slide across the board to scoop up strawberries, flowers, snakes, and golden eggs. Group matching tiles into bigger clusters for bonus points, chain consecutive matches of the same item to trigger x2 and x3 combo multipliers, and watch out for hazards that shrink your safe space! 

[Features]
• Easy to Learn, Hard to Put Down
Simple directional controls (swipe or tap the pixel D-pad) with crisp haptic feedback and retro synth sound effects.

• Cluster & Combo Strategy
Pop bigger clusters for massive score boosts, or chain the same item 2–3 times in a row for x2 and x3 combo multipliers.

• Rising Challenge
Every few moves, new hazards appear on the board — plan your path carefully before you get boxed in!

• Pure Offline Arcade Fun
No ads, no in-app purchases, and no account required. Play anytime, anywhere.

name: Wake Up Words
description:
Rise with your own words.

Wake Up Words is an alarm clock that reads a message aloud when it rings: a bit of motivation, an affirmation, a reminder, or anything you write yourself, spoken in a warm, natural voice over optional quiet music.

MESSAGES FOR EVERY PART OF YOUR DAY
• Eight starter folders written for the app: Morning Motivation, Affirmations, Calm & Breathe, Focus & Work, Health & Habits, Gratitude, Wind Down, and My Reminders.
• Add, edit, and move your own messages. Star your favorites.
• Create, rename, and recolor folders, or hide the ones you don't need.

ALARMS THAT TALK TO YOU
• Each alarm reads one message, a random message from a folder, or a random favorite.
• Give every alarm its own time, days, voice, and background music.
• Also repeat during the day, every few minutes or hours until the time you choose, with a different message each time. Great for water breaks, stretch reminders, and a boost through the afternoon.

READ ALONG AS IT'S SPOKEN
• Open the alarm to see your message in large type, with each word highlighted as it is read, until you snooze or stop.

MORE WAYS TO LISTEN
• Playlist: play all your messages, your favorites, or one folder, with a short breathing pause in between.
• Nightstand: a silent bedside clock that shows one message at a time.
• Message Frame: a talking picture frame that shows a message and reads each new one aloud.
• Today's note: one of your favorites, waiting for you each day.

MAKE IT YOURS
• Light, Dark, or Automatic appearance and adjustable text size.
• Choose any voice installed on your device and try it first.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no ads, no tracking, and no internet connection needed. Everything stays on your device.

PRICING
Free to download with a 7-day free trial of everything. Afterwards, one alarm and up to 3 of your own messages stay free, or unlock everything with a one-time purchase. No subscription.

REQUIREMENTS
iOS 17 or later. Scheduled alarms use Apple's AlarmKit and need iOS 26 or later; folders, the playlist, and Nightstand work on iOS 17 and later.

name: Walls for free
description:
Walls for free is a wallpaper gallery for phones with two screens.

Every wallpaper in the collection is cut twice: a tall 1398 × 2034 version for the cover screen and a wide 2670 × 1878 version for the open inner screen, so both displays get a picture made for their exact shape — no cropping, no black bars.

- Preview first: the top of the app shows the selected wallpaper on both screens side by side, at their real shapes
- Hot and Latest tabs, plus categories (Nature, Sea & Sky, Space, City, Abstract) and search
- Favorites: tap the heart on any wallpaper and it waits for you in the Favorites tab
- Save to Photos: wallpapers are saved into a "Walls for free" album in your Photos, ready to set as your wallpaper

The app is fully offline. No account, no ads, no tracking — it does not collect any data.

name: Walnut Grove LIVE
description:
Game day moves fast. WG LIVE keeps up.

Photos reach your phone while the game is still being played — not next week, not after the photographer gets home. Your sideline photographer uploads from the field, and the gallery fills in as it happens.


HOW IT WORKS

1. Get the event PIN from the photographer covering the game.
2. Enter the photographer's username, your photographer PIN, and the 5-digit event PIN.
3. Watch the photos arrive. The gallery refreshes itself every 30 seconds while you have it open.

Tap any photo to open it full screen. Save it to your camera roll or send it straight to the group chat — these are your photos to keep and share.


WHAT'S INSIDE

LIVE — the event gallery, refreshing on its own while you watch.

SPONSOR — the local businesses and boosters who make the coverage possible.

MORE — version and legal information.


WHAT YOU NEED

WG LIVE is built around a single event at a time. You will need an event PIN from the photographer covering that game; without one there is nothing to show. There is no account to create, no password to remember, and nothing to sign up for.


PRESENTED BY THE GROVE GRIDIRON CLUB

The Grove Gridiron Club is a 501(c)(3) non-profit supporting the Walnut Grove Wildcat football program. Membership goes directly to the student-athletes — equipment, uniforms, game day logistics, nutrition and ongoing support services.

Local business? The club handles sponsorships for the program, and the SPONSOR tab will point you their way.


POWERED BY FIELD2FAN

Field2Fan is the delivery platform behind the gallery, carrying photos from the photographer's camera to the people still sitting in the stands.


——

WG LIVE is not an official Walnut Grove High School app and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the school. Walnut Grove High School names, logos and marks are the property of Walnut Grove High School and its district. Photographs remain the property of their respective photographer.

name: Warsweeper: Orc Strategy
description:
Minesweeper meets orc strategy.

It starts with one tap on a grey grid. Then the war camp rises.

Warsweeper turns classic minesweeper deduction into a real-time orc strategy game. Read the number clues, send your orcs to dig, build a camp on the land you clear, and decide for yourself when the fighting starts.

DIG BY THE NUMBERS
Every number counts what sleeps nearby: blue for graves, red for the crypt, burning for the boss. Dig around the danger, open the land one safe step at a time and wake the enemy only when your army is ready.

BUILD YOUR FORTRESS
The Great Hall brings the workers, huts give them room to live and farms earn supplies. Barracks train warriors, the windmill speeds up the farms beside it and the War Forge turns recruits into Maulers. Ring your camp with palisade walls and watch towers, then hold the walls when the dead come for you.

RIVERS, FORESTS AND STORMS
Meadows open into rivers, bridges, forests and snowy peaks. The weather plays too: rain speeds up farms, snow slows them and lightning sets the ground ablaze. Raise a sprawling camp and watch the whole battle on one screen.

HOLD OFF THE UNDEAD
Graves crack open. Crypts call portals of skeleton archers. Break the crypt, clear the graves and keep the Great Hall standing.

SLAY THE BONE DRAGON
Somewhere under the tiles a burning number hides the boss. Wake it, hold the line and bring it down.

DELVE INTO DUNGEONS
Below the camp lie the dwarves' forgotten halls. Dig down floor after floor, through the Halls, Malvein's Forge and the Ogre Halls, face the Vein Wyrm and bring back elixir and keys.

AN EPIC STORY
Warchief Urgak dreams of the dead on his land and a shadow in a crown above them. Follow the chief from the southern meadows to the frozen north, where an ancient king crowned in bone is waking.

COLLECT AND UPGRADE CARDS
Win missions to open chests and collect cards. Copies and elixir raise a card, and the new level counts from your next battle, so your buildings and your army grow stronger.

SHORT BATTLES, YOUR PACE
A mission takes a few minutes. Pause whenever you need to think. The land around your first dig is always safe. Crisp pixel art and a chiptune soundtrack follow every fight.

Read the numbers. Build the camp. Slay the dragon.

name: Waseej
description:
Waseej is the remote control for the Waseej app on Meta Quest headsets. Choose a film, play or pause it, and change the volume and language from your phone, while the person wearing the headset enjoys the full journey.

It suits anyone guiding parents, children or guests through a film, and anyone running several headsets at once.

What you can do:
- Pair a headset with your phone by scanning a QR code or typing a 6-digit code.
- Choose a film and start it from your phone.
- Play, pause, and change the volume and language.
- See each paired headset's connection, battery and whether it is being worn.
- Control a group of headsets together.
- Sign a headset in to your account from your phone.
- Complete daily, weekly and monthly challenges in levels, and earn points.
- Collect ranks and share them.
- Arabic and English, in dark or light mode.

What you need:
- A Meta Quest headset with the Waseej app.
- A Waseej account. Accounts are created on the Waseej website or on the headset. This app has no sign-up and no purchases.

Waseej is not affiliated with Meta. Meta Quest is a trademark of Meta Platforms.

name: WaxDigger
description:
Wax Digger is the price checker for crate diggers. Standing at a flea market, a record fair or a second-hand shop? Find out what a record is really worth in seconds – before you pay.

FIND THE RECORD
• Barcode – point the camera at the back of the sleeve.
• Label – fit the center label in the circle and tap Capture & Search. Wax Digger reads catalog numbers, label names, track lists, artists, websites and even curved text around the label edge.
• Photo – check records you photographed earlier.
• Manual – type catalog number, label, artist or country; every field is optional.

PICK THE EXACT PRESSING
The same catalog number often hides several pressings with very different values. Wax Digger lists every match and shows the matrix/runout codes, so you can compare them with the etchings in the run-out groove and choose the right one.

SEE WHAT IT IS WORTH
• Discogs suggested price for each condition, from Mint to Poor (requires a free Discogs account)
• Lowest price currently for sale and number of copies available
• Have / want counts
• Built-in grading guide to grade the vinyl yourself

GET A VERDICT
Enter the seller's asking price and Wax Digger tells you instantly: Bargain, Fair price or Expensive – also compared with the lowest online price plus estimated shipping.

MADE FOR THE STREET
• History and watchlist saved on your device, available offline
• Fast one-hand use, dark interface
• On devices with Apple Intelligence, labels are understood even better – fully on device

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No ads, no tracking, no AudioLab account. Photos are processed on your device and never uploaded. Discogs sign-in happens on Discogs' own page and is optional.

Data and prices provided by Discogs. Wax Digger uses the Discogs API but is not affiliated with, sponsored or endorsed by Discogs.

name: We are crafters
description:
Learning Guides brings the step-by-step tutorials and patterns for your We Are Knitters, Funem Studio and Pottd kits together in one app.

Pick your brand, then choose where to go:

• Access learning guides: follow video lessons chapter by chapter, from your first stitch to the finishing touches. Search by product, technique or category.
• Access my patterns: find the patterns that came with your order using the email you placed it with. Available for We Are Knitters and Funem Studio, coming soon for Pottd.

Inside the app:
• Knitting and crochet tutorials from We Are Knitters
• Weaving tutorials from Funem Studio
• Tutorials for your Pottd kits
• Guides in English, Spanish, French, Italian and German
• No account needed: each kit's guides unlock with the password printed on the card included in your kit

name: Weather Verdict
description:
Should you do it today? Weather Verdict gives you a straight answer.

Weather apps show you numbers. Weather Verdict tells you what they mean for the thing you actually want to do. Pick your activities and get a simple 0–100 score, a plain-English verdict like “Yes, Tee It Up” or “Wait Until Morning,” and the reason behind it.

Built for the way you spend your time outdoors
Choose from 10 activities: Baseball/Softball, Golf, Cycling, Photography, Fishing, Hiking, Cross-Country Skiing, Downhill Skiing, Snowmobiling and Lawn Mowing. Each one weighs the weather differently. A 15 mph wind ruins a round of golf but barely matters for a hike. Seasonal activities appear when they make sense, and you only see the ones you care about.

Find the best hour, not just the best day
Sunny in the morning, stormy by afternoon? Every activity shows an hour-by-hour ribbon with the best window to go and the hours to avoid. Tap any day in the next two weeks to see how it plays out.

Plan ahead with confidence

Today, 3-day, 7-day and 14-day views
A week-at-a-glance grid that shows every activity at once
A confidence rating on every score, because next Friday’s forecast is less certain than this afternoon’s
“Better around Wed 7 AM” suggestions when waiting beats going now

Safety first
Weather Verdict watches for thunderstorm risk, damaging wind and hail, and poor air quality, and caps the score when conditions are unsafe. In the US, official National Weather Service watches and warnings are built in, and the verdict names the alert so you know exactly why.

More ways to use it

Compare places: rank your saved locations for any activity
Plan an event: pick a date for a tournament, trip or party and watch its verdict change as the forecast firms up
Add to Calendar: put the best window on your calendar in one tap
Notifications: optional heads-ups for great windows and for a window that is about to close
Widgets: your best bet today on the Home Screen and Lock Screen
Save up to 15 places and switch between them instantly
Works offline with your last forecast and a clear “updated 10 min ago” label
Imperial or metric units
Your feedback tunes it: tell the app when a verdict was right or wrong, and scores adjust to your own tolerance for cold, wind and rain
Light and dark mode, on iPhone and iPad

Private by design
No account, no ads, no tracking. Your location is used only to fetch your forecast.

Weather and air quality data by Open-Meteo.com. US alerts from the National Weather Service. Scores are guidance, not a guarantee. Always use your own judgment and heed official warnings.

name: WendrixoFalmun
description: Thermal spray calculator: coating area, coating thickness, spray process, efficiency, pre-treatment, layers and cost per square metre.

name: WEVS
description:
Serious voting, simple enough for anything. Send every voter their private link by email or WhatsApp, watch the turnout live, and get a result that stands.

The voting system built for the toughest elections, now open to anyone: elections, AGMs, resolutions, referendums, polls, awards, whatever your group needs to decide.

This app is for ORGANISERS: the people who set a vote up and run it. Voters do not need the app. They vote from their private link, on any phone or computer.

SET UP ANY VOTE
• Choose people, decide resolutions, or ask any question, on one ballot
• A secret ballot, or a recorded vote where your rules require one
• Upload your voters' roll from a spreadsheet, or add voters one by one
• Groups, so different voters see different questions

RUN IT
• Every voter gets a private link by email or WhatsApp
• A one-time code for each voter, so each person votes once
• Live turnout while the vote is open
• Reminders to the people who have not voted yet
• Automated voter support on WhatsApp, around the clock

CLOSE IT WITH CONFIDENCE
• Results the moment voting closes, hidden from voters until you publish them
• Official minutes as a PDF, and the full results as a spreadsheet
• A record of everything that happened, for when a result is questioned

ON YOUR PHONE
• Notifications when your vote opens, is about to close, and when results are ready
• Your documents downloaded straight to your phone

Free for small votes. Bigger votes are built and tested free, and you pay when you schedule.

WEVS is made by Wolfatek.

name: WFMAsia
description:
WFMAsia 是一款以經典寬頻調頻接收機為靈感的香港網絡廣播應用程式。

轉動 87.5–108.0 MHz 的調諧刻度，探索六條香港電台直播頻道，從新聞、時事、流行音樂、古典音樂到文化與普通話節目。介面配備射頻頻譜動畫、訊號量測、立體聲狀態與 RDS 廣播資訊，讓你以熟悉的方式尋找聲音。

主要功能
• 寬頻調頻刻度：拖動、點按或掃描，尋找最近的直播頻道
• 六條香港電台直播頻道，涵蓋第一台、第二台、第三台、第四台、第五台及普通話台
• RDS 廣播資訊、射頻頻譜、訊號強度與立體聲狀態
• 我的最愛、快速預設、最近收聽與收聽統計
• 睡眠計時器、背景播放、控制中心及鎖定畫面操作
• 自訂電台：加入支援 HTTPS 的 HLS、MP3 或 AAC 串流
• 四款主題色彩與深色接收機介面
• 繁體中文（香港）

重要說明
iPhone 及 iPad 並不具備可用的內置 FM 廣播天線。WFMAsia 透過互聯網接收香港電台提供的公開直播串流，並非透過大氣電波接收。介面上的訊號強度、射頻頻譜及 RDS 畫面，是為了呈現接收機體驗而設計的視覺資訊。

本應用程式並非香港電台官方應用程式，與香港電台並無隸屬或官方關係。所有節目內容、商標及版權均屬相關權利人所有。內建直播串流由香港電台提供。

私隱
WFMAsia 不需要帳戶，不收集個人資料，不設廣告、追蹤或第三方分析 SDK。你的收藏、預設、收聽紀錄與設定，全部儲存在裝置上的系統偏好儲存。收聽網絡直播時會使用互聯網數據，裝置會直接連接香港電台的串流伺服器。

name: Whetherly: Your Best Days
description:
Whetherly helps you choose your moment. It turns the exact sky of your birth and of every day into a clear, personal forecast for your decisions — and keeps your nights calm.

TODAY
• Energy score and four focus areas: heart, work, mind, vitality
• What to do and what to avoid, colour of the day, affirmation, lucky numbers and stones
• The week ahead

BEST DAYS TO DECIDE
• Planner for signing, launching, money, love, travel and meetings — six weeks ahead
• Retrograde periods with reminders before they begin

YOUR BIRTH CHART
• Calculated on your device from NASA JPL DE440 data, accurate to a fraction of an arc-minute
• Placidus or whole-sign houses, aspects, chart ruler
